anna.name: Anna
anna.title: Commander
anna.description: A veteran fighter who leads the Order of Heroes. Alfonse and Sharena's commander.

Castle Hall: Alfonse was once friends with a great Hero. But when Alfonse lost his friend in battle, he was never the same.

We can revive Heroes who fall during battle as long as you're with us, Summoner.
Still, though this reverses the ravages of the battlefield, they feel pain—just as we do.
Checking up on everyone? Thank you. That's helpful. Let me know if you spot anything unusual!
How about we get some practice in? That'd make you a stronger member of our group—summoning and all!
Good timing. I made some official merchandise for the Order of Heroes. Think they'll sell?
Visit: Looks like your group is strong. I'd better keep building mine. Oh, hello from [F]!
Level: I'm going to push myself even harder now!
Good! But as commander, I must keep striving for more.
I expect much more of myself than that!
Learn Skill: Thanks for helping me get stronger. I swear to make it worth your trouble.
Confession:
I have an assessment to make. You've become more dependable than I ever imagined.
Frankly, I wasn't certain about you from the start. You were new to us. We were new to you.
But look at you now—a great tactician, giving us directions that are often excellent!
Remember when you first showed up and I said you didn't look like the Great Hero from our legend?
I'm sorry about all of that. As the commander here, I should know to never judge a book by its cover.
The person who was once my superior drilled that into my head. So, I should have known better.
You are the Great Hero, and you have lived up to the legend!
Still, you're also part of my Order of Heroes, so don't expect any preferential treatment.
But until the day comes when we save this kingdom once and for all, you and I are in this...together.
Status: Rule number one! Treat Heroes with utmost respect!
Rule number two! Defend the gateways at any cost!
Think I have a familiar face? Hmm. How curious.
That divine weapon of yours was just lying around here... None of us could use it.
Some of us befriend Heroes. Others stay detached. What will you do, I wonder...
Know a quick way to make a profit? Then let's hear it!
I give you my vow as commander that I will keep you safe.

virion.name: Virion
virion.title: Elite Archer
virion.description: Rightful ruler of Rosanne in Valm who has a tendency for wit and puffery. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Ah, cruel boredom, why must you hound me so? Perhaps I shall go and admire a mirror for a while...
I am the rightful ruler of Rosanne, a duchy in faraway Valm. I was... forced from my homeland.
I have noted your good works in patrolling and leading us. You've done well to draw my eye!
Might I interest you in a game of chess? I promise to avoid dirty tricks till the latter half of the game.
I've brewed some tea using some of the fascinating herbs you grow in this land... Hmm? Weeds, you say?
Visit:
I come bearing gracious greetings for [S].
Ah, from whom? Well, none other than [F]!
Level: Please! Avert your envious gazes!
I could do no less—not with my reputation!
What? So little gain for my efforts?
Summon: I am Virion, the finest archer of the fairest of realms. Delighted to be of service.
Learn Skill: I see you have granted me power to match my splendor!
Confession:
Ah, may I steal a bit of your time, [S]?
I've grown fascinated with the board games of other cultures lately. Care to play one now?
Take a look—this board is the battlefield and this dazzling little gemstone is yours truly.
All of these pieces—you move them around the board as you would fighters in a battle.
Yes, yes... Of course... Very good. You grasp the game quickly, as I suspected you would.
But I see that you're not willing to sacrifice that dazzling little gemstone...
Who can blame you? It is more scintillating than all the rest! Still, I need to tell you...
You're playing that wrong. It's better strategy to sacrifice any piece for the greater good.
Much as you could choose to rid yourself of me from your team to serve your purposes.
There are other Heroes to bring into the fold. But do I sense...that you're repelled by the idea?
You don't want to sacrifice anyone, do you? Very well. Then as the first Hero you summoned...
I will make it my duty to keep polishing myself into the most dazzling stone in your possession!
Special: I have a gift for you.
Status: Greetings! You appear to be in high spirits today.
I fancy a cup of tea right now. Care to join me?
I see that, like so many, you have been spellbound by my elegance.
Isn't my ruff extraordinary? ...What?! You thought it was a bib?!
I know my radiance makes it difficult, but do try not to stare.
*sigh* I miss the noble pastimes of my homeland.
You may count on my help until the war is won.

matthew.name: Matthew
matthew.title: Faithful Spy
matthew.description: Happy-go-lucky spy who's actually quite sly. Serves Hector, brother of the Marquess of Ostia. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Working for the Order of Heroes members here isn't much different from what I was doing before.
Want to know the real Matthew? Ha! Let's take it slow. I'll give you half-truths instead of lies.
Hey there. Good work on the patrols. I'm keeping an eye out too to make sure no one suspicious sneaks in.
The way this strange world works... I wonder... Could I ever be reunited with my dear Leila again?
Spy training? Sure, that's a thing, but we never do it in public. That always leads to bad sorts finding you.
Visit:
My boss wanted me to come deliver a hello to you, [S].
You two must have a pretty strong friendship there.
Level: Ha! Isn't that rich! A spy like me—with this much power?
I'm good in combat, but now I'll be even better!
Hmm. Maybe I should stick to the shadows.
Summon: The name's Matthew. I'm in the service of the young master—I mean, milord—Hector. Good to meet you.
Learn Skill: I work behind the scenes, but I won't waste this—I promise.
Confession:
Whoa, never a dull moment with you around, is there? You really keep a spy on his toes!
Speaking of which, you know how we spies stick to the shadows? It's not smart to have close friends.
Makes sense, right? A spy needs the flexibility to do what he needs to, when he needs to.
Friends just muck things up.
The only problem with all this is you. You're the kind of person a spy can't evade forever.
Oh, I'll keep trying, friend, but for now, forget I said anything.
Status: Oh! Have a new mission for me? Let's hear it!
No need for a shakedown. I never hide my weapons.
I sense no enemies here, not even in the shadows.
Need me to pry into someone's secrets? I'm your man!
Glad to chat, but I'm really more of a behind-the-scenes kind of guy.
We all have a place in our hearts that we'd...prefer...that no one goes poking around in.
You...have caught my interest!
This outfit isn't exactly suited to working in the shadows. Wait, was that the point?
Hey, watch it! Your hands are ice cold!
I don't know if I'd mix well with Nifl's royalty. I'm not all that sophisticated.
Milord Hector was beside himself when he saw me wearing this. Is it really that funny?
What am I supposed to do with this gaudy outfit? I'm more of a behind-the-scenes kind of guy.
I know at least one person who'd look much better than me in fancy clothes.
I'm expecting great things for us ahead. We make a good pair.

raigh.name: Raigh
raigh.title: Dark Child
raigh.description: Wielder of dark magic. A scornful loner with a troubled past as an orphan. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I will master the dark arts, even if I must destroy a world or three to do it. What? I'm being serious!

You can't do anything without power, including...protect those whom you must protect.
So that's why I must master the dark arts at any cost.
I keep my distance because I need to. I've got a lot on my mind. And that means I need to be alone...a lot.

Not like I noticed...but you should rest sometimes. These patrols of yours are going to burn you out.
And then I'll have to do more work.

Well, don't you have a spring in your step? I have to admit, I find that pretty...well, irritating.
But that's just me. You go right on ahead. Maybe it'll rub off.
Visit: It was a pain getting here, but I was told to stop by to say hello, [S].
Level: With this kind of power, I can finally—! Hmm, never mind.
I must get stronger. I have to!
Blast! I need to do much better.
Summon: I am trying to learn the deepest secrets of the dark arts. But if you must know...the name's Raigh.
Learn Skill: What use are thanks? Instead, I'll show you what power can do.
Confession:
Sheesh. You just can't help poking your nose in my business, can you? Well, fine.
Thing is, maybe since you did keep prodding me, I might have gotten better than I would have otherwise.
Hey, I said maybe. That's all.
I know you only spent time with me because you feel sorry for... well, whatever has me twisted up.
Right? You don't need to admit it. Besides, I'm the one who got the short end of the stick here.
Now that I'm stuck with you, I have one more person I need to look out for! So, uh, thanks.
Status: What do you want?
Enough. You have my attention.
You push yourself way too hard. And for what? Other people?
I have to admit, I've never met someone...quite like you.
Don't tell anyone that I'm anything but...diabolical.
I must protect...what I must protect!
You think I'll help you? You are fooling yourself.

marth.name: Marth
marth.title: Altean Prince
marth.description: Prince of Altea who fights for his homeland and deeply values his friends. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: It's strange. I feel like you are a part of me—as if we have been together forever.
I am no Hero-King. I only stopped the war thanks to my many allies.
Thank you for everything you do for us. If ever you find yourself in need, I want you to rely on us.
This world is beautiful... It reminds me of my own homeland.
I cannot allow a single one of my friends to die. Together, you and I, with everyone else, will win this war.
Visit: Pardon the intrusion. I was asked to come say hello by [F].
Level: Let this be a ray of hope that lights the way for others!
I shall do my best to always improve.
My apologies. It seems I am not myself today.
Summon: I am Marth, Prince of Altea. It is good to make your acquaintance. Like you, I desire peace above all.
Learn Skill: May I help end the fighting with this ray of hope.
Confession:
Over all the battles we've fought together, I have come to see my own powerlessness.
As but one, I cannot accomplish anything. Together, we can face everything.
That is why having you at my side gives me courage beyond the telling of it.
I shall continue to fight at your side as long as you will allow me.
I am eternally grateful that we may count on one another.
Status: What's wrong? And how may I help?
I admire how you lead your troops in battle.
You, too, are blessed with wonderful allies.
The circlet I wear? A gift from...someone dear to me.
It seems every world is war torn...
I don't want anyone to die. Surely you feel the same way.
I enjoy this time with you. My troubles seem to melt away.
Does this Askran garb suit me?
Wah! You surprised me. Is something...askew? Thanks for fixing it!
There is much I must learn about Askr. Can you aid me?
I wonder what Caeda will think of these clothes...
I plan to venture out of the castle today. Would you join me in town? I want to find out more about Askr.
I may be in another world, but my duty to protect those who are powerless to protect themselves has followed me here.
You seem really pleased that I'm dressed like this. I had no idea you'd all enjoy seeing me in Askran garb!

ogma.name: Ogma
ogma.title: Loyal Blade
ogma.description: A mercenary who was once a slave gladiator. Serves Princess Caeda of Talys. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Days like this remind me of my time as a gladiator. And some things not worth remembering...
I have three men I trust completely: Bord, Cord, and Barst. All three are true warriors.
Rest when you can. You have to be ready to move whenever fighting breaks out.
Can you use a sword? I'm looking for a sparring partner. Not that I'm good at holding back...
I take care of my sword to make sure it doesn't rust. It's a habit that's served me for a long time.
Visit:
You're [S]?
My employer sent me to say hello. Oh, who sent me, you ask? It was [F].
Level: Hm. So I had more power hidden inside me.
Guess I've improved a bit.
I still have a ways to go.
Summon: I am Ogma, a mercenary from Talys. If you need strength put to a task...I'm your man.
Learn Skill: Thanks. I'll pay you back on the battlefield.
Confession:
Since meeting you all, I've learned that strength comes in many forms.
The strength to protect peace... is not the strength I learned as a gladiator, killing for sport.
I've learned much from you, [S]. And I will learn more yet.
I will become stronger. I will learn to swing my blade in service of a lasting peace.
Status: What do you need?
You're an odd one.
I'm not good at conversation.
If I start a job, I finish it.
I've only ever been good at one thing.
I need to get ready for the next battle.
I can't lose. For either of our sakes.

navarre.name: Navarre
navarre.title: Scarlet Sword
navarre.description: Skilled fighter known as the Scarlet Sword. Prefers his blade to do the talking. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: So this is where the greatest warriors of all the worlds gather?
...You're in my way.
Don't waste time talking to me. Focus on the next battle.
If you don't need anything, I'd like to be on my own.
This castle is filled with strange people...yourself included.
Visit: ...Greetings from [F].
Level: Not bad.
Well, that's that.
Summon: Call me Navarre. I'm a mercenary, but I don't come cheap.
Learn Skill: All I do is fight. I don't need recognition.
Confession:
I usually fight alone. However...
I can imagine a future fighting with all of you.
Never mind. Don't listen to anything I've said.
It's all nonsense, and I blame you for my sentimentality, [S].
Status: What?
I don't work cheap.
I'm busy right now.
I'll help, but I don't "chat."
I have vowed never to turn a blade on a woman.
I doubt there is anyone who can cross blades with me and live.
Don't die out there.

roy.name: Roy
roy.title: Young Lion
roy.description: The son of Eliwood, Marquess of Pherae. Talented leader of Pherae's army. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: There are so many amazing Heroes to be found here. I'll learn so much from all of them.
Lilina is a great friend of mine, from way back when we were children. We studied together in Ostia.
You have my gratitude—you know that, right? Thanks to you, we can all fight as one.
Cecilia taught me the art of battle. I wonder where you got your great skills, [S].
I've been reading a book about this world's history. Found it right here in the castle. Fascinating stuff.
Visit: Hello there. My name is Roy. I've come with greetings from [F].
Level: Now that's the spirit!
That's fine, but I'll need to push myself harder.
I must try to do much better than that!
Summon: My name is Roy. I've come on behalf of my father, Eliwood of Pherae. I may be young, but I'll do my best.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I'm inexperienced in many ways. This will help.
Confession:
I must become as strong as I can to ensure that I can keep this and all other good worlds safe.
I want everyone to find their happy endings in life. But to do that, there's still much I need to learn.
On the bright side, I feel that I have learned so much just by being near you, [S].
I don't mean only about battle tactics but also about you—where you're from and what inspires you.
I hope that you and I will forever be good friends. Know that you can always depend on me.
Status: Did you need me for something?
You know...if you ever want my attention, just call for me!
I think we can work very well together. Don't you?
I know I can rely on you completely.
For those I must protect...I cannot lose!
I have faith in the goodness of humankind. No matter what.
I'm with you—all the way!
This outfit is from Nifl. What do you think? Am I wearing it well?
Whoa! Your hands are cold as ice. Are you feeling OK?
Were I to visit Nifl, I suppose the first thing I would do is... Have a snowball fight with my friends!
My father would be pleased to see how close I've grown to so many different countries and cultures.
Prince Hríd's family is huge! I bet the fun times never end when they all get together.
*shiver* These clothes aren't as warm as they look...
With you by my side, I can bear any wind no matter how chilling.

fir.name: Fir
fir.title: Sword Student
fir.description: A woman who travels in search of the best swordplay opponents anywhere. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Everywhere I turn here... More Heroes... More legends... I want to spar with them all!
I really want to become a great sword master like my mother and uncle before me. And I will.
Good work on your patrols! I should learn from your example and go train extra hard with my sword.

Now, prepare yourself to—!
What? I was just getting ready to practice with my sword!

Hyaaaa! Hyaaaa! Hya—?!
Oh! You might want to stand back while I'm practicing, all right?
Visit: Now, prepare yourself to—! Oh! It's you! I've come bearing a hello from [F].
Level: One step closer to being a sword master!
I need to keep this up. It makes a difference!
I'll never surpass my mother or uncle at this rate.
Summon: I'm Fir! I aspire to master the sword and travel all over to find sparring partners. Please spar with me!
Learn Skill: I'll do my best to bloom using this power!
Confession:
I've fought and sparred, and sparred and fought, pretty much constantly since I got here.
I think I'm nearer to mastering the sword, but I have to say that you've taught me something new.
You've shown me that strength isn't just about blades and battles, [S].
It takes far greater strength to want to protect others and keep the peace—as you do.
I would like to stay by your side and continue learning what strength truly is.
You seem to be great at so many things—not just tactics. I look forward to learning from the master!
Status: My turn now?
You know, I'm not really the sort that's good with teasing.
Please spar with me.
I defend myself well with my sword. But you know? I never see a lie coming.
I will be a master of the sword. You can count on that.
I hope to be every bit as good as my mother someday.
I know I'll get plenty of training—long as I stick with you.
Oh! This Nifl garb is really pretty, isn't it?
Hey! Don't startle me. Do you want to be frozen solid?
Princess Fjorm is so strong...and refined. I really admire her.
No matter how I'm dressed, I'm always up for training!
Whenever my father showers me in praise, it's so embarrassing.
Wouldn't it be lovely to walk through the freshly falling snow with someone?
I feel stronger in these clothes because they remind me of the support you've given me!

lyn.name: Lyn
lyn.title: Lady of the Plains
lyn.description: A woman who grew up on the plains before learning she is nobility of Caelin. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I love the feel of the wind. It's always a balm for whatever's bothering me.

Wielding a sword is useful for more than battle. I find that it also gives me a peek into another person's thoughts.
So, I think I might know what's on your mind, friend!
Good job out there. You be sure to stay well rested. You carry the heaviest load of all of us.
We should find a hill and look out across the world. People really don't do that nearly enough.
I may look calm—maybe even still. But I'm really very focused. It's part of my daily training with my sword.
Visit:
I've been asked to come visit you here by your friend [F].
Now, may your friendship always remain strong!
Level: The winds of my homeland are blessing me today!
Oh, good! That seems pretty fair.
Not good at all. I'd better train more often.
Summon: I'm Lyndis of the House of Caelin. Yet I truly belong to the open plains. Just call me Lyn, all right?
Learn Skill: Thank you. Good to get stronger.
Confession:
I'd like to offer my thanks today. It's for all the times you've helped me. Nothing more, nothing less.
But while I'm at it, I should also thank you for giving me courage and never failing to be kind.
Those are rarer qualities than you'd think. In fact...
I think you're as precious to me as the breeze that blows across the open plains of Sacae.
Oh my! Pay me no mind. But, please, know that I'm always here for you, all right?
Status: Need me, friend?
Some people might need to be prodded into action. Not me.
Glad to talk. It's nice to get what's on our minds out there in the open.
I'm always up early, so don't be surprised if I barge in and ask, "Are you awake yet?"
I grew up on the plains, so I'm pretty direct. Still, I have manners. Just not...etiquette.
How I long to be on the open plains. The feeling of the wind...
I'll protect you no matter what. Just stick close to me.
These clothes are from Nifl. They're rather unusual, at least to me.
Ah! Your hand is so cold. Give it to me. I'll warm it up.
Snow and ice, as far as the eye can see... Nifl must be exceptionally beautiful.
I often went ice skating as a child. When the lake froze over.
Princess Fjorm and Princess Gunnthrá are both sweet, and so polite.
I wonder... If I had been born in such a cold country... would I be more...reserved?
I'm so fired up, I don't need these winter clothes!

chrom.name: Chrom
chrom.title: Exalted Prince
chrom.description: A prince of Ylisse and descendant of the Hero-King. Leads the Shepherds. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Seeing you and Alfonse together reminds me of the time I've spent with a friend of mine...
Back home, my Shepherds deal with outlaws and monsters. It's strange that here we battle against Heroes.
Keeping watch? Your dedication reminds me of a certain tactician. Don't push yourself too hard!
Care to spar? Or perhaps we could just work on self-defense drills so I don't break anything...
I was practicing my swing and wound up smashing a pot. Forgive me, [S].
Visit: Ah, are you the master of this castle? I bring warm regards from [F].
Level: No one can stop me now!
My strength comes from diligence.
Well, that was underwhelming.
Summon: I'm Chrom, leader of the Shepherds and Prince of the Halidom of Ylisse. For my friends...for peace...I'll fight.
Learn Skill: I vow to use the power you grant me wisely and well.
Confession:
It seems like a lot of time has passed since you and I first met. At first I was bewildered, but...
your guidance has made me stronger. May we ever remain side by side.
You know, when I first met you, you reminded me a lot of Robin.
Not just your manner, but the way you plan, help everyone, and work to keep all of your allies alive.
There is no one I'd rather have guiding my steps. This bond we've built will last forever.
Status: Our bonds are far stronger than destiny.
That's an unusual weapon you have.
Is your Order of Heroes something akin to my Shepherds?
I hope things are well in Ylisse...
I miss the advice of my tactician.
Damn it... Broke another training dummy...
The bonds we forge are forever. I will always come to your aid, friend.
I'm Chrom. This outfit seems to be from Múspell, the kingdom of flame.
What, can't I dress a little differently? Come on, take a look if you're curious.
My elder sister always said that understanding other cultures is a virtue.
I can't help but wonder what kind of place the kingdom of flame is, and how its people live. I'd like to visit one day.
Múspell's generals burn fiercely. I had better match their intensity.
No matter what I may be wearing, I'm still the prince of Ylisse.
The bond we share gives me the strength to fight. May we always stand together.

lucina.name: Lucina
lucina.title: Future Witness
lucina.description: A princess and daughter of Chrom who traveled to her past to prevent apocalypse. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.
lucina.artist: Maiponpon (まいぽんぽん) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: Father... Mother... When all the fighting has ended, I hope you'll rest easy wherever you are.
My world and everyone I knew were destroyed by the fell dragon, Grima. I can never allow that future to be.
Making the rounds with everyone? If you're tired, I don't mind going for you—don't push yourself.
Can I ask a favor? I'd love you to go shopping with me sometime—my fashion sense is a little...absent.
I-I must apologize. I was caught up in my training, and...I broke one of the training dummies.
Visit:
You're close friends with [F], right?
You must be close, or I wouldn't have been sent all this way to say hello.
Level: I will not watch another innocent life be taken!
This strength serves more than me alone.
I cannot settle for this!
Summon:
I am Lucina of Ylisse, daughter of Chrom. I believe that we can fight to change our fates.
I traveled back from my bleak future to make a difference in my father's past. Now...I am here.
Learn Skill: I will use the power you've granted me to forge a new fate.
Confession:
This world is a truly beautiful place. The white castle, clear blue skies... and all the flowers, of course.
They are, all of them, irreplaceable. We must protect this world at all costs, [S].
My homeland was destroyed by war. I can't bear to let anyone else experience that loss.
...Hm? Thank you for trying to lift my spirits...
I'm always touched by your kindness. I hope that, whatever may come, we'll remain side by side.
Status: Talking with you puts me at ease. Thank you for that.
You have wonderful friends. They remind me of my own.
I must say, I admire your outfit. Is it typical where you're from?
Every day, I must fight against the despair I was born into.
If I had to choose between peace and the lives of my friends...? Hmm.
I wonder if Father is here somewhere. Perhaps training?
I swear by this sacred blade, Falchion, I will do my utmost.

Special: You'll have to go through me!
Status: Be honest. Could I pass for a ljósálfr?
Really, now. What is it?
All these frills and colors... Ljósálfheimr fashion is delightful!
I wonder how my father would look in this style. Can you imagine it?
Yes, I can explore new trends in fashion and keep up with my training. Have no fear.
Peace is no mere fairy tale. I will make it happen.
Perhaps, with the aid of ljósálfar magic, I can remain at your side indefinitely.

lonqu.name: Lon'qu
lonqu.title: Solitary Blade
lonqu.description: A skilled swordsman of Regna Ferox who is oddly skittish around women. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
I hope to truly master the sword...but something might be throwing off my hand.
Maybe if I...steadied myself around women, that would do the trick.
Before becoming a Shepherd, I was right hand to Basilio, West-Khan of Regna Ferox.
If you are too busy, I can patrol in your stead.
Would you care to spar? If you have no combat training, you could always throw rocks at me.
I was just sharpening my sword. If it won't work when I need it, then that will be the end of me.
Visit:
I think you're the one I was sent here to find. You know [F], yes?
I'm here to deliver a hello. Now that I have, I will leave.
Level: This is only the start of what I can do.
...Good.
The path to mastering the sword is a lonely one.
Summon: I'm Lon'qu, a swordsman from Regna Ferox. And...that's all there is to know about me.
Learn Skill: Being granted power instead of slowly earning it...isn't so bad.
Confession:
You're here again. Why? What have I done to deserve this attention?
I have no wealth, no power. Nothing but my skills as a swordsman.
What? You value my presence? You find my help...reassuring?
No one has ever said that to me before, but I am glad my presence gives you strength.
Understood. I shall be your bodyguard, then.
I will stay by your side for as long as you want me.
Status: I, um, have trouble speaking to women.
Did you need something?
You're distracting me from my training.
Before coming here, I was the West-Khan's right-hand man...
Don't come to me for conversation.
The path to mastering the sword is a lonely one...
Why would you want to talk to me?

Special: And so I close this gate.
Status: I'm wearing this simply because I was instructed to wear something new.
Don't approach me so casually.
The princess of Embla is of few words. I can relate.
Regardless of my change in garb, I do not wish to be stared at. So back off.
There are many more swordsmen here than before. I'm glad for the opportunity to hone my craft.
I used to think the path to mastering the sword is a lonely one.
Is this your way of being thoughtful? I appreciate it.

olivia.name: Olivia
olivia.title: Blushing Beauty
olivia.description: A dancer who travels widely and is quite gifted, despite extreme shyness. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I want to practice my dancing, but... I can't concentrate where people can see me!
I traveled the world before joining Chrom's army—I learned tales and dances from all over!
You came from another world too, right? Take good care of yourself— the nights are awfully chilly here...
If you don't mind, I'd like to hear about your homeland sometime. It'd be like traveling there myself!
I'm looking at old souvenirs... Here's a shell from a tropical beach and a pressed leaf from a hot spring!
Visit:
Ah, excuse me? You must be [F]'s friend.
I was sent to say hello.
Level: Everyone's staring! How very embarrassing...
You know, I think I'm really helping!
S-sorry to disappoint you again.
Summon: I'm Olivia, a traveling dancer. And I'm pretty sure that, um, my skills might be useful. Maybe?
Learn Skill: Thank you! Wait, does this mean people will be looking at me?
Confession:
Umm... Thank you for always taking time out of your busy day to come and watch me dance!
I've traveled a lot, but I've never been somewhere like this before. I was pretty nervous at first...
But you always stayed near me and kept a friendly eye on me. I think that's why I've adjusted so well.
I...I hope this isn't too forward, but I'd like you to see my newest dance.
I chose the choreography in honor of our world...and the relationship you and I share.
Special: I didn't want to do this!
Status: I'll do what I can!
I hope my dance helps!
Um, did you need something?
I've traveled lots, but I've never been someplace like this before!
I hope my dancing brings a little more happiness into the world.
5, 6, 7, 8... What's my next step?
I'll be happy to dance anytime you want to see me perform.

mcorrin.name: Corrin
mcorrin.title: Fateful Prince
mcorrin.description: A Hoshidan prince raised in Nohr. Fights on his chosen path with the divine blade Yato. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.
mcorrin.artist: Maiponpon (まいぽんぽん) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: What path will this realm follow? It's not my place to make any pivotal decisions. You must help them.
I once had to make a hard decision: to side with the kingdom of my birth or with the one that raised me.
It reassures me to see you do patrols. I used to do the same at my castle. Brings back memories!
I wish I could show you my castle. There's so much to do there. It's even got a tree house—where I sleep!
I was just thinking about my siblings. I've got quite a few. Do you have any brothers or sisters?
Visit:
I've come with greetings from [F].
Very nice castle you have here!
Level: I've become so strong thanks to everyone's help.
Good. I'll be able to help more folks now.
It seems I didn't get much stronger...
Summon: I'm Corrin—raised in Nohr but born in Hoshido. I devote my Yato blade to your cause, and my dragon power!
Learn Skill: Let's see what I can do now!
Confession:
It's good to see you. We've spent so much time together, I'm uneasy when you're not around.
I'd like to just keep you where I can see you, but people would call me overprotective. Heh.
I've felt...overprotected my whole life, so it's a strange feeling to want to do it myself.
You are obviously essential to the realm's defense, so it's natural to protect you, I suppose.
I guess I'm saying we've got your back, so don't worry about what path to choose. Just keep going.
Status: Thank you very much for looking out for everyone.
Between friends, even the smallest gestures can mean so much.
I have so many siblings. I'm very fortunate.
Ever made a choice that, either way, meant losing something you loved?
I grew up in a fortress, where I was...never allowed outside.
I'm certain that you've chosen the path of peace.
You can lean on me if you're weary. My brothers may be bigger, but I can shoulder more than my share.
Now I look like a real Askran! I love it!
*sigh* Will you ever tire of teasing me?
My siblings were excited to see me in this outfit, but honestly...it was a little embarrassing for me.
I want to apply what I learn in Askr for the good of both Hoshido and Nohr.
I'd love to copy your look. Got any fashion tips?
I'll protect everyone's future. No matter what.
I'll follow you down whatever path you choose, now and forever.

ryoma.name: Ryoma
ryoma.title: Peerless Samurai
ryoma.description: The eldest prince of Hoshido, who wields the legendary blade Raijinto. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: This realm has a beauty so different from my own Hoshido. I would like to show it to all my siblings someday.
My retainers are Kagero and Saizo. I am fortunate to have such loyal and meticulous people in my service.
You're always so diligent. Remember to rely on your allies for strength. And I say, think of me as a brother.

I wish we could spar with our divine weapons. But I am aware that my Raijinto is not like yours at all.
I must admit, I find it a troubling concept that your weapon discharges...Heroes.

I advise you to meditate each day, [S].
It quells bad thoughts and promotes the best ones.
Visit:
Ah! You must be [S].
I bring greetings from a friend, [F].
Level: I take no pride from such gains. It is my duty.
Adequate, but I must strive for more.
I must redouble my efforts and do better.
Summon: I am Ryoma, High Prince of Hoshido, and he who inherited Raijinto. I will give my all, however dire the times.
Learn Skill: I will always give you my all, no matter what my power.
Confession:
Care to join me for some meditation? Then close your eyes. Empty your mind. Envision a relaxing place.
I am thinking of Hoshido—cherry- blossom trees in bloom...rain in the gardens...a moon on the wane.
I must admit that when I've been meditating of late, I have also envisioned something new.
Places from this realm...the faces of members in the Order of Heroes...and, most of all...
I see you, standing on the battlefield. That image lets me achieve inner balance like no other.
I hope that you would feel just the same from my presence here.
One more thing—in my own kingdom, I would never pledge my katana in service to another.
But here, it is my honor and my privilege to serve you to the end with my blade.
Special: May your blood crust my blade!
Status: Should you ever need to converse, remember, I am here for you.
I will follow your orders, for as long as I'm here.
I fight only to put an end to fighting. And war, to end all wars.
I feel as if I could learn much from the prince of this realm.
I see you're taking notice of my armor. Do you find it...unusual?
I never know when Saizo and Kagero are with me. Perhaps they're here now.
No matter which Heroes you take into battle, remember to be a commanding presence.

Special: Feel the wrath of my blade!
Status: A change of outfit can be quite refreshing. Perhaps I should do it more often.
Hm? If something is on your mind, I would be happy to listen.
I hate to impose on your generosity, but would you mind preparing something for my siblings and retainers as well?
I should have no trouble finding a worthy sparring partner here in Askr.
After spending so much time in Askr, I hold an affection for this world that will doubtless make returning home difficult.
No matter where I am, one thing is certain: I must always strive to master the way of the sword.
Our outfits may be similar, but know that I see you as incomparable in every other way.

hana.name: Hana
hana.title: Focused Samurai
hana.description: A noble who is skilled with the katana. One of Sakura's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Wish I could find accessories with a cherry-blossom pattern. But this place seems more Nohr than Hoshido.

I'm Lady Sakura's retainer. And I'm her best friend. No sky knight is going to outdo me. Who do I mean?
Oh...never mind.
Checking up on everyone, huh? Lady Sakura does that. You seem just as thoughtful.
I'll protect you on the battlefield since you don't have a weapon. It'd be nice to spar though!
Hya! And...hyaaa! All right, that's enough katana practice for now. I never miss a single day!
Visit:
Oh, I finally found you, [S]!
Maybe we can spar soon, but first I've got to say hello...on behalf of [F]!
Level: I'm so proud of myself!
Guess all that training paid off.
That hardly made a difference!
Summon:
Samurai Hana at your service! I'm from Hoshido. Want to spar for a while? Or maybe later?
I want to be as skilled with a sword as my father was. So, I'm always up for a challenge!
Learn Skill: Yay! What an improvement! I can't wait to test it out!
Confession:
Hya! And...hyaaa-hyaaa! Whew. That's enough training for now. I think I did pretty well!
What? My footwork was a little sloppy? And my follow-up was slow? And I wasn't flexible enough?
Yikes, Commander, you're so picky!
Huh? So what if I called you my commander? You're really the most important one around here.
Oh, come on! You know it! I know it! Everyone knows it! Don't be so modest.
I didn't mean to demote anyone else around here. I'll just let it be our little nickname...
OK, Commander?
Status: I try to slip in some katana practice whenever I can!
Don't you just want to explore this whole world?
I want to learn all about how the Order of Heroes trains!
Wish we could spar! But I know you're not equipped to fight.
My dream is to become a great samurai! Just like my father was.
Where is Lady Sakura? I'm supposed to always be with her!
Keep sending me at tough enemies. That's how I'll get stronger!
Wow...
Wow, these clothes are incredible! I feel like I can train even harder than usual!
*surprise* Hey, I'm practicing with my sword! Do you want to get hurt?!
Ever since I arrived here in Askr, my swordsmanship's improved by leaps and bounds.
I'll flatten anyone who bothers Lady Sakura!
I want to become a great samurai one day, so I can't afford to neglect my daily training.
The princesses of Jötunheimr are already big, but their muscles are something else! Maybe I could get some tips...
No matter what happens, I'll always be on your side!

hinata.name: Hinata
hinata.title: Wild Samurai
hinata.description: A coarse, yet caring, samurai of Hoshido. One of Takumi's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: As long as we're all here, we should have a big competition. We'll see how good you members of this order are!
I'm a retainer for Lord Takumi. I wouldn't hesitate to give up my life if it meant protecting him.
Hey! On patrol? Good work! If you ever need a hand, just holler, and then I'll come running!

Say, you free? Then why not train with me, [S]!
Need to keep my arm in swingin' shape!
Just bought veggies from a pretty lady. Nah, she didn't overcharge me. No way pretty ladies would do that!
Visit:
You're [S], right?
Your buddy sent me over to say hello. Which buddy? Ha! It was [F].
Level: I kinda want to brag to everyone now.
Oh wow, I'm getting stronger!
I wanted to become even stronger.
Summon: Name's Hinata! I'm a samurai from Hoshido. I'm always training with my katana—got the best slice around!
Learn Skill: This is gonna be an exciting change!
Confession:
Hey there! Just wanna throw a whole bucket of thanks on you for putting me in battle a lot.
You know I live for that, and that sorta thing helps me keep my skills sharp, [S]!
Have to admit that when I first landed here, I was all kinds of homesick.
I mean, seriously! This place doesn't have anything good from Hoshido! No dojos. No miso soup.
But you know what? I love this place now, even without the soup!
Good for a guy to open up to new things, right? Otherwise, life's just dull.
Besides, battling strong foes from so many worlds helps me get better at protecting Lord Takumi.
Ha! Don't think I forgot about you. Me and my katana? We are SO here to keep you safe!
Status: Ha! Might not look it, but I'm actually pretty good at stuff!
Aw, maybe I am a little scruffy. But I give the pits a splash every day!
This realm has such wide, open fields. Man, you gotta love that!
I train really hard—until I'm dead on the floor. Keeps a guy alive!
My blade is devoted to my liege. There's nothing I take more seriously.
Where's Lord Takumi? I gotta protect him no matter what!
I'll always have your back. You just leave it to me, buddy.

laslow.name: Laslow
laslow.title: Dancing Duelist
laslow.description: A mysterious man with a flair for dancing and flirting. One of Xander's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Think I'd be a hit with the ladies if I joined the Order of Heroes? White really isn't my color, though.
I serve Lord Xander and will protect him no matter what the cost. Even if he chides me constantly.
Checking in on us? Why, thank you! Let's you and I have a cup of tea when your duties are done.
You and I should run off on a little excursion at some point. I'd love to take in all the sights while I'm here.

Ah! You caught me dancing! I'm just practicing.
But you'll be the first to see my moves when I'm ready, [S].
Visit: Pardon me. Could I trouble you? I'm here to extend greetings from [F]!
Level: What a surge in power! Really, it's almost too much.
If I keep this up, the ladies will surely riot.
So little? How mortifying. I'll do better next time.
Summon: I'm Laslow, a mercenary from the Kingdom of Nohr. Shall we grab a cup of tea? It's the perfect icebreaker!
Learn Skill: Ah! You've made me stronger. For that, I thank you.
Confession:
Well, this must be fate! I was just thinking about you, and here you are, [S].
There's something I've been wanting to share with you. But, please, tell no one else.
This isn't the first time I've been summoned from one world to another. No, indeed.
You see, I came to this world from Nohr—but I am not really OF Nohr.
I was summoned there from yet a third world. I changed my look and my name for Nohr.
I needed to tell you because I don't want there to be any secrets between us, friend.
My real name is Inigo, and you have my promise to always fight for you—with a smile on my face!
Now, how about you and I go run off and grab a cup of tea?
Status: I'm rather skilled as a dancer, you know.
I have to admit, I shy from a steady gaze.
I find that a smile brightens the darkest of days. Don't you?
Join me in a laugh? It's the best medicine. Ha ha!
The Order of Heroes has a fair share of exquisite creatures!
Where is my Lord Xander? He gets so cross if he thinks I'm lazing about.
How I enjoy our little tête-à-têtes. I hope to never leave your side.

selena.name: Selena
selena.title: Cutting Wit
selena.description: A mysterious woman devoted to service. One of Camilla's retainers. Snarky. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I am so bored. Isn't there any good shopping around here?!
I'm Lady Camilla's retainer. She only dotes on me because I'm strong and cute. I gotta maintain!
Look at you, patrolling! I like it. You're taking a page right outta MY book!

You're bored too, huh? You should show me around this place. It's my third world I've ever—
Wait, no! Just kidding. Two! Just two. Heh.
I know I'm pretty fierce, but I've got to look great too. Hair that looks THIS good takes a lot of combing!
Visit:
I've come with a hello from [F].
So, there you go.
Level: I'm not average. I deserve better!
Bah. Not good enough for me.
This isn't like me!
Summon: I'm Selena, a mercenary who works for Nohr. Very talented. Ask anyone! They'll say I'm cute too. Bonus!
Learn Skill: Thanks for looking out for me.
Confession:
Ah, THERE you are! Hey, do you want to form a team with me? I mean, we already hang out...
Great! We are now the Selen[S] Alliance!
Why are you making that face?! It does NOT sound dumb!
I'll have you know I put A LOT of time and effort into that name so we could become closer friends!
Huh? Oh, well, that's better. I knew you'd come around. Now that we're a team, no secrets!
My name's not Selena, and I'm not from the world you found me in. You can call me Severa...privately.
Status: How's my hair looking today? Good enough? Hope so.
I'll be the best in your whole group. It's just a matter of time.
Nice to have a role model, right? I've got the best one ever.
The uniforms those Order of Heroes people wear... They're so cute!
You keep an eye out for any good clothing stores, OK?
I hate it whenever I'm separated from Lady Camilla.
Hey. If you need my help, ask. Not like I like you or anything.
Well? I'm wearing this because you told me to. Be grateful.
Hey, what's the big idea?! Do you WANT to lose an arm?
I said the Order of Heroes' livery was cute. But this is OK. I guess.
Oh, I look good in this? Well, duh! Is that really the best you can come up with?
Why is everyone in Embla so gloomy all the time?
Lady Camilla! Your adorable retainer Selena has an equally adorable new outfit!
You did go out of your way to give me these new clothes, so I guess I can work a little harder.

alfonse.name: Alfonse
alfonse.title: Prince of Askr
alfonse.description: A prince of Askr and member of the Order of Heroes. Kind and serious, and eager to maintain peace.

Castle Hall: I advise you not to get close to the Heroes. It will just make it harder... should you ever be parted.

Some of our kingdom's subjects objected when I joined this order. But I wanted to do my part.
Still, there are others who say that I don't behave quite like a prince ought to anyway.
I'll be glad to go on patrol with you. Some get lost around here. So, really, it's best I keep an eye on you.
Someday we should visit the library together. There's much information on the Heroes of other worlds.
I was just tending to my sword. Don't you find it a fine blade? The stones in the hilt—they burn like white flames.
Visit:
You must be a good friend of [F], yes?
Hmm. An alternate version of my Askran Kingdom. Is there another one of me here?
Level: All of this is thanks to you, [S].
I have gained the strength I require to battle on!
A humble gain. Perhaps I'll do better next time.
Learn Skill: I deeply appreciate your help, Summoner.
Confession:
I have to confess that I never intended to become friends with you, Summoner.
But you're always there when I need you, to the extent that when you're not near, I feel...not quite myself.
It's a delicate position to be in. The more you have to lose, the worse it hurts when you do.
Others may open themselves to such hurt, but as a prince, I must remain strong.
It seemed reasonable to keep everyone at a distance. But you've shown me the folly of that.
I would have never discovered our fine friendship, had I not welcomed you in.
And then what would I be? Less than I am. Now, I can only hope you feel the same.
In any case, I swear to keep you safe. You're my trusted partner, [S].
Status: How about you and I have a little chat?
We are fortunate to have you with us. I can't imagine a better summoner.
My greatest wish is to see our realm at peace. And our people, happy again.
I find it best not to get too attached these days...especially to Heroes.
Promise you'll never leave us...without warning me first.
I am striving to be an excellent prince—and to master the use of Heroes.
I'm glad to have you here. But someday, I'd like to open the way to your world. We could go there together.

draug.name: Draug
draug.title: Gentle Giant
draug.description: An armored knight of Altea who served as Marth's shield. Very sincere. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Why don't you wear armor? Seems dangerous. Those odd clothes you wear can't protect you, you know.
I'm an Altean knight. I wear this heavy armor of mine so I can protect Prince Marth.
You always seem so busy—are you taking time to relax? You shouldn't push yourself.
I'd feel a lot better if you wore heavy armor like me, but...you might not be able to move if you did!
Hmm... Lately I feel like my armor doesn't fit quite right...
Visit: Excuse me. Are you in charge? I've come to deliver a greeting from [F].
Level: Soon I'll be the ultimate protector!
Very nice. This will toughen up my defenses.
Got to train harder if I’m going to protect everyone!
Summon: I'm Draug, an Altean knight. My armor and I will stand between our enemies and our allies.
Learn Skill: Now I can protect even more of our allies.
Confession:
I've always concentrated more on protecting my allies than defeating our enemies.
That's why I appreciate what you do on the battlefield.
I see that you care about everyone and want to keep them safe.
I think together we can protect a lot of people. Count on me to help.
Status: Did you need me?
If you need me, just say so.
Do I have something on my face?
I'd like to stay by your side to the end.
This armor and I have been through a lot together.
There's someone I've sworn to protect above all others.
Let me be your shield. It’s what I do.

zephiel.name: Zephiel
zephiel.title: The Liberator
zephiel.description: King of Bern. Once a kindhearted boy who became disillusioned with humanity. Wants his world to be ruled by dragons. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: All civilization was sadness from the start. One man's climb based on another man's fall. It must end.
Equality and quietude! They're my two great wishes for my world. We need only surrender it to dragons.
Talk is pointless. But deeds make a difference. Difficult deeds most of all. Now, what have you and I in common?
Does your world still teem with humans? Then, no doubt, it knows nothing but the horror of war.
You may wonder what I am doing, standing here, right now. I am waiting for time to pass—peacefully.
Visit: You may bow. I have come to deliver greetings from [F].
Level: My dream further unfurls its great wings!
More power, yes. But that is my least concern.
I suppose I am...only human.
Summon: I am Zephiel, King of Bern. I hope you aren't one of those types who spouts nonsense about hope for humanity.
Learn Skill: My Eckesachs yearns for greater battles!
Confession:
I've long had the conviction that humanity had no more worth than the least of all fleas.
And then...you.
Your deeds here, and those of the others... Every good act has whittled at my certainty.
What I am saying is that you have earned my attention. Still, be careful.
The last person to toy with my respect was my father. Ultimately, I had to put an end to him.
Now, you have a throat. And I, a hand. Let us hope the two never have need to meet.
Special: You won't get in my way!
Status: What could you possibly want of me?
I have absolutely no tolerance for impertinence.
You...are like an infant. Take that any way that you will.
Humanity...is grotesque.
Pointless. All of it. Utterly pointless.
My world must be freed. Humanity, expunged.
Sometimes I see...myself in you. In days when I was...younger.

cain.name: Cain
cain.title: The Bull
cain.description: Altean cavalier known for recklessness. Rode with Abel in service of Marth. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I'll wager that my strength will bring no shame to the great knights of Altea!
I work with a knight called Abel. I tend to get carried away, but he balances me out with his calmness.
You walk around the whole castle checking in on everyone? Impressive!
Why not train with me sometime? Not everyone knows this, but I used to teach the younger knights.
HA! Sorry—HA! Training! HA! Talk later! HA!
Visit:
I have traveled far with a message for someone important—goes by [S]?
I have brought a hello from my liege!
Level: All right! Let's keep this up!
Not bad, I guess. But I can do better!
I can't face Prince Marth after this...
Summon: I'm Cain, a cavalier of Altea. Oh, yes—Cain! Known far and wide as the Bull!
Learn Skill: I'll show them all what the Bull can do!
Confession:
Sir Jagen used to always lecture me about my tendency to rush in without thinking.
But with you in charge, I don't lose track of myself in battle and I can do my job.
Thanks, [S].
With you, I can fight with the fire in my belly but not lose my cool. That's always been my goal.
Status: Something wrong?
Wha—?! Oh, it's you.
Hey! Want to train?
I must train harder. I WILL train harder!
They used to call me the Bull. Ha! Cain the Bull!
I give everything my all!
Stay behind me in battle—I'll cut a path for you!

eliwood.name: Eliwood
eliwood.title: Knight of Lycia
eliwood.description: A sincere noble of Pherae. His friends Lyn and Hector serve him loyally. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: This realm is embroiled in war. I fear that no matter where I travel, war is everywhere.
I'm told that I'm not the hardiest of Heroes, but I promise to always give any task my best.
Thank you for your guidance in all matters. It gives each and every one of us the confidence to fight.
If the weather is pleasant today, it might be nice if you and I head off on a stroll.

My son Roy is my pride and joy. I'm not afraid to admit that he surpasses me in all ways.
Roy's a stronger fighter, and if that wasn't enough, he's a much better student of life than I could ever be.
Visit:
Hello there. I was asked to come visit by your good friend [F].
May your friendship last forever.
Level: Great! Now I can contribute even better!
Good. I'll have to keep this up.
Sorry. I mustn't be feeling well.
Summon: My name is Eliwood. I'm a noble from a small realm known as Pherae. I hope I'll be of use to you.
Learn Skill: I won't let this go to my head. I'll work even harder now.
Confession:
Looking back on our first meeting, it now seems that we were destined to cross paths from the start.
You believe in every one of us, of course, and you give your all...to us all.
But I take special courage from knowing you. It's as if you're a beacon of hope.
I feel as if I could overcome any obstacle, and I have too rarely felt such strength.
This is why I hope to keep fighting alongside you, for as long as you'll have me.
Status: Hmm? Did you need me?
Ha! Want to bend my ear? You need only ask!
Both you and this place couldn't be more welcoming. Thank you.
I'm not the hardiest fighter you'll ever meet, but I'll prove my use.
I can tell you're the type to push yourself too hard. So please, take care.
You seem to gather very good friends around you. Admirable!
May we all return from battle alive and unscathed.

Special: I will carry out my duty!
Status: So, this is the garb of the Order of Heroes. Fits me well enough. What say you?
Fear not. Despite the new look, I am still the same Eliwood you've come to know.
The Kingdom of Askr has a rich culture. There is much to learn here.
Prince Alfonse and I have a good deal in common. He cares for his people as much as I do mine.
It feels a little frivolous to fuss over appearances, but...I do look good, don't I?
You…you haven't heard Hector say anything about this outfit yet, have you? *pause* So there's still hope he hasn't noticed…
I appreciate all the time we've had to bond. I hope we can continue to fight together, side by side.

stahl.name: Stahl
stahl.title: Viridian Knight
stahl.description: A kind but slightly scatterbrained knight who serves with the Shepherds. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I'm so glad everyone here seems nice. It's always uncertain when you come to a new place.
In the Shepherds, I spent my time taking care of horses and fighting ruffians. I miss the routine of it...
You seem well right now, but if you start to get sick, let me know—I know all kinds of recipes for tonics.
Say, do you want to get something to eat sometime? I want to try the best foods this kingdom can offer!
I tried to fix my hair—does it look OK? Once a Risen attacked me, thinking I looked like a vegetable...
Visit: Ah, I finally found you. A friend sends sincere regards. Who, you say? It was [F]!
Level: Amazing! I can hardly believe I'm still me!
Yes! Progress!
Sorry. I'll try to do better...
Summon: H-hi, I'm Stahl, of the Shepherds. Sorry—can't tell if my stomachache is nerves or my three lunches!
Learn Skill: Thanks for the edge—I'd better get in some practice!
Confession:
Whew, good training session! Must be time to find a sna— Oh, hey, [S]!
Awww! You brought me a sandwich! I was just about to grab something to eat! Thanks!
You're always looking out for me. I can't even count how many times you've saved me on the battlefield!
But I've noticed that people who take care of others sometimes forget to take care of themselves.
That's why I'm keeping my eye on you! Don't push yourself too hard, and I'll do my best to support you.
Special: Got a good feeling about this!
Status: Hey, thanks for coming by to chat!
I'm a proud member of the Shepherds. We help people.
Why are you star— Is my hair sticking up again?
If I train hard enough, maybe someday I can match the legendary Panther.
My father was an apothecary—I learned a thing or two about medicine from him.
M-my stomach hurts—I think I ate too much again...
I can be a bit of a fool for food, but I'll work hard for you.

xander.name: Xander
xander.title: Paragon Knight
xander.description: Nohrian prince respected for his military prowess. Wields the divine blade Siegfried. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I feel as if I could learn much from Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena—the royalty of this kingdom.

My retainers are Laslow and Peri. You may find their behavior questionable.
But their skill in battle is certain. Besides, I've lost retainers before. I don't wish to repeat the experience.

You always look very busy. That reminds me of a time when...
Well, when one of my siblings began leading an army. So, mind your limits. Stay safe and healthy.

I'd like it if you would train with me from time to time. We don't need to spar—just do practice swings.
You'd be surprised how simply that communicates as well as words could ever manage.

I often think of my many siblings, off fighting—and who knows where?
I ask that you treat them well, should you see them.
Visit:
Ah, greetings. Are you not [S]?
I bring you best regards from your friend [F].
Level: I wish to test my new limits. To battle!
Fair result for fine efforts. Yet there's more to do.
This is not sufficient for a future king.
Summon: I am Xander, Crown Prince of Nohr, and wielder of the divine Siegfried. I hope to see you mete out justice.
Learn Skill: My gratitude. Still, as a future king, I must strive higher.
Confession:
Here, take this practice sword, [S]. I borrowed it from Commander Anna.
You're going to join me for training. What, don't you want to? I'm not trying to forge you into a fighter.
I believe that meeting a friend blade to blade is the truest way to give voice to our inner qualities.
In swordplay, you can share your hopes and fears as our leader and I can parry with things unsaid.
I wouldn't spar like this with just anyone. You've proven yourself worthy on the battlefield!
Now, what say you? Would you still rather not...?
Oh, you'll join me! Well then, know that it is my honor completely, [S].
Status: I take it that you want to chat?
If you want victory, seize it. With both hands!
No matter what, I always make time to practice with my sword. Always.
I know I can be stern, but...in time, I'm sure you'll think of me as a brother.
We must put an end to the fighting here, if only for the sake of my kingdom.
Where are Peri and Laslow? Surely lazing around somewhere!
You are...well liked. Which makes you the second person I've known with such...qualities.

caeda.name: Caeda
caeda.title: Talys's Heart
caeda.description: Princess of Talys who's as talented as she is charming. Marth's betrothed. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Ah, good day to you! Perchance, have you seen Prince Marth anywhere?
Though I am a princess, my home, Talys, is but an island kingdom. So my standing isn't all that grand.
You always seem so busy—please let me know if there's any way I can be of assistance.
We may have so many enemies today, but I'm sure that given half a chance? They'll become allies.
I've just finished making a stew. Would you like to try some while it's hot?
Visit: Do you know who speaks very well of you—and bid me to greet you? It was [F]!
Level: I can feel myself growing stronger!
Ah! I can now be of greater assistance.
I'm sorry. It seems I'm not performing well today...
Summon: I am Princess Caeda of Talys. I'm also a pegasus knight, though perhaps an unconventional one.
Learn Skill: I will use this new power to help everyone.
Confession:
Your strength has always impressed me. I've always felt weak, needing protection from others.
I was envious of your strength, but I think I've got it figured out now...
Your strength comes from your belief in your allies. My "weakness" could be your strength.
I would like to stay with you longer and learn more from you and your strength, if that's OK.
Heehee! I appreciate it. I look forward to observing you right up close...
Special: I don't want to hurt you!
Status: What's the matter? Can I help?
Ahh! Don't startle me like that!
You seem to be a very kindhearted person.
Tell me—do you believe in love?
I'm so glad we have a chance to talk! It's always a pleasure.
Would you consider me a "tomboy"?
Let us fight side by side forever.
This outfit is from Nifl. Isn't it just lovely?
Eek! *sigh* You never change, do you?
The detailing on this is so delicate... Nifl must be quite a place, don't you think?
Does cold weather trouble you? I have to admit...it's not my favorite either.
This outfit is certainly a change of pace for me. I feel refreshed and ready to go! Is there anything I can do to help out?
I wonder what Marth will think of these clothes. There's only one way to find out!
Let's go seek out a picture-perfect winter landscape together, a vista peaceful and still.

palla.name: Palla
palla.title: Eldest Whitewing
palla.description: Eldest of three sisters who are pegasus knights for Macedon. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I wonder how Catria and Est are doing... It's natural to worry about my younger sisters, of course.
I'm told that I'm good at looking out for others. Perhaps because of my younger sisters?
Thank you for all you do. When you've finished checking on everyone, please do get some rest.
How are you today? If you're sore from battle, I actually know how to massage hurting muscles.
Ah! I just remembered I should go look after the pegasi...
Visit: Honored to meet you. Someone sent me to say hello—your friend [F].
Level: How wonderful! I can't help but smile.
Oh, I know I can grow stronger than this!
How disheartening...
Summon: I am Palla, a pegasus knight of the Whitewings of Macedon. Pleased to be of service.
Learn Skill: Thank you so much. I will continue to do my best.
Confession:
Of course, Princess Minerva will always be my liege and foremost in my thoughts.
And obviously my two sisters are very dear to me. However...
I must confess that someone else is now occupying many of my thoughts. Someone I met here...
Ahem. I hope I can continue to stay by your side and make you proud.
Oh, thank you so much! You've made me so happy!
Status: Is something the matter?
AH! Oh, you startled me, you trickster you.
We must all strive to do our best out there.
You aren't hurt, are you?
I can't help but take care of you and the others.
Please, make sure you take time to rest. We need you!
If you need my help with anything, please let me know.
What a wonderfully cute outfit! Is this really for me? Thank you!
*gasp* Oh, it's you again? You'll never learn!
This brings me right back to when I used to read my little sisters bedtime stories with fairies in them.
If Est and Catria catch sight of me dressed like this, they might tease me.
Time for a nap? *yawns* Maybe it is...
The dream I'd most like to have? Now that you ask... I hadn't thought about it.
I hope that your nights will always be filled with good dreams!

donnel.name: Donnel
donnel.title: Village Hero
donnel.description: A farm boy from a country village in the Halidom of Ylisse. Handy and hardy. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Wow... This sure is a nice place you got here. What kind o' vegetables grow in these parts?
I was a farmer before I joined His Majesticality Chrom's army, so if you got crops, I'll take care of 'em.
I can do patrols for ya if ya like. You got other jobs and...I'd like you to rely on me more.
Wanna go work the fields together? I kinda planted some crops in the courtyard. Don't tell, though!
My pa gave me this stone. He said it had a kinda power hidden away in it. Been my dream to figure it out.
Visit: Hey there! I came over here to say howdy from [F]!
Level: I'm too big for my britches.
I still got a long ways left to go.
Well, shucks! I'll have to try harder!
Summon: My name's Donnel. Just a farmer from a little bitty village, but I can fight—this pot's not just for show!
Learn Skill: Feels funny... Like I'm a whole different fella!
Confession:
Well, well! There you are, [S]!
I wanted ta give you these fresh veggies from my garden!
Dunno if you've seen the garden— I planted it in the courtyard... Sorry if that was wrong o' me...
Aw, shucks! Thanks for not bein' mad. I'll keep on helping the Order any way I can.
You're always so nice about stuff— that's why I like you so much. Just feels natural, you know?
I'll keep raisin' great vegetables and getting stronger and stronger... Just see the fighter I'll be for you!
Status: This pot's kept my noggin safe for a good while now. Reckon I'll keep it.
You all eat, right? So where do you grow the crops in this world?
Lot of folks don't think much of villagers, but we put up a fight if we need to.
Shucks... Hair's out of control again.
I ain't so good at studying, but I like learning new things.
Someday, after I've made a man of myself, I'll go back to Ma and the farm...
Try some of my veggies! Ma always said there's no taste like honest work.
This outfit is fer me?! You sure it ain't fer someone else?
*startled sound* Hey now, it ain't nice to scare people like that!
Somehow feels wrong fer a farm boy like me to be wearin' this... Ya think it suits me?
Ain't them jötnar folks strong?! It'd be handy to have that kinda oomph on the farm.
Do ya reckon the jötnar would squish me like a bug? Because I'd like to visit 'em.
It'd sure be neat if I could get as big as one o' them Jötnar...
I promise I'll go on doin' my darnedest to keep up with ya!

oboro.name: Oboro
oboro.title: Fierce Fighter
oboro.description: Lance wielder who loves fashion and hates Nohr. One of Takumi's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
Good thing you wear white. I grew up hating dark clothing. Like, really, really hating!
So if you ever catch me making a scary face, that's probably what's on my mind.
I'm Lord Takumi's retainer. He's so strong, beautiful, noble... *sigh* Couldn't be happier to serve him.
I heard you're not equipped to enter battle. No problem. I'll use my lance to protect you. Need to keep you safe!
I'm curious what the fashions are like in this realm. Let's go find a tailor shop or clothing store sometime!

So, you were summoned here suddenly too? I bet you don't have a change of clothes.
I'll make you something!
Visit:
Oh, I really like your style! By any chance, are you [S]?
I'm here to say hello from [F]!
Level: Now that makes a statement!
One step at a time!
Sorry. That didn't make me look very good.
Summon: My name is Oboro. I'm a spear fighter from Hoshido—and a pretty great tailor, if I say so myself!
Learn Skill: For all my talk of fashion, it's what's inside that counts.
Confession:
Oh, is something wrong, [S]?
You haven't ruined your nice clothes, have you? Or ripped a stitch? Or spilled soup on yourself?
Oh, I'm only kidding. I know you come around for more than my needle and thread.
You know, I do like it when I see you in your nice, clean uniform. It's so dapper!
I like it even more when you don't get blood all over it—means you've come back safe from battle!
Clothes can always be replaced, but you're one of a kind. I just couldn't do without you.
So I promise to always protect you...and to help you keep your uniform in top shape!
Special: I'll tear a hole in you!
Status: Oh, did you need something?
The clothing you and your friends wear here is very stylish. Impressed!
I love to make clothing when I'm off duty. So, I'd kill for some good fabric. Have any?
You would not believe the scary face I make when I get really, really angry!
I'm particular about my clothes. But when it's time to fight...? I get dressed in a flash!
Oh, Lord Takumi... Where are you? I should be with you!
I like to keep my stitching abilities in top shape. So I'll mend everyone's clothing after battle!

azura.name: Azura
azura.title: Lady of the Lake
azura.description: An enchanting princess raised in Hoshido who sings in battle to help her allies. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Your uniform for this order is so attractive. And it's a lovely match for what I like to wear too!
I'm sorry to say that I mustn't ever tell you of my homeland. Still, I will be absolutely true to you in battle.
There's no knowing for how long you and I will be here. So, friend, let's be sure to take care of each other.
I'm fond of singing, especially while standing in lakes. Believe me, it's far different from singing on battlefields.
You'll often find me singing. I hope you like songs. They convey truth in ways that the written word cannot.
Visit:
By any chance, are you perhaps [S]?
I bring best wishes from our group to yours in the name of [F].
Level: I must sing in celebration of such wonderful success!
Even my voice feels a little stronger!
Well, every difference makes a ripple.
Summon: My name is Azura. I offer you my song. As for where I'm from? Two kingdoms, in a way... Both Nohr and Hoshido.
Learn Skill: My heart swells in thanks. I will give you my all!
Confession:
You are the ocean's gray waves—♪ So you've come to see me again, [S]...
You visit so often, I find myself looking for you whenever I am singing. You are a lovely audience.
My song is powerful, but that power is both great and terrible.
It can be used to rally and refresh the spirit...or enslave it.
But it seems the song's power is much less in this world, as is the danger to the singer.
So I can stay by your side to the end. And one day I will tell you of the kingdom of silence I was born in.
Status: We can do this!
I have faith in you.
Hummed melody for this lyric: "You are the ocean's gray waves."
Daybreak always brings new hope. And, if you have long hair, more tangles!
There's power fathomless within my pendant.
I wonder where this realm is in relation to Nohr and Hoshido, or even... Ah, never mind.
I vow to bear you up, like a ship upon the waves, no matter what may come.
My name is Azura. These clothes are from Nifl—if you were curious.
Yes? Oh, was I supposed to act surprised? Sorry I ruined it.
What sorts of songs do they sing in Nifl, I wonder? I'd love to try one out, and see how it feels.
The snowscapes of Nifl sound breathtaking. The Kingdom of Ice has a reputation for stark grandeur.
Princess Fjorm has quite a few siblings... Almost as many as Corrin and I.
Even if they mean little to me, these clothes are lovely to look at. If you suggest I wear them, I have no reason to decline.
Being at your side, feeling renewed...I can recall no happier time.

sharena.name: Sharena
sharena.title: Princess of Askr
sharena.description: A princess of Askr and Alfonse's sister. Cheerful and loves making friends—especially with Heroes.

Castle Hall: My brother prefers not to burden me. I suppose that could mean that he thinks I'm not up to the task.
I'm going to become friends with every Hero—ever! Oh, what a grand party it will be!

Oh, are you possibly on patrol, [S]?
Well, of course you are. You're the best. Really, the BEST.

Oh, do you have time to chat, [S]?
I'm a great listener. Bet you didn't know that!
I often write letters to my mother. We live in the same castle, but we rarely have a chance to speak!
Visit: How do you do? Huh? So this is another Askran Kingdom... Hey, tell me! How's the ME here? Nice, right?
Level: How wonderful. It's my time to shine!
I'm delighted to rise to the occasion!
Eeep! Sorry. I know that I can do much better.
Learn Skill: More power? For me? I may well faint away!
Confession:
You know, I consider it a high honor and an exceptional privilege to spend these moments with you.
Aw, who am I kidding, [S]?
Ha! Let's drop all that royal jibber-jabber. It's just us, right? Right!
The thing is, I love being around you. I've never been happier!
Sure, you're a valuable addition to the Order of Heroes—blah, blah, blabbity, blah.
But after spending so much time with you, I just think of you more like...a close friend.
Do you feel the same? Are we friends? Best friends? On our way to being best friends?
We are? Er, which one? Never mind. I'm just delighted... so delighted...so very...
Waah! You've made me cry, you silly goose.
I won't forget this day. Why, I'll save all my tears of happiness in a vial to remind me—forever!
Status: How do you do?
Ha! What was that? A sneak attack?
If there's one thing I'm really good at, it's lighting up the room!
I know my brother can be a bit serious. But I think he's quite fond of you.
The Order of Heroes is simply spectacular since you showed up!
I wish I could summon Heroes like you. Then we'd really have a party!
You know, I pledge forever and ever to be your number-one fan!

gwendolyn.name: Gwendolyn
gwendolyn.title: Adorable Knight
gwendolyn.description: Armored knight of Ostia. Intent on mastering defense, despite feeling awkward in armor. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: This castle has been built with excellent defense in mind. It will rebuff foes more easily. Admirable.
Where I'm from, women are rarely the kind of knights who wear heavy armor. But I want to be like my dear brother.
I admire how seriously you take these patrols of yours. I'd accompany you, but I fear that I'd slow you down.
Between you and me, this armor is simply murder on my back!
Wearing heavy armor like this takes daily practice. It's harder than you think, just walking around.
Visit:
I've come a long way to bid you hello, [S].
Oh, not from me personally. I bring greetings from your good friend [F].
Level: Such power! Now you can really rely on me!
As expected for a knight of Ostia.
I mustn't be a burden on others...
Summon: I'm Gwendolyn, one of the knights of Ostia. Some say I wear this armor as a sort of spectacle. They're quite wrong.
Learn Skill: I never imagined I could get this strong!
Confession:
I've got to say that I appreciate all of your guidance in battle.
But sometimes I worry that you try to protect me too much out there.
Am I failing to do my part as a knight, protecting others, if you're always worried about my safety?
Maybe you think that I draw too much attention to myself by wearing such colorful armor.
But that's exactly why I do wear this—to draw foes to me and away from others!
I know that we need to act as a team out there, but my role really is to put myself in harm's way!
Still, thank you. I'll always have the courage to protect everyone, knowing that you're looking out for me.
Status: Oh MY! Whew...what a surprise. Next time, maybe just say hi.
Please don't let me fall over in this armor. It'd be impossible to get up again.
A truly loyal knight is ever glad to bear the heaviest of armor.
This armor adds a tremendous amount of bulk! Really, you wouldn't believe it.
I offer my gratitude for your kindness and your consideration.
One, TWO! And one, TWO! Whew!
I give you my solemn vow—to defend you, even at the cost of my life.

effie.name: Effie
effie.title: Army of One
effie.description: A gentle knight with great strength and devotion. One of Elise's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: We've got to defeat all of the Heroes that we can if it frees them from being forced to serve.
I work for Lady Elise. My job is to be a wall between her and enemies. So I bulk up—as much as I can.
You're always working. If you need my strength, know that I can crush rocks to dust with my bare hands!
Takes a lot of food to keep me bulky enough to be a good wall. So we should hit all the feasts we can.
I keep stones in my armor to weigh me down. That way, I can train even when I'm just standing around.
Visit: Going around in armor makes a girl hungry. Worth it to deliver a hello from [F].
Level: I feel like I could take on anyone!
Strict training is the trick!
I'll have to work even harder tomorrow.
Summon: The name's Effie. I'm a knight from Nohr. Need protection? I'll crush anyone that gets in your way.
Learn Skill: Thanks. Every brick makes me a better wall.
Confession:
*munch munch* Tasty... Oh, hey, [S]! Is it snack time for you, too?
You brought me a sandwich? Thanks! Nice of you to hand- deliver it and everything!
I've been eating even more since I got here. Got to be ready to protect Lady Elise and...
you know...protect you as well.
I need to eat a lot and train even more so I can be the shield that keeps you safe.
Thanks again for the sandwich. *munch munch* That was great— packed with kindness.
Status: Takes a lot of bricks to make this wall. That means training, food, and lots of both.
One, two, three—! Heh. Always training. Always counting.
Fish or fowl? Either one's just fine. Long as I get a pile on my plate.
Need any boulders moved? No problem for me.
Quite a weapon you've got there. Afraid I'd break it if I touched it.
Where's Lady Elise? She and I like to grab snacks when we can.
You leave the heavy stuff to me. I'd lift a cow for you, friend.
Gotta say, these new clothes are pretty great.
Did you need something? ...Can it wait until after I'm done training?
Those bigger bodies mean even more room to build muscle. Must be nice to be a jötun...
Just what are the jötnar eating to get muscles like that? More importantly, do you think I could get them to share?
Getting up close and personal means I gotta make sure to protect myself AND this outfit.
Have you seen Lady Elise? I bet she'll think this outfit is a delight!
You've always been so nice to me, and I want you to know that it really means a lot. So thanks.

jagen.name: Jagen
jagen.title: Veteran Knight
jagen.description: Veteran knight of Altea who protected Marth since he was young. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: This is a fine castle, full of history and style. Perhaps not as grand as Altea Castle, but that's a high bar...
King Cornelius, you should know that Prince Marth has matured into a fine man...
Exemplary patrolling! Next time, I shall accompany you—don't think I can't keep up!
I could regale you with the history of Altea and Prince Marth's deeds... but we would be here for days.
It seems I've injured my back. Would you be so kind as to press hard just there?
Visit:
You are [S]?
I bring kindest greetings from [F].
Level: Hmph. It would appear I'm still good for something.
Only natural for a paladin of Altea.
I have dishonored my rank and my country.
Summon: I am Jagen of the knights of Altea, Prince Marth's guardian. I will thank you not to treat me like an old man.
Learn Skill: To think I still had new tricks to learn...
Confession:
