I have served many years as a knight, but never have I met someone quite like you.
Do we all follow you because you summoned us? I think not. At least not solely.
There is something about you that inspires others to fight for you. I can't put it into words...
It reminds me a bit of Prince Marth, who also naturally draws heroes to his cause.
In any case, I sincerely wish to spend what days I have left fighting at your side.
Special: Do not turn your back on me!
Status: Did you need something of me?
I will never understand the young...
You are young, but I see wisdom in your eyes.
These old bones can be of service to you yet.
I won't be outdone by any of those young striplings!
I wonder how many more battles I have in me...
Take care not to worry your elders. We know best.

abel.name: Abel
abel.title: The Panther
abel.description: Altean cavalier known for his sensibility. Rode with Cain in service of Marth. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I once betrayed Prince Marth, if only because Est was a hostage. I will never atone for that crime.
I own a small shop in Altea. If you ever have need of goods, you have but to ask.
Here, take this torch with you for patrols. It should make it a little easier to find your way in the dark.
I'm curious about the shops in town. Would you join me to visit them sometime?
My Est prepares the most wonderful dishes. If only you could try them!
Visit:
You're [S], yes?
I've been sent to deliver greetings from [F]!
Level: For my homeland and for my beloved.
I'm pleased that I haven't gotten too rusty.
Drat. I've neglected my training...
Summon: I am Abel, a knight of Altea—or former knight, anyway. These days, I am but a shopkeeper.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will always be a proud knight of Altea.
Confession:
Prince Marth and my beloved Est are both so important to me.
My loyalty toward my liege, my affection toward my beloved... Both feelings are clear and strong.
But are my feelings toward you loyalty because you summoned me? Or genuine, growing friendship?
I cannot say. The only thing that is clear...is that now I have someone else who is important to me.
I hope you will continue to count on me as you always have.
Status: What's wrong?
I fear that I've grown soft since leaving the knights.
I run a small shop. Perhaps you can visit someday.
Let me know if you need anything—anything at all.
I was once known as...Abel the Panther.
When there are two precious things in your life, you must choose between them.
I swear on my life never to betray you.

camus.name: Camus
camus.title: Sable Knight
camus.description: A knight who's devoted to his motherland, Grust. Wields the lance Gradivus. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: An Order of Heroes, hm? I can respect those who fight loyally for their motherland.
I am certain everyone has someone in their past that they will never forget...
What is it? Is there something on my face?
I live and breathe for my motherland. Will I bleed for her? Every last drop.
My early career as a knight was at a remote post. Training was the only way to pass the time.
Visit:
I have come with greetings from afar. I take it that you are [S].
Who sent me? A fair question. It was [F].
Level: Let this power be ever in service to the motherland!
As ever, I must prepare for the next battle.
A bitter moment.
Summon: My name is Camus of Grust. I am captain of the Sable Order of knights.
Learn Skill: Allow me to demonstrate the might of Grust!
Confession:
I wonder when it was that I first began actively shutting others out.
Obviously my experiences played a part, but since fighting at your side, I feel my thinking has changed.
At first my isolation protected me from the pain of losing someone I cared about...or so I thought.
But to allow that fear to prevent genuine connection with others is to rob yourself of their strength.
You taught me that, and you will always have my gratitude.
Status: Do you have need of my service?
I am but a man of war... Forgive me my impertinence.
The one thing I cannot do is betray my motherland.
I will stand as your shield.
Devotion to one’s motherland is the highest calling. And the loneliest one.
I have lived as a knight, and I intend to die as one.
I pray you meet someone who will bring joy into your life.

sully.name: Sully
sully.title: Crimson Knight
sully.description: A member of the Shepherds who is serious about becoming a great knight. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Your commander seems strict—bet I could learn a lot from her. Maybe I'll join the Order of Heroes...
Different world, same deal: fight to keep the peace and make the world a little better.
I know you don't fight, but I'll teach you to defend yourself. Don't worry. I won't hurt ya too bad!
Sometime let's you and me ride my horse out to the forest and get some quiet.
Whew—just got done training! I'm from a long line of knights, but I still gotta earn the title myself.
Visit: Hey, nice to meet ya. I'm actually just here to say hi to you from [F].
Level: Good. Training's paying off.
I can do better than THIS.
Dammit!
Summon: Hey. I'm Sully. Count on me to do my best. And between you and me? My best is pretty damn good.
Learn Skill: Ready to smash heads! ...Is that still my job?
Confession:
Hey, you gonna be fighting by our side again today? Good to hear, [S].
Fighting here has been a great experience for me. And you're pretty damn inspiring, you know?
I know you can't fight directly, but you still always seem like the biggest deal on the field.
Someday maybe I'll inspire courage in my allies like you do. That's my dream since I came here.
Until that dream comes true, I guess I'll just have to stay near you! Thanks, partner.
Status: You ready to be my sparring partner?
A lot of guys have underestimated me. They're dead now.
Hey, come train with me! I'll go easy on ya.
Just so we're clear... I am not cut out for kitchen duty.
My horse is a beaut, right? Best partner I could ask for.
Gotta train hard if I'm gonna match the Bull. That guy was a legend.
I'll protect you on the field—you just focus on giving orders.

peri.name: Peri
peri.title: Playful Slayer
peri.description: A cavalier of Nohr who massacres foes with childlike glee. One of Xander's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The commander is pretty. How does she get her hair so red? Maybe with the blood of her enemies!
Lord Xander is my liege. He can be a little scary, but I like him anyway. He lets me fight lots and lots!
Good work patrolling. Hey, if you get tired, come to me for some huggy, squeezy, head-patty friend time!
I make a great stew. First, I go to a good butcher. Then I look for fresh, red meat—the drippier, the better!
I think about my mommy a lot. She's gone, forever. But I'm a good cook like she was, so she'll live forever!
Visit:
Ooooh! I found you! I found you! You've got to be [S], right?
Someone friendly-wendly sent me here to say hi. It was [F]!
Level: Great! Can I go back to killing guys now?
Let's see what color bad-guy blood is!
Ugh! That's almost nothing!
Summon:
I'm Peri. P as in pierce! E as in eviscerate! R as in rupture! And what's the I for...?
Injure! I'm a cavalier from Nohr, so just point me in a direction and I'll get stabby!
Learn Skill: You made me stronger, so I'll get stabby with anyone you want!
Confession:
Oh, I've been looking for you. I have something tasty-wasty that I made for you!
Cooked it myself. Oh, and I sliced and diced the meat—and all the veggies too!
Eat up while it's hot. Like it? Scrumptious, right? YAY!
My mommy was great at cooking. That's why I want to be good at it too. That way, it's like she's with me!
More than anything, it means that I know how to make you happy-wappy!
So, count on Peri to spice things up in the battle AND the kitchen from now on!
Status: I get stabby if people make me mad.
I can cook up food like you wouldn't believe!
The outfits in the Order of Heroes are so cute!
Why's your outfit so white? To make the blood spatters more spattery, right?
You work so hard! You deserve a huggy-wuggy!
Where's my Lord Xander! Where is he?! I need to protect him!
So, I'll get stabbity-stab with enemies, and you'll thank me. Deal?

catria.name: Catria
catria.title: Middle Whitewing
catria.description: Middle of three sisters who are pegasus knights for Macedon. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I'm a pegasus knight, just like my sisters, Palla and Est.
Macedonian fliers are divided into the pegasus Whitewings and the wyvern Dragoons. I'm a Whitewing.
*sigh* Ah! How embarrassing—you caught me daydreaming!
My sister Palla often says I'm clever but stubborn... *sigh* I wonder which one I am today...
I'd better get training. I'm not as talented as Palla or Est, so I have to make it up with effort.
Visit:
I've been sent here on an errand by [F].
You know, just to say hi!
Level: Times like this are when I really need to focus.
Slowly but surely...I'm improving.
I hope no one sees me like this!
Summon: I'm Catria, the middle of the three sisters in Macedon's Whitewings. I serve Princess Minerva.
Learn Skill: It's good to see my effort bearing fruit like this.
Confession:
Huh. Is that how I seem? Like I'm always staring off into the distance?
Heehee! I guess if that's how it seems, it's probably true, right?
But I know how to fix it—by spending more time with you, developing our...bond.
I know that every day I spend with you will help me focus and keep me looking straight ahead.
As long as I have you by my side, I can do anything.
Status: Whatever you need, I'll get the job done.
Augh! Er...I mean, what's going on?
I must never bring shame to the Whitewings.
I...I have a lot of respect for you.
Allies help one another.
I know I shouldn't feel this way about...him.
Thank you for having me join you. It means a lot.
Did you think this clothing would suit me? Hmm.
*surprise react* What? Is something wrong?
I've noticed that the dökkálfar seem to keep to themselves.
I can't wait to see what sort of new clothes Palla and Est are wearing.
The true nightmare is unending battle. We must bring the fighting to a stop.
I wish that my dreams could bring him to me, at least... But no, it is better to not even dream it.
If you do happen to have a dream of me, I hope that it's a nice one...

est.name: Est
est.title: Junior Whitewing
est.description: Youngest of three sisters who are pegasus knights for Macedon. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: *sigh* Am I too immature?
Watch my sisters and me next battle—we're pretty amazing!

Thanks for being you, [S]!
Nobody works like you—on or off the battlefield!
I make the best stew! Come on now. Eat up! There's plenty more where that came from!
People say I act childish, but I'm basically grown-up already!
Visit:
Message from [F]!
It's for you, [S]. Hi!
Level: I feel like I could fly to the top of the sky!
I was worried I was getting rusty, but I guess not!
Aw...
Summon: Hi there, I'm Est. I'm from the Macedonian Whitewings! Or... at least I was!
Learn Skill: Thanks! I'll be even more incredible now!
Confession:
Abel and I run a small shop together back home in Altea.
That was always my wish for us, but I'm glad to be here, helping you with this fight.
After all, that's how I met you, and you've shown me all the different bonds people can share...
I used to see things a bit childishly, but seeing that means I'm an adult now, right? Haha!
In any case, thank you for all you've helped me to see. I'll keep counting on you!
Status: Hm? Did you need me?
*giggle* You caught me!
My sisters and I are the best at flying!
Oh, hey, would you like some stew?
You can expect good things from me!
I wonder if I'm too childish...
Let's get out there and do our best, OK?
Don't you just love my álfr look? Because I sure do!
Eek! Ugh, you got me again!
I wish I could use these wings to fly!
I get along well with Peony and Mirabilis. We're really close!
They say children can see álfar. Have you ever seen one?
I'd love it if my sisters and I could all wear álfr outfits together.
Thanks for the cute clothes. I'll pay you back by doing my best!

shanna.name: Shanna
shanna.title: Sprightly Flier
shanna.description: A trainee of the Pegasus Knights of Ilia. Cheerful and optimistic. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: My homeland, Ilia, is so cold—and I mean COLD. This place is a real hothouse in comparison.
I have two sisters named Thea and Juno. They're older than me. Guess that makes me the youngest!
Want to chat? Sure! What d'ya feel like talking about? How about...? Hmm. Or maybe...? Nah.
You're welcome to ride my pegasus anytime. Flying is the best!
Are you going to scold me for flying too far ahead of the front lines? Sorry, sorry—I can't help it!
Visit:
Oh, [S]?
Great! It is you! One of your friends asked me to say hi. You remember [F], right?
Level: Yeah! I bet I could beat any enemy now.
Hee hee! I'll be as good as my sisters soon!
I'll never NOT be a trainee if I can't do better than that.
Summon: I'm Shanna from Ilia! I'm a pegasus knight! Well...sorta? I'm actually still in training, but I'll do my best!
Learn Skill: I won't be a pegasus knight in training for much longer!
Confession:
Some people say I'm childish. Not nice to say, but maybe not totally wrong either.
But since I've come here and fought alongside everyone, I feel like I've grown up a lot!
Hey, and here you are, I bet, thinking that ol' Shanna looks just the same, right?
How do I know? Oh, I know. Everyone always looks at me like I'm just the same.
Looky there—it's Shanna! And there—it's Shanna!
The thing is, I like being me. So I wouldn't mind putting off this whole growing-up thing.
That is, if you don't mind. Ha! I knew you wouldn't!
Status: Hmm? Need something? You name it...and I'm on it!
AHH! Whew. Just you.
Hey, it's the chief! You're the chief, right? Right!
Hope you're not skipping meals, Chief! Bad idea!
My homeland is SO cold...
Someday...I'm gonna fly high and light up the sky!
Say! We should visit my homeland! You gotta meet the REAL chief!
I'm Juno and Thea's little sis! My name's Shanna.
Gah! I'll get you back for that—just you wait!
I am loving these clothes! Do you like 'em? Do you?!
Isn't Embla sort of your enemy, Chief? Ugh, complicated...
If ONE MORE person tells me I'm "just a trainee"... Ugh!
I'm proud of my Ilian uniform. It matches my sisters'!
Chief, gimme your honest opinion. Which outfit's better...my regular uniform, or this one?!

florina.name: Florina
florina.title: Lovely Flier
florina.description: Youngest of three sisters who are Pegasus Knights of Ilia. Shy, gentle girl who loves animals. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Oh, Huey! You're the best pegasus a girl could ever hope for. H-hey, stop it. That tickles!
I'm one of three sisters. I'm... well...I'm the youngest one. I guess someone always has to be!

I just don't have the words to thank you for all you do, but... Um, well...?
Thank you, I guess.
Truth is, I get a little shy around men. Even friends. And, well? Way more than a little.
I say sorry a lot, and I know that can get on people's nerves. So, uh...sorry?
Visit:
I was asked... That is, it was [F] who...
Wait—where was I? Oh, yes! I was asked to come say hello!
Level: Growing this much? Incredible!
I've gotten stronger, so I can help more!
Aw. Now my sisters are going to laugh at me.
Summon: My name is—! Sorry, let me start again. Come on, deep breath, Florina... My name is Florina! Hi there!
Learn Skill: Thanks so much! I'll try to do my best for you!
Confession:
Could you maybe give me a moment of your time?
Sorry to bother you, but there's something I...I have to say.
You know how hard I find it to put things into words. But I'm...
I'm really happy to have fought under your guidance! I've gotten more capable in battle!
So I just wanted to thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Hee hee! I hope that made it clear how much I want to keep fighting for you!
Status: So, I think...? You know? Well, of course YOU do.
I'm a bit, hmm, skittish? So don't do anything TOO sudden, OK?
I'm...? I don't know. There's no good word. Shy?
I'm still in training, so sorry if I...? Ugh. Just a big sorry.
I try to do the best I can at everything.
I need to complete my training so I can stand on my own—as soon as I can!
I'm so...thankful...that I can work for you.
I-I don't know about this outfit. Could you, um...maybe...look over there?
Yah! Wh-why would you... What did I do?
The...the realm of the dead? Scary! Can we talk about something else?
You...think these clothes suit me? Huh. Lyn said that too.
I'd like to get to know Princess Eir better, except...I have no idea how to talk to her.
I feel like I'm only half of what I could be. I need to do better!
I just can't stand the thought of you dying… No no!

cordelia.name: Cordelia
cordelia.title: Knight Paragon
cordelia.description: The sole survivor of Ylisse's pegasus knights. Humble and supremely talented. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Your team reminds me of my old unit. I hope I do them proud... wherever they are now.
I was once one of the Ylissean pegasus knights. The others all died...but their spirits live on in me.
Your diligence is admirable, but don't overexert yourself. You're our only summoner, you know.
Can I watch you summon sometime? I'd like to learn more about how I came to be here.
I was just inspecting the armory. Next I shall look over the mess tent, the stables, and the latrines.
Visit: Ah, I'm glad I found you! I've come to bid you greetings from your friend [F].
Level: Hard work is its own reward.
This was to be expected.
I'm sorry. You can expect better from me next time.
Summon: I'm Cordelia of the Ylissean army under milord Chrom. I will do my best to meet your expectations.
Learn Skill: Thank you for the trust you've put in me. I vow to be worthy.
Confession:
Let's see...to summon Heroes, first I'd have to pose, then fire a shot like so... Yes, I have the moves down perfec—
Ahhh! Were you watching me? Why didn't you say something sooner, [S]?!
Hm? Because I let my guard down? You're very rude to spy on me like that!
But I must admit...it's nice that you can see me this way and not just as everyone's "natural talent."
I won't let my guard down on the battlefield, though. You are precious to me, and I swear to protect you.
Status: I know what they say, but please don't call me a genius.
I wonder if there is any feeling worse than unrequited love?
I would like to join the Order of Heroes.
*sigh* Oh! Was I sighing again? I must work on that.
I do not appreciate being stared at. May I help you?
I must do my utmost...for myself and for those who protected me...
I want to learn more about this realm. About you as well.
I'm all decked out like an Askran!
I've always felt like I was in a different world. Now I actually am.
Askr's royalty have made this country a wonderful place for the people. The lovely weather doesn't hurt, either.
I want to learn more about this country and its people. Can you teach me?
I finally feel like a full-fledged member of the Order of Heroes.
I get self-conscious when people stare. No, I'm not going to tell you why!
Our outfits match, don't they? That's so nice.

hinoka.name: Hinoka
hinoka.title: Warrior Princess
hinoka.description: Hoshidan princess who prefers battles over court life. Excels at watching over others. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Whew! Enough training for today. Need to stay in top shape to keep everyone I hold dear totally safe.
My retainers, Azama and Setsuna, might not seem like they're all that on task. But I can totally count on them!
I appreciate how hard you work here, but pace yourself. People would be very sad if you got hurt somehow.
You can depend on me completely. There's something about you. For some reason, I feel like you're family!
I was just tending to my pegasus. Their wings are so downy in a few places. Want to feel it for yourself?
Visit:
You're [S], right?
Whew, I found you! I bring greetings from [F].
Level: Nothing will scare me now.
Well done! Now to try even harder!
That is not good enough. I have to do better!
Summon: I'm Princess Hinoka of Hoshido. I have a reputation as a warrior princess. So, happy to hit the battlefield for you!
Learn Skill: Well? Do I seem stronger than I was before?
Confession:
Hey, you! I just finished grooming my pegasus and was wondering if you'd like to take a ride with us.
I've been wanting something to do to bring us closer together, and this is perfect!
We can talk while we admire the view, soaring through the sky— you'll love it!
Hm? We're already close? That's really sweet...and I'm a little embarrassed now.
Well, I still think a joyride through the skies is in order— you coming?
Status: I want to get stronger. No, I have to get stronger!
I take very good care of my pegasus. I should be doing it now!
Just shout anytime you need help. I'll come running.
You have a divine weapon? Neat. My brothers do too!
I sometimes wonder if I should be more graceful and gentle. You know, a princess.
I wonder where Azama and Setsuna are? You never know with those two!
You can't fight in battle, so I'm happy to help you. More than happy!
You chose these clothes for me? There must be some mistake!
Hey! Watch it! This isn't the most protective outfit in the world.
Are álfar similar to the spirits of Hoshido? No? Maybe I misunderstood...
I don't like the way you're looking at me. So cut it out!
I always feel rested after a good workout. Nothing's better than a good night's sleep.
Ugh. Azama and Setsuna won't let me live this down...
Thanks for the new attire. It's not my usual style, but it's a gift from you, so I'll take good care of it.

subaki.name: Subaki
subaki.title: Perfect Expert
subaki.description: Sky Knight of Hoshido who aims for perfection. One of Sakura's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I can't believe that I came out of your weapon. This realm is so different than my home, the Kingdom of Hoshido!
I serve Lady Sakura, whose grace is peerless. She is patient even in the face of my worst imperfections.
Your patrols in this large place must be very exacting. I'd be glad to do my part anytime you need rest.
You'll find that I try to perform perfectly in battle. And I vow to try even harder for your sake.
You may detect a floral scent from me. Sorry if it troubles your nose. It's a hair tonic made from camellia blooms.
Visit:
Hello there. I'm positive that you must be [S].
Yes? Good. I bring you brightest greetings from your fine friend [F]!
Level: I'm really coming along, right?
This will do just fine for now.
Perhaps I should practice more.
Summon: I am Subaki, a Sky Knight from the Kingdom of Hoshido. I'm perfectly delighted to answer your call.
Learn Skill: Thank you for helping me get a little closer to perfection.
Confession:
You and I have been in battle plenty of times now. Haven't we, [S]?
I'm sure you've seen me make little mistakes now and then. It's only natural.
But it still bothers me, especially here where I rank among the Heroes called upon in this world.
I feel like I must be even more perfect here than back home.
And you, Great Hero! You must be under an even greater pressure to be the best...of the best!
What? You say sometimes your tactics aren't up to snuff?
Aha! How wonderful. You and I have been hiding our little failures. Well, your secret is safe with me.
We will help each other achieve total perfection. Until then, you can count on me—absolutely!
Status: Gracious thanks, friend, for any and all concern!
I'm the perfect partner, whether in battle or simply socializing.
If I have any flaws, it's that I fuss too much over my appearance.
You can rely on me to do a thing right. I assume that's why you summoned me.
What? That wasn't my stomach growling. You must be mistaken.
Where is Lady Sakura? I must serve her well, even in her absence.
Perfection is a fool's errand. I suppose that makes me the perfect fool!

barst.name: Barst
barst.title: The Hatchet
barst.description: Warrior of Talys who works for Ogma and has been a pirate and woodcutter. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: What a castle! Wonder how many guys it took to build this thing...
Wonder how ol' Bord and Cord are doing...
Let me know if ya run outta firewood. I'll chop up a mountain for ya.
Fighting's thirsty work! Wanna join me for a drink?
Try as I might, I'll never repay Captain Ogma. He's like a giant among men.
Visit:
Hey, are you [S]?
My summoner bugged me to come over and say hi to ya. Who? Oh, [F]!
Level: Let me show you what these big ol' arms can do!
This ain't me by half.
Eh, maybe I should just go back to cuttin' down trees...
Summon: The name's Barst. I used to be a mercenary—now I'm just a regular woodcutter.
Learn Skill: I'm feelin' it! Count on me for whatever you need.
Confession:
I joined the Altean army after a stint as a mercenary... Was a pirate for a bit after that.
Thought I'd retire to the peaceful life as a woodcutter, but here's another war needs my attention.
Heh. That's fate for you, I guess.
Not all bad, though—I got to meet you. Here's to shared fate, eh?
But don't get too comfortable— you never know when we might go our separate ways!
Status: Need me for something?
Wha—?! Don't sneak up on a guy like that!
I'm just a guy who chops wood. That's all.
Hey, how ya doing?
Wanna know something? Long time ago I was a pirate for a while.
You give the orders and I'll follow 'em.
Take good care of us on the field, right? Our lives are in your hands.

bartre.name: Bartre
bartre.title: Fearless Warrior
bartre.description: An outpost warrior who went on a journey to find his beloved daughter, Fir. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Gahaha! Glad to take you under my wing if ya want. Think of me as your father, all right?

Fir? Where are you, Daughter?
CAN YOU HEAR ME? FIRRRRRRRR?
Listen up—lesson on battles... Offense! Attack! Bwaaah! Lesson's over.
What? Need me? I'm your guy. Big lug, for lugging stuff.
Who needs a weapon with these trained-up muscles? Bwaaah! Yaahhh!
Visit: Oho! You! No doubt about it. You're [S]. Good to meet you.
Level: True power, right here. Bwaaah! Yaahhh!
Mm-hmm! More of the good stuff, right there.
Wha—?! But that's only—? Sheesh.
Summon: I'm Bartre—warrior type, if you can't tell. Bwaaah! Yaahhh! How'd that sound? Burly nuff for you?
Learn Skill: Aim high—then higher! That's the true way of the warrior!
Confession:
So, I've gotten the sense that you think I should be paying more attention in battle.
What, not just go in swinging? That's what you should be doing—swinging ALL the time!
Bwaaah! Yaahhh! All you need is lefty and righty. We all got 'em, so why not USE 'em?
No use complicating battle with all that fancy stuff. At least, not for me.
Now, are we all good here? Ha! Of course we are, friend!
Status: What, my turn? It's my turn, right?
Check out these arms! Bwaaah! Yaaah!
Ready to train? Then punch me hard, right in the gut.
You worried about something? C'mon, out with it.
Say no more. That look in your eyes says it all. You're a fighter.
A true warrior needs only his muscles—nothing else!
I'll take care of you. Like a father, I will!

raven.name: Raven
raven.title: Peerless Fighter
raven.description: A noble heir whose true name is Raymond. Works as a mercenary to enact revenge. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Like I said, I'm just a mercenary. Not really the type to rub elbows with any royalty around here.
People say I look mad all the time. They can say what they want. If I hear it, though? Then I get mad.
I have to give it to you. You fight with brains, not brawn. Wish I had the knack for that.
I have my reasons for fighting, and for pushing myself to get stronger, and for getting flexible with weapons.
I used to rely on a sword, but the stronger I get, I think the axe suits me better.
Visit:
My business here is with [S].
That you? I'm here on behalf of someone else.
Level: Couldn't hope for better.
Fine results.
Not nearly enough. No way.
Summon: I'm Raven. Just a mercenary. Nothing more to it.
Learn Skill: Power? Like this? You have my thanks.
Confession:
It's nothing worth talking about, but there's something I might as well tell you, [S].
A long time ago, I was from a royal house—a house that was destroyed by our enemies.
That was why I became a mercenary—to seek revenge on those who did it.
I sought power—and always more of it—to better exact my revenge.
But now, none of that matters. I've come to my senses after watching you at work here.
Does any of that make sense? If not, forget I said anything. I'll still fight hard for you.
Status: I take it we're here to discuss something?
Is this touching stuff some sort of amusement?
Likes? Dislikes? Oh, I don't know. I like meat, I guess?
People say I scowl. Hmph. What do they know?
I'm not angry. This is just my face.
Glad to fight for you. Long as it doesn't get in the way of...well, never mind.
Need me? Just say so.
Yeah, yeah, new outfit. Don't even bother—I've already heard it all.
Hey, watch it! You got a problem with me or something?
This wouldn't be my first choice of gear, but it's hard to complain when it gets the job done.
Lucius seems to actually like this outfit... Not sure what he sees in it, but I guess that makes it worth it.
Priscilla won't stop hounding me about these clothes... Listen, if she asks, you didn't see me. Got it?
Death is a mercenary's worst enemy and best friend. If you can't come to terms with that, you won't survive.
I'm here for you, not the money. If you ever need a hand, just let me know and I'll do what I can.

hawkeye.name: Hawkeye
hawkeye.title: Desert Guardian
hawkeye.description: Guardian of the Nabata Desert and Arcadia, where dragons and humans live in harmony. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I have long lived in the desert. Places like this? They're unfamiliar to me.
You possess summoning magic. Careful. Such immense power can, over time, drive a man mad.
I am grateful for what you do. That is all.
I know you are no warrior, but the way you direct us in battle? You're like a beast. Ferocious.
The path of the Desert Guardian is a lonely one. And by necessity. So forgive me if I stand at a remove.
Visit:
Are you [S]?
I've come bearing a hello from a distant place from your friend [F].
Level: WUU-OOHHH!
My strength has gone up. Good.
Is...my time as guardian coming to an end?
Summon:
I am the Desert Guardian—he who defends the dunes around the village of dragons I call home.
But you, stranger, can call me Hawkeye.
Learn Skill: I am grateful for what you have given me.
Confession:
It is time for us to have words of weight. You and I, now.
I sense that you find me strange. Perhaps even stranger than most people here find me.
I am from the deep desert, and those from outside it see me as outside themselves.
Do you feel the same? About me? Or more importantly, about yourself?
You and I are the same in one regard. We both want to ensure that peace persists.
Like the sands of time, which flow but never change, you and I will always be there for the world.
Status: If you need to talk, I am always here.
You wish to get my attention? Friend, you have it.
I have a destiny. I will fulfill it.
The desert I guard... There is no desert more in need of a guardian.
I find you...mysterious.
My time as guardian will come to an end. That time draws near.
I believe in you, friend.

arthur.name: Arthur
arthur.title: Hapless Hero
arthur.description: A sworn ally of justice with uncannily bad luck. One of Elise's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: All of you in the Order of Heroes are some of the most heroic souls I've ever met. Very well done!
My liege is Lady Elise, finest rose of Nohr! No evildoer will harm a single petal of her floral excellence!
You patrol so fearlessly, while I...? I can't go 10 paces without being struck by dragon droppings!
I have terrible luck, friend. Maybe if we patrol together, your good luck will rub off on me.
My whole being aches for justice, but my stomach? It aches from something bad I ate.
Visit:
I've come to deliver greetings from [F]!
Ha! And I fell on my chin only a few times on the way!
Level: This feeling! Such power! Such justice!
At last, my training is paying off!
I thought fortune favored the bold...
Summon: Evil has met its match! I am Arthur of Nohr. My bad luck is legendary, but my heroism, more so!
Learn Skill: Aha! More power! May it counter my bad luck!
Confession:
Ah, [S]! I wanted to tell you—the town is abuzz about the Order of Heroes!
True heroes set the gossips to their work! Perhaps you should adopt a new heroic pose!
I've practiced a few, but every time I try one out, I am struck from above by wild-pegasus dung.
Does that happen to you as well? No? Just me? Then you can pose without worry!
And don't worry about being vulnerable to attack when posing. I'll eliminate any villainous fiends!
I will fight off any number of them, my strength fueled by the flames of our friendship!
Status: Never fear—Arthur is here!
You may think me a clumsy fellow. And, my friend, you are right!
Whoaaa! Banana peel, you are a slippery villain!
Haha! My chin is one of the great wonders of the world!
Do we not all strike a pose when victorious? I do! All heroes should!
Where is Lady Elise? I fear that I lost her when I fell into a swamp!
We will win, friend! For I am the bosom buddy of justice!

sheena.name: Sheena
sheena.title: Princess of Gra
sheena.description: Princess of Gra, a failing realm. Feels the heavy weight of her responsibility. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: This is a good castle—simple, solid, defendable. I hope the same can be said of your country.
I am an inexperienced leader. But I cannot betray my people's needs and expectations.
I'm grateful to you for all you've done. Is there something I can help you with?
I visited the town nearby, and it was filled with smiling faces. The people of this kingdom must be protected.
How heavy is my armor? Not nearly so heavy as my crown.
Visit: I am Sheena. I come with greetings on behalf of your good friend [F].
Level: Ever forward, and with ever greater power!
I will better myself one step at a time.
This step is not worthy of being called progress.
Summon: I am Princess Sheena of Gra. I reluctantly assumed the throne after my father, King Jiol, passed away.
Learn Skill: My power grows yet greater. It's hard to believe.
Confession:
I have heard that you are not originally from this world.
So why is it that you continue to fight for it?
Is it simply that you value the friends you have made here and do not wish to abandon them?
If so...I can understand your feelings. I, too, cannot abandon those who need my help...
As such, I will not leave you here. As long as you remain, I promise to support you as well.
Status: Did you have something to discuss?
I never know when to be princess and when to be warrior.
I'm not sure if I can lead a kingdom, but I will fight for you.
This armor is the pride of my homeland.
I have often been called...stubborn.
I wonder how my people fare without me...
I will continue to put my trust in you.

Special: You'll have to go through me!
Status: I wonder if this armor truly suits me...
Whatever I wear, you would do well to remember that I am royalty.
Diplomatic relations are never simple. Take Askr and Embla, for example.
Prior to now, I've seldom had the time to spend on such frivolous things as fashion.
I've encountered such a wide and interesting variety of people here. It has truly broadened my horizons.
Samson... What did you ever see in me?
I will continue to devote myself fully to your service.

hector.name: Hector
hector.title: General of Ostia
hector.description: Eliwood's friend and brother of the Marquess of Ostia. Prefers action to court formality. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Fine castle you have here. It's not really my thing to stay cooped up all day though. Let's get to battling!

The name of my axe is Armads. It was once wielded by a legendary berserker, you know.
Once had a chance to meet the man, believe it or not. He's one dangerous-looking fellow.
One of my best friends goes by the name of Eliwood. We spar for fun. He even wins half the time!
I'm really bored. How about we spar for a while? Don't worry. I'll go easy on you, friend!
Someone once told me that knights should stand their ground, but that's really just not my style.
Visit:
I'm Hector. You must be [S].
I've come to say hello—sent over by [F], in fact!
Level: Whoa! Now that's how to do it!
Good enough. Now if I can only keep this up.
Bah! I'll lose to Eliwood if I can't do better.
Summon: I'm Hector, from a realm called Ostia. But I'm not its ruler. My brother, Uther, is marquess at the moment.
Learn Skill: Now I'll show you what Hector of Ostia is all about!
Confession:
I'm no poet, friend, so bear with me here. I have a hard time putting my thoughts into words.
But before I joined you, I thought that as long as I just kept on swinging in battle...
I'd always come out on top and bring everyone back from battle, safe and sound.
Then I noticed how you, as tactician, see the line between life and death like no one else.
Not sure why, but that hit me hard. Anyway, know that I've got your back—long as you've got mine.
Status: You need me for something, friend?
Oho! Feels like you're ready to head out. Me too!
Push your limits—that's what I say. But don't burn yourself out.
How about we spar a bit? What say you?
I know we're all in it together. Just letting you know: I'm ALL in.
So...I'm going to die on the battlefield...
I'd better keep an eye on you. Trouble abounds in battle.
These clothes are from a place called Múspell. Is it really hot there—or is it just me?
I know I'm striking, but keep your hands to yourself.
Múspell seems like a rough and tumble place. Pretty sure I'd fit right in.
Eliwood? Where are you? I've got to see your reaction to this outfit!
I'm a function over form kind of man, but honestly...I could get used to this.
Even the most intimidating look won't be enough on its own. Always train hard.
The fashion may be fiery, but I'm still as solid as a rock. And I've got your back.

frederick.name: Frederick
frederick.title: Polite Knight
frederick.description: A knight who serves the royal house of Ylisse and helps lead Chrom's Shepherds. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: The cloaks worn in the Order of Heroes are striking. I'd like to stitch a good recruiting slogan on them.
I have long served the royal house of Ylisse. I shall continue when I return there one day.
I appreciate your checking in on me. I serve another master, but you have earned my respect.
Would you care to weed the garden with me sometime? A well-tended garden is the surest sign of nobility.
I stand ready with a hand-knit muffler to place about my liege's neck at the very moment he may sneeze.
Visit:
Pardon the intrusion. I've come on a mission from your friend [F].
That mission? To pass along warmest greetings.
Level: I will use this power to protect us!
Slow but steady—the best road for a knight.
Hmm. I need to apply myself more.
Summon: I am Frederick, a royal knight and a guiding hand in the Shepherds. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Learn Skill: I shall test my new power right away, picking up pebbles!
Confession:
Why, you're hard at work as always, [S]!
If you're on patrol, please allow me to assist you.
I shall try to predict your path and remove any pebbles or weeds that might obstruct your progress.
My foremost duty will always be to the royal house of Ylisse—that will never change. But...
I feel I should make time to look after you as well. Perhaps I've grown attached to you...
Well, enough lollygagging—I have pebbles to clear. Please, don't mind me! Continue patrolling!
Status: A knight must constantly strive for excellence.
My first task is always the safety of the royal family.
Today, like every other day, I woke up early to clear away pebbles.
I notice there are weeds about. I shall pluck them until you can hire a gardener.
The commissary is serving bear meat? I believe I shall skip dinner today.
Where could my lord Chrom be...
Should we camp outdoors, you may rely on me for a magnificent campfire.

gunter.name: Gunter
gunter.title: Inveterate Soldier
gunter.description: Veteran knight of Nohr. One of Corrin's retainers. Extremely strict. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I'm impressed by the commander of this Order of Heroes here—a keen mind for one still in her bloom.
I was the caretaker for my liege Corrin for many years. So rather than a retainer, I'm more a parent.
I admire your initiative doing patrols. We should trade stories over tea. I'm no butler, but I can brew the stuff.

My lifetime of training served me well in my world. Will it in this one?
Maybe I should train with you ranking members of this order.
I maintain my armor often. When I got here, I had little more than that on me. So I have to take good care of it all.
Visit:
Hmm, I take it that you are [S].
Then I've finally found you. I bring greetings from your friend [F].
Level: It feels good to be in action again!
Guess I can learn new tricks...
At my age, I'm lucky I don't feel weaker.
Summon: I am Gunter, a knight of Nohr. Some might call me too old. Their mistake. This knight is a seasoned veteran!
Learn Skill: A lot of power for an old man. But I'll use it as best I can.
Confession:
I heard from your commander that you're a...Great Hero.
Come now—out with it. Are you a Great Hero? Perhaps you're too humble to say as much.
You might not have my years, but embrace who you are and develop your potential!
That weapon of yours—make yourself into the sort of person who is worthy of holding it!
I have known another one in my days who faced a similar dilemma.
Now, before you dismiss this as the ramblings of an old man, know this:
I have also sensed it while we've been in battle—a gap between your title and your confidence.
No need to apologize. It's only natural, and it's also where I come in.
Let this veteran fight for you a bit longer. I offer my sword and my years, until you are great inside and out.
Status: Others might trifle with me, but I suspect you won't make that mistake.
I find you...intriguing...to say the least.
I am glad to have joined you.
Remain focused. Always—not just on the battlefield.
Curious about the scar on my face? Hmm. Of course you are.
My armor has known...so much blood.
You and I should spar sometime. Builds character!

minerva.name: Minerva
minerva.title: Red Dragoon
minerva.description: Princess of Macedon who took up arms against her brother, Michalis. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I believe Prince Alfonse will be a fine king. He reminds me of Prince Marth in a way.
In these moments of quiet, I sometimes reflect on bygone days with my siblings...
These days I am known as the Red Dragoon... In better days I rode an adorable pegasus...
My brother Michalis and I each made our own choices... I had to execute him with my own hands.
Michalis and I will never be as siblings again. But I shall always wish happiness for our sister, Maria.
Visit: An acquaintance of yours bid me come wish you well. Who? It was [F].
Level: Witness the fearsome power of the Red Dragoon!
So...I had not reached my full potential...
Michalis was always a step ahead. I cannot compare...
Summon: I am Minerva, Princess of Macedon. I will never hesitate in my duty. Ask—and it will be done.
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude. I will show it by my victories.
Confession:
I do not have what is required of a ruler. During my time ruling in place of my brother...
I have allowed rebellion, been captured, and displayed my own powerlessness and disgrace.
Perhaps I could better rule with a tactician like you at my side...
You have a unique quality about you—you make me feel as if...
I still have much I can accomplish. Thank you for that. I swear to not give up and to look to the future.
Status: Mm? Did you need something?
Is that how you greet people in your homeland?
I will fight with honor, if not pride.
I shall never ascend the throne. I do not have the capacity to rule.
Let us restore peace to the people of this world together.
I remember days of light and laughter...
Anytime you wish to speak, do not hesitate.

Special: This is my fight to win.
Status: I am told this is the garb of another world, called Múspell.
*grunt* Careful there. I nearly screamed in fright.
My brother, sister, and I all have red hair. Red has always been my color.
So this look suits me, you think? *laugh* Well, thank you.
The princesses of Múspell are so close. Their relationship is just like the one I have with Maria.
Michalis, Maria... Perhaps this world offers a chance to return things to the way they were...
I am satisfied adding my strength to yours.

michalis.name: Michalis
michalis.title: Ambitious King
michalis.description: King of Macedon who had great ambitions for his country. Murdered his father. Brother to Minerva and Maria. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: An assemblage of great Heroes from all the worlds... With such an army, no power could resist you...
None can control me. I killed my father, the king, and took his throne, all of my own free will.
You, Summoner! You think me your puppet? You will never control me. I will defy you at every turn.
Marth... I despise that man. We will never understand each other. Yet I must admit he is an able ruler.
Minerva and I will never be as siblings again. Yet I worry about my young sister, Maria...
Visit: What insolence, sending me here to deliver a hello! I must reprimand that [F]...
Level: My unyielding ambition burns ever brighter!
Save your praise—such growth is simply the natural order.
This isn't even the merest foothold toward power...
Summon: I am Michalis, King of Macedon. That is all you need know of me.
Learn Skill: Fate urges me onward, ever into battle.
Confession:
I died once—did you know? Minerva defeated me, crushed all my mighty ambitions on that battlefield.
I should have stayed dead, but a foolish spark remained in my heart.
Now I must admit that my time with you has kindled that tiny spark once more.
With the power I've gained at your side, I could dream once more of conquering worlds...
Regardless, until I make my decision, I will follow you and see what else I might gain.
Special: I am the END of you.
Status: How DARE you lay a finger on me?
Curses! What are you doing, skulking around like that?
You will address me as King Michalis of Macedon.
I intend to conquer the worlds. All of them.
If you do not fear me now, you will soon.
I must come to her aid... I must...
I will lend you the grace of my power.

narcian.name: Narcian
narcian.title: Wyvern General
narcian.description: One of three Wyvern Generals of Bern. Conceited and vainglorious. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: What a splendid castle. Strong. Stylish. Why, it's almost my equal in fortitude and magnificence!
To get to the top, one need only be willing to claw...and claw...and glorious etcetera!

I've noticed how dutifully you patrol this place on my behalf.
Your devotion to me, Narcian, makes you greater than every other flea I see hopping before me!

Grraaah! Bwaah!
Everyone else around here makes me, Narcian, so SPITTING mad! They refuse to bow down!

I, Narcian, have a weakness. If I pass a mirror in battle, I'm so smitten with my prowess that I cease battling.
So keep those mirrors OFF the battlefield!
Visit:
Well, well, well—you must be [S].
The pleasure is entirely yours.
Level: Behold the grandeur of me, Narcian!
Another clawful of excellence on my way to the top!
Turn away! Don't look upon it! Who did this to Narcian?
Summon: I am Narcian—a Wyvern General of Bern. Do you wish to kneel before me? Or tremble in fear? Your choice.
Learn Skill: It's only natural that you'd want to pay tribute to me, Narcian.
Confession:
I, Narcian, have a bone to pick with you! I heard that you said I am completely full of myself!
Did you mean it as an insult? Because it's not! I am full of nothing BUT me!
How else would I have clawed my way to the top? Confidence is king, and I would be emperor!
Hmpf. You might be the first one to ever stand there and say such a thing to my face.
I'll make you regret that you picked a fight with me, Narcian! One day I'll make you kneel.
Then I'll pet your head like a little kitty—and keep you at my side forever! Ha ha ha ha!
Status: What business have you with me?
Captivated by my style and grace? Well, of course you are.
My talents are legion. My abilities, unparalleled.
What glorious hair I have!
I am strong... I am clever...
I am handsome... I am righteous... And more than anyone else. Anywhere!
My philosophy of life...? Ah, simple. The weak must obey the powerful.
These new clothes are rather gorgeous. They may even be worthy of me.
Puh! Who said you could enter my presence, urchin?!
The look is fitting. An agent of the underworld, dispensing death upon all filth that crosses my path!
An incompetent fool's death is the world's gain. Do you not agree?
The denizens of Hel are certainly a foreboding bunch... Not that I'm intimidated, of course!
I am almost too ravishing to bear in this outfit. My eyes are hypnotized by the mirror...
You may continue to offer me outfits that emphasize my beauty. In fact, I insist.

cherche.name: Cherche
cherche.title: Wyvern Friend
cherche.description: Wyvern-riding fighter in Virion's noble house. Thinks her wyvern Minerva is adorable. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Oh, what an adorable insect! I'll have to catch it and show it off to [S]...
In my homeland, I was in service to House Virion, but, honestly, you can just forget about my former liege.
It's kind of you to check on me, but I'm sure you're busy. Stop by and chat when you've got more time.
Say, would you like to go hunting with Minerva and me sometime? It's so cute when she eats a whole deer!
I've sewn up all the torn uniforms. Let me know if you need help with the stains on those white capes.
Visit:
So, you there. You're the one called [S], right?
I've come to deliver a hello to you from [F].
Level: I feel invigorated! How about you, Minerva?
See, Minerva? This is the value of hard work.
Well, this is vexing.
Summon: I'm Cherche, a wyvern rider from Valm. My sweet Minerva and I will join your cause.
Learn Skill: I feel simply fantastic! Thank you ever so much!
Confession:
Thank you for always supporting me and my precious Minerva. We both feel so safe with you!
To be honest, I was worried at first. About living in a different world... About fighting new enemies...
I did leave home once before, but coming here is not the same as crossing from Valm to Ylisse.
But spending time with you—learning about this world—has filled me with determination to protect it.
My homeland of Rosanne is a green and beautiful place, just like Askr. I hope to show it to you someday.
Status: I love to sew and cook, so if you have need of such things, don't hesitate to ask.
If you have time, let's chat together awhile.
Some say I'm terrifying when angry, but that's simply not true.
I used to be a servant—now I ride a wyvern into battle. Life is strange, is it not?
Are there any really adorable monsters here? Like the Risen?
I wonder how things fare back in Rosanne...
No matter how dire the circumstance, you may rely on me and Minerva.

camilla.name: Camilla
camilla.title: Bewitching Beauty
camilla.description: Princess of Nohr who dotes on her sibling Corrin and is merciless to foes. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
I can sympathize with the enemy's desire to snatch up so many Heroes.
Sometimes when you're lonely, it helps to find the one thing that stokes your fire—and then feed it!
My retainers, Beruka and Selena, are adorable—and deadly too. I hope you enjoy them as much as I do!
How sweet of you to look in on me. If ever you get tired after battle, come rest your weary head in my lap.
The scenery outside is stunning. You and I should go strolling. I'd love to find out all about your favorite places.
Let's watch out for each other. You know what they say: I'll wash your back if you'll wash mine!
Visit:
Well, well... So you must be [S].
I'm a touch jealous. I was sent to present you with a fond hello from [F].
Level: Now I'll really turn heads in battle.
Oh! That felt good.
Shame on me!
Summon: I'm Camilla, eldest princess from the Kingdom of Nohr. Need my protection, sweetie? Consider me yours.
Learn Skill: What's this? You must be growing fonder of me.
Confession:
Why, if it isn't the one in this whole group who makes me shiver in delight. You, [S]!
I mean, that adorable face. What sort of meanie would think of hurting one hair on your sweet head!
And that weapon of yours! It leaves you totally defenseless. That makes me want to just squeeze you to death!
You can count on your favorite, Camilla, to take care of all of your enemies.
Now, whether I feel that way because you're the summoner and I'm a Hero...then so be it.
I'm in favor of anything that brings us together, even if for a short time. I adore you completely!
Status: Oh? Did you need me? I'm always here for you.
Weary, friend? You may always rest your head in my lap.
Where are the royal baths here? A girl gets dirty in battle.
I'm yours to command. I'll slay anyone for you.
Need I worry for you, my sweet? I do hope all is well.
Where are Beruka and Selena, my darling retainers?
Aren't you adorable? So like my favorite sibling. Why don't you think of me as your big sister?
Thank you for the lovely outfit. Do you think it suits me?
If you're having trouble sleeping, I might be able to help.
Do my enemies truly see me as a creature of nightmares?
The dökkálfar don't seem to realize how adorable they are. What a shame.
I wonder if this outfit might be a bit much.
There is no greater nightmare than being separated from Corrin.
I hope you don't mind if I impose on your dreams tonight.

beruka.name: Beruka
beruka.title: Quiet Assassin
beruka.description: Wyvern-riding assassin who seems devoid of emotion. One of Camilla's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Order of Heroes—hmm, I bet that's just a fancy label for a group of assassins.
My liege is Lady Camilla. She took me under her wing. So I'm going to protect her at all costs.
I'll always follow your instructions in a mission. I can read your lips from all the way across the battlefield.
I need the strongest weapon I can get, but I don't know what that is in this realm. Keep your eyes peeled.
I keep my weapons in top shape. So don't sneak up on me while I'm sharpening them, all right?
Visit:
I'm on a mission to deliver a critical message. Hello... from [F].
Mission complete.
Level: To face me is death.
Time for a new objective...
Summon: I'm Beruka, an assassin from Nohr. Need me for some missions? Fine. I'll take the job.
Learn Skill: More power? Good. I'll need it.
Confession:
[S]... I am glad to see you are still alive.
Why am I glad? ...I don't know.
I am not obligated to you. You are not my liege—we have no contractual arrangement.
However, I...worry about your well-being. Presumably because of your irreplaceable abilities.
Assassins like myself do not get emotionally attached, so I'm sure it's your abilities that concern me.
Status: Need something? Then state it. I can execute any mission.
Name a target. Any target. Until then, I'll be here—getting ready.
I never hold back on the battlefield. I give all. And I take all.
I don't waste time when taking out a target. So, surprise attacks. And poison if I have it.
This realm... These people... It's too bright, all of it.
Where is Lady Camilla? I've got to keep her safe at all costs.
You take to the battlefield with a nonlethal weapon. Hmm.

gordin.name: Gordin
gordin.title: Altean Archer
gordin.description: Altean archer who is masterful with his bow. Looks younger than he actually is. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: So your weapon is like a bow, right? You can fire at things far away? We should practice together sometime!
I'm kind of a baby face and, well, a little childish. I need to work on being more knightly, you know?
I feel like I really do my best with you calling the shots. Thanks for that, [S].
I'd love to give a big, inspiring speech to everyone someday...but I'm not good at that kind of thing.
My archery mentor is a man named Jeorge. He's not just the best shot I know—he's the best person.
Visit:
Hello! Are you [S]?
I've come to bring a hello from [F]!
Level: I had no idea I could improve so much!
Good—one step at a time.
I'll always be a green recruit...
Summon: I'm Gordin—an archer in the service of the Altean knights. And happy to be of help to you too!
Learn Skill: I can hardly wait to see how well I can shoot now!
Confession:
Thanks so much for all your encouragement. I was only able to work this hard because of you.
With your leadership, I was able to help out lots of times, and that makes me real happy.
I just wish I looked as grown-up as I feel! Hahaha—I guess that's asking too much.
I do feel like I'll continue to grow as long as I'm with you, though. Thanks.
Status: Oh, hey. Did you need me?
*chuckles* You checking up on everyone or just me?
I don't really look the part of an Altean knight, do I?
Let's train and improve together. Sound good?
If you had to guess, how old would you say I look?
I know, I know... I look young for my age.
Hey, I'm counting on you. Just thought you should know.
This new outfit is quite dashing, wouldn't you agree?
Whoa! I had no idea you were there!
I'd like to get to know Princess Veronica better. I wonder what she likes?
The other knights seem to think this suits me!
No matter how good I get, I'll never give up practicing my bow. You can always get better!
I think this might make me look more mature. I hope so.
I will cherish this fine outfit you've given me.

jeorge.name: Jeorge
jeorge.title: Perfect Shot
jeorge.description: Archanean archer thought to be the best on his continent. A skilled strategist. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Your realm is goodness itself. That rekindles my faith in people. Courtly intrigue had...smothered it somewhat.
Any nonsense you've heard about my prowess is spread by those who want to bring fame to my family.
I feel you are always coming to my aid. And so I thank you, [S].
I come from a noble family. They have no prowess at anything save intrigue. They are despicable filth.
True aim comes from a strong heart that doesn't waver in the face of obstacles. How's yours?
Visit:
It's a pleasure to meet you.
I come with greetings from [F]!
Level: I wasn't expecting this! A happy miscalculation, to be sure.
Hmm. This seems about right...
Well...er... Unfortunate.
Summon: I'm Jeorge, an Archanean archer. I'm not sure if I have anything to offer you, but you have my aid.
Learn Skill: I must meet your obviously high expectations of me!
Confession:
You've heard tales of me? Well, it's not as if I was trying to keep my life secret, I suppose.
True or not, rumors spread like wildfires. There's no point in trying to correct or refute them.
It's refreshing to speak so frankly. It's wonderful that everyone here trusts each other so implicitly.
Being in such company agrees with me very much. Thank you for bringing me here.
I do believe I shall stick around, if you don't mind.
Status: Curious about me? What would you like to know?
I wasn't expecting you to just walk up and start chatting with me.
The only thing noble about me is my much-vaunted lineage.
I am supposedly the best archer on the continent.
I can't seem to get a read on you.
Are you just being calculating? Or am I?
If I said I'd taken an interest in you...would you believe me?
I was given this new outfit to try on. Am I wearing it correctly?
Hmm? Trying to surprise me again, were you?
Is this not the garb of Askr's enemy? What a curious choice...
Gordin shows a lot of promise. If you give him the chance, he will exceed your expectations.
Many know me as the best sniper in Archanea, a title wholly invented by the shameless glory-seekers in my family.
I hope someday to find a woman who can support me as I would support her.
For you, I find myself aiming to live up to my title.

takumi.name: Takumi
takumi.title: Wild Card
takumi.description: Prince of Hoshido who wields the divine bow Fujin Yumi. Prickly at times. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: So, you've got a divine weapon too? Looks like it's hard to aim. But it really isn't for battle, is it?

My retainers are Hinata and Oboro. They work hard, so I'm glad they know how to relax.
Honestly, I can't help spoiling those two.
I heard you can't fight, so you can count on me...no matter what some people say behind my back.
I like the food of my homeland. Especially miso soup. Maybe you and I can cook something up like that.
I always keep my Fujin Yumi nice and polished. I'm only as good as my weapon. Best to keep it in top shape.
Visit:
I'm here to give you a fine hello from [F].
Now, you be sure to stay in touch.
Level: Phew! Nice growth! What a relief.
All right. Not bad. Not bad at all!
What? It happens!
Summon: I'm Takumi, a prince of Hoshido and wielder of the divine Fujin Yumi. Which makes me pretty useful, I'd say.
Learn Skill: Heh. Nice to see that you're really taking an interest.
Confession:
I've been wondering... How do you think of me? Am I just another Hero to you?
Not that it matters to me. Just curious. But I feel like you acknowledge me and my skill.
If you didn't, why would you spend so much time looking out for me? ...I appreciate that, by the way.
I guess that's all I ever wanted— to be acknowledged for my own abilities. Thank you.
Now just you watch—I'll be the strongest Hero you've ever known.
Status: Must be nice to have free time. Ugh. Sorry, I didn't mean that.
I have nightmares that you wouldn't believe. I wish they'd go away.
Don't worry. I'll obliterate anyone who gets in our way!
Were you happy to see me when I showed up? Hope so.
I have to get stronger! Way stronger! More than my siblings, anyway.
Are Hinata and Oboro around? Not that I need them to relax or anything.
Heh, nice to be needed. But nice to get compliments too.
This outfit is...different. It's supposedly from a place called Hel, if you can believe that.
Whoa! No need to sneak up on me like that. If you want my attention, just say so.
Hoshidan attire is superior, no question, but I figured I'd try this on.
If you're searching for an archer, look no further. Even among all these Heroes, I'm still the best with a bow and arrow.
Just throwing the idea out there...but have you ever thought of ditching that hood? I can barely see your face.
The Realm of the Dead? Yes...it does sound intimidating. But some say that death is a peaceful release...
Death is breathing down our necks, but I'll keep it from catching you for as long as I can.

setsuna.name: Setsuna
setsuna.title: Absent Archer
setsuna.description: Hoshidan archer who is either fearless or daydreaming. One of Hinoka's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Hey, your weapon shoots things. Mine too... It's like we're twins.
I serve Lady Hinoka. She's strong... and kind...and really nice. I like her lots and lots.

On patrol, huh? Watch out for traps. Or you'll fall into one.
Wait... Am I in a trap now?
We should go hunting. We'll step into a trap, I bet. But you can just summon Lady Hinoka to save us.
When I practice at the range here, I nearly hit some guy named Alfonse. Usually, anyway. The face he makes!
Visit:
...[S]?
Oh, good. I'm here to tell you... uh...? Yeah. Hi. Your friend [F] sent me.
Level: I'm doing well...
Woo-hoo.
Yay. Wait, that wasn't much, was it?
Summon: I'm Setsuna from the Kingdom of Hoshido. I'm good with bows. And, uh...falling into traps?
Learn Skill: One step closer to...uh, not stepping into more traps.
Confession:
Woo-hoo. It's you, Summoner. You going to do more of that summoning thing today?
I like a crowd. It's nice. And more of us means more people around to help if I fall into a trap.
That happens all the time, you know. Have I ever mentioned it?
But you know, more of us also means you have less time for me. Sad.
What? You promise you won't forget about me? What? You never could?
Yay. I feel the same. Are you sure we're not the same person? It wouldn't surprise me at all!
Status: Fun times. Good ones too. Every day is a happy day.
I'm in a pit. Oh, no, no. Not now. I mean later, when you can't find me.
You'll help me if I fall into a trap, right?
I love hunting. Anything, really. But little buggies most of all.
I popped out of a divine weapon? Woo-hoo. Always wanted to do that.
Where is Lady Hinoka? She'll totally help if I fall into a trap.
They say I'm a daydreamer. Works for me.

niles.name: Niles
niles.title: Cruel to Be Kind
niles.description: Nohrian scoundrel who wags his saucy tongue at everyone. One of Leo's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: That weapon of yours has such a provocative shape. Does it feel good to fire it? I bet it does.
I serve Lord Leo. He rescued me from my former existence as a filthy thief. I'd give my life for him.
If you run yourself ragged, you should be sure to take a nap. I'd be tickled to show you where.
How about a midnight stroll at some point? I won't bite. I never do. At least, not by the light of the moon.
That prince you serve is a pretty bit of porcelain. But I think he'd look nicer with a few chips.
Visit:
You must be [S].
Someone must be awfully fond of you to send me all this way. And that... is [F]!
Level: My gain will be another's pain.
I deserve better.
How unfortunate.
Summon: I'm Niles from the Kingdom of Nohr. Former outlaw. Current disgrace. My arrows are yours.
Learn Skill: Oh! You've taken some liberties with me. How nice.
Confession:
Here you are. And here I am! Aren't we a pair.
I must confess that I've grown after each of your visits—really and truly, I have!
I must also say that when I first met you, Summoner, I thought you were a fussy bit of butter.
I served you, but not happily. But now! Oh, what a difference! I long to always be with you.
I wonder, have you only indulged your servant Niles? Or are we becoming friends now?
I know some see me as unsavory. To them I say, variety is the spice of life! But, what say you?
Eh? You trust me? How curious. Someone dear to me once said the very same thing.
So, you and I will be friends through thick and thin. And, you know me... I always delight my friends.
Status: Now, now. Be gentle.
Yours until I break, master.
A little advice: wear white, and you invite mudslinging.
So, I came out of that weapon of yours. Scandalous.
Don't you just love to gaze at a full moon?
Where is Lord Leo? I'm sworn to protect him.
You and your prince are in quite a difficult position. I will be glad to assist.
I'm not sure what your game is, having me wear this outfit... But I'm delighted to play.
Don't get yourself too riled up. These clothes are just on loan.
The people of Múspell can be pretty hot-blooded... But play your cards right, and they'll be wrapped around your little finger.
Oh, relax. I may have a new set of threads, but I'm the same Niles you know and love. Don't make me prove it.
Ahh... There's nothing so sublime as watching someone's happiness turn to horror as flames consume all they hold dear...
Does Múspell's moon reflect the crimson of its flames?
Let us set our souls ablaze with the wild flames of passion.

gaius.name: Gaius
gaius.title: Candy Stealer
gaius.description: Thief of Ylisse known for his nimble hands and sweet tooth. Hides sweets in his pockets. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: My emergency torte got crushed in the last fight. I need to reinforce my candy pouches.
I used to do any job for the right price. I grew some standards after I joined the Shepherds.
Hey, nice work out there. I think it's time for a lollipop break, [S].
Hey, do you know where the good beehives are around here? I'm running low on honey.
Hey, try a slice of this cake I made. I think it needs something, but I can't figure out what.
Visit:
So I'm betting that you're [S].
I was hired to come say hello to you. What, by whom? It was [F].
Level: Someone should reward me for this!
A little sugar in my tank, and watch out!
Sweet work.
Summon: I'm Gaius. You need a thief, I've got the goods—as long as you keep me in the sweet stuff.
Learn Skill: I gotta say—that is pretty darn tasty.
Confession:
Hey there. Seems like I've been seeing a lot of you lately, [S].
Here to beg more candy off me?
I'm not sharing this one, though— it's my favorite right now. Packed with sweet, sweet honey...
Hm? You don't want candy? You got work for me, then? ...No?
Wait, you're not just here to spend time with me, are ya? 'Cause that'd make you a big ol' marshmallow.
Only softies try to build relationships up for their own sake. And here you are—soft as cotton candy.
Heh. I changed my mind. Take the honey candy. No reason—just my way of saying thanks.
Status: Sugar...
You got orders for me or something?
You can leave the dirty work to me.
Spying, assassination, and burglary are my specialties. Decent lockpick, too.
Wanna try this coconut brittle? It's crunchy in all the right ways.
I've got sweet little treasures in every pocket and fold of this outfit.
Glad you summoned me here. It's a chance to scrounge up more sweets.

Special: Time to work off the sweets.
Status: As great as a new outfit sounds, what I really want right now is some crème brûlée...
Hey, I'm watching those hands, pal! You're not picking any candy from these pockets.
Múspell is the Kingdom of Flame, right? I better leave the chocolate at home then, or I'll end up in a sticky situation...
I appreciate the new clothes, but don't blame me if they get dirty on the job.
There are some pretty intimidating Heroes in Múspell. I better keep my distance. You know, for the sake of the sweets...and for my own sake, I guess.
Nobody is asking the essential questions about these clothes... For starters, how many pockets does this getup have?
I take my sweets very seriously... You'll know you're on my good side when I offer to share with you.

felicia.name: Felicia
felicia.title: Maid Mayhem
felicia.description: A maid of Nohr who's eager to do good work yet often bungles. One of Corrin's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The outfits for the Order of Heroes are great. I love the fluttery white capes! Wish I could try one on.

Several of us back home have been in charge of looking after our master, Corrin.
There's me—the maid—and my slightly older twin sister, and... who else? Oh yes, Gunter!
So nice that you look out for us. I'd like to do some patrols too. I wouldn't mess it up—promise!
I'm not the best at making tea, but I'll make you some if you want. I... I hope you like it bitter!
I do my best to carry a tea tray with poise and elegance. But, uh... I'll drop it every time!
Visit:
Hello! You know who asked me to stop by and say hello? It was [F]!
And now...I've said it twice!
Level: I think I deserve a raise!
Does this please you?
Whoa, sorry... Flubbed that.
Summon: My name is Felicia. I'm one of the very best maids from the Kingdom of—! Whoa! Sorry. Dropped my tea tray.
Learn Skill: Happy to have this new power! I'll use it to do my best.
Confession:
Oh! I'm so glad I found you! Here, take this! I made you a pot of tea! It's basically a miracle!
Don't laugh—it took me 14 tries! Here, taste some! ...So, how is it?
You like it?! I'm so relieved! I've finally been able to do SOMETHING to repay you.
I'm such a klutz, but you're always so understanding and kind. I wanted to thank you for that.
I've been working hard to be a good help to you, and I promise to keep doing my best!
Status: I'll be sure to wake everyone up first thing in the morning. You can count on it!
Did you know that I'm from the Ice Tribe of my world? Now you do!
Everyone in the Order of Heroes is so elegant... That's nice.
My master is an absolutely wonderful person!
Oh, no! I broke another plate!
Practice makes perfect when making tea. I practice a lot!
I have two left feet. And I'm all thumbs! But I'll do my best for you.

jakob.name: Jakob
jakob.title: Devoted Servant
jakob.description: A butler of Nohr who's superb at his work yet dislikes serving anyone but his liege, Corrin. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
I must say, Summoner, that there's something about you...that I can't quite put my finger on.
I serve a master elsewhere, and yet I find that I'm thoroughly compelled to serve you.
I've dedicated my life to serving my liege, Corrin. Though a butler, I am treated almost like family.
It seems that you're too important to deal with these pesky patrols. Couldn't someone else do it?

I'm forever trying to master the art of making tea, and I'm often in desperate need of a taster.
If your taste is anywhere near as refined as my master Corrin's, you'd be of great help to me!
This kingdom makes such exquisite teakettles. Prince Alfonse lent me one. I owe him thanks for such a kindness.
Visit:
I come bearing a greeting from [F].
Now with that done, I must get to my next task.
Level: Permission to celebrate?
My liege needs me to be yet stronger.
Well, that won't do at all.
Summon: My name is Jakob. I am a Nohrian butler, loyal to my liege, Corrin. I offer you my service, if not my devotion.
Learn Skill: Any butler worth his salt will master any and all abilities.
Confession:
Oh. Did you need something? You've brought me tea? I'm not thirsty at the moment...
But I shall drink it nonetheless. I wouldn't want to waste tea.
It's a bit cold. And too bitter. I would never have served it. But... I sense the effort that went into it.
Regardless of skill, there is flavor in devotion, a taste in affection. You thought of me in making this.
Next time, I shall make the tea for you, and it will taste better than anything you have ever known.
Special: Time to take out the trash.
Status: Care for a cup of tea?
My master is the kindest person you could ever imagine.
Pardon my immodesty, but you see a master butler standing before you.
I dearly hope this realm grows tea plants.
I hate to carry on about my master, Corrin, but you've never met a finer person!
I keep a kettle handy to brew tea for my master, Corrin. I do hope you like tea?
I have to confess... Though I have pledged my service to my master back home, I'm drawn to serve you too.

saizo.name: Saizo
saizo.title: Angry Ninja
saizo.description: A severe ninja of Hoshido. Has a twin brother named Kaze. One of Ryoma's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena aren't attended by bodyguards. Or so it seems...
Surely, they must have a ninja or two in the shadows. But if so, I'm unable to detect any.
I serve Lord Ryoma, the future King of Hoshido. I have long protected him, no matter what the cost.
I appreciate that you do your patrols. But I don't respond well to being stared at. So don't.
You need training. Same goes for everyone here. But you're crucial. And especially defenseless.

I'm always watching over you from the shadows. I've sensed you... sense me. Good.
But not good enough. You miss me most of the time. If I were an enemy, you'd be in your grave by now.
Visit:
You there. I suspect that you are [S], hmm?
Then my mission is nearly over. I bring you greetings from [F].
Level: I can take on anyone.
Soon I will be worthy to serve my liege.
Unacceptable.
Summon: I am a Hoshidan ninja, fifth to bear the proud name of Saizo. I hope you've called me here with good reason.
Learn Skill: Now I'm more worthy of being fifth in a line of Saizos.
Confession:
Hmpf. You always spot me now when I'm around. Not bad, [S].
You couldn't for a while, you know. I'd be standing right here, in front of your face, and you'd be oblivious.
You, our great summoner, were wide open to attack from the shadows! Truly disturbing.
And that's not all. I could follow you for half the day without you ever noticing that I was there.
Oh, now before you run away with any foolish ideas, like maybe I was watching out for you...
I should set the matter straight— that I was only monitoring our weak link.
If you get taken out, then I'll be put in danger. If I get taken out, then my lord, Ryoma, loses my protection.
What I'm trying to say is since you got better at taking care of yourself...
I may be willing to watch out for you from the shadows. A little.
Status: Sorry. Not the type to chat.
Hmm... Is the Order of Heroes some form of royal castle guard?
I never get tired. So don't insult me with coffee or tea. Or candy. Never candy.
You're our leader. So I will respect your authority. Doesn't mean I have to like it.
Why the blazes was I brought here, of all places?
Is Lord Ryoma here? I do have a higher duty, you know.
I'll do everything you command. But only so I can get back home to Hoshido faster!

kagero.name: Kagero
kagero.title: Honorable Ninja
kagero.description: A ninja of Hoshido who is ready to lay down her life for her liege. One of Ryoma's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
The royals of this realm seem to employ no retainers. I find that... interesting.
Both Hoshido and Nohr use them to safeguard royals. Are they that able to defend themselves here?
My liege is Lord Ryoma, a noble leader, strong in spirit and body. It is my honor to serve him.

You are so dutiful. I would be glad to prepare a tea ceremony for you. You'll find it relaxing.
I prefer to use green tea, though mine tends to be bitter. It goes with sweet treats nicely, however.

You're also new here. You'll want to remember everything from these days when all seems unusual.
I find that keeping a diary helps one preserve memories—especially if you draw pictures too.
I draw pictures of the local scenery in my diary. I'm afraid that they look a bit hellish. It's...just how I draw.
Visit:
I've come on a mission from [F].
Basically, it's to say hello. That done, I'll be on my way.
Level: A ninja shows no emotion. Not even joy.
Good enough.
Less than I'd like...
Summon: I am Kagero, a ninja from Hoshido. You have a mission for me? Then I will serve you from the shadows.
Learn Skill: I'll make greater gains with this power. I thank you.
Confession:
I've been doing flower arrangements from whatever I can find in this world. Here's my latest creation.
What do you think of it? Ah. It looks like something from a hellscape? Well, I appreciate your honesty.
Curious to think how I'd have never been able to work with these flowers had I not come to this world.
In a way, you have played a large part in the creation of this flower arrangement.
I can thank you for many things, and most of all, that every one of us remains safe.
So I vow to keep you safe, no matter what dread events come to pass, [S].
Status: Have you known many ninja? We are a...unique breed.
I always carry out my mission. No matter how grave the stakes.
I value activities that require quiet and focus. Flower arranging. Tea ceremonies.
My paintings, my flower arrangements... I'm afraid they're not to everyone's taste.
A ninja should remain in shadow. Until she is summoned.
Where is Lord Ryoma? I have a duty to protect him!
I am often nowhere to be seen in times of war. That's when I'm doing my...best work.

Special: A moment is all I need.
Status: This garb is...far from what I'm accustomed to, but I don't believe it will interfere with my duties.
Wha?! Oh, it's you. I see you've been training in the art of moving stealthily.
Lulling opponents into nightmares and disrupting their slumber, all to sap them of their strength in the waking world... Those dökkàlfar certainly have a terrifying way of doing things.
