My attire matters little—no matter what happens, I will fulfill my duty as a ninja to protect my liege.
The beings called álfar... Perhaps they serve the same role as spirits in my world.
I have sworn to be by Lord Ryoma's side, but letting him see me like this is a little, err, well...
Whatever your dreams may be, I will aid you in pursuing them however I can.

lilina.name: Lilina
lilina.title: Delightful Noble
lilina.description: A noble of Ostia with a natural gift for magic. Roy's friend since childhood. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: It's hard to believe that in this world, I could meet my father...when he was around my age. Astonishing!
My friend Roy and I have known each other a long time. We once went to school together. He's so studious!
Thank you for all that you do. I feel like we can accomplish just about anything with you around!
The amazing Cecilia once said I have a natural talent for magic. To me, that meant I ought to work even harder!
So, you've never studied magic, but you're a summoner with such great power? You must be a natural!
Visit:
Greetings, [S].
I've come today to say hello. And I hope that we will become great friends in time!
Level: How lovely! Now I can help everyone that much more!
A good day! But I must keep pushing myself.
I thought I was working hard enough. Troubling.
Summon: I'm Lilina, daughter of Hector, the Marquess of Ostia. I'm still a student, but I can use fire magic fairly well!
Learn Skill: I've gotten stronger! I hope it'd make my father proud.
Confession:
There's someone in my life whom I dearly want to keep safe.
That is what has driven me to do my best in all things. But now I realize there's a limit to what I can do alone.
Watching you, always working with our allies, has shown me that. People flock to you!
And you're all the stronger for it. You seem to share that very quality with Roy...
So, I just wanted to say thank you. I hope I'll never lose your kind support. I know you'll never lose mine.
Status: OH! Ah, hello there, friend!
Oh, you...! You're such a curious one!
Shall we chat? Just for a while. I know you have plenty to do.
I must really apply myself to studying magic!
I admire your abilities with magic. Really and truly!
What I want most is for the children of all worlds to live in peace. Oh, and to laugh, of course!
I have a good feeling that you and I will be fast friends!
I'm told these clothes come from Múspell, the kingdom of flame.
Eek! Goodness, don't surprise me like that...
My father has clothing from Múspell, too, so we match!
What kind of place is the kingdom of flame? It sounds terribly hot!
Thanks for the clothes. I love the feeling of trying on something new!
I can only imagine Roy's face when he sees me in this outfit.
When I think of you, it sets my heart aflame.

sophia.name: Sophia
sophia.title: Nabata Prophet
sophia.description: A shaman of Nabata who has lived a sheltered life away from other people. Sees the future. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Castles and towns... And so many people... My, it's all so...different from what I'm used to!
I was raised to...avoid... outsiders.
I am half human, half dragon... But why should halves...divide us? My halves make me...whole.
How I long for my village. And most of all...the oasis there. The waters, so pure!

I have been...outside on rare occasion. Everyone can seem so odd to me.
For instance, some arrows are called...quarrels. Isn't that strange?
Visit:
You there... You must be... [S]?
I have seen...your future.
Level: I foresaw that...today would be a good day.
I foresaw that this would come to pass.
My future looks suddenly... very dim.
Summon: I am...Sophia. I am...? Forgive me— I get winded. I am a priestess from the Nabata Desert.
Learn Skill: This—! And my dragon blood—! So light-headed...
Confession:
Your future...has shifted and swirled since we met.
At first, your future was a fog that not even my eyes could pierce.
Over time, I made out the faintest nimbus around you. A weak glow, if you will.
That glow has grown, illumined by light—many lights, from many sources!
These have mystified me until recently, when I realized that I...am one of those lights.
You invite such lights to you, and your glow is becoming like a beacon, banishing the fog!
And so...I want to stay with you to see what your future will look like when the fog...is gone.
Status: Oh...? Did you need me?
Is that...how you say hello?
The outside world...! So vast!
All of this... So exciting!
I feel light-headed...
My blood... Half is that of dragons.
What relief I feel...when I'm near you.
These clothes are from Embla... What do you think?
Ah! Fae also teases me this way.
To close the gates... The royal family of Embla must have great power...
All wrapped up in a cloak...I feel safe.
I wonder... if they saw me like this... what would Fae and Igrene say?
Wearing new clothing...it's very exciting.
As long as I am with you... I can go anywhere...even a new country...

tharja.name: Tharja
tharja.title: Dark Shadow
tharja.description: A mage from Plegia with a dark side and a possessive streak, especially with Robin. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Sharena and Anna both asked me for my "beauty secrets." My secrets have NOTHING to do with beauty...

I served Plegia until I chose to cast my lot with Ylisse. But you know...
I was truly braided by fate with only one person in my past.
Tired from all that walking around? I could curse you so you can't sleep, if you like.
Ah, er, goodness me! This weather is benign, eh? ...Did that sound normal? Which version of me do you like?
I like working on new hexes. So if you talk to me at the wrong time, you might suffer...consequences.
Visit:
I would have words with you. Now, you must be the one called [S], yes?
Someone close to me has taken an interest in you... Someone named [F].
Level: I can feel the darkness growing ever stronger...
Hee hee hee...
Who DARED to curse me?!
Summon: You may call me Tharja. I am a dark mage from Plegia. Now, I shall be your shadow...
Learn Skill: Enhancing MY power? You don't know what's good for you...
Confession:
Ah, excellent—it seems my hex to summon you worked immediately.
Yes, that's right. You came here because of a hex—a hex that made you want to talk to me.
I sprinkled powdered lizard on this paper, and you were drawn toward it. ...Hm? The lizard's worn off...
So you came here of your own free will? Surprising, yet...not.
Heehee... I already have someone I'm destined to be with, but you're just as precious to me.
Special: You won't get away from me.
Status: Did you need something?
I've taken a real interest in you.
Last night you turned over 13 times in your sleep. Impressive.
I like you, but my true devotion is for a particular tactician...
I'll curse all of them. No one will survive.
I just finished it—an extra-special hex just for you.
Heehee... Too late to regret summoning me now.
Yes.
What exactly do you intend by having me wear such...fluttery garb?
Ugh! You are gravely mistaken if you think this outfit will distract me from cursing you.
I don't need to become a ljósálfr to give you dreams... That's what hexes are for.
Ljósálfheimr is home to innocent, lively girls... A world very different than the one I inhabit.
Teehee, I'm a ljósálfr! Sweet dreams for everyone! ...Is that about right?
I can go wherever I want if I'm wearing this outfit, right? I know whose room I'll be investigating later...
Do I ever appear in your dreams?

henry.name: Henry
henry.title: Twisted Mind
henry.description: A dark mage of Plegia with a bright grin and a taste for the gruesome in battle. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: It's so boring here. Without any Risen, who am I supposed to pluck the arms and legs off of? Flies aren't the same...
I kinda miss wizard school. That's where I learned to smile all the time! Also where I got my pain tolerance.

You doing OK, [S]?
No battlefield injuries or anything? I'd hate for you to die yet!
Want to help me with an experiment real quick? It's a hex that kills 100 people at once!
I've been collecting crow feathers for a while. I wonder how many I need to fly...
Visit:
Say, are you [S]?
I come with a big hello from [F]!
Level: I'm a hex of a lot stronger now. Ha! Get it?
Ohhh, wow! When did I grow that?
Nya ha! I hardly learned a thing!
Summon: Hiya! I'm Henry, and I don't want to brag, but I'm preeeeetty much the scariest dark mage in Plegia!
Learn Skill: Oooh! New powers! So who do you want me to curse?
Confession:
Oh! Planning on sending me out to kill some more, [S]?
Nya ha! That's great!
Who's my target? A Hero? Emblian soldier? Oh! Could it be someone in the Order of Heroes?
Huh? Allies don't kill each other? Who told you THAT? Eh, if you say so, I guess...
Then again, I like this place, and I wouldn't want anyone to die.
You won't die, will you, [S]?
If you died, I'd have to invent a horrible new hex for whoever killed you. So just...stay alive, OK?
Status: Wanna play?
Need someone cursed?
All my best friends are crows.
Ready to trade that white cape for a black one like mine?
You don't think I'm scary, do you?
I wonder if it'll hurt when I die...
You need somebody killed? It's no trouble. Like, at all.
Ooh.
Ooh, new clothes, huh? So who do you want cursed?
Hey, don't sneak up on me like that. Do you have a death wish? 'Cause if you do, just say so.
Seiðjárn is SOOO...interesting! *giggle*
How much fun would a REALLY big killing machine be?
What I really want is a machine to help me feed my crow friends...
I don't think it matters how advanced seiðjárn gets. Dead is still dead!
No way I'm gonna let some stupid machine out-kill me. Nuh-uh!

leo.name: Leo
leo.title: Sorcerous Prince
leo.description: A talented Nohrian prince who wields the divine tome Brynhildr. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: So, I came out of that divine weapon of yours, right? Ugh. A disgraceful way to summon royals!
My retainers are Niles and Odin. You might find them...odd. But they're really not bad fellows.
Good work with the patrols. It seems that the Order of Heroes keeps you on your toes. Let me know if I can help.
I'm hoping this place maintains a library. I'd love to pore over books of this realm—especially its history.
I have mastery over gravity, but I'll tell you, it's not the best idea to shake a tree for fruit. What a...mess.
Visit:
Hello there. I've come to convey greetings from someone you know named [F].
So, there you go.
Level: Amazing! Then again, I did work hard for it.
Any growth is good growth.
Given that, I can hardly call anyone else a disgrace.
Summon:
I am Leo, a prince of Nohr. I hold the divine tome Brynhildr, which grants me mastery over gravity.
With less than a gesture, I have blasted many a fool to ashes.
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude for giving me more power.
Confession:
I'm not surprised to see you here, [S]. You always seem eager to chat.
Even when I am cold and distant with you, you check up on me after battle with a kind word.
And that concern and connection have made me stronger than I've ever been.
This isn't something I would normally say aloud, but you make me feel valuable—even needed.
That's why...I want you always to stay by my side.
I never would have imagined this when I first got here, but...I feel as if I could trust my life to you.
Argh, I sound pathetic. I don't imagine you'll ever let me hear the end of this, will you?
Status: Care to chat? I'm always up for stimulating discussion.
I rarely while away the time. But glad to do so with you.
I have achieved mastery over gravity, thanks to my divine tome, Brynhildr.
You'd never guess what vegetable really catches my fancy. Tomatoes.
If you ever see my collar inside out, please tell me. Not that it ever happens.
Where are Niles and Odin? Those two, always gallivanting off...
I'll expect clear orders in battle. Ugh, I'm sorry. I know you're on top of things.

linde.name: Linde
linde.title: Light Mage
linde.description: Daughter of Pontifex Miloah from Archanea. Inherited the light tome Aura. Wants to avenge her father's death. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I will avenge my father by destroying Gharnef with my inheritance, the great tome Aura!
I was once captured by some ruffians. It was terrifying, but Prince Marth saved me.
I wanted to thank you. I know that you've been looking out for all of us.
Thank you for the kind words about my outfit, but please don't make a fuss.
This robe is precious to me. It was a gift from my late father.
Visit:
I think that you must be [S], yes?
I've been sent to say hello by [F].
Level: Today is turning out pretty nicely!
I'm starting to come into my true power.
I can't bear the thought of my father seeing me like this.
Summon: I am Linde, daughter to Pontifex Miloah. I...also don't like having everyone look at me.
Learn Skill: It is not enough that I inherited Aura—I must be worthy of it.
Confession:
Excuse me—not to embarrass you or anything—but I wanted to thank you.
Much has happened since we first met, but I've made a lot of happy memories with you and the others.
Back where I came from, I had just lost my father, and I was...so...
Sorry. I'm OK now. But I wanted you to know how grateful I am for this new life.
Thank you for your concern and your kindness. You are an inspiration to everyone.
Status: Did you need me for something?
Ah! What do you want?
These clothes were a gift from my father. I wear them in his honor.
I'm a little shy with crowds, but I'm not embarrassed by anything I've done.
I'm proud to call myself Miloah's child.
I will avenge my father and bring his killer to justice.
Oh, care for a longer chat?
I thought it was about time I change my outfit. What do you think?
Eek! Ooh, how many times must I tell you: Stop sneaking up on me!
I know it's different, but...this clothing is comforting somehow. I can't quite explain it!
I'm still quite fond of my usual outfit. It was a gift from my father...
Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena are always so kind to me.
It would be wonderful if I could meet my father in this world...
Our clothes match now! I suppose that's not so unusual for you, is it?

mrobin.name: Robin
mrobin.title: High Deliverer
mrobin.description: A tactician of Ylisse and Chrom's close ally. Lost memory of his life before meeting Chrom. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Is everyone here a Hero summoned from somewhere else?

I have no memories from before the time I met Chrom. But I still have a fine mind for tactics.
Oh, you too? How intriguing.
Back home, I was always checking on everyone, too. It helps me relax, knowing they're safe and well.
Do you have a moment to go over some tactical options? I'd love to hear your thoughts.
This kingdom has some amazing authors! ...Oh, ah, is it OK if I borrow books from the library?
Visit:
Nice to meet you. I'm Robin.
I was asked to come say hello by your good friend [F].
Level: Even I couldn't have seen this coming!
This is all part of the plan.
Er, is that it?
Summon: Hello, I'm Robin. I'm a tactician for the Shepherds, so let me know if you need a battle plan.
Learn Skill: I'm glad you see my strategic value to the team.
Confession:
I appreciate the opportunity you've given me to observe your battle tactics in depth.
Every time we head out, I can't help but be proud that you've chosen me to fight at your side.
But I do feel bad for interfering with the bonding process between partners.
You and Alfonse share something special, right? Similar to the bond between Chrom and me?
But there is also an understanding between fellow tacticians, and I vow to support you to the end.
Status: We'll win our next battle—I guarantee it.
Did you say something? I was just planning...
Odd to think I came out of that divine...thing.
I don't know why, but I feel a strange kinship with you.
Oh, good—I've still got my memories of being in Ylisse.
I wonder if Chrom is around here...
I want you to know you can count on me out in the field.
These are the raiments of Hel, the realm of the dead. Don't read too much into that.
I may look a little scary, but I'm still the same Robin underneath. Have no fear.
Each time you brave the battlefield, you must come to terms with death. It never gets any easier.
You know what…? This outfit is actually pretty cool, if I do say so myself.
Wonder what Chrom will have to say about this getup? He'll…probably tell me to go change.
May the cold grasp of death keep far away from my treasured friends...
Come what may, please know that I will do everything in my power to ensure you live on.

odin.name: Odin
odin.title: Potent Force
odin.description: A mysterious man who tends to be overly theatrical. One of Leo's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Ah, friend of this force! Your order needs Heroes to face a grave threat. Well, Odin Dark is up to the task!
I serve Leo! Lord of Nohr. Prince of darkness. Man of umbral moods. (And a pretty awesome guy!)
You, who purifies evil! Who purges malevolence! Slumber if you tire. (Basically, take breaks, OK?)
This place! Oh, its forbidden rooms! Legendary weapons! Wondrous things! (Tons of stuff. So exciting!)

I specialize in probing beyond the ordinary words for weapons to find their true names of power!
Missiletainn is the greatest such name I have ever known. I will give thought to what your weapon's true name is.
Visit:
A friend of yours sent me with a missive of massive import. Now, [F] says...
Hi.
Level: Yes! My true power awakens further!
My hidden potential hides less and less each day!
What?! Has some foul influence leeched my growing power?
Summon: I am Odin Dark. Mage of Nohr! Twilight traveler! Infinite enigma! (And, hey, all-around nice guy.)
Learn Skill: Oh, architect of my excellence! (Thanks for the bump, buddy!)
Confession:
Ha! My third eye told me you would appear in this holy shrine to heroism and warfare.
I would speak with the anointed champion, plucked by fate from— Wait, come back! Don't leave!
I just wanted to say I knew I'd run into you if I waited here. I actually need to talk with you.
I feel like we've gotten real close, and I don't want to keep secrets from you.
I must therefore reveal that I am NOT Odin at all but a warrior of hope from another time...Owain!
Yeah, yeah, enough with the theatrics... But let me tell you this: I have not and will not lie to you.
Status: Odin will always do his darkest to assist you.
You have my infinite gratitude for watching over me.
Hey! You should have some big lines to say when summoning! I'll think some up for you!
Summoner? Order of Heroes? You bask in the light of some powerful words, friend!
Odin Dark never fathomed that he would find himself in a place like this!
Where is my excellent Lord Leo? I ought to be by his side!
Your divine weapon's name is Breidablik? Oh, who am I kidding?! How cool is that!

Special: Join me in this dance of death...
Status: This deathly garb ignites the smoldering flames of my slumbering soul—Oh, you think it suits me? Well, of course it does! Naturally you'd think so!
Ahhh! Wh-what? Don't surprise me like that!
Hel, the realm of the dead...and the true homeland of all who fight with death ever at their side. Destiny will call me there, one day… Hmm, yeah, I can work with this.
Hold, friend! I'm trying to come up with a new catchphrase worthy of this garb…
No, I haven't spoken to Princess Eir yet. Listen, she's just kind of hard to approach, OK?
Lord Leo, where are you? You're gonna love my cool new look!
Your generosity brings life's warmth to my heart, whose beat had slowed, and inspires me to... Um... Well, I...I will continue to do my best.

ursula.name: Ursula
ursula.title: Blue Crow
ursula.description: A cruel member of the Black Fang assassins. Lends her service only to someone truly perfect. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
The castle has terrible defenses. With all these travelers from other worlds, what would happen if...
You know, if ONE was an assassin? A treacherous one, I mean!

I was once ordered to assassinate Eliwood, a noble of Pherae. But I must admit that I didn't succeed.
Rare for me to let my lessers... get in my way.

I find you perfect in so many ways and so wonderful to serve. But if you get too tired...?
Well, I'm just saying that your flaws would start to show. And we CAN'T have that.

I belong to the Black Fang, a group of assassins. I'm among their very elite, known as the Four Fangs.
I'd be the weakest of the four in a direct fight. But what assassin worth her salt is EVER direct?
Now, you keep striving for absolute perfection in all things, and I'll follow you to the ends of the world.
Visit: Ah. I was sent to say hello by— Hmm. Nice army here. I wonder how long it'd take me to finish them off...
Level: Ha ha! Perfection!
Heh. Not bad.
I live for perfection. This... won't do.
Summon: I am the feared Blue Crow. You may call me Ursula. I...sense perfection in you. You have my loyalty.
Learn Skill: In gratitude, I'll be delighted to slay anyone for you.
Confession:
You may have gleaned that I will serve only a perfect master, [S].
I have no friendship to offer you. Nor will I take any. It would be an insult to the both of us.
Why, what are two friends but a pair of failures who've merely agreed to cover for each other?
I give you my loyalty because you're worthy. You don't battle, but your tactics are exquisite!
But...
I will say that if you falter, even in the slightest, you do know how our little arrangement ends, right?
Hmm, yes, I think you do. Then best you make yourself productive. The Blue Crow...is watching.
Status: Oh? Do you require my services?
Never poke an assassin. Lest she...poke you.
Ursula, Blue Crow... No matter the name, the end is still the same.
All you need do is point at someone. That person will simply...disappear.
The light of day is ghastly. Don't you agree?
Perfection...or oblivion. Really, it's quite obvious.
Serving you...has its delights.
So you gift me the garb of a dökkálfr... It appears I'm not the only one with good taste.
Hm? Did you think I would follow your command simply because you gave me new clothes?
The dökkálfar are like fairies who dance in the shadows and deliver nightmares... I suppose I can see the resemblance.
Assassinations would be remarkably simple if I could actually fly. How unfortunate that I cannot.
Useless fools deserve a nightmare or two.
Were I to fail my mission dressed like this... I'd be quite a pretty sight.
Is our time together a blissful dream? Or is it something else entirely?

merric.name: Merric
merric.title: Wind Mage
merric.description: Wind mage who studied in Khadein, known for its magical school. Marth's childhood friend. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: May I ask about your summoning magic? You tie the skies together? Is that wind magic like my own?
I studied in Khadein, the City of Magic. It was a remarkable place, with desert sand to the horizons...
Thank you for what you do. Your guidance keeps everyone motivated and safe.
I've known Prince Marth and his sister Princess Elice for many years. They are truly good people.
I've always been physically weak. But I wanted to protect...people precious to me, so I studied magic.
Visit:
Let's see now... You must be [S], right?
I'm Merric—here with a hello from [F]!
Level: It seems the Excalibur tome has guided me well.
My body feels so light! I can move like the wind itself!
It seems I haven't trained enough. I will begin again with the basics.
Summon: I am Merric, a mage from Altea. What I learned of wind magic in Khadein is at your disposal.
Learn Skill: I will use this new power to protect those precious to me.
Confession:
It's been some time since we began to fight side by side, yet you still find ways to surprise me.
I don't mean that in a bad way! You're just...a very mysterious person.
You're not like anyone I've met. The things you come up with...the rest of us have never dreamed of.
You are like a wind that blows through each of our lives and changes our fates.
So please know that I believe in you and your abilities. I will work with you as long as you'll have me.
Status: Is something the matter?
Er, could you perhaps find another way to get my attention?
Ah, what a pleasant breeze...
I've been reading the most fascinating tome!
If you don't mind, I would like to chat with you.
The magic I have learned must protect everyone.
I enjoy spending time with you. It puts me at ease.

Special: I won't lose us this battle!
Status: This clothing is from a realm known as Niðavellir.
What? Hah! Word to the wise—if you can't can't resist that impulse for mischief, you may anger your allies!
Niðavellir's civilization has advanced considerably. I am eager to learn more about it!
Whatever I can do to ensure the betterment of Altea, I will do it.
Changing your garb does have an effect, doesn't it? I feel driven!
If only I could come to understand the workings of Seiðjárn... I am certain this would be of no small help to Prince Marth.
Ever since you summoned me here...I have never stopped learning.

nino.name: Nino
nino.title: Pious Mage
nino.description: A kindhearted member of the Black Fang assassins. Longed to help her mother. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I hope you'll read books to me a lot. I'm trying to learn how to read, so every little bit helps!
Oh, Lloyd...Linus...and dear old Uncle Legault...
Thanks so much for all you do! Just be sure not to exhaust yourself, OK?
Family is...so important. If I ever have a chance to have my own family, I'd love twins!
I'd love to try cooking sometime. Sweets, if I can! Think it'd be possible to do that here?
Visit:
Oh, is it you? It must be! You're [S], right?
I'm Nino! And I've come to deliver a hello from a friend of yours!
Level: Now, leave everything to me! I know I can do it!
Now I'll be of more help here!
No! I don't want to be useless forever!
Summon: I'm Nino, a member of the Black Fang! Oh, well...I guess these days I'm just a regular ol' mage.
Learn Skill: You know I'll do my best. The Black Fang trained me!
Confession:
I'm so happy to be here, where I can spend time with so many nice people. Every day is so fun.
I had this once before, surrounded by people I loved. They were all...like family.
That life is over, but it was so much fun while it lasted. I'm glad now, thinking back on it.
Those memories were painful for a while, but you helped me remember the good times.
Thank you! I promise to work so very hard for you. Just you wait and see!
Status: What do you need? To talk? I'm always up for that!
Aaah! Whew! Got scared for a second.
I never learned to read very well. You'll help me with that, right?
I'll work really hard for you. Cross my heart and hope to die!
You can't imagine how happy I am to be here!
The Black Fang was my family. I...wonder how the rest of them are doing.
I love baked dumplings more than anything! We should find some!
These clothes are from the Emblian Empire, tee-hee! What do you think of 'em?
WHOA! You sure woke me up! You must really like to scare people.
This outfit is fun, but my normal clothes are important to me too. They remind me of my brothers...
All Jaffar had to say about my clothes was, "Huh." What a stick-in-the-mud!
Now that we match, do you think Princess Veronica would talk to me?
I hope that here, my brothers can have happy lives, at least...
I'm grateful for these nice clothes. They make me so happy!

frobin.name: Robin
frobin.title: Mystery Tactician
frobin.description: A tactician of Ylisse and Chrom's close ally. Lost memory of her life before meeting Chrom. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I don't feel any different here than back home, so what makes me a Hero in this world?
Chrom once found me unconscious and with no memory. He helped me, and I joined the Shepherds.
I admire your diligence. The way you're always running around reminds me of myself.
I've got a plan, but I don't know how it'll work in this world. We should be sure to discuss it at length.
The library is fantastic! So many wonderful books. Hmm. I probably should get permission to go there.
Visit:
Nice to meet you. I'm Robin.
I was asked to come say hello by your good friend [F].
Level: Even I couldn't have seen this coming!
This is all part of the plan.
Er, is that it?
Summon: My name is Robin, the tactician for Chrom's Shepherds. I'm sure you'll find me useful on the battlefield.
Learn Skill: I'm glad you see my strategic value to the team.
Confession:
We've been through a lot together on the battlefield, and I've watched you every step of the way.
Not to be presumptuous, but the way you fight, your tactical skill, the way you keep everyone safe...
It all reminds me of myself and how I led my friends in battle back in my own world.
That means I also know how much you care about all of us and how painful your position can be.
If that weight gets to be too much, I want you to lean on me. After all, I've been at this for a while...
I might just come up with an amazing plan that solves all your problems, on or off the battlefield!
Special: Bet you didn't see that coming!
Status: Oh, hey! I was just thinking I'd like to chat with you.
Let's work on a battle plan together.
I understand you're the tactician for this team.
I don't know why, but I feel a strange kinship with you.
My time before I arrived in Ylisse was a blank. No memories at all.
I wonder if Chrom is around here...
I look forward to working with you for a good, long time.
This outfit is... Well, it's a little macabre, isn't it?
*gasp* I was so surprised, I thought my heart would stop.
Princess Eir is often quiet, but I do not believe she is cold-hearted.
The realm of the dead is certainly frightening. But aren't you a little bit curious what it looks like?
Chrom appears to think this is an unusual state of affairs, and won't stop eyeing me. I wish he'd just get used to it.
I hope that all those who perish in battle can find a peaceful rest. They deserve that much, at least.
The warmth of your hands is something I hope I can always protect.

cecilia.name: Cecilia
cecilia.title: Etrurian General
cecilia.description: Mage General of Etruria. Taught Roy and Lilina when they were young. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Commander Anna seems to be a fine instructor. My methods are different, but I believe we will get along well.
I served as a teacher to Roy and Lilina, two of my favorite students. Both were such adorable pupils.
Serving as a tactician here must be quite taxing. If ever a cup of tea would help, I would like to join you.
You are the tactician in battle. And I, yours to deploy. Our friendship must never disrupt that chain of command.
Though I have taught the art of battle to others, like Roy, I would love to learn all that you can teach me.
Visit:
How do you do? I take it that you are [S]?
I am Cecilia, come to greet you.
Level: How very nice to attain such remarkable gains!
Any improvement is welcome.
I may have to relinquish my title at this rate.
Summon: I am Cecilia, the Mage General of Etruria. Are you the tactician here? Pleased to meet you.
Learn Skill: You chose to bestow this on me. I will live up to your expectations.
Confession:
When I first met you, my intention was to teach you, much as I did my pupils Roy and Lilina.
But then I saw how quickly you grew in your role here, to the extent that you surpassed even me.
It's the bittersweet moment that every teacher goes through, to see those around her learn to soar.
That is the moment when she feels left behind...
What? You still need me? It's a relief to hear you say that. Perhaps I have more still to teach.
Well, then it's settled. I will be staying here after all!
Status: How fare you, tactician?
Now, now... No need to nudge me. You have my attention.
I sense a great deal of talent in you. You're a natural.
Shall we discuss battle strategy?
Should you wish to know anything at all, simply ask!
I will ever do my best to fulfill my role.
You have much to teach, and even I have much to learn.
This is a rather distinctive outfit, wouldn't you agree?
If you want my attention, speak clearly.
I do hate nightmares, but... Let's just think of them as pranks.
Proper sleep is required for optimal learning. Don't stay up too late now.
I'd like to study Dökkálfheimr. There is much to learn.
Carrying the future is quite a burden. The least we can do is give the children good dreams.
Tell me... What do you dream?

wrys.name: Wrys
wrys.title: Kindly Priest
wrys.description: Humble priest of Talys who likes a quiet life. Despises battle, preferring to heal allies. Appears in Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon & the Blade of Light.
wrys.origin: Shadow Dragon & the Blade of Light

Castle Hall: This world is so close to the heavens... When you summoned me, I assumed my time had come!
I hope the children at the orphanage are doing well without me...
I applaud your constant patrols. If I could simply keep up, I would join you, but alas...
Be careful not to overextend yourself. It's important to take time to simply pause and reflect.
Grooming is simple with a head like mine! If you like, I could give you the same cut...
Visit: I am Wrys, a humble curate. I cannot fight, but this staff I carry can heal the wounded.
Level: I suppose miracles happen after all!
At my age, this feels like a job well done!
Mm. Old age is catching up to me...
Summon: I am Wrys, a humble curate. I cannot fight, but this staff I carry can heal the wounded.
Learn Skill: I see you're a risk taker! I'll try to live up to your expectations.
Confession:
I must admit...being surrounded by so many young people has me pushing myself beyond my years.
But the journey has been very much worthwhile. I have seen that there is still much I can do.
I will keep my prayers with those who have guided me on my way... and that includes you.
Please continue to use this feeble old man in whatever way will help your cause.
Let all be as the gods will.
Status: Here to do what I can.
May my healing help.
Are you injured? Let me help.
Oh, my my...
How can a humble curate help you today?
I wonder how the children are faring back home...
I shall attend to your wounds whenever you need.

maria.name: Maria
maria.title: Minerva's Sister
maria.description: Princess of Macedon. Younger sister of Minerva and Michalis, whom she loves dearly. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena are such close siblings... I'm pretty jealous.
Michalis...Minerva...I wish we could all live together again...
Be sure to take breaks sometimes! And if you ever get hurt, I'll take care of you, [S].
Will you go on a walk with me? Anna says I'm too young to go out alone.
This castle is big! We should play hide-and-seek.
Visit:
I bet you're the one here called [S], right?
I'm Maria. I just came to say hello!
Level: Just one more step to being as strong as my brother!
I'm getting as powerful as my sister—bit by bit!
Awww... Disappointing!
Summon: I'm Maria, and I'm a real princess from Macedon. I'll do my best to help everyone, so keep me nearby!
Learn Skill: I can't be a burden—I need to be even stronger!
Confession:
Heeheehee! What do you think— the strongest I've been yet, right?
My siblings have always protected me, and I knew someday I had to be strong enough to protect myself.
But you've helped me realize that "someday" isn't good enough! I need to be strong now.
Fighting is no fun, but I think it's why I've gotten as strong as I have.
Thanks for helping me realize my dream!
Status: I'm here with you.
I always do my best!
Oh! What? What is it?
Someday I want to grow up big like my sister.
Wait! Have more time to talk?
Michalis... Minerva...
I'll stay with you. I can, right?

serra.name: Serra
serra.title: Outspoken Cleric
serra.description: Cleric who thinks less of others, more of herself. Serves Hector, brother of the Marquess of Ostia. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
Excuse me. Girl praying here.
...Saint Elimine... Please make sure everyone stays safe... And that they all give me my fair share...

Just between us, I might look like your usual cleric type, but you know what I really am? A count's daughter!
What?! I really am!

I will always be there when you need me, whether you're injured in battle or exhausted from duty.
And I'll expect some token of thanks from you—which is only fair, right?

I'm always on the lookout for a good servant. Only qualified people, you understand.
I bet you'd be really good at it, though!

If there's one thing I want in life, it's for everyone to be healthy.
But also money and jewels. And great food and fancy friends. Oh! And a royal title befitting my station!
Visit: I'm Serra. Happy to see me? Sure you are. I came ALL the way here to see you, friend!
Level: I'm just a natural!
Ha! Proof of my noble blood.
No, no, no! I can't believe that just happened!
Summon: I'm Serra—a sweet, helpless cleric. So, now that we've got that settled, don't push me too hard, OK?
Learn Skill: Wha—? You made me stronger? Now I have to do more?!
Confession:
By Saint Elimine, you certainly have turned my life upside down since you brought me here!
Go here...battle there...heal this person...then that person...
Why, don't you realize that I'm pretty as a petal and TWICE as fragile?
But I do need to offer my thanks. I have developed a...thicker skin, thanks to you.
And by that, I mean that my skin has actually gotten THICK, being in such harsh conditions!
Still, it's not entirely awful having everyone dote on me, hoping that I'll help them out.
Don't worry. I'll always make time to help you too—as long as you call me Lady Serra at all times. Got it?
Special: Take pity on little old me!
Status: Adore me!
I'm here. Lucky you!
Did you bring me a little gift? Or a BIG one?
Oh, I'd never ask you to rub my shoulders. It's my FEET that are sore!
Battles have such a terrible cost. All that time in the sun? My skin is so dry!
I am a count's daughter. I really, really am!
You will protect little old me, won't you?
Adore me!
I'm here. Lucky you!
I look good in anything, don't I? So, what do you think?
Nifl is a land of ice and snow... But I just can't stand the cold!
A-HEM! I've been waiting VERY patiently to hear some compliments on my new outfit. You're not very thoughtful, are you?
You know...you can tell just how big my heart is from how willing I've been to listen to your orders, can't you?
Hmm... You'll do. For the moment. If it's what you want, I'll stay here with you.

lissa.name: Lissa
lissa.title: Sprightly Cleric
lissa.description: Princess of Ylisse's royal house and Chrom's younger sister. Determined to prove herself. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I wish I knew why I don't have the royal Brand like my brother and sister...
I'm a Shepherd, just like my brother. We travel everywhere and help people all over the world!
You feeling OK? If you get hurt, just let me know. I'll have you patched up in a jiffy!
Sharena seems nice. I wonder if we could have a "princess chat" sometime...

Heehee! I'll put the frog here and... AH, [S]?!
Awww, you caught me before I pulled the BEST prank!
Visit:
Hey, [S]!
Guess who sent me to say hello? It was [F]!
Level: I think I'm ready for the front lines!
I've still got a few tricks up my sleeve!
Maybe I didn't work hard enough?
Summon: I'm Lissa, and despite what my brother says, I am not delicate! I'm a princess and a member of the Shepherds!
Learn Skill: I've come far since meeting you.
Confession:
Hey! I was thinking that I've grown up a lot since I got here. Don'tcha think, [S]?
I've learned to fight, I've made friends with people in the Order, and I always clean my plate!
...Thanks! Glad you agree! Of course, it's all because of your help that I'm so princessy now!
I feel like I'm one step closer to being the ideal lady. I hope you'll keep helping me get there!
Oh, and I've gotten better at little pranks, too. I can't wait for you to find the frog I just hid!
Status: Let's do our best!
Always glad to help.
I've been called "delicate" but only by big, jerky brothers.
Hey, hey! Tell me all about yourself.
I love this team you've built! What other tricks have you got up your sleeve?
Someday I'll work on being a proper lady like my sister...
Let's not waste this opportunity to become good friends!

sakura.name: Sakura
sakura.title: Loving Priestess
sakura.description: Princess of Hoshido who is a gentle healer. Struggles with her shyness. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Do none of you members of the Order of Heroes use staves to support others in battle? Then I'll double my efforts!
My retainers are Hana and Subaki, both equally strong and reliable. Th-they're almost too good for me!
Are you checking on the others? So was I. It's important to make sure that everyone's doing all right.
I'm pretty fond of sweets. If you see any sweetshops around, please let me know right away!
Sorry, I was just practicing. I really want to be as useful as all my older siblings are in battle.
Visit: Why, hello! I come with greetings from [F]!
Level: Now I can really do my part!
That was nice! Every bit helps.
Oh, my! I'll just need to try harder.
Summon: I'm a princess from the Kingdom of Hoshido. But, please, call me Sakura. I'm delighted to help you!
Learn Skill: You've made me stronger? Thank you so much!
Confession:
Oh! Thank you so very much for checking up on me, [S].
I'm doing well, but may I tell you something? When I first got here, I wasn't sure how to act around you.
They call you a Great Hero, so I thought I should respect such a great person by keeping my distance.
But then I got to know you. You're so kind and put everyone at ease—most of all, me.
It's almost like you've become a part of my family. I mean, here we are now, simply chatting.
S-so now...I have s-something to ask you. Would you consider thinking of m-me...
as a friend?
What? You already do? Why, that's wonderful! I am so glad you summoned me into your life.
I promise to help you any way that I can...friend!
Status: I'll do my best for you!
Please, take care!
I'm still finding my voice...but I like speaking with you!
This realm is so beautiful, much like my homeland, Hoshido.
I hope to grow every bit as strong as my siblings.
Have you seen my retainers? Hana? Or Subaki?
I'd like to learn everything about this realm. And...you too.

azama.name: Azama
azama.title: Carefree Monk
azama.description: A monk of Hoshido with a curious sense of humor. One of Hinoka's retainers. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The look on someone's face after being summoned is priceless. Such bewilderment!
My liege is Lady Hinoka—a woman of many marvels. I never tire of basking in her glow!
It's nice that you look after us, but you needn't tire yourself. We of flesh and bone are either alive...or not.
I sense you're troubled by deep thoughts. Glad to help. Let's partake in shallow conversation!
Do I spend time praying? Never. It's like throwing crumbs to the wind—with no birds in sight.
Visit:
I bear a load of hellos from [F]!
Glad to be little more than a mule in this situation.
Level: Strength is fleeting, but I really do enjoy this.
Oh, how lovely. Praise Hotoke.
Ha! Little or nothing! That's life, in a nutshell.
Summon: I'm the monk Azama from Hoshido. How odd, being summoned! I'll give you a hand, as long as I'm here.
Learn Skill: Oh my! It's like a brisk wind, ruffling my robes!
Confession:
Ah, it is you! I should have known from the ever-busy pitter-pat of your footsteps.
You must have far too much free time on your hands if you're always spending it with me.
Why, who am I to deserve it? I'm just a holy man, not worth even the time of day.
Now, speaking of free time, do you plan to ever free me of my time here with you?
I mean, of course, final release. The good-bye. The farewell. The ta-ta and toodle-oo!
I shouldn't let myself be troubled by the idea that we'd be separated.
But I've grown fond of you. I'd like to give you more of my time, not less.
So please, don't give me any of that sort of free time—not for years and years. All right?
Status: Do be careful.
What to do with you?
I assure you, I am a devoted monk. But devotion takes many forms.
Worrying? Suffering? No, no, no. Let's not waste any time on that.
Heavenly vistas? People dressed in white? It's almost like...we've passed to the other side.
Where is my Lady Hinoka? She does scourge me so if I don't come running.
Summoning? Forcing poor souls to fight? Ghastly. But also quite whimsical, so count me in!
Interesting...
Do be careful.
What to do with you?
Does making me wear eccentric outfits amuse you?
Hoshido ought to consider adopting the teachings of seiðjárn.
The people of Niðavellir could stand to loosen up a bit.
Gods and kings can be fools too. The only difference is people being afraid to say so.
If you think a new outfit is going to put a spring in my step, you don't know me as well as I'd supposed.

azama.resplendent: Kinota Tano (田野きの太) / Trys Inc.

clarine.name: Clarine
clarine.title: Refined Noble
clarine.description: Noble daughter of Count Reglay of Etruria. Fond of her brother, Klein. Has lived a privileged life. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: You may correct me if I'm wrong, but you seem to know a bit of etiquette. Did you learn it where you're from?
I shall be a beautiful Mage General like Lady Cecilia in due time. Oh, if only my brother could see that day!

Oh! On close inspection, you look twice as nice as I thought. But if you take a look at me, you'll see that I—
Hey, are you listening to me?!
I am infinitely busy, of course, but I always have time for you. But, please, do me a favor and make it quick.
How to properly do this or that, such as wearing fashions or dancing... Why, it's all a cinch for me.
Visit:
Ah. May I presume you to be [S]?
You have the great honor of receiving a greeting from me, in person.
Level: It's only natural that I sparkle so!
I come from a fine bloodline, so this is only expected.
What, nothing more? But that's preposterous!
Summon: I am Clarine, the very talented daughter of Count Reglay of Etruria. And who, may I ask, are you?
Learn Skill: A fine lady must sparkle in both strength and style.
Confession:
My word! Is it just me, or is nearly every single person here sorely lacking in etiquette?
I don't mean you, of course. Never you—for I have the sort of manners never to say so!
But I must risk offense and tell you the truth. People look to you to set a higher standard.
What? They do! All are quite aware that if we don't use our napkins properly, it will be anarchy!
So, because I am grateful for everything that you do, I will take you on as a special project.
You'll have manners coming out your ears by the time I'm finished with you. Won't this be fun?
Status: I shall save you.
You must be grateful!
Do you need me for something? Whatever can it be?
Now, just who do you think you are, getting my attention that way!
I shall teach you the ways of superlative style.
A lady must always aspire to the highest standards of beauty.
Tea, with me... You know, I think I shall.

elise.name: Elise
elise.title: Budding Flower
elise.description: Princess of Nohr who adores her siblings. A bit childish, but has a pure heart and keen eyes. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I like that Sharena—maybe because neither of us act like princesses. Oh! I hope she wouldn't be offended!
My retainers are Effie and Arthur, two of the nicest retainers a girl could ever have. I'm so proud of them!

I'm impressed by how well you keep an eye on things here, [S]!
I'll help you with my staff if you ever get worn out!
Let's sneak off sometime to explore the town! I used to do that all the time back home—but don't tell my brothers!
This realm has so many beautiful flowers! I'm going to pick all of them and pass them out to everybody!
Visit:
I've come on an important errand from [F].
I'm here to deliver the happiest of hellos. So, here I am!
Level: Step back, world! This girl is on fire!
Yay! I'm such a good fighter now!
All that hard work for this?! Boo.
Summon: Hi, I'm Elise—a princess from the Kingdom of Nohr! I bet we're going to be the best of friends!
Learn Skill: Yay! Now I'll sparkle even more!
Confession:
Yay! I always love it when you come chat with me, [S]!
I know how busy you are. Wait... Are you hurt? Even a little? Then I'll heal you up real fast!
Whew! There. I can't stand to see you hurt. It's like I'm hurt too. And you know why?
Sure you do. Because I love you bunches and bunches—more than anyone from any other world!
You were the first friend I made here. And you know what? That kind of friendship lasts forever!
Status: Go, team!
Glad to help!
I'm always up for a good game!
Nice that people like me are called Heroes here! We do our best!
I have so many older siblings in my family!
Where are Effie and Arthur? We always go exploring together!
Thanks for bringing me here. I really, really love it!
Go, team!
Glad to help!
Thanks for the outfit. I love it!
I've always believed that fairies were real, and now I'm an álfr!
My siblings really gushed over this outfit. They said it was cute beyond belief!
I dream that everyone will live in peace. One day.
I bet I could show you tons of good dreams if you let me try!

ytiki.name: Tiki
ytiki.title: Dragon Scion
ytiki.description: A young Divine Dragon once put into a timeless sleep to keep her dragon impulses in check. Now longs for human company. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Your castle smells great! What is that smell? It makes me a little sleepy...
Right now, everything is just so, you know, FUN!
I get to be with everyone all the time 'cause you called me! Thanks!
I used to have scary dreams... about becoming a monster and stuff... But I don't have them now!
I went into town the other day. Guess what? Everyone was so nice! You should go sometime!
Visit: I came to say hello! Hi!
Level: What's going on? I feel all hot...
I worked hard!
I'm kinda sleepy...
Summon: I don't have to sleep anymore? I can stay with everyone? Yay! Wait, what about vegetables?
Learn Skill: I'm really strong now!
Confession:
Heeheehee! I'm so happy not to be alone anymore!
I have so many friends here—so many people to talk to!
And it's all because you summoned me here.
You're my favorite, you know. Let's stay together forever!
Status: Hm? What's going on?
WAH! You scared me!
I had another bad dream last night.
*yawn* I'm getting sleepy again...
Would you tell me a story about where you're from?
Zzz...zzz...
You know what? I'm not lonely anymore!

Special: I can't bear to be alone!
Status: I thought it'd be fun to try on a new outfit. How's it look?
Eek! I thought you were a ghost!
Princess Veronica always looks so lonely. I used to be the same, a long time ago...
There are always new people coming to play at the castle, so I'm never bored here!
Ban-Ban said, "You look very nice, Tiki!" *giggle*
*yawn* It's a lovely time for a nap!
I won't have any more nightmares if I'm with you!

atiki.name: Tiki
atiki.title: Naga's Voice
atiki.description: Known as the Voice of the Divine Dragon. Has lived for ages. Once friends with Marth. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Sleepy... There's something about this place I find relaxing. It reminds me of the Divine Dragon Grounds.
Over my three millennia, I've said hello and farewell countless times. But I will always remember you.
Thank you for bringing me here—I can be reunited with many familiar faces, including my precious Mar-Mar!
We should take the time to chat. You seem different from the people of this world and the "Heroes."

I really do enjoy roaming this place. Don't you, [S]?
No matter how old I get, new worlds are always exciting!
Visit:
I bring greetings from your friend [F].
Value your friendship—a good friend is a comfort forever.
Level: I vow to protect this world I share with the Heroes.
I miss being in the heat of battle like this!
It must be my three millennia catching up with me.
Summon: I am Tiki. As a member of the Divine Dragon Tribe, I can turn into a dragon! Some call me the Voice.
Learn Skill: You have granted me new power. I will wield it at your side.
Confession:
Tell me...do you look forward to or dread the day you'll go home from this world?
Personally, I can't stop thinking about the sad day I will have to part with all my new friends.
The thought of saying good-bye to you is especially sad. I suppose it's a sign of how close we've grown.
Heh. That's borrowing trouble from the future, isn't it? Better to concentrate on the happy present.
There is still plenty of time for us to spend together, and I plan to enjoy every moment of it.
Someday, when I look back on these days, you will shine ever so brightly in my memory...
Status: Mmm...sleepy...
Thank you for summoning me. It's nice to be needed.
Power such as ours can be used for good or ill.
Looking at the stars always leaves me a bit lonely...
I wonder if Mar-Mar is here as well...
From "Voice" to "Hero..." I have worn many guises.
One day we will be parted, but I am glad to have met you.
So this is how the dökkálfar dress? How peculiar!
*gasp* Hey, you! Don't startle me like that!
Álfar and dragons aren't so different, after all. We both choose light or darkness...
I've had my fill of nightmares. I had lonely dreams for a long, long time...
How would you like to see a dragon creeping up beside your bed? That would give anybody a shock!
Mar-Mar... I hope you're having good dreams...
I had a dream we were forced to part... That was indeed a nightmare.

nowi.name: Nowi
nowi.title: Eternal Youth
nowi.description: Manakete who travels with Chrom's group. Looks young but truly is over a thousand years old. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I wasn't sure when you yanked me to this place, but I like it here. It's pretty, and everyone is so nice!
I was alone for a long, long time... But after I joined Chrom's army, I have lots of really fun friends!
Good job! I've been watching you work, and you've earned a reward. Bend down so I can pat your head.
Wanna play hide-and-dragonseek? I'll be the dragon, and you can be the person I chase after!
I was just looking for shiny rocks! If you find one, let me know so I can put it in my pouch.
Visit:
Hi! One of your friends asked me to come and say that to you. It was [F]!
Now I'm supposed to go straight home.
Level: I feel like I could take on a whole army!
Yes! Now we're talking!
Aw, I can do better than this...
Summon: I'm Nowi, a Manakete. That means I'm a dragon! I'm also over 1,000 years old, so I'll be your big sister!
Learn Skill: Neat power! Does it make me look taller?
Confession:
Found you, [S]! Let's play together! How about some hide-and-dragonseek? Tag?
Huh? You just want to chat? I like to run around a bunch, but if that's what you want, we can do that!
I love playing with you—you're nice and you're fun and I feel safe with you. Hm? Aww! How sweet!
Well, if that's how we both feel, let's stick together forever and ever!
Since I'm older, I'll be sure to always keep you safe, [S]! It's a promise!
Special: Who do you think I am?!
Status: Hey, let's play a game!
Don't worry—the big, tough dragon's got your back.
Maybe in another thousand years I'll be able to reach the top shelf.
Dragon breath! Rawr!
I may not look it, but I'm actually older than you. Heehee!
I wonder where the best sparklies for my collection might be...
Alfonse and Sharena and Anna are the best! You're the best, too!
I changed my clothes! Do you like it?
Eek! You scared me! Oh, is this a game? In that case, I won't lose!
Hmm... Do these clothes make me look more mature?
I wish I could fight in these clothes, but I'm gonna turn into a dragon...
Hey, play hide-and-seek with me! You're it!
Everyone in this castle is very nice to me. It makes me so happy!
You'll be my favorite forever!

fcorrin.name: Corrin
fcorrin.title: Fateful Princess
fcorrin.description: A Hoshidan princess raised in Nohr. Fights on her chosen path with the divine blade Yato. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The protection of this realm hinges on you. I know that role too well. Here, I will protect you.
I love seeing places like this. I think it's because I was kept in a remote fortress when growing up.
It's nice to see you always looking after everyone. I once had that duty. Let me know if I can ever help.
Heard of Dragon Veins? Where I'm from, I can tap their power to change the terrain. Are there any here?
I was thinking of my many siblings. They're all precious in their own ways. Family can be such a treasure.
Visit: I've come with greetings from [F]. What a lovely castle you have here!
Level: I've become so strong thanks to everyone's help.
Good. I'll be able to help more folks now.
It seems I didn't get much stronger...
Summon: I'm Corrin—born in Hoshido, though raised in Nohr. I will fight for you with my Yato blade and dragon power!
Learn Skill: Let's see what I can do now!
Confession:
Ah, [S]! Thanks for coming to visit me again!
Oh, sorry I keep patting you on the head—it's a bad habit I picked up back home.
But I do think that touch can bring friends closer than words can, you know? Wanna try it?
Heehee—you're so gentle! It's been a while since someone patted ME on the head. It's nice!
Anytime you want to pat or be patted, let me know! It can only help us be stronger together.
Status: The small things really count with friends—even a little smile can make a big difference.
I have so many siblings. I couldn't be more fortunate!
I admire the course you've taken here—to fight with everyone's help!
I wonder if there are any Dragon Veins here. Where I'm from, they're everywhere!
You and I are like two peas in a pod. We'll get along very well.
My sacred blade contains the love of everyone I've fought for...even of those I've fought with.
You can lean on me if you're weary. I feel as if you're family. And I, your sister.
This outfit is beautiful, in a...haunting sort of way.
*gasp* Oh, it's just you. Having trouble sleeping?
I know what it's like to wake from a nightmare drenched in sweat.
The dökkálfar are so delicate and beautiful.
I wonder what sorts of dreams my siblings have...
I want everyone to be happy, even if it's only while they dream...
Would you like me to sit by your side until you fall asleep?

fae.name: Fae
fae.title: Divine Dragon
fae.description: A surviving Divine Dragon with the nature of a child and very little life experience. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: You're going to summon more friends here for me to play with, right? Lots and lots, I hope!
You know what I am, right? A dragon! Which means there's almost no one else like me anywhere!
Hey, mind playing with me? Please? Pretty please?

Will you take me out...out... out?!
Waaah! Please take me outside to play!
I like it when you smile. It makes you all smiley and stuff!
Visit: I came to say hi! Wait, I was s'posed to say, "How do you do!" Anyway, hi!
Level: I'm super strong! Rawrrr!
Am I any bigger now?
I'm so...sleepy.
Summon:
Guess what! I'm the last Dee... Dee?!
Oh! Divine Dragon!
Learn Skill: Am I bigger? All growed up now?
Confession:
Ha ha! I'm having so much fun here, getting to play with everyone!
Every day, all the time! Play, play, play, play, play...zzz...
Zzzzz... Oh, what? Sorry— getting sleepy. Is it nap time yet? Nap time, nap time, nap...
zzzzzz.
Status: Ooh! Time for fun?
I'm good at hide-and-seek!
La, la, la! Oh, a butterfly!
Oh, yay! Pretty flower!
Guess what! ...That's what!
I wanna be all growed up!
You smell good!
I put this outfit on all by myself. It's really complicated!
Eek! Oh, are you playing a game where you scare people? OK, my turn!
Múspell is a fire country? Does that mean it's always on fire?!
*sigh* Laevatein and Laegjarn sure are close.
All right! Let's go play!
Hmm, do these new clothes make me look pretty?
If you come to Múspell with me, we can play together!

eirika.name: Eirika
eirika.title: Restoration Lady
eirika.description: Princess of Renais. Ephraim's twin. Cares dearly for her brother. Her kindness has sometimes put her in danger. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I wonder if any of us will ever see a world that's happy, prosperous, and free of conflict?
In my world, I'm constantly being helped by my brother. It's rather embarrassing, really.
I'm quite well, thank you. You're most kind to ask.
What sort of world are you from? One plagued by war? Or one graced by peace?
I was just practicing my sword form. My brother would be sure to scold me if I missed a day.
Visit:
I've come with greetings on behalf of [F].
May your friendship grow.
Level: If only Ephraim could see me now!
Glad to see my daily training pay off!
My brother would never let me forget this.
Summon: My name is Eirika. I'm not fond of fighting, but I'll do my best to support your cause.
Learn Skill: Surely this will help make up for my lack of sheer strength.
Confession:
Do you think I've gotten strong enough? Let me just say that if you're happy, then I'm happy.
When I was a child, my father and brother praised how gentle I was. I value such a quality.
But it can be a weakness in the face of oppression or deception. I wish it wasn't true, but it is.
When you need to protect those you must, strength is crucial.
Still, I refuse to give up my kindness and compassion.
You have helped me stay my course—growing stronger while remaining myself.
For that, I thank you and continue to pledge myself to your cause!
Special: I will give it my all!
If this is war, so be it.
Status: I am grateful for your kindness.
Ah! Oh, no more of that. You'll vex me!
It's best to resolve conflict without fighting. When possible.
Would you be willing to assist with my sword training?
How curious. I feel such warmth and hope when near you.
My brother and I, and our friend Lyon—we once had grand ideas about the future.
Promise me, please, that you won't leave me alone.
The garb of Ljósálfheimr is not what I'm used to, but I do find it quite fanciful and elegant.
There's no need to tease me, you know. I'm not a child.
I suppose I'm lighter on my feet without the weight of armor, but I do miss the protection.
If only these wings were not merely for show. I'd love to soar through the sky!
I wonder if my brother would consider wearing a matching outfit. It could be fun!
If I had the power of the ljósálfar, I would ensure that my brother and Lyon had nothing but carefree dreams. Like the old days...
You're always a reassuring presence in my dreams. As soon as you appear, I know everything's going to be all right.

ephraim.name: Ephraim
ephraim.title: Restoration Lord
ephraim.description: Prince of Renais. Eirika's twin. Cares deeply for his sister. His confidence has sometimes put him in danger. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall:
I might not look it, but I really do hope for peace.
I've always got my lance handy, but there's nothing more precious to me than a kingdom at ease.
I always worry about my sister, Eirika. If I'm not there to protect her, anything could happen.
You're always looking after us. That sort of kindness reminds me of my sister. Must be why I like you.
You say weapons are shaped like your Breidablik back in your world? I'd like to visit and see that for myself.

The royalty of other worlds seem to prefer the sword. I like the lance. Lances have the edge over swords.
You know, I once had ambitions to be the greatest spearman on Magvel, the continent I call home.
Visit: I'm Ephraim. Now, how about we cut this short and get to sparring? It's a better way to get to know each other.
Level: My power grows. But I mustn't let it go to my head.
I must get more powerful. And I will.
How can I ever protect my sister at this rate?
Summon: I am Ephraim of Renais, a prince and skilled spearman. So, point me at my enemy. I'll get to work.
Learn Skill: I will be the master of my power. Not the reverse.
Confession:
It seems that I've gotten much stronger here. My power has grown almost to overflowing.
That isn't enough. Oh, I don't mean my strength. I've always been capable enough there.
I mean that strength isn't always enough to protect us. Yes, it helps force a foe to submit.
But strength can also blind one to others' feelings. That is exactly how I once lost a good friend.
I must become kinder and more compassionate, or else I risk repeating my mistakes.
You have those qualities. And so I must remain with you. Then I will learn all I need to.
You'll find that I'm a grateful student...and friend.
Status: You can rely on me for anything you require.
Oh! Don't startle me. You almost met with the tip of my lance.
Trust me. I don't pick fights I can't win.
You know, I like you. And I feel I can trust you completely.
Here's some advice. Let the fools spread gossip. The rest of us have work to do.
I must protect Eirika, as a brother ought to do for his sister.
I will protect you. Just believe in me and follow my lead.
I was granted this new garb. Truth told, it doesn't matter what I wear. It's all the same to me.
*startle* Oh, it's you. Take it easy with the horseplay.
Size doesn't give one an inherent advantage in battle, but it can intimidate an opponent.
You wish to know my strength? All right then, how about we arm-wrestle?
Eirika is always overjoyed to see me newly attired. Why?
I must become more like my father. Not just in terms of strength, but also wisdom.
I will become stronger yet. I vow to protect you.

seliph.name: Seliph
seliph.title: Heir of Light
seliph.description: Inheritor of the sacred sword Tyrfing. A savior in his time, but dislikes battle. Julia's half brother. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall:
My father once taught me two valuable lessons. That a ruler should know the sorrows of his people.
And that there is more than one truth, no matter what anyone says to the contrary.
I know how valuable you must be to Prince Alfonse as his tactician. I once had one of my own.

Anyone who's borne the heavy weight of saving the world knows how nice it is to have the support of others.
Such people also know how daunting it can be to...meet their expectations.
Do you fear war? To be honest, I am often scared of it, to the extent that it keeps me up at night.
To save everyone that I can, I must train hard to become every bit as strong as my father was.
Visit: My name is Seliph. I bring word that you are very important to [F].
Level: How reassuring. Now there is nothing I need fear.
I am glad to grow stronger. I may equal my father in time.
Hmm. I must get stronger, if I possibly can!
Summon: I am Seliph, a son pledged to fulfilling the wish my father made as he died a bitter death—to battle darkness.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I sense that this will help considerably.
Confession:
People laud me as a hero and legend, but I feel like I owe my whole world an apology.
You know me better than most, so you must realize the truth.
I am too weak, too cowardly, to live up to such a legend. I have truly only ever wanted one thing—to run away.
Still, I have always done the opposite, fighting whoever I must. And do you know why?
Because I have friends who inspire me, and you more than most. I need you... in order to be me. You see?
I pledge to help you any way I can, ever at your side—now and well into our future.
Status: Something on your mind?
What? Oh, it's you. Tell me. What's going on?
Best to speak the truth—I'll never be as strong as I ought to be.
Have you grown tired from our battles?
I would love to stroll in a market with you sometime—perhaps when our battles are done.
I hope to be like my father someday—great and inspiring.
I vow to work hard—until I'm strong enough to protect you.

Special: The strength of the Order of Heroes!
Status: Thank you for the new outfit. Wearing it has strengthened my resolve.
What is it? Oh. I fell for it again.
There is not enough time in the day to learn all there is to know here in Askr.
I must live a life my mother and father would be proud of.
Have you seen Julia? I wonder what she will say when she sees me in this.
I am no great man... But if I fight by your side, we can save this world together.
I am honored to don clothing that matches your own.

julia.name: Julia
julia.title: Naga's Blood
julia.description: Inheritor of the Book of Naga. Seliph's half sister by a different father. Gentle, yet faces her destiny with strength. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.
julia.artist: Haimura Kiyotaka (はいむらきよたか)

Castle Hall: The Book of Naga...has always seemed both familiar...and mysterious.
My mother and father...and my brother Julius... They were all as kind as you can imagine.
As always, thank you for all that you do. Let me know if there's anything more I can do to help.

Seliph...that is, my brother...is the sort of person who could lead a world toward peace.
As are you, clearly.

My brother Julius, once very kind, turned into a twisted devil...
Then by that devil's hands, my mother...and my father... Oh, it's beyond anything!
Visit: Ah. Sorry to be a bother, but I've found myself here and... Where am I exactly?
Level: I will fight—no matter who our foe!
I want to grow stronger so I can give my all.
I won't take flight, no matter how dire things may get.
Summon: My name is Julia—she who inherited the ability to use the book of the Divine Dragon, Naga.
Learn Skill: I grow closer to understanding the reason I am here.
Confession:
My brother Julius and I both inherited a special power through our lineage.
I...gained the ability to use the Book of Naga.
My brother...could take hold of a book of terrible darkness, and it turned him into a devil of a man.
Both of our fates were made merely because of lineage.
What if I could succumb to what took hold of my brother—become your worst enemy against my will?
The thought terrifies me. But I take heart in one thing—how you have continued to be there for me.
I believe, were that to happen, that one word from you would bring me back to my senses.
I ask you to never leave my side, so that I...can never leave yours.
Status: May you never be hurt.
May the gods ever protect you.
Oh! I see. It's you, isn't it?
To be bathed in such warm light!
Wh-what? Have I done...? What?
Mother... You always watch over me.
I want to help you too...

Special: I am as ice and snow.
Status: This outfit comes from a land of ice... I hope it suits me.
Ah! Have...you mistaken me for another?
I am sorry. Am I being cold?
When I was a child, a book my mother read to me contained stories of different worlds.
I...I feel a little unsure of myself... Will you let me know if you see Seliph?
I wonder if I can become close with the people of Nifl...
Being with you warms my heart.

sanaki.name: Sanaki
sanaki.title: Begnion's Apostle
sanaki.description: Empress of Begnion. Known as the Apostle, voice of the goddess. Young but dutiful ruler. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall:
Power can cast shadows, as it did over the senate in my realm.
The prince and princess here, however, remain radiant. May they stay that way forever.

Oh! Do you have candy? I mean, I am far from being a child and care nothing for such things.
But if you have some, I wouldn't say no.
You always strive to do so much for everyone. And so I reward you now with my thanks.
I have an older sister who I didn't know about for years. But she has become so precious to me.
I will now present to you my full name—Sanaki Kirsch Altina. I expect you will remember it.
Visit: You are standing in the presence of Sanaki—37th Empress of Begnion. You may kneel, if you wish.
Level: It's only natural for the Apostle.
Average things can happen to even the Apostle.
It's...a fluke. That's all. No reason to fret.
Summon: You stand in the presence of Sanaki, Empress of Begnion! I am the Apostle—the voice of the goddess!
Learn Skill: What was that? I felt as if I just transcended in some way!
Confession:
Hmpf. I seem to have grown while here in this world. Have you noticed any differences?
I mean, avert your eyes! You gaze upon the Empress of Begnion! I am a privilege to behold!
And yet, you don't give a fig for all that, do you? You stand in my presence without fear.
Most would beg my permission to approach. But not you. I must say that I find it...refreshing.
Still, I am not a commoner, and though I seem to be a girl like any other, I am not.
I don't have the luxury of acting juvenile. But when I'm with you, I wish I did.
I think you might be a bad influence on me. How curious. I wonder what it means...
Still, never forget who I am—the Empress of Begnion!
Status: Here you are, engaging with me so...casually!
Ahhh! Pardon? Scared? I think you mean someone else.
You stand in the presence of Sanaki, Empress of Begnion.
Ha ha ha! Every moment with you is amusing.
A summoner, you say? How wonderful—the stuff of fairy tales!
The truth is...I cannot hear the goddess's voice...
You may have the great honor of remaining at my side.
You stand before Sanaki, empress and apostle of Begnion! I am the voice of the goddess!
Stop that at once! Have you no decency?!
You approve of my new attire? I suppose you are a person of taste, then.
Princess Veronica and I are the same age. In another world, perhaps, we may have been childhood friends.
People feel free to approach me here. That would never happen in my world.
If I appeared before them dressed like this, I am curious how my subjects would perceive me!
Will you tell me of Embla? If I am to wear the garb, I wish to learn the culture.

klein.name: Klein
klein.title: Silver Nobleman
klein.description: A young general of Etruria. Clarine's brother. Treats all as equals. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Some call me the Archer General, but I feel I can serve a kingdom better as an administrator than a general.
I see myself clearly, I think. I don't have my parents' battle acumen. So I make myself useful in other ways.
I'm also glad to handle some tasks for you at the castle. Your burden is heavy. I'm glad to bear some of it.

I have a younger sister named Clarine. She's nice, once you get to know her.
Clarine does live a bit too much in her own world though. Still, she's very sweet in her own way.
I learned all of the etiquette needed at court in my own world. I hope that some of it applies here.
Visit: Well, greetings. I've come to say hello on behalf of your friend [F].
Level: What a surprise! This is unusual for me.
It seems I'm growing at a respectable pace.
Hmm. A reminder of my shortcomings.
Summon: I am Klein, son of Count Reglay of Etruria. I'll be happy to accompany you!
Learn Skill: Thank you. I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
Confession:
Thanks to my noble birth, I've had the fortune to meet many different people during my life.
I feel it's made me a good judge of character.
For example, those who talk the talk rarely walk the walk. And they often run away.
Then there are those who hardly say a word and never boast, yet are quick to help others.
Such a person saved me when I was a child. That's how I know that I can trust you fully.
And I devote my skills to your cause and will continue to do so. It's an honor to serve you.
Status: Anything I can do for you? Please, name it.
What?! Oh, you. Caught me off guard.
I'm always worried about my younger sister. Can't help it!
Let us stay vigilant, for your sake and that of your family.
They call me the Archer General, for what that's worth.
Wouldn't going with the flow be bliss? But in time, what becomes of such a life?
Please, stay close to me. I want to keep you out of harm's way.

reinhardt.name: Reinhardt
reinhardt.title: Thunder's Fist
reinhardt.description: Formidable and admired mage knight in Friege's army. Ever ready to lend an ear to his younger sister, Olwen. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena seem to be quite close. That brings back memories...
It was my duty for many years to protect Queen Ishtar of my world. I took my duty very seriously.
Please take care of yourself. This group would be doomed if it lost your keen sense of tactics.
My sister, Olwen, more than grew up when I wasn't looking—she became formidable in her own right.

There was a tactician so brilliant in my world that he was thought of as a god that presided over war.
I must say, your command is perhaps as impeccable.
Visit: Excuse my sudden appearance. My name is Reinhardt. I bring greetings as a sign of friendship.
Level: Better than expected. I should always focus this much.
At this rate, I may achieve what I must.
Such a failing. Am I losing my conviction?
Summon: I am Reinhardt of Friege. Allow me to unleash havoc on your enemies with my thunder magic.
Learn Skill: This is an honor. In thanks, I pledge to prevail in battle.
Confession:
When I was young, my young sister, Olwen, followed me everywhere.
As her elder brother, I felt it my duty to guide her path in life, helping her at every turn.
But I now realize I wasn't doing it just for Olwen, nor was I even leading as much as I thought.
It was more like she and I each had our own path, though equally high standards.
You have helped me understand that at last. You and I—different, yet fully committed.
What an ideal way to grow—neither leading nor following, but walking together. I thank you.
Status: Tell me. What are your orders?
Come now! No more of that.
You have quite a skill for battle tactics.
I knew a brilliant tactician named Saias. You may be his superior.
I have a younger sister named Olwen. Do you have any siblings?
My sister went her way. I went mine.
I will remain with you—no matter the circumstances.
Such interesting clothes. I hardly recognize myself.
Huh? Oh. I had imagined I would be used to this by now, and yet you still surprise me.
It pleases me to don clothes that so tastefully match your own.
Askr holds great interest for me. Could I learn more, I certainly would.
My sister has donned these clothes as well? That must make her very happy. Thank you.
I was once a man forced down a single path, but perhaps in this world, more lie open to me...
Here forward, I shall dedicate myself to our mission.

olwen.name: Olwen
olwen.title: Blue Mage Knight
olwen.description: A mage knight in Friege's army. Her ideals sometimes put her in opposition with her beloved brother, Reinhardt. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena seem to be quite close. I find that reassuring.

You know, my brother, Reinhardt, is quite superb in battle.
Some people even say he's the second coming of one of our world's greatest crusaders.
Are you curious about magic? I have some knowledge in the matter. I could train you.
My brother, Reinhardt, will continue on his path—and me, on mine, though it makes us enemies.
Children are a realm's treasure, and all of them are adorable. In time, they grow up to bear a realm's burdens.
Visit: My name is Olwen. I come bearing greetings from [F].
Level: What great fortune! How astonishing.
Good, though a far cry from the gains my brother makes.
What? I'll never be able to live this down.
Summon: My name is Olwen. Would you mind if I join you? I would appreciate it more than you could ever know.
Learn Skill: I'll use this in battle to make you proud.
Confession:
My brother is a remarkable person. He always helped and guided me. When I was with him, I felt safe.
But the day came when I was outside of his protection, and then I had to find my own way in life.
It wasn't easy to take full responsibility for myself. There were times when the burden was too much for me.
After joining you, I have seen how you somehow find your answers, even in the most uncertain of hours.
You inspire me. So I would be honored to walk this path with you for as long as you'll have me.
Special: I'll protect all who need it!
