Status: I thank you deeply for giving me your time.
Aaah! Ha ha! I scare easily, I guess.
I'm sometimes at a loss about how to proceed.
Children should be happy. I will always fight to keep their smiles bright.
Where should I even begin, expressing my thoughts?
If ever my brother stands in my way? Well, I will do what I must.
I would like to fight on the side of good, for as long as goodness will have me.
I am Olwen of Friege. This is the attire of the Order of Heroes.
Ah! You gave me a start.
Fred is my second in command. I could not ask for a more loyal or hardworking officer.
I have chased my brother's shadow for far too long.
Askrans are orderly, peace-loving people. I am honored to have the opportunity to learn from them.
Given the option, I wonder which nation's garb my brother would choose...
These are not mere clothes to me. They are a statement—a commitment. Please allow me to continue to fight by your side.

eldigan.name: Eldigan
eldigan.title: Lionheart
eldigan.description: Ruler of Nordion. Wields the Demon Sword in knightly devotion to any master. Older brother of Lachesis. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Prince Alfonse seems thoughtful and considerate. He will be an excellent ruler of this realm.

Oh, my dear sister, Lachesis... I know that I vowed to come back soon, alive and well.
But circumstances have changed.

In my world I was prepared to face death, but some twist of fate has brought me here.
Perhaps this too is part of the tangled nature of destiny.
A knight's loyalty must remain absolute. My sister sees it differently, but I cannot veer from duty.

My great friend Sigurd has a young son named Seliph. I wonder, in this unusual realm we stand in...
could I possibly meet Seliph as a grown man—surely, a heroic figure like his father? That would be marvelous.
Visit: My name is Eldigan. I come bearing the friendliest of greetings from [F].
Level: I will reach for even loftier goals. This I swear.
A knight must strive for the heights of excellence.
Inadequate. Has my grasp of greatness slipped?
Summon: I am Eldigan. Those who defy my lord will meet my blade. But I trust that you and I will have no such problem.
Learn Skill: I vow to put this power to certain purpose.
Confession:
After I was summoned into this realm, I had a strange revelation.
Where I came from, I placed my absolute loyalty in my lord. But here, that lord is you.
A knight of my caliber must serve his lord—no matter what the cut of that lord.
So I have always believed. But I will confess this, now that I have spent so much time with you.
I am honored to pledge my sword to a master of your qualities.
Still, a knight cannot choose his master, and so I count myself most fortunate to have met you.
Again and always—I forever pledge my sword and my loyalty to you.
Status: I am ever steeled for duty. But for conversation? A bit wooden.
What?! Oh, I thought you a foe. Employ prudence.
What is chivalry but taking a friend's cause to heart?
Honorable knights must sometimes end things honorably—with a battle.
I wield Mystletainn, the Demon Sword, a blade once held by one of the 12 legendary crusaders in my world.
I often wonder if my fatherland is in a state of ruin.
I am a knight. And you, my master here. Thus, I will protect you.

Special: Do not make haste for death.
I'll finish this with a single blow!
Status: Quite a change, wouldn't you say? In any attire, I am still Eldigan.
Behave yourself! Should you not be above such childish tricks?
You believe me to look good in this? Consider me...flattered...
My friends, my family, my country... My hope is that they prosper.
This outfit makes an apt pairing with the Demon Sword Mystletainn I wield, does it not?
What I desire is an honorable death—one befitting a knight.
Under my protection, your death shall be kept at bay.

lachesis.name: Lachesis
lachesis.title: Lionheart's Sister
lachesis.description: Lady of House Nordion. Adores her older brother, Eldigan, to the point that other men pale in comparison. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall:
Though not quite as fine a man as Eldigan, my brother, Alfonse has recommendable qualities.
No doubt, the prince will one day help Askr become a truly great realm.
My brother set a high standard for what is possible in a man. How could one ever marry, knowing him?
You mustn't ever perish. I have suffered far too much loss as it is. I would wither away.
One wonders—if you served a foolish ruler, would you obey without question or defy his will?

My brother Eldigan possessed Mystletainn, the Demon Sword, a legendary blade in my world.
He was also known as a lord of lionhearted courage. I'll never meet the likes of Eldigan again.
Visit: How do you do? Oh, on second glance, let me answer that. You're doing surprisingly well here.
Level: Simply splendid, isn't it?
No less than one expected. And yet, no more either.
One isn't used to such disappointments.
Summon: One wonders—who are you? Not to mention, what are your intentions? And what is this curious place?
Learn Skill: One can only hope to be as talented as her brother in time.
Confession:
In my world, my dear brother gave all, struggling to serve the highest of knightly ideals.
How I tried to keep him from being consumed by his situation. Tried—and failed.
My heart has been torn to ribbons, and those ribbons, to tatters.
Dearest, darling Eldie—I mean, Brother—how I miss you and your noble bearing.
Though one longs to walk through life with as superlative a person, one must carry on.
You have proven that you, like he, fight to preserve the hope of others who depend on you.
One hopes—that is, I hope—that you will take great care and let me battle with you. I can't stand any more loss.
Status: Quite all right?
Take care.
Shall we converse? Perhaps over tea.
Oh! My word, these brushes with others.
When one's brother sets the standard, all men fall short of the mark.
Eldie, my Eldie... Why?
I beg of you—don't stray from my side.

Special: I bring you peace at last.
Status: Quite all right?
Take care.
This clothing is slightly frightening, but I cannot complain—I now match my dear brother, Eldigan.
Princess Eir is quite wise. As a fellow princess, there is much I could learn from her.
Everyone I meet has been startled to see me in this attire.
Eldie... Please keep safe.
I desire to protect you from death. That is my request.

lucius.name: Lucius
lucius.title: The Light
lucius.description: A gentle monk who serves Raven. Carries a heavy burden from a dark childhood. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
This kingdom is blessed by such abundance—and graced with such bright spirits!
I believe that this place is so happy that there are few, if any, orphans that go unloved.

In case anyone asks, feel free to share the fact that I am a man—and not a woman.
It is hardly anyone's business, yet still the question has nipped at my heels for years.

I have pledged my service to Lord Raym— Oh, sorry! I mean Raven, of course.
I continue to worry about his welfare.
My staff can be used to heal my allies but also to hurt my foes. That is, if I must.

A moment...I beg you...please...
Ah, there. What ails me has already passed.
Visit:
You must be [S].
I have come to deliver good tidings from [F].
Level: Such gains might better suit others in our party.
I fared well—and pledge to put this to use for us all.
Sorry... Merely a moment... of weakness.
Summon: My name is Lucius. I can tend to your wounded. So I beg you—please put me to work immediately.
Learn Skill: I hope that I have grown in both body and spirit.
Confession:
I have come to trust you more than most I meet, so I feel it's safe to share my story with you.
When I was young, I suffered terribly in an orphanage—children ought never be so tormented.
I also suffer what some might call a sickness of the soul. What it is, exactly, is difficult to say.
Even now, when I think of how I suffered...at that orphanage...my body falls into lapses and strange fits.
I'm sorry. I should have told you all about this, but I wasn't yet comfortable confiding it.
I feared that you'd lose respect for me if you knew the truth—or would even be repulsed.
I do such good works that I shouldn't allow myself to care, but when it comes to you...I do.
I put myself in your hands. Will you like or loathe me? But know this, you will have my loyalty.
Status: Darkness, begone.
Sweet relief.
Hmm. What is troubling you?
You may hear it questioned whether I am a man. I say the question...is a wrong one.
Those who mock the way others look cause great suffering in the world. I have suffered...considerably.
I hope always for my soul to soar. But sometimes I am weak. For that, I am sorry.
If ever your mind is troubled, please speak with me.
Darkness, begone.
Sweet relief.
Múspell is said to be the Kingdom of Flame, is it not? It must be scorching.
I showed my new attire to Lord Raymond and he... He had nothing but kind words.
I hope these clothes help bring me closer to Heroes from other worlds.
If only the flames of Múspell could reduce my own sins to ash...
I pray your heart will ever remain serene.

jaffar.name: Jaffar
jaffar.title: Angel of Death
jaffar.description: An emotionless member of the Black Fang assassins. Known as the Angel of Death. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Order of Heroes... Odd name. This is a group that kills and kills for your homeland, yes?
In my world, I was a corpse. Or nearly one since birth. But meeting Nino...changed me.
Patrolling again, are you? That is the effective way to find spies and deter assassins.

We are making conversation, aren't we? All right.
The best time to assassinate someone is when the target is eating or sleeping.
When I have time to myself, I think of assassination. I have thought of little else since my youngest days.
Visit: Don't run. I'm not here to deliver death. Only a greeting from [F].
Level: Only luck.
Not bad.
Must be rusty.
Summon: I am Jaffar. Known also as the Angel of Death. But only by those in Black Fang—and now, you.
Learn Skill: Will this help me do...what I do?
Confession:
You are too kind—to me, to all around us, to everyone.
That is your weak spot, [S].
You make a grave mistake if you think me a friend. I am your tool to use. Nothing else.
When I fail, cast me into the heap with the trash and offal. You must, for that is the way of life...
What? You won't? Then you leave me no choice but to live on and on, serving you.
Know then that there is no mission too cruel for me to handle on your behalf.
I will finish it. I will return to you. There is no need to worry.
Status: Next mission. Please.
The human touch? Not for me.
I am known as the Angel of Death.
Do I know of...joy, sorrow, anger, dread? No.
I have...no heart.
A pile of corpses. Upon that I was born. An infant in a cradle of death.
You must...live.
I'm wearing this outfit because I was ordered to. I wasn't told anything else, so don't ask.
Next time you need something, just say it.
Seiðjárn? Never heard of it.
What are those things that Niðavellir uses to fight? Actually, forget it—just point me to their weak spot.
These clothes are too heavy. Take away an assassin's speed, and all you've got is dead weight.
At least Nino likes this getup. That makes one of us.
I might complain, but...I know this outfit is special. So...thank you.

rebecca.name: Rebecca
rebecca.title: Wildflower
rebecca.description: A girl who lives in a remote village and spends her time hunting. Kind and sociable. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: The castle is the cat's meow! It's almost more than I can take in—bigger than my village!
I was known as a decent hunter back home. My village needed me when we had a crummy harvest.
Hey, thanks for always checking in with me. I'd like it better though if you and I could explore outside!
You able to use that weapon of yours to bring down geese? We should go hunting if so!
Hmm? Just tightening my bowstring. Always have to stay on top of my gear!
Visit: Hey, I'm Rebecca! Just here to do a job—passing on a hello from [F]!
Level: Whoa! Who knew that I could do that well?
Nice to get even better with my trusty bow!
Yikes. My bowstring must have snapped there.
Summon: I'm Rebecca—a pretty decent hunter, if you ask me. And I'm a real quick shot with a bow!
Learn Skill: Thank you! I'll keep getting better with my bow!
Confession:
I just can't say how glad I am to be here. Everyone's friendly as friendly gets!
There's never a dull moment, which is good for me, since I don't like being left alone.
Years ago, my brother left our village without saying a word. Never came back either.
I waited...you know, day after day, week after week, and year after...
Oh, my! Sorry for carrying on. Don't want to get weepy all over you!
Besides, that's all in the past. I've got you and everyone else around here now.
Just don't you get any funny ideas about disappearing on me, all right? Good.
Status: You need me for anything, just holler and I'll come running.
Oh! Didn't mean to be jumpy. You startled me.
I make a real fine lunch, don't you know it!
Fresh fruit. Roast fowl. Nothing better.
Check my bow...? And the string...? Yep, all in good shape!
I'm pretty good with a bow. Or that's what they say.
Is there anything you like to eat in particular?
Thanks so much for the outfit. It's really nice.
*gasp* What's this all of a sudden?!
If I got stronger, it'd be easier to draw my bow. And would it help with my aim?
These jötnar folks sure are tall! Took me by surprise.
Wearing a new outfit can make you feel like a completely different person, don't you think?
Haven't changed a bit, have you, Sain? Even here… *sigh*
I hope I can be even more useful to you moving forward.

karel.name: Karel
karel.title: Sword Demon
karel.description: A vicious swordsman from a family devoted to mastering the blade. Known as the Sword Demon. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: The most skillful Heroes from all the worlds gather in this one? What a lovely, lovely place.
I have taken up my family's blade, which means that I am now one with my weapon.
Point me at the strongest of this world. My blade longs to feast on worthy meat.
Approaching me? Here? I may take that as a challenge someday. Best you learn to defend yourself.

I am practicing a sword technique that we have kept secret within our family—to the extreme.
So, I'll do you the favor of telling you to walk away. Unless, of course, you wish to see it?
Visit:
You must be [S].
So, you think yourself a friend of [F]? Heh.
Level: I pile my victims to the sky so the gods bless my blade!
My body and my blade must get faster and fiercer!
This risks tarnishing my blade—my body!
Summon: I am Karel. Care to meet my blade? Oh, let me withdraw the offer. You are not ready...yet.
Learn Skill: Lovely, lovely—I yearn to unleash my blade!
Confession:
You are a puzzle to me. I am on the path of the sword and cut down those strong enough to matter.
Yet you cannot fight—not with a sword, not even any magic. Still, you are on my path.
How troubling. Why don't I just walk around you? Why do I continue to fight for you? Perhaps...
Perhaps it is because having you at my side propels me faster along my path!
In any case, here we are—the sword and the swordless!
What else can I do but continue? That is, until the day when I see you standing IN my way.
Status: Point me toward a worthy opponent.
My blade comes out at the...slightest provocation.
I was raised to live and die by the sword. Now, among my family members, I live. My sister does too.
Only one can wield the sword.
My body? My blade? We are one and the same.
I am on the path of the sword. I seek its end—one way or another.
Don't worry. My blade isn't meant for you.

priscilla.name: Priscilla
priscilla.title: Delicate Princess
priscilla.description: The daughter of Count Caerleon. Also Raven's sister. Poised and gentle, with a jealous streak. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
I have heard that my brother, Raymond, is going by the name Raven these days.
What's more, he now works as a mercenary. I can't imagine what changed him so thoroughly!
I'm the daughter of Count Caerleon. But, you see, my true lineage is quite a complicated story.
Oh, Raymond... My Raymond... Whatever happened to you, dear brother of mine?
I'm not skilled in battle. I find it all barbaric and terrifying. I'd rather stay in the castle.
Care to sit down for some tea? I have some sweets, thanks to the kind people here!
Visit: My name is Priscilla. I come with greetings from your friend [F].
Level: Is this an exceptional result? I haven't the faintest!
Was that an acceptable result? I do hope so.
I fear that was not nearly good enough.
Summon: My name is Priscilla. If it's not too much trouble, could I stay with you for a while?
Learn Skill: How curious that you're making me more powerful!
Confession:
May I ask you a question? I don't mean to trouble you. But...do I seem stronger to you?
I barely recognize myself in the mirror, now that I've been here for a while.
I knew nothing of the world—or worlds—before all of this. And what did I know of battle?
I've changed so much, and I believe that you deserve much of the credit. Don't you?
Well, some goes to me. I do think that you and I make a fine team. And I hope we always will!
Status: Care is my calling.
I'll ease your pain.
If you find yourself injured? Please find me. I'll heal you immediately.
What an exceptional individual you are.
Someone once made me a very important promise.
I'd like to say I'm above jealousy. But there have been occasions.
I will stay by your side for as long as you need me.

ninian.name: Ninian
ninian.title: Oracle of Destiny
ninian.description: A young dancer who has a serene and mystical presence. Her dances are divine tributes. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: The wind here...and this land... I find it all so refreshing.
I sense that you are somehow... different than everyone else around us.
Thank you for your kindness. I don't take it for granted, [S].
I know many dances—those for any occasion and a few for special ones. Care to see some?
I am able to sense impending danger. But at the moment, I sense... nothing that puts us in peril.
Visit: I bear greetings as well as a dance of friendship on behalf of [F].
Level: Does this please you? Then I am satisfied.
I sense that...I can do still better than this.
Sorry. I will never be able to help at this rate.
Summon: I am Ninian—quite simply, a traveling performer, glad to put on a show. It's nothing much, really.
Learn Skill: I sense that this has helped awaken my potential.
Confession:
So you surely realize by now that...dragon blood courses through my veins.
Dragons have not often lived in harmony with humans...or is it vice versa?
Yet here I feel as if I can truly be myself without fear or shame. That's because of you.
You have the rare gift of seeing others, or at least me, as if there are no divisions between us.
I appreciate this more than you can know. And so, I offer you all my dances in deep gratitude.
Status: May the dance move you.
I'd like to help.
What do you need of me?
You and I are...? Friends.
I hope you're not afraid of dragons.
Humans and dragons... Will they ever live in harmony?
You accept me as I am, don't you?
Ah... Thank you for these fine new clothes. They lift my spirits!
Ah—! Forgive me, I know I must be freezing.
I feel something of a connection to Nifl. Perhaps it is due to my nature.
Even though I am a dragon, the people here aren't afraid.
Wouldn't it be wonderful to gaze out at a snow-covered landscape?
I wonder what Lord Eliwood is doing right now...
Allow me to dance for you sometime to show my gratitude.

chrom2.name: Chrom
chrom2.title: Spring Exalt
chrom2.description: A prince of Ylisse and descendant of the Hero-King. Dressed to celebrate the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Anna wants to master painting eggs for the spring festival. No doubt she wants to sell them.

We were right in the middle of celebrating the arrival of spring when I was summoned.
Had I known I would be plucked from our castle like that, I would have come...better prepared.

On patrol, [S]?
I know that this time of year can put a spring in our steps. Just remember that if you get tired, I'll take my turn.
We have a custom of painting eggs during our spring festival. But I have a habit of crushing the eggs I make.
I have to take special care with my, er, weapon here. It chips easily. Hmm...I miss Falchion.
Visit:
Greetings from [F].
Do you enjoy the spring season, [S]? I do!
Level: Ha! The spirit of spring moves through me.
In the spirit of spring, I will grow stronger!
I'm not living up to the whole idea of spring growth here.
Summon: I'm Chrom, Prince of the Halidom of Ylisse. Enjoying the spring festival? I've dressed for the occasion!
Learn Skill: Whatever you did there is making this costume fit me better!
Confession:
Ah, if it isn't [S]!
I just finished painting some spring-festival eggs. Not bad, if I say so myself. Take a look.
What? Curious what all that lettering is? It's written in the language of Ylisse.
It's a bit of a poem, I guess, that says how much I value your presence here.
And see? On this side, I've painted a picture of you. Good likeness, don't you think?
What, it isn't? Well, I tried, and at least now you know that I truly do value our strong bond.
Now, may we spend many spring festivals together and...I promise to work on my painting skills.
Special: You will not stop my festivity!
Status: Spring inspires me to give my all.
My trusty Falchion has been replaced by...this.
Those in my group, the Shepherds, tell me to wear more dashing outfits. This dashing enough?
Eggs and rabbits have been symbols of the spring festival for ages.
I heard my sister Lissa hid eggs all over Ylisse. What a quest I'll have in store when I go home.
I'll stand out in battle going out dressed like this!
That we met in the spring must be important. I hope it means our bond will grow ever stronger.

xander2.name: Xander
xander2.title: Spring Prince
xander2.description: Nohrian prince who normally wields the divine blade Siegfried but left it behind for the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Prince Alfonse's sword reminds me of my own Siegfried, which I hope is being stored safely at my castle.

The spring in Nohr is cold and dark, so I like my kingdom to celebrate spring as best we can.
That, if little else, always serves to warm my people's hearts.

Even in busy times, remember what the spring season brings back into our lives after a long winter.
Ease and sleep, and simply slowing down to enjoy life, restores us all to peak condition.

During my kingdom's spring festival, we hide eggs and then search for them. It's the definition of fun.
I wonder if it would be appropriate to hide eggs in this castle?
My siblings goaded me into wearing such a bright and outlandish outfit. I hardly recognize my reflection.
Visit:
I bring to you spring greetings, [S].
These tidings come from none other than [F].
Level: I didn't expect such growth. Spring does bring surprises.
One can only hope for more growth by season's end.
Surely the result of fighting with an unfamiliar weapon.
Summon: I am Xander, Crown Prince of Nohr. Is this outfit correct for the occasion? I ought to look festive.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks. This is as welcome as a spring breeze.
Confession:
I have hidden an egg for you to find, [S].
Now, try your best to locate the— What? You think it's in the hand behind my back?
Hmm. You are correct. I should have known that I couldn't outwit you, Summoner.
Maybe you will be impressed by how I painted this egg. On this side is the symbol of Nohr.
Beside it is the symbol of the Order of Heroes.
Thus, this egg represents our friendship, created in the spring and strengthened in battle.
Now, you should be careful with this egg, taking great care never to break it.
Other painted eggs may be made to be rolled through grass in festival games...
But not this one.
Status: I have come to spread the good cheer of the spring season.
Winter lasts long in Nohr. While our spring is over before you know it.
This isn't my normal attire. What do you think? Does it suit me?
My siblings paint eggs during the spring festival. So too, my retainers. A fine tradition!
You may have noticed that my lance is a carrot. I hope you find that suitable?
I wonder if everyone at my castle found the eggs I hid?
This kingdom enjoys such a long spring—warm and bright. May such a season come to Nohr in time.

lucina2.name: Lucina
lucina2.title: Spring Exalt
lucina2.description: Daughter of Chrom. Future exalt of Ylisse. Curious about the old festival traditions of Ylisse. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: People say the eggs I painted for the spring festival turn out...strange. But Sharena said they look fine.
I've celebrated a spring festival only once. Colorful outfits, communal feasts—all of it, very nice!
You work so tirelessly. If you're hungry, I might have a spring-festival egg around here somewhere.

I've heard of a most curious tradition that's done during spring festivals. Egg rolling—heard of it?
It sounds like a carefree way to spend the day. We should find a field nearby and try it out sometime.
Zzz...zzz... Oh! Sorry. Thinking of spring is so pleasant that I nod off. Sorry again.
Visit:
I've come with spring greetings for you, [S].
May your days be forever warm and lovely.
Level: I feel as if a flower has just burst into full bloom within me!
The strength of spring serves more than me alone.
How dismal. Has winter laid claim to my heart?
Summon: I am Lucina, future Exalt of Ylisse. The spring festival is such a breath of fresh air, don't you think?
Learn Skill: Thank you. Each new ray of sunlight brings more hope to my heart.
Confession:
I imagine that you could only be curious about spring-festival outfits, [S].
We have many kinds of these festival costumes in Ylisse.
One was an egg—cracked on one side. Another was a shirt that showed my father...in bunny ears!
People even go around swinging carrot weapons!
I'm sure that our bond would strengthen if we both dressed up to enjoy such festivities!
Oh...not interested? I see. I was only thinking that if our bond was as strong as possible...
Well, then that would be enough for me if I go back home. I'd like to remember you forever.
Sorry to get melancholy. Anyway, even if we don't go hopping down the trail together in costumes...
I know our bond is strong as it is, and I hope you'll have me stay here and help you as long as I can.
Special: You will not stop my festivity!
Status: Happy spring festival!
Spring is my favorite time of year. It's when I was born.
This headpiece is the height of fashion, don't you think?
Where I come from, there are shape-shifters called Taguel that can turn into rabbits.
In my world, I returned from a future where...we didn't celebrate the coming of spring like this.
I should hide eggs around this world while I have the chance. Who knows when I'll have to return home?
If ever this war ends, I'd love to show you Ylisse's spring festival. I'd get you a stylish headpiece like this!

camilla2.name: Camilla
camilla2.title: Spring Princess
camilla2.description: Princess of Nohr who dotes on her sibling Corrin. Loves her new outfit ever since Corrin said it was cute. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
Princess Sharena really catches my eye. That girl is as adorable as she is formidable.
I'd love to dress her up in a spring-festival outfit!

The realm outside my family's castle is very dark. So every spring, we go all out to decorate our home.
Flowers of all colors...bunnies of all shapes and sizes...and more eggs than you can imagine!

The spring festival always reminds me to live a life of sweet ease, [S].
Do remember that you can lay your weary head in my lap.
Care to dress up in one of these festival outfits? It'd really suit you. Oh, yes. Just too cute!
I adore strolling around here in the spring. It's simply ideal—so many flowers!
Visit: I've come with spring greetings...and with jealousy for how close you are with [F].
Level: How glorious! I could jump for joy!
Festival or not, I just can't help growing by leaps and bounds!
Oh my... Is this outfit holding me back in some way?
Summon: I'm Camilla, eldest princess of Nohr, come dressed for the spring fest. But it's rather tight, don't you think?
Learn Skill: How sweet of you. Building me up for summer, perhaps?
Confession:
Did you want to celebrate the spring festival with me today, [S]?
Delighted to oblige. Shall I pop some rabbit ears on your head? Rest your head in my lap?
No one relaxes better than I do. Back in my world, we lounge all day in public baths. Or at least I do.
Oh, wouldn't it just be the icing on the cake to luxuriate in such steaming-hot water right now?
Hmm? That has nothing to do with this festival? Well, leave it to you to stay on task.
Great Hero of another world, you have outmaneuvered me. I was hoping we'd get a holiday together.
I love to get away from it all with members of my family—and I do consider you family.
That means I'll also protect you as I would a brother or sister, even if you are my superior here.
Still, if you ever grow weary and need to get some sleep, remember my lap is forever yours.
Status: Shall we celebrate?
During the spring festival, egg delicacies are my everything back home.
What would a spring festival be without cute, wittle bunnies? Like me.
I'm rarely found in anything like this. But it's a special occasion.
I was painting eggs with my dear Corrin before coming to this realm.
My brother Xander... He's probably hidden eggs at our castle.
The arrival of spring always warms my heart. May we celebrate like this forever.

alm.name: Alm
alm.title: Hero of Prophecy
alm.description: A brave but kind young warrior, raised by the hero Mycen in Ram Village. His left hand is marked with the Brand. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall:
This place has so many things I've never seen before and all kinds of people I never thought I'd meet.
Amazing, really, and sort of intimidating.
The Deliverance fights to free Zofia from Chancellor Desaix. A hard battle, and who knows when it will end?
Checking in on everyone? Sure you are. I need to do it too as leader of the Deliverance.
Mind telling me your story? I don't know much about much, so you'll find me a ready listener.

I was training with my sword, but mostly because if I don't, I hear my grandfather's voice in my head.
He's Sir Mycen—and someone you don't want to disappoint. So I always stay on top of my training.
Visit:
So this is another version of the Askran Kingdom...
Oh, hello there. Someone sent me here to say that. It was your friend [F].
Level: I can really feel the strength rising up inside of me!
I'll be more helpful to you with more strength like this.
Sorry about that. I'm not doing all that well, [S].
Summon: I'm Alm, leader of the Deliverance. You can count on me to take up my sword for your cause.
Learn Skill: You did that for me? I promise to fight as hard as I can!
Confession:
Good timing. I've been meaning to talk to you about something, [S].
My grandfather refused to let me ever leave my home, Ram Village.
So I don't know much about the world.
Since you summoned me here, I've met many different people. So many...surprises.
When it comes to you, I feel a bond different than the one I have with my friends.
I'm...relieved? Or...at ease? Really, I've only felt this way with one other person.
It's more than just you showing me all of these new things—much bigger than that, really.
This might sound sappy, but I'll say it anyway. Meeting you was like the dawn of something new. Thanks.
Status: Is it just me, or is this place strange?
Except for this, I haven't been outside my village much.
I have a lot of learning to do when it comes to...everything.
My friends? Good people. And fun.
There's nothing harder than the training my grandfather put me through. No way.
I wonder what Celica is up to right now...
If you ever need anything, know that you can count on me.
This is the attire of the Emblian Empire. Am I wearing it well?
Huh? You want to try this outfit on, too?
This armor isn't exactly what I'm used to, but... It's not a bad getup, all things considered.
That masked man is a friend of Prince Alfonse, isn't that right?
Have you seen Celica around here? I wonder if she would be surprised.
What kind of clothes do people wear in your homeland? Huh. Doesn't seem like much help against a blade.
This outfit may represent a fresh start for me, but I'll always be loyal to your cause.

faye.name: Faye
faye.title: Devoted Heart
faye.description: A young woman from Ram Village, and Alm's childhood friend. Her devotion to him stretches back to those days. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: This place is...in a whole different world than mine? Fine by me, I guess, if maybe Alm is near.
I'm not really one for fighting, but Alm joined the Deliverance... so I did too!

You on patrol? Thanks for watching out for us! Pass a note to Alm, if you happen by him?
Nothing much... Just a little "hi" from me!
The Askran Kingdom is so pretty! I should visit all the nicest spots. I bet you can guess...with who.
I'm sewing up a good-luck charm. Alm's always been good luck for me, so I think of him with every stitch.
Visit:
Oh, hello there! Are you [S]?
Guess who sent me? It was [F]!
Level: For Alm and the others, I have to get even better!
Hey, what do you think? Not bad, right?
Aw...but I tried so hard.
Summon: I'm Faye. Glad to help. I've trained a bit with the Deliverance, you know, for Alm and all my friends.
Learn Skill: You did that for me? One step closer to really helping!
Confession:
Oh! Well, it's you, isn't it, [S].
My eyes light up every time I turn a corner around here, hoping that I'll see you-know-who.
And, you know? You're not Alm, but you don't have to be. At least, not anymore.
Funny how people can be so stuck on someone...that they don't see what's right there.
I know you'd think I'm the last one to ever say something like that. But it's true.
I have proof. See? I'm working on a good-luck charm for you. Thought of you with every stitch.
Does it look good? Do you like it? I hope so. You mean a lot to me, so I really want it to be great!
Status: Now, now—what do you want?
Oh, you! Trying to get my attention?
Oh, Alm... Can't you see how much I love you?
I'd love to show you our village someday.
What do I like? Sewing, flowers, and...sewing flowers. How about you?
I wonder what Alm is thinking about right now...
I'm really fond of Alm, as you know by now. But I've come to care for you too!
Can't really say I know what's going on, but SOMEBODY told me to try on this outfit. How's it look?
Ah! Oh, it's you. And here I was hoping I'd get to talk to Alm...
So...are the Emblians our enemies, or friends? It's kinda hard to keep track sometimes.
You want to help me practice? Great! Now just put this apple on your head and stay very, very still...
There are so many different Alms from so many different worlds... And each is just as wonderful as the next!
I wonder what Alm will say when he sees me in this outfit...
I'm with you till the very end. Don't you ever forget that!

clair.name: Clair
clair.title: Highborn Flier
clair.description: A pegasus knight with the Deliverance. Clive's younger sister. Secretly loves Alm. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall:
The uniforms that those in the Order of Heroes wear are splendid. I wonder if they'd let me wear one...
I think the look would suit me very well, don't you?
I was a knight of Zofia until Chancellor Desaix's coup d'etat. My dear brother was right there with me.
Worried about me? Oh, you! It's really not necessary. You just take good care of yourself, all right?
I'd love for you to join me for a lovely cup of tea, and I'd even do you the honor of preparing it myself.

I should write letters to everyone back at our family manor. To Father and Mother, of course!
But also to all our servants, the maid, and the nursemaid... Oh! And our private tutor, too.
Visit:
I have come to bring you greetings from [F].
How nice for you!
Level: A fine result, quite fitting for a noble.
Hmm. I suppose that will do.
A tad unsatisfying.
Summon:
My name is Clair. I battle alongside my dear brother in the Deliverance forces that fight for Zofia.
What fortune that you should meet me like this!
Learn Skill: Now I'll be certain to shine for all the world forevermore!
Confession:
Ah, there you are, my fine friend [S]!
I was just thinking how nice it would be to see your face. Why, you ask?
I suppose I've taken a liking to you. Is there something so very strange about that?
Yes? No? Perhaps? Well, let's throw caution to the wind. It's undeniable we have a bond.
It's quite mysterious, and perhaps even fate. But I hope you don't misunderstand.
My heart's fondest affections are reserved for Alm— Oh! Please forget I said that.
Still, here is what I meant to say. You have somehow become very dear to me. That is all.
Status: I just couldn't be prouder of my brother.
My, my...
That Alm can be so distant.
I would give all I have if it would bring peace to this world.
I can't help but feel a little jealous of Mathilda's skill.
Honestly, I think Alm knows...
I've come to have more respect for you than you'd ever know.
This material is so fine. Won't it tear in battle?
You would do well to keep your hands to yourself.
I've met so many people since I came to Askr. Every day is a joy.
My brother still speaks to me as if I were a child. It's becoming tiresome.
I have a veritable mountain of dresses in my closet!
If only Alm could see how far I've come.
I am sincerely glad that I was able to meet you.

lukas.name: Lukas
lukas.title: Sharp Soldier
lukas.description: A young noble fighting for the Deliverance. Strict, calm, and considerate. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: This world exists in a state of division too? Perhaps it is simply human to be torn in two.

I am of a noble family...at least in the world where I am from.
Our home is near the border, so I joined the Deliverance when crisis erupted in our lands.
You are not from this place, and yet you have committed yourself to their cause. Very honorable.
The weather is often pleasant here. We should venture out on a stroll. Such things sooth the spirit.
I like to lose myself in the books here when I can. It should be no surprise. Even I like a good escape.
Visit:
I have been sent to deliver a hello from your friend [F].
How nice to get best wishes for the future.
Level: This much growth seems almost excessive, don't you think?
I will take an average gain over none any day.
Less than moderate growth. Hmm. I can do better.
Summon: My name is Lukas. I'm among those who fight for the Deliverance. While here, I pledge myself to your cause.
Learn Skill: You have placed your faith in me. And so, I place my faith in you.
Confession:
What perfect timing you have, [S].
I was ready for a break from the usual routine. Chat with me a moment, won't you?
I've noticed that you and I both are walking a similar path here.
We are both Heroes, are we not? Both of us, summoned here.
And both, constrained by the habits and patterns of that place, only to wake a bit upon landing here.
Still, one can't regret the past, ties that bind and all. We must carry on.
Don't you agree? Ha! Well, perhaps I overspoke.
Or is it that we too deeply sympathize—and there is really no need for much ado?
In any case, I'm glad to be with you. Right here, right now.
Status: Yes? What do you require?
Hmm? You needn't needle me.
What shall we do...? Find some sort of diversion?
The Kingdom of Zofia is blessed with great beauty.
My friends have strong personalities. They would try even the most patient of men.
I wonder how the Deliverance fares?
Our meeting here can only be called fortuitous.
This outfit draws a little too much attention for my liking.
Ah—I didn't see you there. Did you need something?
It seems our relationship with the Emblian Empire only grows more complicated.
I rarely give much thought to returning home.
There are so many fascinating people here in Askr...including those from Embla.
What does the future have in store for this world, I wonder…
Getting to know you has been a genuine pleasure.

ike.name: Ike
ike.title: Young Mercenary
ike.description: A kindhearted but stoic young man who has taken command of his father's mercenary band. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall:
The Heroes here are strong. Being around them makes me feel...
Huh. Doesn't matter. I just need to get stronger.

I'm part of a group known as the Greil Mercenaries back in my world. Though I'm its leader...
I wouldn't exactly say that I've got a handle on our finances yet.
You worn out? Let me know if you are. I'll help, unless you think I'll just get in your way.
I train when I can, though usually by myself. I'm not all that great when it comes to...you know, talk.

I'd spar with my father a lot during practice when I was younger.
I'd lose every time. Get upset. Then take him on again.
Visit: Are you the leader here? In any case, I've come with greetings from [F].
Level: Feels good to have a surge like that. Real good!
I must get stronger. I must avenge my father.
I'll never match his level of ability at this rate...
Summon: I'm Ike of the Greil Mercenaries. You the one hiring me? Fine. I'm ready to get to work.
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude. I swear to repay this debt.
Confession:
Back when my father was teaching me how to use a sword, I was barely more than a boy.
Every training battle was more frustrating than the last. I...I just struggled with it constantly.
Then he died.
I had to protect my sister, the Greil Mercenaries, everyone that he did...it was all on me.
But I was told to use what I'd been given. If I did, then great things would happen.
That really stuck with me. Now here I am, fighting in battles with real Heroes.
And I'm battling enemies that are sometimes stronger than I am. Do I really have a place here?
But you hired me—rolled the dice that I might help you do great things here.
So...right. Let's just cut this short there. You believed in me, so I'm glad to give my all for you.
Status: I'm Ike, commander of the Greil Mercenaries.
Whuh?! Not smart to surprise a mercenary. We're quick on the attack.
Sorry if I'm not that great at...this talking stuff. But know you can always count on me.
My father taught me how to handle a sword. It's all I know.
Pretty good food today. Who was on cooking duty?
As a commander, I'm green as they come. But I do my best. Those I fight with...they're family.
You hired me. I said I'd get to work. See? I did. Glad to give you everything I have.
I am Ike. I have donned the clothing of Múspell.
Hm? Did you mistake me for one of Múspell's troops?
Sorry, but... Can I hide out here? Mist and Soren won't leave me in peace.
I don't really care what I'm wearing, as long as it doesn't restrict my movement. Isn't that all that matters?
What's Múspell known for? I hope it's roast meat.
This part, on the shoulder, that sticks up... What's it for?
Whether they are of flame, or of ice... I'll take care of anyone who gets in your way.

soren.name: Soren
soren.title: Shrewd Strategist
soren.description: An officer in the Greil Mercenaries. A coolheaded realist who has opened up to Ike. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall:
The Order of Heroes doesn't fight for money—or even merely for honor. Only to save people.
Very odd. I can't even begin to relate to that kind of thinking.
You're curious...about my world? Tell me how it would benefit me to share those details with you?
If your tactics fail, it's us that fall on the battlefield. Not you. So please ask if you need tactical advice.

Not that's it's anyone's business, but in my world, I'm among those called the Branded.
That means I was condemned more or less at birth to be hated and shunned. So, there it is.

I've been scouring the history books of this world. Oh, I have scant interest in history itself.
I am only searching for any information that will prove useful to guide our tactics here.
Visit:
I've come to deliver greetings from [F].
Now I'll be on my way.
Level: Fortune twists in the wind, and today it blows my way.
Any increase to my abilities is most welcome.
Fortune twists in the wind, and today it blows elsewhere.
Summon: Hmm. My name? I am the mage Soren. Now, I have a question for you. Is Ike here?
Learn Skill: Now, may increasing my strength work to your advantage.
Confession:
...and yes, that concludes my analysis of the abilities of Heroes from other worlds.
As you can now fully understand, they would make dangerous foes if they weren't our allies.
And furthermore... Excuse me? I sense your attention drifting away, [S].
For goodness sake, you are sometimes so vexing to me that I can hardly—
Oh, never mind. But you shouldn't get the wrong idea.
I don't care a whit about anything but getting back home. Being here is only temporary for me.
Oh, you wonder why I haven't left of my own accord then?! It's because you...you...
I mean, it's because staying lets me sneak into other worlds and learn our enemies' secrets.
That's useful to me. But if I can continue to be useful to you...?
Then I am happy to say that we can consider it mutually beneficial.
Status: You're the tactician for this group? Oh, no... It's nothing.
I'll take my leave unless you have a specific request of me.
I am a mercenary. Guided by self-interest. Above bonds and attachments.
Ike is much more than a leader. No one could compare to him.
When Ike isn't feeling well, most would never notice that his left eye twitches.
No matter who I may be...I have a duty.
Helping you is to our mutual advantage. That is all.
What are these clothes? I've never seen anything like them.
You don't know when to give up. Neither of you seem to learn...
The realm of the dead... I find Hel a fascinating study, but I'm in no rush to join her army.
Much like Princess Eir, I won't make friends with just anybody.
I could tell Ike was shocked when he saw me. What do you plan to do about that?
Do you suppose a peaceful slumber awaits me one day?
I have nothing to say about your taste in clothing, but I can say I've learned something of you.

mist.name: Mist
mist.title: Helpful Sister
mist.description: Ike's younger sister. Active and cheerful, and takes care of the Greil Mercenaries. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: This place is amazing. Even the air— it's so, I don't know...fresh? We must be really high up or something!

I'm not too happy being in battles, but I'm glad to help any way I can. You know what I do love doing?
Cleaning and doing laundry, believe it or not!

You should sit down and relax for a while, [S].
I'll get you some water.
Oh, Father... Mother... And my brother...
The wind can really pick up around here—and that can blow all of my laundry right off the line!
Visit: Hi there! Oh, wait.... Right! I'm here mainly to pass on a hello from [F]!
Level: Getting stronger! Only figures. I am my father's daughter!
Looks like I'm getting a bit better at all of this!
See? I'm just not meant to be out here in battle!
Summon: Hi! I'm Mist. But where am I? This all happened so fast! Well, I bet you'll help me get settled in, right?
Learn Skill: Nice you did that, but I hope you don't have better things to do.
Confession:
Oh, [S]!
You caught me in the middle of working on laundry. It's something that really helps me relax.
You know I'm not that comfortable being in the middle of battles, but I do like helping everyone.
I've come to love being here with so many people. You must have seen that I was nervous at first.
Some of the Heroes seemed a bit intimidating! But I knew I could trust you from the very start.
I don't really know why, but I knew it from the second I saw you. Anyway, I've been glad to work hard for you.
So, right... What was my point? Oh, yes. Thanks! And you can count on me to keep doing my best!
Status: Please take care.
We'll do this together!
Oh! You surprised me!
Do you know my brother? He can be...a bit of an odd one.
Always glad when you have time for me. Thank you so much!
Father... Mother... Ike...
You know I will never forgive you if you—you know—die on me. Please remember that.

titania.name: Titania
titania.title: Mighty Mercenary
titania.description: Deputy commander of the Greil Mercenaries. An idealistic former knight who values honor. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall:
The Order of Heroes isn't doing all of this to gain rewards or gather accolades.
It's purely in the interest of saving people. I find that marvelous.

Our mercenary group has an unusual reputation. We're known to do jobs without payment.
And we sometimes take a job only to help save people. But we never do it solely for the money.

Anything I can assist you with? I'm glad to handle any task, for all jobs are crucial among mercenaries.
Why, I've even been known to help Mist with laundry on occasion. No dirtier task than that in our group.

Training must become instinct for those who want to survive on the battlefield.
And so, we must master our abilities, our very bodies, until our training is in our blood.

I wish our mercenary group's old commander, Greil, could see how well his son has developed.
He has carried on Greil's legacy very nicely as our leader.
Visit: Hello. I've come to bring you greetings from your friend [F].
Level: Delightful! This reminds me of my earliest days in battle.
I use the experience of each and every battle to fuel my fire.
It's sometimes clear that I'm not as spry as I once was.
Summon: I am Titania, deputy commander of the Greil Mercenaries. Do you have a job for me? If so, let's start now.
Learn Skill: Thank you for placing such trust in me. I will strive to do my best.
Confession:
Today I'd like to show you what it's like to wield an axe, [S].
First lesson! Make sure you swing the axe so the axe doesn't swing you.
Now, give my axe a try. Good, but set your hips so it makes a base that will not sway.
Oh? Ready to stop so soon? Working such training into your bones and blood could save you.
But I suppose that's my job, and I'm glad that you've summoned me into this world to do it.
It's long been my desire to fight with pride, saving people, with no regard for money or honor.
How lucky I am to have found a friend in you.
So, if you wish it, I'll protect your life, as one of your truest friends, for as long as you'll have me.
Status: I am with the Greil Mercenaries. Have you a job for us?
Wha—? Phew! That was close. Not a good idea to sneak up on me.
So you're the Great Hero I'm hearing about? A legend already at your age!
I'd like to ask you—how many years do you think I've been doing this?
Some think daily training is boring. I think it keeps you alive. So let's keep it up, all right?
What to do...? A battle of strength? You do realize who you're talking to, right?
Whatever the path you choose, I will be there right beside you.
I appreciate the new outfit, but...is there no armor to go with it?
*surprised noise* Hands to yourself! Where are your manners?
A god must be hardy indeed, to be able to fight with such little protection.
I have no special powers or anything of the sort. My strength comes purely from training.
Commander Greil? No—don't even think about calling him over here!
I suppose it's not so bad, having less weight to carry.
You must truly care about me. I appreciate that—thank you.

celica.name: Celica
celica.title: Caring Princess
celica.description: The princess of Zofia; trained as a priestess. Caring toward others, and dislikes fighting. Bears the Brand on her right hand. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: The Askran Kingdom is so beautiful. It saddens me to hear that it is also engulfed in conflict.

I trained as a priestess at a priory. And before that, I lived in Ram, a small village...
But even further back, I lived in a castle. Keep that between us, OK?
If you get tired, please let me know. I'll pour you some hot tea, and we'll take a break together.
I'm going to offer a prayer to Mila. Would you care to join me? I think you'll find it calming. I know I do.

I was thinking about a childhood friend of mine. For some reason, we can never quite seem to meet up...
Is it fate that keeps us apart?
Visit: Are you [S]? I was asked to bring you a message from [F].
Level: I have the strength to fight, too!
Hard work does bring results.
Oh... What a disappointment.
Summon: I am Celica, a priestess. Though I'd rather avoid bloodshed, I am prepared to fight if I must.
Learn Skill: This strength that you've given me will not go to waste.
Confession:
There's something I'd like to speak to you about. Will you listen to what I have to say?
As you know, people call me Celica. But, actually...I have another name. My true name is Anthiese.
This is a secret I must guard closely. If the people of Zofia were to learn of it, it would result in a pointless war.
I do feel safe telling you, though. In fact, I want you to understand. You matter to me. I trust you with my life.
Even if I return to my world, please remember the time we spent. Think of me...
The girl called both Celica...and Anthiese.
Status: Oh? What is it that you need?
All right, all right...
May the goddess Mila protect us all.
I take my duties, as princess of Zofia, quite seriously.
Tell me, is there anyone in your life who is essential to you?
I wonder if Alm...is doing well?
Being here, with you, restores my spirit.
This outfit is from the realm of dreams. What do you think? Do I wear it well?
Be careful. The frills on this outfit are surprisingly delicate.
Were I born an álfr, oh what a wondrous life I'd lead...
As a child, my picture books were filled with fairies. My brother was quite fond of them as well.
I can't help but feel quite merry, wearing a gorgeous outfit such as this.
I wonder if Alm will visit me in my dreams tonight.
Do you have a dream? I'd love to help make it a reality.

mae.name: Mae
mae.title: Bundle of Energy
mae.description: A mage from Novis and a dear friend of Celica. Always cheerful and energetic, but she has a tendency to get carried away. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: So Sharena is a princess...just like Celica... Wait! Forget I said anything!
Hmm. All of a sudden, Celica said she was heading off to the Temple of Mila. What happened?
Good job out there today. Here's a snack! Just think of it as a reward for all your hard work.
Maybe I ought to change my hairstyle... Something a little more... grown up? Whatcha think?
Me? Just taking care of my skin. They say that moving to a different climate is rough on you. And they're right!
Visit: Oh, [S]! I have a message for you. I'm glad I caught you!
Level: I wonder if it's OK to be so strong...
Not bad. Not bad at all.
What? Why?
Summon: Hi there! I'm Mae, a mage. Now that I'm around, everything's gonna be OK. I know what I'm doing!
Learn Skill: Hmm... More power? This is exciting!
Confession:
[S]! Am I glad to see you! Spending time with you gives me energy.
What? I'm already TOO energetic? So mean! You sound just like Boey.
Just kidding! I know you're joking. I'm happy that we're close enough to kid around now.
We've been fighting for a while now... I think I get you, at least a little bit. You're so calm and so kind...
So, yeah, your little joke surprised me! It's nice to see this side of you. Maybe I'll see another one tomorrow!
Status: What's up?
A sneak attack? You scoundrel!
If you tease me, you've got it coming!
I'll be the one who protects Lady Celica.
Traveling in a big group is a lot of fun!
That Boey, he's so clueless.
I'm glad I met you. You're a riot!

boey.name: Boey
boey.title: Skillful Survivor
boey.description: A mage from Novis who grew up dirt- poor. Of calm demeanor, but not great at magic. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: The Order of Heroes, a different world... This is like a dream, and it's more than I can fathom now.

I'm a fisherman's son, from a little island called Novis.
With two brothers, life wasn't easy for my family, so I ended up at the Priory.

I've seen how hard you work. Be careful with that. Work too hard, and you'll wear yourself out.
Then nothing will get done.

When I need calm, I just go and look at the sea. But now that I'm here in this world, how do I even find it?
Maybe you can take me.
I was just reading my grimoire. If I don't keep my studies up, I'm going to hear it from Nomah.
Visit:
I bring greetings from [F].
That's all I got.
Level: Nice! I can celebrate a little now, can't I?
No better than adequate.
Need to try again... And study harder next time.
Summon: I'm Boey, a mage. I usually try to avoid problematic situations. You called me here, so...so much for that.
Learn Skill: Knowing you believe in me makes me feel like I'll become even stronger.
Confession:
My family... Well, I'll be honest with you. We were poor as poor gets, so off to the priory I went.
They said I had a talent for magic. Don't get me wrong. I didn't suffer over it. But I did wonder...
If I was born somewhere else, what would my life have been like? I gave up thinking about it. There's no point.
But then I was summoned here—a world full of different people. Fighting alongside them has been great.
And I have to thank you for that. We've been together for a long time now. You're not just someone I know.
Now...I think of you more like...family.
Status: Looking for something?
Cut it out! What are we, kids?
I see how it's going to be.
I wonder how everyone's doing back at home.
Me and Mae? We're just stuck with each other. We've been together since we were kids.
I do what needs to be done. That's all there is to it.
Now that I think about it, spending time with you isn't so bad.

genny.name: Genny
genny.title: Endearing Ally
genny.description: A meek young cleric from Novis. Likes to write her own stories. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: This castle is so beautiful, I feel like I've become a princess! I wish I could just stay here forever...
Me? Well... I was raised at a priory. I do have a father... But I can't see him. I really wish I could.
I'm a little worried about you! You're always running around. You should follow my lead and take a nap.
I'm writing a story. Actually... I want someone to read it. Do you think you might have time later? Only if it's OK.

... ... ...
Oh! Sorry, sorry! I was thinking about this new idea I had for a story. Would you like to hear about it?
Visit: Excuse me... I was asked to bring you this greeting from [F].
Level: Yay! I'm getting stronger, aren't I?
Oh, this makes me so happy!
Aw... That's disappointing.
Summon: My name is Genny. Since I barely know anybody here...I'm a little anxious. I hope we can get along.
Learn Skill: How exciting! Do I seem any different to you?
Confession:
Can I ask you something? I'd like it if you would visit more often. Will you spend some time with me?
If you find the time, we could drink tea or go for a walk in the woods or around the lake...
Is that too much to ask? I know you already come and see me a lot. I don't want you to get tired of me.
People always tell me that I'm like a little sister, but I want you to see me as more than that.
I'll do my best to get stronger and stand on my own two feet. I really hope you'll see what I mean.
Status: I'm here for you!
Cheer up!
Did you need something?
HEY! That tickles!
Well, you've got my attention!
You know... If I could, I'd like to meet my father.
Just so you know...I'd do whatever I could to help.

lloyd.name: Lloyd
lloyd.title: White Wolf
lloyd.description: A member of the Black Fang assassins. Delivers justice to those they deem criminals. Known as the White Wolf. Son of the group's leader. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
There's something about this place that gets under my skin. It's decent enough.
Maybe that's the problem. It's not at all like places where the Black Fang met.

We of the real Black Fang never killed for pleasure.
We exterminated lowlifes—those who preyed upon those who couldn't fight for themselves.
Your weapon is something else... I wonder if you could use it to shoot vermin somehow.

My younger brother and I both delivered the Fang's justice to evil vermin who deserved it.
But Linus can be reckless, especially when I'm not there to rein the guy in.

The Black Fang has its Four Fangs, those who really get their hands the dirtiest. Who are they?
Sure, I'll tell you. Two of 'em are the Angel of Death and the Blue Crow...Jaffar and Ursula.
And of course, there's me and my brother, Linus... We're the White Wolf and the Mad Dog.
Visit:
So, I take it that you're [S]?
Hey, relax. I bring greetings, not... justice.
Level: Heh, nice. Almost too good to believe.
Just about what I expected.
Eh. Guess I'm not a young buck anymore.
Summon: I'm Lloyd—the White Wolf of Black Fang. Know some vermin? I'll exterminate 'em for you.
Learn Skill: Thanks. Every bit helps when hunting vermin.
Confession:
Got some truth for you. You know the Black Fang that I'm always talking about?
Well, I'm more proud of what we were...than what we are.
Oh, we've always been covered in blood, but it was always for a decent cause—uh, back then.
When? Well, before a bunch of stuff happened. But the Fang fell into some shadowy business.
Still, being here brings back good memories of dark deeds done for the right reasons.
You remind me of my brother too. So I'd better stick around to keep you out of his kind of trouble.
Special: Don't blame me for your fate.
It's time for you to die.
Status: Need someone eliminated? I'll consider it.
This poking and prodding... What are we, children?
We Fangs eliminate lowlifes—no matter how high their station.
In the Fangs, I am known as the White Wolf.
How fortunate that neither of us is a lowlife...or the Fangs would strike.
The law of the Fangs is absolute. There's no wiggle room.
I like your face. Seems like you're the type who values your true family. We see eye to eye on this.

caeda2.name: Caeda
caeda2.title: Talys's Bride
caeda2.description: The charming princess of Talys. Has grand dreams of being a bride. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: What do I want out of my marriage? It's simple. I'd be happiest knowing my husband is safe and sound.
Tell me. Do you believe in love? Do you have someone special out there, [S]?
I've heard that the secret to a happy marriage is consideration. Always show your partner that you care.
I have some experience fighting infantry battles without my pegasus. Not dressed like this, of course...
This dress fits me perfectly. Somehow...I can't help but smile while wearing it.
Visit: Hello! I bring wishes for your health and happiness, sent warmly by [F].
Level: Do you think I'll make a good match?
We learn each and every day... In battle, and in marriage, too.
I'm so sorry!
Summon: I am Princess Caeda of Talys. I was daydreaming about wearing a bridal gown just like this one...and then...
Learn Skill: I owe you much for your kindness.
Confession:
What does love mean to you? Tell me, [S].
As long as the person I love is safe and happy... That's really all that matters to me.
Wearing this dress got me thinking, though. When they wed, two people vow to make each other happy.
If I were to die... I'm sure that the person I love would be sad. I wonder... Is that what love is?
Love isn't as simple as it seems. And I'm sure we all feel it differently...
What does love mean to you? Please, if you would, share your thoughts with me.
Status: Tell me—how do I look?
I know it's silly to fuss...but I do want my tresses to impress on my big day.
I've adored dresses like this ever since I was a child.
I wonder where the perfect place to hold a wedding is around here!
There is nothing more beautiful than two people pledging their love to one another.
I vow that if our lives are put in grave peril, I will be the one to fall. Not you.
I know this is all just for fun, but someday...? Well, a girl can dream, can't she?

lyn2.name: Lyn
lyn2.title: Bride of the Plains
lyn2.description: Noblewoman of Caelin. Eager to win the bridal tournament and nab the prize bouquet. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: My ideal match? I haven't given it much thought... If I had to say, it would be someone I love, of course.
This outfit is so embarrassing. Are women usually OK with getting married in a getup like this?

Feeling tired? Let me know if I can do anything, [S].
I know I'm not exactly the relaxed type, but...

Think this dress is going to keep me off the battlefield? Think again! I'm as fierce a fighter as I ever was—
Yeah, I can see that you get it.
Ugh... This dress is so restrictive! Hey, don't look at me! I didn't pick it out.
Visit: This dress? Don't ask! Forget you saw anything! Oh, right. Hi from [F]!
Level: Wow, I'm doing great! Maybe I'll keep wearing this thing...
Never thought much about being a bride, but I did train for battle!
I can't concentrate when I'm dressed like this!
Summon: My name is Lyn, and I swear there's a reason I'm in this getup, but... Let's not focus on the dress, OK?
Learn Skill: Look! With this power, I can— Actually, don't look. This dress...
Confession:
Oh, sorry. I was staring at you. You just remind me of someone I know, [S].
My husband? You're kidding, right?
No, another tactician. We helped each other out, and we traveled a long way together...
That friendship means a lot to me.
I'm not sure if you're that much alike, but spending time with you does make me happy.
If you feel the same, I hope we're never separated...
That sounds like a proposal? Of course it isn't! Why would you even think that?
Status: I'll protect you.
Always at your side.
I know. I know. I know! This really doesn't suit me.
This dress will be the end of me.
I hope you don't find this whole thing funny.
I wonder if my grandfather would be happy to see me like this...
I would never marry someone who couldn't stand at my side in battle. Hey! Let's spar.

cordelia2.name: Cordelia
cordelia2.title: Perfect Bride
cordelia2.description: Pegasus knight of Ylisse who excels in all things, including being delightful. Hopes to marry her perfect match. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
What? How do I picture my ideal marriage?! Well... My husband and I would always get along, and...
It'd be nice if we had a little girl.

Everyone keeps asking, but no, I wasn't summoned in the middle of a wedding ceremony.
Where I come from, this uniform is formal battle dress.
I can move just fine in this dress, so send me into battle. I just want to help—with anything that needs doing.

Do you have your eye on anyone? Just tell me, and I'll use my bow to turn them your direction.
No, not really.
Hmm... Compared to my armor... Ahh, [S]! I was just adjusting my dress!
Visit:
I bring greetings from [F].
Am I headed to a wedding? Er...no. I guess I can see why you ask...
Level: I think I have what it takes... For battle, and for love.
I guess training in this dress gives decent results.
At this rate... Will I find the one to return my love?
Summon: I am Cordelia. I know, I know! But don't worry. I can fight just fine in this. It's not a wedding dress!
Learn Skill: Thanks to all you've done for me, I can wear this dress with pride.
Confession:
I've finished my patrol. I've checked our supplies, too. I've been looking for you, [S].
What? That's not a job for a bride? Don't kid around. You know I'm a soldier.
Wait.. Is it that you don't want me to spoil my dress?
I'm right? Er... How embarrassing! But thanks for the compliment, all the same.
Well, why not? You've been so nice to me... I'll try being a bride for you.
Ha! You're blushing! How cute.
Shall we walk onto the battlefield, arm-in-arm? Maybe we do make a good couple...
Status: Well, as you can see, this is just perfect.
I'll prove myself no matter what I'm wearing.
There's a saying: bride in June, groom shall swoon.
In Ylisse, it's tradition to pledge your devotion...to Naga, the divine dragon.
A proposal ought to be done only when the time is right, never sooner.
Someday...someday...I would love to be married in a dress like this.
Will I ever pledge my love to anyone...? We shall see. Until then, I pledge my service to you.

charlotte2.name: Charlotte
charlotte2.title: Money Maiden
charlotte2.description: Nohrian border guard always on patrol, whether to find enemies to fight or a rich fellow to marry. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
When I get married, I will never fail to provide a delicious, homemade meal for my husband each and every day!
...
Nothing? OK, I'll need to say that again. Louder.

Why am I in this gown? Like I know! I was daydreaming about marrying someone rich...
All of a sudden, you summoned me... And here I am, dressed like this!
Are you tiptoeing around me just because I'm wearing this dress? Put me on the front lines!
You know what will set off this dress? Flowers. Lots of flowers. Let's go find a field, [S]!
While I'm all dressed up, I had better attract the attention of a wealthy gentleman... Oopsie! I tripped!
Visit:
Well, hello there! Are there any eligible men around here you might introduce me to? Thanks.
This dress? Oh, I'm not married...yet.
Level: Oh, prince I have yet to meet... I'm getting better every day!
I'll be ready for marriage... Whenever it strikes.
If I keep this up, I'll be the last to wed!
Summon: I'm Charlotte. Everyone says I'm just a sweet, gentle little thing, so please watch over me. Tee-hee!
Learn Skill: At this rate... I'll make a beautiful bride. Thanks!
Confession:
Are you going to summon a Hero? Oh, please! Let me come too! C'mon, [S]!
Picture this: Someone tall and handsome, strong yet gentle, VERY rich...and single. My destined one!
WHAT? It doesn't work that way? What is that thing even good for, then? Never mind.
But even without a man like that, I do have a friend in you, don't I? Love fades, but friendship is forever.
In other words...for now, you'll do.
Enough talk! It's time for action. Make way for the Bride of the Battlefield!
Status: I must confess: this dress is the best!
What? Did you say I look pretty? Please, stop!
I'm sure you'd like to know who the lucky fellow is. Doesn't everybody?
This dress is the worst! I can't move. I can't breathe! OH! Never mind.
This spoon is as big as my love. I know. Amazing.
I look good—real good! So where are all the rich princes already?!
I think I'm a pretty good proposition. But you... You're real marriage material.

lucina3.name: Marth
lucina3.title: Enigmatic Blade
lucina3.description: A mysterious swordsman who hides his face behind a mask. Calls himself Marth. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.
lucina3.artist: Maiponpon (まいぽんぽん) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: Tell me again—this is not Ylisse? Did Naga make a mistake? Ah, no! Forget I said anything.
War consumed my world. Those who survived fought so valiantly... But averting the apocalypse falls to me.
So you check on all of your troops? I understand how you feel. It hurts to lose them.
It looks like Prince Alfonse is a skilled swordsman. I'd like to spar with him... You'll arrange it for me? Thank you.

...I was thinking of my home and my comrades. I'm not yet sure exactly why I came here...
Someday, I hope, I'll be able to tell you more about these things.
Visit:
You're [S]?
I've come with greetings for you from [F].
Level: If I keep this up, I can grow strong—like my father!
Excellent. I feel I'm improving.
My apologies!
Summon: You may call me Marth. I can say no more than this just now. If you require my help, I offer it to you.
Learn Skill: This strength will not be wasted. I must continue to ask for your aid.
Confession:
It has been some time since you summoned me here. Really, I should be elsewhere. And I am no Hero.
I am grateful to you, though. I can use the strength you've given me to fulfill the mission that lies ahead.
The day will come when I have to leave, [S].
I must return to the land so dear to me—the one where we all swore to meet again...
The one where we promised we would change our fates. When the time comes, I hope I can explain.
Unlike the other Heroes, I must guard my secrets. I cannot open up to you. But for now, my sword is yours.
Status: I am searching for someone. I can say no more than that.
If you care to duel, I would be happy to test myself against you.
I am afraid I cannot remove this mask. I have my reasons.
I learned swordsmanship at a young age...from my father.
I may have come to the wrong place...
I wonder what's become of Father and the others...
I have a mission of my own, but I will help you for now.

luke.name: Luke
luke.title: Rowdy Squire
luke.description: An aspiring knight of Altea. Flirtatious. Roderick's longtime friend and rival. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall:
A castle needs knights, and a knight needs romance. So, if A equals B equals C...
That means a castle needs romance! Wait. That math didn't add up.

Hey, friend, you keep up the good watch. For what? For the only thing worth watching for!
Ladies for Luke! Any kind—long as they're easy on the eyes.
I'm an Altean knight in training, but that pretty much means that I'm a legend in the making!
My pal Roderick and I go way back. Worries too much, but other than that, he's a fine guy!
We should get out of here and find ourselves an adventure! Or maybe some hearts to woo!
Visit: Hello there! You've now become a part of the Legend of Luke! You can thank [F].
Level: The Legend of Luke keeps getting better and better!
Pretty good, but a legend like me can do better!
That's all? Can't be. Not for me.
Summon: Call for your bards! They will want to write songs about me, Luke, the finest knight of Altea!
Learn Skill: Thank you for doing your part in the Legend of Luke!
Confession:
How do you like how the Legend of Luke has turned out—just as great as you thought, right?
There's no stronger, more virtuous knight than I am. It almost scares me. But you can't keep a legend down!
Ha! I'm just joking. I'm really just an idiot that you believed in, despite all my big talk.
I couldn't stay focused for a minute without you guiding me. So, you know, I really think YOU'RE the big deal.
What? Don't look so surprised! I'm a humble guy under it all. Just please don't let anyone else know, OK?
Status: Need the Luke, huh? Here to help!
Hey, now! You'll mess up the Luke's hair.
Who's larger than life? Me, Luke!
Want a nickname? I'll give you one that will really stick!
Any pretty healers around? Cuz I need some healing!
People like big deals, right? Not average deals?
Who wants to be a leader? Not me. All work, no glory!

roderick.name: Roderick
roderick.title: Steady Squire
roderick.description: An aspiring knight of Altea. Of calm demeanor. Luke's longtime friend and rival. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: This castle welcomes Heroes, but does that include me? I'm only a knight in training!

The leader we had in our platoon back home is someone I deeply respected.
I have to admit that you remind me somewhat of that person!

I want to become a true knight of Altea, and thus a man of any importance.
But to do that, I must complete my time as a knight in training.
I have known my friend Luke for a long time. He may act rashly, but I know he has a good heart.
I would like to join you to scout the area outside of the castle. It's always best to be prepared for anything.
Visit: I beg your pardon. I'm Roderick, a knight in training. I bring greetings from [F].
Level: I'll savor this only for a moment. There's work to do.
How encouraging. Slow and steady wins the race.
I may falter at this rate. I must work harder.
Summon: My name is Roderick, a knight in training for Altea. I will do my best to prove my use.
Learn Skill: I owe you thanks plus a vow to give you my all.
Confession:
Have I yet proven my use? I hope I have grown strong enough to be of great help to you.
I find it hard to know whether I measure up, but I sense that I haven't disappointed you.
I promise that I'll keep doing my best not to be a burden.
I hope to even lighten your load. This order relies so much on your strength.
I can't imagine what it must be like to bear that load. But if you'll allow me to remain...?
I will help you carry it.
Special: I won't go easy on you!
Status: May I be of service to you?
Oh! You seem to do that a lot.
What is our plan for the next battle?
I try to remember to battle as a team—never in isolation.
If ever you need me, I am delighted to serve.
I wonder how everyone in my platoon is doing.
I am deeply honored to fight alongside you.

athena.name: Athena
athena.title: Borderland Sword
athena.description: A foreign warrior with a straightforward personality. Speaks with an accent. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Odor of Heroes... Why is it you say this thing? Do Heroes smell like slop from farm?
We are not teacher at heart, but in other world, we have been tutor of the hacking and slashing.
Always you are busy. Always, never sleep enough. You lay head on fluffy pillow. We do patrol for you.
What are these Heroes? Are Heroes us or fancy people in white uniforms like silly ducks?
People of this kingdom are under attack by empire. We help. Any good person would.
Visit:
In home country, we have expression. Blue means blue, but blue is deep color. Holds all other blues.
Now, you think on that.
Level: We had good day.
We had not bad day.
We had bad day.
Summon: You call Athena? We are warrior, not little child to come running. Still, you are nice. We stay.
Learn Skill: We are grateful. And we always repay debt.
Confession:
We understand many of your fancy words now.
Summon is how you call Heroes like you do.
Breidablik is funny weapon. Divine, divine—we know.
And shoot is to shoot. Even little babies know that.
We are grateful for patience you give us.
There is a saying in home country, that true warriors in group fight as one body with many arms.
So, we help allies, and we give our two arms gladly.
Now, final word we have learned. We are your, how do you say again...? Woman?
Wait, no. Friend. We are your friend. And we hope to learn many more words from you.
Status: You have need of us?
Is that hello in home country?
I try speak your tongue, but is twisted.
Half things people say sound like curse words. I know not. But sound like!
This Odor of Heroes... Why not they just take bath, if smell?
We pledge self to you for life. Is least we can do.
We feel bond with you.
Oi, what?
We get new clothes. What you think? Good, huh?
Hmm? Oh, you do hand-waving thing. Is greeting of your country, yes?
Princess Veronica is never talking. So much quietness. Is dull.
Askr. Embla. These country names of this world, yes? We knowing now.
Odor of Heroes only smell after training. Why you always call it this?
Askr is nice place. We have funny time.
We get gift of clothes from you. Is proper wedding gift. We are married now, yes?

katarina.name: Katarina
katarina.title: Wayward One
katarina.description: Reserved and harboring a dark secret, this trainee tactician depends on others. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: The idea of fighting beside those I've read about in books makes me...a bit nervous.
I was very close to my friend Clarisse. We were orphans, and we swore...to look after each other.
Don't work yourself too hard, and be sure to get rest. If you can't sleep...I could sing you a lullaby.
