You do such a splendid job as a tactician. I once studied for such a role...but decided it wasn't for me.

I wonder if we have ever met before, [S].
Perhaps in the world I'm from?
Visit: Hello. My name is Katarina. I've come to deliver a hello from [F].
Level: I did it! I only hope...that you're proud of me.
That wasn't too bad, was it?
Poorly done. I'm sorry. Please don't be disappointed.
Summon: Please, call me Katarina. I once planned to be a tactician, but that... didn't work out. I have magic though!
Learn Skill: This means so much to me. I'd do anything for you.
Confession:
In my world, there was someone very dear to me. You've always reminded me of that person.
That person was like a Hero to me but is neither in this world or that one.
So I did some reading about other worlds here, and I came to a curious conclusion.
You are that person.
I know...I know... It makes no sense. Perhaps it's even unsettling to hear such a thing!
Whether I am wrong or you simply don't recall those days, I pledge my service to you fully.
I'm not sure I'm always the most competent person in your group, but I will always give you my best!
Status: Is there something I can do for you?
I'm so sorry. For—? Oh, just sorry.
If it ever helps, I once studied to be a tactician.
You're such a great tactician. Could you teach me to be the same?
I will do anything that you request of me.
How can I ever atone for...what I did?
I'm delighted that you accepted me into your group.

legion.name: Legion
legion.title: Masked Maniac
legion.description: One of a group of assassins. Wears an odd mask, as do his many "brothers." Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Order of Heroeses! What's that? What's that? What's that? We like the soundses of it!
There are manys of us and ones of us, all in oneses. That stick in your headses?
What's this? Going round and round again? Have timeses to waste? Uwee hee hee!
Clarisse in our group. Clarisse cold. Reese also in group. Reese is ones we hate. But also like!
How do we trains? We fights ourselveses until ones of us dies. Then practiceses over!
Visit:
We is us. We friendses with [F].
And friendses with youses too. Uwee hee hee!
Level: We great of them allses! Uwee hee hee!
We allses are...better than thises.
We allses are uselesses.
Summon: Whuh? Whoses are youses? We are Legion...and we are Legion too. Uwe hee hee!
Learn Skill: Come on! Come on! Come on! Timeses to fight!
Confession:
We allses are strong now? Strong-strong? Uwe hee hee!
We allses wonder somethings. Why youses use Legion?
We know. But we don't. We know but don't. But we have guess.
Legion is broken. Our heartses. Rest of us allses too. Like we allses are brokenses.
Legion likes you. We allses think you don't hate us. But we too broken to know.
We makes you promises. We stand by youses. Forevers and forevers! Uwee hee!
Special: Come on! Come on! Come on!
Status: Uwee hee hee! Time for us allses?
Want to see under the maskses, hmm?
Legion always gets the jobses done.
Yes, yes, yes! We are allses brotherses.
Legion is many, many, many. Yes, yes, yes!
Which one am...I? Legion doesn't knowses!
Legion likes the lookses of youses.

clarisse.name: Clarisse
clarisse.title: Sniper in the Dark
clarisse.description: One of a group of assassins plotting to kill Marth. Katarina's friend. Cruel and lacks manners, but yearns for a family. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall:
Hmpf...Heroes...from other worlds... I bet there's at least one of them who's not totally loyal to you.
You give the word, and then I'll get rid of whomever it is. Permanently.

Reese is not my sister. Maybe she and I made some pledge when we were children.
But that was then, and this is now. Who'd hold to silly promises like that anyway?

Hey, you. You're going to way too much trouble for everyone's sakes. Take a break, will you?
If you don't, I might just have to give you a permanent nap with my bow here.
Sure I follow your orders, but don't get the wrong idea. I'm...I'm just bound by a contract, all right?

Hey, if I fail miserably in battle and you don't want to keep me around anymore...
Oh, forget it. Do what you need to.
Visit: Don't worry. I'm not going to put an arrow in you. Just delivering a hello from [F].
Level: Wow! But then again, I'd expect nothing less.
Huh. Good enough to prove you shouldn't throw me out.
No, anything but this! Don't look at me.
Summon: I'm Clarisse. I'm a cut above all the other rubbish you probably see around here.
Learn Skill: Hmpf. Well, I won't be totally ungrateful about this.
Confession:
I've been thinking about something. Lots of time has gone by since I got here.
I've maybe helped you more than I like...but also sneered at you more than I should.
Still, the longer I'm here in the castle, I wonder if this is what having a family feels like.
Hey! Get that smile off your face. I'm only wondering! Not saying it's what I want!
Seriously, never bring this up again. Or else I'll have to—you know, put an arrow in your hide.
All right then, have we reached an understanding? Good.
Special: I'll put you out of your misery.
Status: What? Need my help or something?
Ah! Good way to wind up in a grave.
Don't pretend like we're friends.
Why are you nice to me?!
This kindness is getting old.
Alone...as always...
I guess I'll listen to what you've got to say.

gaius2.name: Gaius
gaius2.title: Thief Exposed
gaius2.description: A thief from Ylisse known for his sweet tooth. Usually secrets candy in his clothes, but can't when he's dressed like this. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
I bet you know all the hiding spots. For candy, I mean! Your outfit...looks useful for that.
Dressed like this, I don't have anywhere I can stash my sweets.

We got the army together at an Outrealms resort for some fun...
We collected shells and got attacked by bugs, and somebody tried to feed me a very disturbing cake.
Those Order of Heroes uniforms look really toasty. Take a page from my book and shed a few layers!

Can I ask you a favor? Would you go and get some honey for me?
I'd do it myself, but...would you be brave enough to fight off bees while dressed like this? Me neither.
I guess that's just about enough training for today! If I hear another crack about baby fat...
Visit: What are you looking at me like that for? I know I look a little shifty...but I'm just delivering greetings! Honest.
Level: After working so hard in the summer heat...I deserve this.
I get the job done...no matter how I'm dressed.
Well, what did you expect? I'm wearing a swimsuit, here.
Summon: I'm Gaius. I don't turn down jobs, even when I'm on vacation. You got one for me?
Learn Skill: Thanks... Now let's sneak off and eat ice pops together.
Confession:
Man, is it hot... Wait. What do you want? I don't have any sweets to share...
You saw the tattoo on my arm when I was swimming?!
Keep it down! I'm trying to keep a lid on that...
It's a mark they put on convicts where I come from. I did a favor for a buddy, and that's what it got me...
Talk is cheap, and I don't need your pity. But...it's nice to know you're not judging me for my past.
And you know what? It's summer. I should let loose and try to have fun. Be a good guy for once.
After all, I've got you on my side, don't I? Things could be worse!
Status: When it's hot like this, you gotta choose sweets that won't melt.
Ugh—I hate that ocean air. Too salty.
The bandana? It's...well...it just looks cool, all right?
I fight better when I'm not so exposed.
Even I wouldn't try to hide sweets in a swimsuit.
One good thing about the tropics: sweet, sweet fruit all over the place.
When it's hot like this, you can pay me in frozen-juice bars.

frederick2.name: Frederick
frederick2.title: Horizon Watcher
frederick2.description: A knight who serves the royal house of Ylisse. Collector of pebbles and shells on the beach. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Hmm... There are many Heroes here, no doubt. But few show as much skin as I...

The Outrealms resort was so exhilarating! I kept busy training on the beach, smiting miscreants, and—
it pains me to admit this—sinning.

When I consider the poor souls who, barefoot, might tread on a pebble... I know I must redouble my efforts.
What efforts? To remove debris at every opportunity! I can only hope this eases your journeys too.

Might you be willing to train with me? It pains me to say it, but your defenses are...lacking.
Perhaps we can forge a body of steel to match your stout heart!
Ah, I'm fretting over Lord Chrom and Lady Lissa. I hope they don't step on seashells while I'm away!
Visit: I apologize for appearing before you like this. I was tasked with conveying [F]'s tidings.
Level: Delightful. I can't wait to run and jump into the sea!
My beach training regimen seems to have paid off.
How embarrassing. Perhaps it's the heat...
Summon: I am Frederick. I was on the beach protecting Lord Chrom. Tell me... Where am I now?
Learn Skill: You honor me. I'll focus on my efforts to clean up seashells.
Confession:
I feel that I've gotten much stronger since I came here. You've put a lot of time and energy into my training.
Honestly, I had my misgivings at first. I never expected you to take me seriously, dressed like this...
How wrong I was. You helped me train. Even so, I worried that you might earn my trust and then...
you'd spring a terrible surprise on me. I spent my nights sleepless, certain you'd suddenly force me to eat bear...
But thinking about it, I confess I can see no reason you'd ever do that, Summoner.
To make amends, I'll give my utmost on the battlefield.
I've always relied on my armor, but now it's my zeal that will see me through!
Status: My apologies for my lack of decorum...and suitable clothing.
Out of my armor, I am actually a rather accomplished swimmer.
I usually dress more modestly, but I am attempting to, uh, relax.
The Shepherds once visited an otherworldly tropical resort. It was...nice.
I have cleared the beach of trash, as well as driftwood and shells.
I wish I had managed to catch a sea creature to bring home.
I hope you enjoy this summer. I will, of course, still be at your side in the fall.

frobin2.name: Robin
frobin2.title: Seaside Tactician
frobin2.description: A tactician of Ylisse and Chrom's close ally. Loves the strange creatures she finds on the beach. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
I got envious of Chrom and the others in their swimsuits, so I tried one on...
Look at me now! Summoned to another world... I didn't expect that!

I had so much fun at the resort! I helped out a friend with body oil, fed another one coconut brittle...
I even threw lances and caught a weird creature in a tide pool!

Put me on the front lines! This swimsuit may not offer much protection, I admit...
But a true tactician adjusts their strategy along with their outfit!

I'd love it if you and I took a trip to the sea together, someday...
I don't have many memories, so I'd love to see something besides a battlefield.
I've been keeping my eyes peeled... Seems like I'm one of the few who's dressed in so little. I feel...exposed.
Visit:
Greetings to you from your friend [F]!
This swimsuit? It'll throw off the enemy's concentration! Tell me, can you focus on battle right now? Nope!
Level: My plan for summer fun is paying off!
This clothing is so light that I can move around with ease.
What I didn't factor in was sunstroke...
Summon:
Hi, I'm Robin. I may have been on vacation in the Outrealms...
But I can't turn my back on anyone who needs a sound battle strategy!
Learn Skill: You have plans for me? Great! Let's tackle the summer together!
Confession:
We did a good job out there, despite the heat. Did you lose focus during the battle? No? That's good!
At the resort, fighting in the heat didn't bother me one bit, but here...it does. It's strange.
Maybe it's because there, I was focused on strategy! You know what I'm talking about, don't you?
I'm so glad we met. It's nice to have another tactician to talk to. You understand what I'm saying...
I had a great time at the resort, but I think it's even more fun to talk about strategy like this.
And it doesn't hurt that you're letting me take a vacation from being a tactician during battle!
I hope we can keep talking like this... Two tacticians, striving for the ultimate strategy!
Status: I'm not exactly dressed for battle, am I?
I wonder how many of our friends like swimming?
I want to show you this weird creature I found on the beach!
I think we'll have a memorable summer together.
Swimming, collecting seashells... I'll need to make a beach plan.
Awww... My tome got all wet...
Looks like it's going to be a great summer!

atiki2.name: Tiki
atiki2.title: Summering Scion
atiki2.description: Known as the Voice of the Divine Dragon. Has lived through thousands of summers, but usually doesn't need to worry about swimming gear. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I'll guess the image that "3,000-year- old in a swimsuit" conjures up doesn't match the reality... Does it?
That resort was beautiful...but far too hot to take a decent nap. I think I'll be able to rest here, though.

It's good to take a break now and again. I just learned a fun game we can play, actually...
You put on a blindfold and then try to smash a large melon. Want to try?

Why don't you put on a bathing suit? Look at me—I'm the divine dragon's oracle!
If I'm dressed like this, nobody will even blink to see the Summoner in summer attire.

Does the Askran Kingdom have beautiful oceans?
We must do all we can to ensure the waters of this kingdom do not run red...
Visit:
I bring greetings from [F].
My attire? If you don't consider it appropriate for the circumstances, I could always turn into a dragon.
Level: In a swimsuit, no less. At my age, you take whatever you can get!
Keeping cool in the summer— that's my secret.
Maybe I'm getting a little old to fight in a swimsuit...
Summon:
I'm Tiki, a descendant of the divine dragon tribe. I can take the form of a dragon, of course...
But for the summer, I'm liking the look of this swimsuit a little bit better!
Learn Skill: Thanks for this. I'll treasure my memory of this summer with you.
Confession:
Thanks for taking the time to come and see me, even with this heat... Or is it just me?
We Heroes who dropped in from the resort seem to be stuck in an eternal summer... I'm not sure why.
This world is certainly mysterious. I've seen so many summers, but none have been as thrilling as this one.
I thought I'd gotten to an age where nothing could surprise me, but I was wrong about that!
This summer has filled me with the joy of a child. I find myself wishing it would not end.
I want to stay here with you.
Status: I wear this when I swim. Do you like it?
I love the ocean. It goes on forever...
I'm ready to bury myself in the sand and take a long nap.
Too much swimming makes my skin scaly.
I will always remember this summer with you.
I don't think I'll ever get used to fighting in a swimsuit...
Each summer comes but once. Don't waste this one.

tobin.name: Tobin
tobin.title: The Clueless One
tobin.description: Alm's childhood friend from Ram Village. Honest to a fault, and suffers for it. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: So you just fire off that Breidablik and a Hero pops out? Pretty neat... How's it work, exactly?

Our village is a good place—it's peaceful. Gray says it's lacking a certain something, but...
it's home.

Still hard at work, huh? If you're feeling even a little tired, be sure to take a break.
There isn't anyone around here who can replace you.
If you have some time, let's explore the castle. Should be pretty fun, right?

Mmh-huh? Sorry, you caught me napping. Everyone's talking about such complicated things, and...
Awwh... It just makes me so sleepy.
Visit: [S]? Got a message for you from [F].
Level: Oh, man, look at these muscles. Who wants to touch 'em?
Heh, not bad!
Huh? That's it?
Summon:
I'm Tobin, a fighter in the Deliverance. I joined up to fight alongside my friends.
I'm not too sure what's going on in this world, but... I'm here to help.
Learn Skill: You're really trusting me with this power? I don't know what to say...
Confession:
I try to find souvenirs for my siblings between fights, but I can't afford anything too pricey.
Maybe a jar, or some nice cloth. Looking at things like that helps me picture their faces...
And that cheers me up, you know?
Take a look at this cog. It's a small part of something larger. Really makes you think...
You think so too? I knew you'd understand. Here, you can have it if you want.
I mean, I picked it up for you, after all. I can't get you anything too fancy, but...
Well, I saw this and pictured your face. It can be proof of our friendship. Er, I mean...
Uh, it's my way of saying thanks.
Special: This is the part that hurts!
Status: I'm not great with the tough stuff.
Oh, need something? Ready to do my best.
Our village? It's a great place.
Hey! Is this any time to be fooling around?
Might have to tell me something twice before it sinks in.
There's no way I'm going to let Alm show me up.
You're pretty interesting, you know that?

delthea.name: Delthea
delthea.title: Free Spirit
delthea.description: A naturally talented mage who hates training and hard work. Has a brother, Luthier. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Wow! This place is the best... There are so many elegant people here... This is what I've been waiting for!
I was born in a boring little village in the middle of nowhere. I'm so glad you summoned me here instead!
Are you on patrol? You work too hard! But I have to respect your dedication...I guess. Keep it up!
Come on! Let's spend a day on us for a change! You can show me the best places to get food and clothes.
I'm people watching! And wondering what it would take for me to win somebody's heart...
Visit: Hey, [S]! [F] says hi!
Level: I'm the best there is!
Hah! I'm pretty strong, aren't I?
No way! This is just not me.
Summon: Hi! I'm Delthea! When it comes to magic, nobody else comes close.
Learn Skill: I see how it is. You're giving me this because you think I'm cute!
Confession:
Hey! You kept me waiting, [S]!
I'm impressed by your power...and by the way you fight so hard. You're not even from here!
My brother's always lecturing me. But you're not like that... And I feel safe when I'm with you.
Don't worry. I don't hate Luthier. All I'm saying is that I like spending time with you. I wonder why...
Keep showing me new things, and I'll keep on fighting for you. Do we have a deal?
Status: All right, out with it. What's your type?
Train, train, train... Boring, don't you think?
Heh! I'm pretty bright all right!
Aw... You and I gotta find out who keeps making us work all the time!
My happy ending? Marry a nice guy or whatever?
My brother and I...? Pffff, now there's a story.
So, confession time! I am darn fond of you. Huh! How do you like that?
This is a dökkálfar outfit. What do you think? Cute, right?
Eek! That's it! You're getting dreams of ghouls every night from now on!
I'm definitely a sweetie, but it doesn't hurt to mix in a little bit of spice!
Me? Come nighttime, I'm usually out like a light, so I never remember my dreams.
I wonder if the other Heroes will find these new clothes impressive!
When my brother sees me all dressed up, maybe he'll finally stop treating me like a little girl!
Giving you nightmares...just doesn't feel right.

gray.name: Gray
gray.title: Wry Comrade
gray.description: Alm's childhood friend from Ram Village. Worldly and competent. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: This place sure is beautiful. So beautiful it's unsettling... Truth told, just being here makes me anxious.
When Ram Village was attacked, it wasn't like I could just do nothing.
You on patrol? You look stressed out. If you ever want to unwind, just give me a holler.

Where do people go to have fun around here? I know how to have a good time, so anywhere's fine.
You've gotta show me around!
This place is messing me up. It makes the world I've known up till now feel so...insignificant...
Visit: Hey, [S]! Hi there! That's from [F].
Level: I can't stand to lose.
This'll do. I guess.
Damn it... Not good.
Summon: I'm just an average guy from a village in the middle of nowhere. I'll help out, if you want me to. Name's Gray.
Learn Skill: If you believe in me, well... I better not slack off.
Confession:
Hey, [S]... I have to ask you this. Why did you summon me here?
Take a look around. Princes and princesses...even from other worlds. Everywhere!
I have to laugh. You know I'm just some schlub from a tiny village in the middle of nowhere, right?
You're saying you need my help? You called me here...because I'm a Hero, too?
Joke's on you! I knew that's what you were going to say. But I'm surprised that you kept a straight face...
If you really do think of me as a Hero, well... I feel like I'm stronger than anyone—even some king.
Status: You got me! Well done.
Man... This whole situation just does not feel real.
We're from the middle of nowhere. I'm talking middle of NOWHERE.
Work hard, reap the rewards. You know I'm right.
I'm handsome, I know. But there's no need to stare.
Always lookin' for the ladies.
There's never a dull moment with you around.

mathilda.name: Mathilda
mathilda.title: Legendary Knight
mathilda.description: A paladin of the Deliverance and Clive's betrothed. Strong as a demon, yet gentle to her love. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall:
This is a wonderful place. Everywhere I look, I see order—from the people to the castle itself.
That's the soul of this kingdom and its people. I'm sure of it.
I was captured by the enemy...and caused everyone a lot of trouble. But I'm fighting for the Deliverance now.
The way you look after your people... I'm sure that everyone feels safe just knowing you're here. Thank you.
Show me the place you consider the most beautiful. I want to take my love there.
I was just sharpening my lance. I must be ready to fight at any time for the safety of everyone here.
Visit: I'm glad you're well. I bring regards from [F].
Level: I do wonder... Who could my rival be?
I train every day. That is how you improve—bit by bit.
This...is disappointing. Truly.
Summon: I am Mathilda of the Deliverance. I will prove to you that, in battle, I am as strong as anyone.
Learn Skill: I shall give it my all. I can do no less for you.
Confession:
Do you have a moment? I need your advice. It's about my love's sister. No matter what I do, it's not enough.
I want to bridge the gap between us. She is not so different from him... Attractive, intelligent, and strong.
I'm rambling. What I really want to ask is this: what can I do?
You say that if I care this much, she'll come around eventually? I hope so. For now, I'll take your word for it.
It's strange, isn't it? It's so easy to talk to you, even about such a difficult subject... I hope we may speak again.
Status: All right. What do you want?
This world is quite the diversion.
Should I tell you of my lover? Why not. He's the best man in my world.
If you have a concern, I'll be here for you, day or night.
I wonder if I'll ever get any closer to Clair...
I take up my lance in the service of one man, and one man alone.
I'm proud to fight at your side.

clive.name: Clive
clive.title: Idealistic Knight
clive.description: Former leader of the Deliverance and Clair's brother. Idealistic and focused on the good of the kingdom. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Royalty, fighting on the front lines? A ruler must risk everything, it seems. In Zofia, we forgot that long ago...
I fight as part of the Deliverance. We will take back Zofia from Desaix's unjust rule—no matter what.
I see your consideration for your comrades. You are kind and diligent in your duties. May I rely on you, too?
I'd love to learn more about this world. Your perspective would be of particular value—if you have the time.
I was just taking care of my horse. With no attendants here, the task falls to me. It's a lot of work, but I enjoy it.
Visit:
Ah, [S], is it?
I bring with me the faith and respect of [F].
Level: This power propels us to the realization of our ideals!
I must continue to devote myself to training...
You have my apologies. I have failed to meet your expectations.
Summon: I am Clive. I believe that we of noble birth have a duty to use our strength to bring peace to the land.
Learn Skill: I shall take this power and deliver victory to you!
Confession:
It's strange. As soon as I see you, I feel the tension that has built up within me crumble into nothing.
As a knight commander, I always strive to embody the qualities of a leader. It is my station.
Between us, however...I'll admit that I have sometimes thought about casting all of it away.
I have never spoken to anyone about this, you must understand.
You...are someone I can confide in. I feel I can tell you just about anything. Why is this?
Perhaps it is because we hail from different worlds, and different walks of life...
Though that may be true...that is not the whole truth.
It's your charisma. You charm us all... And we follow you, both on and off the battlefield. That's how I see it.
Status: Hmm? Oh, come now.
Ah. You're a...curious one.
Well then, you want my attention? You have it.
As a knight of Zofia, I sense the stakes accutely.
Win or lose, there is something to be gained from every battle.
Did I make the right choice? Time will tell.
You are worthy of my trust. I pledge my life to you.

saber.name: Saber
saber.title: Driven Mercenary
saber.description: A mercenary who will take on any job...if he's paid enough. His identity is a mystery but his skills are unquestionable. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall:
Huh? So you're saying I've been recruited into the..."Order of Heroes"?
No offense, but orders and heroes... Ain't really my thing.
I was kicking around Novis Greatport, selling my sword, scraping by... Then that strange lass hired me.

You've got another job? Ya know, working yourself to the bone never helped anyone.
Once you're back, I'll show you how to unwind for a change.
Psst. Hey... Got any tips on where a fella can go for a good time? Slip me the info, will ya?
I was just cleaning my sword. It's how I earn a living, after all. Thing's a real beaut, don't you think?
Visit:
I've greetings for ya from [F].
Hey, this place ain't half bad. Might have myself a look around before I head back...
Level: Heh. Not bad, if I say so myself.
Am I sharp today, or what?
That...was unexpected.
Summon: The name's Saber. I'm a mercenary. And as long as you're paying, I'm fighting.
Learn Skill: I'll pay you back by putting this skill to work.
Confession:
Nice timing, [S].
I was about to head into town for some fun, if you want to tag along.
Too busy, you say? There's more to life than work, you know. You never know which day could be your last.
So I say eat, drink, and be merry if you can! OK, OK! Uncross your arms and take that frown off your face.
Ugh, the toughest mercenary you ever met, trounced by a look... My reputation is ruined.
Ahh, no hard feelings. We're cool now, so it's fine. But let's hang out sometime soon, yeah?
Special: You don't know when to quit!
Status: Whoa, hey now. Messin' with me?
Hmm. Think twice before gettin' on my bad side.
Long as this stays lively, I don't give a damn about the details.
Lookin' for a good time here! C'mon! ...Anyone? Hello?
Piece of advice. Dealin' with a fancy lass is always a bad idea.
Everyone has a past. Remember that.
You ain't half-bad. Ha! Not half-good either.

Special: I'll squash you like a bug!
Nothin' but a stain on my boot!
Status: This outfit's from a place called Jötunheimr. Whaddaya think—am I doin' it justice?
Whoa! C'mon, there's gotta be something better you could be doin'...
What, are the jötnar ladies too strong for you? Sounds like quitter talk to me. I like all kindsa women.
Haven't worn something this fancy since... Huh. Pretty sure the last time was back in my Rigel days.
The lass sure liked seein' me in this getup... With all the different outfits she's got, guess I shoulda seen that coming.
Even a merc like me can look halfway presentable in duds like these, right?
Life is short, and these threads can't have been cheap. So how 'bout we get to work and I return the favor, yeah?

sonya.name: Sonya
sonya.title: Vengeful Mage
sonya.description: A mage hired by Grieth. Cool but flamboyant. Vowed vengeance upon her father, Jedah. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: This world's cultures are simply fascinating. If you would allow me to study them, it might aid you too.
I used to work for a very unsavory character. And before that, well...it's really none of your business, is it?
Is there a reason for a noncombatant to be on the battlefield? I can't help but worry for you.
What do you say to a shopping trip? I'll pick out some new clothes for you, from head to toe—it'll be fun!
Might be time for a manicure... My magic always feels its strongest when my hands look their best.
Visit:
I carry greetings from [F].
You two seem awfully close... I'm a little jealous.
Level: Hmmm... How do you like me now?
Did you expect anything less?
Brute force just isn't my style.
Summon:
I'm Sonya. I suppose I'm just your average mage-for-hire now. This place seems interesting enough.
I suppose I'll stick around and see what sort of trouble I can get into.
Learn Skill: Ahhh, how nice... It's like I've been born anew.
Confession:
Oh, [S]. Did you come to see me so I could spoil you? You're just too cute!
Aw, stop squirming—I'm only kidding. I had two older sisters, and they spoiled me rotten.
So can you blame me for teasing you? At least I finally understand why you join us in battle.
It's because you know your presence is a boost to our morale. You really are an exceptional leader.
It's actually charming, in a way...
Seeing your face always puts my mind at ease. Remember to give me a smile now and then, OK?
Status: Oh! Seeking attention, are we?
Mm-hmm. Lonely, I take it.
I used to be quite a pest to my sisters. When I was too young to know better.
What am I going to do with you?
It's a shame if a woman doesn't look as powerful as she feels. Don't you agree?
My sisters...long gone...
Spending time with you helps me forget some painful things. Thank you.

Special: Shall we turn up the heat?
Status: Thank you for the new clothes. So, what do you think? Ravishing, no?
Oh, really now, you've messed up my hair!
I'm always happy to expand my wardrobe. After all, looking good is its own reward.
Múspell certainly lives up to its title as the Kingdom of Flame... But the heat is terrible for my skin.
Not having to lug a weapon around everywhere means I'm free to always look my best.
Genny's bound to get jealous... Could you give her something too?
You know me so well, don't you? I suppose I'll have try a bit harder, just for you.

leon.name: Leon
leon.title: True of Heart
leon.description: A handsome but narcissistic Zofian archer. Adores his friend Valbar. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: My, my, there are quite a number of handsome devils here. But none so handsome as myself, it seems.
Valbar lost his family to a band of pirates. His cause is my own, and that includes his revenge.
Humm, you're looking a bit pale... Fatigue is the sworn enemy of beauty, so get some rest.

Would you show me around town? I need to pick up some new clothes, new accessories, some...
Well, let's just say keeping up appearances is a full-time job.
Oh, I always keep up on the latest trends. I need to know what's in style here. It wouldn't do to fall behind.
Visit: You're [S]? I bring a message to you from [F].
Level: Is there no one who can best me?
Well, I suppose this is the expected result.
This feels funny... And not the ha-ha kind.
Summon:
I'm Leon, an archer by trade. And let me start by saying, you have pulled me away from Valbar...
I will not forgive you if any harm should befall him in my absence.
Learn Skill: Oh, my, I have been made stronger? Why, sometimes I even startle myself!
Confession:
Hello, [S]! I've prepared some tea. Would you care to join me?
I must admit, I was anxious when you first summoned me here.
Ugh, don't laugh—it's rude! I may not look worried, but I have my fair share of concern, same as anyone else.
Anyway, you've proven yourself more than capable, so I suppose I don't mind sticking around.
To be honest, I am eager to return home... But that can wait, I think...
Care for another cup?
Status: Hey, hey, now. No more of that.
I'm a friendly fellow, but not the touchy-feely type. All right?
Is it really so terrible to be this stylish?
Valbar is my dearest friend. If he's happy, I'm happy.
All this fighting can't be good for my skin.
Oh, Valbar. I wonder what you're up to right now.
You're a bit of a riddle, aren't you? Good. I like riddles.

berkut.name: Berkut
berkut.title: Prideful Prince
berkut.description: First in line to the Rigelian throne. Prideful, but loves Rinea with all his heart. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Why should I swallow my pride and fraternize with commoners? This is nothing less than total humiliation!

I have honed my skills unceasingly since my youth. As next in line for the imperial throne, it is my duty.
I take pride in the power I've worked so hard for.
Beavering away on another task? You're a diligent creature, no doubt of that. You'd make a fine servant.
You there. Show me to a jeweler. Not for myself, I'll have you know. Not that I owe you an explanation!
What am I doing? I'm polishing a ring, obviously. It's...none of your concern. Begone! Now!
Visit: Who has the temerity to send me on errands? Oh, none other than [F].
Level: Hah! Now you understand what I'm made of.
I expected better.
I refuse to accept this!
Summon: I am Berkut. Someday I shall stand atop the Rigelian Empire. You should thank the gods I'm here with you now.
Learn Skill: Wise choice. You may have earned a little of my respect...
Confession:
Oh, it's you. Such a restless creature you are. It's undignified. Be calm, and sit down for a moment, at least.
After so many battles, I can see that you have some skill as a leader. Though it pains me, I must admit it.
On my return to Rigel, you could even join my forces as a commander. What say you?
Hah! That "no" was both quick and firm. Of course, that's the answer I expected from you.
Just be glad this is not Rigel. Your head would be rolling on the floor right now. Oh, well...
The fate of a great man is to have no one he might call a friend. But you... Is that what you are to me? Perhaps.
Status: Ugh. What are you doing?
Again? How infantile.
Enough of that. State your purpose, if you have one.
My uncle is owed all of the respect in the world.
I must gather my might. I will need it.
I will rule Valentia in due course.
You do intrigue me. I should keep my eye on you.

leo2.name: Leo
leo2.title: Seashore's Prince
leo2.description: A suntan-despising Nohrian prince who wields the divine tome Brynhildr. Loves red summer produce. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
Prince Alfonse loaned me a robe to ward off the sun. But I'm embarrassed to admit...
It took me the better part of a day to realize I had put it on inside out.
I won a battle and the prize was a trip to a tropical island. I wasn't interested, but my retainers earned a vacation.
Is the heat getting to you? A freshly squeezed glass of tomato juice will help with that.

I'd like to see Askran beaches after the sun has set. The nighttime sea is like a blanket of darkness.
It's a rather beautiful sight. Don't you agree?

Me? I was reading treatises on botany—summer vegetation specifically.
It seems there are many varieties of tomato plants in other lands...
Visit:
Fine greetings from [F]. I'm glad I can wait indoors.
If left outside, I might start to tan.
Level: Such results despite this outfit? Maybe it's not so bad after all.
Pretty impressive for fighting in a swimsuit, don't you think?
If you are disappointed by these results, then give me clothes.
Summon: I'm Leo, Prince of Nohr. And you pulled me off a tropical island. Do you expect me to fight in this outfit?
Learn Skill: Thanks for the extra power. But I would rather have extra clothes.
Confession:
You seem to be holding up well, despite the heat. You're always wearing that hooded robe...
Are you trying to avoid the sun as well?
The sun can burn me in an instant so I avoid it at all costs. I'd rather not be colored red from head to toe.
...I beg your pardon? You say I'd look like a tomato if that happened? How in the world do you...
Come up with such amazing ideas?! How could I possibly hate looking like something I so cherish?
Maybe I'll go get some sun right now.
You think...that's a bad idea? Well, if that's your advice, I'll take it. But you have given me food for thought.
Special: I'll throw your ashes to the waves!
Status: Tanlines. What torture!
Hot beaches? Hate them.
Tropical islands? Forget it. And this swimsuit! Don't even get me started!
I actually like walking a beach at night. But swim? In the ocean? With my body?
Now, tomato juice, that I like. There's nothing more refreshing.
I guess I should get some gifts for my retainers.
Hey, if you like tropical islands, that's fine. Maybe it's not as bad as I say.

xander3.name: Xander
xander3.title: Student Swimmer
xander3.description: A Nohrian prince who wields the divine sword Siegfried but can't swim. Clings to his Lilith water toy. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
I worry my appearance is lacking the decorum one requires to appear before Askran royalty, but...
Well, the young prince and princess don't seem to mind.

Before I came here, I was embroiled in a battle against my siblings and some Hoshidan royals...
It was all over a ticket to a tropical island. I won, of course. I have my retainers to thank for that.

Does the Order of Heroes allow for vacations? We'll take care of the enemy. You go relax on the beach.
It...can be fun.

Tell me, [S]... Can you swim? If so, I would ask that you teach me. Or, at the very least...
Teach me how to float.
This water toy resembles an astral dragon Corrin cared for. I call the toy Lilith. You may do so as well.
Visit:
Greetings from [F]. You want to know if I'm going swimming?
Don't be absurd. Everyone knows I cannot swim.
Level: Could it be I'm more suited to fighting in a swimsuit?
Hm... Passable results for fighting in such an outfit.
Has the heat dulled my senses? I must redouble my efforts.
Summon:
I am Xander, Crown Prince of Nohr. I was at a beach practicing my swimming technique, so...
Well, I'm afraid your sudden summoning caught me off guard.
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude. This will be a fine summer thanks to you.
Confession:
Pardon my saying, but I've had this on my mind for some time...
It's awfully bold of you to force a crown prince such as myself to fight in little more than a swimsuit.
No, no, I don't mean to sound upset. On the contrary, in fact. I seldom get the chance to feel free of my armor.
And even more seldom do I feel so free from the burdens of the crown.
My title of Crown Prince of Nohr carries no weight in this realm.
I can walk along clutching my water toy Lilith and none give me a second glance.
I've experienced nothing like it before. So, [S] you have my gratitude.
Thank you for an unforgettable summer. I shall remain by your side until I must return home.
Status: This garment lacks protection. That...concerns me.
This flotation device is my only defense against my greatest adversary. Sinking.
Sorting seashells... This one from that one... Good fun.
I was asked to compose a list categorizing every...beauty of the beach? Odd request.
I don't mean to scowl on a beach. I'm just concerned about things, that is all.
I left my retainers behind. Worrisome. Chaos is ever their companion.
Should you require fun, I highly recommend a tropical vacation.

fcorrin2.name: Corrin
fcorrin2.title: Novice Vacationer
fcorrin2.description: A Hoshidan princess raised in Nohr. She won a ticket to a tropical island in a lottery. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Sharena and Anna complimented me on my swimsuit, but I have yet to see either of them wearing one.
I won a ticket to an island resort but I wanted one of my siblings to use it. They all refused so I wound up going.
Has my swimsuit caught your eye? If I could take you shopping, I'm sure we'd find one that suits you perfectly.

I've never seen tropical fish before so I got this book that's all about them. Would you like to read it with me?
Experiencing something for the first time is much better if I can share it with someone else!
Do you know of any nearby Dragon Veins? If I find one, I can change some land into a beach for you.
Visit: Sorry to show up in a swimsuit, but [F] gave me a message for you so I rushed out.
Level: What a lovely summer memory. I'll never forget it!
I'll do my best right up to the end of summer!
Perhaps my thoughts of the ocean distracted me...
Summon: Hello. I'm Corrin. I was resting on a beach when I heard someone calling my name. Was that you?
Learn Skill: Thank you! With this, I'll become stronger than the sun's own rays.
Confession:
The tropical island was amazing. I can see the crystal-clear water and blue sky every time I close my eyes.
I spent so many years cooped up inside a fortress, so seeing such vivid colors was a whole new experience.
I had always dreamed of such sights. I could have spent the rest of my life just staring out at the water...
But I'm glad I didn't. I'm glad you called out to me, and I'm glad I answered. It allowed us to meet.
Spending time here with you and making so many new friends are the perfect summer memories.
This place is every bit as wonderful as that island.
Oh, here I am just rambling on and on... Anyone ever tell you you're a pretty good listener?
Well, I hope you'll tell me about yourself the next time we get a chance to talk.
Status: I love to go swimming. Don't you?
I once won a ticket to a tropical island!
I like doing warm-ups before I swim.
I've never had a chance to swim in an ocean before!
So, about this swimsuit... I hope it looks OK.
I wonder what souvenirs I should get for my siblings?
Tropical vacations are fun. Swimming, delicious food...! Do you like all of that too?

elise2.name: Elise
elise2.title: Tropical Flower
elise2.description: A Nohrian princess who loves her siblings and has matured a little by taking a solo trip to a tropical island. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
Hi, [S]! You should try fighting in a swimsuit, too.
It'll keep you nice and cool, and it's real easy to move around!
Before coming here, I fought a big battle to win a trip to a tropical island. And I won thanks to Arthur and Effie!
Anyone who works as hard as you deserves a reward—so, here! I made you a lei out of tropical flowers!

I think the whole Order of Heroes should go for a great big swim together!
Though, I guess it would be bad if the enemy attacked while we were all at the beach...

I took a trip to a tropical island all by myself. Doesn't that sound...mature?
I'm inching closer to being a perfect lady, aren't I? Well, aren't I?
Visit:
I'm here with greetings just for you! I was sent by [F]! Say...
Is there somewhere around here I can take a quick dip before I head back?
Level: Is this the summer Princess Elise finally becomes a mature lady?!
Is this what my big sis meant by "Summer helps a lady mature"?
Huh, what?! OK, I'll stop playing and start concentrating. Promise!
Summon: I'm Princess Elise of Nohr! I was playing on a tropical island, but...this place looks pretty fun, too!
Learn Skill: This new power kinda makes me want a new swimsuit to go with it.
Confession:
Tropical attaaaaack! Hyah!! Heehee, did I scare you? Seeing you just got me so excited!
That tropical island was a lot of fun, but I've really come to love the Askran Kingdom, too.
Everyone in the Order of Heroes is just so nice, and I get to play with so many new people!
But... Well, can you keep a secret?
I have the most fun playing with you, [S]! I always look forward to your visits!
Hey, when we're all done fighting someday, let's visit the beach together.
Pinky swear! That makes it a promise!
Status: My swimsuit is adorable!
Who wouldn't want to wear something like this on a beach?
How much do I love sunny beaches? Bunches and bunches!
Swimming sure makes a girl hungry!
Who needs tacky swimsuits to turn heads on a beach? I've got my bright smile!
I should get leis for my retainers. Red flowers for Arthur! White ones for Effie!
Oooh! Let's go lay on a beach after battle!

seth.name: Seth
seth.title: Silver Knight
seth.description: A young commander of Renais. He's calm, composed, and skilled. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall:
Prince Alfonse is far too kind. Yes, kindness is a virtue. But sometimes...
No, forgive me. It is not my place to speak.
I serve the royal family of Renais. All I want is to protect Prince Ephraim and Princess Eirika.

There must be some tasks you can delegate to me. You must reserve your strength for where it is needed.
This is not simply for your benefit. It is for the sake of the entire army.
Do not trouble yourself over my well- being. I would play the pawn gladly, would it bring us victory.
I spent the day in training. That has been my habit ever since I was a young squire.
Visit: Pardon me. I was entrusted with the task of bringing you a greeting by [F].
Level: Now is not the time to rest. I must set my sights on a loftier peak.
Further training is required—that much is sure.
I'll just have to step up my training to compensate for this.
Summon: I am Seth, a knight of Renais. I must beg your pardon, but...are Princess Eirika and Prince Ephraim here?
Learn Skill: You'll see my gratitude in each and every swing of my sword.
Confession:
I must express my gratitude for your leadership. As a knight, all I ask for is an opportunity to serve.
However, permit me to say just one thing.
Feelings have no place on the battlefield. You issue orders. I obey them. That is all.
In battle, a life-or-death moment could come at any time. Emotions could cloud your judgment.
If my mind was on you instead of the opponent before me, that could end up costing us a victory.
So I must ask that you keep your distance. This will ensure that I can continue to protect you in the future.
Status: Please. Your orders.
Hm? You ought not grow close to me.
In war, a leader may have to forego attachments and send soldiers to die.
It's an old wound. Pay it no mind.
People tell me I'm not much fun to be around. You have my apologies.
Prince Ephraim. Princess Eirika. Please, save Renais.
I will lay down my life to protect you.

Special: I am a knight of Renais!
Status: A humble knight has no need of fancy clothing.
Hmm? Perhaps you have mistaken me for another.
Seiðjárn promises great things. However, it is a terrible weapon indeed.
No matter the realm, it seems that royal siblings face no end of difficulty.
His Majesty was a great man, well worthy of the trust and respect we placed in him.
On seeing this new garb, Princess Eirika remarked that it suits me well. Such an honor.
I will continue to serve with wholehearted dedication.

innes.name: Innes
innes.title: Regal Strategician
innes.description: The prince of Frelia. Tana's brother. He's brash and arrogant, but good at heart. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall:
I must admit, it's benevolent to welcome Heroes from other lands. It's also very naive.
Be careful that you don't provide an opening for rival kingdoms. They may just take advantage of it.

This kingdom is as beautiful as the heavens themselves. This is not to imply it bests Frelia, of course.
When Frelia's pegasi gather in Walles Forest... It's a spectacle of such beauty...

You need to rest. We cannot afford to be defeated, and your strategies cannot fail.
Don't forget, making sure you're battle ready at all times is among your responsibilities, too.

Your reputation for tactical skill precedes you. I have no little skill in these matters myself.
What would you say to using these pieces and this board to test each other's knowledge on the subject?
Yes, I was reading history. As a member of the royalty, it's my duty to be well versed in many subjects.
Visit: I am Prince Innes of Frelia. I have a message for you, which I carry for [F].
Level: Those born to royalty must be perfect at all times.
There is nothing my arrows cannot pierce.
This is simply unacceptable. I must make up for this next time.
Summon:
I am Prince Innes of Frelia.
Not that I care, but...is a man called Ephraim here?
Learn Skill: We of noble birth do not shirk the duties to which we are born.
Confession:
Someday, I will inherit the throne of Frelia. And so I dwell on one thing... A king must be perfect.
This is why I apply myself so thoroughly to my studies and my bowmanship.
The more that I learn, though, the more I realize the breadth and depth of learning I must strive for.
I've come to understand how far away my goal—perfection—truly is.
Consider my sister. I'll speak frankly. She is but a child. She lacks both my strength and my knowledge.
What she has that I lack is innocence. People find it much easier to trust her than they do me.
But there is no way for me to regain that purity of spirit. I know too much of the ways of the battlefield.
Yet I have no choice but to find a way to become a man people can trust unreservedly.
This is what I mean when I speak of the struggle for perfection... As a man who will be king, I must find a way.
This may be difficult to comprehend, given our stations in life...
Understand this. It is my way of making a pledge to you.
I shall study with you, fight for you, and, yes, become the ideal monarch.
Status: I am no ordinary archer. I am Prince Innes of Frelia.
Eh? That was...that was your attempt at greeting me? I see.
As long as I am here, you will not be in danger. I shall see to that.
You and I are not the same. You are a commoner. I am the heir to Frelia.
We of noble birth do not shirk the duties to which we are born.
There is one man I could never stand to lose to. Ephraim.
One day, I will be crowned king. When that day comes, I will welcome you to my kingdom.
This new garb pleases me. It emphasizes the nobility of my countenance.
Hm? Not a hair out of place. Thank you.
There are certainly many unique individuals here. I imagine it's quite a trial for you.
Where is Ephraim? I'd like him to take a look at my new garb. I'm sure he'll be left with little to say.
As I am set above my people, I must embody the very best of my people.
I must see if Commander Anna can arrange a sitting for a portrait while I am attired this way.
Do, uh...do you have a moment? I would like to get to know you a little better, if I may.

amelia.name: Amelia
amelia.title: Rose of the War
amelia.description: A young soldier from a small village in Grado. She is honest and sincere. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall:
I'm from a small village called Silva. It's in Grado. I thought I'd join up and fight for my country...
I just hope everybody back home is doing all right.
I want to believe in justice. I want to know I'm doing the right thing.
If you're worn out, let me help. I am a soldier of sorts as well, you know.
Hey! Can you hear that songbird? What a pretty voice it has! Let's get closer and listen...
I admire General Duessel...and I train every day in the hope that, someday, I can be a little bit like him.
Visit:
Your pal told me to come here... [F], I mean!
I hope you two stay close, [S].
Level: I have a lot of potential, don't I?
Day by day, I'm becoming a real soldier!
Maybe I don't have what it takes...
Summon: Oh... Hello there! I'm a soldier in the service of Grado. I'm a hard worker! My name? Oh, right! It's Amelia.
Learn Skill: I'm getting stronger? This is so exciting!
Confession:
Have I gotten stronger since I came here? Do you think I'm a soldier now, truly?
To me, a soldier is somebody who can protect the people they care about...
You see, when I was little...bandits raided our village. They took my mother.
And I couldn't do a thing for her. I just hid and watched, terrified. I...couldn't protect her.
That's why I have to become stronger. I need to be able to protect the people who matter to me.
Thanks for listening, [S].
I hope you'll keep looking out for me. No matter what, I swear that I will protect those who I hold dear.
Status: I have to get stronger, to protect the people I care about.
AAAGH! ...Don't do that! My heart skipped a beat!
This armor is SO heavy. I feel like I'm going to tip over.
Take that! And that! Hyaah!  Ah! Were you watching me the whole time?
This is making me a little self-conscious.
Oh, Mother. If only... If only I had been stronger.
I want to become the shield that protects you.

Special: This is starting to feel natural!
Status: Hey, it's me! Amelia! What do you think of my new outfit?
Think twice before sneaking up on me!
This outfit suits me? It's nice of you to say so!
Jötunheimr is the land of the jötnar, right? They're so big! Talk about impressive.
I wonder if I'll be as corageous as the jötnar some day...
I want to believe in a justice of my own making.
I'm happy to have made a friend like you.

tana.name: Tana
tana.title: Winged Princess
tana.description: The princess of Frelia. Innes's sister. Somewhat naive, but cheery and very sociable. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: My brother is nobody's fool. But when it comes to Ephraim...well, that's the exception. He sees him as a rival.
I left the castle without my father's permission. I wonder if he'll be angry with me...
How are you doing? Just let me know if you need something. That's what friends are for, right?

Come on! Let's get out of here! Show me a good time. After all, taking time out is important—even in war.
If you don't relax now and again, you'll suffer for it.

Outside of training? I spend my time making friends, I suppose...
I just want to meet people who have the same aspirations I do!
Visit:
Hello, [S]!
Thank you for being such a good friend to [F]!
Level: My brother will have no choice but to acknowledge my skill now!
I wish we could be more like Eirika and Ephraim. Maybe now...
I can just imagine what my brother would say about this...
Summon:
My name is Tana, and I'm a pegasus knight.
Oh, and I'm also the princess of Frelia. I hope you won't let that get in the way of us being friends, though!
Learn Skill: I can hold my head high and fight alongside everyone! Thank you!
Confession:
I had seen so little of the world. But somehow, when I left the castle, I thought I was ready...
But no. Coming here has simply shown me that there is so much that I don't yet understand.
Traveling with you has opened my eyes, though. I am sure of it.
Eirika is my best friend. Of that, I have no doubt. But you've become just as important to me.
I love Eirika, Ephraim, and my brother with all of my heart. And I feel the same about you!
Special: I am a knight of Frelia!
Status: Shall we chat? Yes? Lovely!
Aah! Please don't tease me like that.
My brother is so cruel. You should hear what he said to me.
I'm afraid I haven't been very much help to you.
I feel I should apologize. I'm still in training and not quite battle-ready.
Am I a little bit stronger now? I hope so...
Thank you—truly, thank you—for making an effort to understand how I feel.
It's me, Tana! Don't I look dreamy in this Ljósálfheimr outfit?
Gah! Don't surprise me like that, OK?
These clothes are just like Eirika's...and I couldn't be happier!
I can't stop thinking about what the realm of dreams must be like. I want to see it for myself!
Isn't this outfit just lovely? Just look at these wings. Look at them!
My brother will probably have something to say when he sees me in these clothes...
I hope your dreams are always sweet!

valter.name: Valter
valter.title: Dark Moonstone
valter.description: One of Grado's six generals. Cruelty intoxicates him. Known as Moonstone. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I live to fight. So your goal of seeking peace is...problematic...for me.
Eirika... Ephraim... These two, they are my prey. And only the finest prey will sate my bloodlust.
Are you tired? Then you must rest. Weakness saps prey of its...finer qualities.
I've no use for bloodless minnows. I hunger for prey that will sate my bloodlust...
Training? I don't play pretend. The only way to learn to kill is to kill.
Visit:
So you're the one I was sent by [F] to greet.
You make for delicious-looking prey, [S].
Level: Delicious...so very delicious.
Good... But I still hunger.
I am far from sated...
Summon: I am Valter, the Moonstone, one of Grado's six generals. Do you seek to sate my hunger? Many have...
Learn Skill: I hunger for more...more...more!
Confession:
A senile old fool once called me a beast—a wretched beast that lives only to kill and take what it can.
I will kill that man one day. Still, he is correct, of course. I am a beast, with a mouth full of fangs.
I do take what I want. I'll take whatever I desire. From anyone.
Knowing this, you have made use of me. And you have granted me much power...
I cannot understand your actions.
Do you intend to control me? Or do you long for me to be your master?
Either way, you have become my finest prey. I will not permit another to sate their bloodlust on you...
Just me.
Status: I am Valter, the Moonstone, one of Grado's six generals.
Hm? You desire to touch me?
Never think that I am yours. If you displease me, you'll regret it.
I will master you. Someday.
Show me. Show me. Grovel like a dog.
Ephraim. Eirika. Delicious prey.
You are mine now. Entertain me! More!

ike2.name: Ike
ike2.title: Brave Mercenary
ike2.description: A kindhearted but stoic young man who has taken command of his father's mercenary band. Wields the axe of his father, Greil. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: So war has come to this world as well, and its people suffer for it. Seems there's work for me to do here.
My father once led the Greil Mercenaries. Every person under his command trusted him fully.
Let me take some chores off your hands so you can take a break. I'll... Hmm... I'll go chop some firewood!
This is Urvan, my father's axe... It's rugged and strong. It reminds me of him.
Using an axe is different from using a sword. This guy requires power over skill. I need to get stronger.
Visit: I'm Ike, from the Greil Mercenaries. I have a message for you. It's from [F].
Level: Swinging this axe is becoming second nature.
Seems my body is finally getting used to this.
My training still has a long way to go.
Summon: I'm Ike of the Greil Mercenaries. And this axe is Urvan. You might call it my current partner.
Learn Skill: I guess that means I need to work a bit harder around here now.
Confession:
I had the strangest dream... It was of another world, and there were entire crowds calling my name.
Countless people, all cheering for me. Can you believe it? I don't pretend to understand magic, but...
Well, it wouldn't surprise me if that cheering is why I was summoned to this world.
But if that is the case...I have to make sure I don't let them down.
I'm no knight, and certainly no nobleman. My father was my only example of how a man should be.
So I need to carry out his vision and make sure our mercenary company is something he would be proud of.
To fight for the people, not for the money... That is my desire.
Status: This reminds me of something my father wore.
Hmm? What is it? Do you need something?
I had a strange dream. Thousands of people... And they were all saying my name!
I was called to this world to answer the wishes of many. Or so it seems.
I can't really remember that dream I had. But I do remember that you helped me.
Father, watch over me. One day, I swear...
I'm grateful to you. You've done so much for me. You are a true friend.
First my father's gear, and now this? Why do I need to change clothes?
Didn't I talk to you about this? Speak up before you touch me.
Seiðjárn, the magic-science of the dvergar. Magic, I get. Where does the science come in?
The soldiers from Niðavellir ride beasts I've never seen. Strange beasts.
There are many Heroes here, many ways to fight. I intend to study them.
No matter where I look, I find strong foes, new challenges. The world is vast.
I may not have strange magic, but I don't plan on losing your battles for you, either.

roy2.name: Roy
roy2.title: Brave Lion
roy2.description: The son of Eliwood, Marquess of Pherae. Has immense respect for his father and wields his weapon, Durandal. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I like to believe that heroes are born from people's wishes.
My father is Eliwood, the Marquess of Pherae. He's a hero known as the Knight of Lycia.
I want to help out so you can take a break. Do you mind if I observe you for a bit to get a sense of your work?
This is Durandal, the sword of sacred fire... It's a legendary weapon. My father once wielded it, too.
I haven't had much training in mounted combat. I've still got a lot to learn.
Visit: Are you [S]? I've brought you a message from your friend [F].
Level: Someday I'll be just like my father!
I think I'm getting the hang of fighting on horseback.
I need to learn more from my father's example.
Summon: I'm Roy. With this sword Durandal in hand, I will aid your army in place of my father.
Learn Skill: This is all because of you. Thank you.
Confession:
When I was young, Marcus—a knight who has long served my family—told me many tales about my father.
He spoke of the heroic things my father did in his younger days, the many allies he met on his travels...
And he told me about how my parents first met.
I would get so excited hearing those stories. I looked forward to them far more than any other tale.
That's why I admire my father so much. He's my hero.
I may resemble him, but I still have so much to learn.
And I have to get a lot stronger before I can truly claim to be like him. But if I stay by your side...
I'm sure I'll be able to accomplish that goal. I promise you I'll continue to do my best.
Status: I can't measure up to my father, but if I work hard, I hope I'll become more like him.
Hm? Did you call for me?
I had a strange dream. So many people, calling my name...
I want to repay all those who have supported me.
My father is unmatched at fighting, even on horseback. I have much to learn from him.
People are swayed by their desires. However, they can also overcome them.
Sometimes I feel like the two of us have known each other for a long time.
These clothes are from Múspell, or so I'm told. What do you think of them?
*startled sound* You know, I can hear you just fine from over there.
Thinking of the flames of Múspell, I'm reminded of Lilina's magic.
The people of Múspell may be a bit intimidating, but that's never stopped me from getting to know anyone.
My father can somehow wear any outfit well. I could stand to learn a thing or two from him.
I almost feel like I could shoot flames from my sword on command. Let's give it a try. Hyah!
Your passion for peace speaks to me.

lyn3.name: Lyn
lyn3.title: Brave Lady
lyn3.description: A woman who grew up on the plains. Uses the bow, like her father, Hassar. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: My mother was a noble, but she fell in love with a man from the plains, and they eloped.
My father was chieftain of the Lorca tribe. I wanted to protect our people in his stead, but...now I'm the last of us.

Allow me to take over some of your responsibilities so you can get some extra sleep.
When morning comes, I'll make sure you wake up on time.

This is Mulagir, the bow of swift wind, and one of the legendary weapons.
I hear it was once wielded by a woman named Hanon.

To train one's sight upon a moving target from atop a galloping horse and then strike with perfect accuracy.
Common practice for people of the plains.
Visit:
Greetings from [F]. I hope you'll continue—
Oh? Excuse me if my manners seem a bit off...
Level: Father, Mother... Watch over me.
It's as if this bow is guiding me...
I must be careful to remain atop my horse.
Summon: My name is Lyndis. Allow me to put this legendary Sacaen bow to use by assisting you.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
Confession:
Two types of blood run through my veins: that of a noble household, and that of the Sacaen Plains.
I hold these two sides in equal importance. This heritage is what makes me who I am, but moreover...
It allows me to feel as though my father and mother look after me still.
And should I someday be wed and have children of my own, I'll watch over them in turn.
Hm... That's a strange thing to think about at a time like this, isn't it? I could die tomorrow, after all.
But maybe that's why I think about such things. Someone to carry on my parents' bloodline...
And their happiness.
Status: You think this outfit suits me? Thanks.
If you want to use a bow, first quiet your mind and let your body relax...
I was having a dream, and in that dream, you saved me...
You REALLY remind me of another tactician I know.
My father was an incredibly skilled horseman and a great shot with a bow, too.
Father... Mother... Are you watching over me?
You're special to me. That feeling has been building for a long time. It crept up on me.
So this is how they dress in Múspell, Kingdom of Flame. How do I look?
If you continue to sneak up on me, you're going to get burned. Is that something someone in this outfit would say?
I feel a kinship between the wind and the flame.
The king of Múspell is fearsome, but the princesses appear to be good people.
I so rarely wear clothes of this color, but I find I like it. Black and red pair well together, don't they?
I must never let my own strength get in the way of my good judgment.
Allow me to bolster your strength as the wind bolsters the flame.

lucina4.name: Lucina
lucina4.title: Brave Princess
lucina4.description: A princess and the daughter of Chrom with a strong sense of justice. Fights in similar garb to her beloved father. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Father... Mother... I'll do all I can to bring this fighting to an end.
My father means everything to me. If anyone tries to harm him, then I would have no choice but to...
You deserve some rest. Is there a task you'd like me to take care of for you? Any errands to run?
This lance Geirskögul comes from another world. It's not something... I would normally have access to.
I'm sorry, but...I accidentally destroyed another training dummy. Lances are still new to me.
Visit: Your friend asked me to deliver a greeting. You must cherish your bond with [F].
Level: To protect my father!
I think I'm starting to get the hang of Ylissean lance techniques.
Perhaps the trick is to tighten my grip on the lance...
Summon: I am Lucina of Ylisse. With Geirskögul in hand, I pledge my strength to you!
Learn Skill: Thank you so much. I will not waste this power.
Confession:
I learned all my sword techniques from my father. He started training me when I was still very young.
Though at that age, our "training" may have been more like playing. Those are precious memories...
But despite all our time together, he never got the chance to teach me how to use a lance.
This world has an odd effect on me... It has renewed my sense of hope.
It offers the chance to reunite with the people I've lost. Those most important to me...
I'm no stranger to traveling between worlds, so you can rest assured I will not waste this opportunity.
Status: Maybe it's a bit silly, but...I feel a little closer to my father now.
My father taught me the sword. I hope he'll teach me all about the lance as well.
Was there some kind of...contest in your world?
I dreamt that heroes from another world brought hope to a dark future.
This weapon was entrusted to me by people from another world. I'm certain of it.
Father... I hope I can fight by your side in this world, too.
Our bond... gives me strength!

Special: I'm on a new journey now!
Status: Look! It's an Order of Heroes outfit!
Again? Come on, cut that out.
If I'm going to match my father, I need to train more.
My time in Askr has been filled with fascinating people and very enlightening. I feel like I've really grown.
I'll do all I can to meet everyone's expectations. Especially yours.
I've gotten to spend a lot of time with my father here. It's been wonderful.
You're always so considerate of others' feelings. I'm happy to be working with you.

oscar.name: Oscar
oscar.title: Agile Horseman
oscar.description: A straightforward but accommodating member of the Greil Mercenaries. Has good instincts. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Gathering supplies, preparing the meals... Seems there's plenty to keep me busy today.
My younger brothers are named Boyd and Rolf. I care for them more than anything.

Your face is looking a bit scrunched today. This is just a suggestion, but...
How about you and I chat about your problems, so you don't have to deal with them on your own?
I used to be a Crimean knight, so I still have a close friend within their ranks.
My contributions may be meager compared to others, but I still want to fight and save everyone I can.
Visit: Hi there—I'm Oscar. I've come with greetings from [F].
Level: You need to keep your guard up, even when you're at your best.
Not bad at all. Now I just need to keep this up.
When you're not performing well, make your priority just surviving.
Summon: I'm Oscar, from the Greil Mercenaries. My skills lie mainly in... Hmm, let's see... I guess, cooking for everyone?
Learn Skill: Thanks for this. I'm glad to know you expect good things from me.
Confession:
Attend the war council, procure supplies, coach a training session... Let's see, what else is there to do...
Oh, hey, [S]. Sorry I'm so busy all the time. Such is the life of a jack-of-all-trades.
People come to me for help with all sorts of things, and I'm more than glad to help with all of them.
In fact, I'm happy people rely on me for things like that.
I'm the oldest of three brothers, so helping out like this reminds me of different times.
So if you need anything, just—
Hm? Oh, I know. I'll do my best without pushing past my breaking point. It's a promise.
Your consideration for me is kind of heartwarming, you know!
Special: I will give it my all.
Status: Oh, hello. Feeling fine today, I hope?
Hmm? Oh, hello again. No need for that. I am always vigilant.
I am a great lover of food. How about you? What's your favorite dish?
You seem to get along with everyone. I wish I was more like that.
What is it that I want? To aid those who cannot aid themselves.
It pains me to lose a friend. Every time. But duty calls, and we are the ones to answer.
When we're in danger, you can—you must—rely on me.

elincia.name: Elincia
elincia.title: Lost Princess
elincia.description: The princess of Crimea, whose existence was concealed. Cares for her kingdom and people. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: I've come so far since my time at the royal villa thanks to my lord Ike and the others.

I'm the daughter of Ramon, king of Crimea. People may call me a princess, but...
Ah, no, it's nothing... Forgive me.

I suspect our journeys have left you worn out. When that happens, be sure to make it known.
You can rely on us as we rely on you.

I'm quite good at cooking and other household chores, I'll have you know.
Hm? That doesn't seem very princess-like to you? Haha! You're not the first one to say so.
You may be surprised to learn I'm a skilled pegasus rider. My pegasus belonged to my great-grandmother.
Visit:
My name is Elincia. Might you be [S]?
I've come at the request of [F].
Level: I'll do my very best to rise to meet everyone else.
I'm doing my best to learn what I can, little by little.
I'm sorry if I couldn't quite live up to your expectations.
Summon: My name is Elincia Ridell Crimea, daughter of King Ramon of Crimea. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Learn Skill: Thanks for granting me this gift. From the bottom of my heart.
Confession:
I spent most of my life living at the mercy of circumstance. I was never able to relieve my own uneasiness.
However, traveling with my lord Ike and the others, and spending time here...
It's allowed me to see a clearer picture of what it is I need to do.
My power alone is not enough to accomplish anything. However, if my rising up will help other people...
If it will help even a little, then that is the path I choose for myself. I no longer have doubt about that.
Special: We will fight if we must!
Status: My full name is Elincia Ridell Crimea, and I am the daughter of King Ramon of Crimea.
Oh! I'm...I'm sorry. I ought to stay on guard for any sort of surprise attack.
Could I perhaps ask for your help in practicing for battle? I must do my fair share out there.
I will be forever grateful to my lord Ike and the other mercenaries.
Would you mind if I stayed here longer? I won't be a bother.
Ah, Crimea. Land of my birth, land that made me...who I am today.
I believe in you. No matter what may come.
I received this clothing from Dökkálfheimr. Does it suit me?
Oof, whoah! Ugh. My apologies. These clothes will catch on simply anything...
Nightmares may be scary, but the álfar of Dökkálfheimr are quite beautiful.
I hope that everyone can sleep well, and has pleasant dreams.
Even I could not understand Lord Ike.
I would cherish a chance to meet those lost to me... Even if just in a dream.
If I could have just one wish, it would be to continue sharing your dream.

nephenee.name: Nephenee
nephenee.title: Fierce Halberdier
nephenee.description: A militia member from the Crimean countryside. Since she's quiet, people think she's shy, but... Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: I hope everyone back home is doin' all right...
Ahh, the weather's just swell today, ain't it? Huh? Oh! Um...
There are some trees over yon— Uh, over there... They're growing fruit... Might you wanna—um, want to...
I'm just a country girl, so I try to avoid makin' conversation...
Visit:
Um...[F] asked me to...say hi... So...
Bye now!
Level: Yep.
About right.
Aw, horsefeathers!
Summon: I'm Nephenee. I'll fight alongside ya'll—uh, you all... So... I'm pleased to be here.
Learn Skill: Wait... You meanin' it?
Confession:
Excuse me, [S]...
A-actually, never mind...
But, actually... Um, well...
Maybe you already know this about me, but I'm just a country gal...
I don't take to talkin' all that often on account of my accent... It's a mite embarrassing...
But I just wanted to tell ya... Well...
Thanks.
Status: Wh-whaddya need?
Whuh? Whaddya do that for?
You wanna talk ta me? Ugh, I mean...talk with me?
We aren't really much with fancy talk. I'm just...trying to speak like you.
Yeesh... Can't make out halfa what these castle-breds say.
You heard the way I talk, but that's just the way I talk.
You shouldn't work y'self to death. Good ta no one then!
So these're from...Jötunheimr, ya said? Am I wearin'em right?
Ah! ...Whatcha sneakin' up on me for?
If I was a princess of Jötunheimr, I guess I'd be pretty huge, huh? Stronger too. Neat.
Havin' a sister yer close with must be real swell. Huh? What am I not gettin'?
We never had fancy outfits or nothin' back home.
I gotta get tougher—so tough I don't lose to nobody!
I hope I'm bein' useful to ya. That'd make me real glad.

blackknight.name: Black Knight
blackknight.title: Sinister General
blackknight.description: One of Daein's Four Riders. An enigmatic knight encased in pitch-black armor. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: To think a world such as this could exist... If I stayed here, then perhaps...
Circumstances being what they are, I shall lend you my strength. However, just one shall ever be my true master.
To surpass General Gawain...is my ultimate goal as a swordsman.
I share a sword style with Ike, of the Greil Mercenaries... We also shared a master.

I learned the sword from a man I once called master. And now, that man...
No... I have nothing to share.
Visit: Are you [S]? Accept this missive from [F].
Level: To surpass my master... That is my true desire.
My master's blade was stronger... It was swifter...
Summon: I am a general of Daein, and one of the Four Riders.
Learn Skill: Use my blade as you see fit.
Confession:
I learned the sword from one of my fellow Four Riders, Gawain. He was a general without compare...
I fought my master, and I won. However, by then he had already cast aside his true skill.
This means I have not truly surpassed him.
But defeating one whose strength rivaled his own could be another means of achieving that goal.
I have forever longed for such a battle.
Not everyone would understand such drive, but as one who also lives by battle, I thought that perhaps you...
Well, that is all.
Status: Curious as to who I am? You're better off not knowing, or perhaps even asking.
Your method for wresting my attention is...perplexing.
This armor I wear is blessed by the goddess.
Pray that you never make a miscalculation.
Know your strength to know when to exercise discretion.
The son of Gawain... Ike... He, now, is my prey.
I am here to protect you.
This armor may have changed, but I have not.
What do you hope to achieve by prodding me?
Pit me against any foe you choose. None will be a match for me.
The measure of a ruler's strength can be taken by their closest aides.
The Kingdom of Flame holds power sufficient to draw my interest.
If he repeats his father's mistakes...
What do you wish of me? I am focused on one thing only: combat.

inigo2.name: Inigo
inigo2.title: Indigo Dancer
inigo2.description: A descendant of the dancer Olivia. He carries on his departed mother's dancing and her power. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: My, what a variety of Heroes! I never expected to clap eyes on so many realmsworth of adorable creatures...
I'm told some don't appreciate male dancers, but I do my best to support everyone all the same.
I lost my mother, and sometimes, I wonder if she'd smile if she saw me as I am now, carrying on her legacy.

At the performing arts festival, my friends put on plays, they sang, they danced...
Why don't we do something like that here? A wonderful idea, wouldn't you say?
When I'm dancing is the only time I don't need to remind myself to smile. It just happens naturally.
Visit:
I've moseyed over here to bring you [F]'s best.
My outfit? It's for dancing, of course! Isn't it something?
Level: I've danced so much for you... I have that to thank for this.
My dream came true—I'm a dancer. Now the real work starts!
How embarrassing! And it means more practice, too...
Summon: I am Inigo. I've long dreamed of being a dancer, and I'll dance my heart out on this stage you've provided me.
Learn Skill: With this power, I'll dance even more beautifully. Just watch me!
Confession:
I have to thank you for calling me to this world and letting me dance for so many Heroes.
I've been to a lot of places, seen a lot of things, and met a lot of people... Many of them are dear to me now.
But none of them—not a single one— was able to see me as I am now. Nobody saw my dream made real.
But now, thanks to you, my dream IS real. Nothing could make me happier.
It's not so easy to say this, and maybe it's not easy to hear it, either... Your support means a lot. I'm in your debt.
I hope to stay by your side for a long time to come. I want to help you reach your dream. I want to see you smile.
Now, and forever...my heart brims with affection for you.
Status: Dazzling, yes?
A dance, just for you!
Does this outfit suit me? I had it made for the festival.
