Still not entirely sure what a "good trick" is supposed to be...
Guess I'm just not cut out for this festival business.
Summon: I'm Dorcas. I'm not usually one for festivals, but...figured if I'm going, I might as well go as a monster.
Learn Skill: Hey, thanks for that. Uh... Take some candy in return if you want.
Confession:
To be honest, this outfit had me, uh... a little bit...perplexed at first.
I've never been any good at showing my emotions. So I've never been sure if a guy like me could be any fun.
But thanks to these children's smiling faces...all that uneasiness just melts away.
This getup actually makes people smile. Kids call out to me, and they laugh... That's a first.
This harvest festival is a good thing... I see that now.
Next time I'm with Natalie, maybe I'll let her see me in this costume. It may bring a smile to her face, too.
Status: Just can't get used to this getup.
Don't try to spook me. I'm scaring you.
Making it from day to day takes everything I got. Never had much time for festivals.
This candy might make my wife happy.
You think I look good in this getup? I'm just not seeing it.
If Natalie gets better...I'll take her to a festival. One day.
Natalie can't eat all this. Go ahead, pick one.

owain.name: Owain
owain.title: Chosen One
owain.description: Lissa's son who tends to be overly theatrical. He loves to give weapons dramatic names. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
My arm bears a mark known as the Exalt's Brand. When it appeared, my mother both laughed and sobbed...
Simultaneously. For a whole hour! It was peculiar...but I'll never forget the look upon her face.
I could not protect a single soul in the far-flung future from which I hail. But I've vowed that will be my last failure.

Accept my thanks for your hard work. Even when simply running patrols, you're a vision of inspiration and awe!
Your hood fluttering in the wind, your mighty hands clutching a divine weapon... It gets my blood pumping!
Hey, let's think up some special technique names! Shouting as you summon is sure to improve results!

I was just about to make a new entry in the Manual of Justice. But don't you even think about peeking!
The legendary pages contained within are far more than your mortal eyes could handle.
Visit:
You're [S]? I have braved the abyss to deliver unto you a most sacred message!
Oh, uh... It's from [F].
Level: A mere drop in a bucket already overflowing with greatness!
Keep your distance, friends. I cannot control my true power!
What?! Some sinister forces conspire to impede my growth!
Summon:
Chosen warrior of hope from a dire future...I am Owain Dark! And with the full force of my power, I—
Er, huh? No time for that? Oh, um... I'm Lissa's son from the future. Nice to meet you.
Learn Skill: This feeling... Have you granted me new power?! I shall call it...
Confession:
You've done well to temper my strength, producing something truly formidable, friend.
Or shall I call you...Master?!
Not only have you enlisted the aid of a champion such as myself, but you have given me power without limit.
Yet I know that if I do not appeal to your scrupulous and iron will, then...
Huh? Why are you backing away from me? Wait, wait, come back, [S]! Please!
I shall—I mean, I will—speak more plainly. Promise! I'm just glad you've taken me under your wing is all.
I'm really grateful for all you've done. It's because of you I've grown so strong and remained safe in battle.
Someday I'll become a true hero of legend... And even then, I'll continue to stand by your side!
Status: S-stay back, friend...! I can't...control...my power...!
Ahh, I see you too bear the aura of a chosen one! We are kindred spirits, you and I.
The blood of heroes courses through our veins! It draws us together, binding us to one another in— Hey, come back! I didn't finish my speech...

Ah, if it isn't the Hero Champion! Brave Master? No, Brave Champion! Wait, the Daring Hero! Oh, I've got it! The Hero Champion! Wait, did I say that one already? The Champion of Daring...Heroes! The Heroic Brave! The Master of Heroes! The...
I've arrived somewhere other than Ylisse?! I couldn't concoct a more devious plot twist if I tried.
Mother... Father... Just you watch. I will save the world. I'll save everyone...
A dark hero such as myself is pretty in-demand... Well, you did go through the trouble to summon me. You may share in my boundless strength!

loki.name: Loki
loki.title: The Trickster
loki.description: Strategist for Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame. Likes to play tricks and manipulate people.

Castle Hall:
The time I spend with you and Prince Alfonse, just chatting away like this...
This world offers up so many fascinating opportunities, doesn't it?
Isn't Princess Veronica just adorable? I cherish that child. Any time spent teasing her is absolutely not wasted.
If the Loki of this world is your enemy, then I will be your ally. That should keep things interesting!

The power to summon... The Kingdom of Askr's ability to open gates to other realms...
I'm sure you've pondered them. Don't mysteries like these make you want to uncover every little detail?
If you desire to make use of me, then by all means...ask. You summoned me, didn't you?
Visit:
Well, hello, dear. I am Loki... Let's just say my heart and body were stolen by your comrade...
I mean [F], of course.
Level: What a satisfying sensation... Hee-hee!
What do you think? Come and take a look.
How could I be satisfied?
Summon: Did you call for me? To think you'd try and make me yours... What a scamp you are!
Learn Skill: Thank you! Maybe I can dream up a way to show my gratitude.
Confession:
I can tell by the look in your eyes that you're here to confess your love.
Before we get to that... Can I borrow your divine weapon? Just for a little bit...
It is simply too much power to put in the hands of a human!
You could rule the nine worlds and every conceivable Outrealm...
The power at your command is truly godlike.
I can certainly think of a few things I'd like to do with it...
Is that a no? You're far too strict!
Disappointing, but hardly unexpected. We've got to get to know each other better...
And someday, when we're as close as close gets, maybe you'll change your mind.
Status: Come on. Take a break.
Did you...need something?
Whatever you need... I'll do.
Ah! You really shouldn't tease me.
You're very interested in touching me, aren't you?
Looking forward to what I'll say next?
I feel like you've put a spell on me. You're so bad.

kliff.name: Kliff
kliff.title: Curious Spirit
kliff.description: Alm's childhood friend from Ram Village. Loves learning and hungers to see more of the world. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: The chance to meet with so many Heroes from a variety of cultures... I actually find it kind of interesting.
Life in the village was getting boring, so when Alm asked me to join the Deliverance, I took the plunge.
Being a summoner sounds like it's pretty interesting. Mind if we switch jobs for a day? Yes, I'm kidding.

I've spent so much time in the library here. I'm getting bored. Why don't you show me around?
I bet they let you go anywhere.
I'm taking notes on this place, but when I get back to my world... nobody is going to believe me.
Visit:
I was asked to carry this greeting by [F].
Can I go now?
Level: Impressive! I didn't know I had this kind of potential.
This is nothing to complain about. Did you expect more?
What? How boring.
Summon: My name is Kliff. Hmm... This place looks like it could be a lot of fun. Don't let me get bored.
Learn Skill: Now this looks interesting... As a favor, I'll use it to help you out.
Confession:
Hey, [S]... Want to talk?
Honestly, I wanted to ask you something. Do I have a bad attitude?
My friends say I do. It's true, isn't it?
I don't know why, but just about everything irritates me.
Maybe it's because I'm young. I'm not free to do what I want... I feel like I'm still waiting to grow up.
My dream is to travel the world on my own. I won't be going back to my village. That's a secret, by the way.
When I can go wherever I please, I'll try and find the time to visit you again. Probably.
Don't be surprised if I turn up!
Status: I'm Kliff. I'm a member of the Deliverance, along with everybody — well, it's a long story.
Huh? Don't be such a Tobin. If you're bored, why don't you try studying? It'll sharpen your wits.
I used to go to the school in the village, but it shut down, all thanks to the war. I'm so bored.
I'm not sure I believe what you're telling me about the world you come from. Are you pulling my leg?
My friends from the village all treat me like a child. It's rather rude, wouldn't you say?
I want to see the wide world with my own eyes. If that means I won't see my friends again, well, so be it.
You're not as boring as I expected! When I'm around you, things are never dull. Keep being yourself, OK?

aversa.name: Aversa
aversa.title: Dark One
aversa.description: A wily mage who serves Gangrel of Plegia. Excels at using her charms to disarm and then destroy her foes. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: No one in this country knows me. Nor do they know what I have done. I find that strangely comforting. Heh-heh.
You know, it's quite impudent of you to ask about my past. Oh, look at you! I'm just kidding. Hee-hee!
No matter what world you find yourself in, chores don't do themselves. I'll do my share.
I've been told there is a nearby waterfall. I do love them... Come, give chase. We shall make a splash!
Are you to serve as my guard? I assure you—I am trustworthy. I was just tending to my injuries.
Visit: I am Aversa. I bring you a small token of affection—not mine, of course.
Level: All the naughty children who get in my way will quake with terror.
Playtime is just about over... Get ready for something new.
What a scary face! We should be enjoying ourselves...
Summon: Please, call me Aversa. My, you're adorable. If you don't watch out, I'll tease you mercilessly.
Learn Skill: Is this what you've been wanting?
Confession:
You come all the way out here rather often, don't you? I guess you don't trust me. I'm not a spy, you know.
That's not it? You think I look sad? You don't miss much, do you? It's true. I have many regrets.
I've done terrible things to a lot of people. There is no way I can atone for it all...
My past clings to me. No matter what I do, I can't make peace with it.
And whenever I try to speak with others, well...it gets in the way.
Speak plainly, you say? As if that'd ever work.
If you're that interested in me, why don't we spend a little time together? Until moonrise, perhaps?
As you may have noticed, I'm the fiercely loyal type.
Status: You may call me Aversa. A pleasure to meet you.
And just what are you looking at, hmm?
My, my, you're bolder than you look, aren't you?
If you wish to observe me, by all means. Just don't skulk in the shadows while you do it.
Perhaps you are more than just another fool in motley, capering on the stage...
You want to know about my past? That's not something that I…
What would you ask of me...if I agreed to follow your every command?

Special: Is it a dream you want?
Tell me how this hits you.
Status: These clothes are adorable. Did you have me in mind when you chose them?
Hmm? You want to play? How childlike you are.
Oh, please... I don't believe in tall tales dressed in fairy-wings.
Honestly! What did you have in mind when you gave me this outfit?
And just like that, I fly away... *chuckles*
When I dream, I feel like I'm a completely different person.
Now I understand just how much my regard means to you.

eirika3.name: Eirika
eirika3.title: Graceful Resolve
eirika3.description: Princess of Renais. Ephraim's twin. She and her brother strive to rebuild their war-torn country. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Have I become stronger? I want to be able to do more than just defend myself. I want to protect others.
Though I never wished it, constant battle has honed my skill. Of course, I'm no match for Ephraim or Seth.

You're an unusual person. I perceive something new about you every day.
Looking at you is like looking at a star. The light is constant, but ever changing.
What a remarkable book you have there. Would you be so kind as to let me take a look at it?

Attitude helps, and form is crucial, but when push comes to shove, practical experience matters most.
Do you think we might spar later? I could use some practice.
Visit: You must be [S], [F]'s comrade.
Level: Do not fret. No enemy will reach you as long as I am here!
I am not living up to my potential. I must train more.
Stronger. I need to get stronger.
Summon: I am princess Eirika of Renais. I will do my utmost to protect you and to never sully the title of Hero.
Learn Skill: Thank you. With power like this, I am sure to win.
Confession:
Do you mind resting here for a moment, [S]?
After these past days of battle, you must be exhausted. Close your eyes... Feel peace.
I...do not like fighting. I do not like to see people get hurt. But wishing and hoping rarely bring results...
I learned that I can only protect what is important to me with my own power, and I swore to become strong.
I think you understand what I mean. Don't you, [S]?
I thank you for your thoughts and for this time. Let's stay here a little while longer, shall we?
Status: I am princess Eirika of Renais. What's that you called me? Legendary Hero?
Ooh! Why must you be so...
I was once weak, and I understood nothing. But as a princess, I must change.
Even after the fighting has ended... I want to do all I can to bring joy to the hearts of my people.
I know so little about the world. Would you mind very much if I asked you to teach me?
The ability to overcome sorrow... That is a kind of strength, isn't it?
Now and forever, let me stand by your side.

camilla5.name: Camilla
camilla5.title: Flower of Fantasy
camilla5.description: The eldest princess of another Nohr. A demure and caring older sister to young Azura. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: In dreams, you can change who you are. If you do, it may well reflect a desire buried deep within.
There's another world where I am completely different... To dress in that manner? So embarrassing!
Azura...I will clear the darkness from your path.
An unquiet heart leads to a life of dissonance. Let us be painstaking and conscientious about how we live.
We must live honestly and hold ourselves accountable for our actions. If you lack a guiding light, look to me.
Visit:
I have traveled here with greetings from [F].
This castle seems an upstanding place with a high moral standard. I approve.
Level: I have been swallowed up by my dream.
A bit below the mark...but I am happy to be making progress.
A nightmare...
Summon: I'm Camilla, princess of Nohr. Have I found my way to a different world? Perhaps I am dreaming...
Learn Skill: I will use this power to protect Azura.
Confession:
Smothering someone with affection is one way to express your love for them, I know...
But is it the right way? No, I do not believe it is. You mustn't be sweet all the time. Love requires resolve.
If you truly love someone, you want to help them become strong. And to do that...you must be harsh at times.
That is why I am strict with you as often as I am kind.
I believe that this is the way I can help you achieve your aims in the long run, [S].
Status: Yes, I'm Camilla... However, I may not be the Camilla you're familiar with.
Huh?! Oh, don't frighten me like that.
When Azura refers to me as her sister... It makes me so happy I could cry.
Trouble sleeping? When that happens, I find it helps to count wyverns soaring across the sky.
You wish to...what? Rest your head in my lap? Oh! Why, I would never dream of doing something so...so...immodest!
Azura is my younger sister. Oh, I wish I could save her...
Will you help me think of some way I can bring a smile to her face?

mcorrin3.name: Corrin
mcorrin3.title: Dream Prince
mcorrin3.description: A Hoshidan prince raised in another Nohr. He understands young Azura's feelings very well. They are the best of friends. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.
mcorrin3.artist: Maiponpon (まいぽんぽん) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: If I can do my part to help protect someone I care about...if they're smiling...who I am doesn't matter.
Azura and I were separated for far too long... Finally, we can be together here.
If I can do anything, please let me know. There is no value to strength unless you use it to help people.
To be able to fight alongside all of these Heroes... This world itself might be a dream.
As long as I can make Azura happy, I am prepared to face any hardship.
Visit: I am glad to see you well. A greeting from [F]!
Level: I want to see her smile—always. The stronger I get, the better I can protect her.
I will aim ever upward, and my strength will become everyone's rock.
I have disappointed you. I am sorry.
Summon: My name is Corrin. I am here to see that Azura is smiling once again.
Learn Skill: This feeling can't be a dream.
Confession:
Some people find pleasure in attacking those who can't fight back. Sad to say, but it's true.
Azura's heart has been wounded by people like that. And as long as she seeks revenge, it will never heal.
That is why I want to stay at her side. If I protect her and give those wounds time to heal...
then perhaps she can grow stronger and find a way to live on her own someday.
I know she has the strength to walk on her own two feet. She just has to find it.
Until then, I will watch over her. Always.
Status: I want to bring a smile to Azura's face. She's so young... How can I neglect her?
You're willing to walk right up to people and say hello! I'm not shy either.
If things get too rough on you, it's OK to run away. Retreating isn't all bad.
A happy dream is better than a painful reality.
Do I...truly exist? Or am I just somebody else's dream?
Someday, she will take the first step on her path. There'll be no stopping her.
You're so kind. Something tells me you could bring that girl true happiness...

fcorrin3.name: Corrin
fcorrin3.title: Dream Princess
fcorrin3.description: A Hoshidan princess raised in another Nohr. She understands young Azura's feelings very well. They are the best of friends. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: All is well... Just know that I will shield you from all the malice of the world.
At the mercy of an unfortunate fate... You could say that of both Azura and me. That is why I can't leave her.
No matter how bad things are, if you can believe in the future...you will have the strength to move forward.
Please let me know if you are feeling lonely. I'll be happy to come by and give you a pat on the head.
Azura's smile warms my heart. I want to give her strength enough that she will never stop smiling.
Visit: You must pursue your ideals in friendship as in all else. Stay close with [F].
Level: As I grow stronger, I too inch closer to my ideals!
Gradually, I get closer to achieving my ideals. I won't be deterred!
I cannot give up. I must not let the dream end!
Summon: My name is Corrin. Now that I'm with you, you'll never have to cry anymore.
Learn Skill: Thank you for thinking of me. Your faith gives me the confidence to move forward!
Confession:
Whether you are born to an unkind fate or have it thrust upon you...you can always find meaning in it.
Even if you can't bear the cruelty of it alone, there are others who will help you clear a path to the future.
You should remember that for the times when your confidence falters, for when you lose sight of the dawn.
Never forget all those who support you.
Someday, your dream will become reality... So let us take each other's hands and move forward together.
Status: Azura has been feeling lonely. I need to console her...
You're not shy, are you? Just like me!
It's OK to run if you need to... Taking a break will help heal your wounds.
Wouldn't it be wonderful to return to the same happy dream every single night?
Having trouble sleeping? I can stay by your side until you fall asleep if you'd like.
I wonder if, someday, I'll return to the real world, too...
Help me watch over and protect her... Please.

mikoto.name: Mikoto
mikoto.title: Caring Mother
mikoto.description: The extremely affectionate queen of another Hoshido. She is a nurturing adoptive mother to Azura. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Azura is such a gentle child. But her insight into others' hearts makes her oversensitive, and she harbors ill will.
Ryoma, Hinoka, Corrin, Azura, Takumi, and Sakura... Oh, my children.
Even if we aren't bound by blood... we are still a family. I love all of them so much.
While I am with you, please...think of me as your mother. If that's all right with you, [S].
So many dream of a world without war. I hope you can realize that dream. I believe in you.
Visit: I don't mean to intrude. I am here to check up on you. I was asked to by [F].
Level: Never give up and your dreams will come true. I want all of my children to understand that.
I am grateful.
How unfortunate. We all stumble sometimes.
Summon: I am Mikoto, queen of Hoshido. I hastened to follow a familiar voice and found myself in this realm.
Learn Skill: No matter how old you get, you will always respond to kindness.
Confession:
Am I dreaming? Or is my existence itself a dream?
I have the sense that I fell before I was able to accomplish everything I had hoped...
But here, I am able to see how all of my children have grown.
It was your power that brought me here, [S]. You and young Azura's voice.
Even if I cannot stay...I am grateful to the both of you. You have shown me the continuation of my dream.
For my part, I can help by tending to you and to Azura.
I can only hope that if I nurture you, you can both move forward.
And as long as this dream continues... I will be right here beside you.
Status: It's all right now.
Be at ease.
I am Mikoto... However, I'm a bit different from the Mikoto you've heard about.
Trouble sleeping? Perhaps you'd like me to sing you a lullaby.
I am their mother... And it's a mother's duty to protect her children.
Watching your children grow up and find their independence can fill you with joy... But also with loneliness.
Being by your side offers a great deal of refuge. Not only for myself, but for the children as well.

azura4.name: Azura
azura4.title: Young Songstress
azura4.description: The daughter of Arete, queen of Nohr. She is treated badly by the denizens of the castle, and her heart is touched by darkness. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
Why did you call for me? Nobody ever wants to see me.
Maybe I'm dreaming...
You don't have to be nice to me. I know how to take care of myself. Nobody else will...
We can't change things. Can we? I don't think so. Do you?
You want to hear me sing? That's... But... There are much better singers than me.
I can't trust anybody. Maybe in a dream I could. That's the one place... where nobody hurts me.
Visit: I was asked to come greet you by [F]. Are you mean, or are you nice?
Level: God may be capricious, but for today...I'm happy.
I can feel the power inside me...
This...is what I expected.
Summon: I am Azura, princess of Nohr. I hope you'll be nice to me. Please...
Learn Skill: Why are you being so nice to me?
Confession:
I felt trapped, trapped in a world where I hated everything.
I hated it so much that I wanted it to just go away...all of it.
But there are a few people I can trust...and so many voices calling to me in my dreams.
There are people like you—you're nice to me. You're very gentle, and you even pat me on the head.
Maybe...maybe I should spend a little longer here.
I don't know what's going to happen next...
But if I'm with you, maybe things will be OK. I feel like I can keep going.
Status: Please, stand tall.
You're a grown-up, aren't you?
Everybody's always picking on me... But you don't.
Patting me on the head does not make me happy. Don't treat me like a child!
I thought that things would never change… But you've shown me that they can.
I never had a home... Until I came here.
I'll stay here with you for a bit longer... If you want me to...

surtr.name: Surtr
surtr.title: Ruler of Flame
surtr.description: King of Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame. Carries the blood of the Flame Dragon. A harsh ruler whose desire for conquest is relentless.

Castle Hall: What a languid breeze... The people here slumber quietly, stifled. Helpless fools, all of them.
Extract everything you can from the weak before you dispose of them. That is the law of Múspell.
My daughters are mine to control. If they outlive their usefulness, it falls to me to extinguish them.
Múspell's royalty has ruled for generations... But none have stoked the flames as hot as I.
You are the victor. Now make clear to all who bear witness to your glory—to the victor goes everything!
Visit: Bow before me. I am Surtr. I am king.
Level: I am flame itself! Even the gods will burn.
Ha-hah! This is it! This is my strength!
As king, I am shamed.
Summon: I am Surtr. I was sent to the land of the dead and made to serve... It must be your doing.
Learn Skill: You have fed the flames that will burn your foes to cinders!
Confession:
The strong dominate all. That is the way of it. That is my way.
You defeated me. I submit to you. Do as you please.
I am the flame that will burn as you desire—and burn anything that you desire to ash.
I do not need to hear your reasons. The weak are slaughtered and the strong manipulated and used.
Turn my flame toward any target. Burn it. Burn it all. Burn everything in the nine worlds!
Status: I am Surtr, King of Múspell. Bow before me.
Those who dare touch me will be swallowed by the flames.
My daughter... My people... They’re nothing but fuel for my flame.
This blood in my veins... It longs for the flames to grow hotter still.
The flame will devour everything. My enemies. My allies. And me.
Meeting you...was the beginning of the end for me.
The soul I once had...vanished in the flames of Múspell.
New clothing? What are your intentions?
I could not escape death's grasp. I now wear the garb of death.
Hel is inexhaustible. Perhaps that is fitting for the ruler of the dead.
I bring the inferno. All that lies before me is given to it.
My daughters are my pawns. If they fall from the board, so be it.
My heart is long dead. Not even my daughters can make it beat again.
Count me as an ally and you need never fear Hel's bleak realm.

ylgr.name: Ylgr
ylgr.title: Fresh Snowfall
ylgr.description: The youngest princess of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. Naive and brimming with curiosity, she's eager to explore new horizons.

Castle Hall: This castle is amazing! There is so much going on here and SO many people! This looks like FUN!
I love my brother, Hríd, and my sisters, Gunnthrá and Fjorm. They're always nice to me.
When I was stuck in Múspell, I made friends with this scary-looking soldier. He was actually nice. Sort of.
My big brother Hríd is the best. Strong, smart, daring... As long as he's around, Nifl will be fine.
When they conquered Nifl...I couldn't do a thing about it. I'm still so sorry about that...
Visit: Hello there! My name's Ylgr. This castle looks interesting... Is there anything fun to do around here?
Level: I'm getting better and better... I'm almost TOO good!
I'm a princess of Nifl. Don't you forget it!
What, what, what? No way!
Summon: I'm Ylgr. Where am I? You mean I've been summoned? I'm a Hero? Are you kidding me?! Eeee!
Learn Skill: Hey, thanks! I'm excited to get back out there. Let's go!
Confession:
This place is amazing! Thank you, [S]!
Thanks to you, I get to go on fun adventures day after day.
Why are you so nice to me? Maybe you...like me? Maybe a little bit?
Aaagh! I'm so embarrassed just talking about this! And what am I going to do if it's true?
Don't tell me! I mean, if you did, it would be OK.
Either way, I want to stay friends with you.
Special: I am having so much fun!
Status: I'm Ylgr. Come on! Show me something fun.
Oh, hey. You scared me!
Snow, snow, snow. I come from the land of boring, boring, boring, boring snow.
Ooh. Do you want to play with me?
I've always wanted to go on a big, big, big adventure. Like in my books!
I'm...so sorry.
You're fun. I never ever ever get bored when I'm with you.

gharnef.name: Gharnef
gharnef.title: Dark Pontifex
gharnef.description: A student of Gotoh, the White Sage. Hatched a scheme to revive the Shadow Dragon, Medeus, and rule the world. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: So many offerings suitable for my dark altar... What? This has nothing to do with you!

I should have been the one the White Sage chose!
I've said it before—Miloah was all talk. I was the rightful successor!
Anyone foolish enough to threaten me will quickly learn the true terror of my dark magic...
You are too powerful to waste your time here. You should follow your true desires...
Silence! Do not draw attention to me. Not here...
Visit: This place smells of the blood spilled in war... The depths of its darkness are profound.
Level: So long as I possess this dark power, they cannot snuff my life out!
Only a fool would raise a hand to strike me!
How...
Summon: I am the Pontifex Gharnef. Some call me the Dark Pontifex. That is fitting. Let us dye the world with shadow!
Learn Skill: Let the darkness roar and the stars gleam! All will be as I will it to be...
Confession:
I see how you look at me. You know the question I mean to ask you...
What is the source of your power? I cannot divine it. Just what are you?
I am the Dark Pontifex. I am feared by all. I am no longer human, and I steal the light away with my darkness.
Yet to your enemies, you must appear like a dark ruler, too... Controlling spirits, bringing death...
Heh heh heh... It seems you do not understand. You are more like me than you realize.
Dark ruler [S]...
Dominate your foes. Bend this world to your will. Each of us may lead our own realm, according to our whims...
Status: Heh heh heh... 'Tis I, Gharnef.
Make no mistake... I am well aware that the inferno awaits me.
Miloah's daughter... Linde, was it? A little girl does not possess the power to defeat me.
The power of the Dragon Scion Tiki is not to be underestimated...
Long ago, I was one of the White Sage's two disciples. His other disciple? Why, he was murdered. By my own hand.
So, White Sage... Do you scorn the student who strayed from the path you set?
You wish to command the Dark Pontifex? Heh heh heh... What a fool you are.

hrid.name: Hríd
hrid.title: Icy Blade
hrid.description: The eldest prince of Nifl, Kingdom of Ice. With a steady, calm demeanor, he's always prepared for danger.

Castle Hall: The peace of this realm depends on you. That means your attention is as valuable as any jewel in the treasury.
Thanks to everything you've done, Nifl can rebuild. I will never forget the debt we owe all of you.
Please, rest yourself, if only for a moment. Fatigue clouds judgment... Allow me to keep watch in your stead.
I know I can come across as a little cold. I apologize. I'd love to share a joke, but that's not how I'm made.
As long as I live...I will never forget that I failed in my duty to protect my people and my sisters...
Visit: I am Hríd, eldest prince of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. I bring word from [F].
Level: This is exceedingly good, wouldn't you say?
This, now... A reasonable result.
This, though... This is not satisfactory.
Summon: I am Hríd, eldest prince of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. I pledge on my good name to be of aid to you.
Learn Skill: Thank you. In order to protect that which I cherish, I need strength.
Confession:
My kingdom was as peaceful as any. Of others, we asked only for alliances, not conflict.
Nifl was as pure as the freshly fallen snow, in other words. But once Múspell invaded, everything changed.
A heart that desires only peace is precious, but its bearer is easy prey. I learned that the hard way.
Even if I want peace—no, BECAUSE I want peace—I must become strong.
I must be the blade that secures our realm. I can permit no further threat to Nifl's sovereignty.
Special: I'm putting it all into this one!
Status: I am Hrid, the eldest prince of Nifl.
Hm? Oh, sorry. It's going to take me a while to get used to that.
My homeland is completely covered in snow, as far as the eye can see. I happen to think it's beautiful.
You have warm hands.
You're very mysterious. But spending time with you puts me at ease, all the same...
Protecting my homeland was my duty. And I failed in that duty.
I will lend you my strength. Ask whatever you need of me. I'll do what I can.

eir.name: Eir
eir.title: Merciful Death
eir.description: Princess of Hel, the realm of the dead. Dearly loves her mother, Hel, who rules it. She finds Hel's increasing mercilessness toward the living disquieting.

Castle Hall: This world is dazzling...the people, the trees, even the wind. The light of life is so...so...abundant.
Hel, the realm of the dead... I lived there so long with only my mother.
If you are tired, I'll help you sleep. Just for the night—not forever.

Imagine that your body is ravaged by incurable disease or wracked with pain that never ceases...
You'd consider death a kindness then.
My blade, Lyfja, offers death to those who seek it. To those who wish to live, it offers compassion instead.
Visit: I am Eir, daughter of the sovereign of death. Do not worry. I seek only friendship—not your life.
Level: Strength wells up within me...
Life is growth... I am no exception.
No, no—I am not performing as I should. I apologize.
Introduction:
So you are [S]...
I will devote myself to you. No matter what order you give me, I will obey it.
Summon: I am Eir of the realm of the dead. But now, I have become your prisoner— haven't I?
Learn Skill: Thank you. I see it so clearly now— your kindness makes me feel such happiness.
Confession:
Ah, [S]... I apologize if I look gloomy to you. I am not used to smiling.
Did I smile as a child? I can't quite recall... My memories are so fuzzy, so faint...
I remember giving Mother a flower. She smiled, and I was so happy.
I am still that child. I would still love to make someone happy like I did then.
Maybe...if I can bring you a little joy, my life would have some value to it.
Please, tell me what I can do. If I could help, I'd be happy. I'd have accomplished something, at least.
Status: My name is Eir. I am known to all as the princess of the kingdom of death.
I have noticed that you're overly familiar with everyone.
When people suffer, truly suffer, that is when their hearts open to death.
Death is deliverance. Of course, for those who wish to live, it doesn't seem that way.
All people die, sooner or later. That is what makes their lives shine so brightly.
I have dreams, sometimes... Blue skies, white wings, gentle smiles....
I hope that you will live. This is a new feeling for me.

eirika4.name: Eirika
eirika4.title: Gentle as Snow
eirika4.description: Princess of Renais. Ephraim's twin. Her gentle mien blankets the winter festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: It has been quite some time since I have seen my brother so excited. I'm getting excited myself!
The envoys of the winter festival bring happiness to all the children. Isn't that wonderful?
You're curious about what kinds of presents I wished for as a child? That information...will remain secret.
I want to leave a gift beside Ephraim's pillow. Do you think he will realize it is from me?

This festival is for everyone to enjoy equally. Everyone is special at this festival, or so I'm told.
You should make sure to have as much fun with everyone as you can, even if you're a little bit cold.
Visit: I bring you an invitation to the winter festival from [F].
Level: This is more than I wished for! I feel that I have been blessed.
Seeing everyone enjoying themselves has given me the courage to fight.
The cold has numbed my hands. I must prepare more thoroughly next time.
Summon: I'm Princess Eirika of Renais. My brother Ephraim and I have come to the winter festival this year.
Learn Skill: I can feel this warming my heart... Truly, I am grateful.
Confession:
Taking part in this festival with Ephraim... It's been so long since I've enjoyed myself this much.
Everyone's in a cheery mood, with laughter in the air... And they give presents that really mean something.
The weather may be cold, but the warmth of the heart more than makes up for that.
I hope that one day the chill of war may be replaced by this warmth and everyone can enjoy days like these.
It's up to me to do what I can to realize a world where everyone comes together in kindness.
Status: A prayer of solace...
Are you well?
This festival warms the hearts of all who attend.
Oh, thank you. This cape never stays on straight!
No surprise that my brother is eager to participate in the tournament at the festival. I wish him well!
Oh, what fun it would have been to play in the snow together. Just the three of us...
I'm very grateful that we can spend the snowy nights of the winter festival together.

ephraim4.name: Ephraim
ephraim4.title: Sparkling Gallantly
ephraim4.description: The gallant prince of Renais. His chivalrous nature enlivens the winter festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Nothing warms you up like training. The tournament's coming up, so why don't you join me?
The envoys of the winter festival bring happiness to the children? I can get behind that cause.
You're curious about what presents I wanted as a child? Hmm... Probably lances.
I'm hoping to place a present by Eirika's pillow. The hard part is not getting caught!
I'm not a fan of showy outfits. But if dressing up helps keep everybody in good spirits, it's worth doing.
Visit: The winter festival is on now, and it's something to see. Come and visit [F]'s castle!
Level: I feel power rushing through me. Is this what it means to be an envoy of the winter festival?
I can't let the cold of winter hold me back!
I haven't warmed up enough yet, I guess.
Summon: I am Prince Ephraim of Renais, and I'm ready for the winter festival. I'll give the tournament all I've got!
Learn Skill: Is this a winter festival gift for me? I gladly accept!
Confession:
When I fight, how do you see me? Have I been able to show you skill worthy of a winter envoy?
You're saying that the winter envoy's job is not to fight? Hmm. That's quite different from the legends I've heard.
Does it matter? I feel like I haven't seen Eirika smile like this in a very long time.
This winter festival has been good for her. That's what's important.
Thank you for inviting us to join you here, [S].
I don't have a gift to give you, I'm afraid—unless you require my strength. I will happily give you that.
Status: It's tough to move around in, but this holiday getup is good on defense. Not so bad!
A tournament is a battle. And if it's a battle, well... There is no way I'm going to lose.
Lose a battle, lose your life. This is the mindset I need if I want to win at the winter festival.
Everyone at the winter festival seems to be enjoying themselves. I didn't know what to expect!
I can't fight poorly in front of Eirika. As her brother, my pride won't allow it.
If he were here with us now... I wonder what he'd have to say.
I'm thankful that the two us can spend this winter festival together. It means a lot to me.

fae2.name: Fae
fae2.title: Holiday Dear
fae2.description: A young dragon from Nabata village. Her excitement for her first winter festival cannot be contained. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: La, la, la! The town's all snowy! La, la, la! The snow's bright and white! It's festival time!
So...so pretty! There's no snow where I come from, so I'm having a lot of fun here!
They said that if I'm good, I'll get a present. You be good too!
There's SO much good food here! I'll get you some. Wait right here! I'll be back in a second.
I'm doing my very, very, very, VERY best for the winter festival!
Visit: Guess what! Right now, there's a winter festival going on over at [F]'s castle!
Level: Everybody is so happy... I'm happy too!
Let's have another festival, OK?
So chilly! Oh...
Summon: Can I join in the festival? I've been very good, so give me a LOT of presents!
Learn Skill: What a nice gift! I'll remember this for a long time!
Confession:
Hey, guess what! I got A LOT of presents from SO MANY people!
Toys, books, shiny stones...all kinds of stuff!
But you know what? What I like the best is seeing how happy everybody is.
When everybody's smiling, it makes me smile too. I just feel so...so warm inside!
You know, winter isn't cold—it's warm! Oooh, is it too early to start planning for next year's festival?
Status: Did you hear?! Did you, did you?! It's time for the winter festival!
That means I'm doing a good job, right?
Festival time, yaaaaay!
Do you know what a festival is? You get all of your friends together and go, and you all shout, "Yay! Hurray! Yippee!"
Lots of snow means lots of fun!
Do you think I'll get any presents? Hmm... I hope I do...
I can hug myself, but it's much warmer to hug someone else! Now get over here!

cecilia2.name: Cecilia
cecilia2.title: Festive Instructor
cecilia2.description: Mage General of Etruria. She is currently using her teaching skills to instruct visitors at the winter festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall:
I have prepared my curriculum for the winter festival.
I want everyone to have a good time, so clear explanations of each and every custom are a must.
This reminds me of my days teaching Roy and Lilina. I took them to some festivals then.
When I exchange gifts on a night like this...I feel close to everyone.

I saw a poster that said, "Hurry in and order your winter festival presents at Anna's!"
Seems like this is a great time to turn a profit, isn't it?
I worked hard to make this outfit for the festival, but I was in a bit of a rush. Does it look like I got it right?
Visit: I bring you glad tidings! We're in the middle of celebrating the winter festival with [F].
Level: It's wonderful how the festival has everybody smiling and feeling warm toward one another.
The festival is just getting started. Let's have some fun!
Brrrr. I didn't expect it to be so chilly!
Summon: I am Cecilia, Mage General of Etruria. If you want to know all about the winter festival, I'll teach you!
Learn Skill: The true pleasure of the winter festival is giving gifts. I'll happily accept this one with thanks.
Confession:
I studied the winter festival extensively so I could teach others about it.
Heroes gather here from across the realms, and that means diverse value systems come together here, too.
That said, I believe everyone can enjoy a festival. We all like having fun, no matter where we come from.
My hope was that those who knew only war could smile, if even for just a moment.
If that moment at the festival could reside in their hearts...nothing would make me happier.
Status: This is traditional clothing for the winter festival.
Hm? You have a mischevious streak, don't you? Did you used to tease your teachers?
I happen to have a spare outfit for the winter festival if you'd like to try one on.
Teaching others is a good chance to learn something yourself.
Let me know if you'd like to learn more about the winter festival. I'm happy to teach!
Enemies are likely to underestimate my skills in this outfit... Might be a viable strategy.
I would love it if you and I could learn more from each other.

azura5.name: Azura
azura5.title: Vallite Songstress
azura5.description: Daughter of Arete and the former king of Valla. Gripped by an unkind fate, she strives to lead both Hoshido and Nohr to the truth. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The intriguing conversations I have here are so inspirational... I feel as if I could compose a beautiful song.
While malicious plots eat silently away at Hoshido and Nohr, my own silence consumes me.
The brightness of your smile seems faded. Please, allow me to lift your spirits with a song.
Performing is a far more strenuous task than you might think. You're welcome to join my daily training.
Sleep was particularly evasive last night... My preparations may be more lengthy than usual today.
Visit: Greetings, [S]. Please receive this gift on behalf of [F].
Level: With the power of this song, tranquility will be restored to everyone's troubled hearts.
Today, my voice resonates!
My apologies. It seems my performance today is lackluster.
Summon: My name is Azura. Something about you tells me the power of my songs may be of use to you.
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude. My songs will now carry to even more souls in need.
Confession:
There's a shadow darkening your brow, [S]. Does something trouble you?
If you don't wish to speak, I won't press you. There are silent secrets nestled in all our hearts...
Such a secret plagued me once. I couldn't share my burden with anyone...
Not even with one as dear to me as a sibling. But words swallowed can cause much pain.
It seems as though you may be carrying too much. Please... Speak with me if you trust me.
...Now I'm pressing you, as I promised I wouldn't. Forgive me, if you will. I merely want to help.
When you can no longer swallow your secret, come speak with me. With song, I'll soothe your soul.
Special: For the world I dreamt of!
Status: We can see this through!
Cheer up, OK?
I'm a Legendary Hero? I see... So that's how I'm known in this world.
If you'd like me to teach you a dance, you need simply ask.
That's where the song ends. It says nothing of the future. Maybe the next part is for someone else to write... Why don't we try?
The path is yours to climb. But I'll help you on your way.
You have to survive. Anything I can do to help you, I will.

fjorm2.name: Fjorm
fjorm2.title: New Traditions
fjorm2.description: The gentle second princess of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. Her joy in joining Laegjarn and the others for a trip to the shrine shines through.

Castle Hall:
This may not be my typical weapon, but my brother Hríd and I trained with bows when we were young.
I should be of some assistance to you still.
Nifl is all but closed off due to the snow this time of year. Askr is so warm and cozy by comparison!

Thank you for inviting me to accompany you to the shrine. I already know what I'll wish for...
And I hope your wish comes true, too.

Seeing the dawn of the new year from the sky is like nothing else.
You can join me up there if you'd like. Don't worry, I'll hold the reins!
There is never enough time. We must take life one day at a time and stride steadily toward our goals.
Visit: I come with a greeting for the new year from your dear friend [F].
Level: I'm so happy right now. Recalling this feeling will carry me through the year!
I never want to forget this sensation.
This means I'm not yet strong enough...
Summon:
I am Fjorm, second princess of Nifl. I hear that some people plan their entire year on New Year's Day.
Let's set our goals together, shall we?
Learn Skill: Surely a good sign... I'll make this year better than the last.
Confession:
To be able to visit you for the new year is exactly what I wanted. It's made me very glad.
I've been reflecting on my actions of this past year, and I've decided to embrace new goals for this new year.
I don't want to spend my days idle. I will continue moving forward, and I'll do all I can with the time I have.
And also... I want to help you in any way I can. Even more than I did last year.
Well then... Shall we head to the shrine? Let us both make new promises for this new year.
Status: I have never worn anything quite like this before... How do I look?
Oh, you startled me! I'm glad it's just you.
Are you familiar with new year's traditions like these?
I hope it is not too much to ask, but... Will you take my hand?
Whenever I am with you, I feel such warmth.
My wish for the New Year has already come true, hasn't it?
Spending the New Year with you...makes me very happy.

gunnthra2.name: Gunnthrá
gunnthra2.title: Year's First Dream
gunnthra2.description: The eldest princess of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. A gentle soul with strong maternal instincts. She is very much looking forward to her first dream of the New Year.

Castle Hall:
I've been assured the measurements are accurate, but this outfit is still so difficult to breathe in...
Does everyone have this much trouble getting used to this?
As royalty, I have received training in various weapons, so I do have a little experience outside of magic.
My home may change, but what I hope for remains the same...a world where people can smile peacefully.
The first shrine trip of the year is a sacred custom. I like to pray for a tranquil year.
Will you be taking an omikuji? It's kind of like a kind of lottery, is it not? I find the idea interesting...
Visit: Happy New Year. I bring a greeting from [F]!
Level: A good omen for the coming spring.
I'm grateful for this growth.
It's like a bad dream...
Summon:
I am Gunnthrá, eldest princess of Nifl. I've come to visit and to offer a blessing for the new year.
May all your dreams come true.
Learn Skill: Thank you for the New Year's gift. I will keep your kindness in my heart.
Confession:
Tell me... Have you dreamt your first dream of the new year? I happened to have a very nice one myself.
I can't give you all the details, but it is a dream I'd love to become reality one day...
I like to think it will come true if I work to make it so. And I intend to do just that.
If it does come true... Well, I'll tell you all about it then. I look forward to that time.
Special: I can do more than magic!
Status: That Fjorm and I can spend this holiday together, oh... It means the world to me!
Oh, thank you! I was about to take a tumble... This robe!
To see the world calm and peaceful, with the feelings of the people warm and gentle... That's what would make me happy.
I hear that it is a New Year's tradition to visit a shrine. How wonderful!
Would you mind helping me loosen my garment? It's a bit...constrictive!
Am I wearing this correctly? It's a little bit hard to breathe!
Ever since I met you, in my dream, I have always, always... Well.

laevatein2.name: Laevatein
laevatein2.title: Kumade Warrior
laevatein2.description: The second princess of Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame. She keeps her emotions in check but can't relax without her blade by her side.

Castle Hall: My sister looks beautiful...always. Even in armor...or these foreign clothes. Correct?
I don't have Laevatein right now. I have this staff. It's called a kumade. I am...uneasy.
I have received a small paper bag full of money. What is the meaning of this?
When we visit the shrine...and perform the rite Laegjarn told me about...I will succeed!
Why are you looking at me? Is it these clothes? Is something...wrong with them?
Visit: Happy New Year. That's what [F] said.
Level: I feel a little different...than last year.
All right.
I might have caught a cold.
Summon: I am Laevatein. Is my sister Laegjarn here? We're... We're supposed to visit a shrine together.
Learn Skill: Is this a New Year's present, too? Like the money?
Confession:
You're being slow... Hurry up. You're coming with us—to visit the mountain. The shrine...for the rite, for New Year.
Do not worry. I will not let anyone stop us. I will protect you, and protect Laegjarn, too.
You... You taught me something. I am...not just a blade. There is...more than that.
At the shrine...I will pledge myself. To protecting you and Laegjarn.
Hurry... She's waiting. For both of us.
Status: A new year begins...
A...staff?
Yah! Do not do that again. I will cut you down!
This weapon is strange. Laevatein is better.
This rite is to celebrate the new year. Laegjarn explained. She knows everything.
I can be with her again... I am happy.
I will visit the shrine with my sister. You, too. Let's go.

hrid2.name: Hríd
hrid2.title: Resolute Prince
hrid2.description: The eldest prince of Nifl, Kingdom of Ice. With a steady, calm demeanor, he's always prepared for danger, even when on a simple trip to a shrine.

Castle Hall: In a way, this outfit is sobering. I feel motivated to confront the new year with purpose.
It's much warmer here than in Nifl. Here, I suspect we won't be snowed in during the new year.
If I can protect just one person from a sad fate this year, well...that's my New Year's wish come true.
I've just eaten some sort of soft and white delicacy for the first time. It was called...mochi?
It's exhilarating to dash through the icy New Year's air. It may be chilly, but it warms the heart.
Visit: I have New Year's tidings for you from [F]. I wish you good health this year.
Level: That was better than I expected! Perhaps this is a year for change.
Not bad... My luck seems to be improving.
To not be ready to face the challenges of the new year... I must gird myself.
Summon: My name is Hríd. As the new year rises, let us celebrate the sunset of the last.
Learn Skill: The year is still young, yet I've already found myself in your debt.
Confession:
Nifl's winters are long and arduous. They fiercely test the will and the strength of our people.
Despite knowing this, we stay, and every year we brace ourselves until winter gives way to spring.
For us, the new year is the halfway mark between winter and spring. It signals our coming salvation.
I'd like to assist you in reaching your own spring this year, [S].
This year, I will be at your side with my sword to repay the debt I owe you.
Special: Let's hope for a good year.
Status: Thanks to your efforts, Nifl has been saved.
Perhaps this can be a celebration of our success!
Peace is a wonderful thing... But without strength, peace cannot be sustained.
This realm is quite different from either Nifl or Múspell.
Do me a favor and tell me if I've got this thing on wrong, will you? If I do, I must fix it immediately.
Do you think these clothes suit me? You do? How can you tell?
I will never forget the debt I owe you. By staying at your side, I may repay it.

laegjarn2.name: Laegjarn
laegjarn2.title: New Experiences
laegjarn2.description: The eldest princess of Múspell, the Flame Kingdom, and Laevatein's older sister. Her joy in joining Fjorm and the others for a trip to the shrine is effulgent.

Castle Hall: No matter what she wears, my little sister always looks good, and this garb suits her surprisingly well.
This outfit is so festive with its bright colors... I never had occasion to wear anything like this in Múspell.
It gets so cold at night! After the New Year, we ought to go somewhere warm. We don't want to catch cold.

So it's off to the shrine... As I understand it, there's a rite to be performed, and that grants a wish...
I can tell from the way you're looking at me that I don't quite have it right.
You shouldn't just let the years pass you by. I have things that matter to me, so I must become stronger now.
Visit: I am Laegjarn, a general at [F]'s castle. I bring you a New Year's greeting.
Level: Heat is boiling forth from deep within me.
I will get stronger, one step at a time, as befits my newly made pledge.
I can't stay as I am—I must improve.
Summon: My name is Laegjarn. I have come with my sister in this foreign garb to participate in a New Year's rite.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I need to cut a path to the future, and this will help.
Confession:
Unlike my father and my sister, I don't have raw strength. I have to rely on cunning. Tactics win battles.
Yet I could not defeat you. You and Alfonse are the first to corner me...
It's as though you could see right through all of my schemes.
Please, teach me. That's what I'd like to spend this year on—learning from you.
No matter how demanding it may be, I must study your tactics. Please.
Status: It is difficult for me to relax without my armor. I feel exposed.
Ah! I left myself open. Were you my enemy, I'd have already lost.
No matter how I look at it, this weapon does not seem usable in combat. Perhaps it will lull the enemy into letting down their guard. Is that it?
Pray, and hope that it will come true...I see. So that is the power of this tradition.
This kimono suits me? Please, no flattery.
Laevatein... We are together again.
If I am at your side, I believe that this new year will be a good one.

tibarn.name: Tibarn
tibarn.title: Lord of the Air
tibarn.description: King of Phoenicis, the nation of the hawk laguz. Leads his people by dint of his overwhelming fighting ability and charisma. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Nothing like an unfamiliar challenge to get the blood pumping. Ah, it's been a while...
I don't mind you going out on patrol, but if you move too far from my side, I can't protect you. Stay close.
Worried about our allies in the field? I can check on them for you, as long as the skies are clear.
It's a shame you can't fly. Then again, I can't summon like you can. We each have our talents.
The wind may not have a voice, but it speaks to me all the same. Even in a new world, it tells me a great deal.
Visit: I'm King Tibarn of Phoenicis. Your friend [F] says hello.
Level: Flying high. Let's see how far I'll soar!
I'm not done yet. Not even close.
This is why I don't fight on an empty stomach. Hey, got anything to eat?
Summon: I'm Tibarn. I may be a king, but don't make a big deal of it. Fawning praise does me no good.
Learn Skill: Wait until you see what I do with this.
Confession:
It's refreshing to be out on my own, in the thick of it. The pressures of kingship can be stifling.
It seems I've got a little more chaos in me than most folk. If I sit still for too long, I start itching for a fight.
We laguz have strong instincts for battle. And that includes kings, no matter how civilized.
Zelgius of Begnion, the beorc hero Ike... The world I came from sure didn't lack worthy competition.
Seems I won't get bored anytime soon here, though, either. Speaking of...we should get back to it.
Special: You'll get no quarter from me.
Status: I'm King Tibarn of Phoenicis.
Whoa! Is that how you beorc greet one another?
I can see that you're a beorc, but there's something different about you...
I always pay my debts. That's how I do things.
My people do not use weapons like yours. Those are for the beorc.
I'll never forgive you if you go and get yourself killed out there, so don't do it. Got that?
If you find yourself in a dire position, you can call on me. No matter what, I will fly to your aid.
So this is my new look, huh? Well, your fashion sense is on point.
You're kind of unpredictable, you know that?
Next time you're heading to the Kingdom of Flame, let me know. I'd love to see it.
The Hawk and Raven clans will always be like family.
A hawk's wings are perfect for both pursuit and retreat.
You know, this outfit actually is a bit more kingly than my usual.
Don't be afraid to ask for my help. Lean on me anytime.

reyson.name: Reyson
reyson.title: White Prince
reyson.description: Prince of Serenes, the former kingdom of the heron laguz. Brother of Leanne. Frail, but strong willed. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Ah—the chirping of the birds. Even in the most foreign of lands, it would seem there is familiarity to be found.
My home, Serenes Forest, was rich and bright beyond compare. One day, that beauty will be restored.
Herons only eat fruit and nuts, but that just means more meat for you. Please don't refrain on my account.
You want to hear me sing? Perhaps another time. Apologies, but the moment has to be right.
The chaos of battle saps my strength. That my body is not meant for war is...vexing to say the least.
Visit: I am Reyson, of the heron clan. I've been sent by [F] to wish you well.
Level: The spirit of order invigorates me. I can fight awhile longer.
Perhaps there is some strength in me after all.
The spirit of chaos suffocates me...
Summon: I am Reyson, of Serenes Forest. The heron clan does not easily trust, I warn you. I will be watching closely.
Learn Skill: I do feel a little more robust, now, I must say.
Confession:
I am grateful to you for saving my life, [S]. To fall to the spirit of chaos was...shameful for me.
It is frustrating to feel as if I offer only feelings in battle. I envy Tibarn's powerful body and strong wings.
If I'd had his strength, I may have been able to save myself from capture, my home from the torch.
Thinking of my people's fate cleaves my heart in two. I feel as if I failed them, and I cannot forgive myself.
What I can do is focus on my talents. I know that I possess a rare gift, and I do not mean to waste it.
So as thanks for saving me, and as a sign of my trust and friendship... I will sing for you.
Status: I wanted to make sure you were all right.
I'll accompany you.
We herons are optimistic by nature.
It's hard for me to be on a battlefield, where the air is thick with negative energy.
Do not worry. I can fight. I told you not to treat me specially.
I wanted so much to be like Tibarn. Big body, strong wings...
No matter what comes, I will protect you. I hope you'll let me fight beside you to the bitter end.

leanne.name: Leanne
leanne.title: Forest's Song
leanne.description: Princess of Serenes. Reyson's younger sister. She speaks the ancient tongue and has not yet mastered the language of Tellius. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Nice to meet you!
Worried... About Brother, Naesala, Elincia-queen...
You...can win! I hope.
Um... Hello!
My words...ancient language. Words of Serenes.
Visit: Umm... From [F].
Level: This is good! All of us...happy.
Now...I can...I can help more.
What? No!
Summon: I am Leanne. Can we...be friends?
Learn Skill: I can...do more! Much more!
Confession:
Hello, [S]... Are you...sad?
You want to...protect us.
Your feelings...I know.
Like Elincia-queen, Naesala...
Me too! We all...do our best fighting. Together.
Here—my hand. To sky, so far away... We promise.
Status: Not hurt... No?
Good luck!
Your...words. Strange...for me.
I...I do...best fighting!
I like Elincia-queen.
Forest's...voice. I hear it.
Staying forever. OK? Forever.

nailah.name: Nailah
nailah.title: Unflinching Eye
nailah.description: Queen of Hatari, a desert nation spoken of mostly in legend. Her eye patch conceals an evil eye. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Not long ago, I met the first foreigner my people had seen in 800 years. Now, it seems I'm the traveler.
There is a kind of peace in the cruelty of the desert. When basic survival is a struggle, conflicts are set aside.
Lonely, are you? Well, don't look to me for comfort. Hah! You should see your face. Have I offended you?
I am still learning to tell which fruits here are poisonous. Would you mind giving me some advice?
I yearn for the warm desert wind. The air here is cold and clammy by comparison.
Visit: I am Nailah, a visitor from your friend [F]. You have nothing to fear from me.
Level: Let all who fall under my gaze be paralyzed by fear!
Even the most vicious predator must put away the fangs now and then.
A moment of weakness, but my foes will learn I've strength to spare.
Summon: I am Nailah, Queen of the desert nation of Hatari. Yes, I am missing an eye. Gawk and you'll lose yours.
Learn Skill: A new technique? Good. Stand back and watch how I use it.
Confession:
Something is troubling you—I can tell by your face. I will lend you an ear. Go on, speak.
I see. You lack the strength to take the field yourself, and you fret for the ones you send to battle in your stead.
Listen, [S]. Everyone has a purpose. Take heart knowing you have found yours.
My companion is the same. He too lacks the strength for battle, but his beauty and kindness bring me peace.
Beorc live short lives—focus on what you can do rather than what you can't, and yours will be free of regret.
Status: I am Nailah, queen of Hatari.
It seems you're looking to lose a finger or two.
Beorc of another world, I've been itching to test your mettle.
Did I hear you mention the name Ike, the beorc hero? I have taken an interest in his swordsmanship.
Save your concern. I am well. I do thank you for the thought, however.
So many strong fighters gathered from across the realms... It seems I won't be bored here.
Listen to me. You must not die. Hang on one hour at a time--just don't let go.

naesala.name: Naesala
naesala.title: Sky's Shadow
naesala.description: King of Kilvas and leader of the raven clan. He uses his cunning as a weapon and won't shy away from dirtying his hands. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Money talks. Without it, people die. Still...try not to lose your head over it. There are more important things.
Promises are precious, but think carefully before you agree to one. It may come back to bite you.
You're a diligent one. I hope you're not so hard at work that you forget to take a break occasionally.
Flightless creatures... I never know quite what to say. Do you need a lift somewhere? No? All right, then.
What would you say this country is best known for? I'd like to bring gifts home to Nealuchi and Leanne.
Visit: I am Naesala, King of Kilvas. I was asked by [F] to bring greetings, so...here I am.
Level: I will survive, no matter what. By these black wings, I swear it.
Good enough to keep up appearances, I suppose.
Blast... How could I be so careless?
Summon: I am Naesala, King of Kilvas. I will lend you my talents...so long as I am properly compensated, of course.
Learn Skill: A generous employer, aren't you? We'll get along just fine.
Confession:
You seem to take your work quite seriously. What leverage must these people have over you, I wonder...
Oh, relax. It was only a little joke. As for my reason to fight? Simple. Kilvas desperately requires funds.
In my country, mercenary work is the best—and sometimes only—way to keep the people fed.
Selling one's services to the highest bidder may be unsavory, but worrying about your reputation is for the rich.
The people of Kilvas depend on me. That is why I fight. You'll continue to keep me well-supplied, won't you?
Special: I suppose I'll just have to kill you.
I've no more use for you.
Status: I am Naesala, king of Kilvas. But I am so much more than just the king of a poor island nation...
Hm? Whatever are you thinking? I don't come cheap, I'll have you know.
What do a few human lives matter to me? They're none of my concern.
Black wings—among humans these are considered bad omens, are they not?
For receiving my own royal assistance, let's see...double, no triple rates.
One of the good guys? Me? Your sense of humor is...well, let's just call it "unique."
Certainly, I'll assist you. But you'll owe me, of course...

sakura3.name: Sakura
sakura3.title: Hot-Spring Healer
sakura3.description: Youngest princess of Hoshido. Well versed in the healing benefits of hot springs. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Hot springs warm you up from your head to the tips of your toes. And they're good for injuries, too!
I'm pretty good at finding hot springs back in Hoshido, you know. I know quite a few hidden gems!
Soaking in a hot spring is good for both body and soul. I'm never happier than after a good soak!
If you d-don't mind the suggestion, how about everyone in the Order visits a hot spring sometime soon?
Hmm, it looks like I'm out of fresh towels... I'll need to ask Hana to bring me some.
Visit: Did you know there's a hot spring right near your castle? Oh, this is from [F].
Level: How wonderful! This is all thanks to the hot spring, I'm sure!
I think I've earned myself another dip in the hot spring after this!
Oh no, my towel got wet!
Summon:
I'm Princess Sakura of Hoshido. I had just found a hidden hot spring when I was summoned here!
Oh, b-but, I'm glad to be here... And it's good to meet you!
Learn Skill: I feel so toasty right now! I can keep going!
Confession:
Ahh... What a relaxing soak... I'm completely warm, from the inside out! I'm so glad there are hot springs here.
Relaxing in a hot spring was one of the few comforts I could enjoy while Hoshido was at war.
Through my studies as a healer, I learned they're actually very effective at treating injuries.
And I don't just mean physical injuries. A good soak can heal your soul, too.
W-well, that's how I look at it, anyway...
I always feel like I can give each day my very best as long as I know a hot spring is waiting at the end of it.
So you be sure to take some time for yourself and have a good soak, too, OK?
Status: Let's warm up!
All toasty.
I apologize for my, um...lack of p-proper battle attire...
Huh? I'm so sleepy... I think I was in the water too long.
We have many hot springs in Hoshido.
There's nothing better than soaking in a hot spring. It warms your body from head to toe!
Want to join me at the foot baths?

elise3.name: Elise
elise3.title: Bubbling Flower
elise3.description: Youngest princess of Nohr. Sometimes slips out of the castle to enjoy herself at a famous hot spring. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I wonder... If I bathe in a hot spring every day, will my skin get as smooth as Camilla's?
Back in Nohr, I'd go to a hot spring with Camilla and Effie sometimes.
You're always working so hard. A dip in a hot spring will ease your tension. Take a break!
I hope that everyone in the Order of Heroes is enjoying the hot springs. We should all go warm up together!
What are those? Eggs that have been boiled in a hot spring? Wow! Can I have one?
Visit: Hmm... This doesn't look like a hot spring. Oh, it isn't? I was searching for one, for [F]!
Level: Ooh, the hot spring made my skin nice and smooth. Gorgeous!
Oh, yes... The temperature is just right!
Huh? Uh...I'm getting drowsy.
Summon: I'm Elise, the youngest princess of the Kingdom of Nohr! I hear there's a lovely hot spring here, and I'm ready!
Learn Skill: The water feels so good... I'm warm and toasty, all the way through!
Confession:
Hey, come here! Look at this! My skin is soooo smooth!
The hot spring washed away all of my cares, and I feel...radiant!
I love hot springs. Everyone looks so happy, relaxing in the bath...
No matter what troubles they have or how exhausted they may be, they all have faces of pure bliss...
Do you get it? A hot spring smooths your skin and warms your heart all in one! We've got to go again!
Status: Let's get warmed up!
Right when I get out of the water, my skin feels so soft!
I'm gonna stay nice and warm right up till bedtime!
Huh? Oh... I, uh... I think I spent too long in the hot spring...
We have hot springs in Nohr, too. But I bet you already knew that!
Hot springs sure are amazing! I wonder if I'd grow into a beautiful lady if I took a dip in one every day...
C'mon, c'mon! Let's go to the hot spring!

hinoka3.name: Hinoka
hinoka3.title: Relaxed Warrior
hinoka3.description: Eldest princess of Hoshido. She seeks respite from the travails of battle in hot springs from time to time, but she rarely finds it. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Time to get dressed... W-wait a minute! Where's Setsuna? Ah. I guess she's not here.
In Hoshido, it's a custom to go to the hot springs in winter. They're just the thing to warm up when it's cold out.
Even if it feels good, don't spend too much time soaking in the hot water. You'll get light-headed.
Sure, you're welcome to join me at the hot spring.
Lately, it's been battle after battle... We've earned this, and we need it, too. Taking care of yourself is vital.
Visit: Somehow I wandered all the way here, looking for my clothes... Back to [F]'s castle!
Level: I feel as light as a feather! Must be that rejuvenating water.
I'm feeling good... Just a little bit of a soak, and I'll be ready to go!
There's no way I can give it my all dressed only in a towel!
Summon: Who's there? I'm bathing in here! Don't you have any manners?
Learn Skill: What a feeling! That hot spring... Wow!
Confession:
What wonderful water! I was able to fully relax and recover from all those battles I've been fighting...
It's a little strange to be fighting in a towel, but it's perfect for cooling off. Let's leave it at that.
I got a little nervous when I ran into that Nohrian princess... But nobody wanted to ruin the mood.
In this world, we are allies, after all. We were able to soak side by side without quarrel.
Just thinking about it makes me want to take another quick dip... Next time, I'll invite Sakura and Setsuna!
Status: We heading out? Give me a minute to change. Oh, wait... I don't have anything to change into.
Don't even think about sneaking up on me right now.
There's nothing more refreshing than a cool breeze after a dip in a hot spring.
Finding time to relax is important. Especially when you're at war.
I wasn't asleep! I'm always alert!
The second I slip into a hot spring, every muscle in my body relaxes...
Whoever took my towel is going to pay!
Map Select: Time to work up a sweat.

ryoma4.name: Ryoma
ryoma4.title: Samurai at Ease
ryoma4.description: High Prince of Hoshido. A font of knowledge about remote and hidden hot springs. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Make the water as hot as it can get, I say! Battling the heat is a test of fortitude. It is to truly bathe.

In Hoshido, it is quite popular to bathe in a spring in winter.
Stepping into the bath as snow falls down around you...there are no words to describe that feeling.
Bathing in this spring won't just heal injuries from battle—it will soothe the fatigue of the day. Join me!
Too hot for you, eh? There are other springs that are a little bit cooler. You ought to find one of those.
When I'm soaking in the bath, I may look relaxed, but I keep my blade in reach. If foes attack, I will be ready.
Visit: Please forgive the intrusion. I thought you might like to know of a new hot spring [F] found.
Level: The power of fresh, hot water!
Energy is roiling within me, like the flow of a great spring!
The water's a bit tepid today, eh?
Summon: I am Ryoma, High Prince of Hoshido. I have heard talk of a secluded spring nearby. Would you show me the way?
Learn Skill: Heat drives fatigue away. That's what makes a dip in a spring great.
Confession:
A warrior must never neglect training and always strive for a clear and focused mind.
Tension is the enemy of strength. It could cost you dearly, all in a single moment.
Training is not just about learning to wield your weapon. It is also about preparing yourself for battle.
If you are not ready for the fight when it comes to you, that is your own failure.
In my training, the hot spring is an essential tool. It is the support I lean on as I look toward my next fight.
I will show you my appreciation for revealing this secluded spring to me when next we fight together.
Status: No matter the circumstances, a samurai must be ready for battle.
Huh? Is it that rare for you to see a man enjoying his bath so thoroughly?
Ah! Stepping out of the bath, the wind hitting my skin... It's so bracing!
I would very much like to bathe in the springs of Askr.
Even without my armor or headgear, I will give my utmost in battle.
Well... If you'll excuse me, I think it's high time for a bath.
The camaraderie we warriors enjoy during a good soak... There is nothing quite like it!

camilla6.name: Camilla
camilla6.title: Steamy Secrets
camilla6.description: Eldest princess of Nohr. Loves to soak in a hot spring as she believes it enhances her charm. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Bathing together in the nude gets people to open up... It's just one benefit of visiting a hot spring.
I've always loved hot springs. Bathing between battles is a habit of mine!
If you let the chill seep in, you won't be as effective on the battlefield. You should hop into a spring—right away!
I think my attire has you flustered! You're so cute when you're embarrassed.
My skin is so smooth...probably because of the hot spring. Come and look! I won't bite.
Visit: You should come and visit [F]'s castle. There's a great hot spring there!
Level: The water's just perfect...and so's my skin now.
I'm just getting warmed up!
I'm feeling a bit...woozy. I think I soaked for a little too long...
Summon: Ready for a dip in a hot spring? Come with me! Don't be shy!
Learn Skill: I'm bursting with health! I can feel it...
Confession:
That bath was so rejuvenating... I feel completely refreshed, body and soul.
Just as you'd care for your weapons, you need to make sure to care for your body, too.
Do you know who I met in the bath? A Hoshidan princess! She was shocked to see me there.
What an adorable little voice she had! You know, next time I'll invite Corrin and Elise along.
I get the feeling you're hoping for an invitation, too. I'll think about it! Hee-hee.
Status: Join me for a dip in the hot spring?
Don't be in such a rush. Take a moment to relax and enjoy yourself.
This hot spring has me all heated up...
Nothing beats a cold drink after a hot dip.
Ohh, is it the hot water that's making you blush?
Ahhh... Hot springs feel so...wonderful...
Be a dear and...pass me a fresh towel?

duma.name: Duma
duma.title: God of Strength
duma.description: God of Strength and brother of the goddess Mila. He and Mila fought over the continent of Valentia and split it in twain. Rigel, the north of Valentia, is his domain. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Mankind must become strong. My sister does not seem to understand this. It is regrettable.

In Rigel, the land I rule, the people must become strong and self-reliant thanks to the harsh climate.
That is how mankind should be.

You find yourself in another world, yet you temper your spirit on the battlefield here.
You are a true warrior in my eyes.
You are said to be only a summoner, but I find your demeanor familiar. Would you cross swords with me?
The people of Rigel... If only they could be diligent in my absence, all would be well. It vexes me.
Visit: I come to you from my place at [F]'s side. I grant you my protection.
Level: Only power holds meaning. This is a true blessing.
With this strength, I will strike down the wicked and guide the people.
Justice without strength means nothing.
Summon: I am Duma. Strength is my domain. I created the Rigelian Empire.
Learn Skill: This world holds new power, even for me. Well done, Summoner.
Confession:
I have come to know you in the time since you called me here, Summoner.
You are a strong one. But your strength is not the strength I hope to see in mankind.
At times, you do approach my ideal... But your kindness is more like my sister Mila's.
Seeing you makes me ponder what things would have been like if we had ruled the land together.
No, this is foolishness. A god like me, learning from you, who is as dirt? Pay this no heed.
Status: I am called Duma. I created the Rigelian Empire. Strength is my domain.
Hm. You are the only one who has ever touched me on a whim...
A very long time ago...Mila and I came to Valentia from the land of Archanea.
Rigel is a cold and harsh land. That is why my people grew strong.
Mila governs the corrupt land of Zofia. It is...most regrettable...
When did our paths diverge... One cannot help but wonder...
If you walk the path you believe in, Summoner, I will grant you my protection.

ike4.name: Ike
ike4.title: Stalwart Heart
ike4.description: The leader of the Greil Mercenaries. A stoic and brave warrior who treats his friends like family. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: This doesn't suit me, I know. But they worked hard on this outfit. I have to be polite about it.
As a mercenary, I've taken on a lot of jobs. None of them were as odd as this.
I got you something I thought you'd like. I mean, it would be nice if you liked it.
I don't know what to do with myself at a festival. Do you mind if I follow you? Wherever you want to go is fine.
I'd like to say thanks more often, but I'm no good with words.
Visit: Sorry to bother you during the festival. Just dropping by on behalf of [F].
Level: Seems like I'm getting through to you.
I think I've got it.
Can't blame anybody but myself.
Summon: I'm Ike from the Greil Mercenaries. I've come to offer my thanks for all the help I get.
Learn Skill: I'll put this to good use. Don't you worry about that.
