Confession:
If you want to get stronger, it helps to have something you want to protect.
Is it a place? Is it peace? Maybe you have a vision for how things should be.
That's how I kept taking steps forward. Look at me now.
All I needed to do was keep the people who meant the most to me in mind.
And in battle, I'm not on my own. I have comrades, and that's why I can fight so hard.
I'm not good with words, so I'll have to show them just how grateful I am.
Status: I'm Ike of the Greil Mercenaries. Never mind the outfit.
Something wrong with my outfit? Not like I could tell...
So I can't use my sword. Is this thing going to be good enough?
They say that only the inexperienced worry about what they wear into battle. I guess that means I'm fine with this gear.
Is it true that they always sell meat at festivals like this? Then I'm in.
Thinking about training with my father gets my blood pumping.
I want to fight for you. If that's the feeling everyone's talking about sharing...then I've got it, too.

greil.name: Greil
greil.title: Heroic Exemplar
greil.description: The first leader of the Greil Mercenaries. Father of Ike and Mist. Will meet his family again at the Day of Devotion festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: No matter the outfit, wear it with pride. If you hold your head high, unkind comments roll off your back.
Who would have guessed I'd see my family again like this? And that I'd have a festival to thank for it...
I've got all the gifts I need. Ike and Mist are all I could ask for. Nothing could compare.
It's good to see so many smiling faces. Gives you a little jolt of energy, and keeps you moving.

It may be tempting to be gentle and kind, but sometimes love means you have to be strict.
Oh, don't listen to me...
Visit: I'm here on behalf of [F]. Go help 'em out!
Level: My kids are watching. I have to give 'em a show.
Getting back into the swing of things...
Whoops. Sorry about that.
Summon: The name's Greil. I used to be a mercenary commander. I hear that Ike and Mist are here. That true?
Learn Skill: Seems like you expect a lot from me. I'd better deliver.
Confession:
As mercenaries, we fight and win. We have to stay in perfect condition, or we won't survive. That's the job.
If you do survive, all that fighting wears on you. Believe me, I know!
There's no magic medicine that'll heal that wear and tear on your heart.
Money, status, honor... They won't do the trick either.
It's people who help. My comrades, and more than that, my children... They lift my spirits.
It's thanks to them that I can see a path forward. I'm truly grateful to them, from the bottom of my heart.
Status: The name's Greil. I was the commander of a mercenary company, but... Well, I retired.
Seems I'm lost in a strange world...
Here, it's a gift. Take it. Look, I...I'm not so great at this kind of thing.
My son is a stubborn pup. But I guess I'm the one who made him that way...
I told Ike to forget about revenge, but...
I didn't want anybody dying on me. I ordered it. And then... Oh, Mist, I'm sorry.
We are family. If you don't want to cause your family any grief, then live!

soren2.name: Soren
soren2.title: Addled Strategist
soren2.description: Strategist of the Greil Mercenaries. Always considers the best tactics—even at the Day of Devotion festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: As a strategist, it's my job to rile up the troops. Making people happy? That's more difficult.
So this is what a festival is like. I never had the chance to do anything like this when I was young.
No matter the past you carry with you, you have a right to live your life.
It doesn't matter if Commander Greil happens to be alive here. Ike is the commander of the Greil Mercenaries.
I got you a gift, but whether it's the correct choice or not? I have no idea.
Visit:
I have journeyed to you to bring a Day of Devotion greeting from [F].
There you have it. I'll leave now.
Level: To express your feelings toward someone... There's something to that idea.
These clothes are more appropriate for battle than I anticipated.
I could curse my luck, but that would be a waste of breath.
Summon: I am Soren of the Greil Mercenaries. Festivals are all well and good, but I'd appreciate being given work to do.
Learn Skill: When we return to the battlefield, I'll prove your judgment here was not mistaken.
Confession:
When we first met, I had some objections to your tactical decisions.
It seemed to me you directed your troops to move in ways that they couldn't possibly comprehend.
The results proved me wrong, however. It's like you could see the battlefield from on high...
Since then, I've kept a close watch on your decisions. You've given me plenty of food for thought.
I am grateful for the chance you gave me to improve myself. Meeting you has proven valuable.
Since it's the Day of Devotion...
I felt like I should at least make the effort to express my gratitude to you. That's it.
Status: I have no problem with working. I just expect to be compensated for it.
I really don't have time for your high jinks.
This gift is from...your heart? I see.
What sorts of things do I like? Well, nothing in particular.
If it's Ike you're after, I would suggest checking the food stalls. I'd start with those that serve meat.
To be able to reacquaint with someone who has died... This truly is a strange world.
I suppose I should ask what sorts of things you like in return.

mist2.name: Mist
mist2.title: Purest Spirit
mist2.description: Ike's sister and a great help to the Greil Mercenaries. Looks forward to shopping at the Day of Devotion festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: My brother and Soren don't look like they're enjoying the festival much, do they? Cheer up, you two!
Father... I've done my best. Ike, too.
There's something so nice about giving presents to people. I wish this festival would never end...
Huh? Who do I like? I...haven't even thought about that yet!
I did my best to make sure everyone else was dressed for the festival, so Titania gifted me my dress.
Visit: Hello there! Do you like my dress? On this Day of Devotion, don't forget [F]!
Level: I see that someone understands how I feel!
I want to let everyone know my feelings.
Huh? Where is it? Where's the present? Oh no!
Summon: Did I make it to the festival? My name is Mist, and I want to let everyone know how much they mean to me.
Learn Skill: I'll treasure the kindness you've shown me.
Confession:
Love may not be something you can see, but you can feel it. That warms my heart.
And if you want to give it a shape... you can always give the ones you love presents.
Even if you're far away from someone you care about, you can show them you're thinking about them.
Friends really are nice to have, aren't they?
Because you've helped me so much, I thought I could show you how I really feel with a present.
I hope you like it—I chose it just for you. Let's never drift apart, OK?
Status: Are you feeling all right?
Are you wounded? Do you need a vulnerary?
What do I want? Oh, it's all right. You don't have to worry about me.
A mercenary group has a lot of expenses. That makes shopping for everyone pretty difficult...
Oh, this? It was a gift from Titania. It's my most treasured possession!
Father... I'll... I'll do everything I can!
I'm so glad you're here! I was just thinking about how I want to spend more time with you.

titania2.name: Titania
titania2.title: Warm Knight
titania2.description: Talented second-in-command of the Greil Mercenaries. Her heart stirs at the reunion of Ike and Greil. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: The thought that I might meet Commander Greil again... I...
Money can't buy happiness. That's something we in the Greil Mercenaries understand well.
I put a lot of thought into the present I got for you. I hope that you don't mind that I got you something.
Hmm... I feel like I just saw a very familiar face in the crowd. My mind must be playing tricks on me.
If there's someone you care about— a person you want to become stronger for—hold on to that feeling.
Visit: The festival for the Day of Devotion is such fun that I've been asked to invite you by [F].
Level: There is nothing more joyful than sharing your feelings.
Knowing how to express your feelings is as important as sharing them.
I guess I was a little too playful, even though I didn't mean to be.
Summon: I am Titania, deputy commander of the Greil Mercenaries. Tell me...is Commander Greil really here?
Learn Skill: I thank you, because I understand how you feel now.
Confession:
I was wondering if I should even go to the festival, and I ended up having so much fun I lost track of time.
Everywhere you look, you see people giving gifts and sharing their feelings. Everyone's grateful to one another.
Telling someone how you feel about them makes you feel alive...
Fate can be cruel. You may never get the chance to tell someone how you really feel about them.
If you have something you want to tell someone, don't hesitate.
This is the Day of Devotion, after all. Your feelings will blossom beautifully. I'm sure of it.
Status: For the Greil Mercenaries, there is something more precious than money.
What's this? Oh, well it would be rude of me not to return the favor, now wouldn't it?
If my companions are happy, then so am I.
Telling someone how you feel? Now that's the best gift you could give.
Being in your thoughts is enough. I don't need a gift.
Commander Greil... Is it truly possible to see him again?
What do you think? I hope you like it.

keaton.name: Keaton
keaton.title: Lupine Collector
keaton.description: Leader of the wolfskin who set up their stronghold on Mount Garou. Sociable but isn't always honest with himself or others. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
Aren't these the most beautiful spiders you've ever seen? They're black and purple and green and blue!
No? But they're so pretty... Aw, some people will just never get it.
I'm proud to be a wolfskin! Turning into wolves is what we do.
My tail looks nice and rugged when it's all messed up and filled with junk.

Let's take a look at my treasure collection! Just one of my many fine pieces is an embalmed lizard!
I also have a giant bat corpse! It's huge!

This way? No... How about that way? No...
I'm not lost! This castle is just WAY too big!
Visit: Where did I end up now? Hey, you— do you have any idea how to get back to [F]'s castle?
Level: Ha ha! Did you SEE that? That's what it looks like when I get serious!
I wanna play some more. C'mon!
I'm a little bit lost... Don't leave me behind, OK?
Summon: I'm Keaton! I'll show you how a proud wolfskin hunts!
Learn Skill: What, my tail? No, it's not wagging! It's just...twitching! I'm not excited!
Confession:
In a wolfskin pack, those who contribute can walk with pride.
So what do you say? Am I pulling my weight?
Really? That's a relief. I know I can trust you to be honest with me.
I mean...not that I was worried. I'm not happy to hear you say that. Nope.
If I stick with you, I can avoid getting lost and maybe even accomplish something!
Leave it to me! I'll hunt your enemies and collect some awesome hair balls along the way!
Status: I'm Keaton. I'm from a race called the wolfskin.
Hey! You might think I like to be petted...but I don't!
My tail is NOT wagging! It's not! Got it?!
We're gonna take a look at my treasure collection! Look, touch, sniff, and learn!
I've got a spool of spider webbing! There are even spots with flies and bugs and stuff! Sorta like raisins in a cookie.
Here—a necklace made from bat fangs! Just think of all the different animals whose blood is crusted on them!
I'm fine being on my own. But I guess if you really want me to, I'll come with you.

velouria.name: Velouria
velouria.title: Wolf Cub
velouria.description: Keaton's daughter, carrying wolfskin blood. Has a habit of collecting dust bunnies, furballs, and other random junk. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: It's not that I dislike Selkie... I'd just rather stay inside with my treasures than roughhouse.
This place is full of interesting scents...so many Heroes to smell! *sniff sniff*
I love Daddy's scent. I never get tired of smelling it... Come to think of it, you smell pretty good, too.
Want to see my treasures? I have a big pile of sawdust and some rusty armor. And—oh!—a snake skin!

There's no way it's easy to keep a castle this huge clean...
I just know there are some wonderful dust bunnies lurking here somewhere!
Visit: You have great dust bunnies here, right? That's what [F] told me.
Level: You could pat my head a little bit... I wouldn't mind.
*sniff sniff* I smell stronger!
This is boring.
Summon: I'm Velouria. Nice to meet you. If you say you need me...then I'll do my best to fight, I guess.
Learn Skill: Here, take this furball! It's my way of saying thanks!
Confession:
I really like being alone the best. Nothing bothers me, and I can do whatever I want.
Well...actually, I've changed my mind a little bit since I came here.
There are so many people here, and each has their own way of looking at things...
But they accept each other's differences.
Nobody tries to bother me if I don't want to be bothered... Nobody forces me to do anything I don't want to do.
Everyone here is so good to me... It really motivates me.
I have the feeling that if I stick with you, I'll find treasures I never could have found by myself.
Status: Hrm. Your smell... It's different than anybody else's.
I don't mind if you scratch me.
I'm bored. That doesn't mean I want you to give me work to do. It just means I'm bored.
Hmm, not an unpleasant scent. You smell nice, in fact!
This is a fluffy, delightful dust bunny, if I say so myself. There's nothing quite like the downy bliss of a dust bunny's touch...
Daddy smells good. Being without him is a punishment every bit as bad as death
That feels good. I like it when you fluff my fur.

kaden.name: Kaden
kaden.title: Kitsune Braggart
kaden.description: The chief of a hidden village of kitsune. He has absolute confidence in the beauty of his fur. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Check out my tail! What's with yours, anyway, Keaton? Shouldn't you take better care of it?
I lived in peace in the kitsune hamlet for a long time. Fighting makes me a little nervous!
You made the right call to take me shopping! No one in the whole world has an eye for aesthetics like mine!
Daily grooming is essential if you want your hair to look beautiful. Let me show you how it's done.
I'm grooming the pegasi... Their manes are so glossy and beautiful!
Visit: Hello there, [S]! I am here for [F]! Stay close, you two!
Level: Even my tail is in perfect condition! OK, go on, then. Praise me! More! More!
I must further develop my eye for aesthetics.
Huh. Maybe I've lost my claws and turned into a pet fox...
Summon: The name's Kaden. Tell me, do you know about the kitsune, the most beautiful race in the world?
Learn Skill: Talk about glossy, am I right?
Confession:
What a gorgeous and fun castle you have here, [S]!
It's full of interesting and friendly people. What fun!
I want to pay you back for summoning me to such an amazing place. I insist!
Oh, don't tell me that I don't need to. I really want to! Try and think of something you want, OK?
There must be SOMETHING you'd like me to do for you. Don't be shy! Tell me what it is.
Special: See you on the other side!
Status: I'm Kaden! As you can see, I'm from the most beautiful race in the world, the kitsune!
Tell me, am I cute? Beautiful? I want to hear you say it!
Did I already tell you that I can turn into a big, scary fox?
Anytime someone's nice to me, I have to be nice in return.
I got you a present! What do you think? Isn't it beautiful?
Man, it feels great to finally be appreciated.
I think I'll stay with you from now on. Tell me, aren't you just deliriously happy to hear that?

selkie.name: Selkie
selkie.title: Free Spirit
selkie.description: Kaden's daughter, carrying kitsune blood. Highly curious and fearless. Ready to take on any challenge. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: OK, I know. Next time, I'm going to invite Velouria out to play. It's settled!
I get my hair from my daddy. Our hair is just so silky... I'm also proud of how soft my ears are!
Let's go hunting together! Hunting can take your mind off of all kinds of unpleasant things!
I love it when somebody pats me on the head. Go on! Pat it!
Ugh! Don't offer things to me! Don't worship me! Nothing's going to happen!
Visit: Boo! Are you scared? Hee-hee! I just came here to play for a bit, from [F]'s castle.
Level: I did it! I'm not scared of ANYTHING!
On the hunt! Let's get back out there and play some more!
Oh, nuts. I didn't get much stronger, did I?
Summon: Nice to meet you. I'm Selkie! Ooh, this place looks like a lot of fun. Come on, show me around already!
Learn Skill: Thanks! I'll be sure to pay you back. Hee-hee!
Confession:
I've never felt afraid before. As soon as something crosses my mind, I go for it.
Fighting is the same way. No matter how strong a foe I'm facing, I never think twice.
That's because I have a lot of friends who back me up. I can do anything because I know they're there.
What about you? Have you ever felt afraid during a fight?
You can stop worrying. I'll be there to protect you. I won't let ANYTHING happen to you!
Status: Bored, bored, bored... I'm SO BORED. Let's have a staring contest! GO!
Ooh! Pat my head again! It makes me happy.
Tell me I'm good! Scratch my ears! *laughs* Snuggle time!
Oh, this? It was a bird, of course. I was going to see if you wanted one.
Wait, wait! Come back, little bird! It's gone. No fair, flying!
I love my daddy so much. Daddy loves me, too!
Thanks for always taking time to play with me! You're so much fun!

panne.name: Panne
panne.title: Proud Taguel
panne.description: The last of the taguel, a rabbit-like race. Calm, sensible, and self-reliant. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I once used the expression "hop to it," and everyone laughed. Do you think someone here could explain why?

Humans drove my species to the brink of extinction. Because of this, I believed none could be trusted.
But that changed when I met the exalt Emmeryn...

I hear you have no fighting prowess of your own.
If you encounter trouble on the battlefield, should I carry you to safety?

Tell me, can that divine weapon of yours summon food in the same manner it summons Heroes?
Perhaps you could try summoning me some carrots.

I've been observing the other Heroes. Races from different worlds all exist peacefully together here...
Were taguel and humans once like this as well?
Visit:
Are you [S]? Greetings from [F].
You're both of the same species, so you two should continue to remain friends.
Level: My strength is that of all taguel!
Having this much strength gives me peace of mind.
I suppose this will lead to what they call "natural selection."
Summon: My name is Panne. I'm the last of the taguel. You appear to be human... But are you one worthy of my trust?
Learn Skill: You're giving me this power? You are very kind for a human.
Confession:
Ah, I thought you might be heading this way. I've come to recognize the sound of your footsteps.
What would you like to chat about today? I could tell you about the exalt Emmeryn if you'd like.
Or perhaps the history of the taguel? Although, that is not the cheeriest of subjects to discuss.
Why not tell me about yourself? I know the sound of your footsteps, but I have not memorized your voice.
You're surprisingly quiet for a human, so I end up doing most of the talking. But in truth, I'm a better listener.
No need to look embarrassed. I'll listen to any topic you wish to speak on. It'll only help us grow closer.
Status: Did you have need of me?
I can change shape into a rabbit. That's what a taguel is.
Taguel have excellent hearing. I won't miss your orders.
You seem intent on petting me. Should I change into my rabbit form?
It seems the Order of Heroes draws many different types of people... And yet, they all work together.
I have an intense craving for carrots...
I'm glad to be of use. On my honor as a taguel, I won't disappoint on the battlefield.

roy4.name: Roy
roy4.title: Blazing Lion
roy4.description: The son of the Marquess of Pherae. After overcoming misfortunes, he quells the uprising at Bern and ends the war between humans and dragons. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall:
A battle cannot be won alone. So many people support me that I can't even count them all.
I am grateful to every single one of them. I must be.
In the past, humans and dragons fought. But I believe it's always possible to reach an understanding.
You look a bit grim, friend. We're all here for you, so don't fret!
You can use magic, can you? My teacher told me I'm not cut out for it. Even so, I'd still like to try...
Just a little sword practice. I have a lot to learn, so I feel a lot of pressure to keep at it.
Visit: My name is Roy, and I've been sent to greet you on behalf of [F].
Level: The battle continues! I must have the strength to win it.
Not bad, but I can't let myself become complacent.
No matter what befalls me, I must not be disheartened!
Summon: I am Roy, son of the Marquess of Pherae. If you need help, I'll lend you a hand. Together, we'll prevail!
Learn Skill: Thank you for that. I can feel the strength welling up within me. I will do well in my next battle.
Confession:
Because I won the war against Bern, people think of me as a great Hero. I think of it a little differently...
A truly great Hero is one who can build a world where people can live completely free of care.
A Hero is wise as well. There's so much to understand about the world, the citizens, and even the dragons.
It's so much more complex than just being good with a sword.
Coming to this world and getting to speak with so many Heroes—and also getting to know you—has inspired me.
I want to learn even more from you. We can work together to shape the world. I'm counting on you!
Status: A Hero celebrated in legends? You can't mean me.
Whuh? Sorry. I just cannot get used to that.
When war ends, that's when the real work begins.
The suffering of the people, and the lands that were devastated... I must put things right.
I bet you've saved a great number of worlds by now.
Let us bring forth a new era, together.
As long as we work together, we can save any world. That's what I think, anyway.

idunn.name: Idunn
idunn.title: Dark Priestess
idunn.description: Transformed into a Demon Dragon and sealed during the Scouring. She was awoken by Zephiel and serves him so he may realize his ambition. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I was...alone. There was nothing... Not one solitary thing...but me.
I heard His Majesty Zephiel so clearly. The world was overrun with vermin. I was to cleanse it.
Humans are never still... They hurry back and forth, back and forth...To what purpose, I never understand.
Your hand... It's so warm. Can we stay like this a little longer?
I slept so long...so very long. And as I dreamed in that limitless darkness... I saw boundless, bare white.
Visit: I am Idunn... I have become... I don't know what the word is... with [F].
Level: I am the Demon Dragon, destroyer of humans... As His Majesty desires.
The world will be freed...
Perhaps I slept too long... I stumbled.
Summon: I am Idunn... His Majesty has tasked me with bringing freedom to the world. That is my mission.
Learn Skill: What is this? What does it mean? Are you asking something of me?
Confession:
His Majesty told me that humans were a stain on the world that had to be scrubbed out...
You believe the precise opposite. Your goal is to protect the world and those in it.
I find this very confusing. What will humans do with the world? And what should I do?
Was it to help fulfill your purpose that I was pulled to this place beyond time?
Can I believe the things you tell me?
For now...I will follow where you lead and seek those answers.
Status: You called me here... Why?
...What exactly is your goal?
For age after age...I lie sleeping.
I woke up. Because it is what His Majesty desired...
I...have been ordered to lead this world.
No matter how many thousand suns pass, no matter how many thousand moons…I must.
I feel that long, long ago...I met a person much like you. Someone...warm...

lugh.name: Lugh
lugh.title: Anima Child
lugh.description: A boy from an orphanage. Raigh's twin brother. He's cheerful and tender-hearted. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall:
Chad is clever, but he doesn't like to study. Raigh is a genius, but he's impossible to get along with.
Will those two be all right without me around?

We originally lived in a small orphanage, but the war with Bern threw things into chaos.
I really hope everybody is doing all right.

I saw you talking to some pretty important-looking people just now!
Thanks for everything you do. If there's anything I can do to help out, just let me know!
I managed to get my hands on a cartload of baked goods... You want some? I'm happy to share!
Do you have a moment? I'm not quite sure I understand this part of the book I'm reading... Can you help?
Visit: Hello there, [S]! My name's Lugh. I'm glad to meet you.
Level: I see... So this is the spirit of magic.
I'm doing the best that I can!
Maybe I'm not cut out for this after all...
Summon: Hello, I'm Lugh! I may look a little inexperienced, but I'm good with magic. It's great to be here!
Learn Skill: Wow! What is this power? I can use it? Thank you!
Confession:
Hey, [S]... How am I doing in battle? Am I pulling my weight?
I don't really like all this fighting...so I got a bit concerned that I might be causing you some consternation.
Where I come from, they killed the caretaker of our orphanage, and I found myself fighting for revenge.
It was scary... But once I thought about Raigh, Chad, and the others... that gave me the courage I needed.
I want to do everything I can for you, you see. I like you a lot. You can count on me!
Special: For the people I hold dear!
Status: I'm Lugh! I'm here because I can use magic! Not a lot, but I'm learning.
Woah! Did I do something odd?
Before I knew it, everyone had vanished from the orphanage…
My dream is for all wars to end. Maybe one day everyone will live in peace together.
If I don't survive... Promise me you'll care for the children.
Raigh is rough around the edges. I worry about him...
I don't want to be protected. I just want to protect! That includes you.

sue.name: Sue
sue.title: Doe of the Plains
sue.description: Granddaughter of Dayan, the Silver Wolf, leader of the Kutolah tribe. She hears the voices of the sky and earth and lives in harmony with nature. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall:
The scent of the blowing wind and the warmth radiating from the earth...
All here is different than Sacae. Yet all is good in its own way.

I fought hard against the invasion of Bern—we all did. But we lost and were scattered...
I will never forget the sight of the blood that stained the earth.
We plains folk have good eyes. I will keep watch for you.
Be still and peaceful, like a flower rooted in the soil, and listen to the voice of the wind.
I was looking at the stars. The sky here is not that of Sacae, but still, it calms my heart.
Visit: I am Sue of the Kutolah. I carry with me a message. It is for you, from [F].
Level: I can hear them... The voices of Father Sky and Mother Earth.
I know battle.
Bitter memories...
Summon: I am Sue of the Kutolah tribe. The blood of the Hero of the Plains, Dayan, runs in my veins.
Learn Skill: More will fall to my bow now—I swear on the pride of the Kutolah. Thank you.
Confession:
The sound of the breeze, the warmth of the sun...
Not long ago, my grandfather told me something. "Discard your ill feeling. Listen to the voices."
Being beside you, I feel the world tremble. Every time that happens, I realize how small my troubles are.
It is hard not to cling to hatred... What I can do is find the courage not to let it imprison me. That is my goal.
The sounds of war the wind carries to me are fearful. I must do what I can to bring silence back quickly.
When the fighting finally reaches its end, I hope that we can ride the plains of Sacae together.
Status: I am Sue of the Kutolah, granddaughter of the Silver Wolf.
Is this how the people of your tribe greet one another?
The rustling leaves... The raging river... Listen closely, and you'll hear the earth speaking to us.
The fate of my tribe forever haunts me. I couldn't save my people.
Mother Earth and Father Sky will always protect me. They are the only ones I still trust.
The voices of the land and the air echo all around me. They are all I need. I should listen...
Never again. I won't stand to lose anyone else. My allies are all I have left.

thea.name: Thea
thea.title: Stormy Flier
thea.description: The second of three sisters who are Pegasus Knights of Ilia. She is talented and sincere, but she can be lacking in flexibility. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: My sister Shanna has so much potential. If she would just focus, I'd be a lot less worried.

Ilia is a desolate, snowbound land...
Many of us take to the mercenary trade just to survive...the men astride horses and the women, pegasi.
If you're indisposed, what will we do? Go on, take a rest. I know my way around a patrol route.
You're ordering me to go shopping? Well, if you say so. Oh, you thought it'd be a nice change of pace? Er...
I'm glad there's plenty of horse feed here. We mercenaries rely on our pegasi, so their food comes first.
Visit: You're [S]? A boon, from [F].
Level: I feel as though I could defeat any foe.
I must prepare for my next battle. I might face anything.
If I keep on like this, I'll disgrace the pegasus knights...
Summon: I am Thea, an Ilian pegasus knight. I shall place myself under your command. Orders?
Learn Skill: Ah, that's good! I'll show you the strength of Ilia's pegasus knights.
Confession:
I'd like to have a word with you, [S]!
During the last battle, you put me in the rear, on standby! Why?
It doesn't matter if the enemy wields bows. I am a soldier. Where you need me, I go.
I trust you, and I rely on your orders, so, please—trust in me as well.
No matter where the fight takes us, I will be there to intercept any attack. I hope you know you can rely on me.
Well then! That's settled. Leave it to me. I swear on Ilia and on my pride as a mercenary—you will be safe.
Status: Ilia is cold and destitute. Being a mercenary is the only way to make a living.
What did you say? This is no time for jokes!
"Never go back on a promise once made." This is the pledge of the Knights of Ilia, the mantra I abide by.
Ilia is a country of mercenaries, where the bond with a weapon is stronger than any ties to blood.
My sisters and I are all Pegasus Knights. I am the middle child, of course.
Shanna...my dear sister. May no harm fall upon you.
Regardless of what may come...I choose to believe in you.

rutger.name: Rutger
rutger.title: Lone Swordsman
rutger.description: A swordsman from Bulgar, a trading city in Sacae. He swore vengeance against Bern after they killed his people, leaving only him alive. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall:
I can't understand what she's talking about... "Friends"?
Oh... I was talking to myself.
The tribespeople were so kind. What those dogs from Bern did...
Stop wandering around. Get some rest.
My blade has one purpose: revenge. Keep your distance.
I've killed so many of them. Why doesn't my burden get lighter? What is the point of revenge?
Visit: You're [S], right? Got a message for you. Here.
Level: Yes... This might be it.
Fair.
Am I pushing too hard?
Summon: Name's Rutger. You summoned me here. What for?
Learn Skill: I cut people. That's it.
Confession:
Revenge was my purpose. I fought. I had to. But I didn't take pride in it.
The people you've gathered here... These "Heroes"... They're nothing like me.
I never had an ally—or followed orders. And visiting other realms... All of this is new to me.
Father Sky and Mother Earth are distant... Until I know my path, I'll stay with you.
I don't need revenge anymore. I can slay your foes. Where to?
Status: I'm Rutger, a swordsman from Sacae.
...You're too close. Step back if you want to live.
When my people were murdered, I learned the gravest lesson of all. The weak die. There are no exceptions.
Each swordsman cuts his own path. Mine is stained with the blood of my foes. You cannot learn anything by following this trail of blood.
I will only spar with those as skilled as him. No exceptions.
For me...there is no other way to live.
I won't accept your charity. However, if you will fight by my side, I will welcome your presence on the battlefield.

palla2.name: Palla
palla2.title: Eldest Bun-Bun
palla2.description: Elder sister of Catria and Est. Attending the Spring Festival as a bunny. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall:
Hippity-hoppity...
Er, were you watching?

Right now, I'm dressed up like my younger sister was...
I'd love to see all three of us together in rabbit costumes, if we get the chance.
I think that dressing as a rabbit would suit you. Shall I pull an outfit together for you?
These ears are fine, aren't they? Do you want to touch them?
Rabbits may be cute, but I am a pegasus knight. I won't forget my purpose—you can count on it.
Visit: Hello! I come carrying spring wishes from [F].
Level: I feel great! Setting a good example for my sisters means a lot to me.
I'll jump even higher!
Perhaps I've become timid.
Summon: I am Palla, of the Macedonian Whitewings. I am pleased to greet you dressed as a rabbit.
Learn Skill: What a cheery feeling! Spring has truly come.
Confession:
A warm breeze fills the air...the breath of spring over the hills and fields. Winter has ended.
Winter's chill snatches away warmth from the people and life and color from the land.
No matter how harsh the winter, everyone can always look forward to spring and support each other.
Spring is their reward for overcoming the winter. They can laugh, sing, dance, and celebrate as one.
So let's join them—together. Two happy spring rabbits!
Status: I am Palla of the Whitewings. I admit, I'm unaccustomed to this season's...unusual...attire.
Hmmm... These ears never stay on straight, do they?
I hear my sister Catria braved this attire as well.
This spring weather is so warm and gentle…I'm getting sleepy.
You like my spring outfit? Really? Well...thank you for saying so.
Hip-pity hop-ping into spring... Oh! Haha! Spring has put me in a silly mood, as you can see!
I find that cute bunnies can be comforting during difficult times.

marisa2.name: Marisa
marisa2.title: Crimson Rabbit
marisa2.description: Skilled mercenary called the Crimson Flash. Received an order to participate in the Spring Festival as a bunny. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I'm a rabbit. I survived the winter. Well, that's the idea.
If Gerik and his band saw me like this... No, not thinking about that.
Rabbits can sleep with their eyes open? To protect against attacks... I'll give it a try.
Rabbits die if they get lonely? Er... Well...
Rabbits wake up if they hear a tiny sound. I'm the same way.
Visit: I'm Marisa. I'm here with a spring greeting from [F].
Level: Strong, like a rabbit's kick.
Fast as a rabbit. I've been watching them.
Too slow to call myself a rabbit.
Summon: I am Marisa. Yes, that's right. I am a rabbit.
Learn Skill: I want to hop.
Confession:
As a mercenary, I get jobs done. Whatever jobs come my way. That's how I live.
If I'm told to cut down an enemy, I cut. If I'm told to protect someone, I protect them.
To me, the contract is the law.
Right now, my job is to be a rabbit. And so...I'm a rabbit.
This is the first time I've had to dress up like this for a job... I don't really get it.
But you seem to be having a good time, so that's good enough.
Status: I'm dressed as a rabbit.
*surprise noise* Rabbits...are skittish animals.
You like this outfit? I guess I'll keep wearing it.
You really like this outfit, don't you? Hope it's durable.
If this outfit isn't good for fighting, I'll have to hop away.
I've never seen a rabbit in the desert...just snakes.
You're...nice. I'll keep working hard.

bruno2.name: Bruno
bruno2.title: Masked Hare
bruno2.description: Prince of the Emblian empire, whose lineage remains something of a mystery. Dressing as a rabbit isn't clarifying things for anybody.

Castle Hall: Alfonse, Sharena... Before I faced the trial of the rabbit, you did too. And you overcame it.

Even if you are forced onto a path that takes you far from yourself...
spring will find you and awaken within your soul.
It may just be me...but I see a change in my sister's eyes.
You have no plans to dress as a rabbit? I feel the look would suit you, [S].
A rabbit astride a horse... It's a strange vision, yet one apropos of the spring festival.
Visit: Is it [S]? Good. I bring spring tidings from [F].
Level: Treat me as you'd treat a common hare, and you will find yourself in trouble.
I shall enliven the spring festival yet!
This is embarrassing, isn't it... I must persevere.
Summon: I shall stop myself before I reveal my name. Pay me no mind. I am merely attending the spring festival.
Learn Skill: A spring blessing? I thank the festival for this boon.
Confession:
Zacharias? I apologize, but that name is unfamiliar to me.
Perhaps the exuberance of spring has pushed thoughts of the past from my mind...
All that matters to me at this moment is celebrating with my dear sister.
The spring festival is a balm—a benediction for those who have triumphed over winter's cruelty.
You would do well to bathe in the warmth, too, [S].
Revel in this moment. The season only lasts so long...
Status: Not hurt, are you?
Feel spring's warmth.
To think that even I would be attired like this...
You like these clothes on me? I can't say the same.
Should I compliment Veronica? Tell me—do you think she looks good as a rabbit?
It seems that Alfonse and Sharena also dressed as rabbits...
It is a blessing of the spring season to be here with you.

veronica2.name: Veronica
veronica2.title: Spring Princess
veronica2.description: Imperial princess of the Emblian Empire. Dressed as a bunny for the festival at her brother Bruno's request.

Castle Hall: Saying "hippity-hop" makes my ears bounce. It's fun, but I don't know why.

What's hopping?
I see how you're looking at me. It's the spring festival. I have to say "hop." A lot.
My brother must be the best- looking bunny in this world.
Prince Alfonse dressed this way? Hmm...
This is a lot of fun. I wish I could spend more days like this.
Visit: The spring festival is on, and [F] is there. You should come too.
Level: Hippity-hop. I'm getting stronger.
I'll hop around the festival some more.
Not funny, bunny.
Summon: Hippity-hop. I'm Veronica. I hear there's some kind of festival here... I'll join in.
Learn Skill: I like this festival.
Confession:
Hippity-hop... A happy rabbit, enjoying the springtime...that's me.
It seems everybody is having fun here.
He's usually so serious... And he's bravely suffering... But today, they're both happy.
I think I like spring...
It's getting to me, too. I'm about to laugh—watch me. You can join in.
Status: I am a rabbit.
H-hey. You startled me.
"Hippity-hop." Loki told me that this was appropriate. Isn't it?
This festival is really jumping! Get it? Jumping?
This clothing...well, it is nothing that I am used to.
He looks dashing dressed up like that, doesn't he? My brother, I mean.
As long as the spring festival continues, I will stay here. Even if that's forever...

loki2.name: Loki
loki2.title: Spring Trickster
loki2.description: Mysterious woman who operated behind the scenes as Múspell's tactician. Appears at the Spring Festival as a bunny...yet her true objective remains unknown to all.
loki2.artist: Kusakihara Toshiyuki (草木原俊行) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: I'm an adorable little bunny now, so I'll use these big ears to listen to any request you have...just for today.
Winter has ended, dear. Forget the chill, and enjoy yourself under the warming rays of the spring sun.

Rabbits, eggs, and all the rest signify fecundity...
I'm interested in hearing your interpretation of this symbolism, darling. I'm listening.
Don't let me get lonely... I might just die. Bunnies don't do so well all on their own! Hee-hee.
I told Princess Veronica that "hippity- hop" is a spring-festival greeting. And the sweet girl believed me...
Visit: Oh, come to the spring festival, won't you? Your dear friend [F] says you will!
Level: Suddenly, I can't contain the urge to hop! Hee-hee.
Spring is so refreshing... And it's put me in a good mood.
I got caught up in the whimsy of spring, and look at me now.
Summon: I am Loki, a harmless rabbit. I wanted to go to the spring festival with you, dear. So here I am!
Learn Skill: Isn't this nice? Maybe I can do something for you next.
Confession:
Don't be shy. Come closer—take a look. I wore this outfit just for you!
You're blushing, aren't you? Perhaps it's the warmth of spring that's coloring your cheeks...
Or maybe it's something else.
Spring is a lovely season. Winter's chill has faded, and everyone feels... free.
Come on! Let yourself go, dear...
Don't worry... This is a season to live a little. An indiscretion or two will be easily forgiven.
Status: I like outfits that send people into a tizzy. *laughs*
Ah! Don't be so impatient, darling!
Well, there IS one thing bunnies are famous for. Besides eating carrots...
I wonder if I could hop, hop, hop right up into the heavens?
Make sure to take a look at Princess Veronica. She makes an ADORABLE bunny.
I wish everybunny would dress like this. Don't you?
You're trying to reform me, aren't you? Or maybe you have another motive, hmm?

yune.name: Yune
yune.title: Chaos Goddess
yune.description: A being that is half of the goddess Ashunera. The goddess of chaos, who is said to have thrown the world into disorder long ago. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Tell me...who created this world? They may be nearer than you think... Take it from me.
You don't have to be so formal just because I'm a goddess. Be natural! Talk to me however feels right.
Desire more. Demand more. It's fine to live your life with abandon.
Flawed, self-centered, driven by desire... I find myself drawn to the foibles of these creatures of flesh.
Can I really have an adventure in another world? Or am I dreaming again, inside a galdr of sealing...?
Visit: Your friend believes in you. You must believe in them, too.
Level: On my name, I swear it—the Goddess's Blessing will come to everyone.
I continue to change. This makes me happy.
Defeat and destruction are far more interesting than stasis.
Summon: I am... Freedom. Chaos. Transformation. Future. Mystery. I am Yune.
Learn Skill: My power ripples and changes... Do I have this world to thank for that?
Confession:
Here I am, far from my own world. This is not something I anticipated!
But... No, I'm not bothered... My curiosity has been ignited. I'm thoroughly enjoying myself.
This world is a crucible of chaos... Just what I like to soak in.
You hope, take, give, kill, struggle... Out of all of those needs and desires, hate and strife are born.
My other half could never countenance this. She might just destroy this beautiful mess one day...
You—you're my champion. We must continue fighting for this world!
Status: I am...freedom. Chaos. Transformation. Future. Mystery. I am Yune.
Oh! You got me! Now it's my turn!
"Dark god"? No, I'm pretty sure I'm not one of those. I am neither holy nor base, neither angel nor devil.
Ashera is neither kind nor loving to the beings of this world.
You should strive to get what you want. Challenge your fate. When all else fails, you can still die fighting.
These creatures are made of some tough meat. Do they even need to hear the divine word?
I have never been alone. There has always been someone else, singing comfort to me.

ranulf.name: Ranulf
ranulf.title: Friend of Nations
ranulf.description: A cat warrior from Gallia, the home of the beast tribe of laguz. Though young, his king trusts him deeply. Considered the right hand of the future king. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: What a sweet little vacation...this isn't going to be. We'll just have to see what happens, I suppose.
There's a beorc in my world who's a little bit...different. Nice guy. Wonder if there's anybody like that here.
Forgive me for saying this, but... Beorc sure do fret over the strangest things. Why can't they learn to relax?
Is the color of my eyes really so strange? Don't stare too long. I'll melt away...
Oh, I'm doing my part. I'm patrolling... That's it—patrolling. Gotta put these ears and nose to work, don't I?
Visit: My name is Ranulf. I'm here on behalf of [F]. Let's take a little break, hmm?
Level: My senses feel...sharper! That's the word, right? Sharper.
Oh, yeah...feeling good. Now you're going to see the fruits of my training!
Uh-oh. Little bit sloppy. Gotta get myself riled up!
Summon: I am Ranulf, a warrior of Gallia. That doesn't matter to you, though, does it? Let's just take it nice and easy.
Learn Skill: Well, then. Will this bring forth something bad, or something good? Let's see...
Confession:
You are one focused individual, aren't you? Are you on a mission of self-improvement or something?
You look a little tired, if you ask me. There's a lot of tension stored in your shoulders. Try to relax...
Look, I know how it is. All the people here expect the world from you, and you push yourself way too hard.
This is a beorc thing, I guess. But no matter how strong you are, if you exhaust yourself, that's it.
You can rely on me sometimes, you know. Just forget about today's battle and let me handle it.
That would be irresponsible? No, you're completely turned around. If you drop, what happens then?
Well, I've said my piece for today. Just give your pal Ranulf a call when you need him, OK?
Status: I'm Ranulf, right hand to Gallia's future king...basically.
What, you've never seen someone with ears like mine?
I'm not like the other laguz. I get myself mixed up in the problems of the beorc.
Oh, sorry. I'm interrupting you.
A tail is a good thing to have! Oh you poor beorc... I can't imagine living without a tail.
Sothe and Ike look so much older now. Beorc grow up so fast...
I want to see you make it to the end. Do it for me! Just kidding.

lethe.name: Lethe
lethe.title: Gallia's Valkyrie
lethe.description: A cat warrior from Gallia, the home of the beast tribe of laguz. Once had a distrust of all beorc, but that's slowly changing. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: The smell of iron and blood... The smell of war.
So many fools throw themselves at me, thinking I'm a beorc girl... Their scratches will heal.
You look tired, but you're trying to hide it, aren't you? You can't fool me. I led a unit in Gallia.
Try as hard as you like, but your tricks will be no use to you when you face the laguz.
You don't need to concern yourself with my well-being. Come find me when it's time to fight.
Visit: What do you think you're staring at? I'm here for [F].
Level: No need to brag. I'm just getting better.
Not too bad, but if I don't grab my chance, it might slip away.
I'm out of step, but keep your eye on me—I'll make up for this soon.
Summon: I'm Lethe, a warrior of the beast tribe. I will lend you my strength if you lend me yours.
Learn Skill: It seems I'm even stronger. You'll see the difference.
Confession:
Can't you take a hint? How many times do I have to tell you that friendships don't interest me?
Friends or not, I must admit these so-called Heroes are as skilled in battle as the laguz.
Somewhere along the way, I've started to see them as warriors. They have strength I can count on.
And you, in particular, seem not to hold prejudice against the laguz. That's rare for a beorc.
Hey, I'm not planning to cozy up to you. That wasn't an invitation to take my hand.
But if you want to train, well...that, I can do. What, now? All right... But no complaining about the workout!
Status: I am Lethe, warrior of the beast tribe.
Don't think I didn't see you there!
Your kind are the beorc. Mine, the laguz.
Why do you beorc hate the laguz? ...If you have an answer, I'd like to hear it.
Beorc eyes are so useless! I'm amazed the species has lived this long. Being blind in the dark is lethal.
I don't know how it happened, but I guess even I've changed my spots a little.
You're... You're doing better than I expected.

mordecai.name: Mordecai
mordecai.title: Kindhearted Tiger
mordecai.description: A tiger warrior from Gallia, the home of the beast tribe of laguz. A kind, peace-loving giant. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Can't predict what happens in a place you don't know. I better make rations for everybody.
In my country, too, there is war. So much death... I hope peace can be made in this world.
You look tired. Are you tired? Mordecai can help.
Lying in the sun is nice. Mordecai found a good place by the fountain. Let me show you. Come.
The air of the forest calms me. Take a nap with the squirrels, forget about bad things.
Visit: I thought you would need rations. I made them for you. And also, I have [F]'s greeting.
Level: Oh, yes. This strength is enough to help me protect everyone.
Mmm...stronger now. Forgive me if I close my eyes when I fight.
Hmmm... Got to try harder.
Summon: I am Mordecai, a warrior of Gallia. Do you understand? Beorc words are difficult.
Learn Skill: I don't like fighting, but since you asked, I will do what I can.
Confession:
Hello, [S].
It's rare to see you here, in the deep forest. Taking a walk?
I like this place. Air is quiet and gentle here, like where I come from. Here, I can relax.
Without words, my forest friends can understand me. Not so with beorc. So hard to share thoughts...
Sometimes, you beorc say the opposite of what you think. Understanding is so difficult for me.
When I get tired, I always come here. If you get tired, you come here, too.
Lie in the sun, get comfortable, rest... It is our secret place. Promise me, OK?
Status: I am Mordecai, warrior of Gallia. Do I speak well in this tongue?
Your way of greeting is like mine.
As a cat, I need no hard words.
Mordecai and you are the same. We will become friends.
You are a good beorc...strong and loyal. You are worth fighting for.
I have no taste for watching my enemies tear into long shreds.
Mordecai likes you as much as the sun's light.

caineghis.name: Caineghis
caineghis.title: Gallia's Lion King
caineghis.description: The lion ruler of Gallia, the home of the beast tribe of laguz. Uses his wisdom and courage to seek a path toward peace with the beorc. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall:
It has been a long time since I left my country...
And now, I take to the field of battle once again... Yes, that idea sits well with me.

Gallia has no shortage of brave warriors eager for a fight. But will they ever reach their potential?
Courage and strength alone are not enough. Knowledge is required. I can only hope they heed my words.

Exhausted already? You may be a leader, but you're still green.
Oh, don't worry. The fact that I gripe means I consider you worthy of hearing it.
You...probably shouldn't touch me. My hair is very coarse. You might get poked right back.

Do you need something? I was just taking a good, long look around.
At first glance, life here seems similar to what I know, but the differences are substantial, aren't they?
Visit: I was asked to look after you by [F]. I'll gladly lend you my strength.
Level: My strength is returning... Just like the old days, when I'd dash across the battlefield, bursting with energy.
What a fine thing, having room to grow.
Hmmm. Well, don't be concerned. When it counts, I'll demonstrate my worth.
Summon: I am Caineghis of Gallia, known as the Lion King. I will lend my strength to your ambitions.
Learn Skill: Ideals alone can't protect my citizens. With this, I can at least reduce the casualties on our side.
Confession:
This country's history is fascinating. It teaches a very different lesson than Gallia's.
Perhaps I'm showing my age by saying this, but it feels wonderful to know I still have things to learn...
Courage, of itself, is not power. Knowledge can be sharper than a sword.
As long as you live, you should continue to fight, and you should always learn.
Let us both aim to improve ourselves, [S].
If that is your goal, I will spare no effort to help you realize it. Two of the same mind, fighting with pride.
Status: I am Caineghis, King of Gallia and the beast tribe.
Your country's greetings are strange to me.
We laguz need no weapons but our bodies.
I have met a fair number of trustworthy beorc.
Like many others, my youth was hot-blooded and full of battle.
In the peaceful world I hope for, the only battles are controlled matches, with all the little rules they have.
You must survive. The beorc and the laguz rely on you.

haar.name: Haar
haar.title: Black Tempest
haar.description: A dracoknight and former Daein soldier. Naturally talented, but lazy. Often napping. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall:
*yawn*
No, I'll take a bit more sleep, thank you very much.

You wanna know what it's like where I come from, eh?
Well...all I have to say is this. Everybody's equal there, no matter their position.

Looks like you dropped your firewood...
No, no, no. Those gloves are way too stiff. Just rub some oil into 'em. That'll get 'em nice and snug.
You sure put in the hours. Ever heard of "work-life balance?" If you ever want to loosen up, I'll teach you.

My talent is sleeping. I can fall asleep anywhere—on the floor, in a tree, on my wyvern...
If you find me, please... Don't wake me up, OK?
Visit: I'm here in [F]'s place. I brought the good stuff. Wanna knock one back?
Level: This is no good. If I stand out, you're going to put me on the front lines, aren't you?
Just how I like it—somebody else will pick up the slack.
Sometimes, it's hard to stay motivated, isn't it? Can't have that...
Summon: I'm Haar. You might be surprised to hear I run cargo. If you want something, just ask my partner.
Learn Skill: *sigh* Guess I can't slack off, huh? Oh, well.
Confession:
Oh, so it's you. Here to interrupt my nap once again, are you?
Look, it's not like I dislike you. I just need my space. Dealing with people is—*yawn*—pretty tiring.
I'll get the job done, of course. But in my spare time, I like to be left to my own devices.
You remind me of somebody. You're both way too serious, and give your all to get things done...
I'm not going to babysit you, but I do have your back. I'll rest a lot easier if I know you're doing OK.
Special: This won't go well for you.
Status: *yawn* Boy, I'm bushed. Mind if I sleep? How's a nap sound?
Huh? Sorry, nodded off for a second there.
I've got a delivery to make, and this cargo's really heavy. I'm getting sick of taking orders.
You work pretty hard. I'd better cut down on the naps if I want to keep up.
I was proud to fight for my General.
Do what's best for you. Just don't trample over people you care about to do it.
Whatever happens, let's make sure we survive this, huh?
If you think some new clothes are gonna motivate me...think again.
*startled noise* I'm up, I'm up. Just resting my eyes.
Seiðjárn is fine by me, as long as the machines do the work.
The way they do things in Niðavellir is so strange to me. I just don't get what they're thinking.
I never expected to survive this long. Truthfully, I like being alive!
Queen Elincia may be too humble for her own good, but there are worse things to be.
You'd make a good boss. I'd work for you.

genny2.name: Genny
genny2.title: Dressed with Care
genny2.description: A cleric from Novis. Introverted, but enjoying her conspicuous clothing nevertheless. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Should I have brought a parasol too? Mae is always saying the sun scorches the skin...
On pretty days like this, everyone at the priory on Novis Island would head to the shore and share a meal.
You always look so busy... Why don't you relax a little bit, and spend some time with me for a change?
Save some room for dessert! I baked cookies.
How do I look? I dressed up special, just for our outing. It took a while to find the right thing to wear!
Visit: I was already out and about, so I thought I'd pay you a little visit! It's nice to meet you.
Level: That lunch was delicious! I'm full... of power!
The weather's so nice, isn't it?
Ah, I think I ate too much...
Summon: I'm Genny. Is this where we'll be picnicking? It's...beautiful!
Learn Skill: Thanks! We can go on a longer hike next time.
Confession:
Phew...I'm tired. I'm not used to talking so much, but there's just something about you...
You see, my mother abandoned me. I've always wondered why, but lately I've been thinking about letting it go.
If she hadn't abandoned me, I never would have met Celica...or you.
If I can have days like this, where the fun seems endless...I can forget my worries.
I hope we get a chance to talk again. I really like you. That's our little secret, OK?
Status: Pain, pain, go away.
Let me help you.
Look, I made a little doll as a good-luck charm. She's why it's so sunny!
I packed today's lunch, so eat up! There's plenty to go around.
Ooh, flowers! I'll make you a crown. Celica taught me how!
I wonder if my parents ever took me on picnics like this...
This food is so good... You're here... I'm so happy.

lukas2.name: Lukas
lukas2.title: Buffet for One
lukas2.description: A young noble with the Deliverance. Spends his free time in quiet solitude when he can. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I haven't been on a picnic in a while, so I'm a little uneasy... Did we forget anything?
I never had time to do anything like this before I got here... No question about it.

You may not be surprised to hear that I've never really cooked before...
I can roast wild game on a spit. It's my campfire specialty. Shall we try that?
Let's go on a boat ride in the lake. I'll row—I'm used to it.
I brought a book, and perhaps it's the scenery, but I'm finding that it's resonating rather strongly with me.
Visit: The weather's beautiful, isn't it? I'm here to invite you to a picnic with [F].
Level: I'm in uncharacteristically high spirits. Is it the weather, I wonder?
Even in the midst of all this hubbub, one must remain centered.
Having too much fun can pose a problem...
Summon: Whoa... I've arrived at an unexpected place, haven't I? My name is Lukas. Let's have a good time today.
Learn Skill: Where shall we head to next? Wherever you go, I'll stay by your side.
Confession:
I must thank you for that meal. You're quite a cook, aren't you? It was truly delicious.
When I was first summoned here, I found this place rather puzzling. It was a relief to find I liked the food.
A soldier is useless on an empty stomach, after all.
I'm grateful that we can share a delicious meal together under a beautiful blue sky.
Let's do this again sometime. I find that anything is enjoyable as long as I'm with you.
Status: You work hard each and every day. Even someone with a work ethic as tremendous as yours deserves a break now and then.
Oh! Please don't sneak up when my back is turned. I would never dream of doing such a thing to you.
I feel bad leaving all the cooking to you and the others. While it pains me to admit this, I'm not the most...domestic person.
These sweets are delightful! Did you bring them?
I never have the time to simply read a book under the shade of a tree. I should seize this opportunity.
It's been some time since I've felt so at peace. Maybe it's your calming presence that puts me at ease.
Please allow me to refill your drink. It's the least I can do.

felicia2.name: Felicia
felicia2.title: Off the Menu
felicia2.description: Hails from the Ice Tribe. Younger twin of Flora. Leaves a trail of blunders in her wake despite her best efforts to prepare beforehand. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The scenery here is breathtaking... Blue skies, beautiful flowers. It's all so peaceful. I love it!
I may be of the Ice Tribe, but I long for warm, sunny days. I just want to relax in a sunbeam with my sister!
Woah! Did you eat something that doesn't agree with you? Let's go sit in the shade.
I may not be good in the kitchen, but I pulled out all the stops to make lunch for today. Let's eat it together!

You were looking a little tired, so I made you some tea!
Uh...now you look even worse.
Visit: I've brought lunch! I made it just for you—[F] asked!
Level: No matter the dish, leave it to me! I'm a first-rate maid. It's what I do!
That lunch sure was tasty, wasn't it?
Urgh... I think that the meat was... a touch underdone...
Summon: I-I'm Felicia! Nice to meet you. I'm a properly trained maid, so leave the lunches to me!
Learn Skill: You didn't have to go to the trouble, but I'm happy that I can help out even more now!
Confession:
Where am I? I've gone and gotten myself lost again...when all I wanted was share this lunch.
Oh, [S]! Is that you?
What are you doing here? You're looking for me? That's...that's so sweet! *sniffle*
I'm so grateful to you for putting up with all of my clumsiness.
I suppose it's a little late in the day to eat now, isn't it? Don't worry—I'll make you something nice soon!
Status: I'm great at maid stuff, so leave the picnic prep to me!
Oh no! I didn't spill, did I?
Everyone says my cooking is to die for...and then they laugh...
I did my best. I hope everything turned out all right!
Whoa! Sorry. Dropped my tea tray.
♪Hm-hm-hmm... Picnic, picnic!♪
I wish we could share a nice picnic lunch like this every day...

flora2.name: Flora
flora2.title: Signature Dish
flora2.description: Hails from the Ice Tribe. Older twin of Felicia. Perfectly suited to prepare and plan any picnic. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Let's see... Lunch is taken care of. If the weather changes, I have supplies. All that's left is to confirm our route.
Sometimes we'd eat lunch in the garden at the fortress... Those were good times.
You're injured! Let me take care of that. Let me also apologize for permitting harm to befall you!
You may be surprised to hear that I am an excellent cook. I hope that you enjoy this meager meal I've made.

Now, to grate this cheese... Why is it so hard? Grate, cheese! Argh!
Oh! I was just putting the finishing touches on your meal. Please wait just a moment.
Visit: You need not explain—I've been briefed. My name is Flora. What would you like to eat?
Level: Leave everything to me.
It is my duty to protect my master.
I suppose my sister does outshine me in combat. I apologize.
Summon: I am a maid. My name is Flora. I will do my best to serve you, so please don't hesitate to give me orders.
Learn Skill: You have my deepest gratitude. I shall continue to prepare lunches that are as delicious as I can make them.
Confession:
The warmth of the sunlight...is truly a wonderful thing.
I am of the Ice Tribe, and my body is quite cold. Please, touch my cheek. Do you see what I mean?
Usually, I do very poorly in the heat... But for some reason, I feel very comfortable right now.
Perhaps it is because you are beside me.
I hope that we never part. Promise me...
Status: Please, let me handle all the picnic preparations.
Oh! I hope I didn't spill on my nice, clean outfit...
I've been told my cooking is considered to be quite delicious!
Today's lunch turned out quite well, if you ask me!
I hope that I didn't cool down your tea accidentally…
There is something delightful about a nice picnic.
Would you like me to arrange a wake-up for you? Or breakfast? Whatever you require, I can prepare it.

leo3.name: Leo
leo3.title: Extra Tomatoes
leo3.description: Younger prince of Nohr. Comes off as displeased about the unexpected picnic, but secretly having a lovely time. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Today's weather is quite lovely. I do not care for direct sunlight, but spring is...pleasant.

Nohr, where I come from, has four seasons, of course. But the climate is never quite this nice...
I just want to sit under a tree and study a tactical manual.
Are you fatigued? I have some chilled tomato juice. Let us share it in the shade of that tree.
It's about time for lunch, isn't it? I made this. Be sure to savor it.

Wait, I bid you! I must divide the food into equal portions.
There. Eat as much as you like.
Visit: I am Leo, prince of Nohr. I know you must be busy, so I've brought you some lunch.
Level: I'm in top form. It must be thanks to that delicious tomato sandwich I had for lunch.
Unsatisfactory. Perhaps the tomatoes weren't quite ripe...
I was up so late cooking that I didn't get enough sleep. That must be it...
Summon: I am Leo, prince of Nohr. Today is a rare chance to rest, so let's not get too rowdy, hmm?
Learn Skill: Tremendous. I'll use this newfound strength to pore over recipe books and uncover more delicious cuisine.
Confession:
What's your most enjoyable memory, [S]?
You might be surprised to hear that today may well be one of mine.
I've had so few chances to simply relax with my friends and family, you see...
Seeing everyone gobble up the food I made put a smile on my face.
I'd be happy to cook for you again. So please, eat as much as you like.
Status: I'm not used to this much sunlight. It's...ngh...blinding.
Why are you being so sneaky? This is a picnic!
I'm told my cooking has a certain refreshing flavor.
How does it taste? It must delicious, given I made it myself.
What about this? I had my retainers prepare it for us.
Last time I was able picnic was...too long ago.
You want...to try some of my cooking? If you insist...

alm2.name: Alm
alm2.title: Saint-King
alm2.description: The Rigelian prince who defeated Duma and became the first king of the One Kingdom of Valentia. Later generations remember him fondly as a wise ruler. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Being summoned here is a good chance for me to observe and learn. That's important for a king.

Peace has only just dawned in our kingdom, but I'll remain here and help it break in Askr as well.
There is no true peace if my world is the only one that knows it.
I have a lot of friends to support me. I hope that someday you'll think of me as such a friend, too.

Would you mind showing me the way to the library?
Learning about the history and culture of this world will surely offer valuable insight I can take back to my own.
Huh?! Oh, you startled me... I was just sneaking a snack. Oranges are pretty popular in my homeland.
Visit: It seems [F] has been worrying about you. How are you doing?
Level: This power will protect our kingdom and those we hold dear.
A fitting result for the king of the One Kingdom of Valentia.
Ugh... How disappointing...
Summon: I serve the One Kingdom of Valentia. They call me the Saint-King Alm. I vow my strength to you and yours.
Learn Skill: What a refreshing feeling. Like a new door has opened before me.
Confession:
I may be Saint-King Alm, but I have every intention of remaining true to myself. But, well...
That's easier said than done thanks to the daily tasks required of a king.
Unless there's a major battle, I have to leave the fighting to Clive, Lukas, and the knights.
I hadn't even set foot on a battlefield for some time before arriving here.
I'm glad I can use my experience and strength to help the people of Askr. Every day has been wholly fulfilling.
There aren't many people I can admit that to, so I'm thankful to have met you here in this world.
Thank you for letting me relive my life as a fighter, if even for a moment. It's been like a dream.
And even after I wake from it, I won't forget you.
Status: I'm Alm, king of the One Kingdom of Valentia.
Gah! Oh, it's just you... You startled me.
I'll carry on my father's will...and prove that I can be a great king.
We'll be together from now on, Celica. I will never leave your side.
Being a king doesn't change who I am. I want to keep fighting at everyone's side.
A world where people live and thrive based on their own efforts, not the whims of the gods...
There are so many things I can learn from you. Will you continue to guide me?

ytiki4.name: Tiki
ytiki4.title: Torpid Dragon
ytiki4.description: Princess of the Divine Dragon tribe. She was taken to the Fane of Raman and, under Gharnef's control, incinerated all those who entered. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Defilers... They must be punished...
Where are you, Ban-Ban? I'm... so frightened...
No... Stop... Come no closer...
Are you...another part of my dream?
If I keep my eyes closed like this... time will just pass me by...
Visit: Th-this is...something I must give you. It's from [F]...
Level: I can't...keep going...
You shouldn't come so close to me... Bad things happen.
No! I-I can't... I'm so scared!
Summon: I am...Tiki... The holy grounds must be cleansed of those who taint it...
Learn Skill: Defilers...must be punished...
Confession:
I'm s-so...scared... Don't leave me... Please...
...Hm? O-oh, [S]!
In my dreams...I always have the same nightmare... Everyone leaves... and I stay behind...
But you're different... You stay with me, [S]...
Please, promise you'll never leave me... I hate being alone...
Status: I am... Who... Who am I? ...Tiki?
Grr-agh, ah! N-no... Stay away from me!
Don't...come any closer... If you do, I... I don't want to hurt you!
There's...a voice in my head... It's telling me to...remember.
I will burn...everything. With all my strength!
Ban-Ban... Everyone... Where did you all go?
I had a...a terrible dream... Will you sit with me? Please?

mareeta2.name: Mareeta
mareeta2.title: The Blade's Pawn
mareeta2.description: Foster daughter of Eyvel, mistress of Fiana. As part of a wicked plot, she laid hands on a cursed sword. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Kill...kill...kill... By this sword... Kill them all.
My head... Wh-who are they...you?
Don't interrupt... Unless you have a death wish!
I need prey...FASTER! Maybe I'll start with you...
Ah, a sharpened body... Now, to draw fresh blood.
Visit: Instead of a greeting...take my blade instead, [S]...
Level: Heh heh...
Hmm... Not bad...
Gah. More waiting...
Summon: Wh-who... Where am I? Ah...no matter. With this sword... Kill... Everyone...
Learn Skill: More blood and slaughter!
Confession:
This world is good. Full of war, the scent of fresh blood on the air...
Swords are a good tool for war... They can kill hordes, shedding their blood on the field...
...No, no...NO! My...sword is not meant for that... It's for something far more important—to protect.
But I can't— My name... My loved ones... I-I can't remember! Th-there's nothing... Only...darkness!
Mother... Father... [S]...
Status: Who...am I?
Do you have a death wish?
By this blade...all will die...
Head...hurts...
Mother...Mother, I'm so sorry...
Father...please, don't leave me...
Don't leave me… I won't kill you.

berkut2.name: Berkut
berkut2.title: Purgatorial Prince
berkut2.description: Heir presumptive to the Rigelian throne. Fell into a deep despair when the truth about Alm came out. Gave his betrothed's life to Duma to obtain power. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: All this time! All the effort! What has it all been for?! Tell me, Uncle... Duma... Someone...TELL ME!
You ask me of my...home? I have nothing of the sort. Even Rigel is now forever beyond my grasp...
Ah, the summoner-savior... Tell me, do you see the strings commanding you to dance to liars' songs?
If you thirst for power, give all you are to Duma. Your love, your hate, your past—everything!
Have you seen Rinea? I'm looking for her... Rinea! Where have you gone?! Please, answer me...
Visit: So, you are [S]? You will be sacrificed to Duma, as [F] commands.
Level: Hah! Very good... This can only be a blessing from Duma!
Bow before Duma's power!
Have...even the gods forsaken me?!
Summon: Hah! I am Berkut! I shall end all things...with Duma's supreme power!
Learn Skill: Show me the enemy. I will use my new power to eradicate them!
Confession:
You, summoner...how pitiful you are. To the people of this world, you are little more than a walking sacrifice.
They praise you as a savior, but once your usefulness has run its course, they will cast you aside...
Of course, you struggle with the idea. You want to tell me how wrong I am. Your naivety is plain on your face.
You see only the surface of things. Beneath, the world is cruel—everyone hides their true intentions.
Someday, you will realize the truth as I have... When that day comes, I will relish the regret on your face... Hah!
Status: If you wish to be burned by Duma's flame, then by all means... Touch me once more.
Do you not know who I am? I am Rigel's next emperor! Hahaha!
Did you just utter the name Alm? Never speak that name again!
Valentia... This country... Everything! I'll see it all aflame!
Rinea... Where are you? Where did you go? Oh, Rinea...
I wished to become emperor... I wished to be a king for all of Valentia, and to see a smile upon Rinea's face...
Kriemhild shall claim your life one day. Heh... Are you looking forward to it?

fcorrin4.name: Corrin
fcorrin4.title: Wailing Soul
fcorrin4.description: Unfortunate soul torn between both Nohr and Hoshido, overtaken by the power lurking in her blood. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: My body...burns. My blood...is searing... How long till this power consumes me?
In my world...my siblings and friends helped me to...be myself.
Thank you for your concern, but...it's in your best interest to not get too close.
When there's a nice breeze, I can feel my blood cooling until, finally... comfort.
I pray for peace and tranquility, but... I know not what gods exist in this world...
Visit: Apparently I'm to bring you greetings. So, this is your greeting. I brought it from [F].
Level: Such searing heat... Like...a fire burning through me from the inside!
I can't take much more... The beast inside is...growing restless!
*pant* *pant* Have to...keep control...
Summon: I am...Corrin. If the power that swirls in my blood awakens, it can bring only catastrophe...
Learn Skill: I am...on the edge of...losing myself... Please... I'm so afraid...
Confession:
Somewhere deep down...I can feel a wild hunger I can't control. Each day, it grows a little stronger...
I can suppress it for now, but...the time will come when I won't be able to anymore.
If... When that happens, I...might hurt you. Or worse.
I don't want to hurt anyone I care about...ever again. I want to protect, but...this power yearns to destroy.
I beg you... If my power ever awakens to threaten you or anyone, please... stop me, [S].
Status: M-my apologies... I'm not feeling well...
Th-thank you... I feel a little calmer now...
That blood coursing through my veins... It grows restless.
Should the time arise when I lose myself completely... Promise me you'll do what you must.
Do you... Do you think your power could suppress mine?
I remember hurting Azura... I can't believe that I... I can never forgive myself.
No matter what form I should take... I will protect you.

delthea2.name: Delthea
delthea2.title: Tatarrah's Puppet
delthea2.description: A naturally gifted mage who has fallen under the control of Tatarrah, of the Duma Faithful. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: What am...I doing here? I must return to...killing the enemies of Tatarrah.
I am Tatarrah's faithful servant... All those who oppose Tatarrah...will be killed for their foolishness.
Is there anyone you want dead? Just point out a target...and I'll leave no survivors... Would you like that?
You should join me as Tatarrah's servant. Then we...could crush those Zofian fools together.
Tatarrah's orders are to protect the sluice gates that lead to Rigel...so no Zofian scum may enter...
Visit: Come with me. It's time for you to become a loyal servant of Tatarrah... By [F]'s will.
Level: You...oppose Tatarrah? You will perish under the weight of his power.
You don't understand the full truth of my power... Come along—I will make you understand.
Tatarrah... Forgive me...
Summon: Where...am I? ...Tatarrah? It's me, Delthea. Please...give me your orders.
Learn Skill: Now I'll be even more able...to visit Tatarrah's will upon Zofia...
Confession:
I remember...a small village...always fighting with someone. Who was that, I wonder...
...No matter. If they are an enemy of Tatarrah, I'll kill them just the same.
With you, it is just as it is with Tatarrah... You tell me who to kill. Your will cannot be opposed.
You pretend there is a difference, but I am your tool. I kill for you like I kill for Tatarrah.
Do not worry... With me at your side, all your enemies are as good as dead already... I'll kill them all for you.
Status: Summoner... Are you an enemy of Tatarrah? Or a friend?
What is this place? I must leave... But where must I go?
I am Tatarrah's servant. I will kill the enemies of Tatarrah.
I want to play a game. How about we see who can kill the most people in this castle? I'll start.
Hehe... You are a meddlesome one... Very similar to someone I know.
Save me, brother... I'm... I'm scared... I want to see our village again... I want to go home!
If Tatarrah so wishes, I must kill you as well. However... The command would give me pause...

fjorm3.name: Fjorm
fjorm3.title: Bride of Rime
fjorm3.description: The middle princess of Nifl. Dressed in an elegant dress with clean lines, she elevates the style of the bridal festival.

Castle Hall: This is considered a traditional wedding gown in Nifl. D-do you think the style suits me?
I seem to wear armor more often than I do dresses, so...I am a little out of my element.
I am so grateful I'm able to participate in such a lovely festival—I've already started planning your thank-you gift!
My ideal...partner? F-for marriage? I, umm... Sorry, it's kind of...personal.
I wish Mother could see me in such a lovely dress. I'm sure she'd love it.
Visit: I am Fjorm of Nifl. I've come bearing an invitation to a festival, courtesy of [F].
Level: Mother... Aren't I elegant?
I'll be careful, and put one foot in front of the other.
Wearing unusual clothes... makes me nervous.
Summon: I am Fjorm, second princess of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. W-would this suit me...if I were getting married?
Learn Skill: I owe you so much, I worry I will never repay my debt.
Confession:
I never imagined I would wear a dress like this one day. Especially at a crowded festival. It's...awkward.
When you helped me fight for Nifl, my home, there wasn't any time to reflect on what normal life is like...
But now, having dressed as a bride, I can feel the weight of the peace we seek resting on my shoulders again.
A world where we can spend our lives surrounded by loved ones... That is the life I want for everyone.
And so I'd like to renew my vow to help build a peaceful world with you, [S]—together!
Status: Eternal happiness...
Yes, dear.
There's nothing wrong with my dress, I hope?
I thank you. I will never forget our time...
I have left my kingdom behind. If I am not a princess, then I'd like to be... Oh, never mind!
If my brother and sisters could see me now, I would be very happy.
To promise myself to someone, and to raise a family... I hope that I can have that, someday.

sigrun2.name: Sigrun
sigrun2.title: Steadfast Bride
sigrun2.description: Commander of Begnion's Holy Guard. Serves and supports Empress Sanaki. She heard that Sanaki had participated previously, so she came to see the festival for herself. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: It feels a little tight up top... Are we sure the measurements are correct?
A loving heart is the same whether beorc or laguz.
