If being a bride means thinking about the one you love and hoping for their happiness, then...perhaps I'm a bride.
I will grow strong so I can protect the person I love... You know the feeling, don't you, [S]?
If I stood beside Empress Sanaki with her dressed as a bride... I think we would make a brilliant pair!
Visit: My name is Sigrun. I'm here to deliver an invitation to the festival—directly from [F]!
Level: I can abide no loveless act directed at the empress.
Love has a force all its own!
I need to get used to these clothes... No time to waste!
Summon: I am Sigrun, commander of the Holy Guard of Begnion. I had to rush to put this wedding attire on in time.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks. Your support will not go to waste.
Confession:
If you ask me, spending time with the one you love is the definition of joy.
That joy doesn't come freely—it's something you have to protect and nurture with your own two hands...
It's a vow you must make to protect what is precious to you...which is something even I can understand.
I will continue my fight—and I hope you do too, [S].
Protect and support those close to you...and stride toward your future, together.
Special: For the love of my life!
Status: I am Sigrun…and suddenly a bride, it seems!
Can you hold this for me while I fix my dress?
The apostle dressed as a bride, too. She must have been adorable!
Dressing like a bride…it's quite a change for me.
Does this...look good on me? Thank you. You're very kind to say so.
To be with the one I love… *sigh* I'm filled with joy at the mere thought of it.
I am elated to be here with you...for today, tomorrow, and beyond…

tanith2.name: Tanith
tanith2.title: Forthright Heart
tanith2.description: Deputy commander of Begnion's Holy Guard. Left with no choice, she joins the bridal festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Of all possible outfits, I somehow ended up in this... Surely there is something that would look better...
Don't expect a well-prepared meal from me! Just...don't. You'll regret it.
Wh-what's with that look?! If you have something to say, say it!
Rather than practicing walking in this outfit, I'd rather practice with a blade. One will help keep the apostle safe.
I am sorry to trouble you with this, but...I seem to have lost track of the apostle. Help me look, would you?
Visit: I am Tanith of the Begnion Holy Guard. Ignore the outfit—I was sent here by [F].
Level: Now I can more fully... express myself!
This wedding attire won't hold me back!
Tch. How disappointing!
Summon: I am Tanith, deputy commander of the Begnion Holy Guard. This outfit is due to...unforeseen circumstances.
Learn Skill: W-would you d-do me the honor of— Oh, forget that!
Confession:
My life's purpose is to protect the apostle. I don't have time to dream about the future—let alone marriage.
The apostle did, however, say I look good in this outfit... And if that's true, I'm happy.
And I will hold your compliments dear too, [S].
Victory in battle isn't everything. Sharing smiles with those you care about is important too.
I suppose this silly outfit helped me realize that... So for that, at least, I am grateful.
Status: Do not let this marital attire confuse you. I, Tanith, deputy commander of the Begnion Holy Guard, am still an officer.
The lint on my outfit is none of your concern. Focus on battle, not bridal gowns.
It seems I must conform to festival customs on my search for the apostle, so I find myself wearing this…absurd outfit.
I never thought I'd find myself dressed like this… My heart belongs only on the battlefield.
What did you say? It doesn't matter what I'm wearing. My clothes are of no concern to you.
If this is some sort of misunderstanding on my part, then… Oh, summoner. It's nothing. Carry on.
I pledge my body and soul to protect you.

pent2.name: Pent
pent2.title: Fancy Fiancé
pent2.description: Mage General, Count Reglay of Etruria. Dressed as a groom, making a pair with his wife, Louise. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Have you seen Louise in her bridal attire? She's somehow managed to shine more brilliantly than usual!
I'd rather help those in need than be lionized as a Mage General. That's my greatest wish.
You know, I have an apprentice named Erk. I wonder what he'd say if he saw Louise and me like this...
Times like these truly underscore the importance of peace.
Protecting Louise until the end... That's my mission, I feel.
Visit: I am Pent, Mage General of Etruria. I've come regarding a festival invite from [F].
Level: Louise, my power exists so I may protect you.
It seems I've hit my stride. Do these clothes...help?
I can't look Louise in the eye with results like this...
Summon: I am Pent, Mage General of Etruria. This outfit...makes me a bit anxious.
Learn Skill: I can feel my power grow. Please, accept my thanks.
Confession:
Over their years, people tend to find value in all manner of things.
Perhaps a legendary sword or tome for one—or the power of influence and position for another.
In my case, the most valuable thing I have, without question, is my wife, Louise.
I must become stronger to protect her, for she deserves only kindness and affection in her life.
If you look, I'm sure you'll find the same for yourself... Something you value above all else, I mean.
Status: Pleased to be a groom, that's me.
Oh? Are you offering your blessing? Many thanks!
Of course it's just for the festival, but dressing like this makes it feel like the real thing.
My wife is an honest and gentle person. I admire her.
Abandoning my position... Living on the run with Louise... It wouldn't be a bad life.
Well then, I mustn't leave my lovely bride waiting...
You've shown me quite the wonderful time. From the bottom of my heart, I thank you.

louise2.name: Louise
louise2.title: Eternal Devotion
louise2.description: Bride of Pent, Count Reglay of Etruria. Dressed up for the festival together with her husband. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Lord Pent cuts such a gallant figure... It still feels like a dream to have that man be my husband.
My only merit is my skill with the bow. Yet...my bow is what gives me the power to protect my Lord Pent.
To think I could slip so easily into clothing so splendid... It feels as if the entire world is sparkling bright.
I hope everyone can find themselves a wonderful partner like Lord Pent someday.
Lord Pent is quiet, thoughtful, and he cannot ignore someone in need. That is what drew me to him.
Visit: May the light bless you! I am Louise, [F]'s envoy.
Level: I vow all I am to protect Lord Pent to the end.
I must always remember to be thankful for my growth.
Oh? That's...a bit different than what I expected.
Summon: I am Louise. I have given my heart to my husband, Lord Pent, and pledged my eternal love to him alone.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I am a fortunate woman indeed.
Confession:
Thank you, [S].
Words cannot express how grateful I am that you prepared such a grand venue for our celebration.
I will remember the well-wishes Lord Pent and I received from everyone for the rest of my days.
And to keep those memories and this happiness alive, I will risk my life and limb protecting them.
Whatever it takes to create a peaceful future for all those I hold dear!
Status: I've truly been swept off my feet!
Hm? Is this your way of congratulating me? Thank you!
I know it's just for the festival, but dressing like this makes me feel like I'm walking in the clouds!
I told my sweet Lord Pent that, if he chose me, I would protect him to the end—and I will!
As long as I'm with my Lord Pent, the wheel of fate can carry us where it may.
Show the one you love your true heart...
This has all been wonderful, and it's all because of you. Thank you, truly.

naga.name: Naga
naga.title: Dragon Divinity
naga.description: Ruler of the Divine Dragons. Takes on a variety of appearances in the presence of humans, and is said to have saved the world from despair. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem and Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I am but one of many divine dragons. We will continue to exist, in one form or another...
As dragonkind approached extinction, we gave up our power for the sake of the future...and not simply our own.
The world needs a guiding hand. My role is to steady that hand.
Ritual cleansing is the best way to prepare your body for battle. Come now—I will show you how.
I may not be human, but...the machinations of the children of men still draw my interest.
Visit: The strength of your will is apparent. I see you are indeed worthy of calling [F] your friend.
Level: There exists no evil that the divine flame cannot purify...
I do not seek out violence, but... Let us say that even I cannot hold back the tide.
Do not trouble yourself with doubts. As I am now, I always have been.
Summon: I am she who is called Naga, the Divine Dragon. If you intend to face your fate, prove to me your resolve.
Learn Skill: Hm-hmm...very well, then. I shall see your desires are fulfilled.
Confession:
Come here. Gaze deep into my eyes, [S]...
Yes, I see. I, too, now understand the warmth and peace that arises when one is at your side.
It is strange for one such as I, with strength rival to none, who watches over and guides the world...
to drift into another world and find myself sharing feelings with mortals previously unknown to me.
Yet...these feelings have put down roots in my heart. And your eyes tell me you feel the same warmth.
Status: I am the Divine Dragon. So do the sons of man name me.
How strange! You are the only one whose actions I am unable to predict...
Falchion is my fang. With it, the children of man may seal dragons.
I am no god. I cannot simply grant every wish I please.
I appear before man in many forms: sometimes a great hero, sometimes a harmless child.
Children of man, take my power!
Your heart has been tested and deemed worthy.
Huh...
Clothing? Is this an offering?
Hmph! You mortals and your pranks...
My slumber was so long, and my dreams were so many, that it felt like an eternity...
If I am to give dreams, then it is my wish that they be happy ones.
Such a playful outfit... Álfar must look lovely.
So she has awoken...
May you always know peaceful slumber...

nah.name: Nah
nah.title: Little Miss
nah.description: Nowi's daughter. She might look young, but she's actually very responsible. She tries to control her emotions and act maturely. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I'm a Manakete, so I can hear Naga's voice. But...I haven't heard it at all since coming to Askr...

Both my parents died when I was young, so I was sent to live with the family of one of their soldier friends.
I didn't have anyone to talk to about how lonely I was...

Working so hard all the time must leave you feeling pretty hungry, huh? Well, go bite down on a tree root.
If you can gnaw on it with the teeth in the back, you won't feel as hungry! Pretty good tip, right?

I'm still inexperienced in the ways of Manakete. Sometimes I have trouble fighting the urge to go wild...
So if I lose control, I want you to take me out to a forest where I can't hurt anyone. All right?

Oh, hi! I was just polishing my dragonstone. It's important to be ready for anything, right?
You should polish up that divine weapon of yours, too!
Visit:
Aren't you [S]? I've come with a greeting for you from [F]!
Always value your friends, all right?
Level: Wow... I feel like I could ravage an entire army!
I'm so happy I can grow stronger!
I'm sorry. I'll do better next time, I promise.
Summon:
My name's Nah. It is an odd name, but it's the one my mother gave me.
Either way, I'll chew our enemies up and spit them back out! Oh, I should mention: I'm a Manakete.
Learn Skill: Thanks for making me stronger. I'll help you the best I can!
Confession:
Hiya! Do you need my help with something? Whatever it is, just leave it to me!
Huh? You just want to...spend time with me? But that doesn't sound helpful... I'd really rather be helpful.
You'd let me stay here if I didn't help? Really? Even if I was weak? Even if I asked for things?!
[S], that's... That's so kind of you...
I was raised by a foster family so I was always trying to prove my worth. But I guess I don't need to here...
Thank you for this. I'll stay by your side for ever and ever, [S]!
Even when I'm an old lady!
Special: You know, I could eat you!
Status: Do you think my name is weird? It's probably a little weird.
My breath attacks are amazing!
Summoners are so cool! Well, you're the first one I've ever met, but... Cool.
Hey, thanks for taking the time to say hi!
Don't worry about me. I know how to put up with a lot.
All I wanted was to see my mother and father again...
Leave the fighting to me. I can change into a dragon, you know! I'll bring peace to this world.

brady.name: Brady
brady.title: Daunting Priest
brady.description: Maribelle's son. He has a fierce countenance, but is quite kind and easily moved. He is schooled in etiquette and can play the violin. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
Whenever I see you Order of Heroes folks, I get this epic music stuck in my head. Maybe I'll write it down...
Might sound good on my violin.

I'm pretty good with a staff, but in that future, I couldn't save anyone... Not my friends, not the kids...
Not even Ma and Pop.
Hey, you hurt at all? Even a minor wound can get infected, and if you died out there... Well, I'd cry for ya.
Hey, mind if I call you Boss? I just think it's cool how you can't fight but you're still out there with all of us.

Oh, hi—yeah, I was just crocheting. Hey, what's with the look?! Listen, buddy, I may not look it...
But I could crochet circles around you! So don't mess with me, got it?
Visit: Phew. The trip here was not easy... Anyway, got a greeting for you from [F].
Level: Hah! Bring it on!
Wow, I actually kinda improved.
Guess I just ain't cut out for fighting, huh?
Summon:
Name's Brady. My ma—I mean, my mother is Maribelle. Huh? You thought I was a thief at first?
Hey, buddy, I was born lookin' like this.
Learn Skill: I guess even I can get stronger. Thanks.
Confession:
Oh, hey—good to see you aren't hurt. But you do look a bit tired... You don't have your usual go-get-'em spirit.
Luckily, I have just the cure. I scrounged up some decent tea and some pretty tasty cookies!
And if that doesn't pep you up, I'll play your favorite song on my violin! If that fails, I ain't got a clue what I'll do.
Yeah, it's true I focus mostly on healin' up cuts and scars, but healing hearts is important too, ya know?
Especially yours. This army needs you to lead it.
Nah, that ain't the only reason...
It's 'cause you've become pretty important to me. So if ya don't cheer up soon, I might just start to cry!
Ha, so hurry up and get some tea in you before it gets cold. Got it?
Status: Don't push it.
You good?
You need somethin'? Look, all I got is cookies and tea... W-want some?
Don't judge a book by its cover. People THINK I'm tough. Hmph.
Damn it... This flower... This tiny little flower...
Y'know, I coulda saved Ma and Pop. If only I'd been stronger... I coulda done it.
Your summonin' skills really are somethin'. I respect that. I'm just gonna have to work as hard as you do—so I can say that I'm worthy of bein' here, too.

yarne.name: Yarne
yarne.title: Timid Taguel
yarne.description: Panne's son. The last of the taguel. Continually terrified that his death will mark the end of his race. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
Can you summon some more taguel with that divine weapon? We could stop worrying about extinction!
What? You can't control who you summon? Well...that's too bad.

I don't want to die. I'm sure that's how everybody feels... Including the folks who died in that terrible future.
That's why I'm fighting to save them.
You always look so busy. Why don't you take a break and pet my fur? I hear that it's pretty relaxing.
I'm not big on danger, but I don't want to see you go extinct, either. On the battlefield, you stay behind me, OK?

There are so many different Heroes here... It's fascinating!
I wonder if anybody else can turn into an animal! Maybe a fox, a cat, a wolf... Even a bird!
Visit: Agh! Don't do that! You scared me. Once I greet you, I'll be on my way! Hello, [S]!
Level: The future of the taguel is lookin' bright!
Getting stronger is great, and it makes me worry a little less.
Ack! If I don't pick up the pace, I'm extinct!
Summon: I'm Yarne, Panne's son. If I die, the taguel go extinct, so...keep me somewhere safe, please!
Learn Skill: Hey! You're helping me get stronger. Take that, extinction!
Confession:
Hey, [S]...
Did you notice? I didn't jump when you spoke to me. I heard you coming.
Lately, I catch myself listening for your footsteps, wondering where you're going...
If you ended up getting attacked, summoners would go extinct! And I'd be pretty lonely.
If you're ever in danger, shout my name, or just make a loud noise. I'll hear it and come running!
Thanks to you, I've gotten plenty strong. Now I can protect you! Thanks for giving me the courage to help.
Status: I'm the last of my people.
Don't sneak up on me! If I die of shock, the taguel go exinct, OK?
Aah! Don't shout! You're stripping precious years off my life!
One... two... I'm doing the "Anti-Extinction Exercise Program." Want to join me?
There aren't many summoners, are there? OK. I'll watch out for you.
Mother and Father can't fight anymore, so I have to. I have to!
Being summoned to a new world was terrifying. But I'll work hard to live up to your expectations of a Hero. Keep your eyes on me.

kjelle.name: Kjelle
kjelle.title: Fair Fighter
kjelle.description: Sully's daughter. Won't miss a chance to train for battle. Determined to be the best soldier she can be. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
There's no shortage of sparring partners with so many strong Heroes around. But just once...
I'd like to spar with you.

I was training soldiers back in my world, but they perished when the Fell Dragon attacked.
Just like my mother and father...
You aren't a fighter? Well, I can train you if you'd like. To start... Sprint to that mountain in the distance.

Would you mind if I took a closer look at the Order of Heroes uniforms?
That lovely design on the back reminds me of a feather.
If I have free time, I have time to train. I won't let anyone else die on my watch... I must protect them.
Visit: Are you [S]? I've come with greetings. Before I go, how about a quick spar?
Level: These are the results I need to win on the battlefield.
I'll not settle for this... But it's a start.
This will not do... I need to train more.
Summon: I'm Kjelle, Sully's daughter. My mother was an incredible knight... And one day, I'll be just as strong.
Learn Skill: Through training, I hope to meet a whole new me.
Confession:
Who's there? Oh, it's you. I wasn't expecting to see you here. All done with your daily tasks?
You sure know how to keep busy. I was just training, myself. There just aren't enough hours in the day for it...
I must become stronger, both physically and mentally. That way I'll be ready to face any challenge.
I was uneasy when I first arrived here. I have unfinished business back home, you see. But...
You've been helping me become stronger. So while I'm here, your ways are my own.
Your will is more determined than that of anyone else. Only you can guide us to victory.
Status: I have no interest in weaklings.
I must become stronger. Some day, I will take back everything I lost.
You're telling me you don't spar with the Heroes you've summoned?
I don't need to get all gussied up. I'm a soldier.
Wearing a suit of armor calms me. You should try it too.
Father, Mother. If I said I missed you, would you laugh at me?
I'll show you that I can protect you. I lost someone important to me before. Never again.

cynthia.name: Cynthia
cynthia.title: Hero Chaser
cynthia.description: Sumia's daughter. Has a strong sense of justice. Enters combat with a speech on her lips, and aches to perform valorous deeds. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Askr is so pretty... Just like Ylisse during peacetime! Let's do our best to protect this kingdom. We have to!

In the future I'm from, my mother and I promised to make a lance together when she returned from battle.
But before she could fulfill that promise, she...
Whoa, whoa, whoa... You're patrolling again? You'll wear yourself out at this rate! Leave this to Cynthia the Hero!

You don't say anything special when you summon Heroes? You really need a cool catchphrase!
Something like... "Come forth, my Hero!" What do you think of that? Feel free to use it.

Let's see, what should I do for my next entrance... Showering myself in flower petals would be cool...
But explosions are pretty cool, too. Hey, maybe you could fire off your divine weapon to announce me?
Visit:
Wings of Justice soaring over the battlefield... It's Cynthia, here to deliver a message!
Friendship is the greatest source of power for those who stand against evil!
Level: Look upon my might, ye wicked, and despair!
Battlemaiden Cynthia ups her game!
Eek... Being a hero is harder than I thought.
Summon: I am Cynthia, hero of justice and daughter of legendary pegasus knight Sumia! Evil doers shall be punished!
Learn Skill: Thanks for the extra power. I'll become a great hero! Just watch!
Confession:
I've been doing some thinking, and I came up with a cool way for the Order of Heroes to take the battlefield!
OK, so, picture this... We start with me, right? High up on a mountain, showering Heroes with flower petals.
Then, boom! You enter! You pose in the center of the group and raise your divine weapon as you declare—!
Huh? You think the enemy would strike before all this played out? Well, I guess you have a point...
I wanted to come up with this idea as a way to thank you, but I guess it's no good. On to plan B!
Which is just me saying... Thank you for giving me this power, and for calling me a Hero, and for...
Well, for generally looking out for me.
I still have a long way to go, and I may be sort of clumsy, but... Someday, I will be the Wings of Justice!
And when that day comes, I just know you and I will look so cool together in battle!
Special: I am the Wings of Justice!
Status: I'm trying to come up with a cool way to make an entrance. Help me out!
No matter how fearsome the foe, Cynthia—the One-Woman Onslaught—will never shrink from the challenge!
I like it here. It's nice to be called a Hero.
The Order of Heroes is so cool, so...heroic!
Isn't this pegasus beautiful? She was my mother's. Y'know...back when... Yeah.
I'll always remember the promise my mother made. Always.
I fight to save the world—any world! My hope is to become a true hero, even if nobody notices me doing it!

laegjarn3.name: Laegjarn
laegjarn3.title: Burning Sun
laegjarn3.description: The eldest princess of Múspell, the Flame Kingdom. In her swimsuit, she braves the red-hot sun.

Castle Hall: Laevatein always looks darling no matter what outfit she wears. You'll agree, I'm sure.
In Múspell, every new day brought only more war. The idea of playing in the ocean? A ridiculous fantasy.
In Múspell, the only sea is a sea of flames. You could try swimming in it, but you'd burn to ash in an instant.
Might I bother you to apply some sunscreen to my back? There are some spots I'm unable to reach...
I can't help but feel exposed without my armor on...
Visit: I am Laegjarn of Múspell. I come bearing greetings from your friend [F]...
Level: I can't say I mind the beach in summertime in the least.
Next to the fires of Múspell, the sun here is nice and refreshing.
Perhaps this swimsuit is to blame for such poor performance...
Summon: I am Laegjarn. I wore something I thought would be fitting for the season, but...I grow tired of it.
Learn Skill: Thank you. It's like you knew exactly what I wanted.
Confession:
The beach in midsummer... It's like a dream. I find myself losing track of more time than I'd care to admit.
My duty is to fight. I mustn't lose sight of that while indulging in the pleasures of the summer season.
And yet...spending time with you here, in this weather, has been one of the highlights of my life.
Whatever destiny lies ahead, I will always have these memories to return to—even when times grow dark.
Thank you for that. I will repay you as best I can on the battlefield. You can count on it, [S].
Special: I will show you how I swim.
Status: I'd never even considered dressing like this. Do I put you in mind of Loki?
If you plan to go swimming, you should join me in some stretching exercises.
Compared to the scorching heat of Múspell, the midsummer sun is rather mild, I find. It's relaxing!
Ah, the sun is hot and yet the ocean is so cool. I feel refreshed.
I feel that I must make this clear. Don't even think about laying a hand upon my sister.
I wonder what Laevatein thinks about her swimming garb.
I trust you...to teach me how to swim.

laevatein3.name: Laevatein
laevatein3.title: Bonfire's Blaze
laevatein3.description: The second princess of Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame. She's begun to practice swimming.

Castle Hall: Laegjarn looks lovely in her swimsuit. She sparkles in the summer sun. I just want to watch her forever...
I have trained with the sword. Swimming, though... You don't need to swim on the battlefield.
I have never worn anything like this. Being so far from my sword, I feel like part of me is missing...
I saw someone buried up to their neck in the sand. I would like to try being buried, too.
I've seen others training by trying to smash watermelons... Such training is new to me. I must try it.
Visit: I am Laevatein. I'm on vacation, but... [F] says hello.
Level: Summer is...the best season.
All the sunlight blinded me a little, that's all. I'll...do better next time.
I think I swallowed some sand...
Summon: I am Laevatein. I have come to swim with my sister. But...I must improve my swimming technique a bit first.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will cherish this.
Confession:
Have you been watching me swim, [S]?
I think I've gotten much better since I first started... Thank you for teaching me.
Now, if anything happens to my sister while she's out in the waves, I'll be able to help her.
Of course...I'd swim out to rescue you, too. You taught me to swim, after all.
Why don't we all go swimming together? All three of us. We can race to that island...
Ready?
Status: I have come to swim with my sister. I am Laevatein.
Laegjarn said I should stretch? Then I will.
Summer is hot... Múspell is hotter.
I do not understand how to swim. Yet it seems simple. Do I just wave my limbs?
Listen to me now. If you touch my sister... I will cut you down.
My sister... At the beach, she looks so beautiful.
I'm swimming with Laegjarn. But you can come too...

helbindi2.name: Helbindi
helbindi2.title: Seaside Scourge
helbindi2.description: Rough and tumble general of Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame. Finds the hot beach refreshing compared to his home.

Castle Hall: Hmph! Everyone 'round here seems so damn anxious... Me? I'm great!
Lemme tell ya, back in Múspell, the idea of swimming in some ocean never even crossed my mind.
You call this heat? Pathetic. Múspell winters are hotter than this.
Back in the filth pile I'm from, all we had was a stinking swamp... This big blue ocean is somethin' else.
That Ylgr brat is at the beach too?! Come and play with me, she says... Hrmph. We'll see about that.
Visit: Name's Helbindi. I hate doing stuff like this, but I had to...this time. You can thank [F].
Level: Things are finally starting to get interesting around here! Maybe the beach ain't so bad after all!
Yeah! I'm gettin' fired up!
Huh? What the hell?! How pathetic.
Summon: I'm Helbindi. Next to the dirt hole I crawled out of, this beach is like some kind of damn paradise.
Learn Skill: Not bad! You got any more?
Confession:
When I was invited to the beach, the idea itself pissed me off.
But I gotta admit, it turns out the beach ain't half bad.
Lots of little brats running around, having fun... If Menja were here, I bet she'd be doing the same...
...Ugh, never mind... And quit looking at me like that, got it?
Anyway, I guess I'll stick with you if this is the kind of thing I'm in for. So...where ya makin' me go next?
Status: Me? Been to the ocean before? You're funny.
Who do you think you're pushing?
Look at me in this damn swimsuit! Nuts to that.
You laughin' at me? I will end you.
You call this hot? I come from Múspell.
Maybe Menja'll show up. Maybe...
Hey, you! My sister... You could maybe... Ehhh, forget it.

gunnthra3.name: Gunnthrá
gunnthra3.title: Beaming Smile
gunnthra3.description: The eldest princess of Nifl. Her gentle demeanor seems to encircle the beach itself in a loving embrace.

Castle Hall: With sunlight playing off the palms and the soothing sound of waves... This place is the stuff of dreams!
My home is a land of perpetual snow. A place like this, where summer lasts forever...it's all so new to me...
Is this appropriate beachwear? I've never had occasion to dress like this, so I just want to be sure...
The sun is shining bright today... Please be careful not to get sunburned, [S]!
Have you seen Ylgr around here? It's her first time in a summery place like this, so I want to keep an eye on her.
Visit: My name is Gunnthrá. I come bearing warm, summer tidings from our friend [F].
Level: Oh, how delightful. Like a warm summer's dream.
It seems I've grown used to the heat of the summer sun.
Perhaps I was not meant for the summer lifestyle...
Summon: I am Gunnthrá, first princess of Nifl. I am not used to hot places, but...I'm happy to spend time here with you.
Learn Skill: You should really be relaxing. To think of me...you're far too kind.
Confession:
The ocean during summer is really special, isn't it? Something about it allows one to open their heart...
Now that I'm used to the heat of the sun, it's quite pleasant... In fact, I'd go as far as to say it's delightful!
Perhaps you've noticed, but...I feel so comfortable here that standing closer to you feels...nice.
It's true that winter's cold draws people close, but summer's freeing warmth seems to do the same...
But with us speaking so closely, I'm beginning to feel a little flush... Is it time for another swim, perhaps?
Status: The heat is intense, isn't it? Be sure to take care of yourself.
What's that? Oh, you have a fan for me? How thoughtful.
My homeland is blanketed in snow...I am just not used to this heat!
Let me lay my hands on you. That should cool you down a bit.
A dip in the ocean on a summer's day is so refreshing, isn't it?
This outfit is making me feel a bit bolder than I usually am!
There's no need to let the heat get to you as long as I'm around. I can cool you down!

ylgr2.name: Ylgr
ylgr2.title: Breaking the Ice
ylgr2.description: The naive youngest princess of Nifl. Excited to go to a beach for the first time.

Castle Hall: The beach in summer is AMAZING! The sun is so bright! Hey, let's go swimming already! C'mon—hurry up!
Nifl is cold even in the summer, so if you ever wear a swimsuit, you'll freeze! Here, though, it's no problem!
What do you think of my swimsuit? Cute, right? My sister Gunnthrá gave it to me! I love it!
When I grow up, I hope I can be as stylish as Gunnthrá is...
Askr is such a nice place... But the best part is that I can be together with everyone I love!
Visit: I'm Ylgr from Nifl! I'm here with a summertime greeting from your friend [F]!
Level: The beach is so fun! What game should we play next?
I feel like I'm starting to get pretty good at swimming!
Ugh... I'm not feeling too good... Did I get too much sun?
Summon: I'm Ylgr, and I'm from Nifl. Since this is my first time at the beach, I wanna play as much as I can!
Learn Skill: Is this because we're friends? Yay!
Confession:
The beach is so fun during summer! The sun is so bright, and all the food is so yummy!
It's always so cold in Nifl, I never once thought of wearing a swimsuit! The beaches are mostly ice...
Thank you so much for showing me such a good time. I will always remember this with a smile!
Next, I want to do something for you, so I'm going to do my best to get real strong—just like you! Wait and see!
But even when I'm super strong... I still want to go to the beach with you next summer! OK? Promise?!
Status: I'm Ylgr, and I'm here to swim!
Oh! You gave me a chill! But in this weather, that's not so bad.
Aaagh! It is so hot! Please! Do something!
I miss Nifl! The ice! The snow!
Oh, you don't need to worry! My sisters always take care of me.
Wow, the ocean looks just like it did in my books! This is great!
Hey, you! I've been wondering... Where are we going next?

eliwood3.name: Eliwood
eliwood3.title: Blazing Knight
eliwood3.description: Marquess of Pherae. After overcoming the death of his father, Elbert, he foils Nergal's wicked ambitions with his comrades. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Seeing all the Heroes gathered here... I'm reminded that dragon and human are not so different.
Hector has a certain sturdiness that I envy. I want to train with him as equals, but that may not be realistic...
Are you making sure to get enough rest? Be sure to take breaks often! ...People often tell me that too.
Care to join me for some training? All right. Then hold the sword like that... And set your feet like this...
I've been preparing a special elixir... It tastes horrible, but if it means I stay healthy for Pherae, it's worth it.
Visit: I'm Eliwood, Marquess of Pherae. I've come to exchange pleasantries. Are you...[S]?
Level: I seem to be in unusually good form... All my training must be adding up!
I will remember this feeling for a long time to come.
Have I...reached my potential?
Summon: I am Eliwood. Is anything causing you trouble? I will gladly assist with any task for which you believe I'm suited.
Learn Skill: Thank you. Much appreciated. If I can live up to your expectations, I will do so happily.
Confession:
Hello, [S]...
Your coordination of the troops on the field the other day was superb. It reminded me of an old friend...
Tell me—does someone as powerful as you find me...lacking? Please, you may speak freely...
I ask only because...I am no match for Hector in strength, nor can I match you in wisdom.
The one gift I have is my unyielding resolve. I am willing to weather any storm in order to seize victory.
Even if I'm not the most impressive person here, I am proud of that gift. And proud to be at your command.
Status: I'm Eliwood—uh, come again? Legendary Hero? Did I...hear that correctly?
Yes? Oh, would you like to spar with me?
I may not have the strongest constitution, but battles are not decided by brute strength alone.
My wish is for our world to one day become a utopia, where humans and dragons can live peacefully together.
If it meant a future for our children... I would not hesitate to lay down my life.
The children of fire... The children of prophecy that will save us all...
We are what we are now because of you. Allow me to express my deepest gratitude.

lilina3.name: Lilina
lilina3.title: Beachside Bloom
lilina3.description: The only daughter of Hector, the marquess of Ostia. Excited to dive into the ocean wearing her brand-new swimsuit. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: It feels like the longer I soak up the sun, the stronger my magic gets...
I'm really enjoying this swimsuit... You don't think it's too much, do you? It's just so nice in the sun...
What do you think? Does my swimsuit look as stylish as it feels?
I've seen other Heroes wearing swimsuits around too. Were they... also summoned here like that?
Heat doesn't bother me. I mean... I DO specialize in fire magic, after all!
Visit: Do you...need a break? I was sent to invite you to a summertime beach trip with [F]!
Level: Heehee! This swimsuit must be helping me improve somehow!
The heat of the summer sun is getting me fired up!
The sun may be hot, but the ocean is still freezing...
Summon: My name's Lilina. I was just out for a swim when suddenly...I was here! I hope you were expecting me...
Learn Skill: Thank you. This will be another great summertime memory.
Confession:
The gentle sound of the crashing waves...the ruby-red sun sinking below the horizon...
My time here has filled my heart with a peaceful warmth I'll carry with me for a long time.
It makes me want to bring my friends here to visit, so I can share these feelings with them and others!
But to do that, we must focus on bringing peace to this world first and foremost.
If only we could all talk with one another on the beach, bathed in the calming glow of sunset...
I think we'd achieve peace in no time that way! In any case, I look forward to when we can all vacation again!
Status: There's no time of year quite like summer. The sun is so invigorating!
Got my swimsuit, and I'm ready for fun in the sun!
The sight of the ocean in the summertime is just so beautiful.
Is the heat getting to you? Don't move a muscle, I'll be right back with a fan!
You're right, I do have great taste!
This is my favorite swimsuit. I'd die if anything ever happened to it!
Join me for a swim? I'd love to spend more time with you!

wolt.name: Wolt
wolt.title: Sunbeam Archer
wolt.description: Knight of Pherae. His devotion to his foster sibling and lord, Roy, is apparent—even at the beach. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I'm glad I thought to bring along my bow! I gotta admit, though—I didn't expect it to be this good for fishing!
The Nabata Desert was scorching, but the heat here is totally different... There's a breeze, for one thing!
I'd love to have the honor of serving Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena one of the fish I caught...
Don't scary creatures live in the sea? I'll have to stay alert to ensure Lord Roy and his friends remain safe!
Since we came all the way to the coast, I want Lord Roy to be able to taste all the best saltwater fish!
Visit: Phew! Hot one today, isn't it? Oh! I'm here with a fish delivery from [F]. Here ya go!
Level: Just what I wanted...a huge fish! I hope Lord Roy enjoys it.
Looks like I've hit my stride, but... I'm still just getting started!
Ugh... Catching fish with a bow and arrow is a lot more work than you might think...
Summon: I'm Wolt! I serve with the Knights of Pherae. I'm hoping to help Lord Roy make some good summer memories.
Learn Skill: Wow! Thank you! I'll make sure to put this to good use.
Confession:
Phew... This is my first time ever hunting in the ocean. Who knew you could fish with a bow and arrow?!
It seems Lord Roy and Lady Lilina are enjoying the ocean... I'm sure they'll both treasure this memory.
If only we could enjoy the summer like this forever... But that's not our purpose. We've got work to do...
That's why I'm going to do my best to help end the fighting in this world as soon as possible!
I'll give everything I've got to create a world where days like these can be spent relaxing instead of fighting!
Status: This...heat! I've never been anywhere this hot before!
Even during leisure time, I must stay vigilant and keep Lord Roy safe from harm.
I'm actually a real strong swimmer. I'm used to the river currents in Pherae, you know!
*grump* I should have let Sue teach me how to ride a horse when I had the chance...
I heard sunburns can sting for days... I'd better be careful.
Look how many fish I caught with just my bow! Pretty impressive, right?
It's so nice that we get to enjoy summer here, together. Now—let's get swimming!

lyn6.name: Lyn
lyn6.title: Lady of the Beach
lyn6.description: Noblewoman of Caelin whose true name is Lyndis. Ventured to the island beaches upon receiving an invitation. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: The breeze off the sea is nice. It's nothing like the wind on the plains... but it is good in its own way.
I wonder what Eliwood and Hector would think of me wearing this... It is quite unusual—for me, I mean.
Since I've come all this way, I want to see how far out I can swim... Oh! Want to make it a competition?
I like the summer sun. Plants need its light to grow, and the clear skies make it ideal for outdoor training.
Are there any swimsuits that offer any more protection? I find this outfit lacking as far as armor goes.
Visit: I brought you a tropical souvenir from [F]. Enjoy!
Level: Training in the summer sun really does do wonders!
Have I...grown accustomed to this outfit already?
I think we both know what's holding me back... It rhymes with...slim flute.
Summon: Hi, I'm Lyn. I knew we were headed to the tropics, but no one mentioned we were leaving our armor behind!
Learn Skill: Thank you. This will help me fight through the stifling summer heat.
Confession:
The ocean seems to stretch out forever... It reminds me of the plains of Sacae...
I bathed in a lake before, back home, but I've never swum quite so much as we have here...
A-at first I was worried I would be ill-prepared for combat, wearing something like this...
But there's something about this place... The sun and the sea have relaxed my nerves, perhaps...
Better start training more, so I don't lose my edge. Oh! Let's race to that rock out there! Ready? Let's go!
Status: Isn't the ocean just beautiful? The way it stretches as far as the eye can see... It reminds me of the plains.
For the last time... Sneaking up on me could be...risky.
Well, it's easier to fight in this than it was in that wedding dress...
Keep your compliments to yourself. I'm only here to fight...and to swim.
This is nothing like the garb of my people. Learning another culture's ways often means dressing the part.
I wonder how my grandfather would take to swimming in the ocean...
Let me stay in your shadow. How does one protect against the sun dressed like this?

ursula2.name: Ursula
ursula2.title: Clear-Blue Crow
ursula2.description: An elite member of the Black Fang, known as the Blue Crow. Her motives for visiting the beach remain mysterious. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I don't usually care for bright, sunlit places, but...I suppose they're not all that bad, are they?
If Lady Sonia were here, I can only imagine what sort of incredible swimsuit she would wear... Heehee...
A chilled drink is very nice on such a hot day... Thank you for the idea.
Mind where you rest your eyes... You wouldn't want to lose them.
I prefer to avoid the sun whenever I can help it... How much sunscreen oil is too much?
Visit: I'm here to tell you about the perfect vacation spot, courtesy of your friend [F].
Level: I usually prefer to stick to the shadows, but...
Is this summer sun getting hotter still, or is it just me?
...This is why I detest the sunlight.
Summon: I am Ursula, one of the elite Four Fangs. I selected this outfit in order to lower my target's guard.
Learn Skill: I approve. With this, I'll be able to enjoy summer even more.
Confession:
Half measures are one thing that I simply cannot stand. I demand perfection in all things.
Not only do I expect perfection from others, but I seek to model it myself.
I tell you this because...I want you to know you will get only flawlessness from me. You have my word.
That is...you have my word so long as you continue to prove you are deserving, of course.
At the moment, though, I am duly satisfied with your command. Just... see that you don't disappoint me.
Status: For every mission, the perfect outfit.
If you want my loyalty, show me the extent of your perfection.
An outfit like this can be quite useful on an assassination mission… Just so you know.
Hm... Just what exactly is on your mind, I wonder...
I am not well suited to sunlight... I prefer sticking to the shadows.
Perfection must be maintained in all things. Failure cannot be tolerated...
Never show any imperfection, and I'll never take advantage of it.

fiora2.name: Fiora
fiora2.title: Defrosted Ilian
fiora2.description: A commander of the Pegasus Knights of Ilia. Led away from her snowy homeland to the islands by a mission. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: This mission is nothing like any I've been assigned before... Even so, I will do my best—in Ilia's name!
Pegasus Knights such as myself were raised among the mountains of Ilia... the exact opposite of a sunny beach.
Clothes like these might be more fitting for Farina—or even Florina...
The sound of the waves is so nice... It leaves me feeling relaxed, even after an exhausting battle.
The sea looks wonderful from above, you know... Would you like me to show you, [S]?
Visit: I come bearing summertime greetings from [F].
Level: I hope to keep riding this wave!
Seems I've grown used to this heat...
Coming from a country of snow... this heat can make life difficult.
Summon: I am Fiora, Pegasus Knight of Ilia. If my subordinates saw me like this... they wouldn't know what to think.
Learn Skill: Oh! A summertime gift? Thank you.
Confession:
My sisters and I were raised in Ilia, a country blanketed in snow. We never knew the rays of the summer sun...
Spending time on the beach has introduced me to a whole new world, exposing me to a new way of life.
As a mercenary, I feel I must learn more about what awaits me out in the wider world.
Being here has helped me understand how bright and vivid the world can be—along with the virtues of peace...
I suppose what I mean to say is... Thank you for putting me on this mission, [S]!
Status: This IS for the mission, right?
Yaah! Th-this is no time to test my reflexes!
Ilia is a snow-covered country, so I usually dress to stay warm...
I encourage you to judge me based solely on my ability.
Sometimes I wonder whether everyone building sandcastles here has their priorities aligned...
Not just anyone can command a company of mercenaries in something like this.
I've never had occasion to swim before... Any advice?

edelgard.name: Edelgard
edelgard.title: The Future
edelgard.description: Princess and heir apparent of the Adrestian Empire. Her steadfast ambition is veiled by her elegant, self-confident demeanor. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: As a princess myself, I feel sympathy for Princess Veronica. I wonder if she is acting of her own volition.
My father, the Adrestian emperor, was stripped of his power. As his successor, I will reclaim what he lost.
Having been thrust into an unfamiliar world, I find it difficult to feel at ease. Perhaps you know the feeling.
Your enemies are similar to my foes in my own world. We may both stand to learn from our time together.
Excuse me. I was taking a moment to rest. In my own world, I was so busy that I rarely had the time.
Visit: I was asked to say hello to you. Now that I have, I will take my leave.
Level: I am always getting stronger.
A step forward.
An underwhelming result... I will not let it happen again.
Summon: I am Edelgard von Hresvelg, heir apparent of the Adrestian Empire. I will follow you, but I bow to no one.
Learn Skill: Watch as I master this new power.
Confession:
You tend to look at me as though you expect me to leave at any moment. I suppose it can't be helped.
You need not worry, however. Even if I did not care about this country and its people...
For the sake of my own ambitions, I would still be sure to see this effort to its end. I promise you that.
Remember who I am. I am Edelgard von Hresvelg, and I am sworn to help you vanquish your enemies.
With my allegiance to your cause, victory is a foregone conclusion.
Status: I'm a student at the Officer's Academy. For now.
Gah! Please don't do that!
A painting? ...MY painting?! But how did you... Leave. Now. I have urgent business to attend to!
My strength is due, in part, to the power of Crests.
I value this experience. In my future, a massive battle awaits...
All obstacles will be crushed...without exception.
Please use me well. Together, we cannot lose.
Beautiful as it may be, this outfit is rather flimsy for my taste.
Do not touch me.
Do you suppose the gods dress in this way to flaunt their power over mortals?
To think I would ever don the garb of a goddess. Ironic, isn't it?
I suppose the gods' place in their respective worlds must be as varied as the worlds themselves.
I have faith only in the path I walk myself. On that point, I will never yield.
Place your trust in me, and I swear that you will never find yourself in need of a god.

dimitri.name: Dimitri
dimitri.title: The Protector
dimitri.description: Crown prince of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. Known for his chivalry, but it seems a darkness may lurk beneath the surface. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Honor gained by killing is worthless. When killers are labeled Heroes...that is the most despicable "honor" of all.
So many loved ones lost... Father. Stepmother. Friends. Allies. I alone can silence their pleas for revenge.
One rarely succeeds without help from others. If you need help, you can turn to me, or any of us.
Perhaps you can give me a tour of this land? It's so warm and bountiful, a far cry from my own homeland.
As someone who learned to fight before learning to read, I am most relaxed when training. Care to join?
Visit: My apologies for the intrusion, but [F] asked me to send their regards.
Level: Impressive as this result is, I will not allow myself to become complacent.
I will not lose anyone else. Never again...
A disappointing result, but I will persevere.
Summon: I am Dimitri Alexandre Blaiddyd, heir to the throne of Faerghus. I hereby devote myself to your cause.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks. I will prove myself worthy of your trust.
Confession:
I never expected to stand beside you for this long. In truth, I was more than willing to give my life to your cause.
I am grateful to you, [S]...
That's why I need to say this... You should stay far, far away from me.
No need to look so shocked. I did not mean right now. I know I have a duty to help you save this world.
I will protect you no matter the cost. But when the day finally comes that you no longer need Heroes...
Forget about men like me who are stained with blood. Live in happiness. That is my hope for you, dear friend.
Status: Justice is not reason enough to battle. I firmly believe that.
Please don't sneak up on me. I nearly snapped my lance in two...
Me? I’m fine. It was just a nightmare. I would rather not speak of it, but I would be grateful for your company right now.
No matter the reason, it is evil to kill. I cannot forget that so easily...
Do you recall the faces of those who have fallen? I do...
Not a soul in this world dies without knowing regret and hatred.
I have placed my life in your hands. Use it as you see fit.
These clothes are very unlike what I'm used to. Am I wearing them correctly?
Oh! Please, be more mindful, if you would?
An opponent from Jötunheimr would pose an interesting challenge. I would have to account for the difference in strength.
The princesses of Jötunheimr seem able to speak easily to any they meet. I envy them that.
I'm not particular about my clothing, so long as it does not impede combat.
I...broke another sword. I'm so sorry.
This experience has given me a fresh outlook, but my support for you is unwavering. You may rely on that.

claude.name: Claude
claude.title: The Schemer
claude.description: Heir to House Riegan, the leading house of the Leicester Alliance. Employs both an easygoing attitude and an effortless skill for scheming. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I'm not thrilled about how I got here, but seeing folks from different worlds work together like this? It's nice.
Someday I'll lead the Leicester Alliance, but my ambitions are far grander. I want to change the world.
I like you. If you want something, you don't just pray for it—you take action. We have that in common.
Everyone here takes themselves so seriously. Why don't we have a feast? That would lighten things up.
I've been mixing up a new poison. Some might call it a dirty trick, but I just like to come prepared.
Visit: I was asked to say hello by [F], so... Hello! And with that, I'll be off.
Level: Sometimes I even surprise myself.
I expected as much.
Not one of my finer moments.
Summon: I'm Claude. I'm not big on formalities, so no need to put on airs. Feel free to throw me a feast any time, though.
Learn Skill: I'll put this power to good use.
Confession:
I didn't plan on staying here this long. Time flies, I guess. Sometimes I wish I could leave, but then I think about...
You. There's something about you. You have a presence that compels people to follow you—me included.
I've never been much of a follower, but you make me so curious, I can't help but stay by your side.
I'll go back to my world someday. Before that happens, though, I want to learn more about you.
So I'm planning to stick close to you from now on. That won't be an issue, right? I'm a useful guy to have around.
Special: Don't hold this against me, OK?
Status: People say I'm not very noble. That's a compliment, right?
Don't spook me like that! I mean...it's not like I was scheming or anything.
The world would be better off without the false belief systems that we're bound to... Eh, that's what I think anyway.
It’s time to celebrate! If you even think about sleeping tonight, I’ll consider it a personal insult.
Back home, we have a tradition. Win or lose, we celebrate with a rowdy feast!
We only have this one life...and counting on the gods will just get you killed.
You and I, we're both outsiders in this world. All the more reason to stick together.
This outfit isn't so bad. But it's not like anything I've worn before.
*wince* Why are some parts of this getup so cold?!
If I could bring Seiðjárn back home with me, I'd do it in a heartbeat.
Here's a harsh truth for you: innovations often cause conflict.
I know Eitri's more mature than she looks, but I'm still a little taken aback every time I talk to her.
Technology, resources, military might, religion... That's a lot to consider.
You don't need to force it. I like you!

fbyleth.name: Byleth
fbyleth.title: Proven Professor
fbyleth.description: Child of the former captain of the Knights of Seiros, Jeralt. A stoic, capable professor at the Officers Academy. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Everyone here has a fighting spirit. In that respect, this place feels much like the Officers Academy.
When I was a mercenary, I rarely got too close to anyone. That all changed when I became a professor.
I can patrol the area if need be. I have experience from my mercenary days, and from watching over my students.
As a professor, I spend most of my time teaching others. But I believe I could learn something from you.
I sometimes feel I am grasping for a purpose in life. Perhaps someday I will know what it is.
Visit: I'm here to say hello in [F]'s stead.
Level: Such power dwells within?
Together we can grow stronger.
I'm not setting a very good example.
Summon: I'm Byleth. I used to be a mercenary, but now I'm a professor. I will help your cause however I can.
Learn Skill: A new path to tread.
Confession:
How long has it been since I was summoned to this world to fight alongside you?
The flow of time brought us together, and now we are bound inextricably. I am your ally, and you are mine.
I have not forgotten the needs of my students. But I have no regrets about my decision to join your cause.
The Sword of the Creator empowers me to sever my doubts—to carve a path through tangles of uncertainty.
With this sword in hand, I will defeat our foes and lead us to victory.
Status: Combat, strategy... I learned it all from my father.
Whether I look it or not, I'm rather surprised.
A proper overcoat offers an extra layer of protection.
My heartbeat is...not what you would expect it to be.
My mother died shortly after I was born. I can't even recall her face...
The flow of time guided me here...
I will protect all that I hold dear.
So, this is the Emblian garb. Do I have everything on right?
This outfit is very well made. You should get one for yourself.
I tried to say hello to the princess of Embla, but she wasn't interested in talking.
I'm not particular about what I wear, as long as it doesn't slow me down.
I hope Askr and Embla can develop a friendship in the same way you and I have.
Under the guidance of the goddess, our every action and interaction is imbued with meaning.
I appreciate your kindness and consideration. Thank you.

mbyleth.name: Byleth
mbyleth.title: Tested Professor
mbyleth.description: Child of the former captain of the Knights of Seiros, Jeralt. A stoic, capable professor at the Officers Academy. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Everyone here has a fighting spirit. In that respect, this place feels much like the Officers Academy.
When I was a mercenary, I rarely got too close to anyone. That all changed when I became a professor.
I can patrol the area if need be. I have experience from my mercenary days, and from watching over my students.
As a professor, I spend most of my time teaching others. But I believe I could learn something from you.
I sometimes feel I am grasping for a purpose in life. Perhaps someday I will know what it is.
Visit: I'm here to say hello in [F]'s stead.
Level: Such power dwells within?
Together we can grow stronger.
I'm not setting a very good example.
Summon: I'm Byleth. I used to be a mercenary, but now I'm a professor. I will help your cause however I can.
Learn Skill: A new path to tread.
Confession:
How long has it been since I was summoned to this world to fight alongside you?
The flow of time brought us together, and now we are bound inextricably. I am your ally, and you are mine.
I have not forgotten the needs of my students. But I have no regrets about my decision to join your cause.
The Sword of the Creator empowers me to sever my doubts—to carve a path through tangles of uncertainty.
With this sword in hand, I will defeat our foes and lead us to victory.
Status: Combat, strategy... I learned it all from my father.
Whether I look it or not, I'm rather surprised.
A proper overcoat offers an extra layer of protection.
My heartbeat is...not what you would expect it to be.
My mother died shortly after I was born. I can't even recall her face...
The flow of time guided me here...
I will protect all that I hold dear.

kronya.name: Kronya
kronya.title: Gleaming Blade
kronya.description: One of those who slither in the dark. Hateful, merciless, and diabolical. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You remind me of someone I hate. I'll probably kill you like I killed them.
There's nothing more fun than causing pain and death. The more blood I spill, the better!
You lowly creatures speak incessantly of peace, but you love slaughter as much as I do! Embrace it!
Did you say something? I wasn't paying attention. I was thinking about worms slowly eating you to death.
Heroes are such ghastly nuisances. I would love to just squash them all like the pests they are.
Visit: Your place is as clean and inviting as [F]'s. How boring.
Level: I've made such progress, even Thales will have to be impressed!
When you have power, there's only one thing to do... Use it!
No! I am not this pathetic!
Summon: My name is Kronya. I assume you summoned me to kill you? I'll be sure to make it as painful as possible!
Learn Skill: A new way to kill vermin, perhaps?
Confession:
Just the sight of your face makes me so angry! Can I kill you now, just to get it over with? Please?
Gah! Why not? It would be easy. You're such a weak creature that I'd hardly have to lift a finger.
Fighting alongside you, sharing our victories and defeats... I'm beginning to feel attached to you.
I don't know why. I'm an Agarthan, and you're just a pathetic little worm. It's unthinkable. It's repulsive!
But that's how I feel. So if you won't let me kill you, you'll have to agree to be my plaything. Forever. All right?
Status: Don't get too chummy!
Gah! Don't surprise me like that!
So much death... How exciting!
I love the sight of blood. I don't expect filthy vermin like you to understand that.
I hate the smell of lowly beasts.
I wonder if Thales is angry with me...
How much longer till I can stab someone?

sothis.name: Sothis
sothis.title: Girl on the Throne
sothis.description: Mysterious girl that sits upon a throne within dreams. Full of emotion, her attitude changes by the moment. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
sothis.artist: Maiponpon (まいぽんぽん) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: This world of yours is quite a sight. Was this one of my own creations, or... Ah. Never mind that last part.
I have already lived my fate. I may appear to stand before you now, but is it truly so?
Enough with your patrolling already! Will you not spend some time with me? I am overcome with boredom!
Prepare a bed for me, for I am tired! ...I am only joking. I can and do sleep wherever I please!
Deep in my mind, I glimpse the distant past. Once familiar faces, lost in the mist...just out of reach.
Visit: I come with regards from your friend. Your abode is much the same as theirs. How strange.
Level: The flow of time is kind to me.
I seem to be of use.
Perhaps I am not at my best.
Summon: My name is Sothis. I'm also known as...The Beginning. To summon me, you must be in desperate need.
Learn Skill: Is this the power that I lost? Or am I imagining things?
Confession:
Hello! How good it is to see you. You look surprised. Is it truly a shock that I enjoy your company?
I lost my worldly form so long ago. This shape you see before you is just a shadow, or perhaps a dream.
Yet here I spend my days conversing with friends and battling foes, just like a worldly being.
One might say you gave me new life by bringing me here. For that I feel indebted to you.
As thanks, I will gladly grant you any wish I can. Impart your desires to me...The Beginning.
Status: A dream, or not? At times it's hard to tell.
*yawn* Were you trying to surprise me? It shall take more than that!
I have been called by many names. I am...The Beginning.
This form you see... It is ephemeral. My true form is… Well, I cannot reveal it here.
I did not know that such a world as this one could exist..
*snoring* Hm?! I cannot sleep here... I'll get kicked by a horse!
You are hopeless! I have no choice. I must take you beneath my wing.

hubert.name: Hubert
hubert.title: Sinister Servant
hubert.description: The Adrestian Empire's Minister of the Imperial Household and legitimate son of Marquis Vestra. Has sworn complete fealty to Edelgard. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: A big family of Heroes, caring and watching out for one another. How nauseating.
I am Lady Edelgard's humble servant. I serve you for now, but my true loyalties lie with her. Don't forget it.
You like watching from afar as others spill blood on your behalf. You and the goddess have that in common.
Some say I'm a rat—always conniving in the shadows. Perhaps so. But I'm not the only rat around here.
I have been analyzing the enemy's weak points so we can exploit them. I will give you a report shortly.
Visit: I come bearing well wishes on your friend's behalf. Please tell your friend I have more important things to do.
Level: Any experience is worth having.
This strength will serve Lady Edelgard well!
This is harder than expected.
Summon: I am Hubert, heir to House Vestra and future minister to the emperor. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Learn Skill: Heh, this suits me well.
Confession:
You have a useful talent for expelling enemies from the world of the living. I find it charming.
Provided you held no ill will toward Lady Edelgard, I would consider inviting you to join me in the Empire.
Of course, I cannot allow a personal attachment to compromise my devotion to Lady Edelgard.
I am sworn eternally and irrevocably to her service. However...
If there existed a version of me who had never thus pledged himself, he may have offered his life to you.
Special: I have no need of you.
Status: You are doing quite well. I mean that.
Did you just attempt something? I advise against that.
Should I cut you down now? I am kidding, of course.
House Vestra operates in the shadows, not the front lines.
Until my last breath, my loyalty lies with Lady Edelgard.
Such a state of affairs would strike fear in even a god... Hm? It is nothing.
You have proven yourself worthy of leading me. Do as you will.

petra.name: Petra
petra.title: Princess of Brigid
petra.description: Granddaughter of the king of Brigid, a vassal state of the Empire. Although her speech is not perfect, she gives her all in everything she does. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I am feeling similar in both here and Fódlan. It is a place I was brought, different from my home.
Brigid is small islands with much richness and greenness. For my land of home, I would be giving the all.
Your concern for everyone has no limit. I have admiration for that. I am wishing to join you on your patrolling.
I would like to be hunting for prey, but animals here are a puzzle to me. I am needing your knowledge.
Different lands have different winds. For a bow, this has much effect. I am reading and studying of this.
Visit: I am being a messenger from your friend [F]!
Level: Hard work created this.
War feeds my body and mind.
Disappointing, but I will not misplace my heart.
Summon: Hello. I am called Petra Macneary. I am pleased to be meeting with...no, I am pleased to have met you.
Learn Skill: My understanding has completion!
Confession:
In Brigid, there is a phrase we say. "A small flame will be burning to be a large flame."
I am thinking there was a small flame between us that has grown into a bigger flame.
When I had distance from my land of home, I was lonely and cold, but now my heart is burning hot.
This is because of you. Do you have understanding? You are causing my happiness.
I have been swearing to protect my home, and now I promise the spirits, I will also be giving protection to you.
Special: I am aware of your weakness!
Status: I can be teaching you my deadly techniques.
Attack! The enemy... Oh. You are having a joke?
The Wind Spirit is calling to you... Are you hearing it?
Flame Spirit, give us protection and victory!
You are smart and good. I am wanting to be useful to you.
I will be learning and gaining strength. For Brigid!
I wish to become your strength. With my entire heart!

mercedes.name: Mercedes
mercedes.title: Kindly Devotee
mercedes.description: Adopted daughter of a merchant family in the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. Former nobility with a gentle, easygoing personality. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Goodness, I don't know that I would call myself a "Hero." But I'll try to be as heroic as I possibly can.
I was born as a noble in the Empire, but when I was young my mother and I fled to a small church in Faerghus.
Don't work too hard, all right? If you need any help, let me know. I would be more than happy to lend a hand.
When you're done with your work, why don't we have tea? I can bake some treats for us to eat!
I know that the goddess is always watching over us. That's why I make sure to pray regularly.
Visit: Hello! My, what a lovely place this is. I come bearing a message from your friend [F].
Level: You can rely on me.
I feel more...powerful!
This is not going as well as I'd hoped.
Summon: It's so nice to meet you! My name is Mercedes von Martritz, but you can just call me Mercie.
Learn Skill: A new way to make myself useful!
Confession:
How long has it been since we met? It feels like so long ago—but at the same time, I remember it vividly.
I felt nervous to be in this unfamiliar world, far away from the land I had called home.
I was trying to put on a brave face, but deep down, I was feeling uneasy. I had no idea what might happen.
Yet when I saw your face... It's hard to explain. Somehow I knew I would be safe here.
You're so unlike me. You don't wait in fear for "what might happen." You carve your own path.
You have shown me that I, too, can carve my own path. And I'll make sure my path hews close to yours.
Status: There. All better.
May the goddess protect you.
May the grace of the goddess shine upon you.
I don't hate nobles, but I haven't had very good experiences with them in the past...
I have an idea! Why don't I share one of my favorite scary stories with you soon?
Dear Goddess… Please protect us...
*laugh* It will be OK! I promise to protect you.

hilda.name: Hilda
hilda.title: Idle Maiden
hilda.description: Noble of the Leicester Alliance and daughter of House Goneril. Has a lazy personality and a habit of manipulating people into doing things for her. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I'm not sure why I'm here. This Hero stuff seems important and all, but it isn't really "me," you know?
The Officers Academy turned out to be more work than I expected. Now, at least, I can just relax...right?
You're on a patrol, huh? But you practically run the place. Why didn't you get someone else to do it?
I'm hungry. Why don't you take me out to dinner in town? The fancier, the better!
I was writing a letter to my brother. Force of habit. I have a whole stack of letters I can't even send him.
Visit: Your friend made me come all this way to say hello. So...hello, I guess. I hope that was worth it.
Level: I'm going to take a well-earned break.
Maybe hard work does pay off.
I knew it wasn't worth the effort.
Summon: Oh, me? I'm Hilda. As long as you don't saddle me with any hard work, we should get along just fine.
Learn Skill: Thanks, but...you don't expect me to actually use this, do you?
Confession:
You probably think that I'm just a run-of-the-mill slacker, don't you?
Well, you're right. But you're also wrong. See, I just don't like dealing with people's expectations.
If someone overestimates my ability and I let them down, they're just going to be disappointed in me.
That...kinda scares me, to be honest. So I avoid doing anything that might end in failure.
But when it comes to you, I have this weird, unexplainable urge to help out.
I'm going to make more of an effort around here. Just don't bury me in high expectations, OK?
Special: Gotta put in some effort now and then!
Looks like it's up to me!
Status: Do you need something?
Hey! What's the big idea?
Just don't expect too much from me, OK?
You're asking a delicate flower like me for help?
Let's chat over a nice cup of tea.
My brother must be worried sick about me...
How about I make you a nice  necklace or something? That shouldn't be too much trouble.

deathknight.name: Death Knight
deathknight.title: The Reaper
deathknight.description: The Flame Emperor's subordinate, a knight who desires only to fight the strong. Given his name due to his scythe and dark steed. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You look capable of giving me a decent challenge, and yet I cannot fight you. How maddening.
I slough off the past as a snake does his skin. I slink constantly forward, to my next prey. That is all I need.
Soldiers, like weapons, turn dull from disuse. Only by going to battle and shedding blood can one stay sharp.
Some of these so-called "Heroes" are clearly weaklings. You would do well to let me cull the herd.
My blade has been sharpened...and it craves flesh.
Visit: Your friend sent me here to impart a message. While I'm here, why don't you let me kill one of your Heroes?
Level: I live.
Who will dare face me now?
Failure is unacceptable.
Summon: I have no name. But when people whisper stories of my ghastly deeds, they call me the Death Knight.
Learn Skill: Did you expect me to be grateful?
Confession:
I have a talent for murder that demands expression. How dare you constrict me?
Know that my truest, deepest wish is to engage you in a mortal duel...and, in that duel, to die by your hand.
You are capable of ending my life, are you not?
I eagerly await that day. Meanwhile, I will sharpen my scythe and slay any weakling foolish enough to cross me.
Status: Are you prepared to battle me?
The next time you touch me, you will die.
I thirst for blood...
Nobility is worthless...
I wield a scythe forged by forbidden techniques...
I have detached from all... Even family...
Watch as their bodies fall...

alm3.name: Alm
alm3.title: Imperial Ascent
alm3.description: Son of Rudolf, the Rigelian Emperor. Dons special armor that has been passed down for generations. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: So many Heroes here, and so many wearing such...exciting outfits! Has Celica worn anything like that too?

Even if the people recognize me as the heir to the throne, it still doesn't feel real to me...
Still...I must do my best to live up to what's expected of my station.
How many missions is that today? I don't enjoy sitting still either, but even you must rest sometime.
This armor has been passed down through the generations in Rigel... It weighs...heavy on my shoulders.
Even now, I can't neglect my training. The people of Rigel would reject me if I were to grow too weak, after all...
Visit: I'm Alm. I've come to formally offer a greeting. And to admire this castle you have, [S].
Level: All right! I'm feeling nimble and ready. Let's keep this up!
If I'm to stand shoulder to shoulder with renowned heroes, I've got to grow even stronger than I am now!
I thought I felt some power well up inside me... Was it my imagination?
Summon: Was it you who called me here? If you're in a bind, I can lend a hand. I'm Alm. Happy to be of service.
Learn Skill: So this is my new ability, is it? I'll do my best to put it to good use.
Confession:
Growing up in a village, I never had to think about my country or how it fit in the world.
That's why—to tell you the truth— I can't help but wonder if I'm truly meant for something like this...
But still, I can't give up. I must forge ahead with all of my might, like when I was entrusted with the Deliverance.
Besides, I have so many friends who are working alongside me: Celica, and my comrades in the Deliverance...
And above all, the calls of those who brought me here drive me to build a world where we shape our own lives!
Status: They say this armor has been passed down in Rigel since ages long past. Does it...suit me?
GAH! Oh, it's you... Mind greeting me normally next time?
I'm told Celica wore an unusual outfit like this before. I would've liked to see that.
It wasn't so long ago that I called Sir Mycen my grandfather.
Skilled Heroes abound in this place! I mustn't fall behind!
Perhaps, one day, I'll meet Berkut in this world... And maybe Father too...
You called out, so I'm here to help. I'm grateful for your trust.
What do you think of this outfit? Does it make me look like a jötun?
Whaaa! *chuckle* Oh, it's you... I should have known. You know how to keep me on my toes, that's for sure.
Is— Is Celica— I'm sorry, I'm just so used to being with her in Valentia. I feel restless without her.
I arm-wrestled Princess Dagr! Uh...no, I didn't win, of course... But still, it felt good to try.
My grandfather used to read me books about beings like the jötnar and the dvergar... Never imagined such a world existed.
Father, I wonder if...we might understand each other better now?
I'm learning many things here, so I thank you for bringing me.

eliwood4.name: Eliwood
eliwood4.title: Marquess Pherae
eliwood4.description: The soon-to-be Marquess Pherae. Eyes burning with the fire of determination, he carries on his father's will. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Father... I will keep both Mother and Pherae safe from harm. You can rest now and be at peace...
Ceremonies mark both endings and beginnings—that gives them value, but...I prefer those with less...pomp.
Ah, I beg your pardon. I'm not quite used to this outfit, so it's difficult to move with any grace...
I must make sure my etiquette is well polished for future diplomacy. Do you think I've improved enough yet?
Nerves before a ceremony and those before battle are two different things. One more thing I must get used to...
Visit: I am Eliwood, Marquess of Pherae. I have come with greetings sent on behalf of [F].
Level: My greatest wish is to carry on my Father's will.
I will need to work harder if I'm to be worthy of donning such a splendid outfit as this.
Did I...get ahead of myself?
Summon: Are you...? No, of course not... I am Eliwood, Marquess of Pherae. I'm new to this, but I learn quickly.
Learn Skill: My thanks. Now I will perform for you in a way befitting my station!
Confession:
I've had some time to think since arriving here, and I keep coming back to this: Why me, of all people?
The answer has eluded me so far, but perhaps the gods have seen fit to grant me some sort of respite here.
I've learned much in my time here. Being surrounded by Heroes has revealed how far I have yet to go...
But the voices that called me here, those who called to me with support and praise... I owe them a debt.
Those voices filled me with a resolve I've not known previously. I have a duty to live up to their expectations.
Even so, resolve alone is not enough. So I humbly request you allow me to continue leaning on your support.
Status: Everything has finally been settled. I am to succeed my father as Marquess Pherae.
What? These clothes? I look silly, don't I...
Formal dress is so stiff, I can hardly stand it...
Thank you for your stalwart support.
Will you attend my ascension ceremony?
If it weren't for you, I wouldn't... This world wouldn't be here.
You have my heartfelt gratitude, and my support—whenever you need it. That's a promise, my friend.
I am grateful for this new attire. It hails from Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice, yes?
Whoa! Oh, haha... You haven't changed one bit.
Is the Kingdom of Ice as serene and beautiful as I imagine?
I do not have any brothers or sisters of my own, so I must admit that I am a bit envious of Nifl's royal siblings.
To my delight, I had many close friends attend my ascension ceremony.
As marquess, I shall make it my life's duty to protect Pherae's future.
You always did open your heart to me, and it is because of you that I am able to live up to my full potential.

micaiah3.name: Micaiah
micaiah3.title: Queen of Dawn
micaiah3.description: The fifteenth ruler of Daein. Determined to reconstruct and develop her home country. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I won't waver anymore... I will build an age in which everyone can live their lives in peace!
I once thought Prince Pelleas ought to be ruler... But the people put their faith in me—I must do right by them.
It's always "My Queen this" and "My Queen that." I know it's the way of things, but the formality is tiresome...
Whoops! Almost took a tumble there! I guess I'm still not used to this outfit. Thanks for having my back, as usual.
I've been getting the feeling Yune still watches from somewhere just out of sight. Always up to some mischief...
Visit: I'm visiting on behalf of your good friend, [F].
Level: We will build the future with our own hands! Yune, please watch over us!
I must fight now to forge a future age of peace!
I mustn't get discouraged! Not now, after Daein placed its trust in me!
Summon: I am Micaiah. I hope to lead Daein as best I can. Any support you can offer is appreciated.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will use this power for the benefit of all.
Confession:
My world is one of constant strife. People fought for power, influence, and even just for their daily bread...
The fact is, the weak are no match for the strong... But I couldn't stay silent and watch from a distance.
Thus, the Dawn Brigade was born... and with help from Sothe and the others, Daein has been restored.
By following my heart and giving a voice to those who had none, I was able to change Tellian history...
You and I are similar in that sense. This world needs you just as mine needed me. I can feel it.
But I wouldn't call that a prophecy... more like a belief. Nevertheless, I am happy to join you in walking this path.
Status: I am Queen Micaiah, fifteenth ruler of Daein. It is a pleasure to meet you.
