**Celica**: I am overjoyed by the good fortune of having Alm at my side every day. We were separated for so long...
**Alm**: So...what kind of present would make you smile? Wait, wait! I want to try guessing first. I bet I'll get it!
**Alm**: You look like you could use a snack. I'll happily share some of mine with you. It's cheap, but tasty!
**Celica**: We're about to enjoy a banquet, but Alm won't stop snacking... Can you help me talk some sense into him?
Visit: **Celica**: We come bearing a message of amity from [F].
Level: **Celica**: People grow stronger when they have someone to protect. This drive can bring forth untold power from within.
**Celica**: This seems about right. Our reach ought not exceed our grasp.
**Alm**: There you are! Oh, but... I forgot your gift.
Summon: **Alm**: Happy Day of Devotion! I'm Alm, and this pretty lady is Celica. We're here to enjoy the festivities together!
Learn Skill: **Alm**: You would bestow this power on us? Thank you. It makes us happier than you know.
Confession:
**Alm**: Oh, hello, [S]!
So many gifts you have there! I can barely see the top of the pile. You're one sought-after summoner, eh?
**Celica**: I trust you're prepared to carry all of those home with you. With that said, I do hope we weren't too late...
**Alm**: Don't fret, Celica. I'm sure one more wouldn't topple the pile. Isn't that right, [S]?
**Celica**: I suppose that's true. Well, then... Here, with our blessing. We worked together to pick it out, you know.
**Alm**: Oh no! Maybe one more was one too many... Don't worry, though! Once you unbury yourself, you'll love it!
Here's to many more happy days together!
Special: **Duo**: Love you, Celica! And I you, Alm!
Status: Ha ha...
• You've become pretty important to us, you know. • It's true. Thank you so much for all you do for us.
Conversation:
**Celica**: Hmm, let's see... A hairpin would suit Mae... And a book for Boey. But what about Nomah and Genny?
Ohh... Picking out Day of Devotion gifts for everyone is harder than I thought. I'm running out of time.
**Alm**: Wow, Celica, you're sending each and every one of our friends a gift? Picking them out must be tough.
**Celica**: Oh, Alm, don't tell me you're giving everyone the same gift. Really, you must put more thought into this!

**Alm**: There are some truly bountiful grazing pastures near Ram Village.
I heard the meat raised there is the most delicious around, so I ordered us up a true feast!
Everyone's getting STEAK!
**Celica**: Oh, I... I see... So we're all getting steak...

**Alm**: Not just any steak! It's grass fed! The Knights of Zofia sang its praises! Well, Clair called it a brutish gesture…
But still, everyone— Uh, Celica? Is everything all right? You look upset.
**Celica**: N-no, I'm fine. It's nothing! So, where's my bounty of... Of the finest meat this side of Ram Village?
**Alm**: Oh, uh... You wanted some too? I can't say I expected that...
**Celica**: What do you mean you didn't expect it? There's nothing for me?

**Alm**: Well, no, I mean... I, um... There's… there's no MEAT for you… Close your eyes for a moment. OK, open them...
I hope you like it. I poured my heart into making it.
**Celica**: A wreath of flowers? Oh, Alm... It's just like the one I made for you so long ago.
**Alm**: I'm glad you remember. I was worried you might not.
**Celica**: Of course I do. Thank you, Alm. This makes me so happy.
**Alm**: Happier than a big, juicy steak?

**Celica**: OK, enough meat.
Oh, but I haven't decided what to give you in return... I'm sorry, but I don't have a gift for you yet.
**Alm**: Well, why not make me another wreath? I'll be happy to wear it...this time.
**Celica**: Hehe... OK. But under one condition... We go to the flower patch together.
Duo Skill: • What a lovely day. • Let's try to enjoy it.

rudolf.name: Rudolf
rudolf.title: Emperor of Rigel
rudolf.description: The stern, commanding Emperor of Rigel. Father of Alm and uncle of Berkut. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I am looking forward to this. It has been ages since I last attended a festival.
With Duma freed from his madness, peace has come to Valentia. My deepest wish has been fulfilled.
The gods have chosen you. They would not ask greatness of you if you could not achieve it.
I want to learn more about you, but I also want to see the festivities... Let's talk while we explore, shall we?
Is there something here that would make a good souvenir for my son or my nephew? Hmm...
Visit: I come bearing gratitude and well wishes from your friend [F].
Level: I think my son will appreciate this gift. Thank you for your help selecting it.
This is the gift you would suggest for my nephew? Hmm... A good suggestion, if a little uninspired.
Ultimately I was uncertain what present might suit your fancy.
Summon: I am Rudolf, Emperor of Rigel. I have come from another world. Was it you who summoned me to this one?
Learn Skill: Thank you for this gift. I accept it with gratitude.
Confession:
Rigel's cold climate posed challenges for agriculture, forcing my people to shoulder scarcity and sacrifice.
It will come as no surprise, then, that we were at our happiest during festivals—rare times of indulgence.
Only on such days would you hear children's delighted squeals echoing through the castle.
Until the day I sent newborn Alm away, of course. Then the laughter died.
After that I shunned festivals and even turned away from my nephew, unable to look my decision in the eye.
I was weak. No... I am weak. For a fleeting moment, you have made a weak man's dreams come true.
And for that kindness you have my deepest thanks.
Status: I am Rudolf, Emperor of Rigel. It was brave of you to summon me...
I am in a congenial mood, but let's not get too friendly.
This dagger is a gift for my son. Of course, my nephew must have an identical one, or he will be cross...
I am...unaccustomed to discussing my feelings openly.
Berkut was such a shy lad...always hiding behind the columns in the throne room.
Alm...you will be a just king. Remain strong.
I seldom take holidays. How should we spend the time?

faye2.name: Faye
faye2.title: Drawn Heartstring
faye2.description: A young girl madly in love with Alm. Eager to express her growing feelings to her beloved at the Day of Devotion festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: It's finally here! The Day of Devotion! I've been waiting so long to tell Alm how I truly feel!
The butchers at market were so glad for all I was buying that they threw in these oxtails. They're great for soup!
Want some leftovers? I've got plenty of choice steaks! We can call it your Day of Devotion gift from me!
Silque saw an artist working wonders with spun sugar over there. Want to come with us and see?
In hindsight...maybe asking for an entire side of beef was a mistake. I hope Alm has room for it all...
Visit: Hey, guess who's coming by to check out the festivities? It's your friend, [F]! Join us!
Level: With the power of love, you can do anything you put your mind to!
This pales in comparison to my feelings for Alm!
Do I need to put more love into it? But I'm spoken for... How about just a hug?
Summon: Hi! I'm Faye. I've got some important deliveries here for Alm! Have you seen him around at all?
Learn Skill: A gift? Oh, thank you so much! This is almost as good as getting a present from Alm!
Confession:
Gray and Tobin won't stop teasing me for giving Alm gifts. Like it's wrong to show you care!
They're so weird. Tobin was head over heels for a girl in our village, once. He had no idea what to do.
His way of handling it was to annoy her until she couldn't stand the sight of him. How ridiculous is that?
If you like someone, being mean to them is the last thing you should do. You'd think that would be obvious.
Even if Alm doesn't ever return my feelings, at least he knows I would never do anything to hurt him!
Status: I'm the archer of love, and I'm taking aim straight at Alm's heart!
Don't touch that! That's a gift for Alm. That one too. They're all for Alm, OK?!
Alm loves meat, so...I went to the market and bought it all. Can never be too careful!
Silque doesn't like meat, so I got her flowers instead. I hope she likes them!
Do you think Alm will like my outfit?
The Day of Devotion is the perfect time for me to let out my true feelings!
I don't know what to do with all this meat I bought for Alm. Do you want some sausage? Or jerky?

conrad2.name: Conrad
conrad2.title: Unmasked Knight
conrad2.description: Celica's older brother. Lovingly dotes on his younger sister. Decided to put his mask away for the Day of Devotion festivities. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Look at this gift I got from Anthiese! I'll treasure it until the end of time!
My mask isn't a good fit for a festival about love, so I left it at home. There won't be any enemies today, right?
Are you shy about giving gifts? Don't worry. What matters isn't what you give—what matters is it's from you.
Hey, the band's playing our song! What?! Of course we have a song! Come on, let's dance!
I bought this flute from a local trader. Nice, right? Only...I don't know how to play. Which holes are for what?
Visit: I'm honored to be the Day of Devotion messenger for [F]. So exciting!
Level: Yes! Presents!
I'm going to become so strong that you'll think of me as completely indispensable. Trust me!
You don't like your gift? Oh... Wait! No, no, that one's for somebody else! Ah, how did I mix those two up?!
Summon: Hello there! My name is Conrad, and I come bearing gifts. You'll do me the honor of accepting them, won't you?
Learn Skill: Your gift means the world to me. Thank you so much.
Confession:
What are you doing standing over here, [S]? All tuckered out?
Personally, I'm having too much fun to sit still. The dancing spirit's really got hold of me, I'm afraid.
You won't tell Anthiese, will you? She tends to scold me for "going too far" on the dance floor. Her words.
It's nice to step back and get the full view of things. To see everyone, all at once, having the time of their lives.
But you've caught your breath by now, wouldn't you say? Come on! I need a partner for this next dance!
Special: I got you a little something!
Status: Happy Day of Devotion! I'm excited to take part.
Sorry, this isn't for you. It's a gift for Anthiese!
I hope everyone enjoys the presents I got for them...
Anthiese has had a sweet tooth ever since we were kids.
Excellent outfit, isn't it? The hat's my favorite part.
I'm not used to picking out gifts for people. I hope I don't make a fool of myself...
I've got something for you. Just a little token of my appreciation, for being such a good friend.

silque2.name: Silque
silque2.title: Selfless Cleric
silque2.description: A cleric from Novis. Appreciative of everyone's hard work day in and day out. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I hope these gifts bring some solace to suffering hearts.
On this Day of Devotion, Valentia has been blessed with peace. It must be Mother Mila's divine power at work...
I'm sure your admirers are many. You must be inundated with love letters.
I would like to see the festivities, but I do not know where to start. Care to join me? How exciting this is!
One for Faye, one for Jesse, and one for Alm and Celica. Oh, and I mustn't forget my friends from the priory!
Visit: Here: a token of thanks for all your hard work. Go ahead, open it! It's from [F].
Level: I feel the light of Mila's blessing. A Day of Devotion indeed...
All of this is thanks to you.
Oh, I'm so sorry! I seem to have run out of gifts.
Summon: I am Silque! I have been eagerly waiting to celebrate the Day of Devotion with you.
Learn Skill: I cannot accept such a generous gift. Well...maybe I can.
Confession:
I usually thank others who show me kindness, but sometimes I keep mum for fear of saying something odd.
An example comes to mind. Recently Faye and I happened upon a stall that sold spun sugar sculptures.
There was only one left. Though it was plain that Faye wanted it, she gave it to me.
I thanked her profusely and without thinking I blurted out, "I'll treasure this gift for the rest of my life!"
"I hope not," she snapped at me. "You'd be far better off eating it while it's fresh." I felt so foolish.
Still, it's better to express one's feelings inelegantly than not to express them at all, don't you think?
I shouldn't let fear stop me from giving thanks where they're due.
Special: I'll put my heart into it.
Status: Mother Mila's love is boundless.
This is for you.
To live is to serve. You have been so kind, so please accept my aid.
Faye is going to love the flower I found today.
I would give anything for just one moment of respite for our troops.
Mother Mila, hear my prayer... May this world become one where people exchange gifts rather than blows.
Would you like a flower? It would look great on you.

nils.name: Nils
nils.title: Bright Bard
nils.description: A young boy who travels with his older sister, Ninian. The charming sound of his flute's song has an energizing effect on those who hear it. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: There's something odd about you... But I know you're a good person. Dragons like me can sense as much.
My sister and I are on a journey to our homeland. It's been long and hard—and it's not over yet.
Feeling weak and weary? We can take a break! I can play a little tune on my flute... That'd cheer you up for sure!
I hear there's a hall around here just for singing and dancing! Would you mind...showing me the way?
I can hear the wind's voice in this place... It's quite comforting, actually. Makes me wish I could stay forever...
Visit: Hello there, I'm Nils. I'm a bard! I'm staying over at your friend [F]'s castle!
Level: Everything feels...more alive, somehow! Like I could put on the performance of a lifetime!
Whew! What a refreshing breeze!
I wonder... Has the air of this world changed from what it once was? ...Has it changed too much?
Summon: Hello. I'm Nils. Nice to meet you! See this flute? With this, I'll give everyone whatever support I can!
Learn Skill: Thank you! I'll make sure to work hard and use this to keep everyone's spirits up!
Confession:
Hey, there's something I think you should know... I'm really happy you summoned me!
It's great to share a world with humans again, even if Ninian and I have seen them at their worst...
I grew to really enjoy living in the human world—but in the end, I had to leave. For their sake...
We dragons are not sustained by the same nourishment as you humans... So, eventually, I must leave you too.
Until that day, though...I'll pour my heart into playing my flute! I hope I'll see you striving for success as well.
Special: We'll change the course of fate!
Status: I can keep going!
One more time!
I'm Nils. My sister Ninian and I are traveling performers.
My opinion of humans has changed since meeting all of you. I hope we'll find a way to live together in peace someday.
It's Ninian's wish that I stand by Lord Eliwood.
I hear a familiar voice calling out from the Dragon's Gate. Could it be...
Even if we're apart -- if we never see each other again -- our bond will never, ever be cut.

fiora.name: Fiora
fiora.title: Airborne Warrior
fiora.description: A pegasus knight of Ilia. Older sister of Farina and Florina. A knight full of pride for both her country and family. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
I know the circumstances by which everyone arrived here are different, but some here are far too...friendly!
A proper fighting force should have a solid moral grounding!
Lord Pent dispatched my squad to investigate the Dread Isle. There, we were ambushed, and...and they all—
Discipline demands order in life. So... are you getting enough sleep? I must insist you turn in early tonight.
As a mercenary, I rely on others for work, so I must always prove myself worth my price. That is why I train.

A mercenary's grooming must be sufficient to allow them to remain in the presence of their employer.
That said, I may be due for a bath...
Visit: I am Fiora. I offer you greetings as an envoy of [F].
Level: I will do my best not to betray your trust in my skills.
The secret to true strength is in the little steps taken toward your goals each and every day.
Oh, no...no... This can't be happening. Not again...
Summon: I am Fiora, Pegasus Knight of Ilia. If you wish, I will swear an oath to you, and my strength will be yours.
Learn Skill: Your generous patronage is much appreciated. I will do all I can to make it worth the price.
Confession:
I must thank you from the bottom of my heart for the consideration you've shown me, [S].
However, I must remind you, I am a Pegasus Knight of Ilia. My place is on the battlefield, facing your foes.
From that, I require no safeguard. We knights of Ilia live as mercenaries, sending our earnings back home.
You are...kind to think of my needs, particularly as far as my safety is concerned. But, remember this...
Nothing makes me happier than a chance to defy my employer's expectations on the battlefield.
I hope you will continue to give me chances to do just that.
Special: I can fight on my own.
I'll show them a thing or two.
Status: I am Fiora, a pegasus knight. Whatever the mission, I will give it my all.
Eek! You're like a child! You put me in mind of my sisters.
I bet I'm the worst sister in Ilia... We're always fighting.
Ilia is cold and snowy. That's why I'm in a foreign land working as a mercenary.
We should ensure the proper conduct of all. People's minds are not focused on their duties...
No matter how many tears we shed, the snow will not melt. Better to fight for my homeland.
I would continue fighting for you. Please, let me be of aid.

leila.name: Leila
leila.title: Rose amid Fangs
leila.description: A member of the Black Fang group of assassins whose true loyalties lie with Ostia, which she serves as a spy and skilled infiltrator. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
Life would sure be easier if we all knew where each other stood... That goes for friends too, not just foes...
...Huh? Oh, don't mind me. Just talking to myself.
Oh, Matthew... You said you wanted me to meet your family, right? What else can that mean to a lady besides...

How many times do you think I could cut you before you noticed? ...Heh.
Oh, don't worry! It just looked like you were off in your own little world, so I thought I'd have a little fun.
Hm? Oh, I'm just familiarizing myself with my surroundings. It's something I always do...in case I need to escape.
I never give less than my all. That may sound extreme, but it pays off when it's a matter of life and death.
Visit: I come bearing greetings from your friend [F].
Level: If one of the Four Fangs came at me now, I'd give them a good run for their money...
As you say.
Just have to grin and bear it...
Summon:
...And who might you be? ...Huh? Me? Well, if you must know, I'm Leila. I'd steer clear of me if I were you...
Trust me. It's for your own good.
Learn Skill: I take it you have something in mind for me, and that's why you're giving this to me... Well, I won't say no.
Confession:
You're pretty amazing, you know that? To have gathered so many Heroes under one banner...
And beyond even that, your potential may rival even that of Lord Hector!
Yes, I said "Lord" Hector... I already know there's no point in hiding the fact I'm an Ostian spy from you.
As a spy, I infiltrate organizations, lurk in their darkest corners, listening and leaking information to the outside.
Oh, but don't worry. I'm not here on orders. No, no...I'm just here because, well...you summoned me, of course.
I suppose that means I take orders from you, then! Danger's nothing new to me, so I'll take any mission!
Status: I am Leila. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Who goes there?! ...Oh, it's just you. You're bad for my heart, you know that?
I'm a spy. Everything I do is dangerous. Risking my life is just part of the job.
Matthew wanted me to visit his hometown, but wouldn't say why. He's as slippery as ever...
It seems that Lord Uther has his hands full with his brother, the young Lord Hector. He's quite a character.
Matthew... After this mission, we're going to put this life behind us...
If you ask me, then yes... I will take on even the most dangerous mission.

rath.name: Rath
rath.title: Wolf of Sacae
rath.description: Son of the Kutolah tribe's chieftain, Dayan, the Silver Wolf. Lives as a proud Sacaen warrior. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: In times of invasion, the many tribes shall unite as one to ensure their survival. So state the laws of Sacae.
A disaster looms... A dark flame, consuming all. It is my task—my burden—to stop the burning.

So long as Dayan, the Silver Wolf, can bear his fangs, no foe can claim any foothold upon Sacaen lands.
For that, I am proud to be his son.
Pay me no mind. I've been fighting alone, out of formation, since I was young. I find it easier at this point.
In times of bountiful harvest, all shall pray to the land and stars at sunrise. So state the laws of Sacae.
Visit: I am Rath of the Kutolah. I dwell with [F]...for now.
Level: By wrath of Father Sky!
By voice of Mother Earth!
I am the son of Dayan, the Silver Wolf. Trifles such as this matter little.
Summon: I am Rath of the Kutolah, son of Dayan, the Silver Wolf. My life and limb are devoted to my people.
Learn Skill: I suppose this deserves to be put to proper use. Very well, then.
Confession:
A prophecy foretold a dark flame, consuming all, and a child born to stop the burning... Me.
I was very young, but I heeded the words of the diviner, leaving the Kutolah to wander the world alone...
I have yet to discover what this "dark flame" could be, but coming here has taught me one thing, at least.
No matter the world, there are always those who rebel against Mother Earth and Father Sky.
If my destiny is to stand against such foes so disaster might be averted, then I shall do so by your side.
Special: By the guidance of the wind!
Status: I am Rath of the Kutolah. Son of Dayan, the Silver Wolf.
Wh-what...? If you’ve no business with me, I’m leaving.
A Sacaen warrior proudly defends his own. We do not abandon our brethren.
I left the Kutolah before I was old enough to understand the true strength of the tribe. For fifteen years now, I've traveled by myself.
I was told that I was born into my land to stop the burning... A dark flame, consuming all.
I no longer fear the pain of being alone… Though I do remember how it feels.
May the blessings of Mother Earth be upon you...

heath.name: Heath
heath.title: Wandering Knight
heath.description: A young man troubled by the contrast between his knightly ideal and reality. Forced to leave his homeland, Bern, before becoming a mercenary. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I'm a soldier...but I'm a man of honor first. I have no problem using force. But never against my countrymen.
When I fled Bern, it was in a sad state...our king jumping at shadows, his underlings vying for influence...
If you need a scout, I'm your man. Hyperion and I can swoop in behind enemy lines anytime—no sweat!
Hey, I've been meaning to ask you... Is Askr...recruiting?
Gonna grab my partner some grub! Hyperion needs to be fed... But don't worry—even hungry, he's a big softie.
Visit: I'm Heath. I come bearing a personal message from the summoner I serve, your friend [F].
Level: Yes! Nothing can stop us! Fly, Hyperion!
Any wyvern rider would be proud of such growth. Even the most famed of my foes will stand no chance!
Ugh. With results like this, I should steer clear of the commander... The disappointment would be too much.
Summon: I'm Heath, a mercenary. And this is my wyvern partner, Hyperion.
Learn Skill: Oh. This is for me? Thank you! I'll have you know, I always repay my debts. So, look forward to that!
Confession:
Phew! The work's not easy, but it's worth doing. Plus, you've been fair to me. Makes me, well...glad we met.
Many so-called leaders treat their men like stepping stones, doing anything to win... It's shameful.
I am a proud wyvern rider of Bern. Even forced to abandon my home, I will never abandon my ideals.
You follow the path that you believe is right, one that leads to putting the needs of others before your own.
There's no greater honor than serving such a leader. Finally, I've found one marking a path I want to follow.
Status: Name's Heath. The wyvern's Hyperion. We'll have your back if you have ours.
Who—?! ...Oh, it's you.
I refuse to live a life that brings me shame.
Back when I served as a wyvern rider of Bern, our captain was a true soldier...
I'm at a loss. I have no idea what that Legault guy wants with me.
Bern is nothing to me... I have no love for any country that slaughters its own.
I have finally met a master to whom I can swear my true loyalty. It's you.

chrom5.name: Chrom
chrom5.title: Crowned Exalt
chrom5.description: The new Exalt of the Halidom of Ylisse. Slew the Fell Dragon Grima with the aid of the friendships forged in the fires of war. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: My sister believed in the goodness of people's hearts—and that through such goodness, we will find peace.
Just as evil takes many forms, so too does the power to seal it... I hope my strength can be useful in that regard.
Why is it that all the tacticians I know concern themselves with minutiae? I wish you would relax now and then.
Something troubling you? Nothing a little sparring can't fix! Come on. Exercise is a natural stress relief!
Hm... Is it just me or do these training swords shatter a bit too easily? Might want to look into that, Summoner...
Visit:
Well then, this is your castle, is it, [S]? Splendid!
Oh, right! I've brought you a gift, from [F].
Level: Never give up on your ideals. That is the mark of true strength!
I will train until I am strong enough to protect the peace... But I must first bring that peace about!
My strength may falter, but...it is in no way diminished. As long as the will to fight lives on in me, I'll never give in!
Summon: I am Chrom, of the Halidom of Ylisse. If conflict threatens the peace of this world, we will face it together.
Learn Skill: On the holy name of the Halidom of Ylisse, I swear... I will use this power only in pursuit of peace!
Confession:
When you fight for what you believe in, struggle is inevitable...but one can never know what tomorrow will bring.
There are times when it feels as if you are entombed in darkness, like you will never see light again...
But as we come together, our shared faith in one another can give rise to hope, which lights the way to victory.
You may have more skill than I in the art of war, but I do know one thing... Fighting alone will just get you killed.
Believe in the allies who rush to your side. Even if they cannot always be there, their willingness is enough.
Bonds forged on the field can shatter the shackles of despair more cleanly than any blade.
Let us walk our two paths together, and forge our bonds as well, for both paths lead to one destination—peace.
Status: I'm Chrom. Huh? You think I'm a...Legendary Hero?
Oo-waaagh! Phew, it's just you... Don't scare me like that.
After I performed the Awakening, the divine dragon Naga blessed me with her power.
My world was saved thanks to my friends and allies.
Robin is my closest ally, and friend. We trust each other fully.
It can't be... Has Grima reappeared?
Since coming here, my bond with you has been the most valuable treasure I've gained.

ferdinand.name: Ferdinand
ferdinand.title: Noblest of Nobles
ferdinand.description: Son and heir of Duke Aegir, the Prime Minister of the Adrestian Empire. Accomplished in both literary and military arts, he works hard to live nobly. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: A country—no, a world in need of rescue? A quest fit for the great Ferdinand. Just leave it to me!
My father is the imperial prime minister. I will both succeed and exceed him.
Making the rounds yourself, I see! Admirable, but...shouldn't you be delegating, given your station?
Seems you've got a lot of unique weaponry lying around here. Mind giving me a tour of the armory?
Been doing a bit of conditioning, so I can keep from losing my edge. ...Not that that's a real possibility.
Visit: I have been asked, in the name of friendship, to deliver all the best from [F]!
Level: Greatness awaits me.
The noble standard.
What?! ...Have I already peaked?
Summon: I am Ferdinand von Aegir, heir to the Empire's foremost house. Fret no more. Your savior has arrived.
Learn Skill: Hm! What curious new strength might this grant...
Confession:
Have you need of me? Just point me at a problem, and I will solve it! Your orders never disappoint.
You know, I never thought I'd meet anyone as great as myself... Yet here I am, surrounded by Heroes!
And who commands them but you! Why, if you were emperor, I would gladly swear my allegiance.
And that's not hyperbole! Not one bit! It's a promise.
Join with me, and together we can drive ever onward and upward, to the end of this war and beyond!
Status: A white stallion, a red rose... Oh, I'm just listing things as noble as myself.
Please resist the urge to surprise me! Shock is not befitting a noble.
My father, Duke Aegir, is a proud leader of the Empire... A noble among nobles!
Have you any imported teas? Only the finest will do.
You are not a noble, but I daresay you would do well as one.
I must find a way to demonstrate my superiority...
I acknowlege yor abilities. I will not allow any harm to come to you!

lysithea.name: Lysithea
lysithea.title: Child Prodigy
lysithea.description: Daughter of Count Ordelia and noble of the Leicester Alliance. A determined high achiever who hates being treated like a child. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: This world possesses technology the likes of which are still unknown to Fódlan... An opportunity for study!

My house, Ordelia, is the most impoverished among the leading houses of the alliance.
I have taken it upon myself to lift us out of such a sorry state.
Are you…on patrol? Why not delegate such trifling matters? It would afford you more time to strategize...
If you have the time, why not join me for a study session? There must be so much I could learn from you!
Mmph?! ...Huh? Me? Sneaking treats? How completely absurd! What do you take me for, a CHILD?
Visit: I am here to say hello, as requested by [F].
Level: A natural outcome, considering my efforts.
...I can do better than that. And I can prove it.
Th-there must be some mistake!
Summon: Lysithea von Ordelia, present! Is this...this month's assignment? And where is the professor?
Learn Skill: Thank you for thinking of me. I will be sure to put this to good use.
Confession:
The time I've spent with you on the battlefield has had an immeasurable effect on my skill development.
Academic lectures can only provide so much. There is no substitute for the focused pressure of real battle.
So I suppose I should thank you for calling me here to this world, then, [S].
I hope to use every mote of strength I gain here on the battlefield back in Fódlan, so please...
Allow me to stay here with you a while longer, as your faithful comrade and student.
Special: I do not have time to waste!
Status: Please, stop slacking off and get to work.
Huh?! Oh! I, um, was NOT indulging in sweets. Really!
...Am I afraid of ghosts? Please! I am no child.
Apologies, but I'm extremely busy, you see...
I must grow stronger quickly...for the sake of my family.
*sigh* If only I had something sweet to eat...
You may count on me. I am quite capable, after all.

bernadetta.name: Bernadetta
bernadetta.title: Eternal Loner
bernadetta.description: Daughter of Count Varley, Minister of Religion to the Adrestian Empire. Anxious, she staunchly avoids social interaction. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Leave me alone! I'm no good in a fight, so if you could just let me find a corner to hide in...
I'm not used to being out of my room like this. All this fresh air... Bleh!
Hey! Are you...out patrolling the grounds? Is it because you don't trust me?! That's it, isn't it!
Do you happen to know any good spots one might be able to curl up in and hide? Wanna help me look?
Waahhh! You weren't supposed to notice me here!
Visit:
Hi from [F].
...Can I go now?
Level: I feel...powerful!
I can improve too, you know.
What did I expect...
Summon:
I'm Bernadetta! You can call me "Bernie" if you want. Or you can not call me anything at all...
I...tend to prefer the latter.
Learn Skill: Will this suit me?
Confession:
♪Hmm... Hm-hm-hmm... ♪ Oh! I didn't know you were there, [S]... But...
I did want to tell you, I think I'm finally getting used to it here. Not... comfortable or anything, but better.
Until I start thinking about how I'm in this different WORLD fighting ALL SORTS of people...
...Sorry. I got carried away. But you understand what I'm saying, right? I'm saying, uh... Thanks!
I feel safer making an effort knowing that you're watching my back.
That said...if you want to take a break, I'd happily find a corner to hide in, if one is available...
Status: Go away, I'm busy! No, sorry, I'm really not...
Eeeek! It's over! We're DOOMED!
I just want to hide in my room... Th-that's OK, right?
You always hide your face... Good idea!
Life is so hard... Don't you think?
*humming*
Meeting you is one of the best things that's happened to me...

annette.name: Annette
annette.title: Overachiever
annette.description: Noblewoman of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus and niece to Baron Dominic. Ever the good student, she can sometimes overdo it. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall:
A divine weapon that can summon... heroes? If that is truly how I was brought here, then perhaps father...
Oh, don't mind me!
My father once served the royal family of Faerghus. But he left, abandoning the kingdom...
Wow! Don't you ever take a break? Overworking yourself is nothing to take lightly... Take it from me.
I've been studying, but there's this passage I'm having trouble with... Would you mind taking a look?
I borrowed a book from the castle library... Books are expensive in Fódlan, so I'm reading all I can!
Visit: Hi! I'm here to wish you all the best from [F]!
Level: Ooh! That felt oddly good!
I hope I'm not letting anyone down...
I'm sorry... I'll do better, I promise!
Summon: Hi! I'm Annette Fantine Dominic, and I go to Garreg Mach Academy... Oh! And you can call me "Annie"!
Learn Skill: Thank you! You won't regret this!
Confession:
Sometimes I feel like nothing I try to do ever works out. Do you ever feel like that, [S]?
The task ahead of you is so immense. Summon Heroes! Save the world! That sure is a lot of pressure...
My recommendation is...don't try to do it all alone. It never ends well. Trust me. I'm a bit of an expert.
That same urge made me anxious when I first arrived here, but...look at me now, thanks to your support!
I just wanted to say, I'll do my best for you as long as I'm here. You can count on me returning your support!
Status: Laundry, studies, training... I have my work cut out for me!
♪Just takes a flash of light, and then it all goes boom! ♪Oh! You weren't listening...right?
Need help with anything? No? Oh...
*sigh* I've always been kind of clumsy...
My dearest wish is for my family to reunite.
I know I should be taking it easy, but that's too hard!
I'll do my best for you, no matter how hard things get!

flameemperor.name: Flame Emperor
flameemperor.title: Bringer of War
flameemperor.description: A mysterious individual who instigates conflict, disturbing the peace in Fódlan. Willing to use any method to achieve their objectives. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: "Hero"? The word sticks in my throat. But it is fitting, I suppose.
Better war than a peace built on suffering.
Strangers, everyone. You fight for the unknown alongside unknowns.
Tell me of your world. Perhaps I can offer advice...
May I have a moment? I must remove this mask. It is sweltering underneath. But it wouldn't do for you to see...
Visit: As if I were a common courier, I come bearing greetings from [F].
Level: As is to be expected.
Hmph. Nothing more than a minor setback.
This won't stop me. Nothing will.
Summon: You are in the presence of the Flame Emperor. I am yours to command, if you prove capable.
Learn Skill: Ah. A gift offered freely. May this benefit us both.
Confession:
I am burdened with great purpose. My path, the path I must follow, stretches out before me...
By every right, I should seek to free myself of this childish struggle... And yet, something about you...
Tell me, would you ever consider using your tactical skill in service of my empire?
...Only after your work here is done, I imagine.
Then I will stay. And perhaps the time will come when I no longer have need to don this mask before you...
Status: You see what I choose to show you.
Your foolishness will be your end.
Terrible power has its uses...and use it I will.
Behold the power of the Flame Emperor!
Fódlan's history has been distorted for over a millennium...
Beasts hiding in the light. Monsters slithering in the dark. I will destroy them all.
Say the word, and all will be burned away...

idunn2.name: Idunn
idunn2.title: Dragonkin Duo
idunn2.description: The last of the dragonkin on the continent Elibe. They heard about the spring festival and are trying the costumes out for themselves. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.
idunn2.duo: Grants Def/Res+6 and the following status to unit and allies within 5 rows and 5 columns centered on unit for 1 turn: "Neutralizes 'effective against dragons' bonuses and 'effective against armored' bonuses."

Castle Hall: **Idunn**: We are dressed as rabbits...for the spring festival? I do not understand the connection...
**Fae**: Look! I got some rabbit clothes, so I'm a rabbit now! Watch! Hippity hop, hippity hop!
**Idunn**: You work even amid the festivities? ...Do you struggle to find meaning in time spent with others as I do?
**Fae**: I love spring! It's so warm! And plus there's flowers and butterflies! And so many other pretty things too!
**Idunn**: All these people gathered to pass the time, smiling... Like something from a dream...
Visit: **Idunn**: I am Idunn. I bring warm spring tidings from [F].
Level: **Idunn**: The warmth in the air... I can feel spring's gentle sigh...
**Fae**: Everyone's supposed to have fun at a festival, right? Well...let's have some fun then! Wheee!
**Idunn**: I am unworthy. You need not say anything.
Summon: I am Idunn, and this child is Fae. She desires to see the spring festival...and I am bound to her by duty.
Learn Skill: **Fae**: Ooh! Thanks! I'll have some fun with this!
Confession:
**Idunn**: The more of the festival I see, the less I understand. Why do people behave in such ways?
**Fae**: I don't know! But it's fun!
**Idunn**: But to what end? What is the purpose of it?
**Fae**: Well, look! Everyone is smiling! Doesn't seeing everyone happy make you feel...warm inside?
**Idunn**: I think...I understand. I will help everyone to smile then. And perhaps I will even be able to smile myself...
**Fae**: Yeah! I know just where to start... C'mon—let's go join the others! This will be FUN!
Status: giggle
"What cute ears..." "Ehehehe!"
Conversation: **Fae**: Here you go! Have some flowers... and be sure to try this candy! It's scrumptious!
**Idunn**: So sweet...
**Fae**: Are you happy? You're smiling!
**Idunn**: Yes, I am. Thank you...
**Fae**: No problem! Hmm... Uh, what else will make you smile? Oh, I know!
**Idunn**: Fae? Where are you going?
**Fae**: Hey, bunny! Wait for me! Agh! Oh, that stings! Waah!
**Idunn**: You'll be all right. Don't cry...
**Fae**: *sob* ...Idunn?
**Idunn**: Here... You can have this candy... and these flowers.
**Fae**: You're giving them to me? Thank you!
**Idunn**: You...are smiling.
**Fae**: Whoa, YOU put a smile on MY face! With me, it's usually the other way around!
**Idunn**: Ehehe... I suppose so.
**Fae**: I'm smiling, you're smiling, everybody's smiling! That makes me happy!
**Idunn**: Strange, isn't it? If you smile, I also smile. I wonder why...
**Fae**: Idunn, let's keep smiling together forever! Heheh.

est2.name: Est
est2.title: Springtime Flier
est2.description: Youngest of the three Pegasus Sisters from Macedon. She's come to the spring festival as a bunny, just like her sisters. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: On warm days like this, nothing beats hopping on a pegasus and feeling the wind on your face! Wanna join me?
Look at all those smiling people! You can feel the warmth in their hearts. That's how you know winter's over.
Palla and Catria already celebrated the spring festival. But this time, all three of us can have fun together!
Hehe, isn't this outfit cute? I wonder what Abel will think...
Hippity-hop! Look at me, I'm a rabbit! My sisters won't hop around with me, but if they did we'd be soooo cute!
Visit: The spring festival is happening! This is your official reminder from [F]! Hop to it!
Level: Wow, look at that! Spring HAS sprung!
I can hop even higher, I just know it!
Maybe I got a bit carried away at the festival...
Summon: I'm Est! My two older sisters already got to enjoy the spring festival. Now it's my turn. You can't stop me!
Learn Skill: Ooh! A spring festival present? I love it!
Confession:
I LOVE springtime! It's a refreshing restart where anything's possible!
Like new friends, adventures, recipes, and even a new me!
I know I should focus on fighting, but when the battles are finally over... I hope every day will be this carefree.
All we need to do is push through winter, and our spring is bound to be there waiting... For all of us!
If we do our best, I know it'll happen! Count on my sisters and me to have your back, [S]!
Status: Hippity-hey there! I'm Est! Hoppy to meet you.
Don't mess up my ears. This bunny has fangs!
A celebration where people dress up as bunnies is...a little weird—but it's also really fun!
Seeing my sisters working hard makes me want to follow in their footsteps!
I didn't think I'd be the bunny type...but I'm having fun hopping around anyway!
Why did the bunny cross the road? ...To get to the carrot farm, of course!
Hey—how come you haven't put on your bunny costume yet? Hurry up!

fir2.name: Fir
fir2.title: Student of Spring
fir2.description: Daughter of the warrior Bartre and the swordmaster Karla. She has taken a moment away from training to visit the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I've never seen Father dressed up like THAT before. As strange as it is, the spring festival outfit suits him.
I'd much rather be sword fighting, but if we're here to celebrate, then I'll give it my all!
Enjoy yourself, but this is a serious matter. If you're not careful, someone will have MORE fun than you.
Mother, Uncle...I will use this experience to further my mastery of the sword. Somehow...
Gaudy clothing such as this isn't practical for swordplay. I can't tell if I'm wearing it right. Is this a prank?
Visit: Time to be merry! You're invited to the spring festival by [F].
Level: A fresh spring breeze is at my back!
The new season has revitalized me!
Maybe the nice weather has softened me up too much...
Summon: My name is Fir and I study the sword. Father kept shouting about the spring festival so I had to go see it for myself!
Learn Skill: Why, thank you! I'll be sure to train extra hard!
Confession:
Have you seen my father around here, [S]?
It appears he's been looking for me. I can only hope he's not troubling the festival patrons.
Father is a little... No. He's EXTREMELY overprotective. But it's his way of showing he cares.
When I think of it in that regard, I feel a warmth as though I'm being embraced by the springtime sun.
These thoughts help thaw our hearts and strengthen our bonds. I hope this festival can help us remember that.
Status: I'm Fir, the spring festival's best bun! Best bun-bun? Bun-bun-bun...
Whoa! You're crafty, waiting till I'm busy with the festival to launch a sneak attack!
T-this outfit is...um...well, there certainly are a lot of unique customs out there, huh...?
I do like rabbits. You can find them no matter how far you roam. They're delicious.
These ears aren't just for show... I can hear the enemy's footsteps!
Well... there is one person I'd like to show this outfit off to. But... Y'know...
Let's put some of this bunny energy to a good use—training!

narcian2.name: Narcian
narcian2.title: Vernal General
narcian2.description: One of the three Wyvern Generals of Bern. Making a rare exception, he is donning an unusual outfit just for the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Praising my festival attire, are we? I chose it myself. Such perfection. I'm in awe of my impeccable style.
It's about time Askr had a festival to celebrate my greatness. Bern does it better, but this is a decent effort.
The epitome of beauty. The pillar of wisdom. The embodiment of springtime. In one word: Narcian.
My spirits are high. I shall permit you to trail behind me at a respectful distance as I survey my festivities.
How kind of you to hold this vernal celebration in my honor. Mind you, don't let this level of devotion wane.
Visit: You may ogle, but make way! I come with springtime salutations to you from [F].
Level: Feast your eyes! You peasants are blessed with spring because of ME!
I'll allow you to be more vocal in your admiration!
Gaahh! Who disrespected Narcian? I'll claw you, spineless coward!
Summon: I am Narcian—a Wyvern General of Bern, and the guest of honor at this spring festival. Bow your head!
Learn Skill: Yes, shower me with gifts! I am the reason for your spring celebrations!
Confession:
I once saw you as a mediocre shell of a being, unfit to lick my boots.
But you had a vision to crown me as the guest of honor at this festival. For that, I'll acknowledge you.
And look around! Thanks to my presence, the flowers bloom and the air warms. People rejoice for ME.
Heh heh, was there ever any doubt? My strength, my wisdom, and, yes, my beauty can never be questioned.
By all means, continue your revelry in my honor! Make Narcian synonymous with the Askr spring!
Status: What's all this, you ask? Vibrant spring garb befits one such as I.
*gasp* You dare besmirch my noble raiment? Stop with this nonsense!
I'd say the ears are quite charming, but do tell me what you think.
No matter what clothes I wear, my natural radiance cannot be concealed.
This world does seem to understand a suitable celebration! You have my compliments.
Rabbits are often hunted, but I am, of course, always the hunter. *laugh*
It is the season of life renewed, and yet you look so...limp. I suppose that's just how you are.

bartre2.name: Bartre
bartre2.title: Earsome Warrior
bartre2.description: A warrior from a remote region who takes pride in his strength. Joining his beloved daughter Fir and fully embracing the springtime festivities. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Even dressed up like a rabbit, Fir's ready to cross swords with anyone! That's my girl! Gahaha!
When I was younger, I just wanted to be the strongest. Now I wish for nothing but my daughter's happiness.
I'm wearing this to match Fir! But we don't match as well as I hoped.
So long winter, hello spring! It's time to get stronger and aim for the top all over again! Yaahhh!
If ANY creep tries to bother Fir, they'll face the Bartre-hammer! Even during the spring festival!
Visit: Gahaha! Spring is here! I wanted to extend warm wishes from [F]!
Level: Oh YEAH, that's the stuff. I'm flourishing with power!
The festival's just getting started!
Ugh... Maybe this costume is too tight for someone with big muscles?
Summon: The name's Bartre and I'm a fighter. Let's celebrate being all decked out in spring festival gear! Gahaha!
Learn Skill: New season means new POWER! I'm just brimming with energy!
Confession:
So this spring festival you got here in Askr... I like it!
Everyone's gathered to revel in the coming of springtime. Why, nothing could be better!
Fir's having fun too. I can't remember the last time she smiled that big. Ahhhh.
I'll do whatever it takes to keep that grin on her face. Break down anything that stands in my way!
C'mon, [S]!
The celebration isn't over yet! Let's enjoy ourselves! Gahaha!
Status: I'm Bartre! All dressed up for the spring festival, I am!
Wanna touch? No need to be shy. Go for it! Give 'em a squeeze!
Is it a little weird that my outfit matches my daughter's? *heh* Well, I like it!
Come on, everybody! Spring is here! Let's celebrate!
My wife and I used to travel across the countryside and train together... Whenever I see rabbits, I think about those days.
Me and Fir, all gussied up. Wish Karla could see us...
Dressing up together really brings everybody closer, doesn't it?

bramimond.name: Bramimond
bramimond.title: The Enigma
bramimond.description: One of the Eight Legends who wielded a sacred weapon and fought against the dragons in the Scouring. Bramimond's true nature is unknown. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.
bramimond.voice: Yuri Lowenthal / Patrick Seitz / Wendee Lee / Ray Chase

Castle Hall: Beauty, ugliness... These exist only in the eye of the beholder. No object's essence bears trace of such things.
Humans are weak. Easily intoxicated by power, they lose themselves. ...I, too, was human once.
I grow weary. Allow me some rest...
There is no me, no self to call mine. I am only the chaotic web formed between all those I have met...
My every emotion and memory dissolved in a river of dark. I am what remained. I am...nothing.
Visit: You are [S]... Friend of [F]... Hello.
Level: Gaining new strength... Some cause for excitement, as I recall...
Neither good nor bad—as all things are.
Weak results... Some cause for despair, as I recall...
Summon: I am Bramimond. There is no me, no self to call mine. My heart and voice are borrowed, moment to moment.
Learn Skill: Power can change you...
Confession:
Power changes a person. I've seen the powerful go mad and persecute the weak...
Decline is not unique to humans. Just as water runs downhill, power corrupts—and warps.
And yet, I have also seen those with power fight for peace...and seek equality for the downtrodden.
And you... Would you protect those beneath you? Or would you leave them to fend for themselves?
Only those with power can decide such things, and such power changes a person... How will it change you?
Status: I will crush you!
I take my stand here.
Meet your defeat!
I won't lose.
I'll crush you!
I make my stand here.
Meet your defeat!

rinkah.name: Rinkah
rinkah.title: Scion of Flame
rinkah.description: Daughter of the Flame Tribe chieftain. Her aloof disposition belies the wildness in her heart. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.
rinkah.artist: Kusakihara Toshiyuki (草木原俊行) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: Don't expect me to bow to royalty. The Flame Tribe only gives respect to those who earn it.
No matter how far I journey from home, I am never lonely. My tribe is always with me in spirit.
Are those...sweets? Who told you I... Fine. I will take them off your hands, but just this once.
You ever tried sumo? It's the ideal test of strength. Let's go for a round, [S]. Come on!
The marks on my face? These are traditional Flame Tribe tattoos. They are meant to ward off evil.
Visit: I am Rinkah, of the Flame Tribe. [F] sent me, but I need no formal welcome.
Level: The spirit of the Flame Tribe guides me to greater and greater heights!
Good, but not enough. I need more!
Ugh. I've let my hunger get the best of me. What a disgrace...
Summon: I am Rinkah, of the Flame Tribe. I'll fight for you, and I'll keep my word, but don't expect any more than that.
Learn Skill: I try to avoid involving myself too much with people, but...thanks.
Confession:
My portion at dinner was twice what it usually is, for some reason. Was that you, [S]?
Well, you don't need to butter me up. I get along just fine on what everyone else around here eats.
If giving me a bigger meal than even Alfonse and Sharena was some kind of ploy to get me in your debt...
Well, it didn't work. Totally failed. In fact, I didn't even notice. Ugh, fine, obviously I noticed...
Look, if there's something you want, you don't have to do all that for me. Just ask next time, OK?
Status: I am Rinkah, daughter of the Flame Tribe's honorable chieftain.
Hands off.
I've got fire in my veins. Cut me, and you'll get burned.
I owe Corrin for saving my life. Until that debt is paid, I won't stand idle.
Why is everyone so delicate about eating? Utensils only get in the way.
The Flame Tribe prides itself on its independence. We rely on outsiders for nothing.
I've grown a lot, thanks to you. Let's stick together a while longer, OK?

forrest.name: Forrest
forrest.title: Fashion Forward
forrest.description: Son of Leo. A kind and compassionate soul, with a keen eye for aesthetics. Loves to sew. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
The Order of Heroes' uniforms are amazing... That gleaming white? It's inspirational.
I'd add my own touches, of course. Maybe I'd line the cape with soft rose silk...

I was raised in the Deeprealms to keep me safe from war.
Focusing on my sewing helped me work through the loneliness I felt, not being able to see my parents.
If you get injured or tear your clothes, call on me. Mending bones and outfits are two of my specialties.

Would you like to gather herbs with me? Or maybe we can go shopping for accessories...
Really, I'd just like the chance to have a nice, long chat with you.
I've been watching everybody as they come and go... It's fun to spy out all the different clothing they wear.
Visit: Pardon the intrusion! I've been handed a letter just for you, from [F].
Level: This may call for a new look soon!
My inner strength is really blossoming.
I know I can do better than that.
Summon: It's good to meet you. I am Forrest, Leo's son. I will do my best to uphold his proud name.
Learn Skill: Well, this is lovely. Do you think it suits me?
Confession:
...
Oh, my apologies. I was praying—it's something I like to do. I'm expressing my gratitude for being here.
Why? Because I was able to meet you, of course. You've been so kind, looking out for me, encouraging me...
You've stayed at my side when things get tough. That's how I got interested in the Order of Heroes' uniforms.
I watch out for you for one reason—it means that I care about you! I'd be happy to stay by your side.
Status: Feel better!
I can mend your clothes!
Be honest. My outfit… Too much, or not enough?
There's a bunch of equipment lying around. Do you need me to move it for you?
You know, I think some ruffles would really liven up that robe of yours!
Someday, it'll fall to me to wield Father's weapon, Brynhildr. I'll need to be ready.
I could never leave someone to die. It doesn't matter what the situation is. I refuse to bring shame on the Nohrian royal family!

lilith.name: Lilith
lilith.title: Astral Daughter
lilith.description: Corrin's attendant, whose true form is that of an astral dragon. She reveals her true self to rescue Corrin from a crisis. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Mmm, fish and wheat...no soybeans... Huh? Oh dear. It seems my hungry stomach had me sleep talking again.
Being able to converse with Corrin again in this form... Why, it's almost like a dream. I'm eternally grateful.
I have fond memories of Corrin gently petting my head or carrying me in my dragon form. I'll always remember it.
The Kingdom of Askr feels familiar. The atmosphere is reminiscent of a certain country I once knew...
Please allow me to tend the stables. My strong kinship with horses would be useful to the Order of Heroes.
Visit: Hello. I'm Lilith. I've arrived at the behest of [F].
Level: Now I can be helpful to everyone!
I feel more powerful now!
I wonder if this land can make me strong enough to protect everyone.
Summon: Hello, I'm Lilith. I faithfully served at Corrin's side in the Kingdom of Nohr. Now I'm here if you need my aid.
Learn Skill: I'd like to offer thanks. I'll never forget my debt to you.
Confession:
If you will, I have something to ask. Do you have someone you'd be willing to sacrifice your life for?
I'll confess I'm not fit for combat and I certainly don't wish for wars that cause tragedy and heartache.
But in order to prove my devotion, I'm willing to risk everything in battle with no regrets.
My resolve is why I stand before you. Or could it possibly be due to the strength I get from those feelings?
I'm positive all of the Heroes carry similar sentiments. Let's make a pact to always protect those dear to us.
Status: My name is Lilith. I was Corrin's faithful attendant.
Hey! Please, try not to sneak up on me!
Since meeting Corrin, I never feel alone anymore.
I'll perform whatever duties you ask, but...as a stable girl, I'm good at caring for horses!
A dragon of starlight, a guide for travelers... That's me!
Corrin... Even though I can't tell you the truth, I will always protect you...
You, too, are precious to me... Whatever you need, I am at your service.

midori.name: Midori
midori.title: Reliable Chemist
midori.description: Daughter of the stalwart Hoshidan ninja Kaze. An expert when it comes to crafting balms and poultices from medicinal herbs. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Askr has so many herbs! I've never seen that one before...or that one... Don't worry, I won't wander too far!
I grew up in the Deeprealms far away from my father. There I studied apothecary so I could help people.
Talk to me if you're ever hurt or feeling down! I'll figure out the best way to treat your troubles.
I stumbled on some rare plants and made this medicine. C'mon and try some, [S]!
Here's a charm to ward off injuries. The best kind of medicine is not having to use any at all!
Visit: I'm Midori. Are you feeling OK? I come with herbs and medicine from [F]'s castle.
Level: Hooray! I worked really hard!
I've got a great idea for a new recipe!
I won't let this get me down!
Summon: Hi there. I'm Midori, the biggest herb gatherer around! It's nice to meet you.
Learn Skill: I'm getting stronger! Maybe now I can prove my usefulness to Father.
Confession:
Medicines are amazing, huh? A simple salve can help a patient feel much better...and treat them quickly too!
But, it makes me sad that some wounds have no cure at all. Like a pained heart.
Combat doesn't just hurt physically, it takes its toll little by little...
That's why I want to put an end to fighting so no one suffers anymore.
Promise we'll build a peaceful world together, [S]?
Special: Pick on someone your own size!
Status: Nice to meet you! Do you know Kaze? He's my father!
H-hey! I don't sneak up on you, do I?!
I don't like to keep Father waiting!
I'm all grown-up now, you know!
If you're ever feeling under the weather, just let me know and I'll make you some medicine!
I wish I could spend more time with Father...
I'm so happy we were able to meet and become friends!

iago.name: Iago
iago.title: Nohr's Tactician
iago.description: Tactician in the service of the Nohrian king, Garon. He uses cruel schemes and malicious magic to plague the enemies of Nohr. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Second-rate strategists linger on their decisions. Take heed of the most optimal method to win. That's key.
My duty is to support King Garon. I'll strike down anyone in the way, be they royal blood or common peasants.
Every plan must include finding the heart's weakness. Extract a grain of jealousy so they are consumed by it.
An army of Heroes? Why, I'm capable alone. With my illusions, turning the tide of battle is effortless.
Foes whose first instinct is to use force are easy to conquer, for they never have a backup plan.
Visit: I am Iago, a tactician and illusionist. Heh. Heh. Don't be suspicious—I am here for [F].
Level: Excellent. Just as I predicted.
Well? Did you enjoy my illusions?
W-what? This wasn't in the plan!
Summon: I am Iago, a tactician for the Kingdom of Nohr. Pleased to meet you. Bear witness to my schemes and illusions.
Learn Skill: Ah, yes. This will polish my schemes even further.
Confession:
Greetings. May I have a moment of your time, [S]?
By my thorough evaluations, I've come to see that you are far more than just a mere summoner.
With your abilities, why, you could take this world in hand and rule over its entirety!
You have other intentions, you say? Heh. Quite a modest statement. But my predictions are never wrong.
Should you pursue this path, I shall make use of my excellent tactician abilities to aid you... Heh heh heh.
Status: I am King Garon's greatest tactician—Nohr's dread mage, Iago! The pleasure is all mine.
E-excuse me?! You dare disturb a Nohrian official of my stature?!
I am a master of illusions. Care for a demonstration?
As the king's right hand, I will see his desires fulfilled—no matter the cost.
Corrin—you ever-present thorn. How do you thwart even my best efforts to remove you...
Corrin puts such faith in others... What ridiculous naiveté.
You seem to have a knack for avoiding death. Much like another I know...

palla3.name: Palla
palla3.title: Sisterly Trio
palla3.description: Trio of Macedonian sisters who dream of one day flying alongside Princess Minerva as members of the Whitewings. They appear in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.
palla3.duo:
Unit and adjacent flying allies can move 1 extra space. (Unit can move 1 extra space even if adjacent ally is not a flying ally. That turn only. Does not stack.)
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of odd-numbered turns, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
palla3.voice: Alexis Tipton + Connor Kelley + Brianna Knickerbocker

Castle Hall:
**Catria**: Princess Minerva is strong, to be sure, but I think Palla is just as strong.
Of course, both pale in comparison to Prince Michalis...
**Palla**: Prince Michalis must be gathering military might to face Dolhr. We must get stronger so we can help too...
**Catria**: If my little sister ever appears tired, don't worry. Macedon women are strong. She can handle it.
**Palla**: I prefer lances when airborne, but they can be clumsier than swords when used for grounded combat...
**Catria**: Est has always adored Palla, ever since she was little. I guess I'm different... I want to surpass her.
Visit: **Palla**: I'm Palla of Macedon. I've come with gifts from [F]!
Level: **Palla**: We will let nothing bad happen to Macedon! Its future is ours to defend!
**Palla**: If the three of us are together, we have nothing to fear from any enemy!
**Catria**: Oh no! That can't be right... Can I try one more time?
Summon: I'm Palla of Macedon, and these are my younger sisters, Catria and Est. How can we be of service?
Learn Skill: **Palla**: I see. We can learn a lot from this. We will do our best to use it well.
Confession:
**Palla**: Thank you so much for all the many experiences we've been able to have on the battlefield with you...
Next to wyvern riders, pegasus knights are often seen as mere reconnaissance, but we can fight.
**Catria**: Right! And by now, the three of us together must outmatch even the strongest wyvern rider.
Princess Minerva will be quite pleased, I bet!
**Palla**: Now, don't exaggerate, Catria. Though it is true that we've grown in both skill and confidence...
**Catria**: It's just...Minerva has been so quiet recently. She used to laugh more...
**Palla**: She feels her duty weigh on her... Maybe we should take on the task of easing her burden.
**Catria**: You're right! As Macedonian Whitewings, let's help Minerva however we're able!
**Palla**: Together with the fine knight Est is sure to become, we'll work to protect the future of Macedon!
Status: Oh!
• "How are you?" • "I'm bursting with energy!"
Conversation: **Palla**: How are you doing, Catria? Are you tired, Est?
**Catria**: We're doing fine, Palla. ...Est? What is it?
**Est**: I'm thirsty!
**Palla**: How about we head back, then?
**Catria**: You're interrupting Palla's training! This is why I told you to get some water before we left.
**Palla**: Don't be angry, Catria. It's all right.
**Catria**: You let her get away with murder, Palla! Just yesterday, she was hiding from you so she could eat candy.
**Est**: Ugh! You're always so mean!
**Catria**: What was that?
**Palla**: All right, you two. That's enough. We'll never become pegasus knights if you can't get along.
**Catria**: Wait—are you serious, Palla?
**Palla**: Oh, yes. Pegasus knights must fight as a team. That requires cooperation.
Take a look around. See how everyone's lined up perfectly? Nobody has broken formation.
**Catria**: It...it's perfect!
**Palla**: I want us to fly like that, and I believe that we can. But, well... We're not quite there yet, are we?
**Catria**: I understand. Est, I'm sorry.
**Est**: Oh, me too!

merric2.name: Merric
merric2.title: Changing Winds
merric2.description: Born to Altean nobility, he grew up alongside Elice and Marth as if they were family. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: There's a school of magic in Khadein. I'm planning to study there after this. Hopefully I'll make a few new friends!
This? Oh, it's a good luck charm! Princess Elice gave it to me... But let's keep that between us.
I could hardly walk after a trek with Prince Marth... But Princess Elice nursed me back to health!

Altea may be a small country, but at least we have our dignity. Not like so many Archanean folk...
Hm? Oh! I hope no one was listening to that...
When you feel the wind on your skin, do you also hear its voice speaking to you, [S]?
Visit: Hello, I'm Merric. I was sent to visit by [F]!
Level: Yes! See? I KNEW I could do this!
I must truly have a knack for wind magic, huh...
Not good enough! I'll need to do better than that if I plan on protecting Princess Elice!
Summon: My name's Merric, and I'm a student of magic hailing from Altea. I hope to befriend everyone here.
Learn Skill: Such power! I'll be sure to put it good use—just wait!
Confession:
Altea, where I was raised, is the home of the legendary hero Anri.
Most children there hope to grow up to be knights to be more like he was.
Even when I was younger, I always preferred reading to roughhousing. So magic became my path.
Prince Marth and Princess Elice have always supported me, which led me to continue my studies in Khadein.
I'll learn powerful magic and become a proper mage. For the good of Altea! ...And my experience here will aid me.
As long as it means I can see Princess Elice smiling, I will do what it takes to protect Prince Marth, as is my duty!
Status: My name is Merric. I am a student of magic.
Wh-whoa! You very nearly made me drop my book.
If I want to help Prince Marth and Princess Elice in the future, I must study hard...
Are you familiar with Khadein? A great sage teaches at the school there...
Hm? What type of magic do *I* excel at? Well, I know some wind magic...
Oh, Princess Elice... Guh! I didn't say anything! Perhaps it was the wind...
A certain air of mystery swirls around you, doesn't it...

caeda3.name: Caeda
caeda3.title: Princess of Talys
caeda3.description: Princess of the small kingdom of Talys. Showing kindness to all, she is beloved by the people. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I recognize so few people here... Where are Ogma...and Barst?
Talys is made of many small islands. We all banded together to protect each other from pirate brigands.
Here, I brought you a nice hot drink. Why don't you take a break.
When my father united Talys, there was a fierce commander from Grust who fought at his side.

Talys is surrounded by water on all sides, so attack can come from any direction at any time.
We do not know the luxury of resting on our laurels.
Visit: What a lovely castle this is... You are [S], are you not?
Level: My hope is for the world to become a kinder place.
I am not a child anymore. I can fight my own battles just fine.
But...why?
Summon: My name is Caeda, and I come from Talys. I may have my fair share to learn, but I will put in the work!
Learn Skill: Ooh! Thank you! I'll try my best!
Confession:
I wonder, is there anyone you fight for? Someone you...love, I mean?
My father would say a warrior is only as strong as the love they have for those they fight to defend.
I'm not sure I fully understand yet what he meant. But I do know I want peace...for everyone.
Not just Talys! The whole world... We could all just decide to be kind. But that, too, takes a certain strength.
So for now I only hope more will consider training their kindness alongside building their strength.
Special: I don't want to hurt you!
Status: Hello. I am Caeda. It's nice to meet you.
Oh! Were you trying to scare me?
On the island where I grew up, the people were few but happy.
Do you believe in love?
The world that lies beyond the shores of Talys is so unfamiliar to me…
I wonder if I'll get married someday.
You are a kind person. Thank you for lending me your ear.

marth5.name: Marth
marth5.title: Legacied Hero
marth5.description: Prince of Altea and inheritor of the Hero Anri's blade, as well as the duty it represents. Great- grandson of Marcelus. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Jagen says I must grow stronger... Malledus says I must grow wiser... Being a prince is no easy task.

My father, King Cornelius, is the grandson of the younger brother of the Hero Anri...
That means I have hero's blood in my veins, doesn't it?
The people of this castle fight with such regularity. They should be sure to rest! ...As my sister would insist.
There would be quite the celebration if someone like you were to fight for Altea, [S].
Everyone here is so nice, I have not been lonely a second. And besides, there are a few familiar faces...
Visit: I've been sent to wish you all the best, [S]!
Level: I'm glad that was resolved... Next time, I will take even bolder action.
Not bad. But not perfect either.
Elice...Merric... Without you, I am surely lost.
Summon: I'm Marth, Prince of Altea. I hope the two of us get along well together!
Learn Skill: Thank you. In Altea's name, I pledge to grow stronger!
Confession:
It's strange, [S]...
Even when we had just met, I had a feeling we'd grow close.
Without words, there was a natural connection... My father once said true friendship is like that.
I have a few good friends... Merric, Jagen and the rest of the knights, and my sister, Elice.
All of them are important to me. And you have grown to be equally important, [S].
Status: My name is Marth. I hope we can become great friends.
Whoah! You startled me. It seems you like teasing people, huh?
My elder sister is a very kindhearted person.
I must get strong, and study hard so I can become a great king someday.
My friend Merric is quite adept at magic.
Altea is at peace. I hope it stays that way forever...
I'm eager to learn as much as I can at your side.

minerva2.name: Minerva
minerva2.title: Princess-Knight
minerva2.description: Eldest princess of Macedon. Devoted to her military training so she might one day rule the kingdom with her brother Michalis. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: My brother is unshakable. Yet...there is something off about him lately. He seems somehow preoccupied.

They say the Shadow Dragon was resurrected just outside our borders.
But Macedon's army is strong... If it comes to war, we have nothing to fear.
Soldiers require both harsh training and adequate rest and nourishment. Same goes for commanders.
Macedon was founded by freedom fighters. My brother is said to be the reincarnation of our first king, Iote.
Forts, castles, roads. Those things alone can tell you all you need to know about a country.
Visit: I am Minerva. If you are a friend of [F], then you are my friend too.
Level: For the honor and glory of Macedon, I will gladly sacrifice everything.
I am Minerva of Macedon. I will not be taken lightly.
I must do better if I'm to be of any help to my brother...
Summon:
I am Minerva of Macedon. No need to coddle me simply because I'm a princess.
In fact...allow me to demonstrate some combat techniques I learned from my brother, Michalis.
Learn Skill: Something you chose specifically for me? I will use it as best I can.
Confession:
...Ah! How long have you been standing there? If you want to talk, can it wait? I'm training...
...Do I seem strange to you? Perhaps I am unlike the princesses you may have met before...
As a royal of Macedon I must project strength, whatever the arena may be.
And having a reputation for being a hard-nosed knight keeps the suitors at bay...so I find it suits me just fine.
My only dreams are to serve as my brother's right hand and to keep Macedon and my sister safe.
So I hope to learn as much as I can from you while I'm here—to bring peace to Macedon!
Status: I am Minerva, Princess of Macedon.
I— You— How rude!
My brother Michalis can skillfully wield both his sword and his wit. And he has a kind heart too.
My sister Maria is still little... So I have to do what I can to protect her!
As long as my brother's around, Macedon will be the greatest country on the continent.
I think Michalis had some kind of argument with Father... I hope everything is all right...
I want to stay by your side and keep learning from you. So I plan to do just that.

edelgard2.name: Edelgard
edelgard2.title: Flame Emperor
edelgard2.description: Emperor of the Adrestian Empire. Destroyer of the Church of Seiros and unifier of all Fódlan. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Even in an unfamiliar world, I must keep learning. An emperor can never stop moving forward.
Fódlan is united, but my work is not yet finished. There are still those who slither in the dark to deal with.
There are many rulers among your company. Commanding them must weigh on you... You should rest.
Would you share your opinions on the other Heroes with me? I imagine yours is a more objective position.

I was just designing a new form of government in my mind. One that might make for a better world.
There is much I have yet to consider...
Visit: I was asked to extend a greeting on behalf of [F]. Now I have.
Level: I must outwit even death.
My reach cannot lag behind my ambitions!
It's not enough!
Summon: I am Edelgard, uniting emperor of all Fódlan. Whatever you seek, you may trust I have the reach to deliver it.
Learn Skill: With this power, I will cut my own path!
Confession:
Do not misunderstand, but... I want you. Your wisdom, your ability... But more than any of that, your heart.
The Adrestian empire united Fódlan. But that struggle was only the start. I have much work left to do.
There are many ready to come to my aid, but none like you. You are something special.
So, stay alive, and I will remain here until this world's strife is no more.
And when that time comes, I expect you will return with me to Fódlan. Reach for my hand. Promise me.
Status: The title of Emperor falls to House Hresvelg. However, that legacy ends with me.
Only you are brave enough to surpise the Adrestian Emperor.
Ancient practices, left unchecked, will rot the world.
I will create a world where all people are free, regardless of their bloodline...
Could you trust someone, even knowing they may betray you?
I have no regrets. But I sometimes wonder if things might have been different...
You will become the light that shines over this world...

ike5.name: Ike
ike5.title: Zeal Unleashed
ike5.description: Leader of the Greil Mercenaries. Overwhelmed with negative energy, the power is enough for him to lose control. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Rrrghh... My blood...courses through my veins like rivers of fire...
When I was a child...a calming lullaby was sung to me... Could that be what has kept me sane?
Mist, Soren, Titania... Stay back... That's...an order...
Father... One day, my strength will rival even yours...
Battle... I must temper myself in the heat of battle... Bring me the strongest among you...
Visit: I must leave this place... If I stay here any longer, I may...lose control...
Level: I won't lose to anything. ANYTHING! Least of all this rage inside me!
Where is my next opponent? Show yourself—now!
More... Give me more... The bloodshed has only just begun...
Summon: I am Ike. My blade...hungers. Point me toward something to fight.... Something that will fight back...
Learn Skill: This will...help me achieve my goal...
Confession:
You need not worry after me.
I seek the power to protect those closest to me. To protect... my friends.
If this rage swirling inside me can be forced into submission, then I will be worthy of wielding it.
But that is my struggle... I must tame this beast...make it my own. I cannot let myself fear it...
I will face it head on, and overcome it... That is what it means to be burdened with such power...
Status: I...am Ike. I lead the Greil Mercenaries...
Ugh! Don't touch me.
Wipe it all away. Everything...
Freedom... Chaos... Transformation... Future... Mystery...
If this continues... I will kill them all. I must... stop...
My father... Him, too... On that day... That day... He...
If I lose control... Stop me. I'm...I'm counting on you.

julia3.name: Julia
julia3.title: Heart Usurped
julia3.description: Inheritor of the Book of Naga. Manipulated by Manfroy, she has grown hostile toward Seliph. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Lord Manfroy's orders are...absolute. I cannot abide those that oppose him.
Julius... Brother... Cover this world in darkness... End...everything.
The arrival of the dark god, Lord Loptous...is upon us... It cannot be stopped...not by anyone...
The sacred text...Naga? I know it not! Cease your...vile corruption...
Lord Seliph... Lewyn... My head... It feels as if it's being split in two...
Visit: You must serve Loptous as well... as [F] does...
Level: All will be as Lord Loptous wills it...
Soon...all will be...covered in darkness...
So...cold... I cannot...move!
Summon: I am...Julia, servant of the great priest Lord Manfroy... Faithful disciple of Lord Loptous...
Learn Skill: With this power...the world will soon fall...to darkness...
Confession:
When did the world...become such a dark...and cold place...
There is only despair... Sadness and pain...
You accept that? Here...in this world?
The solution...is destruction. Yet... a strange voice echoes...through my mind... A warm voice...
Seliph... Seliph? Who...is Seliph? And why does the name bring... tears to my eyes...
Status: I serve only the great priest... Lord Manfroy.
Hmm? Are you not terrified of me?
I will dispose of all who stand in Lord Manfroy's way.
There is no way to stop the darkness encroaching on this world.
The almighty dark god Loptous will be reborn!
Seliph... This is familiar, but whose is it? Saying it, I feel a strange warmth...
I'm sure you will join me in celebrating the resurrection of our god, Loptous...

lyon2.name: Lyon
lyon2.title: Demon King
lyon2.description: Prince Lyon of Grado, having become a vessel for the Demon King Fomortiis's power. It is uncertain who directs his heart. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: When I sacrifice this flesh and return to my body of old...this world will be the domain of Demon King Fomortiis!
Is the Demon King controlling me? Or has he simply clawed his way into the dark corners of my mind?
The human heart is an abyss... Deep, dark, and full of hidden pockets in which jealousy can fester unabated...
I will grant all your dark wishes, Lyon. To crush Ephraim...to claim Eirika... Need I go on?
Ephraim, Eirika... Leave me! If you do not, I... No! I can't let it happen...
Visit: Rejoice. Embrace the darkness...
Level: My plans draw ever closer to bearing fruit... Yes, it will not be long now...
The resurrection of the Demon King is close at hand...
