How disappointing... To think this frail form cannot manage so simple a task...
Summon: I am the Demon King... I know nothing of human frailty. I am supreme...
Learn Skill: You would grant me...even further power?
Confession:
I know not by what power you managed to summon me here...but whatever your aim, it is too late.
This frail flesh is Lyon's no longer. That weakling's very soul has been all but consumed.
I see the remains of the foolish hope in your eyes. Such a spark should be easy enough to extinguish.
But perhaps a bit of fun first... This contract of yours binds me to battle your enemies, does it not?
Very well... But when the end comes, Askr and the rest of this wretched world will cower before me! Gehaha!
Status: Lyon, o prince of misery... This body is lost to you. It is mine to compel...
Hmph! Keep your wretched hands off me, human, or you may well lose them.
I've had my fun pretending to be human, but the need for charades has passed.
Do you really not know me? How poorly educated you are!
I am the Demon King... I know nothing of human frailty. I am supreme.
I will now grant you all of your darkest wishes!
...Hmph. Looks like I was wrong to disregard the value of human emotions.

mcorrin4.name: Corrin
mcorrin4.title: Bloodbound Beast
mcorrin4.description: A prince born in Hoshido but raised in Nohr. Within the blood coursing through his veins, a brutal presence lies sleeping. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I would have lost myself to despair a long time ago, had my brothers and sisters not held me back...
My dark impulses are growing... If this power hurts any of my friends, I don't want anything to do with it!
I did not ask for a power like this. But without it, I could never hope to shape my future as I might now.
If I hurt Azura again, I don't think I'll be able to live with myself, much less face the others...
What do you see when you look at me? Am I beast, after all?
Visit: I can't stay here. Where I go, death follows close behind... Forgive me if I leave suddenly.
Level: What enemy would test me like this? Am I simply a plaything at the mercy of fate's cruel whims?
The enemy...where are they? WHERE...ARE THEY? Grraaghhh!
Why does my body not move as I command it... Do even my flesh and blood rebel against me now?
Summon: I'm Corrin. Let me warn you. Terrible impulses stir within me, some I may be unable to keep in check...
Learn Skill: Which path will this power lead me down, I wonder?
Confession:
What is this power of mine, I wonder? Lately, I've been asking myself that more often than I'd like to admit...
To defend life, to resist oppression... Is that not a use of power, just like taking what you want by force?
Is this power of mine for protecting those dear to me...or for causing only suffering?
If there's one person who can help me to find the right way to wield this power, it's you, so—
Rrghh... Graagh! My blood...boils! I'm not sure I can hold back much longer... Please...
Status: I'm fine... I haven't been sleeping well, that's all...
Rgh... GET AWAY! Oh! I'm sorry... Please...I need to be alone...
That blood coursing through my veins... It grows restless.
I hate this! I am not a beast—I'm a person!
No matter what form I take, I will never harm you. I promise...
Should the time arise when I lose myself completely... Promise me you'll do what you must.
When I'm at your side, it's easier to...stay myself. Thank you...

ashnard.name: Ashnard
ashnard.title: Mad King
ashnard.description: The thirteenth ruler of Daein. Plotting to wield his power to rule without opposition, he plunges the whole continent of Tellius into war. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Heh... So, this is the medallion's true power? Come, chaos, and pour forth with rage! Seething, swirling rage!
In the world I have created, only the strongest may live. The sooner the weaklings perish, the better.
The light in which future generations view my works is dependent only on my ability to see my vision complete.
Class, rank...human, sub-human... None of it matters. The weak submit to the strong. THAT is peace.
Fly, Rajaion! Spare no mercy for the weaklings! Rend their soft flesh for your master!
Visit: I hope you put up more of a fight than [F] did.
Level: GGGRRAAAAAGGGGHHHH!!! GGRRAAAHH HAAA HAAA HAAA!!! ...It...feels...so...GOOOOOOD...
There is more, so much more... I have yet to tap into even a shred of my true strength.
This cannot be all the medallion has to offer, can it?
Summon: I am Ashnard, thirteenth king of Daein. I will change the very face of this world...with strength alone!
Learn Skill: Yes... More, MORE! Give me all the power you have to give...
Confession:
Order must be kept by a firm hand. The strong create the framework upon which a stable society rests.
Meanwhile, the weak meekly inhabit that stability, content with their scraps. That is my vision for rule.
So... What will it be for you? Will you follow or lead? Obey or command? Serve or be served?
The weak can only hope to survive by accepting their lot. Those who do not...must die.
Now, bring this world to its knees, and claim it all your own!
Special: I will bring the fight to you.
Status: Release your rage! Release your hate! Show me the fury you keep inside!
Who are you, dog? I have no time to spend on weaklings. Disappear.
Only those with power will be allowed to live. Hurry and die, weakling!
Despise me! Let your hate build and attack me with everything you have!
My sole desire is to rule through strength. The weak perish, and the strong live on...
Gawain's son... I'm looking forward to finding out whether or not you are worthy to face me.
I haven't seen all you are capable of... I'll enjoy my time here a little longer.

micaiah4.name: Micaiah
micaiah4.title: Dawn Wind's Duo
micaiah4.description: Sharing a mutual trust rivaling that even of siblings, they are dressed to participate in the festival activities. They appear in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.
micaiah4.duo:
Grants【Dominance】to unit and allies within 3 columns centered on unit. Inflicts Def/Res-7 on foes within 3 columns centered on unit through their next actions.
【Dominance】 Unit deals additional damage = total penalties on foe for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Micaiah**: Has he gotten...taller? Odd I hadn't noticed before now... Hm? Oh, don't mind me. Just talking to myself.
**Sothe**: No matter what comes, I will protect Micaiah. And if she marries, I, um...
**Micaiah**: This dress is like something out of a dream! I can't believe I get to wear it... What do you think?
**Sothe**: Micaiah—look out! Your hem might trip you as it is. Shall I cut it to your usual length?
**Micaiah**: This bouquet represents happiness. Brides toss it at the end of weddings to share their joy with others!
Visit: **Micaiah**: I was sent to give you this by your friend [F].
Level: **Sothe**: I will keep Micaiah safe. Always, and forever.
**Micaiah**: Is something wrong?
**Sothe**: Fear not, I will be your shield. I will not suffer even a finger laid on Micaiah!
Summon: I am Micaiah and this is Sothe. We're honored to have been invited to this banquet. So let's have some fun, hm?
Learn Skill: **Sothe**: Thank you. I will use this to ensure Micaiah's safety.
Confession:
**Micaiah**: Oh, Sothe, your collar is a mess... Hold still a minute. There!
...Is something the matter? You have the same face you get when you've been scolded by Yune.
**Sothe**: ...
...Can you smell it? Something smells...nice.
**Micaiah**: Oh, you must be smelling my flowers. The scent isn't overpowering, is it?
**Sothe**: Oh, no. Besides, nothing is too powerful to keep me from your side, Micaiah.
**Micaiah**: Oh, Sothe... Thank you. For everything.
If ever we're apart, know that in my heart, we will always be together like this.
Special: **Duo**: I want you by my side. I am.
Status: Giggle
• "Strange, isn't it?" • "A little..."
Conversation: **Micaiah**: Sothe, wait... You're walking a little fast. Sothe!
**Sothe**: Sorry...
**Micaiah**: I'm having a little trouble keeping up in all these frills.
**Sothe**: To be honest...all of this... I'm a little lost.
**Micaiah**: It's just a festival. There's no need to get all worked up over it. All the same...
**Sothe**: What is it?
**Micaiah**: Seeing you dressed like this... It struck me that I'm suddenly seeing you as the man you've become.
When I look at you, I think, "He could take care of someone. He could make someone truly happy."
**Sothe**: Micaiah, the only person I want to take care of is you. If there's someone I want to make happy...it's you.
**Micaiah**: Don't say things like that unless you really mean them.
**Sothe**: But I do mean it. I'm just being honest with you.
**Micaiah**: No, I know you are... It's just...
**Sothe**: I'll admit, I don't really understand why people get married. But if that's what it takes to stay by your side...
**Micaiah**: Oh, Sothe. That's enough...
**Sothe**: Micaiah?
**Micaiah**: We WILL be together. For now and for always. But getting married...that's not something we can just...just do...

But maybe someday, when we're ready...you can ask me again.
When the time is right...I want to hear you say those words.

oboro2.name: Oboro
oboro2.title: Fierce Bride-to-Be
oboro2.description: Hoshidan lancer and retainer of Takumi, she is participating in the festival in her handmade bridal attire. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I've made countless kimonos in my time, but I never imagined I would one day make my own bridal attire.
I hope my mother and father can see me right now...from on high.
Garments like these are for brides on their wedding days. A special occasion calls for a special outfit.
Look, Hinata's fixed up his hair for once! It's usually so long and scraggly.
No, of course I'm not marrying the Demon King! Don't joke about things like that!
Visit:
Wow, this would be a perfect spot for a honeymoon! ...Ah, why did I come here again?
Oh, right! I came to pass along [F]'s regards!
Level: This bodes well for my future!
I will stride proudly down the aisle!
Ah, there's a tear in my kimono. I'll have to mend it.
Summon: I'm Oboro of Hoshido, and I'm dressed as a bride for the festival! Do you think I pull off the look?
Learn Skill: I will learn to be a good partner, and a good hero.
Confession:
This might seem like it's coming out of nowhere, but, um...are you wed, [S]?
I was trying on wedding outfits, and I got to thinking about marriage. Seems like such a big decision.
I mean, your whole life changes! And what's more, THEIR whole life changes! It's not as simple as a crush.
You can have crushes left and right, no problem! Marriage, on the other hand, is so...permanent!
I'm just dressing up as a bride today, but if I ever become the real thing, it has to be with the right person.
Status: I'm Oboro of Hoshido. I've been looking forward to this for a long time!
Whoa! Don't startle me... Today of all days, I do not want to make that scary face!
What do you think of my take on bridal attire? I gave this one everything I had.
Hmm... I see a couple places where the stitches could use reinforcing. Here, and here...
A love that lasts for eternity... How wonderful. Some day, I hope to swear a solemn vow myself.
My ideal groom? Why not Lord Takumi? *mischievous laugh*
When it's your turn, I hope you'll come find me so I can tailor you the perfect wedding attire!

nailah2.name: Nailah
nailah2.title: Blessed Queen
nailah2.description: Queen of Hatari, a lost desert nation spoken of in legend. She's joining the festival ceremony with her partner Rafiel. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: The heron clan are truly statuesque. Witnessing my companion in wedding attire is nothing short of perfection.
Sandstorms are commonplace in my country of Hatari, so I haven't had the chance to dress like this before.
This bridal festival reminds me that Rafiel and I never exchanged official vows, despite being married.
It may seem surprising, but I am an aesthete. Matters concerning beauty and the arts deeply touch my soul.
Rafiel...If you leave this world before me, I'll never forgive you.
Visit: Will you come with me? A wedding ceremony is taking place at [F]'s castle.
Level: No matter how I dress, my combat prowess will always remain intact.
I will pursue happiness... No one can stand in my way.
Perhaps I was overconfident... I had better shape up.
Summon:
I am Nailah, ruler of the desert kingdom Hatari.
This bridal festival will provide some respite so I can celebrate the future of me and my partner.
Learn Skill: A wedding present, how kind. Thank you.
Confession:
By my hand alone, I have fought legions of warriors and reaped many spoils all in the name of my country.
There's no doubt that my greatest achievement is ruling over Hatari. However...
I never expected to encounter such a precious person on my travels as my dear, irreplaceable Rafiel.
My future lies with him because he cradles my heart. No matter the trials we face, together we will prevail.
My bond with Rafiel shall remain everlasting. Stand witness to our vows, [S].
Status: Wedding attire for a festival? How eccentric.
Don't be rude, now. I wouldn't want to use my fangs.
Rafiel is the ideal partner. He calms my nerves and keeps my heart at ease.
Well, what do you think? ...Hehe, Don't worry, I won't bite you. It's such a nice day.
Wearing an outfit as elegant as this truly warms my heart.
We mustn't idle. Bring my groom, with haste.
It's so nice to be all dressed up for once. I'm glad you can see me like this.

rafiel.name: Rafiel
rafiel.title: Blessed Wings
rafiel.description: Prince of Serenes, the destroyed heron country. Fell in love with Nailah after she saved his life. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Reyson, Leanne... All have blessed me. I pray for this happiness to continue.
Queen Nailah is naturally beautiful, but it's her kindness and refinement from within that radiate most of all.
I shall never take flight again, but I still have my voice. I hope my songs can reverberate throughout the world.
The kindness everyone has shown me... I am continuously moved to tears.
I'm inspired to sing a song of good fortune for the future of these brides and grooms.
Visit: I come bearing a wedding invitation from [F].
Level: Everyone's blessings give me strength.
Do not fret, I'm in good spirits today.
...I shouldn't overdo it.
Summon:
My name is Rafiel, a heron and survivor of the Serenes kingdom.
I came here at behest of the one I love and owe my life to.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I can feel this new strength flowing through me.
Confession:
Thank you for inviting me here. Askr is a wonderful place filled with caring people, [S].
After the Serenes Massacre, I trudged through the desert in agony believing my entire clan had been wiped out...
I had lost my ability to fly, but Queen Nailah offered me her hand, and with that, I pledged my life to her.
And now here, I reunited with my brother and sister and will partake in the lively wedding festivites.
My power may pale in comparison to other Heroes, but I'll give all I am to preserve the harmony of Askr.
Status: A song of blessing.
Love overflowing.
Have you seen my bride? She must look very beautiful...
After I lost everything, my queen restored my hope.
I hope that my brother and sister each find themselves in wedding attire in their turn.
You may say that this is a simple festival... but in this attire,  I am as nervous as a groom!
Receiving your blessing on this fine day makes me happy indeed.

hinata2.name: Hinata
hinata2.title: Samurai Groom
hinata2.description: Hoshidan samurai and one of Takumi's retainers. He is wearing clothes outside his usual in order to play the part of bridegroom for the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: If I ever settle down and have kids of my own, I'd want them to be samurai just like their pops!
Oboro and me were just arguing over who's more loyal to Lord Takumi... Heh. Some things never change, huh?
Might be hard to do katana training in this outfit. But hey, I'm not one to shrink from a challenge!
You like the duds? Oboro made them. She's from a kimono-making family, y'know!
I changed up my hairstyle for the occasion. Still looks OK, right? I gotta take care that it doesn't get mussed.
Visit:
Hey! Put your debauching face on! There's a big festival happening at [F]'s castle!
Why not come and join the party, [S]?
Level: I put the grrr in groom!
I'm getting used to this outfit!
Aw, come on! Where's the love?
Summon: Name's Hinata! I'm a samurai from Hoshido. Keep your trap shut about the outfit—they made me put it on.
Learn Skill: You made an honest man outta me!
Confession:
Listen, I'm gonna ask you something, and you gotta give it to me straight. Do I...look weird in these clothes?
Because lemme tell ya, I sure FEEL weird in them! Even thinking about getting hitched makes my head hurt.
My whole life's been about my katana, and serving Takumi. Never gave much thought to love.
I know it's just in fun, but these fancy rags feel like a big joke, with me as the punchline!
Ugh. Maybe I just gotta think of it as... practice. If I ever do find the right gal, I wanna make her happy, after all.
Yeah! This festival's my chance to train up! I'm gonna learn how to be the groomiest groom there ever was!
Status: I'm Hinata, of Hoshido. *pause* See somethin' funny? Laugh it up!
Waaah! I'm... I'm off-kilter today. Must be the clothes.
MARRIAGE? Look, I...I haven't given that any thought. J-just drop it. OK?
Lord Takumi's the one who should be wearing these clothes. He could pull this off, not me.
I'm skipping training today. Don't want to get my stink on the formalwear.
Yeesh... How did I get myself roped into wearing this getup?
Look, I don't really get the whole thing that's going on here, but… Whatever comes, I'll give you everything I've got.

mila.name: Mila
mila.title: Goddess of Love
mila.description: Goddess of Love and sister of the god Duma. She and Duma fought over the continent of Valentia and split it in twain. Zofia, the south of Valentia, is her domain. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I wish to bring peace to the people. I will never understand my brother's insistence on driving them to war...
Zofia is a warm, verdant land, where all can live in happiness. Paradise.
Whenever you tire, you may turn to me. Exhaustion is a kind of pain all its own... Let me soothe yours.
Come to the water. Speak with me. Tell me about yourself. I want to know all there is.
I do hope no misfortune befalls the people of Zofia in my absence...
Visit: Blessings of the goddess, on behalf of [F].
Level: I am overfull with the blessings of this world!
I shall redouble my efforts—the people depend on it.
Is my love...not enough?
Summon: I am Mila. I preside over Zofia and grant its people my love and blessings.
Learn Skill: This will be the people's power.
Confession:
As a goddess, I must guide my people and ensure all are treated with equanimity and live well...
But I sense you are different from those who seek my blessings.
In you, I feel I have found a worthy partner with whom I might share my eternal existence.
You and I have our own homes to return to, however. So let us just be thankful for the time we have now.
Status: I am Mila. I rule Zofia and offer its people my love and blessings.
You require a moment of respite? I will listen.
Duma and I split the land of Valentia between ourselves in pursuit of our own ideals.
Zofia is warm and rich in resources... Truly the paradise of my dreams.
Rigel is cold and harsh... The people suffer hardships simply to become stronger. What could Duma be thinking?
I do not hate Duma. We simply could not agree on a path to walk together. If not for that…
Accept my blessing... May the light illuminate your path.

mirabilis.name: Mirabilis
mirabilis.title: Daydream
mirabilis.description: A ljósálfr from Ljósálfheimr, the realm of dreams. She brings daydreams to mortals and sleeps during day and night. Always seems to have just woken up.

Castle Hall: It's so cozy here... I could sleep anywhere. Inside...outside...
Peony is a friend of mine. She sings me to sleep sometimes... She's very kind, isn't she?
My tummy is grumbling... Once it's full, then I'll really be ready for a nap.
Dökkálfar are scary, but...I don't know... Something about them is... *yaaaawn*...awfully familiar.
Mortals want to dream all the time, even when they're awake... I can understand that feeling...
Visit: Mmrgh... Hello? Oh, umm... I forgot what [F] said.
Level: Yay! ...Now I can get back to my nap.
*yaaaaaawn*
Mmrgh... Having trouble getting to sleep...
Summon: *yawn* ...I'm Mirabilis. If you don't mind, I'd like to rest just a bit more...
Learn Skill: Huh? ...You woke me up for that?
Confession:
A long time ago, when you had just been born, you were the cutest little baby... You don't remember, do you?
Sleeping is what babies do, day... *yaaaawn*...and at night too...
But because they sleep so much, they need someone to watch over them...like their mother or father.
When I sleep here now, I feel like I have you as the one who looks after me while I sleep...
And knowing... Having you there... helps me...*yaaaawn*...sleep. Just like a...
Zzzz...
Status: *snoring softly, soft startle awake, back to sleep*
Mmm... How lovely...
Oh...me? I'm the ljósálfr of the—*sudden yawn*...of day...dreams...*gentle snore*
Mm-yaah! Aww... I was almost asleep...
You work so much... Aren't you exhausted?
...Mmrgh... Mother... Father...
With you near, I always rest easy...

anna3.name: Anna
anna3.title: Secret Seller
anna3.description: A merchant who travels the Halidom of Ylisse. She has many sisters who share both her face and name. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: This world's Anna is in COMMAND? Huh... Knowing us Annas, these folks must've been through the wringer.

Yeah, I've heard about my sisters in other worlds—women with the same name and face as mine...
Oh, you want to know how it works? Well...that information doesn't come free, y'know!
Some children like sweets, some like books. Whatever the case, I've got it on sale! Happiness, at a bargain!
Would it be a problem if I opened up shop nearby? And not just to make a quick buck, I swear! ...Heh, heh.
I'm all for living in a peaceful place. Fewer bandits, fewer troubles, I say. Especially when transporting goods!
Visit: I'm Anna—and I have the finest wares this side of [F]'s.
Level: Record profits!
That's one step closer to becoming a master merchant!
Yikes. Nothing comes free, I suppose. I'll try harder.
Summon: Need of some wares? Fear not! Anna the Merchant, at your service. I've got the best deals anywhere—count on it!
Learn Skill: A pleasure doing business. I hope this little arrangement continues to bear fruit for us both!
Confession:
Listen up! I just came up with the best idea for a tournament... What do you think about...arm wrestling?
There are so many famous Heroes here, it'd be a shame to let all that star power go to waste, right?
A lot of 'em aren't too bad to look at either... Put a pretty face on some merch, and you're in the money!
Huh? What're the profits for? ...Oh! Well...all for the Order of What's-It... oh, Heroes! Yeah—trust me!
Just prepare yourself, because you're about to have more funds than your Commander'll know what to do with!
Status: Hi, I'm Anna. Just a simple merchant traveling from— Huh? Commander who? Never heard of her.
NO REFUNDS— Uhh... Can I help you?
I wonder if fighting tournaments are as popular here as they are in Regna Ferox...
Stick with me, and I'll fill your treasury. That's the Anna guarantee! (Huh, I should write that down...)
Ooh... There's no better feeling than a handful of coins.
What's gonna be the next big thing around here? Y'know, the thing that'll really draw in the coin.

You've earned yourself a special discount! Go on. Browse my wares at your leisure. (One-time offer. Restrictions may apply. Offer may change without prior notice, and probably at time of checkout. You break it you buy it.)

mustafa.name: Mustafa
mustafa.title: Plegian Champion
mustafa.description: General of Plegia. He is endlessly loyal to his king, but he is a military man who prefers a fair fight to besting his foes through trickery. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.
mustafa.artist: Kusakihara Toshiyuki (草木原俊行) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: My king followed a path he believed was just. Why he saw fit to choose that particular method, however...
We as Plegians acknowledged the exalt's sacrifice. My heart wept but I was duty-bound to carry onward...
When combat lulls, my thoughts turn toward my wife and son... I pray they remain in good health and spirits.
Heed my guidance: on the battlefield, you mustn't entertain doubt, for hesitation will lead to your downfall.
If a soldier is not prepared to fight at a moment's notice during peacetime, then all their training was for naught.
Visit: I am General Mustafa of Plegia. I come as an emissary of [F].
Level: Here stands General Mustafa of Plegia! If you wish to keep your lives, then you must win them!
This is my strength. This is my pride! Who amongst you dares to stand in my way?
For as long as my lungs breathe and my muscles move, I will fight!
Summon: I am General Mustafa of Plegia. Other than fighting I'm not good for much, but my strength is yours.
Learn Skill: You would entrust this to me? Thank you. I will see it put to proper use on the battlefield.
Confession:
Your command has been remarkable. I say this being a veteran of countless wartime campaigns.
Soldiers must obey their leader, of course, but imagine their relief when they receive competent orders...
You clearly understand that solid leadership is instrumental in keeping up morale, [S].
Should you ever lose sight of that or your humanity, your forces will crumble in an instant.
Treat your soldiers with respect, and we will fight to the ends of the earth for you...my word on it.
Status: I am General Mustafa of Plegia. Let us join forces.
*belly laugh* If you want a rise out of me, you'll have to try harder than that.
Let us avoid senseless slaughter. If you lay down your weapon, I will lower mine.
I'm fond of Henry. The lad reminds me of my son.
I would have rather not fought Prince Chrom—but it was unavoidable.
So these are the seeds of peace that you have sown, Emmeryn...
In this conflict, I find myself on your side. I take great pleasure in that.

sayri.name: Say'ri
sayri.title: Chon'sin's Blade
sayri.description: The upright and dignified princess of the Chon'sin dynasty. She has a direct approach and never forgives a crooked deed. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Humans are forged in the fires of adversity. So I learned by living hand to mouth, war to war.
The Valmese empire assailed my beloved Chon'sin, robbing its people of all but our hearts and souls.
To the devotees of Teaism, even a lifetime of study is not enough. Not to worry, though—I'm not one of them.
Though adversity may smother it, the flame of compassion is never dead in those who seek a brighter future.
I truly believe in the path I walk, though it diverges from my brother's. I shall soldier ever onward...
Visit: I am Say'ri, Princess of Chon'sin. I offer a gesture of solidarity on behalf of [F].
Level: A clean cut! My form is without fault!
Mastery comes not in a single day. I am satisfied with steady growth.
P'raps I have strayed from the path...
Summon: I am Say'ri, Princess of Chon'sin. My blade gives no quarter. I shall excise the tendrils of chaos at the root.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks. I shall devote myself to mastering this technique.
Confession:
Permit me ask you a question, trivial though it may sound. To your eye do I seem, ah...stronger?
You see, though my royal upbringing in Chon'sin was a joy, it was also, in a certain sense, limiting.
Meeting the great samurai of Hoshido and proud fighters like the Greil Mercenaries has opened my eyes.
Sparring with them, mentally as well as physically, has rekindled the warrior's passion in my soul.
Though the path ahead be long and arduous, I will persevere. For my fellow Heroes, and for you! I swear it!
Special: I take no pleasure in this!
Status: I am called Say'ri, and I fight with the Resistance against the Valmese Empire.
Fie, is this the proper approach to conversation among your people?
My homeland, Chon'sin, has quite a unique culture. I shall be happy to expound upon the differences, if it please you.
The Voice is wise beyond my ken. I am humbled to know that she considers me a friend.
'Tis my joy and privilege to put my study of the way of the sword toward the benefit of Askr.
I do not understand your thinking, Brother. Fie, why must you do the bidding of the Empire?
I, Say'ri, shall cut down your fiercest enemies. This I swear.

emmeryn.name: Emmeryn
emmeryn.title: Gentle Exalt
emmeryn.description: Kind and loving Exalt who rules over the Halidom of Ylisse. She is the sister of Chrom and Lissa. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: The smiles of the Askran people are a treasure unto themselves and a shining beacon for future generations.
I desire nothing more than a life of peace for Ylisse's people, Chrom and Lissa included.

Military force is vital, but that alone is not enough...
Empathy and tolerance must be the foundations of any path to tranquility.
I may not be so bold as to face Askr's foes head-on in battle, but I hope my restorative abilities can be of use.

Citizens do not live only to serve their country.
On the contrary, a country and its royalty, myself included, exist at their behest and for their benefit.
Visit: I am Emmeryn. Your friend [F] wishes that you find what you seek.
Level: May the world overflow with altruism.
Let us praise the goddess's hand in guiding us toward a path of steady growth.
Forgive my unbecoming performance...
Summon: I am Emmeryn. The Halidom of Ylisse is under my watchful eye. May our alliance be strong and fruitful...
Learn Skill: Thank you kindly. Your graciousness inspires me.
Confession:
Your dedication to Askr and empathy for its people is truly empowering.
As a summoner, you are blessed with immense power, but that quality alone is not what defines you.
I regard you as a leader driven by such an innate tenderness for others that your kindness is contagious.
From that behavior, good is born. It fosters resolve and determination among the people. A benefit to all.
Cherish that benevolence, for it shall illuminate the path you are meant to trek, [S].
Status: Are you alright?
May the gods protect you...
I am Emmeryn, Exalt of the Halidom of Ylisse. I hope I can be of some use to you.
I know that Chrom and Lissa must step into danger now and then. As their older sister, however, I feel entitled to worry.
I am feeling quite well. Did you suspect otherwise?
Even a small act of compassion can have a tremendous impact upon the world.
The Heroes are all drawn to your kindness. I should know... I am one of them.

gangrel.name: Gangrel
gangrel.title: Plegia's Mad King
gangrel.description: The King of Plegia, who thirsts for battle. Together with Aversa, he begins a war against the Halidom of Ylisse. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Wherever I go, it's the same story... A big, messy war that will bleed my enemies dry. Bwa ha ha!
There isn't a drop of royal blood in my veins. I got here with a hunger for power, not some musty birthright.
Look at these chumps with their guard down. If I wanted, I could have all their heads in a pile.
You can summon as much cannon fodder as you want? Perfect. I got a job in Plegia with your name on it!
You know what I do to fools who are all bark and no bite? I shut 'em up with a boot in the mouth!
Visit:
You really should work on your security. If I were raiding this dump, it'd already be a heap of ashes.
Be careful who you trust, eh? That's a little warning courtesy of [F].
Level: Gwa ha ha! I love putting runts right where they belong—in the dirt!
What, you got something to say? I'm just getting started, you'll see!
That's it?! Pathetic! Heads will roll for this!
Summon: It was you who summoned me, huh? I'm Gangrel, King of Plegia, and you'd best stay out of my way!
Learn Skill: If I see something I want, I take it, simple as that. Gwee hee hee!
Confession:
Normally, I don't have much to say to you, other than pointing out all the dumb decisions you make.
But there's something I must get off my chest before your foolishness gets you cut down.
You see, love, justice, destiny, all of that lofty trash—it's worthless if there's no bloodshed to back it up!
Don't let worthless emotions get in the way of cold, hard reality. These Heroes? They're pawns, not people.
You got power, so use it. ALL of it. Get your hands dirty, or you might regret that you didn't.
Status: I'm Gangrel, King of Plegia. You the summoner? *laugh* Thought you'd be taller.
You got a death wish or something?
If you're gonna ask me to fight, it'd better be a massacre worthy of my time!
There is a truth about the world we must all learn. A man is either strong...or he is dead! Bwa ha haaa!
Truly, the heavens smile upon mighty King Gangrel this day! Bwa ha ha ha!
Every man lives and dies alone.
When it's kill or be killed...life or death...that's when you know who you really are.

mia3.name: Mia
mia3.title: Harmonic Blades
mia3.description: Young swordmasters Mia and the ever-masked Marth. What destiny does summer hold for the two of them? They appear in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn / Awakening.
mia3.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Once used, Harmonized Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Harmonized Skill has already been used, unit can use Harmonized Skill again.
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Marth**: It's so hot. Maybe if I just took this mask off... Ah! But my identity! Ugh...
**Marth**: Why was I summoned with Mia, and why are we wearing swimsuits? What could fate have in store for us?
**Mia**: Should I say something to Marth? ...If that mask stays on, there'll be one WEIRD tan line underneath.
**Mia**: As warriors, we should compete! How about...a watermelon-smashing contest! ...I'm first up!
**Mia**: I've always wanted to try wearing an outfit like this... I have to show the other mercenaries!
Visit: **Marth**: I am Marth. If you are curious why I'm wearing this outfit... See this note from [F].
Level: **Mia**: Summer is my time of year! C'mon, Marth, let's have some fun!
**Marth**: I will not be caught off guard... regardless of the outfit!
**Marth**: My apologies! Is there...anything I can do to fix this?
Summon: Hi, I'm Mia—and this is Marth! Seems we share a connection... Our love of the beach in summer!
Learn Skill: **Marth**: A summertime gift? I will treat it with utmost care.
Confession:
**Mia**: This has been so much fun! Don't you agree, Marth? You enjoyed the beach too, right?
**Marth**: ...Yes, I did. Though, spending time at the beach in the middle of a war does give me pause...
**Mia**: No need for that. It's important to have fun once in a while—and this is one of those onces!
If we're always training and working and fighting, we won't have any time for enjoying ourselves!
**Marth**: Hm... You make a fair point. In that case, I'll follow your lead and do my best to have fun!
Special: **Duo**: It's a duel! I'm here too!
Status: Giggle
• "So, how do you like your swimsuit?" • "Appropriate to this adventure."
Conversation: **Mia**: Woo boy, is it hot!
**Marth**: Very much so...
**Mia**: OK. I don't know how to put this, so I'll just say it. Turns out you were a girl this whole time! Talk about a surprise!
**Marth**: Please do not make such a fuss about it.
**Mia**: Sorry! It's just...you've still got your mask on. It's a little weird, right?
**Marth**: Weird!? There are many masked Heroes. Are there not?!
**Mia**: Well, yes... But who wears a mask with a swimsuit?
**Marth**: I see your point. I had fervently wished to enjoy the ocean, but...
I suppose fate had something else in store. I'll go change out of this swimsuit immediately.
**Mia**: Wait, what? Why not just take off the mask?
**Marth**: That I simply cannot do. I must never reveal my face...
**Mia**: Uh, really? Really really?

**Marth**: Indeed. And I had so looked forward to building sandcastles, splashing in the waves... *sigh*
Now, if you'll excuse me, I shall go.
**Mia**: Hey, wait a minute! I didn't mean— You don't have to— Hey!
Look, it's a little weird... No, it's really weird! But that's OK! Let's just swim. Forget I said anything!
**Marth**: Are you sure? I thank you.
**Mia**: Don't worry about it! Come on, don't cry!

selena3.name: Selena
selena3.title: Sandbar Fluorspar
selena3.description: One of the Grado Empire's six generals, known as the Fluorspar. Her loyalty is unwavering, even under the summer sea's waves. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Soon I'll be back in my general's uniform and set to patrol the nearby villages. But until then...I'll endure.
Before this, I served as a knight in Emperor Vigarde's employ. And now I am expected to...relax at the beach.

From time to time, I wonder about that child who was so desperate to reclaim her dragonstone.
I wonder if I'll find one that resembles it on the beach. Sorry...I was just thinking out loud.
When heated, the fluorspar rock glimmers. Perhaps this summer I can emulate it to live up to my namesake.
Here, have a cold drink. Hm? I bear no ulterior motives. We are only sharing each other's company.
Visit: I am General Selena, Fluorspar of the Grado Empire. I bring summer tidings from [F].
Level: For the glory of the Grado Empire!
No matter what I wear or where I fight, the pillars of knighthood still guide my path.
The heat's making me sluggish... But I can't let it overcome me now!
Summon: I am General Selena, Fluorspar of the Grado Empire. Many battles await me. Beach battles, I've been told.
Learn Skill: With this power... Why, I feel like I could move oceans in his honor!
Confession:
Do you have a moment? I'd like to tell you about my birthplace.
I grew up in an impoverished village, the sort of place where many lost their lives to the cold, harsh winters.
As for me, I was saved by the grace and benevolence of Emperor Vigarde of the Grado Empire.
No matter the state of the empire, I will always cherish his gratitude and look fondly on those memories.
I'll admit, the warm rays shining down on me at the beach remind me of his majesty, for he was my sun.
Someday, I hope my presence can comfort others like that. Long may we shine in the summer sun.
Status: I'm still General Selena, the Fluorspar of the Grado Empire. Don't you forget it.
You'd best hold yourself back. I won't warn you again.
I'm not used to wearing impractical attire while fighting.
Beautiful...? Me? Surely we have more pressing matters to discuss.
I welcome the radiant sun. It's a far cry from the dreariness of my village in winter...
Ah, breathing in the fresh sea air would do well for His Majesty's health.
You taught me joy I had never known. For that, you have my sincerest gratitude.

lute2.name: Lute
lute2.title: Summer Prodigy
lute2.description: A young mage of Renais possessed of a rather unusual temperament. She is searching for signs of new magics among the summer sands. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Today, we'll find out empirically if increased sun exposure causes an increase in magical power.
Back in Renais, I spent every waking moment researching magic. There was no time for waterside frivolity.
Sunburn? Not a problem. I'm using an herb mixture from De Floris Mysticis to block the sun's rays.
People are prone to falling in love in summertime, you say? How strange. There must be some magical cause...
Who knew sunlight felt so pleasant against the skin? Hmm... On a scale of 1 to 48, I'd say my mood's at a 3.
Visit:
This castle's magic defenses would be more effective if arranged such that... Oh, excuse me. I forgot myself.
My name is Lute. I'm an envoy of [F].
Level: Drawing power from the sun like a garden, no less. I'm just that good.
This minor setback has simply stoked the fire in my belly.
Abysmal. I must return to the drawing board to rethink my approach.
Summon: I'm Lute, genius mage extraordinaire, currently investigating how swimsuits impact one's magical abilities.
Learn Skill: You ascertained that I'd have use for this? Good. You're catching on.
Confession:
My investigation into the correlation between skin exposure and magical ability has been quite fascinating.
I concede that sunbathing in this garb is rather more comfortable than toiling away in my stuffy laboratory...
However, all in all, this swimsuit has not resulted in any measurable change to my spell-casting.
In other words, regardless of the outfit I wear, my magical abilities are second to none.
You agree both work equally well, yes? I am—say it with me—just that good.
Status: Choosing a suitable swimsuit was no trouble for someone of my natural intelligence. It required minimal research.
Let me read you my dissertation. It's entitled "Good Reasons the Summoner Could Have for Constantly Interrupting Me." *ahem*
I have little practical experience swimming, but someone of my natural talent and superiority should be able to master the art in fewer than 10 minutes.
Exposure to sunlight is good for plants, whereas humans wither with overexposure... Fascinating.
My mood? On a scale of 1 to 48, I'd say I'm at a 12.
This outfit has heightened my enjoyment of the beach, but why? Surely one of these books holds the answer...
You're a prodigy of sorts yourself. Our time together has done wonders for advancing my research.

joshua2.name: Joshua
joshua2.title: Tropical Gambler
joshua2.description: A mercenary with a love for gambling. He's in the tropics hoping luck's tide turns in his favor. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: If I swindled someone under the sun's watchful eye, I'd get burnt. Better not take my chances.

What I wouldn't give for Jehanna's famous Audhulma ice blade right now!
Betcha one quick swing of that sword would cool this place down quick.
Watching the sun set with a drink in hand is sublime. Why, if Caellach were here we'd have a smorgasbord.
Why don't you take a dip and relax? When you're down on luck, the best remedy is enjoying a change of pace.
How much you wanna bet that I can slice this watermelon in two on the very first try?
Visit: Hey there. Fancy a coin toss? If you win, I'll tell you all about the big news from [F].
Level: It feels like the goddess of summer herself has blessed me with prosperity. I'm on a roll!
Sometimes you just gotta stop and feel the warm breeze.
Ugh. And I was betting on my luck to turn around this summer too!
Summon:
Beautiful weather and crystal-clear water... In a place like this, Lady Luck will surely shine her blessings on me.
What's that? Oh, the name's Joshua. I'm just a mercenary.
Learn Skill: Not too shabby. I'll surf this wave of good fortune all the way to the bank.
Confession:
My homeland, Jehanna, is a desert. Except for the southern ocean, it's all sand for as far as the eye can see.
Not like we don't know what the beach is, though. I mean, it's also full of sand, innit?
Gotta admit, the ocean breeze here makes for a pleasant stay. Just can't get too comfy, else I'll get burned.
I welcome the lulls as much as the adrenaline. Changes up the pace and gives time for my luck to recharge.
So let's make a wager. Heads, summer vacation continues. Let's see what dear Lady Luck has in store...
Status: I'm no stranger to heat like this. My homeland's practically a desert, after all.
I'm not cheating this time. I swear!
The beach, you say? Heh... Tourists are such easy marks.
Hey, throw some coin my way. Give me one week, and you'll see a major return.
Whew! Swimming is more tiring than it looks... Think I'll take a quick nap...
If only my people could witness this summer sea... My mother would have loved it.
Care to test your luck? No double-sided coins, just a good ol' fashioned swim race.

rhys.name: Rhys
rhys.title: Gentle Basker
rhys.description: A member of the Greil Mercenaries known for his gentle demeanor. He's taking to the battlefield in a swimsuit this time. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Just look how those waves sparkle. If only my parents were here to enjoy this beautiful scenery.
If I were sunburned, I'd be out of commission for a while, so I'm taking all the necessary precautions.
Take care you don't get too much sun exposure. Wouldn't want to wake up tomorrow with a nasty sunburn.
To be honest, I've never worn a swimsuit before. Am I doing it right?
Though sunlight is dangerous in excess, in moderation, it can palliate certain mental and physical ailments.
Visit:
Excuse me. My name is Rhys. I'm just checking in on you, like your friend [F] asked me to.
How are you feeling? Drinking lots of water to prevent heat stroke, I trust?
Level: Splendid! The temperate weather must be doing me some good.
Maybe if I push myself, I can swim a bit farther next time.
I'm feeling woozy... Perhaps I need to lie in the shade for a while.
Summon: I am Rhys. I may appear frail, but I'm one of the Greil Mercenaries. I heard we'll be fighting on the beach?
Learn Skill: Thank you. I'll always treasure this sweet summer memory.
Confession:
I can't thank you enough for taking me on this splendid outing to the oceanside.
The Greil Mercenaries were often ambushed at ports and beaches, so I was a little nervous at first.
But as it happens, the fresh air and sunshine have done my fragile constitution some good.
I wish everyone could be so lucky as to experience a refreshing day at the beach.
Maybe someday, if I can help you restore peace to this land, that wish will come true.
Status: Are you hot?
Take care out there!
The sun can be hard on your body. Stick to the shade and drink lots of water!
If my parents could see me healthy and having fun at the beach, they'd be so happy.
Shouldn't we take a break soon? I don't want anyone worried about me.
*breathing heavily* No, don't worry. I'm OK. I'm a little hot, but I'm ready to go!
The reason the beach is so much fun is because we get to enjoy it together.

seliph2.name: Seliph
seliph2.title: Scion of Light
seliph2.description: Inheritor of the sacred sword Tyrfing. Beside his half sister, Julia, he opposes the dark god Loptous and ends the Holy War. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Under the long and unjust rule of Loptr, the people needed a savior—and cried out for one.
The task thrust upon me has earned me many sleepless nights. I'd be lost without the support of my friends.
You seem fatigued... If I could share my strength with you, I would. As it is, you'll just have to get some rest.
I never felt like a prince... This feels as if I'm deceiving people somehow.
When training in Tirnanog as a youth, Shannan taught me much. Even now, my body moves on its own in battle...
Visit: I am Seliph. I've been sent with regards from [F].
Level: As Baldr's descendant, I shall do what I must to end suffering... Father, Mother, watch over me!
With the divine Tyrfing, I will shed light on the darkness of this world!
I do not fear. Even defeat cannot extinguish the light.
Summon: I am Seliph. I will shed light on the darkness of this world—with strength, courage, and the divine Tyrfing.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will do my very best to perform as you expect of me.
Confession:
When Emperor Arvis was defeated in Chalphy, I heard the voices of my father and mother...
My father told me to learn to know the sorrows of the people... At the time, I didn't understand...
After the battle of Grannvale, though, and having lived here with you and the other Heroes...I'm starting to.
Having the heart to understand the sorrows of others, and giving it form with your own courage and strength.
That is what it means to be a Hero, a true holy knight, the true light... A gift to those who come after us.
That is the kind of Hero I want to be. And I would like for you to help me, [S]. Thank you.
Status: I am Seliph. As king of Grannvale, I will build a new world.
Oh, it's you! You gave me a start!
A Legendary Hero? If that is what the people want, then I shall play the role.
People look at me as if... As if they are looking at a god.
Hate your enemy, and see only evil in them... Do that, and the fighting will have no end.
The power of the crusaders was actually that of ancient dragons.
With you here, this world can be saved. That's how I see it, anyway.

fbyleth2.name: Byleth
fbyleth2.title: Fell Star's Duo
fbyleth2.description: Byleth, a professor at the Church of Seiros's Officers Academy, and Rhea, the church's archbishop, enjoying a summer away. They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
fbyleth2.duo:
Grants【Desperation】to unit and allies within 2 spaces.
At start of every third turn, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Desperation】 Grants the following effect for 1 turn: "If unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack."

Castle Hall: **Rhea**: An archbishop must be sound of judgment, strict of word and deed. Still...everyone needs time to relax.
**Rhea**: I have not visited a beach since before I became archbishop. I had nearly forgotten the sea's beauty.
**Byleth**: I wonder if any students from the academy have made their way here today. I will have to keep an eye out.
**Byleth**: They certainly do a thorough job cleaning up here. I've not found a single lost item lying around...
**Byleth**: Askr must be home to all kinds of interesting fish. I should have thought to bring my rod along.
Visit: **Rhea**: Greetings, [S]. Your friend [F] hopes you are enjoying the sun.
Level: **Rhea**: I have faith that this power shall be applied toward the common good.
**Rhea**: Jeralt has trained you well.
**Byleth**: Take care of your skin, Lady Rhea. It would not do for you to burn.
Summon: I am Rhea, Archbishop of the Church of Seiros. Byleth and I hope to take our ease on the beach together.
Learn Skill: **Rhea**: Thank you for all of your efforts.
Confession:
**Rhea**: Have you enjoyed your summer thus far, Byleth? It must be a fine change of pace from the labor of instruction.
**Byleth**: Teaching is hard work. As much as I might miss the students, it is good to get a break.
**Rhea**: All the power in the world means little without the energy to use it.
A bowstring held taut too long loses its power to draw. It is much the same with people.
**Byleth**: Wise words, Lady Rhea. I agree that rest is essential. I'll be sure to get plenty of it while I can.
Status: So bright...
• "Care for a drink?" • "I would not refuse."
Conversation: **Byleth**: I could do with a break.
**Rhea**: We have played hard, haven't we?
**Byleth**: Been a while since I've seen a beach. How about you, Lady Rhea?
**Rhea**: Come to think of it, yes. It has been some time.
Tranquility of the sea... The caress of the waves... I had all but forgotten.
**Byleth**: Well, now we can experience it whenever we like.
**Rhea**: In this world, at least.
**Byleth**: Should we invite Seteth and Flayn next time?
**Rhea**: That would be lovely. The students should come along as well.
**Byleth**: All of them? We'd have our hands full.
**Rhea**: Yes, we have our share of troublemakers.
**Byleth**: All in good fun. Their hearts are in the right place.
**Rhea**: As is yours. You truly are...so kind. Just like...
**Byleth**: Hm?

**Rhea**: Oh, it is nothing.
Would you care to take a walk down by the water with me? I hear the fish in this area are resplendent.
**Byleth**: Of course.
**Rhea**: Come, then. Let us, for once, relax and enjoy life's simple pleasures.
Duo Skill: • "I'll handle this." • "Allow me to aid you."

dorothea2.name: Dorothea
dorothea2.title: Solar Songstress
dorothea2.description: The only member of common birth in the entire Black Eagle House. Her beautiful voice, honed over years, can harmonize with even crashing waves. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Outer beauty comes with advantages. But inner beauty is more important, don't you think?
Before the academy I was a member of the Mittelfrank Opera troupe. Yes, for a time, I was a songstress.
See Ingrid there, splashing around in her swimsuit? She looks so carefree. I'm not sure I can resist...
If only Professor Manuela were here. I'm sure she'd love the opportunity to flaunt some summer fashions.
What is summer for, if not being a little adventurous?
Visit:
Warm summer greetings from your friend [F].
Hm... I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do now. I can sing, if you like?
Level: I'm always striving for greater things.
I'm just warming up.
I need to rest my voice...
Summon: Dorothea Arnault, at your service. I'm a member of the Black Eagles at Garreg Mach Monastery.
Learn Skill: For me? How thoughtful.
Confession:
Blue waters, cool breezes. What a wonderful summer vacation this has been...gawkers notwithstanding.
Oh, don't get me wrong. I have no problem with the way people look at me. Quite the opposite, in fact.
In Fódlan, I have no title, no wealth. No Crest. Everything I got, I got by using the tools at my disposal.
My voice, my wit, and yes, my beauty. These are all crucial weapons in my battle for survival.
So, people ogling me in my swimsuit, their hearts going pitter-patter? That's exactly how I want them.
Status: Do you like my swimsuit?
Let's go take another dip.
Like what you see? It's rude to stare, you know.
Swimming works up an appetite. What do you say we bring some sandwiches next time?
Ooh! Cold! Oh, you're gonna get it!
I wish Manuela could be here to see all this. Maybe someday...
Would you be a dear and help me lotion up my back?

ingrid2.name: Ingrid
ingrid2.title: Solstice Knight
ingrid2.description: Daughter of House Galatea of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. Her summer outfit does nothing to dull her trademark diligence in any way. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Focus, Ingrid. A knight doesn't stop in the middle of training just because of hunger pangs.
Getting dolled up never appealed much to me. Instead, I choose to prioritize my pursuits as a knight.
Someone handed me a bowl of fried noodles. Did I look desperate? Well, I suppose they're mine now!
I borrowed a book from Askr's library before coming here. It's a pleasure to read while listening to the waves.
I hope Sylvain isn't skirt chasing and causing trouble... Who am I kidding? Of course he is.
Visit: Hello, I am Ingrid Brandl Galatea. I bring tidings and good food from your friend, [F].
Level: Hard work always pays off.
Can't let this heat get the best of me.
I'd like to blame this on the relaxing atmosphere, but it's just my own lack of preparation.
Summon: My name is Ingrid Brandl Galatea. I aim to become a gallant and noble knight. No sunny beach will distract me.
Learn Skill: One step closer to becoming a worthy knight.
Confession:
What a splendid beach! Fresh seafood, fruit, and ice cream. I can't say no to good food.
It's a stark contrast to that of Galatea, my home territory, where its citizens are no strangers to famine.
Now I feel guilty feasting on such luxury while my people continue to suffer... Is this really OK?
Oh, you're saying I shouldn't worry so much right now? I understand. Thank you, [S].
I'll use this time to gather my strength and focus on the prosperous future I hope to make a reality for Galatea.
Status: I'm Ingrid. Ready for a fun day at the beach?
The water's bracing today! Oh, refreshments? Don't mind if I do!
I understand the need for swimwear, but I much prefer my academy attire.
Swimming is a great way to keep your whole body in fighting shape.
My friends are always causing trouble. It's hard for me to completely relax.
I love swimming and sunbathing, but...when do we eat?
Looks like you've gotten a bit of sun. Come on, let's take a break in the shade for a while.

sylvain2.name: Sylvain
sylvain2.title: Hanging with Tens
sylvain2.description: Heir to the title of Margrave Gautier. Excited by the opportunity to show off in front of the ladies spending summer on the beach. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Ah, summer! Everyone cutting loose in the sun... What could be better?
There's all sorts of knights out there. Me, I want to be the kind who's beloved by his people.
You sure you don't want to put on a swimsuit? That summer breeze feels nice and cool on the skin.
It's nice to catch some sun between battles. Maybe I should've brought Dimitri. He could use a little R&R...
I take flirting seriously. It's gotten me out of more than a few life-or-death scrapes...and into some too.
Visit:
Well, well, a castle full of beauties! I'm here with a gift for you ladies, courtesy of [F].
Me. I'm the gift. So? Any takers?
Level: See? I'm not just eye candy!
I'm working on my tan!
Ouch. That burns.
Summon: Sylvain Jose Gautier, the next Margrave Gautier, at your service. Let's go have some fun in the sun.
Learn Skill: Guess you really like me, huh?
Confession:
Summer's all about catching sun, swimming in the ocean...and of course, chatting up ladies!
Hey, don't make that face! I'm not just womanizing for fun, you know. It's important training.
If I'm going to be a knight who's beloved by his people, I have to know my way around the human heart.
That means learning how to charm anyone, irrespective of my bloodline or Crest. You follow?
Good! Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some training to do with that woman over there.
Status: Let's make the most of our time in the sun.
Trying to get under my skin? Cute.
I won't ask if you like my swimsuit. I'll just say you're welcome.
We should've brought Dimitri with us. His Highness could use some R&R...
Swimming's fine, but a nap in the shade is more my style.
So many beauties to choose from. Where do I even start?
Let me know when you need a break. I'll have a drink and a towel ready.

lorenz2.name: Lorenz
lorenz2.title: Highborn Heat
lorenz2.description: Heir to the famously noble House Gloucester. Determined to conduct himself as his status demands, even on the beach. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I may be dressed quite down, but that is all the more reason to conduct myself in a manner befitting a noble.
Surely there must be at least one or two nobles in the Order of Heroes, yes? Hm? Did I say something funny?
Have you seen Lady Rhea? She is an absolute vision. Even Professor Byleth is...unexpectedly stunning.
You need not remind me to behave myself around the ladies. To a noble, proper etiquette is second nature.
No matter the heat, it would reflect poorly upon me to complain. It is my duty to set an example, after all.
Visit: I, Lorenz Hellman Gloucester, wish you a wonderful summer on behalf of [F].
Level: A satisfying result. Did you expect anything less?
A noble must strive to become the very picture of strength.
This is...utterly unbecoming.
Summon: I am Lorenz Hellman Gloucester. By the time your summer is over, that noble name will be unforgettable.
Learn Skill: How sensible of you to appreciate my excellence.
Confession:
Allow me to thank you for all you've done this summer. It has been tremendous, [S].
Someday soon I will need to return to my responsibilities. The Leicester Alliance needs me, after all.
With the future resting upon my shoulders, I must be ready to lead on a moment's notice.
But I do hope that my time here has been fruitful for you. Surely you have learned a thing or two, at least?
Go on, then. Summer isn't over yet. Get out there and show me you know how to enjoy yourself!
Status: A tropical retreat? Lovely. Let it never be said the Order fails to pamper its Heroes.
Hm? Oh, you may set the drinks down just over there. Thank you ever so much.
Worry not, ladies. I am still available.
Do you need protective lotion? I've brought plenty. A noble's skin must be kept pristine, you know.
Even a noble needs a break now and then. A dip in the sea may be just the thing.
To find the analogue of your beauty in nature, I can turn only to the...anemone? Ugh, that's awful—marine metaphors are not my strong suit.
To lay down the burdens of responsibility, even for a little while, and just enjoy the sun... What a pleasant diversion. Thank you.

mkris.name: Kris
mkris.title: Unknown Hero
mkris.description: Hails from the Altean village of Sera. Leader of the 7th Platoon, a group of newly appointed knights. Serves Marth as a royal guard. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Luke, Roderick, Cecil, Ryan...and then Katarina of course... I hope all my old platoonmates are well.
Prince Marth lost his country and his father. He carries a pain shared by every Altean atop his own.
My grandfather said if I wanted to truly serve Altea, as he did, there was one thing I must never do: cook.
As a royal guard, my duty is to keep Prince Marth safe. Even in unfamiliar worlds, that remains true.
HAH! ...Heee-YAH! ...Having fun watching from the sidelines? That's what summoners do, I suppose...
Visit: I am Kris, of the Altean royal guard. This is for [S].
Level: My grandfather always said power without a path is mere brutality. That is why I follow Prince Marth's path!
In time, we will be victorious. Prince Marth will rule a world at peace.
It's a good thing my grandfather isn't here to see this...
Summon: I'm Kris, knight of Altea and royal guard to the hero Prince Marth. But...you can just call me Kris.
Learn Skill: I can make use of this. Thank you.
Confession:
Does the power to summon make one strong? Strong enough to slay even the most fearsome dragons?
That's why I train. I want to be just as strong as the heroes I admire.
But the joy of getting stronger leads to wanting more and more, and along the way I've come to crave battle.
Grandfather warned me about power without principle... As I get stronger, I wonder if I may stray from the path.
But possessing a heart that can resist the draw toward darkness...that's the mark of a true hero.
Naturally, Prince Marth has such a heart, but...I sense the same in you. So, I'm happy at your side.
Special: This is what I've trained for.
Status: Well met. I am called Kris. I hail from Sera. It's a small village, but it's home.
Whoa! Is this how you train knights?
My grandather was a knight, and he taught me of battle. He was rather strict about it, truth told.
Do you read a lot of books? Might you lend me a treatise on tactics? I'd appreciate it.
My allies are remarkable people. After the War of Shadows, they didn't falter.
Would I protect Prince Marth, I must become stronger still.
Though I could be stronger, I truly wish to help.

fkris.name: Kris
fkris.title: Unsung Hero
fkris.description: Hails from the Altean village of Sera. Leader of the 7th Platoon, a group of newly appointed knights. Serves Marth as a royal guard. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I wonder if my other platoonmates are doing all right. Luke, Roderick, Cecil, Ryan...and Katarina too.
Our platoon was commanded by the bull of Altea, Lord Cain. He's a man worthy of admiration.
My grandfather said if I wanted to truly serve Altea, as he did, there was one thing I must never do: cook.
I'm royal guard to Prince Marth, even in an unfamiliar world. It feels natural for me to be by his side.
Lord Marth is a truly kind man. Scoundrels may look to take advantage, but I won't allow it.
Visit: I am Kris, royal guard of Altea. Here. This is for [S].
Level: My grandfather always said that true strength is fighting for others. I'll fight for this world—and for Prince Marth!
I fight with a purpose. Thoughtless violence should not be condoned.
...Huh?
Summon: I'm Kris, knight of Altea and royal guard to the hero Prince Marth. But...just Kris is fine.
Learn Skill: Aha! This must mean you have confidence in me!
Confession:
What do you think things will be like five years from now? Or ten years!
I believe my lord, Prince Marth, will be king of Altea, and he will rule over a world at peace...
And by then, surely Caeda will have borne children, and she will be raising them to be kind and strong...
"True strength is fighting for others." ...I think I may finally understand what my grandfather meant by that.
Just as I'd give my life for Prince Marth, now I fight for you. And by fighting for you, I fight for this world.
Status: I am Kris, royal guard to Prince Marth of Altea. Well met.
Ah! Careful! What if I had been ready to strike?
Wake and go for a run before dawn breaks. It can lift your mood thousand-fold.
When I cook, the food tastes of iron. Where do I go wrong?
To fight someone is to know them. Spar with me!
Whatever harm might befall me, I will safeguard Prince Marth.
I have long wished to be someone who fights to protect another. And now, I fight on your behalf.

julian.name: Julian
julian.title: Tender Thief
julian.description: A reformed thief who takes the War of Shadows as a chance to atone for his crimes. Lives and works in a convent with Sister Lena. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: That Rickard... Kid's got potential. If only he'd put in a bit more effort. Nah, I guess that's just the way he is.
There's been rumors about a ghastly priest wandering around near my village. Hope it's not a bad omen...
Leave the scouting to me! While you take a breather, I bet I can even find out the location of the secret shop.
I-it's not like that with Lena and me. I just... I'll put it this way: I'd go to the ends of the earth to protect her.
A little turn of the lock like that and... it's open! Even though I quit thieving for Lena's sake, I can't get rusty.
Visit: Hi, I'm Julian. I'm one of the good guys, don't worry. Take this from your buddy [F].
Level: No matter what, I'll protect Lena. That's the purpose of my strength!
Not bad, eh? Think I'm getting the hang of using weapons.
Damn, if I don't do better...
Summon: Hey, I'm Julian. You troubled? I might have some advice if you wanna confide in me.
Learn Skill: Fighting isn't really my expertise, but this should help me do my part.
Confession:
Hey there. We did good work today, don't you think? Even if the world's in a tough place right now.
Gee, the Heroes really are something. Some can take out a foe in one hit! If only I had that kind of strength...
What, did you think I was going to say I'd steal a secret technique? No way! I've had a change of heart.
Now, I'm just a guy who works at a monastery helpin' kids who lost their parents during the war.
In order to protect the ones you love, you gotta fight. So that's why I'm at your service, [S].
Special: I won't go easy on you.
Status: Julian, at your service. Used to be bad, but I got better.
Hey, relax. I've washed my hands of thievery.
You can thank Lena for knocking some sense into me.
I don't think Rickard'll ever straighten himself out.
If there are two people I trust, they're Kris and Prince Marth.
I'll be strong for Lena, no matter what. Even if we can't be together.
Helping people's how I make up for the things I've done. So let me help you.

lena.name: Lena
lena.title: Tender Angel
lena.description: A cleric revered as Macedon's Angel. Cares for orphans in her convent after the conclusion of the War of Shadows. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: When I recklessly rush in to help others...when all seems hopeless...he is always there to protect me. Always.
Prince Michalis had admirable ideals but is a man of little patience. I cannot accept what he has done.
Nothing can go well if your heart is not at peace. So please, get some rest and calm your nerves.
Have you eaten yet? Even if you're in a hurry, be sure to eat and stay hydrated, [S].
I always cause so many problems for Julian. If I were to go missing again, he would surely worry.
Visit: Greetings. My name is Lena. I hope your friendship will stay strong with [F].
Level: We must all extend compassion to each other to prevent needless loss of life.
Have courage so that we can walk steadfast on a path that we believe in.
Please forgive my inexperience...
Summon: My name is Lena. If you are ever feeling troubled, please allow me to assist you.
Learn Skill: I thank you. May the gods' blessing be upon you.
Confession:
Despite countless days of war in another world, everyone in the Order of Heroes stays so positive.
Their smiles cannot be taken for granted, and their togetherness serves to console others.
I too have found myself in danger before but have been saved by the beaming faces of my loved ones.
Your tireless dedication to supporting the Order hasn't gone unseen... However, who is supporting you?
Let me extend warmth and a smile whenever you need help. I think Julian intends to do the same.
Status: You're safe with me.
There is no cause for worry.
My name is Lena. I will assist you however I can.
However frightening my experiences have been, my love for Julian has always seen me through.
I am a cleric. I cannot bear to watch others come to harm when I have the power to help.
Julian... I am so sorry to have been a burden.
Whenever you are hurt, I will be there to heal you.

eremiya.name: Eremiya
eremiya.title: Bishop of Woe
eremiya.description: A bishop in service of Gharnef, and leader of a group of assassins. Formerly a kind-hearted caretaker of war orphans. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Everything Lord Gharnef desires... Everything as he commands...
Eradicate the filth of this world... Yes, I understand my orders.
It would be good if my master could also have the clerics of Askr as well.
My children are troublesome trash... However, even trash can be put to proper use.
The brighter a light shines, the deeper darkness becomes... I tried my best...for the children.
Visit: I was asked to visit your castle... No... I was not ordered to assassinate you by [F] yet.
Level: Descend into the dark abyss...
Ugly filth that walk the world... Fear me.
I...have no excuse. I have betrayed your expectations...
Summon: I am Eremiya. Ehehe... It goes without saying, but I shall carry out my duty as you wish.
Learn Skill: Yes, yes. I understand. Henceforth I will demonstrate how I can set a good example.
Confession:
Abandoned children... Such meaningless trash. And who was it that saved discarded trash like that?
It was I... Through the guidance of Lord Gharnef...
Shrouded in darkness at the bottom of the deep Abyss... My children grew to become strong and proper "dolls."
How about I give you a taste of fear deserved by wicked adults? Let this ugly world wallow in eternal despair!
And you, standing before me... You too will become one of my many children, [S].
Status: How pitiable…
Go on now. Fight!
Everything as Lord Gharnef commands...
*laughs* Until you break, my little doll...I'll find a use for you.
Katarina? Oh, you mean Reese. Perhaps a more fitting name for her would be "traitor."
All those children died... They died...
You're such a sweet child, and I will make use of you. In fact, I'll use you until there's nothing left.

hel.name: Hel
hel.title: Death Sovereign
hel.description: Sovereign of Hel, the realm of the dead. Her power increases as the ranks of the dead grow. She aims for all the living to enter her realm.

Castle Hall: How tasteless... That, in your hand. Is that the weapon that undid me?
I draw strength from death. Pain and despair sing to me. All the world will join the chorus of the dead...
Eir's countless lives have dwindled all the way down to the very last one. My power thrums with their number.
I am death. Your reason and meaning are nothing to me.
All who oppose me will feel the fear of death etched into their marrow as they join the cohort of the dead...
Visit: The hour of your death draws nearer.
Level: I will deliver suffering and death to this world.
No time to think in the face of death. It is meaningless...
You are cursed.
Summon: I am Hel. I rule the realm of the dead. You cannot fight death, so you would do well to accept your fate...
Learn Skill: The time of the dead is upon us...
Confession:
No matter what you might accomplish in life, all living beings have the cold realm of the dead waiting for them.
Nobody can run from death. As soon as life is granted, the hourglass's sands begin to fall away...
Someday, death will swallow even you, and the memory of your deeds, your whole existence, will fade away.
Knowing that...you continue. You persist. Without hesitation, you struggle against destiny.
I will stay to watch you struggle... Until that moment your body goes limp and cold, I will watch, waiting.
Status: I am Hel, and I rule over death. Every death, and the realm of the dead.
Hmm? Are you asking something of me?
Above all else, I would see all of the living join the ranks of the dead.
All will die. None can deny the truth of that.
There is an imbalance between the living and the dead. We must bring equilibrium.
Hmmm. I can see what remains of your life.
Do you hope to grasp death, to control it? You?

veronica3.name: Veronica
veronica3.title: Harmonic Pirates
veronica3.description: Veronica, princess of Embla, and Xander, crown prince of Nohr. They're joining the pirate festival for insight into their peoples' hearts. They appear in Fire Emblem Heroes/Fates.
veronica3.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Shields】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Once used, Harmonized Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Harmonized Skill has already been used, unit can use Harmonized Skill again.
【Resonance: Shields】 Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."

Castle Hall: **Veronica**:We are the Embla Pirates. Surrender your treasure, if you want to live...
**Xander**: The pirate is the very antithesis of the knight. This is uncharted territory for me.
**Veronica**:To see Xander dressed so differently is strange, but...in a way, encouraging.
**Veronica**:What am I supposed to do next? Search for treasure, or some such?
**Xander**: I'm not going to take the pirate act overboard. Swimming is not my strong suit.
Visit: **Veronica**:I am Veronica, pirate princess. Your friend [F] is a member of my crew...
Level: **Veronica**:A princess among pirates... I could get used to the idea.
**Xander**: Who would have thought that playing the part of a pirate would become so enjoyable?
**Xander**: The price of freedom, I suppose.
Summon: I am Veronica, Princess of Embla. Xander here will explain why we are dressed as pirates.
Learn Skill: **Veronica**:I get what I want. As a pirate should.
Confession:
**Xander**: So, Princess Veronica, have you learned what it is to be a pirate?
**Veronica**:To live without limits. To sail upon the open sea, free from rules and regulations.
The yearning for that freedom is the idea behind this festival. That much, at least, I can grasp.
**Xander**: It is good for a leader to have a firm understanding of all walks of life.
**Veronica**:True enough. Then I will indulge in this freedom a while longer...
Special: **Duo**: Your life is forfeit! We mean you no harm.
Status: Sigh...
"Let's take to the high seas!" "But...I cannot swim."
Conversation: **Veronica**:Xander...
**Xander**: Yes, Princess Veronica? What is it?
**Veronica**:These clothes...
**Xander**: Ah, yes. This is the garb of pirates from another world. It seems that there's a festival on, and this is the costume.
**Veronica**:Why are we pirates? ...Is it supposed to be fun?
**Xander**: Perhaps not fun, per se, but...consider this: your people will take heart to see you throw yourself into the role.
They live lives of hardship, day after day. This will bring them joy.
**Veronica**:Embla holds festivals too. I know the people do enjoy them...
I've never participated, just watched. And without my brother...I don't know what to do.
**Xander**: There is no need to fret, Princess Veronica. Instead, view today as an opportunity to learn.
**Veronica**:Learn what exactly?

**Xander**: Well, to lead the people, you must come to understand them.
How better to understand the commonfolk than join their celebrations?
**Veronica**:You're right, Xander. But…what about right NOW? I still don't know a thing about pirates.

**Xander**: Er, well... Now that you mention it, I know little of them myself.
But that is inconsequential! Let us find someone who does and inquire.
The Order of Heroes has summoned so many to Askr. Why, some may even be pirates themselves!
**Veronica**:Is that so? Hmm. I suppose talking to them could be fun.
**Xander**: *chuckle* Well then! Take my arm, Princess, and let us be off!
Duo Skill: "I'll handle this." "'We'll handle this,' you mean."

geese.name: Geese
geese.title: A Life at Sea
geese.description: A former merchant captain. Prevented by war from pursuing his business, he reluctantly took up piracy for a time. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I mentioned we were pirates, but I originally ran a legitimate shipping company before the war.
I used to have a brother, and let me tell ya, he fit the role of a pirate far better than me.

You know when you're sailing into the sunset and for a split second the ocean glows like gold?
I live for that moment.
If you need anything for the festival, just holler. I'll have it delivered in no time, [S].
I keep my promises 'cause trust isn't something gold can buy. That's what I learned working the family business.
Visit: Hello. I'm Geese. Your castle's on one of my trading routes. I've got a parcel from [F].
Level: Feels good to be able to help people for once!
Not a bad return on investment.
Some days you get clear sailing, others you get some chop.
Summon: I'm Geese. I was never a pirate by choice, but if it's for a festival then I guess that's all right...
Learn Skill: You've got a good eye. I can tell you know what you're doing!
Confession:
My crew an' I used to run an honest trading business. But we had to turn to piracy to keep food on the table.
That life isn't all it's cracked up to be, you know. It's not like the stories.
Seizing innocent ships, stealing, and killing... The role of a pirate truly never suited me.
But if there's no bloodshed here and we're just going to drink and sing, then that's fine. I'll try to be merry.
Hopefully one day I can sail on peaceful waters again. Yeah, that's the dream.
Status: The name's Geese. You could call me a pirate, but I'm more a victim of circumstance.
Need something?
Might be hard to believe, but I used to captain a merchant ship. I've been everywhere the waves can take me.
My targets are typically those who can afford to lose their precious baubles.
Come again? There are people who...pretend to be pirates? I will never understand all the festivals of this world...
Saving a life is more satisfying than raking in even the biggest plunder.
You're always welcome aboard my ship. If you ever visit my world, I'll show you how beautiful the sea can be.

brigid2.name: Brigid
brigid2.title: Orgahil Pirate
brigid2.description: Gallant and determined, she was separated from her family as a child and raised by a pirate leader. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Apparently there's a hero in this castle who looks just like me? I should go and greet them!
My crew's a chivalrous bunch! Don't go lumping us in with other pirates. We're different.
The Orgahil Pirates refuse to take on dishonorable work. Assaulting the innocent would go against our code!
Although gallant, a pirate is a pirate. If I'm caught, I'll be hung, and I've prepared myself for that fate.
My family is my crew. That's because I don't know much about my past before the captain picked me up...
Visit: Brigid of the Orgahil Pirates is here! Want to hear about the pirate festival from [F]?
