Level: Did you just see that skill?! What a feat!
Land or sea? I won't lose! Doesn't matter the terrain.
The wind's blowing from the wrong direction...
Summon: My name is Brigid from the chivalrous Orgahil Pirates. Let's raise the sail and take off!
Learn Skill: You're giving this treasure to me? How generous of you!
Confession:
So, what do you think? Is a bona fide pirate different from what you expected, [S]?
Even though we go by that word, our crew only takes from rich scoundrels. Then we give it all to the needy!
Our moral code is what sets us apart from other pirates on the sea. I take pride in it.
When I see the look of appreciation on the faces of those we help, I know we did the right thing.
And I plan to continue on this path with the rest of my crew as the leader of the Orgahil Pirates!
Status: My name is Brigid. I command the Orgahil pirates.
You've got guts. I'll give you that.
I won't prey on the weak. That's where I draw the line.
Keeping these ruffians in line is no easy task.
A pirate festival? You do know I'm a real pirate, don't you?
I recall precious little of my childhood.
You've got a good head on your shoulders. What would you say to joining my crew?

tibarn2.name: Tibarn
tibarn2.title: Shipless Pirate
tibarn2.description: King of Phoenicis, the nation of the Hawk Tribe of laguz. Swooping in just in time to participate in the pirate festival by coincidence. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Blues skies, blue seas. Me? I like both as long as I'm feeling free.
We're not like Naesala and those folks from Kilvas. That lot's nothing more than a bunch of pillagers.
We're not your typical pirates who pillage anybody. Our cause is revenge against the humans of Begnion.

I love a good breeze, be it off the sea or when I'm soaring among the clouds.
Say, ever been rocked to sleep on a boat? You should try it.
This pirate diet of salted meat and biscuits is great! It's exactly the kind of food hawks like me eat back home.
Visit: I'm Tibarn. Just in from a festival at [F]'s castle!
Level: Flawless victory! Now, let's hear a war cry!
You won't get away so easily.
Red sky at morning, sailors take warning... Must be why I'm feeling apprehensive right now.
Summon: I'm King Tibarn of Phoenicis. A pirate...festival? Beorc sure do have a lot of strange holidays.
Learn Skill: I'm honored! I won't let you down!
Confession:
Those Begnion ruffians call US pirates but it's they who are the real thieves!
They killed innocent herons and burned down forests... And so we'll have our revenge as "pirates."
But don't think I'm not enjoying myself at this quaint festival. Even while donning these clothes...
Different kinds of beorc exist. Not all of 'em think the same. In times like these I can surely recognize that.
I wonder how this festival compares to others. I hope you will show me all of them, [S].
Status: Call me Tibarn. I've been told Beorc pirates wear this kind of outfit...
Huh? Oh, you'd like to don pirate garb, too. Is that it?
Aye, the "Shipless Pirates" was my crew. Everyone knew us but it was Begnion who truly feared us.
Those landbound Beorc can't cross the ocean except by ship… What a shame.
Understand this: we've got our reasons for what we do, but rampant plunder isn't one of 'em.
Nobody crosses my waters without my say-so.
Festivals are lively, aren't they? I think I'll enjoy myself a little longer.

darros.name: Darros
darros.title: Seawalker
darros.description: A fisherman whose circumstances led him to a life of piracy. He's not proud of it, but the festival is different. Appears in Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon & the Blade of Light.
darros.origin: Shadow Dragon & the Blade of Light

Castle Hall: Fancy a bite o' seafood? Leave it to me! I got more than enough fish to go around.
I'm mighty grateful to Prince Marth. He's saved these old bones more times than I can count!
By the barnacled blade o' Shanty Pete, this be the cleanest castle I ever saw! Who swabs the place?
Rowdiness is one thing, but wasting food I can't abide. You best eat your fill and then some!
There ye have it, a nice haul of grub for the festival... Well? These fish aren't gonna eat themselves!
Visit:
Ahoy! The name's Darros! I'm here to spread word of a festival over at [F]'s.
Being a pirate festival, it was only natural they invite a man o' the sea such as meself!
Level: Don't much care for bloodshed, but I be happy to help the crew.
Raise sail!
That leaves a briny taste in me mouth.
Summon: I be Darros, a simple man o' the sea. My pirating days are behind me, but just this once... Aye, I'll join in!
Learn Skill: That's mighty kind of ya!
Confession:
I used to lead a fisherman's life, living off what I could catch...till one day I was boarded by pirates.
Thought I'd have to fight 'em, but they mistook me for one of their own, so I ended up joining the crew.
Mostly I worked below deck, doing odd jobs, but I feel guilty about those days all the same...
Anyhow, thanks to Prince Marth, I left the life of a sea dog behind, and now I'm back on an even keel.
This festival's more than enough pirating for me, hehe!
And if I run into any pirates who want out o' the plundering life, I'll be sure to help 'em change course!
Status: Ahoy, I be Darros, a simple man o' the sea.
Avast! I haven't the patience for this...
I need to start over. Earn myself an honest living.
I committed a good deal of grave sins in my pirating days...
The life of a pirate isn't something to be proud of, but a festival could be fun...
I owe everything to Prince Marth. He was never one to cast me off.
After the fight is over, why don't we cast off on my ship? I'll set out some tasty food for ya.

dimitri2.name: Dimitri
dimitri2.title: King of Faerghus
dimitri2.description: King of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. Although he lost himself for a time, he now walks the path of a great ruler. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Professor... I humbly ask for your guidance as I make my way in this new world. I still have much to learn.
For better or worse, whatever her path, Edelgard has possessed an unstoppable will since childhood.
Askr's royalty sets a fine example. I hope someday to be half as loved by my people as they are by theirs.
The sins I bear will follow me forever. I can only continue to atone and put all I have toward defending my allies.
The greatest monument to honor those who have lost their lives is a world free of oppression.
Visit: I am Dimitri, King of Faerghus. I bring wishes of good luck in battle from [F].
Level: From here forward, I will walk a righteous path. Upon my lance, I swear it.
Saving lives is the only moral purpose to which I can put my strength.
I must become stronger than this if I wish to achieve my goals...
Summon: I am Dimitri Alexandre Blaiddyd, ruler of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. I wield this lance for my people.
Learn Skill: I will use this power for the sake of my people. You have my gratitude.
Confession:
I once lost myself in a storm of vengeance. That storm claimed many lives.
But the voices of my friends, and the people, whom my father left in my care, brought me back from the brink.
The man who stands before you, thanks to them, is a man who has finally found his path.
For the sake of Faerghus, and for all Fódlan, I swear that I will never lose my way again.
Please, [S], hold me to my vow. Help me be a righteous king.
Status: Seeing myself in the formal attire of the King of Faerghus will take some getting used to.
My position seldom leaves me time for frivolous conversation.
My road to redemption is long, but I hope to be something like my father by the end of it.
However ambitious the goal may be, a world free from oppression is worth fighting for.
The people put their faith in me. I must not disappoint them.
Though some sins cannot be forgiven effort to redeem oneself is never wasted.
Allow me to shoulder some of your burden. It would be my honor.
Yggdrasill's Healing Hands... I really don't think this is right for me.
You are the only one bold enough to do this to the king of Faerghus.
When it comes to animals, I am most comfortable around horses.
I have no siblings, but I have allies I grew up with who are like family.
The abilities of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands are of great value. Enough that I think my kingdom would benefit from them as well.
Forging a better future... That is how I can atone.
The bond you and I share is special to me. I hope to continue fighting at your side.

claude2.name: Claude
claude2.title: Almyra's King
claude2.description: Fought as the leader of the Leicester Alliance, but is also a member of Almyra's royal family. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: It's been a while since I've seen Teach with that hair color. Makes me feel like a kid again.
After seeing him fight up close, I get why they call Dimitri the Tempest King. He really is like a windstorm.
Nice work on patrol. Diligence like yours is hard to come by. I can see why your allies rely on you.
Each of us is weak on our own. Our strength comes from reaching out and opening our hearts to each other.
I hope someday to live in a world that cherishes differences in race and belief. Everyone's valuable.
Visit:
So you're [S].
You seem about as sharp and capable as [F] said.
Level: History's written by the victors. That's just a fact.
Can't afford to dwell on hard feelings. This is war, after all.
Looks like I slipped up! I'll make up the slack next time.
Summon: I'm Claude von Riegan. As King of Almyra, I forged peace with Fódlan. Happy to do the same with you.
Learn Skill: Thanks. You won't regret this choice, I promise.
Confession:
There you are. I've got a request for you, and I'll give it to you straight—it's a big one.
After we've won peace for Askr, what would you say about coming with me back to Almyra?
I know it's a lot to ask, and I don't even know how we'd manage to get you there right now...
But I've come to value your strength, and if you're willing, I'm sure we'll find a way when the time comes.
For now, just give it some thought. With you by my side, there's no telling what we could accomplish.
Status: This is traditional Almyran wyvern rider garb. Looks pretty neat, huh?
Hey now, there are better ways to get my attention. I'm not some kid anymore, you know.
There are so many people here from all walks of life working together... It's pretty much my ideal spot!
Fódlan isn't going to change itself. Sometimes it takes an outsider to make things happen.
I want to see Fódlan welcome a new dawn, and I hope to have my friends there by my side...
It may not be what I had hoped for... But it's time to move forward, right?
There's a lot I could learn from you. I could use some of your tactics back in Fódlan.

edelgard3.name: Edelgard
edelgard3.title: Adrestian Emperor
edelgard3.description: After ascending as Adrestian Emperor, she defeated the Church of Seiros, solidifying her reign over all of Fódlan. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
edelgard3.resplendent: Makimura Shunsuke (マキムラシュンスケ)

Castle Hall: With my teacher by my side, I fear nothing. I will see the battle through to the end, in this world or any other.
Claude is insufferably inscrutable, but I must admit he once brightened many students' monastery days.
Whatever enemies we face... Survive. Prevail. Do that and we'll witness the birth of a new world together!
To lead and fight alongside the Black Eagle Strike Force was one of the greatest honors of my life.
Gods and mortals stand side by side with the Order of Heroes. I...will need to think on this.
Visit: I, Edelgard von Hresvelg, Emperor of Adrestia, bring a message of greeting to you from [F].
Level: I will not rest until every battle is won—until the long war is over and a new dawn shines upon the world.
The Adrestian Emperor strides forward, yielding to nothing and to no one.
No. This is not enough.
Summon: I am Edelgard von Hresvelg, Emperor of Adrestia. I will liberate my people from their ancient shackles.
Learn Skill: Thank you. This will be of great use to my cause.
Confession:
Do you think destiny is decided at birth, [S]?
I, for one, believe we can and should forge our fates with our own hands.
To be so passive as to allow some invisible force to dictate our lives would be ignorant and irresponsible.
I feel that, like my teacher, you have the power to unlock the potential in people, [S].
I hope you will use that power to help them stand on their own—to light the way forward without a need for gods.
Status: The regalia of the Adrestian Emperor is a heavy burden to bear.
I suppose the title of Adrestian Emperor has little significance to you here.
We should feel no obligation to respect traditions purely for their age. Especially if those traditions are wicked.
I will not allow those who slither in the dark to stand in the way of my path.
This world may be the ideal place to study governance. It contains benevolent rulers, despotic tyrants, and everything in between.
My path may demand great personal sacrifice, but it is the only way to achieve real progress.
I have learned—am still learning—much from you. In that way, you have become as important to me as my teacher.
The clothing of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands? Are you certain these are meant for me?
Enough... Be thankful I am not of the Quieting Hands.
I feel fortunate that I did not end up with the ears and tail of a squirrel.
I may be the one in need of healing. I never imagined being an emperor would be this exhausting.
No matter what I lose along the way, I will never regret this path I have chosen.
So many siblings in the Healing Hands... I remember good times I shared with mine.
I am not in need of a new outfit, but I appreciate you thinking of me.

lysithea2.name: Lysithea
lysithea2.title: Earnest Seeker
lysithea2.description: Daughter of Count Ordelia and noble of the Leicester Alliance. Her monastery experience allowed her to achieve much growth. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I agree with Edelgard—if we disavow the value of Crests, we can end the special status of Fódlan nobles.
Life is short. I can't afford to let even a moment of mine go to waste.
I'm not sure what it is, exactly, but something about your presence reminds me of my professor.
Does this dress make me look as refined as I feel? Hey, I asked you a question! Where are you going?!
Askr's sweets are amazing. I mean, I heard...from a friend...that they're great. And that they're good for you!
Visit: Good to meet you. I am Lysithea. I am here to check on you at [F]'s request.
Level: The natural result of superior effort.
This won't do. I need to aim higher.
It would be childish of me to sulk over something like this.
Summon: I am Lysithea von Ordelia. With introductions out of the way...show me to your library. My need is urgent.
Learn Skill: Wise decision. You've got potential.
Confession:
Time may pass at the same rate for all, but not everyone gets the same amount of it.
I can't control how much time I have. I can only decide what to do with what I'm given.
If my time is shorter than others', then it would be a waste to spend any of it grieving.
No—it merely means I must accomplish more with less.
To that end, I plan to learn all I can in Askr. For my parents, and for my friends...I plan to achieve great things.
Status: I am Lysithea von Ordelia. Please do not forget it.
I don't play childish games.
I've grown a lot these past few years. I'm much taller now!
I make it a point to dress in a tastefully mature way. It's worth the time.
No, I haven't eaten any cake today. Why? There is no frosting on my face...is there?!
Think of all I could achieve...if I only had more time.
You bring out the best in us. Just like a professor I once had.

jorge.name: Jorge
jorge.title: Traveling Peddler
jorge.description: A merchant from Crimea. Formed a traveling convoy with his peers, doing business within various countries. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Daniel's my older twin brother. He's more serious and gentle than I am. I should take a page out of his book.
We hail from Crimea but as members of a merchant caravan, we get to visit a lot of different countries.
A mage named Ilyana traveled with us for a time. She sure did have a hearty appetite...
Muston leads the caravan, my brother, Daniel, operates the forge, Aimee runs a shop, and I buy second-hand items.
Anna's shop is popular here, right? Well, the caravan's gonna move in and take a piece of that pie!
Visit:
I'm Jorge from the merchant caravan. Check out these quality goods I'm selling from [F].
Also... Between you and me, I've got better deals on wares than Anna's shop does.
Level: Daniel's forged weapons are really something, huh? Now I can fight AND shove!
I can defend myself just as easily as anybody else! Did you underestimate me just because I'm a merchant? Pft.
Ah... This won't be good for business.
Summon: Greetings! I'm Jorge, a merchant with the traveling caravan. I've got quality imports to sell, so take a gander!
Learn Skill: Thanks for having my back. I was just thinking about how much I wanted this!
Confession:
Hey, it's my favorite customer! Looking for anything in particular? I'm your guy for thrift finds!
But, to be honest, if I had the choice, I'd rather be selling dresses to lovely ladies instead of dealing weapons.
Even in another world, no one can truly escape war. Mulling over it just gets me choked up...
I can't let patrons see the rain clouds over my head, though. It's bad for business.
We merchants should do our best to bring peace. Let us know how we can all work together moving forward!
Status: The name's Jorge. I belong to a merchant caravan, so I'm used to visiting different places.
Whoa! What are you doing? I might drop something! Please—I can't afford to break the merchandise.
Hey, just so you know—I'd like to be paired up with a nice girl, not some punk.
Daniel, my twin brother, is famous for crafting weapons. Great stuff!
If I can't capitalize on these circumstances...then I'm a fool!
If the rumors are true, then there might be hope...
It's been a pleasure doing business with you. You have the air of an extra-special customer, you know?

fcorrin5.name: Corrin
fcorrin5.title: Child of Dusk
fcorrin5.description: A Hoshidan princess raised in Nohr who overcame her fate of choosing between her two homes. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The war with Hoshido took many sacrifices, but...I truly believe we have achieved a lasting peace.
Together, we of the Nohrian royal family will create a grand new era. The kind people will sing songs of.
I may not look it, but I am no stranger to war. So, please, let me assist you in battle, [S].
Hinoka will be Hoshido's next queen. She's been so kind to me...despite having every reason to detest me.
This cape sometimes gets tangled up in my leg armor... Never you mind though. I can fix it myself, thanks.
Visit:
I brought you a gift from your friend [F].
You are [S], yes?
Level: I must keep going. No matter the hardships I face, this is the path I have chosen!
I'll protect all of you... That's a promise!
Wh-why? How discouraging...
Summon: I chose a path, and it ended the war. Sacrifices were made, but we move on, toward a more glorious future.
Learn Skill: If this world can put my power to use, so be it.
Confession:
I consider myself blessed, but that wasn't always the case.
There was something Xander said at his coronation that stuck with me ever since...
The lives Nohr took will be a burden he bears forever. The blood spilled, the tears shed, hearts shattered...
I felt like I was sentenced to a cruel, accursed fate. Losing Ryoma, Takumi, Azura...the sorrow was crushing.
But...thanks to the bonds I share with my friends and my families, we were able to achieve peace.
Now, that is why I fight. To protect those bonds, even between others. And it is why I will fight at your side.
Special: This is the path I chose!
Status: A...Legendary Hero? If you're looking for a great warrior, I'd suggest one of my siblings instead...
I pledge to be someone who believes in people, and works for their betterment.
I want us to become better friends. Tell me about yourself!
Everyone here is such good friends. How did they get to know one another?
Finally... I can be with my brothers and sisters once again.
This path is the one I chose for myself. I have no regrets.
No one can say what the future holds. But if the two of us are together, nothing can stop us!

sigurd2.name: Sigurd
sigurd2.title: Destined Duo
sigurd2.description: The duo of Sigurd, heir to Chalphy, and the devoted Deirdre. This happily married couple radiates joy. They appear in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.
sigurd2.duo:
Moves allies adjacent to unit to opposite side of unit. If an ally cannot move to the target space (if another ally or foe is occupying the space) ally will not move.
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of odd-numbered turns, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.

Castle Hall:
**Sigurd**: Deirdre has not had a chance to grow accustomed to events such as this...
If you can make her time here any more pleasant, I'll be in your debt.
**Deirdre**: The steady pulse of the music, and all the smiling, dancing people... I feel I've found myself in a fantasy world...
**Sigurd**: I have yet to see you dancing... Tend to avoid such things, do you? Well, I could teach you the basics...
**Deirdre**: The atmosphere here is building, growing with such excitement, I may burst...

**Sigurd**: Deirdre has lived much of her life in a remote area of the Spirit Forest, and yet...she seems to belong here.
She truly is the woman of my dreams.
Visit: **Sigurd**: I am here to extend an invitation. A ball will be held this evening, hosted by [F].
Level: **Deirdre**: ♪ I am having...truly the most wonderful time, Sigurd.
**Sigurd**: Take a look around. Everyone here is enchanted by my dear Deirdre...
**Sigurd**: Apologies, Deirdre. I was distracted from my footwork by your beauty, you see.
Summon: This is the ball we were told of, yes? I am Sigurd, and this is Deirdre, my lovely wife. The pleasure is ours.
Learn Skill: **Deirdre**: Oh. For me? What do you think, Lord Sigurd? Is it flattering?
Confession:
**Sigurd**: Deirdre, are you not tired? You need only say the word, and I will bid all a good night, and we can retur—
**Deirdre**: I am all right, Lord Sigurd... I really am enjoying these moments, from the bottom of my heart. And yet...
**Sigurd**: Yet what? Please, do not hesitate to speak your mind. I am your dear husband after all, Deirdre.
**Deirdre**: Of course... It's just that...I am here with my adoring husband, and there are so many other kind faces...
I am overwhelmed by my blessings. It feels just like a dream, so I fear it might slip away at any moment.
**Sigurd**: Well, let me assure you that there is nothing to worry about. As long as I am with you, the dream goes on.
And as such, we ought to return to our dance... Can I take your hand, dearest?
**Deirdre**: Yes. As long as I am by your side... hold me close and never let go, and let us stay in this moment forever.
Special: **Duo**: I'll watch over you. Oh, Lord Sigurd...
**Deirdre**: Only if it is with you.
Status: Haha...
• You're a vision in that gown, Deirdre. • And you look exceptionally charming, my dear Lord Sigurd.
Conversation: **Sigurd**: Would you care to dance, my love?
**Deirdre**: It would be my pleasure.
**Sigurd**: To dance with you feels as though I've yet to awaken from a wonderful dream.
**Deirdre**: It's a dream we share together.
**Sigurd**: I'm truly sorry for causing you such endless worry. Can you ever forgive me?
**Deirdre**: You need not apologize, Sigurd. To have this time with you makes me more than happy.
**Sigurd**: Oh, Deirdre... You are truly a selfless woman.

It would not hurt you to make a selfish request every once in a while.
Nor would it trouble me to tend to your wishes.
**Deirdre**: You want me to make a selfish request? Hmm... I wonder what I should ask for...
Perhaps you would save the last dance of the festival for me?
**Sigurd**: Hm. I would hardly call that selfish. The last dance of every gala, ball, and festival belongs to you already.
**Deirdre**: But when I think of everyone else here...
**Sigurd**: You question why I choose to dance with you? That you should think my love is mere fancy! You wound me.
**Deirdre**: Oh, no! Lord Sigurd, I never meant to question—
**Sigurd**: I merely tease. I'm sorry for being so cruel. Your moments of doubt endear me so.
Now, let us choose to dance with one another. You are my one and only partner, and my one and only love.
**Deirdre**: Oh, Sigurd... I love you the same. Yes, let's dance.
Duo Skill: • Let us never be apart. • Of course, dearest.

quan2.name: Quan
quan2.title: Lightfoot Prince
quan2.description: Prince of Leonster. Gallantly taking part in the dance festival is part of his royal duty. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Sigurd and Eldigan have always acquitted themselves naturally well in these situations. I...need to work at it.
My wife selected this ensemble for me. It is...quite different from military garb. I am unsure how I feel about it.
Nothing to be ashamed of... No one is without shortcomings. Ah—there you are! Help me to learn these steps?
Physical challenges rarely intimidate me, but ballroom dancing has proven arduous. Ethlyn says I ought to relax.
I've been studying the choreography, but have yet to master it. Would you mind being my partner for a while?
Visit: I am Quan, Prince of Leonster. I bring you an invitation to dance from your friend [F].
Level: A performance befitting the heir to the throne of Leonster.
Whether for battle or the dance floor, preparedness is essential.
Perhaps I've overexerted myself...
Summon: I am Quan, Prince of Leonster. It would be my honor to join you for tonight's ball.
Learn Skill: I appreciate this. I will do my utmost to handle it with grace.
Confession:
Stopping for a breather, are you? It seems we are of the same mind at the moment, [S].
To be born a prince means I am obliged to take part in social events of this kind, but...I care little for them.
Perhaps you and I could slip off to the training grounds to spar? I jest, of course. It would ruin my ensemble.
No, I am afraid I must remain here and be princely—for it is princely to overcome one's weaknesses.
You never seem to struggle in your dealings with the Heroes. Perhaps one day you'll share your secret.
Status: Fight on!
Keep steady.
I am a military man first, not a dancer, so I appreciate your patience.
This festival would best befit my friends Sigurd and Eldigan, I'm sure.
My partner is Ethlyn, and she alone.
Before long, my children must themselves learn to dance...
A festival is a fine thing. I am honored to spend this one with you.

ethlyn2.name: Ethlyn
ethlyn2.title: Glimmering Lady
ethlyn2.description: Noblewoman of Chalphy, attending the dance festival with her husband, Quan. As always, she supports him every step of the way. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: He may not be the greatest dancer, but his effort is worthy of praise. So long as it doesn't go to his head...
Quan was fond of my ensemble, but I would like an unbiased perspective. Do you think it suits me?
A dance has more in common with a battle than it may seem at a glance. Keep your wits about you.
You are far too tense—just like my husband. Here, have a drink. Take a moment to collect yourself.
I am not a particularly gifted dancer, but for my dear Quan...I will act the part of elegance, at least.
Visit: My name is Ethlyn. I would like to invite you to the dance, on behalf of [F].
Level: A most satisfactory performance, if I do say so myself.
Not bad. But I still have room to improve, wouldn't you say?
Perhaps I should take a step back from the action...if only for today.
Summon: My name is Ethlyn. My husband, Quan, and I both look forward to enjoying this evening's festivities.
Learn Skill: For me? Hehe... Quan is sure to envy me this. Thank you!
Confession:
Phew! Dancing certainly does take its toll. Join me for a little rest?
I am not overly fond of this sort of pageantry, if I'm honest. But I do see the need for it.
Festivals of this kind afford people opportunities to bond that they may not otherwise have.
My husband, for instance, would like to be anywhere other than here. But it is good for him, nevertheless.
That is why I have decided to enjoy this as much as I can. Shall we get back to it, [S]?
Status: Please. Allow me.
Steady now.
When I was a girl, my father worried I was too much of a tomboy.
It is expected that all members of House Chalphy receive dance training. Of course, so did I.
Quan's touch is so gentle. Following his lead feels like second nature.
Altena, Leif... What dance partners will your futures hold, I wonder...
This dance festival is a delight. Thank you for letting me join you.

lachesis2.name: Lachesis
lachesis2.title: Ballroom Bloom
lachesis2.description: Younger sister of Eldigan, ruler of Nordion. Sheds her armor for a gorgeous dress and a night of dancing. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Ah, my heart... *sigh* As the younger sister of King Eldigan, I must do my best to avoid any disgraceful actions.
I can still recall the footwork to one of my favorite Nordion songs. Would you like to learn the steps with me?
Do not be too hard on yourself. I have also stepped on my partner's feet while learning to waltz.
Hold on a moment! Your footwear is not suitable for the ball. One would advise wearing much cleaner soles.
As you can see, I adore dancing. Why, I could dance all day and night! Hehe, I must sound so childish...
Visit: Good day. I am Lachesis, princess of Nordion. Here is a formal invitation to the ball from [F].
Level: So delightful, just like a dream... If only one could continue dancing like this forever!
No one is as wise and dashing as Eldigan, but if you would like to dance with me, try emulating his behavior.
No... My favorite shoes that Eldigan gave to me, they...
Summon: I am Lachesis, sister to Lord Eldigan. Since the ball will begin soon, would you mind escorting me?
Learn Skill: Thank you. One can enjoy dancing even more now.
Confession:
You think me a wallflower because I turned down a single dance? It is quite rude to be so presumptuous.
I fancy balls, but if my partner does not have equal stature to that of my brother, it simply would not work out.
When I was younger, I used to be incredibly passionate about dancing. But that foolish child is gone now.
I don't expect you to understand... But, you have to admit that your comments to me were hypocritical.
Why don't you summon up some courage and ask someone to dance with you, [S]?
That way you can have a beautiful dream. This ephemeral chance will vanish once the last song plays.
Status: You must be careful.
Do not risk your life.
My brother Eldigan and I used to spend hours dancing together, for practice. I quite enjoyed those days...
One cannot help but shine in such a splendid outfit.
The princess of Nordion often turns heads with her refined style of dance.
With whom will Eldie be dancing, I wonder.
You strike me as a competent dancer. Care to take my hand for the next song?

eldigan2.name: Eldigan
eldigan2.title: Strutting Lion
eldigan2.description: Young ruler of Nordion. Also known as the Lionheart. Sets out for the dance festival in dignified attire. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Let us ensure all can enjoy the festivities. I would like to personally chat with each attendee one-on-one.
I may be king, but it has been long since I have donned clothing like this, as I must always be ready for battle.
To a casual observer, dancing seems effortless. But, it requires discipline similar to a knight's formal training.
I could go for one more waltz. Would you fancy joining me on the dance floor, [S]?
A waltz, you say? That reminds me of days gone by when I was forced to dance with my sister for them...
Visit: I am Eldigan, Lord of Nordion. I have a formal request for you to attend the ball held by [F].
Level: What did you expect? The real performance shall begin at once.
It seems I have finally warmed up. That being said, shall we have another dance?
My coordination seems to be off. If this continues then...
Summon: I am Eldigan, present in response to your invitation. Do not think my talent lies in swordsmanship alone.
Learn Skill: I give my thanks. Now I can continue dancing until dawn. Haha, I am only joking.
Confession:
Your expression tells me that you have an affinity for Nordion culture, especially the food and music.
I see similarities to my own country here. Festivities know no borders, regardless of the language.
Seeing a tranquil gathering such as this gives me joy greater than that of a victory on the battlefield.
As the Lionheart, protecting people and ensuring harmony are my prime reasons to fight, after all...
Although war presses on, I hope that peace finds this world someday. Then we can hold another magnificent ball.
Status: Let us dance.
Maintain composure.
I am Eldigan, Lord of Nordion. I would like you to join me in a dance.
This brings back memories... My sister and I often danced together, to work on our steps.
Festivals are important for lifting the spirits of the citizenry... They aren't so bad, are they?
Lachesis, I would never leave you alone. I will not die. I vow to return to your side.
If you are unskilled at dancing, allow me to teach you. Here — give me your hand.

jill.name: Jill
jill.title: Fiery Dracoknight
jill.description: A wyvern rider of Daein. Only daughter of Shiharam Fizzart, lord of Talrega. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Heroes from both past and present... This is the perfect place for me to test my mettle. You can do this, Jill!
Captain Haar! Are you here? ...Captain HAARRR!
It is a knight's duty to obey the king and fight. Orders cannot be questioned. Or so I thought...
I fight for my father, for Talrega, and for all of Daein. Tell me... Who do you fight for?
Captain Haar, I... Oh, forgive me! I mistook you for another.
Visit: You're [S]? I bring greetings from [F].
Level: I fight for those I wish to protect. I fight for what I believe in!
I will not run... I will not hide... But most of all, I will not lose!
I am the proud daughter of Shiharam Fizzart. I will not let a small setback like this discourage me!
Summon: I am Jill Fizzart, wyvern rider of Daein, attached to Captain Haar's battalion. Um...where are we?
Learn Skill: This is for me? Oh, thank you. Um, you'll forgive me if I have nothing to give in return...
Confession:
Do you remember when I told you that I was born and raised in a kingdom called Daein?
Corruption in his own land motivated my father, Shiharam Fizzart, to leave that home behind and serve Daein.
He is worthy of such respect that not even Captain Haar would dream of dozing off in his presence.
He is truly the epitome of a wyvern knight, and I respect him and his decisions more than anyone.
Even so, my time away from Daein has shown me that my father and I are destined to walk different paths.
Little by little, I want to build up the confidence to hold my head high like him—and like you!
Status: I am Jill Fizzart, daughter of Lord Shiharam of the Talrega region of Daein!
Who are you? What are your intentions?
I need to see things for myself to truly understand them. I can't let my beliefs be shaped by the opinions of others.
My father was...a very special person. Not just to me, but Haar as well.
When I'm with Mist, all of my worries seem to fade away...
The decisions I made may have turned my own father against me, but... They were decisions I had to make for myself.
I've come to know a new world full of new people, and it's all thanks to you. You have my gratitude.

ilyana.name: Ilyana
ilyana.title: Hungering Mage
ilyana.description: A girl whose constant hunger pangs cause stress for her and worry for others. Has a seemingly bottomless stomach. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: The food here is delicious... But we need to talk about the portions. I had to eat eight helpings at breakfast...
I was separated from my traveling companions and lost my way... Thank you for feeding me.
By my estimate I've only had three portions of food today. I'm so hungry...
I'm no good at running, much less marching. Physical exertion makes me so hungry...I might just faint.

Hello, [S]...
Of course I remember you. You gave me so many treats.
Visit: For all of those lovely meals, I owe [F]...
Level: Hmm... I detect something delectable... We can't stop now... We must find it!
I'm... I'm sorry. I got a little dizzy there. It happens all the time.
Hold on... Kinda dizzy... And so hungry... Can't move...
Summon: My name is Ilyana. I'm a traveling mage. Sorry, but...I'm about to faint... Can you spare a bite to eat?
Learn Skill: You're too kind...but what I really wanted is a snack.
Confession:
Thank you for always finding food for me when I need it. I know that's pretty much all the time...
I never had much growing up, so I got used to relying on the generosity of others.
That has its limits, of course... I can put away a fortune in food. Not everybody is so understanding.
Here, though... I can eat my fill, and nobody even bats an eye. It's like a dream come true!
Let me stay and feast with you, and I'll be sure to do everything I can to help you out. It's a win-win!
Status: My name is Ilyana. I'm a traveling mage.
...Yes? Do you have something for me? Food, maybe?
When I left home, I was all alone...I couldn't find work. Those were hungry times...
I'm not picky—I'll take any food you have...
I'm just...you know. I'm hungry.
You summoned me to this smörgåsbord. I'll never forget you...
There's so much delicious food here, it's like...heaven...
I'd rather have more food than new clothes, but...
Oh... I thought you were bringing me food.
Warm food is even tastier when you eat it in a cold place! Don't you think?
The Nifl royal family has three sisters and a brother... That sounds like a lot of fun to me.
So, I got this new outfit. Think we'll have a banquet to celebrate?
Is it just me, or do you also get hungry faster when it's cold out?
My heart AND stomach are full when I'm with you...

shinon.name: Shinon
shinon.title: Scathing Archer
shinon.description: A sniper with the Greil Mercenaries. Has a sharp tongue and is a master of the bow, a fact that neither he nor his foes will deny. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Everywhere you look...you see selfish people without a care in the world. Bah, it makes me sick.
Gatrie always comes to me for advice. Bah... He's so hopeless. But I can't seem to get rid of him.
Worrying is a luxury. Unless you've struggled so hard you cried yourself dry. Go ahead and worry then.
Stop. My bow is for protection only. I'm not gonna be hunting for sport.
I don't know what your expectations of me are so I'll be direct: I'm a merc, not a member of your fellowship.
Visit: I am a mercenary, not an errand boy. But here's a message from your friend [F].
Level: I fight to live. That's all. Doesn't everyone? It's not like people kill each other for fun.
This mission is like shooting apples off a tree. Let's finish this and get out of here.
Damn... You're making me angry...
Summon:
I'm a mercenary named Shinon. If you turn out to be untrustworthy, I won't hesitate to nock an arrow.
You have been warned.
Learn Skill: Well... I don't have any regrets about this.
Confession:
Watch out! ...Sheesh, lucky for you, my arrow found its mark. Try to keep focused, [S]...
Do you expect everyone here to protect you at all costs? What a cozy status to have, O great summoner.
A stark contrast to the disposable mercs and ordinary soldiers. I wonder what other fancy treatment you get!
Sorry. Forget that. I've just dealt with far too many black-hearted nobles and useless generals in my time.
But still, as a mercenary, I couldn't let my employer die before me. It'd leave a stain on my conscience. That's all.
Special: Like shooting apples off a tree.
Let's see how you handle this.
Status: A single arrow, right between the eyes? Who else could make a shot like that?
Stop being a fool. Are you a child?
Rolf has what it takes. He trains the right way, and he'll surpass both his brothers.
Ike pretends to have no interest in anything but ends up taking everything.
You may be my friend, but if there's gold on the table, I'll take you down. That's what it means to be a mercenary.
It's not like people kill each other for fun. I fight to live. That's all.
Out of the goodness of my heart, I'll teach you how adults fight. You can thank me later.

gatrie.name: Gatrie
gatrie.title: Armored Amour
gatrie.description: A knight with the Greil Mercenaries. Easily excited, he flirts with women at every turn but suffers rejection just as often. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Look at all of these cute girls! One of them HAS to be my dream girl... I just know it!
Shinon always keeps me busy with one thing or another. We're never in the same place for long.
That's a furrowed brow if I've ever seen one! So here's my advice: don't sweat the small stuff, OK?
This is it... This is the day I meet my dream girl. Oh, er... Hi there! I'm looking for love. Didn't you know?
Shinon said I should polish my armor until I can see my face in it. Man, it's hard work looking cool for the ladies!
Visit: The name's Gatrie. Got a delivery from [F].
Level: My fated love is waiting for me! Until then, I can't lose!
You see that? Better pick your jaw up off the ground, because I'm just getting started!
Oof. A sorry performance like that, well... It'll put a dent in my pay as well as my pride.
Summon: Hey there. I'm Gatrie. What do you need? We can bash heads or trade dating tips. You tell me!
Learn Skill: This'll show the ladies how strong and manly I am! And help in a fight too, I guess.
Confession:
You won't believe this, but I did it! Let me regale you with the ultimate tale of your old pal Gatrie's love life...
I met this cutie selling flowers on my way home from the pub. It was love at first sight, I tell ya!
She said she was working day and night to support her bedridden pa, so I emptied my pockets then and there.
You should have seen the look on her face! And now...we're gettin' hitched when she returns with the old man!
Should be in about...say, six months. I can work for you till then, right? What a time to be alive! Ha ha ha!
Special: You can always count on me!
Status: I'm Gatrie. But I'm sure you already knew that.
Finally got your attention, huh?
There are so many lovely ladies in this army!
Hey, you. Yeah, you! Name's Gatrie. What's yours?
I had the honor to serve under Greil -- Ike's father. Ike's not a bad person, by any means. But he has no manners whatsoever...
The easygoing life of a mercenary is the only life for me.
I'll always protect you. This armor isn't just for show, you know.

petrine.name: Petrine
petrine.title: Icy Flame-Lancer
petrine.description: One of Daein's Four Riders. Wields the Flame Lance with a callous disdain for those around her. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: So this is the kingdom of Askr... I've heard this land is rife with conflict. Seems like my kind of place.
There's plenty of fresh meat here. I should try recruiting some to serve His Majesty. You don't mind, do you?
Justice and purpose are pretty words, but they won't stop a blade. In this life, you must rely on yourself.
Need someone hunted down? Remember, I am General Petrine! I have never failed, nor will I ever!
Do you like your meat rare? Or do you like it charbroiled? Of course I'm talking about steak! What else?
Visit: Another one from the Order of Heroes, eh? Be sure to support [F]!
Level: The Daein army's motto is "Success or failure, life or death." I am General Petrine, and I forge my own fate!
Come now! I've put so much kindling to the torch today, but I haven't even broken a sweat.
Y-Your... Your Majesty... Forgive me... Please... I will not fail you again.
Summon: I am General Petrine, of the Four Riders of Daein. I'll roast your foes, just as ordered!
Learn Skill: So you've seen fit to value me, as well you should! Keep it up.
Confession:
Justice and purpose are pretty words, but they won't stop a blade. In this life, you must rely on yourself.
Those who can't keep a cool head in battle may soon find it separated from their shoulders.
You, however...are not typical. And I am no ordinary beorc. You must have deduced that much already...
This brand on my chest is proof of the beast blood surging through my veins. It sets me apart.
We all have our dark secrets, Summoner. What say you share one of yours? It's only fair...
Special: Hope you like your meat charbroiled!
You anger me, you know that?
Status: General Petrine, of the Four Riders of Daein. Yes, you heard me correctly.
Dog's breath! Do you need a lesson in manners?
You seek the friendship of those hairy devils too, hmm? Hmph. What an absolutely stupefying world.
The Daein army's motto is "Success or failure, life or death." Remember those words.
You know, I think I'll keep you! Yes, I do think you'll make a grand souvenir.
*laugh* You really do know how to sweet-talk a girl, don't you?
Do you like your meat rare? I'll roast your foes to order.

plumeria.name: Plumeria
plumeria.title: Lewd Dream
plumeria.description: A jaded dökkálfr from Dökkálfheimr, the realm of nightmares. She delivers salacious dreams to mortals. Though she would wish to do away with all cloying mortal desires, she cannot.

Castle Hall: Ah... I can feel your mortal gaze pass over me, dripping with desire. How repulsive.
I drank of the dream nectar, and was given a new life as a dökkálfr—a life shaped by Lady Freyja's love.
People are happier indulging in their fantasies than wading through this harsh reality... Don't you agree?
I want to be loved...needed... Isn't that what everyone dreams of?
Throughout this castle, wretched mortals engage in questionable acts... Utterly deplorable.
Visit: I am Plumeria, and I was sent here by [F]'s love...
Level: A dream of love overflowing, a love never ending...
The grand existence of a dökkálfr is above that of a vulgar mortal.
Stop your staring.
Summon:
I am Plumeria, the lewd dream, a noble dökkálfr of Dökkálfheimr.
Now that you've summoned me... what are you planning to do?
Learn Skill: Hmm... And just how are you planning to use this?
Confession:
Before...I was never loved. And no one accepted my love. And then my mortal life ended.
I wanted to feel loved... I needed to be needed...
The love my mother had for men... that obscene love between mortals is something that I always detested.
Yet...even now, deep down, I still want only to be loved.
Even if only for a moment. Even if it's all a lie...
Will you...love me?
Status: A dream debased.
I'll get you going.
Yes, I am Plumeria of the dökkálfar, and I have seen your secret dreams...the ones no one else ever sees...
...Humans. You cannot help but be vulgar, can you?
The depravity of human desire seems to know no bounds... Your fantasies, beyond filthy.
...S-so dark... Someone...please... Help me...
You are but one of innumerable wretched humans. And yet, here I am...

ytiki5.name: Tiki
ytiki5.title: Harmonic Hope
ytiki5.description: A Divine Dragon and Ice Dragon, Tiki and Ninian have come to make memories at the harvest festival. They appear in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem / The Blazing Blade.
ytiki5.origin: Mystery of the Emblem + The Blazing Blade
ytiki5.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Grants another action to ally with the highest HP that is within 2 spaces, has already acted, and is from the same titles as unit (excluding unit). (Allies with Sing or Dance can be granted this effect as well. If multiple units meet the conditions, effect will not trigger.)
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Tiki**: I got so much candy... I'd love to share some with you. Come on!

**Ninian**: Tiki is an exceptional girl...
She's broken down the wall between humans and dragons with the power of her smile.

**Ninian**: Thank you for bringing us here...
You've even been nice enough to give us these costumes for the festival!
**Tiki**: Oh! Xane is here too! He looks like he's up to no good... I need to stop him from playing tricks on people!
**Ninian**: Hehe. Tiki is always so full of energy! It reminds me of when my brother, Nils, was this age.
Visit: **Tiki**: I'm Tiki! I've come from [F]'s castle to play!
Level: **Tiki**: What a lot of fun this harvest festival is! I wish it could go on forever!
**Tiki**: Rawr! Tricked you by turning into a dragon! Were you frightened?
**Ninian**: Tiki, are you all right? Be careful!
Summon: I'm Tiki! I'm going to play with my friend Ninian as much as I can! I can't wait!
Learn Skill: **Ninian**: You've made Tiki so happy... Thank you.
Confession:
**Tiki**: Thank you for playing with me today, Ninian! I had ever so much fun!
**Ninian**: I had fun too, Tiki. I only have a little brother, but today...it was like I had a little sister too.
**Tiki**: Thank you for inviting us to the festival, [S].
I've met so many nice people... I was alone for so long, but today has been like a wonderful dream.
I've made more new friends than I could have ever imagined! *sniff*
**Ninian**: Don't cry, Tiki! I'll stay by your side from now on. I'll make sure you're never alone again. I promise.
Status: Ooh! Hee hee!
• I'm gonna scare Mar-Mar so bad his hair will turn white! • Don't go overboard, Tiki.
Conversation: **Tiki**: Ohh, look at it all! I can't believe we got so much candy!
**Ninian**: Indeed we did... In fact, I daresay the two of us can't eat it all on our own. What a shame.
**Tiki**: That's no problem! We'll share it with Mar-Mar.
**Ninian**: You mean Prince Marth? That's a splendid idea. Hmm... Who else might like some?
**Tiki**: Umm... Maybe Prince Alfonse? And the summoner too!
They're both real nice! They're my favorite people in the whole wide world! Er... The whole wide worlds?
**Ninian**: Are they now? That's wonderful to hear, Tiki.
**Tiki**: When I'm feeling lonely, the prince's sister always plays with me too. So let's share with her as well!
But the lady with the ponytail gets grumpy when I eat too many sweets, so maybe not her...
But we can share with the icy princess! And the pale sad lady... and the cute butterfly lady too!
**Ninian**: Hm, perhaps we'll actually need more candy than we have...
**Tiki**: What's wrong?
**Ninian**: Oh, I was just thinking about how many humans you've befriended despite being a dragon like me.
You've set a wonderful example. And I think I'm ready to follow suit... Yet, I must admit I have lingering doubts.
**Tiki**: Well, don't you worry. If anyone's mean to you, Mar-Mar will beat 'em up! Like... Boom! Bam!
Oh, it's lunchtime! Humans love eating together. It's the best way to make friends! Come on!
**Ninian**: Hehe, is that so? Then let's see just how good an impression candy for lunch can make...

xane.name: Xane
xane.title: Autumn Trickster
xane.description: A Divine Dragon who discarded his dragonstone and takes a human form to cause mischief. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Yeah, it's a festival, but I'd best be careful. If Kris sees me pullin' too many pranks, I'm in for an earful.
Humans pass away in the blink of an eye. It's always sad to say goodbye. For now... I'll try to enjoy this festival.
Looks like Tiki's havin' fun. Seems like her nightmares've died down too. I'm glad she made some friends.
Trick or treat! Better make with the candy quick. My tricks'll make your head spin!

Who should I change into next... A kid'd have the best chance of makin' off with tons of candy, but...hmm...
Er... Were you listening?
Visit: Name's Xane. I'm havin' lots of fun at the harvest festival over at [F]'s castle!
Level: Nothin' better than a good trick!
Think you're clever, do ya? You'll never see through my tricks!
Now that's no good.
Summon: I'm Xane. I can change into anybody—even you! Wanna see? It'll make the festival a lot more fun!
Learn Skill: I'm not helpin' humans that easily. But you're someone I can trust.
Confession:
You're not angry that I disguised myself as a whole bunch'a Heroes and filled up on candy, are you?
You can't hold that against me! Tricks like those are what the festival is all about.
See, humans don't have long to live, so they have to figure out how they WANT to live.
You can't spend all your time fightin'. You need to fool around every once in a while too!
Look at me! I have hundreds of years set aside just for pulling pranks and goofin' off.
Special: I've got a bag of tricks!
Status: The name's Xane. The princey and me go way back. Oh, I mean Marth.
Whoa! Tryin' to scare me? You've got some guts.
This world sure has a lot of festivals... I'm not sayin' it's a bad thing.
You're lookin' at a bona-fide master of mischief. Who should I impersonate next?
Where am I from? Well... Let's just say, not from around here. Not even close.
This world's BURSTIN' with stuff, isn't it? I'll never get bored!
I look good like this? Aw, cut it out, you. You're makin' me blush!

frobin4.name: Robin
frobin4.title: Fall Vessel
frobin4.description: Possessed by the Fell Dragon Grima, Robin has arrived for the harvest festival. What could she possibly hope to accomplish? Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I hoped to find the power I seek at this harvest festival... But it seems that was a mistake.
Festivals are nothing more than a brief reprieve from despair. The vain struggle of a worm...

Submit or suffer!
...Must I say "trick or treat"? How dull.
If you intend to play a trick on me, it will be your last. Such foolishness is absolutely intolerable.
Costumes are a fool's amusement. Who was it who said it would be enjoyable, again? I'll kill them first.
Visit:
The castle I'm visiting from is lively with harvest festivities. You ought to come...
And witness the despair that awaits [F]...
Level: Candy or death. I can choose for you, if you'd prefer.
Retribution for every little trick...
I refuse to let sugary sweets be my downfall...
Summon: I am the Fell Dragon Grima, bringer of despair and ruin... Let us bathe this harvest festival in true darkness.
Learn Skill: I suspect you have more of these hidden away... If you hand over all such treats, your life will be spared.
Confession:
Enjoy your short lives while you can, worms. Before long, utter darkness will smother you...
Although... These sweets are quite palatable. Subtle sweetness with a delicate mouthfeel, I—
Yah! How long have you been there, [S]?!
What did you hear?! No, nothing! There was nothing TO hear. Yes.
I wish to harvest ruin and despair. Sweets harbor no interest for me.
But next time the harvest festival comes around, I expect an invitation.
Promise me, lest I am forced to destroy this world. You understand...
Status: This outfit? Pah. More of your garish frivolity.
You would pester me? Dare to touch my ears and I'll take that finger.
Of course worthless worms with nothing better to do would waste their time on a harvest festival.
This is a harvest festival, so let's separate the wheat from the chaff. You humans are the latter.
Help me recover the rest of my memories and I'll shower you in so much candy that your teeth will rot.
I am Grima... I am despair... And I...am not enjoying this festival...
Am I having fun? What about my appearance makes you think I'm having FUN, worm?!

dheginsea.name: Dheginsea
dheginsea.title: Harvest Goldoan
dheginsea.description: One of the Three Heroes who saved Tellius from chaos. Joined the harvest festival after hearing dragons are somehow involved. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: We were neutral and chose not to commune with others... I believed that was as it should be...
I fought side by side with Altina and Soan under the watchful protection of the goddess Ashera.
Ambition can lead to growth, and with wisdom to temper it, one can avoid making enemies along the way.
This is festival garb, hm? I am used to black—but I could grow used to this extravagance as well...
Imagine this festival celebrated by all peoples, hand-in-hand... That is something to aspire to.
Visit: I am Goldoa's king, Dheginsea. I have come calling the castle of [F].
Level: The Three Heroes are not to be looked down upon.
Little better than a flailing youth...
An embarrassment...
Summon:
I am Dheginsea, Goldoa's king and one of the Three Heroes under the protection of the goddess Ashera.
Now, I hear that this harvest festival has some connection to dragons... Is that true?
Learn Skill: I will rise to meet your expectations. Of that you can be sure.
Confession:
This harvest festival celebration is fascinating to me. I've been thinking, [S]...
You beorc sow seeds and then harvest the bounty of the land...
It is not unlike how you sow a culture of hope into your comrades, as I see it.
The fruit of war is only more war, a cycle that spells ruin to all that lives—and what has yet to come.
But seeds of hope you sow can be harvested for generations, nourishing the future.
Hope is a legacy worth leaving.
Special: I will take my tribute in sweets!
Status: Thank you for the invitation to this harvest festival. I believe I will enjoy it.
If it's candy you are after, I have amassed something of a stockpile.
To think that I would be taking my ease in a place like this... Fate is a curious thing.
I have never worn a...costume before. I suppose there is a first time for everything.
Beorc and laguz seem equally happy in this world. I am beginning to see its merits, myself.
My children have long since grown, but to see young ones here fussing over sweets...I am reminded of those times.
It is rare for me to have such a wonderful time. You have my sincerest gratitude.

ena.name: Ena
ena.title: Autumn Tactician
ena.description: A dragon laguz from Goldoa. She is considering the best approach to take in order to liven up harvest festivities. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: A celebration of the harvest and togetherness... Surely many benefit from this festival.
With constant battle comes fatigue. That is what makes festivals like these a necessity.
The ratio of people to sweets seems to be skewed as the treats diminish. We must prepare more, and quickly.
I, too, can take a form that scares people. I can show you, if you'd like.

To find such fine festivals, in worlds not our own...
It is a shame we cannot always share such experiences with those whom we care for most deeply...
Visit: Trick or treat. That's the phrase, correct? Harvest festivities are on at [F]'s castle.
Level: I hope I was not too scary. To make up for it, care for some treats?
An obvious trick. Perhaps try another strategy.
I apologize... It seems the festival atmosphere has me off balance.
Summon: I am Ena. If this is a harvest festival... my duty is to spread excitement. My mission is clear.
Learn Skill: Thank you for your thoughtfulness. You will reap the rewards.
Confession:
Thank you for inviting me to this festival. It is quite lively.
I believe I have likely lived far longer than you imagine...
Much of that life has been consumed by war and tragedy, and I struggle to find much that was good in it.
This festival, in this county, though. This memory will shine brightly, with togetherness, joy...celebration.
As one of the Heroes, I will do my very best to ensure that this festival continues for a long time hereafter.
Status: It's the harvest festival, so I've donned a mask.
Oh! So you're trying to trick me?
If the idea is to scare people, I could do that easily... But I feel assuming dragon form may not be in the spirit of the festival.
It's hard to tell who's who when everyone is dressed up.
This world's confections are agreeable... I had not tried them before.
If by joining in I can make people happier, I'll do it.
Thank you for showing me a nice time. I will return the favor one day.

shamir.name: Shamir
shamir.title: Archer Apart
shamir.description: A member of the Knights of Seiros and a sniper. Unusual among her peers in that she does not believe in the Church of Seiros's teachings. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I've traveled across many lands in my time, but this one seems...peculiar.
Wherever there are people, there will be conflict. And wherever there is conflict, I can find work.
Rest when you can. Our line of work will wear you down if you let it.
Bored? You can stay here and waste time, or you can hone your blade. The choice is yours.
I'm seeking bug-repelling herbs. The greenery here is nice, but it attracts a lot of bugs. Little monsters...
Visit: I'm here on a mission. I was directed to deliver greetings from [F].
Level: I will train to hone my skills as best I can.
An efficient weapon is everything to a mercenary.
Ugh... No good.
Summon: My name is Shamir. I work with the Knights of Seiros. I'm here if you need anyone taken care of.
Learn Skill: Good. A new weapon in my arsenal.
Confession:
I'm not eager to bend the knee to anyone, but mercenaries need employers.
A good employer is the kind that pays. Or, at the very least, doesn't treat mercs like expendable pawns.
That's to say, I haven't had any of those concerns working for you. It's been mostly pleasant...
*ahem* My apologies. I didn't intend to get so emotional. There's no room for that on the battlefield.
Remember that a good leader knows how to lead from behind. Keep that in mind, and don't get in my way.
Status: I'm not amused.
It would be in your best interest to stop.
I was an outsider in Fódlan as well, but I devoted myself all the same. Nothing has changed.
I have trained to overcome all fear. Including bugs. Creepy little monsters...
Swords, lances, bows... Whatever the weapon, I'm ready.
A good mercenary stays focused. Nothing can be allowed to get in the way of the assignment.
I'll join you if you're heading out. Can't risk losing an employer.

catherine.name: Catherine
catherine.title: Thunder Knight
catherine.description: A member of the Knights of Seiros and wielder of the Hero's Relic Thunderbrand. She deeply reveres Archbishop Rhea. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You trying to pick a fight? Come on, don't back down now. It's just a test of strength. No one has to die.
I only swing my sword for Lady Rhea. Not that I can imagine her having many enemies in this world...
You look tired. Make sure you're getting enough sleep between training.
I hear you're no use with weapons? That's disappointing. I was hoping we could spar.
Weapon maintenance is important. Thunderbrand's blade never chips, but the hilt will be ruined if I ignore it.
Visit: There are so many Heroes here. It fuels my drive... Oh, right! Greetings from [F]!
Level: There's no one who can stop my progress!
As long as you keep fighting, you'll get stronger, even if that wasn't your intention.
Even I have times where I don't grow as much as I had hoped.
Summon: The name's Catherine—I'm a Knight of Seiros and servant of the goddess. Want to taste my blade?
Learn Skill: I always welcome opportunities to learn and grow!
Confession:
Of all the things I've experienced in this world, I only have one regret: not being able to fight you!
I find you and your leadership style fascinating, but I'll never be able to know how you operate in combat.
Well, no sense dwelling on it. I'll just have to change my frame of mind. Still, it really is too bad.
At least I can still see some action on the battlefield. I'll have to settle for celebrating victories with you instead!
From now on, I'll wield the Hero's Relic Thunderbrand for you!
Status: Relax. If nobody's dying, it's not worth getting worked up over.
Don't sneak up on me like that. I almost cut you down. It's a reflex.
Despite what you may think, I was actually born to a noble line. I even bear their Crest.
These hands can brawl with the best of them, but don't ask me to pick a lock or thread a needle.
The Knights of Seiros are sometimes called the shining knights. We're the sword and shield of the divine Seiros.
The sword may be my focus, but I'm good even without a weapon. You'll never catch me with my guard down.
Give me the toughest opponents you can find. For you, I'll take on any challenge.

seteth.name: Seteth
seteth.title: Seiros Adherent
seteth.description: Serves the Church of Seiros as Rhea's right hand. He is serious and stubborn with most, but dotes on his younger sister, Flayn. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Flayn...? Where is Flayn? I cannot calm down until I know where Flayn is. I must find her immediately!
As assistant to the Archbishop, I was swamped with tasks day in, day out. It seems here, I may relax...
The Order of Heroes faces many challenges. If there is anything I can do to help, simply ask it of me.
Is there anywhere to fish around here? I don't mind if I don't catch anything. I simply enjoy it.
I wrote a children's fable. Will you read it and share your thoughts? I'd like to know if the moral is clear.
Visit: So you're [S]. I come bearing the greetings of [F].
Level: Things are going quite well, it seems. Surely this is the goddess's blessing.
Not bad at all. It seems all my hard work is paying off.
What is this? Have my struggles been in vain?
Summon: I am the one called Seteth. Now explain yourself—why was I called to this world?
Learn Skill: I feel a new power... I owe you my thanks.
Confession:
Were I to return to Garreg Mach, I can only imagine the pile of tasks awaiting me...
In comparison to that, the days I spend here are like a vacation.
Perhaps it is a bit irresponsible of me to say so... Rest assured I will execute your orders faithfully and fully.
You know, you show quite a lot of promise. You're talented, responsible, and brimming with charisma.
I feel as though coming to this world has meaning, simply because we could meet. You inspire me.
I am not sure how long I can stay, but I will do what I can to be of help. May the goddess protect you.
Status: I see you are hard at work. I am happy to witness such diligence.
Hm? Were you attempting to surprise me? I shall try to oblige next time.
Curious about my age, are you? Let us leave it at this... I am a fair bit older than you.
The Church of Seiros does not inherently view followers of other religions as our enemies.
Keep this to yourself, but I care more about my sister Flayn's well being than all else...including the church.
Time may pass and the world may change, but people will never stop fighting each other.
You look tired... Please, do not overexert yourself.

flayn.name: Flayn
flayn.title: Playing Innocent
flayn.description: Younger sister of Seteth, who dotes on her constantly. Having lived a sheltered life, she sometimes appears to lack common sense. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: It does feel a bit strange to be called a Hero... But I am nevertheless quite curious about this world of yours.

My brother tends to stick his nose into my business more often than he does not.
Prince Alfonse is completely different in that regard...
Ah, might I ask what it is you are busy doing? If there is any way I might help, please do not hesitate to ask.
Do you know of any place where I might find delicious seafood on the menu? Fish is my favorite, you see.
I have been speaking with everyone I meet here. I am delighted to learn about the lives of the townspeople!
Visit: I have come with greetings on behalf of [F].
Level: I feel my strength has grown an incredible amount!
All in all, I feel rather nice.
Perhaps I have reached an age where my growth has slowed...
Summon: I am Seteth's younger sister, Flayn. Now that I have introduced myself, where exactly am I?
Learn Skill: I am touched that you would offer me this power. Thank you.
Confession:
When I arrived in this world I was always bewildered and perplexed, but now I am only enjoying myself.
From food to clothing, everything is new and fresh here... The Askran people, all the Heroes...
Everyone and everything is a delight!
And then there is you, as new and as fresh as it seems possible to be.
Your presence is unique in its feel. Deep...and mysterious. Hmm...
You remind me of...water? No! A fish. I can try to grasp you, but you swim through my fingers whenever I try...
And like a fish, I believe if I ever managed to catch you, the reward would be ever so sweet...
With that, I have whet my appetite for fish, so I am off to find some... Would you care to join me?
Status: Do let me know if I may help with anything.
Greetings!
Do you know much about the ocean? I simply adore gazing upon the deep, blue water...
Do not worry, as I plan to give it my all. I love experiencing new things!
I do not need you to worry about me. My brother does enough of that for the both of you.
How delightful to be somewhere so lively!
I do believe I shall be most useful to you!

nemesis.name: Nemesis
nemesis.title: King of Liberation
nemesis.description: A king who faced Seiros in mortal combat long ago, commanding the Ten Elites and wielding the Sword of the Creator. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Enough standing idle. Send me into battle so I may cut our foes down with this sword.
Seiros... Until I tear you to shreds, not even death itself can restrain me.
You are young and inexperienced... An army must be commanded by a powerful presence.
If you could summon my 10 Elites to this world, we would be a force without equal.
I have had a thousand years of sleep. Nights offer me no rest...
Visit: Friends are not worth the trouble... But I bring regards from your ally [F] all the same.
Level: I am overflowing with power.
A shadow of my former glory.
Far from what I once was...
Summon: I am Nemesis, King of Liberation, Hero among Heroes.
Learn Skill: This is fitting for me.
Confession:
You've pulled me from the clutches of idleness. For that... I owe you a debt, [S].
When I first arrived, I was tempted to cut you down and claim this land. But you are more than I expected.
You have proven your strength to me, so I will lend mine to you.
The strong rule over the weak. That is the natural order.
With your strength and mine, to rule would be a simple thing indeed. I am looking forward to it...
Status: You dare to compete with me for command?
Do you think I don't see you lurking there?
No mere human can so much as scratch me.
I was slain long ago...by a woman named Seiros.
This world too will be liberated.
Seiros... I must kill Seiros...
You are sure to keep me entertained...

dimitri3.name: Dimitri
dimitri3.title: Savior King
dimitri3.description: King of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. Overthrew the empire and united all of Fódlan. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: If there are people in need, I will do my utmost to help as many as I can, be they my own citizenry or not.
The people should lead the way into the future, not kings. A king's task is but to build the path before them.
Bringing so many together, despite their differing customs and beliefs, is no easy task. You should rest.
Do you ride? We could go out, if it suits you. Nothing brightens a mood quite like fresh air.
I am not above working the fields. To use the strength my father gave me only for battle would be a waste.
Visit: I do not wish to intrude, but I bring regards from [F].
Level: I will tolerate not one more death!
This will serve me well in the future.
Any progress is significant.
Summon:
I am Dimitri, King of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. You called, and I answer willingly.
Let this lance clear the way forward!
Learn Skill: I will not waste this.
Confession:
Forgive the clumsiness of my words, but meeting you here has been a true blessing for me.
I am what I've become because I have fought many battles—and taken many lives.
I have dealt that justice not only as king, but as an avenger.
I have not shied away from cruelty in the past, and I have made many to suffer as a result.
I am unlikely to find honor in this life. And yet you keep me at your side...
I know only one other person like you. A person who offered me their unfailing support...
Even if we are to part one day, I will not forget you—nor will I forget your guidance. I am grateful for every bit.
Status: Here, I can almost forget the burden of my title.
Moderate your mischief-making, will you?
Our bloodlines and ideals may differ, but we can still help one another.
Life, once lost, never returns... We must never forget that.
No one moves forward all on their own. You must learn to rely on others.
The past cannot be changed... Sins can never be washed away...
I would love to show you what Faerghus looks like covered in snow.

lyn7.name: Lyn
lyn7.title: Ninja-Friend Duo
lyn7.description: Two young women who met on the plains and formed a bond that extends even to wearing unfamiliar ninja garb. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.
lyn7.duo: Grants unit another action. (May be used only if unit has already entered combat during the current turn.)

Castle Hall: **Florina**: A ninja festival? I wonder if I can succeed here... Maybe I should just hide somewhere? Oh, I'm anxious...
**Lyn**: Subterfuge and information gathering are not my usual strong points, but I'm happy to give all this a try.
**Florina**: Lyn, are you all right with so much of your legs exposed? Aren't you cold? I'm shivering just looking at you!
**Lyn**: Ninja garb is quite the new look for you! I'd like to see you flying around on Huey wearing that.
**Florina**: Being together like this reminds me of the Lyndis's Legion days. I remember our time fondly.
Visit:
**Lyn**: Infiltration successful. We're inside [S]'s castle...
We've been detected!
Level: **Lyn**: We've nearly mastered the art of stealth. Keep it up, Florina!
**Florina**: All right, Lady Lyndis! Oh! ...Was that too loud? I'll be more stealthy.
**Lyn**: Do not worry, Florina! We'll do better next time, I'm sure!
Summon:
I am Lyn, and this is Florina. We are h— Oh, wait. Was that a proper ninja greeting?
...Do ninja have special greetings?
Learn Skill: **Florina**: Lady Lyndis, we've been given a new ninja art! We are stronger than ever now!
Confession:
**Lyn**: Ha-tah! ...Saiii-YAH!
What do you think, Florina? I'm beginning to look the part of the ninja, don't you think?
**Florina**: Yes! You have incredible technique, Lady Lyndis! You looked just like a real ninja.
Of course, I don't really know all that much about real ninja, but...
**Lyn**: Thank you all the same. Now, why not join me, Florina? Don't be shy!
We should make the most of our time at the festival. The experience could prove to be invaluable.
**Florina**: I don't know how, but...if you're enjoying yourself, then I'm happy. Let's just do the best we can!
Special: **Duo**: This is it! Yes! What she said!
Status: Hey!
"Are you hurt?" "No—I'm all right."
Conversation: **Florina**: Hey, Lyn. What can you tell me about ninja?

**Lyn**: They are a type of warrior who uses stealth.
I'm told they originated centuries ago in the Kingdom of Hoshido.
They are keepers of secret combat arts, honed and passed down over generations of masters and disciples.
**Florina**: Huh, that's interesting! But...
**Lyn**: But what?
**Florina**: For warriors who are supposed to be quiet, the design of these outfits seems kinda...loud.
**Lyn**: Hm, you raise a good point. Though I will say, they're certainly easy to move around in.
**Florina**: Well, sure. With so little protection, you have to be light on your feet to evade attacks and stay out of sight.
Anyway! Guess it's time to change back into our regular clothes, huh?

**Lyn**: Oh, did I not mention? These outfits are designed for stealth.
The plan is to sneak into the enemy stronghold and gather intelligence.
**Florina**: That sounds a little…scary. I don't think I'm ready for that!
**Lyn**: Florina. A ninja must be self-assured. Are you harboring doubts?
**Florina**: Yes! I mean...no! As long as we go together, I suppose it'll be all right.
**Lyn**: I'm afraid that's not an option. You must go alone. Otherwise the risk of enemy detection would be too great.
**Florina**: Fine, then! As of now, I quit being a ninja.
**Lyn**: Relax, Florina! I'm kidding. We're only wearing these outfits for the festival.
**Florina**: Oh... Ha, you really had me going there, Lyn. That's...so funny...
Duo Skill: "Lyn, I'm not sure I can—" "Courage, Florina."

zihark.name: Zihark
zihark.title: Ninja Blademaster
zihark.description: A skilled mercenary swordsman. Friendly and free from prejudice, he's answered the call to join the ninja festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: It's a strange ask to learn the way of the ninja...but I'll do my best since it's now my role at the festival.
Remembering faces is a skill I learned as a mercenary. I should be able to put it to use as a ninja too.
Ninja also carry around preserved food. No matter the discipline, it's hard to fight on an empty stomach.
This garb is flexible and allows for quiet travel. I see, it's meant to aid in the success of covert operations.
We should investigate that strange house over there... Let's move very discreetly.
Visit: Yes, I'm dressed like a ninja, and yes, I come with a coded message. But I'm just a mercenary.
Level: So this is how to maintain a ninja's blade? Sword arts and ninja teachings are comparable, that's for sure.
Feels like I'm starting to get used to being a ninja.
Completely hiding my presence is a pretty hard thing to do...
Summon: My name is Zihark. I'm dressed as a... ninja? It's not my usual line of work, but I'll do my best.
Learn Skill: Ah, so this is the way of the ninja. How interesting.
Confession:
I was asked to participate in this ninja festival and studied up on the craft to make my act look more believable.
So get this. To succeed, you must employ tactics contrary to what works in swordplay.
Light-footed ninja concealed by the dark of night bring down foes and then slip away totally undetected...
Color me impressed. It's nice to be reminded of how much knowledge you can gain by trying new things.
I owe it to you. If the opportunity presents itself, then invite me to the next festival.
Special: Luck is not on your side!
Status: I'm Zihark, and I'm dressed this way for a reason. You'll just have to trust me.
Ah, it's you. Enjoying the festival, I see.
Being a ninja has its perks. If the enemy can't read your movements, they don't know where to guard.
I'm confident in my swordplay. Send me into battle and you will be too.
There sure are a lot of ninja around here, huh? Hoshido must be pretty powerful...
Seeing beorc and laguz enjoying this festival together is truly something special.
As long as you're giving the orders, I'll follow through.

laevatein4.name: Laevatein
laevatein4.title: Ninja of Múspell
laevatein4.description: The younger princess of Múspell, joining in on the ninja festivities and donning ninja garb to help her sister.

Castle Hall: A festival for those who sneak through the darkness... There must be a reason for this.
If I become a ninja master, I can complete difficult missions. This will be of use to Laegjarn.
There is said to be a ninja art of coiled flame... If I were in Múspell, I could master it.
Is there a reason the amount of fabric used for ninja gear is so...little?
I do not favor stealth. But to be a ninja... I must erase my presence.
Visit: I have infiltrated the castle... And stolen information for [F].
Level: Perish...in the darkness...
The blade conceals the heart. Like me, a ninja is a weapon.
I will never master the skills of the ninja like this...
Summon: I am Laevatein, ninja of Múspell. I will become a ninja master...for Laegjarn.
