Learn Skill: I understand. I will learn this technique, as you ask.
Confession:
I have been investigating you these past few days.
As hard as I try, there are things I cannot understand... Who are you? What is your goal?
I did find out one thing.
You are not my sister's enemy.
Someday, I will learn more. I will use my ninja skills...and unmask you.
Special: I am more than the blade.
Status: I am Laevatein. For the festival, I have dressed as a ninja.
*gasp* A ninja must be invisible. It seems...I am not.
I can move more easily in these clothes. So now, I am more useful to Laegjarn. That is all I can ask.
They say that a skilled ninja can walk on water or soar through the air. This will be a challenge.
A ninja can uncover the most carefully guarded secrets... What can I find out for you?
As a ninja I don't have anything more to find out…I have already learned all there is to know about my sister.
To become a true ninja, I must redouble my efforts. You will help me.

navarre2.name: Navarre
navarre2.title: Scarlet Ninja
navarre2.description: A master swordsman known as the Scarlet Sword. He's dressed as a ninja to join in on the festival! Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I can move rather easily in this outfit. Its versatility is convenient.
No matter the part I play, my vows still hold true: I shall never wield a blade against a woman.
...If we have no business to discuss, then leave me alone.
A ninja must serve a master... So that means I'm now beholden to [S]?
So, a ninja must work exclusively in the shadows to complete missions...
Visit: My business will be short. I'm only here to deliver a personal message from [F].
Level: Moving on to the next mission.
It's settled.
Was my presence detected?
Summon: I'm Navarre. Apparently ninja can be ordered to fight anyone, but I'm not so blindly loyal as to attack women.
Learn Skill: So this is what a ninja's power looks like... Not bad.
Confession:
Throughout my life, I've worked as a mercenary, a swordsman, and taken on various other jobs.
Were the employers immoral? Was the work dirty? Those details never affected me.
I thought working as a ninja would be no different. A job is a job. However, something preoccupied my interest...
The similarities between the path of the sword and the way of the ninja are apparent once you study both.
Although this is just a festival, I'm fortunate to have discovered this connection. I thank you...
Status: I am Navarre. These clothes are for the festival.
Back off unless you have a death wish.
Ninja excel at assassination and intelligence gathering. I wouldn't want to make enemies of them.
There are female ninja, yes. But I shall not raise my blade against them.
Sword or not, if it has a blade, I will master it.
Perhaps someday I'll be able to let my guard down and enjoy a festival like this...
If you require my aid, then I will fight for you.

hana2.name: Hana
hana2.title: Focused Ninja
hana2.description: A samurai from Hoshido who serves as Sakura's retainer. She heard the ninja festival was being held and is attending with pride and high spirits. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: There are ninja dojos near Hoshido, you know—in the countries of Mokushu and Kohga.
Teamwork isn't exactly my forte. But I make up for it by being so capable on my own!
I wish this cherry-blossom pattern were a little flashier, but that'd make it harder to sneak around.
In this outfit, even the smallest tear will become a big gash. Good thing I always carry a needle and thread!
This steamed bun is from a ninja ration that Saizo gave me. Want a bite? It's good, I promise!
Visit:
Psst! I got a secret message for you from [F]!
Whaddaya think? Am I an impressive ninja or what?!
Level: I never miss an opening!
What are you looking at? You're wide open!
Don't blame me! It's the shuriken— they're not flying straight!
Summon: Hey, my name's Hana! I traded in my usual samurai outfit for ninja robes.
Learn Skill: I'm one step closer to becoming a master.
Confession:
What do you think? Would you say that I've become a master ninja yet?
See, when I first heard about this festival I thought: There's no way I can be a ninja!
I didn't know how to throw shuriken, didn't know the first thing about stealth combat.
But it turns out, being a samurai isn't so different from being a ninja! It all comes down to dedication.
There's someone I want to protect. Whether I'm a samurai or ninja or whatever else, I will protect them!
With everything I've learned at this festival, I'm sure to be even better at keeping them safe.
Status: I am Hana of Hoshido. I may not be wielding my katana, but my form is still first-rate!
Oh! You must have the silent footsteps of a ninja to sneak up on me like that.
Hoshido's ninja are masters of their art...but who's to say a samurai can't learn their trade, too?
I need to continue training hard and learning all I can, so I may always keep Lady Sakura safe!
Throwing a shuriken is a lot harder than it looks...but check THIS out!
The garb of a ninja is different from what I'm used to. I'll ask Kagero's advice.
I can serve you as a ninja, but only when I appear as one… I hope you have many tasks for me!

guinivere.name: Guinivere
guinivere.title: Princess of Bern
guinivere.description: Princess of Bern, and sister of the king, Zephiel. Her beauty, kindness, and intelligence make her popular among her people. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: The Fire Emblem is the key to awaken the blade that can bind dragons. My late father told me this long ago.
My brother...he has changed. He has awakened dragons, which will bring freedom to the world, in his eyes...
Is it true that the larger a land gets, the more it must crush the hearts of its people? I hope not.
Do you have an errand? Were you amenable, I would be pleased to join you.

This castle is home to so many Heroes who have brought wars to an end...
I would very much like to collect their knowledge and use it to architect a lasting peace.
Visit: It is often that I hear [F] mention [S].
Level: Let us move forward! For the good of all in the land!
I have betrayed Bern, betrayed my brother...and yet, I am still proud to be of Bern.
Even if my name is cursed as a traitorous princess... My convictions will not waver.
Summon: I am Guinivere. My elder brother is Zephiel, the King of Bern. I must stop him at all costs.
Learn Skill: Yes. I am prepared.
Confession:
My brother is not a trivial man who dreams of easily bringing the world to heel...
He sees himself as a liberator. I have heard him speak of it time and again, seen the darkness in his sad eyes.
No matter the justification, there is no cause to drag innocents into a war and steal their lives. Surely you agree.
He was so kind to me when we were young, but I know that those days are gone. And so...I must stop him.
With your knowledge and bravery, I believe that I can overcome any challenge. Please remain with me.
Status: I am Guinivere. My elder brother is Zephiel, the King of Bern.
Oh! You gave me quite the fright. I used to play the same prank on Zephiel when I was a girl, you know.
I...I must stop my brother, before it is too late. I must.
Melady and Elen are the best retainers a princess could ask for. I have nothing but gratitude for them.
Lord Roy may be young, but he has a greatness about him that belies his years... I believe he will make things right.
I do fear that, if I am remembered by history, it will not be fondly but as a princess who betrayed her own kingdom.
When I'm with you, I somehow feel a rush of confidence...the very confidence required to face my fate with head held high.

melady.name: Melady
melady.title: Crimson Rider
melady.description: A wyvern rider who accompanies Guinivere. Though she is conflicted about opposing her homeland, she is loyal to her lady. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I pledged my loyalty and fought proudly as a knight of Bern. I never intended to fight you, Galle...
Knowing she would be vilified, the princess took flight all the same. She should hold her head high.
Your role is to lead, is it not? Leave the trivialities to others. It is past time you should rest.
I would ride today—a good, long ride. Would you join me? I will be happy to serve as your guide and support.
She might look intimidating, but she's quite docile, really. Say hello, Tryffin!
Visit: I am Melady. Today I serve as an envoy bearing a message from [F].
Level: I will continue my momentum, riding this strong wind! For my lady, Princess Guinivere!
In order for my lady to continue on the path she has chosen, I must become stronger.
I regret this.
Summon: I am Melady, a knight serving her highness, Princess Guinivere. It is an honor to meet you.
Learn Skill: Thank you so much. Tryffin is pleased as well.
Confession:
I have a question...does leading a group of women and men into battle not cause you some distress?
My path was clear from the beginning. I trained to become a wyvern rider, like my father and grandfather.
Then I pledged my oath as a knight to Her Highness, the king's splendid daughter. My path was ever clear.
Zeiss also had a sensible upbringing, even if he can be foolish... But enough about me! What of you?
It is not often you open up about yourself. It might alleviate your distress to do so.
After all, we are allies, and we put our lives in each other's hands.
Status: I am Melady, and this is Tryffin. Pleased to make your aquaintance.
What?! *sigh* It seems etiquette here is much different than in Bern.
I am a knight of Bern, but first and foremost, I live to serve Lady Guinivere.
Like my father and his father before him, I am a wyvern rider, continuing our family's legacy.
My younger brother Zeiss is also a wyvern rider. He can be a bit rash sometimes, so I keep an eye on him.
Galle...if this war continues... will we really be forced to fight against each other?
In my eyes, you are just as worthy of my protection and loyalty as Lady Guinivere.

dieck.name: Dieck
dieck.title: Wounded Tiger
dieck.description: Head of the mercenary groups employed by Pherae, having once been a gladiator himself. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Seeing those two kids all grown up and treating me with respect... Guess it's proof of how old I've gotten.
Everyone in my band has serious skill. Some of 'em aren't the most reliable, but even Shanna is the real deal.
I ain't slackin' off. When it's time to rest, I rest. When it's time to eat, I eat. Might die tomorrow, after all.
Sneaking up on a merc? You want to get chopped in half? Though to be fair, I did see you comin'.
The most important thing? Training. Next most? Training. In this line of work, you have to hone yourself.
Visit: You [S]? Got word from [F].
Level: Body is movin' just like I want. Nobody's gonna beat me today! Who's next?
No shortcuts on the battlefield. Training's all you got.
Seems like the wind's not blowin' my way... May be time to pack it in for today.
Summon: You my new employer? If you want to hire Dieck, you better be ready to pay for Dieck.
Learn Skill: Well, aren't you fancy? For this, I'll put in the work. No problem.
Confession:
So, when's the next battle? Actually, before that, we need to talk.
To put it plain, I don't get you. Battle is serious, bloody business. You learn about someone on the battlefield...
And what I learned is that you don't take it seriously. Do you understand the stakes? It doesn't seem like it.
That's why you hired me? Hah! Can't argue with that logic. Guess you got me there.
Seems you do have guts! Well, as long as you can afford me, I'll stick by you. Let me know what you need.
Status: Yo. The name's Dieck. I lead a band of mercenaries.
Whoa! It ain't wise to sneak up on a mercenary, kid.
I used to work for Lord Pent and Lady Louise. They always looked out for me.
In the eyes of the ones giving the orders, mercenaries are just fodder. You've got no choice but to accept that if you make a living of it.
The folks in my crew ain't exactly the easiest to deal with... What can I say?
When you stare into the empty eye sockets of death itself, you learn something about what it means to be alive.
You point at the target, and I handle the steel. I'm the professional.

merlinus.name: Merlinus
merlinus.title: Pherae's Clerk
merlinus.description: Tactician of Pherae for generations. Formerly a traveling merchant. Travels with Roy and serves as an advisor. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I am an important person in House Pherae. The family's head himself chose me as his seneschal, after all!

Can you credit it that the princess of Bern was shut up in the cellar of a castle in the middle of nowhere?
Even I, with all of my years of experience, could not have foreseen such a thing!
Pushing yourself like this is simply unacceptable. I won't allow it! The night is a time of rest.
I was a merchant, but Lord Roy's father rescued me, you see. Thanks to that, I came to serve his house.
♪ Hmm, hmm, hmm... ♪ Hmm. I may not be as boisterous as I used to be. I must project dignity at all times!
Visit: I am here on behalf of the esteemed [F].
Level: I know, I know... Luck such as this is fleeting. Perhaps I should withdraw while things are going well!
Do I have talent for fighting? Dear me, no. I favor a hasty retreat!
Oh, no. No, no, no. Fighting pointless battle after battle is no strategy!
Summon: I am Merlinus, seneschal to House Pherae. I may not be a warrior, but I have knowledge and courage aplenty!
Learn Skill: I see! You would have me make use of this treasure. I gladly accept!
Confession:
Commander Anna, was it? She struck me as a tad flighty, but in truth she has the situation well in hand!
I must say that her invitation to share drinks after the end of the fighting was unexpected—and quite gracious!
Speaking of being in control, you're doing a fine job, aren't you? I'm reminded of Lord Eliwood...
That power of yours could generate a tidy profit, I say! Not for me, no, but for all to share in.
We're much the same, aren't we? Strong convictions and a thirst for justice! Ha-ha!
Status: I am Merlinus, a humble servant of my lord Eliwood, Marquess Pherae.
Hyaaaa! You nearly gave me a heart attack. Have some respect for your elders, you rascal!
*sigh* I know nothing of combat! How did I end up in this mess?
Do not overlook the importance of merchants. Without us, there could be no battle!
I dreamt of working for a noble house for so long...and I saw my dream come true!
What a joy it is, seeing my Lord Roy grow into such a fine young man.
You are not a noble but...bah, it matters not. You are worthy of my services, and my services you shall receive!

galle.name: Galle
galle.title: Azure Rider
galle.description: Considered by many to be the strongest Wyvern Lord of Bern's army, he is loyal to the leader of the Wyvern Generals, Murdock. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Oh, Melady... The days we spent together were my happiest. If only we had met in peaceful times...
His Majesty gave this Etrurian outsider a place in Bern... It was only natural I pledge myself to his service.
Your attire is unsuited to battle. If you plan on taking to the front lines, you are either courageous or eccentric.
I am simply tending to my wyvern. Forming a bond with the partner you fight alongside comes naturally.
A gathering of wyvern riders from across many worlds... A gathering of the elite. I won't soon be bested.
Visit: I am Galle, wyvern rider of Bern. I bear a message from an ally. Are you [S]?
Level: Now you ken the strength of the wyvern riders of Bern!
I cannot take pride in this. I will continue my training.
Purely an amateur. Pah!
Summon: I am Galle, wyvern rider of Bern. If you are honorable, my mount and I stand ready to aid you.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks. Know also I will repay you. That is my way.
Confession:
Ah, [S]...
Oh, it's nothing important. I was just reflecting on something that happened long ago...
I believed in my path. I obeyed my leader, fought my hardest, and yet was defeated. And I regret none of it.
However, here I've been able to speak to old friends and other Heroes...and perhaps...another path was open.
I can see what you think of this. I am a knight. My convictions and loyalties guide me. I will fight and die for them.
That is how I live my life. So, let us go and strike down your foes. I will take to the skies with a clear heart.
Status: I am Galle, a knight of Bern.
Melady?! Oh. It's you.
You must crush all who stand in the way of your cause...no matter who they are.
In battle, we are but servants to our betters. It's that simple.
Zeiss doesn't mince words. Melady can count on him.
Oh, Melady... Our days together were the happiest of my life. To have met you was incredible luck.
You have proven yourself worthy of my trust. I am at your command.

triandra.name: Triandra
triandra.title: Nightmare
triandra.description: A dökkálfr from Dökkálfheimr, the realm of nightmares. Delivers terrible dreams to mortals. Cold and distant, she lives on without hope.

Castle Hall: This is the land called Askr, then. It is full of kindness. I do not belong.

Dökkálfheimr is a realm of nightmare. When people wake from nightmares, they are usually relieved.
"Just a dream," they say...
...Stop looking at me.
Our world exists only because people have nightmares... Dökkálfheimr was born from dreaming mortals...
There is a mortal I always dreamed of killing. Such a dream must make me despicable to you...
Visit: My name is Triandra. I am from the nightmare realm and bring terror care of [F].
Level: Yes, I remember... I need power to protect her...
I am nightmare...
Whose bad dream is this?
Summon: I am Triandra. I come from the land of your nightmares, and nightmares are all I have to offer.
Learn Skill: Thank you. You are kinder than I deserve.
Confession:
What were you like as a child? Strong? Weak?
I was weak, and I realized one truth: A weak person can do nothing.
Kind and virtuous people are crushed under the heel of the malicious.
Without strength, you cannot protect what you care about. I had to do what I did. For her. To protect her...
I apologize for bringing this up so suddenly. I'm not sure why I'm telling you any of this in the first place...
I suppose I want someone to know me...someone to understand.
Special: If it's a nightmare you want...
Status: And again.
Nightmares unending.
I am Triandra… of dökkálfheimr.
*annoyed gasp* What are your intentions?
For mortals, nightmares are bitter, even painful... I'll never have the chance to make anyone happy...
I once had a sister I loved very much... Didn't I?
Cursed with a dökkálfr as an ally? Unlucky.

freyja.name: Freyja
freyja.title: Lady of Nightmare
freyja.description: The queen of Dökkálfheimr, the nightmare realm. Her love for her brother Freyr drives her to wish she could stay with him no matter the cost.

Castle Hall: I detest mortals... If not for them, I would still be at my brother's side.

When I was young, I was tormented for the way I looked. Only my brother was ever kind to me...
Only he showed me love.
It was you who summoned me, then. I will do as you wish...
You alone deserve my respect. Give me your orders—but I won't tolerate being spoken down to.
You've interrupted my reminiscence. What is it that you want?
Visit: I am Freyja, lest you forget. To you lowly mortals, I am nothing less than a god.
Level: A queen's power.
Serving under mortals... Humiliation yet again.
Could it be that I have not fully adapted to life outside the dream?
Summon: I am Freyja, ruler of Dökkálfheimr, a god from beyond this mortal realm. To be summoned here... Disgraceful.
Learn Skill: If you insist. But how will this change me?
Confession:
Dream or reality? You chose reality. And you reunited with your friends.
Reality shifts with time, though, doesn't it? To rejoin reality is not an ending, nor is it happy.
Reality is cruel... Being from that cold world of steel, you should know such truths well, [S].
If you wish, I could offer you a dream. A little escape...
You could be free from the anxieties of the future... No sadness or pain... You could be free from it all, forever.
So, I ask again: Dream or reality? Which do you choose?
Status: I am Freyja... To mortals, I am known as the goddess of love.
Ah! Unforgivable! You're not Freyr.
The love my brother and I feel is deeper than most siblings...
Since the day Freyr rebuffed me, I have made the realm of nightmares my home.
I am so much more than any lowly mortal. I demand your respect.
Why, Freyr? My love for you... Why?
You resemble him not one iota. So tell me...why do I care?

reginn.name: Reginn
reginn.title: Bearing Hope
reginn.description: Adoptive sister of Niðavellir's king, Fáfnir. Chooses to work together with Askr to stop her suddenly changing brother.

Castle Hall: Fáfnir, Ótr—my brothers... If only we could go back to when we lived together in peace...
In my country, there are many incredible machines. I'd love to understand what makes them tick!
One thing you ought to know about me is, I'm an excellent cook. I could make a great meal here and now!
Being in such a huge castle is so exciting! Want to explore with me? ...Prince Alfonse won't mind, right?
My brother gave me this compass. I like to keep it polished. The day may come when I'll need to use it again.
Visit: My name's Reginn! Let's be friends! I'm already full-on friends with your friend [F], soo...
Level: All thanks to [S]!
I want to get stronger, but I know I mustn't rush it.
Ugh. Disappointing. But I mustn't give in to misery...
Introduction: Hello! My name is Reginn! I could use your strength. Will you help me? Niðavellir, my home, is in trouble!
Summon: I'm Reginn! I'm here to help, and that is exactly what I'll do. Pretty soon you and I will be full-on friends!
Learn Skill: Oh, wow! You're sure? I won't let this go to waste!
Confession:
...Oh! I hadn't noticed you there. Sorry about that. I can be a bit absentminded sometimes.
I know I'm usually thinking about my brothers, but...this time I was thinking about you.
You're just...such a mystery to me, [S]!
You forgave me for attacking you, and you agreed to help me, and... I appreciate that.
When I'm with you, I feel a little more at ease. Which isn't to say I don't feel nervous around you...
...Now's no time to get shy, Reginn!
I don't know what the future has in store, but it's comforting to know you'll be right there with me.
Status: I'm Reginn. Who are you? ... No, let me start again. I am Reginn. It's an honor to make your acquaintance.
Argh! Oh, it's you? Cut it out already!
I don't remember my parents, but... Don't waste your worry on me. I'm not sad.
My brother Fáfnir is a Hero to me. He's always protected me.
Ótr may be hot-tempered, but underneath it all, he's a sweet guy.
I hope my brothers and I can all live together as a family again someday.
Thanks for all your help. Before you know it, I'll be returning the favor!

duessel.name: Duessel
duessel.title: Obsidian
duessel.description: One of Grado's oldest generals, he is known as the Obsidian, one of the Imperial Three. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: When Prince Lyon and his mages, after great effort, finally produced the Dark Stone, everything changed.

Emperor Vigarde was a wise man with a good heart, celebrated as the Silent Emperor...
For him to suffer the fate he did is too terrible to bear.

When I tossed my honor aside and turned traitor to the empire, I knew what was coming for me.
I hoped only that His Majesty would rediscover the kindness I once knew.

I've trained with just about anything you can call a weapon.
Prince Ephraim may hold my lance prowess in high esteem, but I think of myself as a jack-of-all-blades.
I have no objection to being branded a traitor. I regret only turning on the empire and, despite it all, His Majesty.
Visit:
I see. So you're a summoner, just like [F].
There really is no telling from appearance alone, is there?
Level: Any who face me had better have their affairs in order!
The strength of Obsidian has not waned since His Majesty, Emperor Vigarde, bestowed the honor on me.
I will muster every last ounce of my strength to serve what remains of Grado and its people.
Summon: I am Duessel the Obsidian of the Imperial Three—or rather, that is who I once was. Now I am just an old man.
Learn Skill: You ought to favor those with more youthful vigor, eager to grow... Nevertheless, you have my thanks.
Confession:
As a warrior, it is when I am closest to death that I feel most alive. Fate's sense of humor, I suppose.
When the evil of the Dark Stone gripped Grado, I lost my honor, everything—I was a hollow shell.
Perhaps I should have remained and followed the orders of my emperor.
I could have died for Grado and avoided the shame that followed my betrayal.
But how can I sit by as the young— Prince Ephraim, Glen, Cormag, Selena, Prince Lyon—risk their lives.
I will fight to my last breath for the young warriors marching to war to defend their countries.
My final wish is for a new Grado to be founded, and I will bear that weight however I must.
Status: I am Duessel. I was once the obsidian general of the Grado Empire, but cirumstances demand I turn my back on my home.
I haven't seen a soldier show guts like that in a long time. Good on you. Haha!
As a warrior, I take pride in improving my skills and passing them on to willing students.
Ephraim has grown strong. There's nothing left for me to teach him, it seems.
This lance is one of the last weapons forged by Gavaleus. It is my pride and joy. Care for a closer look?
Surely, Cormag will be able to tame that cursed lance once and for all...
I'll keep a good eye out for you. Command me without worry.

selena2.name: Selena
selena2.title: Fluorspar
selena2.description: Commoner from out of a desolate village who used her magic ability to become the Fluorspar of the Imperial Three. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Myrrh told me the darkness had to be stopped—but it was already too late for His Majesty...
We generals were meant to protect our people, not assail our neighbors. Our power exists to serve the weak.
It's said the Sacred Stones drove the darkness back long ago. Yet we were ordered to destroy them...

Ahh... Plenty of warm water, pristine bathing tubs... Oohh, I could certainly get used to the luxury on offer here.
...Oh! How long have you been there?
I got a fine barrel, and I aim to ferment some local vegetables to mimic the flavors of home.
Visit: I am Selena. I bear a message from [F].
Level: Ever since His Majesty bestowed the gift of the title Fluorspar on me, I've given everything I have as his general.
I will not senselessly take another's life, and I will lay no hand on any who lack the power to resist!
I am a general of the Grado Empire and servant to Emperor Vigarde. I am Selena, Fluorspar.
Summon: Urgh... Wh-where— Who... Right. I am Selena of the Imperial Three. Selena, Fluorspar.
Learn Skill: I am grateful, but this is more than I deserve. I hope to live up to your expectations of me.
Confession:
Your Majesty, I— Oh. Please forgive me, [S].
I am grateful for your guidance.
Even so, I still remain unable to understand my true purpose in this world.
What I do know is that you have a kind heart, and in that you remind me of Emperor Vigarde.
In a way, that kindness alone can be dangerous, if it can be twisted and taken advantage of.
But I believe that is a lesson you've well learned, or you would not have made it to where you stand now.
So I will fight by your side to help bring about the world you envision, for I know it, too, will be a kind one.
Status: I am the Grado empire's servant and His Majesty's vassal. Call me General Selena, the Fluorspar.
You have a peculiar way of fraternizing, you know that?
On my emperor's command, I will fight without hesitation—even against my allies.
The role of an imperial general is that of the shield, not the blade.
I was but a commoner raised in poverty. Our village stopped paying taxes one winter, but the emperor sent provisions anyway. He saved my village—saved me.
My path may be considered foolish, I know. Yet it is my duty as a knight...
Ah. You resemble His Majesty in many ways. He was...so benevolent.

natasha.name: Natasha
natasha.title: Sacred Healer
natasha.description: A gentle cleric from Grado, and a woman of beauty and grace. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Grado is responsible for the war. The only way to restore peace is to stop them, and so stop the war.
I was born near the Renais border, so I heard my fair share of rumors about King Fado and his family.
Moments before he was sentenced to death, my mentor informed me of the plot to destroy the Sacred Stones.
Neither Emperor Vigarde nor Prince Lyon are themselves... A demon has driven Grado to madness.
Do you think our prayers reach our gods even from this world? ...Don't answer. I'd rather believe they do.
Visit: Let us pray and give thanks for friends like [F]...
Level: What happens to me is not important. My only wish is to excise evil and return light to Grado!
Is anyone hurt? I can attend to any wounds...
Please! Grant me the strength I require!
Summon: I am Natasha, a cleric from Grado. I have little skill beyond prayer, but if I can help in any way, I will.
Learn Skill: For me? Thank you. I will use it with care.
Confession:
You wonder why I put myself on the field of battle despite being a simple cleric.
I betrayed my country to spread news of the changes in Grado. My mentor...didn't make it out.
All I could do was work to heal those wounded in war against Grado. Only to then send them back out to war...
So, I am drawn to the battlefield to repent for the blood shed. Purely selfish reasons.
I must atone for my sin eventually, in one way or another. When the time comes, will you stand by me?
Status: You are saved.
Believe in me.
My name is Natasha. I was a servant of the people at Grado's Imperial Temple.
The emperor is not himself. You all MUST be able to see that!
If we are able to save and rebuild Grado, I don't care what happens to me.
Please! Grant me strength. The strength to tell the truth...
So, you are the light that guides Heroes to this world...

knoll.name: Knoll
knoll.title: Darkness Watcher
knoll.description: Royal mage of Grado and researcher of dark magic. He knows the secret of Prince Lyon's change and the Dark Stone's creation. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: With Prince Lyon, we sought to see into Grado's future. I wished only to help our people.
The land trembles, many die... That is the future we saw. Our Sacred Stone shattered, and Prince Lyon...changed.
The hearts of the Heroes here shine with a pure light—a courageous light. So bright it is, I fear I will be blinded.
The revival of that ancient dark magic was always part of Prince Lyon's plan...
Mages are not often thought of with fondness. Many believe we rely on demons to perform our magic.
Visit:
Why I was sent here is unknown to me. I am not suited for such friendly gestures.
...You agree, do you not?
Level: This, too, is a great punishment. There are some powers best left unknown.
To be a mage is to test every boundary you face. To do otherwise is against our nature.
In this darkness, there is peace.
Summon: I am Knoll...a former royal mage of Grado. I would prefer to speak no more about it.
Learn Skill: Time is like the water of a river: it flows ever on, never stopping.
Confession:
You use the power of other worlds to wage war... Prince Lyon would approve, no doubt.
We read of a spell entitled time shear. It causes, in effect, a hole in time, punching through cause and effect.
It allows you to meddle with time and other worlds. And here you are, the full expression of that. If only...
Prince Lyon sought only to help our people. He foresaw a great disaster approaching...
That is but one facet of the power of time shear. And now...you have some of that power, Summoner.
To be frank, I fear that power of yours. Even so, I wish to see where you lead this world.
Status: My name is Knoll. I was one of Grado's top researchers in arcane matters.
If you need something, I would rather you simply call to me.
I was branded a traitor and arrested. I was just one day from execution.
It is said that time flows like a river... Does it follow that you can read that flow? Each ripple, every wave?
There are as many truths in the world as there are people to tell them. Find the truth that speaks to you.
All Prince Lyon wanted was to help people. And we were his servants.
I had lost my way... But as long as I'm with you, I may be able to find it again.

caellach.name: Caellach
caellach.title: Tiger Eye
caellach.description: The Tiger Eye of Grado's six generals. Rose from mercenary life doing whatever it takes to achieve his goals. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Yeah, I've smashed a few Sacred Stones. Lot of fuss over something so fragile.
I like this world. No shortage of battles here! Climbing the ranks through war suits me perfectly.
I like this castle. It'd make a suitable palace when I take over, wouldn't it? Oh, don't get incensed. Only kidding.
Do you want a job when you're done summoning for Askr? If I had you with me, no one could stop us.
Let me give you a little advice... When you're across the table from someone, watch both their hands.
Visit: You're the [S] [F] spoke of? Huh. All right.
Level: You're just another stepping-stone on my way to the throne!
Well done. Now, is there something you want from me?
Wait, that's all? Hang on a second!
Summon: Ah-haha! I'm Caellach, and I will be king one day! Stick with me, and I'll see you get yours.
Learn Skill: Good, good. With this, I could...yes... Don't worry, I don't have any plans. Not yet.
Confession:
It's been long enough. Are you ready to join me? ...I suppose you still have business here—but the offer stands!
You may not understand it, but I have a vision for myself! I was born a man in this world, and that means...
Like all men, my dream is to be king! And I'll do whatever it takes to make that dream come true.
Y'know... You could always abandon this place and join forces with me.
And do what? It's obvious, isn't it! We'd conquer! It won't be easy, but with you by my side, we can do it!
Status: The name's Caellach, but some call me the Tiger Eye. I fought in the desert as a mercenary.
What's the big idea? Looking for a fight?
Hah! So that hunk of rock is a Sacred Stone, eh? Seems kind of fragile...
I'm sick to death of living like a desert rat. I'm going to be a king one day.
I'm not like that freak Valter. I'm kind to women.
My palace... Oh, how I do like the sound of that.
I like you. You've got guts.

altina2.name: Altina
altina2.title: Cross-Time Duo
altina2.description: Altina, the founder of Begnion, and her descendant Sanaki, binding past and future. They appear in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn / Path of Radiance.
altina2.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Grants【Vantage】to unit.
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Vantage】 If foe initiates combat, unit can counterattack before foe's first attack for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Sanaki**: I wonder... Could I create a world where the laguz and beorc live together too?
**Sanaki**: Begnion was founded by none other than my great forbear, the empress Altina, of the Three Heroes.
**Altina**: Sanaki is fortunate. She is surrounded by so many who adore her.
**Altina**: You say you're the...37th empress? I am suddenly weary with the weight of time's passing.
**Altina**: Our fight was not in vain. Looking at Sanaki and the rest, I feel that in the core of my being.
Visit: **Altina**: Shall we explore this castle, Sanaki? I am sure our friend won't mind, will you, [S]?
Level: **Altina**: The powers granted by the Goddess of Dawn live on in my line, and will continue far into the future!
**Altina**: Are you still in one piece, Sanaki?
**Sanaki**: Lady Altina must not see me acting like such a coward!
Summon: My name is Altina. And this is my descendant, Sanaki.
Learn Skill: **Altina**: Sanaki, can you feel it? With this, we can grow even stronger!
Confession:
**Sanaki**: Lady Altina always wished for the beorc and the laguz to band together and create a peaceful world...
But as time went on, the people of the continent moved counter to Altina's wishes...
**Altina**: Sanaki, it's nothing to worry yourself over. My dream for Tellius and the seeds of my hope live on.
When we accept each other and value our differences, we can make progress, no matter our tribes.
**Sanaki**: Lady Altina...
**Altina**: And I believe you can help build that new future as well—for all Heroes, [S].
Status: Yes.
You look nice.  Do I?
Conversation: **Sanaki**: Are you... You're Lady Altina, right? You founded the Begnion Empire.
**Altina**: That is correct. And you are mine and Lehran's... Oh my! Let me have a look at you.
Hmm... You certainly have my hair. And I see traces of his face in yours...
**Sanaki**: You're making me blush, Lady Altina...
**Altina**: Oh! My apologies. It's just... I'm so very pleased to meet you.
**Sanaki**: You are? Oh...um... You should know something. I'm not the apostle you think I am.
**Altina**: What ever do you mean?
**Sanaki**: Well, the truth is... I cannot hear the goddess's voice. My abilities are...unremarkable.

But you... You were able to defeat Yune!
And generations of apostles were able to predict disasters. I have nothing like that.
Yet I still call myself apostle... Lady Altina, I am so sorry.
**Altina**: What are you saying? You are alive and in good health. What more could I wish of you?
**Sanaki**: Lady Altina?
**Altina**: Let me tell you what I would wish for instead of a peaceful night of gift giving.
**Sanaki**: Wh-what is it? I'll do whatever I can to help!
**Altina**: I would wish simply to hold you, and to comfort you, as a mother does her beloved child.
**Sanaki**: Oh. If that's all you want, then—oh my! How impetuous you are!
Mm... Actually, this is really nice. Thank you.
Duo Skill: The two of us together.  Of course!

bernadetta2.name: Bernadetta
bernadetta2.title: Frosty Shut-In
bernadetta2.description: Daughter of Count Varley, Minister of Religion to the Adrestian Empire. Pressed to join the winter festival despite her fear of strangers. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Aaah—I just came to give out gifts! Nothing suspicious here! Sorry!
I was born on the twelfth of the Ethereal Moon, right in the middle of winter. Still hate the cold, though...
I don't know why everyone's asking me what I want now. I've been saying for ages I just want to be left alone!
Did you say burn a candle...or Bernie candle?! Aaah! Please don't make a candle out of meeee!
Ugh, why'd you have to wear such bright colors, Bernie?! Nobody wants to see you stand out like this. Stupid!
Visit: Um...hi. I brought you a winter festival gift from [F]. Can I go now?
Level: Is it over? It's over, right? We're all finished here? Can I go?
Home feels so far away. I miss my room...
Aaah! Careful! Last time someone snuck up on me like that, I fainted standing up!
Summon: Um, hi. I'm Bernadetta. It's cold out, so I'll just be in my... Huh? Festival? What did I do to deserve this?!
Learn Skill: You have a gift? For me? R-really? Wait...is this a trick?
Confession:
If nothing else, this festival's shown me different people enjoy holidays differently, [S].
Some folks want big, loud gatherings. I get it, sort of, but that's...definitely not me.
Even so, I think it did me good to come out a little. I'm kind of amazed I didn't completely hate it, honestly.
So...I feel like I should thank you. Because without you, I wouldn't have even tried.
However it might turn out, it's no good for me to decide I'd hate something before giving it a chance.
Wait, what? There are MORE of these festivals?! No way, forget it! One was enough! Count me ooouuut!
Status: Festivals would be perfect...if there weren't other people around.
Aaaah! I mean, um... It'll take more than that to s-sneak up on me!
Snow is so nice. I want to build a snowy cave and shut myself inside.
My perfect gift would be a room just for me...with a lock. A big lock.
Don't look! You'll spoil the present I'm making for you...
♪Hm hm-hm...♪ Ah! How long have you been standing there?!
I feel comfortable around you. It's making me sleepy...

hilda2.name: Hilda
hilda2.title: Holiday Layabout
hilda2.description: Noble of the Leicester Alliance and daughter of House Goneril. Will this lazy girl lift a finger at the winter festival? Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You know what you deserve even more than all these gifts? You need a break, [S]!
My brother always gives the most amazing gifts. I can't wait to see what he comes up with this year.
Sephiran and Bernadetta are pitching in with the festival, huh? I, um...better give them a hand.
Festivals can be pretty exhausting, but the cute clothes make it worth the effort.
You ever wonder how great these festivals would be if Claude used his scheming talent for party planning?
Visit: Brrr! Could you show me to the fire? I can't believe I agreed to come all this way for [F]...
Level: A festival is pretty much the only time I'm likely to overdo it. I can never resist a good party.
What do you mean I could be doing more? I've literally never worked harder than this in my entire life.
Huh? No, that was my pre-lunch nap break. This is my post-lunch stretch break. Totally different breaks.
Summon: Hilda here! Hm? You want help with the winter festival? I'll do it, but don't get your hopes up too much, OK?
Learn Skill: Oh, is this for me? How lovely! You wouldn't spoil this moment by asking me to work harder, would you?
Confession:
I've got to be honest with you. All this giving has worn me out. Receiving gifts is so much easier!
It's been fun, though. And, I have to say, I feel like I maybe learned something this winter festival.
People don't just smile when you come through for them with a great gift. They positively sparkle.
That kind of cheer is nice to see. And to know I had a hand in it is... Well, it's something, that's for sure!
I don't know if I'd go so far as to say giving is BETTER than getting. Let's face it, that just wouldn't be me.
Even so—thanks for showing me the power of generosity. Now, let's enjoy ourselves, [S]!
Special: Got you something big and sweet!
Status: What do you think of my winter look? Cute, right?
Guh! I know this is a festival, but don't you think you're going a little overboard?
Oh, I wouldn't dream of asking you for a present, but if you're offering... Some sweets would be nice.
Delivering presents is grueling labor for a delicate flower like me. If only somebody would do it for me...
Sure, I used to love playing in the snow! Then I turned 11.
Aw, everything's so shiny and beautiful. I wish my brother were here to see this.
Don't you worry, there's an extra-special present in your future... Once I think of one...

sephiran.name: Sephiran
sephiran.title: Hoary Sovereign
sephiran.description: Senior Statesman of Begnion and Prime Minister who serves Sanaki. Wields his abilities with great skill even at the winter festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Something in the air of this world seems familiar to me. Perhaps it is only the celebration.
Empress Sanaki is like a ray of sunlight. Such warmth is necessary during a wintertime celebration.
I have walked across all the lands of Tellius, and I must admit that Askr's festivals are second to none.
There are more presents to deliver than I had anticipated. I suppose I have no choice... I'll need a helper.
The scale of the decorations is simply marvelous.
Visit: I am...a pilgrim. My name is Sephiran. I come bearing wintertime gifts from [F]'s castle.
Level: From the depths of my heart, I thank you, for this is not the result of my efforts alone.
I wonder... Am I living up to what everyone expects of me?
I do not fit this role well... It must be that the goddess sees through to the truth.
Summon: I am...a pilgrim. My name is Sephiran. What a cheerful celebration. I am glad to play my part.
Learn Skill: Your selection is praiseworthy. This should make for an exciting festival indeed.
Confession:
Ah, hello. You've timed our meeting perfectly. I've just finished handing out the gifts.
It warmed my heart seeing everyone come together to celebrate the winter festival with one another.
In Askr, it isn't just the royals and the commonfolk, there's the beorc and laguz too...
The two peoples have overcome their differences in order to build a better future, side by side.
If I had known such a thing were possible... How different my choices would have been...
Ah. Do forgive me. I've begun to babble, I fear. As I was saying...
There is a lot one can learn from the people of Askr. For summoning me here, I cannot thank you enough.
Status: Are you injured?
Let's fix you up.
Today, I don the attire of the winter festival. Does it suit me?
This is a gift for Lady Sanaki. I know her well.
The amassing snow gently conceals all sadness... That's the sort of celebration this is.
If I'd have known a future like this would come... What could I have done?
So these happy moments are your gifts. I shall treasure them.

felix2.name: Felix
felix2.title: Icy Gift Giver
felix2.description: Heir to the Dukedom of Fraldarius. What trials await during the winter festival for one known for always practicing with his sword? Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You seriously want me to go around delivering gifts? Hmph. Make the boar do it. That'll be good for a laugh.
My only interest is in honing my skill with a sword. Festivals are an unwelcome distraction.
I don't even want to think about what Sylvain would say if he caught me wearing this.
This whole thing feels pointless to me...but I understand it helps some people relax.
Maybe if I think of the festival as a kind of training... No. Still dumb.
Visit: I'm Felix. I'm here to take on your strongest fighters...and to deliver gifts from [F].
Level: I have no time for stupid games. Here's your gift. Goodbye.
Stay out of my way and you won't get hurt. Simple as that.
Still can't believe I got caught up in this dumb festival. What was I thinking?
Summon: I am Felix Hugo Fraldarius...and I'm sure you think this outfit is funny. Get your laughs in while you can.
Learn Skill: No, I'm not having fun right now. How do you keep a straight face asking such asinine questions?
Confession:
Now that the festival is over, I want you to know exactly what I thought of it, [S].
It was a waste of time that would have been better spent training.
I'm not sure which is worse—that I spent all that time giving out gifts, or that I actually enjoyed it.
Their stupid smiles, their ridiculous words of gratitude... Ugh...
I hope you don't think I learned some kind of lesson from this. Or that I'll suddenly get all warm and fuzzy.
Let's just get back to training and forget this ever happened.
Special: This has your name on it.
Status: I'm Felix. Smirk at this outfit and I'll run you through.
What?! You think because I'm dressed like this, you can bother me?
We should be training, not wasting our time with this foolishness.
Sylvain would enjoy this stupid festival, no doubt.
What do I want? A new weapon. One forged by a master of the craft.
A night of celebration, shared with family... A hideous notion.
As much as I hate this frivolous festival... I don't hate seeing you smile.

lilina4.name: Lilina
lilina4.title: Firelight Leader
lilina4.description: Young leader of the Lycian League whose talent for magic is a force to be reckoned with. Known as one of the heroes who defeated Bern. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall:
Roy, my father...people were always there for me, no matter how hard things got...
That's why I can't give up. I have to fight, for everyone's sake!
Your power seems entirely different from the magic I know. Is it like the Dragon's Gate, perhaps? I wonder...
All right now, why don't you take a break. You seem a bit out of sorts, so why not relax?
I still study magic every day. It's just habit now! And Roy's the same with his sword training.

I caught a glimpse of a young version of my father! He had a child with him. I think it might have been me...
It felt a bit odd, so I kept my distance.
Visit: We can be friends too, right, [S]?
Level: My magic is a weapon of peace! With it, I will incinerate evil!
I may not fight like my father, but I won't embarrass myself in battle either.
...Hm? Oh, sorry! Was I staring off into the distance in the middle of a battle?
Summon: I am Lilina. I hope to succeed my father, Hector, and create an age of peace.
Learn Skill: Thank you. Let's keep helping each other succeed, just like this!
Confession:
There was a time I thought myself utterly alone, that there was no one who would help me.
My father, a truly magnificent man, was gone. And I thought I had to do it all on my own. But I was wrong.
Roy was there for me...and he wanted me there for him as well...
Without Roy and Cecilia's support, perhaps I, too, would have lost faith in humanity as King Zephiel did.
It's better this way, relying on others, standing side by side with friends...
That is why you must continue to love this world and offer it your support... For the sake of all of us.
Special: I call upon the red fire!
Status: Legendary Hero? Are you talking about Roy or my father?
Hm? The greetings of your country are quite different from the greetings of my own...
Even during peacetime, there are still so many who need a helping hand...
Through your efforts, I believe that this world can also find peace.
You are such a mysterious person... I'd love to learn more about you.
If it truly is the heavens that have given me this gift...then I'll use it for everyone's benefit.
No matter what world I find myself in, I'll be fine as long as you're by my side.

peony2.name: Peony
peony2.title: Álfar Dream Duo
peony2.description: Peony, bringer of sweet dreams and Triandra, deliverer of nightmares. Which dreams might they lay upon Askr?
peony2.duo: Grants another action, Atk/Spd/Def/Res+3, and the "unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces" status to adjacent ally with the highest HP for 1 turn. (Allies with Sing or Dance can be granted this effect as well. If multiple units meet the conditions, effect will not trigger.)

Castle Hall: **Triandra**: How is it I'm working with Peony now? Not that there's nothing to like about it...
**Peony**: I just know that Triandra and I will grow closer and closer. We do have a lot in common, after all...
**Peony**: Mortals come in all kinds, so I think there should be all kinds of dreams to go along with them!
**Peony**: The álfar dream too, you know! Mine is for everyone to get along, even if they're a ljósálfr and a dökkálfr!
**Triandra**: I have no need for happy dreams. No matter the dream, it always comes to an end eventually...
Visit: **Peony**: Hi! I'm Peony, and this is Triandra. We've come to deliver dreams all the way from [F]'s!
Level: **Peony**: I'm so happy! Even Triandra is smiling! ...A little?
**Triandra**: Not so sweet this time...
**Triandra**: Nightmares tend to follow one no matter where they go...
Summon: Hi! We're álfar from the dream realm! OK, Triandra, now it's your turn to give your most energetic greeting...
Learn Skill: **Triandra**: This warmth...is somehow familiar...
Confession:
**Peony**: I've been thinking, Triandra... There must be a reason the two of us were summoned together.
**Triandra**: Reason? Unlike you, I bring only nightmares and suffering to mortals. What reason could there be?
**Peony**: Well, nightmares aren't always bad... A nightmare can change the future!
If someone had a nightmare, they would want to be sure it never became reality, right?
Surely mortals could find good use even for the worst nightmare.
**Triandra**: You don't need to encourage her, [S]...
Even so, while I'm here, I will share your dream with you, if only for a little while.
Special: **Duo**: This year we'll be— Together again.
Status: Will we get New Year's gifts?
"So pretty, Triandra!" "Th-thanks..."
Conversation: **Peony**: Happy New Year, Triandra!
**Triandra**: To you as well, Peony. I imagine this time of year is rather busy for you.
They say the first dream after the festival decides a person's luck for the whole next year.
People must want to only see happy dreams tonight. Your sort of dream...
**Peony**: Oh, isn't it wonderful? I'll just have to work my hardest!
**Triandra**: Yes, do it for me. I...am not quite welcome at times like this. I'll try to stay out of the way.
**Peony**: Oh, Triandra... Hm... Oh, I know! I've got the perfect thing.
**Triandra**: Perfect thing?
**Peony**: I want to do everything I can to bring people their happy dreams.
So...I want you to come with me! Will you help me?
**Triandra**: Help you? Me? How?
**Peony**: Because when I'm with you, *I* feel happy!
You get it, right? After all, you are—
**Triandra**: I am Triandra, the Nightmare. The dreams I give people are... not like yours.
But...if you'd like, I suppose I can follow close behind. For moral support.
**Peony**: Hooray! With you there, I know I'll have no trouble at all!

plumeria2.name: Plumeria
plumeria2.title: Temptation Anew
plumeria2.description: A dökkálfr from Dökkálfheimr, the realm of nightmares. Delivers dreams crafted from mortal desires. In Askr for the New Year with enticing visions of broken resolutions.

Castle Hall: Though it's a departure from my everyday dress, a kimono does have a certain allure I've come to enjoy.

I wish I could celebrate the new year in Dökkálfheimr with Lady Freyja...
She'd hold a banquet so lovely, it'd be beyond even your wildest dreams.
If only for the first dream of the year, I'd enjoy some time alone with you. ...With innocent intentions, of course.
The indecent deserve no mercy, regardless of the year.
A new year, a chance to start anew... Even times like these are stained by the appetites of mortals.
Visit:
So you're [S], are you?
I've come to deliver your first dream of the year, with love from [F]...
Level: Ahh... This year will be filled with a love like none have ever known...
Hee hee... How were your dreams as the new year began? Pleasant, I hope...
Not a good sign for the year to come. Surely some vulgar mortals are to blame for this...
Summon: I am Plumeria the dökkálfr. Having to consort with mortals at the New Year is nothing short of a nightmare.
Learn Skill: Y-you're granting me new power? For what purpose? ...What is it you want from me?
Confession:
What hopeless beings mortals are. The audacity to proclaim their wants for the coming year...
And even in this attire, I've noticed the stares I receive from some are similarly audacious.
I hesitate to react in any way, for it seems any action can be subverted by an onlooker's secret desire.
With you, however, it's different. Your gaze is gentle, like a shroud of protective warmth.
A dökkálfr has no family, but our connection feels like I imagine family to feel—like home, like love...
Status: I understand this outfit is traditional in certain mortal lands... Do I look all right?
Unhand me, miscreant.
Do you know what most mortals dream of? Nothing I am willing to describe.
There seem to be many New Year's traditions. Can you tell me about some of them?
A New Year's gift...for me? Ah...thank you. Thank you very much.
Beautiful clothing, good food... This is what dreams SHOULD be.
You're staring because I am dressed unusually, right?

velouria2.name: Velouria
velouria2.title: Renewed Wolfpup
velouria2.description: A young woman of the wolfskin tribe. In high spirits and elegant clothes for the New Year. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: This outfit is...actually nice, I'll admit. But a stain or maybe some twigs and leaves stuck on it couldn't hurt.
I don't know why Hoshido wants to have outdoor parties on New Year's. It's so much warmer inside...
I went to the shrine to make my New Year's wish. What was it? To spend more time with Daddy, of course.
I've heard that children get special gifts on New Year's. You can give me mine now, [S].
Is that... *sniff sniff*... roasted mochi I smell? Mmm...
Visit: I'm Velouria. Can I smell your castle? *sniff sniff*... Hmm...different from [F]'s, but good.
Level: Oh, it's like finding a hairball on the side of the road! This year is going to be great.
I'm off to a good start this year. Daddy is sure to be impressed.
It's too cold out for this. Should have stayed home with my treasures...
Summon: Nice to meet you. I'm Velouria. Oh, I'm supposed to wish you Happy New Year too, right?
Learn Skill: If you really want to give it away... I guess I can take it off your hands.
Confession:
According to Selkie, the people of Hoshido say that New Year's Day is the key to the rest of the year.
I like the idea of setting goals for the year from the start. I think that makes a lot of sense.
So here's what I decided I'm going to do, [S].
I'm going to spend each day this year searching every corner of Askr for all the very best dust bunnies.
What? Hey, if I got a dust bunny for each time someone reacted like that, I'd already have a huge collection.
So if you think about it, in a way, it's sort of your fault I spend so much time collecting dust bunnies, isn't it?
Status: Woken up early AND I gotta wear these fancy things? Bleah.
Does my outfit look all right? Would you straighten it up a bit?
*sniff* You smell that? We're gonna eat it later!
I found lots of treasures during my big clean. So many dust bunnies!
Everybody's taking a break for New Year's. I can play with ANYBODY today!
Daddy's wearing a kimono too! He looks so handsome!
My New Years' resolution is to get more scratches behind the ears.

kaden2.name: Kaden
kaden2.title: Refreshed Kitsune
kaden2.description: Leader of the kitsune tribe who prides himself on his beautiful fur, but is donning a kimono for the occasion of the New Year! Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Have you seen Keaton in his kimono? He cuts an amazing silhouette! I'm actually kinda jealous.
The kitsune hamlet I lived in was part of Hoshido, so I'm pretty used to these New Year's traditions.
They say New Year's Day sets the tone for the whole year, so you can bet I'm gonna make sure I look good!
Selkie and I are gonna start off the New Year by visiting shrines. Wanna come with, [S]?
I feel like it'd solve a lot of problems if folks could just set fighting aside and enjoy the osechi on New Year's.
Visit: Happy New Year! Want some mochi? Freshly made! I brought it over from [F]'s castle.
Level: I feel sleek and shiny as a freshly brushed coat of fur. A good omen for the new year!
Great! Now let's hurry this up. We've got a party to get back to.
Can't let a little thing like this bring down the New Year's mood.
Summon: No one can throw a New Year's party like the stylish and beautiful kitsune. Lucky for you, you've got Kaden!
Learn Skill: How generous of you! I'll make it my resolution to pay you back this year!
Confession:
Thanks for getting me this amazing kimono, [S]. I love it!
I look great in everything, but New Year's traditional wear positively shimmers on me, don't you think?
Honestly...I appreciate all that, but most of all I'm grateful for the chance to share this celebration with Selkie.
For that priceless gift, I'm going to have to pay you back twice—no, ten times over!
Wait, what's ten times priceless? Is that even possible? Whatever, I'll figure something out.
You deserve nothing but the best. Let's all keep working together in the new year, [S]!
Status: This outfit does a great job of showing off my natural beauty.
No! It can't be! My tail is...ruffled.
New Year's is great! I like a holiday where you mostly eat and lie around.
I gave Selkie a little money for New Year's. Hope she spends it on something good!
Ready for a game? We got badminton...kites...and tops. I'm gonna win at any of 'em, though.
Nice of you to let me wear this beautiful kimono! I'll get you back later.
I know what the best part of your year will be: having me at your side!

keaton2.name: Keaton
keaton2.title: Resolved Wolfskin
keaton2.description: Proud leader of the wolfskin tribe. Celebrating the New Year in garb that is completely new to him. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I don't know how Kaden makes an outfit like this look comfortable. What's his secret?
Drawing omikuji's a New Year's tradition, I hear. My fortune's gonna be great—you'll see.
I wanna get Velouria a New Year's gift she'll really like. Any ideas?
Mochi's delicious, but make sure you chew it right. Seriously, you can choke if you're not careful.
What, my tail? Yeah, look at it go. Guess there's no use in trying to hide that I'm enjoying the party.
Visit: Hey, how'd I get here? Just a minute ago I was celebrating the new year with [F].
Level: Oh yeah! I'm in top form this year!
Nothing like a good hunt to kick off the new year.
Ugh... It's like a bad dream...
Summon: I'm Keaton, and I'm itching for the first fight of the new year! When do we get going?
Learn Skill: A New Year's gift? For me?!
Confession:
Enjoying the New Year's festivities? I've gotta admit, I'm having a great time, [S].
Sure, I was leery at first...especially about the uncomfortable clothes. Thought this'd be pretty tedious.
But the kites and the hagoita are pretty fun. And the osechi—oh, yeah! Talk about delicious!
More than that, though, it's great just to see everybody enjoy themselves. The energy rubs off, y'know?
Velouria seems to feel the same way. She actually likes the weird clothes too. Go figure.
Anyway, what I'm saying is I'm happy to celebrate New Year's any day. You can even put me in a silly outfit for it!
Special: A gift from me to you!
Status: Ugh, I'm not used to this outfit... How am I supposed to hunt like this?
If you wanna brush my fur, I won't stop you...
What do people do during the New Year? I'm not too familiar with Hoshidan customs.
I know that mochi tastes better fresh, but if there's any that's moldy, I can add it to my collection.
Check this kite out! It's broken in all the right places. Truly a work of art.
Don't tell her, but I scrounged up the perfect New Year's gift for Velouria. Hehe!
I'll be loyal and stay by your side all year if that's what you want, but only if you ask extra nicely!

sara.name: Sara
sara.title: Lady of Loptr
sara.description: Granddaughter of Lord Manfroy, archbishop and great priest of the Loptr Church. Hates Manfroy for what he did to her parents. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall:
If everyone could be silent and listen to their inner voice, they could understand so much...
What is so hard to comprehend about that?
Indeed, my grandfather is Manfroy, the great priest of Loptr. I'd rather not speak of him.
You're tired, aren't you? There's no deceiving me. Come, rest your head. I will watch over you.
*sigh* You're not doing much to help with my boredom. Let's go for a walk. You need a break too!
Being here, I hear so many voices... Beautiful voices, hesitant voices, all kinds of voices. I really enjoy it!
Visit: I was told to follow the sound of a beautiful voice, and here you are, [S]!
Level: I hear the voice, and I understand everything. I'm ready to go!
I can't quite make out what the voice is saying...
*sigh*
Summon: My name is Sara...and I know just who you are. Hee-hee. Very well, I'll do what I can to help.
Learn Skill: Well, isn't this fun? Thank you!
Confession:
It's good that I came here. There's something fun around every corner. Being minded by scolds was so dull...
Here, there are many people from many worlds, and the jumble of their voices is so pleasant.
Your voice, though, is the clearest of all. It rings through the cacophony... not as a single voice, but as a chorus.
How mysterious, and so beautiful. I get the feeling that as long as I am with you, I will never be bored.
I think we should have fun together for a long time to come! As long as you need me, here I am!
Special: Who are you supposed to be?
Status: I'll help you.
Get it together.
I'm Sara. I know all there is to know about you.
My mother and father are dead. They say my grandfather murdered my father.
I do not wish to speak of my grandfather. I despise that man.
Aagh! This is so boring. Can I go for a walk?
You were the one calling out to me, weren't you? I like your voice.

asbel.name: Asbel
asbel.title: Windswept Youth
asbel.description: A wind mage from a small city in Ulster, Hrest. Undertakes a long journey in search of Leif in order to fulfill his pledge. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: During my search for Lord Leif, I happened upon Lord Ced. I was lucky enough to learn wind magic from him.
In Hrest, Lord Leif and I swore an oath. Though it might mean our deaths, we would take back Thracia.
Agh! Sorry...I was completely absorbed in this tome. Are you hurt? Did you need something?
I have heard that many esteemed magic users are gathered here. Would you introduce me to them?
I've been borrowing lots of books... I must study hard to be of use off the battlefield as well as on.
Visit: So you're [S]... I hear you're a stalwart friend.
Level: I see... This is the true power of the magic Lord Ced taught me!
I may be inexperienced, but... I will show that this magic has its purpose!
Is it true? Am I too weak to help?
Summon: I am Asbel, of the Magi. I will do my utmost to put the magic Lord Ced taught me to use on your behalf.
Learn Skill: If you believe I may be of some use, then I'll make every effort to prove you right!
Confession:
I've improved at using magic, and it's all because of you. I can't thank you enough!
I've come to realize, though, that fighting can't be my only job on the battlefield.
You don't fight, but are so talented at leading others. You draw out their potential and help them thrive.
With skills like those, I could help Lord Leif and Lord Ced on the path toward peace...
So, it's decided. I will become your student!
Until I master these skills, I swear that I won't leave your side. Er, if that's all right by you, of course!
Status: We finally meet! I am Asbel.
*yelp* *sigh* I'm no fan of childish games.
To me, Leif is someone with great significance...
I made a promise...a promise that we would work together to take back Thracia.
Do you mean to imply that that promise was nothing more than the fancy of a child?
Ced, we'll meet again someday. Won't we...?
Let me be of help to you! No matter the hardship, I'm ready.

ronan.name: Ronan
ronan.title: Villager of Iz
ronan.description: A hunter from the village Iz. Has a strong sense for right and wrong, and a stronger distaste for pirates. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: There's not much in the village of Iz, but it is a peaceful place. To think that pirates would despoil it...
The food here is delicious, but I do find myself longing for my mother's cooking. I hope she's all right.
You need help carrying equipment to storage? No problem at all. I'm off!
Gazing at the horizon tires my eyes. I had to rest them! I certainly wasn't dozing...
Lord Leif is kind to everyone. And the Askrans seem so generous. If only all the nobility were like this...
Visit: My name is Ronan. Am I mistaken, or is this the castle of [S]?
Level: I swear on my bow that I will protect everyone!
I made up my mind to fight. I must put fear aside!
Maybe... Maybe I am not cut out for this. Am I, Mother?
Summon: I am Ronan, a simple hunter. I do have confidence in my skill with a bow, however. Please let me join you!
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will be certain to keep my bow arm limber.
Confession:
Great work today. You outwitted our foes once again!
I've doubted myself time and again since arriving here. Yes, I can hit my mark. But am I really strong enough?
I will put my doubts aside and keep fighting. I'm no crusader, but I can do my utmost. And that is not all...
Strong or not, I learned a lesson in Thracia...sulking and refusing to help accomplishes nothing.
If you need something done, call on me. I will do whatever I can to aid you. I am always ready to help.
Status: I am Ronan and I have a request. Please allow me to fight with you.
Wha—oh! How can I help you?
I'm confident in my skill with a bow. I will try my best not to be a burden to you.
I was a hunter in my village. If you require some hunting to be done, please leave it to me.
Pirate attacks were not uncommon back home. I will never allow a pirate to take me by surprise again.
Sorry to make you worry, Mother. However...I must fight. That is what I've decided.
Is it strange that I always speak politely? But you are my commanding officer. Surely...

miranda.name: Miranda
miranda.title: Willful Princess
miranda.description: Princess of Ulster who was held hostage by Grannvale. Strong-willed but not without a gentle side. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall:
My father granted Prince Leif refuge... This gave the empire a pretext to intervene, and he lost his life.
Father abhorred fighting and was unfailingly kind... And he paid a terrible price for his kindness!
They would have me marry Prince Leif and become queen. He, however, has loftier matters on his mind.
It is true that I was a hostage, but Count Conomor did what he could to grant me some small freedoms.
If you have the time, I'd speak with you. Please, tell me about this land, and the battles it has faced.
Shut up in a fusty cell in that monastery, I could scarcely breathe. I do like to stretch my legs these days.
Visit: I am Miranda, princess of Ulster. I carry tidings as a close confidant of [F].
Level: I will not stop until Ulster is restored!
Powerlessness begets regret. To avoid that pain, one must put in the effort to become stronger.
I will never lose heart. My father's anguish must be dispelled!
Summon: Where am I? What is this place? I am Miranda of Ulster. State your name, you rude creature!
Learn Skill: By the pride of Ulster, I will not forget your kindness.
Confession:
Do you have a moment? I would apologize for my conduct when I was first called here.
I was sorely upset, but that rudeness ill befits a princess. I apologize.
I also have a request... When the fighting here ends, what would you say to accompanying me to Ulster?
The longer I spend here, the surer I am that your steady hand would help me overcome my own hardships.
Indeed, that is the only reason I ask! Did you perceive another motive? Er...
This request may be extreme, and if so, I would withdraw it. For now, I will focus on aiding you here!
Special: I am a girl, not a fool!
Status: I am Miranda, princess of Ulster.
*yelp* What in the world do you think you're doing? I am a princess!
No matter how low I fall, I will never forsake the pride of Ulster.
My father was a kind man. He never wanted to go to war. To think that granting refuge to Prince Leif would result in this...
My one aim is to take back Ulster. I will avenge my father!
I do understand, you know. That none of this is really Prince Leif's fault...
I sense no falsehoods in your words. I believe in you.

veld.name: Veld
veld.title: Manfroy's Rock
veld.description: Bishop of the Loptr Church. Works to support his lord, Manfroy, carrying out the will of the church. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: I can perform a rite that births fearsome warriors. Say the word, and I will offer you their strength.
To think that the descendants of the crusaders have gathered in this world... I should conceal my identity.
To enter battle...is imprudent at best. Arrange it so that ambitious tools and decorated warriors do it for you...
Summoner...if you have interest in my power, we must speak. I would ask something of you...
I must briefly take my leave of you. Oh, it's nothing important...
Visit: I have an interest in you... Ever since your name fell from the lips of [F].
Level: Fear and confusion will spread. As the world falls to chaos, it sinks ever further into darkness...
Death should not be feared, but worshipped... Its power becomes the power of the Loptr Church.
Tch!
Summon: I am Veld. I serve the great priest Manfroy. Speak ill and you shall find yourself made of stone.
Learn Skill: Seeking my favor? Clever.
Confession:
Are you enjoying these battles, Summoner? No, you need not reply... Simply listen.
This is neither Grannvale nor Thracia. Without Manfroy's orders, I may act as I see fit...or not act at all.
You seem to understand that endless skirmishes will not bring the conflict to an end. There is a larger picture...
To move the world you must listen in the shadows. Discipline your mind... Choose whether wars begin or end.
Supporting the simple, honest prince of this land and becoming one of his closest confidants? A solid plan...
What's that look? I am stating things plainly! Now, about that matter I had wanted to discuss...
Special: How shall I deal with you?
Status: I am Veld. I serve the great priest Manfroy.
Vex me further and you'll find yourself made of stone.
Pitting Thracia against itself worked quite well, wouldn't you agree?
That brat from Leonster and Travant are mere puppets dancing at my command.
If it's a deadlord you want, a corpse is all I'll need.
My death is meaningless. Loptr will not fall, struggle as you may...
A world of peace... *chuckle* Best not to speak such foolish ideas.

dorothea3.name: Dorothea
dorothea3.title: Twilit Harmony
dorothea3.description: Women of beauty worthy of the pride of their respective worlds, winning the hearts and minds of all they meet. Appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses / Genealogy of the Holy War.
dorothea3.origin: Genealogy of the Holy War + Three Houses
dorothea3.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Shields】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Grants another action to ally with the highest HP that is within 2 spaces, has already acted, and is from the same titles as unit (excluding unit). (Allies with Sing or Dance can be granted this effect as well. If multiple units meet the conditions, effect will not trigger.)
【Resonance: Shields】 Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."

Castle Hall:
**Dorothea**: So many people around, and in such fancy garb. You don't happen to know any of them, do you, Lene?
Ooh! What about that guy with the blue hair? He's kind of good looking, isn't he?
**Lene**: This castle and courtyard seem a bit brighter, don't they? Of course they do, now! They've become our stage!
**Dorothea**: These clothes are so easy to slip into, it's incredible. They seem to slide on no matter how you approach them.
**Lene**: Hey, watch it! You touch me, and I'll touch you right back! ...Hyah!
**Dorothea**: Lene is a great dancer... Much better than I am. But I've got my voice and good looks, so we're the perfect pair!
Visit: **Lene**: Oh, hey! I can get a lot of gold around here, [F] said!
Level: **Dorothea**: I may have no crest or noble name to swear on, but...on the Mittelfrank Opera Company, I will triumph!

**Lene**: Agustria's most renowned dancer and the most magnificent songstress in Fódlan have combined their powers.
There's no way we can lose!
**Dorothea**: Oh, come now, Lene. If you keep making that face, it's going to stick like that. Don't worry!
Summon:
I am Dorothea of the Mittelfrank Opera Company. Lene and I have similar pasts, so we've teamed up.
The two of us working together won't be a problem for you, will it?
Learn Skill: **Dorothea**: I will use this to better myself... Its light will guide me toward my future!
Confession:
**Lene**: We put on a nice performance today, didn't we! Oh, Dorothea... Who's the girl you were talking to?
**Dorothea**: Huh? Oh, it was nothing. She was just saying she looks up to us.
...And she wanted to know who was more popular between us.
**Lene**: Whaaat?! I think I stood out a bit more today, but...what did you tell her?
**Dorothea**: Tee hee! I told her the person who'd know best is [S]!
**Lene**: Oh really? Hm. Well, in that case... Hey, [S]!
I see you there! Don't try to escape! What did you tell that little girl who was asking about us?!
**Dorothea**: Yes, who DID you choose? Me, THE songstress of Fódlan, Dorothea? Or Agustria's best dancer, Lene? Hm?
Special: **Duo**: Let's give them a show. Yeah!
Status: Giggle
"Perfect for dancing." "Perfect for us!"
Conversation: **Dorothea**: All right, one more dance!
**Lene**: How do I look?
**Dorothea**: Beautiful, Lene. You move with such grace.
**Lene**: *giggle* Thank you, Dorothea. That means a lot coming from a professional.
**Dorothea**: Former professional. My years as a songstress feel like a lifetime ago.
**Lene**: Even so, you're so talented! You got to perform up on a big stage, didn't you?
That's so impressive! I wish I could dance in front of an audience like you!

**Dorothea**: Well, there must be a stage somewhere here in Askr, but...
I'm not sure the Order of Heroes would appreciate a performance right now.
**Lene**: I guess you're right. They might get upset if they think we aren't contributing.

**Dorothea**: That said, it seems unreasonable for the Order to be upset...
...with someone who is contributing the best way they know how.
**Lene**: Hmm... Maybe we could say the performance is a reward for the other Heroes?
**Dorothea**: Right! In that case, how does this sound? We'll work to end the fighting here in Askr...
Then, when the world is at peace, we'll ask Prince Alfonse to set up a stage where you can perform!
**Lene**: That would be wonderful! I'm sure the other Heroes could use a show to lift their spirits after all that fighting!
But, Dorothea, you'll dance with me, won't you? Oh! And sing too?
**Dorothea**: It would be my honor, Lene! I should make sure I can still hit the high notes...
**Lene**: Yay! It'll be so much fun! *giggle* I should work hard now to make that dream a reality!
Duo Skill: "Let's show off our moves." "And be bold!"

katarina2.name: Katarina
katarina2.title: Torchlit Wanderer
katarina2.description: Knight of Altea who joined the new recruits of the 7th Platoon. Currently deployed on a mission. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I have to wear this for a mission, s-so don't think this is a normal thing for me...
Clarisse would look better in this Plegian garb than I do. She's so beautiful, and cheerful too...
Um... If you see Kris, please tell him he's a bit too...exposed, wearing this type of clothing around.
Is there anything that needs doing? I get nervous standing around with nothing to do...

Dorothea, Lene, and Tharja are all such fantastic people, aren't they?
I know it will probably never happen, but I'd love to be like those three one day, somehow.
Visit: My name is Katarina. I've brought a gift from [F].
Level: I must be doing well today! I'll be sure to make the most of it while I can!
I'm fine, I'm fine. I can keep going!
Ungh... I'm going to keep working at it. Don't leave me behind...
Summon: My name is Katarina. I happen to be in the midst of a mission, so please ignore the clothes I'm wearing...
Learn Skill: Thank you for your generosity.
Confession:
Oh no... The pin fell out...and I have no idea where!
If you hadn't pointed it out, this cloth around my waist could have fallen, and then where would I be?
I hear these clothes are from a distant realm. My world has a similar fashion, but this fabric is even finer...
While I do enjoy the compliments, I can't help but think this garb would be best suited for assassination...
I would use it that way, if you asked. I will take the missions others won't. You need only say the word.
Status: My name is Katarina. You might not recognize me—these are Plegian clothes.
Agh! Did... Did I deserve that?
