Clothing for hot places is bold... Am I wearing it right?
Plegian mages curse people? Fearsome.
I would like to visit a desert, and see the land stretch on and on...
This outfit matches Kris's. I like that.
If you get stuck with a curse, I'll find a way to remove it. I promise!

raphael2.name: Raphael
raphael2.title: Muscle-Monger
raphael2.description: Eldest son of the Kirsten family of the Leicester Alliance. Wondering what kinds of food will be served at the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: These clothes are great for showing off my muscles! I wish my little sis and grandpa could see me in this!
I'm one of the best eaters around! Bring me meat! Bring me fish! I'll take on any challenge!
Hey, summoner. What're you up to? Wanna go find some food?
Hah! Grah! Yah! Hrmph! ...Whew! I gotta keep training to get stronger. Can't let these muscles relax!

All right, here's what you do. First, grab a sack and fill it with rocks. Then you swing it round and round, got it?
Huh? What's wrong? I thought you were looking for a new exercise!
Visit: Hey! You're [S]! This is for you. It's from your old pal [F]!
Level: Grraaahhh! I'm fired up! My muscles are happy, and when they're happy, I'm happy too! Check 'em out!
I gotta keep working to get bigger, stronger muscles!
My poor muscles... I can't keep letting them down...
Summon: My name's Raphael Kirsten! I'm not really sure what this festival's about, but I hear the food's pretty good!
Learn Skill: For me? Thanks!
Confession:
I hear there's a country called Plegia, and that's where these clothes come from. The material is so thin though!
Do you think they get cold in winter? And what kinds of food do you think they eat? I bet it's tasty...
Oh! I gotta tell my little sis about this festival! She'd love it here! Maybe I can write a letter and send a gift...
What's something Maya would like? I'm no good at picking out gifts. I'm great with muscles! But bad at gifts...
Ugh. All this thinking's worked up my appetite. C'mon, let's go find something to fill our stomachs!
Status: Someone said they wear these clothes in a country called Plegia, but... I've never heard of the place.
Dagh?! Hey now! Don't sneak up on me like that!
I don't even know what this festival is about, but I heard there was a feast!
What do people eat in the desert? I hope it's meat...
I like these Plegia clothes. They really show off my muscles, huh?
I gotta become a proper knight so I can take care of my little sis!
Hey, I got an idea! Let's have a muscle festival next time!

tharja4.name: Tharja
tharja4.title: Florid Charmer
tharja4.description: A mage of Plegia who commands powerful dark magic. Wearing particularly enchanting attire to a festival celebrating her homeland's culture. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Katarina and the others may be shy, but this is a festival and this clothing has meaning. You'll join me, right?
*sigh* What a waste. My time would be better spent continuing the ceremony.
Oh my, is the sun too much for you? Or am I the reason for your flushed cheeks? Hmhm, I'm simply joking.
Plegia wasted such time on bitterness and hatred... These are feelings that I never shared with my homeland.
Shell of turtle, tongue of lizard... Hm? Oh, I'm mixing a bug-repelling perfume for Dorothea and Lene.
Visit:
I'm Tharja, from Plegia. And you— You know [F]?
Oh... Then I guess I won't curse you.
Level: Hmhmhm... It seems last night's ceremony is already bearing fruit.
My curses are much more reliable than any prayer or wish. Wouldn't you agree?
Ugh... I feel sick to my stomach. I wonder if one of my curses somehow bounced back at me...
Summon:
I'm Tharja. And this is the attire of an ancient festival. Perhaps that of a sacrificial maiden?
Or perhaps of the one performing the deed...
Learn Skill: Hmph. What is it you want from me?
Confession:
Ugh, I'm exhausted from being led around all day. So many people... Why even leave home for this?
Enjoy myself, you say? Oh, please... I care nothing for the smiles of others. I live only for my fated love.
Hmm... But when I heard your voice, I thought maybe dressing up and going out now and again isn't all bad.
You remind me of my fated one. So I'll follow your lead for now... I'll allow only you to drag me out.
But betray me, and it will be your undoing. The sorcery of this land will turn you into my eternal servant.
Special: How would you like to die?
Status: This is the garb of my homeland. I think it suits me. Don't you?
Ugh. Your manners are severely lacking.
I don't exactly long to return to Plegia... But I do miss it.
Shoo, shoo! Stop pestering me! Can't you see I'm observing Robin?
My curses have become more effective since joining with the Order of Heroes.
You want to attend a Plegian festival? You're an unusual one.
If there's someone you deem deserving of a curse, don't hesitate to seek me out. It will be my pleasure.

mkris2.name: Kris
mkris2.title: Ardent Firebrand
mkris2.description: Knight of Altea who advanced to become the leader of the 7th Platoon. Currently deployed on a mission. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: What would the 7th Platoon think if they saw me like this? Luke would be first to tease me, no doubt...
People used to tell me how much I resemble Marth. It used to feel strange, but now I'm proud of it.

I tried to talk with Katarina, but she said she wasn't sure where to look when she was talking to me...
I can't say I don't have the same problem...
I was hesitant about this Plegian garb at first, but I've grown to like it... Why don't you try some on yourself?
Are all the women in Plegia as... bewitching as Tharja?
Visit: I'm Kris, royal guard of Altea. I've brought a gift for you, [S]!
Level: Who we face will make no difference! We will win. I swear it on my honor as a knight of Altea.
Simply changing clothes can make quite the difference in how one feels. Hm... I feel like...an assassin!

My grandfather once told me, "It's better to do something than to just sit there letting your feet get cold."
On that note, I'll be right back! I'm going for a quick run.
Summon: I'm Kris, a knight of Altea. Oh, um... These clothes have nothing to do with Altea. It's just for a mission.
Learn Skill: Thank you. This must have been fate.
Confession:
Perhaps I'm having a little too much fun in this unfamiliar garb... I'm only wearing it for a mission, after all.
I mean, everyone tells me it looks good on me. And I know Katarina is looking beautiful as well...
Er, wait—that's not what I wanted to talk about!
I was once told that I bore a strange destiny... Perhaps you can relate?
Have you maybe felt unseen eyes gazing at you from the heavens? Or from the depths of the sea?
What role fate plays in life, I can't say, but...I believe my choices have been my own. That means something.
I thought, if anyone could, you would understand that feeling... And so we ought to aid each other from here on!
Status: So this is the desert style of Plegia... How do I look?
Don't startle me! I am in no mood.
All right, I'm dressed. Now, what should I be doing?
Ah! These clothes should be well-suited to desert combat.
Even in the hottest desert, I will protect Prince Marth!
Curses are truly frightening. I have no use for them.
I care not where we are. I will protect you.

seiros.name: Seiros
seiros.title: Saint of Legend
seiros.description: Founding saint of the Church of Seiros. Stern but gentle, she guides the people of Fódlan and defends them from danger. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: If you come to me searching, say so. I will not turn away one who seeks their salvation.
It was the goddess who brought peace to Fódlan. I merely carry out her will.
Rest for a while, won't you? Do not worry over your enemies for now. While I'm here, there is no threat.
The goddess watches over us always. Now, let us pray together...

Hm? Oh, I was...just thinking of my mother. She was kinder and stronger than any I've ever known.
I have faith I will see her again. One day.
Visit: I come bearing friendship and good will from [F].
Level: A power that lay dormant has now awoken...
This is not enough. Not yet.
An unfortunate result.
Summon: I am Seiros. My duty is to guide the lost toward the will of the goddess.
Learn Skill: You wish to grant me new power? I understand, and I accept.
Confession:
Your kind are frail, ignorant creatures, incapable of accomplishing anything without the guidance of the goddess.
...Or so I had thought. But I have been forced to realize, meeting the Heroes here, that I was wrong.
You in particular stand apart as well... You are different from the rest. Special in some way.
My instincts are not often wrong...
If you continue to fight for this world, I will fight by your side, as a warrior. As an equal.
And I know the goddess will be watching over you as well.
Special: In the name of the goddess.
Status: Do not be afraid. You may speak openly with me.
What are you doing? Do you require my assistance?
Do the teachings of the Church of Seiros hold interest for you?
If you humbly devote yourself to prayer, even you may receive the blessing of the goddess.
If something precious is stolen from you, you must do whatever it takes to recover it.
Mother... I wish I could see you again, just once more...
I shall never abandon you. Even if it means staining my hands with blood…

lif2.name: Líf
lif2.title: Undying Ties Duo
lif2.description: Líf and Thrasir have come to attend the festival, brimming with love and radiant with life! ...Are they planning something?
lif2.duo: Deals damage to foes within 3 spaces = 10 + 50% of total damage dealt to HP of allies within 3 spaces (max damage: 40). Inflicts Atk/Spd-7 on foes within 3 spaces of unit through their next actions.

Castle Hall: **Líf**: I see Alfonse over there... Before my world was destroyed, I must have worn a smile like his.
**Líf**: After everything that has happened... Can the warmth of love really change anything?
**Thrasir**: I see that Princess Veronica is joining in the festivities... Back then, I had no idea what love was.
**Líf**: Stay close, Veronica. We must appear festive. The living are watching.
**Thrasir**: This clothing is so ostentatious... It's been so long since I've worn anything like it. Does it look strange, Alfonse?
Visit: **Thrasir**: I bring notice of the Day of Devotion. Join the festivities while you yet live.
Level: **Thrasir**: Even in death, we two will not be parted.
**Líf**: Love that cannot be sundered... It may exist in this world.
**Thrasir**: Failure... It was our misjudgment to get drawn into this festival.
Summon: **Líf**: I am...Líf. She is known as Thrasir. Though the Day of Devotion means nothing to us, we will do our duty.
Learn Skill: **Líf**: This power is needed...to oppose the gods.
Confession:
**Líf**: The Day of Devotion... An event that holds no meaning for the dead, who exist only as memories...
We have no future. For us, love has no meaning.
However...Veronica, I do have you.
**Thrasir**: And I, you. Our future and our world were both lost. For me, only you have remained.
If our bond can even be called love... I can use that love. It is a support to carry me forward—for eternity.
Status: sigh...
"Strange, isn't it?" "It certainly is."
Conversation: **Líf**: That unsavory cadre of gods... What are they doing with us?
**Thrasir**: Who can say? Her instructions were so vague... "When you arrive, you will understand."
**Líf**: Have you noticed anything?
**Thrasir**: What is there to notice? It is a simple festival. These people always find some excuse to celebrate.
**Líf**: The Day of Devotion... A day to express gratitude to those important to you.
**Thrasir**: This festival is not meant for us. We should go.
Your mother and father are here... How much longer can you bear to stay?
They will save our world... That is what they promised us, those gods.
Even if our world were to be saved, as we wish it to be...
**Thrasir**: It would be no place for us. In a world that's saved, we are nothing...
**Líf**: As you say. But, Veronica, remember this...
We are not alone.
**Thrasir**: Alfonse...
Yes. We are not alone. No matter what happens...
**Líf**: Let us go. We need to focus on uncovering the weaknesses of those gods...
**Thrasir**: Very well. We will do as you suggest.

gustav.name: Gustav
gustav.title: Majestic Love
gustav.description: King of Askr. Taking part in the Day of Devotion to spend some quality time with his family.

Castle Hall: There are times when a king faces difficult decisions. But they must always look to their country's future.
Seeing Alfonse here, now... There is much he can learn from the Day of Devotion. I look forward to his growth.
Because of you, the people can enjoy the Day of Devotion. You have my gratitude, [S].
Alfonse is still an inexperienced ruler. But he will likely grow into a better king than I was one day.
A king should not be all-powerful, placed above others. He should give of himself for his people.
Visit: I am Gustav, King of Askr. I bear an invitation to the Day of Devotion from [F].
Level: The love here reflects the history of this country.
Strength may wane with time, but experience is just the opposite.
My strength is not enough... How disappointing.
Summon: I am the king of Askr, Gustav. I had not imagined I would be able to visit Askr again. Certainly not like this...
Learn Skill: The people are what grant me my strength. I will give them a king in return.
Confession:
A king, too, must understand the true value of love.
Love for country, for its people... and love for family.
Without love, a king cannot keep a great country united.
Alfonse and Sharena have much they can gain from this festival.
I hope you will continue to support Alfonse as well. This country needs your love, [S].
Status: Allow me to express my gratitude to you. You've protected my children ably so far.
Is that some sort of greeting in the Order of Heroes?
My scar? Chalk that one up to a Hero from another world...
Alfonse is a wise young man. I imagine he will make a good king one day.
Sharena is kind, but I pray that kindness won't bring her harm.
I must protect my people, even if it costs me my life.
I am astounded that you came to this world, and very glad about it too. You are most welcome here.

henriette.name: Henriette
henriette.title: Overflowing Love
henriette.description: Queen of Askr, adored by her people. Joining in on the Day of Devotion festivities alongside her family members.

Castle Hall: If the world was free from war, would every day be more like the Day of Devotion?
Every soul in Askr is precious to me, like family. That includes the Heroes too of course.

I may not be a great warrior, but I excel at supporting those who are important to me.
That's a technique born of love, wouldn't you say?
Back then, we'd always enjoy the Day of Devotion festivities together. Hm? Oh, just thinking of the past...
It's a lovely outfit, don't you think? I've been preparing for this festival since it appeared on the horizon.
Visit: My, what a lovely castle! Now, I have an invitation to the Day of Devotion festival from [F].
Level: Fear not, for we have love on our side.
Chin up. It's the Day of Devotion, after all!
Hmm... I can't seem to get in the spirit today...
Summon: I am the queen of Askr, Henriette. The Day of Devotion is my favorite time of year. I hope you enjoy it too.
Learn Skill: Oh, for me? Are you sure? I will take good care of it.
Confession:
Are you enjoying the festival? I love every moment of it, of course.
Love is an odd thing... It's not like any legendary weapon or tome, but it can steel our hearts.
It creates bonds between us and our children, and their children... and on even beyond that.
I hope Alfonse and Sharena learn the power of love as I have. That would make me truly happy.
Of course, with your love for this land as a model, they can learn much, [S].
But enough talk of the future. This festival isn't over. So let us take the opportunity to celebrate love.
Special: I don't want to lose control.
Status: I'm Alfonse and Sharena's mother. Please, call me Henriette.
Aah! Oh, you. You like to tease people, don't you?
Oh, I'm so glad to see that all of you are doing well. I've been so worried!
Alfonse has a tendency to rush in. He's very brave, but as his mother...it worries me.
Sharena is so sweet, but that just makes me worry about her more.
It doesn't matter what happens to me. As long as my children are safe...
I feel my whole family owes you a debt of gratitude.

alfonse4.name: Alfonse
alfonse4.title: Uplifting Love
alfonse4.description: Prince of Askr, serious yet gentle. Participating in the Day of Devotion festival to display his affection for his people.

Castle Hall: Are these clothes a bit much? Commander Anna was in charge of the Day of Devotion preparations...
Nothing is more precious or more enduring than bonds of fellowship. Many Heroes have taught me that.
I can feel the joy of the citizenry celebrating the Day of Devotion. That is the joy I want to defend.
Do you have a festival like the Day of Devotion in your world too? You must tell me all about it sometime.
Princess Veronica is attending the festival as well... I hope there can be peace between us, if just for now.
Visit: Would you care to come join the Day of Devotion festivities happening over at [F]'s castle?
Level: I care about you, from the bottom of my heart. I hope you feel the same.
I must be distracted by all these thoughts of love...
Rather embarrassing...
Summon: The Day of Devotion is upon us! I hope to express my love in a fashion I can call my own.
Learn Skill: Thank you. This must be yet another way you show your affection.
Confession:
The Day of Devotion festival was a success again this year!
The people gathered here speak with joy and love in their voices.
Someday I, too, hope to have someone at my side to celebrate the Day of Devotion with...
But for now, my priority is bringing peace to Askr and protecting the lives of its people...
Those hopes consume my every thought and desire.
Until then, I will fight as hard as I can so that Askr can continue celebrating the Day of Devotion.
Status: Happy Day of Devotion! Let's enjoy ourselves today.
What? Oh! But...today isn't a good day for horseplay.
This festival brought my mother and father together. Nothing could make me happier.
I'd like to give gifts to all the Heroes helping the Order, but...well...
I am so excited to get presents... Did anybody notice that? Anybody?
One mistake and I might have ended up just like Líf...
This is for you. To me, you are just as important as family.

veronica4.name: Veronica
veronica4.title: Bestowed Love
veronica4.description: Imperial princess of the Emblian Empire. Involving herself in the Day of Devotion festivities in an attempt to make sense of what love means.

Castle Hall: Love does not take any one shape... What does that say about its nature?
Is the way I feel toward the people of Embla not also a kind of love?
Does Prince Alfonse know what love is, I wonder? Princess Sharena, on one hand...clearly does not.
The Day of Devotion is for lovers to get each other gifts? Is that what love is about?
I tried to make some sweets to give as presents. They do not taste good, but you can have one if you'd like.
Visit:
An invitation to the Day of Devotion festival from [F].
There. I've done my job.
Level: If you are happy...I can be happy as well.
Here. Take this gift... It's a special thing, just for today.
Love is...difficult.
Summon: The Day of Devotion makes no sense to me... I may never understand it.
Learn Skill: I wonder... How could I return the affection you have shown me.
Confession:
What is love exactly? Can you explain it to me with words?
The feeling you have toward those dear to you? The feeling of wanting someone near to you?
I admire my brother, and I feel... gratitude toward Xander. Are those feelings not a kind of love?
It seems I still cannot grasp it.
But seeing everyone smiling as they speak of it, I imagine love must be rather...well, lovely.
If I ever understand it, I hope to return to the Day of Devotion festival again to enjoy it like others do.
Status: I am Veronica. I've heard that today is the Day of Devotion...
Ah! If you startle me, you won't get your gift.
The people I'd like to give gifts to are Bruno...and Xander...
These flowers have a lovely scent.
Thrasir...she is me, but...different.
What I want is...to always have my brother at my side...
If you want a gift, I suppose I could get you one.

annand.name: Annand
annand.title: Knight-Defender
annand.description: Leader of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse and Erinys's elder sister. Conceals her longing for Lewyn and fights to her last breath. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: The flowers are in full bloom...like a beautiful dream. And such a lovely fragrance too.
I hope Prince Lewyn is doing all right. Erinys was to retrieve him, but there is still much she has to learn...

Ah. One moment, please...
There we are. I wanted to finish mending this tunic first. Now, you have my full attention.
Hm? Prince Lewyn? Ah... No, pay me no mind.
I may have a certain inflexibility, but as a knight, one must be stalwart to carry out their duties properly.
Visit: I am one of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse, Annand. I bring a gift from [F].
Level: No matter the time or place, as a knight of Silesse, I must fight in a fashion worthy of that title.
Do not fret. Leave the skies to me.
Even as one of the Four Heavenly Knights, I must not allow this to lower my spirits.
Summon: I am Annand, a knight of Silesse. On the honor of the Four Heavenly Knights, I vow to defend you.
Learn Skill: With my blade and this new power, I will be an extension of your will. Permit me to show you.
Confession:
Do you know much of my homeland, Silesse, [S]?
It is surrounded by treacherous mountains, a land of snow and ice.
There is hardly any land suitable for growing crops, so our country faces a harsh reality.
But even under those conditions, we have our queen, Lahna, who reminds us there is more than the cold dark.
She is a kind and gentle soul, ever concerned with her people... I would give everything to protect her.
Your fight here is also for the sake of the people. I sense no lust for war or conquest with the Order.
So, I will happily join you, and we can bring this fight to its rightful conclusion together.
Status: I am a knight of Silesse, and my name is Annand.
Oh, Lord Lewyn—? Ah, you are not Lord Lewyn. Apologies.
I am one of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse. I will fight honorably.
My lady, Lahna, is the picture of virtue and compassion. It is an honor to serve her.
I cannot be other than I am.
Lord Lewyn...I wish you well.
Together, you and I will fight without restraint or regret.

erinys.name: Erinys
erinys.title: Earnest Knight
erinys.description: One of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse and Annand's younger sister. Has a serious outlook that Prince Lewyn teases her about. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: I've sworn to return Prince Lewyn to Silesse no matter what. I cannot allow either of us to die before that!
All the Heroes work hard in service of this country... I must pull my weight too. I won't be left behind!
The battles seem to go on with no end in sight... Why not rest? I will tend to matters for you.

When next we have an opportunity, would you go shopping with me?
I'm hoping to get some fine clothes like I see others in the castle wear.

I brush my pegasus often. It clears out the pests and helps bring out the coat's shine.
It takes some strength too, so it also serves as a way to build muscle.
Visit: I am Erinys, a pegasus knight of Silesse. I've come with a delivery from [F].
Level: I am no longer the person I once was. I will never be called a crybaby again!
As a pegasus knight of Silesse, I will fight in the service of Queen Lahna and Prince Lewyn with pride!
I'll never reach my goal if this keeps up...
Summon:
I am Erinys, a pegasus knight of Silesse. Like my sister, I am one of the Four Heavenly Knights.
I ask that you not look down on me because of my inexperience.
Learn Skill: Huh. This feels unusual somehow... I want to help out even more now!
Confession:
Thank you ever so much for your kindness, helping me when I'd nearly lost all I had on me...
I was caught up looking at all the shops, I let my eyes drift from my belongings for a moment, and...
Well, if I was alone, I would probably be left with only my own tears.
I finally became a pegasus knight like I always dreamed, but I mustn't let myself feel so secure.
I am not at my sister's level just yet.
I've come to think of my being summoned here as a new way for me to train and get stronger.
I want to prove I am a knight who can stand apart in my own right!
But before that, I should prove I can shop by myself, I suppose... I will be more careful next time!
Hey! Please don't laugh!
Status: I am Erinys, knight of Silesse, and I would be honored to fight by your side for a time.
Oh, was there something on my uniform? *sigh*
Lord Lewyn is known as the Hero on the Wind. He inherited his might from the crusader Ced.
I was called crybaby and worse when I was younger, but I am no longer that child.
I must bring Lady Lahna some happiness.
Hmm... Lord Lewyn and Annand...?
I am glad I came to Askr. Do I seem more worldly after meeting all the other Heroes?

azelle.name: Azelle
azelle.title: Youthful Flame
azelle.description: Half brother to the head of House Velthomer, Arvis. Compares himself to his older brother and suffers from an inferiority complex. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: My brother, Arvis, is a remarkable man. Yet for all he has given to our nation, there are...times I fear him.
Princess Sharena is a gentle, if slightly boisterous, person. In truth, she reminds me of someone dear...
You always seem so busy. If there is ever any way I can aid you, please do not hesitate to ask.
I cannot seem to find the castle library. Could you show me the way, [S]?
Riders charging to the front lines... Spells of all types to consider... There are so many tactics to account for.
Visit: Greetings. My name is Azelle. It is always a pleasure to meet an ally of [F].
Level: I feel new strength burning within. This was the power of crusader Fjalar...and now, of me!
My words and deeds must always be worthy of House Velthomer.
Would that I had the talent...
Summon: I am Azelle of House Velthomer. Though my magic cannot compare to my brother's, it is at your disposal.
Learn Skill: This strength will not go to waste.
Confession:
I left House Velthomer behind to save someone I cared for... It's a little embarrassing to remember it now.
Leaving allowed me to experience the world, meet dear friends, and witness the upheaval of war firsthand.
Certainly it would have been safer to stay at home, but I would have been crushed in the shadow of my brother.
Now, after being summoned here by you and battling alongside the Order of Heroes...
I am pleased to say that I have come to know myself in a new way. I can stand alongside you with confidence.
I only hope that I may continue to serve, and that we all live to see the day when peace comes to this world.
Status: I am Azelle, from the house of Velthomer. I may be no match for my brother, but all the same, I am happy to be here.
Whoa there! You gave me a fright!
Arvis...he was more than a brother to me. More than a father, even. But now...
Lord Sigurd has such a warm mien. The contrast with my brother could not be more stark.
I must be a burden to Arvis—just a talentless younger brother.
I'll find my own path.
No matter what happens, you are welcome to speak to me about it. I want to help you as much as I am able.

lex.name: Lex
lex.title: Young Blade
lex.description: Second son of Duke Lombard of House Dozel. Joins the army under Sigurd's command along with his friend Azelle. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Looking at that pond in the middle of the courtyard, I can't help but think of the time I dropped my axe in Verdane...
Prince Alfonse is a good man. He can seem detached, but he'd never let hunger for power cloud his judgment.
So, when do we head out? I've got nothing but time on my hands here. Come find me if you decide to go.
What would you say if I told you I was going to ask that girl to tea? Wait, no! Come back, [S]!
I guess you know my secret... Look, even the sharpest fighters must study now and then. Keep this between us.
Visit: You must be [S]. I am Lex! I'm sure you'll be good to [F] and company.
Level: Now do you understand the extent of my strength? By the crusader Nál, I swear to face and disrupt our foes!
I know I look a little rough around the edges. Truth is, I come from an elite family, so you can expect greatness.
Hmph, bad luck can strike anyone, I suppose... No matter, though! Let's move on to the next one!
Summon: I'm Lex, a mere warrior with a mighty axe. I don't know your story, but you can bet you'll remember mine!
Learn Skill: A gift for me? So, it finally happened... You've fallen for me, huh? I knew it. It's cute when you blush like that.
Confession:
I teased Azelle into leaving home. To give him a hard time, sure, but...really I wanted an excuse to leave myself.
You see, being the descendant of a crusader may sound excellent, but it's only caused a rift in my family.
I wanted to escape the sinister gaze of my father and brother and live as I please for a while...
But the goddess of war had other plans for me. Now I'm helping my friend fight for the love of his life.
He has grown strong, and I have found true kinship in the comrades who fought beside me in battle.
If you ever decide to take that first leap to make a change in your life, know I will fight alongside you too.
Special: I'll show you what I can do.
Status: I'm Lex from Dozel. I'm sure we'll be fast friends.
You trying to challenge me to a fight?
Arvis is a total mystery. He never seemed like a bad person, so why would he...
Azelle carries quite the torch for Lady Edain! Heh, what a cute kid.
I once dropped an iron axe into a lake. A goddess appeared and gave me a brave axe in return! True story!
My father has taken so many innocent lives. I believe he'll get what he's owed.
If you're the one who's asking me, I'll do all that I can.

dithorba.name: Díthorba
dithorba.title: Cutting Knight
dithorba.description: One of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse. Comes to serve Lord Myos, youngest brother of the late king. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: I left a young girl behind... Misha is her name. I hope she remains safe.
An amateur like Erinys made one of the Four Heavenly Knights? Absurd.
Queen Lahna invited crisis to Silesse. The late king's brother, Lord Myos, must lead us now!
You come from another world, and yet here you lead a powerful army. Outstanding, [S].
These bracelets represent my hopes. One, for Silesse, that it will thrive, and two, for Misha, that her life is happy.
Visit: I've come bearing a wish for a friendship never cut too short, from [F].
Level: I am Díthorba, of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse. The skies are ours! All those under us will kneel!
Shame you had to die, but you may count yourself unfortunate having met me on the field of battle.
You embarrass me... I will not forgive this!
Summon: I am Díthorba, of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse, servant to Lord Myos. Where am I? And who are you?
Learn Skill: With this, neither Annand nor Pamela will be able to stand against me. I will lead the Heavenly Knights!
Confession:
Ah. My liege Summoner... Or rather, er, [S].
Life with my weapon in hand is all I know, and I had no place I belonged. I appreciate you taking me in.
I must not die yet—for the child I left behind... I cannot allow her to suffer a life like the one I've led...
Heh... Does that not sound like me? I suppose not. I am Díthorba of the Four Heavenly Knights, after all.
For now I will rest my wings at your side, if only for a fleeting moment. Peace here and now will have to do.
Special: Your head will be my trophy!
Status: I am Díthorba, one of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse.
You will take your hand off me if you care to keep it.
That crybaby, Erinys, is no match for me.
Annand is the captain of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse. For now.
Queen Lahna's time is over. Lord Myos must rule us.
I will have the last laugh...eventually.
I do not take betrayal lightly. Don't give me a reason to kill you.

claude3.name: Claude
claude3.title: King of Unification
claude3.description: Hero who left Fódlan. Bringing peace to Fódlan, he returned to his homeland. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: It's up to me to plot a course to a bright new age. Of course, I'm happy to apply my experience here too.
I'll leave Fódlan in Teach's hands while I try to change things beyond its borders. Hope it all works out.

At a certain point you have to put the pen down and put schemes into action, ready or not.
...What, not persuasive coming from me?
Fighting for your life day after day is exhausting to both body and mind. I suggest grand post-battle feasts!
Whether it's battle or governing, if you stick to the old ways, you never break out of the same tired patterns.
Visit:
I have a message of friendship here from [F].
You two have a good thing going, if you ask me.
Level: Even I have room to grow.
Getting a little stronger is never a bad thing.
Well, no use panicking at this point...
Summon: I'm Claude von Riegan. Though...I no longer introduce myself as a Riegan. Or as Claude, as a matter of fact.
Learn Skill: With this power, I'll plot a course to a bright new age.
Confession:
I never had much faith in gods or goddesses, [S].
But now, seeing godlike folks isn't out of the ordinary. That's what it seems like, anyway.
Do you believe in destiny? Like the kind of miraculous encounters that change your life?
Surprise meetings that are somehow inevitable at the same time? You get what I'm saying, don't you?
I feel that my meeting you was part of my destiny. Maybe even a miracle of some god's design...
Well, if that god knows how I feel, they'll know I ought to stick with you a while longer, for a brighter future.
Special: Ready or not, here it comes!
Hold a grudge if you must.
Status: Nobles and commoners are equals here...that suits me just fine.
Don't spook me like that! I'm just mixing up some peaceful poisons, don't mind me.
I have to believe this path leads to the sight I dream of seeing...
A good general doesn't count on luck to win the day.
If worrying's your thing, have at it. Otherwise, let's feast!
I think the world would be better off without borders, but that's just me...
I want to know more about you... Um, not in a creepy way. I just find you intriguing!

dedue.name: Dedue
dedue.title: Dimitri's Vassal
dedue.description: Survivor of the tribe that inhabited the Duscur Region west of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. Swore loyalty to Dimitri. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I hope someone is maintaining the greenhouse. But I doubt anyone will bother with the Duscur flowers.
My purpose is to be a shield for His Highness.
Do not concern yourself with me. The people of Duscur have been despised for years.
Associating yourself with me will not lead to any enjoyment.
My duty is to remain at the side of His Highness. I will never falter.
Visit: I am here to bring you regards from [F]. That is all.
Level: I will use this power to aid His Highness.
Fighting for you has strengthened my ability to defend His Highness.
War is an effective teacher.
Summon: This life was given to me by His Highness. Serving him is everything to me.
Learn Skill: This changes nothing. I will continue to do what must be done.
Confession:
I am from Duscur. The people there are accused of regicide against the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus.
For that reason, Duscur is despised. In Faerghus, we are harassed. People spit. Throw stones.
Here, it is different. It is strange not to feel the hatred of others wherever I go.
You in particular accept others without question. It intrigues me.
If it is all right with you... I would be honored to call you my friend.
Status: Dedue. Vassal to His Highness, Prince Dimitri.
It would be best if you kept your distance from me.
The people of Duscur are despised in Fódlan.
Animals have never taken to me. They do not like my face.
I will brook no insult to His Highness.
Nothing remains of Duscur.
I have cooked you a meal. Please eat as much as you'd like.

linhardt.name: Linhardt
linhardt.title: Hevring's Heir
linhardt.description: Heir to House Hevring of the Adrestian Empire. Has deep friendship with the second son of House Bergliez, Caspar. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Maybe it would be good if I tried from time to time... On second thought, it sounds like a pain.
This moment of quiet ought to go on forever... *yawn* It's the perfect sound to sleep to.
If you insist on talking to me, you must first defeat the demon of drowsiness—which is no easy task.

Crest versus nurture. Which causes a noble's personality disorder? There's a research project, eh?
Now, would you find me someone with a disorder?

Fighting holds no interest for me. Someday, though, I might like to become a Crest scholar...
Have you heard of the Crest of Flames by chance?
Visit: I was asked to come here and had no opportunity to decline. So, here you are. From [F].
Level: I'd rather not kill. I don't want blood on my hands. I just want to read a nice book to put myself to sleep...
Honor? A foolish reason to fight. Glory? Even worse. Let's stop this.
Is there a point to me fighting if the result is only this unpleasantness?
Summon: I'm Linhardt. I was considering dedicating myself to Crest research but, well... Here I am, I suppose.
Learn Skill: Is that all you wanted with me? Well, my nap time is coming up, so...
Confession:
I don't sleep all the time like everyone thinks I do. I actually study more than anything, if you ask me.
I don't enjoy speaking with others, so I like nighttime, when no one else is around. It suits me the best.
And then, since I'm up all night, I end up sleeping during the day.
You're aware, are you? Well, while we're on the subject, you're rather active at night too, are you not?
I ought to ask when exactly you sleep.
Do you have a Crest that causes insomnia, perhaps? Mind removing that hood and cloak so I can check?
You may have a Crest hidden somewhere on your body...
Oh, not here? All right... Well, let's go to my room then, shall we?
Truthfully, I've been interested in you for quite some time now. Wait, why are you leaving? It's just for research!
Status: ...Now try to stand.
I'll make this quick.
I am Linhardt. It's nice to meet you.
Say, do you know of a quiet place to take a nap?
Each person must follow their own way. This is how I prefer to live.
I have to fight in this world too? Ugh. Fine.
You do have a cute side to you.
Map Select: I'd like to take it easy.

ingrid.name: Ingrid
ingrid.title: Galatea's Heir
ingrid.description: Heir to House Galatea of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. Lost her fiancé in the Tragedy of Duscur. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Being away from home has allowed me to focus purely on the lance, that I might best defend the ones I love.
My fiancé was an honest and faithful knight. Pained as I was to lose Glenn, I'm proud he did his duty to the end.
A clean space makes for a clean mind, and that starts with what you wear. Straighten out those cuffs!
Meat, veggies, fish... Char-broiled, seared, smoked... So many choices. What should I eat today?
I must study intensely now so that my skills in riding and the sword and lance will be ready when called upon.
Visit: Greetings. I am here to deliver warm regards to [S] from [F].
Level: My aim is to become a devoted knight—one who could have stood proudly by Glenn's side.
Ah, no big deal.
Spare me the consolation! I will do better next time.
Summon: I may still be in training, but so long as brave and determined knights are needed, I will gladly answer the call.
Learn Skill: Thank you for this. I promise I will see it put to good use.
Confession:
I find myself wondering, perhaps counterproductively, what place a knight has in a world free of conflict.
That world is His Highness's goal, I know, but what good is a knight who is not fighting to protect her people?
House Galatea's lands are barren, its coffers bare. Until I was born, we had not seen a Crest for generations.
Ever since we lost Glenn, my father has rushed to arrange one marriage proposal after another for me.
He means well. He wants what's best for me and for our house. He has already sacrificed so much...
Ah, forgive me—I have a lot on my mind. I'm not sure exactly what I'm trying to say right now.
Perhaps I'm simply grateful to fight to protect you...as a knight should.
Status: I am Ingrid Brandl Galatea. Pleasure to make your acquaintance.
A civilized conversation isn't too much to ask for, is it?
Since I was young, I've always wanted to be strong enough to protect our kingdom, like Prince Dimitri—or Glenn.
My father was never pleased when I'd steal away on my horse...
Some say I could do more to maintain my appearance, but I take little interest in fashion.
All this training has given me a rapacious appetite.
Perhaps we could dine together sometime. I'd be curious to try some of your favorite foods.

marianne.name: Marianne
marianne.title: Adopted Daughter
marianne.description: Adopted daughter of Margrave Edmund. Came under her current, renowned adoptive father after losing both parents. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Dear Goddess, I ask for guidance... And for protection...
My apologies if I cause you any trouble, summoner.
I spend most of my time looking after animals and praying to the goddess...
I'm not good at talking to others. I can talk to a pegasus or a horse just fine. But if it's a person, I freeze up.
Um, did you need something from me?
Visit: This is, um...a gift for you from your friend. I just came to deliver it.
Level: I wonder how much more I can learn.
I guess I feel a little stronger.
Um... Oh well.
Summon: Sorry...you're stuck with me.
Learn Skill: OK, I've got it now. I'll try to put this to use.
Confession:
I-is this a good time? I, um... I wanted to thank you. You always watch out for me. It's very encouraging.
I've never been good at talking to people. I'm actually much more comfortable with horses and birds.
It's not that I'm disinterested in people. I just...freeze up. It makes others uncomfortable around me.
It's because of my adoptive father that I went to the Officers Academy and made friends, but...
I'm sorry—I'm starting to ramble. I wanted to ask you... Is it OK if I stay here in Askr?
I-it is? I'm glad. Everyone here is so nice. Staying here really means a lot to me, [S].
I never dreamed I'd come this far. Thank you again for your guidance.
Status: I'm M-Marianne von Edmund...
Eeek! Oh...my apologies. I was distracted talking to my bird friend...
My adoptive father is a noble with territory in the north of the Alliance. Oh, um...you seem surprised to learn that I was adopted.
I wonder... What is my purpose here? How can I make myself useful to others?
P-Please forgive me...I'm not used to speaking so openly.
Dear Goddess, I ask for guidance...
When I'm with you...I feel at ease. I would like to continue working by your side. That is, um, if you don't mind, of course.

solon.name: Solon
solon.title: Church Shadow
solon.description: Dark Bishop of those who slither in the dark. Lurked in the Sealed Forest, waiting for the Fell Star. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You share the form of the beasts, but you may in fact be similar to us. Or, perhaps... Hmm.

This castle reminds me of Garreg Mach... Can you sense it? A power unsuited to this place roils here...
One wonders what might just happen one day...
My experiments at the village went well. It's all coming together... We will see our dreams realized.
Whether the beasts quarrel, fight, die, or even live... We care not.
With an offering prepared, all can be set in motion... But it seems best I simply observe for now.
Visit: So, you are [S]... An ominous star shines on you. Like [F]...
Level: My name is Solon, the savior of all!
If you prefer it so, you shall also be added to the ranks of the dead!
A pity. Now that I have what I came for, I must bid you farewell.
Summon: I am Solon. My research has been tireless...and I draw ever closer to saving the world from those beasts!
Learn Skill: I know not what you have in mind, and I care little, but very well. It is but a trifle.
Confession:
Fascinating. Truly fascinating. I must offer you my thanks. An opportunity like this is rare.
The Forbidden Spell of Zahras forms a darkness that consumes all, and yet...
What you wield could be considered its antithesis. It steals a sliver of light from the ocean of chaos.
The Askran monument and that light must be twined in a formula...
But I presume you do not yet understand it yourself.
Understanding may come, however, if we join forces... Worry not. Time is of no concern. Not for us...
Status: My name is Solon. I am the true savior of all.
What is this foolishness? I have no time to waste on the likes of you...
I was hiding away in Garreg Mach to get the blood of that girl.
This is not the end... Thales will carry out our mission, somehow...
You are but a savage, insignificant beast.
The cursed Fell Star... The one I fear...
I shall be the judge of whether you, too, are perhaps more than a lowly beast.

myrrh3.name: Myrrh
myrrh3.title: Spring Harmony
myrrh3.description: Myrrh and Nah journey to the spring festival, where they deepen their ties as manaketes. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones / Awakening.
myrrh3.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】and the following effect to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn: "Foe cannot make a follow-up attack."
Grants the following effect to unit for 1 turn: "Neutralizes 'effective against flying' bonuses."
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall:
**Myrrh**: You've got dragon blood running through your veins too, so you'll live a long time, like me, Nah...
We can be friends forever and ever!
**Nah**: My clothes are so I match Myrrh! Mother looked a bit jealous, so I plan to make her some for next year.
**Myrrh**: Nah said I should chew on tree roots if I get hungry, but...they don't taste very good.
**Myrrh**: Are you curious what's in these eggs? Well...that's our secret.
**Nah**: I polished both our dragonstones until they shined. I'm not some procrastinator—I come prepared!
Visit: **Nah**: I'm Nah, and this is my friend, Myrrh. We've come to bring spring greetings from [F]!
Level: **Myrrh**: The spring winds carry us forward. Let us continue to grow stronger while together.
**Nah**: Myrrh and I keep getting stronger. Even if it's one step at a time, we'll keep on growing!
**Myrrh**: It can take a long time for a manakete to fully develop...
Summon: I am Myrrh. This is Nah, a dear friend of mine. I've so been looking forward to the spring festival.
Learn Skill: **Nah**: A gift of growth for spring, is it? We both appreciate it!
Confession:
**Myrrh**: I must thank you, Nah. This is the most fun I've ever had in springtime. It's nice to not spend the time alone...
**Nah**: Having lost my parents when I was still very young, I understand how you feel... It is nice to be together.
And it's not just me you have with you. There are other Heroes here, and [S] too!
I know your father can't be replaced, but...we'll make sure you never feel so alone again!
**Myrrh**: I am so happy I came to Askr and was able to meet the two of you, Nah, [S]...
Let's keep finding new ways to celebrate spring from now on, so we can keep being happy together...
Status: Boing!
"Are these...bunny ears?" "Look, I've got some too!"
Conversation: **Myrrh**: Hippity hop... Hippity hop...
**Nah**: What are you doing, Myrrh?
**Myrrh**: Oh... Um... I'm pretending to be a bunny.
**Nah**: Why would a dragon pretend to be a bunny?
**Myrrh**: Well, we're dressed as bunnies... So I thought we should act like them too.
**Nah**: I see. I guess I didn't expect to find you playing pretend. You always seemed so mature.
**Myrrh**: You're right. Maybe I got carried away... Can we keep this between us?
**Nah**: Oh, uh... But you make a great bunny! Why hide it? *giggle*
In fact, if you need a buddy, then I'm your girl. So let's...hop to it!
**Myrrh**: Oh, wow! I didn't know you could hop so far in one leap!
**Nah**: We all have our talents, my friend. They say practice makes perfect, so why not have a race?
**Myrrh**: A race? That does sound kind of fun... Where are we racing to?
**Nah**: Hmm... How about... Whoever can hop to the summoner first is the winner!
**Myrrh**: Hehe, and whoever loses has to buy sweets for the winner.
**Nah**: Oh, you're begging me to go all out with a prize like that. I hope you're ready...
**Myrrh**: Just wait until you see how much I've been practicing... On your mark, get set... Hippity hop!
**Nah**: Hippityyyyy... HOP!

minerva3.name: Minerva
minerva3.title: Verdant Dragoon
minerva3.description: Eldest princess of Macedon. She is donning seasonal garb while attending the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: What I wear is of no concern, for the pride of a Macedonian princess does not waver. Not for an instant!
I was caught off guard... I had not expected to ever don such garb as this.
The Askran spring is beautiful indeed. Riding wyvernback across the sky, basking in the sun's warmth is...bliss.
I am not fond of festive dress, but Maria put effort into this costume for me. I wear it out of obligation.
This is no wyvern egg. It is merely decorative. Wyvern eggs are quite a bit larger, their shells harder.
Visit: I deliver a springtime greeting from [F]. Enjoy.
Level: Let us celebrate both the coming of spring and our victory with gaiety!
Whether in festive dress or not, I must not perform shamefully.
This cannot be. For me to have let this happen is...unthinkable.
Summon: I am Minerva, princess of Macedon. I will do as you ask of me during this spring festival.
Learn Skill: I shall swear this spring season will stir new growth in me as well.
Confession:
Macedon, my homeland, was founded by Iote, a king born as a slave. It was not a wealthy country in those days.
However, the people settled in the thick forests and took to building a country with wills of steel.
As a result of their efforts, Macedon entered a new season, and their work bore the fruit of abundance.
Enduring a long winter carries the promise of spring. In a way, it is a reflection of Macedon's victory.
So, let us celebrate this season together and soar even higher.
So that next year we may celebrate this day again, and all it represents.
Special: I am a princess and a warrior!
Status: It seems that this is the garb of the spring festival. It is somewhat awkward.
Hm? A flower petal drifted onto my shoulder? I see. Thank you.
I heard that Palla and the other Whitewings participated in the festival before. I thought that this year, I would join in.
Rabbits, eggs, and pretty colors... This festival is full of adorable decorations. Maria would love it.
Spring is a wonderful season. I feel that everything is given new life.
I would not much like for my brother to encounter me in this attire.
Next time, I would like to show you Macedon in spring.

inigo3.name: Inigo
inigo3.title: Festival Flower
inigo3.description: Olivia's son. Conquering his shyness, he makes his entry to the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Once the music starts and everyone's all smiles and having fun, my body will just start dancing on its own!
This festival is like a dream. In the future I lived, spring celebrations like this were just fireside stories!
Do you...think these eggs might hatch into bugs? I'd sooner die loveless and alone than see that happen!
Girls in bunny outfits as far as the eye can see! This calls for a new opener. Maybe... "Hey, what's hopping?"

Mother said the best way to conquer shyness was to talk to girls.
If she could see how many girls I've talked to here, she'd be SO proud!
Visit:
If you have any tips on how to make people stop trying to tug on these ears, I'm all, um...ears.
I've entirely lost count of how many have tried. Maybe I shouldn't have left [F]'s castle...
Level: I've got to be strong if I want to show ALL the girls around the festival!
I'm feeling a little extra spring in my step!
I was distracted... I simply caught a glimpse of a lovely maiden.
Summon: My name is Inigo, and now that spring has sprung... Um... S-stop staring—I'm actually quite shy.
Learn Skill: Oh my! This spring certainly is warming up quickly!
Confession:
Thank you for asking me here to the spring festival, [S].
I must admit, I wasn't sure about the dress code. At first, I thought the ears would be a little embarrassing...
But once I saw Princess Sharena and Prince Alfonse enjoying theirs, I was finally able to pluck up my courage.
Sometimes all it takes is a little encouragement, don't you think?
Ahh! That's something I would have loved to have told my late mother, Olivia, were she still with me.
Actually, her younger self is here in Askr, so I suppose I still have the opportunity after all!
Perhaps later! For now, I just want to soak in the festival spirit...and maybe try to talk to a few lucky ladies.
Status: I know, I know. I look ridiculous.
HEY! I did NOT say you could pull the ears.
Spring is so full of cheer, it just makes me want to frolic!
Hey, it's spring—the season for smiles!
You think Mother would like some flowers? Maybe I should make her a bouquet.
The festival's got everyone in such good spirits, I might actually have a chance...
Your smile is as lovely as the springtime sun.

severa2.name: Severa
severa2.title: Bitter Blossom
severa2.description: Cordelia's daughter. Came to participate in the spring festival. Kind to her friends, but has a bit of a chip on her shoulder. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Hey! These clothes are actually kind of cute! Why not buy me some new shoes and jewelry while you're at it!
It's not like this isn't any fun! I'm just not used to this kind of thing, so I'm at a bit of a loss as to what to do.
Why don't you stop patrolling around and enjoy the festivities a little, huh? Spring won't last forever!
There's another girl that looks just like me here already? And her name's Selena? Bring her to me—now!
What? I have to help with the festival preparations? Sounds like a pain. I'll have my doppelgänger handle it.
Visit:
Hey! Don't just stand there! Aren't you going to at least offer me some tea or something?
I brought you this all the way from [F] after all...
Level: Did you see how amazing I was? I'll be expecting my reward!
Wearing cute clothes helps soothe the sting a bit, at least!
Ugh! I told myself, "It's a festival! Just have fun with it!" and now look...
Summon: The name's Severa. I don't know anything about this spring-festival stuff, but I'll join in the fun, I guess!
Learn Skill: I'll take more if you got it! One can never have too much of stuff like this, you know!
Confession:
Hey! Isn't this a festival? Stop looking all stiff and relax a bit, would you?
Everyone can use a little carefree fun in their lives, you know. Otherwise folks get irritable, don't they?
The world I came from was, well... it was the absolute worst. The men were all hopeless, for one thing.
There weren't even any shops with cute jewelry and accessories...
Don't give me that look. That stuff's important, all right?!
Anyway! We all need a little peace and relaxation! So you better enjoy this festival with everything you got!
Status: The name's Severa.
Watch it! Hands off the ears!
Listen up, because I'm only going to say this once... Have a very "hoppy" spring!
Of course my outfit looks amazing. Did you expect anything less of me?
I know I look good in this outfit and all, but you're staring a little too hard, pal. Move along.
Wait, my mother is here?! Gods, if she sees me like this, I'll never live it down... Hide me!
I guess the spring festival isn't so bad... As long as you're here to spend it with me.

saleh.name: Saleh
saleh.title: Vernal Sage
saleh.description: Sage of Caer Pelyn, come to celebrate in the spring festival. Also Ewan's teacher. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall:
I come from Caer Pelyn. It is very remote, and the people there enjoy simple lives.
A festival as extravagant as this would be beyond imagining to the people there. What a marvel!
My life's purpose is to defend Myrrh, the Great Dragon. Even here at this festival, that purpose does not waver.
When all creation aligns in harmony, the blessings of spring come upon us. This cycle of rebirth is never-ending.

Gerik would enjoy this festival... Perhaps I should have invited him.
He has become a dear friend. I will forever be thankful he was able to overcome his hatred of me.
If my apprentice, Ewan, were here, he would almost certainly lose himself in the revelry of this festival.
Visit: Spring tidings to you! I come with a missive from [F].
Level: Excellent! May this power bring the festival even more joy.
Let the blessings of spring wash over us all.
My apologies. I did not wish to put a damper on the festivities...
Summon: I am Saleh, from the village of Caer Pelyn. Let us celebrate the coming of spring, and build a world of harmony.
Learn Skill: Truth lives within the heart, as does strength.
Confession:
Ah, it is you, [S].
I was practicing Valega, the ritual of knowing and feeling harmony, of finding one's self within the whole.
With enough dedication, it is said that the rite can guide one to their most noble and pure self.
It also reminds me of home. Valega has been taught for generations in the village of Caer Pelyn.
In many ways, I find the spring festival of Askr to be much the same...
Both are passed down as a tradition, both honor harmony in nature, and both remind their followers of home.
It brings me great joy to have a part in keeping such an event alive and vibrant.
Thank you for celebrating with me. When spring comes again, I will remember this day.
Status: The spring festival... A time to give thanks for all of creation's blessings.
Oh, sorry. I was distracted. This really is quite a festival.
I have never used a weapon like this... But I will do my best.
Align your desires with the world around you. By knowing the vastness of creation, you will come to know yourself.
I am...unused to such extravagant clothes.
Dragons and humans both share a love of spring. Such similarities help us live together peacefully.
The Great Dragon is having a wonderful time at the festival. And we have you to thank!

dagr.name: Dagr
dagr.title: Sun's Radiance
dagr.description: The younger of the princesses of Jötunheimr, and Nótt's twin sister. Cheerful and bighearted, but also ready for a scrap when the time comes.

Castle Hall: Me? Giant? Mom is WAY bigger than me—like several TIMES bigger! Hope I grow that big too...and soon!

I have a fool sister and a terrifying mom back in Jötunheimr.
Huh? A dad? Uhh... I might have one. I forget, honestly. Not that important!
I snuck into the kitchen and snagged a huge pile of sweets... Hey, don't go telling Alfster on me, all right?!
Hey! Take me somewhere fun, why don't you! I'm sooooo bored! ...Hey! Are you even listening to me?!
I've been chatting up lots of folks around here. Everyone's from some weird place I've never heard of!
Visit:
Can't believe I'm being treated like just another foot soldier even in [F]'s crew...
Huh? Oh, right. Here.
Level: That's right! Expect nothing less from me! No one's a match for THIS jötun!
This seems just about right, wouldn't you say? Don't go having unrealistic expectations! I'm just one jötun!
What?! I've been cheated!
Summon:
Hey, I'm Dagr, second of the twin princesses of Jötunheimr. Hope you're ready for a good time!
Thanks for the invite, by the way!
Learn Skill: Hah! Get ready for the new and improved Dagr! Oh, and thanks. You're sweet! *wink*
Confession:
*yawn* Ah... Sorry—I haven't slept all that much lately. I've just been enjoying my time here, y'know?
There are just so many interesting people to talk to here, so I end up staying up half the night!
Like some change into dragons or are secretly other people... It's wild!
The world—er, worlds, I guess—have a lot more going on than I expected!
Just listening to everyone, I feel like I've learned a ton. I might even be smarter than I already was! *wink*
I guess what I'm trying to say is that I'm having fun here, and I'm real glad you summoned me! That's all!
I'm looking forward to being here for a while still. Hope I can hear more of your story too while I'm at it!
Give me a shout sometime, will ya? Don't be a stranger!
Status: I'm Dagr, the younger of the princesses of Jötunheimr. Nice meeting you!
Waah! What are you doing? I can't take you runts.
I'm going to be a GREAT queen. My reign is going to be a lot of fun for everyone!
I wonder if I could get taller! Double this would just about do it.
Sure, Nótt's beautiful. And she looks put together. But don't let that fool you!
Nótt is my sister, and she is what she is, so... I have to clean up her messes.
Hey there, don't forget about me now! I'll get lonely, you know?

farina.name: Farina
farina.title: The Great Wing
farina.description: An Ilian pegasus knight; younger sister to Fiora and older sister to Florina. Her pragmatic worldview can sometimes border on avarice. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
I had imagined being a Hero would be freeing, but many here seem like they're just as stiff as they were...
Is it a symptom of being too strong, I wonder?
Only women can ride pegasusback, so all pegasus knights are women. Ilian men all work the fields.
Eat when you have food and rest when you have shelter! That's how mercenaries live!
Being a pegasus knight costs money. The noble pegasus must eat noble carrots, after all!
Those damn nobles, taking advantage of my sister and her contract breach. They'll get theirs before it's over...
Visit: I'm Farina, of the Ilian Strongwings, requested by Lord Hector himself! It'll be 20,000 gold for my service.
Level: We have a saying in Ilia: One foe for country, and another foe for family! ...Actually, I just made that up.
Did you see that? You get all 20,000 gold's worth from me!
Hey! What're these scraps?!
Summon: I am Farina, of Ilia's third division of pegasus knights. Want my help? It usually runs about 20,000 gold.
Learn Skill: Wait, really? ...You're not going to ask me to pay you back later, are you?
Confession:
Hey! You have a moment to chat, [S]?
This might seem a bit sudden, but... how much is Askr paying you? Don't tell me nothing! Seriously?!
Seems like you have no plans for your own future. You think you can live without worry—but you can't!
Every service has its price, so why don't we get you set up with a real contract, hm? Just leave it to me!
I'll even offer you a special rate and just take a mere 20% commission off the top for doing the negotiating.
All right! Let's go nail down the details of the terms!
Status: I'm Farina, a mercenary member of the Strongwings, the third wing of the Ilian Pegasus Knights. Of course, I assume you know all that...
Whoa, hey there! My time is worth money, so don't waste it.
Fiora, Farina, and Florina—the three of us sisters are the beauties of Ilia.
How much are they paying you? My last job paid 20,000 gold...
A woman needs an income! You have to be willing to walk away if they try to offer you less than you're worth!
Fiora, Florina... I'll be back one day...and I'll be hauling lots of gold.
I will carry this entire operation on my back if I have to, so you should offer me a startlingly high salary!

louise.name: Louise
louise.title: Lady of Violets
louise.description: Wife of Pent, Count Reglay of Etruria. Said to have caught the eye of many an admirer with her dazzling beauty and impeccable aim. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: An unfamiliar land full of unfamiliar people... Were my husband here, he'd no doubt be buried in research.
Does the water here seem a bit...soft? When I make tea, I just can't seem to get the same flavor I get in Etruria.
Please, call me Louise. It would make me happy if you could see me not as a noble or commoner, but as a peer.
Quivering simply won't do. You must stand up tall, with your back straight and your head high. That's it.
I used to do the girls' hair. Even in the midst of battle, a woman's beauty ought not to be concealed.
Visit: I come with a gift and to check on you in [F]'s stead.
Level: Goodness! I imagine even my husband would be impressed by that.
If I put in a little more effort, will I be able to fire even farther, do you suppose?
Oh! My bowstring snapped! What an ominous sign...
Summon:
My name is Louise, wife of Pent, Count Reglay of Etruria. Are you in some kind of trouble?
If we work together, I'm sure we can make it through any struggle.
Learn Skill: I'm confident in my accuracy, so you can trust this skill will be put to good use.
Confession:
Oh my, Summoner, how do you do? It feels like we've been meeting quite often lately, though I'm happy to talk.
You're not interrupting anything. I've reached a stopping point in my journaling for today.
The joys and tragedies of each day... Memories of my husband... Anything and everything. I want to remember.
I hope, when peace comes, we can reflect on our current anxieties with some fondness, as distant memories.
I hope to tell these stories to my children one day...
When and if Lord Pent and I have children, I hope they grow to be as wise and bighearted as you are.
Status: I am Louise. The honor is all mine.
My, you sure are friendly, aren't you!
Despite my upbringing, I shoot much better than I dance or sing.
Loving another person can fill you with endless joy and energy!
I am always pleased to be of service!
Once it begins to turn, they say, none can halt the wheel of fate...
Having met and spent time with you, I can tell you truly are irreplaceable.

pent.name: Pent
pent.title: Mage General
pent.description: Count Reglay. Husband of Louise and leader of Etruria's most prominent noble house. Known to all as a seeker of magical knowledge. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: This is the first time I've seen any of these texts! This castle's library is a trove. I could peruse forever!
I'm sure everyone back home must think I'm back to my old habits again. Hopefully I won't be away too long...

When I touch my hair, I can't help but think of my wife, as she combs my hair each morning...
Do you have plans to settle down anytime soon, Summoner?
I've added candlesticks to the room to improve the light. Care to join me as I examine these texts?
Ah! Have you been there long? My apologies. I was absorbed in my work.
Visit: I am Pent, Count Reglay of Etruria. I've been entrusted with giving you this, from [F].
Level: The magical energy is surging through me! This may be imprudent, but my heart is racing...
Hm. Well, this seems about right, I suppose.
My apologies. I will endeavor not to make the same mistake again.
Summon: I am Pent. In my country, I am known as the Mage General, but here, I am but a mere seeker. It is my pleasure.
Learn Skill: Is this the result of your research? Rather impressive, I must say.
Confession:
My, but those techniques our foe used last battle were astounding. I'd practically stopped to gape!
I nearly suffered a direct hit for my curiosity. I simply wanted to see such an incredible ability up close...
Had it not been for your support, there is no telling what fate might have befallen me. Thank you, truly.
Though, at times intellectual pursuits demand one puts their own life at risk. You understand, don't you?
Your eyes share the gleam I see in the mirror. I must ask... How would you wish to see the world shaped?
Once we reach the end of our path here together, I would love for us to discuss it—and in some depth.
Status: I am Pent, Count Reglay of Etruria.
Hah! What a peculiar way of greeting people...
Even if I told the people back home about the power of a summoner, no one would believe me.
Being away from my home for long periods of time is nothing new for me. I doubt anyone will be upset.
In this world, there are many mysterious things that fall beyond our realm of understanding...
If something out there is guiding me, I have no choice other than to bow to the dictates of fate...
It seems the fate of this world rests on your shoulders.

erk.name: Erk
erk.title: Studious Mage
erk.description: Ward and student of Pent, Mage General of Etruria. Feels a great debt of gratitude to his foster family for raising him. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.
erk.artist: NA / Creative House Pocket Co., Ltd

Castle Hall: Is there a cleric here by the name of Serra, by chance? I just want to avoid getting involved in any more trouble...
Has anyone ever told you that you remind them of a tactician from Elibe?
I am not cut out for battle. My dream is to be a person worthy of respect, and to establish a place of research.
Magic feels the same in this world. That must mean, like the people, the spirits are similar to those in Elibe...
Ah... Pardon me. Just a moment. I am nearly done with this book...
Visit: I've been sent to bring this to you, from [F].
Level: Yes! This is the feeling I live for.
Phew... One more battle, and then can we rest a bit?
I want to control the magic within me at will... If I cannot manage that, I'll never be a first-rate mage.
Summon: I am Erk. I am to be my teacher's ideal student.
Learn Skill: I still have much to learn next to my teacher, but I will put in whatever effort is necessary to close that gap.
Confession:
...
...Hm?
...Ah! So sorry! Yes, I am all right. I must have dozed off there.
My teacher, Lord Pent, who trained me in magic, found me sleeping like that and woke me similarly.
I must admit, it is a somewhat embarrassing way to be roused.
I have been working to learn more about the magic here—for several days now—and I must be exhausted...
I will try to be more mindful of getting rest moving forward so I do not worry Lord Pent...or you.
Special: Let my studies show their worth!
See if you can match me!
Status: My name is Erk. If I am going to fight, I will show you the true power of magic!
Serra? Oh, no. It's you. You gave me a fright.
There is no stronger ally than Lord Pent. Is he here?
When I am caught up in a book, I become so absorbed that I forget even to eat.
Anything but protecting Serra again. My nerves couldn't endure it...
Lord Pent, Lady Louise... I will repay my debt to you one day.
It would please me to use the magic that I have mastered in your service.

sonia.name: Sonia
sonia.title: Inhuman Beauty
sonia.description: A mysterious woman who seduced the leader of the Black Fang. Her true loyalty lies with Nergal, at whose instruction she secretly manipulates events. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I was chosen by Lord Nergal himself! I'm a perfect being! Entirely different from those morph failures.
There are but two types of people in the world. Chosen leader and mere refuse. Which will you be?
Is there someone impeding your progress? Would you like me to kill them for you?

This castle will soon hold a grand ball, you say? And many nobles will be in attendance? Hmm...
I shall make them all my prisoners!
Only the chosen few will live to see the new world—only the perfect, like me. I wonder...how will you fare?
Visit: I come bearing a notice. You are in [F]'s debt...
Level: Ahahahaa! Refuse like you only exists to be reduced to quintessence and consumed by those like me!
Once you've made yourself my enemy, there is no escaping the painful death that awaits you.
Such failure will tarnish my reputation... A worse fate than that of a morph...
Summon: Do not tell me you summoned me simply to gawk... Why don't we skip the formalities, then. Call me Sonia.
Learn Skill: Hah... Placing your trust in a stranger is so utterly foolish.
Confession:
Ah, [S]...
How are you? Better with me by your side, I expect...
You know, at first I thought I might just take your quintessence right away, but...well... Heh, never mind.
You seem to shine in an unusual way. Your light is both bright and dim, here and yet somewhere else entirely...
I can only assume this must be the result of some unknown magic.
With that in mind, would you come with me? There is someone I know who would like to meet you.
Surely he will recognize your power, our combined perfection... Then we will rule over the filth together.
Status: I am Sonia, a perfect specimen, chosen by Lord Nergal.
Ugh. Surely you know I detest that.
There are two types of people in the world. Those chosen to lead and those fit only to serve: human refuse.
Limstella was created by Lord Nergal... A morph. Nothing more than a filthy puppet.
I will take care of Eliwood and his companions. I! Sonia!
Nino? She's trash. Garbage. Human refuse.
You must become like me...a perfect specimen.

eirika5.name: Eirika
eirika5.title: Twin Refulgence
eirika5.description: Twin prince and princess of Renais, children of King Fado. This lively brother and serene sister make for quite the pair. Appear in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.
eirika5.duo:
Grants【Dodge】to unit and allies within 3 rows and 3 columns centered on unit.
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of odd-numbered turns, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Dodge】 If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 4 (max 40%).

Castle Hall: **Eirika**: I don't care for fighting. There's too much blood and pain... Why are adults drawn to such things?
**Eirika**: Renais has many strong warriors... Orson, Seth—oh, and Father! You'll be strong too, Ephraim! I know it!
**Ephraim**: I told you to stay behind, but you clung to my side. Don't cry to me if something happens to you!
**Ephraim**: I'm prince of Renais, so I must grow strong so I can lead our armies and protect our people!
**Ephraim**: The two finalists of the youth bracket of the tournament the other day were amazing... I must keep training.
Visit:
**Eirika**: I am Eirika. I've come to greet you as princess of Renais!
Ephraim, you're supposed to offer your greeting too!
Level: **Eirika**: I'm the princess of Renais, country of brave knights! I can't simply stand by while we're under threat of attack!
**Eirika**: Are you all right, Brother?! You insist on rushing ahead... I worry about you!
**Ephraim**: Are you hurt, Eirika?! As long as you are free from harm, all is well.
Summon: My name is Eirika. This is my brother, Ephraim. We're twins! That's why we're always together.
Learn Skill: **Ephraim**: This is possible? I had no idea. I must learn more about this world! Ah, but the lecture can wait until...later.
Confession:
**Ephraim**: A world where you can focus on the martial training, free from obligations of nobility...
This is how a world should be! I'm glad I was able to leave the palace behind to come here.
**Eirika**: Brother... If we don't get home soon, Father will worry!
**Ephraim**: I must grow stronger if I'm to protect our kingdom. The complicated stuff is your responsibility if you ask me...
**Eirika**: Well, if you ask ME, it's upsetting that you'd think of leaving me behind just to go on a journey to train!
**Ephraim**: Fine, fine. It was selfish of me... You can stop giving me that look now.
**Eirika**: Ephraim, you worry me, going out and getting into battles.
**Ephraim**: It'll be fine! Listen, I'll get stronger and stronger, and then you won't have to worry!
And I'll always be there to protect you too. You can count on that!
**Eirika**: ...You promise? All right. As long as you stay near so I can always keep my eye on you too.
Status: Yes.
"Together, we're unstoppable." "Definitely!"
Conversation: **Eirika**: Ephraim! Are you all right?!
**Ephraim**: I'm fine, Eirika. It's only a scratch.
**Eirika**: It's my fault you're hurt. I'm so sorry!
**Ephraim**: It's OK. Everyone trips now and then. If I hadn't intervened, you could have rolled right off that cliff.
A few scrapes and bruises are a small price to pay to keep you from getting far worse. Easy choice.
**Eirika**: Even so...I put the future king of Renais in danger.
If something happened to you, the whole kingdom would be lost. Your safety is so much more important...
**Ephraim**: That's not true, Eirika.
**Eirika**: But...
**Ephraim**: Whether I'm to be king or not makes no difference. My life is not worth any more than yours.
No matter what, I am your brother, and I will always protect you. Do you understand?
**Eirika**: Yes, Ephraim. I do.
**Ephraim**: Good. Then let's return to the castle. We're in for a scolding, I'm sure.
**Eirika**: I'm bound to get an earful over your scratches, aren't I?
**Ephraim**: Relax. I've got your back.
**Eirika**: In that case, even the harshest words won't faze me. Together, we can handle anything!
**Ephraim**: There's the sister I know and love! Off we go, then.
Duo Skill: "Put your faith in me, Eirika." "Always, Ephraim!"

tana3.name: Tana
tana3.title: Frelian Starlight
tana3.description: Princess of Frelia, and sister to Innes. Wants only to be friends with the twin prince and princess of the neighboring kingdom, Renais. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I did it! Freedom... I'm like a bird who flew from her cage!
Father and Brother treat me like I'm a child. Put a spear in my hands, and I'll put the boys to shame!
There was some fruit left over from breakfast, so I took some! Let's put it in water with honey and drink it!
Hey! What're you doing? Let me help! C'mon, [S]!
I can take care of myself. Whenever I'm in the castle, though, a bunch of guards always follow me around...
Visit: How nice to meet you! I'm Tana, from Frelia. I've come to meet you on behalf of [F].
Level: I bet you didn't expect that! ...I didn't even expect it!
Focus, Tana! Focus! Ephraim and Eirika are surely doing their best right now. I have to do the same!
What? Ugh... C'mon!
Summon: Nice to meet you. I'm Tana, princess of Frelia—not that noble status means anything... Let's be friends!
Learn Skill: I'm going to get even stronger than my brother while he's not looking!
Confession:
Let me ask you something... If I'm the princess of Frelia, is it so wrong for me to play like a normal girl?
"Remember your duty as royalty," says my brother. Pompous! How can I learn anything behind castle walls?
I love Frelia... The smell of the forest, the wind off the sea... And I love the people that live there!
Eirika understands... We may not get to see each other often, but she's my best friend...
If my brother had his way, he would likely bully Eirika, Ephraim, and the others, but I'll defend them!
Oh! Does that count as my duty as royalty? If so, being a princess is all right then.
I'll protect the people of Frelia! Yeah... Just like Eirika!
Status: Nice to meet you! Call me Tana. I'm the princess of Frelia.
Hey! It's rude to scare me like that!
My brother always calls me a child, but he's no shining example of maturity...
Flying through the sky on a pegasus makes you feel like you're on top of the world!
Ephraim and Eirika are my very best friends. They're from Renais, did you know?
Is there a way to grow up more quickly? My father and brother need my help!
Protecting you is hard work. I've got to get way stronger!
