lyon3.name: Lyon
lyon3.title: Grado's Gaze
lyon3.description: Beloved son of the emperor of Grado, Vigarde. Like his father, who is referred to as the Silent Emperor, he prefers to keep to himself. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I hope Father is well...
Grado is a large country, but it is not great in wealth. Earthquakes cause trouble frequently as well...
I don't care for places that bustle with people...
I'm not built to wield a sword, spear, or axe—or even a bow. That is why I pour my effort into studying magic.
Hhnngg! Ahh... General Duessel often tells me to stand up straight, stretch my back, and breathe deeply.
Visit: My name is Lyon. I was told to give you this by [F].
Level: Can I grow even more powerful still? If so, I aim to, for father's sake—and for the sake of Grado!
You would not retreat, so what choice did I have!
I will not be ashamed, nor will I shout in anger... I am the prince of Grado.
Summon: I am Lyon of Grado. I am new to this place, so I hope we can be friends.
Learn Skill: This is a strange feeling... What are your expectations with regard to my growth, [S]?
Confession:
My father is Vigarde, the emperor of Grado. He is a great man who thinks only of his people.
I hear he is called the Silent Emperor by some, and is not taken seriously... But he is truly strong—unlike me.
Grado has General Duessel too, so our military is strong. That is why I will support Grado with my studies.
Speaking of which, my father often journeys beyond Grado in search of those who might be of service.
I'd like to introduce you to Father if I get the chance. I think he would appreciate meeting you!
Status: I'm... Lyon. Oh, yes... I'm the prince of the Grado Empire. Right.
Aaagh! Oh...It's you. You scared me.
I always wanted friends the same age as me...
As emperor, I hope I can match up to my father.
It would make me happy if we could get along with people in other countries.
If I can just get stronger, then... I...
You want to be friends? That's great.

larachel3.name: L'Arachel
larachel3.title: Seeker of Justice
larachel3.description: Niece to Pontifex Mansel and princess of Rausten. Her ultimate ambition is to rid the world of monsters. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: There are two things I cannot abide: monsters who would sow chaos, and evil that would sow destruction!
Never despair, no matter what! The light of hope will not abandon those with hope in their hearts!

The Sacred Stones, great treasures with the power to repel darkness...
It is said that in ancient times great heroes sealed away the Demon King with their blessed power.
I have a dream! It's to go journeying, once my uncle permits me, in order to destroy monsters!
Ugh! I'm so irritated...I could yank an old man's beard!
Visit: You! I hear you always take good care of [F].
Level: Light will shine in the hearts of the people as long as I live! Eradication is what awaits darkness everywhere!
Losing is inconceivable to me! Justice always wins!
Father...Mother...I've let you down!
Summon: Ahem... I am L'Arachel, the beautiful princess of Rausten!
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude!
Confession:
Oh, you're just in time to come offer up your prayers with me. Come on!
Protect Rausten, O Saint Latona... Bless us with your light...
That we may extinguish evil and banish the darkness that plagues the land...
I will one day destroy the monsters of the Darkling Woods and bring peace to the world!
I pray for that day to come as soon as possible!
Once I have done that, I will save all those who grieve in the world... And all the future will be bathed in light!
Status: Is it not an honor?
Fight with all you've got!
I am L'Arachel, the princess of Rausten!
I can tell you're excited to be speaking to someone so noble as I!
When I grow up, I'm going to beat so many monsters all on my own!
My mother and father... They left me... I'd give anything to see them.
*giggle* I like you! I shall make you my vassal!

innes3.name: Innes
innes3.title: Frelian Moonlight
innes3.description: Son of Frelia's king, Hayden. Harbors a fierce rivalry with the prince of the neighboring kingdom, Renais. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall:
I don't know where she gets it, but my sister is too energetic for her own good...
Take your eyes off her for a moment, and she's gone. Her guardians do not have it easy.
One should think beyond their own country. Frelia must keep an eye on events in Carcino, for example.
Future kings must mind both their words and their deeds. This is a fact I strive to remember.
It is somewhat strange to be away from the royal court. Though I feel no sense of liberation.
Tana is nowhere to be seen... I tell her to remain at my side when away, and this is what she does.
Visit: A gift, delivered in friendship from [F].
Level: Right. I expect nothing less of myself.
It is no simple task to keep one's goals in sight in combat, but I will prove I am up to the task!
Calm down, Innes. You must not lose your composure over such trivial matters!
Summon: I am Innes, first son of the king of Frelia, King Hayden. Now, please, tell me your name and title.
Learn Skill: As the heir of Frelia, I must be skilled in all manner of things.
Confession:
*sigh* Being a prince is exhausting. I am expected to behave as the future king at all times, you see.
Some time ago, I tried to speak with the prince of Renais about diplomacy, but...it did not go well.
It was as though matters of the court meant nothing to him.
Instead it was the princess, hiding behind her brother, who seemed to have a mind for such things.
She said her name was Eirika, as I recall...
She was intelligent—and rather beautiful as well. I do wish my sister could learn from her...
D-don't laugh! How rude. I'm simply paying the princess a compliment. I don't mean anything beyond that!
Special: Is that all you can do?
Status: I am Prince Innes of Frelia. I will rule the kingdom one day.
Insolent fool! Do you think you can just—
A king must not show any weakness. To be a ruler is to be without flaw.
I am proficient enough with the blade and the spear; however, it is the bow that is, to me, most natural.
My little sister, Tana, is something of a tomboy. I hope she can grow to be more dignified.
Ephraim of Renais... Anyone but him. I must best him!
You show quite a bit of promise! In the future, you would excel in my service.
Map Select: My arrow will pierce the heart!

sigurd3.name: Sigurd
sigurd3.title: Fated Holy Knight
sigurd3.description: Legendary Hero whose life tragically ended with a broken heart. But the threads of his fate went on to weave new hope. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall:
If Heroes from across times and places gather here, does that mean our crusader ancestors are here?
If so, I hope to have an audience with them.

I promised that when the fighting ended we would all join each other in celebration, but...
Regretfully, that promise can no longer be kept.
There is not much one can achieve on their own. It is wise to seek advice from friends. Remember, I am here.

Deirdre... If our meeting was fated, the tragedy that followed must, too, have been an inevitability...
Even so, I will never regret my love for her.
Shannan and Oifey raised Seliph to be a great man in my stead. I wish I could express my full appreciation.
Visit: Here you are. For having been good to [F].
Level: Battle is not a simple matter of strength. Without it, however, some things cannot be protected...
Baldr grant me the strength to fight once more...
It is too late for anger. I must take one step at a time... I must keep moving forward.
Summon:
I am Sigurd of Chalphy. My father, my dear friends, and all those under me risked everything...
Now, all I am left with are my regrets.
Learn Skill: I thank you. I hope to repay this kindness you've done me.
Confession:
I fought for my beliefs, my ideals. My blood hot, I took up the sword, my honor and pride on the line.
Even so, I asked myself, why must we wage this war? For the light? The light...
Back then I could not see the evil of which Claud of Edda spoke, the rage in the shadows of the world.
Although I do not regret my choices, chasing after what was before me distracted me from the true evil.
My fate may have been unavoidable. But seeing you work revives that drive to pursue my ideals once more.
Keep the kindness, courage, and strength in your heart burning...
By doing so, a world without war will one day arrive, and a world of light will be ours. In that I have every faith.
Status: I am Sigurd, of House Chalphy.
Oh? Have you something to ask me? I will listen.
I, a Legendary Hero? I find that difficult to credit.
My wife Deirdre commands remarkable magic. Together, we will lend you our strength.
I descend from the crusader Baldr. On the battlefield, I strive to stay worthy to his name.
Seliph has grown into a remarkable young man. He has exceeded my expectations.
I am honored to fight shoulder to shoulder with you.

dimitri4.name: Dimitri
dimitri4.title: Savage Boar
dimitri4.description: Prince of Faerghus overcome by hatred. Vowing to have his revenge on Edelgard, he commits to slaughtering his foes without mercy. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Seeing those who stole everything from me living...free of care or guilt. I cannot forgive them!
The dead cannot wish for revenge, much less seek it. That burden falls on those left behind.
If you do not approve of what I have become, then kill me. If you insist that you cannot, then I will continue...
By my hand, Edelgard's head will be removed from her shoulders...

Those before me were just beasts with human faces. I had no choice but to kill them, and so I did.
That...that is all there is to it.
Visit: So which are you? The kind who kills or the kind who gets killed? I ask for [F]'s sake...
Level: Kill every last one of them!
I will tear your heads from your shoulders...
I will not die... Not until I have her head!
Summon: I am Dimitri Alexandre Blaiddyd. No matter the world, even if I must do it alone, I will keep killing...
Learn Skill: I will crush anyone who blocks my path.
Confession:
...How many lives have you taken in the name of peace?
To protect Askr, you add to another growing mountain of corpses...
To dispel the regrets of the dead, these hands have grown stained with blood. They've taken many lives...
Piling up corpses for justice...for the dead... In the end, it's all murder.
We're the same, you and I. Monsters who were born to kill... No surprise then that we work well together.
Status: I am Dimitri Alexandre Blaiddyd. Everything has been taken from me...
You would touch me? I do not seek the embrace of a friend...
Only hatred remains. If I could tear that woman to shreds right this very moment, I would.
Friends? A beast of your depravity, prattling on about friends? How amusing.
If you do not approve of what I have become, then kill me.
As soon as possible...I must kill her.
After all is said and done, we are both murderers. Both stained. Both monsters.

edelgard4.name: Edelgard
edelgard4.title: Hegemon Husk
edelgard4.description: Adrestian Emperor who has chosen to take on a grotesque form for the sake of pursuing her ideals. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: This body is my wish...for change in a crooked world. Tremendous power is necessary.
To put an end to a bloody history, someone must stand up, even if some call it self-righteous...
My progress cannot be stopped. All who oppose me will fall to ruin. There can only be one true ruler.
If you believe the weak will remain weak, look again when they are no longer forced to rely on others...
The goddess ignores the pleas of the faithful, and countless souls are lost. That is the crookedness of this world!
Visit: I am the one who will free this world of its corruption—together with [F].
Level: We must trample the past underfoot. We must move onward to a tomorrow that is brighter still!
The weak will be scattered.
Without power, nothing changes.
Summon: I am emperor of the Adrestian Empire, Edelgard. With my power, I will reshape the crooked world...
Learn Skill: I will change the world—by any means necessary!
Confession:
The longer change takes, the more who fall victim to injustices of our current era...
My wish is to bring change about as quickly as possible. That is why I chose the path of war...
If fewer people suffer in war than would suffer under the present circumstances, that is a victory.
Fools imprisoned by their situation, with no vision for future possibilities... They are betrayers of progress.
You may try, but not even you can stop me. I must continue down the path I've chosen—no hesitation!
Status: I am Edelgard von Hresvelg. The one who will free this world of its corruption.
I will not suffer child's play. That piece of my heart is no more.
We must trample the past underfoot, and move onward to a brighter tomorrow!
My progress cannot be stopped, no matter how many people try.
These fools cannot see the future ramifications at stake...
There can only be one ruler of the world...
Facing you... I grow weak...

mmorgan2.name: Morgan
mmorgan2.title: Fated Darkness
mmorgan2.description: A mysterious young man from a future that knows only despair. His voice is somehow familiar... Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Comrade or friend, it doesn't matter. Get in my way, and I'll obliterate you.
Is that... Master Grima?! Master Grima i-is here? ...Oh, no. They look alike, but that is a different person.

People should be used and discarded as soon as they're no longer useful.
A proper tactician should know how to make use of assets—even if those assets are called friends.
My faith cannot be shaken. No matter what happens, I will follow Master Grima to the very end.
Those allied with Naga are here, so I must be careful. For now, I will just observe...
Visit: Master Grima was in need of aid, so [F] is occupied.
Level: Any who get in Master Grima's way will be destroyed.
Master Grima deserves better.
An error like this, from me of all people... Unbelievable.
Summon:
My name is of no concern. Everything is for Master Grima.
If you must call for me, you may address me as Morgan.
Learn Skill: You're sure? When you give someone like me something like this, you never can know what might happen.
Confession:
Let me extend a word of warning to you, [S]...
I have agreed to help you now that you've summoned me, but...
If I decide that you are working counter Master Grima's interest, I will kill you without hesitation.
You think I would overlook a power capable of extending influence over other worlds? You are a threat.
This is your only reminder. Try not to do anything that forces me to end your life.
Status: About my mother... No. I must not speak out of turn.
Aah! A sneak attack? You dare?
Naga... That damned dragon has no right meddling with my heart.
My will, my choices. No matter what you do to me, I shall act as I believe.
Master Grima... I remain your servant.
Up until now, my faith was unshakable. I was ready to kill my own friends...
You remind me of the kind and gentle mother I once knew...

fmorgan2.name: Morgan
fmorgan2.title: Devoted Darkness
fmorgan2.description: A mysterious young woman from a future that knows only despair. She has sworn allegiance to the Fell Dragon, Grima. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Believe and entrust everything... Your hopes, your ambitions... Surrender them to the inevitable.
This false connection does not make us close. A true bond connects souls across worlds, age, and death.
I don't recall accepting your friendship. I am only helping you to polish my skill.
There's something that sets you apart from the other Heroes, isn't there, [S]?
Naga's followers have spread even here...
Visit: Do not concern yourself with [F]...
Level: The obvious result.
Not bad. But I'm not satisfied.
I must live up to Master Grima's expectations of me...
Summon: My name? Does it matter? Master Grima will decide all our fates. But if you insist, you may call me Morgan.
Learn Skill: With this power, I will pile the corpses high...all in the name of Master Grima.
Confession:
Let me be blunt with you, [S]...
I cannot betray the foundations of my soul for you.
I help you because of our contract, and I will continue to.
But if you ever move to destroy my foundation, I will never forgive you for it.
And not only will you be my foe, but every other Hero will be as well. I will fight you all if I have to.
Let's hope it doesn't come to that.
Special: You shall fall by my hand!
Status: About my father... No. I must not speak out of turn.
Aah! Y-you tried to strike me down just now!
I know where my allegiance lies.
My will, my choices. No matter what you do to me, I shall act as I believe.
Master Grima, I'll never betray you. I'll stay by your side no matter what form you take.
Up until now, my faith was unshakable. I was ready to kill my own friends...
You remind me of the kind and gentle father I once knew...

orson.name: Orson
orson.title: Passion's Folly
orson.description: A former knight of Renais who defected to side with the Grado Empire in a desperate attempt to resurrect his late wife. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I betrayed all I knew for the woman I love—my country, my lord... Everything.
Sacrifice my life for king and country? No. My life belongs to the wife I love.
My...departed wife weeps for me? I'm sorry. You must be confused. Monica is still among the living...
If anyone could understand, Princess Eirika might. I would forsake all else for my beloved...
There is nothing wrong... In fact, I have never been happier.
Visit: Monica? Are you here? Have I been deceived by [F]?
Level: Monica... I'll return soon. I will kill those who wish to get in our way...
Hah hah hah... I hope you were watching, Monica...
Gah! How can I face Monica like this?
Summon: My name is Orson. Please, I am looking for my wife. Her name is Monica... Is she here? Please...
Learn Skill: I will use this power to defend Monica's life for all of eternity...
Confession:
Monica... Where are you? I want to see you again...to gaze upon your face.
My precious Monica, where is she? Tell me, [S]...
Unless... Someone is trying to keep Monica and me apart...
But our bond cannot be broken. Not by god or demon...
Until I can see Monica again, I will do as you ask... How many must I kill to see her, [S]?
Monica, please... Wait for me. I will see your gentle smile again soon...
Status: I am Orson. Monica and I...will live happily.
I am busy... I must return to my wife's side.
What is it, Monica? You seem so happy today.
I'd never forget your birthday! I have a present for you, dear. I think you'll like it.
...Get out. This is Monica and my place. I will not have our home disturbed by anyone.
My fondest wish will be granted... To spend the rest of my days in the embrace of my loving wife once more...
...I will help you. But first, assure me that you will not get in my way.

catria4.name: Catria
catria4.title: Azure Wing Pair
catria4.description: The middle children from two trios of pegasus sisters. Their shared bonds transcend worlds. They appear in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia / Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.
catria4.origin: Shadows of Valentia + The Binding Blade
catria4.harmonized:
Grants the following effects to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn: 【Resonance: Blades】,【Desperation】, and "if unit initiates combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack."
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Desperation】 Grants the following effect for 1 turn: "If unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack."

Castle Hall: **Catria**: I'm often mistaken for Thea while I'm out on patrol... Is it the hair? It must be the hair, right?
**Thea**: Younger siblings are to be spoiled and scolded as need demands. Catria and I are of one mind there.
**Catria**: The middle sister must be a bridge between younger and older. Few can truly understand... But Thea does.
**Thea**: I would happily take armor and lance over a frilly dress any day... But some variety can't hurt, I suppose.
**Catria**: I hadn't imagined other worlds would have trios who had mastered the art of the Triangle Attack as well...
Visit: Greetings. I'm Catria, and this is Thea. We've come as envoys on the behalf of [F].
Level: **Catria**: All right, Thea! If we keep this up, we're sure to reach new heights!
**Thea**: With Catria at my back, I can devote all my focus to what's in front of me.
**Thea**: Oof. Let's try not to overdo it. If we accomplish our mission, we'll have performed well enough...
Summon: I'm Catria, of Macedon's Whitewings, and this is Thea, of the Ilian pegasus knights. Azure Wings, at your service.
Learn Skill: **Catria**: Thank you. Thea and I will be sure to put this to good use.
Confession:
**Catria**: I used to think there was no one I'd rather share the sky with than Palla, Est, or even Princess Minerva...
**Thea**: I know what you mean. When I flew alongside Juno or Shanna, my heart always pounded with excitement.
**Catria**: Exactly! Which is why it's so strange that when I'm flying with you, I feel so serene... Just perfectly in sync.
**Thea**: I feel the same... It's like the joy of... just being yourself. No performing for others, just existing as you are.
I think we're alike in more ways than we may have thought. Perhaps right down to the very core of our being.
**Catria**: You may be right. In any case, I am glad we met...and glad we can take wing in Askr's azure skies together.
Status: ふふ…
"How do I look?" "Like a true bride!"
Conversation: **Thea**: A bridal festival... I wonder when my big day is destined to arrive.
**Catria**: It'll come. You're so sweet, and you'll make a fine match sooner than later.
**Thea**: That's very kind of you to say. But surely the same is true of you! You look beautiful in that dress...
**Catria**: I appreciate the compliment, but... I don't see myself wearing something like this for real.
**Thea**: Oh... Are you sure about that?
**Catria**: Mm... Would you say it is proper to agree to marry when, deep in your heart, you love another?
**Thea**: Another? So you have a secret love...
**Catria**: I can't ignore my heart... So I must content myself to serve at his side.
**Thea**: I understand how you feel, but... can you really settle for that and truly be happy?

There is someone out there who would be lucky to have you. And seeing you in that dress...
I cannot help but say that you deserve to be loved!
**Catria**: Oh, Thea... Let's not get ahead of ourselves! And what about you? You're also dressed as a bride...
**Thea**: I'm not really sure... I can tell you that my older sister's wedding was eye-opening.
I don't mean that it was fancy... because it wasn't. It's just...I've never seen her so happy.

Seeing two people...standing so close, so close that they seem almost to become one... It has an effect.
You want that for yourself.
**Catria**: Your day will come. And when it does, I'll be there to celebrate!
**Thea**: And when your wedding comes, I'll expect an invitation!
**Catria**: Hee hee! All right, then. I suppose we both have something to look forward to!

juno.name: Juno
juno.title: Soaring Bride
juno.description: A retired pegasus knight and older sister of Thea and Shanna. Joining the bridal festival alongside her husband, Zelot. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Our parents died when Shanna and Thea were still young. To them, I'm more of a mother than an older sister.
I have a trusted friend looking after my daughter. She's safe there while Zelot and I win peace for Askr.
Shanna teases me that Zelot and I are going to fall in love all over again at this festival. Oh, how right she is!
I wonder if this outfit might be too grand. Then again, the occasion most certainly warrants it!
If I want my sisters to be able to start families of their own, we must first secure a lasting peace.
Visit: Are you here for the bridal festival? My name is Juno. I hail from [F]'s castle.
Level: May the happiness of brides past, present, and future last forevermore.
I'm surprised this beautiful dress is still clean after that! Well then, shall we head to the festival proper?
Has my edge dulled so quickly?
Summon:
I'm Juno, former member of the Pegasus Knights of Ilia.
It's been quite a while since my own wedding, but I'll be happy to help with the festival in any way I can.
Learn Skill: You are so very thoughtful. I will remember this day for a long time to come.
Confession:
Seeing an Askran wedding brings back so many memories of Zelot's and my own ceremony...
My sisters worked so hard to make everything special and beautiful.
And just wearing this outfit makes my heart overflow with giddy nostalgia. What a day that was!
It's no wonder everyone's so eager to be a part of this festival. Weddings are about joy and laughter and hope.
It's more than just the union of a pair of lovebirds or their families. It's about new beginnings!
It's so wonderful! But how about you? Is there a special someone in your life, [S]?
Status: I am Juno. Zelot is my husband. I want to thank you for inviting us to this lovely festival.
Ah! Oh, it's you. Is Zelot looking for me?
Once again, I am dressed as a bride, and it makes me just as happy as it did the first time.
I wonder if my younger sisters will ever marry. Oh, I do hope so.
Oh, this dress… I'm eager to see Zelot's reaction.
I hope that the day comes when we three can live together peacefully.
I am so happy that you were able to share this joyous day with us.

shanna2.name: Shanna
shanna2.title: Bridal Novice
shanna2.description: A pegasus-knight trainee from Ilia. Cheerfully participating in the bridal festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I grew up in Ilia, which is frigid and dreary, so I've never seen anyone dressed in an outfit this pretty!
Both of my sisters, Thea and Juno, are dressed up just like me today! A bridal festival we'll never forget!
When I get married, I'm going to fly down the aisle on my pegasus! ...Hm? Is that a bad idea?
I know this is just a festival and I'm not actually getting married, but still... Tell that to my racing heart!
So, what do you think? Not bad for a festival costume, huh? I wonder what Lord Roy and Dieck will say... Haha!
Visit: Hi, I'm Shanna. Nice to meet you! As you can see, I came from the bridal festival at [F]'s!
Level: Nothing like wearing wedding attire to make a person feel powerful! Armor doesn't even compare!
Does this dress make me seem more ladylike? Well, I guess it's true what they say: looks can be deceiving!
This dress sure is a pain to move in... I keep worrying about ripping it!
Summon: I'm Shanna, an Ilian pegasus knight in training. I'm excited to see what this bridal festival is all about!
Learn Skill: For me? Oh, I do, I do! ...Just kidding! You should have seen your face.
Confession:
Whew! The bridal festival sure is something, huh? I'm glad everyone has enjoyed themselves!
It seems like the festivities are for my older sisters more than for me, frilly white clothes included.
I mean, Juno is already married, and it's only a matter of time before Thea follows. My marriage is pretty far off...
But that just means I have even more time to become the greatest pegasus knight in the whole world!
This festival was a nice preview of what I can expect, but that doesn't mean I'll lose sight of my goal.
From lancework to pegasus care, I'm going to get better and better— just watch, [S]!
Status: Whaddaya think of the dress? Good? Too good?!
Wha! Ugh, wow. Moment...ruined.
I'm gonna hang out with my sisters today!
I'd marry someone who "gets" me...lotsa gifts! Hee hee!
There'll be a feast at the festival, right?! Can't wait!
One day Thea might get married too, and... And then I'll be...all alone...
Got your vows ready? Ha-ha. I'm kidding! This dress is just for show.

saul2.name: Saul
saul2.title: Minister of Love
saul2.description: A holy priest of St. Elimine. Enjoys spending his time among women. Joining the bridal festival as an observer. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: There is no sight more brilliant than a beaming bride on her wedding day. If only I had one of my own...
Those who blindly follow scripture and ignore their hearts are puppets. The true gift from above is free will.
A wedding is a turning point in the life of a couple. A joyous event, after which they will be joined as one.
Ah, hello! If I might inquire... Do you have a sister I might introduce myself to, [S]?
The Heroes truly are a dizzying array of beauties. It's enough to convince one that good looks are required!
Visit: Should you need anyone to observe a wedding, you may call on me, Saul, at [F]'s castle.
Level: O blessed Saint Elimine, watch over me as I train to spread word of your glory to all the women of this world!

Come, one and all! Pledge yourself to Saint Elimine and all of your problems will instantly be solved!
...That's a little joke.
Ugh. If this keeps up, the scolding I'll get from Bishop Yoder will be even harsher than usual.
Summon: I am Saul, priest in service of Saint Elimine, here to witness the festivities and perform services as necessary.
Learn Skill: Praises be! I will use this blessing to protect your flock. The women will be given priority, of course...
Confession:
Every time I witness two lovers being joined in matrimony, I am struck by how blessed I am to be a priest.
Under ordinary circumstances, my primary focus is helping women to the altar, but...another time, perhaps.
I wish those who make pledges to love one another only the utmost happiness—as does Saint Elimine.
Seeing happy couples off on their honeymoons over and again can make one feel a bit...lonely.
Would it be too much trouble for Saint Elimine, blessed be her name, to find me a beautiful wife of faith?
Ah, but for now, let us celebrate the love here before us! Shall we join in, [S]? Praises be!
Status: A blessing to you.
Congratulations!
Ah, a couple in love, bound together by a holy vow. It is a magnificent thing.
Me? My love is for the people. Chiefly the women, I'll admit.
Beautiful women, dressed in their finest, as far as the eye can see... Is this heaven itself?
I must take this opportunity to spread the word of St. Elimine. To not do so would be a waste.
I would be happy to preside over your wedding as well. I will devote myself to the task wholeheartedly.

zelot.name: Zelot
zelot.title: Avowed Groom
zelot.description: Captain of the Ilian mercenaries, who rely on battle to earn their living. He is attending the bridal festival alongside his wife, Juno. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: They say a bride is most radiant on her wedding day, yet none more so than my dear Juno. I am a lucky man!

The harsh realities of mercenary life have torn many Ilian clans apart.
In the end, as long as Ilia herself benefits, she will always endure.
I hope Thea and Shanna find partners worthy of them. I suppose after that, it won't be long until they're wed.
I would like nothing more than a day with my Juno—not as a fellow soldier, but as a loving husband.

Juno and I first met on an Etrurian battlefield. She had been hired by our enemy.
Rather than fight, I tried to reason with her. Things just...grew from there.
Visit: I'm Zelot, mercenary captain of Ilia's knights. Please accept this gift from [F].
Level: I swear that I will protect you no matter the cost, down to the very last fiber of my being.
The truth is that I only do this to make others happy. Yet who am I to argue with self-improvement?
Ilia's knights make their living as hired muscle. Our reputation is everything. It does us no good to get sloppy.
Summon: I am Zelot, mercenary captain of Ilia's knights, and husband to my beloved Juno. How may I be of service?
Learn Skill: As long as this power is mine, no harm shall come to those whom I love. I swear it as a knight of Ilia.
Confession:
I cannot thank you enough for inviting me to such a wonderful festival, [S].
Ordinarily, us soldiers spend all our time finding a way to survive long enough to see another sunrise.
Such a life can be difficult for those in love. I'm sure my dear Juno often worries about me. And I about her.
But seeing her smile, radiant in her wedding dress... That is a gift I can never hope to repay.
That sight alone is more than enough to convince me that everything we've gone through has been worth it.
I will do whatever it takes to see that smile again. Rest assured that as long as I'm here, I will protect us all.
Status: I am unused to this attire. Does it...suit me?
Woah! I'm uneasy enough without you doing your best to unman me.
We had a small ceremony... Nothing so grand as all this.
Forgive me. Seeing Juno looking so radiant...it gladdens my heart.
It's my day to be teased by Shanna and the rest. Ah, well.
As long as I live, you will be safe. This I swear.
I'm a little nervous, but I take courage knowing you are by my side.

ashera.name: Ashera
ashera.title: Order Goddess
ashera.description: The once-slumbering goddess of order, half of the goddess Ashunera. She desires to create a world of structure and peace. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Ashunera, the Dawn Goddess. That is the name given to me by the people. I would like to be called that again.
Lehran is gentle-hearted and wise... Taking that to heart, I choose to place my faith in mortal beings once more.
Beings growing without guidance will only bring chaos and turmoil to the world. Thus I must pass judgment.
The children of flesh will never learn. Time may pass as it always does, but nothing alters the nature of mortals.
The children of this world are born of chaos. I will suffer no such thing in my world.
Visit: I hope you, too, seek order, as [F] does.
Level: I am perfect. I am free of emotion, so I have no doubts. And therefore I commit no errors.
You will know my judgment. You will pay for your sins.
You expect me to reverse my judgment? The goddess of order cannot be so...mercurial.
Summon: Child of another world, I am Ashera... If you seek order and balance, I vow to apply my judgment fairly.
Learn Skill: I do not reject the gifts of mortals. This, too, is the duty of a goddess.
Confession:
What are you thinking, child of another world?
Facing endless battle, strife, and disorder... And what kind of world awaits you at the end of it all?
Order cannot be born from disparity between the children of the world...
Prosperity for some and oppression for others... It is unacceptable.
Build a world of peace, order, and equality. That is the world that named me Ashunera, the Dawn Goddess.
If you choose a different direction, you know my judgment. All will pay for their sins, everyone, to the last.
Status: I am...restraint. Order. Stability. History. Resolution. I am Ashera.
All this pointless flailing...I need no further evidence of your kind's imperfections.
It is inevitable. The start, as it should start. The end, as it should end.
Yune has faith in people. She is an imperfection in my being.
Yune and I were once a single being...
Ashunera, the Dawn Goddess...The name your ancestors gave me so long ago.
Tell me. Do you believe that people can change?

nott.name: Nótt
nott.title: Moon's Elegance
nott.description: The crown princess of Jötunheimr and twin sister of Dagr. Appreciates the finer things in life, prizing beauty and elegance.

Castle Hall: When Dagr was young, she broke many a training dummy... I hear she may not be alone in that here, hm?
Mother is a great queen. But when she gets angry, it can be frightening... like she will tear the land itself apart.
There is no harm in being friendly with Dagr...so long as you are careful not to adopt her crude mannerisms.
Oh, but you do look fatigued... Would you care to eat something? I do know something of proper nutrition.
When I visit other lands, my size often calls attention to me. Here, however, it is hardly the most unusual sight.
Visit: I am here to offer a greeting by the grace of [F]...
Level: I strive toward perfection. Continued improvement is expected of me.
Not awful, I suppose...though I ought to remain positive.
Urgh... What an embarrassment...
Summon: I am Nótt, Jötunheimr's next queen. I hope we can forge friendly relations between our two grand realms.
Learn Skill: That's one step closer to becoming queen... You have my gratitude.
Confession:
Dagr and I have not always quarreled as we do now. We were once quite close, in fact...
But we were born princesses of Jötunheimr, so we could not remain on friendly terms forever.
One of us must one day be queen. That means we must make certain sacrifices...for the realm.
When we were children, I never lost to Dagr, but she's grown into an entirely different jötun...
Now, if I do not take her seriously, she can easily outmatch me during a fight...
I believe I have you to thank you for that, [S]...
As her older sister, thank you.
However! I will NOT lose to her, so I must learn all I can while I am here in this realm! Now, what's next...
Status: I am the firstborn princess of Jötunheimr, Nótt. I do hope we can get along.
Oh! A touch is a fair greeting.
I will be the one to succeed my honored mother, as Jötunheimr's next queen.
Dagr is so unrefined...it's perfectly indecent! How can she be my sister?
Excuse me...Summoner? I hear that a tight embrace is a symbol of great affection with your people. Is that true?
The Order has brought together so many beauteous Heroes... My eyes may become exhausted by their radiance!
My body and mind are already yours... I pledge myself to your cause.

palla4.name: Palla
palla4.title: Kind Eldest Sister
palla4.description: Pegasus knight from Macedon who ventured to Valentia in pursuit of her sister. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I know they aren't the same Princess Minerva and Prince Michalis, yet I'm still nervous around them...
I went all the way from Macedon to Valentia, looking for Est... Looking back, it was quite the journey.
Please don't hesitate to bring me your troubles. I am the eldest of us three, after all. I'm a good listener!
I'm about to make my rounds of the castle. Why don't you come along? We can keep each other company.
Est! Hey, Est! That's not my Est, you say, but an Est from another world? Just how many are there?
Visit: I was sent by a friend of yours to check up on how you're faring. Oh, it was [F]!
Level: I still have a way to go, but this is clear progress, and for that I am thankful.
Let's look on the bright side... I have more room for growth!
This just won't do. You have my apologies.
Summon: I am Palla. I belong to the Macedonian Whitewings, but I traveled to Valentia for, let's say, personal reasons.
Learn Skill: As the eldest Whitewing I will do my utmost to ensure that I live up to your expectations.
Confession:
Perfect timing! I've been wanting to have a little chat with you for some time.
It's just that... Well, this place is so different from my world, and I'm having a little trouble taking it all in.
It's hard not to feel overwhelmed, but at the same time, I know I have to set a good example for my sisters.
"Just take it a day at a time," hmm? That's very kind of you to say, [S].
Somehow I feel more myself when I'm with you. I hope I'll continue to have your ear in the future.
Status: I'm Palla. I've come from Archanea in search of my sister.
What? Please...pester someone else.
My youngest sister, Est, was kidnapped by pirates. I hope she's safe.
The people of Valentia were unfailingly kind to us.
I keep running into different versions of my sisters here in Askr! I can hardly believe my eyes.
Oh, Abel... No, I mustn't. These feelings are for me and for me alone.
You're a mysterious one, aren't you? When I'm at your side, I somehow feel that everything will turn out all right.

luthier.name: Luthier
luthier.title: Odd Wayfarer
luthier.description: A mage and eccentric man of Zofia who excels in magic but has no friends. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Delthea has a vast store of untapped potential but flatly refuses to invest in her studies... I'm at my wits' end.
I studied magic in a secluded forest village. I may not be very worldly, but I'll manage... Somehow.
Feel free to consult me whenever something is on your mind. That's what friends are for. Isn't it?
I have devised a new spell. Would you mind observing as I test it? I value your opinion.
Have you seen Delthea? That girl is always up to something. I'll need to set her to rights...again.
Visit: Because we're all friends now, I come bearing a friendly greeting from [F].
Level: Hmm... Something's changed! Ah, I've thought up a new spell. Splendid!
I'll never rise above average at this rate...
Abysmal! Truly abysmal...
Summon: I'm Luthier, a mage from Zofia. Are you the one who summoned me? If so, I'd love to study your technique...
Learn Skill: You're entrusting me with this? Thank you. I will consider closely how best to use it.
Confession:
Oh, you've spotted me, have you? What am I doing? Well, I'm observing my fellow mages in the castle.
Any good student requires a master, and Askr is simply bursting at the seams with powerful mages!
It's... Er, well, it's a little difficult to find the right opportunity to approach a potential tutor, however...
What am I waiting for, you ask? It's not that easy...
You probably find approaching a stranger natural... I'd bet you have two, or perhaps even THREE friends!
Wait a moment...you can ask on my behalf! My plight has moved you, and now you can rush to my aid. Go on!
Status: I am Luthier, a student of magic. Pleased to meet you. (Yes, that sounds right...)
Whoa! Given the responsibility you wield, shouldn't you act a little more mature?
You must understand—there's a reason I joined up with the Deliverance. I owe Alm more than I can say.
My younger sister Delthea is a real handful. If you value your sanity, you'd best steer clear.
I must thank you for summoning me. I never would have imagined in I'd have the opportunity to study magic in another realm...
The world is larger than any of us could possibly comprehend... I must never stop learning.
You're more than just the summoner to me...you're my friend. Um... We ARE friends, right?

tatiana.name: Tatiana
tatiana.title: Devoted Saint
tatiana.description: Cleric of the Rigelian Empire who tends toward thoughtlessness, but she's also very generous and loves Zeke deeply. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: There are so many talented clerics here. I do hope they will allow me to ask them questions from time to time.
I was the one who found Zeke washed ashore, near death. Looking back, it was almost like a fairy tale.
Don't let the little things get you down. I can be clumsy, but I always bounce back, and you can too!
I'm on my way to have tea with Zeke. Would you care to join us? I baked a cake for dessert!
*sigh* I made sweets, but they don't taste quite right. I think I forgot to add the sugar again...
Visit:
I baked this bread for you on behalf of [F].
Just be careful not to break a tooth on it...
Level: I have truly amazing news: I baked the perfect loaf of bread! It's soft and everything!
I managed to avoid tripping, stubbing a toe, or breaking anything, so I'll call that a success!
Waaaah! Ouch... I think the ground might be a bit uneven over here...
Summon: Hello! I'm Tatiana. I can be somewhat clumsy, but I'll do my best not to be a burden!
Learn Skill: Your confidence in me has always been a source of my strength. Thank you for that.
Confession:
Do you have time to chat, [S]? I made tea for everyone, but...well...
I forgot to steep the leaves and ended up serving nothing but hot water. I'm so embarrassed...
Everyone laughed it off, but... I'm always making mistakes. It's one accident after another with me.
I try to focus, but... Huh? You like me the way I am? That sounds like something Zeke would say.
He says it makes life interesting. Well, if you feel the same way... Then here's to more happy accidents!
Status: My name is Tatiana. I am a cleric, and I serve at an orphanage. Pleasure to meet you.
Eep! Zeke, we really mustn't... Wait, you're not Zeke! Oh, how mortifying!
Zeke had lost nearly all of his memory when I found him washed up on shore.
The brave warriors of the Deliverance rescued me from Nuibaba, the wicked woman who'd kidnapped me.
I'm so sorry... I meant to clean this vase, but I broke it in the process. Curse my clumsy hands...
Zeke... Promise you'll stay with me, no matter what memories of your past resurface...
Would you like some bread? It's fresh out of the oven! I haven't perfected the recipe yet, but I'll get there.

zeke.name: Zeke
zeke.title: Past Unknown
zeke.description: General of the Rigelian Empire. Tatiana found him unconscious, his memory lost. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall:
Why are there other men here who so strongly resemble me?
I'll admit I feel a connection to them, though. Even the one with the mask...
Emperor Rudolf is like a father to me. I'd have remained at his side had his orders not led me to the Deliverance.
I know well the unease that comes with finding oneself in a foreign land. Do not let it trouble you much.
Tatiana and I are meeting for tea, if you would like to join. She said she would be baking a cake as well.
Have you seen Tatiana, by chance? We were to meet here, but I fear she has gotten lost in the castle halls...
Visit: I've come with fond greetings from [F]. Might you be [S]?
Level: My daily training continues to bear fruit.
I could do better, yes... But I daresay not many could, so I believe this is satisfactory.
Forgive me... I'm just not myself today.
Summon: I have yet to regain my memories, including my real name... But for now, you may call me Zeke.
Learn Skill: You would grant me this power? I am honored.
Confession:
I have not failed to notice or appreciate the attention you have paid me since I was summoned here.
You remind me of the emperor in his prime. Despite his position, he took in a stranger like me.
Rudolf has taken my true father's place in the void that is my memory. I intend to repay everything in kind.
But many twists of fate have taken me far from his side—once to the Deliverance, and now to Askr.
My fate is out of my control. But I can promise that I will serve you as honorably as I served him.
Special: Do not think badly of me.
Status: My name is Zeke. It is true that I'm a warrior of Rigel, but I have my reasons for fighting for the Deliverance now.
Hm? Oh, it's you. Ha... The way you tug on my sleeve reminds me of Tatiana.
I still have no recollection of who I am or from whence I came.
Simply being with Tatiana puts my mind at ease. She may be a bit clumsy, but she always does her best.
Emperor Rudolf accepted as a father does his own son. I could never betray that trust.
Her face is dim, but it is there, etched in the recesses of memory. The face of my... My...
In this world, you are my lord, and thus I swear my fealty as a knight to you.

fernand.name: Fernand
fernand.title: Traitorous Knight
fernand.description: A noble of Zofia and part of the Deliverance until leaving to serve under Berkut. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: To think I was brought here by a plebeian masquerading as a summoner. A cruel joke indeed.
I once belonged to the Deliverance... but I eventually had to take my leave. I serve Lord Berkut of Rigel now.
If you insist on ordering me around, you should at least look the part. I'd start with a change of clothes.
Take care not to send me into battle with any rabble from the Deliverance. It would not end well, I assure you.
Can't you see that I'm busy? There's too much to learn about this world to spend my time entertaining you.
Visit: It's rude to keep a noble waiting, you know. Allow me to deliver this from [F] and be done.
Level: Proper form, perfect precision... Though who would expect anything less from true nobility?
This will have to do.
Damn it all...
Summon: I am Fernand, and my fealty is earned, not given. You have a lot of work ahead of you, "Summoner."
Learn Skill: A wise choice. You will not regret it.
Confession:
Long ago, I formed the Deliverance with two like-minded souls, Clive and Mathilda, to save our homeland.
Those were the days. We fought as one heart and mind for Zofia, inching ever closer to our shared goal.
But along the way, something changed. I blamed Clive at first, but perhaps the fault is my own.
I can't say I enjoy being under your command, but it is a distraction, and for that I am grateful.
Someday I shall quell the doubts in my mind... For now, however, you have my lance.
Status: I am Fernand, a son of Zofia—but my ties there are in the past.
Mind yourself, plebian. This is no time for levity.
Imagine me taking orders from some wretched farmchild... Hah! Not likely.
Lord Berkut shares my perspective. That alone earns him my trust.
Seeing children about the castle grounds, I'm reminded of my— Ah, it is better to forget.
Why, Clive... Why wouldn't you listen?
You may be a complete stranger, but...you have my trust. For now.

hilda3.name: Hilda
hilda3.title: Deer's Two-Piece
hilda3.description: The cosmopolitan Hilda joined by the provincial Marianne, but it seems even with their polar- opposite personalities, the two get along well... They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
hilda3.duo:
Inflicts Atk-7 on foes within 3 columns or 3 rows centered on unit through their next actions and inflicts【Isolation】on them.
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Isolation】 Target cannot use or be the target of Assist skills through its next action. (Target can neither use nor be the target of skills like Dance and Sing, skills that neutralize penalties, like Restore and Harsh Command+, etc.)

Castle Hall: **Marianne**: The sea breeze and these endless blue skies truly are a blessing from the goddess... I'm just so grateful.
**Marianne**: I'm useless, and I'm always getting in Hilda's way... I wish I could show her how much I appreciate her.
**Marianne**: This is Askr's sea? I wonder if I'll be able to talk to the sea creatures...
**Hilda**: Marianne, you're so cute, but you hide your face when you're talking to anyone... Why?
**Hilda**: I hate the chore of battle, but if I can let my hair down and have a little fun after a job, well...that's different!
Visit: **Marianne**: Please excuse my dress... I've just come from the beach with summery tidings from [F].
Level: **Hilda**: Nice! Just like that, Marianne! Keep it up!
**Marianne**: I'm embarrassed, but...if you're here, I'm sure it will be all right...probably.
**Marianne**: I knew it... I'm just getting in your way, Hilda. I'm so sorry.
Summon: I'm in the mood for a swim today! What do you say, Marianne? You can show off your cute swimsuit!
Learn Skill: **Hilda**: At times like this, just smile and say thank you, all right, Marianne?
Confession:
**Hilda**: Phew! That was a lot of work—even if it WAS fun... Let's not fight all the time, all right, Marianne?
We should take time to relax too!
**Marianne**: Yes... It is not often we have such an opportunity. It's nice to enjoy our time when we can.
**Hilda**: Now that you've been to the beach, why don't we invite all the Golden Deer to come with us next time?
**Marianne**: W-well, I...I might still be a bit too bashful for that...
**Hilda**: It'll be fine! You have all summer long to work up to it—and besides that, [S] will be there!
**Marianne**: ...Thank you for taking my feelings into account, Hilda. I'll do my best to be more...heroic this summer.
Status: You've got this!
"How immodest..." "You're fine! Don't give it a second thought."
Conversation: **Marianne**: Oh... It's so hot out...
**Hilda**: No kidding! But it's all right. Just think cool thoughts.
**Marianne**: What strong sunlight… It's intense.
**Hilda**: Well it's not exactly easy for me, either. But here we are.
**Marianne**: Y-you're right. I suppose we should try to enjoy ourselves.
**Hilda**: Hm, you seem gloomier than usual. Oh, I know! It's because there aren't any animals around!
**Marianne**: Ahh... You might be right. But I do love fish.
**Hilda**: Me too! They're delicious.

**Marianne**: Oh, no, I...I meant that I love looking at them. Such a beautiful array of colors.
And they have such a majestic way of gliding through the water.
**Hilda**: Oh, that's what you meant! Um, sure. There are certainly lots of fish here that I've never seen before.
**Marianne**: Right? There's such a splendid variety of creatures flitting past the coral...
**Marianne**: It's like paradise. I can only thank the goddess for sending me to such a wonderful place...
**Hilda**: No complaints about the ocean! But swimming sounds like a lot of work.
**Marianne**: Well then, why don't we relax on the beach? I brought a book I've been meaning to read.
**Hilda**: All right. You've twisted my arm.
**Marianne**: *giggles* This is nice. The two of us, relaxing by the sea...
**Hilda**: Yeah! Kicking back like nobody's business!

mercedes2.name: Mercedes
mercedes2.title: Unfussed Basker
mercedes2.description: A gentle cleric who attends Garreg Mach. She decided to challenge herself by vacationing in a place where everyone dons their swimsuit. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: The beach really is the best place to spend a holiday, isn't it? I'd like to invite Annie to join us next time.
Your sunburn hurts? Hmm, maybe I can heal you with my staff... Let's give it a try, shall we?
Do you like my swimsuit? I chose it for the fine stitching details in the ruffles. It's quite cute too.
I thought a sweeter tea would pair well with the beach atmosphere, so I prepared some for us to enjoy.
Thank you for inviting me. I'm glad I decided to come along and enjoy the beach with you.
Visit:
I'm on vacation at the beach with [F].
Would you care to join us?
Level: Wonderful! Well, should we get back to enjoying the sunshine?
Swimming at the beach is a bit like training, I suppose.
The sunlight is a little too strong... Could we rest in the shade for a bit?
Summon: My name is Mercedes. I'm not usually one for exercise, but if you'd like to go swimming, I'd accompany you.
Learn Skill: For me? Hehe, it seems this is going to be a wonderful summer.
Confession:
Do you see the sunset on the horizon? It's so lovely against the sea.
Just looking out at it lifts my spirits. I must show gratitude to the goddess for that. However...
I'm not completely free of worry. I would love to enjoy the beach in a battle-free Askr one day.
I will do everything I can to make that peace a reality. Being here makes me even more determined to do so.
I hope that the next time the two of us are here, watching the sunset over the water, we'll feel truly at peace.
Let's continue to work hard while we pray for that day to come, [S].
Status: Thank you so much for including me on this trip to the beach. I'm just so happy to be here!
Oh? *giggle* You're a sneaky one, aren't you?
I'm not usually one for exercise, but swimming sure is fun!
Oh my, it's really warming up. Should we find a nice, shady spot to relax?
Everyone else ran off to participate in a swimming competition. Ah, to be so young. *giggle*
I must remember to thank the goddess for this wonderful vacation in my nightly prayers.
I spotted some beautiful fish in the nearby shoal. Would you like to take a look with me?

ashe2.name: Ashe
ashe2.title: Fabled Sea Knight
ashe2.description: A commoner who was adopted by Lord Lonato. He is so focused on his goals, he won't take any breaks from his training, even while at the beach. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: What a lovely beach... I wish my brother and sister could be here with me. And Lonato, too.
I never imagined I'd be able to afford a beach trip like this, but here I am, having fun with everyone!
Do you think ghosts come out at the beach at night? O-on second thought, maybe we shouldn't talk about that...
I was helping out at a food stall that was set up on the beach! I figured they could use my cooking skills.
Even if you're wearing a swimsuit, you can't slack on training. I won't become a great knight if I take breaks!
Visit: My name is Ashe. I've come to deliver summer greetings from [F]'s castle!
Level: My body feels lighter than usual! Do you think it's because this swimsuit is easy to move in?
I need to work harder. I'm not gonna lose to the summer sun!
Have I been having too much fun? I need to pull myself together!
Summon: I'm Ashe Ubert. I'm studying to become a knight. And today's training is... Huh? Swimming in the sea?!
Learn Skill: I think I'm almost done...maybe? I'll keep working hard!
Confession:
When I was little, I read a chivalric tale about a knight who crossed the sea to save many countries.
Thinking about what adventures lie in wait across the sea made me want to become a knight one day too.
I wonder what kind of country lies beyond the sea of Askr, [S].
Though I hope for peace, if there are people in trouble across the sea, I want to go fight for them.
But first, we should help the people right where we are, right? We need to bring peace to the Kingdom of Askr.
For now, it's just a dream... But one day, I want to save people across the sea, just like the knight in that story!
Status: I was so excited to hit the beach today that I hardly slept at all last night!
Some kind of...frozen sweet? Don't mind if I do!
I once got lost in a book about tropical travel. Now I feel like I'm living it!
I like seeing my friends cut loose at the beach. As long as they don't go overboard...
Look at how many fish I caught. Quite the haul, if I do say so myself!
I wish I could share this sunrise with my brother and sister...
I'll never forget the time we spent together this summer. It was wonderful. Thank you.

caspar2.name: Caspar
caspar2.title: Summer Intensity
caspar2.description: Second son of House Bergliez of the Adrestian Empire. Even at the beach, his mind is solely focused on his training and getting stronger. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I won't let anyone disturb the peace at the beach! If I see anyone up to no good, I'll knock their lights out!
My brother's gonna inherit House Bergliez, but me? I'm gonna make a living with my own two hands.
I heard it's gonna rain later, but... There won't be thunder, right? N-not like I'm scared or anything!
This heat is perfect for training! I'm gonna work up a good sweat! Hey, [S], wanna join?
Did I swim too far out? No, I can keep going! I'll swim until I hit my limit!
Visit: I'm Caspar, of the Black Eagles! I just swam over from [F]'s place!
Level: My summer is never coming to an end! I'm gonna keep training and getting even stronger!
Anyone who gets in my way is gonna be sorry! I'll hit 'em so hard they'll forget how to swim!
Damn... Could the heat be getting to me?
Summon: I'm Caspar von Bergliez. Training at the beach today, huh? Sounds fun! I'm gonna train to the max! Hiyaaah!
Learn Skill: Man, the beach really is awesome! I never thought I'd see these kinds of results from my training!
Confession:
Huh? Oh, it's you... What was I just doing?
That's right... I was seeing how far I could swim, and I went out into the open sea!
What? You found me floating in the water, unconscious?! ...I guess I must have pushed myself a little too hard.
But... When you look out at the open sea, don't you just think... Is there an end? How far can I swim?
You know the feeling, right? I was hoping you'd say that, [S]!
All right, let's try this again! This time, I'm going to push myself even harder and swim as far as I can!
Status: The beach is so great! The warmth and the water feel so refreshing after a workout!
Huh? Are you offering me a drink? Next time just ask!
It sure is...hot out here... But there's no way I'm letting the heat take me down!
Even at the beach, I can't skip out on training. I should go for a run along the shoreline first thing in the morning!
I caught a HUGE fish when I went diving. Probably the biggest that's ever been caught. We should cook it up!
Swimming sure makes me hungry. Not snack hungry. Hmph. I'm gonna need a full meal!
Are you resting? There's no time to slack! C'mon, let's go for a swim!

leonie.name: Leonie
leonie.title: Relentless Rays
leonie.description: From Sauin Village of the Leicester Alliance. As the daughter of a hunter, she can't wait to show off her talents with a bow at the beach. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: This is a really pretty beach. Blue skies and a pleasant breeze... I want to show it to everyone in the village!
My dream is to become the best there is, just like Captain Jeralt. I can't stop training, even at the beach!
I can't afford anything fancy. But those frozen treats at the stall... No, resist! Be responsible!
I don't wear them often, but I like swimsuits. You feel nice and cool, and they're easy to move around in!
Quite the catch, huh? I'm pretty good at fishing, you know. And I can cook it up nicely too!
Visit:
You're [F]'s friend, right?
I just caught some fish from the sea. I'll share them with you!
Level: So, what do you think of my skills? Maybe summertime and I are a good match!
That's the spirit! I think I'm getting the hang of it.
Maybe I spent too much time fishing... Captain Jeralt's best apprentice should do better.
Summon: I'm Leonie Pinelli. I hate to lose, so I'm gonna enjoy the summer sea more than anyone else!
Learn Skill: Do you like sunflowers? They start to bloom in summer, you know.
Confession:
I'm not confident in my ability to judge a person's character, but you, [S]...
You brought me to this amazing beach. I know you're a good person, and I'm grateful.
I'm from a small village. I borrowed money to enter the Officers Academy so I could achieve my dream.
And... I've been training hard so I won't fall behind the nobles. So they can't look down on me, a commoner.
But, in front of this vast open sea, I've felt like focusing on nobles and commoners is kind of a waste of time.
I want to open myself up to more, just like Captain Jeralt. And just like the sea!
Status: Fine waves, soft breeze... Yup, it's a good day.
Oh! You brought drinks? Nice, thanks.
Hilda insisted I decorate my bow. It looks pretty silly, but it still shoots fine.
The scenery's nice, long as you don't think about the creepy-crawlies lurking under the rocks. Eugh.
The fish around here must make for great eating.
The break's been nice, but I'll have to work double to make up for it later.
Hey, what are you sitting around for? The waves are amazing! C'mon, let's go!

mbyleth2.name: Byleth
mbyleth2.title: The Fódlan Star
mbyleth2.description: Former professor at Garreg Mach Monastery who leads the charge in the campaign to end war. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Even if it only lasted a year, my days at the Officers Academy continue to give me strength on the battlefield.
I hope to never again find myself away from my friends when they are most in need...

Have you ever had an experience that you couldn't tell anyone about?
Something like...visions of a girl who laughs with you, gets angry at you, and even cries for you?

No matter the battlefield, I'm always grateful to fight alongside allies willing to lend me their strength.
The same is true for you, right? In that case, let us train together.
I may never get answers to many of the questions I have about my life, but I will press on nevertheless.
Visit: Sorry for dropping in suddenly. I was asked to bring you greetings from [F].
Level: I'll use this power for the greater good.
There's no turning back now.
Not my best.
Summon: My name is Byleth. I fight to bring an end to the chaos that has enveloped Fódlan.
Learn Skill: Thank you. With this power, I can keep moving forward.
Confession:
Even in this world, where so many Heroes have banded together, there is still no end to the cycle of conflict.
My heart is heavy having seen this.
How can I hope to quench the flames of war engulfing Fódlan? How can I wield my blade and seek peace?
Even so, I know a Hero does not yield—a Hero fights for their dream. Even if they may not live to see it.
I still struggle to see myself as such a Hero, but...despair is not an option I will allow myself.
I'm with you to the end. Allow me to demonstrate how my experience can be applied here and now!
Special: You cannot stop the flow of time!
Here is something to believe in!
Status: Yes, this garb is ornate. It does make me stand out, I suppose.
Hmm? Did you need something?
I can't hear Sothis's voice anymore...
Here, we can all coexist, without strife.
The goddess gifted me her power. In doing so, I was changed.
This may be one of the answers that I sought as I drifted through the flow of time...
I will lend you my strength. Bring about a world where people can always smile.

caeda4.name: Caeda
caeda4.title: Sea-Blossom Pair
caeda4.description: Caeda, princess of Talys, invited the dökkálfr Plumeria to the beach. What memories might these two make? They appear in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem / Heroes.
caeda4.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Grants another action to ally with the highest HP that is within 2 spaces, has already acted, and is from the same titles as unit (excluding unit). (Allies with Sing or Dance can be granted this effect as well. If multiple units meet the conditions, effect will not trigger.)
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Plumeria**: Loitering at the beach in nothing but these flimsy clothes... Mortals truly are utterly shameless.
**Caeda**: Talys is an island kingdom, so I grew up surrounded by the ocean. I'd love to show it to everyone someday!
**Plumeria**: We dökkálfar are...unaccustomed to blue skies, but Princess Caeda... She encouraged me to give it a try.
**Caeda**: Isn't Plumeria's swimsuit lovely? It suits her perfectly!
**Plumeria**: Princess Caeda's words carry no falsehoods. Indeed, everything she says comes right from the heart.
Visit: **Caeda**: We come bearing summer greetings. Plumeria, come on! You know [F] said to say hi!
Level: **Caeda**: All right, Plumeria, let's enjoy all the fun summer has to offer!
**Plumeria**: I will do my best to live up to Princess Caeda's expectations...
**Plumeria**: Ah...this view is everything I could ever ask for. The allure of the beach is a dangerous thing indeed...
Summon: I'm Caeda, princess of Talys. Plumeria and I are here to create some wonderful summer memories!
Learn Skill: **Caeda**: Oh, thank you so much! ...Plumeria, you seem wary about this. Don't worry, I'm not going anywhere.
Confession:
**Plumeria**: Princess Caeda... Are you really not frightened of me? I am a dökkálfr. By my own hands, mortals have...
**Caeda**: I think we all have things we regret. And even if I don't understand your past, your powers, or your pain...
Your eyes tell me that your heart is still gentle—that you are still kind. You are very dear to me, Plumeria.
**Plumeria**: But...is that really enough for you to trust me? Even though I have led countless mortal hearts astray?
...Even though I have never once been loved? You would still think so much of me, despite that?
**Caeda**: Of course! And whenever summer arrives, I will fondly remember these days we spent together.
**Plumeria**: Thank you, Princess Caeda. I will also cherish our time together... This fleeting dream of summer.
Status: giggle
"Thirsty?" "Never you mind."
Conversation: **Caeda**: Plumeria, I've heard that your people have the power to grant dreams...
Would...would you consider giving me a dream?
**Plumeria**: What?! You? Do you...know what kind of dreams I deal in?
**Caeda**: Well, no, to be honest. I was just hoping you could give me a dream where I have wings like yours.
Flying under your own power like that... It just seems like it would feel so good.
**Plumeria**: Ah. Well, my dreams are... My dreams are not like that.

You see, the dreams I give are... especially intense.
If you aren't used to...such things, you might not wake up for a long, long time. Days, even.

Besides, w-we have this beautiful view of the ocean!
What do you need with dreams when the real world is so lovely?
**Caeda**: Oh, you're right, of course. Thank you, Plumeria.
It means a lot to have you looking out for me like that.
I'm so glad we became friends. You're like my personal guardian angel!
**Plumeria**: ...A-angel?
I had heard you had a silver tongue, Princess Caeda...
But you will find that I am not subject to your flattery.
**Caeda**: Flattery? No, Plumeria, I just like having you as a friend, I swear!
**Plumeria**: You really do, don't you? ...Very well, friends we shall be.
**Caeda**: Wonderful! In that case, my dear friend, we can't let this ocean go to waste! Let's go for a swim.
Duo Skill: "You enjoy this...grit?" "You mean the beach? Yes!"

freyr2.name: Freyr
freyr2.title: Estival Dreams
freyr2.description: Dream-King of Ljósálfheimr, the dream realm, making an appearance at the beach after being invited amidst a summer's dream.

Castle Hall: The walls of a sandcastle may stand for but a moment...but the memory will remain forever...
Normally, I do not venture beyond the dream realm...but the whimsy of summer ought not to be passed up.
The dazzling array of chilled treats is sure to please Peony and Mirabilis...
Freyja and Plumeria have joined us, have they? ...This dream must be a good dream for them as well.
This is the first time I've worn a suit meant for swimming, but it is a rather pleasant way to relax...
Visit: I am Dream-King Freyr. I have been asked to give you a good summer's dream from [F].
Level: Dreams dreamt under the light of the sun's brilliance are even more radiant than I had expected...
The ocean's roar crashes against my heart, weathering it smooth...
The heat seems to have gotten to me...
Summon: I am Dream-King of Ljósálfheimr, Freyr... Summer is the season to spread pleasant dreams to all...
Learn Skill: This dream of yours will grow into summer love's eternal flame.
Confession:
Long, long ago...I dreamt of a summer day spent beneath the sun's rays...
And you were standing beside me in that dream, [S]...
There is no mistake.
That was a true dream... It was a promise made by the future.
How will the dream continue from here, I wonder... Of course, knowing would detract from the mystique.
Dreams form our desires and shape the future...but for now, let us simply drift off into the summer sun.
Status: Thank you for inviting me here... I hope we can enjoy this time together.
Hmm...? Ah, no, I am not sleeping... Simply enjoying the sunlight's caress...
I have seen this beach before... In a dream... It must have been a dream of this moment...
I wish Peony and Mirabilis could join me here...
Dreams can occur even in full sunlight... Just look around you.
How long has it been since you were so untroubled, Freyja...
The time I've spent here... It has been dreamlike. Thank you.

freyja2.name: Freyja
freyja2.title: Fleeting Summer
freyja2.description: Lady of Nightmare who rules over Dökkálfheimr. What will she dream up under the summer sun?

Castle Hall: The steady rhythm of the waves reminds me of my gentle brother's comforting voice.

A world of everlasting summer sun is no place for us denizens of Dökkálfheimr...
Though, I suppose I can allow us this momentary joy. It will be over all too soon as it is.
My álfar have come to the summery seas as well, hm? How wonderful this must be for them.
The summer sunlight glittering over the water's surface brings visions of my brother's smile to my mind...
I am dressed appropriately for the occasion. I will abide no implication to the contrary.
Visit:
I am Freyja, Queen of Dökkálfheimr, ally to [F].
I come with tidings of summer.
Level: How long has it been since I've known the comfort of summer sunlight, I wonder...
A fleeting summer's dream, vanishing at the slightest touch...
Nightmares are meant for mortals...
Summon: I am Freyja, queen of the realm of nightmares, Dökkálfheimr. A vision of a summer dream called to me...
Learn Skill: If you wish it, let it be so. I will cherish this memory and bask in it as the summer sun.
Confession:
I do not recall seeing the golden glisten of the evening sun over the waves before now, and yet...
I cannot escape the feeling that it is familiar to me somehow.
Perhaps I witnessed a similar scene within a dream once, long ago...
Dreams are fragments of memories and desires woven together, twisting like a vision in a kaleidoscope...
I must have, deep down, wished for this day, the day I would visit this place, these sands...
There was a time I... Well, I was not always the lady of nightmare.
But for now, in this moment...let me sink into a dream of summer love and reflect on those days now long past.
Status: You brought me to the beach alongside my dear brother... So, you can be sensible.
*gasp* You'd dare touch my bare skin?
So this is the sort of thing you drink in this world? ...I have no complaints.
My beloved álfar seem to be enjoying themselves. I'm glad.
I am no mortal. Do not look at me as if I were.
I hope to enjoy the sun and sea here with my brother. *sigh* It has been so long since we've had such time together...
I suppose I ought to spend time with you here as well, after you brought me along...

ogma2.name: Ogma
ogma2.title: Blade on Leave
ogma2.description: Mercenary of Talys. Following Caeda, who had saved his life, he's come to pay a visit to the summer's warm sands. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Bord, Cord, and Barst are all experts of fighting on the shores and waters. They are true men of the sea.

When I was a gladiator, I was made to fight for spectacle. I didn't know what the next day would bring...
Princess Caeda changed my fortunes.
Princess Caeda kindly told me that I can enjoy the beach, but... I have no idea how to spend my time here.
The beaches of Talys were beautiful, but Askr's beaches are also captivating.
Even at the beach, I still need to take care of my weapons. I don't want the salty air to rust them.
Visit:
I bring summer greetings from [F].
We're on vacation, so excuse my appearance.
Level: Hm. Guess I've improved after some time in the summer sun.
No matter what I'm wearing, I'll always work to meet my employer's expectations.
It's not like me to let my guard down.
Summon: My name is Ogma. I won't allow anyone to disturb Princess Caeda's holiday.
Learn Skill: Thanks. This gift from the beach will give me strength.
Confession:
In truth, I once had no good memories of the beach.
In my days as a mercenary, there were many battles fought on the beach and many lives lost to the sea.
However, a beach without fighting is a beautiful place to be. I finally feel that I understand its magnificence.
I am very grateful that both you and Princess Caeda invited me to come.
When our holiday is over, the fight in Askr will resume. With my renewed strength, I will give all I have to Askr.
Special: I'll beat you at swimming, too.
Status: I'm Ogma. My orders are to enjoy 'summer activities.' I...don't know what that means.
What is it? I hope you're not bored.
Mercenary work took me all over the continent. ...I've never seen a place this beautiful.
I don't know what to do with myself here. Do I get in the water or...?
I can master any weapon, even this one. You'll see.
I shouldn't be at the beach with Princess Caeda like this. It's not my place.
It's been good to unwind like this.

norne2.name: Norne
norne2.title: Seaside Volunteer
norne2.description: Volunteer soldier of Altea excited to be taking her first trip to the beach after having been summoned. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I wish we could enjoy the beach without worryin' about all the fighting in the world...
I like both the ocean and the mountains. Either way, ya get pretty views and lots of critters!
I want to make lunch using the finest fish from the sea. I'll make enough for everyone, of course!
The beach would be even better if Kris were here! I was hopin' to get a second opinion on this swimsuit.
I just saw Princess Caeda on the beach. She looks so elegant, even in a swimsuit.
Visit: Hey there! I'm here to give ya summer greetings from your pal [F]!
Level: The beach is real fun! I'm so full of energy!
Let me know if you get hungry, will ya? I have some lunches ready to go!
Huh? My legs feel shaky... Was I having too much fun?
Summon: Heya! I'm Norne. I've really been lookin' forward to this beach trip!
Learn Skill: Aww, for me? Thanks! I'll gladly take a summertime gift!
Confession:
When I joined the Altean army and fought around Archanea, I was able to see beaches from far away.
I always thought it would be nice to actually go to the beach with friends and swim in the ocean.
Bein' able to realize that dream here in Askr has made me so happy!
Now that we've all relaxed on the beach, we can do our best in battle goin' forward.
When all the fighting is done, I hope I can come to the beach again with Kris and Lord Marth!
Status: Check me out! Whaddaya think?
Oh! How'd you know I was thirsty? Thank you!
I've actually never been to a beach. This is pretty nice!
Ahh! I'm so relaxed. It's hard to believe we're usually fighting...
There was a real pretty fish over there. It's too bad you missed it.
I wonder what Kris would say about all this...
Oh hey, are you hungry? 'Cause I brought us lunch!

nifl.name: Nifl
nifl.title: God of Ice
nifl.description: The god of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. Her frozen personality is as cold and distant as her realm.

Castle Hall: So this is the kingdom Askr granted power... I ought not to remain here longer than necessary.
Nifl is a land of ice and snow. There, all is silent, as if time itself has frozen. That is how I prefer it.
Your power defies the logic of this world... It is a power even we gods do not possess.
Fjorm is not so different from Hvergel... Her smile is— *ahem* Enough of that.
The potential of mortals knows no bounds... As gods, even we can uncover but a piece of it.
Visit: I am Nifl, and that is greeting enough. It is not in my nature to exchange pleasantries.
Level: Do not be overjoyed. Emotionality is best avoided.
Temperance and moderation generate a fine result.
Do not be discouraged. Emotionality is best avoided.
Summon: Lady of one realm of nine, I am Nifl, called the god of ice. I now walk this world, having shed half of my divinity.
Learn Skill: ...What do you ask in exchange?
Confession:
Fjorm gave her life to me for the power to defeat her enemies...
Contracts compel one to obey the wishes of another...
What is it that you wish for, [S]?
What do you want so badly that you would give up your life for it?
Emotionality and desirousness are foolish. Though, if there is anything you wish for...speak.
As for your end of the contract, we can address that afterward.
Status: Without delay.
Do not lose.
Lady of one realm of the nine, I am Nifl, god of ice.
*gasp* ...Cease your unpredictable foolery.
Be silent. I am beyond your sentimentality.
I will settle this, Múspell... Of this I am certain.
If you wish to see it granted...state your desire.

charlotte.name: Charlotte
charlotte.title: Wily Warrior
charlotte.description: A Nohrian border guard who dreams of rising above the class of her middling birth. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
My, my. Look at all of the eminent bachelors here... All these purebreds, ready for the taking!
Then again, if I married somebody from another world, sending money home would get pretty tricky.
