I know it's hard to believe, but I used to be a border guard, swinging a giant axe, of all things! Goodness!
The big problem was catching my beauty sleep, with all those stupid Chevois rebels making trouble.
You'd like me to defend the castle? Of course! If something happens, I'll just smash—I mean, I'll call for help!
Want to go for a stroll, just the two of us? You do? In...the ruins? You...want to summon Heroes? Uh, OK...

I've been working SO hard on keeping my act up, and yet...the fish just aren't biting. UGH!
Oh, forgive me... That evil little fairy nipped me again. You know the one. It just won't let me be! So naughty!
Visit: Why, hello there! Tell me... Are there any rich, handsome, reliable and— crucially—single men in your army?
Level: I hope rich men like powerful women...
There we go! I'm a wee bit stronger now.
As you can see, I'm just a delicate flower.
Summon: I'm Charlotte, a Nohrian border guard. I'm a delicate little thing, but I'll do what I can. Tee-hee!
Learn Skill: Why, thank you! I'll do my very best out there.
Confession:
Oh, my! Who is that calling me? I can hear you... Oh. It's you. I can drop the act.
How's it going? You look fine—not sick or hurt or anything. You don't look that strong, so I worry about you.
I mean... You keep on visiting me, even though you know what I'm really like. So, yeah, I think about you.
Maybe that's your trick... You sucker everybody into wanting to protect you. I feel like I learned something...
Of course I'm kidding. I know you're not that manipulative. That's why I like you. But if you die on me...
Special: I will smash you so hard!
Status: I'll make you my extra-special lunch!
I'll do whatever I can to support the Order of Heroes!
My lustrous hair and healthy skin... How does it feel to touch them?
Being surrounded by all these upstanding Heroes... It's making me a little nervous.
What's that? You saw me slug an enemy? Oh, you! Such an imagination you have.
These stupid enemies keep underestimating ME, of all people! What a joke!
You know, you're pretty good at taking care of everyone. It throws me off, and I can't help but let my guard down around you.

nyx.name: Nyx
nyx.title: Rulebreaker Mage
nyx.description: A mage who once grew so overwhelmed by her own power, she cast a forbidden spell, inflicting unspeakable loss. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: You'd do well to keep your distance. Who would want to associate with this pitiful, cursed existence?
The lights of this castle are as bright as its occupants are lively. I can't say this place suits me well.
Could there really be others in this world who share my burden?

I can cook well enough—I am an adult, after all.
Hmm... You don't believe me, do you? I can tell by the look on your face.
You want to be friends, hm? Well, know this: I don't intend to waste time on pleasantries.
Visit: Ugh, I can't bear this place much longer. Can I go back to [F]'s castle yet?
Level: This may be impressive now, but in the end, nothing will have changed. That is how I must atone for my sins.
To grow and to change as you head toward your final days is not a gift that should be squandered.
No matter how much I grow, this cursed form remains the same— an eternal reminder of my crimes.
Summon: My name is Nyx. Let me be frank: I'm best left alone. Not you nor anyone else can understand my plight.
Learn Skill: You think this is a good fit for me? If you say so...
Confession:
Yes? Can I help you?
I hope you know you're intruding on my alone time. Though... I guess an interruption now and then is fine.
This place is peaceful... Almost too peaceful for someone with so much blood on their hands.
I never thought I'd work side by side with people again... Until I was summoned here, that is.
What do you think? Will you be the one to give me a second chance, [S]?
Special: Crimes are meant to be punished.
Status: My name is Nyx, and I will thank you to not treat me like a child.
*startled noise* Oh, it's you. Think twice before teasing your elders like that.
Cutting all ties with people will help me atone for my past. It must...
I'm quite the bookworm, so permit me to ask: what do people in Askr like to read?
I took countless lives in my foolish youth. For that, I was cursed with this unaging body...
My true body is surely much taller and more mature than this one...but what of my hair?
Summoning me was a bad omen...but worry not. I'll make it up to you.

orochi.name: Orochi
orochi.title: Merry Diviner
orochi.description: A Hoshidan diviner who was a frequent visitor at the castle from a young age, quickly growing familiar with the royal family. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: You haven't seen any rats lurking about, have you? I could've sworn I heard their wretched squeaking...
Care to hear a secret? I'm actually a magical cat! ...Wait—you didn't actually believe that, did you?
There's no need to thank me for my work. But if you truly insist, I could always go for a shoulder massage.
Can you stop by my room later? I plan to be up all night concocting elixirs, and I need a helping hand!
Hnnn....mmmmm.....rrrrgghh... Oof, I didn't even stand a chance at that staring contest, huh?
Visit:
A certain someone asked that I divine your future, [S].
Just don't shoot the messenger, OK?
Level: Well, this is certainly a surprise... This power must be the result of all your support.
Just as I foresaw. There is no need to waste precious energy when you already know the outcome.
I knew this would happen but... Ugh! Don't look at me like that! This was fate, you hear me? Fate!
Summon: I am Orochi, diviner of Hoshido and seer of all. Your future is but a glance away...if you wish to know it.
Learn Skill: For me? Really? Aww, you shouldn't have... That said, there had better be more where that came from. Hahaha!
Confession:
"I am Orochi. I am everywhere, and I am nowhere." What do you think? Not bad as a self-introduction, huh?
I thought I should prepare one, since other summoners will no doubt also desire my services.
Any moment now, I will be whisked off to some battle or festival or— What's that? You want me to stay?
I-is that some sort of joke? You're getting me back for all of those mean tricks I played, aren't you?
Hmph. If fate truly has decided that I shall remain here, by your side... Well, I certainly won't complain.
Status: I am Orochi, a diviner in service of Hoshido's royal family.
Ah! What in the—?! If you're really that pressed for something to do, make yourself useful and fetch me some herbs.
Queen Mikoto loved me like I was her own daughter. I'll never forget that kindness.
*giggles a couple times*... Oh, sorry! I was remembering a rather amusing story.
Your fortune is... (chosen randomly) → The best! → Good. → Um... It's bad.
Queen Mikoto...please watch over me...
I once failed to protect someone I cared about... But on my pride as a diviner, I swear that shall not happen again!
Map Select: We think alike, you and I.

benny.name: Benny
benny.title: Sensitive Soul
benny.description: A Nohrian border guard from a farming village. A gentle giant loved by animals. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.
benny.artist: Konomura (木ノ村) / Creative House Pocket Co., Ltd

Castle Hall:
Isn't it kind of scary never knowing what may come through that summoning gate?
Huh? I've been the scariest thing to come through so far?

I was a border guard before coming here. And before that, I lived in a farming village.
Goes to show, you never know where your life will take you next until you're there.
You can't fight, but you aren't afraid of battle. You've got a strong spirit.
I've made friends with the animals living nearby. Maybe you'd like to... take a walk with me and meet them?
I made some more charms. Enough for everyone. I want to make sure everyone makes it home safely.
Visit: Thanks for coming to greet me. I have a message for the summoner on behalf of [F].
Level: Is it OK for me to get this much stronger?
This is nice.
Maybe it's time I made myself a new good-luck charm.
Summon: I'm Benny, a border guard from Nohr. I hope you aren't scared of me, because I'd like to make friends.
Learn Skill: Thank you. The stronger I get, the better I can protect everyone.
Confession:
Oh, it's you. You always take the time to talk to me... You aren't scared of me like the others.
I know I have "one of those faces." It's led to all sorts of rumors spreading about me back home.
People claim that I once tossed a man so high into the sky, he never came back down.
And just the other day, I overheard someone say my battle cry could shut the gateways for good.
Commander Anna even paid me a visit to remind me to save it for the battlefield!
But the truth is, I don't have that sort of power. The sort of power I do have is that to protect my friends.
And it's all thanks to you and the time we spent together. Thanks for being brave, [S].
Status: I brought a lot of good-luck charms with me.
When I was summoned, I thought I was headed to the other side...
Who...who's there? Oh. It's just you. You scared me.
I like animals. They aren't scared of me.
You aren't hurt, are you? I always worry about my friends.
All of the Heroes are so brave. I need to find my courage.
If you ever find yourself in danger, just hide behind me. This is sturdy armor.

arete.name: Arete
arete.title: Requiem's Beauty
arete.description: The combination of her alluring figure and her songbird voice are said to have entranced royals everywhere from Valla to Nohr. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Now and again, I feel a strange ache in my head...as if my mind is crying out for memories it has lost...
Azura? Of course, of course. Azura... She...she is my daughter... My, er... My daughter?
I have been told my song can melt away one's stress. Should you ever feel overburdened, call on me.
I wouldn't speak of my past even if I could. There are too many painful memories I prefer to keep buried.
♪You are the ocean's...♪ Oh, pay me no mind. I feel compelled to fill the silence with song.
Visit: I was sent to sing to you, courtesy of [F]. May I?
Level: Strength is the only way to ensure your survival.
It seems I still have room to improve.
Forgive me... Such poor performance ought to be beneath me.
Summon: I am Arete. I will serve you to the best of my ability—so long as you promise safety for both me and my daughter.
Learn Skill: With this, I will prove your faith in me is not misplaced.
Confession:
When I look at you, I am struck by the impression that you and Azura are quite a bit alike...
Though she and I are related by blood, I've always felt that she has a certain strength I seem to lack.
I worry such strength may draw unwanted attention to her and keep her from a normal life...
As summoner, you must surely realize what sway fate holds over us all...
I wish not to discourage you from breaking the chains of fate. On the contrary, in fact...
I will do everything in my power to ensure you can both live your lives as you choose to.
Status: I am Arete, queen of Nohr and wife of King Garon.
Ah! Aren't you a bit old for such games?
As King Garon's second wife, I am forever in the shadow of his first...
My only wish is for Azura to grow up healthy, and strong.
If you wish to know where I am from, I do apologize; I must avoid the subject.
Azura... I hope you know that I love you...
If you can make use of my abilities, I will gladly lend them to your cause.

ullr.name: Ullr
ullr.title: The Bowmaster
ullr.description: One of the 12 crusaders who gathered at the Tower of Dahna. With her holy bow Yewfelle, she has felled many a foe. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Are you certain of this, Forseti? That boy is... Hm. Perhaps it is not my place.
The Miracle at the Tower of Dahna was the blood contract that granted us the power to challenge Loptous.

A summoning ability beyond powers known even to the gods, they say...
Yet even here there are those who seek to dominate any who oppose them... Some things never change.
No matter the weapon you wield, the principle is the same: aim for your foe and strike.

I've heard others from Jugdral are present as well... I hope to speak with them if possible while here.
I wish to warn them against placing too much weight on the shoulders of too few.
Visit:
You are [S], are you not?
I wish you well in your friendship with [F].
Level: Witness strength awoken in me!
If my blood wills it, I would accept this fight as my own...
This world is still strange to me...
Summon: I am Ullr—once called crusader. Should you have the heart to face the myriad evils, my bow is yours.
Learn Skill: True excellence is found in uplifting those who cannot yet do as you do.
Confession:
Your power of summoning ranks you among the godly. As such... I must warn you of something.
Strength can lead a people out of darkness, but with such strength comes darkness borne upon it...
In Jugdral, we forgot that lesson. We grew arrogant...and invited disaster upon ourselves.
I do not claim to know the source of your power, nor do I know how you came by it...
I do know, however, that it is real.
While we look to the same horizon, my strength is one with yours... I ask only that we not stray from the light.
Status: My name is Ullr... Once, I was called a crusader.
*gasp* What was that?
Strong light can guide us. It can drive away the darkness.
I wish to pass this bow to one with a worthy heart.
Men are men. If mankind turns its back on the gods, it is lost.
The dragon we defeated…it must never return to life.
It brings me joy to fight by your side for this worthy cause.

hinoka4.name: Hinoka
hinoka4.title: Fair Pirate Pair
hinoka4.description: Two princesses, one from Hoshido and the other from Nohr, have banded together as pirates. They appear in Fire Emblem Fates.
hinoka4.duo:
Grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit and flying allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, and they can move 1 extra space. (That turn only. Does not stack.)
Inflicts【Gravity】on bow, dagger, magic, and staff foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit if they are also infantry, armored, or cavalry foes.
【Gravity】 Restricts target's movement to 1 space through its next action.

Castle Hall:
**Hinoka**: While I appreciate the work put into the costuming, I can't help but wonder...
There wasn't any way to add a little more...costume to the costume?
**Camilla**: Take what you want, by force if you must... The pirate's life might be just my style.
**Hinoka**: I'm usually defending against pirates, so I feel a little on edge wearing all this, even if it is just a costume.
**Camilla**: Ooh, you want a better look at our pirate costumes, do you? Well, don't be shy... Come a little closer!

**Hinoka**: Are there pirates in your world as well, [S]?
If there are, you can count on our help in pacifying them!
Visit: **Camilla**: As you can see, we are dressed in pirate garb. The pirate festival is on at [F]'s castle!
Level: **Hinoka**: Ryoma, Takumi, Sakura, forgive me... I am becoming a pirate in both body and mind...
**Camilla**: I'll be taking all the treasure, thank you very much—and I may just steal your heart while I'm at it.
**Hinoka**: Playing the part of pirate is not my favorite, as it turns out... Can we reconsider this, Princess Camilla?
Summon: P-pirates?! We—princesses—are playing at being pirates? Princess Camilla, what's going on here?!
Learn Skill: **Camilla**: To think I'd find such booty... This pirate work isn't bad, is it?
Confession:
**Camilla**: I believe the treasures we hold in our hearts are very much the same, Princess Hinoka.
**Hinoka**: The treasure in our hearts, huh? Hm... I think I know what you mean!
I'm not sure how to describe it either, but we seem to be on the same page.
**Camilla**: The law and propriety are trivial when it comes to protecting what is truly precious to us.
If a precious thing is taken from us, we go to any lengths to retrieve it, no matter what.
No arbitrary rules would be able to stop us!
**Hinoka**: That's right I would use every ounce of my strength to reclaim such a thing!
**Camilla**: Hm-hm-hmm... Perhaps you're more suited for the pirate's life than you had imagined, Princess Hinoka...
I'm happy I thought to invite you to come to this festival with me.
Status: Hehe
"Counting on you!" "Oh! I'm honored!"
Conversation: **Hinoka**: ...How did this happen? No princess of Hoshido should be dressed up as a pirate—let alone pretending to be one!
**Camilla**: Oh, it's not so bad, is it? You know, I'm a princess too... And look, I'm having fun, aren't I?
We all do what we must. As long as we can enjoy ourselves at the same time, why shouldn't we?
**Hinoka**: Hoshido is different. If the nobility flaunt the rules, it sets a poor example for the people.
**Camilla**: Oh, you're so serious! This is supposed to be a festival, and we're not in Hoshido—so relax!
Use your imagination... Imagine we're pirates... Imagine we sail the seas in search of treasure...
**Hinoka**: Rrrrright... Umm... All right. Wait—what kind of treasure?
**Camilla**: Only the most lovely treasure of them all... My dear Corrin! ...Who has...been taken captive!
**Hinoka**: Taken captive?! By who?!
**Camilla**: Hmm... My brother Xander was here as a pirate before... Let's say he's taken Corrin!
**Hinoka**: Taken by the crown prince of Nohr? Then we have no choice but to save Corrin right away!
**Camilla**: You...do understand this is all just imaginary, right?
**Hinoka**: The time for talk is over!
We'll crush Prince Xander and get our Corrin back! Let's go, Princess Camilla!
**Camilla**: O-oh... All right... Sorry in advance, Brother...
Though it warms the heart to see how she fights for our dear Corrin... It's just precious.
We have some of the same sisterly sensibilities, it seems... Friendship blossoms upon the waves!

surtr2.name: Surtr
surtr2.title: Pirate of Red Sky
surtr2.description: King of Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame, attending the pirate festival with intent to consume everything in a reign of fire.

Castle Hall: I will see the waves aflame! All shall flee before my coming—and what is left behind is mine to take!
Piracy is unheard-of in Múspell... If only for the simple reason that I incinerated all who defied me!
Weaklings are ill-fit for piracy. A festival like this may be suitable even for the citizens of Múspell.
One must have sufficient strength to live free of others' restraints... What else is there to being a pirate?
My daughters could hardly believe their eyes seeing me like this. ...I fail to see what is so shocking.
Visit: Come and join the pirate festival—but do not expect that you will survive to see another sunrise!
Level: I will consume the waters with flame!
A diversion perhaps, but I will not hold back! The sea's floor awaits the weak!
Hm... Battle at sea seems to require a different tack...
Summon: I am Surtr, king! This festival will be burned away until only a sea of raging flame remains!
Learn Skill: Power is the treasure worth seeking, and we will never have enough!
Confession:
You may be one of the few with any strength—yet you do not act as such.
The powerful must dominate and take what is ours by right. It is our obligation. Pirates understand this.
A pirate festival is a mark of culture. I see no matter more deserving of celebration than taking by force...
Free of all restraint, the pirate takes the seas by storm... Such a life would suit me well.
Now, we are obligated in turn to return to the festivities—and take everything we can carry!
Status: I, Surtr, king of Múspell, drawn into this farce...
Do you not know? To touch me is to die.
I care not if it is the ocean. I will set it all ablaze.
I wish for the flames to grow hotter still!
The strong take from the weak. That is the order of things.
It has been a long time indeed since Múspell saw a festival.
Serve me, and we will take everything there is to take.

naesala2.name: Naesala
naesala2.title: Sea's Shadow
naesala2.description: King of Kilvas and leader of the raven clan. Hired to join in the pirate-related festivities. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Pirates take as they please. I live my life in much the same way. Only my garb has changed.
This look is stylish—and it breathes well too. I'm rather fond of it.
Not all pirates enjoy looting and pillaging, I'm sure... Some simply do what they must to survive.
Pirate garb would not suit a member of the heron clan. Make sure Leanne knows that she should not imitate me.

King Tibarn is here as well, is he? If we encounter one another, I fear it may dredge up old grudges...
That may present a problem.
Visit:
If you want not to die, place your valuables on the ground and get out of here before I change my mind.
...Only kidding! The pirate festival is on at [F]'s keep.
Level: The strong take whatever they want. Pirates aren't the only people who follow that particular code...
Well...seems I've won. Hand over all you've got, or you walk the plank! ...Just play along, for the festival.
Guh... Feels like the winds have changed.
Summon: You cast I, Naesala, King of Kilvas, as a dastard pirate? Is this your idea of a joke? I expect reparation for this...
Learn Skill: This is no bauble... Seems as if the treasure has found me for once!
Confession:
The strong take from the weak. It's been that way forever. It's an immutable fact of life.
That is why the raven tribe went from being the taken-from to being the takers—to survive.
I'll leave the moral debate for future philosophers to argue over. What is important is the side you choose.
One needs to be prepared to be taken from if one is to become a taker. Are you...prepared for that?
...Heh. Only kidding. I wouldn't think of taking anything from you, of course.
I'm simply having a peck of festival fun. You can trust me.
Status: Sure, a pirate festival may be a delight for the senses, but...is it in good taste?
Hm! You should pick your fights more carefully.
Of course this suits me. I was already halfway there.
Sure, put a pile of treasure in front of me and I'll be whatever you want—a pirate, a bandit... You say the word!
Everyone here seems so carefree... Is this what peace looks like?
Leanne saw me and said she wants to dress up too, but... I don't know if this is her style...
Tell me what you need—anything—and I'll snatch it up! ...Well, for a price.

vika.name: Vika
vika.title: Sea-Dark Wing
vika.description: A warrior of the raven clan and member of the Laguz Emancipation Army. Dressed as a pirate, she adds some extra life to the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I imagine Tormod could appreciate playing pirate more than I do...
Being ignored or hated without any reason is no way to live... I want for all to feel included in this festival.
Was this pirate garb selected to match my wings?
If Muarim or Tormod ever arrive, please let me know. Of course, I'm perfectly fine alone, it's just...
As long as no one gets hurt, playing the character of a pirate should be a delight.
Visit: I come bearing an invitation to the pirate festival. Please come enjoy the festivities if you're interested.
Level: If I'm this successful at piracy, I suppose I ought not to complain.
Treasure is to be taken when you are a pirate.
I am struggling against this wind...
Summon: My name is Vika. We are not pirates; we fight for freedom. That said, this is not a freedom-fighter festival...
Learn Skill: You're just handing this treasure over to me? ...I must temper my expectations, or I will grow spoiled.
Confession:
Ah... Have you been there long?
I wasn't daydreaming... I was watching the people participate in the festival.
Askr is such a wonderful place... Laguz, beorc, and so many others are all celebrating together.
I believe the goal of the Laguz Emancipation Army might just be to create a country like Askr.
Anyway... While the festival lasts, I'm going to go look for treasure.
And then, when I return to Tellius, I'll tell Tormod of what I saw here to share the treasure of this experience.
Status: I'm not sure I like being called a pirate... I'm more of a freedom fighter.
You sure do like to goof around.
All the excitement around the festival is a little overwhelming...
Hmm... Do you think my black wings make my "pirate look" too sinister?
My personal treasure is a figurine of the goddess. Just holding it makes me feel more optimistic.
Laguz and beorc, all smiling together... This is a sight I'm happy to have seen...
For you, I don't mind being a pirate.

lifis.name: Lifis
lifis.title: Terror of Iz
lifis.description: Leader of the Lifis Pirates, who ply the waters off the coast of Iz. He has come to the pirate festival after having a change of heart. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall:
A pirate's heart beats in my chest. Wearing the outfit does not make someone the genuine article...
I'll show you what it means to live a pirate's life!

Where I'm from, there isn't a soul who hasn't heard the name Lifis Pirates, even in Munster!
...H-huh?! Did I hear someone mouth off? What was that about "small-time crooks"?! Come say it to my face!
Perne isn't here, is he? No? ...Truly? Incredible! ...Hah! That jackass.
Wait... If I help out at the festival here, Safy might rethink her opinion of me. ...All right! I hope you're ready!

Why FAKE being a pirate when I can just as easil—
Prince Leif! You're...here! Great! ...As you can see, I pirate solely for the entertainment of others now!
Visit: You look like you have time to kill... Here's an invitation to the pirate festival at [F]'s.
Level: Defy me, and it's to the briny depths with you!
Heh. Not bad, eh?
H-huh? Have I lost my land legs after too much time at sea? Whooh...
Summon: Name's Lifis, friend to the sea and leader of the Lifis Pirates. Don't think I'll hold back because it's a festival!
Learn Skill: Heh... They'll never manage to catch me while I have this!
Confession:
Hey, hear me out... Could you do me a favor, [S].
I promise I'll change my ways and turn away from a life of crime. I'll even entertain at festivals...
All I ask is that you, please, don't summon a thief from Dacia named Perne—whatever you do!
Please, I'm begging you!
Huh? There's a chance you might if Askr needs his aid one day? ...No! Not him! Anyone but him!
Not that I'm scared of him, or that he bullied me all through my entire childhood... Nothing like that! Got it?
Now, listen! If you summon him... My time helping out at these festivals is over, you understand! I swear it!
Status: We're the Lifis Pirates. Treasure is ours. All of it, everywhere—every last coin!
No! I won't go quietly!
Give me your gold and I'll give you your life.
Festival?! Ugh! Pirates are not your playthings!
Askr's castle is very pretty. I bet it's bursting with treasure...
I'll show her how dashing I can be, and Safy will fall for me just like that... *chuckle*
I could share some of my treasure with you. I suppose.

gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.title: Nothing to Report
gatekeeper.description: The guard who watches over the gates of Garreg Mach Monastery. A kind man who cares deeply for all Heroes who pass through his gate. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You can hear all sorts of stories while guarding a gate. I ended up privy to a lot of what was happening in Fódlan.
It was my job to make sure no one suspicious got inside Garreg Mach. No villain will ever get past me!

Getting called to Askr was a real shock, but I've got great instincts when it comes to stuff like this.
Although, I never could've imagined what it actually feels like to be summoned to another world!
Today...there is quite a bit to report! I saw a girl transform into a dragon! ...What? That happens all the time?!
Sharena asked if I was the gatekeeper everyone's been talking about lately... But why would they talk about me?
Visit: Nothing to report from [F]'s castle!
Level: You can count on me to protect the gates with everything I've got!
Let's battle with all our might and pray we win this thing, so that we both can survive!
I will pour my heart and soul into improving so that I can become an even better gatekeeper.
Summon: Greetings! What a pleasu—wait, this isn't the monastery! ...Askr? Uh huh... Well, thanks for having me!
Learn Skill: For me? Really?! ...In that case, I'll use this strength to make sure the gates are secure, no matter what!
Confession:
Greetings, [S]!
Thanks for all your hard work! There's nothing to report today!
Um... That said, can I talk to you about something?
To be honest, I couldn't understand why a lowly gatekeeper like me was summoned to Askr.
I mean, there are so many incredible Heroes! You've got warriors, nobles, and even gods from all these worlds...
But you know what I realized? I don't need to be any of those things to help. Just being me is more than enough!
So I'm going to focus on what I CAN do. Even if they bring an entire army, I won't let a single enemy get inside!
Until the day comes when everyone in Askr can live peaceful, joyful lives, I will protect the gates.
Status: Greetings, summoner! Nothing to report!
Thought you could sneak up on me? Hah! Not a chance!
Being in a new world just means I have to stay more vigilant than ever!
I'm under strict orders to keep my eyes up and stay on guard.
Huh. There's no fishing pond around here. Where are people supposed to catch fish?
No matter where I'm stationed, my only concern is protecting the gate.
Nothing to worry about, summoner! Not even a suspicious bug could crawl past me!

marth6.name: Marth
marth6.title: Prince of Light
marth6.description: Prince of Altea destined to be revered as the Hero-King, having done countless deeds for the good of those who came after him. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: No weapon, divine or not, offers more comfort than the presence of one's companions.
I can remember the day I began to stand up for peace in Altea as if it occurred yesterday.
If I am to don this garb, I must approach battle in a way that will honor the legend of Anri.
There are many relics known as the Fire Emblem across the different worlds... Could this be coincidence?
I've been saved by Caeda's kindness countless times. She is irreplaceable. I could not do without her.
Visit: I am Marth, prince of Altea. I come bearing a symbol of your lasting bond with [F].
Level: My companions push me onward. They are what keep me going.
If bringing the battle to an end will take us closer to peace, I will waste no time hesitating.
If my sister were to see me like this, I would never forgive myself.
Summon:
I am Marth, prince of Altea. I can see from the look in your eye that your resolve is unmatched.
I will aid you in your campaign for peace.
Learn Skill: Your faith in me gives me strength. I will not disappoint you!
Confession:
I can still remember the feeling in my hands when I first took up a sword...
It was so heavy, so sharp...dangerous! I felt so helpless, wondering if I could ever manage to use such a blade.
But since then, I have swung a sword thousands, no...tens of thousands of times, I'm sure.
I use it for the sake of my people and their future. For those yet to come.
It is because of the support people have given me that I am where I am today.
I want to live up to their faith in me, and repay that support somehow.
That is how I wield my blade.
As long as I have something I must protect, I will likely continue to do so, with an eye toward a brighter future.
Status: These clothes are those of Altea's first king, King Anri.
Hey, woah there. You always do that. I'm catching on.
Artemis and Anri could never be together. What a sad story.
Anri won his battle all alone. I, on the other hand, rely on the strength of my friends.
There are so many that believe in me, and nothing could make me happier.
I can overcome any difficulty with my friends beside me.
As long as I am with you, we will never lose. I wish to continue fighting at your side.

marianne2.name: Marianne
marianne2.title: Serene Adherent
marianne2.description: Adopted daughter of Margrave Edmund. She can often be found speaking with animals or praying to the goddess. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
marianne2.artist: Kusakihara Toshiyuki (草木原俊行) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: I used to pray to the goddess for forgiveness. But more than anything, I wished she'd take me away with her.
There was a horse named Dorte who I was close to back at Garreg Mach. I hope he's doing well...
When I was given this outfit, Hilda was so happy for me it was as if she'd gotten it herself.
I want to express my gratitude, but... I-I'm sorry—I don't know what to say.
Growth as a practitioner of the mystic arts has no positive impact on one's ability to keep things tidy...
Visit: Many blessings be upon you. I've come with a symbol of friendship from [F].
Level: I...I'm all right. I think I can move forward now.
Goddess, I ask for your guidance...
Misfortune seems to follow me...
Summon: I'm Marianne von Edmund. I, um... I'm sorry to be a waste of your, er... Excuse me...
Learn Skill: Are you concerned for me? Is that the reason for this gift? I appreciate your thoughtfulness, of course...
Confession:
I've always...avoided others, ever since I was little. I struggle to open up to any but animals and the goddess.
You see, it has always been easier to be alone than...to interact with people, afraid all the time.
But I've changed now. I have people who support even someone like me. There are those who have faith in me.
I no longer want to retreat from life. I want to keep moving forward, side by side with those I care for...
O-of course, you are one of those people, [S].
I will press onward for those who accept me...for those who care for me as I care for them.
Status: Is everything OK?
Keep your chin up.
I don't think I understand it, but I suppose they chose me for a reason...
I have to grow stronger than I am now. I need to make myself useful.
Does this outfit look OK? Sorry. I, um...I'm just not sure...
Please, goddess... Lend me the courage I need...
I'm not the most, um, confident person, but I... I want to do my best for you.

eirika6.name: Eirika
eirika6.title: Pledged Restorer
eirika6.description: Princess of Renais. She has taken up her brother's lance so she can defend their kingdom's future. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: My brother entrusted me with Reginleif. In order to protect my people, I will do all I can to master it!
I wouldn't be the person I am today without the support of others. I won't let their faith in me go to waste.
This armor was made to be like my brother's. It's very easy to move around in.
You work incredibly hard, no matter the time of day. It inspires me to work harder myself.
I thought I'd style my hair a bit differently than usual. Do you like it?
Visit: I am Eirika, princess of Renais. I've come to deliver a small gift from [F].
Level: I will wield this spear now so that one day I will no longer have to.
My brother taught me this spear technique. How's my form?
If the fighting continues...will it be my fault for lacking the strength to end it?
Summon: I am Eirika, princess of Renais. With Reginleif, the spear entrusted to me by my brother, I will protect Askr!
Learn Skill: Your support gives me the strength to keep moving forward. I will not let you down!
Confession:
In our battles with Grado, I always had someone there to protect me.
Whether it was my brother or one of countless friends, it's thanks to them that I was able to fight to the end.
I do not wish for war. I believe we have more to gain from cooperation than from conflict.
But... If war finds us and we run from it, we won't be able to protect those precious to us, nor our ideals.
If I can be brave, I may be able to end the fighting. I want to be the protector this time.
A battle to end battles... I have faith that, with you by my side, we can accomplish that goal.
Status: What do you think of this armor? It's just like my brother's. I know we're twins, but...
Enough mischief, Ephraim! Oh, it's you, summoner. My apologies.
There are those who have faith in me... When I think of that, I feel strength well up inside.
I'm so very glad I could be of service to you.
I learned how to wield a spear from my brother.
Tell me... Would you be pleased to hear that I hope we never part?
I used to be so unsure, and understood the world so little. That has changed, and I thank you for your part in it.

pelleas.name: Pelleas
pelleas.title: Ashnard's Orphan
pelleas.description: The prince of Daein left behind by the late Mad King Ashnard. To rebuild Daein, he joins with Micaiah and involves himself in the struggle. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I've never killed before—never even seen a battlefield before now... But I aim to do all that is in my power.

I am told my father was Ashnard, who was known as the Mad King. It still doesn't feel real to me...
It's a little overwhelming, to be frank.
Micaiah and Sothe are in this world as well, aren't they? I am glad to have an opportunity to fight alongside them.
If I am ever able to rebuild Daein, I hope to put all that I have learned here to good use.
Even if my fate threatens to overpower my desires, I will not give up. I will persevere.
Visit: I am Pelleas, prince of Daein. This is a token of friendship, entrusted to me by [F].
Level: That was rather effective. Not half bad, coming from me.
I must be satisfied with slow growth if that is the best I can manage.
If things continue at this rate, I would be better off never showing my face in Daein again...
Summon: My name is Pelleas. I am the prince of Daein. But you need not be formal with me—I was raised a commoner.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I am grateful, truly. I will use this new power to stoke the fire inside me.
Confession:
Hypothetically...if you were caught up in events beyond your control, what would you do?
I sense a strong will behind your eyes. I think you would overcome any obstacle, no matter what it was.
Unlike my father, who was known for his dauntlessness, I have no love for combat.
But when the people I should protect are forced to live under the weight of domination...
I cannot simply stand by and allow such things to happen.
The time will come when I must make a decision, a decision that will require courage from me.
It may even mean I am forced into a battle I would just as soon avoid...
But to have the courage to move forward, to never give in...even in the face of unspeakable odds...
I have been learning all this and more during my time here with the Order, and I do not plan to stop now.
Status: I am Pelleas. I may be a prince of Daein, but I was raised as a normal commoner.
*laugh* Making mischief, are you? I've not done that since I was a child.
It still doesn't feel real to me...that I could be the son of King Ashnard.
I count my blessings to have Micaiah as vice-general. She gives me hope.
I cannot ignore the tragedies of this world. No man can, and certainly no prince.
Micaiah and Sothe are so close it's almost like they're siblings. As an only child, I envy them.
I don't fight for you out of princely duty. I do it because I want to—because it makes me happy.
Map Select: I will do as you ask.

micaiah5.name: Micaiah
micaiah5.title: Radiant Queen
micaiah5.description: The fifteenth ruler of Daein, often praised as the country's dawn. After her ascension, Daein was thrust into a new age of progress. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Just as the sun must set, the dark of night must, too, give way to dawn. The people of Daein have my faith.

The people of Daein are exhausted after such a long period of struggle.
I want to return the smiles to their faces somehow...someday...
When I observe the people of Askr, I see how important it is for a place to offer safety and foster collaboration.
Princess Sharena invited me to join her for tea later. Isn't that nice? I can hardly wait!
The future is clouded with uncertainty... Surely, it— Could it be?
Visit: I am Micaiah, Queen of Daein, come bearing greetings as a sworn ally of [F].
Level: I vowed to remake Daein. I will make it a country where everyone accepts one another, with all allowed dignity.
Has something gone wrong? I will see to it that it is corrected.
When I think of the people of Daein, fighting against nature every day, through the brambles and barrens...
Summon: I am Micaiah. I wish for everyone to spend their lives in peace... As ruler of Daein, it is my goal.
Learn Skill: Thank you for your guidance, Goddess Ashunera.
Confession:
I was...quite shocked to learn Sanaki, the 37th Empress of Begnion, is my younger sister, to be sure.
I am glad she wanted me to stay with her, but...Nolan, Edward, Leonardo, and Sothe...
The Dawn Brigade is my family. And Daein is my homeland.
That's why I've taken the throne, for the sake of everyone in Daein.
Clearing the land to prepare it for agriculture is no easy task...
The path will be difficult...and painful. But with my family and friends at my side, we will make Daein prosper.
When that day finally comes, I hope you will come visit. Daein welcomes you anytime, [S]!
Special: I will do what I must!
Status: Legendary...Hero? I think you're confused. Are you positive you're not looking for Commander Ike?
Hm? Ah... I see Yune has some influence on you as well. Hee hee!
I, like many others, have fought in a bitter struggle to keep on living...
I am descended from Lehran and Altina—and Misaha, the former apostle, was my grandmother.
I'll stand by you no matter what. You needn't even raise the question.
Empress Sanaki... My dear little sister... Thank you.
As long as I'm here...I'll show you that, together, we can overcome anything.

leif3.name: Leif
leif3.title: Destined Scions
leif3.description: The princes of Leonster and Grannvale have joined forces to bring hope to a new generation. They appear in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776 / Genealogy of the Holy War.
leif3.origin: Genealogy of the Holy War + Thracia 776
leif3.harmonized:
Grants the following effects to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn: 【Resonance: Blades】,【Desperation】, and "if unit initiates combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack."
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Desperation】 Grants the following effect for 1 turn: "If unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack."

Castle Hall: **Leif**: Lord Seliph's garb is connected to the crusader Baldr while mine is based on the crusader Njörun.

**Seliph**: During desperate times, people hope for a savior...
This festival in honor of the crusaders must have been started by people who knew the sting of that hope.

**Leif**: A tournament is being held for the festival and, though it's all in sport, everyone is taking it seriously.
Myself included, of course.
**Seliph**: I felt awkward wearing the outfit of Baldr like a costume—but I've grown more comfortable as I've worn it.
**Leif**: Lord Seliph and I were just about to begin our training session. Would you like to join us?
Visit: **Leif**: We are in the midst of a festival at [F]'s castle!
Level: **Leif**: Fitting for descendants of the legendary 12 crusaders!
**Leif**: I bear the responsibility! But with Lord Seliph at my side, I will not allow my shame to win the day!
**Seliph**: This is no cause for concern. We all have hardships we must overcome.
Summon: I am Leif of Leonster. I have come to participate in the Day of the Twelve celebrations, joined by Lord Seliph.
Learn Skill:
**Leif**: It's unfortunate we're not able to spend every day at a festival like this one...
N-not that I've lost sight of what matters! ...Do you know what I mean, Lord Seliph?
Confession:
**Leif**: Members of the liberation army gathered at the Tower of Dahna and made blood contracts with the gods...
And so they were able to defeat the forces of Loptous...
**Seliph**: Together, they founded Grannvale itself and its six duchies, along with the five kingdoms.
But in time...the servants of light and dark came to fight once more.
**Leif**: We gained allies, grieved those we lost, learned of bravery and the importance of building peace.
**Seliph**: If those descended from crusaders were to indulge in the power granted to them by their Brand...
I believe they would be no better than Deadlords.
**Leif**: A crusader's power is to be wielded to aid the powerless. We must not forget that.
We must not allow our descendants to forget either.
**Seliph**: Indeed. A battle between dragons, white and black... A battle that will last into ages unknown.
But we do know that we have inherited the light of the crusaders, and that is enough direction.
**Leif**: We must continue to follow that light. We cannot lose sight of it as our world enters a new age!
Status: Yes!
"You certainly look smart!" "As do you, Prince."
Conversation: **Leif**: A bow, huh...
**Seliph**: Is something the matter, Prince Leif?
**Leif**: Ah, Lord Seliph... Well, I was given a bow to use for the festival tournament.
But because this festival is in honor of the 12 crusaders, I was hoping to wield a lance.
**Seliph**: To emulate your ancestor Njörun, I presume.
**Leif**: Exactly. Altena has a much...stronger connection to her, though.

When I see my older sister astride a wyvern, wielding the Gáe Bolg...
I cannot help but think she is like Njörun reborn.
I'm envious of that, I have to admit. I wish I could carry a divine weapon into battle.
**Seliph**: This envy serves no purpose, Prince Leif. There will always be something one cannot do.
The crusaders' blood is in my veins as well, and yet I cannot use magic the way Julia does.
**Leif**: That's true...
**Seliph**: Even without a divine weapon, your contribution has been great. All are thankful, myself included.

And with the battles you've endured...
there can be no doubt your achievements are worthy of the crusaders of yore.
**Leif**: It means a lot to hear you say that.
You're right. I should focus on making the most of what I do have, rather than dwelling on what I don't.
**Seliph**: Precisely. Now, I'll be looking forward to seeing what you can do with that bow in the tournament.
**Leif**: I won't let you down, Lord Seliph.

julia4.name: Julia
julia4.title: Scion of the Saint
julia4.description: Imperial princess, descended from Saint Heim of the 12 crusaders, and heir to the Book of Naga. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall:
The Book of Naga was once wielded by Saint Heim, but instead of my brother Julius, or Lord Seliph...
...I was the one who inherited it. But...why? Why me?
Thanks to Lord Seliph, I have found meaning in my life. I will strive for the sake of the world and all its people.
The festival will continue for a while longer, so please do not be afraid to get some rest if you become fatigued.
This festival exists to remember the wills of our ancestors and the blood they passed down to us.
For as long as I have known them, Lord Seliph and Lord Leif have been inseparable.
Visit: Oh no... I'm sorry, but I would like to return to [F]'s castle now...
Level: Prayer brings light... And light becomes the white dragon that will vanquish the black dragon!
As one descended from Saint Heim, I will take the book of light and pray to the heavens...
May Naga protect us...
Summon: I am Julia... As a descendant of Saint Heim, I will perform a rite to ensure a wonderful festival.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I appreciate that you thought to give me this.
Confession:
Even though this is a festival...my outfit is not very different from what I normally wear, is it?
Hehe... I thought the same thing. But it seems my usual attire is quite similar to what Saint Heim once wore.
Speaking of similarities... It is curious that our god of light shares her name with a god from other worlds.
Even in worlds beyond my own, darkness is born, and light arrives to chase it away...
I pray that Naga's great purpose transcends worlds...and brings peace to all people.
Special: To bring peace to this land.
Status: This festival is dedicated to the 12 crusaders.
Hm? Oh, you must be excited for the festival, too.
A sacred Brand appears on the body of each direct descendant of a crusader.
Under Saint Heim's great leadership, the people were able to free themselves from the Loptr Empire's control.
Only Naga can be used against the dark god... And I am the only one that can use it.
Where could Lord Seliph—my brother...be? I would like to enjoy the festival with him.
You are unfamiliar with this festival, I think. Allow me to tell you a little about it.

larcei2.name: Larcei
larcei2.title: Scion of Astra
larcei2.description: Daughter of Ayra and descendant of Sword Saint Od of the 12 crusaders. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Astra is an Isaach technique passed down from the Sword Saint Od. This attire should help me hone it further.
Prince Shannan is not attending the festival, so I must protect Lord Seliph in his stead!
I'm well-rested and got plenty to eat—perfect conditions to go out and best any opponent!
I like my clothes as light as possible, since it's easier to move in, but I can make an exception for the festival.

I wonder if the crusaders' original armor still exists...
After all, we still have Balmung and the other weapons, right?
Visit: Come enjoy the Jugdral-themed festivities at the castle of your friend [F]!
Level: My blade is the twinkle of a star... I will drive back the dark with the Astra I inherited from the Sword Saint Od!
Attack, then follow up... I won't forgive anyone who tries to disrupt the festival!
Huh? No, I feel fine... I just need to try harder.
Summon: My name is Larcei, and I vow on the name of Od the Sword Saint to take first place at the festival tournament!
Learn Skill: You want to see what I can do? I suppose I have no choice then.
Confession:
Seeing the sword masters of other worlds, I've realized that, even in this outfit, my legs are still powerful tools.
The air of the battlefield, my foe's intent to kill...I can feel it on my skin. And then my legs carry me forward!
I might not know exactly what the Sword Saint Od wore, but I'm certain he felt the same way.
He probably used his legs to step forward without hesitation—just like this! And...also just like my mother...
Even though I was never able to meet the person her allies knew... I'd like to live up to those memories of her.
Special: Don't treat me like a child!
Status: Today is the festival! Don't worry, I'll make sure you have fun.
Ugh, you need to calm down.
In our land, the crusaders are greatly admired to this day.
I refuse to become an embarrassment to Sword Saint Od... That's why I need to keep sharpening my skills!
Hmm, I wonder if I can master this weapon... No, I WILL master it!
The festival to honor the crusaders... I wish my mother were here to enjoy it with me.
Did you enjoy the festival? I'm glad you could learn more about where I come from.

lewyn2.name: Lewyn
lewyn2.title: Wind-Song Scion
lewyn2.description: Royal of Silesse. A descendant of Ced, one of the legendary 12 crusaders. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Unlike their weapons and tomes, the clothing of the 12 crusaders was lost to time... This is merely a costume.
The legend of the crusaders and the power within their blood are far more than mere legends of the past.

A festival to honor the 12 crusaders chosen by the gods, and to convey their deeds to their descendants...
Oh, to know what they would say if they could see all this!
Hmm... Perhaps I should dedicate a piece to my ancestor. This calls for notes that can soar through the sky...
Those descended from the crusaders will likely lead their countries, serving as guiding lights for their people...
Visit:
I am Lewyn, a friend of [F].
I hope that we can become close as well.
Level: Anyone tactless enough to ruin the festivities should be blown away by the wind!
Behold, the skill of one who has mastered the power of the wind itself!
Cloudy days are another part of life.
Summon: The name's Lewyn. Since I'm a bard, I was asked to sing at this festival. Care to hear a tune or two?
Learn Skill: Worry not. I already know exactly how best to use this.
Confession:
Are you enjoying yourself? Oh, come now! No need for that face—festivals are meant to be enjoyed, after all.
During the war, I wandered the land. Scraps of food, drops of water... I saw people fight bitterly over such things.
But the nobles...they spent all their time vying for power as nothing more than a game—a pointless sport.
Power is necessary, and war is inevitable. But...why? What drives a person to fight?
That question threads throughout the song I wrote for this festival.
If we could answer that question, perhaps the power of the Brands would never again be used for war...
...I can sing it for you now, if you would like to hear it.
Status: I've adorned myself in the manner of the crusader Ced... What do you think? Appropriate?
Ah! Now, I know this is a festival, but do try not to get carried away...
The hearts of those who pursue salvation beat as one, now and always...
If you have any questions about the 12 crusaders, I can answer them.
One moment of happiness at a festival can last a lifetime.
Even now, the world shifts beneath our feet...
I am wind...wind that comes before the light's warmth.

nanna2.name: Nanna
nanna2.title: Mystletainn Scion
nanna2.description: Daughter of Lachesis, the princess of Nordion, and descendant of Hoðr, known as the black knight of the 12 crusaders. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Behold—I am the black knight Hoðr, wielder of the demon sword! Or at least I can pretend to be...
It seems that, no matter the world, the title of "black knight" is a symbol of tremendous strength!
Lord Leif and Lord Seliph... Where are those two headed?
As a member of House Nordion, I must familiarize myself with the etiquette of the Askran kingdom.
This festival is a way to remember the legend of the 12 crusaders' arrival, and how they saved Jugdral.
Visit: I've arrived with greetings, and to wish a you a lifetime of friendship with [F].
Level:
"With the demon sword Mystletainn in hand, I will slay the darkness!"
Hehe, that's one of my lines for the play we'll perform at the festival.
I feel good about this.
How embarrassing... I must focus!
Summon: I am Nanna. I'm taking part in this festival as a descendant of one of the 12 crusaders—the black knight Hoðr.
Learn Skill: Wow, thank you so much! I'll make sure to live up to your expectations.
Confession:
My ancestor was one of the 12 crusaders... Hoðr the black knight.
The black knight... With a title like that, it's easy to think of him as a fearsome warrior...ominous, even.
However, Hoðr was one of the 12— the light that fought and drove away the darkness.
I suspect that his duty to help people was more important to him than any impressions they had of him.
I must etch his ideals onto my heart and follow his example by supporting everyone as best I can.
Status: Are you hurt?
I have your back!
This staff appears to have been modeled after Mystletainn...
Have you seen Lord Leif? I hope to show him my outfit...
I am a descendant of Hoðr, the black knight of the 12 crusaders.
My mother would enjoy this festival too, were she here with us...
I would be honored to accompany you for the festival.

muspell.name: Múspell
muspell.title: Flame God
muspell.description: The god of Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame. His raging personality burns white-hot with a drive toward violence.

Castle Hall: Summoning contract, huh? Then I'm under your command, am I?! Gah-HA! Maybe we are not so different!
Do not ask me of the Kingdom of Múspell. I know nothing of it. Mortals are of no consequence.
That weapon... Let me try it out. Now, now! Don't be stingy! Are we not on the same side?
It doesn't matter who they are— everyone sounds the same when they scream for mercy.
Mortals make little sense. You live only a moment, and yet you worry over the most meaningless trifles.
Visit:
You are in the presence of the god of flame!
...Shouldn't you be making an offering to me?
Level: HAH! More!
Who's next?!
This is the shape of things.
Summon: Master of flame, lord of one realm of the nine... Múspell I am!
Learn Skill: An offering? I see you are beginning to understand how to win my favor.
Confession:
Sit down and listen.
You mortals... You lot have hot blood running through your veins...
But now you use all these blades and armored plates... Pah! What fakery.
Long ago, when the mortals lived uncovered, bare to the elements...
Back then, there was a fire in the bellies of mortals—a fire that could be stoked into a raging flame at my will.
That same fire burns deep within you as well... Let it out! Do as you please! Take what's yours!
If anyone complains, stab them! Let your true nature come forth!
Status: Move, lout.
Or feel my sting.
Master of flame, lord of one realm of the nine... Múspell I am.
You choose death, do you?
Beasts you are, and naked should you all be.
The end comes for you, Nifl. Soon.
Where's the fight in you?! Let's go already!

yuri.name: Yuri
yuri.title: Ashen Valiant
yuri.description: Leader of the Ashen Wolf House. Behind the tough talk lies a valiant defender of the weak. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Those in the church may consider Abyss to be "filthy," but some have no choice but to live underground.
I was meant to join the Blue Lions, but I ended up underground. I have my disagreements with the church.
Don't sit back and do nothing. You'll just end up dying needlessly. That's how it goes in my world, anyway.
I am but an insignificant and beautiful creature. Surely there's nothing I have to offer for your plight.

In this book, I've written down the names of the people I've failed to protect.
I can't let myself forget them. We share the same dream, after all.
Visit: Using me as a messenger boy... You can't help but laugh at [F]'s guts.
Level: Don't forget who you're dealing with.
I'll never be satisfied. *laughs* Who's next?
Well, that's, uh...yeah. Some days are just like this.
Summon: I'm Yuri of the Ashen Wolves. What need might you have of this insignificant and beautiful creature?
Learn Skill: Now that feels good.
Confession:
Strolling through the town, I saw no poverty or squalor anywhere I went. Not bad place to end up!
And the people? So friendly! Almost foolishly so. They called out to me as I passed, smiles on their faces.
Those smiles are fragile things. If war comes to Askr, they'll vanish in an instant, as will these carefree days.
I have no connection to this land. But I don't want to see smiling faces exchanged for sobbing ones.
As long as you keep fighting for these people, so will I.
I should have died of illness, but it seems I have good luck. I'll lend you that luck. Use it well.
Status: You can call me Yuri. You'll want to remember that.
Oh! Whatever you think you heard, I wasn't singing.
When I was young, my mother took in an elderly man. He ended up saving my life.
Are you speechless? Am I that captivating?
Helping people in need is what my gang's about.
I don't even know much about where I come from—or why I have this Crest.
I may not seem like much of a chef, but I know a thing or two about cooking. I could make you something.

constance.name: Constance
constance.title: Fallen Noble
constance.description: Young lady of the fallen Imperial house of Nuvelle. Has an overbearing attitude until she's somewhere with sunlight. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Abyss is home to the Ashen Wolves, those who shun the light of day. It is the secret shadow of Garreg Mach.
Like the gilded wyvern taking refuge in its cave, in time, I too shall soar free and have my nobility restored!
If I may presume to offer my opinion, summoning me was a very keen decision, [S]!
Are you captivated by my charms? Ahahaha! This happens all the time to those of us blessed with such beauty.
Even standing beside such great Heroes, I still shine remarkably... You sense my genius, do you not?
Visit: I trust you have been well? Naturally, I was sent to greet you in [F]'s stead.
Level: I've done it! I've improved on perfection!
There's no masking my splendor.
My next effort shall compensate.
Summon: I'm Constance von Nuvelle! Tremble before my noble magic! Ahahaha!
Learn Skill: What noble power! This will be of use to me in restoring the splendor of House Nuvelle!
Confession:
Oh, it's you! You've arrived at the perfect time, [S]!
I was hoping to speak to you about assisting me in achieving my dream of revitalizing House Nuvelle!
We will wait until the conflict in Askr has concluded, of course, but I then expect your presence in Fódlan.
Are you not willing? Helping me to achieve my dream would be an honor for any—wait! Where are you going?!
Hmm? Oh! The dreadful sunlight is peeking through the clouds! Please...
Please excuse my cavalier behavior... If I have upset you, I request that you please punish me accordingly...
What's this? You grant me forgiveness for the way I spoke? Such words are wasted on me...
Status: I am Constance von Nuvelle. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Ah! Such rudeness is beneath you, surely.
Though House Nuvelle has fallen, it is still every noble's duty to provide for the commonfolk.
Abyssians tend to be the first suspects whenever there is foul play.
Do you have some need of me? I assure you, I am busier than I may seem.
This castle has far too many bright spots. I must be on my guard.
My superior spellcraft is yours.

hapi.name: Hapi
hapi.title: Drawn-Out Sigh
hapi.description: An apathetic young woman whose sighs have the unique ability to draw monsters to her. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You summoned me here to fight, but I don't want to hurt anyone. I guess it can't always be avoided though...
Monsters come running when I let out even the slightest sigh. It's my curse...
The church has rules, dogma. They want us all bound to their system so they can control us. I can't stand it.
You're wasting your time on me. Talk to Yuri-bird, Coco, or B if you want someone you can rely on.
You really did summon me to another world... Even the stars in the sky are different than the ones above Fódlan.
Visit: Hi, I'm Hapi. Don't get too close though. I'll just set this gift from your friend [F] here.
Level: I've come a long way from the young Hapi who left her village so long ago.
That's what you get.
You can work and train as hard as you want, but when your time is up, that's that.
Summon: My name's Hapi. You summoned me here, but...why? I'm not great at fighting, and I'll avoid it if I can.
Learn Skill: For me? Thanks, I'll keep it.
Confession:
I'm originally from a settlement deep in the forest. The village was hidden well enough that no one bothered us.
But I wasn't satisfied with spending my whole life there, so I left to go experience the world.
Soon after, I was caught by some bad people. Maybe I deserved it for abandoning my village...
A lot happened after that, but the Knights of Seiros eventually found me and sent me to Abyss. Now I'm here.
This is better than the monastery though. The people here seem to care about me, or at least pretend to.
I still don't want to fight, but I'll help out where I can. For you, and for the Order of Heroes.
Status: So you're the summoner, huh? I'm Hapi.
Cut that out.
People keep their distance from me. It's easier that way.
I don't have good memories of the church.
Loss can lead to despair. But that's OK. You don't have to be strong all the time.
The kind of world I want doesn't exist.
You're special. I just hope that doesn't get you into trouble.

balthus.name: Balthus
balthus.title: King of Grappling
balthus.description: Former noble who ran away to Abyss due to money problems. Revels in competition as Leicester's King of Grappling. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Whoa! Hilda and the professor are in this world too?! You better not have summoned the debt collectors...
I racked up some debt and made a habit of attracting bounty hunters. That's how I ended up in Abyss.
Yuri, Constance, and Hapi all have their quirks, but they're not bad people. I bet you'll get along just fine.
Don't think I look like a noble? I get that, but you're looking at the head of a minor noble house of the Alliance!
We all have to decide where we belong and then fight for it. Can't let your wallet control your fate.
Visit: Let me hide out here for a little while. Don't ask why! Just do it as a favor for your pal [F]!
Level: It's good to be king.
Fresh out of luck.
Heh. Can't seem to find my footing today...
Summon: The name's Balthus, heir to House Albrecht and the Undisputed King of Grappling. You can count on me!
Learn Skill: Thanks! My arms are throbbing from all that training!
Confession:
I finally made it out of life underground, but now I'm fighting in another world. It's always something!
I guess leading an adventurous life is better than a boring one, but...
On the other hand, I feel like my life might be a little too adventurous, you know what I mean?
Either way, there don't seem to be any debt collectors or bounty hunters after me, so maybe I can relax a little.
While I'm here, I might as well show you what it means to be the Indomitable King of Grappling.
I'll make it so our enemies won't know what hit 'em. Just let me do things my way and we'll be square.
Status: The name's Balthus. Formerly of the Alliance.
Gonna take more than that to get the jump on me, pal.
We all have to decide where we belong and then fight for it.
Bounty hunters are the worst, yeah? They can't just let me be.
If they want a fight, let's give 'em one to remember!
Where do I gotta go to get some gold around here?
You're a busy one, aren't ya? Being a summoner seems like a tough gig.

aelfric.name: Aelfric
aelfric.title: Custodian Monk
aelfric.description: Cardinal of Garreg Mach Monastery who oversees Abyss. Formed the Ashen Wolf House. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: To the Ashen Wolves, I am a mere guardian. I could protect them, but I could not enrich their minds.
Those who dwell in Abyss were chased underground. But do not take that to mean they are criminals.
Yes, I knew Jeralt. When we met, he led the knights of the monastery.
Even if the church or the archbishop consider the existence of Abyss a nuisance, my conviction isn't shaken.
Do... Do you have a desire that grips you? So strongly that you would sacrifice everything?
Visit: I am Aelfric, a monk of the Church of Seiros. I come bearing proof of your tie with [F].
Level: May the goddess's authority rain down on us all, sparing none.
As the goddess wills.
The result was not as I had hoped...
Summon: I am Aelfric, a monk of the Church of Seiros, which has entrusted me with the management of Abyss.
Learn Skill: I will do my very best to meet your expectations.
Confession:
Society requires that each and everyone has a place they belong if they are to lead a fruitful life.
To find that place, one must start by understanding their role and finding support from those around them.
Those who have fallen on hardship, whatever form it may take, must also have a place.
I believe it is my duty to aid those who have been driven underground. I have made this my mission.
I have seen that you are strong— strong enough to make your own place.
If one as strong as you could aid me in creating a place for others... Nothing would please me more.
Status: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Aelfric. The church has granted me custodianship of Abyss.
Ah—did you require something of me?
I believe it is my sacred duty to provide a place for those who have nowhere else to go.
She had a radiant smile...but not for me.
It is my hope that you will live a full life— experiencing the world, fostering strong relationships with people.
Surely there are those you wish you could return to life.
Should you ever require counsel, know that I am here for you, always.

otr.name: Ótr
otr.title: Kingsbrother
otr.description: Adoptive brother of Niðavellir's king, Fáfnir. Worships his brother and supports his ambition.

Castle Hall: Without Fáfnir at my side... everything feels strange.
I'm from Niðavellir, the realm of the dvergar—the land of seiðjárn! This place is nothing in comparison.
I thought you'd be too dull-witted to be as troubled as you appear... Tell me of your woes, if you wish.

*ahem*
...Could you point me to the sweets vendor? You can come along if you wish.
I beg your pardon! I am maintaining my Gullinbursti here. It is intricate machinery! ...H-hey! No touching!
Visit: Hmm... Yes, I see. A lowly creature like yourself... Of course you must be [F]'s friend.
Level: Don't misunderstand. This strength is for my brother—ALL for him.
...Have a complaint?
What a waste of time. You realize this is your fault, I hope.
Summon: My name is Ótr, brother of King Fáfnir of Niðavellir. I am nothing more than that.
Learn Skill: And you expect something in return for this, do you? Hmph.
Confession:
I was only a child when the coup happened. I didn't know what was happening or what to do...
All I knew was that I was in danger, and I needed to leave. So, in the chaos, I grabbed the baby and ran.
My only explanation is that I had occasionally been asked to look after it.
I heard my mother screaming behind me, "No! We must kill the child!" But only a moment later, she was killed...
Killed by the same people they'd asked me to lead into the castle.
Afterward, war broke out, and eventually I came to understand what had happened.
Thinking back on it now, I can't say I should have done anything different.
But all that is in the past now. It's all meaningless at this point. There is only one side to be on: Fáfnir's.
Fáfnir is ALL there is.
Hmph. And who are you to disagree, Summoner?
Status: I am Ótr, King Fáfnir's brother.
You would do well to remember that I detest jokes.
If my brother hadn't found me, I wouldn't be here now. He is everything to me.
Reginn should act more like royalty. Remind her, won't you?
I do not find sweets disagreeable, so if you have any, you can always give them to me. Hm.
Brother, don't leave... Don't leave me alone!
How can you tolerate having me around? I'll never understand you.

sothis3.name: Sothis
sothis3.title: Bound-Spirit Duo
sothis3.description: A mysterious girl who appeared to Byleth only in dreams now joins him in reality for the harvest festival. They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
sothis3.duo:
Grants【Null Follow-Up】to unit and allies within 2 spaces. If unit or any ally within 2 spaces has their Special cooldown count at its maximum value, grants them Special cooldown count-1.
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of odd-numbered turns, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Null Follow-Up】 If unit's Spd > foe's Spd during combat, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Byleth**: Seeing Sothis give thanks for the bountiful harvest... It makes me think man and god may not be so different.
**Byleth**: I find myself paying more attention to Sothis than the festival, but I'm used to looking after others as a professor.
**Sothis**: You're sure to be impressed by my repertoire of tricks and—huh? I'm not supposed to actually trick anyone?
**Sothis**: I saw the strangest thing... It seems someone spared no effort in carving a face into a pumpkin! But...why?

**Sothis**: I'm still not convinced this costume isn't someone's idea of playing a trick on me.
These mortal customs will never cease to elude me...
Visit: **Sothis**: Trick or treat! The harvest festival is in full swing over at your friend [F]'s castle!
Level: **Sothis**: If the goal is to collect sweets, then I won't be satisfied until our pockets are bursting. Look sharp, partner!
**Byleth**: I think we need to focus, Sothis. Let's set the trick-playing aside for now, OK?
**Byleth**: Not much of a treat at all...
Summon: I am Sothis, and this is Byleth. That is quite enough with the pleasantries. We're here for the harvest festival!
Learn Skill: **Byleth**: We give thanks to the land for a bountiful harvest, and we give thanks for lessons learned as well.
Confession:
**Sothis**: Feast your eyes upon our veritable mountain of sweets! I daresay we gathered nearly every piece in Askr!
Everyone gazed in awe when I asked for candy. Has word of my eminence already reached this kingdom?
**Byleth**: Maybe they were surprised to see what appeared to be a child running through the castle unattended.
**Sothis**: Excuse me?! No mortal would be foolish enough to mistake the mighty progenitor god for a mere child!
**Byleth**: I suppose. Child or adult, man or god, what truly matters is that the harvest festival is a time for celebration.
**Sothis**: Truly... In any case, it is rare that you and I do not share corporeal form, so we should make the best of it. Come!
Status: ふふん…
"This attire is...quite odd." "Do you think?"
Conversation: **Sothis**: Mm, I must say, these sweets have fully surpassed even my lofty expectations. I insist you try this one next!
**Byleth**: You eat a lot. I'm not sure I can take much more.

**Sothis**: I suppose I assumed too much of you mortals. Hmph...what a shame.
It's a rare occasion being able to enjoy such a bountiful feast.
Speaking of rarities, it feels quite strange to be...how should I put it? Independent in mind and body.
**Byleth**: That it does.

**Sothis**: Now that I have a corporeal form to call my own, there are many things I have begun to notice for the first time.
One of which is your height.
I must appear a mere child in your shadow. To think that I would be beneath you in stature...
**Byleth**: People may think we're father and daughter.

**Sothis**: Surely you jest!
*sigh* I see that I am no more capable of reading your expressions from outside your mind than I am within.
In any case, I cannot deny that walking around with you like this during the festival is quite entertaining.
Even better, the rest of the world can finally see how delightful I can be!
**Byleth**: Is that how you see yourself?
**Sothis**: What? No! Of course not. I...it is my turn to jest!
**Byleth**: If you say so.
**Sothis**: Good. Now that that's settled, we have more pressing matters to attend to. Our sweets supply seems to have run dry.
In the spirit of the harvest festival, we must venture forth and gather more tasty treats, posthaste!
We should have no trouble getting more candy with costumes as remarkable as these. After all, I am delightful, aren't I?
Duo Skill: "The time for tricks is nigh!" "Let's not be rash."
"The candy is ours." "A noble pursuit indeed!"

mrobin4.name: Robin
mrobin4.title: Fall Reincarnation
mrobin4.description: The body of Chrom's close ally possessed by the Fell Dragon Grima. Is this year's harvest festival doomed? Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: If I had my way, this absurd festival would not exist...since there would be nothing but ruin in my wake.
"Trick or treat?" Pah. Try "the utter destruction of the world, or treat." And I do not have a sweet tooth.

Giving thanks for the harvest? Hmph. Of course you worms would waste time on something so meaningless.
Resources exist to be consumed. It's as simple as that.
Before you play a trick on me, think hard of the consequences. Surely even a worm like you can imagine it.
You think I'm enjoying all this? Perhaps in your complacency you've forgotten the danger you're in.
Visit:
So you're [F]'s friend, hm?
Once I'm done with that worm, I'll continue the harvest here.
Level: The harvest is upon us. Now that I am here, nothing shall be spared from the reaper's scythe.
The only things you will reap are ruin and despair.
You call THIS a bounty?! Pathetic.
Summon: You have some nerve to summon Grima to this harvest festival. Now prepare to learn what true trickery is.
Learn Skill: What I want, I take. Pray this meager offering is enough.
Confession:
It seems you possess a grave misunderstanding of the harvest festival, [S].
You may celebrate nature's bounty, but remember that there are winners and losers in every exchange.
For you to gain something, someone else must lose it. What brings joy to you casts bitter sorrow upon another.
Those without the will or power to resist can only be crushed underfoot. Such is the nature of the harvest.
Now you see the world through the Fell Dragon's eyes. Thus, I ask you: Are you the hunter or the hunted?
Consider well your path. For my part, I will continue to reap the harvest's bounty through ruin and despair!
Status: This outrageous costume was not my idea. Do not ask me about it again.
Listen well, worm... This may be a festival, but do not use it as occasion to wriggle your way closer to me.
The propensity of humans to while away their days in pointless frivolity is a deficiency I will never comprehend.
I find it ironic that a "harvest" festival should be celebrated not by the predator, but by the prey.
Help me recover the rest of my memories...and I'll consider tossing a few pieces of candy your way.
I am Grima... I am despair... And I...am not enjoying this festival...
You may enjoy the festival as much as you wish... So long as you remember there is a price for wasting my precious time.

rhea2.name: Rhea
rhea2.title: Witch of Creation
rhea2.description: Archbishop who guides the Church of Seiros. Donning a witch costume, she has come to enjoy all Askr's harvest festival has to offer. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I quite like this costume...but Seteth would surely say it is lacking in decorum if he ever caught sight of it.
In Fódlan, the Horsebow Moon marks a time of harvest and savoring the many blessings of the goddess.

All who share in the harvest's bounty are welcome. Those who would spurn such gifts, however...
They must be educated accordingly.
I may be unfamiliar with trickery, but I shall do my best to live up to this costume. Now...how do witches act?

It does the spirit good to see Heroes from so many worlds coming together to celebrate the harvest.
I am glad to count myself among them.
Visit:
I have heard that you are a good friend to [F].
May the bounty of the goddess ever provide.
Level: From the bottom of my heart, I am grateful for this season's bounty.
It may be some time before I can succeed in playing a trick...
We must always help others in their darkest hour—for how else can we expect others to help us in kind?
Summon: I am Rhea, archbishop of the Church of Seiros. I come dressed as a witch to celebrate the harvest festival.
Learn Skill: This bounty serves to illuminate the path forward.
Confession:
I was truly elated to receive an invitation to the harvest festival, [S].
The people of Askr may not worship the goddess, but they give thanks for nature's bounty all the same.
Whether by the goddess's grace or our own hands, the harvest we reap ensures our continued prosperity.
It pleases me to see that this truth is alive and well even outside of Fódlan.
We must continue to guide others so that the smiles brought by this bounty never disappear.
Today was a valuable reminder of gratitude and joy that I shall treasure for many years to come.
Status: I'm dressed as a witch. *chuckle* Would you like me to cast a spell on you?
You're as excitable as a child. How darling!
This is a harvest festival, so let us begin by giving our thanks to the goddess.
I adore seeing everyone in their harvest festival costumes. They seem to be enjoying themselves.
Eating sweets can calm the spirit.
What a lively festival... Hm. My mother would be pleased to see it.
I wish to stroll the festival with you. Would you indulge me?

kurthnaga.name: Kurthnaga
kurthnaga.title: Autumn Goldoan
