kurthnaga.description: The prince of the dragon tribe of Goldoa. Intent on using the harvest festival as a chance to build amicable relations with other peoples. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: It is wonderful to see the joy that a bountiful harvest brings. If only my siblings were here to join me...
I hear some of the Greil Mercenaries participated in past harvest festivals. That must have been quite the sight.

I see a pack of monsters up ahead! Stay back, [S]!
...Oh. It appears they are simply costumed revelers. My mistake.
My father often speaks fondly of his time livening up the harvest festival. I must follow in his footsteps.
It's hard to tell when a trick goes too far...but I have a feeling my dragon form would frighten the children.
Visit: I am Kurthnaga, Prince of Goldoa. The harvest festival is brightening [F]'s castle.
Level: I must say, I am growing rather fond of seeing everyone's reactions to my costume.
Oh, did I frighten you? My apologies. Such was not my intention.
My apologies... It seems I let my excitement get the better of me. This is my first harvest festival, you see.
Summon: I am Kurthnaga, Prince of Goldoa. It is a pleasure to finally see the harvest festival my father spoke so highly of.
Learn Skill: Beorc and laguz... The harvest's bounty is a gift for all.
Confession:
I must thank you for your kind invitation to the harvest festival, [S].
Askr's bounty is evident in the sounds of celebration that fill the air.
More importantly, that chorus of voices counts beorc, laguz, and even gods among its number.
Due to our strength, the dragon tribe severed relations with the outside world in order to maintain balance.
This festival has taught me that there is wisdom in looking beyond our own borders—a lesson I will take to heart.
Status: Thank you for inviting me to your harvest festival.
*startled sound* Is this your way of frightening people?
I am unused to garments of this kind. Is my appearance acceptable?
The confections of this world come in so many wondrous colors.
I have considered asking my father for sweets, but...perhaps I better not.
To see beorc and laguz living amongst each other in harmony... I feel as if I have strayed into a dream.
I passed by some delicious looking food earlier. Would you partake with me?

sophia2.name: Sophia
sophia2.title: Cobweb Prophet
sophia2.description: A half-dragon priestess from Nabata. She has come to the harvest festival accompanied by her spider friend. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: The harvest festival is a chance for everyone to get to know each other... So...why do some insist on fighting?
We...never did anything like this back in my village in Nabata, so all of this is...quite the shock.
At first...I was taken aback by this outfit. But now that I've worn it for a while...it has grown on me.
Festivals may end...but their spirits live on. Gratitude for the land's bounty will light the path forward.
Trickery, you say? Oh... I don't think I have it in me. Have you asked Fae? I'm certain...she would love all this.
Visit:
You are [F]'s friend...right?
My name is Sophia. This is...a token of the land's bounty.
Level: I feel light-headed, but...in a good way this time.
I foresee that my trick will succeed...
Oh, my... Did I truly frighten you? My apologies.
Summon: I am...Sophia, a priestess from the Nabata Desert. My vision of this festival is one of gratitude and joy.
Learn Skill: I must give thanks for the land's generosity...and for yours. I will etch this feeling into my heart.
Confession:
When I received an invitation to this festival...I began to experience visions of people laughing and smiling...
Now that I have spent time with other festivalgoers, it is clear that they were the ones whom I saw.
In the remote Nabata Desert, I lived away from the wider world, unaware of anything beyond its borders.
But...this festival has shown me that the world is an amazing place, filled with amazing people.
I am glad to have had the chance to see so many new, smiling faces. It...truly means a lot to me.
Status: I've been told...this is for the harvest festival...
Oh... Candy? ...For me? How kind of you...
Are spiders...scary enough?
Fae will be looking forward to sweets...so I will do my best for her...
The festival atmosphere is certainly infectious... What fun...
The festival lights twinkle...like little stars...
I...had some extra candy, so...I thought we could share.

fjorm4.name: Fjorm
fjorm4.title: Ice Ascendant
fjorm4.description: Princess of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. A woman who keeps much of her thoughts to herself. She has become a champion of Nifl, god of ice, and so has been granted a portion of her power.

Castle Hall: So much time has passed since I first came to Askr. I have such fond memories of my time here.
My brother and the people of Nifl are working so hard to restore our homeland and bring happiness to all.
I am glad to spend time with you again. Oh, I didn't really mean anything by that. I'm just happy.
Please, allow me to continue to repay my debt to you. That is my wish.
This weapon is the power of Nifl, the god of ice, crystallized. To wield it is an immense honor.
Visit: I am Fjorm of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. I hope you will continue to treat [F] well.
Level: For [S]!
Slowly but surely, step by step.
Not again... I'm sorry.
Summon: I am Fjorm, clad in the armor of the champion of Nifl, god of ice. I am pleased to rejoin your side.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will strive even harder now.
Confession:
I have come to understand that Lady Nifl was close to Queen Hvergel, my ancestor.
I have also come to understand something about losing someone you care about...
I have a request for you, [S].
Please, allow me to protect you from any enemy that may seek to harm you—from across all the nine realms.
Even if I must sacrifice myself to do it, I will ensure your safety.
Status: This weapon and armor were granted to me by the great Nifl, god of ice.
Ah! Please, do not startle me like that! *pause* I'm glad to see you're the same as ever.
A power bestowed by a god... Am I truly worthy to bear such a thing?
I wonder how Princess Laegjarn felt at that moment... I can't even imagine it.
I will give my life to repay your kindness.
I know it may not seem it, but Lady Nifl is actually very kind.
Being here with you again... I couldn't ask for anything more.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.title: Coyote's Loyal
wolf.description: Leader of the Coyote's Men of Aurelis. He has pledged an oath of loyalty to Hardin. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: The true hero of the War of Shadows is Lord Hardin. Without Aurelis, Marth wouldn't have ever raised his army.
The land of Aurelis belonged to the plains people. Lord Hardin reclaimed that pride for us!
I see there are many archers of some skill here, but I am confident none can best me in mounted archery.

The secret to the Coyote's Men's strength is our trust in one another.
Vyland takes the front lines, Roshea watches his back, and Sedgar acts as my right hand.
I've been tanning leather since I was a child. The key to quality lies in how much of the oil and fat you brush off.
Visit: I am Wolf, commander of the Coyote's Men. I've heard a lot about you from [F].
Level: There! Did you see it? That was the technique of a plainsman of Aurelis!
I am the leader of the knights of Aurelis. And your head...is mine!
Argh! I cannot allow Lord Hardin to see me like this!
Summon:
I am Wolf, leader of the knights of Aurelis. We are none other than the Coyote's Men.
Now, prepare to witness how people of the plains fight!
Learn Skill: I'm aware of what this means. Expect much from me.
Confession:
Aurelis belonged to the people of the plains...and then the Archaneans arrived and claimed it was theirs.
We were told that some man from another country was our king and were expected to simply fall in line.
I do not know what kind of person the king truly is, but I do know this: He is not one of us.
And with a frail body like that... Perhaps even he could sense he would never be able to lead us.
But his younger brother, Lord Hardin... He proved his strength to us and earned our respect!
His future...is surely bright, isn't it, [S]?
...No, forget I asked. I am Wolf, of the Coyote's Men. For now, my duty is to fight alongside you on the battlefield.
Status: I'm Wolf—leader of the Coyote's Men.
Stop fooling around.
Sedgar can always calm me down. That's a talent I appreciate.
I will die at Lord Hardin's side. I made a vow.
Dying at Adria Pass would have been so much easier...
The life Lord Hardin gave me...must fulfill its purpose.
I won't abandon you.

roshea.name: Roshea
roshea.title: Coyote's Faithful
roshea.description: Member of the Coyote's Men of Aurelis. After the War of Shadows, he retired from the army but eventually returned to the field. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I had hoped to never again have reason to fight...

I was compensated for more than I deserved after the War of Shadows...
I left the military not long after and donated that money to an orphanage.
I owe a great debt to Lord Hardin. The artistocrats of Aurelis subjugated my people until he freed us.

I'm a little surprised by how relaxed everyone in Askr is, even in the midst of fierce battles.
That must speak to just how prepared everyone truly is...and how ready you must be to survive such conflicts.
I'm writing a letter, but...is there a way to send it to the realm I was summoned from?
Visit: I am Roshea, of the knights of Aurelis. Is [S] here? This is from [F]!
Level: I'll try to do even better next time!
I don't wish to fight, but... If it's for my brothers, I will!
That...wasn't very good, was it?
Summon: I am Roshea, of the knights of Aurelis. I've mostly avoided actual battles, but I think we will work well together.
Learn Skill: All right, let's do this!
Confession:
I understand well how Wolf feels, for I was the same. We were determined to fight for Aurelis, for our future...
But, no matter our intentions, sadness was born as a result of our actions. It's an unavoidable truth of war.
Every soldier you see on a battlefield has someone—be it parent, sibling, or even child—praying for their safety.
The king of Aurelis was frail, so he vested all of his power and faith in his younger brother, Hardin.
It was no doubt the wisest decision, but the king still showed great courage by doing it so swiftly.
After all, everyone has the potential to become a tyrant after gaining power—as Archanea can attest to.
But the courage to let go of that power... That is a rare and truly amazing thing.
I do not wish for the Coyote's Men to follow the mistaken path Coyote went down.
Heh, and you might call me naive for it, but I also wish he had not lost his way in the first place.
Status: I'm Roshea of the knights of Aurelis. You have my support.
Wh— Hey! Is that how you...express kindness here?
In Aurelis, my comrades and I are known as the Coyote's Men.
I could never have believed Lord Marth's goal was conquest.
Vyland might be swayed as well, if my words reach him.
Are we in the right?
I believe your heart is just. My strength is yours to wield.

malice.name: Malice
malice.title: Deft Sellsword
malice.description: A capable mercenary who works together with her father, Dice, who in turn loses most of their earnings gambling. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: That jackass said I would look good in a dress! Next time he screws with me like that, he's a dead man. Got it?
My father is a skilled mercenary, but a lousy gambler. Sure as hell doesn't stop him from tryin', though.

I've watched my father lose enough times to know the score—the house always wins. Everyone else? Losers.
If that's your thing, just make sure it doesn't get outta hand.
I just want my old man to be happy. Money lost to bets can be earned back, but there's no replacin' him.

Of course you can't make sense of my techniques. It's not like they're proper "martial style" or whatever.
It's all just for show—movements meant to dazzle the untrained eye.
Visit: The name's Malice. I'm [F]'s merc. ...Oh yeah, I was told to give you this.
Level: If you want me to keep working, I'm gonna need to see some coin. Let's say...590 gold. That'll do the trick.
Long as you keep paying, I'll keep workin'. Simple as that.
Damn it... Botched the landing.
Summon: I'm Malice. My sword doesn't come cheap, so I hope whoever's in charge here has their finances in order.
Learn Skill: Hell yeah! I'd expect no less from ya. Misers are no fun to work with.
Confession:
You never thought twice about a woman like me choosing the sellsword life, did you?
Normally, people can't help sayin' something. But it's not all bad...
Hell, one time someone told me that my blade danced like shooting stars!
Can you believe that? No matter what world you're in, I guess some people just have a way with words...
I'm not one of 'em, so I'll keep it simple: I'll follow you wherever you go. It's fun keepin' ya company.
But in return... Let's see, what should I have you do?
...Got it. I want you to praise me more, [S].
The words that spill outta your mouth aren't half-bad, so feel free to get started right away!
Status: I'm Malice, a mercenary. Want to hire me? It don't come cheap.
Hey now! What do you think you're doing?
I try to save up, but...the moment the money comes in, it goes back out again. My old man and his gambling...
Ogma? That man saved us. He gave us food when we were dyin'.
Got a question for ya. Is Prince Alfonse good about paying people what they're owed?
Hmmm... If I want to eat tomorrow, I've got to get my hands on some money today...
Nah, I don't mind showing you how I swing a sword. Hell, I won't even charge ya.

vyland.name: Vyland
vyland.title: Coyote's Justice
vyland.description: Member of the Coyote's Men of Aurelis. To him, Wolf, Sedgar, and Roshea are considered to be nothing less than brothers. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: As a warrior of Aurelis, I have sworn to fight and die for my country.

If departing from Archanea, the plains of Aurelis lie beyond Lefcandith Valley.
The surrounding mountains form a natural stronghold mighty enough to deter most outsiders.
When was the last time you rested? You should take this chance to do so, before the exhaustion builds up.

There is certainly no lack of sparring partners in this castle, and all of them are experienced warriors.
I want to grow as strong as they are.
I'm off to take my horse out for a run. If you have time, would you like to ride it?
Visit: I am Vyland, of the knights of Aurelis. I have greetings from your friend [F].
Level: As long as we are here, we must never give up any ground.
That went well! It seems we've gotten used to working together.

If you wish for your foe to crumble, wear them down by attacking and withdrawing before they can react.
That is the most effective way to fight that I know of.
Summon: I am Vyland, of the knights of Aurelis. I am good at leading the charge, so do not hesitate to ask anything of me.
Learn Skill: Hmm... I understand. I would like to learn more from you later about how we will fight from now on.
Confession:
The Coyote's Men crossed countless battlefields, ignoring wind and rain, and Hardin always led the charge.
The reason Marth's army was able to defeat Dolhr... It was undeniably thanks to him.
I sometimes wonder, though... Coyote is a courageous man, but is joining Archanea truly for the best?
Wolf and the others have no such qualms. Lord Hardin is our hero.
To the people of the plains, he is hope itself. Hope for a better Aurelis.
...I am a warrior of Aurelis. To fight to the end as one of the Coyote's Men... That is all I wish for.
Status: I am Vyland of Aurelis, one of the Coyote's Men.
Oh? There's no need to be so crude.
Among the Coyote's Men, Roshea has always been the kindest of us all.
It was Lord Hardin that freed us from slavery.
Lord Hardin has...changed. It's as if he has become a completely different man...
The truth is... I don't know. I just don't know what I should do.
Will you continue to fight beside me?

sedgar.name: Sedgar
sedgar.title: Coyote's Dutiful
sedgar.description: Second in command of the Coyote's Men of Aurelis. Alongside Wolf, he fights with the pride of the plains people. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall:
Lord Hardin freed the people of the plains from slavery and gave us weapons.
No one had ever so much as looked our way before that.

So the lost prince mustered up his strength and rebuilt his homeland...
Who do you think really made that happen?! The prince certainly wasn't up to the task, I'll tell you that much.

The bonds between those of us in the Coyote's Men are strong.
Whether it be in Grust or Macedon, we can face anyone if the battle is held on an open field.

When it comes to horseback battles, none can best Wolf.
He can tame and ride even the unruliest of horses and makes deft use of any weapon he touches.

You shouldn't need the help of others to maintain your own weapons. That being said...
I was the best at it, so I'm no stranger to repairing my team's weapons— especially Wolf's bow.
Visit: I am Sedgar, of the knights of Aurelis. I was told to give you this by [F].
Level: Moving in perfect unison to deliver a flurry of strikes... None can withstand a joint attack from the Coyote's Men!
I care not what justification they might try to use... I can never forgive those who invade another's land.
I suppose I shall ride even more fiercely next time.
Summon: Sedgar, of Aurelis's cavalry. You may have heard of us—the Coyote's Men. We are unmatched on the open field.
Learn Skill: You went out of your way to do this...for me? You have my thanks.
Confession:
Wolf, Roshea, and Vyland... We are the backbone of the Coyote's Men, and they are like brothers to me.
We rode across the battlefield and fought at Lord Hardin's side, crushing every formation we came across.
Even against the knights of Grust's Sable Order, or Macedon's Dragoons, defeat felt as if it were impossible.
We had overwhelming mobility on the ground and could shoot down anything in the sky. We were...strong.
None could deny our power, but... In our ambition, we lost sight of what matters.
And not just us, but him as well...
Status: Sedgar, of the Coyote's Men. Pleased to meet you.
*chuckle* A little rough-housing never hurt anyone.
Believe it or not, I used to think Prince Marth was an entitled brat.
I knew about Lord Hardin's ambition, but for a time there was nothing I could do.
Wolf has quite a temper. I wish he understood the pressure it puts on me to rein him in.
Painful as it may have been...there was no other choice.
I can think of no better way to atone for my past than to remain steadfastly by your side.

fae3.name: Fae
fae3.title: Childlike Dragon
fae3.description: Young Divine Dragon who has lived her life hidden in Nabata. She is loved and revered as the guardian of Arcadia. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Fae isn't my real name, you know! It's actually— Oh, right. You can't hear it! Well, it's really, really long!
The outside world is great! After just seeing the same thing forever, this makes it all worth it!
Are you busy? I can help too! Don't forget it, all right?
If I stay out of trouble, you'll keep giving me head pats, right? Heehee!
I'm bored of being stuck inside the castle... Let's explore outside! Bet I can get there before you!
Visit:
Hey, you're friends with [F], right?
In that case, you're my friend too!
Level: I still keep on growing... I wonder how strong I'll be when I'm finally all grown up!
Don't mess with me! RAWR!
Wh-what happened?
Summon: I'm Fae, Legendary Hero! Sounds like a pretty big deal, right? ...Er, can you tell me what it means?
Learn Skill: Aw! For me? Yay!
Confession:
♪Hmm-hm-hmmm♪Oh! There you are, [S]!
You aren't busy...right?
Then how about a pat on the head?
Heehee! You're the best, [S]!
With head pats like these, I might just have to stick around forever!
Status: Come on! Come on! We're gonna play all day!
Why are you patting me on the head? Did I do something good? *giggle*
Legendary Hero? That sounds like a big deal! What is it?
You seem really busy. Here, let me help!
There are so many pretty ladies in the castle! I hope I can grow up to be just like them!
Am I going to stay a kid forever? Hmm...
Let's play together, forever and ever! Promise?

fcorrin6.name: Corrin
fcorrin6.title: Nightfall Ninja Act
fcorrin6.description: Princesses of Nohr, Corrin and Elise. Dressed in Hoshidan ninja garb, they have infiltrated the ninja festival in secret. They appear in Fire Emblem Fates.
fcorrin6.duo: Grants unit another action. (May be used only if unit has already entered combat during the current turn.)

Castle Hall: **Elise**: You stand before Elise—master of secrecy and she who vanishes within the umbra of the Nohrian dusk...
**Corrin**: Elise was really excited to learn about Hoshidan customs, so I decided to tag along on her little adventure.
**Elise**: Oooh, I bet a shuriken-shaped cake would be a fun baking challenge... Wait, no—I need to focus right now!
**Corrin**: You wanted to know what ninja training was like, Elise, so no slacking off. Keep up the pace! Feel that burn!
**Elise**: Ninja can hold their breath to avoid detection for....HOW long?! Well, here goes nothing. Deep breath!
Visit:
**Elise**: Hi! I'm Elise, and this is Corrin! We're friends of [F].
What's your name? Tell me all about yourself!
Level: **Elise**: Hiyah! Refrain from approaching me carelessly, lest you find yourself on the pointy end of a shuriken, evildoer!
**Corrin**: I will see Elise home safely, no matter what!
**Elise**: Aww, don't sweat it. I know you'll get 'em tomorrow!
Summon: I'm Corrin, and this is Elise. Hm? Oh, we're seeing what it's like to play the part of ninja right now...
Learn Skill: **Elise**: Wow, this is gonna be great! Thanks so much, [S]!
Confession:
**Elise**: Hey, Big Sis, guess what! We're not ninja after all! Well, we kinda are, but...it's complicated, I guess?
Turns out that some ninja are called "kunoichi!" Isn't that WAY cooler? Let's be those instead!
**Corrin**: "Kunoichi," huh? Now that you mention it, I think I've heard Kagero use that term once or twice before...
**Elise**: Kunoichi are supposed to be super- sneaky, so we gotta lose all this gear! Lemme untie this and loosen that...
**Corrin**: H-hold on a minute, Elise! You can't just do that outside of your room!
**Elise**: WHEW, that sash was tight! We've gotta get stronger, so let's chow down like there's no tomorrow!
**Corrin**: Haha! You're a real handful, Elise, but I wouldn't have it any other way.
Special: **Duo**: Time to land... The final blow!
Status: ふふっ
"That outfit looks good on you, Elise." "*giggle* Thank you! I'm glad you like it."
Conversation: **Elise**: Soul-Shredding Shuriken! Hyah!
**Corrin**: Um, Elise... What are you doing?
**Elise**: Huh?! Drat, you spotted me... This is supposed to be my secret training!
**Corrin**: Why do you need secret training?
**Elise**: Because the ninja festival is today!
I really need to work on my ninja skills if I wanna be as strong as Saizo and Kagero.
**Corrin**: Well, that explains all the shuriken stuck in the walls...
You never cease to amaze me, Elise. Your dedication to growing stronger really knows no bounds!
**Elise**: I don't need to be the strongest, but I need to be able to hold my own.
I know I'm kind of the runt of the litter...
**Corrin**: That's not true. If you ask me, you're the strongest of us all.
**Elise**: You don't mean that!
**Corrin**: Don't I? The reason you train so hard is to help protect us, right?
That selflessness is what gives you your strength. I'm proud to call you my little sister.
**Elise**: Aw, Corrin... Thank you! You're the best sister a girl could ask for!
**Corrin**: I suppose all that's left is to work on our ninja skills. I bet we could learn a lot from each other.
**Elise**: Yeah, let's do it! Concealed Chameleon Crawl!

igrene2.name: Igrene
igrene2.title: Ninja of Nabata
igrene2.description: Daughter of Hawkeye and protector of Nabata. She appreciates the utility of the ninja garb and the mobility it grants. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Ninja are essentially spies, right? If I am to play the part, I'd better be careful to avoid detection.
I wonder... Are ninja similar to the spies of Ostia or the assassins of the Black Fang? Or, perhaps both?
Are you getting enough rest? You should always be ready to head out for battle, even at a moment's notice.
This outfit is quite impressive. I feel even more nimble than usual in it.
Katana, kunai, shuriken... These weapons are all so interesting.
Visit:
Are you [S]?
I have a confidential message for you from [F].
Level: Hm, did I get a little too carried away? How embarrassing...
Find an opening, and then strike it in an instant... Perhaps archers and ninja are more alike than I thought.
Is...that it?
Summon: I am Igrene, a guardian of Nabata, the place I call my home. I hear this outfit is perfect for stealth missions.
Learn Skill: I won't let you down.
Confession:
So, how did I fare in that last battle? I was worried about fighting without my bow, but I think I did well enough.
I suppose that means I am becoming accustomed to all of this, but I still have much to learn...
Speaking of which, I have heard that female ninja are called "kunoichi."
Surely the Order of Heroes has its own detachment of spies, right?
I'm well aware of the danger that comes with the role, but...I want to support the Order from the shadows.
Perhaps then, I might come closer to understanding how my late husband felt while he worked...
Status: It's interesting to wear an outfit from so far beyond Nabata.
Another attempt at teasing me? One of these days, you'll need to act your age.
How long has it been since I've used anything other than a bow?
The children flock to me every time I come by in this outfit. They want me to strike poses for them.
This may be just a festival to some, but I see it as a chance to learn.
The more I learn about ninja, the more I wonder... Were these the kinds of things he had to do?
I will be your shadow, ever vigilant against those who would do you harm.

shinon2.name: Shinon
shinon2.title: Sharptongue Ninja
shinon2.description: A skilled sniper, but...also a ninja? A man who values competence more than anything, and is not afraid to say so. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Let's get this out of the way now: don't expect me to play nice. That's just not my style.
Stealth, huh? An arrow is perfect for that—catch someone unaware and you can end them in an instant.
This outfit fits a little TOO well... You didn't have a ninja investigate me, did you?
Heading out to patrol the castle, huh? In that case, I'm coming with. Just think of me as your shadow.
You leave yourself wide open. If I was an enemy, you'd have been riddled with arrows ages ago.
Visit:
I have a message for you from [F].
...Got it? Good. And not one word about this outfit.
Level: Bah! It's just one thing after another with you people... Don't even bother trying to run—you're mine now.
Maybe being a ninja ain't so bad after all. Huh? Oh, I was just...talking to myself. You heard nothing, got it?
Damn it... Did I draw too much attention?
Summon: I'm Shinon. Hm? This outfit? Uh... Listen, I'm on a covert mission. This ain't how I usually dress, I swear!
Learn Skill: You sure my skills aren't too flashy? Well, if you're fine with this, I'm certainly not gonna complain about it.
Confession:
This is a Hoshidan festival... So why the heck did you rope me of all people into it?
Ridiculous as it is, guess I can't deny that it's been a learning experience. ...Not like I wanted it, though. Haha!
But y'know, even if I still can't say I totally get what makes ninja tick, I do feel a bit closer to them now.
Ranged mercs need to stay quiet and inconspicuous if we want to survive out there, after all.
Bah! You're one of only two people whose requests I'd be willing to hear out. So...what's next?
Status: Why are you forcing me to join this stupid festival, anyway?
You're so clingy. How'd you like it if I kept tapping you all day?
You don't have to be quiet to take out enemies quietly. You just have to make sure no one lives to rat you out.
Gatrie seems to think this outfit would help him get a date. Can he wear it instead?
Wait, you think my long hair gets in the way of combat? Get lost.
Festivals are supposed to be fun. So why am I stuck here working?
I don't work for scraps. If you want my help, you better make it worth my time.

mcorrin5.name: Corrin
mcorrin5.title: Daylight Ninja Act
mcorrin5.description: A ninja torn between the kingdoms of Hoshido and Nohr. He is participating in the festival in the garb of the Hoshidan ninja clans. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
"I am Corrin, silent as a whisper and subtle as the shadows themselves."
...Well? How did that one sound?
In Hoshido, ninja also serve as spies. Whenever I hear "ninja," I always think of Kaze, Saizo, and Kagero.
Oops, you spotted me! I was trying my best to stay hidden, but it looks like I've still got a lot to learn.
I sent some traditional outfits to my siblings in Nohr as a sort of cultural exchange. Elise sounded so excited!
How does Saizo appear out of thin air like that? I should ask him to teach me the trick behind it...
Visit: This is from [F]. I hope the two of you continue to get along.
Level: This is going pretty well, huh? Maybe I should try becoming a real ninja!
Mission accomplished. On to the next target...
Seems I got a little carried away...
Summon: I'm Corrin. This is the outfit worn by Hoshido's covert ninja. Oh, but don't worry—I'm just here for the festival!
Learn Skill: As you command!
Confession:
I once heard that samurai serve at their lord's side, while ninja serve from the shadows.
But that is hardly unique to Hoshido. Leveraging the talents of each warrior is the key to success in Nohr as well.
I wonder... Is this festival a way for us to see how the other side lives? If so, our ancestors were indeed wise.
I still have much to learn about my birthplace, but I'm going to study as hard as I can every day.
I look forward to your counsel and friendship both during this festival, and after, [S].
Special: Did I catch you off guard?
I will see this mission through!
Status: This is the garb of Hoshidan ninja. Does it suit me well?
Whoa! To think I let you sneak up on me... What a rookie mistake.
I was born in Hoshido but raised in Nohr, so I'm glad for the chance to learn more about my birthplace's culture.
Elise sure gets a kick out of this whole ninja thing, huh? They're a rarity in Nohr, so I guess it makes sense.
Every time I try to practice blending into a crowd, one of my siblings shouts a greeting at me...
I hope to someday match Kaze's shuriken skill... He makes it look so cool!
"I would die before failing you, master!" Heh. Do I sound like a real ninja yet?

shamir2.name: Shamir
shamir2.title: Lone-Moon Ninja
shamir2.description: A knight of Seiros who lived as a mercenary in her past. She carries out her duties, speaking no more than is necessary—a perfect quality for a ninja. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: My family had too many mouths to feed when I was a kid, so I left. I joined some mercs for the pay.
Fódlan and now Askr both prove that where people gather, schemes follow. There's no light without dark...
You've been sluggish lately. Get some rest and don't let me catch you off guard again.
I don't avoid unsavory company. To understand someone, you have to see the world through their eyes.
I've made a living tracking down and taking out targets. That won't change anytime soon.
Visit: I'm working, so I'll keep this short. [F] says hello.
Level: I've far and away exceeded the terms of our agreement. I'll return later to collect.
I've trained to control my breathing and mask my presence. I'm good, but I could always be better.
I faltered in a moment of weakness. I...I saw an insect on the battlefield.
Summon: The name's Shamir. Does everyone here dress like this? Never mind. I'll wear it, as long as I get paid.
Learn Skill: You trust me to use this on my missions? I appreciate the vote of confidence.
Confession:
What's the point of this outfit? It hasn't helped me in battle, but it hasn't hindered my work either.
I suppose it doesn't matter, as long as I get paid. I'm not usually picky about jobs I take, but this place isn't ideal.
It could use some more level-headed Heroes who don't follow the royals and nobles with blind zeal.
You think I want to leave? Are you thick? I want to stay and help make that change. I won't say it again.
Status: I've been told that this is what ninja wear. It might take some getting used to.
I warned you against that before, didn't I?
I understand that ninja specialize in undercover operations behind enemy lines.
This gear is different from what I'm used to, but I'll make it work.
Everyone is distracted by the festival. Should make my job much easier.
I'm prepared to take on most any job, for the right price.
You should keep your distance if you plan to leave in one piece.

laegjarn4.name: Laegjarn
laegjarn4.title: Flame Ascendant
laegjarn4.description: Princess of Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame. Friend to Fjorm. She has become a champion of Múspell, God of Flame, wreathed in the power of Múspell's fire.

Castle Hall: It is hard to believe that I, after losing my life, would join Askr's fight.
I wonder what has befallen our land, Múspell. My thoughts turn to my sister. Is Laevatein all right?
Princess Fjorm is my friend. If the time comes when I must fight her...
I have no great talent as a warrior... Having said that, I do believe I may be of some aid with your campaign.
In life, my sister was my sole ally. To have a friend... It is something I had never considered.
Visit: I am Laegjarn, a general in the army of [F]. Greetings.
Level: I will fight using my own strength, not that of the flame dragon Múspell.
I am Laegjarn, warrior sworn to [S]!
I must get stronger...for Fjorm's sake as well.
Summon: I am Laegjarn. My guise may be of one bound to serve the flame dragon Múspell, but my will is my own.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks. I will demonstrate my newfound strength to you.
Confession:
The desire to protect someone dear... It is a wellspring of strength, and it alone sustained me as I fought.
Princess Fjorm, a friend without equal, has also become dear to me. So I must ask you this...
What are your feelings toward the princess? And have you considered her feelings?
In truth, it is not my place to say even this much, but I will add just one thing.
Any who treat her feelings lightly will have to answer to me. You would do well to consider this.
Status: Múspell, god of flame, has forged me again. Stronger.
What was that? Don't think I will go easy on you.
Chosen by a god... It is no different than being cursed.
Being brought low is nothing new to me. I have learned to live with abasement.
Tell me truthfully. What is the nature of your relationship with Princess Fjorm?
Fjorm, one day... We...
If Princess Fjorm desires it, I shall lend you my strength.

volke.name: Volke
volke.title: Man of Mysteries
volke.description: A man who makes his living as part of the criminal underworld, answering to no one. Also occasionally referred to as "fireman." Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: As a rule, I don't join up with others. I prefer to work alone.

Death only marks your loss, and our enemy's gain. It grants you nothing.
If there is something you want, make sure to survive.
I'm here by choice...for now. Why? The answer to that will cost you 100,000 gold.
Stoking embers is useless. There's a reason I'm called "fireman"—I put out problems.
Gathering intel is a specialty of mine. Give me three days, and I'll know more about this country than you do.
Visit: I'm here on business. Don't ask questions.
Level: Time for me to leave. Any more than this will draw too much attention.
Results like this don't make money.
Might be time to look for another job.
Summon: I'm Volke. It doesn't seem like you have work for me right now, but...you know how to reach me.
Learn Skill: You're a good one. Guess this means you feel the same about me.
Confession:
My work? If I have to answer, I'd say I do whatever's asked of me—but only if the pay is good enough.
I'd probably even take a job to assassinate you. Not like it'd be hard, given this castle's defenses.
That's not a threat. It's just how committed I am to my contracts.
Lucky for you, I never take two jobs at once, and I never quit a job early.
The smartest move you could make now is hire me first. Doesn't matter to me what the job is.
...I see. Only reason I brought it up is your skills have probably made you no few enemies, but suit yourself.
Status: I'm Volke. I solve problems.
This doesn't interest me.
My occupation? You could say I'm in... intelligence.
Tell the barkeep you've need of a fireman. You'll see me within an hour.
You want to know why I need money, do you? 100,000 gold. That's what it will cost you for me to answer that question.
Greil's death was unfortunate and unexpected.
Interested in taking on my kind of work? You certainly have the skill for it.

marcia.name: Marcia
marcia.title: Petulant Knight
marcia.description: Left her position in Begnion's Holy Guard for personal reasons, choosing to travel the land in search of her missing brother, Makalov. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall:
Gaaah... It's not like I didn't want to fulfill my duties to the Holy Guard.
But when debt collectors started hanging around the barracks, I just had to do something.
My brother's not a bad person, he just likes gambling and...doesn't work. So he borrows money and... Ugh.
Everyone here works so hard... I get it more than ever now—my brother really is super lazy!

Aaah! O-oh, it's just you, [S].
Phew... For a second, I thought a debt collector had somehow followed me here.

I wanted to do the right thing, so I wrote a letter of resignation when I left the Begnion Holy Guard.
But...I'm not sure that will be enough for the deputy commander. I-I really hope she isn't mad at me...
Visit: Hmm... I wonder how much I could make if I sold this... Oh, I'm just curious is all!
Level: Where are you, Brother?! Next time I find your worthless hide, I'm going to knock some sense into you!
I was considered one of the most promising rookies in the Holy Guard, so don't you dare underestimate me!
Ugh... C'mon... I'm going to turn out like my brother at this rate.
Summon: I'm Marcia! Have you seen my brother, Makalov? He's got a mangy mop of hair that's the same color as mine!
Learn Skill: Are you sure? You'd give this to a lowly deserter like me?! Wow, there really are nice people out there, huh?
Confession:
Did I ever tell you why I'm trying to find my brother? Yeah, that's right. His debt.
He didn't even have a good reason to borrow all of that money—it was all just to amuse himself.
To be honest, even if I DO somehow manage to find him, it's not like I can just wipe away all his debts...
But I have to find him. For his own sake.
If I don't set him straight, he'll never become a respectable member of society! Plus, I...
He used my name to borrow money... I can't inconvenience the knights. So I did the only thing I could: resign.
But now? Oh, they'll see what I can do! I'll become a mercenary, work my butt off, and make a ton of money!
Special: What say I run you through?!
I'll beat some sense into you!
Status: It's me, Marcia! I'm going to join your group.
*yelp* Oh, it's you. Crackers! I was sure you were a debt collector...
I used to be in the Begnion Holy Guard, but...I had to quit.
I'm searching for my missing brother. He's kind of a dolt and a scoundrel.
The Begnion pegasus knights were always moving around, so I learned to pack quickly.
It's all my brother's fault. *sigh*
Anything you need, just say the word. I'll give it my all.

astrid.name: Astrid
astrid.title: Resolute Damsel
astrid.description: Lady of Begnion's House Damiell. Refusing the life of an aristocrat's daughter, she enlisted and became a knight. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall:
As a daughter of House Damiell, I am expected to marry for politics, not love.
I have not even met the suitor my father decided upon...

The noble houses of Begnion keep their scions within a gilded cage from the moment they are born.
Can... Can I really live like that?
I can't even sleep at night because I'm terrified of surprise attacks. It's made me painfully aware of my frailty.

I don't have much fighting experience. I want to learn so I can hold my own in a battle.
I don't want to be a burden.
Will you teach me how to fight like a mercenary, [S]?
Visit: Please accept this gift. I was tasked with delivering it as a token of [F]'s gratitude.
Level: Changing your strategy based on the circumstances—in other words, adaptation... That's the key to victory.
I was taught that aim is everything to an archer. A single accurate shot can bypass even the heaviest armor.
What... What happened?
Summon: My name is Astrid. I may not be the most seasoned fighter in this army, but I will contribute however I can.
Learn Skill: Oh, thank you... I appreciate your doing this for me.
Confession:
Oh...hello. Would you care to lend me your ear, [S]?
I wish to discuss the circumstances that led to me becoming a knight.
Would it surprise you to learn that the man my father gave my hand in marriage to is even older than he is?
Getting married away to improve your family's standing... Such a thing is considered ordinary in Begnion.
My older sisters suffered that fate, and the letters I receive from them are all warped and stained with tears.
When destiny came calling, I saw only one way out: volunteering for military service.
It was a desperate attempt to delay the inevitable, but so long as I remain free, I wish to choose my own path.
I may have lived a sheltered life, but if you are willing to lead, yours is a path I will readily follow.
Status: I am Astrid, of House Damiell. I may be of noble birth, but I can fight!
Pardon me, but is this some sort of jest?
Some say that I am ignorant to the wider world, but I think I just have much to learn.
I intend to live according to my own wishes, not those of my family. I want my life to be my own!
Oh, my pendant? My grandmother gave it to me when I was just a girl. I wear it to remember her.
Are you teasing me? You're not? Oh... I can't believe I said that... I'm so embarrassed...
I'm sure I will grow stronger if I continue fighting by your side.

tanith.name: Tanith
tanith.title: Bright Blade
tanith.description: Deputy commander of Begnion's Holy Guard. She leads with strength and discipline. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall:
The people gathered in this castle do not share a common discipline, or even a uniform.
And yet, they all seem to follow you without question... How strange.

Young girls these days are weaklings. Running away or even crying from only the slightest bit of scolding...
It wasn't like that at all when I was young.

It's embarrassing to admit, but I can't even crack an egg without hurting someone.
You ought to remove me from meal duty...for the troops' sake.

Some say a direct charge from Begnion's Holy Guard is like seeing the sun break through the clouds.
Even in the skies of another world, not a single one of us will fall out of formation.
Ah, Summoner. Thank you for all of your assistance. Courtesy is key between allies, wouldn't you agree?
Visit: I am Tanith. Please accept this gift from [F].
Level: It is time to show what Begnion's Holy Guard is capable of! No enemy will pass through these skies!
This is tolerable, but it seems like I'll need to add one more task to my training routine.
Whether it's real combat or merely training, I must do better. I cannot let my subordinates see me like this.
Summon: I am Tanith, deputy commander of Begnion's Holy Guard. Don't expect me to be as lenient as Sigrun.
Learn Skill: A new technique has opened up to me. I'll put it to good use.
Confession:
You look uncomfortable. Is something the matter, [S]?
Hmm... I see. So you heard someone call me the "Great Demon." Well, that is what I was called back in my world.
The truth is, my teaching methods can sometimes be a little...intense. If anything, that name is a compliment.
It would be troublesome if some noble's daughter joined our pegasus knights merely to go sightseeing.
After all, a group is only as strong as its weakest member. In times of crisis, we must protect each other.
If being strict can help my subordinates return home safely, I do not care what they call me.
For the sake of Begnion's future, I have been charged with teaching and protecting the noble Holy Guards.
It is a responsibility I intend to carry out with all of my heart and soul.
...It's a bit embarrassing to say out loud, though, so I would appreciate it if you kept that last part between us.
Status: I am Tanith, deputy commander of the Begnion Empire's Holy Guard. I am an officer, and you will address me as such.
Soldier! Face me, or be prepared for the consequences.
I'm on a quest to find the apostle, but she certainly does not make it easy.
It's embarrassing to admit, but I can't even crack an egg without hurting someone.
Today we'll show them a fight that will honor the apostle's guards!
Cooking is a useful skill, even in battle. I could make rations. I'm good with a knife.
No harm shall fall upon you. I've made it my responsibility to protect you.

bertram.name: Bertram
bertram.title: Dread Cavalier
bertram.description: One of the Four Riders, the strongest of Daein's generals. No one knows who it is that wears the helm and armor. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: ...Gah! ...dell... mea...
...King... King Ashnard!
...Orders...
...Guaaa! Kill...me...
...Gah... Owww...
Visit: Stop...me...
Level: On...my life... You will not...pass!
...Perissssh... ...Perissssh...
Make a graveyard...of thissss place. Bury them all.
Summon: Drive...back...the foe! GUAAAA!
Learn Skill: Yesss... Invest in your soldiers... Dominate!
Confession:
...Like this...
... ...Ramon's...
...Gah!
...Go forward... ...Ridell Crimea...
...What you...believe!
Status: I am Bertram, of the Four Riders of Daein.
Don't...touch me!
General of Daein...loyal to King Ashnard.
Kill the enemy. Let none live!
Crimea? I do not know it.
Elincia? I know...that girl.
You... You can end my life... Please...

eitri.name: Eitri
eitri.title: Youthful Sage
eitri.description: A scholar of Niðavellir. Despite her youthful appearance, her exceptional intellect has earned her the title of sage.

Castle Hall: My interest in Askr goes without saying, but any world that houses Heroes is also worth further inquiry.
To conduct my research, I took to living in the forest, alone. But lonely? Never. It was nice, actually... Quiet.
Allow me the opportunity to apply some seiðjarn to aid you...
Your weapon is a miracle only one of the great dragons could produce... Do you mind if I take a closer look?
What secrets does the summoning shrine hide within? I hope to unlock its secrets, but...no success thus far.
Visit: Would you like me to improve your Heroes for you? You need not worry over the results...
Level: The occasion of growing stronger is something to be savored. I get the opportunity so rarely.
Adequate.
The nature of experimentation, I'm afraid.
Summon: I am Eitri, a humble scholar. To be the Hero summoned is...exhilarating.
Learn Skill: A new power... Nothing could make me happier. Conducting tests on my own body is very convenient.
Confession:
Something's been troubling me. The number of kind people here is higher than I expected.
Because of the way I look in this form, people seem to think I will have interest in candy or play...
I only want to conduct my research in peace...
I made a manakete girl cry by using a device to make myself disappear during hide and seek... Tiresome.
But being able to study manakete behavior up close is something I relish, so I put up with it...some.
Maybe you'd care to join us next time? I won't need to take it easy on YOU, will I? Heh heh...
Special: You shouldn't get in my way.
Status: I am Eitri, a humble scholar. There are those who call me a sage, but, well...
Hmm? Oh, sorry. Were you trying to surprise me?
Family? Friends? I do not have them. I do not need them.
So these are the Heroes produced by a successful summoning, and they obey you. I see...
As a civilization develops, war is inevitable, and sacrifices will be made. Why wring your hands over progress?
My country was founded by one with a vision...and I want to see it through. That is all.
There is nothing that could make me happier than to observe the summoner at work, up close.

thorr.name: Thórr
thorr.title: War God
thorr.description: Known to mortals as the god who presides over combat and war. Respects mortals who display true strength.

Castle Hall: I cannot believe this. Me, spending my time with the mortals of Askr...
Loki and I made a wager. The winner could make the loser do anything... I could not help but take the risk.
The Thórr you know is your enemy... Yet you bring me here as your ally? Help me to understand...
You should not exist. Nor should your power to summon. You are outside Alfaðör's design. You should not be.
If you have a request to make of me, out with it. My strength is yours to direct now.
Visit: I am Thórr. I will not be entertaining questions pertaining to how I came to serve [F].
Level: What incredible new strength... Is this the work of [S]?
Every strike is a chance to grow stronger.
Hmph. Bring me a challenge!
Summon: I am Thórr. I made an arrangement with Loki, and now my strength is yours to wield...for now.
Learn Skill: Thank you. A summoner's power is even greater than I had imagined...
Confession:
Did you summon me on purpose, [S]?
I only try to understand. You and that weapon you carry are not part of this world as it was designed.
And we cannot abide a mortal with power enough to challenge the gods. What you fight for is incidental.
Alfaðör is likely to command that I rid this world of you and your power.
And when that happens, I... Well...
Status: My name is Thórr. True strength is what I seek.
Why would you touch me like that?
In battle, you must always show your foe respect.
Loki and I have known each other for a long time. In truth, I do not always understand her motives.
A mortal, powerless, takes up a blade and faces down death... That, too, is strength.
There is no breaking the bond our contract forged. I will fight for you—no matter what.
Know that I am prepared to give all that I am to you, should you ask.

ash.name: Ash
ash.title: Retainer to Askr
ash.description: Retainer to Askr, god of connections and strong bonds. Earnest and polite, she strives to always say exactly what she means.

Castle Hall: The fact that this kingdom bears the name of Lord Askr is a sign of love and respect I find deeply moving.
Where I come from, Lord Askr's domain, there are many openings— gateways, that is—to other worlds.
It seems no matter the meal, I always end up feeling sluggish once I finish eating. It can be...troublesome.
I commend your diligence with regard to maintaining the happiness and health of all. May you never falter.
For one such as myself to be able to be in the presence of a mortal like this is, well—to be honest—a joy.
Visit: Sincere apologies for the disruption... My name is Ash. I am grateful for the opportunity to appear before you.
Level: Yes, I believe that is a satisfactory result given my ability. I am, of course, biased in that regard, you understand.
Would you object to the idea that this result is the sort you ought to expect from someone like me?
I regret to report that I have failed to meet my own expectations for myself. I offer you my most sincere apologies.
Introduction: My name is Ash. I am grateful you responded to my request so quickly and honored to have your assistance.
Summon: I am Ash, retainer to Askr, the Divine Dragon for whom this land is named. I offer my service, if you will have it.
Learn Skill: How can I thank you enough for such generosity? This gesture demands an immediate display of my gratitude.
Confession:
I exist to serve a specific purpose. In that way, my existence differs from that experienced by you mortals.
Hopes, desires, dreams, and other such things that fill the lives of mortalkind...I do not experience.
I can, however, feel the happiness of mortals almost as if it were my own.
And because of that, if I were to have a dream, it would likely involve the happiness of mortals, I believe.
Toward that end, my plan is to use the full extent of whatever power I can muster to further your cause.
Status: We are...not exactly what you might call family, perhaps—but it would not be accurate to say my relationship to Lord Askr is entirely unlike familial kinship.
*startle* Do you consider such interaction a form of greeting?
Please allow me to express my most sincere appreciation to everyone for making me feel so welcome here since I have arrived only a short time ago; it feels almost as if we have already been...
My deepest wish is for everyone to both discover and obtain that which will make them happy in this life, holding onto it as long as they might wish; such a thing would be a true blessing...
Regarding the matter you've raised, I can offer no satisfactory answer to that particular inquiry at this time—however, I will research the topic and report back with any findings...
This is the first occasion I have had in which I have been able to interact with any being quite like you... I must say, I have learned much thus far.
Please remember that I am ever at your service. Providing my assistance to those who have gathered here is truly my pleasure.

priam.name: Priam
priam.title: Radiant Hero
priam.description: Descendant of the Radiant Hero who hails from a distant village. An earnest seeker of strength. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
I just got back from sparring with Alfonse. He has real skill, and he never lost his calm.
I'd like to challenge him again.
When I lived in a far-off village, I'd fight any who made it there. Chrom and Robin's army was the toughest.
I see that you're on patrol again. Don't forget to eat! Meat's good for keeping your energy up. I'll get you some.

Sometimes I get jealous of our foes...
If we were enemies, I could cross swords with the Order of Heroes and any of the Heroes whenever I wanted.

I was training. Training is something you can do anywhere and anytime.
Take a look around here—you could do push-ups, run laps, or practice your form. Hmm...
Visit: Lots of strong fighters here. I should challenge somebody before I head back to [F].
Level: Not good enough. I won't settle for being less than the best.
Nothing beats the feel of accomplishment.
Maybe I need to train harder.
Summon: Name's Priam. I'm a descendant of the Radiant Hero, but my strength comes from my own efforts.
Learn Skill: For giving me this power... You have my thanks. Sincerely.
Confession:
What's this, now? If you're here, that means you're finally ready to duel. Weapon at the ready!
Yes, I know your weapon isn't for fighting. Summon your Heroes, and I'll fell each and every one.
Oh! You can't summon Heroes unless you're at the ruins? I see... When my sword is in my hand, I get overeager.
When I'm faced with a strong opponent, It's always like this. I think Chrom and Robin got sick of it.
What about you?
I'm glad to hear it. I don't want you frustrated with me. I want to be at your side—your strongest sword.
Status: I will become stronger—stronger than any man alive!
You wish to learn all I know of fighting? Prepare yourself. This journey will be a long one.
A warrior's life extends no further than that of the weapon he wields. Fail to perform proper maintenance, and... Hmph.
The act of eating is to take the soul of others and make it into one's own flesh. We should eat with a spirit of thanks.
The road to strength... For you, I guess, that means seeking stronger Heroes, doesn't it?
As a weapon, Ragnell may be reaching its limit...
Usually, I don't take orders from anybody. But I guess working for you is good enough for now.

miriel.name: Miriel
miriel.title: Rapier Intellect
miriel.description: A serious and methodical Shepherd. Loves to research and is knowledgeable on a wide range of subjects. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
A power to activate gates possessed only by royalty... And a power to summon possessed only by...
I am incredibly fascinated by each and every one of you.

I'm with the Shepherds. They're quite lax when it comes to keeping track of their personal belongings, but...
I believe you would agree with my evaluation that they are quite proficient when it comes to battle.

It appears the burden of our mission has left you quite weary.
If you wish to achieve more efficient battle results, you must remember to take a break now and again.

I have some research to conduct outdoors, but my grasp of Askran geography is lacking.
Would you be interested in assisting me as my guide?

Take care that you do not misplace your divine weapon.
I was admiring the perfect organizational structure of my literature and thought to remind you.
Visit:
Your acquaintance [F] requested I deliver a greeting to you.
That done, I will be on my way.
Level: Never sate yourself with middling returns!
These results are...generally satisfying.
Someone must preserve the status quo.
Summon: I am Miriel, of the Shepherds. I do not believe I've been to this world before... How terribly fascinating.
Learn Skill: If my calculations are correct, I can now perform at a higher rate.
Confession:
Ah, it's you. I was so entrenched in my thoughts I didn't notice you approach. Oh, no, you needn't leave.
I would never consider a subject of my fascination to be intruding on my time. Please, stay as long as you like.
Especially since your being here means you won't be summoning any more Heroes...
The arrival of a new Hero always leaves me...vexed. On the one hand, it's another specimen to study.
But on the other, I find it irksome to have your attentions directed toward someone else.
What? That's called jealousy? I see. Then, I suppose I'm jealous.
I will make a note of how troublesome this emotion is.
...There.
But surely this emotion must have practical applications as well...
Status: A different world... Fascinating.
Make sure your posessions are secured at all times. Please.
You have a divine weapon and the ability to summon Heroes. May I study you?
Is this physical contact intended as an attempt to increase interpersonal familiarity and establish a stronger bond? Fascinating.
Yes, I do find the Order of Heroes a worthy subject for observation.
The universe contains so many fascinating things I have yet to see...
Since coming here, I have learned of so many more mysteries worth investigating. I have you to thank for this.

flavia.name: Flavia
flavia.title: Feroxi East-Khan
flavia.description: East-Khan of Regna Ferox, a country led by its preference for battle over politics. Boldly faces even the most perilous situations without fear. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Just because Ferox is split between east and west, doesn't mean we're at war. We just...don't always get along.
Basilio and I have tussled more times than I can count. But now we've both been ruling khan... Maybe we'll relax.
Your diligence is admirable, but we all have our limits. Have some warm soup and a nap. You need it.
What's wrong? You're carrying a heavy weight on those shoulders. If you want to talk, I'm happy to listen.
We fight to survive because we all have something worth protecting. Can't defend anything if you're dead.
Visit: Pleasure to meet you. I'm Flavia, East-Khan of Regna Ferox, and friend of [F].
Level: Ferox is a kingdom of warriors! We care not about gender or race— only about being the strongest!
Soldiers are born on the battlefield! Steel your resolve, and let your weapons strike true!
Oof, that one hurt. I don't know if I should be amused or embarrassed...
Summon: I'm Flavia, East-Khan of Regna Ferox. But enough with formalities. What say we have some fun?
Learn Skill: This will do me some good, but what I really need is a reliable champion to represent me in the next tournament.
Confession:
I've had my eye on you ever since arriving in Askr. It's difficult not to notice your strengths.
You command your armies well and are sound in body and mind. That's rare, even in Ferox.
But what makes you tick? The Askran royals and other Heroes may hold the answer.
It's clear that the bonds you share with them are key. And so, I say: let us strengthen ours.
You're champion material, to be sure. But it's more than that. You've the makings of a true friend.
Status: I am Flavia, East-Khan of Regna Ferox. A pleasure to meet you.
Hey! Trifle with me and you'll live to regret it.
Boast your victory! When you win, make damn sure everybody hears about it.
Robin is quick-witted, bold, and decisive... A superior tactician like that would be most welcome in Regna Ferox.
You know how to talk, don't you? Yes, I like you already.
I'll cut that dastard Walhart down myself! I swear it before the gods!
We've only gotten this far thanks to that clever head of yours. Thanks for having my back.

basilio.name: Basilio
basilio.title: Feroxi West-Khan
basilio.description: West-Khan of Regna Ferox, a country led by its preference for battle over politics. A simple warrior who has nothing to hide. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Ever since I was a young'un, my motto's been "live to play and play to win!" Remember that before a scrap.
I grew so bored when I was reigning khan. I had to sneak out of that drafty castle to have some fun!
Work all you want, but don't forget to fit fun into your schedule. If you can't relax, you won't get very far.
Gods, but I miss my travelin' days. A man needs spice in his life! A mug in his hand, a lady on his arm...
I hear this world has kingdoms of ice and fire and more. Maybe I'll get to relive my travelin' days after all.
Visit: Good to meet you. I'm Basilio, West-Kahn of Regna Ferox, and friend of [F].
Level: Bwaa ha ha! You whelps got nothin' on ol' Basilio! Watch and weep!
Bwaaa ha ha! Take a leaf out of this book, sprogs!
Curses! But what do you expect? I'm already perfect.
Summon: Name's Basilio, West-Khan of Regna Ferox. But enough with formalities, let's grab a mug and enjoy ourselves!
Learn Skill: That's right! Come to Papa Basilio!
Confession:
You need somethin'? Oh, I know! You wanna knock back some mead with ol' Basilio, is that it?
Fine by me, but we'll need some juicy conversation. Let's see...you taken a shine to any of the Heroes?
You mean you've never thought of anyone that way?! Way to kill the mood, [S]!
Take a leaf out of my book! I may be bald and grizzled, but inside beats the heart of a man half my age!
Even Flavia can appreciate my— Er, never mind. Forget what I said! C'mon, bottoms up! Bwaaa ha ha!
Status: The name's Basilio, West-Khan of Regna Ferox. Pleasure's all mine, I'm sure.
Huh? Hah! What are you, a child? Show some respect!
Lon'qu may not be the most sociable man in the army, but his bladework is second to none. Hell, he's on track to succeed me as West-Khan some day.
I'll be glad to take on any mission, no matter the odds. Better a grizzled veteran goes out in a blaze of glory! The young should live to fight again.
The West-Khans once safeguarded Gules, one of the five sacred gemstones... But it was lost long before my day.
Just point me at the enemy. I'll give those kettleheads a taste of Ferox's barbarian roots!
Hey. Leave the fighting to old Basilio. You've got the safety of the young prince Alfonse to worry about!

yenfay.name: Yen'fay
yenfay.title: Blade Legend
yenfay.description: A powerful king of Chon'sin, his now-lost homeland. Once the Blade Legend, he has succumbed to Walhart, and now serves him. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Chon'sin, my homeland, has many volcanoes. Flames erupt from their peaks, and the land is blanketed in ash.
The hearts of my people are strong. So long as my sister, Say'ri, lives... Chon'sin will one day recover.
Ah, curse it! I fell asleep. I'd meant to be meditating.
Meditation is meant to unify one's spirit and allow contemplation of movement in the stillness.
Some quandaries in this world have no proper answer...
Visit: I am Yen'fay. My heart was saved by [F]...
Level: I'll not say the path I chose was one of justice. Only that I have my own battles to fight, same as any other.
My opponents will not be able to see through my swordsmanship.
Hm. I still have more room to improve...
Summon: My name is Yen'fay. I was once called Blade Legend... Now I wish only to be a lone warrior. Nothing more.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks.
Confession:
I'm grateful you gave me a place and a reason to fight... For I am a man who's become no more than a blade.
I lost my parents to conquerors. I could have cast all aside and resisted, but I chose to do the opposite.
I know the truth of who I am. Call me king or Blade Legend... I still have no homeland. No people to call my own.
So I put such matters behind me. Now I simply wield my blade and slay my foes. It's the only reason I live.
I am The Demon's Edge, walking a path of carnage! I offer up my blade to you, [S]!
Special: I will not ask for forgiveness.
Status: I am Yen'fay of Chon'sin. That is all you need to know.
Think twice the next time you are about to prod a man armed with a sword.
I have reasons for fighting, but that is not cause to explain them to strangers.
Say'ri? She is a rebel and traitor to the empire. I have no sister.
My homeland... It is a place of beauty, with a culture all its own.
You have found strong comrades, Say'ri...
We all walk our own paths. Do not try to stray into mine.

lysithea3.name: Lysithea
lysithea3.title: Gifted Students
lysithea3.description: Exceptional women working together to fly across the world in one night, delivering gifts along the way! They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses / The Sacred Stones.
lysithea3.harmonized:
Grants Atk+6,【Resonance: Blades】, and 【Bonus Doubler】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Bonus Doubler】 Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = current bonus on each of unit's stats for 1 turn. Calculates each stat bonus independently.

Castle Hall: **Lysithea**: If I could have any gift this holiday season, it would be more time to study. There's so much left to learn!
**Lysithea**: Why are sleighs pulled by reindeer? Think about it: if sleighs were drawn by pegasi, they could fly!
**Lute**: I've deduced that, although different, some form of the winter festival is celebrated in every world. Incredible.
**Lute**: Miracles are the fruit of meticulous methodology and careful calculations. It's quite basic...in theory, at least.
**Lute**: Lysithea's love for sweets is logical: sugar improves one's mood, and thus enhances cognitive function.
Visit:
**Lysithea**: Here's a winter festival gift from [F].
Delivered, um, flawlessly! Right, Lute?
Level: **Lute**: There is no theory our combined cognitive muscle could not put to the test. We're just that good.
**Lysithea**: I guess this was an acceptable performance. But let's redouble our gift-giving efforts!
**Lysithea**: Brrr... By my calculations, it shouldn't be this cold out. Um, Lute...are your eyebrows frozen?
Summon: I'm Lysithea, and this is Lute. We heard you might need some help with the winter festival, so here we are!
Learn Skill: **Lute**: These gifts will prove extremely beneficial in ensuring the success of the winter festival.
Confession:
**Lute**: Excellent work today, Lysithea. It was no small feat getting all of those gifts delivered on time.
**Lysithea**: Careful planning and earnest effort were key. But I failed to account for how exhausting it would be.
**Lute**: Perhaps this card will lift your spirits, then? It's from the children we met, according to [S].
**Lysithea**: Oh, how sweet! I can't quite read the messy handwriting, but it's clear they loved the gifts we sent them.
**Lute**: Although we did not enact this plan to earn any sort of reward, the card is a pleasant result nonetheless.
**Lysithea**: It's just these sorts of surprises that makes our experiments so interesting. We must treasure this!
Status: Hehe...
"So many sweets... I'm so happy..." "Compounds with sugars are effective on superior brains."
Conversation:
**Lysithea**: *sigh* There's still a mountain of presents to sort through.
Who'd have thought that helping at the winter festival would be such hard work?
I just want to be done so we can enjoy the festival. I saw a lot of delicious-looking sweets at the plaza...

**Lute**: Lysithea. There's no time to rest.
According to my calculations, if we stop now, we won't be done here until dawn.
**Lysithea**: I-I know that. I was just saying...
**Lute**: So, you actually want to go to the festival? It does seem like something a child would enjoy.
**Lysithea**: Hey! Who are you calling a child? It's not like I want to go to a festival!
Who needs baked sweets anyway? All those cakes. And cookies with cream. And berry-covered tarts. And—
**Lute**: You retain quite a high level of detail for someone who isn't interested. I'm impressed by how observant you are.
**Lysithea**: Indeed I do. But to be sure, we ought to investigate further, and if possible, confirm the flavors as well!
**Lute**: Ah, the captivation of a curious mind. That I can understand.

But now I've grown hungry from all of this manual labor.
Maybe it would be in our best interest to investigate those sweets.
**Lysithea**: Yes! We should take a break to enjoy—I mean investigate—the festival.
**Lute**: That could be a worthwhile use of our time. Upon consideration, I am now thirsty.
Tell me, Lysithea, did you also happen to observe sweetened beverages for sale in the plaza?
**Lysithea**: No, I didn't see those! You're very perceptive, Lute.
**Lute**: Yes. I'm just that good.
**Lysithea**: I think I'm pretty good too, you know. Anyway, let's go. We can prove how perceptive we are at the plaza!

mirabilis2.name: Mirabilis
mirabilis2.title: Sugarplum Vision
mirabilis2.description: A ljósálfr who can be found sleeping at all times and places. Struggling to stay awake for the winter festival, she is doing her best to participate.

Castle Hall: A gift for the winter festival? Umm... I could always use a good pillow or three, I guess...
*yawn* The kids are having so much fun. I hope they'll still remember this day after they've grown up.
My regular outfit isn't warm enough for this weather. Are these fluffy bits supposed to help with the cold?
I've been trying to think of a gift for Peony, but she's the kind who always says she'd be happy with anything...
I've got a bunch of presents for the kids. This almost feels like handing out dreams.
Visit:
*yaaawn* H-huh? Wait, isn't this [F]'s castle?
Is there a winter festival going on here as well? How strange...
Level: Here you go! Yes, even our foes get presents during the winter festival. Sweet dreams!
Ahhh... I bet I'd have a wonderful dream if I warmed myself up by the fireplace for a while.
It's too hard to doze off in the cold. Somebody find me a blanket...
Summon: *yawn* I'm Mirabilis. I have some gifts to deliver, but...*yaaawn*...I think I'm going to catch a few winks first.
Learn Skill: Oh, I get a present too? Thank you!
Confession:
Hello. I just finished...*yawn*...handing out gifts to everyone. To be honest, it was pretty hard at first.
I was so cold that I could barely even move, and my eyelids felt so heavy... But something strange happened.
As I handed out gifts, I felt warmer and warmer. Before I even realized it, I'd given them all away!
This festival feels like a dream, one where everyone is smiling and able to enjoy each other's company.
If you asked me to describe a daydream...I think this is how I would do it. This moment right here.
I know this season is special, and that it cannot last forever...but I hope we can feel like this all year round!
Status: *yawn* So sleepy...
Stay warm...
It's cold all of a sudden! How long was I out?!
Delivering gifts just sounds...so tiring...
I get why they call it a snowbed. Looks comfy...
*yawn* Mother... Father... Isn't the festival nice?
I don't need any gifts... I'm just glad we're friends.

artur.name: Artur
artur.title: Silver Saint
artur.description: A sincere monk of Renais who has come to Askr to play the role of winter envoy. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Ah, so Lute is also an envoy in the winter festival? I'm sure her superior intellect will be a blessing.
Being of service fills me with joy, whether I am defeating monsters or serving as winter envoy.
On the eve of the winter festival, I plan on praying longer and deeper than any other night of the year.
Isn't it beautiful? The snow in Askr glimmers like pure silver. I will treasure this memory for a lifetime.
Oh! I have gifts for Sir Cormag and Genarog. I only hope that Genarog likes them—wyverns are quite picky.
Visit: I am Artur, a humble monk. I have come to share wintertime blessings on [F]'s behalf.
Level: A hearth may warm your body, but only a smile can warm your heart.
Everyone has the right to pursue what makes them happy. I believe the gods wish it so.
Why does my sack of gifts feel lighter than before? Oh dear, oh dear! The seam has split completely!
Summon: I am Artur, a monk from Renais. The gods have guided me to lend my aid to these wintertime festivities.
Learn Skill: I will prove your faith in me is deserved. I swear this to the gods!
Confession:
Brr, it sure is chilly outside today. Have you been able to keep warm, [S]?
I find that the grateful smiles of the locals somehow soften the biting sting of the cold.
I'm constantly amazed by how the people of Askr face one hardship after another, and yet...
They find time to come together in joyous celebration. That optimism is more important than it may seem.
I hope that this festival lives on in the people's hearts, even after we have restored peace.
That would make all of these battles worth the fight, and I will be happy to have played my humble part.
Special: I've put my heart into this.
Status: I'm here as a representative of the winter festival. I hope I'm doing a good job.
*surprised noise* A spider! ...Oh, it's just an ornament. Good.
I have all kinds of gifts in this bag—something for everyone!
The best part of the holidays is waking up to find something nice waiting for you!
*sneeze* It really is cold out, huh?
What should I get Lute? She'd love a bug or a monster, but, uh…
I got you a little something. I hope you like it!

manuela.name: Manuela
manuela.title: Silver Caroler
manuela.description: A former songstress who teaches at Garreg Mach Monastery, her song resonating out and blessing all who hear it. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: This winter festival, I know my date with destiny is waiting in the wings! Now I just have to find them!
My voice is a gift from the goddess. Will it resound even more strongly during these festivities, I wonder?
Of course I prefer receiving gifts to giving them...but it always makes me happy to see my students smile.
Hmm? Do I have any plans for after the festival quiets down tonight? How should I take that question, hm?
How do you like my festival outfit? I imagine several someones would be happy to get this as a present, eh?
Visit: I'm Manuela. I thought you'd like to know the winter festival's under way at [F]'s castle!
Level: I think a special performance is in order to properly commemorate the winter festival. A song, then!
The winter festival is a chance for me to shine brighter than ever before!
Ugh... This blasted hangover has some teeth... Oof...
Summon: I'm Manuela. By day I'm a professor at Garreg Mach, but tonight I'm here to revel in the holiday spirit with you!
Learn Skill: Is this for me? Oh my. Is it possible? Could you be...the one?!
Confession:
Hear that laughter from the houses? The lucky ones are inside, enjoying each other's company.
On this sacred night, I'll lift my voice in celebration and prayer, that all may be blessed with a bright tomorrow.
But what'll happen when the festival envoy needs help? I'm close to becoming a festival spinster!
Say, why am I out here freezing my rear off when I could be finding someone to keep me warm?!
Hmph. Well, I'm off to the pub. Come along, Summoner. You can just drink tea if you want.
Next year, I'm going to be cozying up to that fireplace next to someone special. I can see it now...
Status: I'm used to dressing up for the stage, but this is a bit much...
Oh, it's you. I was just thinking how nice it would be to have some company.
The students seem to be having fun. That's a relief.
I hope someone charming will come along and give me a gift too.
Something about the cold weather makes me feel even more single than usual...
There are happy couples everywhere... *sigh*
Shall we sing a special song for the winter festival?

ignatz2.name: Ignatz
ignatz2.title: Snowscape Artist
ignatz2.description: A student at Garreg Mach Monastery who has come to participate in the winter festival in search of a landscape he has yet to see. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: In wintertime, my breath fogs my lenses. But I can't go without them, even when wearing a costume.
My father decided I should be a knight. The truth is, the life of a painter would suit me better...
This is a quality gift. I'm the son of a merchant family, so I have a better eye for these things than most.
I include a hand-painted card with each of my gifts. I hope each stroke conveys my feelings for the recipient.
Askr's winter colors exude a cool serenity. I would give anything to truly capture that beauty on canvas!
Visit: Hello! My, what a picturesque castle! I'm here as winter envoy, on behalf of [F].
Level: This winter wonderland is quite the sight. I need to think on which shades of blue will best capture the scene.
Phew... I'm glad that my gifts escaped unharmed, at least.
It appears the burden of acting as a winter envoy is a heavier one than I first imagined...
Summon: My name is Ignatz Victor. I can't wait to learn more about Askr's winter festival. Where shall we begin?
Learn Skill: Now I truly feel like I understand the meaning of the winter festival!
Confession:
I've been interested in what lies beyond Fódlan's borders ever since I knew there were borders.
What would such lands look like? Who were the people living there? I used to daydream for hours.
In all those imaginings, I never thought I'd be able to join a foreign festival. Much less as an envoy!
Such events are special because they only come around once a year, when the weather and time are right.
All the more reason to capture the moment in a painting, yes? Well, if I can do it proper justice, that is.
Of course, such a painting wouldn't be complete if I didn't include you, [S].
Special: Let me give you a gift!
Status: The winter festival's once a year, right? Let's make the most of it!
Oh, it's snowing! *shiver* Cold!
The decorations in the plaza are amazing. I lost track of time while admiring them.
Oh right, a gift. Could I interest you in some paints? Or drawing paper?
My glasses fog up every time I come inside. I can't see a thing...
Someday I'll paint a landscape of this incredible scenery.
I got you something. It's not much, but I hope you like it.

fbyleth3.name: Byleth
fbyleth3.title: The Fódlan Light
