fbyleth3.description: Former professor at Garreg Mach Monastery who leads the charge in the campaign to end war. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Even if it only lasted a year, my days at the Officers Academy continue to offer me strength on the battlefield.
I hope I never again find myself away from my friends when they are most in need...

Have you ever had an experience that you could tell no one about?
Like...visions of a girl who laughs at you, gets angry with you, and even cries to you? For example.

No matter the battlefield, I'm always grateful to fight alongside allies who are willing to lend me their strength.
The same is true for you, right? In that case, let us train together.
I may never get answers to many of the questions I have about my life, but I will press on nevertheless.
Visit: Sorry for dropping in so suddenly. I was asked to deliver greetings from [F].
Level: I'll use this power for the greater good.
There's no turning back now.
Not my best.
Summon: My name is Byleth. I fight to bring an end to the chaos that has enveloped Fódlan.
Learn Skill: Thank you. With this power, I can keep moving forward.
Confession:
Even in this world, where so many Heroes have banded together, there is still no end to the cycle of conflict.
My heart is heavy having seen this.
How can I hope to quench the flames of war engulfing Fódlan? How can I wield my blade and seek peace?
Even so, I know a Hero does not yield—a Hero fights for their dream. Even if they may not live to see it.
I still struggle to see myself as such a Hero, but...despair is not an option I will allow myself.
I'm with you to the end. Allow me to demonstrate how my experience can be applied in the here and now!
Special: You cannot stop the flow of time!
Here is something to believe in!
Status: I suppose this outfit makes me stand out. It is more ornate than I am used to.
Yes? Can I help you?
I can no longer hear Sothis's voice...
This is a place where Heroes can coexist free of conflict.
The goddess gifted me her power. I was changed by her favor.
I was looking for answers as I drifted through the flow of time... I may find what I sought here instead.
Let us work together to bring about a world of peace. My strength is yours.

dagr2.name: Dagr
dagr2.title: New Year Jötnar
dagr2.description: Dagr and Nótt, twin princesses of Jötunheimr, realm of the jötnar. With these two side-by-side, it's sure to be an eventful New Year!
dagr2.duo:
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+6 and【Pathfinder】 to unit and allies within 5 rows and 5 columns centered on unit for 1 turn.
【Pathfinder】 When an ally moves through unit's space, that space is counted as 0 spaces moved instead of 1 space. (Unit's space can be freely added to ally's normal movement. Applies only to allies with movement types that allow movement through unit's space.)

Castle Hall: **Nótt**: Seeing so many beautiful Heroes all in one place is a perfect way to begin the new year.

**Nótt**: In Jötunheimr, our New Year's tradition is to hold a tournament in the queen's honor.
I win every year.
**Dagr**: There's so much delicious food at Askr's New Year's festival, I'm glad I can loosen the waist on this thing!

**Dagr**: So, Sis, when should I expect my New Year's gift? Don't tell me you suddenly forgot you're the eldest...
It's the tradition around here to give your younger siblings gifts, you know!
**Nótt**: I've grown rather fond of this kimono. The styling was done so well, it even makes Dagr look civilized for once.
Visit: We're here with greetings and a New Year's gift from your friend [F].
Level: **Dagr**: Wow! At this rate, odds are I'll be three times as tall by the end of the year!
**Nótt**: Winning a battle is the proper way to begin any year. I will dispose of any who stand in our path.
**Nótt**: Something seems to be throwing me off my rhythm... Could it be these unfamiliar clothes perhaps?
Summon:
Yes! Dagr's here, so the New Year's celebrations can finally begin! *wink* ...Ow, Sis, knock it o—oh, right!
This is my sister. Her name's Nótt. She's here too.
Learn Skill: **Nótt**: What's this? A New Year's gift from the summoner! You have chosen the recipient well. Just wait and see.
Confession:
**Nótt**: Just how long are you planning on enjoying the festivities, Dagr? We're missing valuable training time.
**Dagr**: What? There's still food I want to try and other fun stuff to do!
**Nótt**: Askr's foes do not rest just because there's a festival here. We are only falling behind.
**Dagr**: ...I'm sure you'll overcompensate and train extra hard to make up for me enjoying myself a little.
**Nótt**: ...The time I would have to spend training just to pick up your existing slack is already an eternity, Dagr!
**Dagr**: *sigh* So we're doing this whole thing again this year too, huh? Just remember you asked for it...
Status: Laugh
Wow, you look amazing in that kimono! I know you only say that because we're twins...
Conversation: **Dagr**: Ahh! Tasty food, Heroes partying all over the place... Askr really knows how to celebrate a new year!
Back home we'd just have to spar in front of Mom. Normally New Year is awful—for me, at least! But not here!
**Nótt**: It's not so bad, is it? It's a time- honored Jötunheimr tradition!
**Dagr**: Well, maybe it's different if you've never lost. Ever think of that? Plus, you always got a gift too! ...Ugh!
**Nótt**: To the victor go the spoils... Is it really a gift if you've earned it?
**Dagr**: Whatever. I just hate starting the year off as the loser. Every new year feels like a new low.
**Nótt**: Sorry I have no comforting words to offer you... Use those feelings as motivation for next year, perhaps?
**Dagr**: Hmph! ...You're more and more like Mom every year. You know that?
**Nótt**: Oh? Is that so? Well, I'm glad to hear it, Dagr! I will be the next queen, after all, so it is only fitting.
**Dagr**: Sure, sure. But here's the thing: When I'M queen, I won't be caught up in all those crusty old traditions...
Don't get me wrong; being strong is great, but what about the people who don't want to fight all the time, huh?
**Nótt**: What about them? Appealing to the weak will never win you the approval of the court nobles.
**Dagr**: Hah! Like I need them! Besides, I've got enough going on without worrying about what they think!
I was already spending all my time training just to get stronger, but now I have to protect Askr too!
**Nótt**: Hm... That is true... Perhaps we ought to set the politics aside for the time being, then? For the summoner?
If Askr truly needs our help, we ought to be combining our strengths rather than using them against one another.
**Dagr**: It's about time you figured that out! Let's get this party started already!

reginn2.name: Reginn
reginn2.title: Bearing Dawn
reginn2.description: The bright and energetic princess of Niðavellir, realm of the dvergar. She's charging into the new year at full speed!

Castle Hall: All this New Year's food looks so delicious! I want to learn how to make it so I can cook it for my brothers.
I brought this otter from Niðavellir! It looks a little bit like Ótr, doesn't it?
Look! Fáfnir gave me some money as a New Year's gift. Hmm...I think I'll save it!
I drew my fortune 10 times in a row and got the worst luck every time... Huh? I'm only supposed to take one?
This is called a kimono? It's so frilly and cute! I'm going to go show my brothers!
Visit: Happy New Year! We are all celebrating over at [F]'s castle!
Level: I have a feeling I'll be really lucky this year. This just confirms it!
I can still get so much stronger! The person I am this year will be even better than I was the year before!
*sigh* I must have eaten too much mochi. I'm so full I can barely move...
Summon: I'm Reginn! Happy New Year! I plan on enjoying this next year in Askr to the absolute fullest!
Learn Skill: This is for me? Thank you so much! With this, I can be an even stronger ally for you this year!
Confession:
[S]...
Umm, I have something to ask you.
I overhead people saying that your first dream of the year becomes reality. Is...is that true?
Last night I dreamed that I was celebrating the New Year in a cozy room with my brothers.
We promised we would all get along and work together again, like a family. They were even smiling!
I hope that will become reality. But hoping only does so much. I have to work to make this dream come true.
Will you help make my New Year's dream come to pass? You will? Yay! Let's work hard together this year!
Status: Happy New Year! Let's make this year just as fun as last year!
*startle* Ugh! Even when I'm dressed up, I can't keep the refined act going all that long...
So, that huge stack of mochi over there... Is that...decoration? Or are we going to eat it? It's making me hungry...
Since it's a new year, I fixed up my Gullinbursti so it's sparkling!
Time for my New Year's fortune! ...All right, let's see... Huh. The worst possible luck.
Do you think my brothers will give me New Year's gifts? *giggle* I can't wait!
This next year, we'll do everything together, right? It'll be the best year ever!

fafnir2.name: Fáfnir
fafnir2.title: Fresh Ambition
fafnir2.description: The king of Niðavellir, realm of the dvergar. He has come clad in a kimono to celebrate the coming of the new year with Askr.

Castle Hall: This "kimono" isn't bad. A shame it is only worn for the new year. Perhaps I will bring several back to Niðavellir.
Niðavellir also has its New Year's traditions. They are quite extravagant.
So the cogs have turned, bringing us into a new year...
You think you can be lazy just because it's the New Year, do you? What a childlike notion.
Hmph, that Reginn. She wants a New Year's gift, though I don't know what she expects. Her pestering is endless.
Visit: I, Fáfnir, Niðavellir's king, have come to deliver a New Year's greeting in place of [F].
Level: New Year's Day determines one's fate in the coming year. My victories are clearly secured.
Did you think that I would let my guard down just because of the New Year?
Pathetic... Have even I been distracted by this festive spirit?
Summon: I am Fáfnir, king of Niðavellir. I'll show you lazy fools how to truly celebrate the New Year.
Learn Skill: Yes...this is good. You would do well to continue admiring my prowess.
Confession:
Even as the calendar changes to a new year, my goals remain the same, as will my actions to achieve them.
I will make Niðavellir a force to be feared, richer and stronger than all who oppose us. That is my duty.
Summoner, our contract demands that I lend my strength to your cause for the sake of Askr.
However, when peace returns, I will resume my own ambitions. My plans are already being laid.
I have no need to pray to vague god-like idols at the new year; I will succeed by my strength alone.
Although, I understand you weaklings may need to rely on gods. Now, let's go. I'll be at your side...watching.
Status: You are in the presence of Fáfnir, Niðavellir's king. Greetings in this...new year.
...You have some spine, approaching me like that.
Starting the year by visiting a shrine for good luck? Hah! As if the gods will favor you any more in the new year...
In Niðavellir, the New Year pyrotechnics are something to behold...
This kimono...is acceptable, I've decided.
Reginn continues to trail behind me... What is she expecting from me?
At New Year, it's customary to give gifts to those beneath you... Here—this is for you.

lyre.name: Lyre
lyre.title: Lap Cat of Luxury
lyre.description: A cat warrior from Gallia, home of the beast tribe of laguz. Wrapped in a kimono for the first time, she is enjoying herself to the fullest. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall:
I wonder if anyone will appear in my first dream of the year...
Probably Lethe, right? Oh, but what if it's Captain Ranulf!
Getting to wear such a pretty outfit is like a dream come true. Now Lethe and I can be kimono twins!
Urk... Rice cake...stuck...in throat!
I missed out on seeing the first sunrise of the year, so I'm waiting for the second. Want to join me?
So, this is a long-sleeved kimono, huh? I gotta say, I love it! I wonder if Captain Ranulf does too...
Visit: Hey there! New Year's greetings from [F]'s castle!
Level: New year, new me! But who's gonna judge how much I've improved? Oh, I know! Yoo-hoo, Captain Ranulf!
This year is going to be great!
Urk... I think I had a bit too much to eat at the feast the other night. I think I'm just gonna lie down for a bit...
Summon: Happy New Year! Getting to meet me, the ever-so-lovely Lyre, means your year's off to a pretty good start!
Learn Skill: Thanks a bunch!
Confession:
This has all been so amazing, [S]!
I absolutely, positively, totally, and completely, LOVE IT!
The New Year is always fun, but celebrating it like this? I don't think I've seen a single frown all day!
I think we all need something like this sometimes. Having to fight all the time can get pretty exhausting.
You know what I mean, right? After all, getting along is way better than fighting. Everyone knows that!
And now that the greetings are all out of the way...it's time for the gifts!
So go on, cough 'em up!
Special: I want my New Year's gifts!
Status: Happy New Year! Let's celebrate!
Hey, what was that for?!
I wanted to get up early and watch the first sunrise of the year, but, uh, I kinda slept through it.
I've got my very own kimono! Not so special anymore, are you, Lethe? *laugh*
So what if I eat all this? I'm sure Kyza packs away just as much—if not more!
I bet Captain Ranulf's gonna give me a ton of New Year's money! Aaaaaany second now...
Spending the New Year with you is the most fun ever!

kyza.name: Kyza
kyza.title: Tiger of Fortune
kyza.description: A tiger warrior from Gallia, home of the beast tribe of laguz. Serious and dutiful, not even New Year's celebrations can keep them from their training. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Aren't kimonos lovely? Getting this one made was a bit difficult, but one day even that will be a great memory.

A world in which people, regardless of who they are, can celebrate the new year together...
If our rulers can build such a world, I have no doubt its future will be bright beyond compare.
If you revel too much, a foe might see it as an opportunity to strike. So take care to never drop your guard.
Is Captain Ranulf here? Oh, Lyre asked the same thing? Really now... That girl's getting ahead of herself.
Hmph... Hyah! No matter the season, a true warrior of Gallia neither forgets nor neglects their training.
Visit:
Happy New Year. You are friends with [F], right?
I was asked to bring you this. Here, greetings for the new year.
Level: Heheh... It looks like this year is going to be a very good one indeed.
I haven't neglected my training, so my fangs are as sharp as ever. This battle is only just getting started.
This is a trivial setback. I assure you it will not hinder the performance of my troop.
Summon: Happy New Year. Let's greet this year as allies.
Learn Skill: If you wish it...I will obey.
Confession:
Oh, [S]!
Ahem... Excuse me, Summoner. Going to the shrine together the other day was fun, wasn't it?
I wished for the safety and peace of this land, as well as the prosperity of my people in Gallia.
Hm? Did you expect me to wish for something involving Captain Ranulf?
Oh, Summoner... The two of us already share an unbreakable bond forged on countless battlefields.
It is the duty and pride of a warrior of Gallia to use their power to its utmost when the need arises.
Rest assured, I shall show you all that I am capable of here, on this stage and beneath these clear blue skies.
I pray that we will be able to spend this year and the many years that lie beyond it at each others' sides.
Right now, in this moment...that is what I wish for. What is your wish?
Special: May you have an excellent start!
Status: Happy New Year. May we both succeed in all our endeavors.
Hm? Were you trying to push me? I almost thought a bug landed on my shoulder.
Aren't kimonos lovely? I feel even more graceful than usual in this!
It's cute that you think you have a chance, Lyre... But I'm not letting you have Captain Ranulf this year either!
Do you know where Captain Ranulf is? I need to make sure he sees my new look!
The start of a new year is a time of celebration. We all feel that, no matter who we are.
May we always be together this year as well.

joshua3.name: Joshua
joshua3.title: Resolute Tempest
joshua3.description: Prince of Jehanna who tossed his status aside to wander the land. Heir to his mother's dream, he's sworn to protect his homeland and world. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I want to believe that Carlyle only desired to protect my mother, but... his actions speak for themselves.

I always intended to return to the throne. I just had to become worthy of it first.
I am, if nothing else, my mother's son...and a child of Jehanna.
A flower can't bloom unless its roots run deep enough to sustain it. If only I had understood that as a youth...
I need to turn my focus to the state. There are so few leaders who grasp the true value of coin...
Jehanna Hall lies in cinders, but we will rebuild. We have more pressing needs to take care of first, however...
Visit: I've heard only good things about you. May your friendship with [F] continue on.
Level: I promised my mother that I would help destroy the Dark Stone. I will defend Jehanna and her future!
I learned these techniques long ago, in my youth. Useful, aren't they?
It seems I still have further to go...but that just gives me something to focus my efforts on!
Summon: The winds of change are howling. It's time to finish what my mother started and usher in a new era of prosperity!
Learn Skill: I will become stronger, not only in body, but also in mind. The people deserve nothing less from a king.
Confession:
It's hard to put into words, but...I've finally stopped running, stopped thinking only about myself.
When Grado invaded, I didn't grasp the threat. How could I have known Jehanna Hall would be burned?
Because I was too slow and naive, Carlyle's traitorous plot came to pass. I lost my mother because of that.
It was probably too late, but I should have returned immediately when I learned who led Grado's army.
Despite my failures as a son, the queen never failed me. She taught me what it means to rule with grace.
I'm done wandering aimlessly. From now on, I'm going to do everything in my power to protect my people.
Special: If it's a fight you want...
Status: What'll it be—heads or tails? I'm feeling pretty lucky today.
Who's there?! Oh, it's you. Don't sneak up on me like that.
Long ago, I grew tired of the formality of palace life, so I left. I felt I could never understand the people, sequestered in a castle.
I was a fool in my youth, yes, but I learned much over these ten years.
I know it doesn't sound like me, but…I will defend Jehanna and her allies.
I have learned much, but I've lost much more. Mother...
I've wagered everything on you. Let's win this thing.

rennac.name: Rennac
rennac.title: Rich "Merchant"
rennac.description: A thief forced to accompany L'Arachel on her adventures. Member of a wealthy merchant family and well-versed in the ways of the world. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: The name of the game is making money. Money is all that matters. When will that little urchin learn?
Trying to find a worthy prince who's willing to take Princess L'Arachel? Dozla has his work cut out for him.
Colm thinks we're alike because he was forced to do a little gardening? Hah. I'll show him what real work is.
Merchants are stingy. It's who they are. My father was especially stingy. He gave me nothing for free.
I prefer to earn rewards that aren't for the taking, if you catch my drift. I won't pull a muscle trying, though.
Visit: Granted, Princess L'Arachel is worse, but I landed with a real taskmaster when I met [F].
Level: You'll never beat me with skills like that. You're greener than the fruit I left out for a month.
Slow... slow... quick, quick, slow... Too bad battle is not akin to dancing with a beautiful woman...
These people respect my abilities and value my skills... Well, at least I hope that's still the case...
Summon: I'm Rennac of Carcino. I beg your indulgence, and a fair bit of gold, should you choose to employ me.
Learn Skill: Mercenaries fight to get paid, simple as that. So it's nothing personal if I don't stick around, OK?
Confession:
*sigh* Oh. Apologies. I was told by a rather noisy companion that it's rude to sigh when you see someone.
Heh. She also asked me what makes me happy. I hadn't ever given it much thought until then, if I'm honest.
She told me to treasure what I do possess instead of lamenting what I don't. I know she meant well, but...
I'm the son of a Carcino merchant. I grew up believing you could move the world if you had enough gold.
Bah, I shouldn't complain. This isn't what I'm paid to worry about. I'll just try to make the best of it.
Special: I think I'll just scamper off.
Status: The name's Rennac. I'm a world-class thief, and proud of it.
Do you see this jacket? It has silk embroidery. The truly cultured man cares about every detail.
They say Prince Ephraim hoards money like a starving beast with a fresh kill.
The name of the game is making money. Money is all that matters.
I thought working for a princess would pay well.
Hey, you haven't clapped eyes on Princess L'Arachel, have you?
I'm a useful fellow to have around. And cheap, too! Only 9,980 gold!

colm.name: Colm
colm.title: Capable Thief
colm.description: A thief from a village in Renais called Lark. Daring enough to infiltrate the lair of the bandits who burned down his village, and do so alone. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Neimi and I... We've got no home to return to. It's up to me to make sure we don't go through that again.
You may see my path as a dark road...but some of us don't know anything other than a thief's life.
You look tired. My mother taught me a secret remedy...I think it was for pimples, but it helps insomnia too!
I'm gonna have a quick look around the enemy camp. Backup? Nah, it'll be easier if I go alone.
Oof! Sorry for bumping into you. Huh? Oh, relax. I didn't pickpocket anything...this time. Ha ha!
Visit:
You're [S], right?
Good. Here, this is for you. And with that, my job here is done. Later!
Level: How do you like that? Pretty good, huh? Ha ha ha! Oh, please. You're embarrassing me...
Great! This is so encouraging! With this, I can continue fighting for my friends!
I can't stop now... Neimi needs me... I have to push through this!
Summon: Hey. I'm a handy guy to have around. I know I can help you out. You won't regret taking me on, I swear!
Learn Skill: You value my service? Neat! This will help me pay you back twice over.
Confession:
Focusing on your enemies is good and all, but what about your friends? Aren't they just as important?
In my opinion, Prince Alfonse and everyone else are a lot like Prince Ephraim and Princess Eirika.
I mean, they both have a strong sense of justice and a pure heart, but that's just what worries me.
Sometimes people with their head in the clouds need friends like us to keep them grounded, you know?
I just want what's best for Askr, so that no other village gets torched by bandits like mine did.
Status: Name's Colm. I'm a handy guy to have around. I know I can help you out.
What? I didn't steal anything! Seriously!
Prince Ephraim hates studying. He's just like me!
Neimi and I... We've got no home to return to.
People in my... profession... have sharp eyes. Far-off enemies? I'll spot 'em.
Neimi... I'm the only one who can make you cry.
Stick with me—I promise you won't regret your decision.

neimi.name: Neimi
neimi.title: Tearful Archer
neimi.description: A hunter from Lark, a village in Renais. Joins the Renais military after bandits burn her hometown to the ground in the midst of war's chaos. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: *sniff* I'm fine. I just...have something in my eye... *sniffle*
This hand mirror was my mother's. She was a cleric, but...when I was younger...an illness...*sniff*
These are michew berries from my hometown. They're shiny, sweet, and a little tart. Want to try?
Grandpa never did join the army. He said that it wasn't in his nature. It's not in mine either but...I want to help.
Hmm? Oh, I-I was just restringing my bow. Grandpa taught me everything I know about archery, including this...
Visit:
Are you [S]?
Oh, that's a relief! I was asked to deliver this to you!
Level: Grandpa used to only take one arrow with him when he went hunting. I hope to be that skilled someday...
Well, I might not be the best, but when something needs to be done... I do it.
Where'd my mother's hand mirror go? What? The leather strap! It's torn! Ohhh... *sniff*... Waaah!
Summon: I'm Neimi... *sniff* Colm says I'm a bit of a crybaby, but I'll do my very best, I promise!
Learn Skill: *sniff*... I'm so...so happy!
Confession:
Thank you for looking after me. It's really kind of you, [S].
I've always needed someone to watch my back, like Colm...though he doesn't seem happy to do it.
We grew up together, and I know he cares for me, but... *sniff* He can be really blunt sometimes...
But he did rescue me when I fell into a river and helped repair Grandpa's bow when I broke it...
When our village was torched by bandits, he was there, at my side... *sniff* Oh, I hope they're at peace...
Grandpa and the rest of the villagers would want me to hold my head up high. So that's exactly what I'll do!
Status: I'm Neimi. I've learned a little of archery. I hope it will be helpful to you.
*yelp* Don't scare me like that! *quails*
I wasn't crying... I just...have something in my eye...
This hand mirror hanging from my waist is a keepsake from my mother. She was a cleric.
I was just restringing my bow. Grandpa taught me how to shoot when I was little.
Thank you, Colm. For then and now... I like you a lot...
Don't go running off into danger alone. I'm worried about you... *sniff*

riev.name: Riev
riev.title: Blood Beryl
riev.description: A heretical priest shrouded in mystery. As one of Grado's six generals, he is known by the name Blood Beryl. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Heh heh heh...
I, the Demon King's faithful servant, bask in his radiant power! I shall take revenge on those who scorned me!
Heh heh heh... You keep watch even at this time of night? Such a diligent summoner you are.
Gaze deeply into this azure jewel. Do you not wish to become lost in its cerulean depths? Heh heh heh...
My work is far from done. I must not rest until darkness has snuffed out every ray of light...
Visit: Heh heh heh. You're the summoner? Very well. Accept this small token.
Level: Heh heh heh... Humans will never conquer darkness. Drown in a never-ending night!
Can't you see what the night is hiding? No... The power of true fear is not yours to fathom.
Grrr...
Summon: Heh heh heh... You desire my power? You had best be prepared to pay the price...
Learn Skill: I will drown all in unending agony! Heh heh heh... Heh heh heh heh!
Confession:
Heh heh heh. I am one of Grado's six great generals. I have come to be known as the Blood Beryl...
A name that grants me freedom to travel the empire unhindered. What a wonderful benefit for my master.
Humans...are but beasts, living only to sate their wretched desires. Don't you agree, [S]?
Humanity must return to the void... Yet the unenlightened cannot help but struggle against such a fate.
Follow me and see what it means to transcend all others in this world. Heh heh heh!
Status: I am Riev. Riev the Blood Beryl. Heh heh heh...
Hm? Do not bother me with foolishness. I am too busy...
Humans will never conquer darkness. Drown in a never-ending night.
I, the Demon King's faithful servant, will bask in his radiant power.
He believes that thing is his wife... Aren't people amusing?
Mansel... You should never have excommunicated me. The Demon King will be your new master!
Leave everything to your humble servant, Riev. Heh heh heh...

azura6.name: Azura
azura6.title: Hatari Duet
azura6.description: Hoshido-raised Azura and Leanne of the Heron Clan descend upon the Hatari festival, ready to take on their roles as songstresses. They appear in Fire Emblem Fates / Path of Radiance.
azura6.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Grants another action to ally with the highest HP that is within 2 spaces, has already acted, and is from the same titles as unit (excluding unit). (Allies with Sing or Dance can be granted this effect as well. If multiple units meet the conditions, effect will not trigger.)
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Leanne**: Excitement is in the air...I feel it. The festival...brings such joy. I wish to go out...and sing!
**Azura**: Leanne's singing is so mysterious. It's pure and clear...like the clearest water in a still pond.
**Leanne**: Azura's voice...makes me very happy. It is...so pretty. I wish to hear it... forever and ever!
**Azura**: Everyone seems to be in high spirits. Both the fighters and spectators are enjoying the festival in their own way.
**Leanne**: Tibarn told my brother...not to fight. The festival tournament...is too dangerous. Tibarn said.
Visit: **Leanne**: You are invited...to join a Hatari festival. Come enjoy it. At [F]'s castle.
Level: **Azura**: Let us harmonize, Leanne, so our song can bestow courage on all the brave fighters of this festival!
**Leanne**: We must...continue! The festival is... just getting started!
**Azura**: There's no need to strain yourself, Leanne. Let's find something fun to do while our voices recover!
Summon: I am Azura, and this is Leanne of the Heron Clan. Listen now as we raise our voices to this valiant festival.
Learn Skill: **Leanne**: Thank you. This will help us...to sing even more! Everyone...at the festival... will enjoy our song.
Confession:
**Azura**: That was quite an experience, wasn't it, Leanne? How did you enjoy the Hatari festival?
**Leanne**: Everyone was...so brave! Such passion...strength...skill.
**Azura**: A real battle can end only in tragedy, but this festival celebrates the beauty of combat without the sorrow.
**Leanne**: Why is there not...always a festival? Beauty instead...of pain. Seems like something...to strive for.
**Azura**: If we did, combat would be a part of daily life. Better to admire it from afar than to always live in its shadow.
**Leanne**: You are...right. I shall sing...to make beauty and...celebrate peace until the festival returns!
Status: *Sigh*
You have a beautiful voice. Thank you...
Conversation: **Azura**: Are you ready?
**Leanne**: Yes... I am ready.
**Azura**: I think this festival's a little on the boisterous side! Why did we get summoned here, of all places?
I can handle myself, but I worry about you, Leanne.
**Leanne**: No, I... I like Hatari.
Hatari has a strong queen...and now my brother is here too.
**Azura**: That's right! Your brother and Queen Nailah are a couple, aren't they?
Well! That being the case, this is your brother's festival too, I suppose!
**Leanne**: Hahaha. What are your brothers and sisters like? Do you get along?
**Azura**: What are they like? That's a difficult question... I have a lot of them, after all. It's...complicated.
**Leanne**: Complicated? You mean...difficult? Your family?
**Azura**: It can be, yes. But they're all precious to me. Every one...
**Leanne**: If that is...your feeling, then... You are true family...
**Azura**: You're right, Leanne. I cherish them all as family.
**Leanne**: Let's sing! Bring joy to all!
**Azura**: Yes, let us sing. Let us sing so that all of my brothers and sisters can hear us!
We will sing a gentle song that will bring their hearts just a little bit closer together...
Duo Skill: Let our voices ring out! Listen to our song!
I like your song! Heehee! Thank you, Leanne.

karla2.name: Karla
karla2.title: Sun-Piercing Steel
karla2.description: A swordswoman known as the Sword Vassal. Looking to test her limits at Hatari's festival, where many a proud fighter has gathered. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I am told that this is traditional Hatari festival garb. It does not offer much protection, but it is easy to fight in.
This festival would be a good chance to test myself against Karel without either of us losing our lives...
Even while wielding another weapon, the spirit of the sword burns within my soul. It is my constant companion.
Do not expect me to go easy on you just because this is a festival. If you wish to test me, bring your very best.
They say Hatari was isolated from the rest of the world for years, like I was isolated from my tribe.
Visit: I am Karla. Know that the passion of the Hatari festival is alive and well at [F]'s castle.
Level: It will take opponents far stronger than this to make me flinch!
I think I have gotten over my initial unfamiliarity with this garb. Now I can really cut loose.
How could I let this happen... Did I lose myself in the festivities again?
Summon: I am Karla. My expertise lies in blades, but I hope to learn more about how Hatari warriors fight with a lance.
Learn Skill: This festival has something to teach all of us, it seems.
Confession:
I have not yet thanked you for inviting me to this festival of warriors, have I?
My sole purpose in life has been to become skilled enough with the blade to surpass my brother.
Even knowing that it would force me to either take my opponent's life, or lose my own...I fought to surpass him.
I did not think highly of those who would risk their lives in an arena for a chance at fame and fortune.
But what drives this festival is different: not glory, but passion. Not vanity, but pride.
I am thankful for each and every one of my opponents. I will not forget this experience for as long as I live.
Status: Thank you for inviting me to the festival.
*sigh* To think I would wear something like this... I must have lost myself in the festivities.
Queen Nailah's skills are impressive. Exactly what I look for in an opponent.
I may be unaccustomed to this weapon, but I will not need excuses.
I have seen many festivals in my travels, but...none as lively as this.
This festival is filled with many skilled participants... Will my brother be drawn here as well?
I am glad you think this suits me, but...for some reason, I feel a little embarrassed hearing you say it.

nailah3.name: Nailah
nailah3.title: Hatari Scorcher
nailah3.description: Queen of Hatari, a desert kingdom. Holding one of Hatari's traditional festivals in Askr for a bit of fun. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Traditional Hatari festival garb instills courage in the wearer, and paints the battlefield in a storm of glorious color.
Hatari culture thrives in part due to our long isolation from the rest of Tellius.
I can best any competitor with my strength alone. I need not rely only upon the power of the evil eye.
Ike and his group have no interest in participating? Odd that they pass up an opportunity to test their skills.
We ask only this of our competitors... Believe in your strength. Fight until you have nothing left to give!
Visit: You are hereby invited to the Hatari festival by your good friend [F].
Level: The savage strikes of the wolf queen will rattle your very bones!
Do not hold back on account of this being a festival. Bare your fangs!
If this is not enough to lift our spirits, then I shall double my efforts!
Summon: I, Nailah, ruler of the desert kingdom Hatari, look forward to seeing the Askr people enjoy my land's festival.
Learn Skill: Give yourself over to the festival! Let its frenzied atmosphere nourish your soul!
Confession:
The desert can be cruel. Everything seems built to kill you. Still, such adversity can be unifying.
When you fight only to survive... race, creed, and upbringing stop having much meaning.
Strong are ties forged in adversity. It is for this reason that our festival is focused so heavily on combat.
When you bare your fangs, others see that you are willing and ready to defend what matters most to you.
Have you taken the opportunity to find a battle sister or brother during the festival, [S]?
Let the festival's excitement awaken your primal rage. Only then can you learn the true limits of your strength!
Status: I am Nailah, Queen of Hatari. Welcome to my desert.
You are in my domain. I'd advise you to tread lightly.
Fighting to fight is a waste. This festival gives fighting a purpose.
My festival garb is much more comfortable than my formal attire.
Don't mind my companion. Rafiel is only here to spectate.
It's important to make time for a celebration every now and then.
What do you think of the festival? Give me an outsider's perspective.

xane2.name: Xane
xane2.title: Desert Mirage
xane2.description: A mysterious young man who can adopt the appearance of others. He's come to answer the call of Hatari festivities with aplomb. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: A festival for fighters, eh? Seems like there's a festival for everything! So... how 'bout one for dragons?
Y'know, I remember princey dropping by an arena when he needed cash... Well, no danger of dyin' this time!
I wonder if Kris would want to crack some skulls. Our powers combined, we'd sweep the competition!
Mirages are pretty common in the desert, right? They trick you into seeing things...just like me!
Y'know, I bet if I impersonated a dancer, I'd get everyone on their feet in no time! But who to choose...
Visit: How'd I get past your guards? Easy! I just went ahead and impersonated [F]. Hah!
Level: Yeah! This is the best feelin' in the world! Keep it up, keep it up!
Hah hah! Life's too short not to laugh at yourself! Feelin' less nervous now? Good. No point bein' too serious.
Dang! I knew somethin' was off. My transformation must've failed partway through...
Summon: The name's Xane. So, these are the festival grounds? Who should I mimic first to make the biggest splash?
Learn Skill: Everyone's spirits are soarin' at this festival. And with this, mine are too!
Confession:
Funny story: Nailah caught me right as I started to impersonate her. The wolf queen herself, outta nowhere.
Thought I was done for, but she just chuckled and said I didn't look nearly fierce enough for her liking...
Guess even royals like her gotta have a sense of humor. We both had a good laugh over that one.
Even though we're here to celebrate the land's seasons and culture, we gotta have fun while doing it too.
If I can help just one person forget their troubles for a day, I'm gonna keep at it till I collapse!
Status: Up and at 'em!
Get back out there!
This festival's a little on the rowdy side!
Hey, what was that? You lookin' for a fight? This seems to be the place! *chuckle*
Maybe I should change into someone with BIG muscles. I could muscle my way to the top of the heap!
Does it even matter who wins? But I guess I can't just watch, now can I?
Imagine if I changed into you and took the crown! Ain't gonna happen, but you'd be tickled, wouldn't you?

deen.name: Deen
deen.title: Bladed Sandstorm
deen.description: A skilled mercenary who once came to Celica's aid. Having been invited to the Hatari festival, he decided he would see it for himself. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I was told I must wear this outfit to participate in the festival. It wouldn't be my first choice of attire...
Soldiers don't have the luxury of choosing their battlefields. This isn't my first fight in arid conditions.
The festival atmosphere is lively and fun, but the bloodlust...is palpable.
This festival isn't a game. I'm here to prove my strength in gladiatorial combat. No one will stop me.
I don't need anyone cheering me on. But I won't try to stop you, either.
Visit: I have a message for you. This is it: there's a festival in full swing at [F]'s castle.
Level: Are they all cheering for me? Huh. What an odd thing to hear.
This is just a festival? Maybe. But the combat's real. I'm not going to take it easy on you.
Ugh. I'm better than this...
Summon: I'm Deen. I've heard Hatari's a place where people like me can enjoy a show of strength.
Learn Skill: Something that can help me during my fights? I'd be a fool to say no.
Confession:
Whenever I swing my blade, death's at hand. Either my opponent's gonna lose their life, or I am.
A soldier has to kill to live. The longer you survive, the more blood you get on your hands.
This festival's different though. Here, the loser lives to fight again. Just with a well-bruised ego.
I didn't respect my opponents at first. But now I get that there's merit to sparring and not dueling to the death.
My opponents took me seriously, and were proud to test their skill against mine. They taught me to do the same.
This festival has made me reconsider what it means to have strength, and I'll always be grateful for that.
Status: Here, I get to test myself against the best of the best. It's a fair reward for enduring the crowds.
I know the festival's exciting, but go be excited somewhere else.
The Hatari queen's strength is clear from her gaze alone.
My clothing? I'm told it's from a place called Hatari.
Princess Celica was all smiles when she heard I'd be here for the festival.
I used to enjoy this sort of thing, but those days are long gone.
You really are having fun, huh? Well, that's good enough for me.

elimine.name: Elimine
elimine.title: Scouring Saint
elimine.description: One of the Eight Legends who defeated the dragons during the Scouring. Her teachings live on as passed down by the Elimine Church. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.
elimine.artist: Alan Smithee (阿藍澄史) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: The light of one's heart can illuminate darkness, cleanse the mind of doubt, and ease suffering.
The Demon Dragon's spawn, the war dragons, proved a great threat. So we eight marched upon their stronghold.
Our victory over the Demon Dragon was possible only with our sacred weapons and many great sacrifices.
The dragons were not fully broken by weapons. It was bonds between hearts that enabled the killing blow.
It is true that we defeated the Demon Dragon. Yet it was not destroyed... Hartmut's kindness saved it.
Visit: A bond between hearts is a testament to strength. I pray your bond with [F] is eternal.
Level: The seven affinities were a gift from God. If we strengthen our bonds, those affinities can shine.
Our hearts are weak alone. We must have guidance to forge the proper bonds that will make us strong.
Never forget that dragons are but destruction given form. Our sacred weapons are our only defense.
Summon: I am Elimine. Accept my guidance and be one with the light that heals your neighbor and extinguishes demons.
Learn Skill: Let us be one with the light that would pierce the Demon Dragon's darkness.
Confession:
The hearts of men are weak and feelings are fleeting. The eight of us were no different.
All pray for peace. But who will build that peace? And who will protect it?
After we sealed the dragon, we faced a terrible trial... Endless icy darkness. It must never happen again.
One man's kindness was enough to sow discord, to weaken our chain... Our bonds must be as hard as iron.
We must face the danger the dragons pose with eyes unclouded, united in our opposition to their threat.
Of all, you must understand what it is I seek. Let us play our parts until the end, [S].
Status: May God bless us all.
There is always a light.
My name is Elimine. I am a servant of God.
I am the last goddess to descend upon the land... Is that truly what people say?
Instead of intervening directly in their affairs, God chooses to believe in people.
The dragons must never return. They would bring calamity.
I pray that God will grace you with good fortune.

chrom6.name: Chrom
chrom6.title: Fate-Defying Duo
chrom6.description: A pair connected by a bond that transcends even time. They are handing out tokens of gratitude for the Day of Devotion. They appear in Fire Emblem Awakening.
chrom6.duo:
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-5 on unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit through their next actions and grants【Grand Strategy】to those units.
Grants the following effect to unit for 1 turn: "Foe cannot make a follow-up attack."
【Grand Strategy】 Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = current penalty on each of unit's stats × 2 for 1 turn. (Example: if unit has -7 penalty to Atk, grants Atk+14, for a net bonus of Atk+7.) Calculates each stat bonus independently.
Unit's negative effects that last "through unit's next action" will remain in effect until this status (Grand Strategy) is neutralized.

Castle Hall: **Chrom**: Putting your life on the line to protect those most precious to you... I think there could be no greater act of love.
**Robin**: Having someone to express your love to is an amazing thing. There IS more to life than constant battle!
**Robin**: I made sure to research what everyone wanted as a gift. It's a special occasion, after all.
**Chrom**: My sister loved her people. She led with warmth and benevolence. I plan on following her example.
**Chrom**: Does Robin like these clothes? I find them somewhat embarrassing, but he wears them so well, and so proudly...
Visit: **Robin**: Hello! I come bearing an invitation to the Day of Devotion, compliments of [F].
Level: **Chrom**: Even fate can be changed by love!
**Robin**: Hmm... I suppose this is OK, but I can do better. I just want my strategy to prove useful to Chrom.
**Chrom**: Urgh. Was I not grateful enough?
Summon: I am Chrom of Ylisse. It is my pleasure to take part in the Day of Devotion with my companion Robin.
Learn Skill: **Robin**: I can feel your love through this. You are a skillful leader indeed.
Confession:
**Chrom**: Phew. Did we get to everyone? I'd never have guessed that showing we cared would be so...difficult.
I think I'm more used to swinging a blade than delivering gifts. I'm more exhausted than I should be.
**Robin**: Hmm. Maybe the Shepherds' only goal isn't just protecting people from their enemies...
Perhaps their role is also to support and care for those they protect, so everyone can live happily, in peace.
At least...that's what I think...
**Chrom**: Protect not just their lives, but their happiness as well? I think you may be on to something, Robin.
It's a noble goal, ensuring that those we care for feel supported. I will hold that in my heart from now on.
Status: Hm...
• "Who should we give this to?" • "Let's consider it carefully."
Conversation: **Robin**: There's Lissa, Emmeryn, Lucina, Frederick... I think we've got gifts for everyone. Don't we?
**Chrom**: Well, all but one. What would you like your gift to be, Robin?
**Robin**: What? Me? You can't just come out and ask like that, you know. There are rules!
**Chrom**: You know I don't care about that. Just tell me what you want.
**Robin**: Truthfully...I can't think of anything.
**Chrom**: You don't want anything? Aw, come on. Think of the bind that puts me in.
**Robin**: You gave my life meaning when I had nothing—not even my memory.
The sense of purpose I've found at your side, working for peace in the world, is all I could ever ask for.
**Chrom**: You're not alone in that, you know. I feel the same way.
That's why I wanted to give you something nice. To show you how I feel.
**Robin**: All right, all right. In that case, why don't you give me one of those flowers you're wearing?
**Chrom**: It's only going to wilt.
**Robin**: I'll press it into one of my books. That way I'll never forget this Day of Devotion.
**Chrom**: You're too easy to please. If only Lissa could learn that from you.
Speaking of, I'd better start passing out these gifts.
**Robin**: Don't be shy about it, Chrom. Remember, the whole point of this is to show your gratitude.
**Chrom**: I know, I know. No need to nag me, I'm not a child.

lucina6.name: Lucina
lucina6.title: Future Fondness
lucina6.description: Chrom's daughter from the future. The flowers she's adorned with are a perfect fit for the Day of Devotion. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: The Day of Devotion lives up to its name. Every face I see is lit up with a smile, like a flower in bloom.
In my desperate future, almost all blossoms have withered away. That is why I want to protect these flowers.
I can't believe you prepared such a gorgeous outfit for me. Should I wear my mask as well? Hmm...maybe not.
Never forget to hold on to your feelings of gratitude. That mindset is important, no matter where you are.
I'm looking for flowers that will suit my father. If you find any that you think he'll like, please let me know.
Visit: On this Day of Devotion, I come with words of gratitude from the castle of [F].
Level: Fate can be changed by the power of love!
I hope many smiles bloom today!
Kyah! I blame this on my dress! I'm not used to wearing such things, and the hem got tangled...
Summon: The Day of Devotion... I'm not used to such extravagance! But I'll try my best to cherish every moment.
Learn Skill: I've heard your wishes. With this power, I will ensure the future is filled with love and flowers!
Confession:
A world without flowers, where all life has slowly withered away... Can you imagine, [S]?
That's the world I'm from, the world I want to prevent. There, no one could think of love...only survival.
I traveled here in hopes that, together, my father and I could stop that horrible future from happening.
I want to restore the world to one where people can focus on love and gratitude. Where flowers can bloom.
I won't give up on a future where everyone can cherish that beauty. We all deserve such a happy world.
I hope that whatever happens, the future of Askr is overflowing with love. Together, we can make it so.
Status: This is a festival of love, isn't it? This is my chance to show everyone just how much they mean to me.
Hm? Oh, is something stuck in my hair?
I'd better get these flowers delivered while they're still alive!
*chuckle* Do you like my flower crown?
I had my own idea for an outfit, but no one seemed to like it...
Nothing makes me happier than showing my parents that I love them.
I've truly come to appreciate you. I hope you know you mean a lot to me.

frobin5.name: Robin
frobin5.title: Tactful Deliverer
frobin5.description: A tactician of Ylisse joining in on the Day of Devotion festivities in hopes of expressing her gratitude to those she holds dear. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Love is such a tricky thing. It can be someone's critical weakness, just as it can be their source of strength.
That man with Chrom is a Robin from another world, right? They get along so well, I'm almost jealous...
What do you think of my outfit? Hmm... I wonder if Chrom would share your opinion...
My tactical treatises contain nothing about love. I suppose I'll have to fill in the blanks myself...
Empathy, compassion, and gratitude are our best weapons against the forces of darkness and despair.
Visit: The Day of Devotion reminds us to show our friends we care. That's why [F] sent me!
Level: I've survived so many conflicts... Through them, I've learned that love can transcend any obstacle.
I hope that those closest to me understand just how truly grateful I am for them.
Perhaps I am over-complicating this. Expressing love may not require such an intricate strategy, after all...
Summon: My name is Robin, the tactician for Chrom's Shepherds. I have a strategy for livening up this Day of Devotion.
Learn Skill: I appreciate this token of your affection. I will not let it go to waste.
Confession:
My mind was a blank slate when I first met Chrom. I couldn't remember anything, not even who I was.
Because of that, I didn't have any goals, nor any drive to move forward. All I had were my skills as a tactician.
Thankfully, I was welcomed in by Chrom and the rest of the Shepherds. They made me feel at home.
They taught me everything I know about courage and hope, and for that I am forever grateful.
They showed me the love that we all share for our world...and the strength required to shield it from harm.
I think the greatest act of gratitude I could express is sharing that joy with everyone I meet.
Special: I've put all my heart into this!
Status: I hear today is the Day of Devotion—the perfect chance to show how much we love the people who are always there for us.
Hm? Oh, you have a present for me? That's so sweet of you!
There are many I am grateful to, but even among them, Chrom is special.
Flowers! And they smell so lovely... I've been told flowers soothe the soul, and I tend to agree.
Would you mind waiting a moment? I need to figure out the optimal route for getting to every stall before the festival ends.
Showing our gratitude and being considerate of others... That's how we make a kinder, more peaceful world.
Here, this flower reminded me of you. I hope that we can continue to fight side by side, just like this.
Map Select: Your joy is mine as well.

owain2.name: Owain
owain2.title: Devoted Defender
owain2.description: Lissa's son from the future. Poised to take the Day of Devotion by storm, ready to unleash his unconventional approach to festivities. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
"One without the capacity to love has not the capacity to be a Hero..."
Who said that? Oh, um...I made it up.

What a glorious flower. I wonder what it's called? A name as lilting as its petals are beautiful, I'd wager.
In the future in which I was raised, I was so focused on surviving that I was unable to appreciate such things.

I must devise a special move befitting the Day of Devotion. Maybe... Love Flame! No... Heart Slash?
Hmm... Neither of those have that special ring to them...

Rage on, oh hurricane of love! I will hold true to myself, with my indomitable soul...
Mother?! How long have you been watching that?!
A true warrior of love and flowers can wear anything well!
Visit: Hark! It is I, Owain, messenger of love! I come to impart the undying affection of [F].
Level: My Brand...it cries out... Saying I must express more gratitude!
Urgh. No, this is bad. Run! Before my love covers the entire world!
No! It cannot be! Do you mean to say I don't...have enough...love?!
Summon:
Master, you called? Now that I, Owain, have come to your aid, this Day of Devotion is sure to succeed!
I mean...I'll do my best.
Learn Skill: Oh wow, are you sure about this? Giving me such power... My gratitude will go on a rampage!
Confession:
All things with a form will surely fade in time. Such is the fate of all material phenomena...
But love! Love is everlasting! Feelings, once woven, will ride across eternity! In other words, love is eternal!
Why do I say this? Because I am pierced with the arrow of love and am feeling an outpouring of affection.
It is because of my mother's love that I am the man I am today. One could even say that love creates the future.
You have taken such good care of me, in a myriad of ways. That in itself is a form of love, is it not?
So please, take these flowers. They aren't enough to show my gratitude, but I shall show it fully with time!
Status: Hark! I have been reborn as the warrior of love and flowers! Oh, uh... Is that how it goes? Never mind.
Hey, cut that out! I can't risk crushing these flowers.
This outfit may not suit my dark and debonair persona... Yes, that's it! This must be a trial from fate itself!
I'm working on a new move. First, I throw a bunch of petals into the air, and then, while my foe's vision is obscured, I strike! Pretty cool, huh?
I never let down my guard—not even during a festival that looks...really fun, actually. Hmph.
I want to express my gratitude to Mother today, but I just can't seem to find the right words...
You're always helping me out. I wish to show you my gratitude.

lissa3.name: Lissa
lissa3.title: Sweet Celebrant
lissa3.description: A princess of Ylisse. Excited to show her appreciation to those closest to her as part of the Day of Devotion. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Look at all these beautiful flowers! I can't help but smile when surrounded by so many colors.
Well, first, I want to show my love for my siblings. Then Maribelle, and Frederick, and... whew, so many!
I won't be playing any pranks today. Promise. Really! This is a day to show gratitude to everyone, not mischief!
Owain! You're taking part in the festival too? Oh, stop your posing and help me deliver gifts to people.
I just love wearing these cute clothes! If it were up to me, I'd celebrate the Day of Devotion every day!
Visit: Guess what I have? No, it isn't a frog! This is a Day of Devotion present for you from [F]!
Level: Yay! I can shine even during the Day of Devotion festival!
I hope I can show just how much I appreciate everyone close to me!
Hmm... Maybe I'm just not showing enough gratitude yet?
Summon: I'm Lissa, a princess of Ylisse! Is this where the Day of Devotion festival is? I need to show my gratitude!
Learn Skill: With this, maybe I can be a noble lady...one capable of discussing love! ...Are you laughing?
Confession:
I wanted to thank you for inviting me to the Day of Devotion. This is the loveliest festival I've ever been to.
All these flowers, everyone smiling... it was such a fun time. It made my brother really happy too!
I learned that rather than focusing on those you dislike, it's best to show gratitude to those you care about.
I just hope this war ends quickly. Then we can really focus on caring for our favorite people...and flowers!
I wish you and my brother the best of luck. I'm sure that, together, you can help bring that happy time about.
Just as importantly, I really think that this festival brought me one step closer to becoming a true lady.
Hey...why are you laughing? I'm being serious!
Special: I'll show you how you matter!
Oooh, look at all the flowers!
Status: Come on, you can do it!
Here, just for you!
There are so many people I'm grateful to… Who to start with?
*surprise* Hey! I'm dressed up like a proper lady, so no pranks today, OK?
*inhale* Mmm, these flowers smell so good! I really hope my sister likes them...
Wouldn't it be nice if everyone could always show how much they appreciated others? Just like we're doing right now!
I know how hard you always work, so... Thank you!

idunn3.name: Idunn
idunn3.title: Divine Demon
idunn3.description: Once a Divine Dragon, she was transformed into the Demon Dragon. After the uprising in Bern, she began a new life in Nabata. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: His Majesty wished...to liberate the world. He may be gone, but that yearning for freedom lives on in me.
The hearts of dragons and humans are so similar, and so easily twisted. If only we had seen that sooner...
Whether it be relaxing, learning, or loving, humans are ever inclined to lose themselves in their pursuits.
I'm...smiling? I'm smiling!
When I see a flower swaying in the wind, I feel as if I finally understand what it means to be alive...
Visit: I am Idunn... I am on a pilgrimage of sorts, to see what I can learn from every corner of the world.
Level: After a thousand suns and a thousand moons, I still await the shared world my brethren dreamed of long ago.
Even if you can't change the past, you can live for the future. Take heart, and move ever forward.
This must be what sorrow feels like...
Summon: I am Idunn... Though I was once in a slumber for years beyond count, my life has begun anew.
Learn Skill: This is but the first step. One day, I will understand the wisdom held by humans and dragons alike.
Confession:
The dream... It felt like it lasted for an eternity. All I could do was wait, trapped utterly alone in a silent void.
I only awoke because His Majesty willed it. A fervent voice, a pair of hollow eyes, and a mighty sword...
In that moment, the seal broke, and my eternity ended.
The isolation had robbed me of my heart, leaving nothing but despair in its wake...just like His Majesty.
The joy of friendship, the hope of new beginning, and the warmth of life... I wish he could also feel these.
His Majesty now slumbers in his own dream, but perhaps he will get that chance one day.
And, when I finally feel truly free, he will be glad...for we are all connected by our dreams.
Status: I feel as if I've been reborn somehow...
*surprise* You're mysterious.
Fae was so happy to see how I've changed.
Wind, trees, laughter... I know these things now. Thanks to them...
Flowers are very beautiful. I like them.
I wonder if...if a heart has grown inside of me...
When I am with you, I can smile.

hugh.name: Hugh
hugh.title: Worldly Mage
hugh.description: Taking after his grandmother Niime, he traveled the world to research dark magic. His travels, however, led him to focus on anima magic. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I spent some time traveling with a kid who was studying elder magic. He had a gift for it that I've never had...
Dark magic, elder magic... No matter what you call it, it just never clicked for me. Anima, on the other hand...
My nana always said my old man had a knack for elder magic. Oh, but most people know it as dark magic, huh?
If you ever need some coin, let me know—I do a bit of lending on the side. It's good money too.

Hmm... How about here? Or maybe over—hey, who's there?! ...Oh, it's only you, [S].
Don't mind me, I'm just looking for a place to lie low for a while.
Visit: Uh... Hi! It may look like I'm sneaking around, but I was actually sent here by your friend. Yes, really!
Level: Hahaha! How do you like that, huh? Don't worry—there's plenty more where that came from!
Clear a path, or face the wrath of this dashingly handsome and eminently talented mage!
This can't be happening... My poor, delicate heart has been pierced clean through! Please, remember me...
Summon: In need of a mage, friend? I'm a lot stronger than I look, and I daresay you'll find my rate quite reasonable.
Learn Skill: Don't you worry—I'm going to put in work that's worth every coin, and then some!
Confession:
My nana is a master of elder magic, so she expected me to follow in her footsteps. But...that didn't work out.
And then I met an orphan who could wield dark magic so...easily. Like it just came naturally to him.
Seeing that made me question my own ancestry. I hail from a family of dark mages, so why couldn't I use it?
According to my nana, though, my aptitude for anima magic comes from my mother. Learning that was...nice.
Oh, do you have a master of your own? You don't seem like you're from around here either...
Hmm... Almost like you've been set adrift, forever wandering...
Ah, it's nothing. You just reminded me of myself, that's all. Guess we've all got our own path to follow, eh?
Status: You need a mage? You got one! The name's Hugh.
Whoa, hey! You after my money?
"Sir"? Did you call me "sir"? That's like a knife in my tender young heart...
I tried to study elder magic. For the life of me, I couldn't figure it out.
One, two, three... What? I have to make sure the gold's all here.
My nana always called me a fool. Me, her own grandson! Can you believe that?
I know you have a tough job, but there's no need to look so serious. Lighten up!

niime.name: Niime
niime.title: Mountain Hermit
niime.description: Scholar of dark magic and ancient dragons. Everyone in Elibe who knows anything about magic has learned her name as well. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: My grandson inherited much from his parents. A shame he also inherited his grandfather's idiocy.
Dragons have always been the mortal enemy of humanity. Even if they appear human, they are anything but.
There's no shortage of pretty young ladies around here. It takes me back to the days of my youth...

I was once quite the beauty, you know. Strapping young men would spend fortunes just to win my heart...
And then I'd dump them. Ha!
What right do people who can't even make their own family happy have to crow on and on about world peace?
Visit:
I'm visiting on behalf of your friend [F].
Don't bother putting together a fancy welcome—a warm cup of tea will do. ...Well? Get to it!
Level: My world has already survived one calamity. Everything I've studied was to make sure we never see a second.
Hah! Too bad for you, there's still some fight left in these old bones.
The darkness is not to be feared. When it calls, answer. Where it leads, follow. Deeper, ever deeper...
Summon: I am Niime. Apparently, my research into elder magic has led some to call me the Mountain Hermit. Hmph.
Learn Skill: I look experienced enough to make use of this? Hmph. That had better be a compliment.
Confession:
The spells I command are often derided as forbidden, dark magic due to their destructive potential.
My son Canas had a natural aptitude for it, but my grandson did not inherit the necessary fortitude of mind.
I had hoped he might be able to carry on my work, and my disappointment led me to being...harsh with him.
Elder magic is mighty, but it takes in equal measure from the one using it... A price too costly for my progeny.
In the end, my work will die with me. There are a few loose ends to tie up, but I trust you are up to the task.
Status: I am Niime, though perhaps you'd know me better as the Mountain Hermit.
Oh, were you trying to startle me? When you've seen as much as I have, little things like that stop surprising you.
Dark magic is not something to take lightly. Used carelessly, its power could destroy the very world around us.
That girl, Sophia... She reminds me of myself, back when I was young.
There is still so much I'd like to learn about dragons...
Perhaps our paths will cross again, in another time or world... Who can say?
It seems I've grown rather fond of you. You should make use of my dark magic!

cath.name: Cath
cath.title: Master Thief
cath.description: Mysterious girl who always seems to show up where there's treasure to be found. In truth, she is a thief known for outsmarting rich nobles. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Heehee... There's no treasure I can't steal. Time to make some coin! Oh, you heard that? Forget I said anything!
When invaders ordered us to set our village on fire, my cowardly father was the first to pick up a torch.
Even a master thief has a sense of honor. I give every coin I steal to those who need it more.
I'll never let myself owe anything to anyone. I won't allow anyone to have that kind of power over me!
A castle as imposing as this one must have a massive treasure vault. I'll find out soon enough...
Visit: Your friend sent me to say hi and to get the location of your treasure vault. Haha! Just kidding!
Level: Oh! My treasure-sense is tingling... Shiny coins and sparkling jewelry! They cry out to Cath, master thief!
This fighting should make for a perfect distraction while I sneak in and nab some good loot!
Eh. Don't sweat the small stuff. We should focus on the bigger picture, yeah?
Summon: Quake in your boots, nobles! The great Cath has come to Askr to relieve you of your ill-gotten gains!
Learn Skill: Well, aren't you the generous one?
Confession:
Oops! Heeheehee... I dropped my scarf. Could you get that?
You know, you remind me of an old flame. You might just be my type...
Oof! Why are you pushing me away? Oh, this is awkward. OK, you caught me. I'm sorry.
You're pretty perceptive. I spent a lot of time perfecting that ruse. Pretty slick, don't you agree?
I thought you might have a nice bunch of Orbs on you, that's all. No harm, no foul, eh?
Status: Hello, my name is Cath! I have come to Askr!
What? Me? What was I doing? Oh, nothing. *nervous chuckle*
I really hate bandits! They're disgusting.
Nobles sure are dumb. Always fighting wars.
As a master thief, I have sense of honor. I would never keep the gold I steal!
Do you think it's all right to do anything as long as you're "protecting" someone? Burn a village down, or destroy crops?
From here on, I'm naming you my number-two underling!

gonzalez.name: Gonzalez
gonzalez.title: Kindly Bandit
gonzalez.description: An uncommonly large man, born in the Western Isles. Searching for a group who would accept him for who he is, he wound up with bandits. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I...I am ugly. People...people hate me.
I want to fight. Together, with you. I do my best. Get stronger. Fight with Heroes.
I understand... People scared...of me. Because I...I am ugly.
B-Bartre say... Do not rely on armor! A warrior must win...in one hit!
Th-thank you. But I no eat strange things.
Visit: My name...Gonzalez. I am...friend. Friend of [F].
Level: Getting...stronger!
Must beat...bad people. Gonzalez will beat them!
I want...to get stronger. If I get strong...everyone will like me.
Summon: My name...is Gonzalez. I...I not so good...at talking.
Learn Skill: I...I... Thank...you?
Confession:
I forget...many things. But I want...to remember. I try...very hard. Like names! I try...remember names.
Lilina...Roy...G-G-Garrett...Rec! Echidna...yummy drinks... See? I remember...good people's names...
But... But I don't know your name. Tell Gonzalez.
...[S]... [S]. [S]!
Yes. I remember now. You are good person, [S].
Always remember you.
Status: Gonzalez...is my name.
*blustering, stuttering* What? Surprised me.
I am ugly. People never look at me. But here? They are not afraid.
If I get stronger, maybe people like me.
What is your name? I forget.
Lilina is kind. And pretty. I…
You are good. I like you. I will fight hard.

caeda5.name: Caeda
caeda5.title: Beloved Queen
caeda5.description: First queen of the Archanean Alliance, married to Marth, its king. Her love for Marth is second only to her love for their people. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Sunrises are just as beautiful in this world as my own. Bathing in the light refreshes the spirit.

Archanea saw continuous wars that spread a dreary sadness across the land...
I hope this world, too, can escape that fate.
You need not worry yourself over me. I may not look it, but I've seen more than my share of war.
Even after his ascension, I still pour tea for Marth. It's a task I have difficulty letting anyone else enjoy.

If only people could live in harmony instead of constant competition against one another...
That is the kind of world I dream of.
Visit: You have a lovely castle. Praises from [F]!
Level: To return to a more peaceful age, we must recognize that fighting creates only strife...
As you offer me no choice, I will not give up.
What's come over me?
Summon: I am Caeda. Lor—excuse me, that is KING Marth's...queen. I'm still not used to introducing myself like this...
Learn Skill: Oh my! Thank you so much. I will do my best to use it well in your name.
Confession:
Is there someone you love? Someone you would fight and die for, [S]?
...Strange, I almost feel as if we've had a conversation like this before. But that couldn't have been you...
I'm sorry, where was I? Oh right... When I met Marth, I wanted to help and support him however I could.
But in reality, it was a selfish wish. I wanted to be near to someone like him, who made me feel safe.
He was gentle, noble, and adored by all—and he believed in me.
So, I gave everything I am to help his cause. That is how I gave him my love.
If everyone in the world could be true to one another...think of what we could accomplish.
That is why we continue to fight, even now.
We'll keep up the fight to create a better world for as long as it takes!
Status: I never expected to become a Legendary Hero. I'm a little overwhelmed, to be honest.
Ah! Oh, it's you. What are you up to, exactly?
I grew up in a small island kingdom. My horizons have broadened considerably since those days.
So long as people put their trust in me, I must do all I can to succeed.
I truly believe that we are all capable of coming together in mutual love and respect.
I think I've come a little bit closer to understanding how Marth must feel.
As a Hero, I aspire to give hope and comfort to those I protect.

sonya2.name: Sonya
sonya2.title: Dazzling Rabbits
sonya2.description: Bewitching bunnies that have journeyed to Askr for the spring festival to steal the gazes and hearts of all. They appear in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia/Awakening.
sonya2.harmonized:
Grants Special cooldown count-2 to unit and allies from the same titles as unit. Grants Atk+6 and【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Sonya**: Feels real good to be needed by an adoring crowd. It's a festival, after all! Mustn't disappoint.

**Sonya**: I had two older sisters, and they spoiled me rotten.
Right now it feels as though I have a little sister of my own, and I must say—it's a lot of fun!
**Tharja**: Henry is here at the festival? Be on your guard. I can tell from his face that he's up to something.
**Sonya**: You always dress so beautifully, dear Tharja! But your spring festival garb will ensure you're the star.
**Tharja**: If you intentionally made this outfit excessively constrictive, I'll hex you.
Visit: **Tharja**: If you don't come to the spring festival, I will be forced to curse you. Blame [F].
Level: **Tharja**: Hippity-hoppity-hooray! Is this... really going to make him happy?
**Sonya**: What's caught your attention? Not me, I suppose? Hee-hee.
**Tharja**: You're so carefree. I am not.
Summon: I am Sonya. Thank you for inviting me to the spring festival. Tharja is probably happier than she looks too.
Learn Skill: **Sonya**: You have my sincere thanks. And though she may not have said so, I know Tharja is pleased.
Confession:
**Sonya**: What do you think, Tharja? It's fun to change things up, isn't it? Women should flaunt their style, I say.
**Tharja**: These clothes are too flashy for me. I can't get used to them.
**Sonya**: I think it'd feel a little more natural if you were out and about, not hiding away in the shadows.
You should be the center of attention!
**Tharja**: Are you sure? This isn't a trick, is it? I will hex you if you're lying.
**Sonya**: Come and see. I'm certain it'll take just a moment for you to see I'm telling the truth. To center stage!
**Tharja**: Hey... Wait a second!
But then again, if it makes him go all red in the face, I should seize this chance. I'll do my best...
Status: うふっ
"Don't we look fine?" "Speak for yourself."
Conversation: **Sonya**: Spring certainly is a wonderful time of year. The flowers are blooming, the breeze is blowing...
It feels as though nature itself is luring us out of hibernation just in time for the festival. Don't you agree?
**Tharja**: I do not. Are we honestly expected to put on a bunny act? This whole thing is a waste of time.
**Sonya**: Oh, come now! You're still upset about the bunny ears? You look absolutely ravishing.
As I've said before, beautiful women should celebrate their beauty. What you're wearing is that celebration!
**Tharja**: How long did you spend practicing that speech in the mirror?
On the other hand, perhaps I could use such a "celebration" to draw Robin's affections...
**Sonya**: You didn't tell me you had your eye on someone. Who is this mystery man? What's he like?
**Tharja**: Well, yesterday he cracked his knuckles five times, he used two spoons for his three meals...
**Sonya**: That's…interesting. I won't ask how you know all that.
I can see that you're head over heels for him, and this is your chance to get his attention! So go on, take the lead!
**Tharja**: If it may help, I suppose I can mimic the actions of those who have worn this ridiculous costume in the past.
Ahem... "Hippity hop! I am a cute little bunny! I enjoy burrowing, cursing my enemies, and eating carrots!"
**Sonya**: That's the right direction! I'm sure you'll have him eating out of your hand in no time!
**Tharja**: "I'd be very 'hoppy' to keep warm with you this spring!" ...Eh?
**Sonya**: OK, that's enough practice. Let's take to the stage and steal the show!
**Tharja**: If we must. I suppose that if it's for Robin, I can endure just about anything—even a performance like this.

delthea3.name: Delthea
delthea3.title: Prodigy in Bloom
delthea3.description: A prodigal mage who wants to run free at Askr's spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I've always been adorable, but this outfit makes me even cuter! I can't wait to see what my brother thinks.
We don't have festivals as fun as this back where I'm from. The outside world really is amazing!
You wanna know what's in this egg? Hmm, maybe I'll tell you... Just kidding! I don't know either!
Look! Now that I'm a rabbit, nobody can catch me! Why? Because I can hop higher than anybunny. Hehe!
Hehe, oh big brother. Did you really think I wouldn't find you? These big bunny ears can hear you anywhere!
Visit: Bounce bounce! I'm not just hiding cute eggs; I bring spring greetings from [F] too!
Level: Amazing! I'm still a genius, even when I'm a rabbit.
Hippity-hop! You can't catch me that easily!
Huh? That didn't go as great as I'd expected. Did I trip on an egg?
Summon: Ta-da! It's Delthea! Aren't I just the cutest rabbit? I'm going to make this spring festival so much fun!
Learn Skill: Now it will always feel like spring!
Confession:
You absolutely made the right choice when you invited me for the spring festival, [S]!
I had so much fun! And I was able to make a lot of people smile while doing it! Even my brother had fun.
I've spent most of my life wishing I could go to a festival as wonderful as this.
All I could do back home was practice magic, with only my brother to talk to. I was so bored!
But there are so many exciting things to see and do outside my village, including these great festivals!
I want to experience so many more things. I can't wait to see what my next adventure will be!
Status: Didn't think I had such a cute side, did you?
Hey! Oh, come on... Is that any way to treat a lady?
Spring is my favorite season! Lively and romantic.
Did you see Luthier's costume? He looks amazing!
Why are rabbits always hiding their eggs? And how many eggs are they laying?!
Rabbits are cute and all, but I've always thought of them as food, not family.
Come on, the festival isn't over yet. There's still so much to see and do!

henry3.name: Henry
henry3.title: Peculiar Egg
henry3.description: A dark mage of Plegia who finds the spring cheer altogether confounding. He will keep plugging away at his curses all the same... Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Curious about what's in these eggs? You should be! I placed a real special curse on them. You'll love it!
I couldn't really celebrate like this in Plegia. I mean, if you let your guard down there, you might get cursed!
Huh? Tharja's taking part in the spring festival too? And here I thought she didn't like socializing.

Isn't the weather lovely? You know what else would be lovely? Me putting a sleeping curse on you.
Hear me out! You'd be able to snooze in the sun forever!
I bet General Mustafa would get a real kick out of seeing me in this. He might even give me treats again...
Visit: Nothing says "spring is here" like a curse to make you cheerful from your friend [F].
Level: Hippity-hop, hippity-hop! When the curses start, they never stop!
Just because I'm dressed all cute and fluffy doesn't mean I won't curse you!
Hmm. Maybe I'm not really cut out for this season...
Summon: I'm Henry, a dark mage. You sure you want to invite me to this festival? Who knows what I might do... Hah!
Learn Skill: I wish I had a curse that would make spring last forever.
Confession:
You know, I've never really been interested in the spring until now, but this could be a lot of fun!
Everyone's let their guard down because of the warm weather. It'll be so easy to curse them!
Or, wait...is the reason I'm dressed like this because someone put a curse on ME?
