Well, I guess that's OK. Because it actually feels pretty great to be this fluffy.
I know! How about I put a curse on you? Then you can go hippity-hop all through town!
I'm sure it will be unforgettable. Who knows? You may even end up getting addicted to the floof!
Special: What shall I do with you?
Status: The spring festival sure is fun. Thanks for inviting me!
Ooo, you got me! Nice one—you'll pay for that later!
Most of my friends are crows. Not the right crowd for this festival, I think.
Bunnies are so fluffy!
I never wear such cute colors. How do they look on me?
So things can be fun even without anyone dying? Huh.
Bunny ears are a lot of fun. You should give them a try!

maria2.name: Maria
maria2.title: Sunny Smile
maria2.description: Youngest princess of Macedon. Her ready smile adds a touch of joy to the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I wonder what's hiding inside this egg? Oh! I bet it's a wyvern!
Macedonian winters are so harsh... I'm always grateful when the spring comes along. The sun feels so good!
*sigh* The warmth makes me a little sleepy. Maybe I'll take a short nap.
Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena are both dressed as rabbits! Hehe, there are so many rabbits about.
Look at me! I'm a fluffy rabbit! I even have cute floppy ears and a puffy tail.
Visit: Hippity hop! I've come to deliver some spring cheer from [F]!
Level: I'm so glad I became a rabbit! Seeing everyone smile makes me so happy!
If I hop around a lot, maybe I can get big and strong like my brother and sister...
Oh...I guess I just got carried away by the festivities...
Summon: Hop hop! I'm Maria, and I'm a princess from Macedon. But now I'm a rabbit! I can't wait for the festival!
Learn Skill: Wow, this must be a present from spring itself! I'll be sure to cherish it!
Confession:
Thank you so much for inviting me to the spring festival.
I had so much fun dressing up as a rabbit and hopping around.
But more than that, I was so happy to see everyone smiling and celebrating.
Even my brother and sister enjoyed themselves. I just wish they smiled like that all of the time...
I have to believe that someday, they will always be that happy. I can't give up on that hope!
With your help, I know we can make every day as happy and warm as the spring festival.
Status: This spring festival outfit is just adorable. I love it!
Oh! Hey, be careful with my ears!
I received this weapon for the festival. I hope I can use it well!
I just love bunny rabbits. They're so adorable!
I've heard that at some festivals, you can get candy. Is this one of them?
I wish I could walk through this festival with my brother and sister by my side...
I found a nice patch of grass where we could sit and watch the festival together. Want to join me?

luthier2.name: Luthier
luthier2.title: Spring Hopes
luthier2.description: His fervent study of magic may have cost him the chance to make friends, but it did bring him to this festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: What kind of relationship exists between bunnies and spring magic? Seems a bit of a rabbit hole...
Alm told me I can turn to him if I have anything I need to talk about. I don't know what he means, but nice, right?

I've been hearing murmurs that the world will come to an end if these eggs aren't watched with utmost care.
Is that true?
I am not "frolicking." I'm seeking out spring magics. I won't reduce my enthusiasm on your account.
If Delthea sees me in this outfit, she'll tease me for the next three years... She absolutely must not witness this.
Visit: This outfit? It is the mark of one who is investigating the magics of spring—for [F]!
Level: Perhaps there is something to be enjoyed on a spring day like this... Er, don't listen in on my private talk!
I think you can see that I am quite serious.
I was distracted worrying over what could be hidden within the eggs...
Summon: I'm Luthier. I am here in search of seasonal spring magic. This outfit is part of— Don't laugh at me!
Learn Skill: A new power?! Is this the magic of the spring season that I've been seeking?!
Confession:
So, is it true that if I dress like this, I will grasp the secrets of seasonal spring magic?!
It's possible this sort of magic comes as second nature to me...
People have been much more drawn to me here... They keep calling out and stopping to talk.
Hm. Perhaps I have made a few new acquaintances... I imagine the festival atmosphere helped matters as well...
It is possible that some of them may even become my friends... Maybe...
...What are you grinning about?! You're incorrigible.
Despite my struggles with the seasonal spring magic, I have enjoyed my time... So, thanks.
Special: Why don't you take a nap?
Status: So wearing bunny ears in spring is a cultural custom in Askr. Fascinating.
Watch where you're going! You nearly made me drop my egg...
Something about warm and peaceful weather puts me in the mood to nap.
While I prefer to remain indoors, I see now that festivals can be as engaging as research.
Does our spending time together here mean that we've become...friends?
If Delthea saw me in this outfit, I'm certain I would scarcely hear the end of it.
My research during this festival has bloomed vibrantly. I owe you my thanks.

mareeta3.name: Mareeta
mareeta3.title: Astra Awakened
mareeta3.description: Foster daughter of Eyvel, mistress of Fiana. The gleaming strength of Astra is hers, and she is now beyond peer. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Put your heart into it, put your heart into it...
My father was a strong and brave man, but also gentle.

I'm impressed by all your hard work, [S].
Let me know if I can help in any way.
The sword is swung using the motion of the hips and legs. That's why I stretch before heading into battle.
I keep Lord Shannan's words in mind. "Put your heart into your technique and the path to Astra will open."
Visit: My name is Mareeta. I'm training in the ways of the sword while I stay with [F].
Level: Hah! Hah! Yah! Tyah! My sword movement is still too slow. I need to get faster, stronger!
I am the daughter of Eyvel of Fiana! I cannot lose here!
I will become even stronger!
Summon: I am Mareeta, and Eyvel of Fiana is my mother. I will protect everyone with this blade!
Learn Skill: All right! I am ready to fight!
Confession:
People tell me that I am...that I have become stronger. I am starting to believe them but...
Some nights, though I don't know why, I feel like crying.
When my heart is shaken like that, it affects my blade, and I feel the weight of that uncertainty as I hold it.
That weakness of heart is the reason my blade falls short of my mother's. I doubt I can match her as I am now.
Ah, please don't be concerned! I just get this way sometimes. Thank you so much for listening!
I have decided not to harbor regrets. I vow to do my very best for you, [S]!
Status: Good technique comes from the heart. Shannan taught me that.
Aah! Don't startle me like that!
My power is growing. I can feel it.
When technique and heart are one, the path to the true Astra will open...
I have never hated my father. Not once.
Mother, Father, please look after me...
It is my sincere pleasure to fight for you.

august.name: August
august.title: Astute Tactician
august.description: Former priest of Bragi; a thorough realist. Teaches young Leif just what a hero truly is. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: The meek require a guiding light to chase away the darkness. Only true heroes can meet that need.
The Loptr Empire's methods are merciless. Burning rebels or burying them alive... Truly an age of darkness.
Just as people seek to use power, so power seeks to be used in turn. What matters is how it is used...
As it is said, "A thousand pegasi led by one dragon can defeat a thousand dragons led by one pegasus."
The idealist may seek glory by death in battle, but a ruler must seek only life, so his people may prosper.
Visit:
People thrive or decay based on guidance from their ruler. I wonder... Which fate will befall those of Askr?
Ah, forgive me... I am merely a traveler.
Level: Do you finally understand? There is nothing I cannot do.
Our plans shall proceed accordingly, so long as my advice is respected.
Your concern is appreciated, albeit wholly unnecessary.
Summon: My name is August, a traveling priest of Bragi. Allow me to ascertain if my skills will prove useful...
Learn Skill: Bounty births greed, and greed begets conflict. Let us steel our hearts to avoid that disastrous path.
Confession:
Allow me a question. In your eyes, what does the future of this kingdom—no, this world—hold?
You may feel you are not able to presume. That is realistic, considering your position.
After all, it is you and your Heroes who will play the key role in this kingdom's survival...or destruction.
Yet I wonder: do all these Heroes understand that the people are the ones who suffer most in conflict?
Where will your beliefs and drive lead? If unending conflict is the result, so be it...
But do allow me to bear witness.
Status: Get ahold of yourself.
You must not fail.
There is nothing I cannot do. Leave everything to me.
The people don't need a hero. They only need the illusion of one.
My name is August. I am a traveling priest of Bragi.
Hm. Before I do anything, I'll need to inform Lewyn...
Know this: I, August, am here to serve you.

galzus.name: Galzus
galzus.title: Dark Blade of Od
galzus.description: Lives the life of a mercenary, searching for the daughter that was stolen from him. Both of them carry the blood of Od, the Sword Saint. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: That swordswoman who was turned to stone...she was the one who raised my daughter when I couldn't.
There is nothing to be gained from digging into my past. I no longer do.
I was foolish for bringing my daughter on the road with me. I know I can't atone, but I want to do what I can...
Do you need something?
When my work is done here, I think I will travel once more.
Visit: Nice castle. You should give [F] a tour.
Level: Hmph... I pity you.
Foolish...
Perhaps I am the one who is cursed...
Summon: I am Galzus. I have no past or future to speak of. I only live in darkness waiting for my death.
Learn Skill: I will be sure to return the favor.
Confession:
Stop peeking at me from there and just come in.
Are you wondering about my back? It's what they call a Brand. Mine is of the Sword Saint Od.
I was part of royal House Ribaut, but it was put to ruin with others slaughtered at Dahna.
After that, I threw everything away. My body is clad in death...my hands stained with blood.
As I am, I cannot even embrace my own daughter...
However, as a remnant of that conflict, I can surely be of use to you.
Status: The name is Galzus. Raydrik hired me.
Hm? Need something?
When my daughter was young... She was carried off by a slave trader.
I am stained by the blood of many men. It is better you forget me.
Eyvel rescued Mareeta and raised her in my place. I owe her.
Mareeta... you've grown up so strong, so gentle.
I will act with honor. I pledge it on the house of Isaach.

karin.name: Karin
karin.title: Driven Knight
karin.description: Pegasus rider from Silesse searching for the missing prince, Ced. She can face the most trying battles with the support of her beloved pegasus. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Prince Ced is the heroic inheritor of the Forseti Tome... Which is why he can't abandon his mother and Fee!
Silesse was never truly destroyed. Our forces moved north, to Tófa, and guard the royal family to this day.
How are you feeling? Make sure to rest on occasion—it's not healthy to push yourself too hard!
One day, I'll join the royal guard and help rebuild Silesse. When that day comes, we'll drive out the empire.

The prince just...left us. Without a word. I know he was searching for his father, but when the queen passed...
He wasn't even there to mourn...
Visit: Wow! This castle is incredible! I would love to see a castle like this in Silesse, someday...
Level: Just you wait. One day, I'll be a fully- fledged pegasus knight! It's always been my dream!
I've got this!
W-woah, Hermes, calm down! It's OK. I'm all right, see?
Summon: Hi there! I'm Karin, of Silesse. I may not be the most seasoned fighter, but I won't disappoint you!
Learn Skill: Yes! I'm going to keep getting stronger. And one day, I'll be strong enough to defeat the empire!
Confession:
Do you want to hear my secret?
The truth is, I...well...
I'm not really a fully-fledged knight yet! I know, I know. But it's OK. You see, I really get pegasi.
Take my pegasus, Hermes. He's not just cute. He's really smart too. And when I'm angry, he gets angry.
It's like we share one heart! That's pretty unique, isn't it? Now it's your turn. Will you tell me a secret?
Status: I am Karin. It's a pleasure.
Wh-what?! An enemy attack?!
Our prince left our country. I've come here in search of him.
Want to meet my pegasus? He's so smart and cute!
I will never forgive Raydrik. Taking innocent girls as hostages!
I...I didn't know. I didn't know so many were starving...
You have my sympathies, so I'll help however I can.

salem.name: Salem
salem.title: Dark Sage
salem.description: Although he was a priest of the Loptr Church, his doubts drove him to risk his life to leave it. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: The Loptr Church's laws are clear. They will not suffer a traitor. It's a miracle that I was saved.

They would burn you at the stake if they discovered you were a follower of the Loptr faith.
Believers were forced to flee to the desert and hide underground.
It's time for a shift change. I'll go stand watch.
Evil is everywhere. But evil by itself has no power. People can choose not to follow that path.
Nighttime can be dangerous. Watch out for yourself, and get some rest.
Visit: Oh... I'm Salem. I'm an acquaintance of [F].
Level: All those who stand with us, draw your swords! Evil will not have its way!
To your rest.
Who am I meant to be? What is my purpose?
Summon: I am Salem. I was once a priest of Loptr, but I have chosen a new path.
Learn Skill: Who you are should not be determined based on a single choice you make. I think I have to believe that.
Confession:
It's said that the Loptr Church is an evil group that worships the dark god Loptous, but it isn't that simple.
The church's founder, Bishop Gair, destroyed Grann and established the Loptr Church and empire.
There are those who wish to revive the empire, to take revenge on the 12 crusaders who brought it down.
The church, the empire... They were things I could believe in at a time when all I knew was poverty.
In time, it stopped making sense, so I ran away.
Please understand—not everyone in the church is an enemy of the world.
Status: I am Salem. I was once a priest of Loptr, but I have embarked on a different path.
Ah. I am not yet used to your humor.
The Loptr Church will not suffer a traitor. That is law.
The church no longer made sense to me. I can tell you no more.
Perne is a thief but he is not wicked. As long as that holds true, he has my aid.
Sara can wield the Kia Staff... She is Archbishop Manfroy's granddaughter, so it is no surprise.
I do not yet fully understand you. But for now, I will join you. I do not have much choice, do I?

nanna3.name: Nanna
nanna3.title: Beloved Princess
nanna3.description: Daughter of Lachesis, the princess of Nordion. Known for her grace, charm, and kindness. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: I think fondly of Fiana, the place where Leif and I once lived. It was my home, and I will never forget it.
Lord Lewyn said my mother is still alive... I want to meet her. I want her to see who I've become.
Retreat is not always an option, and you must be prepared for that. Which is why you should rest now and again.
What should I do next? Oh, no...sorry. That's something it would be best for me to figure out for myself.
I'd like to spend my days peacefully, surrounded by loved ones. That's all anybody really wants, I believe.
Visit: I've come to bring a gift of friendship from [F].
Level: I feel as if I'm full to bursting with light! I will dedicate this power to the well-being of people everywhere.
I've known war. You underestimate me to your own detriment if you can't see past my title as princess.
Th-this can't be...
Summon: I am Nanna. Lachesis of House Nordion is my mother. I am proud to carry the power of Hoðr's blood.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will use this new power to shine as a beacon of peace.
Confession:
When I was three years old, my mother left, saying that she was going to meet my brother Diarmuid.
She vanished in the Aed desert...
Lord Leif made me a promise. He told me that after the war was over, we'd search for my mother.
I was so happy at the time, but...now it feels like I was only thinking about myself—and I took advantage of Leif.
For that, I feel ashamed.
War is known to create orphans. I've felt their sorrow... So, I want to help as many of them as I can.
My greatest wish is to create a place for children who have been hurt—for them to rest, to sleep without worry.
Special: I wish to be of aid!
Status: I'm a Legendary Hero? Are you sure this is not some misunderstanding?
*gasp* Please don't startle people like that!
As a member of House Nordion, it is my duty to learn how to wield a sword.
When I feel my courage falter, I remember you are at my side. That makes even the fiercest battlefield bearable.
Mother... Please watch over me.
I wonder what Leif thinks of this outfit...
I must work even harder so that I can continue to be of use to you.
Map Select: I will give it my all.

ike6.name: Ike
ike6.title: Close-Knit Siblings
ike6.description: Children of Greil, leader of the Greil Mercenaries. Ike aspires to be just like his father one day. They appear in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.
ike6.duo:
Inflicts Atk/Spd-7 and【Guard】on foes within 5 rows or 5 columns centered on unit through their next actions, and inflicts Special cooldown count+2 on those foes.
【Guard】 Inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on target per attack during combat through its next action. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

Castle Hall: **Ike**: I don't know if this is all real or just a dream. Either way, though, I've got to keep Mist safe.
**Ike**: My father leads the strongest group of mercenaries in the world. I'll do what it takes to follow his example.
**Mist**: Something on your mind? We can talk about it, if you want!
**Mist**: I wanna go outside and play for a while. Is that OK, Ike?
**Ike**: Keep behind me when I swing my sword, Mist. For your own good.
Visit: **Ike**: Have we met somewhere before? No? My mistake. Anyway, this is from [F].
Level: **Ike**: My opponent wants to win just as much as I do. I'd better think fast.
**Ike**: That went well. Stay close, Mist!
**Mist**: Focus on the fight, Ike. I can take care of myself!
Summon: I'm Ike, and this is my little—where's she going? Mist, quit wandering off!
Learn Skill: **Ike**: I'll be just like Father someday!
Confession:
**Ike**: We've been moving for a while, now. How are you holding up, Mist? If it's too much, let me know.
**Mist**: I'm more worried about you, Ike! You should give those scrapes and scratches time to heal.
**Ike**: These wouldn't slow Father down at all. I can't let them slow me, either.
The longer we're away, the more I see I've got a long way to go to measure up to him.
**Mist**: Don't push yourself too hard, Ike. He can't come swooping in to rescue us here.
Actually, now that you mention it... I am really tired...
**Ike**: Haha... All right, get on my back, then. I'll always be here to carry you.
Status: ふふ…
"Stay close, Mist." "Right behind you!"
Conversation: **Mist**: Wait up, Ike! I'm coming with you!
**Ike**: Not this time, Mist. This isn't for fun. I need to train.
**Mist**: But staying here is so BORING!
**Ike**: Maybe so. I need to practice if I want to get better. And you might get hurt if you're in the way!
**Mist**: I'll be careful, I promise! I'll watch from a distance.
**Ike**: *sigh* If you say so...but you better not wander off. Come on.
**Mist**: Great! This is gonna be the most fun outing ever! Let's go!
Ooh! Look, Ike! A butterfly! Where are you off to today, Mr. Butterfly?
**Ike**: Mist! Where are you going? I told you not to wander off!
**Mist**: Oh my gosh! Ike, look at all these pretty flowers!
**Ike**: Wow. This place really is in full bloom. I guess I was too focused on training.
**Mist**: I've got an idea! What if we pick some for Mother? And Father too, of course!
Because you let me come along, I'll also make the prettiest crown of flowers, just for you!
**Ike**: Erm... Why don't we just make them a bouquet?
**Mist**: No way! We're gonna have matching crowns! Think how you'll look with a sword AND a flower crown!
**Ike**: Wait, what?!
**Mist**: I knew this was gonna be fun!

soren3.name: Soren
soren3.title: Hushed Voice
soren3.description: A boy with a natural talent for magic. He has difficulty speaking due to his experiences growing up. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: *sigh*
Hmm...
Ah!
Level: Nnnh... Ah! Hm... Oh?
Heh...
Oh...
Summon: Hm? Ah...
Learn Skill: Hmm...
Confession:
...
Ah...
Hmm.
Status: Ugh-uhh.
Wuh...
Wh-hah...
Huhh...
U-unhh.
Oh... Ah. Ugh...
Eh... Heh!

ilyana3.name: Ilyana
ilyana3.title: Awakened Appetite
ilyana3.description: A girl who is endlessly hungry. She has a knack for magic, but...how many Heroes' worth of rations will it take to satisfy her appetite? Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: I can't get enough of the delicious food here. Even though I ate so much this morning, I'm already starving...
Adults always compliment my appetite. At least at first...
I think it's time for me to eat. Magic always makes me so hungry.
What? No, there's no reason to be worried about me. Moving around always makes me this hungry.
A cookie in my right hand...dried sweet potato in my left. Help! I don't know which one to eat first.
Visit: *sniff* I thought I smelled a feast... When do you usually eat around here?
Level: You know what would make a great reward? A snack...or two...or three...
I'm not picky. I'll eat anything once... so long as it's edible.
I must be hungrier than I thought. Do you have anything to eat?
Summon: Hello. My name is...Ilyana. I'm studying magic. I'm also starving... Do you have anything I can eat?
Learn Skill: For me? Thank you! But, you know, I'd rather have something I can eat...
Confession:
I learned a new expression today.
"Eat me out of house and home..." Do you know what it means?
It means "to eat too much, without doing anything to help in return." That's what Commander Anna said.
Her face was so red when she saw me eating. She said there was a limit to what she could spend on food.
I hope that someday, I'll be the type of adult who can eat in all the houses, without anyone getting upset.
Status: I'm...Ilyana... I'm studying magic...
Did you just push me? Give me a snack and I'll forgive you.
I wish I could run around and play with everyone, but...I get so hungry, and...
Grown-ups always say I'm not picky when it comes to food. Is that a good thing?
*sniff sniff* Do you smell something good?
The food in this castle is so delicious. And there's so much! I've never been this happy....
I guess I could share my snacks with you... but only a little bit.

mia4.name: Mia
mia4.title: Budding Blade
mia4.description: A girl who learned to wield the sword in search of strength. Her energetic attitude allows her to stay focused on her goals. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: I can't lose. No matter what!

People try to tell me I can't do things because I'm a girl. But that doesn't change anything...
I still want to win instead of lose, same as everyone else!
Hiiiyah! Don't be mad, Boss, but your back was wide open!
I wanna spar with everyone here! Axe users, swordsmen, even archers... There's so much they can teach me!
You celebrate a bunch of festivals here, right? I mean, um, not that I care. I'm just here to train. Yeah...
Visit: Hi! I'm Mia, and I'm gonna be the strongest fighter in the entire world. You just watch me!
Level: Yes! I. Am. AWESOME!
If you time your strike properly, you can win...even if you aren't the strongest fighter.
Not my best...but I still think I've gotten sharper than yesterday. What do you think?
Summon: Hi, I'm Mia! I was just going to start my sword training drills. Wanna join?
Learn Skill: That's great!
Confession:
Hey [S]! Boss Summoner!
Do you think that a girl shouldn't be swinging a sword? No? Good!
I hate when people think that way! You can judge me if I'm weak or inexperienced, but not for that!
I knew coming here was the right call. There are so many strong Heroes here I can learn from.
My fortune told me to follow my instincts, and it got me here—which means I'm at your service, Boss!
Status: Hi, I'm Mia! Wanna duel?
*yelp* What was that? Special technique? Surprise practice? C'mon! Tell me!
Look around! Everyone's so strong... This is great!
This castle… I could play hide-and-seek and you'd never find me!
My fortune will tell me how to train. That's how I'll pick today!
I'm going to be the best swordfighter…ever!
Wanna practice, Boss? Come on! I'll get my sword!

boyd2.name: Boyd
boyd2.title: Future Great
boyd2.description: The second of three brothers, between Oscar, the eldest, and Rolf, the youngest. He wants to grow up as fast as he's able, for Rolf's sake. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: I'm gonna be a merc when I grow up. I can't wait to see Oscar's face when I show him how much I earn.
Rolf is still so small, it's up to me to watch his back. After all, that's what big brothers are for.
You let us into your home, so you're as good as family. If you need any help, like chopping wood, just ask.
I may be young, but these muscles pack the punch of someone twice my age!
I'm gonna work hard, play hard, and eat lots. That way I'll get super strong!
Visit: Hey there! I brought you something pretty cool. But I didn't look! It's from [F].
Level: Oh yeah! I'm so strong, I can take on anyone. Nothing bad's gonna happen to Rolf while I'm around.
Fights are just about overpowering the other guy with brute force, right? I can do that. Let's go, go, go!
How did I... Rgh. Maybe I can learn something from this...
Summon: I'm Boyd. I might be young, but when I get serious, my determination is bigger than any adult's—you'll see!
Learn Skill: Thanks for this. I won't let you down!
Confession:
Hey, um... What's your family like? You know, parents, brothers, sisters, that sort of thing.
I don't wanna seem rude. I just haven't seen anyone like that around, so I was wondering...
After Rolf was born and our father died, without a mother, the three of us were left to fend for ourselves.
It wasn't my father's fault, but that doesn't change the fact that we got left out in the cold.
That's why we're so grateful you took us in. We're gonna do whatever we can to help you out!
Status: I'm Boyd. You might know my big brother, Oscar, or my little brother, Rolf.
Hey! Don't sneak up on me!
I've gotta get stronger if I wanna help Oscar.
I'm plenty tough! I can take on any of the kids my age!
Show me to the grub, would ya? I'm starving.
My brother Rolf is a great kid. I've got to make sure he keeps out of trouble.
You put food on our plates and a roof over our heads. Thanks for that.

ishtar3.name: Ishtar
ishtar3.title: Echoing Thunder
ishtar3.description: Princess of Friege who turned her back on her lover, Julius, and secreted captured children to safety. Later took part in the holy war. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Is there a parent who would not lament their child being sacrificed to the flames of Loptous?
None can defy Julius's orders. But the children he would see hunted down...are innocent of any crime.
Why am I here? What am I meant to accomplish here? Will the day come when I know these answers?
It was Emperor Arvis himself who said we must release the children being held in the castle.
I envy pegasi and falcons... They may simply fly away. Would that I had wings.
Visit: The smiling faces that surround me are harsh and glaring like the sun.
Level: Why do I, as I am now, have such power?
My strength must find its purpose.
Lord Julius, I...
Summon: I am Ishtar, a mage of the proud house of Friege. Please, grant me an opportunity to fight.
Learn Skill: Do not trouble yourself on my account. Ah, no. It is only right that I thank you.
Confession:
My love for Lord Julius is true. At first, we were even happy. He was kind, and I served his rule gladly.
But things changed. He instructed me to abduct children, inflicting despair upon the people. I could not do it.
If I have one request for you, it is this. Value each general, each soldier. Consider their lives as your own.
How many souls were sacrificed in the endless war of my realm? We knew no other way.
I pray that the day comes when he and I may atone for our sins. We may then find peace, hope, and joy.
Status: One of the children gave me this doll. Adorable, isn't it?
*startled* Oh, summoner. I thought I might be needed by a little one...
I disobeyed Lord Julius. He...does not yet know.
I have no regrets. They are safe now.
That was meant to be my time... My end.
Lord Julius... I do love you.
You have the potential to change the world. What a wonderful thing.

tine.name: Tine
tine.title: Rumbling Thunder
tine.description: Niece of Bloom, ruler of Ulster and duke of Friege. Reuniting with her older brother, Arthur, she joins the liberation army. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Hilda...I will never forgive the things you did to Mother!
I don't think my uncle, Bloom, or my cousins, Ishtar and Ishtore, were ever truly bad people...
My cousins, Ishtore and Ishtar, were always very kind to me. I don't believe they really wanted to fight.
I... I will fight if I must. I'll do it to avenge my mother's death!
This pendant is a cherished memento of my mother.
Visit: My name is Tine... I've come on behalf of [F].
Level: Mother... Help me to be strong too!
I do not wish to fight, but I will do so to protect what's right.
I-I'm sorry...
Summon: I am Tine. I know I can fight, if that is what you wish of me.
Learn Skill: Mother, watch over me. I will make sure Hilda is punished!
Confession:
I don't have many memories of my mother, but I remember that she always seemed sad.
I didn't realize how terribly Hilda was treating her... But that's no excuse.
When was I reunited with my brother, Arthur, I felt ashamed. Mother had protected me while she suffered.
Still, I don't believe that my cousins, Ishtore and Ishtar, were ever false in their kindness to me.
Even now, there are times I don't know what to do. How do I know what's right? Do you know?
Special: I do not want to fight.
If this is what you wish...
Status: I'm Tine. Have you met Arthur? He's my brother.
Huh? You must have me confused with someone else.
Friege may be my home, but I don't feel any fondness for it. Maybe that will change someday.
Hilda held a grudge against my mother. And now my mother is dead.
This pendant? It's a memento. I carry it always.
Mother, watch over me. I will make Hilda regret what she did to us!
I wish I could have met you sooner.

arthur2.name: Arthur
arthur2.title: Furious Mage
arthur2.description: Raised alone in Silesse, separated from his sister and mother at a young age, he harbors resentment toward House Friege. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Reptor, Bloom, Hilda... I can't forgive the things they've done, but the people of Friege are innocent.
House Friege took my sister and mother... I've hated them ever since. I intend to destroy them myself.
A commander must realize that there is a time for perseverance and a time for rest if they want to stay sharp.
I suppose that someday, someone from Bloom's bloodline may hate me as much as I hate them now.
I keep this pendant to remind me of my mother.
Visit: Here, this is for you. It's from [F].
Level: Bloom! Hilda! I will make you pay for the things you've done!
Would you mind... Oh, just stay out of my way!
Phew... I pushed it a little too hard.
Summon: I am Arthur. My mother was a mage. Though my magic might not be as strong, I will do my best to help you.
Learn Skill: I must be strong if I'm going to avenge my mother's death and protect my sister.
Confession:
My mother was a mage in the liberation army. After one terrible battle, she fled with me to Silesse.
That's where we were when she and my newborn baby sister were taken. All I was left with was this pendant.
I was surprised to learn that King Bloom of Ulster took my mother and sister, and a little relieved too.
My mother was of his House Friege, after all. But then I heard that she passed away. Damn that witch Hilda!
Ah, I'm...OK. I'm calm. I just get so angry when I think of it. Thank you for listening.
Special: I've got something to show you!
Status: I'm Arthur. I traveled here from Silesse.
Ah! Never surprise me like that. I might have hurt you.
My mother and sister were taken from me when I was very young. I had to build a life on my own.
Is Fee here too? She's a good person, and her energy is infectious.
My mother was a mage too. She served in the liberation army.
Hilda, the woman that drove my mother to her death... I will destroy her with my own hands.
Working with you is always interesting. It would please me to stay and help you for a while.

scathach.name: Scáthach
scathach.title: Astra's Wake
scathach.description: Wielder of Astra, a secret technique passed on to him from his mother, Ayra. He is the twin of Larcei and cousin to Shannan. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: My sister and I fight for Lord Seliph. Surely our mother would be happy to see us now.
So long as Lord Seliph and Prince Shannan are at our side, the empire will fall!
Aren't you overtaxing yourself? You'll make everyone worry. Do not forget that we all rely on you.
I'm itching for a fight. I must hone my technique in battle. That desire trumps all fear.
I always worry that Larcei will take it into her head to run off again. She is not the type to look before she leaps.
Visit: I was sent by [F] with this boon.
Level: This technique stands above all others in Isaach—handed down by the Sword Saint Od!
Do not forget that I am a swordsman of Isaach!
I'll put in some more training. That is what's needed.
Summon: I am Scáthach, a warrior descended from Od, the Sword Saint. I fight with the pride of Isaach in my heart.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I'll do whatever I can to ensure you aren't disappointed.
Confession:
Prince Shannan has told me more than once that Larcei may have an even stronger will than our mother.
I know so little about Mother... Neither Larcei nor I do. I am always happy to hear anything about her.
Larcei clings to the hope that she is out there, somewhere... I do hope so too, but...
I...
I must put these feelings aside and focus on battle. I will make use of the techniques I inherited from her!
Status: My name is Scáthach. I am Larcei's twin.
Huh? That was sudden!
Lord Seliph is so gallant. It is an honor to fight by his side.
Don't think I've forgotten the pain the empire has caused us.
In a battle of wills, Larcei might best our mother. That's what Prince Shannan says, at any rate.
It is time I turned toward the truth… Our mother died at Belhalla.
Don't push yourself. You can be rash.

hilda4.name: Hilda
hilda4.title: Queen of Friege
hilda4.description: Wife of Bloom, leader of House Friege. Feared for her cruelty after it is revealed she forces children to participate in evil rituals. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Lord Julius has certainly taken a fancy to Ishtar. I wonder when he will finally ask for her hand...
I am of House Velthomer, same as the royal family. And House Friege is one of Grannvale's most prestigious.
I swear...I am surrounded by incompetent fools.
There is none more suited or qualified to be Lord Julius's bride than Ishtar.
Tailtiu was a waste of space. I made her suffer day in and day out. Hoho! Those were such amusing times.
Visit: This hovel barely qualifies as a castle, but I suppose I could deign to visit every now and then.
Level: I, Hilda, will send you kicking and screaming into the depths of hell!
Yes, just like that. Surround them on all sides and do not let a single one escape with their life!
What sort of trickery is this? Was I not victorious? I deserve my reward!
Summon: What is it now? You require my aid? Fine. I suppose I have to do everything myself...
Learn Skill: Hoho. Not bad, not bad...
Confession:
You again? You should know better than to bother someone who is drowning their sorrows.
Your needs do not concern me. I am but a widow wishing to grieve in peace at the bottom of her bottle.
My husband, Bloom, and my son, Ishtore, both slain by the resistance... Ulster stolen. How much must I bear?
All that remains of House Friege are myself and Ishtar...and it's all the fault of that insipid brat Seliph!
Does my tortured soul please you? I am not here to be your entertainment. Begone before I lose my temper...
Status: I am Hilda, of House Velthomer. Just like the imperial family.
Keep your hands to yourself if you hope to keep your hands at all.
If Lord Julius were to make Ishtar his princess... What a wonderful match that would be.
Seliph and his pathetic little army are enemies of House Friege.
Tailtiu was a waste of space. I made her life miserable and I would do it again.
I will avenge my father, my husband, and my son... I will see their killers burn!
If you mean to take advantage of my skills, you had best know what you're doing.

medeus.name: Medeus
medeus.title: Earth-Dragon King
medeus.description: King of the Earth Dragons, previously defeated by the hero Anri. Resurrected by Gharnef, he seeks domination. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: No matter the age, it is unchanging. The hearts of men conceal hatred and evil intent.
They feigned weakness and we lent them our strength. Before long, they became conceited. That is mankind!
Who or what are you? Do you know the answer to this question?
Dragons will retake the world. Dolhr is a torch to light the path I am forging.
The dragons of this realm will hear my call. Our time will come...
Visit: An opportunity to emerge from my confines? This is agreeable.
Level: Take this to heart... So long as there is light, the darkness shall never fade.
Fools...be consumed by the flames of hell!
Yes... Come to me! I will cast you into the deepest pit of hell!
Summon: Men call me the Shadow Dragon and cower before me. Hear me, dragons all! It is time to reclaim what is ours!
Learn Skill: Such caprice.
Confession:
Do you think to regard me?
In fairness, I have been observing your little act.
Flaunting power unsuited to you with wild abandon. Playing lead in a farce about a fool who flies too high...
Dragons were asked to discard their power. Mankind was not grateful. You suggest I accept that?
Naga's charity was wasted on these hearts, so far beyond redemption. O cursed creature, man!
Someday, the heart of the inferno will open upon them! The world will be remade—no, restored!
Special: Burn in the pits of hell!
Status: I am Medeus, king of the Earth Dragons.
Do you tempt my wrath?
Foolish human! You dare disturb my slumber?
Marth... Ah, yes... Anri's descendant. A troublesome one.
As long as there is light...the darkness will never be extinguished!
You'll find an Earth Dragon like me harder to tame than Gharnef, weakling...
I will show you the true power of the Earth Dragons. You should be thankful!

rhea3.name: Rhea
rhea3.title: Immaculate One
rhea3.description: Child of the progenitor god Sothis. Unable to control the power coursing through her, she takes on a draconic form. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I created a young woman...my twelfth try after much heartache... Sitri. But Sothis did not stir within her...
The Immaculate One...my true form. You too have witnessed it, have you not, [S]?
My home that was lost long ago... The voice that enveloped me... I need it back. All of it.
I-I can no longer...contain my power. Fódlan's fate lies in the hands of... Grrraaahhh!

That one has...arrived in this world too? That one who bears the Crest Stone of the progenitor god...
My last hope...
Visit: Quickly... You must flee... I do not wish to inflict harm upon a friend of [F]...
Level: Gah! My—my Crest... I cannot maintain control!
For the future...of Fódlan...
Does this mean...I will not be able to achieve my goal?
Summon:
I am...Rhea... Archbishop of... the Church of Seiros...
Mother, I... I seek the progenitor god... I-I seek...ah... Graaah!
Learn Skill: All this work for the sake of... regaining that which was lost...
Confession:
I just wanted to...to get it back. A small, precious thing... So small it slipped between my fingers...
The smile I still see when I close my eyes... Those gentle hands... I can feel their embrace...
My only desire is to see my mother one last time. I have carried on for so long, allowing that ache to guide me...
But now, I have drifted... I am so far from Fódlan...from home... I have drifted to another world.
It is strange though... Even in this land, I sense a familiar presence. Her presence.
If I continue to fight for you, will you let me see her? Please... May I...may I I hear mother's voice one last time?
Status: I am...Rhea... Archbishop of...the Church of Seiros...
*growl* Do NOT touch me.
Why, Mother... Why?!
If only I could resurrect my mother... I could regain all that has been lost...
Please... The progenitor god's power...Mother's power... must be used to save Fódlan...
Even though I had to do some...questionable things to achieve that goal, I wished to see Sothis...my mother...once more.
When I'm with you...I can remember...peace...

lilith2.name: Lilith
lilith2.title: Silent Broodling
lilith2.description: Daughter of Anankos. Wholly dedicated to serving her father and removing any obstacles from his path. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I'm not just the daughter of the great King Anankos, I'm his most loyal servant. I live only to obey him!
There is another me in this world? Well, that's just a distraction. If she tries to stand in my way, I'll end her.
Corrin? Corrin... Ugh. Why does that name make my heart hurt?
You're a fool! You're a coward! And a fool! You wear your heart on your sleeve! I can't stand you!
Anyone stupid enough to follow that fake King Anankos will end up the same as him: dead.
Visit: Only fools seek close friends. Fools like the false King Anankos. Are you a fool? Like [F]?
Level: There's no point trying to resist the great King Anankos. I'll gladly beat that into your stupid skull if I have to.
You were meant to die here. It's fun to watch you struggle—you can't escape your fate.
Well... This is unpleasant.
Summon: I am Lilith, daughter of King Anankos. My blood is of the true Silent Dragon, and I'll snuff out any who resist him.
Learn Skill: With this power...with this power I can cut down all who dare stand in his way!
Confession:
You may think that it was your power that summoned me here, [S]...
But that is far from true. I'm here because the great King Anankos imposed his will through you.
This means, of course, that you cannot command me like you would the other so-called Heroes.
No. I'll take my time and judge your strengths and weaknesses for myself. Then we'll see.
So you should probably avoid letting any stupid notions like "trust" or "friendship" into your head, got it?
Special: I like that look of despair...
Status: I am Lilith. Daughter, and most loyal servant, of the great King Anankos.
Hmph! I despise jokes. Take them elsewhere.
Impersonating Anankos... Despicable.
Foolish humans...  Did you really think you could beat me?
Why can't I make the final blow...? I must carry out my mission!
I've...never known love...
You are inferior to King Anankos...but I will do as you say.

gustav2.name: Gustav
gustav2.title: Sovereign Slain
gustav2.description: Former king of Askr and father of Alfonse and Sharena. Slain by Hel, ruler of the dead, his body is now under her command.

Castle Hall: Should I raise my blade to you in a fit of frenzy, you must not hesitate. Not even for a moment.
Alfonse and Sharena are not yet prepared to usher in Askr's future... And I laid that burden upon them.
Henriette, never lose that radiant smile. Walk toward the light, the people of Askr beside you.
This body of mine is not of the living. It has no place beside those who yet draw breath.
I am merely of the endless cohort of the dead—one of the innumerable victims of conflict.
Visit: Fear not. Your friend is safe. The grasp of Hel has not yet closed... as it has upon my throat.
Level: When will you let me die? How much more blood must stain these hands?
The dead have no need of power. Yet here I stand.
This body is not fit to persist amongst the living. It should decay...
Summon: I am Gustav. Once I was king, but no more. I am but a king's rotting husk.
Learn Skill: You need not concern yourself with me. Your gifts are wasted on a corpse.
Confession:
I have a request for you—not as a king, but as a father who dearly loves his children.
When all of this is over, I hope that you will grant me the eternal rest that I have been denied.
At that time...bury my axe on the hill that overlooks the castle of Askr.
That way, at least some part of me will be able to stand watch over them as time marches ever onward.
The dead ought not to trouble the living. Summoner... I leave Alfonse and Sharena in your capable hands.
Status: I am Gustav. My flesh has been reconstructed by the dread power of Hel.
Do not approach me. I can make no promises for your safety.
My body is beyond even my control.
One who lacks the will to strike me down is not fit to be king.
Alfonse is strong... If the time comes that he must battle his own blood, he will not falter.
Alfonse... Sharena... My beloved children.
As I am now, I can do no more than entrust my fate to you.

ninian3.name: Ninian
ninian3.title: Frozen Heart
ninian3.description: Oracle who opens the Dragon's Gate, her draconic strength now forcefully harnessed by Nergal. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I cannot see the future... It is nothing but darkness to my eyes... Oh, Nils... Lord Eliwood...
I cannot stay here... I cannot allow something terrible to happen...
I cannot shake the haze from my mind... Everything is clouded...
If it is my fate to die in the arms of someone I care for... So be it.
I have done so many things... So many things that can never be undone...
Visit: Lord Eliwood is not here either, is he? Tell me, where should I go? Oh, [F]...
Level: Lord Eliwood, where are you?
I feel as though I am fighting in my dreams...or perhaps...
Please... Keep your distance...
Summon: My name is...Ninian? Ninian...
Learn Skill: What is the purpose of this power?
Confession:
I have no wish to fight anymore... I do not want to hurt anyone...
I feel as though everything I have ever cared for...is being swallowed up by a horrific darkness...
But you... You are still going to fight, aren't you, [S]?
Somehow the threat of this darkness has not yet crushed your hope...
If you are able to stand strong in the face of it...then perhaps I can too... Maybe I can even find myself again...
Status: Who am I?
What are you doing?
No... This is not what I...
Please... Protect this land...
No more... No more fighting...
I...I want to see Lord Eliwood...
When you're near, I feel...a little more at peace.

muarim.name: Muarim
muarim.title: Raw Instinct
muarim.description: Warrior of the Laguz Emancipation Army, his mind overtaken after being forced to consume the potion used to create Feral Ones. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Rrrgh... Body...on fire. Curse you, Izuka! What...did I drink? Urghhh...
Must resist...for the little one...for my chained brethren... I must fight for our... Rrrghhh!
That song...I barely can hear it... and yet...it soothes me. Could it be...
If anything happens to me...take the little one...leave him in little Sothe's— I mean Sir Sothe's—care...
When laguz...become Feral Ones... They lose more than just...rrragh... their sanity...
Visit: You know [F]... Why...am I here?
Level: Body...burning! Must...hunt!
Raaagggh! Not enough! Not nearly enough!
No...must fight these...urges! They cannot...control me!
Summon: I am...Muarim... Raaagh! What is... happening to me? No, stop! Come no closer!
Learn Skill: I cannot control myself...let alone a power like this...
Confession:
Rrrggh...[S]...
Come no closer...for your own good. The foul elixir I was forced to drink... turns laguz like me into Feral Ones.
It robs us...of our senses. Turns us into mindless...weapons. It is repulsive... Rrragh!
I...I'm all right. I must not—will not— let it control me... Just give me some space.
I would never...lift a claw...against you, or the little one... I would... never...
Status: I am Muarim... I am a laguz!
Do not touch me! You must not come near me now.
Hrrraaaugh!
Get away! I'll hurt you if you don't…
Agh... My body can't... No, no... Little one... get away!
...Grah...little...one...
It's up to you now… Take care of him…

roy5.name: Roy
roy5.title: Blazing Bachelors
roy5.description: Roy frets over the festival while Eliwood watches on, bemused. What matches might yet be made? They appear in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade / The Blazing Blade.
roy5.origin: The Binding Blade + The Blazing Blade
roy5.harmonized:
Grants Def/Res+6,【Resonance: Shields】, and【Treachery】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Shields】 Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."
【Treachery】 Unit deals additional damage = total bonuses on unit for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Roy**: Father, I'm not sure I can handle all this attention...
**Eliwood**: It feels strange to say, but you are a fine young man, Roy. I suspect I have your mother to thank for that.
**Roy**: Whoever catches the bouquet will play the part of our brides, right? My heart's pounding out of my chest...
**Eliwood**: I might be older than him now, but perhaps one day we will meet again, and he will be the older of us.

**Roy**: So, we hold each other's hand, then... Wait, which foot do I put forward?
The fact that you can keep track of all this is incredible, Father.
Visit: **Eliwood**: I am Eliwood, here to give my regards to both you and my future son, Roy.
Level: **Roy**: I can't believe I get to fight alongside my father! I won't hold anything back!
**Roy**: It's a bit difficult to move around in this, but I'll wear it until I meet my bride-to-be!
**Eliwood**: There's nothing to be discouraged about. Everyone starts somewhere.
Summon:
I am Roy, son of Eliwood, marquess of Pherae. I may only be playing the role of groom, but I'll give it my all.
...That said, I still can't believe I get to spend time with my father like this. Just look at him! He's so young!
Learn Skill: **Eliwood**: Thank you. I will do my utmost to live up to your expectations.
Confession:
**Eliwood**: It's about time, isn't it? I'm supposed to be acting as a guardian, so you'll be playing the role of a groom, Roy.
**Roy**: I'm not sure if I can do this... It seems like I know all of the people who are competing for the bouquet.
**Eliwood**: Ah, yes, that does appear to be the case. Hopefully that means your special someone is among them.
**Roy**: W-wait! Hold on! Don't tell anyone! You can't! Please, I'm begging you!
**Eliwood**: Don't worry, I won't tell a soul. We made a promise between future father and future son, after all.
...Oh! Do you hear that? It sounds like the bells have started ringing.
**Roy**: That almost makes it sound like a real wedding... Wait, why are you pushi— Father, please! Just one more minute!
Status: Heh...
• "Where's Mother?" • "Oh, I don't know..."
Conversation: **Roy**: Hmm... How should this look? Does this go…here?
**Eliwood**: The festival's about to begin, Roy. Are you ready yet?
**Roy**: Sorry, Father. Not quite. I've never worn anything like this before. It's a bit much for me.
What do you think? Does this look right to you?
**Eliwood**: It looks great. You wear it so well, I can scarcely believe you are my son.
But that says more about me than you. Fatherhood still feels premature to me—I'm not even married yet.
**Roy**: But you're in love with Mother, aren't you? Tell me, what do you like most about her?
**Eliwood**: Hmm... I suppose it's her strength I most admire, and her kindness I most adore.
**Roy**: It seems I do take after you. I feel the same way about someone in my life.
**Eliwood**: Is that so? I would love to meet this person who means so much to you.
**Roy**: I'm not sure if that will happen at the festival, but...I guess we'll see.
**Eliwood**: The possibility seems to make you nervous. Is it because you happen to be dressed as a bridegroom?
**Roy**: Maybe, though marriage is a long way off for me yet.
**Eliwood**: You're a fine young man, Roy...so fine I sometimes forget how young.
Just think of today as a bit of practice. Enjoy yourself!
**Roy**: All right, now I really am nervous.
**Eliwood**: Relax. I'm right here with you. Come on, let's get going.

lilina5.name: Lilina
lilina5.title: Beaming Bride
lilina5.description: Only daughter of Hector, the marquess of Ostia. When she learned Roy would be playing the part of bridegroom in the festival, she had to join in. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Roy and I are good friends, but... Marriage? I-I'm not sure about that...
I've heard that Lord Eliwood looked exactly like Roy when he was young. I wonder what his wife looked like...

My father got so worked up... "It's too soon for you to marry!" "At least stay in Ostia with me when you do!"
Really, Father, it's only a festival...
I would like to have a real wedding ceremony of my own one day. Don't worry—I'll be sure to invite you too!
Scrambling to get the bridal bouquet sounds a little scary, but I've made up my mind. That bouquet will be mine!
Visit: My dream came true! I hope you, too, are blessed by this happiness one day!
Level: All of the well wishes I've received are making my magic stronger! I hope everyone can experience this one day.
With the power of love! ...Th-this is a little embarrassing...
I've looked forward to wearing this dress for too long to have something like this ruin it!
Summon: On my name as Lilina of Ostia, I vow to play the role of bride better than anyone else at this festival!
Learn Skill: I'll need to study a lot if I'm to become a proper lady. So thanks!
Confession:
I wonder how Roy feels about me... It's so hard to tell what he's thinking sometimes.
Oh, [S]!
No, no, I'm not crying. I'm just... Well, I guess I'm thinking about the future.
Not only are Roy and I the same age, but our fathers are also close friends.
Needless to say, the two of us have been friends for a long, long time.
So when Roy said we should both do our best in the festival, I was really happy...
But then I realized he was cheering on other girls, as well. And I'm just... I'm not sure what to think.
...Mhm. Right, yes... I was the first to love Roy, it's true. And I always will.
So I can't let this get me down. I won't lose to those other girls! Thank you, [S]!
Status: I'm Lilina. This is the first time I've worn a dress like this… How does it look? Good, I hope!
Ah! Hey! Can't you see how nervous I am?!
I always thought I'd wear something like this, one day... But after actually putting it on, I'm not quite sure how to feel.
Even if this is only a festival, I'm not sure Father's happy about the reminder that I'll get married one day... Hee-hee-hee.
Oh, I wish I could have seen Father and Mother's wedding.
Roy... Someday, you and I…
One day, I'll have my very own, proper ceremony. You'll be there for that as well, right?

cecilia3.name: Cecilia
cecilia3.title: Etrurian Bride
cecilia3.description: The Mage General, the pride of Etruria, taking a hiatus from her usual armor for the day and hoping to catch a bouquet. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: This garb is different from the Mage General uniform I usually wear... How exciting!

The fact that a woman became Mage General of Etruria upset many within and without the country.
I was rather despised at the time...
I will not hold back when training with Roy or Lilina. That is a teacher's duty, even if I only taught for a spell.

So we congratulate the bride and are thus blessed with well wishes. We then find new love, and nurture it...
There is so much for me to learn!
I can't seem to stop conducting myself as a general... Is that all right?
Visit: I look forward to building a long- lasting relationship with both you and [F].
Level: Today is a good day to spar with me. After all, you can blame any mistakes on being captivated by my dress!
Not only do I feel great in this outfit, but my magic flows well too. Maybe I should change up my usual attire...
You pick me? Really? Well, it's just, I'm so...
Summon: It may be "only" a festival, but it is still worth celebrating properly. And since I have fully prepared, let us do so.
Learn Skill: I am filled with gratitude. Truly.
Confession:
I am an Etrurian general. And as the honored Mage General, my duty is to command troops and deliver justice.
Therefore, my future husband must also be wise and capable of leading others.
*sigh* I'm sure this isn't meant to be a formal affair, and yet, here I am, acting as though it were serious.
But...I can't go back to being "just" Cecilia. Not that I had any intention of going back, of course.
I must rebuild and usher my country into a new age. My future husband has a tough job ahead of him.
Status: How curious. Simply wearing a wedding dress makes me as nervous as a bride...
It's impolite to play tricks on a bride. You ought to know better!
I suppose even a Mage General can blush like a bride!
What's my type? Well, someone I can respect, I suppose.
That plan, in this dress? Surely I taught you better tactics than that.
Someday, perhaps, I will wear this dress for my own wedding.
I am grateful I could take part in this festival. Let's be off so we can enjoy it!

sophia3.name: Sophia
sophia3.title: Prescient Bride
sophia3.description: Half-dragon gifted with the power of prophecy. She can feel the hopes and dreams of all the people present at the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: This is...a wedding gown? Every thread...feels infused with joy.
The future is...uncertain. But one's wishes and determination...can change its course. I have seen it.
Fae and...Igrene... I am certain they would be...quite surprised if they saw me dressed like this.
It is true...the world is filled with sorrow. But...people can create just as much joy.
This dress...it is...fluttering. Hehe...
Visit: This festival...is being celebrated by [F] as well.
Level: It flows in my veins...the blood of a dragon.
The festival will end soon... I can see it.
I know. I grow...slowly.
Summon: Hello...I am Sophia. May I also take part...in the bridal festival?
Learn Skill: Blessings upon...you as well.
Confession:
I was wondering... What are... festivals?
People laugh together...feel at ease... love one another. These are times of great happiness?
People have...so little time to live. Even I...with half-dragon blood. Eventually...we will all perish.
Perhaps...that is why you pledge eternity to someone...someone who understands. A love that won't fade.
I can see it. Such a short time. A fleeting moment. And yet...those feelings transcend all. And I...
I wish for it too... An eternal love. Someday...for someone to hold my hand...as we walk to the horizon...
Status: It seems that...today is the bridal festival...
Ah! Oh... Um...I think you have...the wrong person...?
This bridal dress... is so beautiful... so white, and so delicate...
In all my visions, I never saw that I would be a bride...
To pledge a vow of eternal love, how wonderful…
Perhaps… If I can find someone who accepts the dragon blood in my veins...
May bridal festival blessings...shower upon you too...

larum2.name: Larum
larum2.title: Dancing Bride
larum2.description: Adopted daughter of the renowned Douglas, Great General of Etruria. She aims to draw all eyes to her bridal attire with her artful dancing. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Eeee! I just can't WAIT to get married!
I'm worried that, when I get married, Daddy will be all alone... I know! My husband can live with Daddy and me!
Getting carried away during the bridal festival is fine, but get some sleep! Your bloodshot eyes are scary!
A bridal dress! How pretty! I just want to run around and show it off. Well, what's stopping me? Off I go!
I'm going to win and nab that bridal bouquet. I don't understand it, but I'm gonna do it!
Visit: I'm here to share bridal-festival greetings, compliments of your pal at [F]'s castle.
Level: Make way! Make waaay! The beautiful Miss Larum is coming through!
Umm, beg your pardon?
I just realized I don't care about a bouquet or whatever. Because I'm the most stunning flower there is!
Summon: I'm just so happy to become a bride. Our love is eternal! Always! Forever!
Learn Skill: Oh no...if I become any cuter, everyone will be too obsessed to fight! Wait, maybe that's good...
Confession:
Hey, I've been thinking about something! And don't laugh—I'm really serious about this.
I mean, you only live once, and youth flashes by in a blink.
So, well...I've made a decision about something that is very important to me.
I want to be with someone who loves me for me, even when we're old and wrinkled and gray and—
And...why not tell me what you look for in a partner? If I keep talking, I'll reveal too much!
Status: Well, what do you think? About my dress, I mean. It's cute, right?
Oh! Hey, come on. You can't poke me when I'm looking so good!
You think I look pretty? Aww, you're making me blush...but say it again!
Oh, Lord Roy! Don't I make the most perfect bride?
Let me handle the cooking! My father says my food is delicious!
I wonder if Daddy will be happy when I really do become a bride?
You get to escort me! Come on, just take my hand...

myrrh4.name: Myrrh
myrrh4.title: Guardian Dragon
myrrh4.description: A manakete girl who quietly works to protect the world's future, having witnessed the war between humans and the Demon King. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Father would have worked hard to defend everyone too...
Magvel will persevere, so long as its people pass down tales of Ephraim, Eirika, and the Sacred Stones...
It's impolite to ask a woman her age. I think you're being rude.
Sleep allows your body to be reborn anew... Please don't hesitate to rest when you get tired.
This stone is very important to me. It reminds me of the memories I've made with so many people...
Visit: I come with greetings from [F]...
Level: I will remember all of you.
I'm sorry... I'm stronger than I look.
Oh no, my stone is becoming dull...
Summon: I'm Myrrh, a dragon from Caer Pelyn. I carry with me the many memories of those I watch over in Magvel.
Learn Skill: Let's continue on this path together.
Confession:
I used to not understand why humans always fought each other, bringing demons and dragons into conflict too.
Did they really not wish to live in peace? Then I realized: humans aren't content to be led by destiny.
I saw them muster their courage and use the Sacred Stones to forge a new future in the face of demonic threat.
They shared their strength and grief and kindness with me. I'm proud to call them my friends.
Humans try to do as much as they can with what little time they have. As a dragon, I admire that.
Will you also choose to fight against fate? I will watch over you, no matter your decision.
Status: I'm Myrrh. Legendary Hero? What's this all about?
Ah! So you'll tease a Hero, will you? I'm glad I'm still part of the fun.
It's a shock to be discussed in this way...a legend? Me?
Is Brother here? I would love to see him.
I would prefer not to fight, but there's something I must protect.
I'm sure Father is watching over me.
I'll always do my best to be helpful to you.

letizia.name: Letizia
letizia.title: Curse Director
letizia.description: Royalty in the line of succession to the throne of the Emblian Empire. Growing up, she and Veronica were as close as sisters.

Castle Hall: I cannot bear to face Veronica now. Not after all that's happened.

Long ago, under a sky not unlike this one, a little girl and I shared tea together...
Little Veronica was very cute then.
I had thought Prince Alfonse to be naive, weak—an opponent unworthy of me. I misjudged...
You know... The Curse Directive marks you as our greatest threat.

I wonder...is there some world where this rage does not burn in my heart?
A world in which Veronica and I could have been...like true sisters.
Visit: A gift, from [F]. ...No agenda.
Level: What is power without an objective...
I operate best from darkness...
We cannot always have what we want... A truth I am growing uncomfortably used to.
Summon: I am Letizia. Tell me...is Veronica here as well?
Learn Skill: You freely choose to grant me this power...and believe you will not regret it later? Hm.
Confession:
When we were young, I often noticed Veronica imitating me. Even during our teatimes...
She was so young, but she did her very best to make tea for me. Heh... It was cute, pure and simple.
But that...all of it... That exists only in the past. It is not a place we can ever return to.
The things I've done...the hatred I've built in my heart...those things are a part of me now.
Even so, I wish no further pain on her. That much I can promise. She has surely suffered enough.
Status: I am Letizia, ninth in the Emblian Empire's line of succession.
Why, I nev— You, a peasant, dares touch me?!
I lead Embla's Order of Heroes. We specialize in curses—or did you know that already?
My wrath knows no bounds. Not even the malice in Lady Embla's heart runs as deep.
Can you even fathom the pain of losing everything that was promised to you?
Oh, Veronica... Sweet, little Veronica... We had such fun together back then, didn't we...
My hate, my rage, my thirst for vengeance... When we speak, it all fades away...

florina2.name: Florina
florina2.title: Azure-Sky Knight
florina2.description: Florina, having grown during her time with Lyndis's Legion. With Lyn's encouragement, she has redoubled her focus on bow training. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall:
A long time ago, there was an ice dragon in Ilia who helped the people live through constant snow.
My sister told me that story to help me sleep as a child.
Lady Lyndis has been recognized as a noble lady of Caelin, so I can join the service of her noble house.
All the Caelin knights are men, so it was a struggle to adapt to that... I'm still adapting, to be honest!
I found a lovely little spring not too far from the castle. I wonder if Huey would enjoy it...
Nyaah! Was that— Was that a bee?!
Visit: H-hello, I'm Florina. It's a pleasure. I'm always happy to meet a friend of [F]'s.
Level: Yaaah! Behold the might of the Pegasus Knights of Ilia! ...Wh-what do you think?
I-I'm a full-fledged pegasus knight!
I won't cry over this... I'm a proud pegasus knight of Ilia!
Summon: I'm Florina, and I'm a pegasus knight. Lyn is a dear friend of mine, and I will always do my absolute best for her.
Learn Skill: Th-thank you so much!
Confession:
Lyn's spirit is like the wind across the plains... Swift and bracing.
She asked me to stay by her side, to lend her my aid as her friend...
She's the type of person who makes me want to always do my best, so I'm happy to give her any help I can.
...
...
...Oh! The same goes for you too, of course, [S]!
I hope we can keep growing closer as we continue to work together.
Status: I'm trying out the bow now. Just like Lyn.
Oh! Uh. Heh... Do you need something?
I... Um... I want to keep getting stronger. To do my part.
You like my new outfit? That's so... Aww... Thank you...
Thanks to you, I feel like I can stand just a little taller.
I don't want to rely on my sisters and Lyn forever. I want them to see what I can do!
I just want to say, um... I'm happy to be with you... Aaah, no, pretend you didn't hear that!

sain.name: Sain
sain.title: Green Lance
sain.description: An impulsive and playful knight of Caelin. Despite his age, he was appointed to be subcommander of the Caelin knights. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Ladies to my right or to my left, as far as the eye can see! What heaven is this I've been summoned to?
If you've been looking for a knight of Caelin with a fiery passion, you've found your man!
To NOT comment on the beauty before me would be the gravest discourtesy... Don't you agree?
Oh, what dazzling visions of beauty! Will you grace me with your company and join me in my reverie?
Kent's scowling again... I hope that doesn't mean trouble. Hm? Oh, just talking to myself! Never mind me!
Visit: Sain, the gallant man of Caelin, stands before you! All you lonely ladies, get ready to have your spirit rejuvenated!
Level: This won't be easy, but I won't let that stop me. After all, why worry? I'm not alone.
Sain, the gallant man of Caelin. That's me!
I was too focused on the offensive. I got careless.
Summon: You called for THE Sain? Of course you did! Now, if you wouldn't mind pointing the way to the ladies...
Learn Skill: I will show you the true force a knight of Lycia can be!
Confession:
What a wonderful place you have here—this Askr, the Order of Heroes! My envy knows no bounds!
Strong, beautiful women in every direction... I regret only that I was not summoned here sooner!
But I, Sain, will not allow any minor setback to keep me from my dream!
It was providence that I met you. Truly, I believe that! And I have just the plan for our future...
Why not put a team together made exclusively of beautiful ladies?! Think about it...
We can call it, I don't know... Oh, how about [S] Squad!
Goddesses on guard! Beauties of the battlefield! We can figure it out later...
What's important is that I'll handle leading the unit and handpicking all our special recruits!
I foresee my schedule filling up rather quickly!
Status: Sain, the gallant man of Caelin. That's me!
Ah! Oh, It's you! Don't scare me like that!
We knights are honor-bound to protect fair maidens.
Lady Lyndis is quite a beauty. I'm blessed to call her my liege.
Kent worries too much. He's going to grow old before his time.
Aah! So many beautiful women, and only one of me!
We were destined to meet here! It's fate!

kent.name: Kent
kent.title: Crimson Shield
kent.description: A straightforward and stern knight of Caelin. Appointed to be commander of the Caelin knights at a young age. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: It is my sworn duty to protect Lady Lyndis, daughter of Lady Madelyn, granddaughter of Marquess Caelin.

The Lycian League is a collection of noble houses who have agreed to a policy of mutual defense.
House Caelin is one such house.
I still have much to learn of what is expected of a knight in Askr...
It is a knight's duty to follow the orders he is given. I truly believe that.
Sain is hopeless... If he doesn't start taking battle more seriously, he'll find himself on the wrong end of a blade.
Visit: I am Kent of Caelin. I have been sent, for reasons unknown, to deliver this from [F].
Level: Blades cry out for those destined to wield them. I want to be a knight worthy of such a calling.
My happiness is to serve.
This is a problem indeed.
Summon: I am Kent, knight of Caelin. I believe this is our first meeting... Let us ride on to victory, shall we!
Learn Skill: I will strive to live up to what is expected of me, as is my duty to you—and to Lady Lyndis as well.
Confession:
I am a knight of Caelin. I view Lady Lyndis as my liege, and it is my happiness to serve her.
I am sure that you're aware, but Lady Lyndis is wise, kind, beautiful, and strong. And I would be remiss to le—
...Excuse my rambling. Lady Lyndis aside, there is something I've been meaning to ask you...
What are you planning to do once the fighting here is through?
Caelin would be sure to welcome someone as strong as you. You could be a knight—or a tactician perhaps.
I'll leave you to think it over...
I imagine there are many worlds that would be eager to have you, but... I do hope you'll consider mine.
Status: I am Kent. Let us fight together and ride on to victory!
Hm? Is that a game in this world? Poking knights?
Lady Lyndis is wise, kind, beautiful, and strong. She is honorable, and... Well, you see my point.
My happiness is to serve Lady Lyndis.
Sain is almost more trouble than he's worth. But I know that I can rely on him.
I have so long believed that a knight owed blind obedience to his lord... How do I know what my loyalty truly requires of me?
Would you like to join the Caelin knights? As Knight Commander, I would welcome you to our ranks.

guy.name: Guy
guy.title: Kutolah Blade
guy.description: Swordsman of the Kutolah, one of the three tribes of Sacae. He set out alone on a journey to hone his skill with the blade. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I think I'm starting to get a feel for this. Heh. Maybe I'm kinda, you know, a genius or something.
A warrior of Sacae defends his own with pride. Plus, there's a debt I have to repay.
Oh, uh, bows aren't really my thing. Everyone has different talents, right?

I was never good with the bow and frankly, I'm terrible at hunting...
But I have been told I have a good sword arm!
Does this castle—or maybe this whole world—have an unusual number of, er, beautiful people?
Visit: I'm Guy, the future best swordsman in all of Sacae! I'm here to visit from [F]'s castle!
Level: I will become a great knight one day! Until that day comes, I will not return home!
My sword will never lose to foes like these! Let me show you just how much I've learned!
Wow... That is not great!
Summon: I'm Guy, a warrior of the Kutolah. We're led by the Silver Wolf, Lord Dayan himself!
Learn Skill: I'm going to get as strong as I can, and then, back home, I...I will defend my tribe and mother as best I'm able!
Confession:
Warriors of the Kutolah are usually pretty good at riding horses while using their bows... But not me.
I chose the path of the sword.
Everyone kept telling me how there are already so many who are skilled with the sword out in the world...
I knew that, of course. But I didn't want something like that to stop me from doing whatever I could.
Besides, I made a promise to my master...that I would grow strong enough to beat him...
I'm going to have to get a lot stronger still...
That's why I'm still honing my skills here and now, and will continue to do so until I'm the best in all Sacae!
Status: I'm Guy, a warrior of the Kutolah. We're led by the Silver Wolf, Lord Dayan himself!
Ah! D-don't scare me like that! It's dangerous to sneak up on a skilled swordsman, you know!
Three years ago, I left my tribe behind and began my training. I decided to master the art of the sword.
A Sacae warrior proudly defends his own.
Master, I said I would challenge you. I will grow stronger. I will beat you.
Mother, I... Hey! Don't listen in to my private thoughts!
I’m traveling and training to grow stronger! I must defend my tribe, my mother, and you as best I can.

limstella.name: Limstella
limstella.title: Living Construct
limstella.description: A constructed being known as a morph, created with ancient magics. They serve Nergal with absolute loyalty. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: The quintessence from the Black Fang has all been used. This place should provide the next harvest.
I steal quintessence from the strong. With it, Lord Nergal's ritual to call forth the dragons will be completed.
Your concern is not necessary. I will handle any obstacles to my mission.
My method of obtaining quintessence is far more direct than the schemes Sonia employs.

This world has an abundance of strong individuals. It is like a box filled with glittering jewels.
I must observe closely to determine which is the most exceptional.
Visit: It would appear you have a marvelous quintessence. As I expected from a friend of [F].
Level: As Lord Nergal commands, I shall kill all those who bear signs of great power.
I've come for your quintessence.
Hm.
Summon: My name is Limstella. Everything is guided by my master, including my presence here.
Learn Skill: Morphs are not human—no matter what you give us, we will not change. Only Lord Nergal has that ability.
Confession:
My name is Limstella. A morph of perfect beauty and strength, created by Lord Nergal. One beyond humanity.
Since I am not human, this body is nothing more than an empty vessel. There is no need for imperfections.
However... When Lord Nergal calls to me, something within me stirs. I have learned this is called joy and sorrow.
...Sorrow? Did I say sorrow? Why would I say such a thing?
Your hidden quintessence leads me astray. Do not come any nearer. I... I am Lord Nergal's...
Status: My name is Limstella. I am a puppet created by Lord Nergal.
What are you doing? Why do you humans do such pointless things?
I am not human. This body and this heart are constructs...
As Lord Nergal commands, I shall kill all those who bear signs of great power.
Puppets have no essence to harvest. Not I, nor Sonia.
As long as my mission is fulfilled and Lord Nergal is pleased, all else is irrelevant.
You have marvelous quintessence... I am certain of it.

edelgard5.name: Edelgard
edelgard5.title: Sun Empresses
edelgard5.description: Legendary empress of Tellius joins future emperor of Fódlan for a vacation to the tropics. They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses / Radiant Dawn.
edelgard5.harmonized:
Grants Atk+6,【Resonance: Shields】, and 【Bonus Doubler】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Shields】 Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."
【Bonus Doubler】 Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = current bonus on each of unit's stats for 1 turn. Calculates each stat bonus independently.

Castle Hall: **Edelgard**: Altina is a legendary queen, yet she does not possess even a hint of arrogance. I must follow her example.
**Altina**: I can sense a powerful determination in Edelgard's eyes. Her gaze is fixed firmly on the future she desires.
**Edelgard**: There is still much I can learn, even at the beach. Seizing such opportunities demands ambition and force of will.
**Edelgard**: I never imagined I would wear something like this... Though, I have not had many chances to before now.
**Altina**: Don't worry, Alondite and Ragnell are in good hands. I can't exactly go swimming with them, after all!
Visit:
**Edelgard**: Lady Altina, I have carried out [F]'s errand.
Let us return at once.
Level: **Edelgard**: No matter how tall the waves crashing down upon us are, we will push through them and press on!
**Altina**: Now that we finally have a chance to relax, I will not allow anything to get in our way!
**Edelgard**: Ugh... I truly am not suited to the water, am I?
Summon: Let's go, Lady Altina! We have an entire tropical island to explore together!
Learn Skill: **Altina**: Are these the blessings of the sun? In that case, I will gladly accept them.
Confession:
**Edelgard**: Thank you very much, Lady Altina. Thanks to you, I was able to become more comfortable with the ocean.
