**Altina**: Edelgard, please—there is no need to thank me. I have enjoyed the time we've spent together.
It is a pleasure to see you freed, at least briefly, of the burdens that come with governing a country.
**Edelgard**: I feel the same way, though... From watching you, I have realized that there is still much I must learn.
**Altina**: In that case, I have but one request for you, Edelgard.
Would you please continue to be my friend, even after the summer is over?
**Edelgard**: Nothing would make me happier than if we continued to help each other grow. Now then, take my hand!
Status: *Chuckle*
"I'm not fond of the water." "Don't worry! Come on, I'll show you."
Conversation: **Altina**: Such beautiful waters... Come, Edelgard. Let's go for a swim.
**Edelgard**: No, thank you. I'll just stay here and relax. You should enjoy yourself.
**Altina**: Could it be that you can't swim?
**Edelgard**: Not...exactly. I just prefer to avoid the water.
**Altina**: I see. Well, then I'll stay.
**Edelgard**: Don't feel you must hold back on my account. Please, go and swim. I'll be fine right here.
**Altina**: It is no matter. I am a bit surprised, however.
You're so self-assured. But I suppose even you must struggle with some things. We all do, after all.
**Edelgard**: Naturally... For my part, I am a bit surprised by you as well.
Of course I am well aware of your stature, a legendary queen... Yet I find you so approachable.
**Altina**: If that is indeed so, I would say we're cut from the same cloth.
**Edelgard**: You may be right. And if that is so, perhaps this will appeal to you...

What do you say to skipping the usual activities? Let's spend the day doing nothing more than relaxing...
and sampling the local delicacies. I've always wanted to do that.
**Altina**: Oh, I hadn't even considered it. But now that you mention it, it does sound enticing...
Very well! Let's make that dream into reality. It is, after all, just one day.
**Edelgard**: I was hoping you'd say that. We can spend a relaxing day together, just as I'd hoped.
**Altina**: It's settled, then! Think of it... a vacation! I can hardly wait. Hee hee!
Duo Skill: "Queens of the seas!" "Do not doubt it!"

dimitri5.name: Dimitri
dimitri5.title: Sky-Blue Lion
dimitri5.description: Crown prince of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus and student at Garreg Mach Monastery. He has come to the tropics for some summer training. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Regardless of my light attire, I am still always ready to fight, should the need arise.
Much of the Kingdom of Faerghus is just barren land... Compared to that, this island is like a paradise.
I hear Edelgard is training on the beach instead of swimming. Well, I'm sure she knows what she's doing.
How strange. Merely listening to the sound of the waves seems to put my heart at ease...
My home gets a lot of snow, so I am used to the cold. But all this sunshine will take some time to adjust to...
Visit:
I am Dimitri, from the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. I have an invitation for you from [F].
Well? Would you care to join us in our tropical-island training?
Level: Looks like the training has paid off. It was well worth working up a sweat.
No matter how tall the waves, I will not be swept away.
This heat is...exhausting. Please give me...just a moment...
Summon: I am Dimitri, of the Blue Lion House. Even if it is only as practice, I will give my all to swimming around the island.
Learn Skill: I trust your judgment. If you say that I need this, I will believe you.
Confession:
Oh, are you already done swimming? I haven't run into any problems, so I'll keep going for a while longer.
Hm, yes... I suppose you have a point. Claude also said something about rest being an important part of training.
Very well, I will follow your example and do my best to relax.
You know, this island is quite lovely. It has plenty of fruit and seafood, and, of course, a pleasant breeze.
If there really is such a thing as paradise, I think it would probably be a place like this.
Tomorrow, we will no doubt be back on the battlefield. But until then, I will remember the time I've spent here.
That will be what gives me the strength to move forward—to accomplish what I must.
Status: Thank you for inviting me to this island. Perhaps it's OK to have some fun today.
What? Oh, a drink? It is rather hot.
This place is so warm and bright compared to the Kingdom of Faerghus.
I don't do well with the heat... Hey, no laughing. We all have our weaknesses.
I'd rather be in the water than on the hot beach. I'm going to swim over to that island.
It's not often I can forget about fighting and spend a day relaxing.
I don't know how best to say this, but... I was honored to join you at the beach today.

claude4.name: Claude
claude4.title: Tropical Trouble
claude4.description: Member of House Riegan and leader of the Leicester Alliance. The sea air makes his heart race. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: You know, comfortable clothing like this suits me a whole lot better than some heavy suit of armor.
My hometown, Derdriu, is often called the Aquatic Capital. It's a great place to spend a summer vacation.
The imperial princess and crown prince are here too? Time to find out which of us is the fastest swimmer!
You can't REALLY say you're living it up on a tropical island unless you put together a feast, right? Right.
I'm still not gonna put my faith in any gods, but I guess I can be a little grateful for the summer season.
Visit: I was sort of in the middle of my vacation, so it'd be great if I could get back to [F] soon.
Level: Looks like I've worked up quite the sweat. Now it's time to get ready for a feast!
You know, running around under the sun isn't all that bad sometimes.
Starting to think I may have overdone this whole vacation thing...
Summon: I'm Claude, of the Leicester Alliance. You're planning a trip to the beach, right? Perfect, count me in!
Learn Skill: It's like you read my mind—this is just what I need to beat the summer heat!
Confession:
Phew! It's been ages since I was able to kick back and unwind like this... Beaches really are the best, huh?
Now, on a completely unrelated note, did you know that the bowstring affects a bow's performance?
I know, I know, it sounds obvious. But hear me out, [S].
If you keep a bow strung for too long, it'll eventually warp, and might even become useless.
In other words, you need to give the bowstring a break.
It's the same with people. If they stay tense and guarded, they'll get worn out, and end up falling apart.
If you want to take care of yourself, sometimes the best thing to do is just give yourself time to relax.
Speaking of which, I'm feeling nice and refreshed now. Time to make sure this trip is one to remember!
Special: Let's settle it with a swim!
Status: Nothing's better than a tropical island vacation.
Gah! Your hands are so cold! Were you holding a drink or something?
Heroes around here are getting a little rowdy. I'll let 'em know we're aiming for a more laid-back vibe.
*yawn* I'm gonna go find a nice, shady place to nap.
I'm planning a big party on the beach after the sun goes down. Invite any Heroes you know!
If the whole world were as peaceful as this island, well... It'd be nice, but...I think I'd want something more.
Wow, I can't even enjoy one day at the beach without you ordering me around... H-hey, come on, now! You know I'm kidding!

micaiah6.name: Micaiah
micaiah6.title: Wavecrest Maiden
micaiah6.description: Silver-haired maiden of the Dawn Brigade. The winds of paradise have led her to the seaside sands. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Tropical islands are home to birds of all shapes, sizes, and colors. Oh! Doesn't that one look like Yune?
When our long battle is finally over, I'd love to return here with the Dawn Brigade for some rest and relaxation.
The tropical sun shines brightly for everyone, regardless of who they are or where they are from.
I can't remember when I last wore an outfit this revealing. I'm sure Sothe has his own thoughts on it...
A tropical paradise really does make you feel alive. It's no stretch to call it a blessing from the goddess herself.
Visit: I'm Micaiah, of the Dawn Brigade. Care to join me on a tropical island retreat with [F]?
Level: With the cool summer breeze at my back, I feel like I can do anything!
The tropical sunlight isn't as blinding as it was before... Good. I may have gotten used to it.
My throat...is parched...
Summon: I'm Micaiah, of the Dawn Brigade. The winds of paradise have led me to these seaside sands.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I won't forget this summer for as long as I live.
Confession:
I had another vision... In it, I foresaw that I would soon experience the "winds of paradise."
Only now do I understand that those winds are in fact the pleasant breeze blowing through this tropical island.
I don't just feel the wind on my skin. It invigorates me deep down in my heart and speaks to my soul.
I only wish that there was a way to share this feeling with everyone. Wouldn't that be wonderful?
Perhaps, once all the fighting has come to an end, we can find a way to do just that.
Until then, I will etch the time I've spent here into my memory and redouble my efforts to ensure peace.
Status: Thank you for inviting me to the beach. I can't wait to enjoy the sea and sunshine!
Oh! Sorry, I just didn't see you there!
I hear some beautiful fish were spotted near shore. Let's go look!
The sand is so hot! Much hotter than I expected. Oh, my feet...
Phew! There's so much to do here. I think I overdid it...
Oh, I wonder what Sothe would think if he saw me dressed like this.
My memories of this beautiful place… And the time I spent with you… I will always treasure them.

elincia3.name: Elincia
elincia3.title: Seaside Queen
elincia3.description: Kindhearted queen of Crimea enjoying some time away, relaxing in the tropics. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I see there are all manner of frozen treats here, and they look delicious... Would it be all right to try one?
My travels with my lord Ike taught me that being able to swim is vitally important when battling on the ocean.
This attire feels so comfortable and refreshing. I must remember to give [S] my thanks...
The sun's rays are strong, but they aren't at all unpleasant. If anything, I feel quite comfortable.
I've seen so many fruits and fish that can't be found in Crimea. They've made for wonderful souvenirs.
Visit: I am Queen Elincia of Crimea. I've been tasked with delivering summer tidings from [F].
Level: I will try my utmost to bring as much light and comfort to Crimea as the tropical sun does here.
I would love for the people of Crimea to one day also know the warmth of the tropical sun.
S-sorry! The waves were far taller than I had anticipated...
Summon: I am Elincia, Queen of Crimea. Oh, but I'm here simply as a sightseer eager to relax on a tropical island!
Learn Skill: Is this a summer gift? Thank you, I'll make sure to take good care of it.
Confession:
Thank you so much for showing me such a lovely place.
As queen of Crimea, I have spent countless hours thinking about what I can do to bring my people joy.
However, it seems that I had become exhausted in both body and mind without even realizing it.
This tropical island made me see that. But now, I feel as if the waves and the gentle wind have healed me.
Yes, I am all right now. Beginning tomorrow, I can step forward once more, with confidence, as queen.
I will build a bright future for Crimea, while filling my heart with all the happiness this summer has given me.
Status: Do you think this swimsuit looks all right on me? Is it ostentatious?
Nyah! Oh, a drink. How refreshing. Thank you.
I've never gone swimming in tropical waters before. What a wonderful new experience.
I found a little crab. Look, isn't it cute?
Swimming makes me so hungry. Is it bold of me to ask if there's anything to eat?
What a wonderful break... It's like a beautiful dream of peace.
Let's walk along the beach and watch the sunset. I'm sure it will be beautiful.

xander5.name: Xander
xander5.title: Gallant King
xander5.description: Newly crowned king of Nohr. Trains tirelessly in order to stand firm on the side of righteousness. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Past wars have left our world in ruin. But still, together we persevere. Nohr, Hoshido, and my dear siblings.
The royal line of Nohr is descended from the First Dragons. As such, I will do my duty and lead the world.
Though I am now king, I will not let that fact change my heart. I will only grow stronger, more disciplined.

I feel there are some similarities between my family and the royal family of Askr...
I hope I will be able to build a good rapport with Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena.
I must better myself, not only for the sake of Nohr but so all people may prosper... That is my goal now.
Visit:
If you happen to meet anyone by the name of Laslow or Peri, please tell them Xander is looking for them.
Here, take this as payment for your trouble.
Level: My axe grows sharp against the will of my foes!
As Nohr's king, I refuse to fall behind! I will not be outdone, even by a Hero from another world.
My blood runs cold in my veins... Perhaps we ought to rethink our approach here.
Summon: I am King Xander of Nohr. My life is devoted to battlefield perfection, in both power and grandeur.
Learn Skill: What is this? A gift? I suppose I should offer you my thanks.
Confession:
Do you know of my siblings? Camilla, Leo, Elise...and Corrin, of course.
Though we may have been born to different mothers, each of them is nevertheless dear to me.
As the eldest brother of Nohr's royal family, I often felt I would never know a moment's peace.
Of course, that is to be expected with the territory, but...
Ultimately, looking back, I am grateful to my father for having given me so many wonderful siblings.
My siblings taught me to love others in a way that makes me different from my father.
What I mean to say is, simply that, well... Siblings are good. And such bonds are not for family alone.
I hope to reach such a level of trust and camaraderie with you one day as well, [S].
And I hope to build that trust not just as the king of a nation but simply as Xander—as your friend.
Special: I will see your era fade.
Status: In my reign as Nohr's new king, I vow to seek peace and understanding.
Hm? ...Ah, you wish to spar with me.
I'm a legendary Hero? To think that my name would be known across the worlds...
Prince Ryoma of Hoshido... Tell me, is he here?
Nohr is indomitable. I have no doubt that we will taste victory.
War defies all reason. It is driven by madness and greed. Yet wage war we must.
I have made my vow to seek peace and understanding. Together, you and I will bring forth a just world.

thorr2.name: Thórr
thorr2.title: Sun-Kissed Gods
thorr2.description: Loki, whose subtle manipulations touch a wide range of worlds, and Thórr, the war god. What purpose might these two have for coming to the seaside?
thorr2.duo:
Inflicts【Gravity】on foes in cardinal directions of unit. Neutralizes any【Bonus】active on foes within 5 rows or 5 columns centered on unit. (Does not neutralize stat bonuses of foes inflicted with Panic.)
【Gravity】 Restricts target's movement to 1 space through its next action.
【Bonus】 All effects that last "for 1 turn" or "that turn only." Includes bonuses granted by a skill like Rally or Hone and positive status effects (extra movement or effects like Dominance).

Castle Hall: **Thórr**: Why are mortals drawn to a place dominated by such heat? Is it...a way for them to challenge themselves?
**Loki**: I had suits with even scanter material, but...Thórr would only glare at me until I relented and put them away.
**Thórr**: No matter where you find yourself, it is possible to train. If you desire true strength, battle the tide.
**Loki**: There's no need to be shy in a place like this. Half the fun is enjoying all the delightful sights.
**Thórr**: Loki lured me here with promises of battle and glory. In other words... this was another of her schemes.
Visit: **Loki**: I am Loki, and this is Thórr. We are indulging in all the beach offers, at behest of [F].
Level: **Loki**: Thórr seems to finally be enjoying herself... Good. One ought to enjoy these sunny beaches when one can.
**Loki**: Hm. A bit distracted, are we?
**Thórr**: I could not bear to face Alfaðör in such a state as this...
Summon: I am Thórr, and— Loki, what is the meaning of this? What do you have us wearing?
Learn Skill: **Loki**: Thank you. We'll be able to have even more fun on our little vacation with this.
Confession:
**Loki**: Oh my, Thórr. Look at you, watching the sunset... Such childlike wonder.
**Thórr**: Childlike? How could a being as long-lived as I be anything like a child?
**Loki**: What does the length of your life have to do with it? It's the sparkle in your eye that matters.
Tanning under the summer sun, surrendering yourself to the surf, staying on the beach until sunset...
I think most mortals would identify those things as youthful.
I caught that sparkle in your eye, Thórr—and it was just like that of a child first seeing the ocean!
**Thórr**: ...As usual, you make it difficult to tell where the flattery ends and the manipulation begins.
I must admit, however, that your games are not always wholly without fun.
Status: "Maintain your composure. It is merely a beach." "Always the stick in the mud."
Conversation: **Loki**: Oh, it's so hot. Hot enough to simply ruin one's mood.
**Thórr**: Cease your squirming. You are attracting unwanted attention.
**Loki**: Squirming? Me? Preposterous. Besides, it's not just me they're looking at, dear.
**Thórr**: Explain.

**Loki**: *sigh* I do wonder about you, Thórr.
It seems that no matter how long you live, you just can't find the trick to sharpening your wit.
What I mean to say, dear, is that many of the gazes are trained your way.
**Thórr**: My way? It seems this scanty garb is strange, then.
I had intended only to conform to the social etiquette of these mortals. But now...

**Loki**: Oh, darling, no, no, you've got it all wrong. Their interest is an indication of just what a good job we've done.
Their eyes reflect nothing but approbation!
**Thórr**: Stop, please. I have no appetite for your tricks.

**Loki**: Fine, then. If you are feeling put out, let me mend your mood. Please lie down so I can apply some oil to you.
It has a lovely, calming scent.
**Thórr**: By way of apology? Very well, then.
**Loki**: You'll forget we have ever quarreled. Just let me unfasten this...
**Thórr**: You would remove what scraps of clothing I do bear?
**Loki**: Oh, dear, of course! This oil is for the body. I must apply it to your flesh. That's just how it's done!
**Thórr**: Is that so? But... It seems to me that...
**Loki**: Shh-shh-shh. Simply lie down. Then no one will be able to catch even a glimpse of you. Now, shall I?
**Thórr**: You may begin.
Duo Skill: "A nice breeze." "And a spot of shade."

nifl2.name: Nifl
nifl2.title: Tropical Ice God
nifl2.description: The dragon of ice and founder of the kingdom that shares her name. How could she possibly enjoy the summer heat?

Castle Hall: Mortals seem fond of garments that fail to defend against the sunlight.
This heat annoys me. Not unlike the flame god...whom I would rather not think of.
Is Fjorm here? A location like this is meant for mortals...
Tell me about this frozen treat... It's not bad... In fact, I rather enjoy it. Bring me more.
If I were to freeze the sea, this place might be easier to bear...
Visit: I am Nifl. I've brought a frozen treat, from [F].
Level: I understand now, the pleasure of a quiet beach.
If I wished it so, winter would arrive on these sunny shores.
It is not only hot but noisy as well... I am not meant for this.
Summon: Why would you summon me to this wretched inferno? Choose your answer wisely.
Learn Skill: Although I would rather avoid bearing such heat, I do appreciate this.
Confession:
The pleasure of the sun is wasted on me.
For me, relaxation is a cold space where time itself seems to stand still.
The frozen treats one can find here, however, are wonderful.
Enjoying them under the sun even adds to the experience somehow. An impressive mortal achievement.
Hm... Next time Fjorm ought to accompany me here.
Not that I plan to return... But if I did, her presence may help me stave off the boredom... Nothing more.
Status: Avert your gaze.
Mmh... Do not touch me.
The sun here... I will surely melt.
"Icy"? I will show you how cold I can be.
The constant rhythm of the waves is a soothing presence.
Fjorm would likely enjoy the tropical scenery...
I am...not bored. Let that suffice.

eirika7.name: Eirika
eirika7.title: Beach Restorer
eirika7.description: A kind princess who has come from Renais to a tropical island in order to rest and recover her strength. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Seth gave me some sunscreen, but... it remains to be seen whether I'll be able to evenly apply it to my back.
What a pleasant breeze... The climate on this island is quite similar to that of Renais. It makes me feel at home...
Do you think this attire is suitable for battle? I'm accustomed to wearing something a little more...armored.
I am glad Lyon was invited as well. He spends much of his time in his room, so the beach is a nice change.
That cloud looks just like my brother! Well, somewhat, at least... Maybe not from straight on... Do you see it?
Visit: I am Princess Eirika of Renais. I've come bearing summer tidings on behalf of [F].
Level: One must approach all things in life with full effort and focus. That is the energy I plan to bring to this summer!
I have no wish to bring conflict to these peaceful shores.
This heat and humidity are stifling... And the lack of wind is not helping.
Summon: I am Eirika of Renais. I have come to the beach this summer to take some time to enjoy myself.
Learn Skill: Oh, thank you! With this, I'll be able to enjoy summer to the fullest!
Confession:
We swam quite a lot today... I'd say it's about time for a break. What do you think, [S]?
Even though I'm tired, it's a pleasant sort of fatigue. It feels different from the exhaustion of combat training.
In a world without war, I imagine every day could be as peaceful as this...
That thought gives me hope for the days ahead.
I will carry the memories of this summer in my heart no matter what is to come.
It will be my reminder that it is possible for people to laugh and smile together.
I will protect those dear to me, so when the fighting ends, we can come here to have fun again, together.
Status: I'm Eirika. This is my first trip to a tropical island. I can't wait to explore!
Hmm? Oh, a cold drink for me? That's so kind of you.
The deep blue sea, the sprawling sandy beaches... It's just how I pictured it from my books. But even better!
Just look at this cute, spiny rock. Wait a second! It's alive!
There were so many great swimsuits to choose from. It was hard to select just one...
I wonder what Ephraim would have to say if he saw me wearing this...
I will always cherish the summer memories we made here.
Map Select: Is the sun too much for you?

lyon4.name: Lyon
lyon4.title: Sunlit Prince
lyon4.description: Prince of Grado who has made his way to the tropics after receiving an invite from his old friend, Eirika. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I wonder what kind of country lies beyond this sea... I would love to see it with my own eyes some day.
I am not particularly good with lively places... I'd rather sit at the cove and listen to the sound of the waves.
This is just between you and me, but I couldn't even look at Eirika in her swimsuit. She was just too radiant...
I once read in a book that the ocean is the origin of all life. This place is certainly teeming with it.
I walked out on the beach for only a short while, but...apparently, I burn quite easily.
Visit: I am Lyon, prince of Grado. I've been entrusted with delivering a tropical gift by [F].
Level: Ephraim, Eirika... It looks like even I know how to enjoy the summer.
I wasn't sure I'd be able to handle it, but it seems I've gotten used to the heat. Thank goodness.
I... I think I had a little too much sun... Please forgive me...
Summon: I am Lyon, prince of Grado. I am not accustomed to having fun on the beach, but I will do my best.
Learn Skill: Thank you, this is perfect for passing the time on a tropical island. I will treasure it.
Confession:
I spend most of my time in my room reading books, so I was nervous about coming to a tropical island.
But even here, there has been so much to learn—why, just look at all these unusual fruits and colorful fish.
I have discovered so much here, under this boundless blue sky.
I will need to express my gratitude to Eirika for inviting me. And of course to you, [S].
No matter what fate awaits me, I will never forget this summer.
These days, glittering like jewels... I am certain they will always shine within my heart.
Status: Good to meet you—I'm Lyon. Is the ocean view always so breathtaking here?
Oh! That looks refreshing. Some kind of warm-weather treat, I take it?
I only now saw Eirika. She was running full speed toward the ocean with a huge smile on her face.
Ephraim outpaces me in swimming as easily as he does in sparring.
What a strange little sea creature. It's rather cute, if prickly. Wouldn't you say?
Watching everyone enjoying themselves by the seaside, I feel as though I've strayed into a dream...
What do you say to a stroll along the beach at sunset? I think it would be lovely.

seth2.name: Seth
seth2.title: Silver-Sea Knight
seth2.description: Young general of Renais who has been assigned to protect Eirika, prepared to accompany her into the water if the situation calls for it. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Whether on beach or battlefield, my duty does not change. I will protect my charges with my life.
Running along the coast certainly works the legs. The Knights of Renais could benefit from this training.
It is not my place to comment on a swimsuit of Princess Eirika's choosing—and yet... Never mind.
I would prefer to stay on the shore. It is easier to spot dangers as they approach from this vantage point.
Do not fear. My armor is stowed under a nearby tree. I can spring into action at a moment's notice.
Visit: I hope you will do me the honor of accepting this summertime gift from [F].
Level: I will protect Eirika when necessary, by whatever means are required. That is why I have come here.
Though I have shed my armor for a swimsuit, my senses remain as focused as ever.
To think I could be brought so low by mere heat...
Summon: I am Seth, of the Knights of Renais. Prince Ephraim asked me to join the princess on her retreat.
Learn Skill: Thank you. There was no need for you to go out of your way for me in this blazing-hot weather.
Confession:
I had not expected to find you here so late, [S].
It's getting dark. The princess has returned to her lodging, and you should as well. We will dine soon.
Oh, I see. You meant to watch the sun sink below the horizon... Forgive my intrusion then.
It is a beautiful sight, that bright vermilion jewel slowly sliding out of view... I cannot blame you.
I ask the princess to return to her lodging early every night purely out of interest in her safety, but...
I think perhaps I will not protest her remaining outside a while longer in the future, if only to see the sunset.
Status: I am merely here to escort Princess Eirika.
*splutter* Do try to avoid splashing me with water, inadvertently or otherwise.
I must do my utmost to ensure Princess Eirika does not suffer a sunburn.
The proof of a knight's duty is the scars his body bears.
I have my duties. Rest comes when appropriate.
I hope that Princess Eirika can enjoy a moment of respite, however fleeting it may be...
I must express my gratitude. It has been a great pleasure to spend time with you like this.

ymir.name: Ymir
ymir.title: Life-Mother
ymir.description: A dragon from the realm of life. Her motherly, compassionate heart laments her realm's destruction at the hands of Hel.

Castle Hall: What a lovely country this is... The people, the scenery—it all has a certain glow to it. Just like home.
I tried to gather the souls of those in my realm who were being taken by Hel. I had nearly all of them...
Are you feeling well? You are always welcome to speak with me. I will not ever turn you away.
Whew... The amount of walking in this place has made me hungry. Would you care to eat with me?
I got some sweets in anticipation of enjoying them with Eir. They're delicious. Would you like to try?
Visit: I am Ymir. I come with a message from [F].
Level: The warmth of life's flow fills me...
A glimmering spark of life...
Without any change, this will not do for long.
Summon: I am Ymir, the dragon of life. If my life's spark might aid you, I am glad to offer it.
Learn Skill: For me? I'm delighted!
Confession:
If you don't mind, I would like to take a moment to express my gratitude.
Because of you, Eir is safe and in good spirits.
...Hm? How can I tell? Hee hee... She can be a bit difficult to read, but I know when she is happy.
For her to enjoy her life as she does, and to want to keep on living... Those things are your doing. So thank you.
You were able to do what I could not—a failure I've regretted for a long time. But there is no need now.
This, too, must be fate. In saving Eir, you have saved me as well. And I cannot thank you enough.
Status: I am Ymir, dragon of life and steward of its realm.
*surprise* How bold you are, to test a dragon.
Our realm was beautiful once, flush with the sweet glow of life.
All living things are precious to me—every plant and every creature.
Eir was such a dear little girl.
If only I could have saved them! At the very least, if I could have protected Eir…
You hold in your hands the lives gathered here. Allow me to ease that weight.

celica5.name: Celica
celica5.title: Valentia's Hope
celica5.description: Princess of Zofia and member of Lima IV's line. She has grown stronger over the course of her journeys with her friends. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: We are all human; disagreements are inevitable. But understanding becomes possible with effort.
We cannot just stand by and watch as the flames of war spread across the world. We must all do what we can.
I made this outfit to resemble Alm's armor. That way, we need never be separated.
The power of faith can change the future. I have learned this well on my ongoing journey to save Valentia.
To be considered a true warrior priestess, one must master sword and spell both.
Visit: I am Celica, princess of Zofia. I offer a token of enduring amity from [F].
Level: With this power, I shall protect the land of the goddess Mila and all those I cherish!
I feel my thoughts become power...
I cannot give up on the future!
Summon: I am Celica, princess of Zofia. I will lend my aid as a warrior priestess under Mila's divine protection.
Learn Skill: I must give thanks to the Earth Mother for her blessings.
Confession:
I learned many lessons as I journeyed with my companions.
What was particularly etched into my mind was the need for the strength to protect others, wielded with love.
Ideals alone won't build the future; power alone won't win people's hearts.
To move forward, we need both fortitude and sympathy.
I live with the wills of my cherished friends, who strove to shape the future, and my prayers for peace.
I must stay strong and protect all that is dear to me—with Alm by my side forever!
Status: I feel invigorated—as if I've been reborn.
Oh! Mischievous as ever, I see.
I feel so warm, it's as though the goddess Mila herself dwells within me.
Alm and I can get through anything, so long as we're together.
The strength to protect others, wielded with love—that is how you save the world.
I hope always for peace and prosperity for Valentia.
You have earned my sincere devotion. I will never hesitate to fight for you.

est3.name: Est
est3.title: Sweet Baby Sis
est3.description: The youngest of three pegasus knight sisters. Left the Macedonian Whitewings and now runs her own shop. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I got kidnapped by pirates and ended up all the way in Valentia. Of all the luck!
I'm done being a soldier. I'm running a shop in Altea with Abel. It may be tiny, but it's ours!
I just saw kid-me walking around! I guess there are lots of different mes here, from different worlds... Wild!
There are so many good people here. Come to think of it, maybe there's somebody for my sister Palla!
Even after I left the Macedonian Whitewings, I would sometimes drill with the knights of Altea.
Visit: Your friend [F] sent me. Bye now!
Level: My instinct for combat is coming back. I'm sure I can help!
I am NOT getting kidnapped by pirates, or ANYBODY, EVER again!
I really do have the worst luck.
Summon: It's good to meet you! I'm Est. I may not be a soldier anymore, but I still know my way around a battlefield.
Learn Skill: This is for me? Thank you! That cheers me up.
Confession:
*sigh* Here I am, fighting again. I'd finally quit being a soldier and set up shop with Abel too.
And if I hadn't gotten kidnapped by pirates in the first place, my sisters wouldn't have gotten roped into this.
There's no use fretting about it. I just have to try and give my help to whoever needs it!
I may have quit the Whitewings, but I'm still a pegasus knight. I have my pride!
Once we bring peace to Askr and Valentia, I can go back to the shop.
Wait for me, Abel! I'll be back as soon as the fighting is over!
Status: My name's Est. I'm the youngest of three. Do you know Palla and Catria?
Ah! Oh, come on! And they say I'm childish! Tch...
I'm done with being a soldier. I'm running a shop with Abel.
I'd finally settled down, and then I got kidnapped by pirates. Just my luck!
Well, I've come this far. I'm going to give this fight my all. Are you with me?
Oh, Abel... When will we finally live in peace together?
I've been through a lot, but I'm glad to have met you.

kamui.name: Kamui
kamui.title: Wandering Blade
kamui.description: A mercenary who drifts from place to place. He hates being tied down and models a carefree yet composed attitude. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Ever since I arrived, people keep mistaking me for some monk. Do we really look that much alike?
I've lived my life as a wanderer. I don't put down roots.
With all these Heroes, you'd think someone else might be called Kamui too. But I guess not.
Might be nice to settle down one day and make a safe haven for other mercs with no place to go.
Valbar's a guy who sees things as they are. If he already sized you up, then we should be good to go.
Visit: I'm Kamui, a wandering mercenary. At the moment, I swing my blade for [F].
Level: Hiring me was the right choice. Go on, say it!
You know how to keep me busy! No complaints, though. More work, more pay!
Well, that wasn't worth it.
Summon: I'm Kamui, a wandering mercenary. So you're my new boss? I'll make sure you aren't wasting your money.
Learn Skill: This job has some perks!
Confession:
I was born a wanderer. I've seen my share of kingdoms, and more than my share of battlefields.
This, though, is my first time in a new world. Never thought I'd end up somewhere my feet can't carry me.
Believe me when I say that Askr is one of the better places I've been. Just look at everybody! All smiles.
And listen to them too. These Heroes have vowed to defend this kingdom with their lives. I can see why.
But most important is the fact that there are precisely zero necrodragons. I'll miss this place...
Yes, I'll be on my way sooner or later, but work comes first. The peace of Askr is at stake!
Special: I'm just in it for the money.
Status: The name's Kamui. I'll work for whoever is willing to pay me.
Huh? Stop kidding around, I'm trying to relax here.
*yawn* What? You need something done? Sure, I'm on it...
This job you need done: we won't be running into any necrodragons, right? Right?
Valbar was all right as far as employers go. I wonder how you'll fare.
When I finally return home, I may just consider settling down for good.
I'm a bit of a wanderer, so I'm used to being away from home. I guess you could say I've enjoyed my time here.

atlas.name: Atlas
atlas.title: Forest Muscle
atlas.description: A woodcutter from a Zofian mountain village. He accompanies Celica to repay a debt of gratitude he owes her. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I owe the priestess a debt for saving my little brothers. If she's in this world, I'll help her however I can.
Right after I left to serve as a soldier, the village was attacked by bandits. Damn it, if only I'd stuck around...
Can't say I like fighting much. You're the same way, right? I can see it in your eyes.
The mountains here in Askr sure are something else. They're so majestic, I never get tired of looking at them.
I've used this axe to chop down hundreds, if not thousands of trees. All to keep my little brothers fed...
Visit: Name's Atlas. I'm a woodcutter. I've got a little something for you from [F].
Level: Heck, I do this kinda thing to unwind!
Who's next?! I'm gonna beat the snot outta you!
Guess my woodcutting skills aren't as relevant as I thought...
Summon: Name's Atlas. I'm just a woodcutter, not some warrior, but if someone's in trouble, I'll lend a hand!
Learn Skill: Thanks! I'll pay you back for this on the battlefield!
Confession:
I was just a woodcutter back home. Never thought of myself as a hero or anything grand like that.
And it's not like I really understand politics or religion. I always figured that stuff was more for royals.
But I also ain't a lowlife who would just turn a blind eye to someone in trouble right in front of him.
If innocent lives are in danger, I'll do whatever I can to help—even if all I've got is this old axe.
I can't just do nothing. Not after everything I've seen.
Scorched villages, rivers of blood... Not even the mountains themselves are safe from the ravages of war.
You wanna put a stop to it too, don't you? In that case, we've got our eyes set on the same goal.
Once there's peace, I can go back to being a simple woodcutter. So let's get all this fighting over with!
Special: Ready to fall? Bring it on!
Status: Name's Atlas. I'm just a simple woodcutter.
Huh? The heck was that?! Oh... You call that a prank?
I ain't really cut out for being a warrior. I'm better suited for chopping trees, if you ask me.
Summoning? Divine Weapons? Sorry, friend, but you're gonna have to explain it simpler to me.
That priestess Celica has got smarts, sophistication, and on top of that, she's strong... She's just amazing.
Just you wait... Your big brother's definitely coming home...
I don't really like fighting, but if you need me to, I'll put my life on the line.

brigandboss.name: Brigand Boss
brigandboss.title: Known Criminal
brigandboss.description: A brigand who set up a hideout in a shrine to the east of Ram Village and acts as the leader of a group of ruffians. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: You put brigands to work and still got the gall to call yourselves good guys? You're worse than the Duma Faithful!
This place is so peaceful...it's borin' me to tears! I miss runnin' roughshod over Zofia. Now THAT was fun...
My real name don't matter. I'm a brigand, and my boys call me "Boss." Simple as that.
Got any delicate maidens you need kidnapped? It's kinda my specialty— Hey, relax, all right? I'm only kiddin'!
From what I hear, I wasn't even supposed to get summoned to this place. Send me back already!
Visit: Get a load of this palace! I might have to take a gift back with me. Ya know, for your pal [F].
Level: Steal everything that ain't nailed down, then go for the nails! That's how me and my boys do business.
What, I'm supposed to act like some kinda hero now? Not a chance!
Gah, what a miserable take...
Summon: OK, boys. Steal everything that ain't nailed down, then—wait, where am I? "Kingdom of Askr?" Never heard of it!
Learn Skill: Hu-hu-ho-ho-ha-ha-ha-ha! Now this is the kinda reward I'm talkin' about!
Confession:
Hey! It's about time ya sent me back to Valentia, you think?
Huh? You want me to kick the life of crime and start livin' on the straight and narrow here in Askr?
Ugh... Well, if it means hot meals and a roof overhead for me and the boys, I could be convinced.
Even brigands can have a change of heart if their basic needs are bein' met. We ain't monsters...
Is what you wish I'd say, you softy! Once a brigand, always a brigand, and me and the boys are doin' just fine!
We'll take what we want from who we want, then we'll take some more! Hu-hu-ho-ho-ha-ha-ha-ha!
Status: My name? What good'll that do ya, huh?
Hey! Quit pokin' me! You got a death wish or somethin'?
That whelp came bargin' in just as I was gettin' to the main event...
Zofia used to be ripe for the pickin'... It was paradise.
Need some work done? Better be ready to pony up.
There's no shortage of shiny treasure here...or fine women. Heh heh heh...
This partnership is shapin' up real profitable. I think I'm gonna stick around.

askr.name: Askr
askr.title: God of Openness
askr.description: God of the opened kingdom, which shares his name. Cheerful and benevolent, he concerns himself with the changes in Embla's heart.

Castle Hall: So, this land is still known as the Kingdom of Askr, is it? I take pride in that—but it can be confusing.
Mine is a world that connects to all others. Where would you like to go?
Ash is like a daughter to me. Her drive to help people is a precious quality I hold dear.
I imagine each world connected to all others... If the people could find a way to cooperate—just think of it.

I've come to see you are something interesting indeed. Perhaps we could get to know each other better...
Would you have the time to speak with me, [S]?
Visit: Hello! Here you are, in light of your bond with [F]!
Level: Together, no world in existence is beyond our reach.
What sort of world shall I go to next? I wonder...
Oh! My, my...
Summon: Hello! I am Askr. To be summoned is to see a new world, so I am pleased indeed! I look forward to our travels.
Learn Skill: Thank you! I am pleased to receive such a gift.
Confession:
Mortals are dear to me. I wish to learn of them and embrace the wonderful variety of their ways...
Their lives, short as they may be, burn with an intense brilliance. I would like to help them shine.
That is why I made my contract with Líf, and why Embla contracted with Thrasir...
These ties live on, even today, within Alfonse, Zacharias, and others of their lines.
It all pleases me endlessly, and I hope only to protect that brilliant light of theirs.
Status: Speaking with you is a pleasure. I foresee us growing quite close indeed.
Curious about me, are you? Delightful.
I do wish Embla and I could make peace. She, however, feels very differently...
How has Ash been doing? She takes her work very seriously, you know.
I do not comport myself as you expect of a god? But gods are no more special than any mortal.
A world of companionship, where all gaps between people can be bridged. That is my ideal.
I believe our worlds will only continue to grow closer.

nina2.name: Nina
nina2.title: Shadowy Figures
nina2.description: A former thief and a Hoshidan ninja. Under the cover of night, they glide through the darkness with the silence of shadows. They appear in Fire Emblem Fates.
nina2.duo:
Unit can move 1 extra space. (That turn only. Does not stack.) If any foes are in cardinal directions of unit or【Penalty】is active on any foes, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-7 and【Panic】 on those foes.
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Penalty】 All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).
【Panic】 Converts bonuses on target into penalties through its next action.

Castle Hall:
**Kagero**: Nina said master thieves must always leave a calling card, so I drew ours. It's quite good, if I may say so myself.
...Excuse me? It is clearly a cat.
**Nina**: The thief escapes, with the guard hot on his heels. Then, a relationship blossoms between the two. Hehehe...
**Nina**: I'm not really a thief anymore, but it's not like I regret those days. Even now, I'm certain I did the right thing.
**Kagero**: I expected thief's attire to differ quite a bit from that of a ninja's, but...are these always so gaudy?
**Kagero**: Nina demonstrates considerable insight on occasion. Perhaps that is from her time as a chivalrous thief.
Visit: **Nina**: I can't believe you found us hiding in the barrels! I guess that's a friend of [F]'s for you.
Level: **Kagero**: Victory is ours. Now for the treasure...
**Nina**: What, did you think I lost my edge when I gave up on being a thief? Think again!
**Kagero**: To think I would make such a blunder... My apologies.
Summon: Sorry to keep you waiting! Nina and Kagero are on the scene! With our skills, there's nothing we can't steal!
Learn Skill: **Nina**: Nice! I feel like I'm positively bursting with motivation!
Confession:
**Kagero**: Nina, your lock-picking skills are quite impressive. Is there some trick to it?
**Nina**: Hmm... This might sound obvious, but it's important to think about what kind of key best fits the keyhole.
What shape is the key? What is it forged from? Copper? Brass? Steel?
What's the tensile strength of the material?
As the heroic keyhole waits to be unlocked, does it dream of a sturdy key? Hehehe...
**Kagero**: I can't say I understand any of that, but you clearly have a passion for locksmithing.
**Nina**: Not with me yet? I can't wait for the day when just seeing a key on a table is enough to get your heart racing!
Status: • Thief and guard... A forbidden romance... • What are you mumbling about?
Conversation: **Nina**: So, looks like we'll be doing a bit of thievery! Don't worry, this is old hat for me. I'll show you how it's done.
**Kagero**: My expertise is more in espionage than theft. I will gratefully take your instruction.
Demonstrate your secrets. I am eager to learn!
**Nina**: Really?! Ooo, how exciting! With my help, you'll be a master in no time. Trust me.
First things first: observe your target closely. Evaluate security. Determine any possible weak points.
**Kagero**: Understood.
**Nina**: Let's say we're looking at Askr's treasury, right? There are these two guards who have regular duty there.
There's a tall skinny one with dark hair, and a shorter one who's ginger.
The ginger's the superior officer—you can tell by the way the dark-haired one talks. But that's not all I realized.
**Kagero**: Mmm. You've got my attention. What else?
**Nina**: The more they work together, how they speak gets less formal... Ooo, they're getting closer by the day, I know it!
It's only a matter of time until they're sharing secrets. Confiding deep, dark vulnerabilities. Holding hands!
**Kagero**: W-wait a moment. What does this have to do with thievery?
**Nina**: All they need is a dash of danger— some action to make them realize how much they mean to each other!
And who's gonna give them that? We are. We're the matchmakers.
We'll snatch the shinies from the treasury and lead them on a merry chase. Come on, let's do this!
**Kagero**: You left me behind a while ago. However, your enthusiasm is admirable!
Duo Skill: • Focus on the task. • Look at those two!

cath2.name: Cath
cath2.title: Caper Captain
cath2.description: Leader of a group of thieves who steal from the rich. Eager to recruit strong members into her crew. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: With everyone distracted by the festival, treasures in the castle are— Ahahaha! That was a joke. Just a joke!
The rich hoard money by bullying the weak. I steal from the rich, and give it back to those who deserve it!
A new outfit for the festival! Hehe, this is perfect for the occasion, don't you think?
There are people in this world who can't live unsullied lives. Master thieves are here to help those people.
What's this? A festival just for us thieves?! This is my time to shine! Cath's Bandits, assemble!
Visit: Security seems a little light in this castle. Don't worry, your friend's castle had the same problem.
Level: The shiny coins and sparkling jewelry! It's all calling out to me!
You did leave yourself wide open. Good learning experience though!
No way! I can't believe you sensed my presence!
Summon: I've come a looong waaay for this event! It's really happening! I'll be the star of the festival!
Learn Skill: This is what they call a "lavish feast," right? I'm gonna try everything!
Confession:
The Kingdom of Askr is throwing a festival, just for me! Nice!
It's not that kind of festival? How can you say that? When someone says "master thief," you think of me, right?
Therefore, it isn't an exaggeration to say that this festival is the ultimate celebration of me!
Oh! You know what else? This is the perfect place to scout for more recruits for Cath's Bandits.
I met a pair earlier with a mysterious air about them. And that masked lady thief seemed to be quite skilled.
So many great additions to the roster! Cath's Bandits have a bright future!
Status: What? You don't know who I am? I'm Cath! The master thief!
*squeal* Calm down, Cath! There's nothing to be scared of. You're a thief, after all!
I'm an optimist. No time for doom and gloom!
It's no fun if you can just walk in and take things. Where's the thrill?
I just wish I could hand out all this wealth back home...
Psst. Just between us...where does the royal family hide its treasure?
Y'know, you're not so bad. I mean, you're nowhere near as good as me, but...who is?
Map Select: Fine, I'll take care of it.

leila2.name: Leila
leila2.title: Keen Lookout
leila2.description: A spy in service to House Ostia forgoing her usual attire to join in on the thieving action. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Matthew's more of a master thief than I am. But I'll do what I can.
Treading lightly is nothing new to me. For a spy, it's second nature.
Lord Hector is the sort of eccentric who'd enjoy a festival like this.
What do you think? Does the mask complete the illusion?
The outfit's functional enough, but you'd think the last thing a thief would want is to stand out.
Visit: I have a secure message to deliver to [S], entrusted to me by [F].
Level: Once I get eyes on the valuables, they're as good as mine.
Can't afford to get careless.
I must have made a mistake...
Summon: I'm Leila. Are you looking for a thief? Count me in.
Learn Skill: I'll help myself to whatever isn't nailed down.
Confession:
So, what do you think? Do I look the part, [S]?
Spying and thieving have a lot in common. I'm used to the former, so the latter comes easily.
Of course, spies are interested in acquiring information, not material goods. But the skills translate.
I enjoy a straightforward stealth mission. Get to the objective, keep out of sight. Simple as that.
So feel free to give me as much of this work as you've got.
Trust me, the risk of losing my life is nothing at all in comparison to what I'm used to.
Status: The most masterful skill in thievery is to do the work without being detected.
*startled noise* If just anyone can sneak up on me, I'm not half the thief I thought I was.
My skills as a spy will help me steal with panache.
What do I want? That's a good question. Perhaps a peaceful life with Matthew... Silly, I know.
I can't decide if it's riskier to live as a spy or a thief.
All it took to shake you from my tail was putting on a mask… Hah. Talk to me again when you're more astute.
I'll steal whatever you desire.

sothe2.name: Sothe
sothe2.title: Rushing Dawn
sothe2.description: A thief for the Dawn Brigade wearing a disguise in celebration of masked gentleman thieves. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: If we're stealing from the rich to give to the poor, then count me in.
Beast tribe laguz tend to be quiet and agile. Lots of them could be great thieves, if they chose to.
Someday, I hope we live in a world where stealing is unnecessary. And unheard of.
These clothes are as comfortable as they are functional. I'm tempted to just wear them all the time.
If you need a lock handled, let me know. I've been picking them for most of my life.
Visit: I'm Sothe. Here for the festivities, on [F]'s orders.
Level: Slow. Too slow. I'm falling asleep over here.
No sweat. I could have handled this even without my thieving skills.
Guess I got careless...
Summon: I'm Sothe, of the Dawn Brigade. I don't know too much about what's going on here, but I'd like to help out.
Learn Skill: For me? Don't mind if I do.
Confession:
I saw some children messing around in the square earlier. Playing at being thieves.
Their game was all about stealing the silver and gold from the villains and giving it over to the needy.
It's amazing to me that we all know stealing is wrong, but at the same time, that feels like justice.
I think we can all agree that what we really want is a world where no one has to steal to survive or be happy.
In a world like that, thieves would only exist in celebrations like this one.
But speaking of—the party's still on, right? Let's keep it going a bit longer. I want Micaiah to have some fun too.
Status: Taking to give to folks in need isn't theft. It's doing the right thing.
You again? Don't you ever get bored of doing that?
I'm not after anything in particular, but I would like to nab something for Micaiah.
Most nobles get rich by trampling on commoners. I'll take whatever I can from them.
All dressed up in black. Should help me blend in to the shadows as I go about my business.
Our goal's to make the world a place where nobody has to steal to survive.
You should learn how to pick a lock. Never know when that could come in handy.

rickard.name: Rickard
rickard.title: Carefree Culprit
rickard.description: A thief who looks up to Julian. He is barely able to contain his excitement for thievery, let alone a celebration of it. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Julian's put thievery behind him, but don't let me hear you say he's lost his edge. No way.
I was thinking about quitting thieving and joining up with the chief. There's more than one way to get gold!
Always seemed to me that all these royals and knights were nasty bits of work. Besides Marth 'n Kris, I mean.
One of them fancy-lookin' thieves was eyeing me and Julian. What's that all about?
There must be PLENTY of treasure just lyin' around in this castle. Don't think anybody'd miss a tiny bit...
Visit: Name's Rickard. I'm a big-time thief—at least for now—over at [F]'s castle!
Level: I'm gonna do my best today— Julian's watching!
I'm a damn sight better than this! I could do this in my sleep!
Are you kiddin' me?! Just like with the chief, I put myself out there and got nothin' to show for it...
Summon: The name's Rickard! Julian asked me to help out with the Thieves' Masque. You can count on me!
Learn Skill: You're giving this to me? Big shot, ain't ya? Heh.
Confession:
Askr's a funny place, ain't it? Who'd stage a festival for thieves?
It isn't usually a job you shout about. "Hey! I'm a thief!" Nah. Like Julian said, you can't hold your head high.
But if I can play the role of a big-time thief and make the festival more fun, then maybe being a thief is worth it!
'Course, Julian ain't a thief anymore, so I have to work twice as hard to make things lively!
I'll show you what a big-time thief can do! Keep your eyes peeled, Chief!
Status: I'm Rickard, a small-time thief. But it seems like you have something big in mind…
*startled reaction* Oh, it's you! I thought I got nabbed.
Moving quietly, picking locks... Julian taught me everything I know.
If I'm a big-time thief now, does that mean I can steal as much as I want? Oh, nice!
Chief... Throwing me away like that was just too cruel.
I wonder if any treasure is lying around here... Time for a look-see!
It's settled! I'll lend you a hand. But I'll take a cut of the loot as payment!

chrom7.name: Chrom
chrom7.title: Fated Honor
chrom7.description: Chrom, exalt of the Halidom of Ylisse. Intent on honoring his sister's dream, he faces his fate with his treasured bonds close at heart. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Emm... This was the correct path to follow, right?
Ah! I'm sorry, did I startle you? It's surprisingly difficult to gauge my strength with this armor on...
Ylissean armor symbolizes justice. If I am to live up to that idea, I must refrain from any rash behavior.
I will cross oceans and even time itself for the sake of a peaceful world. That is why I have this power.
I remember this malevolence... Is the Fell Dragon here?!
Visit: I'm not suited to acting like a king, so I think I'll accompany you on your rounds for a while, if that's OK.
Level: Even if a future of despair is all that awaits us, we will believe in each other and fight! We will change fate!
I will not let anyone else be lost. That is what I fight for, and why I must win!
So this is my limit right now... Still, I won't give up, no matter what!
Summon: I am Chrom, of the Halidom of Ylisse. It is my duty as the exalt to wield this power for all those who seek peace!
Learn Skill: I will carry the hopes and prayers of all my friends. I swear it on the holy name of the Halidom of Ylisse.
Confession:
Oops! I bump into you a lot, don't I? I'm sorry, but could you spare a bit of your time while we're here?
It's just... It's no good. No matter what I try, I can't seem to sit still.
It isn't as if I'm hoping for a battle, but... Well, I think I must be too accustomed to fighting.
I enjoyed leading the Shepherds and never intended to become a ruler... but fate can have unexpected plans.
No matter the world, life never seems to go as we expect it to. Still, my friends and I fought against that.
Guided by the bonds I had formed with all of them, I vowed to change our dark future—to change our fate!
In truth, I know that prayer alone cannot prevail against power. But my heart tells me something else.
People's wishes, their pleas for help... They are never in vain. I will believe in that for as long as I live.
If there is a name for that feeling, it must be justice. I'm sure you have your own justice that you believe in.
So, let us each live our lives to the fullest, to protect those feelings as we carry them in our hearts.
Status: This is the armor of a Great Lord. It takes a lot of training to earn this, and to wear it well!
*surprise* Don't strike me out of the blue, friend. Even with this armor, it still hurts!
If my power can be used to promote peace, then I will happily go wherever I am needed.
You think Lucina takes after me? I'm not sure what to say...
Another training dummy. Damn. Hope they're not in short supply.
For the good of the people, no matter who or where they are. Isn't that right, Emmeryn?
You called on me. Now it's my turn to live up to that, and do my part.

seliph3.name: Seliph
seliph3.title: Enduring Legacy
seliph3.description: Descendant of the crusader Baldr and son of Sigurd. Brings Jugdral's long war to its conclusion. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Noble of Chalphy, crusader of Grannvale... Clothing can impart more than one truth.
Just as the people of Isaach recognize Shannan, those who knew my father see significance of these clothes.
As child of a father branded a traitor, I want to live up to the expectations of those who have supported me.
If it is my fate to fight as a crusader, if that is my destiny, so be it. I will do as the gods wish of me.
My father was loved and trusted by many. I hope to be like him in that way.
Visit: I am Seliph. I have heard you are quite a capable tactician, according to [F].
Level: Father, Mother... Watch over me.
The light of divine Tyrfing shall judge the darkness of this world!
Light is always with us, so long as it is never forgotten...
Summon: I am Seliph, crusader of Grannvale. I wear these clothes to celebrate my father—a great man indeed.
Learn Skill: I will do my best to live up to the expectations you have of me.
Confession:
According to scripture, Naga and eleven other gods descended from the heavens...
Lewyn once told me of how the 12 crusaders made their pact with those gods at the Tower of Dahna.
My world had known much chaos. When it was learned that a dragon was behind it all, they took a stand.
The gods themselves let flow their blood from their hands, and that power flowed into the crusaders.
In that way, the crusaders gained a dragon's power so as to set the world as it should be.
The gods, it seems, were themselves an ancient dragon tribe.
I have heard similar stories from other worlds, and I can't help but wonder...
If we know of so many other worlds, we can assume those worlds are shaped by the same mistakes.
Being here, in this world, the thought was nearly unavoidable.
That is why I believe we who come together across worlds should help create a new future for each other.
Status: I am Seliph. I wear the same garb as my honored father, Sigurd.
*startled* You still manage to sneak up on me.
I have always felt someone calling to me.
Dressed as my father? Nothing could honor me more.
I think that Julia will also be delighted by this outfit.
Father, Mother... Please watch over me.
With all my heart, I wish to protect you and the world you hold dear.

atiki3.name: Tiki
atiki3.title: Fated Divinity
atiki3.description: A manakete who has lived for thousands of years, through many ages. Worshipped as the Voice of the Divine Dragon by the people of Valm. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: These clothes take me back to my childhood. Although, I believe Lucina once got me something similar...

"Naga, god of light, appears as a young girl, and Salamander, god of fire, takes the form of an old man..."
Hehe, they certainly sound familiar.
People worship dragons as gods, but we are neither ageless nor immortal.
The blood of dragons, shared with the people, helped fan the flames of war... There are worlds like that, too.
Wearing these clothes, I am reminded of the days I spent with Mar-Mar and the others so very long ago...
Visit: I'm Tiki, a manakete. This is from your friend [F].
Level: I know what I am capable of now, which is why I will warn you—do not force me to take this seriously.
Is this all right?
Sorry, I think... *yawn* ...I might be getting sleepy again.
Summon: *yawn* ...Oh, did you call for me? I am Tiki, inheritor of the blood and soul of the Divine Dragon, Naga.
Learn Skill: Thaaa— *yawn* ...Thank you. Would you mind if I take a little nap?
Confession:
Summoner, do you have a moment? There is something I would like to ask you. Do you...believe in reincarnation?
Ah, the look on your face tells me all I need to know. I suppose that is normal in this world.
There is a reason I ask, of course. We Heroes may be but echoes from other worlds and even times.
To draw upon the power of those echoes... Well, I suppose the desire to save others can take many forms.
When you live for three thousand years, it becomes difficult to not wonder about such things.
There are no coincidences. Only fate.
If that fate has an architect, I have yet to meet them. So, shall we seek it? Together, to a world yet unknown.
Status: As I dreamt, I heard so many voices calling my name...
Huh? What? I'm awake! Can't you tell?
My age? Now that's a secret!
Ever since I've come to Askr, I've met rather a lot of people! So many of them are dear to me now.
*long yawn* Oh, sorry, sorry. I am a bit sleepy.
This is one dream that I would like to keep having for as long as I can.
I'm so used to being left behind... Even so, I do want to stay here with you.

fbyleth4.name: Byleth
fbyleth4.title: Sublime Light
fbyleth4.description: A former professor of Garreg Mach Monastery. Guided by the voice of the goddess within, she aims to illuminate the darkness smothering the world. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: These clothes are in an ancient style that matches the ones worn by the progenitor—I mean by Sothis.
The goddess Sothis once dwelt within me.
I'm often told I don't show much emotion, but I've never thought of myself as an "Ashen Demon."
The Officers Academy made me who I am today. It's all thanks to my wonderful students.
I'll use this power for the greater good.
Visit: I hope I'm not intruding. I was asked to come say hello by your friend [F].
Level: With the goddess!
Just like that. Stay focused.
I'm not setting a very good example...
Summon:
In time’s flow, see the glow of flames ever burning bright... On the swift river’s drift, broken memories alight...
When we bring our voices together, we can conquer the very heavens.
Learn Skill: There is an endless amount of knowledge out there. I hope to never stop learning.
Confession:
Time's flow... A place where all the possibilities of fate seem to lie, stretching out into infinity.
Twisting through time, a glimpse of destiny... What did I see there? What did I know? What did I accomplish?
Wearing these clothes puts me in the mood to think about these mysteries. The mystery of power most of all.
I don't want to dwell too much on the past. That much is clear. I need to keep moving forward.
We cannot accept the status quo. War cannot be the norm. Not in Fódlan, nor in Askr.
I know the Heroes of this world feel the same way. And their brave voices inspire me to fight for change.
Status: This garb matches that of Sothis.
Hm? Your hand is cold. Are you well?
I heard countless voices calling me here...though their origin remains a mystery to me.
It's not that I feel embarrassed, but... Is it appropriate to hold class in this attire?
The goddess Sothis once dwelled within me. I understand if that is hard to believe.
Could this be where the flow of time has guided me next on my journey?
Let us continue working together to build a better world.

jeralt.name: Jeralt
jeralt.title: Blade Breaker
jeralt.description: Famed former captain of the Knights of Seiros. Moved on to lead a band of mercenaries after the loss of his wife. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Let's skip the formalities, shall we? Care for a drink?
Risking your life is part of the job for a mercenary. It's smart to keep your eyes on what's in front of you.
There is only so much guidance I can give. Sometimes all you can do is watch the young surpass you.
It's all a bit reckless if you ask me. I just hope my counsel about Lady Rhea left some impression...
I have no intention of getting overly involved—for our mutual benefit.
Visit: You're [S], huh? That right?
Level: The battlefield is no place for idle thoughts. The fight is all you should think about—if you want to survive.
I'm gonna get myself cleaned up, all right, [S]?
Damn... Am I losing my edge?
Summon: I'm Jeralt. I'm a mercenary, so I can handle myself in a fight. If you don't mind, why don't we leave it at that.
Learn Skill: Huh... Interesting. I hadn't imagined I'd still be finding ways to improve myself at this point.
Confession:
Damn, nothing like a cool drink after a long battle...
So? What was it you wanted to ask me about?
Right... My full name is Jeralt Reus Eisner. I was once captain of the Knights of Seiros.
You've done your research.
Lady Rhea saved my life once, and I ended up in her service.
And I am also the father of the Ashen Demon. My life is a long, complicated story. Too long...
So long that I've grown a bit weary of it—all the fighting, the struggling to create a life...
The world is full of secrets that no one needs to know. And once you've made the mistake of learning...
I can tell you that there are truths about the world more terrible than any could imagine.
Even so, if you choose to seek out those truths, I won't be the one to try to stop you.
Status: Name's Jeralt. These days I'm just a wandering mercenary.
Hm? Did you need something? I'm a little busy.
Risking your life is part of the job for a mercenary like me.
I tried to teach that kid everything I know.
I used to be a Knight of Seiros, but that was a long time ago.
Lady Rhea's here too, huh? I guess there's no avoiding it then...
You've come a long way since we met, but I still have a lot to teach if you'll listen.

deirdre2.name: Deirdre
deirdre2.title: Fated Saint
deirdre2.description: A central figure of the tragedy at Belhalla. Brought three children into the world as dictated by the whims of fate. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.
deirdre2.artist: Haimura Kiyotaka (はいむらきよたか)

Castle Hall: Seliph has turned out so well. I am grateful to Prince Lewyn for all the guidance he gave my son.
I knew that, as a maiden of the Spirit Forest, I should not have contact with outsiders. I knew it would bring ruin...
Please care for the ones you hold dear. Those bonds are what keep the world from falling apart.
I was told that I would be despised by the outside world. Lord Sigurd's love made me forget that...for a time.
However long or short my time in this place may be...from the bottom of my heart, I thank you for it.
Visit: Please, take good care of yourself. Please...live a peaceful, happy life.
Level: All life is a cycle. Even this is destiny.
Can you hear the voice of the spirits?
Julius... Julia, I...
Summon: I've lived two lives. Both were tragic. But each had irreplaceable blessings. Each made me happy.
Learn Skill: You will see my gratitude expressed in my performance. Thank you.
Confession:
Seliph, Julia...and Julius. Each of my children was forced to endure such hardship due to my cowardice.
I was raised with the warning that any contact I had with the world outside my forest would lead to ruin.
I chose to ignore that warning to be with Lord Sigurd. I wanted to stay with him forever.
Even in another life, even across vast swaths of time...even knowing the consequences, I would do so again.
But I cannot ignore that my choices have caused my children to suffer.
Perhaps, someday, the gates of light will open, and we can be free of the yoke of destiny. I dream of that day...
Special: To protect those I hold dear!
Status: My name has been passed down in legends...? Are you certain?
Oh! Do you ever grow tired of startling others?
What really happened does not always find its way into the histories…
I once lost my memories...and became a puppet to the whims of fate.
I promise to honor the faith you have in me, no matter what.
To simply live with the one you love... Why is even that so difficult?
I am glad to have met you. That is something I can hold onto.

tana4.name: Tana
tana4.title: Soothing Warmth
tana4.description: The princess of Frelia and the álfr of sweet dreams, joining hands with one another at the festival of flames. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones / Heroes.
tana4.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Grants another action to ally with the highest HP that is within 2 spaces, has already acted, and is from the same titles as unit (excluding unit). (Allies with Sing or Dance can be granted this effect as well. If multiple units meet the conditions, effect will not trigger.)
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Tana**: I may be new to this festival, but I intend to compete with the best of them. I'll hold nothing back!
**Peony**: Sumo seems easy enough. If I get pushed, I can just fly away, right? Wait, that's against the rules?
**Peony**: Let's not give up too soon, Tana. If we want to win, we have to be sure to show it!
**Tana**: This outfit's comfortable to move around in, but it's definitely not my usual style.
**Peony**: Tana is doing her best for her family and friends. That's why she has my full support.
Visit: I'm Tana. Peony and I are taking part in the festival of flames over at [F]'s castle.
Level: **Peony**: We earned this victory together!
**Tana**: Attacking head-on isn't the only way to win!
**Tana**: I should have believed in us more...
Summon: This is Tana, and I'm Peony! She and I are here to give it all we've got at this festival of flames!
Learn Skill: **Tana**: I feel ready to learn something new!
Confession:
**Tana**: I have to thank you, Peony. I never would have made it this far without your constant support.
**Peony**: Oh, I just gave you a nudge here and there. You're the one who's done all the hard work!
**Tana**: My brother thought I'd be hopeless at sumo, but I wanted to give it my best effort anyway.
I want to be strong enough to help people, the way he, Eirika, and Ephraim do.
**Peony**: You already are. Look how far we've come! Do you think I would have gotten anywhere without your help?
**Tana**: You're right. I'm glad you're with me, Peony. With you around, dreams really do come true!
Status: This outfit is a bit bold. Seems fine to me.
Conversation: **Tana**: I'm a little winded! Can we take a breather?
**Peony**: Sure! Hey, Tana, don't you think it's great that we're holding our own out here?
**Tana**: Yes. I'm a little surprised that we keep winning our matches.
**Peony**: I know! At first, I wondered if we stood a chance of winning. So many of our opponents are big and strong!
I guess it's true that it takes more than brawn to win a battle.
**Tana**: If we strategize and use our skills effectively, we can even win against people much bigger than we are.
I'm glad I decided to participate. Although, my brother was completely against it.
**Peony**: Oh, you have a brother?
**Tana**: Yes. He's remarkable. And he may be older than I, but I just wish he didn't always treat me like a child.
**Peony**: I bet he's just worried about you. That's how older siblings are.
**Tana**: Oh? Do you have an older brother or sister?
**Peony**: Huh? Well...maybe I do. I don't remember much about my childhood.
I do remember that I had someone very close who was kind to me. Wouldn't it be great if that was my older sister?
**Tana**: Oh, yes! How lovely. It sounds like you did have an older sister. One to take care of you.
That must be why we get along so well. We're both little sisters! It could be why we do so well in the ring.
**Peony**: Maybe so... Thanks, Tana.
**Tana**: Come on! Let's show them what we can do!
Duo Skill: By these hands... It will be decided!
We're going to win! Hear, hear!

lyn8.name: Lyn
lyn8.title: Blazing Whirlwind
lyn8.description: Noblewoman of Caelin whose true name is Lyndis. She joins the festival of flames to represent the Lorca tribe of Sacae. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Whatever I may lack in brute strength, I can make up for with agility. Don't count me out of any match!
We're very familiar with sumo out on the plains. Sometimes we even have a match to settle disputes.
So, Rinkah is representing the Flame Tribe? I'll have to do my best for the Lorca, then. Won't be easy.
I thought Florina might be interested in sumo, after how well she took to being a ninja. I was wrong.
The Flame Tribe can teach us a lot about bravery and strength. They always stand their ground.
Visit: I'm Lyn. I've just come from the festival of flames that's happening at [F]'s castle.
Level: Give it your all, right until the end. That's the key to victory.
Looks like I've hit my stride. Maybe sumo is for me after all!
What a terrible match...
Summon: I'm Lyn. I've been training hard for this festival of flames. I'm here to do the Lorca proud.
Learn Skill: There's a scorching wind blazing at my back. I feel the heat coursing through me. It's invigorating!
Confession:
Phew... They weren't kidding when they called it the festival of flames. Every muscle in my body's on fire.
I have to thank you for the invitation, though. I've learned a lot by being here, [S].
Time and again I've seen that raw strength isn't enough to win. If it were, I'd never have stood a chance.
But I can hold my own with Hector and Eliwood because I've got agility and technique.
Skill on its own isn't enough either, though. If you really want to win, you need heart most of all.
Thanks to you, I've got plenty of that. So next time you're hosting a festival of flames, let me know. I'll be there.
Status: This garb may be suited to this manner of combat, but it's no match for a cold breeze.
The match hasn't started yet! Pushing me now would be unsportsmanlike.
We of the Lorca tribe held competitions similar to sumo. The goal was to determine the strongest among us.
Just because it's a festival, there's no need to be formal. We can cut loose.
I must embody the Flame Tribe's blazing will to fight!
It's too bad Eliwood and Hector aren't participating. I'm sure they would have a great time, too.
I'll spar with you, but don't underestimate me. I get plenty of training in.

rinkah2.name: Rinkah
rinkah2.title: Consuming Flame
rinkah2.description: Daughter of the Flame Tribe chieftain, fueled by a white-hot passion for the festival burning deep within her. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
I couldn't ask for better opponents...
Múspell's passion, Lyn's technique, Mordecai's strength... Even Tana and Peony have impressed me!
Kagero and I practice our sumo skills all the time. The only downside is the crowd that always seems to gather...
Don't forget to visit the festival's food stalls. Your muscles need fuel to be at their best, so eat up!
You up for a match? I always have time to practice, so long as you come at me with everything you have!

To think we could host the festival of flames right here in Askr...
I'm going to do everything in my power to make it a rousing success!
Visit:
You're [S], right?
You should stop by the festival of flames we're holding over at [F]'s castle.
Level: I won't let anyone tarnish the spirit of the Flame Tribe—not now, not ever!
Good. I'm ready for the next round!
Rrgh... It seems my footing needs work...
Summon: I am Rinkah, of the Flame Tribe. We hold the festival of flames to show our strength, and this is no exception.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I look forward to honing my skills with this.
Confession:
The Flame Tribe has traditionally kept outsiders at arm's length. I've found making friends to be...arduous.
But if they are simply competitors, I'll take on as many as I can without a second thought.
After all, if I only ever trained on my own, how could I check how much progress I was making?
Yet, there is also the thrill of facing a powerful opponent and knowing victory will take everything you have.
Needless to say, I like to test myself against others, since it benefits both me and my opponent.
All right, that's enough of chatter. Daylight's burning, and we still need to train until our muscles ache!
Status: I am Rinkah, and I won't be bested in sumo.
Hands off! No shoving until we're in the ring!
Sumo is a time-honored test of mettle for members of the Flame Tribe.
In sumo, it's important to dress lightly so your opponent has less to grab on to. Remember that.
Your grip is too loose! This may be practice, but you'll never win unless you give it your all.
The spirit of the Flame Tribe is always with me, no matter where I go.
Thank you for practicing with me. When I win the tournament, we can split the earnings!

muspell2.name: Múspell
muspell2.title: Raging Inferno
muspell2.description: The god of Múspell, the Kingdom of Flame, has descended upon the festival of flames to put his might on display in the arena of hand-to-hand combat.

Castle Hall: In a contest of strength, that wretch Nifl would stand no chance! I would hurl her off the edge of this world!
You are no more than beasts. You understand that? Fight the hardest, and you live! ...Sounds ideal to me!
