I could get used to clothes like this. Jangling, dangling armor gets in the way. This, however...just right.
Why don't you set that divine weapon of yours aside and fight me with your own two hands, huh?!
Hah! Even if they attacked all together, I will yield to no gaggle of fresh-sprouted weaklings!
Visit:
You're [S]?
I am here to challenge you to a contest of strength, in place of [F]!
Level: Let it be burned into your mind just how the god of flame fights!
Show your face and I'll reduce you to ashes!
What?! Absurd...
Summon: You have some guts to call upon Múspell, the great god of flame. I will light this world ablaze!
Learn Skill: Now this is something I can find a use for!
Confession:
I still have fight left in me. Show me my next opponent already!
I want the beast that remains once you burn away the love, peace, and all that other worthless prattle.
A beast fights or dies. If you do not fight, you cannot survive. A bizarre twist of fate, to be sure!
Rejoice! You are in luck! Life without struggle has no value—fight to create a meaning for your worthless life!
If you refuse to fight, you are already dead.
So, why not show me to my next opponent while you still have life left in you? The festival rolls on!
Status: Haha! Why is every festival not more like this one?!
Huh?! Stick your hand in an open flame, would you?
No guts shall go unspilled!
You dare hold me up against such pathetic mortals?
You will scream and struggle like the beasts you mortals are!
Damn that Nifl. We will settle things here...
Behold! My glory brands your eyes with my image!

mordecai2.name: Mordecai
mordecai2.title: Gentle Firetender
mordecai2.description: A warrior from Gallia who can take the shape of a tiger. He has come to the festival of flames to compete in a contest of raw power. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: The Heroes are very strong. There are many brave beorc and laguz.
War is sad. Fixing things without fighting is much better.
You want to see all of Mordecai's strength? Then Mordecai will not hold back. Come!
Are you not going to try sumo? You should. It feels good to work hard and sweat, [S].
King Caineghis and King Tibarn would be very good at sumo. Challenging opponents for Mordecai!
Visit: Do not be afraid. Mordecai is here to tell you about the festival of flames at [F]'s castle.
Level: Winning is fun. Mordecai is strong!
Are you hurt? I did not mean to get carried away...
I am too hungry for this...
Summon: A festival of strength? And no one will be hurt? Mordecai will enjoy this!
Learn Skill: Mordecai grows more strong each day. Train, train, train!
Confession:
Conflict is bad. People get hurt... people cry. There are no winners.
Sometimes we have to fight. But it always makes me sad.
But this festival is fun! We can fight at full strength, and no worrying.
Losing a match is not a problem. We are all winners anyway. We all get to be happy.
We should make Askr like this all the time, [S].
If you are fighting for that, then you can always count on Mordecai.
Status: Festivals are good. Lots of fun!
You seek a match with Mordecai? Mordecai accepts!
Sumo is not the killing kind of fighting. That is why it is good.
The clothes look good, but are not very warm.
Fighting is hungry work. When do we eat?
Friendly contests are a good way to show strength. Wish we could settle everything this way.
You can always count on Mordecai.

hilda5.name: Hilda
hilda5.title: Helping Hand
hilda5.description: Noble of the Leicester Alliance and daughter of House Goneril. Despite lacking enthusiasm for work, she is willing to lend her aid...sometimes. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: It seems like there are lots of people around ready to fight. Maybe I can just hang back and cheer them on...
Claude works so hard at pushing me and others to be our best. I figured I'd save him the trouble for once.
Hey, what are you up to? I'm hungry. Want to get a bite to eat with me?
I got my hands on materials to make some new fashion accessories. Any requests?
If you knew me a couple years ago, you'd be shocked by how motivated I am now.
Visit:
You're [S], right?
Today's your lucky day! I'm here with a message for you.
Level: Yeah, yeah. I know I'm great.
I'm pretty happy with this.
Aww, just when I was getting excited.
Summon: If you really need my help, I'm willing to put a little work in. Just enough to meet your expectations, obviously.
Learn Skill: With this, I'll be even more useful.
Confession:
You haven't somehow gotten it into your head that I'm a hard worker, have you, [S]?
I'd hate for people around here to get that idea just because I've been doing a little more than usual lately.
I try not to work too hard, because the harder you work, the more people expect from you.
For you, though...I wouldn't mind putting a little more effort in. I'd like to be useful to you.
But that doesn't mean you get to expect it of me all the time, OK? You have to promise!
Special: Want to see what I've got?
Status: Do you want me to cheer you on?
Hey! Cut it out!
Ohh! You have an interest in fashion? Come and have a little chat with me!
I may be a delicate flower, but when I need to, I can get things done.
I suppose I should train a little every now and then!
Hm... What will I do if Holst shows up?
So, are you going to say you want me to protect you now?

lif3.name: Líf
lif3.title: Arcane Blade
lif3.description: Swordsman of the realm of the dead, now wielding a weapon imbued with magic, having made a contract with the god Thórr.

Castle Hall: I have made a contract with the higher powers. The day may come when we are again enemies—soon.
Are Queen Henriette and Sharena... safe here, in this world?
Something about Princess Eir has changed. Some ordeal has spurred her growth.
The dead weep for no one—neither do they smile or laugh. Those are for the living alone.
Éljúðnir is a weapon of death...and of Hel, who ruled death's realm.
Visit: I am Líf. Once my task is complete, I will depart.
Level: I require strength enough to bring low the higher powers.
This blade trembles, aching to spread death's reach...
You have seen what weakness yet remains...
Summon: I am Líf. I seek the power to slay the gods I have been made to serve.
Learn Skill: Well, [S]...
Confession:
Éljúðnir is an arcane weapon once in the possession of Hel, the ruler of the dead.
...Hel, who took everything from me.
I will not hesitate to take what was Hel's to use for my own purposes.
There is someone I must defeat. I will use any means at my disposal to reach that end.
Alfonse...is not so different in that regard. And in the coming battles, he will not have the luxury of avoiding it.
Should you desire, you may consider the power of Éljúðnir to be at your disposal, for now.
As I am, that is all I am able to promise you.
Status: I am Líf. I have been granted power by Ganglöt, who rules the dead.
Cease your foolishness. I am in no mood.
I should not be here. My aims lie elsewhere.
Many here recognize me and smile, but...I feel nothing.
No matter who rules the realm of the dead, it is unchanging.
My wish is that you find happiness in this world.
Are you trying yet again to give me hope?

mshez.name: Shez
mshez.title: Rising Mercenary
mshez.description: A mercenary who wandered Fódlan. Though ordinarily rational, a burning desire sleeps within him. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: Still not sure what a mercenary like me is doing here, but hey—I'm up for any opportunity to get stronger.
The mercenary group I belonged to got wiped out not long ago. Honestly, I was overwhelmed by that defeat.
I'm good at fighting on the front lines, but you seem like you've got a good eye for tactics. I'm counting on you.
Hey, I've been having strange dreams lately. Know any weirdos who might have an idea about this kind of stuff?
The food here is incredible. Do you think I could get someone to cook for us next time we're on a mission?
Visit:
You [S]?
I was sent over here to say hi, on [F]'s request.
Level: I'm getting stronger!
Yeah, not bad.
Wait, that's it?!
Summon: I'm Shez. A mercenary. Now that you've hired me, I'll do the job I'm paid for. So, who are we fighting?
Learn Skill: This'll help me break new boundaries.
Confession:
Feels like I've been here awhile now, somehow or other...
Oh, don't get me wrong—it's not like I hate it here or anything. I'm grateful for this chance to get stronger.
And of course, I've enjoyed working with you. Enough that I'd be happy to stick around for as long as you want.
But...someday, I'm going to go back to Fódlan. There's this voice in my head telling me I have to.
When I do, that'll be goodbye. But until then, I'll use my blade to cut a path for you. That's my job, after all.
Status: Swordsmanship? Mostly self-taught. There's nobody I could point to and say, "that's my teacher."
*yelp* Is poking people what you consider a good time?
On the battlefield, you have to keep moving. Stop and you pin a target on your back.
This? It's a Merc Whistle. We use it to find each other on the battlefield. Can't get by without it.
I don't know where I was born or who my parents are. I've been alone a long time.
I should probably get some sleep while I can...
Just remember, I've got your back. So stay in the thick of things!

fshez.name: Shez
fshez.title: Keen Mercenary
fshez.description: A mercenary who wandered Fódlan. Though ordinarily rational, a burning desire sleeps within her. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: To be honest, I'm still not sure why you summoned me here. I'm just a run-of-the-mill merc... Well, mostly.
Fódlan had plenty of mercenary work to go around, but it was nothing compared to the constant war here.
I've given orders before, but I get the feeling you're better at it than me. So, feel free to send me to the front lines.
Hey, are you busy right now? I'm practicing a new technique and could really use some help.
I'm not great at sitting still. Unfamiliar places just make me want to wander around, but I always seem to get lost.
Visit:
I've come to deliver a message from [F].
Wow, it sure is lively around here.
Level: I'm getting stronger!
Yeah, not bad.
Wait, that's it?!
Summon: I'm Shez. A mercenary. I'll win no matter who I'm up against, but only after we sort out contract terms.
Learn Skill: Hey, a new power! All right...
Confession:
Out of curiosity, do you know when our contract will end? Not that I'm unhappy with it, or anything...
It's just... I know I can't keep fighting as a mercenary forever. And when that time comes, what happens?
Will we wrap up the contract and go our separate ways like a couple of strangers? Maybe that's for the best.
At least that would mean I could listen to the little voice in my head saying I need to get back to Fódlan.
No point worrying about that now, though. Seems like there's still plenty to do around here.
So until that day does come, I'll keep offering my blade to your cause. That's my job, after all.
Status: Other than fighting, my mom taught me everything I know.
Woah, there! You were about to get a face-full of counterattack!
No matter where you go, always keep a weapon at the ready.
This? It's a Merc Whistle. We use it to find each other on the battlefield. Can't get by without it.
I look like I was raised in the mountains? I was...but how can you tell?
Can't take my eyes off the map...
If the enemy comes, call for me. I'm always ready to head into battle.

monica.name: Monica
monica.title: Favored Vassal
monica.description: Noble of the Adrestian Empire and daughter of Baron Ochs. Endlessly faithful to Edelgard. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: There could be no greater Hero than Lady Edelgard. If it will help me serve her better, I am happy to be here.
What are you all fighting for? To me, war is nothing more than a means to an end—supporting Her Majesty.

The sooner I can return to the Empire, the better...
Oh, but I couldn't possibly show my face to Her Majesty without first finding some souvenirs for her!
I suspect I have my keen eyesight to thank, but I am actually quite adept at hunting. Care to join me sometime?
I never forget what I've read, so I'm gathering books from Askr. I'm sure they will prove useful at some point.
Visit:
Ah, you must be [S].
In that case, I was asked to pass on a few words to you from your friend [F]. Verbatim.
Level: Now I can be even more useful!
Well, would you look at that?
I won't let this stand in the way of my love...
Summon: I'm Monica von Ochs, eldest daughter of the Adrestian Empire's Baron Ochs. Now, where is Her Majesty?
Learn Skill: I'll surely put this to good use.
Confession:
Tell me... Have you ever had a brush with death? I have, though that's not the part of the memory that pains me.
It was the trouble I caused her. I was kidnapped, and I knew I would soon be killed. But then she came for me.
Lady Edelgard rescued me, despite the risk of it costing everything—her country, her people...even her life.
No matter what happens to me, I will never allow that to happen again.
And so... I pray that all of the battles we've fought together may one day be in service of Her Majesty.
Special: I'll fight with everything I have!
I will give it my all!
Status: When I think about Her Majesty... It's so inspiring.
Yes, your majesty? *pause* Oh, my mistake...
Should I prepare some tea and sweets?
If something is weighing you down, a good night's sleep will do the trick.
Oh, I'm just a minor noble. There's no need to mind your manners around me.
As long as Hubert does his job, everything should be all right...
Your words... know that I remember each and every one of them.

holst.name: Holst
holst.title: Hero of Leicester
holst.description: Noble of the Leicester Alliance and son of House Goneril. Unmatched in combat, but still prone to doting on his sister, Hilda. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: They say all kinds of things about me in the Leicester Alliance, but there are plenty of folks as strong as I am.
The truth is, I am rather frustrated to be here. The flames of war spread across Fódlan. Hilda needs me!
You need training. I can protect you while I'm here, but you need to be able to defend yourself when I'm not.
Got any enemy encampments you need scouted? I can handle it! I'll just take out all the enemies myself.
Poring over some strategies, I see. These tactical treatises look much different than the ones in Fódlan.
Visit: My name is Holst! I have arrived with a message for you. It is from your friend [F]. Here!
Level: That was a valuable experience.
There's always room for improvement.
That could've gone better...
Summon: Hilda?! I—oh. Hello. I'm not sure what is going on here, but let me introduce myself. I am Holst Sigiswald Goneril.
Learn Skill: This power will help me soar!
Confession:
I've noticed you taking the time to train lately. I've been very impressed with what I've seen.
A well-honed body leads to a sharp mind and a healthy spirit, as I'm sure you would agree.
No doubt overseeing all these Heroes in the field is a demanding task. The burden on you must be immense.
Now that I've seen what you've got, though...I'm not worried.
I know you can handle it.
Even so, if you ever need a hand, feel free to lean on me. I'll be right here, ready and willing to help you out!
Status: There's no weapon I can't handle, but a sword does feel best.
Huh? ...If you can sneak up on me, you aren't half bad.
Nothing fires me up like a fight with a strong opponent!
There's no better teacher than fighting in a real battle. Don't you think?
I love to cook with mushrooms. Why don't you let me make you dinner?
Hilda... *sigh* I worry about her.
If you need to borrow my strength, it is yours.

ninian4.name: Ninian
ninian4.title: Ice-Dragon Oracle
ninian4.description: An ice dragon in human form, who lost her life at the hands of the man she loved. Resurrected, she now lives alongside mortals. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Elibe was once home to dragons, but we have long since abandoned it. It is now claimed by humankind.
We knew that it was forbidden, and yet we answered Nergal's call and opened the gate...to see home again.
Stay strong. No matter what happens, trust yourself to overcome. That is how I made it through hard times.
My power may be diminished, and I may age and die as humans do, but I have no regrets. In fact, I'm happy.
If we can realize Lord Athos's vision of utopia here, then perhaps humans and dragons can finally live in peace.
Visit: Oh—please, pay me no mind. I don't think I'm really all that good at talking to people...
Level: A saving light shall rise...
Forgive me...
This world will once again be enveloped by darkness...
Summon: I am Ninian. I have a vision of a better world—one in which humans and dragons prosper together in harmony.
Learn Skill: Thank you for your kindness.
Confession:
A question, if I may. Have you ever heard of Lord Athos, the Archsage of Elibe, [S]?
He believed that humans and dragons would one day live together in harmony and understanding.
His vision was called Arcadia. For a long time, a utopia like that seemed like it might be forever out of reach.
But I have seen the seeds of such a paradise planted, in Elibe and in Askr. It pleases me to watch them grow.
Perhaps it will take centuries. Maybe you and I will have long been scattered to the winds by then.
Nils will still be here, though. And I'd like my brother to see a world where both humans and dragons are happy.
Status: Take this strength.
I'll watch over you.
My name is Ninian. I'm a type of being known as a dragon... Have you met many of us?
My wish is that our world will one day become a place where humans and dragons can live together. A true utopia...
Oh, hello! I was just practicing, but if you need something, I'd be glad to help.
Even if my lifespan is that of a human's... Well, I'm all right with that.
I'll support you in battle. All I ask in return is that you allow me to stay by your side.

duma2.name: Duma
duma2.title: Strength and Love
duma2.description: The God of Strength and Goddess of Love who once divided Valentia between them now join in Askr's harvest festival together. They appear in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.
duma2.duo:
Neutralizes any【Penalty】, restores 30 HP, and grants "neutralizes foe's bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat" for 1 turn to unit and allies within 5 rows and 5 columns centered on unit.
【Penalty】 All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).

Castle Hall: **Duma**: We offer our blessings unto humanity. Mila, her compassion and wisdom; I, my strength and protection.
**Mila**: Seeing all of these smiles reminds me of the paradise I once envisioned for my people. Isn't it lovely, Brother?
**Duma**: These humans are all so sickeningly carefree... If this is truly what human wisdom inspires, it should be feared.
**Duma**: You want this candy? Then show me your strength, and hold nothing ba— Mila, wait! You can't just give it away!
**Mila**: We must treat those who worship us equally. May every soul find one of these delicious candies in their palm!
Visit: May this castle be safeguarded by my strength and Mila's love, and the land awaken to the harvest's blessings!
Level: **Duma**: Very good! As arbiters of this festival, we shall offer up a prayer for unlimited blessings and unending struggle!
**Duma**: To trick, or to treat...but to whom, and for what reason? The human mind is as inscrutable as ever.
**Mila**: Brother... You must not let humans continue to think might makes right. The gift of love is for one and all.
Summon: Let praise ring out across the land for Duma's strength and Mila's love! We shall answer the harvest festival's call.
Learn Skill: **Mila**: Excessive displays of emotion can be dangerous for dragons, so my brother and I typically refrain from them.
Confession:
**Duma**: The harvest is a blessing that sustains life. Surely this festival is meant to extol you and you alone, Sister?
**Mila**: Are you regretting my invitation? You never did have patience for humans who enjoyed anything other than war.
**Duma**: If you speak of Rigel and Zofia, then that is in the past. We have already entrusted Valentia to its heroes.
**Mila**: Indeed, and so it shall be. They are, after all, the ones who corrected our courses when we went astray.
**Duma**: Yet my ideals remain unchanged: war was, is, and always will be necessary for humans to mete out true justice.
**Mila**: As do mine: love was, is, and always will be necessary for gods to bless and guide the people from on high.
**Duma**: And humans must find a place for themselves somewhere in between. Until then...let us enjoy the harvest.
Status: "To think a day would come when we could enjoy ourselves like this..." "Indeed, it is truly a wonder."
Conversation: **Mila**: I must say, dear brother...you wear that costume well!
**Duma**: Ugh. Why must we debase ourselves? It only diminishes our godly authority.
**Mila**: Haha. We are in a different world. To these people, who know us not, we pass as human revelers.
**Duma**: So it is reverence they lack... Tell me, Mila. If not gods, who do the humans honor with their harvest festival?
**Mila**: From what I can tell, it is not held to honor anyone specific, but rather to give thanks to the land for its bounty.
**Duma**: In that case, what possible reason could there be for wearing these ridiculous outfits?
**Mila**: We will have to find that out together. The human mind never fails to conjure up the most curious of ideas.
Does it not excite you to wear something different for once? I find this all to be rather invigorating.
I was once bored with life, unable to find any stimulus that could stir even the faintest feelings in my heart.
This costume and festival, though... They are like a breath of fresh air that reminds me of the joy of being alive.
**Duma**: Absurd. The hearts of gods must not be so fickle as to be swayed by mere festivals such as this. And yet...
**Mila**: And yet?
**Duma**: My mind must be starting to go, for I find myself unable to deny that your enjoyment of this silliness pleases me.
**Mila**: Duma...
**Duma**: As you have observed, today we join this festival in the attire of ordinary revelers. Thus, let us act accordingly.
Take my hand, Sister. These humans will be hard-pressed to tell us apart from any other merry pair.
**Mila**: I would like that very much, Brother.

fcorrin7.name: Corrin
fcorrin7.title: Starry Seer
fcorrin7.description: A woman caught between Nohr and Hoshido who overcame an uncertain destiny. She wants to bring smiles that shine as brightly as the stars in the night sky. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I'm told this is the garb of a witch who flies through the sky at night. Sounds like a Nohrian to me.
Costumes are so interesting. Wearing one lets you become a completely different person for a while.
I like the idea of Nohr and Hoshido celebrating each other's fashions. It fosters mutual understanding.
I have plenty of sweets. Would you like one? OK, open wide—here comes the candy broom!
See these bats? I trapped them in webs. That's what happens when you try to trick me!
Visit: Want to join us for a harvest festival celebration? Get your costume and come to [F]'s!
Level: Are you enjoying this harvest festival as much as I am?
I won't stand for anyone getting in the way of others' dreams!
Oh no... I dropped the whole bag of candy...
Summon: I'm Corrin. Leave it to me to light up this festival like a twinkling starry sky!
Learn Skill: Festivals are the best! Thank you!
Confession:
Hi there! Nice to see you! Are you having a good time at tonight's festivities, [S]?
Get this—I asked my siblings what they thought my costume was meant to be, and they all said "Nohr Noble."
Silly, right? It's got pumpkins and a broom and everything. I mean, I guess the colors are a bit Nohrian, but...
It got me thinking. It's interesting how people are drawn to what they know, even when they're far from home.
That could explain why we see some of the same things over and over again. Conflict, for example.
Sorry, I don't mean to be a downer. Enjoying the harvest festival is what matters now—let's get back to that!
Status: Trick or treat! I'm dressed like a witch today.
*surprise sound* Was that a trick? I'll give you a treat—just don't do that again.
Believe it or not, I've been to a similar festival in my own world.
After everyone collects heaps of candy, we all get together and enjoy the spoils, right? I can't wait!
I can give my siblings treats, but only after they play a trick on me, right?
If I were a real witch, I could probably help a lot of people.
You need a costume. Let's see... I know! How about an adorable wolf?

naga2.name: Naga
naga2.title: Harvest Divinity
naga2.description: Ruler of the Divine Dragons descended from on high to visit the harvest-festival revelers. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem and Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I am Naga. We are Naga. We exist as others wish to see. To that end, I now appear as the queen of ghosts.
Those who carry my blood are my eyes, my shields, and my weapons. Yet, this world seems to be unique...
Did you give some candy to the little ones and receive some in turn? Then let us be thankful for your harvest.
I am about to check on the little ones. Would you like to join me? Here—a mask, so that you may look the part.
You must not turn away little ones seeking harvest treats. If you do, the queen of ghosts will be very angry...
Visit: I trust you will treat the little ones well. If not, Naga's flames—er, the queen of ghosts' curse will find you...
Level: All right, all together now, everyone: "trick or treat!"
Some little ones are threatening to play tricks just to get extra treats. I cannot abide such naughty behavior.
As the queen of ghosts, I find myself lacking in blessings. I feel nothing...
Summon: Rowdy celebrants of the harvest festival, hearken to me, for I am Naga. No...tonight I am the queen of ghosts!
Learn Skill: I am familiar with human customs. Let me see... You intend to express hospitality with this offering, yes?
Confession:
BOO! Heehee, did I scare you? Festivals are a curious tradition, and these outfits most curious of all.
It is not often that I must ask for what I desire. Truly, it is a most peculiar feeling.
With that said... Trick, or treat? Will you choose to indulge me, or suffer my wrath?
Know this: mere candy will not suffice. As ruler of both dragons and ghosts, I expect much more.
It must befit one of my position. Oh, and need I remind you, trifling with a dragon is akin to playing with fire...
Status: Was it you who invited me to the harvest festival?
Ahh! So, that is considered a trick then?
I thank you for treating me and sharing these sweets.
I sense the presence of a dragon at this festival, one not unlike myself...
A costume? I've never donned such clothing before. Does it look strange?
May the people always feel gratitude for these earthly blessings.
You always find a way to share your own outlook.

mcorrin6.name: Corrin
mcorrin6.title: Celestial Sorcerer
mcorrin6.description: A man caught between Nohr and Hoshido who overcame an uncertain destiny. He wants to bring smiles that shine as brightly as the stars in the night sky. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: People from Hoshido might mistake me for a mage from Nohr. What do you think, [S]?
Wearing a costume is an interesting experience. You get to become an entirely different person for a while.
I like the idea of Nohr and Hoshido celebrating one another's fashions. It helps us understand each other.
I've got a whole bag full of sweets. Would you like one? OK, open wide— here comes the candy broom!
See these bats? I trapped them in webs. That's what happens when you try to trick me!
Visit: We're celebrating the harvest festival! Want to join? Get your costume and come to [F]'s!
Level: Are you enjoying this harvest festival as much as I am?
I won't stand for anyone trying to get treats without tricks!
Oh no, I'm all out of sweets. Don't worry, though—I'll restock later for you, I promise!
Summon: I'm Corrin, and I've brought plenty of sweets for all these festivalgoers!
Learn Skill: Oh, thanks! What a great gift to celebrate the festival.
Confession:
Hey, good to see you! Are you enjoying the evening's festivities, [S]? Good.
My siblings have all been very curious about my costume. They all thought I was supposed to be a Dark Mage!
Not exactly what I was going for, but it makes sense. The look does have a Nohrian feel to it.
It's interesting how people are drawn to the familiar, even when they're in another world, don't you think?
It makes me wonder if some human tendencies are just inescapable. Like conflict, for example.
Ah, sorry. I don't mean to bring down the mood. Let's focus on what matters: enjoying the harvest festival!
Status: Is this how wizards really dress? I love the hat!
Whoa! You're good at playing tricks too, huh?
There's so much variety in these costumes. Wait... What's that one supposed to be?
Look at all the masks on display. That pumpkin one's great! I considered it myself.
Ooh, sorry, I'm fresh out of treats. All my brothers and sisters…
If I were a real wizard, do you think I could find a way for all of my siblings to be together?
I cannot wait to see your costume. Hang on… You're not planning on wearing one?

nils2.name: Nils
nils2.title: Wandering Star
nils2.description: A bard whose travels take him between the worlds of dragons and humans, known to vanish as quickly as he is revealed. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: This world is amazing, Ninian. It's full of mystery and potential. You can really feel a sense of hope here.
Nothing quite like a festival, is there? Everyone's up so late celebrating, so it feels like the day will last forever.
You look like you could use a nap. Go catch some winks—I'll wake you when something interesting happens.
I've got to tell you, I'm having a great time. There's a spring in my step, [S]. I can feel it!
Have you seen that weird lady acting like she's queen of the ghosts or something? Wait, what? She's who?!
Visit: Happy harvest festival! Want to come join me for the parade over at [F]'s castle?
Level: I knew it'd be fine. Now, let's get back to some festival fun!
Trick or treat! I'm coming for all the candy!
Ha! Haha... This is a joke, right?
Summon: Hi! I'm Nils. Now I say "trick or treat," and you give me something nice, right? That's how this goes?
Learn Skill: If this is your idea of a treat, I'm sure not complaining!
Confession:
Being a bard has taught me a lot. I've been to all sorts of places, and met all kinds of interesting people.
Some of those people were bad, but just as many were great. I've seen so much honesty, bravery, and kindness.
I like to show my appreciation for people with music, so I'm thinking of putting on a little concert here.
Commander Anna agrees that the festival's perfect for it, so she's going to get an audience together for me.
Maybe my flute music isn't as useful as what my sister can do, but I want to do something for my new friends.
That means you! So come to the castle courtyard with me and enjoy the tunes, OK? Let's go!
Status: Let's find some treats!
Rouse your spirits!
I'd say this choice of outfit is delicious!
I'm pretty good with the flute. I bet I could liven things up with a tune or two!
I can't wait to go around the festival with Ninian. It's going to be so much fun!
I wonder if humans and dragons will ever celebrate together like this in my world...
The candy you gave me is so pretty, it's almost a shame to eat it. Almost!

eir3.name: Eir
eir3.title: Life Ascendant
eir3.description: Princess of the realm of life, raised in Hel, the realm of the dead, as daughter and heir to its ruler.

Castle Hall: I am finally able to appreciate the radiance of this world fully.
Each day with the Order of Heroes is filled with delightful surprises. The time seems to pass so quickly...
Your duties must be exhausting. If there is anything I can do to help, please say the word.
I trust in Líf. I suppose it is because, in the realm of the dead... Well, in short, he understands my past.
Ymir's power has filled me with new warmth and life.
Visit: I am Eir, blessed with renewed life. To see me so was the wish of your friend [F].
Level: This body is full of life.
I am pleased with my progress.
Life is not without its challenges...
Summon: I am Eir, blessed now with the power of Ymir, the dragon of life.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will strive to become worthy of the faith you have placed in me.
Confession:
Ymir told me what my life was like when I was very young. I still find it difficult to believe.
I do have some early memories of my mother, however. Those can never be wiped away.
Even if much of what has happened in the time since has been painful...
Ymir says that all will be well. That we can make new happy memories together.
What do you think? Do you feel the same way, [S]?
Ah. Yes, that is true.
One day I will restore the realm of life to its former glory. I hope, when that day arrives, you will come to visit.
Special: There is too much at stake.
Status: I am Eir. I have been...changed. It is as yet beyond me…
You are always up to mischief...
All I know of my true home, I learned from Ymir.
I cannot say that life in the realm of the dead was pleasant. But, even so…
My mother in Hel and my true mother… They both have a place in my heart.
Someday... If only I could return to the realm of life...
Being near you fills me with the courage I need to go on living.

frobin6.name: Robin
frobin6.title: Fell Tactician
frobin6.description: A host for the soul of Grima, the Fell Dragon, bent on using her newfound power to sink the world further into despair. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: This arcane mark on my hand is now a part of me. Perhaps this is what despair made manifest looks like...
The future of this world is drenched in despair. It is only natural that all vanity would return to nothingness.
You would do well to remember your place. The moment I tire of you may well be your last.
If you wish someone destroyed, do not hesitate. Swallow your sorrow and end their miserable existence.

Do you know what the most powerful weapon is? One that deadens hearts and smothers all hope?
It is fear, and it cuts far deeper than any blade.
Visit: I am Robin, vessel of the Fell Dragon. Speak carefully. The fate of your friend rests in the palm of my hand.
Level: Allow me to fulfill your destiny. I will eradicate you from this world so that not a single trace remains.
The only response to a worm is to squash it. They do not deserve even a single drop of sentimentality.
This is...slightly unpleasant.
Summon: This "Robin" is merely a vessel. When your world is laid waste, you will rue my true name: Grima, the Fell Dragon.
Learn Skill: Give all unto the Fell Dragon. That is your one and only choice.
Confession:
Why was I given this power? To what end will I use it? You need not concern yourself with such matters.
After all, a worm like you is only capable of the most instinctual of reactions: fear. It is inevitable.
In the face of absolute power, what could you feel in the depths of your heart but total helplessness?
Did you consider this might happen when summoning me? Or did you hope that I would simply submit?
Let me be clear: you have no hope of controlling me. And yet, all is not lost for you. Not yet.
Vow to support my cause, and I may allow you to harness my strength. The choice is yours...
Special: I will tear you to shreds.
Status: Now that this new power is mine, none in this land can stand against me.
Hm?! Shall I teach you the meaning of fear?
I fear no human. After all, do you fear the worms beneath your feet?
These clothes are tasteful. I like them.
Devote yourself to me entirely. Only then will I consider lending you my power.
It matters not how much power I obtain... This emptiness in my heart will not be filled.
You still smile at me... Utterly incorrigible.

gregor.name: Gregor
gregor.title: Swell Sword
gregor.description: A likable merc who has set foot on many distant lands. The years of experience have hardened him, and his age has begun to show. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Your commander is Anna, yes? She yell at Gregor. Say, "no sleeping here!" Strong woman not so bad!
Gregor has been to many lands as mercenary. Job don't matter, but Gregor won't beat up weak ones.
You are looking tired. You should make tea with herbs and rest. Too tired, maybe is dying in battle!
Why not take Gregor somewhere fun? Gregor want to see some beauties! Give energy for the fighting.
Ow! Crick in Gregor's back. Grrr... When did this happen? In battle before?
Visit:
Your friend [F] say hello!
Nothing better than friends.
Level: What is this? Gregor's biceps tingling!
Hmm... Gregor have crick in back tomorrow.
Oh dear. Gregor not make good impression.
Summon: Gregor wandering mercenary. This very fancy place you got here! Gregor's fee going to be very high.
Learn Skill: Getting stronger! Thank you. Ready to work hard now!
Confession:
Talking to Gregor? You must be very lonely. Come! Gregor give you big, big bear hug!
Not lonely? But you are always coming to visit! Gregor thinking you fall for him, maybe.
Why staring? So cold! Gregor only tell truth, my friend! You are hurting feelings.
Is wonderful you spend so much time with Gregor. So many Heroes here, and you picking this one!
You can count on Gregor in battle— always. You staying strong in battle too. Always will be watching out!
Special: No want to get along, eh?
Status: You want Gregor notice you? No little tapping. Speak with big voice! Hah!
You get it wrong. Gregor not old man. Gregor young and so strong! Young!
Is Gregor really so scary? Really? Hmph.
Before, Gregor just mercenary. Now, Gregor "Hero!" Hah!
Lately Gregor work for free too much! Gregor is poor, like beggar.
Gregor need less-dangerous contract. Is crazy, this war!
You are very lucky! Why? Is not obvious? You summon stallion like Gregor! Hah!

ricken.name: Ricken
ricken.title: Shepherd Novice
ricken.description: A mage who joined the Shepherds as an apprentice in hopes of learning all he's able from his mentor, Chrom. Young, but a hard worker. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Chrom saved my life. I want to repay that debt by becoming just like him.
My family's an old and noble one, but we've fallen on hard times. I hope I'll be able to rectify that.
I've taken notes on all of Chrom's battles. I'm sure they'll come in handy when I give him counsel.
I was only a novice when I joined the Shepherds to follow Chrom. Here in Askr, I'm aiming to be so much more!
Don't ask me to sit by while my friends, my family, and my country are in danger.
Visit: Hello! I'm Ricken. I brought you a gift, courtesy of [F].
Level: I'll protect everyone from now on!
EWWW! Leggo! No noogies!
Hrmm...
Summon: I'm Ricken. I'm a practiced mage— and before you ask, yes, I'm old enough to fight.
Learn Skill: This is for me?! Thank you so much! I won't let you down!
Confession:
Hey, do you think there's anything more I can do to be useful around here, [S]?
Being useful to people is important to me. That's why I trained so hard back in Ylisse, so I could help Chrom.
One thing I noticed pretty quickly, though...training and combat aren't even close to the same thing.
I'll admit that when I think about fighting actual people who actually want to kill me, my hands still shake.
I can't shy away from that, though. There are people I want to protect, and to do that, I have to fight.
So, I've resolved to make myself useful—not just to Chrom, but to you and Askr too.
Status: I'm Ricken! I'll show you my skill with magic!
What? I'm not playing tag with you.
All Chrom does is treat me like a child.
Am I lonely being so far from my family? Hm... Maybe a little.
My dream is to become Chrom's right-hand man and most trusted ally.
Boy, do I need to grow up in a hurry...
I'll grow to be someone you can trust to protect you. Just wait and see!

phila.name: Phila
phila.title: Pegasus Master
phila.description: Leader of Ylisse's pegasus knights. She pours everything she has into training the future generation of pegasus knights. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Exalt Emmeryn... On my honor as a pegasus knight of Ylisse, I will protect you this time. I swear it.
To serve the exalt is my purpose. To serve Emmeryn and her predecessor has been my honor.
Morale in the Order of Heroes is admirably high. An impressive organization indeed.
Sumia may yet be a novice, but her potential is vast. I intend to assist her in realizing it to the fullest.
Cordelia's tenacity is second to none, and her skill as a pegasus knight approaches perfection.
Visit: Greetings from the sky above. I am Phila—a pegasus knight serving under [F]'s command.
Level: My knight-sisters are with me in spirit, wherever I go.
I must always be on guard. An attack could come at any time.
Forgive me, Exalt Emmeryn...
Summon: I am Phila, commander of Ylisse's pegasus knights. I will do all I can to keep the exalt safe from harm.
Learn Skill: I appreciate your support. I will make good use of it—have no fear.
Confession:
It is thanks to the many brave knights who came before me that I have the privilege of soaring through the sky.
In the same way, it is my duty to pass my skills on to the next generation of those who would mount a pegasus.
That is not to say I am contemplating retirement. I have no plans of going anywhere, [S].
On the contrary, I intend to make the most of my time for as long as I can, just as my predecessors before me.
I believe I owe that to all those whose lives were tragically cut short on the field of battle.
When I am gone, I hope that Askr will remember me as one who lived each moment to its fullest.
Status: My name is Phila. I am the commander of Ylisse's pegasus knights.
Oh! Rather cowardly to ambush me, would you not agree?
Exalt Emmeryn, Prince Chrom, and Princess Lissa are all quite fond of one another. It gladdens me.
Cordelia has exceptional natural talent. I look forward to seeing her develop.
It is our duty to protect the exalt with our lives.
The spirit of the pegasus knights is with me, wherever I go.
Something about you is reminiscent of Exalt Emmeryn. I am happy to be by your side.

cervantes.name: Cervantes
cervantes.title: Invincible General
cervantes.description: A general backing the Valmese Empire's war effort, having not lost a single battle since deciding to let his whiskers go unshaven. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: The name Walhart is synonymous with conquest. You must peer into his soul if you wish to keep pace!
There is no shortage of whiskered warriors in Askr, it would seem. My competition is fierce.
My journey to another world has in no way diminished my need to maintain a strict grooming routine.
So long as I remain unshorn, I am invincible. If my foes wish to defeat me, they shall have to shave me first!
My hairs stand on end—every one of them! This beard shows my constant readiness for battle.
Visit: I, Cervantes—the unparalleled, the undefeated, the unshaven—am now in [F]'s service.
Level: You stand before an undefeated and invincible general. Go on—bask in the glory of these whiskers!
I've not shaved since my very first battle. And have I ever lost? No! Not even once!
Hm? What could this portend?
Summon: I am General Cervantes of Valm. My foes shall buckle before me like a flimsy belt around the waist of defeat!
Learn Skill: Do you see these whiskers? Look closely! They are jumping for joy!
Confession:
I once had dreams of commanding a nation myself... But Walhart? Aye, he dreams bigger.
He would rule the entire world! Mine is nothing compared to the moxie of the Conqueror.
I am but a single hair on the beard of a flea in his great moustache! So, why did I follow him? Why indeed...
I wanted to taste the thrill of being part of something bigger than myself. The Order of Heroes is similar.
If true heroes from worlds apart join together as one, there is nothing they cannot accomplish.
Thus, my whiskers and I remain at your disposal. Let us see how far we can go together!
Status: You think you can beat me—General Cervantes, the unparalleled? The undefeated? The unshaven?!
Are you trying to touch these whiskers? I cannot say I blame you.
Walhart shall become king of all the world!
Since my very first proper battle, I have been unshorn.
We will show them the meaning of fear. Not beard, you fool. FEAR!
I shall follow Walhart to the ends of the earth.
Let us face one another, as equals, as human beings! Let me peer into your soul!

arval.name: Arval
arval.title: Cycle Keeper
arval.description: A mysterious being who exists on the edge of dreams and reality. Fond of offering advice and intent on providing guidance. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: Once upon a time, I wished to save the world. I never aspired to anything as grand as being a "Hero," though...

I've had friends and compatriots who fought alongside me, but...none of them ever truly understood me.
In that sense, I suppose I've always been alone.
Looks like someone's working hard again today. Don't worry, I'm certain all your efforts will pay off one day.
Care to join me for a stroll outside? It's a beautiful day, so I'm sure it'll be quite pleasant.
Ow... Heh, looks like I'm still not used to all the bumps and bruises that come with having this body.
Visit:
You must be [S].
Here, a message for you from [F].
Level: So this is what I'm capable of...
I'm stronger now! How lovely.
That was a bit... How do I put this? Bad.
Summon:
My name is... No, actually, forget it.
Regardless, I am a being who exists on the edge of dreams and reality. You may call me Arval.
Learn Skill: For me? Heh, guess this means I'll have to rise to the occasion.
Confession:
Summoning Heroes, military affairs, daily chores... You sure are a hard worker, [S].
I wish a certain someone would learn a thing or two from you.
Being able to feel the breeze like this is nice, and the view is nothing to scoff at either.
From the merchants in the market to the children playing in the plaza, I can see the whole town from here.
When I see you working so hard to protect all of them, it... It's like my heart begins to ache terribly.
I have already perished twice. I am outside the cycle.
To put it simply, I'm something like a remnant. Still, even I have my uses.
If you would permit it, I would like to continue fighting alongside you.
Perhaps the two of us can create a future where people live in peace, without fear of gods or devils.
Status: It is strange for me to take form in this way.
Heh. You never fail to pique my interest.
History will always be written by the victors...
My partner in destiny. We fight together... We live together... Truly irreplaceable.
What is your home like? Tell me everything.
Summoning Heroes from other worlds, and using them to fight your battles for you... How efficient.
Thanks to you, my time here has been well spent.

laegjarn5.name: Laegjarn
laegjarn5.title: Flame and Frost
laegjarn5.description: Princess Laegjarn of Múspell and Princess Fjorm of Nifl, of the Kingdoms of Flame and Ice, unite to participate in the ninja festival.
laegjarn5.duo: Grants unit another action. (May be used only if unit has already entered combat during the current turn.)

Castle Hall: **Fjorm**: Ylgr is also curious about the ninja festival. It seems ninja are as popular with children as they are with adults!
**Fjorm**: The Kingdoms of Flame and Ice may seem at odds, but I believe Princess Laegjarn and I can still be friends.
**Laegjarn**: I have come to learn the importance of allies. With them, even the most challenging goals can be achieved.
**Laegjarn**: I hear some ninja techniques require the use of flames. I ought to be particularly well-suited to those.
**Laegjarn**: Are these extravagant outfits not rather counterproductive to a ninja's goal of blending in?
Visit: I am Laegjarn. Princess Fjorm and I are participating in a ninja festival at [F]'s castle.
Level: **Fjorm**: Have we done it, Princess Laegjarn? Have we finally mastered the Sparkling Shuriken?
**Laegjarn**: Mission accomplished. I suppose I could get used to this.
**Fjorm**: Oh no! Have we been spotted?!
Summon: Ninja Fjorm, reporting for duty! Princess Laegjarn is here too— go on, ninja partner! Say hi!
Learn Skill: **Laegjarn**: It would seem our rigorous training has borne fruit, if you are entrusting us with this.
Confession:
**Fjorm**: Well, Princess Laegjarn, I think our mission has been a success. This ninja festival may be the best yet.
**Laegjarn**: If that is true, it is thanks to your boundless enthusiasm. I would never have achieved this on my own.
**Fjorm**: I could say the same to you! I think we've made a wonderful team.
**Laegjarn**: This experience has been a powerful reminder of how much I've changed. My old self would...not be here.
But there is no use dwelling on the past. I am here now, because a friend has brought out the best in me.
**Fjorm**: This is just the beginning, Laegjarn. Our friendship is only going to grow from here.
Status: • As a partner, will I suffice? • Of course!
Conversation: **Fjorm**: Yah! Tah! Hu-AH! Sparkling Shuriken!
**Laegjarn**: Sparkling Shuriken?
**Fjorm**: Oh...that? Princess Elise taught me how ninja announce their attacks. She participated in this festival before.
She said it's a ninja tradition.
**Laegjarn**: I see... There is much to the art of the ninja, it seems.

**Fjorm**: I suppose so. But even if it's what I'm SUPPOSED to do, it does feel a bit strange to just shout it out.
Sparkling Shuriken!
**Laegjarn**: Hehe... Hahaha...
**Fjorm**: What's so funny?
**Laegjarn**: It is good to see you doing no more than simply having fun.
You had so much on your mind... I prefer seeing a smile on your face.
**Fjorm**: Now that you mention it... I hadn't even thought about it.
There's something different about you too. It seems like your sharp edges have become...softened.
You remind me of Gunnthrá. Just a bit.
**Laegjarn**: Do I? For I wish you to feel less like I'm your older sister, and more like we're the friends we have become.
**Fjorm**: Oh! We have become friends, haven't we?
**Laegjarn**: Yes. And now, we are partners who must rely upon each other. I look forward to it.
**Fjorm**: As do I! Let's enjoy the festival as much as we can.
Duo Skill: The power of the ninja. Prepare yourself!

camilla8.name: Camilla
camilla8.title: Midnight Bloom
camilla8.description: Eldest princess of Nohr whose love for her siblings is second to none, she has joined the ninja festival in a captivating outfit. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: This ninja garb is quite charming. Useful if I need to have my target wrapped around my finger...
I've always wanted to learn about the ninja of Hoshido. How lucky that this festival's drawn them into the light.
I'm well aware of how essential it is to gather reliable intelligence. One false lead can have dire consequences.
As Corrin and Elise said, this festival is full of surprises. It's quite a thrill to experience so many new things.
"So long as it is in service to Corrin, I shall do whatever is asked of me." There—was that ninja enough?
Visit: Camilla the ninja, at your service. I have a little gift for you, from your friend [F].
Level: Ninja are always ready to risk their lives for the ones they care about. That is their greatest strength, I think.
If those eyes of yours wander much longer, I might begin to suspect that you've let your guard down.
So sorry—I know I have a tendency to stand out in a crowd. I'll do my best to be discreet in the future.
Summon: I am Camilla, princess of Nohr. I'll be playing the part of ninja today, so if you need to find me...good luck.
Learn Skill: Charm isn't the only means I have to gather information. I'll prove it to you.
Confession:
A ninja will fearlessly take on any mission, even a life-threatening one, in service to a lord.
Partaking in this festival has given me a great appreciation for the strength and resolve of ninja.
Especially because that strength most often comes from a desire to protect those who are important to them.
I can, of course, relate to that a great deal from my personal experience.
As a princess, I rely on those who support me from the shadows. It's refreshing to see the other side of it.
Thank you for giving me this learning opportunity. It's not one I'll soon forget, [S].
Status: A festival to honor the ninja of Hoshido? How fascinating.
*gasp* I let you catch me by surprise? How unbecoming of a ninja.
Gathering intelligence is more difficult than I thought. My retainers deserve more praise!
None of this is easy for me, you know. I do tend to stand out.
I could tell you all my secrets, but then I'd have to... Well, you know.
Corrin and Elise make utterly adorable ninja.
What will it be today? Infiltration? Assassination? I'm ready for anything.

cherche2.name: Cherche
cherche2.title: Shaded by Wings
cherche2.description: Wyvern-riding fighter in Virion's noble house. Hastens to join the ninja festival with her beloved mount, Minerva. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Isn't Minerva adorable? She's even caught on to my ninja act and started growling more quietly!
In my world, I worked in the service of House Virion, so I'm quite used to dealing with lords and their demands.
Rather than trying to be stealthy, I'd be better off charging in head-on? Hmm... Who told you to say that?
Shuriken are a ninja weapon, no? And yet, their cute shapes make them nearly as adorable as Minerva's fangs!
I've heard that the food ninja eat is made to be portable and nutritious. I should add it to my repertoire.
Visit:
I've come to deliver some goods from [F]...
And now, my mission is complete.
Level: Am I meeting your expectations of how a ninja should perform? If you are satisfied, then I am as well.
Let's take it slow today, Minerva. It wouldn't do to get worked up and cause a scene.
Oh my... Moving around in this outfit is a bit more difficult than I expected.
Summon: Is this where the ninja festival is being held? Minerva and I are here to enjoy the festivities.
Learn Skill: Oh, is this for me? Very well. I will strive to meet even the loftiest of your expectations.
Confession:
Hello there. Enjoying your time at the ninja festival, I hope? Minerva and I are certainly having fun.
At first, I wasn't sure about wearing these clothes, or even what acting like a ninja meant...
But then I realized that ninja are people who support their lords from the shadows. That, I can understand.
Of course, true loyalty does not mean blindly following a lord's orders without any hesitation.
When someone is wrong, they must be told so, and guided in a different direction. That is true loyalty.
So take heart! If you ever stray from the right path, Minerva may just have a few words for you. Hehe...
Status: My name is Cherche. I look forward to participating in this unique festival.
Ooh! Oh, did you fix my scarf? Thanks.
Minerva has been looking forward to the festival too.
If you have a top-secret mission, put me on it. I've done that kind of work before.
Virion would make a terrible ninja. He's too fond of standing out.
Whatever the sacrifice, I will ensure the mission is a success.
I made us some lunch! Take some time out to eat with me later.

heath2.name: Heath
heath2.title: Wyvern Ninja
heath2.description: A wyvern rider who once served Bern. Takes to the skies as a ninja on the back of the loyal Hyperion. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Maybe I should ask Legault for some tips on covert operations... Nah, better not associate with his type.
I want to serve a lord who puts the people first and does not give in to selfish desires.
When I think of skill with a bow, I think of Lady Louise. Ah, but now is not the time to reminisce...
If I want to tail someone from above, all I have to do is get on Hyperion... so long as he's actually awake.
I do not consider myself the stealthy sort. Even as a ninja, I prefer a fair and straightforward fight.
Visit: I am Heath, a wyvern rider—well, at present, a ninja. I have something for you from [F].
Level: You'd be proud of me, Commander Vaida. I've finally found a place where I can fight with a clear conscience.
Show me an opening, and I will strike without hesitation! That's what a ninja would do, right?
A ninja must be calm and collected at all times. Flying off the handle will get me nowhere.
Summon: I am Heath, a wyvern rider formerly from Bern. If you're looking for a ninja, I'm ready to serve.
Learn Skill: I am proud, at last, to risk my life and limb for a lord who's truly worthy of my service.
Confession:
I'm a mercenary now. That means I'll do what my employer asks of me—within reason, of course.
I never expected to be recruited as a ninja, though. I think Hyperion is bewildered by it too.
Ninja earn a living in the shadows, risking their lives to keep their lords safe.
I've...had bad luck with lords. As a knight, all I ever wanted was to swear fealty with a clean conscience.
Askr has given me that, in a way. Here, I can take pride in fighting to protect the people.
As a ninja and a knight, you can count on me to serve with devotion. Thank you for inviting me to this festival.
Status: A festival from another world, huh? Makes sense... This outfit is something else.
Huh?! Oh, it's you. I didn't think you could sneak up on me.
Hyperion's a bit sluggish. He may have eaten too much. Come on, buddy, stay sharp!
Being stealthy on the back of a wyvern is no easy feat. Hyperion's not subtle.
Honestly, I have a hard time not breaking cover. I'm liable to say what I really think.
Commander Vaida... She could pull off an assassination without a hitch.
I could dig up your deepest, darkest secrets... Hah! Relax, I'm only kidding.

haar2.name: Haar
haar2.title: Tempest Runner
haar2.description: A dracoknight and former Daein soldier. Can he stave off sleepiness long enough to make his mark on the ninja festival? Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: There's nothing more exhausting than dealing with incompetent leadership. It's a problem anywhere you go.
I prefer not to draw attention to myself, so you could say I have an appreciation for a ninja's abilities.
I've had some practice muffling my footsteps. It's handy when I want to sneak off for a nap.
If you need anything moved, I'm your man. Whether it's treasure or trade secrets, your cargo's safe with me.
This outfit is perfect for blending into the shadows. Just what I need when I'm looking to sleep uninterrupted.
Visit: Got a special cargo delivery here with your name on it. Take a look—says it's from [F].
Level: Thought I was asleep? Joke's on you. Maybe you're the one who should be paying more attention.
The best way to blend in? Just be as average as possible. Works for me.
I kind of like working in the dark. The only real problem is the constant temptation to fall sleep.
Summon: I'm Haar. I run cargo. Not sure how I ended up dressed like this, exactly, but I'm willing to roll with it.
Learn Skill: If you really think that highly of me, I guess the least I can do is try not to disappoint you.
Confession:
*yawn* Oh, it's you. No, I'm awake. Just trying out a technique that one of the ninja taught me.
No, really! The point is to let your target think you're asleep and then strike while their guard is down.
You seriously think I'm making this up? Feel free to put me to the test. Just, uh, let me know beforehand.
Anyway, I appreciate you checking in. Are you actually checking up on all the festivalgoers one at a time?
Sounds exhausting. And maybe a bit controlling. But I guess it's a comfort to know you're looking out for us.
Tell you what—if it makes you feel better, I'll get all my duties taken care of before I take my nap. Sound OK?
Status: What exactly have you gotten me into here?
Watch your hands. You could hurt yourself.
I figure somebody else would enjoy this getup more than me.
Espionage is very useful. No denying that.
*yawn* Huh? No, of course I'm awake. Don't you trust me?
I bet a peaceful scene like this would've made General Shiharam very happy.
I could use a nap. Know any quiet spots around here?

ytiki6.name: Tiki
ytiki6.title: Awakened Blood
ytiki6.description: Divine Dragon princess, entrusted to slumber by the White Sage, Gotoh, reawakened after the restoration of the Binding Shield. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: All alone, in a pitch-dark room... I've cried so many times, and that's why... I don't want to be alone anymore.
I kept having scary dreams about the fire dragons and ice dragons... Will that happen to me too, one day?
If I stay here with all of you, I won't have those scary dreams anymore? Really? You mean it?
Everyone is so nice! I love them all! I want to live together with humans!
Ban-Ban took me to a human village. It was so warm and bright outside, and so much fun...
Visit: Will you play with me? I came here from [F]'s castle!
Level: Gotoh said no dragon would compare to me if I ever got angry.
Please... I don't want to be alone anymore. Ban-Ban, Mar-Mar...
Huh? Oh, I'm so sorry. I guess I couldn't do it quite right...
Summon: I'm... Tiki... Will the scary dreams go away if I stay here?
Learn Skill: Wow... Even though I'm a dragon, everyone is so nice to me!
Confession:
The White Sage, Gotoh, told me to stay asleep for as long as I could, but the dreams... They were terrifying...
I would turn into a monster, just like those poor fire and ice dragons, and then I'd start attacking humans!
I'd scream and wake up, only to find I was still in that pitch-dark room. ...I used to cry, all the time.
I had this feeling that every time I fell asleep, I got closer to becoming a monster... I was so scared.
But then, Mar-Mar came. He said that the Binding Shield would protect me. That I could go outside.
I won't become a monster, and I don't want to go back. So, can I stay here with everyone? Please?
Status: I can stay here with all of you, can't I?
*surprised* You were teasing me just now, weren't you?
Thanks to Mar-Mar, I can be up and about! No more sleeping.
I can't stop smiling... I want to do things! Lots and lots of things!
Would you play hide-and-seek with me? Great, you're it! Hee hee!
I want to eat some of Ban-Ban's pickled vegetables...
I can stay with you forever! Isn't that amazing!

ganglot.name: Ganglöt
ganglot.title: Death Anew
ganglot.description: Severe, somber servant of the ruler of the dead. She has sworn complete loyalty to Hel.

Castle Hall: There is too much light here. I cannot say I find it pleasant.
I served Lady Hel, the ruler of the dead. To rule the dead, one must command them.
To have so many Heroes at your command is not something to be taken lightly. Impressive, in fact.
A nice stroll near the Death Gate might do you well. The damp miasma has a calming effect.
Since I have joined with the Heroes, I thought I should know their many histories... I have learned much.
Visit:
I am here as a representative of [F].
If you should have any issues with your dead, I am willing to assist.
Level: What power... This is almost too much for me to hold back.
Regardless of outcome, we continue.
If Lady Hel were here... This will not do.
Summon: I am Ganglöt. Although I served Lady Hel, the ruler of the dead... I now am left to oversee a realm without rule.
Learn Skill: A wise choice. I will see to it that this is used effectively.
Confession:
I served Lady Hel for a long time.
I was abandoned in the realm of the dead when I was still very young...
I was full of resentment and hatred for what had been done to me, but Lady Hel saved me.
Lady Hel would judge the fate of the dead with a cool, calculated calm, without the slightest bias.
In that, she has no equal.
It is that aspect of Lady Hel that I wish to emulate—to watch over all things with unbroken vision.
Free of hate, free of love, selfless. That is how I want to be.
Lady Hel was free of all passion... Completely.
Status: I am Ganglöt. I am the new ruler of the realm of the dead.
I do not recall granting you permission to touch me.
Lady Hel was...magnificent. There will never be another who can rule the dead as she did.
I am more a more appropriate successor to Lady Hel than Princess Eir would be.
I will not stand idle. Give me a task or leave me to my business.
Lady Hel... I hope I can live up to your example...
I am learning much from you and your ability to make consistent use of so many Heroes.

nyna.name: Nyna
nyna.title: The Last Princess
nyna.description: Princess of the Kingdom of Archanea. After the Dolhr Empire attacked, she escaped to Aurelis and entrusted the Fire Emblem to Prince Marth. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Despite the ruin the Dolhr Empire and its leader, Medeus, brought upon Archanea, I was not to be executed.
Dolhr's assault crushed the capital. Afterward, Bishop Boah and very few others were allowed at my side.
As princess of Archanea, I chose the hero worthy of wielding the Fire Emblem: Prince Marth of Altea.
When Prince Marth of Altea, inheritor of Anri's legacy, appeared, it was akin to a beacon lighting my darkness.
When the Fire Emblem last changed hands to save Archanea, it was not without cost... Artemis's Curse.
Visit: I sense light in your heart, much like I sense in [F]...
Level: Never give up. Fight, until the day you restore light to our world.
I must not misjudge the duty laid at my feet. I must ensure that Archanea endures...that it is restored.
The Fire Emblem is a crest bestowed only upon a true champion, a symbol of divine authority...
Summon: I am Nyna, princess of Archanea. We must join hands, end Dolhr's tyranny, and restore the holy kingdom!
Learn Skill: The courage of countless souls has inspired me. Now, it is I who must be courageous.
Confession:
All members of the royal family were killed in battle or executed when Dolhr and Grust attacked...all but me.
I was prepared to throw myself upon the sword, but a man stopped me, saying I had a duty to Archanea still...
That man was Camus, the Sable Knight of Grust. In reality, my greatest foe had saved my life.
My ability to escape the capital and seek refuge with Lord Hardin was all thanks to him.
Despite the risks, he fought to keep me from harm. Worry for his safety possesses my every thought.
If only I could speak with him even once more... Camus, I... My apologies. This is neither the time nor place.
Please...I would value your discretion regarding this conversation.
Status: Gather your strength.
I will aid you.
I am Nyna of House Archanea.
The Fire Emblem is bestowed upon a true champion, one we believe has the power to save the world.
With Linde's father gone, I will do everything within my power to keep her safe.
Camus... I hope I get to meet you again someday.
It will be difficult, but we must nevertheless fight—until the day you restore light to our world.

hardin.name: Hardin
hardin.title: The Coyote
hardin.description: Younger brother of the king of Aurelis, nicknamed the Coyote. Rescued the Archanean Princess, Nyna. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: May Prince Marth's knights of Altea join with the Coyote's Men to protect Princess Nyna.
Archanean nobles may look down on the people of Aurelis, but they know not of the plains people's strength.
An army needs to distribute labor to function. We will have need of your tactics later. For now, get some rest.
As an exceptionally good judge of character, I believe you will achieve great things, [S].
Some here are feeling the tension before battle—others, the relief of surviving it. All is as it should be.
Visit: I am Hardin, captain of the knights of Aurelis. I bring tidings on behalf of [F].
Level: Seekers of glory, step forward! Come, test the blade of Hardin, brother of the king of Aurelis!
So long as my moniker strikes fear in the hearts of my enemies, I will howl "Coyote" like a ferocious beast!
I cannot afford such carelessness.
Summon: Hardin, commander of the Coyote's Men of Aurelis, reporting in. On my honor, I will never yield to evil.
Learn Skill: Feel free to set high expectations for my knights. They are the best that Aurelis has to offer.
Confession:
Summoner, if I may... When will I be able to return to Aurelis? I am concerned for my elder brother.
He has had a good reign, but he was getting on in years even before I left to join Altea for Princess Nyna's sake.
I swore upon my life to vanquish Dolhr, deliver the princess safely to the capital, and end this nightmare.
That is my conviction. The Coyote's Men must be victorious, that our dreams may finally be realized.
But perhaps this discussion is best held for another time. For now, let us focus on the path that we both share.
Status: I am Hardin, captain of the knights of Aurelis.
I see we are prone to acting like children.
The Coyote's Men are as good as they come. Whatever you expect from them, you will not be disappointed.
Make no mistake, I consider myself an exceptionally good judge of character.
Princess Nyna would not be pleased to hear any nitpicking over who will be listed in the history books.
Princess Nyna... I swear I will protect you always.
I have truly begun to think of you as a friend.

elice.name: Elice
elice.title: Altean Princess
elice.description: Gentle princess of Altea and Marth's older sister. Noble with a heart that places the lives of those she cares for above her own. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Seeing my brother grow into his own, surrounded by his friends, fills me with pride. Please, treat him well.
Gra was Altea's trusted neighbor and ally, until King Jiol betrayed us. Marth did what he had to do to survive.
Marth is the hope, and the future, of Altea—for there is now no other in the world who can wield Falchion.
Setting sun shining through the forest canopy... Birdsong in rhythm with the streams... This world is beautiful.
The only silver lining in the fall of Altea Castle was that Malledus and Jagen secured my brother's escape.
Visit: May all friendship be as everlasting as the one between you and [F]...
Level: Even as we revere what was built by our forebears, let us recognize that it is today's hearts that shape tomorrow.
Heroes do not simply appear out of nowhere. It was the refusal to yield to despair that gave rise to Anri.
Marth...you and I are all that remains of House Altea's blood. It falls to us to fulfill our family's duty.
Summon: I am Elice, princess of Altea—but I assume you are more familiar with the name of my brother, Marth.
Learn Skill: I still recall Marth being so frustrated that he could not match Merric in his studies. Ah, they grow up so fast...
Confession:
Do you ever find yourself exhausted by the sheer number of issues at hand, [S]?
I am sometimes overwhelmed when I consider all the brave souls who gave their lives to protect Altea.
I had intended to meet the same fate as my castle, then. Instead, I became a hostage of Grust, Gra, and Dolhr.
Ironically, it was Gharnef who saved me. He wished me to wield the staff of Aum, found in the Resurrectory.
I still do not understand what he hopes to achieve, but I pray that Marth will put a stop to his plans.
Special: I will not let you through!
Status: Are you well?
You mustn't give up!
I am Elice, the princess of Altea.
Merric, when did you become so reliable?
Marth is the hope, and the future, of Altea.
Oh Marth... Stay safe, and live on...
You are much like my brother — a light that leads the way.

matthis.name: Matthis
matthis.title: Brother to Lena
matthis.description: A noble knight of Macedon. Though he would prefer to avoid bloodshed, he had no choice but to take up arms. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Although I dislike war, were I to refuse, I would be put to death. I was left no choice...
Macedon has bowed to Dolhr, and now we face the worse end of the bargain.
Aah! Even the approaching steps of warhorses are frightening. The very sensation of dread itself...
I don't wish for this to get out but... Prince Marth of Altea is truly kind. If I must serve, I'd serve Altea.

My younger sister refused the prince's marriage proposal. I suppose she was nervous or something...
We must find her a suitable match.
Visit: A fine castle. Someday I may request entry to escape battle. Please, do not tell [F]!
Level: Oh! Have I improved?! Well, I suppose I am a soldier of Macedon, after all.
I must find my resolve. If I am to die, I want to do so with some dignity and grace.
Lena...my sister. Forgive your fool of a brother...
Summon: My sister ran off, I was ordered to war... My family may very well end with this generation.
Learn Skill: Your expectations are troubling... Please just promise not to put me on the front lines.
Confession:
Here, [S]!
Sorry to be so loud, but I have been thinking.
What if this place, I mean this world, is the other side? There is no doubt that I would have died in that battle.
A hodgepodge group of guys dragged into battle clearly has no chance of defeating Prince Marth's army...
Lena...my sister. Forgive your foolish brother. I will pray for your happiness from the comfort of this castle.
My sister is capable, but plenty of scoundrels wish to exploit her heart and steal her affection. Protect her...
Special: I can fight if I must.
Status: I'm Matthis. It's nice to meet you.
Huh... Lena?! Ah, it was only you.
My greatest wish is to see my sister again before I die.
I won't just hand over my sister to a thief like Julian!
I never wanted to fight. I was pressed into joining the rebel army.
Lena, where could you be?
Let us work together and search for my dear Lena!

embla.name: Embla
embla.title: God of Closure
embla.description: God of the closed kingdom, which shares her name. Spite and jealousy rule her, and she wishes death to any who side with Askr.

Castle Hall: The Kingdom of Askr...so full of people and their noise. This is not where I belong.

Everything here is so open. There is too much space, too much...light. Too much.
I need to go to a dark space to put myself at ease.
Elm is my faithful servant. He will never shrink from a task I've given him. Never.

We are all alone. No matter what you do, no one will ever truly know you— and you will not know them.
The only choice is to close everyone and everything out.
I am no Askr. I have nothing to say to you—or anyone.
Visit: I am Embla... Despite knowing my disdain for other worlds, you have chosen to bring me here... I see.
Level: Face the endless dark.
However much power I am able to gain, I will never again grant it for the benefit of mortals.
Hmph...
Summon: I am Embla. Summoned...here? By this mortal? Infuriating.
Learn Skill: ...Tribute? Hm. I will not turn it away, but expect nothing in return.
Confession:
I detest mortals. They are weak, their lives too short to have any real meaning.
And their praises and oaths have even less meaning.
It was Askr's curiosity that led me to grant a mortal the power of my blood when I did. How was I repaid?
Mortals showered me with gratitude. They called me savior...a benevolent god come to aid them.
They...devoted themselves to me.
But those memories are just that— they remain ever in the past.
Had it never happened, it would have been for the better.
Status: Ahh... This seething envy...
...Sheer impudence.
The mortals chose Askr. All of them. Over me...
Elm is a faithful servant. He would never betray me...
Even alone in the absolute, I do not yearn for companionship... I do not know loneliness!
Mortals once loved me as they do Askr… I had no choice.
Though the words stick in my throat, I am with you—for now.

veronica5.name: Veronica
veronica5.title: Princess Rising
veronica5.description: Imperial princess of the Emblian Empire. Has come to consider the needs of the people of both Embla and Askr.

Castle Hall: Brother, I...
A ruler serves their people. I was selfish, but...I have learned much.
Princess Sharena confuses me. She wants to be my friend even still.
Embla has been swept up in the whims of its nobility. It is time for a change.
The Veronica of this world is...much like me. We both have many faults.
Visit: I am Veronica. I've come to deliver a greeting from your friend [F].
Level: Will gaining strength help me reach my goals?
This is...the power of Embla?
Forgive me... It's...my head...
Summon: I am Veronica. The power I wield is now at your command. Not for any reason but that I choose to grant it.
Learn Skill: Thank you...for considering me.
Confession:
I was foolish. I was hurt and turned away from everyone, like a child.
The Heroes I've met have taught me a great deal.
What is right and what is wrong have become clearer to me...as has the meaning of family.
What more will I learn while I am here with you? How will I grow? When will I feel...ready?
Someday, I hope.
Status: I am Veronica. This form is Embla's doing.
Oh... Is this the behavior I should expect?
Embla was...lonely. I believe that is what changed her.
One day, maybe I'll be more like Alfonse and Sharena… I hope so.
A ruler's purpose is to serve their people.
I was once so closed off, alone, that...being this open with others is a challenge.
Am I...to be counted among your friends, then?

seidr.name: Seiðr
seidr.title: Goddess of Hope
seidr.description: Goddess of Vanaheimr, the realm of light. Descends upon the land to save the people from destruction. Always acts with propriety.

Castle Hall: Midgard is the realm of mortals. As a goddess of Vanaheimr, it is my duty to serve as your guiding light.
Vanaheimr, the realm of light, realm of gods, beautiful and shining... It is ruled by Njörðr, king of the vanir.
Are my garments so unusual? Perhaps they are, from a mortal perspective... Hm.
You mustn't lie to a goddess. Only mortals who are true of heart can receive a goddess's blessing.

Vanaheimr, the realm of light, and Ásgarðr, the celestial realm, are both realms of the gods.
The two realms are in no way allied, however—or even on friendly terms.
Visit:
My greetings to you, child of Midgard. I am Seiðr of Vanaheimr, the realm of light.
...Might you also be able to point the way back to where I've just come from, please?
Level: Oh! Hoora— Erm... As is to be expected from a goddess such as myself.
Witness the power of a goddess of Vanaheimr.
Oh no... The shame...
Introduction: Child of Midgard, I am Seiðr. I come to you as a goddess, asking for your help. We must...save the future.
Summon: I am Seiðr of Vanaheimr, the realm of light. May all the children of Midgard receive light's blessing.
Learn Skill: Thank you. What a sweet mortal you are.
Confession:
I have granted you revelation, and in doing so have chosen you as the mortal destined to stand beside me.
Together, we will save this world.
I am sorry I was unable to ask you whether this path is one you would choose, but my hand was forced.
As a goddess, I promise you that, should you be righteous and true, you will receive my blessing.
We goddesses have honored this arrangement since time immemorial...
Whatever it is that you desire—be it gold, silver, or any other treasure—it will be yours. You have my word.
Status: Child of Midgard, I am known as Seiðr of Vanaheimr, the realm of light.
*yelp* You...startle a goddess so brazenly? I will not forget this...
With my light, I have given you a gift of revelation—a vision of the future.
So long as we never give up, our wishes will one day be made reality. I truly believe that.
