Heiðr is no less than a sister to me... She is dearer than any other.
There are ways a goddess must act, and ways she must not...
It is no small thing for a goddess to give the gift of revelation... Of course, it was bound to happen.

ophelia2.name: Ophelia
ophelia2.title: Starlit Maiden
ophelia2.description: Daughter of Odin Dark, mage of Nohr. Received a crystal ball filled with the power of the stars from her father. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I am called Ophelia Dusk. When shadow and light converge in the sky, my true power shall be unveiled.

My father and mother mean the world to me, and I'll always be grateful to them.
I am certain the Kingdom of Askr feels grateful too—for the new star shining in its sky named Ophelia!
There's no need to worry about not having your own mark. After all, we're both chosen ones guided by destiny!

The Order of Heroes has a nice ring to it, but I feel like we could make it sound even more impressive!
How about the Far-Flung Fellowship? Do you think they'd let me join?
N-no, this isn't what it looks like! I'm jumping up and down to...speak with some new spirits! Via motion! Yeah!
Visit: Under all skies, the light of the moon is the same. All are connected, so if you see someone new, say hello!
Level: The crystals glimmer... The stars and I become one... Now, embrace the light! Glorious Stella Nova!
This much is only natural. After all, the star of destiny shines upon me!
It's all right! I'm still sparkling! T-tell me I'm sparkling!
Summon:
I see you've noticed my overflowing power. Yes, I am a warrior of destiny, chosen by the stars themselves.
Those who have witnessed my power call me Ophelia of the Glittering Stars!
Learn Skill: Forgotten spirits of stardust, grant me strength! Phew... Now I'm even closer to becoming a chosen one!
Confession:
I see it—countless worlds in crisis. Their fates are stirring, preparing to converge...
But I can hear the spirits of ancient stars whispering to me, telling me how calamity can be averted, and...
Yeah, I think I'll go with this plot for a while! A grandiose start like that will make the foreshadowing way easier.
What am I talking about, you ask? I guess it's the power of imagination.
Sort of like how you have to really imagine a wish for it to come true. In a way, I'm practicing for that.
See, I've always admired my father and mother for not only fighting for a better world, but believing in one.
And now that I'm here, in another world, I intend to carry on that legacy!
If you say it enough times, it'll become true, right? That's the power of a person's will.
All that's left after that is to follow the stars that guide us. That's what it means to be a chosen one!
Special: I bestow this light upon you!
Status: Ta-da! Oh, with this new power, I'm one step closer to becoming the chosen one!
*gasp* This magical tome is very special, so I'm afraid I can't give it to you!
I'm a warrior chosen by the stars. I must be destined to fight, mustn't I?
Father looks kinda jealous. I wonder why? He's so much more amazing than me!
I just wanna yell out "woosh!" and "bam!" when I deal the finishing blow, don't you?
Do I deserve this new power...? No! I can't doubt my destiny!
Our hearts will remain connected by the stars, no matter our distance. Of that, I'm sure!

dwyer.name: Dwyer
dwyer.title: Sleepy Butler
dwyer.description: Jakob's son. Supremely apathetic, but has much potential. The coffee he brews is superb. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Summoning is a pretty sweet gig, huh? Just summon up some Heroes, then sit back while they do the rest.

I was raised in the Deeprealms. It was there my father taught me martial arts and how to buttle.
That is, how to serve as a butler.
All this summoning must make you thirsty. Do you want some coffee or tea? I recommend my coffee.

Sooo tired... Doesn't look like we're moving out any time soon, so maybe I'll take a nap.
You should take one too.
I baked some sweets for everyone. They were a big hit, so maybe I'll show off another hidden talent...
Visit:
Hi there. I'm here with greetings from [F].
Since I'm here, want to see a neat trick?
Level: Ta-daaa... Guess that means I'm pretty strong now.
Will this make my chores easier?
Didn't change as much as I'd hoped.
Summon: It's good to meet you. I'm Dwyer... My father is Jakob... Anyway, what am I doing here?
Learn Skill: Maybe my coffee will be even better now. Wanna taste test for me?
Confession:
Well, if it isn't [S]. What's on your mind? I'll listen if you talk.
You're a little sleepy? Well, I can put some coffee on if you'd like. It'll wake you up for sure.
But if I was you, I'd opt for a nice, long nap. My coffee is good, but nothing beats sleeping.
Whether it's coffee or a good nap, I always try to experience the best each has to offer.
Anyway, don't push yourself too hard. When you aren't your usual peppy self, it throws me off too.
It makes me worry about you.
So you decided to take a nap, huh? Good choice. I'll wake you with the scent of fresh coffee, so rest up.
Oh, and thanks for everything, our great and powerful summoner.
Status: Oh. I'll do my job.
Don't push yourself...
Are you tired? I could make you a cup of coffee...
You're going to give me a shoulder rub? How thoughtful...
Don't rest so you can work hard... Work hard so you can rest.
If I have to be a Hero, I guess I'll be a better Hero than my father.
I avoid complications whenever I can, but I don't mind working for you. What do you say to that, oh great and powerful Summoner?

caeldori.name: Caeldori
caeldori.title: Perfect Angel
caeldori.description: Strives for perfection, following in the footsteps of the father she admires, Subaki. Naturally talented, beautiful, and motivated. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: There is nothing else for me to learn in the classroom. I need real combat training. This is just the place!
My knowledge of combat tactics, pegasus handling, and lancework could use some improvement!
I appreciate your concern, but I am fine.
This castle's library is quite well organized. However, there were a few minor errors I saw to on my day off.
My skills are no match for those of my father's, so I must take my training seriously.
Visit: I am Caeldori, daughter of Subaki, a sky knight of utter perfection. I have a gift for you, to offer a friendly hello.
Level: Darting Blow! I'd say that wasn't too bad... But it's still a far cry from what my father could do.
As long as my feet are planted on the battlefield, I will use every ounce of knowledge and skill I possess to win!
I can't wrap my head around it... What could have gone wrong?
Summon: Hello, nice to meet you. I'm Caeldori, daughter of Subaki, a sky knight of Hoshido. I strive to be perfect like him.
Learn Skill: Thank you for looking out for me. I'm not always so sure about myself.
Confession:
Eek, [S]!
Huh? O-oh, this book? Um, I-I was just a bit interested, and...
No, no, I have no need for anything like this! I mean I, um, you know, have a wealth of romantic experience!
Nope, not me, I certainly don't have any troubles with love... *sigh* I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hide it.
But the person I'm in love with is... Hey, actually, I have a question. Is there anyone you're interested in?
Oh, um, I'm just asking as a friend!
Status: I'm Caeldori, daughter of Subaki. It's wonderful to meet you!
Ah! Gods, you caught me in a daydream.
Is there a library here? I've  committed most of the books I have at home to memory.
I'm not particularly concerned about my physique.
Why do I always fall in love with men who never love me back?
My father is just perfect! I have to work as hard as I can to catch up to him.
Don't worry, I'll keep training hard to improve!

kiragi.name: Kiragi
kiragi.title: Upbeat Archer
kiragi.description: Takumi's son. Easygoing and friendly, he always looks for the silver lining. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
Your divine weapon is so cool! Hunting and summoning are kind of similar, now that I think about it.
You'll never know who—or what— you'll encounter!

I grew up surrounded by nature. It was great playing in the mountains every day.
Oh, I don't mean to say being here isn't a lot of fun too! Because it is!
Tell me right away if you find yourself in trouble. I've got keen eyes so I can help out no matter where I am!
Want to join me for target practice? If you can hit a bullseye, maybe it'll improve your summoning!

I'm not great at studying, but I try my best. Hunting skills alone won't make for a strong royal.
I've gotta devote myself fully if I want to take after my dad!
Visit: This place looks like a lot of fun! Oh, I've come to say hello. I was sent by [F]!
Level: Wow! I feel like I'm ready for anything!
A little bit better than yesterday...
Eh, I'm good enough the way I am!
Summon:
It's good to meet you! My name's Kiragi. My dad is Takumi, and I love him to death! I love hunting too!
Say, we should go hunting together!
Learn Skill: I want to show this new power to Dad. Think he'd be proud of me?
Confession:
Wow, you've come to see me? I had a feeling something good would happen today!
I hope great things like this keep happening. That would eventually bring the world to peace, right?
I was raised in the Deeprealms, but I knew there was a war raging in the outside world.
Things must have been really tough for my parents. I just hate how war is so hard on everyone...
That's why I want to work to bring peace to all worlds. Hoshido, Nohr, and now Askr...
I want to turn them all into kingdoms where the only things that happen are great things!
And with you by my side, I think I can make that dream come true.
Status: Who's the man! That was an amazing hunt!
♪Hm-hm-hm...♪Another day, another chance for some fun. Let's go!
When you get done with your Order of Heroes stuff, want to head up to the mountains with me? We could get some hunting in.
My dad is the best. Seriously. So amazing.
If I believe something will go well, it does!
One day, I'll wield the Fujin Yumi. But when?
Thanks for summoning me. I know what I'm good at, and I'll take care of what needs taking care of.

hans.name: Hans
hans.title: Ambitious Brute
hans.description: A soldier under the direct command of King Garon of Nohr. Known for being merciless. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I won't stop at captain. I will keep on climbing!
I'm a loyal warrior of Nohr, mighty and cunning in equal measure.
The weak only hold back the strong. Best to get rid of 'em before they give you trouble.
I'll be a king someday. I'll make it happen—you wait and see.
I'm itching for a fight. Maybe I'll go pick one to amuse myself...
Visit: Out of the way—I'm here to crush a rebellion. Oh...there's no uprising? Fine. Blame [F].
Level: Bow down! That's right! Bow down before me! I'll slaughter anyone!
Ah ha ha! Die, scumbags!
What?!
Summon: I'm Hans, Nohr's newest captain. Who wants an axe to the neck?
Learn Skill: Let me show you how I got my promotion. HAAAH!
Confession:
You've seen a lot of battle, huh? I can practically smell the blood on you. I respect that.
Chaos will always topple the ones who don't earn their status. It's folks like you and me who rise to the top.
And the way we do that is by cutting down all our enemies. Gahaha! Don't act like you don't know what I mean!
No matter how orderly things look, chaos is always ready to bubble up to the surface...with a little help.
Even a kingdom like this one could be in the hands of people like us before you know it. Just follow my lead!
Status: I'm Hans, Nohr's newest captain. Who wants an axe to the neck?
Try that again and you'll be sorry.
I'll be a king someday. I'll make it happen—you wait and see.
Don't even think about defying King Garon.
Corrin's here too? Ugh, I can't stand that soft-hearted weakling...
I won't stop at captain. I will keep on climbing!
I'm gonna use you to get ahead. You better work real hard.

cordelia4.name: Cordelia
cordelia4.title: Unyielding Snow
cordelia4.description: Cordelia of Ylisse and Selena of Nohr. The pair has come to bring glad tidings to the festival. They appear in Fire Emblem Awakening / Fates.
cordelia4.harmonized:
Grants Atk/Spd+6,【Resonance: Blades】, and【Treachery】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Treachery】 Unit deals additional damage = total bonuses on unit for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Selena**: Guess I inherited a bit of my mother's awkwardness, huh... Wait, you heard that? Forget I said anything, or else!
**Selena**: There wasn't anything like this where I'm from. It was a world full of deathly chill and unending despair...
**Cordelia**: I've prepared something special for Selena, but it can wait until we've delivered our gifts to everyone else.
**Cordelia**: If it gets cold, Selena and I can huddle under my cape. That should be warm enough for the both of us.
**Cordelia**: I'm keeping my expectations in check. May he stay warm this winter, whether I can be there or not.
Visit: I've been entrusted with a gift for you. Go on, take it!
Level: **Selena**: As long as we work together, there's nothing we can't do!
**Cordelia**: I can't explain why, but sometimes it feels like Selena and I are perfectly in sync. Almost like we've met before...
**Selena**: Brrr... This isn't fair in the slightest! How do you expect me to fight when my hands are frozen solid?
Summon: I'm Cordelia, and I'm on a mission with Selena to deliver cheer. Let's make this festival one to remember!
Learn Skill: **Selena**: Hey, we're the gift givers here, not you! That said, it's not like I don't appreciate this...
Confession:
**Selena**: OK, that should be just about all the gifts... Hey, are you still messing around with my outfit? Give it a rest!
**Cordelia**: But it's just too cute! To be honest, I'm a little jealous that you can get away without wearing a breastplate...
**Selena**: What are you talking about? You'd look amazing with or without one, just like me!
**Cordelia**: Oh, um... I'll admit, it's hard to argue when you say it with such conviction. Still, do you really think so?
**Selena**: Well, duh. There's no way my mother could look anything less than perfect in this or any other getup.
**Cordelia**: Your who? Oh well, never mind that. Let's just make sure these final gifts get delivered before sundown!
Status: • "I'm enjoying these outfits. You look great, Selena." • "Oh, shut up. You know you look better."
Conversation: **Cordelia**: The winter festival... How lovely. *sigh*
**Selena**: Don't give me a sigh. It makes me think you'd rather be somewhere else.
**Cordelia**: No, it's not that! I'm sorry. I was just... thinking about someone.
It'd be nice to walk through these glittering streets together, but... it was only a thought.
I don't think he'd really want to spend this occasion with me.
**Selena**: I think I know who you mean...
**Cordelia**: What? Did you say something?
**Selena**: No, no. That sounds rough, though.
I can't really relate. I have an easy time getting men to fawn over me.
**Cordelia**: Ahaha. Well, OK. I believe it. You are very cute, Selena.
**Selena**: Yeah, I know. I get it from my mother.
She was beautiful, smart, talented... Everybody said she was perfect.
**Cordelia**: I can tell by the way you say it that you really love her.
**Selena**: Yeah, I... I guess I do. So much so that I got her a present. Here, this is for you.
**Cordelia**: Wait, what? Are you saying...
**Selena**: Now, come on. We've got a lot of other gifts to deliver tonight. Let's get moving!
**Cordelia**: Selena, wait! She really is quite a mysterious girl. Still, I can't help but feel close to her, somehow...

dorothea4.name: Dorothea
dorothea4.title: Yuletide Dancer
dorothea4.description: This charmer has done everything from trodding the boards to studying with the Black Eagles. Here, she will liven up the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: What do I want for my winter festival gift? Would a good partner to take care of me be too much to ask for?
I grew up in the alleys of Enbarr, begging for coins, eating scraps... I never thought much about festivals.
This is a time for us to forget about barriers of status that divide us, and celebrate what brings us together.
Worried about the chill? Sing a song with me. You'll warm right up!
I'd like it if Edie and Hubie could find an opportunity to relax at this year's winter festival...
Visit: Hi there! I've got a special invitation for you: a winter festival over at [F]'s castle!
Level: If I can play even a small part in making people happy, I'll gladly do it.
Come on, brighten up! It's the most wonderful time of the year!
This frigid air is wreaking havoc on my poor throat...
Summon: Today I am no mere songstress—I am a winter envoy! May the seasonal festivities begin!
Learn Skill: A gift? For me? How delightful! I'll treat it with care.
Confession:
I wasn't happy about being made to play the role of winter envoy, to tell the truth, [S].
I didn't want to step into another role so soon after retiring from the stage. I wanted to be myself for a while.
On top of that, I wasn't even sure I was qualified. What do I really have to offer, anyway?
I'm not noble born. I'm not rich. I'm not particularly witty. I can't even fight as well as most here.
But as soon as I saw how even my humble gifts were putting smiles on faces, my fears were put to rest.
I'm glad to take part in this festival, not as an actress, but as a human being. Thank you for inviting me.
Status: I'll sing you a carol!
Come on, get up!
You want me to play the part of winter envoy? I'm retired from the stage.
*gasp* You must be freezing. Let's get you warmed up!
The whole town looks like it's sparkling. It's positively gorgeous.
Hmm... Where has Manuela gotten to? It would be lovely to sing with her.
It's been absolutely lovely spending this evening with you.

annette2.name: Annette
annette2.title: Festive Helper
annette2.description: A student with the Blue Lions who works twice as hard as anyone. Joins the festival as a good learning experience. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: ♪Steak and a cake for a festival meal that's yummy yum... It's time to celebrate and fill my tummy tum...♪
I get the feeling there's a lot of history and lore behind the winter festival. I need to dig in and learn it all!
I'm happiest when I'm digging into a sweet treat! I can't wait to savor the frosting on that winter festival cake!
Winter mornings are definitely frigid, but at least they wake you up! We could take a little stroll to stay warm!

Let's see... To scale the chimney, we need a ladder that's long enough to reach when leaned at an angle, so...
I'll crunch the numbers!
Visit:
I'm Annette, a visitor from [F]'s castle.
I brought you a gift just to say happy winter festival!
Level: I'll do all I can to help make the winter festival an absolute success!
I'm going to have to be extra sweet to outshine this cute outfit!
Don't tell anyone, but I might have blown up an iron pan trying to make a winter festival Sweet Bun Trio...
Summon: You can expect good things with Annette Fantine Dominic lending a hand! Count on me to help!
Learn Skill: You'll see! I'll make the winter festival even more lively!
Confession:
I'm back! All of the winter festival gifts are in the hands of their lucky recipients, [S].
This festival has taught me so much about all sorts of things. I've been enjoying myself the entire time!
I absolutely love learning, of all kinds. That's why I'm constantly reading up on the latest and greatest.
Now, exploring Askr and making new friends has opened up a whole new world of knowledge to explore!
It's been eye-opening to experience the new things here in Askr that are different than at home in Fodlan!
I'll be sure to put everything I've learned at the festival to good use. You can count on it!
Status: Ba-dum-bump-bah!
Boom! It's done!
I'll give this festival my very best. You can count on me!
Ooh, got any more gifts to give out? I'm all done with mine.
I don't know which I'm more excited for—the presents, or the feast!
The only way to improve on tonight...would be to have my whole family here.
Oh, I almost forgot—I have something for you! Here, take it!

blackknight2.name: Black Knight
blackknight2.title: The Night's Blade
blackknight2.description: One of Daein's Four Riders. What could have brought him to the festival? None can say. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Only when I have delivered the last of these gifts will my duty be fulfilled.
With armor blessed by the goddess, I am better suited to observing a holy night than most.
Alondite can rest for one night. I have chosen a different implement for this occasion.
I will have no trouble getting to the recipients of these gifts quickly and covertly.
So I am to enter the house through... the chimney? Why?
Visit: No need to be tense. I have merely come to deliver a gift to you from your friend [F].
Level: No one shall disturb the festivities. You have my word.
The fight is over. Take this gift as consolation and return home.
It would seem I have scared them off.
Summon: I will do and say only what is strictly necessary to ensure the success of this festival.
Learn Skill: As thanks for this, I shall redouble my efforts to make the festival a success.
Confession:
This festival has afforded me a rare opportunity to reflect upon what it means to be a knight.
To cross swords with worthy foes in order to become stronger is one aspect of knighthood. But only one.
A knight must also serve a liege, so that the nation may remain stable and safeguard its people.
It follows from this that a knight must also have a relationship with his liege's subjects.
With that in mind, if there is anything I might wish for, it would be... No. Now is not the time.
For the moment, I will devote myself fully to protecting the peace.
Special: The winter festival is upon us.
Status: I will carry out the orders given to me by my lord. Whatever they may be.
It would seem that a gift for you is not among the ones I have here.
I had hoped this appearance would help me to blend in. Not to be accosted continually by children.
This festival is utterly foreign to me.
Peace, however temporary, ought to be cherished.
My wishes...are my own.
May your night be peaceful.

bruno3.name: Bruno
bruno3.title: Masked Reveler
bruno3.description: Emblian prince shrouded in mystery. Appears at the Askran winter festival in hopes of ensuring its success.

Castle Hall: There are surely other Heroes who are better suited to handing out gifts...
So this is the winter festival of Askr... I remember it well, from the days fore I donned this mask.

This mask isn't a costume for the festival masquerade, but I will allow the children to think what they will.
It is not my place to correct them.
Each gift is met with a smile, and each smile, something precious... That much I can understand.
I must take care not to give someone else the gift I chose for Veronica...
Visit: My name is— No, I'd better not. Here is a winter-festival gift, from [F]. Take it.
Level: Now that I've committed, there's no turning back. We will make this an unforgettable winter festival.
Instead of looking to see behind my mask, why not simply enjoy the winter festivities?
Ugh. All the eyes on me have put me off balance...
Summon: My name is of no importance. I am simply an attendee, here to enjoy the winter festival.
Learn Skill: I know I have caused you concern. I hope my actions from here on will quell any worry.
Confession:
I've just finished delivering gifts as part of the winter festival.
There is no difference between the snow that falls in the Emblian Empire and the snow here in Askr, I find.
Just as there is no real difference in the kind, warmhearted smiles shared between citizens in each nation...
I ought to take my leave, however. If Alfonse and Sharena were to see me here, it may be troublesome.
...Ah. I see there are still some gifts left to deliver—and gifts for Alfonse and Sharena, no less.
I can only pray I find them already asleep. I'll have to remain on guard until the festival's close, it seems...
Status: Another costume? Is a change of attire really so diverting?
Huh? Do you mean to seek a gift as well?
If the gifts are sufficiently hefty, delivering them could be considered training. In a sense.
I am not hiding. I am simply waiting for Alfonse to pass.
Even a fleeting moment of calm is to be valued.
This is for Veronica. In truth, I do not know if she will like it.
To spend a night so serene with you... I will not soon forget it.

fshez2.name: Shez
fshez2.title: Sharpest Blades
fshez2.description: Mercenary that throws herself into the battles of Fódlan. Defeated countless foes and led many allies to victory. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: I wonder if anyone in this world has powers like mine... I mean, it is a pretty strange place.
There's no end of wars here, huh? Not that Fódlan was much better... Yeah, there are always forces at play.
Hm? I'd be happy to hang around for a while if you want to chat. I've been there before, so I get how you feel.

Ughhh... All this standing around is gonna kill me. Maybe we could do some weapon maintenance?
Or, and just hear me out, we could try thinking up a brand new dish. Come on, it'd be fun!
Over the past few years, I've had to interact with all sorts of nobles. You get used to it after a while.
Visit:
You're [S], right?
Looks like what I heard was right on the money. You're a pretty interesting person, you know that?
Level: Definitely getting stronger.
I've still got a ways to go.
I'm not stopping anytime soon.
Summon: Oh... You called for me, huh. Name's Shez. With these blades, I'll cut a path for you through the battlefield.
Learn Skill: I'll take whatever power I can get. Maybe this'll be enough to win.
Confession:
This place sure is different from Fódlan. They both have battles, but the ones here are...unreal.
Still, fighting alongside you has taught me a few things, and I know I've gotten stronger.
At first, I would have just thought of this like any other job and not even bothered to celebrate victory.
But now? Now, I find that the future of this world is as important to me as the future of Fódlan.
So I'm gonna achieve victory in both worlds. No matter how impossible, I'll find a way. Just you watch.
Special: I'll put you in your place!
Status: I have no idea what this blade is made of.
Uh, hey! Could you stop doing things that scare me half to death? Thanks.
Mmm, no. I'm no good at art or anything like that.
If you want to keep spirits high on the battlefield, make sure everybody is well-fed.
I was alone for a long time, but these days, I have the kind of friendships that aren't easy to come by.
Mhm... I need to move.
I can't be pragmatic when it comes to you. My feelings take over. I'm sure you've noticed.

askr2.name: Askr
askr2.title: Renewed Gods
askr2.description: The gods Askr, of the opened kingdom, and Embla, of the closed kingdom. They have arrived together to ring in the new year.
askr2.duo:
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+6 to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn, and grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit and those allies.
At start of every third turn, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.

Castle Hall: **Askr**: Ringing in the new year with Heroes of all sorts in attendance is a fitting celebration for the Kingdom of Askr!
**Askr**: Embla, there was once a time that you, too, enjoyed celebrating the new year with mortals. I've not forgotten!

**Askr**: Look, Embla... They play a game in which the victor may draw on the face of their opponent!
Which of the many worlds did that one tradition come from, I wonder...

**Embla**: Mortals... Ever the self-centered creatures, abandoning what they leave behind without a thought...
Why celebrate what is to come? It will surely fall by the wayside soon enough.
**Embla**: Given even the slightest opportunity, Askr cannot help but succumb to his desire to speak to me... It never ends.
Visit: Happy New Year's! May your bond with [F] flourish!
Level: **Embla**: I will mark this new year upon the face of whoever is foolish enough to face me! Hm-hm-hmh-ha-hah...
**Askr**: Good fortune comes to those who enter the new year with a smile! So...will you join me, Embla?
**Embla**: This...this is the true nature of the coming year...
Summon: Happy New Year! I look forward to all the new faces we will meet in the new year! Don't you agree, Embla?
Learn Skill: **Embla**: Wh-what is your aim here? Do you think some meager tribute would be enough to change my heart?
Confession:
**Askr**: It seems that making a New Year's resolution is a way to determine a path for the coming year...
What do you intend to make of your year, Embla?
**Embla**: What does it matter? My mind is filled with thoughts of the inevitability of mortals perishing as I look on...
**Askr**: Ah! So you plan to use this coming year to watch over them? I always knew you were gentle at heart!
**Embla**: No, you misunderstand... I would never put forth such effort for the sake of mortals...
I wish only to be closed away—away from interaction with everyone and everything. And yet, with you...
Being in your presence makes me feel as if I am losing my mind...
**Askr**: I do wish that you have a wonderful year, Embla. Truly, from the bottom of my heart.
Status: "There's the Embla I know!" "Stop talking."
Conversation: **Embla**: Hm-hm-hmh-ha-hah...
**Askr**: Enjoying yourself, are we, Embla? Care to let me in on the joke?
**Embla**: These mortal fools...so peculiar...
With their short lives, every new year is one step closer to death.
Yet still they celebrate each year all the same! How can you not laugh at them?
**Askr**: They are making the most of what time they do have by celebrating!
Their celebration is beautiful! Though, I understand it must leave you feeling lonely...
**Embla**: It does no such thing.
**Askr**: I know you, Embla. I know you have always loved the mortals. You cherish them, yearn to keep them close...
Because their lives are short, you fear a future where they step out of your reach.
**Embla**: Ridiculous! I would never.
Do not pretend to know me better than I know myself.
**Askr**: I would not go so far as to say I do. I simply know the part of your heart you've closed off and hidden away.
Be it this year, next year, or some year far in the future, I will reach that part of you again someday.
But until that day comes, I have faith your true self is in there—and that I will meet her again.
**Embla**: Askr, you...are completely unbearable.
**Askr**: Hah! So I may be! Let us celebrate that as well!

ash2.name: Ash
ash2.title: Earnest Greetings
ash2.description: Retainer to Askr. She welcomes the new year with gratitude.

Castle Hall: I'm told this style of kimono is a New Year's tradition. I am overcome by the austere dignity of the garment...
I would like to wish you well in this coming year, and express how glad I am to be here, celebrating with you.
All the New Year's food is particularly delicious... I do hope you can forgive me for succumbing to my sleepiness.
There is a rumor about some special gift for the new year... Can you tell me about— Oh! It's for children. I see.

I've learned of a game that results in the loser getting their face marked with scribbles of ink...
A game played with a Hero's dignity on the line is quite the ruthless New Year's custom, I must say!
Visit: Please allow me to humbly offer you most sincere well-wishes on behalf of [F].
Level: I am reminded of the first sunrise of the new year. I will strive for greater heights in light of this blessing!
I hope to remain satisfied with the lot that befits my station, and to not be burdened with ambitious wanting...
This is rather unpleasant... I hope this is not an ill portent for the remainder of this year. I must be more diligent!
Summon: Greetings and happy New Year's to you. I, Ash, offer you my most sincere well-wishes as retainer to Lord Askr.
Learn Skill: I will do everything I can to repay this kind gift by making good use of it on the battlefield!
Confession:
Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for inviting me to this lovely New Year's celebration.
The sight of all the extravagant foods was almost too much for me. There are so many options to choose from!
I suppose I am taking a roundabout way to wish you a happy New Year... What I mean to say is that...
New Year's in Askr was a true joy, the feast was delicious, and thank you for inviting me! And happy New Year's.
...Yes, I think that summed up my feelings on the matter. I hope I was as clear as I intended.
At any rate, I will work even more diligently this year, and will devote myself to being more help to you all.
Hm... I may have managed to still use more words than necessary, but...you understand, don't you?
Status: Please allow me to humbly offer you my most sincere well wishes on the occasion of the new year.
Oh no! Did I make a mistake in the process of dressing myself? This is a complicated (if lovely) garment.
This kimono is so elegant and well made… I feel as if perhaps it may not befit one such as myself.
The various New Year's celebrations across the many worlds are all so intriguing. I find myself enthralled.
With all the treats available here, I am nearing the point where I must retire...
I am so deeply happy to be able to celebrate the coming new year with everyone here—and that Lord Askr could join the festivities as well.
This year I will strive to become a greater asset to you, and to remain diligent in that pursuit.

elm2.name: Elm
elm2.title: Resolute Grouch
elm2.description: Retainer to Embla. Has roused himself enough to take a passing interest in the festivities.

Castle Hall: I'm here, so go ahead and show me how to "welcome the new year" and enjoy whatever there is to enjoy.
I was created to serve Lady Embla. We had no reason to celebrate the arrival of a new year.
These clothes restrict my ability to move properly—but I must wear them if I am to get my New Year's gift...
I am here as Lady Embla's retinue. Do not think I would stoop so low as to seek out your meager gifts.
Making sport of dignity is a fine idea. So, I return this odd object using the paddle? The cow will soon be inked!
Visit: If you wish to receive your New Year's greeting, you ought to speak to [F] yourself.
Level: Those who dare get in my way will receive no mercy this year.
I will be of value to Lady Embla again this year—as with every year.
Is this the luck I should expect all year long? ...Damn!
Summon:
I am Elm, servant of Lady Embla. The purpose of my wearing this attire is simply so I may join her.
I expect you to entertain us appropriately for the trouble.
Learn Skill: Is this what they've been referring to as a New Year's gift? It isn't nearly as bad as expected.
Confession:
Mortals get so excited by this New Year's event, yet I find myself only disappointed with it all.
The kimono is restrictive, many of the "festivities" are done outside in the cold... Who could enjoy this?
Of course, you may think I have had some measure of fun, but I assure you that it is all an act.
I merely played my part, expecting to be given a gift of money for my efforts, but...
I was given barely enough to justify the tiny envelope it's carried in! It is far worse than I could have expected.
And I suppose you will be denying responsibility for it all!
Well, so as not to put my efforts to waste, I will allow you one more chance to deliver on your end.
Now, swear you will do your duty and repay me for my attendance!
Status: What is it about the new year that makes you expect a greeting from me?
Enough! Do not dare touch me again!
Ash is asleep standing up! I should go tip her over.
This kimono is so uncomfortable. It binds me. I better not have to wear it next year.
It's customary to exchange New Year's gifts, isn't it? ...Well? Let's have it!
I hope you're enjoying the festivities, Lady Embla...
I imagine I have at least another year in your service—based on how badly you need my help.

panne2.name: Panne
panne2.title: Welcoming Dawn
panne2.description: One of the taguel, who can transform into rabbits, celebrating in New Year's garb. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I normally prefer clothing that is easy to move around in, but I can make an exception to celebrate the New Year.

The history between taguel and humans is a sad one, and yet, here we are.
We can still come together to celebrate the New Year and wish for a happier future.
This New Year's dish has lots of carrot in it. What did you say it was called? Osechi? Hmm...
Do taguel hibernate in the winter? At the very least, I certainly don't. I doubt Yarne does either.
Taguel don't usually wear very thick clothing, but Yarne doesn't look bad in that kimono.
Visit: Don't get negligent just because it's a holiday. That said, here—a gift for you from [F].
Level: A sign of good things to come. Still, carelessness can ruin even the best of starts.
There is a future where we survive. With my allies at my side, I will fight this year as well.
That's not good. At this rate, I won't even survive the year...
Summon: I am Panne. I'm glad to be here celebrating the New Year with you.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks. With this power, I will cut a path through the new year.
Confession:
Whether it's the old year or the new, danger is unavoidable. It creeps up on you, waiting for a chance to strike.
As long as Yarne and I are alive, we taguel will always be in danger. I am prepared for that much, at least.
But...I have no intention of forcing anyone else to make the same commitment.
Everyone here is so excited about the new year, after all... It's probably not what I should be dwelling on.
You don't need to worry. I am simply enjoying the holiday in my own way. It is a new year, after all.
So, let us struggle, fight, and survive, so that we and all our allies can celebrate the next one.
Special: The best for a new year!
Status: Happy New Year. That's what you say, right?
Oh, I didn't hear your footsteps. Not bad.
Is there really such a thing as a year of the rabbit? Then, wouldn't that make it our year?
You want to pet a rabbit? Does it have to be me? I got all dressed up for this!
I'd like to start the year off with lots of carrots. Can you cook something like that?
These clothes look nice, but they're a bit uncomfortable. I can't move around like I'm used to...
I hope that we will be able to enjoy this year together as well.

yarne2.name: Yarne
yarne2.title: Hoppy New Year
yarne2.description: One of the taguel, who can transform into rabbits. Excited to hear about the large role rabbits play in this year's festivities. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: HAPPY NEW YEAR! Feels nice to just yell sometimes, right? I definitely feel safer knowing I can call for help.
In my world, we didn't have the time to celebrate the new year. It took everything we had just to survive...
The year of the rabbit in your world is once every twelve years, right? That's a lot of years...
This kimono is nice and all, but it's kind of hard to move around in. What if someone attacks me?
Mother really looks good in a kimono! So confident and beautiful... I'm proud to be her son.
Visit: Hey there! I've got a New Year's gift and well wishes for you from your friend [F].
Level: Not sure why, but I'm feeling really good this year! At this rate, I'll be safe from extinction!
W-well, the year has only just begun. It's OK to take it slow and steady.
Oh, no... This is really, really bad. Sorry, Mother, I couldn't save the taguel from extinction...
Summon: My name is Yarne. I've heard that this is the year of the rabbit, so I'll try to keep a hop in my step all year.
Learn Skill: This'll be perfect for avoiding any danger! ...That is what it's for, right?
Confession:
Something about a new year just makes me want to jump around. Like, boing!
After all, a new year means I survived the last one! So here's hoping nothing bad happens this year either.
It's not all bad to go in blind, though. Otherwise, I wouldn't be so excited right now.
That said, I can't be careless! A rash taguel can meet their end in the blink of an eye!
But I'm going to survive this year, along with Mother. Side by side, as mother and son.
Needless to say, I'll be counting on you, [S]!
Status: A new year has begun! Let's make it a good one, OK?
Ah! Hey, watch it! These ears are off limits!
There's a "Year of the Rabbit" in your world? *gasp* Rabbits get a whole year?
My Anti-Extinction Exercise Program is the perfect way to start the year on the right foot! One, two, one, two...
Oh, this? It's a talisman meant to ward off extinction.
*sniffle* Check it out—Mother gave me a New Year's gift!
You know, it's scary not knowing what the new year might bring...but I'm still gonna give it my all!

linde3.name: Linde
linde3.title: Bound by Fate
linde3.description: Linde, dressed in the robes of the Khadein school of magic, joined by Sara. They bond over the tragedy in their pasts. They appear in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem / Thracia 776.
linde3.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】,【Dodge】, and "Special cooldown charge +1 per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack)" to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Dodge】 If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 4 (max 40%).

Castle Hall: **Sara**: It seems to me that you, too, harbor a great sadness, Linde. But you endure, for you are strong.
**Linde**: The great Gotoh founded Khadein's College Arcane as a sanctuary for study. My father was his disciple.
**Linde**: If this is the traditional garb of Khadein, then the robe my father gave me...is lovely too!
**Sara**: Staying in this castle is stifling. Linde, let's go for a walk.
**Linde**: The College Arcane was so important to my father. I must do what I can to uphold its name.
Visit: **Sara**: I am Sara. I was walking with Linde when I heard a voice calling to me... It wasn't your voice, though.
Level: **Linde**: Amazing! You're right, Sara. Together, we're practically invincible!
**Linde**: Garbed in the attire of Khadein, I can channel its glory into my magic!
**Sara**: Ugh. Kicked up some pebbles...
Summon: I am Linde, mage of Archanea. Sara and I have joined forces. What, this? It's more comfortable than it looks.
Learn Skill: **Sara**: I am pleased you are well. Shall we take a walk? With Linde, of course.
Confession:
**Sara**: I, the granddaughter of the archbishop of the Loptr Church. You, the daughter of Pontifex Miloah.
I feel that fate binds us, in a way...
**Linde**: Sisters who inherited powers coveted by many... At times, I feel I am being crushed by the weight of this destiny.
**Sara**: As do I. Power can drive people mad. Good people, bad people— it doesn't matter.
**Linde**: Can we escape fate? Will I become like the Dark Pontifex, Gharnef? My father's foe?
**Sara**: No. No matter how powerful, the individual makes the choice. Don't you agree?
**Linde**: You're right, Sara. Even if our paths were laid down by others, we are the ones who walk them.
Status: • "How do you like the fashion of Khadein?" • "I can...understand its appeal."
Conversation: **Linde**: Looks like the Khadein festival has been a success! I couldn't be happier.
**Sara**: So I see. Why is that?
**Linde**: It's only natural. My father was a renowned pontifex.
The great Gotoh entrusted him with the Aura tome...even Khadein itself!
Khadein will always have a special place in my heart.
**Sara**: Oh, I see. I know little of my own father, so I cannot truly understand.
**Linde**: Ah...I'm sorry. I got caught up in the mood.
**Sara**: No need to apologize. It is not as if your unhappiness would make me happy.
**Linde**: Well... Even if you know nothing about your father at all, you can still remember him, in a way.
He lives on in whatever he left you— your talent for magic, perhaps. Or even just the color of your eyes.
**Sara**: I take no pleasure in my magic. It only means my grandfather can use me as a tool for his convenience.
But I suppose it's comforting to think that when I look at myself, I am seeing some part of my father.
**Linde**: Well, there you go. We can call that his gift to you.
**Sara**: It seems arbitrary to simply...decide that. I don't even know if the thought is particularly helpful.
**Linde**: It is if you believe it!
**Sara**: I can see that you are trying to cheer me up. Next time think before you speak.
Still, I thank you. Your voice is remarkably lovely.

ursula3.name: Ursula
ursula3.title: Royal-Blue Crow
ursula3.description: Ursula, dressed in the robes of the Khadein school of magic. Also known as the Blue Crow of the Black Fang assassins. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: All these scholars gathered to study... Noisy, aren't they? Irritating.
Though this is a different world, the essence of magic is the same. I must report this to Lord Nergal.
None in the Black Fang could match my magical talent, but perhaps the mages of Khadein will come close.
I can't seem to reach the highest shelf... Would you mind helping me? You'd make the perfect footstool.
What do you need? I'm quite busy with my surveillance duties.
Visit: I was tasked with delivering the "eternal regards" of your friend [F]. That was it.
Level: Let us dedicate this victory to Lady Sonia! Her perfection is the shining example I strive for!
This was a worthwhile learning experience. Now for the next one.
I can offer no excuse. Results are what matter.
Summon: I am Ursula. As you can see, I am studying the magic of Khadein. I hope that I meet your expectations.
Learn Skill: I don't wish to take in impure power, but... It would be unnatural for me to refuse. I will accept this—for now.
Confession:
Hello, Summoner. I am always happy to hear from you... So tell me, do you like this outfit?
Ah, but I suppose you're too busy wondering why I came all this way, dressed like this, no less.
What am I plotting? What is my true mission here? Given my history, those questions are only natural.
Still, there is no need to be so guarded. Relax, for you are not my target. At least...not today.
Truth be told, I am simply here out of curiosity. What is it that YOU desire? Not that I would fulfill it, of course.
Instead, I will show you exactly why the Blue Crow's skills shone as the greatest among the Black Fang.
I once served beauty and power, but now... I serve you. So, enough of that blank look. I demand awe.
Status: You have my thanks for the invitation. This festival should prove quite fruitful.
At least try to make sure your naiveté does not get you killed.
No amount of effort by human refuse can lead to improvement.
Being able to wield magic this powerful is proof that I was chosen to lead.
Now then, who do I have to kill around here to get my hands on a powerful tome?
Lady Sonia... I will become like you...
I'll remain loyal…as long as you keep striving for perfection.

nino4.name: Nino
nino4.title: Spirited Sorcerer
nino4.description: Nino, dressed in the robes of the Khadein school of magic, bursting with excitement over the chance to attend a school for her first time. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Didja know that at this school you're more respected for the classes you take instead of your age?
That green-haired student said it may be best that people don't know I can commune with spirits. Wonder why?
Hey, you're doing great! You deserve a break. Let me grab you some water!
I'm so inspired by all the fancy books here! Do you think even I could write a book someday?
They say you gotta rest your mind just like your body. So make sure to take it easy after all your hard work!
Visit: Oh, hi! You're the summoner, right? The name's Nino! Here on behalf of [F].
Level: If it means creating a more peaceful world, I'll do my best to stand and fight by your side!
Hope everyone's watching, 'cause I'm going all out!
Uh, what? Guess I kinda messed up...
Summon: Hi, I'm Nino! I may not be great at studying, but I'll work hard to learn as much as I can!
Learn Skill: Wow, thank you! I'm gonna— Uh, I mean, I shall perform to the best of my ability!
Confession:
Growing up, I didn't spend much time with kids my own age. But I always dreamed of going to school.
It sounds pretty nice to learn from wise teachers, doesn't it? Oh, and also to play with friends!
I've always wanted to create the kind of world where people didn't have to live in fear and uncertainty.
A world where kids can study and fall in love without a care. Everyone should be able to live like that.
So I gotta work even harder to make it happen! I can count on your help, right, [S]?
Special: I'll show ya what I can do!
Status: I love festivals. I couldn't get to sleep last night at all!
*gasp* Oh, it's just you.
They say Khadein is a town where people study magic! Did'ya know that?
If I studied really hard, could I help even more? Oh, I hope so.
I'm better at reading than I used to be. Everybody's been so kind to help me.
Festivals would be even more fun if my brothers could go...
The time I spend with you is just plain fun! You're a good friend.

mbyleth3.name: Byleth
mbyleth3.title: Fount of Learning
mbyleth3.description: Byleth, dressed in the robes of the Khadein school of magic, with plans to demonstrate the teaching methods of Garreg Mach. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: My students clearly have something to say about my look, but whenever I ask they simply avoid the question.
I don't use much flourish or detail when I write. It's probably because I was raised as a mercenary.
I have heard that Khadein's magic is strong against dragons. From what I've seen, I do believe it.
All I know about strategy and tactics, I learned from my father. I can pass those lessons on to you, if you'd like.
Mages should not neglect physical conditioning. Concentration is a function of the body's stamina.
Visit: Hello. In the spirit of your continued friendship, I bring you greetings from [F].
Level: Follow your convictions. Listen to your intuition.
We all contributed. Now, let's do it again.
No need to rush things. Let's take our time to ensure we get results.
Summon: I am Byleth. I have some experience as an instructor, if that is something you would find useful.
Learn Skill: I feel the hand of the goddess guiding me toward something new.
Confession:
As a mercenary, I learned early on in life to accept that people die. It's the cold reality of the battlefield.
The more time I spend teaching, however, the more my perspective seems to change.
I don't want that for my students. I want them to be safe and happy. And I...don't want to lose them.
I'm sure you have a similar motive to fight. You strike me as that sort of person, [S].
I imagine, as we spend time together, I will begin to feel that way about you as well. I suppose we'll find out.
Special: This is a place of learning.
Status: This festival should prove interesting. I appreciate the invitation.
What are you doing? Is this some kind of tradition I don't know about?
I imagine that a city devoted to the study of magic must be full of wonders.
For the sake of my students, I must use this sabbatical to learn as much as I can.
A festival is a gathering for the enjoyment of its participants. Let's observe.
It is a strange twist of fate, my being here. Yet I sense the goddess's hand in it, somehow.
I promise you this: I will always use my power to strive for greater heights, no matter the circumstances.

soren4.name: Soren
soren4.title: Wind of Tradition
soren4.description: Soren, dressed in the robes of the Khadein school of magic, struggling to hide his confusion over the garb's significance. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: If magic was originally designed to fight dragons, the designers were fools. Look at the conflict it's led to.
I learned magic before I learned to speak. You could say magic is more my native tongue than any language.
Who did she mean by "green-haired wind mage"? Sothe has green hair and is called Zephyr, but he's no mage...
Did you need something?
I have been asked to stand in as an instructor, so I am compiling my notes on wind magic.
Visit: I have something for you. It's from [F]. Here.
Level: It doesn't matter where or how you learn to fight. As long as you defeat your enemy.
A leader can't afford to obsess over small details. Focus on the full scope of the battlefield.
Don't let your feelings get in the way. We will move past this.
Summon: My name is Soren. I am a mage. This outfit may signify that, but my magic is just as strong in any clothing.
Learn Skill: If I am to use this, then I would first like to know precisely what you expect me to do with it.
Confession:
I probably don't need to reiterate this, but just in case you need a reminder... We are not friends.
I'm sure that doesn't trouble you terribly much. I've noticed you have no shortage of allies.
Personally, I have no need for that. My loyalty lies with only one person. He is why I cooperate with you.
For whatever it's worth, I do find you curious. Many seem to adore you, even though you use them as pawns.
I wonder if that is the result of some kind of power. And if so, what I might learn by studying you.
So, for the time being, consider us to be...close acquaintances. I will look forward to working more with you.
Status: Another festival? I'm not much for social gatherings.
Are you trying to get a rise out of me? Really?
I'm not opposed at all to learning. I'd simply prefer to do it on my own.
I didn't learn magic by choice. Still, I consider myself fortunate to have the ability.
I will study any magic that has the potential to be useful to Ike.
Magic is a tool for survival. Nothing more.
If it will benefit you to learn from my wisdom, I suppose I can spare the time.

alfred.name: Alfred
alfred.title: Floral Protector
alfred.description: Crown prince of Firene, a peace-loving land. He trains constantly with the intent of improving his constitution. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Since coming to Askr, I've been feeling great! If I can hold on to that, I know I can be of use to you.
Firene is a peaceful kingdom, full of flowers. I'd love to show you around Florra Mill Town someday!
Do I see some big muscles hiding under that robe? No? Well, let's train and bulk up together!
I've heard of a beautiful flower garden here in Askr. Would you like to go? We could run there—then it's training too!
Hup! Hup! Yes! Training went smoothly today. Check out that definition!
Visit: I'm Firene's crown prince, Alfred! I jogged right over to give you this. It's from [F].
Level: Great results. Take a look at my muscles and you'll see why!
Not bad! My muscles are singing a happy tune!
Sometimes things just work out this way. That's all there is to it.
Summon: I'm Alfred, crown prince of Firene. As soon as you summoned me, I dashed here with all my might!
Learn Skill: If you give me something, I'll make use of it. That's why I'm training so hard.
Confession:
Hey there! I was just thinking about you, and here you are. Lucky me!
I've gotten even stronger since I got here—big gains! And that's thanks to you. To think that I was worried...
Summoned to fight, all that stress and strain... I thought it would take its toll on me!
Turns out I had nothing to fear. Even when I've been down, you're there. With your support, I'm staying strong!
What I mean to say is, you have my thanks. My strength is your strength. I wish you luck!
Status: I have been making big gains lately! Nice of you to notice!
Yeah, I'm still working on my arms. They'll bulk up soon though, you'll see.
I feel like I'm getting to know you. Hey, how about we go for a run? Friends always train together.
My kingdom, Firene, was entrusted with the ring of Emblem Celica. Maybe you've heard of her?
I usually get fresh flowers for my crown when they start to wilt. Ever since I got to Askr, though, they just...haven't.
I've seen some Heroes with amazingly huge muscles around here! I need to learn their secrets.
I'm happy to spend time with you, if you'd like to sit and chat. Oh, are you feeling sleepy? Let me sing you a lullaby!

falear.name: Alear
falear.title: Dragon Child
falear.description: Successor to the Divine Dragon, awoken from a long sleep. Summons Emblems to lead the world to peace. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Can I try to engage with you? It may not work, but it's worth a shot. Emblem engage! Hmm, nope.
My mother was everything a Divine Dragon should be. I will honor her last wish and bring peace to Elyos.
That weapon of yours looks a little tarnished. Want me to polish it up for you?
I saw the most adorable owl earlier! Do you think anyone would mind if I adopted her?
Hm? Sorry, I must have nodded off. You have a very gentle way of waking people up, you know. It's nice.
Visit: I am the Divine Dragon Alear. I came here to honor the bond between you and [F].
Level: I hope to be as strong as my mother one day.
As long as I'm improving, I'm happy.
Sorry, everyone...
Summon: I'm the Divine Dragon Alear. I never imagined I'd be called upon like this, but I'm here to help however I can.
Learn Skill: Thank you so much. I promise to use this to help protect everyone.
Confession:
Thought I might find you here. This is where you come to rest after a battle, isn't it, [S]?
Hm? How do I know? Well, I've been watching you, to get to know you better. Want to know what I've seen?
You're a wonderful person. In fact, the more we work together, the more you remind me of the Emblems.
Maybe it's just our connection, our bond of friendship, that reminds me of how I felt around them.
It's that warmth I think of, more than any ring. That feeling you get when you're sure someone is there for you.
So, I want to be that for you as well. I want to be by your side, protecting you to the end. Consider it a promise.
Special: I am guided by the Emblems.
Status: I'd like to be as much of a help to you as the Emblems were to me.
Oh! Hi! Good to see you.
The sky is gorgeous here. Sometimes I feel like I'm back on the Somniel.
Some of the Heroes here look an awful lot like certain Emblems I know. I can't wait to talk to them!
Want to hear a secret? I only ever get bed head on the blue side of my hair.
I don't know if I'll ever get used to not having an Emblem Ring...
How do I merge with an Emblem? I just shout "Emblem, Engage!" Go on, give it a try. You never know.

celine.name: Céline
celine.title: Joyous Royal
celine.description: Princess of Firene and Alfred's younger sister. She has a gentle demeanor and a particular love for tea. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall:
Many of the Heroes who preceded me here are the dignified sort.
But there are also many who appear to be quite strong... My brother is sure to be pleased by that.
My country is both beautiful and peaceful. My duty is to understand what sacrifices maintain it as such.
Would you care to join me for tea? I have some here with me... Just a drop of honey makes it truly superb.

There is some time before our next battle, so I hope to use it to find some small joys here.
Are there four-leafed clovers in this world, by chance?
Would you be so kind as to show me to the library? I would like to learn more about Askr while I'm here.
Visit: Hello, my name is Céline. I have the joyful task of delivering greetings from [F].
Level: Such joys can be overwhelming, but I am grateful for them all the same.
Wonderful. This is the strength I have hoped to develop as princess.
Next time, I will seek to gain the strength I need in the fight for peace.
Summon: I am Céline, princess of Firene. In the fight for peace, I will bring to bear all the luck and strength I am able.
Learn Skill: It feels as if my heart is all abloom... I will not disappoint the faith you've placed in me.
Confession:
I'm so glad you agreed to join me for tea, [S].
It's always a joy when we're able to spend time together like this.
You know, there is something about you that reminds me of the Divine Dragon...
Perhaps it is your divine weapon, and your power to summon Heroes into the world.
Whatever the reason may be, I feel I can trust you completely—which is a rare thing indeed.
A peaceful kingdom like Firene is at risk if it allows itself to be taken advantage of.
For that reason, I am cautious when it comes to those who hail from other countries, but with you...
Well, I hope you don't mind, but it would bring me joy to think of you as my ally—and close friend. Heh heh...
Special: I will do what I must.
Status: You have much in common with both the Emblems and the Divine Dragon. Quite the mystery, you are.
Oh, would you like to have tea? Very well, what shall we brew today?
Tell me more about the Order of Heroes. What are some of your guiding principles?
I hope that my aid can bring happiness to this land.
All of these Heroes… This castle is a riot of flowers in bloom. How delightful!
In truth, I do miss Elyos. But I will do what I must for Askr while I am here.
Your happiness must stem from all the wonderful friends that surround you. I hope I may count myself among them.

chloe.name: Chloé
chloe.title: Fairy-Tale Flier
chloe.description: Royal knight of Firene and retainer to Princess Céline. Descended from a noble line, she also loves fairy tales and folk food. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: There are so many delightful Heroes here. Princes, princesses, knights— and all so well-dressed!
As Princess Céline's retainer, I feel compelled to protect her at any cost. I'm sure you understand what I mean.
If you're tired, some fried snake eyes should pep you right up. Oh, do they not make those here?
Hmm...who would look best standing by your side! Oh, I know! How about the Hero you summoned last?
Your divine weapon is so lovely. Not even my long-distance throwing compares to shooting shining orbs!
Visit: This castle reminds me of a fairy tale! You should go and take a look at [F]'s castle too.
Level: Like the moment of triumph at the end of a fairy tale!
I should treat myself to something tasty after all this hard work!
Sorry about that. It's hard to focus when I'm hungry...
Summon: I am Chloé, a royal knight of Firene. This place is beautiful! I think it would suit Princess Céline perfectly.
Learn Skill: You're giving this to me? Oh, I'm so happy! Thank you very much!
Confession:
Oh, I'm so sorry! Was I staring at you again, [S]?
I didn't mean anything by it. I just think you look picturesque in the company of all these Heroes.
Hm? You want me to be the one to keep you company today? Sure! That sounds great!
Spending time with you always feels like I'm getting a chance to take part in something magical.
So, what should we do? Do you want to go looking for folk food? I'd love to see you try something unique!
Status: I'm glad I was summoned by such a charming person.
Oh? No need to make conversation. I'm content to stand here and daydream.
Is there a folk-food stall around here? I want to know what unique things people eat in this world.
The Order of Heroes is altogether picturesque. The scenery, the Heroes... Together, they make for a charming sight!
You look just like a fairy-tale hero! If you stood next to a spirit or a prince, that would really complete the picture.
What I would do for a bite of grilled gecko, deep-fried snake, or... Oh! Sautéed fish eyeballs!
Being here, supporting you, I almost feel like an Emblem... I hope you know I'll always fight to protect my allies, whoever they are.

etie.name: Etie
etie.title: Fitness Fighter
etie.description: Royal knight of Firene and retainer to Prince Alfred. She is a noble lady who seeks out any opportunity to continually build her muscle. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Moving your body can cure what ails you... It's true! When I'm sad, I just go for a run. The problem solves itself!

Retainers of Firene answer to the queen. Growing up with Princess Céline, I thought I would serve her...
Imagine my surprise when I got a different assignment.
When your body gets worn out, you need to rest your muscles so they can recover. Why not give it a try?
I whipped up some new muscle balm. I made it with Askran ingredients that seemed good for sore muscles.
I'm planning to water the flowers... It can be a good workout if the watering can is full enough!
Visit: I ran all the way here to deliver you a friendly message from [F]!
Level: I'm full of energy! I hope I can make good use of it!
Results like this come naturally after putting in the work building muscles like these.
Oh no! Time to visit the training grounds, I guess.
Summon: I'm Etie, a royal knight of Firene and Prince Alfred's retainer. Can you... point me toward the training area?
Learn Skill: Thank you! This will make me stronger for sure.
Confession:
I appreciate you giving me a place to use my strength. So, let me say thank you, [S].
As a token of my gratitude, I would like to give you flowers from Firene, but they don't grow here, so...
I picked you some Askran flowers instead. I found them growing around the castle.
May they bring you strength and the eternal affection you deserve.
Anytime you need me, don't hesitate. My bow and my strength are yours.
Even if it's just to open a jar with a stuck lid, I'll come running!
Status: I like to build a lean physique to emphasize agility. Tone before bulk.
Hey, watch it! That arm's sore from lifting.
You're always running around. I respect that.
That divine weapon of yours looks like it's got some heft. Mind if I give it a try?
Is it teatime? Let me go get my weighted cups.
The flowers of Askr are beautiful, too. I’m so glad.
I'd love for you to see the fields where I'm from. They're full of beautiful flowers... I'll show you—on a nice, long run.

lumera.name: Lumera
lumera.title: Dragon Monarch
lumera.description: Divine Dragon Monarch, ruler of the holy land of Lythos. She is Alear's mother and the hero who once saved all of Elyos. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Here in Askr, I will finally be able to have the quality time with my child that I could not have before.
The Divine Dragons ruled Elyos for generations from a place called the holy land of Lythos.
The skies of Lythos and Askr may be connected somehow. Whatever the case, may peace reign under both.
I call upon the Emblems through the power of prayer. How does your summoning ability work, exactly?
What an interesting experience it is to meet Heroes who are nearly identical to the Emblems I know from Elyos.
Visit: I am the Divine Dragon Lumera. I am here to pass along the best wishes of your friend [F].
Level: As a Divine Dragon, I must always use my power responsibly.
If you desire it, then yes, I shall become stronger.
Let us await the next opportunity.
Summon: I am the Divine Dragon Lumera. I will fight for you, in the interest of peace. Is my child here too, by any chance?
Learn Skill: I am honored to receive this gift. I promise to use it well.
Confession:
Allow me to thank you from the bottom of my heart for this wonderful opportunity, [S].
In my own world, I know that I simply would have perished. But here, I can do so much more as a Hero.
My dreams can live on that much longer. I now have time to laugh, to cry...to be silly now and again.
Most importantly, I can spend time with the people I care about. And it is all thanks to you.
So, as I fight for peace in Askr, I look forward to more long talks like this with you. Shall we call it a promise?
Special: I am the Divine Dragon Queen!
Status: I hope I haven't kept you waiting.
Oh dear, is something the matter? Why don't we take a nice long walk, and you can tell me all about it?
I adore wildflowers. Do they bloom in this world as well?
If someone asked you the color of fire, what would you say? Red is the most obvious answer, but fire can be blue as well...
This garb has been the attire of the Divine Dragon Monarch for generations. I am honored to be wearing it.
I have not forgotten our promise, Alear. I will keep it, even in this new world.
I am certain the Emblems would answer your call. If you ever find yourself in possession of a ring, you need only say "Emblem Engage!"

fomortiis.name: Fomortiis
fomortiis.title: Demon King
fomortiis.description: The Demon King who once threatened all of Magvel before being defeated by five heroes and sealed in the Sacred Stones. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: The manaketes' power has waned. Morva has been subdued. All that remains is to shatter the stones...
Humans are demons' preferred prey. They are so wonderfully vulnerable to their own grief and resentment...
Does this form frighten you? Ha. I can take on another, if you so wish.
It is inconvenient to move about the castle in this form. Perhaps I should borrow the body of an Askran noble...
You still refuse to surrender, fragile prince? Even after your body and mind belong to me?
Visit: Hmm... Which is a more fitting vessel for me to possess? Shall I take you... or [F]?
Level: I will taint this pathetic land, corrupt these foolish humans, and reign for eternity as the Demon King!
Wither and rot under my destructive power! Face your demise if you dare! Approach the gates of my domain!
If your mood is influenced by these pointless fluctuations, then you are a miserably shallow fool.
Summon: Lament, weep, despair! Wail, scream, tremble! The Demon King is risen!
Learn Skill: A sensible one, you are. I shall remember your name.
Confession:
What is it you seek from the Demon King, [S]?
Eternal life? The resurrection of one you have lost? I am the master of death. Nothing is beyond me!
Of course, the corruption of life and death is evil. But why should we not seize the power of evil for ourselves?
Evil can never be destroyed. The Fire Emblem and the Sacred Stones can never vanquish it.
Let us grasp true darkness, you and I. Let us rise up, corrupt the land, and rule over all of these maggots!
Status: I am Fomortiis. I am returned.
You dare lay a hand upon me?
It was I who planted the seed from which Lyon's ambitions grew.
My deceit made Lyon my puppet, and oh, how he danced at the end of my strings.
Grado's disaster cannot be averted.
Do you still intend to oppose me, fragile prince?
Do not think yourself capable of containing me.

gotoh.name: Gotoh
gotoh.title: White Sage
gotoh.description: Legendary figure who granted gifts to humanity across the age, including the Khadein school of magic. Also known as the White Sage. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: My disciple Gharnef has a great talent for magic, but his heart has been consumed by darkness.
The Divine Dragon Naga sensed the decline of dragons. I now know she sought a balance with humans.
You need not worry over whether I have food or bed. Those who walk the path I do have no need of either.
And once this battle is over? Power can lead to corruption. If you so wish, I can teach you a way to shed it.
Stars and sunlight, darkness, night... Though this world is different, that which comprises it is still familiar.
Visit: I am Gotoh. I am here to serve those who seek knowledge. Though, I must say this is a far cry from my true form.
Level: I haven't felt like this since the wars long ago... I hadn't realized there was still room for my strength to grow!
Only those who can trust their own wisdom and courage can resist the darkness and follow the light.
Oh my... I seem to have stumbled. I wonder what Xane would say...
Summon: I am Gotoh, just an old man who grew weary of the world. Ask me questions you wish answered, and I will provide.
Learn Skill: At times, people can achieve feats beyond even the gods. Perhaps this is the fruit of such labors?
Confession:
The dragons, unable to contain their ever-growing power, had to give up on being dragons.
But the world was full of humans, and so the fight to lay claim to the dragon's legacy began.
Princess Tiki alone was hidden away to keep her from that world... But her contact with a human saved her.
I do not believe everything a person does is as just as one may be led to believe by listening to his words.
Even still...
Perhaps the Divine Dragon knew this was the way to save both dragons and humans from doom.
You, too, are a unique presence and are sure to play a grand part in this chaotic world.
I see you now, like a great dragon that conquers light and dark.
That balancing of the scales is what I once sought, as did the Divine Dragon herself. So...have faith.
Status: I am Gotoh. Allow me to offer what help I can.
Please! Don't creep up on me. My heart...
Men are foolish...and I had sworn to let the affairs of this world proceed without me. But now...
There are those who call me the White Sage.
Gharnef's flesh may have been destroyed, but his spirit remains, sustained by a deep-seated malice.
Marth, I entrust Tiki to your care. Please, do your utmost to ensure that she does not slip into the darkness…
Watching your struggles, I came to think that perhaps I was too hasty in my judgment.

elise4.name: Elise
elise4.title: Sweetheart Royals
elise4.description: Princess Elise of Nohr and Princess Sakura of Hoshido, arriving at the Day of Devotion wearing their brightest smiles. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.
elise4.duo:
Grants【Dominance】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit. Inflicts Def/Res-7 on foes within 3 columns or 3 rows centered on unit through their next actions.
【Dominance】 Unit deals additional damage = total penalties on foe for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Elise**: These Hoshidan sweets are called manju, right? They're so springy! I wonder if Nohr has the right flour...
**Elise**: Let's get something for your brothers too, Sakura! Ooo, I know! How about some of those berry-filled manju?
**Sakura**: Elise... We won't have enough sweets to give for gifts if you keep eating them all...
**Sakura**: Mmm, they really smell like peaches! And the colored wrappers were definitely worth the effort.
**Elise**: Mmm... I love these! So sweet, and just the right amount of tart!
Visit: Hi! Want to come celebrate the Day of Devotion? We'll wait for you at [F]'s castle!
Level: **Elise**: See how happy everyone looks? Love conquers all, Sakura!
**Elise**: You're always there to support me. I love that about you, Sakura!
**Sakura**: It's all right, Elise! I-I'm here with you.
Summon: I'm Princess Elise of Nohr, and this is Princess Sakura of Hoshido! We're here for the Day of Devotion festival!
Learn Skill: **Sakura**: Thank you for all you do for us! Elise and I will do everything we can to make this festival great.
Confession:
**Elise**: Looks like you got a whole pile of gifts for the Day of Devotion festival, [S]!
**Sakura**: Even just counting the Heroes alone, it's going to be hard to find the time to thank everyone.
**Elise**: That's a good point. Sakura and I both have big families, but that's nothing compared to this.
**Sakura**: Would you like some help? Elise and I could assist you in shopping for and doling out thank-you gifts.
**Elise**: Hey, great idea! That sounds like lots of fun!
**Sakura**: Hehe... I was hoping you'd say that.
**Elise**: We'll be the greatest thank-you team Askr has ever seen! All right then, let's get to it!
Status: "I'm glad we get to enjoy the festival together!" "Me too. It's a lot of fun."
Conversation: **Sakura**: Oh, don’t forget about this one...
**Elise**: And the last gift goes to...
Whew... That was the last gift, right?
**Sakura**: I think so. Getting presents for everyone in both our families has been a lot of work.
**Elise**: I know! I was worried we'd run out of good ideas by the end.
**Sakura**: Hehe... It's been fun, though.
I love to imagine everyone's happy faces as I pick out each gift.
It's so rewarding that...that it almost feels like a gift to myself.
**Elise**: Hehe, that's adorable, Sakura. It says a lot about you as a person too. That generosity's why I like you so much!
**Sakura**: Oh no, you don't have to say that. I wasn't fishing for a compliment...
**Elise**: Hehe, I know. I mean it, though. You're a great friend. Which reminds me—here!
**Sakura**: Wh-what's this? Did you get a present for me?
**Elise**: Yep! Just my way of saying thanks for being you. I hope we'll always be friends.
**Sakura**: I know we will! Actually, I was also... I mean...I got you this.
**Elise**: Wow, you got me a gift too?! Great minds really do think alike!
**Sakura**: Well... I was also thinking about what a great friend you are.
You mean a lot to me. I love you, Elise.

takumi5.name: Takumi
takumi5.title: Troubled Heart
takumi5.description: Prince of Hoshido, difficult to please as ever. He reluctantly joins the festival after receiving an invitation from his sister Sakura. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
It seems shallow to think you can show how much you care about someone by just giving them stuff.
But I guess it does feel pretty good to get a gift...

Peace between Nohr and Hoshido? Hmph, well...
Maybe if we can focus on each other as individuals rather than solely on where we're from...
I just realized that I have no clue what kind of gifts Oboro, Hinata, or even my siblings would actually like.
Don't really know what I'm looking for, but might as well start in town. Lead the way, [S].
Whoa! You scared me. Hey, eyes off the gifts! You'll get one in a second. Hope you like it, or whatever...
Visit: Says here this is a token of thanks from [F] to you.
Level: Who and what are most important to me? That's what the Day of Devotion seems to be all about.
Don't worry, I still have lots of gifts to hand out. Just keep the line orderly— hey, no pushing!
Jeez, they just keep coming! When I said I had gifts left, I meant a few, not a few hundred!
Summon: I'm Takumi, from the kingdom of Hoshido. What? I have to deliver gifts to everyone? What a pain...
Learn Skill: Oh, thanks. Why are you looking at me like that? Don't tell me you want a gift in return. *sigh* Fine...
Confession:
The Day of Devotion festival sounded kind of boring, to be honest. But I'm actually pretty glad I joined in.
It was nice to not only see happy faces, but to think about the people who have really helped me.
I know I don't come off very warm, so the festival was a handy excuse to show my appreciation.
It's easy to take things like kindness for granted, especially when you're in a position of royalty like I am.
I'm glad Sakura and Princess Elise invited me to do this with them. It'd feel so weird if I was on my own.
Anyway, that was a lot of words just to say "thanks" to you. For being one of those people looking out for me.
Status: Day of Devotion, huh? Fine, I guess...
Hey, watch where you're going! I almost dropped all these gifts.
Yeah, all right. I'll give the Nohrians peace—just for today.
I've got a box of Hoshidan sweets. Oh, you want to try one?
I just don't know what I'd do without Oboro and Hinata.
I hope everyone will be happy with what I got them...
Of course I got you a gift. Hope it's what you wanted—I can't read your mind.

leo4.name: Leo
leo4.title: Shrouded Heart
leo4.description: Prince of Nohr, both confident and proud. He reluctantly joins the festival after receiving an invitation from his sister Elise. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: It's just one festival after the other! I can't say I really have the time, but I suppose I must admit they're fun.
I can't speak to my competition, but I'm adept at selecting the right gift. Among my family, anyway.
So it's to be a competition, is it? To select the gift that resonates most? I shall receive the most ardent thanks!
