Yes, I can see how it would be tough to find a gift for me. Wait...don't tell me that you're fixated on tomatoes!
Oh, you are persistent. Trust me. I'm considering the ideal gifts for my family, retainers, and, yes, even you.
Visit: I have a Day of Devotion invitation to deliver. Let's see...the name [S] is inscribed.
Level: It is a festival, after all. We should enjoy it to the fullest. This celebration shall be magnificent!
I can see that you tried, but really... A gift like this simply can't touch the heart. Put some thought into it.
This is just how things turn out sometimes. There's no use getting worked up.
Summon: I am Leo of Nohr. This Day of Devotion is another test I shall pass with flying colors, no doubt.
Learn Skill: Did you choose this for me? You've got good taste—I'll give you that.
Confession:
Here we are. You are last on my list. It seems you have received a lot of gifts already, but mine is unique.
I have noted the sweet smiles and kind words that have come along with the gifts, so let me try...
Ahem. You always put me ahead of yourself, so I just wanted you to know I'm thinking about you too!
Don't you dare forget that you'll always mean the world to me, dear summoner!
What's with the look? Lost for words? Well... No matter! I must have melted your heart into a cute little puddle.
It's exceedingly rare that I express gratitude at all, so consider this festival a success indeed.
Just forking over a box of candy is a tired cliché, so I decided to spice things up. You should be overjoyed!
Status: The Day of Devotion, you say? I guess I could take part, if it means that much to you.
Come now, that's enough of that.
Family comes first, of course, but I also made time to get gifts for my retainers.
I'm rather confident in my ability to choose personalized gifts.
What do I like? Well, I enjoy tomatoes. Though I don't think a tomato would make a very good gift...
If we can learn to appreciate each other, then war may quickly fade.
Of course I have a gift for you! Did you think I'd forget? ...Hmph. Here.

hana3.name: Hana
hana3.title: Striving Heart
hana3.description: Samurai of Hoshido and retainer to Princess Sakura. She joins the festival to protect the princess she's served since childhood. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.
hana3.artist: Alan Smithee (阿藍澄史) / INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Castle Hall: I'm saving the best gift for Lady Sakura, but I've also got something for Subaki. He's earned that much.
Isn't this kimono great? I'd like to bring it back to the capital sometime, if I ever get the chance.
Getting gifts is nice, of course, but don't you think the gift givers are the ones actually having the most fun?

This festival's about showing your love and gratitude, right?
Sakura... I mean, Lady Sakura! I'm so glad I get to be here with you!
Hey! Knowing what the gift is ahead of time takes all the fun out of it!
Visit: Your friend sent me here to give you a token of their appreciation. I guess that makes me a messenger of love!
Level: This is so much fun! Way too much for just one person—I'm going to have to share it with everyone!
Oh, don't worry! I've got gifts for friends as well!
Oh no... Do you not like that flavor?
Summon: Hana, the messenger of love, is here! Even festivals are serious business, so I'll deliver these gifts in a flash!
Learn Skill: Today's a day for honesty, right? That's why...I'm grateful to you for everything you do!
Confession:
I gave a gift to Lady Sakura, and she said thank you, as always, but...do you know what she said after that?
She said, "The fact that you've become a great samurai makes me happier than any gift could." Really!
I just... How am I supposed to respond to that? I almost started crying right then and there!
Talk about unfair... I was trying to give her a gift, but she went and gave me something so much bigger.
It's moments like this that really remind me what I'm thankful for.
That's why I'm going to learn even more, so that I can be useful to Sakura—I mean, to Lady Sakura!
Oh, right! Here's your gift. It's my favorite: dried mandarin oranges! I promise you'll love them!
Status: Getting to attend the Day of Devotion festival with Lady Sakura is like a dream come true!
Ah! Hey, watch it! This is a gift for somebody!
Isn't this kimono beautiful? I just love the cherry-blossom pattern!
Do you even need to ask? Of course I've gotten a gift for Lady Sakura! Oh, and Subaki.
We could all be a bit better about expressing our gratitude more often.
Becoming a great samurai is the best gift I can give. I just hope that's enough...
Here, this is for you! As thanks for everything!

effie2.name: Effie
effie2.title: Dedicated Heart
effie2.description: Armor-covered knight of Nohr and retainer to Princess Elise. She joins the festival to protect her close friend whom she serves. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Everyone loves delicious food; maybe I should pick up some for a gift! And I am getting pretty hungry myself...
Do you know what kind of gift would show unwavering gratitude? It's gotta be...sturdy, so I don't break it.
Sounds like the festival feast is in full swing over there! Busting through the wall would be the quickest way in...
Lady Elise is so good at gift-giving. I hope I can reach her level one day!
Well, that's another one. No more soft or small gifts. I'll just break them all.
Visit:
Hey there! I've got a gift from [F] for you.
It might, uh, be a little broken...
Level: Time for a post-workout snack! Nope, not that. That's a gift for Lady Elise. Don't eat it, Effie... Don't eat it...
Oh, sorry for bumping into you like that! Here, I actually wanted to give you this gift.
Ah, shoot. Looks like I smashed the gift in my pocket... Again. *sigh*
Summon: I'm Effie. Looking forward to eating festival food and stretching my gift- giving muscles for Lady Elise!
Learn Skill: Wow, is this for me? Thank you! The Day of Devotion sure makes you feel warm and fuzzy.
Confession:
I pushed myself to my limits in order become a royal guard and protect Lady Elise. Now I'm her retainer.
But despite her position, she's still just as friendly when talking to me as when we were kids. She's so kind.
If I hadn't met Lady Elise, I'd still be in the slums of Nohr right now, with no hope of anything greater.
I have a hard time expressing how I feel with words. Maybe that's why this festival means so much to me.
Heh, to think the two of us once gobbled up stale crusts like they were a delicacy after we'd been playing...
I will never forget those days. Lady Elise hasn't changed a bit. This gift is but a small token of my gratitude.
I'd better go deliver it to her!
Status: The Day of Devotion... A festival where you shove gifts into the arms of your beloved, huh...
What? You got me a gift? I'm so pleased.
Lady Elise has done sooo much for me... I have always been so grateful.
I can't carry delicate gifts. I...fear I would just break them.
There's going to be a feast? Um... How nice! Heh.
I would like to express my love and gratitude to everyone, just as Lady Elise does.
I brought a gift for you too. I hope you like it.

elincia4.name: Elincia
elincia4.title: Devoted Queen
elincia4.description: Elincia, having overcome hardship. She leads Crimea backed by her conviction and the affection of her people. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall:
I am now the ruler of Crimea. I will not abandon that role. It is time to take all challenges in stride.
I will endure anything to build a better future for my people.

The discontent among the lords and populace was due to my lack of experience as a ruler.
I did not have the determination required of a queen.
I will not allow a single seed of future trouble to take root in the present. I will see that effort through.

Two successors—myself and King Pelleas—found two heroes, Lord Ike and the Silver-Haired Maiden.
It is almost unnatural...
War creates despair and hardens hearts. The Crimean people shall not be subjected to such horrors again.
Visit:
You are the esteemed summoner of this castle, yes? May your fortunes continue to grow.
Oh! My apologies. I come bearing warm regards from your ally, [F].
Level: May my light bathe the people of Crimea, and all those who call this world home, in its warm embrace.
Thank you, everyone. I am indeed the queen of Crimea, and a queen does not hide.
I will weep and tremble no longer. With everyone by my side, I have no other direction but forward.
Summon: The orphan of the late King Ramon, I am now queen of Crimea. I'm Elincia, and together we will chart our future!
Learn Skill: Thank you for your concern, Summoner. I assure you, I am well.
Confession:
I once thought if we could only repel Crimea's invaders, the kingdom would return to how it once was.
But that was not so. The people buckled under the weight of war, and lords obsessed over petty squabbles.
Countless wounds inflicted during the conflict slowly shredded the kingdom from the inside, leaving it to rot.
Further, those whose loved ones had been lost by Daein's hand demanded revenge, and how could I refuse?
The Crimea I knew was gone, throne stained with blood, and yet I was to rule as queen? I did not want that...
Even so, allowing it to be taken by someone with a wicked heart instead would only lead to more pain.
I could not ignore my culpability in Crimea's suffering. So I pledged the rest of my life in service to her.
Now, with my ever-loyal retainers at my side and the people's love at my back, we will chart out a new future.
Status: Onward.
With my allies beside me!
I was able to come this far because so many people believed in me.
I want to be more diligent in my training. Perhaps my lord Ike will help me.
Instead of cursing one's own powerlessness, it is critical to foster a desire to change and become stronger.
If I could save just one ally, it would mean so much to me.
I have ascended to a new strength. I vow to protect you.

geoffrey.name: Geoffrey
geoffrey.title: Realm's Protector
geoffrey.description: Paladin leader of the Royal Knights of Crimea. His loyalty for his homeland and Queen Elincia knows no bounds. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I am proud to serve my queen. To a knight of Crimea, such a responsibility imparts nothing short of joy.
I was awarded this set of silver tableware from His Majesty with my knighthood. I could never part with it.
The Royal Knights of Crimea will not waste a chance to improve ourselves. It is how we will avoid another defeat.

Mixing this powder imparts a specific color to my flares only discernible by our allies.
This allows me to command even distant soldiers.
This lance is a physical manifestation of my loyalty and honor. I daresay it is the most splendid in all of Crimea!
Visit: I am Geoffrey, a lance paladin of Crimea. Allow me to deliver a gift from [F].
Level: I will eliminate all obstacles in Queen Elincia's path toward Crimea's restoration!
Have you the will to surrender? Your life will be spared if you do. Her Majesty frowns upon needless death.
Do not panic! The enemy is looking for an opening. Should we act rashly now, we will fall right into their hands.
Summon: The leader of the Royal Knights of Crimea has arrived! Soldiers of the enemy, hear me and surrender at once!
Learn Skill: I am at a loss for words... Thank you. Apologies. I suspect Bastian could have said that much better than I did.
Confession:
I am hardly suited for the noble life. My older sister, Lucia, seems much more at home in the royal palace.
The title of House Delbray has felt like a weight on my back, if anything. But I am thankful for my origin.
First, it led me to meet my lifelong friend Bastian. Second, I met a queen deserving of my eternal loyalty.
How brightly did she illuminate all Crimea, even as a princess! Her radiance is difficult to describe...
With kindness and sagacity in equal measure, she can be summed up in a single word: perfect.
When the fighting became fierce and our overly optimistic plans fell apart, she rallied us on many an occasion.
Supporter became supported. I soon realized that Crimea and its people's burdens weighed heavily on her.
Bastian and Lucia realized this too. Indeed, I shed many a tear when she finally ascended to the throne.
It was then that I declared to the gods above my intention to serve and protect her with my life!
You must have a reason to fight, Summoner. Perhaps it is a topic for after the next battle ends.
Status: I am Geoffrey, commander of the Royal Knights of Crimea.
Ah! That was unexpected. I did not take you for the clandestine sort.
Come what may, I will remain by Queen Elincia's side. It is my honor and sworn duty.
Bastian may come off as insincere, but he is actually a considerate and reliable friend.
I would willingly die for my country. My sister would do the same.
Queen Elincia... I swear that l shall never leave your side again!
I will serve you in the same way I serve my liege. For you, I am prepared to lay down my life.

lucia.name: Lucia
lucia.title: Tireless Advisor
lucia.description: Daughter of Count Delbray and master of the blade. She supports Elincia, sharing a bond stronger than that of most siblings. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: There is no greater honor, and no greater joy, than to serve Her Majesty.

Our desire is to see the survival of the Crimean royal family, and above all, that of Queen Elincia.
My younger brother, Geoffrey, and I will accept no other outcome.

I ask that you declare any objections you may have openly and without reserve. It is for the best, assuredly.
I have no tolerance for boors flashing forced smiles in my face only to disparage me behind my back.
The duke of Felirae once spread his followers across the land, inciting insurrection. The actions of a fool.
I can't walk the castle without getting an armful of flowers and sweets. It's a bit much, but refusing would be rude.
Visit: I am Lucia, loyal servant of the queen of Crimea. Allow me to bestow upon you a small token of my gratitude.
Level: In Crimea, we dream of peace for all people—the world's nations extending their hands in mutual friendship.
Are you prepared for this battle to be your last? If so, I shall be your next opponent. Face me if you dare!
Surely, this is no reason to lose my composure. Above all, I must ensure my life does not go to waste.
Summon: I am Lucia, retainer to Queen Elincia. May this sword be infused with my pride, that I may cut down her foes.
Learn Skill: Your generosity is both unexpected and appreciated. Be assured, I will report it to Her Majesty without delay.
Confession:
When the capital fell, my comrades and I were forced into hiding. There, we contacted the surviving retainers.
Dressed as merchants and townsfolk to escape the enemy's prying eye, we infiltrated our homeland as assassins.
Objectively, if you were to consider which of us was best suited to the role, I daresay, it would be me.
Geoffrey tends to stick out like a sore thumb, with his noble gait and stature, regardless of his clothing.
And the count of Fayre, well... The only disguise capable of matching his bravado is that of a street performer.
Bastian once admonished Geoffrey and me for our greater devotion to Lady Elincia than to Crimea itself.
Yet, he zealously believes his devotion to the royal family must result in his unyielding service.
Her Majesty must constantly deal with my overexcited brother and a bombastic deputy prime minister.
Once again, it falls to me to keep those two in check and work towards a brighter future for Crimea with you.
Status: I am Lucia—retainer to Queen Elincia of Crimea.
Really! Where are your manners?
Bastian has a terrible habit of talking so much but saying so little.
I bear Queen Elincia no grudge for the difficult choice she was forced to make.
Queen Elincia was raised right alongside Geoffrey and me. She's like a sister to us.
No matter how difficult it may be, I will always choose the path that serves Queen Elincia best.
I can't entrust my duty to anyone else. You're much like me, aren't you?

bastian.name: Bastian
bastian.title: Crimea's Keystone
bastian.description: Deputy prime minister of Crimea and trusted ally of the new queen. During the war, he visited many countries to engage them in diplomacy. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: My dear, beloved Lucia! I cannot bear to ruminate on how our continued separation must leave you wretched!

I had prepared enough funds to make General Ike disappear were he a miscreant seeking power in Crimea.
However, given how things turned out in the end, it seems that my fears were quite unfounded.

The day after the fateful battle at Nados Castle, I led a band of soldiers in a detailed survey of the ruins.
And yet, despite our best efforts, we could locate neither hide nor hair of the Black Knight's corpse...
By your leave, my comrades and I shall retire for a moment of respite once the sun is below the horizon.

I plan to sample a rare Askran drink in the comfort of my modest—and provisional—accommodations here.
Perhaps you would do me the honor of joining me?
Visit: Why, yes, I am a traveling performer! Stilts, a jack-in-the-box, beanbags... I have it all! Shall we "shock" hands?
Level:
Brave and noble warriors of Crimea, keep your spirits high! My comrades and I are here to rally behind you!
Together we shall renew our oaths in service to our sacred kingdom!
You are in the presence of Bastian, the count of Fayre. Behold my deep devotion to the Crimean royal family!

Alas, though my quick-witted mind is a veritable font of all-encompassing knowledge, it falls short in one area.
Woe is me, for the words it conjures to my lips, no matter how sweet, will not penetrate my beloved's heart!
Summon: You address Bastian, the count of Fayre. Please excuse the discourtesy of my unannounced arrival.
Learn Skill: You wish to see my beaming smile? Without further ado... BANG! Joy bursts from my heart akin to confetti!
Confession:
Geoffrey is both my friend and the greatest paladin in all Crimea. Lucia is the singular aim of my affections.
The public has showered them both with praise for their noble actions in service to Her Majesty the queen.
Alongside fellow patriots, I swore deliverance for my kingdom. But I would be remiss not to extol him...
I speak of the famed heroic general who must be kept foremost in mind when discussing war effort impact.
Sullied with the disgrace of abiding Crimea's occupation, we were once ready to make the ultimate sacrifice.
Though we despaired, he pushed us to reconsider what we fought to save, and whom we fought to protect.
His storm of passion pierced through the dark clouds and nourished our barren hearts. How moving it was!
If I may, the skills of retainers and heroes are only necessary when nations devolve into chaos.
Though our fate is tied to that of the kingdom, we should strive for the day when our services are unneeded.
That being said, esteemed summoner, allow me to give a word of advice. Do not let smoldering embers lie.
Discern what simmers behind the scenes, and—FOO!—snuff out flames before they erupt into an inferno.
One cannot accomplish such delicate work through overt means. No, you must rely on manipulation and deceit.
But fear not, for I will volunteer my services for expressly that purpose. Please, do consider what I have said.
Status: I am Bastian, the count of Fayre. I was but a humble courtier in the service of Prince Renning.
If this is your manner of greeting, I suppose you could do worse.
I have worked out a strategy. Everything for the future of Crimea...
My dear friend Geoffrey is a true knight. The very essence of composure.
Duke Renning was next in line to succeed the throne of Crimea...
Ah, my dear, beloved Lucia! It pains me to imagine your piteous tears during those cold, lonely nights without me!
Summoner, a toast. To the crazed whims of our shared destiny!

ludveck.name: Ludveck
ludveck.title: Rebellious Duke
ludveck.description: Prominent noble of Crimea's House Felirae, bearing the title of duke. He foments dissent with the goal of forcing Elincia's abdication. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I am certain to know of any and all facts that concern your activities. My dear, lovely Lucia...

Lady Lucia and her brother misjudge me. The house of Count Delbray is in need of a strong hand to guide it.
As is the kingdom of Crimea...
Citizens exist to be ruled by nobility. It is as natural as the wind existing to blow. There is no need to dwell on it.

My house's lineage lies close to the royal family, so it should not be difficult to gather the lords' support.
Crimea and its glorious history beckon me!

Crimea is in chaos and requires a strong arm as king. As a man from house Felirae, I am a fitting choice.
For my queen, a woman of the blood of house Delbray would be most suitable!
Visit:
I am Ludveck, duke of Felirae, here in response to your invitation. My thanks for your reception.
Please accept this message in lieu of a monetary gift.
Level: Will you crawl back to me, face wet with tears, begging for mercy? How I pray to see that face, Your Majesty!
A kingdom cannot stand without a strong king. He is essential for any country.
There's no way I can lose, considering that I have a card which has yet to be put into the game.
Summon: I am Crimea's duke of Felirae. If you wish to meet with me, offer a seat and service befitting my station.
Learn Skill: I do not know your end game here... But I must use this offering to become stronger.
Confession:
I can understand if you are not aware of innocent little Elincia's true nature.
She is quick to let her guard down and naively believes everything she is told.
What if she is speaking to a fool, or someone with a hidden weapon? What if an offered drink is poisoned?
A country, even a court, in such an uncertain state breeds discouraged hearts and unrest.
Under such conditions, Crimea would never see a revival. Hm...
Perhaps someone like Bastian will write about how my insurrection was dealt with in one swift stroke...
How it was a triumph for the regime, how they could deal with those who opposed the queen all at once.
But such division leaves lingering grudges regardless. Only a resolute ruler can bring order to such chaos.
Lady Lucia, Bastian...show me your resolve. You and your beloved queen.
To the glory and future of Crimea!
Status: I am Ludveck, duke of Felirae. I am here in answer to your summons.
Hm? Do you have need of me?
No matter the might of an army, if the ruler leading it is weak...
I want to protect my country — protect Crimea.
My dear, lovely Lucia... You truly are a gem among stones.
Queen Elincia, you're so naive.
Are you truly a strong leader? I will be the one to judge that.

mrobin5.name: Robin
mrobin5.title: Exalt's Other Half
mrobin5.description: Tactician of Ylisse. Celebrated as Exalt Chrom's other half in the legends that followed their exploits. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Powerful forces gather here from across time and space, I see... And you form bonds with each of them.
Chrom saved me. He told me that my life was worth living—that we could change my fate together...
You shouldn't fall asleep in a place like this or you'll catch cold. Come, let's get you to a proper bed.
I consider myself a tactician; that is how Chrom always referred to me... You and I are similar in that regard.
I'd like to meet Heroes from other worlds—those with knowledge about dragons, if at all possible...
Visit: Greetings. I am Robin. I've wanted to meet you since first hearing of you from [F].
Level: It's the duty of a tactician to look for the next move even after a success. One mustn't rest on their laurels.
That strategy played out beautifully. Let's keep this up and press on toward victory.
I wish I could say this is all according to plan...but these things happen.
Summon: I'm Robin, a tactician of Ylisse. Being called a Legendary Hero is humbling. ...What do they say about me?
Learn Skill: I can't believe I'm a Legendary Hero... I'd feel odd telling Chrom and the others. I simply want to offer support.
Confession:
If the name Robin is now a legend, it's only proof that I was saved from my fate by Chrom and the others.
Lucina once told me that in a cruel future, shrouded in darkness, I had killed someone I held dear...
I don't know how that fate changed... There was never any obvious sign. I only know my friends didn't give up.
Chrom, Lucina...all of them fought against that fate without reservation. They held their hopes close.
When such hearts cry out to one another like that, they can join to create something powerful.
As Chrom says, we changed fate... That's the power of those bonds. I should know. I'm living proof.
I can tell that you have bonds that are just as strong. That is why I want to protect this world of yours.
Special: I'll put an end to this.
Status: Me? Legendary? I don't see how.
*startled* You're quite the mischief-maker!
If my achievements are worthy of legend, it's only because I've had the support of so many wonderful friends and allies.
I'm sure Chrom will find it hilarious that people think of me as a Legendary Hero.
This is a tactician's outfit. Let me guess—you have one just like it.
Thank you, everyone. Thank you for believing in me.
If my strategies are of any use to you at all, then I'm happy.

karla3.name: Karla
karla3.title: Spring Reveries
karla3.description: Karla the swordmaster joined by Freyja, Lady of Nightmare. What could bring these two together at the spring festival? They appear in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade / Heroes.
karla3.harmonized:
Grants Special cooldown count-2 to unit and allies from the same titles as unit. Grants Atk+6 and【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Blades】 Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Karla**: Lady Freyja is no warrior. And yet, her presence is as sharp as any blade. How mysterious...

**Freyja**: The same dream can bring either comfort or pain, depending on the dreamer and their circumstances.
So...which will this festival inspire?
**Freyja**: Ever ready to fight, Karla walks her path with dignity. A rare mortal, to be certain.

**Freyja**: I cannot forgive the mortals that took my brother from me.
However...I will not hold it against the children enjoying this festival.
**Karla**: The explosive power of a rabbit is nothing short of impressive. That said, I'm still not sure about this outfit...
Visit: We are messengers of the spring festival. This time, we have a gift from your friend [F].
Level: **Karla**: Lady Freyja, I will open our path. Let's leave this festival behind us.
**Karla**: However I am asked to perform, I will not falter.
**Freyja**: All just a trick of spring...
Summon: Karla, stand proud. You face the spring festival with the queen of Dökkálfheimr at your side.
Learn Skill: **Karla**: I-I'm so happity hoppity! ...These spring pleasantries are difficult to get used to.
Confession:
**Karla**: Is this place...really a dream? If it is, I would prefer to wake up before my brother can see me like this.
**Freyja**: To think you mortals would feel shame even in a dream... You truly are beyond my understanding.
**Karla**: Huh? W-well, isn't that only natural? If I'm wrong, and this isn't a dream, others will remember this odd attire.
**Freyja**: Why worry yourself over others? Dreams are your soul and its deepest desires made manifest.
This form you are in now is, without question, based upon your own feelings.
**Karla**: I find it hard to believe that I would ever desire this, no matter how deep it may be buried...
Still, I suppose feeling embarrassed about it is proof that, even in a dream, I am still myself.
**Freyja**: Indeed. Perhaps now you can begin to realize that there is no true difference between dream and reality.
After all, even the loveliest dream eventually ends.
Status: "Lady Freyja." "Yes."
Conversation: **Karla**: Hm? Is that—no, never mind...
**Freyja**: Karla, what are you so flustered over? It is undignified.
**Karla**: My apologies. I thought I saw my brother in the crowd. But of course, it was someone else.
**Freyja**: Oh? Would it be strange for him to attend a festival such as this?
**Karla**: Not strange, exactly. In truth, it is that I hope we don't meet like this. Not now.
We were never on the greatest of terms, and it's been years since we last saw each other.
**Freyja**: I see. I know of what you speak.
**Karla**: Lady Freyja, did something also happen between you and your brother?
**Freyja**: Yes. Though my experience is not one you could comprehend.
Because no matter if decades or even centuries pass...the distance between us can grow no smaller.
**Karla**: I see... You may be right. Centuries are far too long for most people to ever truly fathom.
**Freyja**: Still, I can say this much: to my eyes, the lifespan of a mortal is like the fleeting dream of a single evening.
If it is something that can be done before that dream fades away, you should strive to accomplish it.
**Karla**: Yes. I thank you for that.
I will not give up. Someday, I will find Karel and tell him what I've learned from my own journey.
**Freyja**: Good. Now then...if you think he might be here, let us find him.
**Karla**: Find him? Now? Dressed like this? I...

triandra2.name: Triandra
triandra2.title: Sunlit Nightmare
triandra2.description: One of the dökkálfar of Dökkálfheimr. What will the spring festival hold in store for this girl who once lost all hope?

Castle Hall: I am not meant for festivals like this. ...Why did you bring me here?
Dökkálfheimr is an abyss of despair, full of the fragments of nightmares...
Changing my attire will not make the nightmares end. But you know that, don't you?
While there are some things that appear in spring, others vanish... They simply fade away, unnoticed.
The end of winter is like waking from a long nightmare... It is when people feel most alive.
Visit: I am Triandra, bringer of nightmares. A dream of spring now drifts over [F]'s halls.
Level: Perhaps this is why spring is so beloved...
Embrace the season's warmth, and drift off to sleep...
I was carried away by the season's many distractions...
Summon: I am a dökkálfr of Dökkálfheimr, Triandra, the Nightmare. You expect me to attend...a spring festival?
Learn Skill: For...me? Hm. Thank you.
Confession:
Birds chirping, sun shining through the rain, shared laughter...
These things do not exist in Dökkálfheimr. I have no connection to any of this.
It is strange that it still somehow feels so familiar to me...
Perhaps I knew this warmth once long ago...
Now, however, I am one with only nightmare...
This festival is my nightmare now. But, for her...this world's warmth is a dear thing, so I will suffer it.
Status: Spring stirs.
Still asleep?
Those consumed by nightmare long to finally wake.
You think I'm...cute? Surely you mean the outfit.
Colorful blossoms, a warm breeze... Nothing like Dökkálfheimr.
Bunnies are...so small, so fluffy. They always made her happy...
Why attend to me like this? I cannot understand you.

bernadetta3.name: Bernadetta
bernadetta3.title: Late Hibernator
bernadetta3.description: Daughter of a prominent noble family within the Adrestian Empire. Shy as she is, she is sure to face trials at the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: There must be someone better suited to liven up the festival than me... Wait! Is this some kind of prank?!
Festivals are meant to be avoided and not joined. That's Bernie social etiquette!
I don't mind admiring flowers and the like...but I'd prefer to do it alone.

"Wow, the world outside my room is so wonderful and vast!"
...is exactly the sort of thing I wouldn't say. I'm going home!
If I can blend in somehow, maybe no one will find me... Oh no! This outfit is too bright for that to work!
Visit: Oh! I-I guess you found me? This is a gift I was asked to bring you from [F]...
Level: I-I did my best, so that means I can be done now, right? Bernie is leaving, and at a hare's pace!
It's just a festival, so...please don't take it too seriously, OK?
Oh no... I guess a rabbit's foot isn't that lucky after all...
Summon: H-hey! What's with this clothing?! I think you pulled the wrong rabbit out of your hat...
Learn Skill: Y-you're giving this to me? Spring festivals might not be as bad as I thought...
Confession:
J-just because it's spring doesn't mean that everyone is excited to go outside.
There are still animals that want to continue hibernating and people who want to stay in their rooms...
So, just go easy on Bernie, OK, Summoner? See you next winter...
Huh? What do you mean people want to see me in this outfit? Wait, they're gathering by my room? Now?!
Aaah! Why are s-s-so many people here?! Don't look at me, please! Don't...look... Ah...
...
Status: This outfit was just to embarrass me, wasn't it? Augh, stupid! Can't believe I fell for it! I'm so HUMILIATED!
*yelp* If you want me to go away, just say so! You don't have to push me around!
I'd love to hibernate. No obligations, no people... Just me in my cave, safe and warm.
My favorite part about this whole thing? Probably the candy...
What? You think I'm...cute? Oh, no-no-no—you're not fooling me. You think I don't know a trick when I see one? I'm on to you!
Spring makes me tired. All this outdoor stuff... Can we go back to winter?
So, instead of Bernie-bear, how about...Bernie-bun? *chuckle*

ashe3.name: Ashe
ashe3.title: Budding Chivalry
ashe3.description: Devoted knight in training who wishes to help those in need. He has come to Askr's spring festival full of spirit for the season. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: There's a lot to learn, even outside the classroom. I'll need to see it all if I'm going to become a proper knight!
Sylvain said that a knight is loved by their people. So, I'm going to make sure this festival is fun for everyone!
I wish my little brother and sister could come to this festival too. I'm sure they'd love it!
Aren't you going to get dressed up in spring festival garb, Summoner? I'm sure you'd look better in it than me!
The Kingdom of Askr sure is a nice place. I really get the sense that everyone is enjoying the festival!
Visit: I'm Ashe Ubert! I've been entrusted with delivering a spring festival gift from [F]!
Level: No matter the challenge, I'll hop right over it—quick like a bunny!
I won't let anything get in the way of everyone enjoying the festival to its fullest!
The spring sun feels so nice. It makes me want to drift off to sleep... No, I need to focus!
Summon: Oh, is this where we're celebrating the spring festival? Let me know how I can help make things fun!
Learn Skill: It is a knight's duty to be steadfast! I will make sure this spring festival is a success!
Confession:
Summoner, the spring festival is a smashing success! Everywhere you look, people are all smiles!
A long time ago, I tried to get by on the wrong path. I did it to feed my brother and sister, but still...
Lord Lonato saved me. I want to become a proper knight, not so I can atone, but so I can save others too.
A knight's duty is to make sure the people can keep smiling. This festival has only strengthened my resolve!
I still have a lot to learn, but I will never, ever give up on my dream.
With the memory of this spring festival engraved on my heart, I will continue on my path to knighthood.
Straight ahead, without faltering!
Status: Thank you for inviting me to such a fun festival!
Ah. What is it? Is something wrong?
I always make sure to get plenty of rest. Knights need to keep their energy up.
Getting all dressed up like this... I dunno.
It's nice to be called cute, I guess. Even if I'd rather be dashing.
I found some adorable bunny-shaped treats. I wish I could bring them home to my brother and sister.
It's been a real pleasure spending the spring with you.

michalis2.name: Michalis
michalis2.title: Fruiting Ambition
michalis2.description: King of Macedon, asked by his sister Maria to take part in the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: What can I leave for my sisters, not as king but as their brother? Perhaps I will find the answer at this festival.
The people of Macedon must desire to welcome the coming of spring as well...

This is the first time I have ever been surrounded by children.
It is more burdensome than being surrounded by soldiers...
Do not misunderstand. I am only taking part in this buffoonery at the request of Minerva and Maria.
What is this? It does not seem to be a wyvern egg, but what a curious color it has...
Visit:
I have something to deliver to you from [F]...
This attire is for the spring festival. Do not inquire any further.
Level: Thought you could attack while my attention was diverted by the festival, did you? Fool!
How absurd to think I would ever let my guard down, even while at a festival.
It feels as though this garb is dulling my wit...
Summon: I am Michalis, king of Macedon. What reason could Minerva have to invite me to such a festival?
Learn Skill: If I desire something, I need only take it. However, I am not so tactless as to refuse a festival gift.
Confession:
The people of Macedon live in a harsh environment where they must support each other through battle.
But the days of fighting are not meant to continue in perpetuity.
At conflict's end, days of fulfillment and abundance await them. With that hope do we continue the struggle.
How will it feel when those days finally come to pass? The answer may depend on who you ask.
However, this country's festival gives me a glimpse of what Macedon must continue to strive for.
I imagine that my realizing this is why Minerva and Maria must have invited me here. If so...
I must give my utmost devotion to Macedon so I may meet my sisters' expectations for our people.
Status: I do not understand this fanciful costume. Explain your thinking.
Hm? You presume you may be so casual with me because of these festivities? You may not.
Minerva is quite insistent that I join in the festival—for Maria.
Studying the customs of other cultures can yield valuable insights.
When my sisters were young, I would cavort with them in springtime fields like these...
The chance to see my sister so happy is no bad thing.
And here I had hoped to see you don some inane costume.

tana5.name: Tana
tana5.title: Soaring Princess
tana5.description: Princess of Frelia. Takes to the sky with a bow connected to the bow Nidhogg, her brother Innes having tasked her with looking after it. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Eirika and I are both childhood friends and comrades in battle. She has my trust, and I hers.
Innes will carry Frelia into the future. I must grow into someone who can support him in that task.
I am inexperienced with the bow, but tell me—do you think that I can master it with practice?
Syrene is like a big sister to me. Her skill as a knight and her kindness set wonderful examples.
I've made changes to my garb. I hope to show it off to Eirika soon. I think she'll have nice things to say!
Visit: I am Tana, princess of Frelia. I carry a vow of unceasing friendship from [F].
Level: Watch me, Innes. I will open a path to the future, grasping the bow you have entrusted me.
I must bring this battle to a quick end. I cannot allow any more lives to be sacrificed.
Another miss! Archery is challenging indeed.
Summon: I am Tana, princess of Frelia. As long as I have this bow my brother entrusted to me, I will never lose.
Learn Skill: How pleasing. I will work even harder.
Confession:
Born a princess, I lived knowing little of the world...
I learned, in time, that I had become accustomed to the luxuries of my sheltered world.
I left it to go to battle—for Magvel. Once I saw the suffering of the people, I realized it could not stand.
I fight for the people of Askr because I wish to shield them, too, from the flames of war. It is my duty as royalty.
Even I, who knew nothing of the world, could change it. I am certain anyone can grow, with determination.
I will continue to study, to learn what it is that I can do—all that is in my power to do, given my position.
Status: My brother is quite the bowman. Now that he's given me this bow, I hope that I can become as skilled!
*gasp* Why, you! This bow is a treasure. You almost made me drop it!
Like this? Hmm, no. That's not right. *sigh* Maybe I should ask Innes for help after all...
Archers make short work of pegasus knights. It pays to know your foe!
I want to stand shoulder to shoulder with Innes on the battlefield, as Eirika does with Ephraim.
Attired like this, I feel more confident on the battlefield. What do you think? Does it suit me?
Now that I can wield a bow, I can do even more for you. How wonderful!

gilliam.name: Gilliam
gilliam.title: Wall of Silence
gilliam.description: Commander of Frelia's guard at Border Mulan. His menacing look conceals a caring heart. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall:
My armor's full of scratches. I got this one here defending Border Mulan in a siege years back.
The others are from my earliest days as a knighted soldier. Each of these is a story. Each one a mark of pride.

Keeping Princess Eirika safe from harm is the right thing to do, not just a service to our sworn ally, Renais.
My own Princess Tana feels the same.
In Askr, there are many Heroes of different experience levels. I will give them all I have to give.
I've known Syrene a long time—since she first became an elite pegasus knight. I know she has my back.
Acting alone out there in battle leads only to chaos. We must consider how our actions affect others.
Visit: I am Gilliam, an armored knight of Frelia. I am to deliver these goods to you in [F]'s stead.
Level: This body was painstakingly sculpted through consistent training. You will not find a single weakness!
If we're discussing strength, none of Frelia's armored knights can hope to match me!
Even these muscles need rest every now and then.
Summon:
I am Gilliam. Been stationed on the eastern front of Frelia. However, if this is to be my new assignment...
I swear to protect both this place and you with all my strength.
Learn Skill: The armored knights of Frelia understand a simple truth: a day without training is a day wasted.
Confession:
I've been continuously impressed by your adept show of ingenuity on the battlefield, [S].
It really is a shame your body isn't as hardy as your brain. Ho, how scrawny those legs of yours are!
Fear not—a few days of Frelia's resistance training and you'll be in the best shape of your life!
Be warned: this program is not for the faint of heart. It will push every single muscle, even your fingertips.
Muscles are the very fiber of your being as a knight, the thing that pulls you together and gives you strength.
In Frelia, we strive to keep every moving part of our bodies in battle- ready condition. Every muscle counts.
But, I've worked this tongue enough chatting. All that's left now is to prove your resolve to me.
Wait a minute, where are you going? Ahh... Maybe you do have pretty strong legs after all...
Status: I am Gilliam. Been stationed on the eastern front of Frelia. Good to meet you.
Looking to arm wrestle, are you? I'll gladly accept.
No other knight in Frelia can match my strength.
I know I've seen many battles, but I'm still pretty young.
I learned a lot in Renais. I expect Askr to be much the same.
Syrene has been with me since her very first mission. She's one of Frelia's finest knights.
I should show you Frelian resistance training. Think it would do you good. Oh, I can teach you—it's no trouble.

vanessa.name: Vanessa
vanessa.title: Dutiful Rider
vanessa.description: A pegasus knight from Frelia who is both very serious and sincere. She also looks up to her sister Syrene. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I look up to my sister. She's an exceptional knight and a charming woman. You could say she's perfect.
Prince Innes has had high hopes for me since I joined the pegasus knights. I must be worthy of his confidence!
You are rather mysterious, Summoner... I somehow feel more relaxed around you.
I've been told I need to "loosen up" more. I didn't realize I was being uptight in the first place...

This is a protective charm, a battle amulet of the war god Fale. Syrene delivered it to me.
She said it was a gift from our father.
Visit:
I am Vanessa of Frelia's pegasus knights. I come before you bearing a delivery from your sworn ally.
Please accept this symbol of your kinship with [F].
Level: I will protect the prince, even at the cost of my life!
I am still learning, but I must grow ever stronger!
I'll never be able to defend anything if I keep up like this...
Summon: I am Vanessa of Frelia's pegasus knights, newly appointed to this post. I shall defend you from the sky.
Learn Skill: I can feel strength surging anew. I will see to it that the skies of Askr remain safe.
Confession:
My mission is to ensure Prince Innes remains safe. I would gladly lose my life if it meant protecting him.
But he once told me that, as a prince, he has a duty to protect me, his subject, not the other way around.
So I intend to soar through every battlefield with all my strength, that I may aid in his noble designs.
If he wishes to save Askr, then I will tirelessly defend the skies of this land to make that wish a reality.
It feels like my partner, Titania, agrees with me!
Status: I'm Vanessa. I'm captain of Frelia's pegasus knights.
Eeyah! Huh? I just had a leaf on me? Oh, thank you.
You know, I'm often told that I need to loosen up and not be so serious. What do you think?
I'd always tried to be like my sister. She's very strong, as both a knight and a person.
My pegasus and I can scout the enemy in no time.
My prince, I have...always...
When I'm with you, I can relax and just be myself.

syrene.name: Syrene
syrene.title: Graceful Rider
syrene.description: Famed commander of Frelia's third battalion of pegasus knights, as well as Princess Tana's bodyguard. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.
syrene.artist: PavilionUshima (パビリオン右島) / Trys inc.

Castle Hall: Vanessa, you know you don't need to call me commander when we're alone. Just call me sis...
My first mission as a member of the knights was to care for Tana. Even so, those days were like bliss...

I'm glad to see that Vanessa and Gilliam have also come to Askr.
Just knowing they are here is enough to feel at ease.
Frelia is known for a fish called the Frelian snapper. If I ever have the chance, I'd like to cook some for you.
My most important mission is to protect Princess Tana. I will always be at her side.
Visit: I've come with supplies, courtesy of your friend [F].
Level: Calling it a secret might be a bit much, but proper rest and nutrition is key to growing stronger.
No matter the battlefield, my daily training will not betray me.
Perhaps I overdid it a little bit...
Summon: I am Syrene, commander of Frelia's third battalion of pegasus knights. My sword is yours to command.
Learn Skill: This is for me? Thank you. I will work even harder to meet your expectations.
Confession:
A person's true value is revealed only when they are put in a difficult situation.
That is a lesson I learned from my sister, Vanessa.
When our father fell ill, she gathered nuts and berries and sold them to the villagers to buy medicine for him.
She saved his life, and when our mother and I could do nothing but sob in relief, she even comforted us.
She says she respects me, but she's the one who's truly amazing. Nothing is too difficult for her to overcome.
So I won't give up. No matter how proud of her I might be, I still won't lose to my little sister.
That is how I will protect my family and those who are precious to me.
Status: I am Syrene, commander of Frelia's pegasus knights.
What the—is this how you entertain yourself?
I am very proud of my sister Vanessa. I only wish she were more confident.
Princess Tana has grown a great deal. I suppose I have you to thank for that as well.
When you face a difficult circumstance, your true self emerges.
To be rescued by Prince Innes was like something out of a dream.
I promise to protect you.

vigarde.name: Vigarde
vigarde.title: Silent Emperor
vigarde.description: The once-admired Emperor of Grado. Known as the Silent Emperor, he has been reduced to only a shadow of his former self. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: The Grado Empire shall never fall... I shall seal away even the wrath of the land with our army's might!
A new age will come to Magvel when every Sacred Stone is destroyed. An age in which Grado reigns supreme.
Urgh... Lyon. It falls now to you... The future... Our people...
Traitors shall receive no mercy. Those who turn against the Grado Empire seal their own demise.

The Sacred Stone passed down in our land of Grado was called the Fire Emblem.
A secret, powerful stone that once sealed away the Demon King.
Visit: I am Vigarde, emperor of Grado.
Level: Impudent fool. Bend your knee before the Emperor of Grado.
All who oppose me will be utterly destroyed.
Stop resisting...
Summon: I am Vigarde, ruler of the Grado Empire. Soon, the grasp of my rule shall expand over all of Magvel...
Learn Skill: I feel immense power... Such that this vessel of a body can hardly contain it.
Confession:
In the past, some have called me the Silent Emperor.
I am now one who commands with might, one who crushes enemies with the utmost prejudice.
When all the Sacred Stones in Magvel are shattered, the age of the weak will end.
A wish 800 years in the making will at last begin to take shape...
Urgh... Ah... Lyon...I...
For what reason do I hesitate? We cannot move the hands of time. The course of fate cannot be reversed...
Status: I am Vigarde, emperor of Grado—nay, all of Magvel.
You dare lay a hand on me? You must not know fear.
Frelia's Sacred Stone has been destroyed. Now, you must locate the Stone of Renais.
Find the children of Renais. Find them and take from them the bracelets that they wear...
Crush the Sacred Stones housed in Jehanna and Rausten...
Lyon... Our people must be saved.
All decisions are mine to make. You need not concern yourself with a single detail but obeying.

yuri2.name: Yuri
yuri2.title: Underground Lord
yuri2.description: Leader of the Ashen Wolf House and proficient with both magic and the sword. He fights for those who can't protect themselves, seeking no favor. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Gold is gold. It doesn't matter where it comes from when you're in need. It's how you feed your family...
You can't simply remain underground if you want to see love and justice in the world.
A plague nearly ended my life... Do your best to keep warm and dry—stay rested and healthy.

You have a scrap heap here? Can you take me to it? Scrap is a great way to learn about the people who tossed it.
And sometimes you can find some good stuff too.
Are you following me or something? Well...nothing to see here. I'm out running a few errands. That's all...
Visit:
Nice to meet you. I'm Yuri, here on behalf of [F].
I've got a gift for you. Here.
Level: I can't be caught. Even my name is a disguise. My enemies just end up chasing my shadow. That's how it is.
I am not some dog that wags his tail and begs for scraps... I'd bite through my chains and kick open my cage!
That's how it is, is it? Time to switch things up then.
Summon: Shocked? Like anyone else has looks like mine... I'm Yuri—but you already know that. Anyway, see ya around.
Learn Skill: So long as our efforts are aligned, I'll happily work alongside you.
Confession:
Most of my comrades will do what I ask with little wheedling... But you people here are all even easier marks.
Not that I'm scheming. Though, of course, I'm not above a little villainy if it's for my family.
That's the code I live by.
...I can spot a person's weakness from a glance. Even if they mask it, people are essentially selfish.
That's why we're stronger together, with our friends—when you have others to lean on.
I have friends like that back home.
I remember them in the light of the mornings there. It was always warm, and everything was beautiful...
You and I are going to have a long friendship too. I've already decided to stick around. It'll be good!
Status: Me, a legendary hero? Well, fancy that.
Uh, watch it with the hands, friend.
Folks must have really talked me up over the years, if I'm some kind of legend.
Put me on a pedestal if you insist. I'm not gonna let it go to my head.
What is it that's legendary about me, exactly? Apart from my pretty face, obviously.
If nothing else, I'm glad that all I've done wasn't for nothing.
Hungry? I could whip something up for you.

mark.name: Mark
mark.title: Winds of Hope
mark.description: A master tactician with the power to change history and the girl from the Lorca tribe who became the staunchest of allies. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.
mark.duo:
Inflicts【Isolation】,【Guard】, and Special cooldown count+2 on foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit.
【Isolation】 Target cannot use or be the target of Assist skills through its next action. (Target can neither use nor be the target of skills like Dance and Sing, skills that neutralize penalties, like Restore and Harsh Command+, etc.)
【Guard】 Inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on target per attack during combat through its next action. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

Castle Hall: **Lyn**: I'm glad that Mark is with me. I may not have been able to keep calm in this unknown place otherwise...
**Lyn**: The Lorca chieftain is my father. It's only natural that I learn how to ride and fight alongside everyone else!
**Lyn**: I won't leave Mark alone. If we're going, it'll be together!
**Lyn**: You know, Summoner, you kind of remind me of Mark... I can't really put my finger on why. Just a feeling!
**Lyn**: Seeing all of these Heroes makes me wonder about what incredible things may happen in their worlds!
Visit: **Lyn**: Best regards from your friend! I'm happy that you and [F] get along.
Level: **Lyn**: Amazing, Mark! We go together so well—like the wind and the plains!
**Lyn**: I've got your back, Mark! You just focus on the fight!
**Lyn**: Don't worry, my gut is telling me that something better will happen next time!
Summon: I'm Lyn, and this is Mark, an aspiring tactician! I bet you two can learn a lot from each other, so listen up!
Learn Skill: **Lyn**: This is great! Let's have a big group hug as thanks! Come on, Mark, get in here!
Confession:
**Lyn**: Here's one of Sacae's laws: you must offer a prayer to the land and stars each and every day, without fail.
Sacae has so many tribes, even the scariest invaders would turn tail and run if they all rallied together!
I'd raise my sword and fight alongside the Lorca to protect the plains of Sacae!
Oh, I know. Why don't we make a vow, Mark? Let's swear as friends to help each other in tough times.
It'll be a formal promise between Lyn and Mark. Oh, why don't you join in too, Summoner?
Even if we grow up and forget our vow, the promise itself will stand for all time. Always!
Status: Let's hold hands so we don't get separated. OK?
Conversation: **Lyn**: Whew... I'm exhausted. Let's take a break.
Being whisked away to a new world was a big surprise, but I think I'm finally getting used to it.
How about you, Mark? ...Oh, so you feel the same?
I'm really glad to have met you here. It probably would have been a lot harder alone.
Say, Mark. You said that you wanted to study tactics, didn't you?
My father and the other Lorca chieftains are teaching me how to ride a horse and fight.
If something bad happens, I want to be able to fight with them!
Don't give me such a worried look! This is just natural for someone from the plains of Sacae.
Besides, my mother is so gentle...
So I want to protect her! I won't let anyone lay a finger on her!
Hey, why are you laughing? I'm pretty strong, you know.
Someday I'll be like my father, a warrior galloping gracefully on horseback!
When that time comes, I'll protect you too, Mark.
If you become a tactician, you'll need to go into battle too. That could be dangerous.
My father always says that it's the duty of Sacaen warriors to defend the tribe with our lives.
You may not be part of the tribe, but you are my friend.
So I promise I will be there for you. Even after we grow up. Don't forget that you can always call on me.

eliwood5.name: Eliwood
eliwood5.title: Pledged Friend
eliwood5.description: A young noble of House Pherae, part of the Lycian League. Sincere and considerate toward everyone he meets. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Father... Mother... My dream is to bring forth a world where all can live happily. But am I being naive?
From the moment I clasped Hector's hand, I could feel his strength, his confidence. He's brimming with both.
Father once told me that overwork is a road leading to nothing. When it gets tough, he said, you need rest.
Sometimes studying history feels meaningless... Rulers clash, but it all ends with their people suffering.
There are others here my age or even younger. Yet they are strong enough to be called Heroes...
Visit: I am Eliwood of Pherae. I have been told much of your stout heart by [F].
Level: I will do Pherae proud—for myself, my parents, and for the people!
I must gather myself. I cannot protect anyone if I don't.
We may have defeated the foe in front of us, but that does not mean we can rest easy.
Summon: I am Eliwood, son of the marquess of Pherae. I would be honored if you accepted me into your circle.
Learn Skill: I thank you.
Confession:
The nations of Lycia have banded together to protect ourselves from threats from the outside and within.
Our parents have sworn that all in the alliance fight as one, no matter who is attacked—or by whom.
While our parents were swearing that oath, we children were assembled in another chamber...
It was then that Hector called on us to swear an oath of our own, as he sliced his palm with his knife.
Clasping cut palms is a famous custom of warriors—an oath of friendship sealed by lifeblood.
My hand was the only one that met his.
Our friendship began with that vow. When one is in danger, the other will risk everything to save him...
That is the promise I made to Hector that day. I will draw from his strength as I take stewardship of Pherae.
Status: I am Eliwood, son of Marquess Elbert of Pherae.
*gasp* You startled me! How may I help you?
My parents are so happy when they're together.
Can you help me find my friend? His name is Hector.
To follow in my father's footsteps and protect Pherae… That is my dream.
Mother, Father... I hope you're thinking about me.
I want to learn as much as I can while I'm here. Consider me at your disposal.

hector6.name: Hector
hector6.title: Sworn Friend
hector6.description: A young noble of House Ostia, part of the Lycian League. Respects his older brother Uther, who is known for his discernment. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Ostia, and all Lycia, will one day be peaceful—with all as equals. That's my brother's dream, and mine.
"Corrupt neither the body nor the mind." That's the Ostian motto! It's just how we do things.
I've got to get stronger—and wiser. One day, I'll be my brother's right hand.
Ugh. Reading is so tiresome... Why do I bother? Uther and Oswin have brains enough for me as well.
I can't seem to get to sleep. Take a walk around the castle and clear my head—that's what I'll do.
Visit: I am Hector of Ostia! Your boon companion sent me over to say a little hello. So, hello!
Level: How do you like that? As I told you— I'm no child!
I'm always ready. Anytime, anywhere!
Unbelievable!
Summon: My name is Hector. I'm no child, so don't treat me like one. I'll take on any challenger!
Learn Skill: Hah! That's the stuff. Keep it coming! I'll take 'em all on!
Confession:
Lycia is not governed by a single ruler. It is an alliance of lords, and what matters most is trust.
Least, that's how I remember Uther putting it. They must have felt that the kids needed to know it too...
Because they gathered us up and dumped us in a room while they were hashing things out.
Erik of Laus tried to sweet-talk us into, well, something or other, but it was just a lot of hot air.
As he was finishing up, I recalled the old custom of the warriors' blood oath, sealed by clasping cut hands.
The only one with the guts to take my hand was Eliwood of Pherae. And I feared he lacked the stomach for it!
He certainly changed my view. We spoke frankly about so much. His family, and my brother Uther...
We shared our visions for the future. One day, he'll be marquess, and I'll take my place at Uther's side.
If either of them needs me, I will be there. Together, we will bring Lycia into a new age!
Status: I'm Hector. My brother, Uther, is the marquess of Ostia!
D'oho! You surprised me this time, but don't expect to get the drop on me again!
Are you free? I am itching to get some training in!
Eliwood's a close friend. He's also my rival. I like that he doesn't hold back.
Order of Heroes? Gates to other worlds? Are these things I should know about? I'm not big on studying, sorry… Why don't we spar!
I'm not just getting big and strong for me. I want to help out my brother!
You're an odd duck, but that keeps things interesting. I like it!

rebecca2.name: Rebecca
rebecca2.title: Breezy Scamp
rebecca2.description: Born and raised in a village within the territory of Pherae. Worries for Dan, her older brother, who left the village with her neighbor Wil. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Maybe my big brother and Wil have been brought to this world like me...

There are so many strong people here. I wonder if that knight is one of them...
The knight on the white horse who saved my village from bandits!
Out on patrol, huh? Is it OK if I tag along too?
Doesn't this bread smell great? Baked it myself, you know. I kneaded lots of fruits and herbs into it.
Look at all these nuts and berries I picked! Hm, what should I make? A necklace might be nice.
Visit: Hey, I'm Rebecca! Just here with a hello from [F]!
Level: Big brother Dan, Wil... Come home soon! I promise I'll keep working hard until then!
I'm going to be strong enough to defend my village from bandits!
I'm just taking a little break. That's OK, right?
Summon: I'm Rebecca! I love to cook, and I can even use a bow!
Learn Skill: I-is it really all right to give me so much? Wow...
Confession:
U-um, excuse me, Summoner! I've been waiting to talk to you.
I'm sorry, I'm sure you must be tired. But there's something I wanted to ask you about.
I could use some advice. I'm looking for a couple people: my big brother, Dan, and neighbor, Wil.
They both left our village without a word one day... I was thinking that maybe they could be here.
If you happen to see the two of them, please tell them that Rebecca is really steaming mad at them!
I have no idea where they are, or if they're eating properly... Ugh! I'm so worried, it's making ME hungry!
Status: I'm Rebecca! I hunt with my bow!
*gasp* Are you trying to play a game with me?
Wil's my neighbor. We play together most days.
I love shooting my bow, but I still have a tough time changing the string.
My brother Dan is really kind.
I wonder what the world is like outside my village...
I can cook, so I'll make you lunch sometime!

lucius2.name: Lucius
lucius2.title: Calming Light
lucius2.description: A young monk who serves House Cornwell. Looks sickly, often grimacing in pain. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Remembering what happened at the orphanage is...difficult. It's painful.
I lived with my parents until I was three years old. My father was a skilled mercenary.
They say that Lord Raymond has a sister who was taken in and raised by Count Caerleon at a young age...
Poverty and despair can eat one's very soul if it is not strengthened with faith. But many people can't do that.

People's hearts can be twisted so easily... The orphanage was no exception.
I pray that salvation comes for us all.
Visit:
You must be [S].
I've come with greetings from your friend [F].
Level: I want to become a proper monk, to repay my debt to the marquess and his wife, and to support Raymond!
I am feeling fine. But thank you for your concern.
I won't be of much use like this...
Summon: My name is Lucius. I'm a monk in service of the marquess of Cornwell. Saint Elimine's light guides me.
Learn Skill: Oh, thank you. But I have nothing to give you in return...
Confession:
I've already told you that I was an orphan, haven't I, Summoner?
One night, my father was attacked by bandits who broke into our home.
Though he was a skilled mercenary, he was killed right in front of me. I remember it so clearly...
The bandit's eyes, as black as the deepest darkness... The knife in my father's chest... Ugh...
After my father died, my mother fell ill, and in no time at all, I was alone.
If I could pray for one thing, it would be to reduce such suffering in the world, even a little...
Status: I just know I can save you!
Anything to help.
Nice to meet you. I am Lucius, a retainer to House Cornwell.
The marquess and his wife, and of course Lord Raymond, are all near and dear to my heart.
Just...one moment. *sigh* No need to worry. My sickness has passed.
My memories of the orphanage are mostly painful ones.
I wonder why I feel so calm around you?

ingrid3.name: Ingrid
ingrid3.title: Beacon of Honor
ingrid3.description: Eldest daughter of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus's House Galatea. Wields her spear with chivalrous intent. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: Glenn... Have I become closer to being the kind of knight that inspires others, like you once were?
Compared to my home, the Kingdom of Askr is a very warm and pleasant place to be. Honestly, I'm envious.
Whether it's horses or pegasi, you should always treat them as dear partners who will share your destiny.

Oh, [S]!
Would you care to join me in the dining hall? ...Huh? What do you mean "so soon?" That was hours ago!
Every time I wield this lance, I ask myself—for what purpose did I choose the path of knighthood?
Visit:
I come bearing a message from [F].
The next time a strong enemy appears, we will fight as one!
Level: My devotion will not waver!
I cannot afford to lose here!
I see. Now, to make the most of what I have learned.
Summon: I am Ingrid Brandl Galatea. I aim to walk the path of a loyal knight. With this lance, I will be your strength.
Learn Skill: You're giving me something this valuable?! I will not let your thoughtfulness go to waste!
Confession:
My heart is what guided me to the path of knighthood, but there are all sorts of chivalric tales in Fódlan.
It's difficult to not admire the knights in those tales, so I've always wanted to be like them.
But...such knights who fought with honor and virtue were merely characters in legends and stories.
In the back of my mind, I warned myself not to confuse those tales with reality.
And yet...there are great knights here in the Order of Heroes befitting of tales of their own!
They aren't mere characters, but great predecessors who persevered on the path to knighthood!
They are the ones I should be learning from! Then, I will find my own path to chivalry.
With this lance, I will surpass those who came before me!
Status: Upon my lance, I swear I will protect you.
Oh! You caught me with my guard down! I still have a lot to learn.
Have you read any chivalric tales? I can lend you some, if you're interested.
Pegasus knights are the specialty of House Galatea. I'm proud to set an example.
Could you point me to the stables? I want to care for the horses.
Perhaps I'll go for a stroll through the woods...
If you ever find yourself in trouble on the battlefield, you need only call my name. I promise I'll be there.

felix.name: Felix
felix.title: Lone-Wolf Blade
felix.description: Second son of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus's House Fraldarius, a prestigious noble family. He seeks to grow stronger on his own terms. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Swordsmanship may be my main interest, but I know my way around a battlefield.
Only a fool would sit back and rely on social status or a Crest. Train hard. Skill is everything.
Ugh—Sylvain's causing trouble again. But if I make a scene stopping him, Ingrid's going to lecture us both...
I want to learn from the Heroes who have been tested by the toughest battles. Their skills are the real thing.
Even in this world, people expect me to play nice with the boar? Hmph. I'll handle things my own way.
Visit: I'm Felix. I'm here to see how your best fighters compare to the ones in [F]'s castle.
Level: Too easy. Attack me all at once next time.
Weak opponents don't interest me.
Hmph. I've been too cautious...
Summon: I am Felix Hugo Fraldarius. Swordplay is my only interest. Don't waste my time with anything else.
Learn Skill: Looks like I've gotten the hang of it. But I won't get complacent.
Confession:
I'll be honest—I was pretty annoyed when you yanked me into this world without my consent.
Once I got used to it, though, I began to see the appeal of the place. I might even prefer to stay.
My professors from Garreg Mach are all here—along with so many other strong fighters to watch and study.
You might have been able to talk me into helping Askr for its own sake, but with all these learning opportunities...
Well, let's just say I don't need any convincing. This is as good a chance as any to sharpen my skills.
So, consider me in for the long haul. I want to see how far I can go without relying on my status as a noble.
Status: Call me Felix. My family name? What does that matter?
Stop that. If you want to fight me, say so.
Skilled sparring partners wherever I look. This will be fun.
Dimitri? Ugh, what has the boar done this time?
Give me the name of your best blacksmith. I can't entrust my weapon to some flailing incompetent.
Wherever I go, I am met by the specter of war.
Enough talk, Summoner. Let your sword speak for you... What? You don't wield one?

sylvain.name: Sylvain
sylvain.title: Consummate Flirt
sylvain.description: Heir to House Gautier. Finds the allure of beautiful women irresistible. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: They say a Crest gives you freedom. What's free about being shackled to a power you never chose for yourself?
This place is a paradise compared to where I came from—for the food alone, if nothing else.
Oh, Felix...you were so adorable, the way you'd come crying to me over every little thing. What happened?
Askr is a showcase of all the beautiful specimens you can find in other worlds. I mean the flowers, obviously.
Of course I talk to a beautiful woman when I see one! What am I supposed to do, give her the cold shoulder?
Visit: Don't mind me, just admiring the scenery. Oh, I brought supplies for you from [F].
Level: Child's play. I'm getting better and better at this.
I could get used to this.
Luck wasn't on my side this time.
Summon: I am Sylvain Jose Gautier. And since you're counting on me, I guess I'll show you a little of what I can do.
Learn Skill: So, this is what it means to get stronger? I'm finally getting it.
Confession:
Do you believe our fates are decided at birth, [S]?
Personally, I can't stand the idea. To live your whole life according to someone else's expectations...
In my view, a life like that is nothing short of cursed.
That's why I admire Askr's Heroes. They're strong enough to defy destiny and live how they choose.
I guess fate's a heavy subject though, huh? Let's talk about something else, like... What are you doing later?
Hah! You think I'd ask you out just to avoid my insecurities? You might be too insightful for your own good.
Status: I'm Sylvain Jose Gautier. Feel free to say hi whenever you like.
Hey, no need to push me around. I get enough of that from Ingrid.
If I'm ever coming on too strong, just say the word.
One thing I definitely don't miss about Faerghus is the food. Seriously, we're way behind this place.
Felix is like a little brother to me. That's why I can't take him seriously.
A Crest isn't a privilege. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
I guess...I joke around a lot because it's safe. If you really get to know me, you might not like what you see.

rhea.name: Rhea
rhea.title: Loving Matriarch
rhea.description: Archbishop who guides the Church of Seiros. Watches over her students with the calm air of a caring mother. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I'm sure it was my mother—excuse me, the goddess—who led me here.
Being the archbishop sometimes requires me to judge rationally and speak firmly.

Do you find this crown overstated?
It has been passed down from archbishop to archbishop for generations in the Church of Seiros.
If there is something on your mind, do not hesitate to confide in me. I wish to be a pillar of support for you.
Many gods and goddesses have come down from the heavens to Askr. I feel a strange sense of nostalgia here...
Visit: I am Rhea, archbishop of the Church of Seiros. I am lending my aid to the castle of [F].
Level: I must be steadfast in mind and body for the sake of my people.
Reflect on your deeds so you may set yourself on the path to redemption.
Were my prayers not enough?
Summon: I am Rhea, archbishop of the Church of Seiros. I wish to bring the light of hope to Fódlan and Askr alike.
Learn Skill: Such altruism is noble, indeed. May this power aid us in bringing light to the world.
Confession:
Oh, Summoner. Are you on patrol, at this time of night? Your dedication to our safety is inspiring.
I sense a certain quality in you... One might call it great potential, a power to shape the future.
This power you possess is what drew me and the other Heroes of Fódlan to this world.
It is your special gift, shared by none, that combines our disparate powers into one even greater force.
I shall support you. When darkness shrouds your path, do not hesitate to call upon me.
The teachings of Seiros shall lead you from peril into a future bathed in light and shaped by love and connection.
Special: In the name of the goddess.
Status: I am called Rhea. I am the archbishop of the Church of Seiros.
No, you mustn't play such games.
Through the long history of Fódlan, an unending stream of those who threaten the peace flows.
You are doing quite well. I would advise you to be confident in your abilities.
May the sinful be punished in equal measure to their deeds.
Mother... One day...
Blessings of the goddess upon you.

cornelia.name: Cornelia
cornelia.title: Saint Consumed
cornelia.description: A mage from the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. She was once considered a saintly figure before one day becoming something quite different. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Don't make me laugh. You know what lies ahead if you cling to the Church of Seiros' filthy teachings!
I see quite a few familiar faces here. How irritating.

Should you rise against me like a fool forgetting their place, I will crush you like the worthless beast you are.
And you will thank me for it.

Everyone looks positively saintly, don't they? Ugh, how vile. If only I was not bound by contract...
I suppose I will play nice for now.
Victory comes at the cost of sacrifice. Surely, even you are not so foolish as to deny this.
Visit: I am Cornelia Arnim, a mage from Fódlan who was summoned by [F].
Level: Won't you be a dear and wallow in despair for me?
Heheheh. How marvelous. Entertain me more, if you dare.
Tsk... What brutes.
Summon: I am Cornelia Arnim, court mage of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus, and I expect to be for some time...
Learn Skill: Oh, for me? One can never be too prepared, after all.
Confession:
Summoner, I presume you were the one who called me to this world...
Knowing full well who I am, you made ready to welcome me as your ally to attain victory in battle. Correct?
Heheh, such an avaricious desire for victory... I don't hate it. In fact, it makes me feel right at home.
This world is so beset by threats that you need strength like mine. There is not a moment's respite, is there?
Hahaha! It sounds enthralling! I don't typically play with beasts, but if I can toy with them until their last breath...
Oh, my, look at me getting all worked up. This body will never hold out if I let myself get carried away like that.
I suppose I should take my time and really enjoy myself, then...
Special: I'll take good care of you.
Don't look at me like that!
Status: Pathetic.
Get up.
I am Cornelia. How lovely to make your acquaintance. *chuckle*
That Dimitri is such a troublesome young man...
Patricia was willing to sacrifice anyone or anything. I granted her wish, in exchange for the king's head...
*Chuckle* You should be wallowing in despair about now.
You seem quite useful. Perhaps I should take you home with me...

nerpuz.name: Nerþuz
nerpuz.title: God of the Land
nerpuz.description: Goddess of Vanaheimr, the realm of light. She exudes a maternal aura and adores all the many creatures who live upon the land.

Castle Hall: There are so many children of Midgard here... Such an abundance of adorable little things! Ahh...
I have no attachment to Vanaheimr. Njörðr and I are like water and stone, and the other gods are so...uncute.
Come here and let me squeeze you! You don't mind, do you, [S]?
Among the gods, I am the odd one out in that I have a certain infatuation with mortals like you...

Vanaheimr and Ásgarðr are both realms in which gods live, though we are on extremely bad terms...
Not that I had anything to do with it.
Visit: There you are! And every bit as cute as [F] promised!
Level: I do hope you can forgive me... You simply have no hope of defeating me as you are.
Ahh... Have I gotten stronger?
Perhaps I ought to spend less of my time napping...
Summon: Heh. How adorable... Somehow I knew you would summon me here, [S]...
Learn Skill: Oh, what joy! Come here and let me give you a squeeze of appreciation!
Confession:
Show me your divine weapon, [S]...
I can bless your weapon with the power of the land.
And I will...someday. Or perhaps I already have...
Either way, I freely choose to give you my blessing. And in return, I ask only one thing...
I can give you just one more little squeeze, can't I?
Status: I am Nerþuz. People know me as the goddess of the land.
You are cute, but you mustn't poke and prod like that.
All creatures that live upon the land are precious to me—and that includes you and your kind.
The trees, the squirrels, and, oh, the bears, too… All my little darlings.
Njörðr may be my brother, but we could not be more opposite in the way we think.
May all the cute little creatures of this land go forth and be fruitful...
Come here. Let me SQUEEZE you!

chrom8.name: Chrom
chrom8.title: Fell Exalt
chrom8.description: Former exalt of Ylisse who lost his life to the Fell Dragon Grima and became lord over the Risen. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: The land and its people...all come to ruin. Nothing remains but...a wasteland of despair...
The Fire Emblem...is nothing before the despair that approaches, but...
If your future is one of loss...is set in stone...it is best not to dally with hope to begin with...
Robin... I shall never again...feel the joy of hearing of your voice...
Those who were once my friends... are no more. Only the Risen remain...
Visit: [S]... [F]'s castle will soon descend into...despair...
Level: All is fated...to fall...to ruin...
You shall count yourself...among the dead...
You would...block my path...
Summon: Who calls me? My name is...Chrom... I am the king of corpses. Where I go... despair follows...
Learn Skill: If this power were mine...back then...
Confession:
All with physical form...shall fall to ruin. The country and people...the history and traditions... will crumble.
