Destruction cares not of mercy. It consumes the people...their bonds... their love...their very hearts...
None...can escape...this fate... do not believe Askr to be the exception, [S]...
Status: I am Chrom... Exalt over these fell forces...
Back away...
Fate is inevitable... There is no changing it.
All corpses now—everyone... Ylisse is gone...
Emmeryn, Lissa, Robin...
I cannot protect a thing...
You must follow fate's decree...

fbyleth5.name: Byleth
fbyleth5.title: Vengeance Vessel
fbyleth5.description: An elite mercenary known as the Ashen Demon, but she seems to have changed somehow—and now she seeks vengeance. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: Begone with you, now! Leave this to me.
You want my thoughts on Fódlan? It is a weeping land, bathed in blood, and in desperate need of a savior.
You are quite the strange one. I do wonder what you are doing here...
If you are idle, and it is entertainment that you seek, come and spend some time with me.
What's wrong, you ask? I seem different to you somehow? Ask me later... I am sleepy, at the moment.
Visit: I have arrived at last. You may now rejoice, [S].
Level: Not bad, not bad!
I can do more than this!
It would seem I have reached the limit of this body...
Summon: I am...Byleth. Yes, Byleth. A simple mercenary, and nothing more.
Learn Skill: I will make my mark.
Confession:
Nothing but endless battle, day in and day out. How droll!
Well. I suppose even a progenitor god must endure an unpleasant turn of events now and again.
Ugh—this vessel, it simply will not behave! Stop it! What do you think you're doing?!
Apologies—I know I'm not myself. And I'm sure you already know what's come over this body.
It can't be helped, but...no use dwelling on it. As the Ashen Demon, I will bring my blade to bear for you.
Status: Become my vessel? Ha! A foolish hope.
Such vexing arrogance for one so small.
A vessel like this one constrains me so. Its poor quality stifles my power.
It yet remains behind a veil to me... Tell me, why am I here?
Revenge fulfills your own desires. Boast not of taking it for someone else's sake.
And now, behold all that I have discovered at the edge of time.
*laugh* It would seem you begin to understand.

maria3.name: Maria
maria3.title: Ritual Sacrifice
maria3.description: Youngest princess of Macedon, kidnapped and robbed of her consciousness by Gharnef for use as a sacrifice to Medeus. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Is this a dream? I see nothing but darkness all around me...
If not for the war, I could have lived a quiet life...with Michalis and Minerva...
It's all right... Once I accept Lord Medeus's control, everything will... be better...
I don't want to see Michalis and Minerva fight again... This world... So awful...
Macedon? I'm sorry, I...don't know what that is...
Visit: Where am I? What is this place? It's not [F]'s castle...
Level: Michalis... Minerva... Please don't leave me here alone...
Lord Medeus will rule the world...
Stay back... You frighten me.
Summon: I am...Maria. I offer up my life...for the world Lord Medeus will create.
Learn Skill: Do I use this...to take more lives?
Confession:
Michalis! Minerva! Are you here to... save me? Wait, no... You're not my... You're [S].
Where am I?
I'm tired of being afraid... I'm tired of being sad all the time...
If this is what the world is like...then the world is bad. It should end. Lord Medeus can make it end.
Or maybe you can end it for me? Please...it's the only way to stop the endless conflict...
Status: Rise.
Move.
Slay all who defy Lord Medeus.
Minerva, is that you? Michalis, are you there?
Who… Who am I?
My family… I want to be together... Always…
Will you be my friend? Will you stay with me? And never leave?

anankos.name: Anankos
anankos.title: Seething Silence
anankos.description: The dragon of wisdom having succumbed to madness. The memories of those he once held dear lie in the depths beneath the waves. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: You believe ME mad? It is HUMANITY that has lost its way! You forget your debt—my blood does not come free!
Valla was paradise... Those days... Their melodies are lost. Smiles on faces I no longer remember...

Why do you hinder me, deny me?! Is it so wrong to crush that which is beneath me?
Is it so wrong to...wish for that which I have lost?!
Are you able to call to your side... any being you wish? Bring me...the king of Valla from days past.
I will search as long as it takes... The Valla I dream of must exist! Where our kinds are not at odds...
Visit: This is not the land I seek... This is not my Valla... I have come here at [F]'s request...
Level: What becomes of me matters not.
Quickly, on to the next world...
The turnings of this world are of no interest to me.
Summon: I am Anankos, of the First Dragons... Why have you called me here? Simply to kill? ...Or is there more?
Learn Skill: Even this gesture is empty of real meaning... Nevertheless, I will remember this.
Confession:
You come to gawk? To take pleasure in my suffering?
Outside of Valla, I am but a shadow of my true self. That much I know now...painfully well...
I am bound here, unable to act as I choose...unable even to succumb to madness.
Cadros is gone... I know this. So then why can I think of nothing and no one else?!
I loathe you, Summoner, for forcing me to live knowing this truth.
There will come a day when you will learn what it means to suffer! I will see to that! That is...unless...
Unless, perhaps, we find you can make a suitable substitute...
Status: Away, insect, unless you wish to vanish from this world.
You claim sanity, yet engage in such frivolous banter! Have you passed beyond reason?
Humans are chattel who forget what they owe when it suits them.
You stand no chance against one such as me! I will crush your bones beneath my feet—and even that fate is more than you deserve!
This world is wrong, wrong, wrong! This is not the path I am meant to tread!
Cadros... Hm. Even now, I think of you and remember those days with fondness...
You cannot know the pain of being forgotten—of what you are, what you are owed, falling from memory...

linus2.name: Linus
linus2.title: Savage Dog
linus2.description: Member of the Black Fang assassins. Following his death and now made into a morph, a living construct, by Nergal. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Morphs, huh? Never heard of 'em... What I wanna know is...what the hell is going on with my body?
Somewhere along the way, we took a wrong turn... Was it her fault, or were we on that path from the start?
Our prey is right in front of us... So let's stop licking our chops and take a bite already!
Father, Brother, where did... Right, Nino was... No, wait. I don't get it. I don't get any of this...
It's getting harder to move... Little by little, my body's growing colder from the inside out...
Visit: Huh? Who are you? Why...am I here?
Level: The Fang's justice has been dispensed... The end is coming for all of you.
Once the Mad Dog's teeth find your throat, there's no loosening his grip...
Ugh... Lloyd, where are you? Answer me, please...
Summon: I am of the Black Fang... Or am I? Why can't I remember? My name is... Linus. I think...
Learn Skill: What are you...going to make me do with this?
Confession:
We, the Black Fang... We fought to embolden the weak...protect the vulnerable...uplift the downtrodden.
All this...without excess or cruelty. We lived to dispense the Fang's justice...unto the truly deserving.
My father, my brother...Legault and the rest... We were bound by trust, each of us of the same mind.
Until that woman came along... She took all that we had...and shattered it to pieces...
Is this...all that's left of my sanity? I can feel it slipping away...as my body grows colder...
Status: I'm of the Fang...
Brother...is that you?
The Mad Dog. Yes… That's right. That's me.
Nino? Nino... I know I've heard that name before...
My father and brother do not make mistakes…
Father... How could you trust that woman?
You... I won't kill you…

atiki4.name: Tiki
atiki4.title: Bridal Reflections
atiki4.description: The Voice, Tiki, who met her younger self at the bridal festival and is having a lovely time together with herself. They appear in Fire Emblem Awakening / Mystery of the Emblem.
atiki4.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Shields】, "neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat," and "neutralizes unit's penalties during combat" to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
Once used, Harmonized Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Harmonized Skill has already been used, unit can use Harmonized Skill again.
【Resonance: Shields】 Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."

Castle Hall: Among all of these Heroes, only one has earned the title of "Hero-King." We are all lucky to know him.
Robin wears this attire much like Marth. Somehow, however, I feel as if the one he truly resembles is me...
**Tiki**: I hope I get to be a bride one day too. Like everyone else at the festival!
**Tiki**: Who do you want to marry, Big Tiki? Whisper it in my ear and I won't tell anyone! Hehe... You're blushing.
**Tiki**: If you're Big Tiki, then I'm Small Tiki. And if I sit on your shoulders, we'll become Extra-Big Double Tiki! Hehe!
Visit: Here, I have something for you. Think of it as a gesture of goodwill from your friend [F].
Level: **Tiki**: I heard whoever gets the bouquet will win something incredible. Let's do our best, Big Tiki!
Taking setbacks in stride, persevering through fear, doubt, and misfortune— that is why human nature is beautiful.
Everyone is battling it out for the bouquet. Stay behind me, Tiki. I won't let you to come to harm.
Summon: I am Tiki, the Voice of the Divine Dragon. This here is a prior version of me. We are here for the festival.
Learn Skill: **Tiki**: I love Big Tiki and all my friends. I think that means I'll be a happy bride one day.
Confession:
**Tiki**: Humans and dragons, like light and darkness, are forever in conflict.
The rivalry has ebbed and flowed over countless years. I have seen as much with my own eyes...
But if your drooping eyelids are any indication, it's probably best we set aside the lecture for now.
Instead, let me ask you this: when you first ventured out of the Ice Dragon Temple...were you afraid?
**Tiki**: No, not really. At least not once I met Mar-Mar, Caeda, and all their lovely friends. They were ever so nice!
**Tiki**: I'm glad to hear that. In fact, I think you'd do well to continue to make as many human friends as you can.
Speak with them. Learn everything about them. Cherish the memories you make with them forever.
**Tiki**: You're crying, Big Tiki. Are you thinking of something sad?
**Tiki**: No, I... No. On the contrary, I am filled with joy for all I've been able to experience.
I have seen the spirit of dragonkind, and I have witnessed the heart of humanity in equal measure.
You and I have saved our worlds from shadow and despair—and in so doing, have made so many friends.
Despite the conflict between dragons and humanity, we have held dear the love they have bestowed upon us.
So, let us stay the course. In time, I truly believe we will be blessed.
Status: "Hmm, your dress... There we are." "Oh! Thank you! Does it look nice?"
Conversation: **Tiki**: So I take his hand... And then, the ring goes on... *giggle*
**Tiki**: Tiki, what are you doing?
**Tiki**: I'm playing weddings! I'm marrying Mar-Mar.
**Tiki**: Marrying Mar-Mar... Mm... Well, Tiki, you see... Er...
**Tiki**: Big Tiki, when I grow up, will I be pretty like you?
'Cause then, maybe Mar-Mar will marry me. What do you think?
**Tiki**: Wh-what do I think? Well, uh, how should I put it... It's not that simple. When you grow up, well...
**Tiki**: Not that simple?
**Tiki**: Oh, don't mind me. Follow your dream! Here's an idea—let's practice.
**Tiki**: All right. I'll be the groom. So! Tiki!
**Tiki**: Hee hee... Yes?
**Tiki**: Today we have the couple here... Erm... What do I say... In sickness and in health!
In good times and bad... We stay together forever! Do you promise?
**Tiki**:  Yes. I vow to stay together with you forever.
**Tiki**: What a beautiful day! Hee hee!
**Tiki**: That's enough practice, I think! It's time to meet up with the others. Ready?
**Tiki**: Yes! Let's go!

anna4.name: Anna
anna4.title: Secret Charmer
anna4.description: A merchant with many secrets who has been swept up in the world of the bridal festival, now hatching schemes to make an easy fortune. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
This may all just be for the festival, but that doesn't mean everything here is fake.
So long as the wedding gifts keep coming, I'm happy to pour all my heart into this!

You know, my sisters and I have never actually talked about marriage... Isn't that weird?
You'd think a topic like that would come up at least once in a family so brimming with beauties!

I booked a venue for the after-party! We still need to figure something out for the after-after-party, though...
Might as well charge these lovebirds for their honeymoon send-off while I'm at it!
The Voice of the Divine Dragon is here, and she's brought a friend! That means double the autographs!
Oh, a bridal bouquet? I hear those are in pretty high demand right now, but I can get you one for half-price.
Visit: Business is booming, so I'm here to share the love! Send the thank-you gifts to [F]!
Level:
I don't normally like standing out this much, but it's been great for drawing in new customers. Wanna see?
Ahem... Feast your eyes on these gowns that'll have you feeling bold and adored on the big day!
Here's the deal: if you can avoid boring me to tears, I'll let you partner up with me for the next big event!
Oof, that really could have gone better. Guess Lady Luck isn't on your side today, huh?
Summon:
I'm Anna, the premier purveyor of happiness! If there's business to be had, I'll be there!
And if I just so happen to run into a special someone of my own along the way, that'll only sweeten the deal!
Learn Skill: Are you sure you're not mistaking me for one of my sisters? Well, either way, I'll gladly accept this gift!
Confession:
Oh, bridal festival, my beloved... These fancy dresses and suits are practically flying off the shelves.
Immensely expensive garments are in season, and just in time to balloon my margins to new heights!
They say money talks, and that's never been truer. Tying the knot is nice and all, but it's so expensive!
Oh, don't get me wrong—I'm not trying to squash anyone's dreams of the perfect big day.
Even I've thought about finding someone and building that kind of loving relationship, you know.
But that's enough of that talk. This is a festival, right? We should be going out and having some fun!
...What, nervous? Me? Fine, fine. Even I can act like a blushing maiden when faced with a promising prospect.
Anyway, um... I feel like taking a walk, but I want you to lead. Here, take my arm... There! The rest is up to you.
And before you ask, I have absolutely no ulterior motive. We're just enjoying a casual stroll together, OK?!
Special: Bring a better gift next time!
Status: Hm? Come on, I can devote myself to things other than money!
Hey, no laughing! It's normal to get nervous before a big payday!
This dress is kind of uncomfortable, but it's worth wearing just for the gifts!
You know, I wonder if any of my sisters have gotten married...
I'm not the type to sit back and be taken care of. After all, two sources of income are better than one!
I'm about to start planning a ceremony of my own... Just think of all the wedding gifts. Mm.
I'm glad you got to see me dressed up like this before the festival ended. Not bad, huh?

sayri2.name: Say'ri
sayri2.title: Righteous Bride
sayri2.description: Princess of Chon'sin who has been showered with festive bridal blessings. She takes part despite being puzzled by the festival at large. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: To think me the blushing bride, and in such foreign attire, no less! P'raps Yen'fay would celebrate all the same.

Restoring Chon'sin, my homeland, to its former glory is of the utmost import. 'Tis a task rife with hardship.
For that reason, I am most eager to acquire a partner prepared to assist me in this vital campaign.
'Tis my first time donning garments such as these. I beseech you... Would you say they suit me?
A princess I may be, but Chon'sin is naught but a meager kingdom. 'Tis no surprise we need care for ourselves.
Wheat and rice look to have much in common. Could one then assume bread might be made using rice?
Visit: In the spirit of the bridal festival, please accept this small gift in honor of the celebration. May it impart joy.
Level:
Even in the throes of battle I've pondered what it is to love...and suddenly it's struck me!
Knowing you would lay down your very life for another, that is love. 'Tis an everlasting fount of daring.
Heed not my attire, lest you mistake me for anything other than your deadliest foe, a warrior of Chon'sin.
P'raps I lack the adoration necessary to play the bride...
Summon: 'Tis with a happy heart that I join in this festival. I may not grasp all of the customs, but I attend with all sincerity.
Learn Skill: Ah, you share this joy with me that I might use it as my own. Together, we shall create a cycle of bliss.
Confession:
I had no notion of what to expect from this festival, so my heart is full of gratitude at your presence here.
I would have truly felt out of sorts without you at my side. That is to say... My home is quite different.
In the spring, the kingdom of Chon'sin is teeming with thousands of blooming cherry trees and florals.
'Tis the springtime when families gather under the blooms to celebrate marriage and exchange solemn vows.
I have long imagined drinking from the three nuptial cups—past, present, future—and declaring my eternal love.
I suppose 'tis not too dissimilar from this festival. In the end, all I wish is for a partner to share in life's trials.
If I may, p'raps you would enlighten me on customs of your land...and your ideal partner?
Status: I am Say'ri. I may yet have much to learn, but I pray this relationship brings us both happiness.
Fie! Do not surprise me while I wear such unfamiliar raiments.
I am not yet well prepared to marry. I am well prepared to fight, however.
The Voice in bridal garb... 'Tis a sight that stirs the heart.
I would like to show my homeland to whomever I end up marrying.
I wonder... Should I marry, would Yen'fay be happy for me?
Tell me, what do you think of this attire? It suits me? I am pleased to hear it.

flavia2.name: Flavia
flavia2.title: Bold Bride
flavia2.description: Khan of Regna Ferox appearing at the bridal festival in bridal attire, much to everyone's surprise—including her own. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Listen up: I'm only here for the festival. I didn't think I'd actually have to wear this thing. Really!

I became the ruling khan of Regna Ferox by besting all others. There are none stronger in my kingdom.
Hm, maybe I should be looking for a strong partner somewhere outside our borders...
Sheesh, this is one hell of a festival. My people might enjoy a diversion like this after the fighting tournament.

Hey, you got something to say to me? I know I probably don't look the most natural in this dress...
But stop trying to find some polite way to tell me that and just spit it out already!
Don't think wearing a fancy dress will stop me from training hard like I always do. The clothes serve me!
Visit: Don't ask about the dress. Do come to the ceremony though! Oh, here's a gift from [F].
Level:
Protect your family and support your companion, huh? Kind of reminds me of my duties as ruling khan.
Guess this whole "wife" thing won't be so hard after all!
If things keep going this well, I might just become the strongest bride alive!
Hey! You're supposed to walk me down the aisle, not into a ditch!
Summon: I'm Flavia, ruling khan of Regna Ferox. Don't give me that look. I'm just as confused as you are!
Learn Skill: I'm feeling better than ever! Seems like spending time with you might have something to do with that, eh?
Confession:
Whew, I'm beat. My muscles are on fire... How about you massage the knots out, [S]?
You can start with my feet. Yeah, that's good. Hm, maybe I could get used to being pampered like this...
At least, that's what I thought at the beginning of the festival. I can't say I'm a fan of the frilly clothes, though.
All right, lower back next. Keep it moving. Anyway, this just proves that weddings are the same everywhere.
Couples are always subjected to all this flashiness and ceremony. It just isn't my thing, and never has been.
I was raised to fight tooth and nail, to barrel through all the dirt and grime necessary to win.
Hell, I became ruling khan through a fighting tournament.
I thought this sort of outfit didn't suit me at all, that maybe it was time to cast it aside...
But you obviously think it looks good on me. What? I can tell by your face!
You're not nearly as subtle as you think you are. Much like a certain old oaf I know back home...
You know what, I suppose I'll keep playing along until the festival is over, dress and all.
Let's finish up with the shoulders, then. Well, what are you waiting for? Get to it already!
Special: Where do you think you're going?
Status: Thinking this look doesn't suit me, aren't you? Ha! I can see right through you.
*scoff* Mock me again and you'll meet my blade.
What would I do for my wedding? I'd get the whole country together for a fighting tournament!
I'd be the strongest wife there is, protecting both my husband and my country!
You want to know what I look for in a man? I bet you do.
Wonder if I'll get married one day... You never know.
You can walk me down the aisle then. You're honored, I can tell.

mrobin6.name: Robin
mrobin6.title: Keen Groom
mrobin6.description: Tactician of Ylisse and Chrom's other half. He has been appointed to the role of groom and is working on a strategy for surviving the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I hope I'll be able to play my role convincingly. I must admit, even just wearing the outfit makes me nervous.
What does marriage mean to you? To me, it represents becoming family with someone you love.
Where was it I read that governing a family is just as much trouble as managing an entire kingdom? Hmm...
What kind of person do you want to be with? Maybe it's unfair of me to ask—I'm not sure of my own answer.
Chrom's wedding was magnificent. I'll carry the memory of the happy couple's joy for the rest of my life.
Visit: Hello, I'm Robin. I bring you tidings from—wait, I'm still dressed for a wedding, aren't I? Well, too late now.
Level: That went well! I hope my wedding vows will be as joyous an occasion.
Weddings and battles have a lot in common. Each requires careful planning to avoid it all going wrong.
These clothes represent something important. I shouldn't sully them with this kind of performance...
Summon: I'm Robin, a tactician of Ylisse. I know I'm to play the role of groom, but... Who am I supposed to be marrying?
Learn Skill: Oh, wow. Someone's getting into the spirit of the reception!
Confession:
I know this is the idea, but seeing all these lovely people in wedding attire makes me think of getting married.
Maybe Askr will be where I find the one to spend my life with. What do you think, [S]?
Ah, that's right. You did mention that you aren't originally from here either. I guess we have that in common.
There must be people from your homeland you miss. Loved ones you feel lonely to be without...
Sorry—I don't mean to pry, or bring down the mood. Still, it won't do for you to be lonely at a festival like this.
Well, as long as I'm here, I promise you won't be. Here, take my hand. Let's go enjoy the festivities together.
Status: I know it's only for fun, but dressing up like a groom still gives me butterflies in my stomach.
*start* Hey, don't do that! I'm nervous enough as it is!
There's no greater joy than spending your days with the one you love.
Hah! You should have seen Chrom's wedding.
The brides' dresses are like flowers in bloom. Everyone looks incredible!
I'd like to find someone to spend the rest of my life with.
You have so many people close to you. I must say, I envy them.

hinoka5.name: Hinoka
hinoka5.title: Thundering Wings
hinoka5.description: Queen of Hoshido, having taken up both the convictions and the divine weapons of her brothers, Ryoma and Takumi. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The battlefield is no place to show off—the point is to keep your head and survive.
I lost my temper with Takumi once, attempting to explain that losing him would break us...would break...me.
Lavish titles are embarrassing... I'd prefer you treat me no different than any other warrior in your retinue.
The food in this castle is incredible. Soybeans used to replace meat? I'm sure even Sakura would love it...
Ryoma told me you must always keep your future in mind, and I find myself wanting to tell you the same now.
Visit: I see... So, this is your castle then. To tell the truth, it has a similar feel to [F]'s castle.
Level: Nothing can scare me anymore. Now, don't let up—victory is near!
Things may be going well now, but I won't just rest on my laurels.
Are you here to watch me fight? Well, I've done better, but this will do—for the moment.
Summon: Being called on as a Hero is certainly an honor—it's my chance to show off the might of Hoshidan kinshi knights!
Learn Skill: With this, I'll be able to do even more for you. I look forward to being able to put it to use!
Confession:
Do you happen to notice anything different about me? Any scent you may not have noticed before?
...Nothing? Maybe try getting a little bit closer... Take a sniff.
Smells good, right? It's a fragrance crafted by the artisan perfumers of Hoshido.
Perfumes aren't usually an interest of mine, but I know there is a certain image we royals must keep up.
Ryoma once told me I could stand to behave more properly, and I'm trying to take that to heart, so...
I tried my best to remember how to apply perfume, but I may have forgotten the finer details.
But now I want to try on different perfumes every day until I can find the perfect scent for me!
Any help you can offer along the way would be appreciated... I will follow your nose, [S]!
Status: I'm a Legendary Hero? Might be a stretch, but I'll take it.
Ah! Uhh... What is it? Oh. We're not children. Show some restraint.
It is an honor to be called Legendary Hero. Though I don't deserve the title, I will do my best to live up to it.
I guess following my own path paid off.
I'm feeling restless... Do you have time to talk?
I'm sure Azama and Setsuna will have plenty to say about this...
I intend to become a Hero who can support you, no matter what may happen.

heidr.name: Heiðr
heidr.title: Innocent Goddess
heidr.description: Goddess of Vanaheimr, the realm of light. Pure and innocent, she adores Seiðr like a sister.

Castle Hall: Midgard is so full of people... I'm happy to have this opportunity to meet them all.
Seiðr and I were raised together like sisters—and we look so similar, you'd be surprised to learn we're not!
Is there something unusual about my outfit here in this world?
You must not lie to a goddess. So, tell me the truth... What do you think of Seið?
They say goddesses are born in light. I can't say I have any memories from when I came to be, myself...
Visit: I am Heiðr, goddess of Vanaheimr. Would you...be willing to show me around this castle of yours?
Level: Do you think I'll grow to be as strong as Seiðr if I continue on like this?
Don't worry over me. I am still a goddess of Vanaheimr, after all.
I hope you can forgive this... I'm rather embarrassed.
Summon: Y-you summoned...me? I hope Seiðr doesn't get the wrong idea, with you being her destined and all...
Learn Skill: Thank you, but... I hope you didn't forget to give Seiðr a gift as well. I don't want her to feel left out...
Confession:
Goddesses can create children of their own... Did you know that, [S]?
Like you, I have a mother... I know she exists, somewhere. I exist, so I know she created me.
Of course, that doesn't change the fact that I don't know her.
Even so, knowing she's out there is like a light in the darkness—even if I never am able to meet her.
This curse is sure to be the end of me soon. I can feel how little time I have left...
I'm still grateful for what time I was given.
Special: I will do as Seið would!
Status: I'm Heiðr. I know I may not look the part, but I am a goddess of Vanaheimr.
Ah— But your destiny lies with my sister!
So then, this is Seiðr's destined... How exciting!
A goddess who gives the gift of revelation will be wholly bound to their destined... That's no small matter!
Seiðr is so kind... She has always been like a sister to me.
I'm sorry, Seið... I would never wish this on you...
I hope you show Seiðr the kindness she deserves... Oh, should I say please?

fir3.name: Fir
fir3.title: Swordmaiden
fir3.description: With blade in hand, has worked to polish her skills, following in her mother's shadow. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall:
In my mother's family, only one child was allowed to learn their clan's secret sword techniques.
Mother may not be around to teach them to me, but I'll still try to become as strong as she was!
I don't know much about my mother's tribe. We lived on our own—just Mother, Father, and me.
Sometimes, I look at my sword, and I can almost see my mother's face in the shine of the blade.
Who here's ready to fight? I won't rest till I've sparred with all of you!

It's funny. When people see me fight with my sword, they can tell that I'm from Sacae.
Reclusive as my mother's clan was, I guess something about our style connects us to other Sacaens.
Visit: I'm Fir, the myrmidon! Now, pull out your blade and prepare to— What? C'mon, a quick bout!
Level: I'm going to find my own way forward. I have to decide for myself the meaning of my blade!
I hope Mother is watching over me.
*pant* *pant* Best two out of three?
Summon: I'm Fir, daughter of Bartre the warrior and Karla the Sword Princess. I am taking my own path in life!
Learn Skill: Every day is a chance to reach new heights!
Confession:
There was a time when all I wanted was to train with my uncle, the legendary Saint of Swords.
He was close to my mother, the Sword Princess, so...I thought he could teach me about who she was.
And I believed if he taught me how to master the sword, I would have her strength. But he disagreed.
He said weapons weren't what made someone strong. They were just tools for taking life.
I was my own person—not my mother, and not him—and I shouldn't try to walk the same paths as them.
Then our eyes met, and the look of misery in his eyes... It knocked the wind out of me.
I saw the terror behind his mastery. Every swing of his sword had brought him closer to drowning in darkness.
His path was cursed... He was a killer. That's not where I want my road to take me.
I don't believe that was my mother's path either. Father must have seen more in her to love her so much.
Every day, I'm closer to knowing who she was... I'm glad you're with me on my journey, [S].
Status: Can you see how I'm overflowing with strength now? It's as if I've been reborn. I want to show you what I can do!
Oh! You got me from behind. How frustrating!
I've had the opportunity to cross swords with so many people here. I can't think of a better way to improve my skill. It's been a real help!
I caught my father crying when he saw me. He was smiling a little, too.
I'm not finished yet! I'll continue down the road I'm traveling, getting stronger.
I wish Mother could have seen me like this.
I want to use this power to help you accomplish your goals.

saul.name: Saul
saul.title: Loving Shepherd
saul.description: A priest of Saint Elimine who cannot refrain from speaking with any beautiful woman he comes across in his travels. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: There is no use contemplating why conflict continues. Better to spend that time praying for it to end.
Thanks to my efforts, Saint Elimine gains more followers by the day. And they are all beautiful people.
This place is full of so many lovely individuals. I am looking forward to spreading the good word here.
Prayer to Saint Elimine is said to help with any problem. She is particularly popular among young ladies.
The divine guides me to hold the beauty of a young lady in the highest regard. Any less would be an insult.
Visit: Hello. I am a priest of Saint Elimine. Would you like to hear a sermon about the joy of her blessing?
Level: I suppose you wish to hear something like, "Nothing makes me happier than contributing to your cause"? All right.
A grievous fate awaits all who dismiss the sacred word of Saint Elimine. Repent while you still can!
According to Saint Elimine, the divine has faith in people—and thus does not intervene to save them.
Summon: A pleasure to meet you. I am Saul, a servant of Saint Elimine. I hope you will allow me to preach freely here.
Learn Skill: I shall gladly receive this, that I might better serve Saint Elimine.
Confession:
The battlefield has a way of revealing people's true colors, as I am sure you are well aware.
In the throes of conflict, people are apt to show you their very best...and, just as often, their absolute worst.
Why, then, does the divine not simply conjure up a storm to wash away all undesirable souls?
The answer is simple: the possibility of redemption. The wicked must be allowed the opportunity to repent.
Saint Elimine envisions a world without petty squabbles. One in which we learn to live together in happiness.
If that interests you, then I would encourage you to—oh, look at the time! Pardon me, but I must be going.
I promised some young ladies an exclusive sermon. Until next we meet, Saint Elimine's blessing be upon you!
Status: Rise, my child.
I will aid you.
I have never laid eyes on you before... I am Saul, a servant of Saint Elimine.
My interest, as a humble priest, is in saving souls and no more than that. That is all that guides my actions.
Oh, it's you. I was hoping to run into the young lady who took such an interest in my teachings earlier.
As a servant of the holy one, I must be unstinting with my kindness.
Would you listen to my words? I am happy to discuss theology anytime.

dorothy.name: Dorothy
dorothy.title: Devoted Archer
dorothy.description: A member of the Elimine Church and bodyguard to the priest Saul, at the mercy of the priest's carefree behavior. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Wow, it looks like there are a lot of expert archers here. I'd like to learn a thing or two from them if I can...

Ugh, it's people like Father Saul that muddy Saint Elimine's good name!
Imagine, pretending to deliver holy teachings while just chatting up every girl you see...
I want to heal the injured, just like Father Saul and Bishop Yoder. I pray to the holy one about it every day.

How to approach them... "Hey, that's a nice bow, can I touch it?" Argh, no, no, that's all wrong...
Come on, Dorothy, you need to be more natural...

"Come, one and all! Pledge yourself to Saint Elimine and all of your problems will instantly be solved!"
Good grief, Father Saul, again with these fliers?
Visit: Wow, what a beautiful castle! Here, I have a delivery for you from your friend [F].
Level: Oh, yes! That's good, right? I think that went really well!
I'm so sorry, but please move out of the way! I need to track down Father Saul before he gets into trouble!
I tend to get scared when I go into an actual battle... My nerves make it so I can't move my body like I want to...
Summon: My name is Dorothy. I'm Father Saul's bodyguard... Oh, where did he run off to now?
Learn Skill: I'm not so sure I deserve this, but... I-I'll try my best!
Confession:
OK, Dorothy, time to get some good training in so you're not a burden on the other Heroes... Ah!
Watch out!
I-I'm so sorry! I tried to aim for the target, but the arrow flew over this way instead, a-and—
Oh gosh, get it together, Dorothy! You're not hurt, are you? I am so terribly sorry!
A-are you sure you're all right? Whew...that's good. You're such a kind person, Summoner.
You've got these incredible powers, but you're still so humble...
Father Saul could learn a thing or two from you!
Special: I think I can do this!
Status: My name is Dorothy. I'm Father Saul's bodyguard.
Aah! Please don't do that again. Oh, my poor nerves...
There are so many archers here... I hope I can learn from them.
Have you seen Lady Clarine? Oh... Just Clarine, since we're friends. *giggle*
I can't find Father Saul anywhere... Oh no, what is he up to this time?
I wish I could do more to help people. I'd love to heal the sick and injured with holy power...
I want to be of use to you. If you need anything at all, please let me know.

noah.name: Noah
noah.title: Mercenary-Errant
noah.description: A member of the Ilian mercenaries who joins Pherae's army under General Zelot. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Trec and I were part of a ragtag group of recruits General Zelot molded into respectable knights.
I've heard of a Sacaen warrior called the Saint of Swords who fought off an entire bandit horde all by himself.
If I may be blunt, I'm not here for friendship. All I ask is that you tell me when and where to strike the enemy.
It's not like I'm expecting to save the world or anything...but at times I do wonder what all of this fighting is for.
Oh, these? They're supplies I need to write an important letter someday. For now, the page remains blank.
Visit: I have been contracted to deliver these supplies on behalf of your ally, [F].
Level: The chaos of the battlefield requires quick thinking—as long as you don't disobey a direct order, of course.
I presume your strategy predicted this result? I am ready and waiting for your next command.
Yesterday's friend may be today's foe... The reality of mercenary work in times of conflict is harsh.
Summon: I'm Noah, of the Ilian mercenaries. It's always good to gather more allies. I look forward to working together.
Learn Skill: I fight only for my homeland's sake. What money I earn goes directly into providing for those back home.
Confession:
Ilian mercenary squads are always accompanied by a small detachment of non-combatant pegasus riders.
These women are responsible for a sacred duty should any soldiers fall in battle.
Upon such a loss, they will return to Ilia to deliver a special letter to the loved ones of the deceased.
The other knights who enlisted with me have already given their letters to the riders. I haven't yet...
When I imagine the heartbroken face of a family member or lover when my letter arrives on their doorstep, I...
I don't want to inflict that sort of pain on anyone. The stronger the bond, the easier your heart breaks.
Whether or not you agree, you can at least understand where I'm coming from, can't you?
Please, there's no need to look at me like that, Summoner. You can be sure that I won't let my death come easily.
Status: Well met. I am Noah, of Ilia's knights.
Oh! You certainly are a friendly one, aren't you?
I see Fir hasn't changed at all. Even here in Askr, she's still striving to hone her sword skills.
Following orders is admirable, certainly, but sometimes the only way to win is by improvising.
It is thanks to General Zelot that I've been able to come this far.
Nobles from other countries say that Ilia survives by...peddling death... Is it so?
For you, I will fight to the best of my ability. Anything, if it means not losing you.

murdock.name: Murdock
murdock.title: Loyal General
murdock.description: Leader of the Wyvern Generals, who head the army of Bern. He has given his support for his country since even before his king took power. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: How might a battle between me and the commander of the Lycian League turn out, I wonder...
His Majesty Zephiel is the future of Bern. That is why I saved his life.
You may place military matters in my hands, Summoner. You are free to take your leave.
Do not shrink away from displaying your strength.
Swords, lances, bows... No weapon is unfamiliar to me. But I find my axe suits me well.
Visit: Greetings. You must be the one they call [S].
Level: I am above defeat.
Forward.
The military might of Bern is not something to be trifled with.
Summon: I am Murdock, leader of the Wyvern Generals of Bern. I serve under His Majesty King Zephiel.
Learn Skill: Indeed.
Confession:
You are a mystery to me.
I look at you and cannot imagine you have the strength or ability to seize this world.
And yet, I see that your eyes are set steady on the horizon and do not waver from your goal.
I've met few of whom I could say the same. So few in fact, I can count them on my fingers.
I am watching... Do not disappoint me, [S].
Status: I am Murdock, leader of the three Wyvern Generals of Bern. I serve under His Majesty, King Zephiel.
Hm? I have neither the time nor patience for your games.
The Bern army has no need for a man who cannot handle the consequences of his own actions.
His Majesty, King Zephiel, was almost killed by his father, the previous king. It was I who saved him.
Galle will no doubt become a powerful asset to Bern. Where he comes from is irrelevant.
Roy is here, is he? I would like to meet with him. On the battlefield.
I look forward to seeing how you fight.

shamir3.name: Shamir
shamir3.title: Heartbeats United
shamir3.description: Shamir and Catherine, both members of the Knights of Seiros. The two have dedicated themselves to enjoying their time at the beach. They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
shamir3.duo:
Inflicts【Gravity】on foes in cardinal directions of unit and【Feud】on foes within 5 rows or 5 columns centered on unit.
【Gravity】 Restricts target's movement to 1 space through its next action.
【Feud】 Disables all ally skills (excluding unit's) during combat through unit's next action.

Castle Hall: **Catherine**: There aren't many people I trust to have my back—but I know I can count on Shamir.
**Shamir**: People in Dagda marry whoever they want—regardless of gender. You OK, partner? You're blushing.
**Catherine**: Whaddaya think of the swimsuit? Not bad, right? I wonder what Lady Rhea would say about it.
**Shamir**: I'm not used to this kind of outfit...but at least it's easy to move around in. Leave cleaning up the beach to me.
**Shamir**: Catherine's incredibly skilled, but when we're on missions related to Rhea it's like she's wearing blinders.
Visit: Summer tidings from your friend [F]. Here.
Level: **Catherine**: Bright sun, pleasant breeze... I'm rarin' to go!
**Shamir**: Finally getting used to working in this outfit. Bring on the next job.
**Shamir**: It's not like I was slacking off...
Summon: I'm Thunder Catherine, and this here's my partner, Shamir! We're ready for a day at the beach!
Learn Skill: **Catherine**: This is gonna be a great summer! ...Right? C'mon, Shamir, give me some enthusiasm.
Confession:
**Shamir**: Just how long are you going to swim, Catherine? It's practically sundown.
**Catherine**: Yeah, that's why I want to stay out here. Look at the orange sparkles on the water—it's perfect!
Why don't you get in too? We're on vacation! Gotta live it up a little!
**Shamir**: You're frolicking enough for both of us. Think I'll just enjoy the show.
**Catherine**: Hey, I'm not here for your entertainment. But fine. Won't stop me from having a good time!
Status: "Don't you think we're showing too much skin?" "What, worried about a little sunburn?"
Conversation: **Catherine**: Ahhh... Blue sky, clear water, white sand... If this isn't heaven, I don't know what is.
Ah. See that rock? How about it, Shamir? Want to see who can swim over there the fastest?
**Shamir**: Absolutely not. I've waited too long for this vacation to waste it with even more training.
I'm gonna take a nap in the shade over there. You can swim to your little rock by yourself.
**Catherine**: Aw, well, aren't you a spoilsport? Come on, swimming by myself isn't nearly as fun.
Hm... OK, what if the race had some stakes?
**Shamir**: Why would I agree to that?
**Catherine**: Because if you beat me, I'll treat you to a drink or something. Whatever you want.
And if I beat you, then... Well, same deal. Not bad, right?
**Shamir**: Pass. I'm not a child—if I want something, I can just buy it myself.
**Catherine**: Oh, come on! Then what would you want?
**Shamir**: Hmm... If I had to say, it'd probably be some peace and quiet.
**Catherine**: Got it! Then, if you win, I'll go swimming by myself. That work for you?
**Shamir**: Wait. Are you saying I have to win the right to spend time away from you?
**Catherine**: Obviously! We are partners, after all.
**Shamir**: But that's just for work and... *sigh* Arguing won't get me anywhere.
**Catherine**: There we go. Now, if we're doing this, you'd better take it seriously! Let's go, partner!

fshez3.name: Shez
fshez3.title: Mercenary Shine
fshez3.description: A mercenary from Fódlan given unexpected orders to take some time off seaside in Askr. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: I went ahead and brought some nautical charts, just in case. Better safe than sorry.
I don't know how I feel about relaxing in times like these. So, let's just call this "morale building," all right?
When I go somewhere new, I have an itch to wander around and see every nook and cranny of it.
I see the value in these light outfits. If you're fighting in water, you don't want bulky armor weighing you down.
With all this fresh fruit, we'd be fools not to make tropical elixirs. Come on, help me whip them up!
Visit: Summer tidings from your friend. Hm? Oh, don't mention it. Just doing what [F] asked.
Level: The sunshine's done me good. I'm stronger than ever!
Land or sea, doesn't matter—the battle's always won by whoever trained the hardest.
Ugh, why can't I focus?
Summon: I'm Shez. Not an expert in aquatic combat, but I'm adaptable. Hm? You brought me here to relax?
Learn Skill: It's been a productive summer.
Confession:
I've already told you about my upbringing, right? How I was raised in the mountains?
Well, when that's all you've known your whole life, an ocean's a hard thing to comprehend.
Not that it was boring where I came from. There was activity if you knew where to look.
The animals bustling around, the landscape changing color with the seasons.
But an ocean—it's nothing but activity. Water moving and shifting every second you look at it.
It's mesmerizing to watch...and a little unsettling too.
Everything disappears under the waves... Once the currents have you, it's over.
It makes me think: Will I get swallowed up in the undertow of history, my name lost in the depths?
I don't think so. As long as I'm alive, I still have a say—and that's gotta be worth something.
I'll leave a mark while I'm still around, just you watch.
Status: Gotta say, this outfit's pretty easy to move around in. Consider me convinced.
Hm? What, never seen muscles before?
Up for some long-distance swimming? It's great training, you know.
Can't take my eyes off the map, especially on the water...
Sure, I was raised in the mountains, but it's not like I mind visiting the sea.
Look at all that fruit! Wonder if it's tasty…
Don't worry. If I see you struggling, I'll be the first to come to your rescue.

larachel4.name: L'Arachel
larachel4.title: Summer Princess
larachel4.description: Princess of Rausten, gracing the beach in her swimsuit to bring some summer color to Askr! Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I see that Ephraim and Eirika have joined our little beach excursion as well. The more the merrier, I say!
Nothing can match the beauty of Rausten's flawless shores, but this Askran beach is breathtaking!
I must seek shade awhile. The sun is in a jealous rage over my radiance.
I do wish that Dozla and Rennac were here. This pristine water would wash away their worries in an instant!
I, L'Arachel, shall purge this beach of its vile villainy! Face the whacking end of my parasol of justice!
Visit: Rejoice, for I have brought summer tidings from [F]!
Level: Bear witness, O summer sun, for the one who shall outshine even your brilliance has arrived!
Even the waves congratulate me on my performance as they crash upon the rocks in thunderous applause!
My, the summer sun is a formidable opponent indeed...
Summon: I, L'Arachel, have arrived to dazzle you all! Join me, and we shall enjoy the summer to end all summers!
Learn Skill: The glittering brilliance of summer dwells within me!
Confession:
Glittering waves, a gentle breeze, sun-soaked sand... What could make for a more perfect summer scene?
Why, none other than the beautiful princess of peerless beauty! I shall be the crowning jewel of this tableau!
You must be so pleased to have the opportunity to enjoy the summer season at my side.
Alas, it has been fight after fight since my arrival. Heavy is the hand that wields the hammer of justice...
That is not to say that our efforts have been in vain, as we are able to enjoy a moment of respite today.
I pray that the memories we create together under the sun's rays will sustain us in the coming conflicts.
May the image of the midsummer princess of peerless beauty remain forever burning in your heart!
Status: Behold the beach princess!
Stricken by my radiance.
I fear that in this swimwear there is nothing shielding the world from my blinding beauty... How distressing!
You split a melon with a large stick? And this is a game? Then don't tarry! Roll it out!
My, this frozen treat is delicious! Here. Have some.
The sparkling blue ocean truly accentuates my loveliness.
Let us explore the beach! There is no doubt this summer will be one you won't soon forget!

ephraim6.name: Ephraim
ephraim6.title: Sunshine Valiant
ephraim6.description: Prince of Renais looking for any excuse to train during his vacation at the ocean. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: This land's fruits grow in every color possible. What a paradise!
Eirika was right—this ocean is quite pleasant... Alas, training calls!
I thought it would a great feat of strength to swim in full plate, but Innes and Tana put a stop to that...
Running through the sand is a superb way to firm up those legs. How about it, [S]?
I want Eirika to be free of her cares while we are here. I'll train twice as hard for the both of us!
Visit: I'm Ephraim, the prince of Renais. Here you are—a sampling of the sea's bounty from [F].
Level: What, the heat? This is nothing. If I gave up now, Eirika would never let me hear the end of it!
Even if we are blown over by raging waves, I'm sure we will weather the storm!
I guess I overlooked the strength of the sun's rays...
Summon: I'm Ephraim. I had planned to relax but... who can turn down so many perfect opportunities to train?
Learn Skill: This season seems perfect for training. I can only hope my efforts bear some fruit!
Confession:
Do you remember when I told you of my dream to become the greatest spearman in all of Magvel?
Perfecting the craft is only a small part. My true dream lies in traveling the world as a warrior for hire.
Never choosing your destination, just following where the fighting leads... It's imperative you learn to adapt.
You may be required in a dark forest, on a cliff face, or even on a sandy beach like this one...
That's why it's so important for me to be out of my element like this. The training possibilities are endless!
Me? Relax? Don't worry about that, just being here has done my spirit a world of good! Now, excuse me...
I think I have a few more laps in me before my arms give out!
Special: Let's see who can swim faster!
Oh, look, there are fish here!
Status: I'm Ephraim. I think I'll have an enjoyable vacation if you're there too.
*start* Ugh, cease your foolish games and hand me my drink normally.
The beach is nice. It's a good place to strengthen your legs.
Eirika is here too? I hope she's not running wild.
Hmm... So we're going to play a game where we smash that big round fruit? All right. Sounds like fun!
My petty worries seem pretty meaningless when I gaze out over the open ocean...
I must do whatever I can to make this summer special since you're here.

mshez2.name: Shez
mshez2.title: Mercenary Shade
mshez2.description: A mercenary from Fódlan having been tasked with taking a vacation at the Askran coast. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: Odd... The map says there should be land over here.
I was raised in the mountains of Ordelia territory, so I don't know much about beach life.
Just look at that horizon, huh? I wonder if that's where the souls of mercs go after they're gone.
I feel a bit exposed in just this. But I guess the light weight makes it good for training.
I just passed a stall selling frozen dessert. In this heat, I can see that being a money maker.
Visit: I'm Shez. A mercenary. I was hired to deliver this chilled drink from [F].
Level: There's a big wave coming, and I'm gonna catch it!
When it comes to training, I never take a vacation.
Ugh. I think all the warm coastal air is making me soft.
Summon: I'm Shez. I take it you're hiring me for a fight on the water. Not like I have a choice, but... Hm? A vacation?
Learn Skill: I'm finally getting to learn some aquatic fighting techniques!
Confession:
I might be a bit green, but I've been a merc long enough to see my share of battlefields.
This line of work's taken me to all sorts of settings.
From barren fields with no crops to gleaming lakes and majestic, snow-capped mountains.
And you know what those places have in common? They all look like hell when the fighting starts.
Fortunately, our little stretch of paradise here in Askr is far out of the way of battle.
And personally, I aim to keep it that way. That's our job as Heroes anyway, right?
I know it might be strange for someone who profits off war to talk about peace...
But after we're done with this little outing, I really hope this beach stays as serene as we found it.
Status: Something to be said for taking the time to just unwind every once in a while.
Hey, quit poking me! This sunburn hurts!
Not a lotta cover along the coastline... I'll have to keep an eye out.
Surfing? Self-taught, just like my swordsmanship.
I hear running along the beach makes for a great workout. Wanna join me?
Look at all those fish! Wonder if they're tasty…
Want a chilled drink to cool down? I'm taking requests!

guinivere2.name: Guinivere
guinivere2.title: Queen of Bern
guinivere2.description: New queen of Bern, having inherited the throne from Zephiel, now seeking to rebuild Bern for the sake of her people. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I cannot change that Zephiel and Bern brought war on the world. I can only learn from their mistakes.
Elen and Melady have done so much for me... It is not exaggerating to say they are to thank for Bern's new way.
*sigh* ...Sometimes I hold my breath without thinking, like I'm waiting for something bad to happen.
Walking the halls alone is not how I wish to spend my time. Gazing from the window is perfectly suitable.
There are so many Heroes here, all who have known war... I imagine they could also teach me of peace.
Visit: So you're the [S] I was told of...
Level: Zephiel's Bern committed atrocities. I cannot disregard the terrors of the coup, and yet...still, I...
I have broken with the violent past of my people. I will renew the pride of Bern's royal line!
Brother, watch over me, that my heart remains steadfast...
Summon: I am Guinivere, queen of Bern, and as such, it is my duty to heal the ruin my country has suffered in its wars.
Learn Skill: I am prepared for whatever awaits.
Confession:
A soaring wyvern rider is the symbol of Bern. The Hero Hartmut founded our nation of warriors.
But with our wars at an end, we've reduced our military, lest we be seen as hungry for further conquest.
But still the idea of the mighty Bern remains in the hearts of the people...
Still the memory remains of Zephiel bringing the continent to its knees before the three Wyvern Generals.
For those who revere that Bern, I've made it a country of cowards—of chipped fangs and broken spears...
Nevertheless, I must remain steadfast. I will bear it for the sake of Bern, that it might one day return to glory.
I take comfort, though, knowing the difficult road ahead will be that much easier with you at my side...
Special: I will be my people's shield!
Status: I am Guinivere, queen of Bern.
Ah! You certainly seem to enjoy sneaking up on people.
Surely, none of my actions as a leader have been worthy of legend.
My people and I have worked desperately to rebuild Bern after the war.
If I devote myself to my kingdom, I am certain the people will place their faith in me.
I wonder what Zephiel would think of where Bern is headed now...
It would be my greatest joy if what I have learned as queen may be put to use.
Map Select: I will not lose my way.

ymir2.name: Ymir
ymir2.title: Seasons of Life
ymir2.description: Ymir, the dragon of life, with Eir. They are aglow with the radiance of life, enjoying the Askran summer to the fullest.
ymir2.duo:
Neutralizes any【Penalty】on unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit and restores 20 HP to unit and those allies. Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. 
At start of odd-numbered turns, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Penalty】All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).

Castle Hall: **Eir**: The sea is a precious treasure, full of life. We must not allow it to be corrupted by conflict.
**Ymir**: Much like the realm of life, the ocean nurtures so many of the living creatures of this world.
**Ymir**: It's plain to see how mature Eir has become. I'm very proud of her, but at the same time...I mourn what's lost.
**Ymir**: Let's take a run along the beach together, Eir. I want to feel the sand under my feet!
**Eir**: The notion of summer is still new to me. There was nothing like it in the realm of the dead...
Visit: I am Ymir, and this is Eir. We are having a summer celebration over at [F]'s castle.
Level: **Eir**: With Ymir by my side...everything seems to shine a little brighter.
**Eir**: The sun engenders life. When I stand in its rays, I can feel its power...
**Ymir**: Don't overdo it, Eir! Be sure to take breaks and drink plenty of water.
Summon: Look, Eir! The ocean is the source of all life. Don't you feel a connection to it?
Learn Skill: **Eir**: I will do my part to make certain that life in this world endures.
Confession:
**Ymir**: Look at you, all grown up. And the two of us, enjoying our time together on the beach. It's like a dream!
**Eir**: Yes—and it is thanks to you and our friends in the Order of Heroes that I'm able to be here.You rescued me from that deathly prison, and brought me into the light of the sun. I am eternally grateful.
**Ymir**: Think nothing of it. Now, let's focus on making happy memories from here on out. We have a lot to make up for.
**Eir**: Agreed. Let's enjoy ourselves—and preserve the radiance of life, so that we can all go on doing so.
**Ymir**: Well said! Life in Askr shall flourish for as long as the sun shines!
Status:
What a delicious drink! Shall we try the frozen treats next?
 I am...quite full...
Conversation: **Ymir**: Eir! Have a look at this!
**Eir**: Again? What is it this time?
**Ymir**: Crabs. And starfish! Aren't they just lovely? Sea creatures are adorable, don't you think?
**Eir**: They are small, but full of life.
**Ymir**: You've grown so reserved. Long ago, I could count on you to be much livelier.
**Eir**: Do you mean when I was a child? Of course I have changed as I've gotten older...
**Ymir**: I understand that. But there is so much I wish we hadn't missed.
I wanted to be there for you as you grew up. We would have had so much fun!
We could have played hide-and-seek, picked flowers...whatever we wanted.
**Eir**: Your kindness gladdens me... Thank you.
Being with you now is enough for me, however. I am content.
**Ymir**: Are you sure? It seems a shame to miss out on all those fun games.
**Eir**: Are you certain you're not the one who wants to be playing hide-and-seek, Ymir?
**Ymir**: What? Of course not! Though I do happen to be quite good at it. Especially in the forest.
**Eir**: Ehehe... Very well then, let's play. Since we're not in a forest now, perhaps I will stand a chance.
**Ymir**: You want to? Truly? Very well! I shall be the first to hide. Best of luck finding me—I don't think you will!
**Eir**: We'll see. You have until I count to thirty. One, two, three...

fjorm5.name: Fjorm
fjorm5.title: Seaside Thaw
fjorm5.description: The second princess of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. Her heart is filled with excitement experiencing her first swim in the ocean.

Castle Hall: I think I saw Lady Nifl in a swimsuit just now... But that would be silly, wouldn't it?
This tropical ocean is so calm and beautiful... Nifl's seas are full of ice. It's far too cold to swim.
Oh, would you like to share this drink with me? It's quite refreshing on such a hot day!
Ylgr told me before how fantastically vivid Askr's ocean is. I'm happy I get to see it myself!
I've never needed to dress for hot weather before... I'm a little out of my element at the beach.
Visit: I am Fjorm of Nifl, the Kingdom of Ice. I come bearing frozen treats from [F]!
Level: It's nice to be so warm for a change. It looks like I'm enjoying summertime more than I thought I would!
I can keep going! I think I'm finally getting used to the heat.
Whew, I feel a little faint... Do you think I overdid it today?
Summon: I am Fjorm, second princess of Nifl. Wow, the summer sun is so bright and warm...
Learn Skill: Oh, thank you! Do you think this will help me become a better swimmer?
Confession: Summoner, look, the sun is starting to set. You can see its colors reflected in the water. How beautiful... Thank you for teaching me to swim today. I was a little nervous, but the water actually felt very nice. The ocean in Nifl is freezing cold and dangerous to swim in, so it's always been a scary place for me. But I love the ocean now thanks to you! I never thought it could be so much fun. I know I will treasure the memories we made this summer for the rest of my life!
Status: The sun is so hot! I feel like I'll just melt away.
*gasp* That's cold—even for me!
Ah...the sun is really beating down, isn't it? I don't feel well. I hope I'm not spoiling the fun.
I'm used to covering up… I've never dressed this way before.
Isn't this beach ball adorable? Let's watch it fly!
The ocean is so beautiful... I'll carry this warmth with me for the rest of my days.
Um... I've never been swimming. I might look a little...awkward. You're not going to laugh, are you?

ivy2.name: Ivy
ivy2.title: Tidal Breeze
ivy2.description: Crown princess of Elusia. Though she has no enthusiasm for summer, it is tolerable spent by the Divine Dragon's side. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Even in the shade, this place is sweltering. I'm contemplating a dive into the ocean, if only to cool off.
The academy in Elusia would give us time off in the summer, but our vacations were nothing like this.
I wonder what my father would say if he could see this beach. Probably nothing—his face would say it all.
Elusian summers are short and cold. Forget about the ocean—the air alone will freeze you if you fail to cover up.
I've heard that snowfall at sea is a uniquely pretty sight. I hope to show it to the Divine Dragon one day.
Visit: I am Ivy. Before I go to find a colder place to be than here...summer tidings from [F].
Level: I will admit, I've begun to experience something resembling...fun.
I did not expect I'd be honing my battle prowess while dressed for the beach. A pleasant surprise.
I have any number of outfits that would be better suited to—ugh, no. Too hot.
Summon: I am Ivy, crown princess of Elusia. Might you direct me to the chilliest portion of this castle?
Learn Skill: Thank you for the gift. Could I trouble you for an ice-cold drink as well?
Confession: Despite the atrocious heat, and the indignity of swimsuits, I've...begun to become accustomed to being here.In Elyos, where I come from, we sort of merge with our Emblems when we engage with them. So when I began to think of this as rather like...engaging with the essence of summer, it became more palatable. But do not take that as permission to dress me up in more silly outfits! I assure you this is my absolute limit. Consider directing your attention in that regard to someone fun-loving and inspiring—like the Divine Dragon.
Status: I want nothing to do with swimwear or sandy beaches. But for the Divine Dragon's sake, I will endure.
Hands to yourself, please. I have a sunburn.
The swimsuit I wore on the Somniel was rather more plain than this one.
First order of business upon returning to Elusia: research the means to export snow.
Yes, I do know how to swim—despite appearances to the contrary.
In case you haven't noticed, I don't enjoy the beach. I'd rather be in the snow. Or encased in a block of ice...
I've read many fond stories of the summer. Perhaps I might tell my own someday.

tharja5.name: Tharja
tharja5.title: Beach Dark Mage
tharja5.description: A mage of Plegia, sure to curse something or someone on the sun-beaten sands. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
I love the ocean, especially during the summer.
Ugh, I thought I could trick myself into not hating this, but nothing seems to be working...
So you say my usual garb looks like a swimsuit? Heh. It's designed to amplify my curses, fool.
Dark mages live in shadow, so going to the beach in summer is akin to entering a nightmarish hellscape.
While they're distracted by my swimsuit, I'll strike with a curse... Hmhm, they'll never see it coming...
This accursed sun... Perhaps I'll cast a hex to ensure it never rises again! I'm joking, obviously...
Visit:
I bring glad summer tidings from [F]...
You know I'll curse you into oblivion if you keep staring, right?
Level: Not even the beach can weaken my curses. You know that all too well, don't you, Summoner?
Dark forces, hear my plea... May their feet be caught in endless algae during their next swim...
Ugh, this place is infuriatingly bright... Of course my curses wouldn't work here, you fool.
Summon: I'm Tharja, a dark mage from Plegia. Why would you bring me to such an annoyingly bright place?
Learn Skill: Heehee... Surely this will be enough to grab Robin's attention...
Confession: I was born and raised in Plegia, a desert country, so I never had much interaction with the sea. How surprising that I'm now at the beach and even dressed the part. Fate is truly mysterious... I considered cursing you for dragging me to the ocean, but I suppose I shall let the offense go this time... After all, who is to say that is not the will of fate as well? As it was when Robin and I met. I might even see Robin here, and we must take every opportunity to grow closer... I will cast a spell that makes me shine brighter than the sun! Hmhmhm, my love will have no choice but to stare...
Status: This outfit, the "fresh air"... Does it look like I'd be having a good time here?
*gasp* What? Oh...a drink? You can just hand me things normally, you know.
It is said that fashioning a talisman out of these shells will lead to love... It had better work.
It's absolutely sweltering! If only there were a curse to freeze over the blasted sun...
Loves me not, loves me, loves me not, wha— Hmph. Well, at least it looks like this lush foliage will supply me with endless petals.
The sea breeze actually feels pretty nice...
Perhaps I could spare some time to walk the beach with you—a-after dark, obviously.

donnel2.name: Donnel
donnel2.title: Sunny Villager
donnel2.description: A farm boy from the countryside of Ylisse out enjoying the ocean with his beloved pot. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Golly, the ocean's beautiful. My ma would sure love it. I think my pa would too, bless his soul.
Villages on the island back home reaped one heck of a bounty from the sea, so we traded crops for fish!
Nothing beats fresh summer veggies! Why don't you take a load off and snack on 'em with me?
It ain't easy fightin' all the time. Even Heroes need to rest their weary bones now and then!
I love summer star-gazin' back home. Can't wait to see what Askr's stars look like!
Visit: I got some summer veggies for ya from [F]! Gosh, I'm not breakin' any kinda dress code, am I?
Level: The ocean and I are gettin' along swimmingly! Maybe my true calling is bein' a fisherman...
I won't let nothin' get in the way of these fine folks havin' a swim!
Ouch! Looks like I got a little carried away in the sun...
Summon: My name's Donnel! Huh? Why'd I bring a pot to the beach? You never know when it'll come in handy!
Learn Skill: Summer fun does a body good! I'm gonna keep on getting stronger!
Confession: Oh, Summoner, look! There's a fish over here I ain't ever seen before! Gosh, there's new things left and right at the ocean, from colorful fish to tasty frozen treats! Staying here forever sounds mighty appealin' right about now. It's hard to believe that there are still bad folks tryin' to hurt everyone even in such a perfect place... Well, enough's enough! I've decided I'm gonna do those bad suckers in so everyone can enjoy the ocean freely! 'Course, I know I can't go at it alone. There's a lotta bad guys and only one'a me, after all. I wonder if I could persuade anyone to join the fight by sharin' these fresh veggies I got...
Status: Pardon!
What a warm n' sunny day! Perfect for splashin' around in the water!
Whoa, what's that? Sure is cold! Yer tellin' me it's food?!
I've never seen so many kindsa fish! I'll be out here 'til the pigs come home!
Ain't that outfit a little heavy for this weather? Ya got me kinda worried.
Phew! I am tuckered out after all that swimmin'!
I'd sure like to show my ma how beautiful the ocean is...
I reckon this was the funnest summer of all time, 'cuz of you! Thanks a bunch!

eitr.name: Eitr
eitr.title: Hand of Nothing
eitr.description: Unquestioning servant of the ruler of nothingness, she lacks the confidence to express her own will.

Castle Hall: Askr's...Order of...Heroes? There are so many worlds I have not learned of yet...
It is terrifying to share spaces with...so many other people.
You don't treat me like you're better than me... You must be a nice person.
If there is anything I can do, I will. Just...don't leave me...
I had a dream that... Er, well...I can't tell you. It's too embarrassing.
Visit: I...am Eitr. I will leave soon. Don't be angry with me...please.
Level: Wh-what is this? ...I did well? Do you really mean it?
I must get stronger...
Even here I fall short...
Summon: I am...Eitr. I serve the nothingness and the one who rules it... Wh-where am I now?
Learn Skill: I don't know what will come of it, but...I must not stay as I am...
Confession:
I...had a dream I...wanted to tell you about. It was a scary one, but...someone was there to save me.
I don't remember their face, but they were very kind...
I think it could have been you, since you're always so kind... But it was just a dream.
And of course there is no way you would know anything about my dreams... I'm sorry.
Even so, you are kind—that much is still true.
Status: I am...Eitr. I serve the nothingness and the one who rules it...
*yelp* I... Forgive me.
Freyja must not be revived... The Lady of Nightmare cannot live again...
The one who rules the nothingness... I cannot defy.
Do you see me as your foe as well?
Everything is strange... Like a half-remembered dream...
With you beside me, I can allow myself to be at ease...

alcryst.name: Alcryst
alcryst.title: Tender Archer
alcryst.description: Second prince of Brodia and Diamant's younger brother, he is prone to self-deprecation. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Could you point me to some of the... less-impressive Heroes? I just want to make sure I'm in the right place.
Between my father and brother, Brodia is in good hands. I only hope I can be useful to my family one day...
Am I in your way? I'm so sorry about that. I'll find someplace else to stand.
It's me, the Brodian prince who isn't Diamant. I promise I'll do my best not to get in your way.
Oh, don't mind me. I'm just watching this ant march around my foot. Kind of inspiring to see him work so hard...
Visit: I'm so sorry it's me who's here to greet you. I think there was a mistake at [S]'s castle...
Level: I don't understand... How could so much growth happen to someone like me? What's happening?
I feel stronger... Am I actually... satisfied? Aah! Don't mind me! L-let's just move on...
I knew it. This is the best that someone like me can do...
Summon: Who, me? I'm Alcryst, the second prince of Brodia. Sorry, you were probably hoping for someone better...
Learn Skill: I'll do my best with this, but don't get your hopes up. I'm just leftover scraps compared to Diamant.
Confession:
Oh, are you curious about my hair clip? It's just to keep all this unruly business up here under control.
My hair is kind of delicate. If I don't keep it pinned down, the slightest breeze will blow it all over the place.
I've thought about cutting it shorter, just to make sure it doesn't get in the way of my aim.
But I realized, if I did that, I'd be forcing everyone to get a full view of my face whenever they look at me.
No one deserves that kind of torture, right? Especially when dealing with me is already a nightmare.
What's that? You...you actually like seeing my face? But that's...
That's so unbelievably kind! Truly, your compassion is so warm I feel like I'm going to melt on the spot!
I should go. I've already taken up so much of your precious time. But from the bottom of my heart...thank you.
Status: You want to talk to me? You must be really desperate for something to do...
Please don't shine your brilliant light on me! It only makes clear what a pathetic puddle of darkness I truly am!
You don't have to say it. I'm a waste. Just throw me in the trash where I belong.
Did you need something? Whatever it is, I'm probably the worst person you could ask. I'm sorry!
It's me, Alcryst. Sorry, I thought you'd be even more disappointed if you mistook me for somebody else...
I feel sick with guilt every time the Heroes call me one of them.
I'm sorry for smiling so much around you. I-I don't mean to be a burden, but I can't help but notice how wonderful you are.
Map Select: I'm sorry you're stuck with me!

diamant.name: Diamant
diamant.title: Rising Power
diamant.description: Crown prince of Brodia, the Kingdom of Might. Has a strong, genuine spirit and the trust of his people. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I know it's pointless to think about what might have happened in Brodia since I left. Still, I do worry.
My country, Brodia, is known as the Kingdom of Might. But I'd rather make alliances than start wars.
If it is a soldier you need, you can call upon me. I have not let up on my training here, if that's your worry.
That weapon of yours shoots spheres, hm? Aim it at me, then. I'd like to see if I can deflect them.

One of my retainers writes novels, and the other is known for his many delightful, ah...let's call them feats.
Thinking about those two, I can't help but smile.
Visit: You'll have to forgive me for dropping in on you. I was asked by [F] to bring this.
Level: A fitting achievement for the crown prince of Brodia.
I'm always striving to be better.
That's all right. I fight well enough with the strength I have.
Summon: I am Diamant, crown prince of Brodia, and your new ally. I vow to protect this land as if it were my own.
Learn Skill: Send me into battle, and I'll show that I'm worthy of this gift.
Confession:
Is something wrong? Did you find a spider on your pant leg or something?
...I see. Well, I'm glad it wasn't a spider. The way you ran around last time that happened! Ahaha!
*ahem* Sorry... When I start laughing, it's difficult to stop. And you have a way of making me drop my guard.
I suppose that speaks to true friendship, doesn't it? Putting each other totally at ease.
When I'm around you, I forget the pressures of my life... I stop worrying if I have the strength to lead.
I need that sense of peace if I'm going to achieve victory. So, I can only hope our bond lasts for a long time yet.
Status: If you're trying to gauge me for weakness...try harder.
*startle* You caught me with my guard down. Seems I still have a lot to learn.
I am very curious about that weapon of yours. Perhaps you'll spar with me sometime.
Emblem Roy's ring was entrusted to the kingdom of Brodia, my homeland.
This armor is exceptional for deflecting blades. For magic...less so.
Father... Wherever my path takes me, I swear to make Brodia proud.
I don't mind chatting, but if it's an interesting conversation you want, you should seek out my retainers.

lapis.name: Lapis
lapis.title: Mighty Flower
lapis.description: A warrior of Brodia and retainer to Alcryst, she boasts both incredible strength and extensive knowledge of everyday living. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall:
*chomp* *chomp* Bitter, but not the worst weeds I've tasted. Should do in a pinch if we run out of... AAH!
N-no, this isn't... I don't eat weeds!
Yeah, I had a typical middle-class childhood. Came from a prosperous town in Brodia... What? It's true!

Commander Anna's always trying to make more gold, huh? I guess the Order of Heroes is a bit hard up.
That kind of makes me feel more at home here.
If you spot any threatening animals around the castle, come find me! I have experience dealing with bears...
All right! Using some gravel and tree branches, I made a device that'll pick weeds for us. What do you think?
Visit: I'm nervous being in another castle... I hope I didn't smush your package from [F].
Level: Phew! What a productive battle!
Every little step counts, I guess. I should be grateful to have made it this far...
Ugh. This feels like tallying up a pitiful harvest back home...
Summon: I'm Lapis, a royal soldier of Brodia. Quite the lavish castle you've got... Any chance Prince Alcryst is here?
Learn Skill: You mean I can just...have this? Really?!
Confession:
When I was out on patrol, I found a few slabs of wood lying around. Would you mind if I take them?
...What? You don't want to dump your old rubbish on Heroes? But it's not rubbish if I can make use of it!
We'll just have to settle this with an old-fashioned round of Rock Paper Scissors. One, two, three... Go!
Aha! I win! And that means I finally have materials for the relief carving I was planning.
That's right...a carving of us. It's to celebrate my time here, and how much I've learned from you.
Special: I'll cut you down to size!
Status: What is it? Did you need something?
*gasp* Oh, sorry. I thought you were a bear.
Oh, look! This is a rare type of leaf. I wonder if it's edible...
Hey, be careful! I just mended that sleeve!
Your weapon and cape are so nice. I'd be too afraid of ruining that stuff to use it.
How am I supposed to get money all the way home from here? Huh? Ah! I...didn't see you there!
I can teach you all kinds of things. Scrounging up food, making tools—whatever you need!

citrinne.name: Citrinne
citrinne.title: Caring Noble
citrinne.description: A noble of Brodia and retainer to Alcryst, she shares blood with the royal family and has an incredible fortune at her disposal. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.
