Castle Hall: This hall seems lovelier every time I see it. I'm convinced it would be a wonderful spot for a ball or banquet.
I can tell that you treasure your home as much as I do mine. For that reason, I will do all I can to protect it.
How can I show you my gratitude? Hmm... I know! Tell me your favorite food—I'll get you a lifetime supply.
Your weapon is made of a most fascinating metal. The craftsmanship is very impressive too.
As much as I strive to be dazzling, there are times when I have to set appearances aside for training's sake.
Visit: What a lovely castle you have! Oh, I've brought you a little something from [F]. Here.
Level: I've attained something valuable and rare by my own hands...and I plan to celebrate it.
Oh, I'm so delighted! I feel as if I've just arrived at a banquet.
Oh, my... Perhaps I'll do better next time.
Summon: How do you do? I'm Citrinne, a royal soldier of Brodia. It's an honor to be here. Thank you for inviting me.
Learn Skill: I am so grateful for this wonderful gift. It's every bit as thrilling as the first dance at a ball!
Confession:
Let me take a moment to express to you how delighted I've been with my time here, [S].
Every day has presented me with new opportunities to meet people from all manner of backgrounds.
I've met other nobles like me, people from tribes that don't exist on Elyos...and you, of course.
Time is more valuable than any gem, and you've devoted a considerable portion of yours to me. Thank you.
I truly appreciate every moment we have spent together. And, if I may, I hope there are many more to come.
Status: I'm so grateful to have been invited to this lovely place.
Oh! Do you like my accessories? Let me gift you a set—then we can match!
The castle here would make a wonderful venue for a ball.
I'd like us to become friends, so let me start off with a gift. Oh, I know! What would you say to your very own island getaway?
I love your outfit! White is the most difficult color to maintain, but the effort is very much worth it.
I simply must train harder. There is no other way around my lack of skill.
As grateful as I am for this opportunity, I do miss my homeland. Brodia is my treasure. Perhaps I'll show you its beauty one day.

malear.name: Alear
malear.title: Dragon Youth
malear.description: Successor to the Divine Dragon, awoken from a long sleep. Summons Emblems to lead the world to peace. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Shine on, Emblem of Beginnings! ...No, it's still not lighting up. Why is it so hard to summon Emblems here?
In Elyos, we have 12 powerful beings called Emblems. All of them make for powerful allies—and loyal friends.
You look exhausted! Why don't you get some sleep? I can come and wake you up later, if you'd like.
Would you mind taking me on a quick tour? I need to know what's where before I can help with patrols.
I'm seeing a few familiar faces. I'd like to say hello, but it might be hard to explain how I know them...
Visit: I'm the Divine Dragon Alear, here with warm ring—I mean, regards— from [F].
Level: Happy to have grown so strong!
That should help.
That wasn't much.
Summon: I'm the Divine Dragon Alear! I will serve you as best I... Hold on. How did you summon me without a ring?
Learn Skill: I can sense new power. Thank you.
Confession:
Now that we've become such good friends, I find myself looking for you when you're not around.
I can't explain it, but your presence makes me feel calmer. Maybe it's because of our similar powers...
You have Heroes, I have Emblems, but we're both summoners, and that commonality binds us together.
Hey, can we make a promise? Whatever happens, wherever we end up, let's never forget each other.
You agree? Then our pact is sealed! Now, if only we had rings, that would really make it official...
Status: I'm glad you summoned me.
Oh! Sorry about that. I must have dozed off. Maybe I'm not quite awake yet.
Polishing rings is surprisingly relaxing. You should try it.
I'm amazed by how many Emblems—I mean Heroes—you have here.
My hair and eyes might be a little unusual, but...I like them.
Marth...my first Emblem. It feels wrong not to have you here.
Even if I can't give you an Emblem ring, I can give you a glimpse of what it feels like. Go on, say it with me: "Emblem engage!"

zephia.name: Zephia
zephia.title: Scheming Dragon
zephia.description: Servant of the Fell Dragon Sombron and leader of the Four Hounds. She is a Mage Dragon who has lived thousands of years. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I'm bored. Are you going to give me something to do, or would you really rather I just stand here?
I wonder how long it took Lord Sombron to notice my absence. Or indeed, if he noticed at all.
You poor thing! You look worn out. Why not take a little nap? I can run things around the castle for a while...
A happy family of Heroes living in harmony... Oh, how I would love to turn them on each other!
Why yes, I have been watching you. I simply like to know what you're getting up to. Is that a crime?
Visit: Is this the right place? All these castles look the same... Anyway, [F] says hello.
Level: You cannot begin to grasp a Mage Dragon's full power.
Did I improve or didn't I? It's a simple question.
My, you do nag, don't you? What happened to "just do your best"?
Summon: I am Zephia, a Mage Dragon who has lived thousands of years. If I am to serve you, I need something in return.
Learn Skill: Such sweet attention! It seems someone is fond of me.
Confession:
A fine day, isn't it? Diminished only somewhat by a question that's been bothering me...
Summoner, why did you bring me here? Was it a passing fancy? An accident?
And why, since my arrival, have you shown me such kindness? I simply do not understand.
If it is my heart you want, you won't have it. I seek family. People who love me and only me.
Because your attention is split among countless others, undivided love is something you cannot give.
So, as fond as I am of you, you will have to content yourself with being second to Lord Sombron.
Status: Hilarious.
I trust that we'll be friendly during my stay, won't we, dear summoner?
Curious about my horns? All right, you can touch—just this once.
Since you summoned me, you must take good care of me...or else.
There are no Emblem rings in this world, are there? I suppose that's fine. Less bloodshed that way.
You remind me of someone I know. She's an obnoxious little gnat too.
Lord Sombron... I wonder if you miss me at all.
My dear, sweet summoner. You have my cooperation. If it's my undying devotion you seek, then you will need to show me the same in return.

freyr.name: Freyr
freyr.title: Dream-King
freyr.description: Dream-King of Ljósálfheimr, the dream realm. He is the god of dreams and wishes for all to lead tranquil, blissful lives.

Castle Hall: I am...a remnant of the dream realm... Though it seems I still have some role to play in this waking world...
Mortals once turned away from their dreams, and the dream realm was nearly consumed by nothingness...
My sister, Freyja, is...precious to me. It is my love for her that drives me to stop her from harming mortals...
By blowing the horn Gullinkambi, one can awake from any dream... if one wishes to...
Nerþuz is...my father's sister... I have not seen her since I left home, but we share a fondness for mortals, I recall...
Visit: I am Dream-King Freyr... Wishing you well in pursuit of your dreams, on behalf of [F].
Level: There is...still hope in this world. My existence here is proof.
War brings only suffering... I cannot wish such ills upon the world...
Have even I lost sight of the dream?
Summon: I am Freyr, Dream-King over the realm of Ljósálfheimr... As long as mortals dream, I hold to my hopes...
Learn Skill: The potential of a dream is infinite... One need only believe.
Confession:
I took children who had been abused and gave them nectar... All to save mortal hearts—and the dream realm...
I used the pure hearts of children to drive back the nothingness...
Now, I cannot say I would make the same choice...knowing those children will never again be mortal.
I stole their futures...I regret that.
I do have hope, however... You and your nature are beyond anything even we gods have known before...
You yet may find ways of defending mortals the gods themselves have never dreamed...
Status: I am Freyr. To you humans, I am the god of plenty.
Hm? You...need something of me?
It is you, then... So, the prophecy has come to pass...
Though my eyes appear closed, I watch you closely. Within dreams, all things can be seen...
Human life is fleeting. As are dreams...and all things... That is what makes them precious.
Oh, Freyja... Though I love you, I...I cannot...
Humans are radiant with dreams and desires. I can feel them...like the sun's warmth...

ayra2.name: Ayra
ayra2.title: Together in Tea
ayra2.description: Princess Ayra of Isaach is joined by Mercedes of the Adrestian Empire, and the pair are serving tea together! They appear in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War / Three Houses.
ayra2.origin: Genealogy of the Holy War + Three Houses
ayra2.harmonized:
Grants Atk/Spd+6,【Resonance: Blades】, and "unit can move 1 extra space (that turn only; does not stack)" to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn and neutralizes any【Penalty】on unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).
(Harmonized Skills can be used by tapping the Harmonized button. Harmonized Skills cannot be used by units deployed using Pair Up.)

Castle Hall: **Ayra:** I'm not well suited for this sort of thing, but I will do what I can. I leave introductions to you, Mercedes.
**Ayra:** Each day during the war might have been our last. We had no time for luxuries like enjoying tea.
**Mercedes:** Your outfit is lovely, Ayra! You look every inch the refined tea server.
**Ayra:** I saw Lord Sigurd in similar garb earlier. He seems to have taken to this quite well. I must work harder.
**Mercedes:** I baked these sweets myself! I think they'll be a nice complement to the tea, so please help yourself!
Visit: Hello! I'm Ayra, and this is Mercedes. We're taking a break from tea service at [F]'s castle.
Level: **Ayra:** It makes no difference whether the blade is a sword or a cake knife. You must put your all into every slice!
**Mercedes:** Please let me know if you'd like a second serving of cake or another cup of tea!
**Ayra:** Forgive me, Mercedes, but it seems I have broken the tea caddy. It was more delicate than I anticipated...
Summon: I'm Mercedes von Martritz, and this is Ayra of Isaach. We're here for your every tea-party need!
Learn Skill: **Mercedes:** Oh, Ayra, look at the beautiful tea leaves we were gifted! I'm excited to use them at the next tea party.
Confession:
**Mercedes:** I don't mean to harp on this, Ayra, but it's OK to relax a little. There's no competition in enjoying tea!
**Ayra:** Perhaps... But I still must work hard for the happiness of those attending the party.
**Mercedes:** Your earnestness is admirable, but teatime is quite different from sword training!
It's about making time to do nothing and just rest. It's important to give yourself that space!
**Ayra:** Yielding results from inaction is not a concept I am familiar with...
I will admit I did not expect to find so much wisdom in something like a tea party.
**Mercedes:** I've found that the more you learn about tea, the more fun it becomes!
And it's much easier to relax when you're having fun. I hope you're able to have fun today, Ayra!
Status: Must we dress this way? There's more to tea than drinking it!
Conversation: **Ayra:** How vexing. I would never have believed it so difficult to serve a simple beverage.
**Mercedes:** You'll get the hang of it soon! No one would expect a princess to be trained to serve...
**Ayra:** True. But even compared to other princesses, I know little of these things.
The truth is I spent my time not with a teacup, but with a blade in my hand. But that is no excuse.
**Mercedes:** Well, I'm not inclined toward physical activity. We all focus on what we're good at.
You are very strong, and you worked hard to become so. Tea was not your priority.
**Ayra:** Yes. I needed to safeguard my nephew, Shannan—our prince.
**Mercedes:** That is a heavy responsibility.
**Ayra:** Times were hard. In that regard, I was no different from anyone.
**Mercedes:** You're quite strict, aren't you? Even with yourself. You remind me of some of my classmates from Garreg Mach.
So for today, let us simply relax and enjoy ourselves.
I think it's time for some tea!
We could enjoy it together. Oh! There are some lovely seats over by those flowers.
**Ayra:** That would be nice. You seem to have a gift—I can allow myself to relax around you.
**Mercedes:** I'm so glad! I have loved spending time with you.
**Ayra:** It would be my pleasure to pour you some tea. Er, if that is all right.
**Mercedes:** It certainly is. And I will happily teach you the technique!

lysithea4.name: Lysithea
lysithea4.title: Tea Sweetener
lysithea4.description: Daughter of Count Ordelia and noble of the Leicester Alliance. Renowned for her brilliance, she is trying her hand at the role of waitress. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I quite like serving tea and cake. All the little steps involved appeal to my meticulous nature.
This reminds me of tea parties I used to have with my professor. I recall those occasions fondly...
I'm happy to play the role of server. What could possibly go wrong? It's not like there'll be ghosts or anything.
How much sugar do you want in your tea? You can be honest—I won't judge, [S].
Mmm...yes, that's very sweet. What? Of course I'm not stealing. I was only testing the cakes! For quality!
Visit: Hi there. I've brought you some tea leaves—want to take a look? They're from [F].
Level: This tea party will go off without a hitch, thanks to my efforts. You'll see.
Out of the way, please. I have snacks to prepare for the tea party.
Ugh... To work so hard, and not see the effort bear fruit...
Summon: Lysithea von Ordelia, at your service. Your snacks are my responsibility!
Learn Skill: Thank you very much. Here, I got you a little treat to enjoy with your tea.
Confession:
I have to admit, I didn't see the point of me working a job like this at first. It took time away from my studies.
The more I do it, though, the more I realize that I'm actually learning a lot. I'd say it's been worthwhile!
Serving people is hard work. For one thing, it requires you to understand them really well.
You have to anticipate their needs by picking out and preparing teas and snacks you think they'll like.
That means you have to be studious, observant, and determined to give everyone the best experience.
Speaking of—I've put together a little selection for you. So, which of these teas do you like best?
Status: J-just because I'm serving doesn't mean I can't partake!
*gulp* I was only taking a sample! For analysis!
Knowing how to serve tea is a sign of maturity, I'll have you know.
So these cakes go here, and these biscuits go there... That means we'll have some left over.
I don't put any sugar in my tea. That's right—none at all.
Sipping tea, making small talk... It's kind of nice, actually.
Here. I saved some of the best sweets for you.

ferdinand2.name: Ferdinand
ferdinand2.title: Highborn Sipper
ferdinand2.description: Son and heir of Duke Aegir, the prime minister of the Adrestian Empire. Plays the role of waiter in a manner befitting a noble. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I have been told the teas in Askr could stand toe to toe with Fódlan's finest. I will have to test them.
Amidst war, tea parties are necessary intervals of calm. They give us time to reflect on our reasons for fighting.
As your server, I would be more than happy to bring the snacks— Hang on. Some appear to be missing...
If you need anything, please tell me. As your server, all I wish is for you to come away satisfied.
I made these teas myself. Each is of the highest quality, as you can tell by their aromas.
Visit: I am Ferdinand von Aegir! I brought something to accompany your tea, courtesy of [F].
Level: An exceptional tea party! One of my best, I daresay.
Small sips.
Oh dear... I may have oversteeped it.
Summon: I am Ferdinand von Aegir! As your new server, I will personally see that you are fully fed and refreshed!
Learn Skill: Your kindness is noted, though I would happily perform my duties without any recognition.
Confession:
Welcome to the tea party! By all means, have a sip. Do you like it? Delicious, no?
There are those who would look askance at us for sitting down for a tea party during wartime...
But you and I know that times of great conflict are when such things are most vital.
For nothing facilitates a discussion about hopes and ideals quite like a good, fragrant pot of tea.
One cannot begin to envision a bright future without room to relax and stretch one's mind.
I firmly believe that—and I think it holds true for everyone, of noble birth and otherwise.
So no, I don't see tea parties as a waste of time at all. Indeed, I think their benefits are quite profound.
Status: Thank you for choosing me to be your server today. You have excellent taste.
Oh! *chuckle* Careful! I almost spilled your tea!
This is one of my favorite teas. *sniff* Do you smell that fragrance? A delight for the senses!
The tastiest teas are the most fragrant ones. Ah! You may want to make a note of that!
A pleasant conversation is the perfect complement to a nice cup of tea.
We seem to be running out of cakes surprisingly quickly. Hmm...
Please, have a seat! I've brewed something particularly special with you in mind.

sigurd4.name: Sigurd
sigurd4.title: Proper Pourer
sigurd4.description: Heir to Chalphy, participating in tea parties to grow closer to his companions. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Teatime etiquette is, in a way, it's own form of chivalry. A bevy of good manners is no waste here.
Between battles long past, such moments of peace and quiet as these were a rarity.
This change of garb has me slightly more on edge than expected. Yet, I will endeavor to wear it with pride.
What could be more enjoyable than sharing a pleasant tea with one's family?
I wish to ensure my comrades find ample moments of respite. Therefore, I shall eagerly fill their waiting teacups!
Visit: I am Sigurd of House Chalphy. I come bearing an invitation to share tea with [F].
Level: I shall put my hospitality to the test. Please sit back, relax, and allow me to attend to your every whim.
The art of making tea is astonishingly complex. The more I delve into the details, the more fascinated I become.
This failure shall be my life's blood, for the next tea I brew will be unparalleled.
Summon: I am Sigurd of House Chalphy. I thought it would be apropos to invite my comrades to a relaxing tea.
Learn Skill: Allow me to repay this kindness at our next tea party. Your cup will have my unyielding attention.
Confession:
Certainly my efforts were not in vain. Serving tea was well worth it if only to see my comrades' smiling faces.
It is for such serene moments as these that we risk our lives, for what could be more symbolic of peace?
I may brandish a weapon every day in search of peace, but I cannot let that turn my heart cold.
It is vital that we acknowledge the value of peace and hold the sharing of joy to the utmost import.
When these conflicts have subsided, know your cup will overflow with my appreciation.
Status: Though I am yet an amateur, I can certainly do my utmost.
*start* Now, now. This is the time to be on your best behavior.
Ah! Tss! That was hot! I apologize for my clumsiness.
Deirdre also enjoys tea. We often converse over a freshly brewed pot.
It seems that I must strike a balance between comfort and formality, while also maintaining an air of elegance... The art of the tea service is complex.
I hope that one day my family can enjoy a moment of peace together.
If you found respite while sipping tea...nothing could please me more.

tailtiu2.name: Tailtiu
tailtiu2.title: Teatime Mingler
tailtiu2.description: Noblewoman of House Friege and descendant of the crusader Thrud. She holds tea parties to form personal connections. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Askr's tea sure is tasty! Maybe I could sneak some back to Friege... Oh, and some of these cookies too!
Sharing delicious tea together is way better than wasting time fighting each other. Don't you agree?
Ta-dah! Isn't this outfit the cutest thing you've ever seen? I wonder what Father Claud would think...
I can guarantee these sweet treats are tasty! How? Um, I may have had had a nibble or two myself...
How about if I heat the teapot up with a few zaps? Aw, why not? It's a great idea!
Visit:
Hi, I'm Tailtiu! I'm working a tea party at [F]'s place!
Stop by if you get the chance!
Level: Woohoo! The tea turned out great. I'd love to brew some for the folks back in Friege.
Smiles are kind of contagious. When I see one, I can't help but smile back!
Oh NO! I think I scalded the tea! Ugh, this is the worst...
Summon: Welcome to Tailtiu's Tea Time! You'll be faithfully served today by yours truly, in one of my cutest outfits ever!
Learn Skill: I think I'm starting to get this whole "tea-brewing" thing. I can tell my next pot is going to be the best one yet!
Confession:
Oh, hi! What did you think of Tailtiu's Tea Time, [S]?
Hope you had as much fun as I did! Don't get me wrong, it always feels good to get praise for my magic...
But it's such a thrill to hear people compliment the tea I've made and see them smile!
I want to invite even more people to Tailtiu's Tea Time, and I won't rest until they're all beaming!
Hmm, whom would I invite... Father, Father Claud, Azelle... Heehee, and that's just the beginning!
If I could help everyone become better friends with my tea, I'd be the happiest girl in the world!
Status: Welcome to Tailtiu's Tea Time! *giggle* How does that sound?
*startle* I wasn't sneaking food, I promise!
I think even Father Claud would enjoy being served by someone this cute, don't you?
The worst thing would be if nobody showed up. *sigh*
These cakes are delicious. Really delicious.
I wish my father and grandmother could enjoy a tea party like this.
There you are. Sit yourself down! It's time for a full tea service.

mrobin7.name: Robin
mrobin7.title: Exalt's Deliverer
mrobin7.description: The exalt Chrom's most trusted tactician. Possessed of a mysterious charisma that draws people to him. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Chrom entrusted me with this—the blade of an exalt's tactician. It's a symbol of my position and our bond.
I don't remember a thing from before I met Chrom, but I have a wealth of fond memories with my friends now.
It isn't naive to have hope for a world without conflict. The Order of Heroes is motivated by exactly that.
Our bonds transcend hardship. Even if the future is full of despair, their strength will endure.
I've heard incredible things about the Greil Mercenaries' tactician, Soren. I'm glad he's on our side...
Visit: Hi there. I hope you can make good use of these supplies—I brought them from [F]'s castle.
Level: The future can be changed. I believe in those words with all my heart.
Somehow we made it through. Well, let's not take it for granted—focus up as we move ahead.
I can't afford to get down on myself. The battle isn't over. Let's just try a different tack next time.
Summon: I'm Robin, tactician to Exalt Chrom— and I hope I'll actually be as useful to you as that makes me sound.
Learn Skill: Thank you for trusting me with this. Now it's up to me to prove you made the right choice.
Confession:
The Shepherds' fight to protect Ylisse started small, but eventually it engulfed the entire continent.
And now I find myself taking part in an even bigger struggle—one that involves Heroes from many worlds.
However the scale of our battles may change, there is one thing that will always remain constant for me.
I will always carry hope for a peaceful world—the same hope Chrom's eyes held on the day he and I met.
As long as that hope is alive, we will never give up the fight. We will never surrender to despair.
I promise you this: if you'll share in that hope with me, then I'll guide you on a path to a brighter future.
Status: This is the outfit of the exalt's—erm, Chrom's—personal tactician. Does it look as impressive as it feels?
*startle* Oh. You were fixing my hair? Uh, thanks.
Nobody goes along with the plans of a tactician they don't trust. Right?
I've come this far thanks to not only my successes, but also my setbacks.
I could have sworn I heard a chorus of voices calling my name...
Someday, I will devise a strategy to free this world from conflict once and for all.
I can't imagine doing any of this without you, and, well...I hope you feel the same.

soren5.name: Soren
soren5.title: Radiant Confidant
soren5.description: A member of the Greil Mercenaries. Supports Ike with his extraordinary talent as a tactician. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: This is the garb of an arch sage of Tellius. Supposedly it bolsters the wearer's magic.
The vicious cycle of abuse and hatred will continue for as long as there are those willing to perpetuate it.
Ike spoke to me of Askr's future. I suppose that means this place must have at least some value.
I calculate what is necessary to achieve victory—no more, no less.
I've heard a great deal of the tactical prowess of Robin of Ylisse. Someone I should consult with, perhaps...
Visit:
I've come to deliver a personal letter from [F].
You're [S]? Great. Here.
Level: I will not rest until Ike's vision for the world has become a reality.
No need to get excited. Victory was a foregone conclusion.
I won't waste time dwelling on a failed strategy. Let's just revise and move forward.
Summon: I'm here to support Ike, commander of the Greil Mercenaries.
Learn Skill: Excellent—more tactical options. I will make good use of this.
Confession:
Let me make one thing absolutely clear to you, [S].
I am not aiding the Order of Heroes out of any concern for its future or its people.
I am merely following Ike's lead—and he has placed his trust in you, for the time being.
So, if I were you, I would take great care to honor that trust in good faith.
That said, for as long as Ike continues to find your cause worthy...
You will have my full support. I give you my word on that.
Status: Yay...
Fancy clothing won't disguise a lack of substance.
Be reasonable. I have things to do.
My place will always be at Ike's side—regardless of what people want.
You're staring at me. I dislike it.
At least there are some knowledgeable mages to learn from here. I guess that's something.
Wherever my work calls me, my objective will always be the same.
I suppose I've developed some genuine interest in supporting you.

gullveig2.name: Gullveig
gullveig2.title: Seer Beyond Time
gullveig2.description: Seiðr, goddess of Vanaheimr, the realm of light, having become Gullveig, the Golden Seer.

Castle Hall: These clothes are from a past that was lost to me. They are all that remain of that hope I once had.
Corrin, queen of some other world, is said to have chosen her path...yet mine is a closed loop.
There is something I must say to you, but now is not the time. It must wait until we reach the end of this cycle...
What am I doing here, now, dressed like this? This should be impossible... Has the cycle...been broken?
In my hands I hold hope and despair. I have made them both my weapons.
Visit: So this is the version of you who shares a timeline with [F], hm?
Level: The future cannot be changed. Everything faces annihilation in the end...
Unending despair.
Completely meaningless...
Summon: Seiðr? No...that name is a thing of the past. I am Gullveig, the Golden Seer, whose life is a cycle unending.
Learn Skill: Even in an endless cycle, I somehow am made to grow stronger still...
Confession:
I was not born...
It is not that I have no memory. It is that my birth has never occurred.
...Nor do I die.
The cycle is set. There is no future in which I will perish.
And yet...something is different here in this world, this time, this...existence.
I seem to be freed of the cycle's influence and demands.
Which means I may see a new future, events I've never witnessed in all the cycles of my being... We shall see.
Status: This clothing reminds me of long ago—though the fit is not as I remember.
You mistook me for Seiðr? Be honest. That isn't true.
Wearing this, my heart has been spirited right to those days...
I have lived the cycle of grief so many times, I am nearly worn through...
I remember when I knew only light and hope...when I was Seiðr...
I am the Golden Seer. My purpose is to bring ruin.
If only we— *sigh* No. It is nothing.

fcorrin8.name: Corrin
fcorrin8.title: Silent Bloodline
fcorrin8.description: Born in Hoshido and raised as a princess of Nohr, she has overcome many trials and grown alongside her many companions. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: This outfit comes from Valla, one of three places I call home. When I put it on, I can feel the weight of its history.
Mutual caring and understanding is what brings people together. That's true no matter where you're from.
I wouldn't be where I am today if not for the support of my friends. I want to make them proud.
This Gullveig is said to bring ruin to the future, but to me she just seems... sad. I hope she finds a new path.
Askr is a mysterious place, isn't it? Just standing here, I can feel its power—almost like a Dragon Vein.
Visit: Thanks for coming out to greet me! Here, I brought you a gift from your friend [F].
Level: War has taught me that strength and conviction go hand in hand.
I will decide my fate!
I can't let everyone down like this...
Summon: I am Corrin. I come to this world with thoughts of the people of Hoshido, Nohr, and Valla held firm in my heart.
Learn Skill: I will use this power to protect those who are precious to me.
Confession:
Even large-scale conflicts can be caused by small misunderstandings that spiraled out of control.
I'm certain there are many battles that could have been avoided if the two sides understood each other.
That's why I try to see where my foes are coming from whenever I can.
Even if that's harder than a battle would be, and even if it's likely we'll fail to reconcile...it's worth the effort.
Come what may, I want to be able to say for certain that I did all I could to bring people together.
That said, with your support, I feel like my chances of finding peace are better than ever. Thank you.
Status: What do you think of this outfit? Does it suit me?
*startle* Your hands are so cold! You need to warm up.
My greatest strength is my faith—and that my friends and allies are worthy of my faith.
I am certain now that the path I chose was correct.
The veiled kingdom is neither Hoshido nor Nohr. It's Valla.
I get the sense that I was somehow called here by many voices...
My wish is to remain by your side. I want to support you however I can.

cyril.name: Cyril
cyril.title: Rhea's Attendant
cyril.description: Came from Almyra, having lost his family when he was young. Archbishop Rhea took him in when he was working at House Goneril. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: It doesn't matter what world I'm in. My purpose is to serve Lady Rhea.
It's true that I was taken to Fódlan as a prisoner, but I have no desire to return to my homeland, Almyra.
Shamir's the one who taught me how to shoot a bow. She really guided me into developing my own archery style.
The writing system in Askr looks like the one in Fódlan. Maybe I could try studying it...
I'll clean, do laundry, gather firewood, tend to gardens... I'm good at taking care of more general stuff like that.
Visit: I've got other things to do, so let's make this quick. Got a delivery from [F] for you.
Level: Lady Rhea's enemies are my enemies. I must not lose!
Feeling pretty good about this. But I have to keep aiming higher.
How am I supposed to help Lady Rhea like this?
Summon: I'm Cyril. I served Lady Rhea at Garreg Mach Monastery. Got any work that needs doing at your castle?
Learn Skill: This is for me? Well, all right. I don't really get why, but I'll do my best to make use of it.
Confession:
I've dedicated my life to Lady Rhea. She is the only reason I'm still alive.
Lady Rhea gave me hope and a place to call home when I had neither.
I'll never be able to repay her, even if I spend my entire life trying to do so.
That's why I have to get stronger. I need to be able to help her clear every obstacle in her path.
Nothing brings me greater joy than knowing I'm doing something to support her.
So, if Lady Rhea wishes to save Askr, I will charge into the battlefield with all my strength.
Status: I'm Cyril. I'm always at Lady Rhea's call.
Hey! If you don't have anything better to do, go for a walk in the gardens!
It's my job to protect Lady Rhea.
I can see farther than most other people.
Doesn't matter if it's cleaning the floors or doing laundry... I just don't feel right unless I'm doing somethin'.
Lady Rhea... I hope I can see you again real soon.
You should just do what you can, and no more than that.

falear2.name: Alear
falear2.title: Awoken Divinity
falear2.description: She who, dressed in white and wielding a gleaming blade, once exterminated the Fell Dragon to save the world. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: When I see Heroes who look like the Emblems, memories of their strength and kindness come flooding back.
In my world, I collected 12 rings. With their power, and the help of my friends, I was reborn as an Emblem.

If you make a promise knowing you can't keep it, do you think it still holds meaning?
I believe it does, as long as behind your words there lies a sincere wish for the future.
Giving up isn't always a bad thing. With time, tears of resignation can become the burning fuel of resolve.
I just got out of bed, so to wake myself up, I was doing some training techniques I learned from my friends.
Visit: I sense you're the person I was sent here for. Thank you for being a good friend to [F].
Level: I hope this makes me a reassuring presence on the battlefield.
Good. Let's keep doing that.
Growth isn't always quick or easy.
Summon: Here to answer your call. I am Divine Dragon Alear, and I will not rest until peace reigns beneath this sky.
Learn Skill: Much appreciated. Now, is this the change you hoped for?
Confession:
If you don't mind, there's something I would like to speak with you about, [S].
It's that I... I have Fell Dragon blood in my veins.
I'm not sharing this with you out of shame. I know what matters is what I do, not how I was born.
You're just such a dear friend, I thought you deserved the truth.
Now, I can be whatever you need: a Divine Dragon, an Emblem, even one of the Corrupted.
And if you decide to become someone new, I'll still be right here. Your friend and protector.
Status: I will be your ally until the very end.
Idle hands? Do what I do—find a ring to polish.
I promised my mother I would protect everything under the sky. I intend to do just that.
Emblems don't usually have physical bodies. With you, though, anything seems possible.
I am the Divine Dragon, and your Hero. I will fight for you, always.
My friends are always with me. All I have to do is say, "Emblem Eternal!"
Whatever your dream, it's never too late. Mine took over a thousand years, but it finally came true.

kagero4.name: Kagero
kagero4.title: Bond Unwavering
kagero4.description: Childhood friends Kagero and Orochi from Hoshido putting the strength of their bond on display at the wind festival. They appear in Fire Emblem Fates.
kagero4.duo:
Grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit. Grants "unit can move 1 extra space (that turn only; does not stack)" and "neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat" to unit for 1 turn.
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Orochi:** These feathers are from peacocks, aren't they? Such a rare species— you hardly ever see them in the wild.
**Orochi:** Kagero and I have been joined at the hip since we were little. That's why we work together so well!
**Kagero:** It's not often that Orochi and I get to attend a festival together. We'd best make the most of it while we're here.
**Kagero:** A ninja always has to know which way the wind's blowing. Their very survival depends on it.
**Orochi:** I think I just overheard someone call me "immature." The gall! What about ME says immature?!
Visit: **Orochi:** We made it, Kagero! The splendid castle you see before you is where [F]'s friend lives.
Level: **Orochi:** Very good! The wind festival is off to a roaring start!
**Kagero:** Keep it up, Orochi! Now we really have the wind at our backs!
**Kagero:** I'm sorry, Orochi. I fell out of step.
Summon: I am Kagero, and this is my friend Orochi. We're here to celebrate the wind festival!
Learn Skill: **Kagero:** Thank you! Now we'll really kick up some dust on the battlefield.
Confession:
**Orochi:** Ahh! Nothing to put the heart at ease like a good festival.
**Kagero:** True—provided you have the right person by your side.
I doubt I would have had nearly as much fun without you here, Orochi.
**Orochi:** Whoa there! Are you trying to make me blush, Kagero?
I agree, of course. You're my best friend in the world, and that's the sort of bond that never fades.
**Kagero:** Very true, my friend. There's no gale strong enough to tear the two of us apart.
Status: These outfits are bold. All the more reason to show off!
Duo Skill: Like two peas... In a pod!

dagr3.name: Dagr
dagr3.title: Bluster Princess
dagr3.description: Princess of Jötunheimr, she set her royal duties aside and rushed to join in the wind-themed festivities.

Castle Hall: Countries that are open with others are great. That's how my country's gonna be too!
The Order always seems to have some festival going on... I'm jealous! I'll have to start some in Jötunheimr!
The air this thing can move is mighty impressive! Watch it, or it could send you flying, [S]!
You know where I can find a good spot to fly a kite? The more open space, the better.
This outfit is awesome, right?! I love it! I can't wait for Reginn to see it too.
Visit: Hey! It's me, Dagr! How's it goin'? I'm here with this gift for you, from [F]... *wink*
Level: Whew! This is a breeze! I've just gotta keep up this pace.
That's a nice breeze... Seems like a good sign. It's my time!
Hm... I can't seem to catch the wind right now.
Summon: Heyyy! Dagr has arrived! Time to get this wind festival started!
Learn Skill: For me? Thank you! I won't blow this opportunity!
Confession:
I hate being tied down by duty and that kind of thing.
I need to be free to do whatever I want—like the wind, I guess! That's how I've always been.
But you can't just stick to what's comfortable forever, right? Life has more to offer than that!
Nótt would always say things like... "Stand strong against headwinds!" "Remember to be true to yourself!"
Life may have its obstacles, but nothing can take the freedom that lives in my heart. I'll always have that.
Status: Loook!
Finally, some fun! I've been waiting for something like this...
Oh, uh...musta been the wind... Hah! Nice try!
There sure are a lot of different tribes out there... I guess the jötnar are kind of like a tribe too, huh?
I may not know any wind magic, but the air this thing moves more than makes up for that!
Jötnar make great friends, right? Stand behind me, and the wind won't touch a hair on your head! Haha!
I love the sound of the wind... It reminds me of someone who isn't here anymore.
Don't you worry! Stick with Dagr and everything'll be fiiine!

catria5.name: Catria
catria5.title: Windswept Knight
catria5.description: The middle child of three pegasus sisters, taking part in the wind festival accompanied by her beloved steed. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: A festival offering gratitude to the wind... That's a good idea. Wind is important to pegasus knights too.
I used to enjoy flying beside Lady Minerva's wyvern. It had the strength required to lead me and my sisters.
This light clothing is much more practical than stiff, heavy armor. The wind protects me, anyhow.
Even sentiments may be carried on the wind... Do you believe that to be true, [S]?
The wind blowing through the Askran sky is wonderful. Flying feels special here.
Visit: I am Catria, of the Whitewings. I've come with an invitation to the wind festival from [F].
Level: It looks like I used the wind to my advantage. I wonder if Palla and Est noticed...
I feel the wind rush through me. That way I can become one with it.
If you don't know the wind, you can't soar through the skies.
Summon: As a pegasus knight, I know how precious the wind is. I will enjoy the festival with my gratitude in mind.
Learn Skill: Many thanks. I will use this wind at my back.
Confession:
The wind has been by my side ever since my first flight on a pegasus.
It followed me through the skies in every bright moment and through every difficulty.
It was there in the days after the start of the war...drifting across the skies of Macedon, of Aurelis...
Each breeze different in its own way. At times it became a headwind to challenge me...
But in the end it always saved me. The wind always propelled me when my heart was full of doubt.
I pray to continue through life with the wind as my companion. During this festival, I'll offer up my gratitude.
Status: A people that lives as one with the wind... That feels right to me.
*surprise* That startled me, you know!
Lady Minerva once remarked that on the back of a pegasus, the wind feels gentle.
When I am in battle, I make the wind my ally.
If I fly way, way up into the sky, the chilly drafts are so bracing.
If only my thoughts could ride the wind and reach him.
I hope the breeze that blows to you brings amity with it.

claude5.name: Claude
claude5.title: Golden Breeze
claude5.description: Heir to House Riegan, drawn to the festivities celebrating the wind. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: It's easy to overlook what you can't see, but the wind is how seeds get scattered. We couldn't live without it.
I'm well acquainted with the wind. I negotiate with it every time I ride a wyvern or shoot a bow.
So this is the garb of the Wind Tribe, huh? They know how to read the breeze, I'll give them that.
If we're calling it a wind festival, then I expect it to be a wild party, full of freedom. No stuffy rules allowed!
The wind in Askr is no different from the wind in Fódlan. They're both invigorating, full of life and love.
Visit: I'm Claude of House Riegan. If you want to enjoy the wind festival, try [F]'s castle.
Level: Nothing like the wind at your back.
You think I'm slippery? Try and catch the wind.
Ugh—don't stand downwind of this. It stinks.
Summon: A festival of wind, eh? Well, you've piqued my interest. Count me in.
Learn Skill: Whenever the wind is behind you, you've got to take advantage.
Confession:
You can't see, smell, or taste the wind. The only way to sense it at all is through touch.
Fortunately, touch is all you need to make the wind your ally—if you know how to listen to what it's telling you.
Which way's it blowing? How strong? Is it soft and steady, or is it coming at you in big, wild gusts?
If you can read the wind, you can live by it. And it's far more reliable than leaving your fate up to chance.
I don't have to tell you that, though. You're as good at reading the wind as I am, [S].
For my part, I need to study up. I've got a few ideas about how to make the wind a bigger part of my life...
Status: This tribe can control the wind, huh? Fascinating. What kind of magic is that?
*laugh* A textbook move like that won't catch me by surprise.
So this is basically just a feast, right? Count me in.
I feel a bit strange wearing this outfit...in other words, pretty much normal.
Nobles and commoners from all manner of worlds and cultures live as equals here. I love it.
We all need a breather now and then—especially when things are tense.
You know, you've got a calming air about you. I appreciate that.

fuga.name: Fuga
fuga.title: Force of Gales
fuga.description: The chief of the Wind Tribe, who shares close ties with the kingdom of Hoshido. Though he may be growing older, he's still in peak physical condition. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: My tribe does not curry favor with any foreign power. We maintain a neutral position with our own might.
My people have long trained in the strong desert winds. They will not be easily moved.

The Wind Tribe makes an excellent healing potion. The recipe has been a long-held secret of ours.
However, if you should have need of it, I would teach you the recipe.
This is special garb worn only during the wind festival. It is usually stored away in Reppu Castle.
Many of those whom you call Heroes are yet children. They seem to have taken a liking to me somehow...
Visit: I am Fuga, leader of the Wind Tribe. You have been invited to the wind festival by [F].
Level: I feel a mighty wind coursing through me!
My strength is born of necessity.
We must anticipate poor results from time to time. In this life, many days will prove disappointing.
Summon: I am Fuga. As chieftain of the Wind Tribe, I am honored to share our festival with Askr.
Learn Skill: You expect much of me, it seems. Allow me to show my gratitude on the battlefield.
Confession:
The wind carries seeds of life, but it can also whip into a ferocious storm capable of great destruction.
It takes no physical shape, and yet is the embodiment of strength itself.
We of the Wind Tribe have dedicated our very being to learning how to live with this force's power.
The wind has forged us and bestowed its blessings upon us. Our lives revolve around it.
No matter how it blows, we will continue to hold our heads high and press forward.
We do so because we know this truth: the wind will bring us good fortune in our time.
Status: I am Fuga. I lead the Wind Tribe.
Hm? Is this some manner of greeting among your people?
Ah. I am honored to see so many people from other worlds taking part in our festivities.
Hayato is a skilled diviner who has mastered a number of unique skills.
I was once friends with Sumeragi, the late king of Hoshido.
The divine sword Yato... So the legends were true...
I hope you will visit Reppu Castle one day. You would be most welcome in my home.

plumeria3.name: Plumeria
plumeria3.title: Rapturous Dream
plumeria3.description: A jaded dökkálfr from Dökkálfheimr, the realm of nightmares. She delivers salacious dreams to mortals with a new power, as if she once again received the dream nectar that made her álfr.

Castle Hall: I have gained a new power over dreams. Why is it humans still think it appropriate to leer at me? Ugh...
Lady Freyja was the first to show me love. She showed me undying love could exist—if only in dreams.
What use is reality? With the dream realm, I can know I am loved. Can the real world offer the same joy?
Eitr, fragile as she is, surely wishes there were someone to love her...
There are disgusting humans in all directions across these vast lands... Ugh! They make me sick!
Visit: I am Plumeria, the lewd dream... I hope this is to your satisfaction.
Level: Such ecstasy...
I am one of the dökkálfar, not some petal-soft ljósálfr.
Am I to make this up to you somehow?
Summon: I am Plumeria, dökkálfr of lewd dreams. My dream, though, is one day seeing Lady Freyja reawaken.
Learn Skill: And what is it you intend for me to do with this?
Confession:
Eitr is weak—always crying, fearing she'll be abandoned.
She reminds me of how I was when I was human.
I had that same yearning to be loved, to be needed by someone else...
You wouldn't understand, surely.
Y-you know the feeling too? I...I see.
Status: Avert your eyes.
In Lady Freyja's name.
This change has put new eyes on me... That, I do not find pleasant.
The ecstasy of the dream nectar will never fade from my memory...
Should Lady Freyja wish it, I would endure any torture.
When I look at Eitr, I see...only the weak child I once was.
You may command me, but...I find no cause for despair in that.

ced2.name: Ced
ced2.title: Sage of the Wind
ced2.description: Prince of Silesse and inheritor of Forseti. Leads the fight against an empire, searching for his father. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War / Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.
ced2.origin: Genealogy of the Holy War + Thracia 776

Castle Hall: I shall return home to Silesse after I defeat Raydrik. I promised as much to Karin.
Prince Leif helped me realize what it means to be a crusader, and what purpose our power is meant to serve.
I cannot ignore the plight of those in need. My sister is the same—she is truly our mother's daughter.
Mother... I regret that I could not get you even a glimpse of Father before...
I heard a rumor that my father was in Munster. I traveled there as quickly as I could, but he was already gone.
Visit: I am searching for my father. You don't happen to know anything, do you, [S]?
Level: The correct approach to war is to save as many lives as you can. There is no meaning in being a sole survivor.
Those who surrender without a fight will be spared. I swear it.
Only my father could have cured my mother's illness. Even by her side, I could not help her...
Summon: I am Ced, leader of the Magi in Munster. Together, I believe you and I can save many lives.
Learn Skill: Let us gather our strength and stand against adversity. Only with a strong will can we achieve our aims.
Confession:
An evil cult devoted to the dark god Loptous once ruled all of Jugdral for several centuries.
That empire was finally overthrown by the heroes we call the crusaders.
But simply being crusaders is not what made them heroes. Their heroism was in their actions.
Rather than meekly submit to power, they chose to endure terrible conflict to fight for freedom and peace.
**That is what a crusader is to me:** one who leads people to victory, as Lord Seliph and Prince Leif have done.
I aspire to do the same. I only hope my mother is watching over us.
Special: I will hold fast to hope.
Status: I am Ced of the Magi. Do not think me a hero.
Was that you? I thought I was touched by the breeze.
What does it mean to be a crusader? I feel that Prince Leif embodies the very idea.
To inherit a divine weapon does not make one a crusader. To carry on the will of the crusaders is the true measure.
The hard road Prince Leif has been forced to march has also made him strong.
So many have suffered such great loss... For their sake, I must continue on.
You are embraced by a gentle breeze.
Map Select:
Yes.
I await your orders.
My aid is yours.

fee.name: Fee
fee.title: Aspiring Knight
fee.description: Daughter of Erinys, of the Four Heavenly Knights of Silesse. Seeks her brother, Ced, who set out in search of their father. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: My father left our family behind, so my brother left to search for him... Where are you, Ced?
I am not a knight yet, but my mother was a pegasus knight. She said that she fought alongside Lord Sigurd!
Mother's illness was...unusual. Ced told me that our father was the only one who could cure it.

Though my father and brother can be selfish, I believe they would join the fight against the empire.
That is why I decided to join the liberation army.
I named my pegasus after my aunt Annand. She is a famous hero in Silesse!
Visit: My name is Fee! Let this be a token of continued friendship between you and [F]!
Level: When I return to Silesse, it will be as a full-fledged pegasus knight!
Yes! That's the spirit!
Are you all right, Annand? Just keep in the air a little longer!
Summon: My name is Fee! I hail from Silesse. You haven't seen my brother around, have you?
Learn Skill: My father and brother failed our family, so I have to work even harder to make up for that!
Confession:
I mentioned before that my father went missing. My mother, Erinys, waited for his return dutifully.
Soon, Ced left to search for Father. In the end, I was the only one there when our mother died.
Why?! Why would Father just leave us like that? It was heartbreaking to watch Mother get sick alone...
I cannot forgive him. I refuse to say a word to him until he apologizes before my mother's grave!
Why are you looking at me like that? Huh? Oh... I-I didn't realize I had started crying.
I didn't mean to let my guard down in such a way. I swore I would never cry in front of others, but...
You are so kind and easy to talk to. Thank you for always listening to me, [S]!
Special: I have to do my best!
Status: My name is Fee. I am part of Isaach's liberation army.
*gasp* Please behave yourself.
No one knows where my father is. Even still, my mother always believed he'd come back one day...
Ced left me and mother at home, saying he would search for father.
I've always wanted to be the kind of hero that gets talked about in stories, like Sigurd and his allies.
I will see you again someday, Brother...
I'll admit, I thought you strange at first. But you turned out to be a decent person after all!

patty.name: Patty
patty.title: Youthful Thief
patty.description: A thief who targets imperials and ruffians alike, stealing for orphans she cares for. Her mother Brigid's noble blood flows within her. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: My brother and I weren't the only ones at the orphanage. Many children lost parents to the imperial army.
I met Prince Shannan at a temple in the Aed desert, and...well, the rest is history, as they say! Hehehe...
Whether it's buying bread or raising an army, you need coin. That's why I do what I do—whatever it takes.
I'm making lunches for folks. Huh? How did I get the ingredients? In the normal way, obviously!
Everyone around here is so...good. I've got no targets to ply my trade on! What do I do with myself?!
Visit: Got something for you. Don't worry, I've already taken my cut. It's a gift from [F]! Here!
Level: Ha! Look at me, making a killing.
I can get the job done, when I really feel like it.
Ugh... What will Prince Shannan say?
Summon: I'm Patty—Prince Shannan's special someone. Hehehe! Only joking.
Learn Skill: For me? Really? Oh, thank you so much!
Confession:
There you are! I've been looking all over for you, [S].
Have you had a chance to eat today? I thought not. Well, Patty's here to save the day! I made you lunch.
You're one of the few who gets to try my cooking. Only Prince Shannan and Lord Seliph are as lucky as you!
Oh, and I got you a little something else. Call it an extra surprise.
Tada! A stamina drink! My special recipe. A swig of this and you'll have a spring in your step all day. Enjoy!
Status: I'm Patty. Prince Shannan's special somebody... I'm joking!
Ugh! Unhand me, or you'll sully my good name!
You can't wage war without a treasury. I'll fill it up for you!
Let people say whatever they want. I pay it no mind.
The empire orphaned all these children. Unforgivable!
I've always admired Prince Shannan. I await our fateful encounter... *chuckle*
I whipped up this stamina drink for you. Don't waste a single drop!

febail.name: Febail
febail.title: Mercenary Waif
febail.description: Inheritor of the Holy Yewfelle and descendant of Ullr. Raised in an orphanage after his mother, Brigid, went missing. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: I will brook no harsh talk about my sister. Patty is a decent and honest person at heart.
My sister and I grew up in an orphanage. That's why, all the money I make, I'm giving to children in need.
I hope Patty is all right. Sometimes she pushes herself too hard trying to help out the orphanage.
Patty said I was out of my mind to work for the empire, no matter the money involved. And she was right.
I remember very little of my mother. But I do know she was beautiful—and had the kindest of hearts.
Visit: Hey there. I dropped in to pass along this token of friendship from [F].
Level: I will never stop fighting for peace! On this bow, I swear it!
Everything I do, I do for the orphans!
No, this won't do! I can't keep making Patty act like a thief...
Summon: I'm Febail—a mercenary, but not here to do your dirty work. Ah...if you see my sister, please let me know.
Learn Skill: What's the job? I'll see it gets done.
Confession:
You haven't run into Patty of late, have you? That girl... Always going off somewhere.
I thought learning our mother was a noblewoman of Yngvi might temper her attitude, but it seems not.
Though in fairness, it didn't temper mine either. I'm still fighting for the children at the orphanage.
For me, this is not a war of allies and enemies. It is about making a happier world for the next generation.
I'd like to think my mother would be proud of what I've done—and what I still have yet to accomplish.
Special: I don't shrink from a challenge!
Status: Well met, summoner. I am Febail.
Hm? Did you...need me?
A mercenary I may be, but I draw the line at dirty work.
More fool I, to do the empire's bidding. It was wrong.
Mother was so beautiful, so kind...
Patty has changed, that's for certain.
I finally feel as though I've found my calling.

arion.name: Arion
arion.title: Gungnir's Heir
arion.description: Prince of Thracia, land of wyvern knights. Son of King Travant, he has been entrusted with his homeland's future. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: My father's life's work was to claim the fertile northern Thracia. It was not for him, but the people.
We wyvern knights are formidable, but we could not face the empire alone. Careful strategy was needed.
When he entrusted me with the lance Gungnir, my father told me not to let the people of Thracia suffer further.
It is a luxury to have a place to rest one's wings. I am grateful for it.
Battles may be won with strategy and might, but without a righteous cause, faith can falter...and then all is lost.
Visit: I am no mere messenger. That said, I come bearing something on behalf of [F].
Level: They call Thracia a country of hyenas simply for being willing to work with whomever we must to survive.
This is a battlefield. There will be no holding back.
Altena continued to call me her brother, even though she knew the truth about her birth...
Summon: I am Arion, son of the king of Thracia, Travant—and I will be your opponent. Show me what you are capable of!
Learn Skill: Is this for me? You have my thanks.
Confession:
My father said that unifying Thracia was his life's work—that our people needed the fertile northern land.
I know full well that Altena, Hannibal, and others despise the empire's way of doing things.
But the hard truth is that, without the empire's help, Thracia would have ceased to exist. We had no choice.
I had planned to die on the battlefield as a warrior, in solidarity with my father...but, as you can see, I yet live.
I have decided that my purpose now should be to support the new Thracia from the shadows.
If you want to live a life free from regret, you must find a path that you believe in, [S].
Status: I am Arion of Thracia, son of King Travant.
*gasp* Put a stop to your rudeness.
I...was wrong. Altena's entreaty opened my eyes.
For me, there is no longer a place to return.
I have never seen the king like this. What has shaken my father so?
Altena, you could not understand Father as deeply as I.
This contract with you may be my last.

elincia5.name: Elincia
elincia5.title: Undaunted Queen
elincia5.description: A queen who always stood by her people and healed her country in the wake of war. Praised as Crimea's heart, she has earned her subjects' respect. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: So many are compelled by war to risk their lives in defense of their homes. We must never fail to honor them.
It took a great deal of support from friends and allies to secure my rule as queen. I will never forget that.
Difficulty concentrating? Try to focus on your breathing. That always helps me feel better.
I took to the battlefield to help my allies bear the burden of risk, but... I fear I only caused them more worry.
I was taught how to prepare for battle by the Radiant Hero himself. I warn you, I learned his lessons well.
Visit: I pray that you will always cherish the happy and fulfilling friendship you have with [F].
Level: If you are ever in despair, it will be faith in yourself and your allies that rekindles the radiant flame of hope.
May the hearts of the people be ever full of hope's light!
Even in the deepest darkness, always remember that the dawn will come.
Summon: I am Elincia. I became Crimea's queen only by necessity—but if my deeds earn praise, I am honored.
Learn Skill: No matter the place or time, I always find hope and beauty in the rise of the morning sun.
Confession:
If I'm being entirely honest, I have to wonder what future generations will think of our rule in Crimea.
I can say for certain that those of us involved in rebuilding did everything we could for a prosperous future.
We fought and lived alongside our loved ones with the intent to build an honest and peaceful society.
If we were at all successful, and if our people remember us with any amount of fondness, then I am satisfied.
The future is in the hands of those who come after us. I hope they are able to live fulfilling lives.
If I could speak to them now, I would remind them that there will always be times of adversity ahead.
But if they can stand strong and hold hope in their hearts as the Radiant Hero did, then they will persevere.
Status: Please, just call me Elincia. I've done nothing worthy of recognition.
Ah! You always manage to catch me by surprise!
History is not shaped by monarchs, but by the multitudes.
If I have nudged the scales even slightly toward prosperity...then I am gratified.
No matter the age or world, conflict always seems to be brewing. Will we ever see an end to it?
I wonder how history will remember my deeds...
Being near you has a way of putting me at ease.

anna5.name: Anna
anna5.title: Twice the Anna
anna5.description: Sisters from different worlds. They don the other's outfit and work together to develop a marketing plan. They appear in Fire Emblem Engage / Fire Emblem Awakening.
anna5.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】and【Resonance: Shields】
and restores 99 HP to unit and allies from the same titles as unit. Grants Special cooldown count-5 to unit.
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Shields】
Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."
(Harmonized Skills can be used by tapping the Harmonized button. Harmonized Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Anna:** We swapped outfit styles, just for a change of pace—and to show our customers what we're capable of!
**Anna:** My young sister and I may come from very different worlds, but they both have Divine Dragons in them!
**Anna:** I love festivals. We had all kinds of them back in Wintertide Village. Say, that gives me a business idea...
**Anna:** You expect me to just...give you some candy? For free? How about I throw in a little extra if you buy something?
**Anna:** I usually have to think of new product ideas on my own. Having a fellow Anna around is really nice!
Visit: **Anna:** Hi! This harvest-festival greeting is brought to you by Anna, Anna, and your friend [F].
Level: **Anna:** Amazing harvest so far! Keep up the good work, Anna!
**Anna:** Candy's great, but the sweet taste of victory might be even better. It's all thanks to your patronage!
**Anna:** Really? What a waste. The harvest festival only comes around once a year, y'know!
Summon: Hi! We're Anna and Anna—merchants from different worlds, here to make it rich at the harvest festival!
Learn Skill: **Anna:** Ooo, is this for us? Thanks so much! We'll make sure you get your money's worth.
Confession:
**Anna:** I wish the harvest festival could last forever. What are you going to do when it's over, Anna? Will you...go?
**Anna:** If there's an interesting place I want to visit, sure. That's what traveling merchants do. Hey, are you OK?
**Anna:** Yeah, it's just that...I got separated from my sisters back in Elyos, and it's been lonely ever since, so...
**Anna:** Ah... I get it. But not to worry! There is plenty of festival left—and when I do leave, I want to take you with me.
**Anna:** You do? Yes! I can't wait to travel to new worlds and make new profits with my new favorite sister!
**Anna:** Definitely! Our products will shake up the market everywhere we go. But for now, let's get back to the festival!
Status: Boo!
"The Annas are here to serve you!" "On the house!"
Conversation: **Anna:** Ta-da! Here's my festival outfit! What do you think?
**Anna:** You look adorable, Lady Anna! And might I add that you have excellent fashion sense?
**Anna:** *snicker* Of course you'd say that about your own style! Thanks for helping me with the adjustments.
This Ylissean fabric is still new to me, but the more I learn, the more ideas I get for products to sell back home.
**Anna:** I'd expect nothing less from a sister of mine. Your entrepreneurial spirit is a credit to Annas everywhere.
I've also been inspired by the stuff I've seen from Elyos. That said, I do think this getup is a bit...
**Anna:** A bit super cute on you?! It's the cutting edge of fashion, trust me.
**Anna:** For people your age, maybe! But we grown-ups are a big part of the market too. You should study what we like.
**Anna:** Ha! Grown-ups are just kids with bigger arms and legs.
**Anna:** Oh, look who's such an expert! You'll change your tune when you're older.
**Anna:** Huh... Think I'll look like you?
**Anna:** Hehe. Sure you will. Like me, but an even better dresser.
**Anna:** And by then, I WILL be a fashion expert—kid AND grown-up fashion!
**Anna:** You will. No reason to rush it on that front, though. You'll get there sooner or later, like it or not.
So you better enjoy being a kid while you can! They get way more candy at the harvest festival, y'know. Hehehe.
**Anna:** Oh, good point. I'd better get as much as I can while the gettin's good!
**Anna:** Hey, score some for me while you're at it. I've got an idea to turn a profit, and two Annas make a great team.

timerra2.name: Timerra
timerra2.title: Trick or Meat
timerra2.description: The crown princess of Solm. She was wants to eat and sing along with everyone at the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: In the right costume, I bet you could mingle with regular folks without being noticed...or go digging for intel.
In Solm, there's a day every year when they say the dead come home—so we all dress up like ghosts!
If plentiful crops are proof of a thriving country, then I'd say Askr's doing pretty darn well.
Hey, looks like we both decided to wear white today. Costume buddies!
Where are the trick-or-treaters? The meat's gonna get cold if they don't hurry up and take some!
Visit: I'm a huuungry ghooost... Give me your steeeak... Ha, just playing— [F] says hi.
Level: Oh yeah, reaping the gains! That's what I'm talking about!
I'm so good, it's almost scary.
Aw, c'mon... What a pitiful harvest.
Summon: Boo! Hehe... I'm Timerra, the princess of Solm. You ready to take this harvest festival to the next level?
Learn Skill: If you ask me, a harvest festival's all about changing things up!
Confession:
Hey, there you are! I just got the fire started, [S].
It's not only steak we're eating tonight. Look. I laid out some fruits, veggies—and fresh cheese!
You know me—I could eat meat for the rest of my life. But I figured you might want some variety.
So c'mon, grab a plate! For tonight, let's forget about fighting and just have a nice time.
That's what a harvest festival is all about, right? And as a special treat, I'll sing while you chow down.
I call this song, "Harvest Friendstival." ♪A crackling fire, a full plate... Isn't this all pretty great?♪
Status: I'll now be performing my sixth song, "Haunted Harvest Festival." ♪There's a ghoooost in the candy...♪
Huwaah! Hey—I'm supposed to be the one scaring you!
So this is what a harvest festival is like! I've always wondered... Solm's sunny year-round, so the fall is really short.
Check out these delicious-looking veggies! I bet they'd go great with some nice, juicy meat...
Back in Solm, there's a haunted castle that the locals won't dare go near... Heh! Did I scare ya?
When I become queen, I'll make sure to host lots of festivals like this. Gotta keep the people happy.
Come on summoner, let's make the most out of this festival! I wanna be eating and singing 'til the sun comes up!

seadall.name: Seadall
seadall.title: Misfortune-Teller
seadall.description: A dancer from Solm, and a skilled fortune-teller. He's maintaining his disciplined diet even with all the many sweets around the harvest festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Ah, now that's a full moon worthy of a harvest festival. Although...do you call it a "moon" in this world?
I was a traveling dancer, so I have been to many a festival. Would you like me to tell you about some?
A dancer must maintain their beauty. I have to be strict with myself, or my master will frown from the heavens...
La Pomme—the apple card. It seems I have the stars' blessing to enjoy some fresh fruit.
In return for a dance, I was given this bag of treats. I shouldn't eat them, but I don't want to be rude...
Visit: Hello there—I am here to perform a harvest dance for you, courtesy of [F].
Level: O moon and stars above...for this bountiful harvest, we give our thanks.
I suppose the fresh food has done me some good.
Hmph. Well, there's always next harvest.
Summon: I am Seadall. I take it you want me to read your fortune? Or did you just bring me here for the festival?
Learn Skill: Hah, what a boon! As if I was not skilled enough before!
Confession:
You survived another day unscathed. Thank the stars. I am always relieved to see you looking well.
Not that I worry about you—it's just that when I last read your fortune, the cards were...
All right, fine! I do worry about you. I suppose you could say you're important to me.
I don't want to lose you the way I lost my master. He died before my very eyes...
**Now he's gone, departed to the same place we will all go some day:** among the constellations.
Would you...mind if I stayed by your side today? Please? I want to be there in case something happens.
Status: In light of all the appetizing food here, let us give thanks to the harvest moon for blessing us with abundance.
*grunt* I'm reading a fortune. Could you not sneak up on me?
I have consulted with the stars, and I see two paths ahead... You give me a treat, or you get tricked.
La Récolte—the harvest card. That means you can count on this festival being a bountiful one.
I must say, I feel quite stunning in this outfit. But it may not be ideal for dancing.
O spirit of the cards... Will I have the discipline not to eat too much candy?!
You say you want your fortune read? Very well—but it will have to be when the voices of the stars can be most clearly heard.

flayn2.name: Flayn
flayn2.title: Silly Kitty-Cat
flayn2.description: A girl who lives in Garreg Mach Monastery with her brother, Seteth. She's come to Askr's harvest festival dressed in a cat costume. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: The whole castle smells of sweet treats... Other worlds hold such marvelous festivals!
Many cats lived in Garreg Mach Monastery, so I'm quite skilled at imitating them. Mrrrowr!
I simply adore festivals! Wouldn't it be wonderful if there were a festival every day?
These paws are so soft and fun to play with... I feel like a real cat! It's a shame I can't keep them forever.
Have you seen Seteth? I thought I might ask him to accompany me in some trick-or-treating.
Visit: A trick or a treat upon you! We are having so much fun at the harvest festival with [F]!
Level: This strength is quite the bountiful harvest indeed!
What sort of trick shall I play on you?
Dear me... Do you suppose that was one trick too many?
Summon: Meow! Have I arrived at the harvest festival? I, Flayn, shall enjoy the festivities today as a cat!
Learn Skill: Oh my! How touching that you knew just what I wanted!
Confession:
Festivals are marvelous, aren't they? I can think of no better reason to don such a cute outfit!
Though I do think such clothing suits me, don't you agree?
Summoner, I would love to attend even more of Askr's festivals, so do invite me again if it pleases you.
The merriment in the air, new friendships to be made...
I'm already looking forward to next year's harvest festival! I will plan on bringing Seteth along as well.
Now, I shall prance about and enjoy the rest of the harvest festival as joyfully as a cat! Trick or treat!
Status: Meow!
Purr, purr... Heehee!
Just for today, I have become a cat. Meow!
Why does one dress up for the harvest festival, exactly? Please explain it to me.
Where is my brother? He is certain to give me a treat.
I simply adore all of this merriment!
Shall we stroll around the festival together?

kellam.name: Kellam
kellam.title: Pumpkin Knight
kellam.description: The most easily forgotten armored knight in Chrom's Shepherds. Will anyone notice that he dressed up for the festival? Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: No one noticed me in the Shepherds. If I wasn't wearing such a silly outfit, no one would notice me here either.
I used to be very cowardly, so it's kind of shocking that I was able to play tricks on people...
I may not look it, but I'm pretty good at sneaking into places. No one ever sees me coming.
I was born on a farm, so I might be better suited to wielding a shovel rather than a spear.
I'm seeing some really flashy outfits here. Do you think I'm underdressed?
Visit: Trick or treat! You're the only one who has noticed me since I came from [F]'s castle.
Level: Oh no, I'm not drawing too much attention now, am I?
Whew... Somehow made it through without my usual armor.
W-wait, my pumpkin's all turned around! I can't see!
Summon: I'm Kellam. I'm a member of the Shepherds. The harvest festival is here, right? Um, hello?
Learn Skill: For me? Wow, thank you! I didn't expect a literal bounty from the harvest festival!
Confession:
This pumpkin has a nice shape. You can tell how much care the farmers put into raising it.
Oh, I was born into a farming family, so I can tell how well a crop was grown by its color and shape.
I'm happy that there's a festival to give thanks for the bounty of the fields even in Askr.
After all, no matter where we are, crops are the reason we're alive.
I know I don't have much to offer, but what I do have I will give in service of the Order of Heroes.
I really like helping people, so, um... please don't forget about me once the festival ends.
Status: Does the costume help me stand out at all?
Whoa! It's rare for anyone to get the jump on me...
I was raised on a farm, so that's why I'm a pumpkin—and I'm also a ghost because, well...
Let me know if you want to try gardening. I've got a bit of a green thumb.
The harvest festival's great, but I'm thankful for the fruits of the field all year round.
Everyone’s costumes are amazing. I could have gone further...
Spending time with you will make the festival even more fun for me.

peony3.name: Peony
peony3.title: Cherished Dream
peony3.description: A ljósálfr from Ljósálfheimr, the realm of dreams. Delivers pleasant dreams to mortals. Her connection with Triandra has awakened a new power.

Castle Hall: Triandra is kind, deep down... She does everything she can for the people she cares about.
Everyone has dreams... Some may bring smiles, some may bring tears.
Mirabilis is a ljósálfr like me... Despite her being half-asleep most of the time I've known her, she's a dear friend.
If anything can happen in dreams, then King Freyr and Lady Freyja may still one day find peace once more...
My dream is for everyone to be happy!
Visit: You are rather close friends with [F], aren't you? How lovely!
Level: Ooh! Wonderful!
I will do my best no matter what. Just you watch!
Huh. That doesn't usually happen...
Summon: Hi, I'm Peony! These clothes sure are wonderful... They remind me we can be anything in our dreams!
Learn Skill: Oh, thank you! You've made me so happy!
Confession:
Dreams are wonderful... Dreams are where new ideas are born, after all!
My dream is to make as many people happy as I can.
Warm and floaty, not a care in the world... You know what I mean?
You might be overthinking it...
All right, come with me. You can take a nap, and I'll show you what I mean.
Status: Sweetest dreams.
Want to play?
This power makes me feel like I could burst... I may never get used to it.
We mustn't ever give up. That's what Eitr taught me.
Triandra... I remember...
Dreams can be strange, but that is what makes them wonderful.
I'm glad to be able to play some part in your dreams.

triandra3.name: Triandra
triandra3.title: Reverent Dream
triandra3.description: A dökkálfr from Dökkálfheimr, the realm of nightmares. Delivers terrible dreams to mortals. Her connection with Peony has awakened a new power.

Castle Hall: Peony's bright cheer spreads to everyone she meets... I am nothing like her.
Everyone has dreams... Some may bring smiles, some may bring tears.
You're...looking directly at me... without hint of fear. What strange new dream is this?
Lady Freyja is the purpose for everything I do.
My dream is to give life rather than take it away.
Visit: I am Triandra, the Nightmare... I can choose what visions fill your head as you sleep tonight.
Level: There is someone I wish to protect. I will claim the power to do so.
Is this power coming from within... or is it from her?
Anguish is nothing new to me...
Summon: I am the Nightmare, Triandra... This new form was born from her dreams and mine...
Learn Skill: Thank you. You are...too kind.
Confession:
Dreams may be mysteries, but they are made up of our thoughts...and our feelings.
I wanted to protect her, no matter what would happen to me...
And now, I want to protect Lady Freyja...and still, there is no sacrifice I would not make.
What becomes of me is not part of my dream...for I am Nightmare.
Yet...you don't fear me, do you?
You are something of a mystery yourself, Summoner.
Status: Up.
We're not done.
Everything we do is in service to Lady Freyja...
I will face any foe.
Peony... I remember...
I will make sure the dream realm survives. For her...
Can I assume you...don't want me gone?

sonya3.name: Sonya
sonya3.title: Beautiful Mage
sonya3.description: Daughter of Jedah, high priest of the Duma Faithful. She swore vengeance on her father for giving her sisters over to the Fell God. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: My body and soul belong to me and no one else. I'll never give myself over to the control of another.
Women who give their souls to Duma become witches. And yet my father was willing to... Urgh. My poor sisters.
To be beautiful, you have to be brutally honest about what you see in the mirror.
Some people don't know how lucky they are just to have a warm bed and a full belly.
One day, my power will surpass my father's...and I will at last be able to reclaim my sisters' souls.
