Visit: I hope you won't mind me saying, but you seem to be getting along very well with [F]...
Level: This is exactly what I needed—power. But I must have more!
Not enough... I need more power.
No... At this rate, I will never be able to undo my father's twisted sacrifices to Duma...
Summon: I am Sonya. I have to say, the power gathering in this castle is dazzling... It's like thousands of dancing colors.
Learn Skill: So, this is how it feels to be reborn.
Confession:
You want to know what I'm researching? Oh, don't take stock in the rumors going around.
Unless, that is...you are asking out of genuine care, rather than mere curiosity.
Fine. I am studying possible ways to reclaim my sisters' souls from Duma. And from my father, Jedah.
Such power can only be achieved through forbidden means...which is to say it's not exactly safe.
I suspect that to accomplish my goal, I will have to forsake the person I am altogether.
And if that's not enough to scare you off, then I suppose you really are a true friend.
Status: If you want to be a great enchantress, you have to look the part.
Ow! Must you always act so childish?
With one strong gale from Caliburnus, I'll sweep our enemies off their feet.
I'll never say no to a gorgeous outfit. Makes me feel that much more dangerous.
I think I've learned a thing or two here in Askr.
Even if you have all the power in the world...there will still be things you lose and can never get back.
So, now that I'm reborn, what do you make of me?

hestia.name: Hestia
hestia.title: Duma's Witch
hestia.description: Second-eldest daughter of Jedah, high priest of the Duma Faithful. She looks down on her sister Sonya, who fled life as a witch. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: My father... Does my father not exist in this world?

Once a witch is created, they can never be human again...
They must serve Lord Duma and offer up sacrifices in his name as long as they draw breath...
For what purpose do you stare? Am I under surveillance?
You seem to be unafraid of me... Do you not know that I am a witch?
You say that I too could have done what Sonya did? It is too late for such thoughts...
Visit: I am an emissary of the War Father Duma. Do not resist. We have allied with [F]'s castle.
Level: Yes... That's it. Obey.
Why do you refuse Lord Duma's truth? It is incomprehensible...
Why? I have done nothing wrong...
Summon: My name is Hestia. I am a witch in service of the War Father Duma. I will submit to your command...
Learn Skill: This power... What do you ask of me in return?
Confession:
Father said he was resurrecting a god in order to save the broken world of man, which grew weaker by the day...
Marla's soul was offered up to this god...and she became a witch in service of Lord Duma...
I thought it was for the best... All part of the plan. But then... Sonya fled. Why? Why did she get to leave?
It's not fair... I have done nothing wrong. I have followed Father's every order.
Father, why? Why would you do this to me?! I don't understand... Nothing makes sense anymore... I... I—
Status: My name is...Hestia. Yes, I am Hestia.
What is it you want from me?
Marla...you spoil that girl too much.
I'm the second of three sisters. The middle child, always forgotten...
Refusing Lord Duma's truth? Arrogant fools...
I've done nothing wrong...only as Father commanded.
I prefer to be alone, but...you. You may stay.

mycen.name: Mycen
mycen.title: Zofia's Champion
mycen.description: A hero who rose from soldier to knight, and on to earn the title of count. Retired, he lives in Ram Village with his grandson, Alm. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I pray that Alm follows his path— that he liberates Valentia from its accursed fate.
It was the gods who divided Valentia in two, between Rigel in the north and Zofia in the south.
Fate is cruel, and it is mighty... No matter how I struggle, I know it will overpower me in the end.

Valentia, for all the blessings the gods once gave it, is now a continent of lost people.
The people of Zofia have forgotten their purpose; those of Rigel have forgotten their kindness.

Rudolf lit the fires of destruction, hoping a heroic warrior might be born from the ashes.
He did this knowing full well it might condemn him...that his soul may burn in flames of a different kind.
Visit: May your friendship with [F] long endure.
Level: It seems experience really is the best teacher.
I will redouble my efforts.
This will not do.
Summon: I am Mycen. I made a promise to my friend that I must keep, for the sake of Valentia's future.
Learn Skill: There is always another battle, hm?
Confession:
It was the gods Duma and Mila who divided Valentia into a northern part and a southern.
For a time, the people enjoyed the gods' protections, but with time they fell into depravity.
For the gods' noble intents grew distorted, and the people likewise lost their way.
Rudolf sensed imminent danger. He felt if nothing were done, the people would destroy themselves.
Thus began the lonely struggle of my friend, Rigel's emperor...a quest to destroy the godly order.
To me, a general of Zofia, Rudolf entrusted his newborn son. I swore to see his tragic will to fruition.
Now I am bound by duty to see that Alm achieves his destiny...
Status: I am Mycen. Just an old man from a humble village.
Hm? Oh, was that your idea of a prank? Reminds me of my grandchildren when they were small...
Alm does not lack for talent. Someday, he... Oh, don't mind my rambling.
Our true foe is Duma. We must cast that Fell God back to the shadows.
Emperor Rudolf is a friend. Perhaps the only close friend I have.
Alm and Celica have begun to walk their own path.
I will happily assist you, provided you can put up with an old fool like me.

marla.name: Marla
marla.title: Duma's Witch
marla.description: Eldest daughter of Jedah, high priest of the Duma Faithful. She looks down on her sister Sonya, who fled life as a witch. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Lord Duma, please tell me... Where is Father?
Lord Duma bestows his blessing on both those who offer him their souls and those who perform his rituals.
Rest assured, I shall follow your orders. Unless I receive contrary orders from Father, of course...
If Father were here, he would be able to demonstrate Lord Duma's power. War would rage across this land.
Incredible... Lord Duma would be pleased to see such a world where battles roar on endlessly...
Visit: Soon this land will succumb to chaos and destruction... As long as those faithful to Lord Duma persist...
Level: Shhh... Let me sing you a lullaby. Sweet dreams...
This world shall be controlled by power and fear, as our god Lord Duma wills.
Such...stubborn children. You should listen to your elders...
Summon: My name is Marla. I am a witch in service of the War Father Duma. My powers are at your disposal.
Learn Skill: I will use this power for the glory of my father and Lord Duma!
Confession:
Sonya... Where have you gone, dear sister? Father has been worried...
You know, he said you had the most potential of all of us to become a powerful witch.
How could you believe there is anything more joyous than offering your soul to our Lord Duma?
We were born as Lord Jedah's daughters. But you abandoned your father. Your sisters. Your family.
You are a selfish girl, Sonya, and you must be punished for your own good.
I will find you and I will turn you into a witch at last. You must be saved from yourself.
Then we can be together again, my sister. You, Hestia, and me... We can go back to how things used to be...
Status: There, there.
I am Marla. I am here to carry out Lord Duma's wishes.
Tch. Impudent child, always roughhousing...
Why won't you be good and listen to Father?
Lord Duma is truly wonderful. Father says so.
That sister of mine should be here with me. She always has been a willful one...
Does she...really hate Father so?
You're a good child. Here, I'll sing you a lullaby.

veyle.name: Veyle
veyle.title: Gentle Dragon
veyle.description: Daughter of the Fell Dragon. She has devoted a loving heart to working for the good of humanity. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: That owl is so adorable. And its plumage is the same color as my clothes! Er, is that odd for me to say?

Before I came here, I was on a search for my kin, and I kept waking up in unfamiliar places.
Thankfully, that hasn't happened since I came to this world.
Is there anything I can assist with? I like to be helpful, so don't hesitate to ask if you need something.
So there are other dragon Heroes? I'd like to learn more about them— their lives, their pasts...
Sorry for hiding. I thought you might not want to be seen standing next to someone like me.
Visit: Hello. My name is Veyle, and I have a gift from your friend. I hope you and [F] stay close!
Level: My wish for the future is what keeps me going.
This power isn't for hurting. It's for protecting.
I'm sorry. You must be so disappointed in me...
Summon: Sorry for showing up unannounced. My name is Veyle. I'll try to help you however I can.
Learn Skill: What a kind thing to do. I promise, I'll use this power to help you.
Confession:
So, I... I just want to thank you for being nice to me. I must be terrifying to be around.
I know I am evil in my core. As the Fell Dragon's daughter, I have destruction and death in my blood.
Oh, but don't worry! I won't turn into a dragon. I can't. I buried my dragonstone long ago...
Anyway, if you keep being my friend despite what you know about me, then I swear to be loyal.
And I will never, ever misuse my power. I promise.
Status: You treat me so well here. I'll try to make myself useful however I can.
Oh! What is it? If I've done something wrong, please tell me.
I always enjoy talking to you. Maybe we could chat more often! ...If you want to, I mean.
Is there anything I can do to help out? If not, that's OK. A defect like me will probably mess things up anyway.
Do you have spicy food here? In my world, there's a spicy red seasoning I can't get enough of. I put it on everything!
I'd like to make friends with the other Heroes, but I'm worried I'll scare them...
I don't really know why you summoned me, let alone why you call me a "Hero," but I am grateful. I promise I'll repay your kindness little by little.

sanaki3.name: Sanaki
sanaki3.title: Dawnsworn Ninja
sanaki3.description: Sisters, free from the fate of the apostle, using their ninja garb to conceal their worldly roles. They appear in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.
sanaki3.duo:
Grants unit another action. (May be used only if unit has already entered combat during the current turn.)
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Sanaki:** People are fragile... Which is precisely why they must learn to have strength. Do you not think so, Micaiah?
**Sanaki:** A ninja... If only I had such a person at my disposal, perhaps then I might have quelled the senate's rampage.
**Micaiah:** It's about time for the festivities! Shall we take a short break? Participation in a festival takes ample strength.
**Sanaki:** I want to take this time to truly know you, Micaiah. I suspect that will be of import for Begnion and Daein as well.
**Micaiah:** Hrah...yah! Hmm... Shuriken don't fly as I thought they would. If only Sothe were here. He'd have just the thing.
Visit: **Sanaki:** Urgh... There's nothing to be done if we've been detected. Our infiltration training is over. Let's away, Micaiah!
Level: **Sanaki:** Aha! It hit the mark! Micaiah, you must observe this technique!
**Sanaki:** Stand down! Your ill-intentioned deeds are over!
**Micaiah:** Keep your head up, Sanaki. We are improving slowly but surely.
Summon: Shh... Hush, you! At present, I am no empress of Begnion, but a ninja of justice! I protect the peace!
Learn Skill: **Micaiah:** Let us unite in strength and mold this world into one of peace, together.
Confession:
**Sanaki:** I can scarcely believe how incapable my body is of following my wishes. I can't seem to move like you, Micaiah.
**Micaiah:** I spent my life running between alleys and the underground... I'm bound to have a bit more endurance than you.
**Sanaki:** It may not appear to be the case, but I've done my fair share of training with Sigrun, Tanith, and a few others.
**Micaiah:** You mean to say you've been doing special ninja training with members of the Holy Guard?
**Sanaki:** To train, we've been swatting at fast-growing ivy in the mornings. At times it's so tall, Tanith must lift me.
**Micaiah:** We are quite similar, you and I. We both take these festivals seriously and are earnest in our pursuits.
**Sanaki:** Yes, well...er...we are sisters after all! Though, I simply figured if I was going to participate, I may as well go all in.
**Micaiah:** That's one of your best qualities. You are incredibly decisive and have such strong convictions—a true ruler.
**Sanaki:** Well...this conversation has taken a turn, but I quite enjoy being with you. Shall we continue this discourse?
**Micaiah:** Of course, not only for our sakes but for Begnion's and Daein's as well. But we must watch those sneaky shadows.
Status: "Stealth is rather thrilling!" "Shh! You'll get us spotted!"
Conversation: **Sanaki:** Excellent. Now that I've slipped in undetected, all that remains is to reach out and take...
**Micaiah:** Found you!
**Sanaki:** Blast! That is the third time in a row you've caught me! What gave the game away this time?
I suppose that is a foolish question to ask a diviner. You looked into the future, didn't you?
**Micaiah:** Not at all. I merely took the time to familiarize myself with all the little nooks and crannies in this place.
More by force of habit than anything else, admittedly. I needed that sort of awareness to survive, growing up.
**Sanaki:** Ah... Of course. I can scarcely imagine the trials you must have endured in those years...
**Micaiah:** Now, now, none of that. It's all behind us.
Right now, I'm at a festival with my sister—and I couldn't be happier.
It reminds me of festivals back home, though. I'd often see brothers and sisters leading each other around.
It used to make me envious, seeing siblings holding hands, enjoying their time together as family.
**Sanaki:** I hope you harbor no intentions of chaperoning me like that. I am an empress, you will recall!
Still... I suppose I would consent to holding hands. If you'd like.
**Micaiah:** Oh, I didn't mean anything by it. I was just reminiscing, that's all.
But, since you've made me such a generous offer, how could I refuse? Go on, take my hand.
**Sanaki:** Very well! Hehehe...this will be fun. Come, we have a festival to enjoy! Hurry it along now!
**Micaiah:** Oh! Hehehe! Keep swinging my arm like that and you're likely to send me flying!

zelgius2.name: Zelgius
zelgius2.title: Ninja Knight
zelgius2.description: The most powerful general within the whole of the Begnion Empire. Has his quest for strength found its end in the way of the ninja? Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I am not used to speaking, even when asked to.
My armor is my pride. However, it concealed my true identity—so you could say it is also my shame.
A ninja is light on his feet. I am not.
I may not be a ninja, but I do have some practice in keeping my presence a secret.
Battles alone do not end wars. Little as I can stomach it, politicking is often required as well.
Visit: Take this gift, and go forward in good health. So says your friend [F].
Level: Scaling mountains, vaulting over chasms—I will do what I must to finish my mission.
Being in this new world, I am learning who I truly am. As we all are.
I am weak. Perhaps I should hang back and observe the enemy's movements.
Summon: I am Zelgius. If I must split open the heavens and part the very seas to fulfill my duty, I will.
Learn Skill: If one can resolve a conflict without blood, it is their imperative to do so.
Confession:
Ninja lurk in the shadows, working in the service of secret masters. In stealth and combat skill, they excel.
I, too, once operated in secret, concealing my visage and identity. In that way, I, too, am a ninja.
Or at the very least, what I did was not totally different.
I am a knight, and always will be. But I have learned much from using more of the ninja's techniques.
You must always be looking to grow your skills. That is what my master taught me.
Status: I will attend any festival, if I am ordered to.
I assume you meant to do that. Now tell me why.
The ninja's approach to combat is antithetical to my own.
When I was told of this outfit, I had my misgivings. But it has proven fearsome enough.
I choose to view this as a chance to master a new weapon. It is more palatable that way.
So many smiling faces... Is this what peace looks like?
Do I not look out of place here? ...Very well. I will trust in your judgment.

heather.name: Heather
heather.title: Wandering Ninja
heather.description: A wandering thief from Crimea. She is happy to find that so many outstanding women have been gathered together in Askr. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: So that's Princess Sharena of Askr, huh? Hmm... Not bad.
Much as I'm loving the experience of being a ninja, I wouldn't want to be any nation's pawn either.
Something you need, or are you just happy to see me?
I couldn't care less about most people, but I can't just sit back when a girl's in trouble.
Hate to leave the pretty girls, but it's time to find a mark, get the goods, and move. Be home soon, Mom!
Visit: I'm Heather—a ninja in the employ of [F], for now.
Level: A lethal blow, too quick for the eye to catch! I seem to be getting the hang of this ninja thing.
Lucky me!
It's just not my day...
Summon: I'm Heather. I came to fleece some gullible—I mean, to enjoy dressing up amid such lovely company!
Learn Skill: Aw, you shouldn't have. No, really— I'd much prefer gold.
Confession:
Hah! A spectacular payday, and I hardly had to use any of my usual tricks.
Oh, hello! It's not what you think— I actually earned this money, fair and square. I was performing!
I get captured by a nasty lord, I suffer for a bit, and then I make a daring escape. The audience goes wild for it.
Oh, you were there? And Princess Sharena too? Hmm... Interesting...
Say, where is Princess Sharena now? I'd love to catch up with her before she turns in for the night!
Status: All I have to do is bat my eyelashes, and the marks come running.
*giggle* Oh, you're adorable.
Espionage is one of my many strengths. Didn't you know?
A ninja is basically a spy, right? This festival was made for me, I'm telling you.
While I'm disguised, I can flirt with all the women I want.
So many pretty girls all dressed up. What fun!
Maybe I'll steal your secrets too. *laugh* Kidding, kidding!

reina.name: Reina
reina.title: Sanguine Shinobi
reina.description: A warrior from Hoshido known for her warmth toward her friends and the ruthlessness she shows her enemies. Enjoys the feeling of a nice slaughter. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
I usually defeat my foes with a grand flourish on the battlefield. But lurking in the shadows might not be so bad...
Just think of all the creative ways I could experience the thrill of the final blow if they don't see me coming.

Saizo has told me that a ninja should be able to disappear seamlessly into a crowd.
I suppose donning festival garb at a festival is one way to do that.
At your word, your enemy will find an arrow through their heart. A moment's opening is all I'd need.
As a kinshi knight, I typically wield a naginata and bow. But I am curious to learn the ways of the ninja...
This outfit is not well-suited for doing laundry or cleaning, so I'm afraid I will have to help another time.
Visit: Greetings. I am the ninja Reina. I come bearing a gift from [F].
Level: Hehe... I will relish their cries of terror and anguish as I descend upon them. Won't you scream for me?
And now for the finishing blow...
You believe I can improve if I give it my all? Then it shall be so!
Summon: My name is Reina. I am overjoyed to take part in the ninja festival. Now, to bring our enemies to slaughter...
Learn Skill: My, how flattering.
Confession:
I am grateful for the opportunity to attend this festival and speak with you, [S].
Ninja are warriors of Hoshido. In my youth, I heard countless rumors about them.
In serving the imperial palace, I have developed a better understanding of both the honor and cruelty of ninja.
It may not fit the merriment of this festival, but when a ninja violates the rules of their clan...
their punishment is said to be so severe that no one dares speak of it.
Ah, what tortures could they be employing? If only I could witness such a punishment...
Oh my, it seems I've dominated the conversation. How rude of me.
Allow me to excuse myself. Do take care, won't you, Summoner?
Status: I enjoy the outfit, though perhaps it would have suited me better in my youth.
Oh! Do I need to adjust my outfit?
The moment when my blade punches through a skull... There is nothing like it.
If you insist, I will leave my foes alive. It is a festival, after all...
I am ill-suited to covert operations. I tend to...forget myself in battle.
*sigh* I long for the rush of combat...
Rely on me to protect you—both in the open and in the shadows.

saizo2.name: Saizo
saizo2.title: Hoshido's Flame
saizo2.description: A ninja who serves Ryoma of Hoshido. Determined not to lose to mere novices in the craft he's mastered. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I am Saizo, fifth in my line to bear that name. I am always at the ready.

A true ninja is always on their guard. Those who act with ill intent could take advantage of a festival.
For example.
Lord Ryoma will one day rule Hoshido. It is our task as ninja to ensure his reign is long.
Wha— What exactly is this "ninja food" they're serving at this festival? ...And why is it so sweet?
I see now... The festival is a ruse. The true goal is imparting ninja arts while assessing individual talents...
Visit:
I've come to deliver a message from [F].
With this, my mission is complete. Farewell!
Level: They never had a chance to escape.
Ninjutsu is nothing to play at.
Has the festival food gotten to me?
Summon: I am here—Saizo, fifth of my line. As a representative of Hoshido, I will show you what it is to be a ninja.
Learn Skill: I will leave no trace.
Confession:
I did not come to tell others their approach to being a ninja is wrong.
Such a self-centered way of thinking is not part of what it means to be a ninja to me.
I myself—though I strove to keep my mind unclouded by selfishness— was once consumed by revenge...
I led a life that took me away from what one might expect of a ninja.
This festival has given me a chance to reflect back on the path I've taken. The path that led here.
And you have let me see what being a ninja means to...people from worlds beyond imagining, it seems.
For that, I thank you.
The lessons I've learned here will be passed down to Saizo the Sixth, and so will outlive us both.
Status: They couldn't find any other ninja to teach them our ways? Really?
*startle* Do you think I wear a blade on my arm because I like to be touched?
*groan* What the hell is a Sparkling Shuriken?
You're offering me...sweets? No thanks.
Where is Kaze? I can't do everything on my own.
Look at all of these naive fools. They're so...happy.
All right. I'll teach you the way of the ninja. But I won't go easy on you.

nino5.name: Nino
nino5.title: Fang's Heart
nino5.description: Nino, her ties with her false family in the Black Fang finally cut. She looks to the future having overcome her past with the help of new friends. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: You told me we're friends. That made me happy.
All the prince of Bern wanted was to meet his father's expectations...and for his family to get along again.
Thank you for the pendant, Uncle Jan. I'll take good care of it.
My true family in Lycia guarded the secret of the dragons for generations.
I can't ever give up. I'd be letting down everyone who risked their lives for me. Not to mention my real family.
Visit: Hi! I'm Nino! I'm here on an errand from [F]'s castle.
Level: Thanks to Jaffar, and everyone in the Black Fang, I have the power to fight!
We can do this, everyone!
I loved the Black Fang that my father and brothers made. Everyone was so kind... They were all family to me.
Summon: I'm Nino. I'm here to get really strong, so I can repay everyone who's been kind to me!
Learn Skill: I've got to give it my all. I owe that much to everyone who isn't here with me anymore.
Confession:
I don't know much about my real parents, but I do think they had to be very nice people.
I like to think my mother held me close and protected me until the very end, you know?
Still...I'm grateful to the Black Fang for raising me like they did.
Truth is, without them...without my parents, without Jaffar and everyone in the Black Fang...
Well, I wouldn't be alive.
It wasn't easy to hear that from Sonia, but you know what? It also means I was never alone.
That's why I'm going to do all I can to make everyone who believed in me proud. Just you wait and see!
Status: I don't know if you noticed, but these clothes are just like Jaffar's. I'm so excited we get to match!
Hey! Why do you always tease me?
What if my belly gets cold?
Jaffar may not talk much, but I like having him nearby.
Jaffar is holding onto my greatest treasure for me.
I just want to be together, like this, forever...
I'll always try my best, and I won't quit!

ginnungagap.name: Ginnungagap
ginnungagap.title: Ruler of Nihility
ginnungagap.description: She who rules the nothingness and seeks to crush hope itself, bringing an end to dreams, humanity, the Lady of Nightmare, and all álfar.

Castle Hall: I hold no grudge against the Lady of Nightmare or her álfar. It is my purpose to end them. That is all.
I am the ruler of nothingness. I exist by necessity. The ephemera of the past your kind carries means nothing.
Commanding the ruler of nothingness is a feat no god could accomplish. Yet you, a mortal...
The stone of this castle has no heart. It has no hopes or dreams. It has no preferences. It is like me in this way.
What is it that you desire from me? Spout no dream nonsense. What is it, really, that you wish for yourself?
Visit: I rule nothingness. Dreams are far beneath me—unnecessary. The only reality is that which exists.
Level: This is the power that rules over nothingness.
Nothingness is the path all mortals should walk.
The dreams of mortals cloud my power...
Summon: I am Ginnungagap, destroyer of all dreams, the ruin of hope... I rule the nothingness.
Learn Skill: Nothingness is eternal. I am without end.
Confession:
Confusing their dreams for reality is what led mortals off the path.
The delusion must end.
The world you call your home is what all worlds must become, [S]...
Mortals must discard their dreams and return to the world of facts, logic...consistency.
It is the fate of every world, eventually, no matter the path they choose to arrive there.
To fight it is futile.
Status: I am the ruler of nothingness. I am the ender of dreams.
You will not touch me.
No álfar will be tolerated.
**You have but one choice:** abandon hope.
Wail. Your cries cannot change reality.
No dream survives.
I will see your hopes remain ever out of reach.

isadora.name: Isadora
isadora.title: Escort of Pherae
isadora.description: A knight of Pherae known for being a paladin of marked beauty. She serves as the personal guard of Eleanora, wife of Marquess Pherae. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Harken... Do you know what anguish your absence brought? I have been so very worried...

I was born the youngest daughter of a country nobleman. Knighthood has always been my dream.
I spent many long, bitter hours in training to achieve it.
Should you grow tired, you can rely on me to keep watch while you rest.

I am a believer in the teachings of Saint Elimine, though I may not be the most pious of souls...
I'm afraid I brandish a weapon far more often than I pray.
I cannot forgive you, Harken. Not after everything you have put me through.
Visit:
You must be [S].
I have heard all about you from [F].
Level: I shall not avert my eyes from fear or sorrow. Such is my conviction.
I await your orders.
Fear not. I shall protect you, no matter what storms come.
Summon: I am a knight in service to House Pherae. My name is Isadora, and I'm under your command.
Learn Skill: Please accept my sincerest gratitude for this gift. I will work hard to prove I am deserving.
Confession:
I always hoped to one day protect my country proudly as a knight. But I was unprepared for a knight's reality.
To protect means to do battle with one's enemies. And to do battle with enemies means to strike them down.
I have taken many lives in battle. For justice, for peace, for my lord, and for my country...
At times, I grow uneasy... I grow sorrowful for the lives cut short on the end of my blade.
I still have much to learn. This feeling of hesitation is something a knight must also battle and overcome.
Speaking with you has eased some of that weight, so I thank you. I pray we have the opportunity to speak again.
Status: I am a knight in service to House Pherae. My name is Isadora, and I'm under your command.
*start* Surely you don't intend to anger me!
I am honored to be the shield of Lady Eleanora, Lord Eliwood's mother.
Harken is dear to me. I was beside myself with worry when he disappeared without a trace...
My pride shall not be broken! My strength holds true!
At times, I grow uneasy... I grow sorrowful for the lives cut short on the end of my blade.
The fate of this world lies in your hands. Know that I will serve your cause with my very life.

harken.name: Harken
harken.title: Troubled Warrior
harken.description: A knight who single-handedly infiltrated the Black Fang to exact his vengeance after failing to stop the abduction of the Marquess Pherae. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: My recklessness caused so much suffering... I will endure whatever punishment I receive.
We were annihilated before Nergal's magic. I vowed to strike his lot down for what they did...

Hm... As I expected. Summoner, you appear to be holding much tension in your shoulders.
Shall I share some stretches with you that might alleviate it?

Lord Elbert encouraged me to polish my skills, knowledge, and character to become worthy of being a general.
There is much I could learn from your leadership.
Supporting Lord Eliwood is the best thing I can do for Pherae. I hope it also puts Lord Elbert's spirit at ease.
Visit: It is my sincere hope that you maintain friendly relations with [F].
Level: I offer my life in service to my lost master, Lord Elbert, as well as his son, Lord Eliwood.
I bear no grudge against our enemies. My reasons for fighting are my own.
I am a knight of Pherae. I fight in a way befitting my station.
Summon: I am Harken, a knight of Pherae. I am at your service.
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude.
Confession:
My technique is not that of a typical knight. It has been forged through countless vicious battles.
Perhaps it is closer to a style one might expect from a member of the Black Fang.
I carried out the bloody orders of my previous lord without question. But Lord Elbert welcomed me anyway...
He acknowledged my strength and placed his faith in me. I swore I would repay his kindness. And yet...
I failed to protect him in the end.
I became determined to avenge him, even at the cost of my life. It seemed like the least I could do.
To live on in disgrace while my lord perished... The regret nearly crushed my heart.
But Lord Eliwood brought me to my senses. I'd been saved by House Pherae not once, but twice.
That is why I fight for my lord. I will remain by his side through Pherae's conflicts, until my dying breath.
Status: I am Harken. I beg your forbearance.
Oh! Yes? Did you need something?
I would rather die a knight than live in shame.
When Lord Elbert was taken away, I was...powerless.
My life is Lord Eliwood's. May it serve him better than it served his father.
Isadora, I have given you much reason to worry... Please forgive me.
I care not where I meet death. Just guide me wisely.

wil.name: Wil
wil.title: Unequaled Archer
wil.description: A young man from a village in Pherae. With his easy manner and friendly personality, even those who are initially wary soon warm up to him. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I've been an archer for the Knights of Caelin, an operative for the Order of Heroes... What a full life!
I had a friend back home named Dan who left to become a mercenary like me. Wonder how he's doing...
I haven't been home in years, so I have no clue how to start this letter to my folks... Could you help me?
During a war, bad people come out of the woodwork. Bandits, pirates, thieves... It has to stop.
Ah! For a second I thought you were the Manual of Knightly Prowess... Oh, uh, sorry. Inside joke.
Visit: Are you the summoner here? I've got a gift for you from [F]!
Level: I want to hurry and become a knight so I can give Mom and Dad an easier life!
Yes, that's more like it! Let's get the first strike!
Hahaha... I'm such an idiot...
Summon: So you're the summoner? I'm Wil, master marksman. No, no, the pleasure's all mine!
Learn Skill: All right, let's do it!
Confession:
Oh, Summoner! I heard you also came here from another world!
And I heard you might not be human. Is that true? How old are you? Are you way older than you look?
S-sorry! Pretty rude of me to ask all sorts of weird questions like that...
I guess that's why Raven nicknamed me "Master of Rudeness." Huh? You mean you don't mind the questions?
Well, all right then! Guess we're on the same page. I think we'll be great friends, Summs!
What? It's a nickname! "Summs," short for "summoner"! Isn't it great? I'm gonna tell the others!
Status: The name's Wil. I'm honored to be working with the Order of Heroes.
Whoa! What's this all of a sudden?
I ended up enlisting with Caelin. I'm still just a squire, but I've come a long way.
Pherae? It's a nice place. It's near the sea, and the smell of the brine rides on the wind...
Dan? Is that you?! Ah, my mistake. Thought you were someone else.
"Dearest Mother and Father..." Hmm, is that too formal? Letters are tough...
You need a nickname! It's got to be perfect! Uh...

fargus.name: Fargus
fargus.title: Badon Buccaneer
fargus.description: Captain of a band of pirates who operate out of Badon. A man of his word who sticks to his code, he is beloved by many of his subordinates. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Sailors are a superstitious sort. Nothing good's ever come from upsetting any gods of the seas.
I once saved a lad I found on death's door in the port of Badon. It was a miracle he was alive, truth be told.

Eat when you can, just not so much you can't move. It's important to take care of your guts when you're eating.
Same goes for when you're drinking too, of course.
Tomorrow's a holy day for Elimine's flock, so...you won't be sending me out on any missions. Got it?
The Davros pirates are no rabble. We may not bow to any government, but we have principles of our own.
Visit: Quite the glint in that eye of yours... Here. From [F].
Level: I would've let the fools live if they hadn't gone out of their way to bring it on themselves.
If you can't judge your enemy's skill, you'll wind up fish food.
Feels like back when I was getting started with only these two hands to my name—sails full of wind!
Summon: I'm Fargus, captain of the Davros. You're here to see me, aren't you?
Learn Skill: You've got guts, whelp! Let's go!
Confession:
I can't say I don't wonder at how I wound up here... A man can't resist the call of adventure, I suppose.
After living as long as I have, I've faced about every obstacle a man can face...
I've been tossed about by the ups and downs of life, but...I've not met a new challenge for a long time now.
And here I find myself in this world full of Heroes... A world unlike any I've laid eyes on.
The years I've spent captaining my ship and my crew feel like they've been stripped away, and now...
I feel like I'm back in the swashbuckling days of my youth, sailing from one battle to the next!
It's like a fresh breath of sea air!
Special: Let's carve ya some new gizzards!
Status: I'm Fargus, captain of the Davros.
Hah! You've got guts, whelp!
If you can't judge your enemy's skill, you'll wind up fish food.
You're not one of my mates. Drop the "Captain"—call me Fargus.
Those whelps Eliwood and Hector aren't too bad in a fight. Their mates, neither.
Men are strange beasts. We can't resist a challenge.
I'm impressed with your courage. Stay alive out there.

gullveig.name: Gullveig
gullveig.title: Golden Seer
gullveig.description: A seer who, in the future, has already driven the world to the brink of destruction. Can alter time and bend the future to her whims.

Castle Hall: Midgard is the realm of mortals. As Golden Seer, I exist to destroy it.
I killed Njörðr, King of Vanaheimr, fulfilling a desire I once held long ago, when I was Seiðr...
When I look in your eyes, the feelings Seiðr and Kvasir still feel well up within me.
The version of me who lives in this world charts an unknown future... Though unseen, it is a bright one.
The future I know no longer exists. We live in a future that you made possible, [S].
Visit: I am the Golden Seer, Gullveig. My path, both past and future, is no longer clear to me...
Level: I know this—I have seen it. I am not surprised, nor gladdened.
I am the Golden Seer. My purpose is destruction.
I know this—I have seen it. I am not surprised, nor saddened.
Summon: I am the Golden Seer, Gullveig. Though you have summoned me here, I sense I do not belong...
Learn Skill: ...Thank you. Your kindness is... dear to me.
Confession:
As Kvasir, I met you—and we spent time together...
As Seiðr, I meet you—and we perform the ritual together...
As Gullveig, I will meet you—and... I will kill you.
In all—past, present, future—I love you... Always.
Now is no different.
Status: I am Gullveig, the Golden Seer.
*yelp* You would behave this way even with me? Ridiculous.
Being with you, memories flood back... My emotions well up and overcome me.
Persistence is all it takes to make your dreams come true. I believed that, once.
Heiðr, forgive me... Everything that happened to you—it was all my doing.
I find myself yet again in a future I could not see...ever bound to this mortal.
You have restored my hope. Thank you.

kvasir.name: Kvasir
kvasir.title: Seer of the Past
kvasir.description: Gullveig, the Golden Seer, as she once existed. A lonely goddess who wishes for friendship deep in her heart.

Castle Hall: Midgard is the realm of mortals. They must never be lonely with there being so many of them...
I know little of Vanaheimr or Njörðr. I am from a time before those of Seiðr and Gullveig.
Because I am from before Gullveig and Seiðr, it is only natural that I appear younger.
To lie to a goddess is to ask for punishment, they say. Though who says, I cannot recall...
Ásgarðr? I feel I have heard the name before, but...it is now just out of reach.
Visit: I am Kvasir. Where I came from is unknown to me, so I have no home to return to.
Level: Growth... What joy.
I am a goddess of Vanaheimr.
What an embarrassment...
Summon: I am Kvasir. I am a goddess of Vanaheimr, but I was not created—I simply am.
Learn Skill: Any time we are together, I recall our days spent with one another in the past...
Confession:
Do you remember when we met? You were injured. I helped you.
Spending time together...time with someone else...was important to me.
Even when my memories were taken from me, though, somewhere in my heart...my feelings for you remained.
Status: I am Kvasir. Not yet born... Come from long ago...
*yelp* You startled me! Why?
I do not know you very well. Even if I did... I would forget.
I was born from a flaw in time. Without it, I would not be.
Could even I...one day...find someone who will hold me dear?
I am Kvasir. And Seiðr. And Gullveig.
Seiðr and Gullveig must...like you too...

ratatoskr.name: Ratatoskr
ratatoskr.title: Mending Hand
ratatoskr.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands who has a tendency to get overwhelmed when there are things that need to be done. Has healed illnesses across the nine realms.

Castle Hall: Prince Alfonse, Princess Veronica, and all the people of both their countries are...are important!
Our home is among the branches of the World-Tree Yggdrasill. It's huge— as big as all nine realms combined!
Huh? Wh-what's strange about a tail, hm? Is it really so odd?
Father... Brother... My sisters... I must do this.
My sister is very kind. I would... I would do anything for her.
Visit: Oh, hi! Umm... I'm Ratatata! Er, no—wa-wa-wait! Ratatoskr! I'm Ratatoskr!
Level: I want my life to be in service of someone good, like Prince Alfonse!
Ow-ow-ow-ow! ...Oh, I'm still alive?
Gah! I bit my cheek...
Introduction: Oh! Er, hello... I'm Ratatoskr! I just want all my sisters, Prince Alfonse, and everyone to, well...to stay alive...
Summon: I-I'm Ratatoskr, of the Healing Hands! Anyone sick? Or injured?
Learn Skill: Th-thank you! I hope I can return the favor!
Confession:
My father, my brother, my sisters... All of my family is important to me.
I loved them all so dearly. And they loved me as well...
They always did whatever they could to heal the sick—and they were loved for that. I loved them for that.
I was proud to be a member of the Healing Hands.
Looking back, I still have fond memories...but those memories are a reminder of what I've lost.
Status: Oh! Um, hello... I'm Ratatoskr! I'm a member of the Healing Hands.
*start* ...Wh-what was that for?!
Every world can be found within the branches of Yggdrasill.
We Healing Hands were devoted to saving the lives of the sick and the injured...
I can't harm innocents! Even if there is a reason to...I just can’t!
Hræsvelgr... We will work side by side again, one day...
Call on me if you're ever hurt. I am one of the Healing Hands after all.

lucina7.name: Lucina
lucina7.title: Fate's Resolve
lucina7.description: A princess and daughter of Chrom who traveled to the past, where she studied and trained to change her world's desperate fate. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I must match my father's strength! The fate of my world will remain unchanged otherwise.
I must grow stronger, so I never have to witness such a terrible tragedy again.
I really should apologize to the Hero-King Marth for borrowing his identity...
This garb is proof of my resolve to forge a thriving future for Ylisse.
I'm so sorry! I was doing some training and ended up putting a hole in the wall of my room...
Visit: I am Lucina from the Halidom of Ylisse. I come bearing gifts from [F].
Level: I will never give up, Father! I will fight back against fate until the bitter end!
I can continue on thanks to the support of my friends.
How can I face Father like this?
Summon: I am Lucina, princess of the Halidom of Ylisse. I will change fate and never yield to despair!
Learn Skill: There is no limit to how strong I can become... I'm sure that's what my father would say.
Confession:
When I journeyed to the world of the past, I had only a sword. I didn't yet understand how to resist despair.
But through forging relationships with people in that world, fighting through adversity together, I grew strong.
I also learned the most important tool at one's disposal during a fight is strength of heart. Hope.
Father and his friends were tight-knit and loyal. They overcame incredible obstacles together because of that.
I want to emulate that steadfastness. So I've started training my heart in addition to my sword arm.
Refusing to let hope die is the most powerful weapon against despair. My father showed me that.
Status: You know, it's strange... I feel this rush of heat, and suddenly I'm stronger than ever.
*startle* Be careful! What if I'd had my weapon drawn?!
The more weapons you're comfortable with, the better. You can never be too flexible!
I overdid it and broke another training dummy. I'm so sorry!
Have you seen my father around? I've been meaning to ask him for some sparring practice.
Those with the power to shape the world bear an incredible burden of responsibility. Father knew that all too well.
Knowing I can be of use to you makes me really happy.

laurent.name: Laurent
laurent.title: The Elucidator
laurent.description: Miriel's son and a serious student at the top of his class. He often finds himself being taken advantage of, but he can be frightening when angered. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
The method by which Heroes are summoned is simply fascinating. If the same Hero is summoned twice...
do they exist as the same person but from different times? Or are they the same person twice? Or perhaps...

My mother never returned from the battlefield, and her body was never recovered.
As such, for quite some time I allowed myself to believe that she still lived.

As a keen and regular observer of behavior, I am able to quickly identify even minute changes in someone.
But with so many Heroes about, it's quicker to simply ask... So what is the state of your physical well-being?

Time permitting, would you accompany me to any nearby shops that deal in tomes?
Collecting tomes of curious, or even sometimes useless, power is something of a hobby of mine.

I've collected all the dropped items from around the castle. While some are the personal effects of Heroes...
It is striking how many of them belong to Princess Sharena. Is she incapable of looking after her own things?
Visit: Hello there. I'm Laurent. I've come with greetings from [F].
Level: A logical consequence of tireless diligence.
A fair result.
What went wrong? Thorough analysis is required.
Summon: I am Laurent, Miriel's son. Tell me, are any of my allies about? I do hope we didn't become separated...
Learn Skill: You've made me stronger? What a fascinating phenomenon.
Confession:
Ah, [S]!
You have impeccable timing. There is a tome I wish to show you.
It is known as the "Book of Summoning..." Uh, allow me to blow away some dust... "Pieces"!
It's said this tome has the ability to summon a piece of a Hero's equipment.
And the most fascinating part is the reader need not be a summoner for it to work! Come, let us experiment.
Hmmmm... Ah! It has worked! We appear to have summoned...a scrap of blue cloth.
Based on its coloration, condition, and material, I've concluded it comes from the World of Mystery.
How absolutely fascinating. And how entirely and utterly...useless...
Simply magnificent.
Have I told you that I quite enjoy collecting odd tomes such as this? It's something of a hobby of mine.
Tell me, what are some of your hobbies?
Despite the countless hours you and I have shared, you continue to fascinate me so.
Special: Defeat is out of the question.
Status: My hat? It once belonged to my mother.
What?! Please don't touch me without asking first.
I do hope that Askr has its fair share of curious tomes.
Please leave it to me to oversee the well-being of our troops, as well as the army's resources. I consider it my duty.
How DO my glasses get so dirty? I must rectify this situation immediately. At least I have my favorite lens cloth.
One may scheme and plot as much as they like... But no scheme can stand against our genuine desire to save the world.
Interacting with the unknown brings me great joy. I'm grateful to you, you know, for summoning me to this world.

inigo.name: Inigo
inigo.title: Flower Picker
inigo.description: Olivia's son. Blessed with a natural talent for dance and a flair for philandering, but is shy by nature. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
I wonder if I'll ever be as amazing a dancer as my mother...
A dancer that can fill an entire audience with courage and bring smiles to all their faces.
Sometimes I think about home and all the people we couldn't save... I couldn't do a single thing for them...
Thanks for checking in! I appreciate that you run patrols for everyone. But make time to chat with me too!
Say, could you show me how to use your weapon? If I could summon a cute— Huh? Only you can use it?

"Care to join me for a cup of tea?" Perfect. No way I'll get shot down with something as innocent as that!
Heh, the fastest way for a man to practice bravery is to talk to women!
Visit: Don't worry, I'm not here to steal the hearts of your female Heroes! This is from [F].
Level: Please let all the girls have seen that...
Ah, another solid step in the right direction.
Please don't let any girls have seen that...
Summon: I'm Inigo, Olivia's future son. And I'd... Prefer it if you wouldn't stare. It's very embarrassing!
Learn Skill: Now that I'm a brand-new me, it's time to chat with some ladies!
Confession:
Oh, it's you! You sure seem to be hanging around me a lot lately. You must have fallen for me pretty hard!
Wait, wait, don't leave! I was just kidding! Heh, sorry, I'm just glad to see you.
Despite how close we've gotten, you and I still haven't gone anywhere just the two of us—like to a café.
I guess you don't want it to look like you're playing favorites with the Heroes, huh? Yeah, that's it.
You're not MY summoner, after all. You summoned all of us, so you're all of our—
Huh? We can go? You mean it?! Oh, thank you! I guess that means you only have eyes for me today.
I'll make sure we have a great time!
Status: And another fair maid has rejected me. Mustn't get discouraged!
No matter where I end up, it seems the ladies are just not buying what I'm selling.
Don't forget to smile. Smiling makes life a lot more fun.
I would like to be a dancer. Like my mother.
Gods! You were watching me dance?
Father, Mother. Watch over me.
Well, you look great today. Want to skip out of here and head somewhere a little more fun?

severa.name: Severa
severa.title: Secret Dreamer
severa.description: Cordelia's daughter, who is always comparing herself to her mother. She is kind to her friends, but acts as if she has something to prove. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
My mother was simply amazing. Beautiful, strong, perfect in every way... I really respect her.
I don't think I'll ever surpass her. Especially now that she's dead.
I need to be ready to take on any Hero. In my world, you never know who will become your next enemy.

Out on patrol? Looks like hard work! I'm sure the Order keeps you busy, but...
Be sure to make time to slack off once in a while too!
I could go for a shopping spree right about now. Want to come with? We can be shopping buddies!

The water here is so clean, I couldn't help but primp a bit. You know, hair and skin care, basic stuff.
Admit it, my hair's looking prettier than usual.
Visit:
I came all this way just to deliver a greeting from [F].
I hope you're grateful!
Level: I-I'm not grinning... This is my war snarl!
Mmm, yes. An excellent showing. Naturally.
Excuse me?! I clearly deserve better!
Summon: I'm Severa, Cordelia's daughter. You wanted to meet me, right? I mean, I did come all the way from the future.
Learn Skill: Something feels new... Did that make me more like my mother?
Confession:
I've been here for a little while now, and I thought you should know I don't actually have time to waste here.
Huh? You're sorry? I...wasn't actually looking for an apology... Hey, what's with the look?
Aw, you're making me feel like I was bullying you!
I guess I do owe you for helping me get stronger. I don't want you to feel bad or anything.
I guess I'll stick around for a bit. Actually, I'll stick around until the fighting is over.
So quit looking so sad, all right? Also, [S]...
Thanks... For everything. For staying by my side, and for helping me train, and...
And just know that I'll never, ever say anything like this ever again!
Status: What?
Well, if you're asking me...I guess I can make an effort.
Just so we're clear, I am NOT fighting for your sake.
"Keep it up"? Is that a compliment? Uh...thanks.
We're going shopping. There's a lot of stuff I need.
Why can't I be more like my mother?
Father and mother... They left me behind.
Of course I look after my appearance. You should be proud you get to hang out with me!

validar.name: Validar
validar.title: Fell Architect
validar.description: Leader of a religious sect that worships the Fell Dragon, Grima. Takes the throne as king of Plegia after Gangrel's death. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: The Fire Emblem is a threat. It is our most loathsome foe.
Those who attempt to divert fate's course will not be forgiven. Grima will rule; it has been decided.
The end that awaits will not change, no matter how the weak conspire...
The followers of Naga have gathered in Askr as well? Hm. I'll have Aversa look into the extent of their presence.
This castle seems to serve as a place of gathering for the weak and fragile. Though not all are so fragile...
Visit: Try as you might, you will not change [F]'s fate.
Level: Companions? Meaningless before my awesome power!
You will die here. Your future is already written.
In the greater scheme, this is but a minor setback.
Summon: I am Validar. My task is to prepare the world for Grima's rule.
Learn Skill: Hah! With this, your destruction is assured!
Confession:
Askr's future is none of my concern.
I aid you only to gain power for myself.
I care not for the people of Askr.
The evils of this world are nothing to me. I am an agent of fate.
Whatever pitiful bonds you share cannot stop the inevitable! But do go on... I will enjoy your struggling.
Status: I am Validar. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Agh! What is this childish behavior? Stop that.
I will rouse Grima. The fell dragon needs only a mortal vessel...
Your rightful place is at my side, Robin. Not wasting your time with these doomed servants of Naga!
Even as they resist, they write your future with every step, O great one!
All that matters is Robin's return.
I look forward to building a strong bond between us. *laugh*

mbyleth4.name: Byleth
mbyleth4.title: Frosty Professors
mbyleth4.description: Byleth and Byleth, defying the boundaries between their worlds. They participate in Askr's winter festival in the interest of their students. They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
mbyleth4.duo:
Grants Def/Res+6, "reduces damage from area- of-effect Specials by 80% (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials)," and【Hexblade】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn. Grants the following effect to unit for 1 turn: "Neutralizes 'effective against armored' bonuses."
【Hexblade】
Calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res during combat for 1 turn (including damage dealt by Specials before combat).
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Byleth:** Sothis often has outlandish requests, but an invitation to another world's festival still caught me by surprise.
**Byleth:** Books, paints, socks, weapons, food... The students have an array of gift requests. This will take a lot of work.
**Byleth:** Byleth, it's going to be cold outside. You'd be wise to dress warmly.
**Byleth:** When we're through delivering gifts, we should have tea. It's not every day you get to talk to yourself!
**Byleth:** Did you find something? Someone must have dropped it. I suppose I have that talent in every world.
Visit: We have your gift here with us. May your bond remain strong with [F].
Level: **Byleth:** There's no time to waste. The students are waiting.
**Byleth:** I am familiar with combat in snowy terrain. As a mercenary, any place could be my battlefield.
**Byleth:** Ah! The gifts!
Summon: We are both Byleth from different worlds, but, together, we will fulfill our obligations as winter envoys.
Learn Skill: **Byleth:** Thank you. Now, I believe it's time to warm up.
Confession:
**Byleth:** When we first met, it was like looking in a mirror with a different face reflected back... Uncanny.
**Byleth:** Agreed. But once we spoke it became apparent that we are the same.
**Byleth:** Your time spent as a mercenary, your dedication for the students...
**Byleth:** And the days being pushed around by Sothis. It was all the same for us both.
**Byleth:** It's been quite the journey, but I wouldn't trade the hardships. Neither would you, correct?
**Byleth:** Correct. Now, we're nearly there. One last push to ensure this festival is one the students will never forget.
Status: "Let's show them how it's done." "For the winter festival!"
Conversation: **Byleth:** Hmm... The sun's almost up, and look how many presents we still have left to give out.
**Byleth:** Seems like we got turned around a bit too much. Let's try to knuckle down and hurry up with the rest.
**Byleth:** Agreed. I just hope the students won't be disappointed.
**Byleth:** They won't be. I think a few might actually be glad if we don't get to them in time.
**Byleth:** I suppose that's true. There is at least one who wouldn't want us going into her room...
**Byleth:** And I can think of several who are likely to turn down anything they didn't earn themselves.
**Byleth:** They're an eccentric bunch, aren't they? Not that I blame them, with all the burdens they bear.
**Byleth:** Indeed. Though sometimes it's like pulling teeth to get them to be honest about their feelings...
**Byleth:** Your students must be a handful.
**Byleth:** No more than yours, by the sound of it.
**Byleth:** Supposedly the existence of other worlds means infinite possibilities...
But somehow I doubt there's any world where teaching is easy.
**Byleth:** *chuckle* I think you're probably right about that.
**Byleth:** Even so... Challenging as they are, I wouldn't trade my students for anything.
**Byleth:** Nor would I—problems and all.
**Byleth:** With that in mind, what do you say we get back to it?
**Byleth:** Right. Let's.

edelgard6.name: Edelgard
edelgard6.title: Snowfall Future
edelgard6.description: Princess and heir apparent of the Adrestian Empire. Advances on Askr's winter festival with the intent of ensuring its success. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: To be chosen as winter envoy was surprising, but I've committed, so I shall do my best. No slacking.
The anniversary of Garreg Mach Monastery's completion happens to be the same as Askr's winter festival.
Of course I've prepared gifts for the professors. I'm certain they will be well-received.
The gift-delivering itinerary is perfect, I assure you. I made certain to map it out with Hubert and the war council.
This lance looks to be a fir tree. I appreciate that it adds to the colorful atmosphere of this festival!
Visit: I am Edelgard, princess of the Adrestian Empire. I come bearing winter's blessings!
Level: I will overcome every obstacle to ensure the winter festival's success!
People are counting on me to fulfill their winter wishes! I refuse to let anything get in my way.
I must ensure these arrive before daybreak, somehow...
Summon: I am Edelgard von Hresvelg. I will deliver a winter's eve so astounding it'll rival that of the Adrestian Empire.
Learn Skill: I thank you for your gesture of faith. I promise to live up to your expectations.
Confession:
Typically, I believe blindly following old customs to be a bit foolish.
However, not all customs are bad. I find that some are inherited with great care and feeling attached.
This winter festival seems to be one of those instances. Bonds old and new are solidified through gift-giving.
Every glimmer of light on this eve is a dream, a radiance produced by the ceaseless efforts of humankind.
It's truly a tradition we mustn't let go. One final push to protect this night and ensure the tradition shines on.
Status: You actually want me to be an envoy for the winter festival? I assumed there was some mistake.
Ah! Do you mind?! Your hands are freezing!
If you truly want something, then seize it. Don't sit back and wait for someone to deliver it to you.
What sort of gift would I like? Perhaps a new writing quill.
The decorations in town remind me of the picture books I read as a child.
Would it be irresponsible to forget about battle, if only for one night?
I have a gift for you. I do hope you like it.

dimitri6.name: Dimitri
dimitri6.title: Blessed Protector
dimitri6.description: Crown prince of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus, delivering winter warmth to the people of Askr as their winter envoy. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Edelgard and Claude are working as winter envoys too? I must not let myself fall behind.
Winters in Askr are mild compared to to the harshness of the season in Faerghus. This country is blessed.
This is an opportunity to express my gratitude to the professors. I hope the present is well-received.
The snowstorm has turned it white outside, but this cloak protects me from the cold. Thank you for this.
This axe for the winter festival... At first the colors caught my eye, but it also seems quite strong.
Visit: I am Dimitri, prince of Faerghus. You should visit the winter festival [F] is holding.
Level: If someone stands in my way, I will just move them. That is what this power is for.
Please step aside. I have somewhere I need to be.
It had not occurred to me that this chill would make my hands go numb while holding my weapon...
Summon: A sacred festival of Askr... On behalf of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus, I am honored to serve as winter envoy!
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will use this power to fulfill my role as winter festival envoy.
Confession:
Faerghus, where I was raised, is a barren, desolate place. Not a fertile or gentle land at all.
The hostile winters there test people, fostering the strength they need to survive in that environment.
It is an unforgiving place. That is why the people of Faerghus work so hard to support one another.
I am sure the heartfelt devotion of Askr's winter festival helps warm the soul to weather the season.
Winter chills our hearts and minds, but it gives us an opportunity to build warmth by connecting with others.
I will give my all as a winter envoy to bring everyone's hearts together through this joyous festival.
Status: You truly think I will make a good envoy for the winter festival?
Please watch where you're going. You could get hurt.
I'd better be careful not to break any of the gifts...
The only gifts I'm interested in are weapons and riding gear. People seem to find that unsettling somehow.
I must not make any delivery mistakes. I don't want to cause trouble.
My kingdom will be one where people can enjoy peaceful nights like this.
I hope you get everything you want this year.

yunaka2.name: Yunaka
yunaka2.title: Spirited Envoy
yunaka2.description: A wandering thief who has taken it upon herself to stir up excitement for the winter festival with her spirited outfit and attitude. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I thought delivering these presents was a covert mission... But these duds are pretty flashy!
Don't think I ever got a winter festival gift, myself. But I'm more of a giver than a taker, so suits me just fine!
Summoner! Getting chilly? I could lend you my cloak! But then I'll be the one who's cold? Well, yeah.
Sure is nice how everybody is all smiles at this festival. No kids shivering in alleys here...
Sharpened my blades up! I hear that all kinds of things need to be sliced at festivals. Meat and cakes, I mean!
Visit: Here comes the winter envoy on her spiffy sleigh with a greeting from [F]. Zappy!
Level: You know two things that make a big difference the more you pile 'em up? Snow and effort.
Small presents can be the best presents of all. Now that's why I love this festival!
Dang. I'm usually good in the cold.
Summon: It's that mysterious winter envoy, Yunaka, here to spread holiday cheer!
Learn Skill: A gift? I'm gonna go climb a fir tree, I'm so chuffed!
Confession:
Zappy! Want a present? No? You're not a kid anymore? Now that's no fun!
I'd have thought you, of all people, wouldn't care about that kind of thing. This is a festival for everybody!
And whether it's the haughtiest noble or the lowliest commoner, I plan to bring each of them a present!
It may just be the clothes talking, but I want to serve everybody a little slice of joy this season.
So, point is, let me know what you want. You may just wake up to find something by your mantelpiece!
Status: Zappy winter festival! *chuckle* Are you having fun?
Ooo, the snow's really coming down! I hope it sticks!
How's the cold treating you? Honestly, I love it.
Me? Flashy clothes? Nah, you're thinking of somebody else.
So this whole thing is like one big robbery in reverse, right? And it's for kids?! Sign me up!
Snow is good for cover. And for dumping bodies.
I'm so excited for the winter festival, I could crow like a turkey! *crow* Wait. That was a rooster, wasn't it?

claude6.name: Claude
claude6.title: Yuletide Schemer
claude6.description: Heir to House Riegan, leader of the Leicester Alliance, joining in Askr's winter festival in the role of envoy. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: These presents weigh a ton... Is now a good time to mention that I never carry my books to class?
Winter is pretty harsh in Fódlan. Even warm Adrestia in the south gets hit by freezing sea winds.
Hey! If you were a good kid, you'd be sound asleep. Real shame that you must not want presents this year...
I'm not really a "divine intervention" kind of guy. I think miracles are the result of dedicated effort.
We won't get any gifts delivered if we panic. Let's take a minute to breathe and think up a strategy.
Visit:
Here's a winter festival gift from [F].
I'm a busy man with places to be, so...later!
Level: Only a few more presents left to deliver. Let's finish strong and celebrate our victory with a feast!
Some bumps in the road are to be expected. Don't worry, I've got a thing or two up my sleeve.
Brrr! Cold fingers do not an accurate marksman make...
Summon: Claude von Riegan, here for all your winter-festival needs. Now, what's our first move?
Learn Skill: For me? I graciously accept!
Confession:
Winter festival keeping you busy, [S]? Me too.
A little strategy and planning goes a long way, though. All my gifts have been delivered.
It's nothing compared to what these kids really need, of course. An end to all this war. A life of peace.
But let's not kid ourselves—that's more than we could ever hope to deliver in one night.
Still, I hope these gifts will tide them over in the meantime and keep their spirits up.
Let them enjoy the winter festival while we work on getting them the gift they deserve most of all.
Status: Winter festulations! Wait, that doesn't sound right, does it? Enh!
Careful with the cold hands! You could startle somebody that way.
It's great to see everybody giving gifts to kids. Really builds community.
That big tree with all the decorations on it is gorgeous. I wish I could take it back to Garreg Mach and show everybody there.
After the presents are out, let's gather everyone up for a huge feast. Then we can all just watch the snow together and unwind.
What do I want? Well, it's not something you can put in a box and wrap with a bow.
You're never gonna believe the gift I found for you. *chuckle*

camilla9.name: Camilla
camilla9.title: Alluring Darkness
camilla9.description: Eldest princess of Nohr. Both elegant and bewitching, she is often praised for being ever more and more alluring. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Leo, Elise, and I fully respect and support Xander. We need not follow in our parents' footsteps.
I'm quite fond of Beruka and Selena. They both work so hard to hone their skills. I just know you'll like them too.
Come now... Even your eyes look exhausted. You mustn't overdo it.
Try lightly grilling meat so fresh it's bloody. Then devour it hot to take the energy of that life into you.
It's so lovely to be enveloped in steam. Afterwards, the dampness on your skin shimmers in the firelight...
Visit:
I am Camilla from the kingdom of Nohr. You're a friend of [F], yes?
You needn't be so formal.
Level: Hmm... I put in quite the workout. Now I'm all sweaty. I'm taking a hot bath the minute I get to the castle.
I'll never be satisfied with watching from the sidelines. I much prefer being part of the action.
Perhaps this is best... If I grow too strong, I worry the fit of these clothes may suffer.
Summon: Your heart called me here. I am glad we got to see each other again.
Learn Skill: Oh dear... What are you thinking? You mustn't get your hopes up so.
Confession:
Isn't today's fighting already finished? Oh, you just missed me that much?
How sweet! Very well. Why don't you come talk with me?
I believed I had dedicated all of my heart and body to Xander, Leo, Elise, and my dear Corrin.
But I never took time to consider what I would do with my life, my future, after all the fighting.
This must be fate of some kind. Perhaps I am meant to stay here? Please call upon Beruka and Selena.
I would like to consider such a future. That is, if you approve of the idea, [S]?
Status: I'm Camilla, eldest princess from the kingdom of Nohr.
*startle* You know, you do remind me of someone...
My brother Xander is a glint of light cutting through the dark of night.
My siblings and I must all support Xander, the king of Nohr.
I wish I could cast aside my royal title and protect Nohr and my dear Corrin from the shadows.
Legendary Hero? A title so serious must mean I have a role to play here.
It seems I can't live without you anymore...

seidr2.name: Seiðr
seidr2.title: Time's Goddesses
seidr2.description: Seiðr and Heiðr, goddesses of the realm of light. The two of them, who are like sisters, have come to bless the new year with light.
seidr2.duo:
Grants【Time's Gate】and "Special cooldown charge +1 per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack)" to unit and allies within 4 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
【Time's Gate】
Allies within 4 spaces of unit can move to a space adjacent to unit (that turn only).
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Seiðr:** May the start of this new year be an opportunity to guide the children of Midgard toward a brighter future.
**Heiðr:** Goddesses are born within light. It is possible that one is born as the sun rises on each new year.
**Seiðr:** Your kimono suits you well, Heið. It's a fine outfit, worthy of a goddess of Vanaheimr.
**Heiðr:** Your usual dress is splendid, but your kimono highlights your beauty all the more, Seið!
**Heiðr:** Seiðr gave me a New Year's gift. I plan to keep it and cherish it for as long as I can.
Visit: I am Seiðr, goddess of Vanaheimr. I've come to wish you a happy New Year, from [F].
Level: **Seiðr:** Let us illuminate the new year with our brilliance.
**Heiðr:** Did you see that, Seið? We are in perfect sync this year!
**Seiðr:** Such disappointing results are improper for a new year—or for a goddess...
Summon: I am Seiðr, goddess of Vanaheimr. Together with Heiðr, I will bring light to Midgard's new year.
Learn Skill: **Heiðr:** Seiðr is sure to shine even brighter with this power!
Confession:
**Heiðr:** I am rather fond of Midgard's New Year's celebration, I must say.
**Seiðr:** Some of the celebrations are a bit raucous for my taste, but it's nice to see everyone so full of hope.
**Heiðr:** One year draws to a close, and a new year starts fresh...
We goddesses live a long time, where the short lives of mortals fill them with a new resolve each year...
**Seiðr:** That is true—but we must remember that it is a goddess's duty to guide and watch over mortal lives.
**Heiðr:** Yes, and I look forward to watching over the children of Midgard at your side for the years to come, Seið.
Status: "Here's your New Year's gift!" "Thank you! Now, what to spend it on..."
Conversation: **Heiðr:** You look beautiful in that kimono, Seið! Really!
**Seiðr:** Thank you, Heiðr. You look adorable yourself.
**Heiðr:** Aww, thanks! Hee hee! It's strange... Kimonos remind me of armor in a way. So stiff...especially the belt part!
**Seiðr:** Kimonos seem designed to set the wearer into a dignified posture.
Such clothing is appropriate for goddesses of Vanaheimr. And the children of Midgard surely admire it.
**Heiðr:** Speaking of admiring, what's that up your kimono sleeve? Could it be...some sweets, perhaps?
**Seiðr:** That is...merely an offering a child of Midgard pushed into my hands!
I would not simply yield to a temptation for treats...
**Heiðr:** How convenient for you to have received such an offering then!
**Seiðr:** If I am to serve as a guiding light, I must be above such temptation— as is only proper for a goddess!
**Heiðr:** Oh, Seið... You need not worry over whether you are a proper goddess. You are kind, caring, beautiful...
You've always been my guiding light...
That's why it's no surprise to me the summoner took to you so quickly...
**Seiðr:** What does the summoner have to do with this?!
**Heiðr:** Hee hee. I hope this coming year is even more blessed than the last... How's that?
**Seiðr:** It is unbecoming for a goddess to tease, Heiðr! Now...shall we go give the summoner our blessings as well?
**Heiðr:** Good idea. Hee hee.

nerpuz2.name: Nerþuz
nerpuz2.title: New-Year Doter
nerpuz2.description: God of the land who hails from Vanaheimr, the realm of light. She has joined in the New Year's festivities to experience it alongside all the mortals.

Castle Hall: I cannot help but be moved by the sentiment of the traditions created by the children of Midgard...
Vanaheimr has no New Year's tradition. The lives we gods live are not so easily divided.
The young Heroes were all so happy to receive their New Year's gifts... I may even try giving some to adults.
Children of Midgard have a limited lifespan. I imagine that is why they cherish each new year.
I do quite like this kimono. Many of the children of Midgard have said it looks nice on me as well!
Visit: I am Nerþuz, goddess of Vanaheimr. I am here with New Year's greetings from [F].
Level: The beginning of a new year comes with many blessings.
Nothing brings me joy like seeing smiles on the faces of the children of Midgard.
Not everything can go to plan, even when one is a goddess.
Summon: Happy New Year. I am Nerþuz, goddess of Vanaheimr, realm of light. I am here to celebrate the new year.
Learn Skill: I shall use this strength to secure the future for all the adorable children of Midgard.
Confession:
It is wonderful to watch the children of Midgard carry out their New Year's celebrations up close.
Everyone's faces aglow with dreams of a tomorrow even more lovely than today... It's sweet, really.
They may not have the power we gods command, but they are still able to create lives from these small joys.
Their earnestness is so endearing, I just love being in their presence...
What is it you dream of in your new year, [S]?
I look forward to seeing your future unfold, step by step, day by day.
Status: Happy New Year! Now is an appropriate time I hope.
*startle* I won't be tolerating any naughty children!
A sweet child of Midgard gave me this folded paper bird... I love it.
How do I look in this kimono? Well... It's my pleasure to wear it.
You mortals do get excited about a new year... Adorable.
Each new year is blessed with the possibility of change.
No matter how many years may pass, I will remain.

kvasir2.name: Kvasir
kvasir2.title: Unknown Future
kvasir2.description: The Golden Seer before she became Gullveig. Experiencing her first New Year's celebration.

Castle Hall: The moment the new year begins is one I want to hold on to forever.
I have not yet known a New Year... I feel certain I will learn much.
I wonder how Seiðr is planning to spend her New Year's celebration.
I received a "New Year's gift." I'm not aware of any use for it, but I will treat it with care.
This is special attire worn to celebrate New Year's... Wearing it makes me feel radiant.
Visit: Happy New Year to you from all at [F]'s castle!
Level: I feel so full of cheer... Is this what to expect from New Year's?
This is where the year starts anew.
This kimono is lovely, but... it is not easy to move in.
Summon: I am Kvasir. I am new to New Year's, so I am grateful for whatever you are able to teach me.
Learn Skill: Oh! Another...New Year's gift? Thank you.
Confession:
Time flows from past to future, forever, without pause...
Time cannot be seen or touched. Calling out to it yields no reply...
But mortals give time meaning. They imbue it with importance.
New Year's carries the significance of not only the passing year but the year being welcomed as well.
That is the feeling I get from the celebrations around New Year's.
I have marked New Year's as an important time in my heart. For now, that is enough.
Status: Why celebrate a day that comes every year? I don't understand.
*startle* You seem enthusiastic.
They call this a kimono. It is...tight.
Someone gave me a pouch. There was money inside.
Everyone is so excited...
Even as the years change, I will remain here with you...
I never want to lose today...

mkana2.name: Kana
mkana2.title: Rising Dragon
mkana2.description: Corrin's son, always lively and cheerful, with new light in his eyes at the prospect of visiting a shrine for the new year. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I know dragonstones shouldn't be spun around like tops... But don't they look like they could be?!
We always wear our kimonos on New Year's in Hoshido. They're kinda hard to walk in, but you learn real fast!
I heard a rumor there's a place that has a "year of the dragon." I bet their dragons are super strong that year!
Look at all the yummy food! What should I eat first? Ah, it's so hard to choose... Might as well try everything!

Do you wanna play hanetsuki, [S]?
The winner gets to draw on the loser's face!
Visit: I'm glad I found you! I was told to wish you a happy New Year! From your friend [F].
Level: Do you think I'd get more New Year's gifts if I was stronger?
The cold can't stop me... Especially not on New Year's!
Oof, I think I ate too much mochi. My belly really hurts...
Summon: I'm Kana! Nice to meet you! Hope you're enjoying the new year so far!
Learn Skill: A New Year's gift? For me? Wow, thanks a lot!
Confession:
Hey, [S]!
Look at the yummy mochi I got! They're so fresh that they're still warm! Here, eat some!
Isn't Askr's New Year so much fun? Everyone is so happy, and there's food everywhere you look!
We didn't really celebrate New Year's in the place I lived before, so I feel really lucky that I get to enjoy it now!
I wish we could celebrate New Year's every single day! I'd have fun with my friends and Mama all the time.
Maybe everyone in Askr will be happy like they are on New Year's once there's peace...
Status: Happy New Year! Let's make it the best one ever!
Ah! Hey, that's my first scare of the new year! Thanks!
New Year's is great! I get to have fun with all my friends and eat yummy food! What could be better?
Look! Mama gave me a New Year's gift! I bet I know what's inside...
I ate three whole mochi today, and I'm still hungry!
My goal this year is to become as strong as Mama!
Let's have lots of fun together this year, OK?

fkana2.name: Kana
fkana2.title: Rising Sunlight
fkana2.description: Corrin's daughter, always lively and cheerful, celebrating the new year and taking in all the festival sights with a smile on her face. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Oh no, where's my dragonstone? It was in my sleeve just a second ago...
I didn't get to see Papa or Mama in the Deeprealms, even on New Year's. It was really lonely...
Prince Alfonse, Princess Sharena, Commander Anna! Where are you? I need to wish you a happy New Year!
