Let's see who can enjoy New Year's the most, Summoner! Huh? What do you mean "it's not a competition"?
Isn't my kimono pretty? And it never rips, even when I turn into a dragon! Do you think it's made of magic?
Visit: Happy New Year! Did I get it right? Yes! Well-wishes delivered! I can't wait to tell [F]!
Level: Hooray! I think this'll be a good year!
I'm gonna work even harder so I can get lots of New Year's gifts!
My sandal strap tore off while I was running...
Summon: Hi, I'm Kana! I can't wait to see what New Year's is like in Askr!
Learn Skill: Whoa, for me?! New Year's is the greatest!
Confession:
What do you think makes New Year's so fun? I think it's the feeling that something new is gonna start.
Speaking of new things, do you have goals for the new year, Summoner? I sure do!
First, I wanna become a strong hero like Papa.
Second, I wanna help keep Askr safe so we can all have another fun New Year's together next year!
So that means I gotta work hard to make it happen.
My dragon powers are going to get even cooler this year! Promise me you'll be watching, OK?
Status: Happy New Year! Let's play a lot this year too!
Aaah! Nice one! If I was tall enough, I'd drop snow down the back of your shirt!
Kimonos are so pretty! But they're a little uncomfy...
My papa gave me a gift for New Year's! I just need to figure out what to spend it on...
Papa is always busy, but we get to spend all of New Year's together!
Will I feel less lonely when I get older?
I'm going to do my best for you this year, too, 'kay?

reinhardt4.name: Reinhardt
reinhardt4.title: Thrud Reborn
reinhardt4.description: A powerful and respected mage knight of House Friege. Well-mannered and loyal, he is acclaimed as the second coming of the crusader Thrud. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: My sister is an adult now, as Bishop Saias once reminded me. As such, I should respect her decisions.
Olwen now wields the sacred blade that Ishtar once presented to me. I no longer have need of it.
Please, do not overexert yourself.
I shall stay by your side and defend this land until the bitter end.
It is...jarring to realize just how alone I have been all this time.
Visit: Excuse my unannounced arrival, but I come bearing greetings from our ally [F].
Level: May this flash of lightning illuminate my path forward.
This must be fate.
What is it I am so afraid of?
Summon: My name is Reinhardt. Allow me to demonstrate why Friege's lightning magic knows no equal.
Learn Skill: I am honored.
Confession:
Oh, Summoner. Does sleep elude you as well? I have been writing up a military tactics book to pass the time.
**There has long been a debate in the military world:** is it wiser to insist on victory or retreat before loss?
I believe the ideal action in battle is the one that produces the fewest casualties. Victory requires survival.
However, such a macro debate doesn't truly allow one to value the life of an individual soldier.
I fear I have lost sight of this value as well. Even though it is what I was bred and trained for, recently I...
Ah, how unbecoming. Forgive me for rambling.
Please know that no personal strife shall dull my capability and pride as a mage knight of Friege.
I believe crusader Thrud will forgive my absence from Friege to support your noble cause.
Status: I am Reinhardt, knight of Friege. I come bearing power anew.
*start* Please, stop your foolishness.
Perhaps it is my natural affinity, but thunder magic seems to grant me more power than any other.
I strive to remain diligent in all my pursuits. One must not fall victim to complacency.
You think this attire suits me? I am flattered to hear as much.
Lady Ishtar... It seems you no longer have need of me.
It brings me joy to support your ambitions.

tina.name: Tina
tina.title: Playful Scamp
tina.description: Younger sister of Safy, cleric of Tarrah. Leaves town in pursuit of her sister only to be swept up into a band of thieves. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Someone like Leif is ideal for me, but what about you? Come on, tell me, [S], please!
What?! If the empire is abducting children, I will never forgive them!
Here are some provisions! Since it's so cold, I made these things to help warm us up.
When did I gain the skill to use a staff, I wonder... I was merely copying what my sister did.
Telling me to get my head on straight... How rude!
Visit:
You're [S].
Hmm. You had better be good to [F], all right?
Level: Safy, wait for me! I'm on my way to you now!
We can't spend all our time fighting! Ugh, this is making me upset!
Huh? But why?!
Summon: I'm Tina. I'm pretty good with a staff, but I'm not that great at combat. Nice to meet you.
Learn Skill: What? What is it?! I'm ready to burst with excitement!
Confession:
*sniffle* Oh...it was just so awful, [S]...
You see...all I wanted was to help my sister out by finding people to fight, so I went after her.
Then I was captured by this rotten group of thieves. It terrifies me just thinking of them now... *sniffle*
They made me help them because of my staff. If I didn't do everything they said... Ugh! It makes me shudder still!
They threatened me with a huge bug! They would wave it in front of my face and put it on my head!
It was horrifying! I thought I was going to die... Well, that's enough crying for now. Time to take a bath, I guess!
Status: You'll be fine!
Don't give up!
My name's Tina. Nice to meet you!
If you ever meet my sister Safy, you'll see just how kind a person she is.
I'm telling you, Perne is just the WORST. He even shoved a big, gross, squirmy caterpillar in my face!
Isn't Prince Leif handsome? My ideal man is regal. You know, like a prince!
I made a late-night snack for you. Something nice and warm. Eat up!

safy.name: Safy
safy.title: Font of Piety
safy.description: A cleric of the city of Tarrah. Captured and held by pirates while on a journey to recruit warriors to help liberate her homeland. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Lady Linoan entrusted me with an important mission for the future of Tarrah... For our futures.
The duke of Tarrah gave Prince Leif refuge from the empire without giving in to fear of the consequences.
My wish is for people to be happy. If a day comes when everyone can smile, then I will be happy as well.
If you would consider coming back to Tarrah with me, I would do anything within my power for you.
Gods... I ask you to please watch over me.
Visit: I am Safy, a priestess of Tarrah. Will you help us in our fight against the empire, [S]?
Level: If we do not stand up now, the world will fall under Loptous's control.
A heart full of fear can prevent us from taking action. Let us face our great foe together.
Let us join hands and find courage in our hearts.
Summon: I am Safy. I believe that you can help us fight against the empire. Will you stand with us?
Learn Skill: So, you will go back? You will return to Tarrah with me?
Confession:
In Tarrah, after the duke passed on, corruption continued under the empire. They began hunting children.
Sacrificing children should never be allowed. Not in exchange for one's own safety or any other reason.
The people of Tarrah came together to form a resistance, even though it might mean our annihilation.
Within days, an army from the empire had Tarrah's small volunteer army surrounded. The fighting continues...
That is why I set out across Thracia to seek warriors who would join us in our fight for Tarrah.
I beseech you, please lend us your strength. Help protect the sanctity of our people, [S]!
Status: As I am able.
My aid is yours.
Oh, have you forgotten? I am Safy of Tarrah.
My sister, Tina, has a tendency to...exaggerate. It can be trying in the best of circumstances.
To use children for human sacrifice... For that there can be no forgiveness.
*sigh* I seem to have lost all my energy...
Let us fight for our futures, together.

lara.name: Lara
lara.title: Step Lively
lara.description: A member of the Magi, who work to bring freedom to Munster. Bursting with vitality. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: I hope it's all right that I can't help with lifting anything heavy.
The empire's priests and warriors just do as they please. All the weak can do is endure it...
Hey there, Summoner! Heehee, did I scare you?
It's my turn to patrol the grounds. Do you want to come with me?
Turn...spin...yes, I got it! Oh, hello. I was just seeing if I remembered a dance I learned years ago.
Visit: Hello! I was sent to say thank you for your friendship on behalf of [F]!
Level: Just what I needed!
I'm feeling the rhythm!
Hm... I guess I'm not feeling very inspired today.
Summon: I'm Lara of the Magi! I hope to help in whatever way I can.
Learn Skill: Oh, thank you!
Confession:
You know, I was a dancer in a traveling entertainment troupe until recently.
They treated me horribly... But my parents sold me when I was little, so I had nowhere to return to.
I was finally freed by a thief, um, I mean a chivalrous thief named Perne. After that, I became a thief too.
I know people don't have many nice things to say about Perne, but he's a hero to me. So, Summoner...
I'd really appreciate it if you had us work together. I'd really like the chance to talk with him more.
You've both been so kind to me. I hope I can repay that kindness one day!
Status: Leave it to me!
Let's stay safe!
I can't carry heavy weapons like most people here can.
Making a living as an entertainer is hard, but I like dancing.
I could always count on Perne to come watch me dance.
I'll dance as long as it helps keep everyone's spirits up.
Would it make you happy if I said I miss you when you're gone?

perne.name: Perne
perne.title: Dacian Scoundrel
perne.description: Leader of the Dandelion Bandits. Though he seems unfriendly, he doesn't believe in ending a life. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Abandoning all the power that comes with being a priest of Loptr... That Salem's a strange one.
We're thieves, not murderers. That said, our numbers are growing, and some...disagree with me.
Night's fast approaching. Look after yourself, all right?
If I were the prince of Askr, I sure wouldn't let someone as useful as you wriggle away.
I trust you. Do with me as you will.
Visit: Pretty nice castle... What's your name? It's [S] I'll remember that. I think we're gonna get along just fine.
Level: Hmph, idiots. I bet you thought I was no more than a simple thief.
I'm not interested in killing.
What? Got something to say?
Summon: The name's Perne. Neat place you've got here. I'd like to meet whoever's in charge.
Learn Skill: Do you think I'm the kind of person who can be bought? Well, perhaps I could accept a gift from a friend...
Confession:
Y'know, I think I know what's next for me after hanging around all these Heroes.
I'm not interested in being some noble's flunky, but I'm not planning on thieving in Dacia forever either.
Thracia's my home. It's in my best interest to help it find peace, so I figure I should help out Prince Leif.
I'll cut ties with Cullough and his goons and become a regular hero of Thracia.
I'll bring Troude and Salem along with me, of course... Was that a chuckle just now, Summoner?
Do you think I'm joking? You should know that when ol' Perne makes a plan, he follows through.
So don't forget it. Actually, why don't you come along with us, pal? Promise there'd be no dull moments!
Status: Now this is a place that could keep my interest for a spell. Oh, me? I'm Perne.
What? Reckless, aren't you? I'd get a handle on that, if I were you.
I trust you. Do as you will.
I see you thinking "that Perne's no more than a thief." I would invite you to think again.
You'll want to check under Lifis for puddles. Unless he's learned to stop wetting his pants by now.
I will escape this life of petty thievery one day... Oh, yes.
Ah, we're the best of friends now. Aren't we?

igrene3.name: Igrene
igrene3.title: Sworn Protectors
igrene3.description: Igrene, guardian of Nabata, with Louise, countess of Reglay. These two protectors look ahead to what the future will bring. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade / The Blazing Blade.
igrene3.origin: The Binding Blade + The Blazing Blade
igrene3.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】,【Treachery】, and【Desperation】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Treachery】
Unit deals additional damage = total bonuses on unit for 1 turn.
【Desperation】
Grants the following effect for 1 turn: "If unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack."
(Harmonized Skills can be used by tapping the Harmonized button. Harmonized Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Igrene:** Lord Athos hoped we could form bonds—forge true understanding with dragons. We honor that ideal.
**Igrene:** Arcadia is a very small, hidden village where we try to nurture a future for humans and dragons together.

**Igrene:** I was but a child when Lady Louise gave me a bow. I tugged at its string like it was nothing but a toy.
Oh, how my poor father wanted to see me with an axe in my hands.
**Louise:** I am quite happy to hear that Igrene used the bow I had Hawkeye pass along to her.
**Igrene:** Lady Louise is wonderful. Though, it is disconcerting when she calls me "little Igrene" like I'm still a child.
Visit: **Igrene:** I'm grateful to those who understand the nature of my village, like you and [F].
Level: **Igrene:** I pray that dragons and people will one day understand each other and learn to live together!
**Igrene:** I have no desire to force my ideals upon you, but I will never bow to ignorance or tyranny!
**Louise:** You have no need to worry. Igrene is strong, and Hawkeye is quite proud of his daughter.
Summon: I am Igrene. I preside over festivals in a village in Nabata and... Oh, Lady Louise, watch your step!
Learn Skill: **Louise:** Oh...isn't this wonderful? Let us do our best to make good use of this.
Confession:
**Igrene:** Did you enjoy everything the festival of Nabata had to offer, Lady Louise? And you,[S]?
It may have seemed awkward, as the villagers could only mimic what they know of festivals outside Nabata.
**Louise:** I think it a noble endeavor. You will protect Nabata in this new age, won't you, little Igrene...I mean, Igrene?
**Igrene:** Yes, I shall carry on the will of Lord Athos and my father—to protect this cradle of humanity and dragons.
I pray that their ideals will one day spread throughout the world.
**Louise:** I believe that time will come. These sentiments and oaths will be passed through generations. But, Igrene...
You should not feel constrained by the idea that a guardian's lot must be a lonely one. You are yet young...
**Igrene:** It may be in the past now, but my love has been spoken for, and I can give it to no other.
Just as you would give yours to no other but Lord Pent.
**Louise:** Oh, how embarrassing. I am afraid I spoke out of turn. Please forgive me.
**Igrene:** Think nothing of it. We are living in a time of war. Let us move forward, holding our loves close to our hearts.
Status: I can't believe I get to fight beside you, Lady Louise. You've become such a wonderful woman!
Conversation: **Louise:** Oh, little Igrene! Would you have a look at this? Do you have any idea what it could be?
**Igrene:** Lady Louise, surely I'm old enough to no longer be called "little Igrene."
**Louise:** Good heavens, silly me. I suppose I still think of you as a little girl.
And what an adorable little girl you were!
Always carrying around that bow that was larger than you, following in Hawkeye's every step.
**Igrene:** My father was my entire world in those days.
But then you and Lord Pent came along and expanded my world.
Those stories of the Etrurian capital you told me, the local myths and legends...
They sounded like magical dreams to someone like me, who had only known life in Arcadia.
**Louise:** Oh my, really? Here I thought we were boring you. I'm glad they had such an impact.
**Igrene:** I felt so lonely after you and Lord Pent left... My father was troubled by how often I cried.
He frequently scolded me over it, saying it was not fitting for a future Desert Guardian.
Even still, I longed to see you both again someday.
**Louise:** I'm so sorry... But how wonderful that we have been reunited!
We can speak about all manner of things that we weren't able to before. There is so much I want to ask you!
**Igrene:** I feel the same. There are so many of my own stories that I want to share with you.
**Louise:** Let's make some delicious tea, then, shall we? It pairs well with long conversations.

altina3.name: Altina
altina3.title: Unrivaled Dawn
altina3.description: One of the Three Heroes who fought a dark god under the protection of a goddess. Interested in the utopia in Nabata and its sublime ideology. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: In Arcadia, humans and dragons live in harmony despite their differences. There is much to be impressed by.
Tellius has its ancient desert ruins as well. It is evidence that all things fade in time, returning to dust...
This is the common style of Nabata... It would fit Soan and Dheginsea well. I hope to bring them here if I can.

Do you need something from me? I was out in the Nabata heat and need to wash the sweat off me.
I will find you when I've finished.
How would the goddess see this world, I wonder... While I admit I cannot know, I myself am fond of it.
Visit: I come bearing well-wishes from [F]'s world.
Level: All who threaten the peace will be judged by the goddess!
Despite being festival dress, these clothes have a certain simple practicality. I rather like them.
*sigh* No matter how I try, I cannot seem to rid myself of this layer of sand that's covering me.
Summon: I am Altina. The goddess has guided me here, so I will face this challenge without reserve. We will have victory.
Learn Skill: I will shine the goddess's radiant light to the far reaches of this land, and with it bring justice! That is my duty.
Confession:
I am the goddess's blades... I do not fear battle.
Beneath that, however, I am a beorc who wishes for peace.
War ravages the hearts and bodies of those it touches. I do not blame those who would rather run from it.
I wish all beings could see each other as equals and so avoid conflict festering between them...
The goddess herself may agree, in fact, which makes it a worthy discovery for me to have made.
I can feel the goddess's guiding hand as I come to this knowledge, and so I know it to be right and just.
Status: Thank you for inviting me here. I shall do my very best to serve you.
*yelp* Huh? My foot got stuck in the sand!
It takes a lot of practice to wield two blades at once, but I put in the effort.
In my world, the desert was widely feared. We called it the Desert of Death.
This world has given us a wonderful opportunity to learn about other cultures.
You said we can coexist, Lehran. I have to go on believing that.
When I am with you, time always seems to pass so quickly.

juno2.name: Juno
juno2.title: Nimble Grace
juno2.description: The eldest of three sisters from Ilia. Visits Nabata's festival as a representative of Edessa. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall:
I intended to withdraw from military conflict when I got married, but...
I couldn't simply watch as my husband and sisters departed for war.
This desert would be difficult to live in. Strangely, it reminds me of Ilia with its intense temperatures.
All bodies grow weary. Remember to take the time to rest while you can.
People are people. It does not matter where they are from. We can only flourish by supporting each other.
I hear the desert gets quite cold at night. Perhaps my experience living in Ilia will be useful.
Visit: Hello there. I hope you will pursue a friendship with the people of Nabata alongside [F].
Level: I will continue to fight so that I may raise my child in a world free of war.
I think I understand the message that the people of Nabata are trying to impart through this festival.
As a mother, I know that there are many things more important than my own life.
Summon: I am Juno, from Edessa. It is an honor to be invited to this festival, though my sisters may have been a better fit.
Learn Skill: My, this is for me? I graciously accept.
Confession:
What a wonderful festival. It's easy to see the pride and strength of the people who live in the Nabata Desert.
I previously thought life in the desert would hold nothing but endless toil and challenges.
Intense heat during the day and biting cold at night... Nature doesn't always accept humanity easily.
We mustn't force our way in, but strive to live in harmony with it and remain grateful for its gifts.
The same can be said of relationships between people and countries. I've learned that much at this festival.
I shall impart what I've learned here to my husband, sisters, everyone I can...
so that, no matter the world or time, we may all welcome a time of peace at last.
Status: Thank you for inviting me to this festival. Let's make it one to remember.
*start* Oh, I thought you were one of my sisters for a moment. They used to tease me as well.
This may be a festival, but it also offers an excellent opportunity for desert combat training. Quite useful.
My sisters were such cute children.
Nothing soothes my tired heart more than seeing my daughter's smile.
I fight so that, someday, children will be free to grow up in peace.
Should you need a shoulder to lean on, I am here.

tormod.name: Tormod
tormod.title: Indomitable Will
tormod.description: Boy who claims to lead the Laguz Emancipation Army. Confidently pursues his ideals for a new world. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Once, I saw this light fall from the sky and then I had strange dreams after, so I know I'm called to greatness.
Ike and the others talk about Yune... Did you know she's called a dark goddess in our world?
I know this is your job and all, but you should spend time with your other friends too!
There's a man here in the desert who looks pretty strong. I think he'd challenge even Muarim's strength!
*sigh* I'm so busy... Did people figure out how good I am at everything? So many favors, so little time!
Visit: This castle is a lively one too! Nice! Anyway, just checking in on you, at [F]'s request!
Level: I'll clear the path with one good blast!
I may still be growing, but I'm no child!
I won't settle for this!
Summon: I'm Tormod. I may not look like it, but I'm pretty much the most dangerous mage around!
Learn Skill: I just saw Ike and Sothe for the first time in a while—they're both huge! I'll be just as big as them! Someday.
Confession:
Since we're not total strangers anymore, I have to ask... What are your dreams,[S]?
I want to free the laguz. They've been treated terribly, and for so long... I want our kinds to live in peace.
Laguz, beorc—it doesn't matter. They may have ears and fangs, but we're all people.
That's why I respect that Arcadia has been made a reality. They've proven my dream is achievable.
Even if people can be stubborn, I'll never give up! I'll make somewhere that laguz, beorc...everyone can live!
Special: I'll knock you off your feet!
Status: I love festivals. Thanks for inviting me!
Huh? Oh, so you wanna play, do ya?
Ah, the desert is great! Sand as far as the eye can see!
I used to live in the desert with my friends in the Laguz Emancipation Army.
Wait, you're saying there could be treasure buried in the desert?!
If humans and dragons can live together, laguz and beorc should be able to do the same.
I'll do everything I can to make my own world as peaceful as this paradise!

hawkeye2.name: Hawkeye
hawkeye2.title: Taciturn Guardian
hawkeye2.description: Loyal servant of Archsage Athos, one of the Eight Legends. Protects the village of Arcadia in Nabata, his master's paradise. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: A festival to affirm Arcadia and our wishes for the future... Igrene is a remarkable young woman.
Arcadia is home to both humans and dragons, overseen by Lord Athos. There is no conflict here.

If I did not know better, I would believe this pathway to another time to be some evil magic...
But I am grateful for it.
Life in the desert is not easy. Here, people cannot easily find food or water... It requires strength of heart.
I was told powerful magic can drive people to madness, but...even so, I trust my master's guidance.
Visit: I pray for your continued friendship with [F].
Level: Let the beating of my heart echo across the battlefield!
None will escape my wrath.
I will not take my eyes off the enemy.
Summon: I am Hawkeye, protector of Nabata's peace. While this seems a strange twist of fate, I will not shy away.
Learn Skill: With this, I will come to know myself anew.
Confession:
Even on the battlefield, you keep your head. That state of mind is like that of my master's.
Lord Athos once told me humans and dragons have grown to hate each other due to their long war.
Hatred is not easily washed away... but people can change, and we learn much over our short lives.
After seeing this world, where countless others meet, I am now certain that my master was correct.
The possibility of utopia can be found in each of our hearts.
I am grateful to have met you—and to see this world. I will pursue the peace in Askr as I would in Nabata.
Status: I'm Hawkeye, defender of the Nabata desert.
*grunt* You bumped me.
I am pleased to welcome visitors from distant lands to our festival.
Pent and Louise are my good friends.
The day humans and dragons understand each other will come. I have faith.
My daughter, Igrene... She must succeed me as Desert Guardian.
I am certain that one day you will build a utopia, one like our village in Nabata.

lumera2.name: Lumera
lumera2.title: In Distant Skies
lumera2.description: Divine Dragon who watches over Elyos. A transcendent being who is aware of the fate she follows. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: This world will be all right in the end. With so many Emblems—er, Heroes, rather, it is all but assured.
I served as ruler of Elyos, but am simply a Divine Dragon now. My child has inherited my throne and power.
How is it you summon Heroes? To what ends do you wield such great power?
There is something familiar about the bustling atmosphere of this place. I can feel it call to me... Is it fate?
I have been wondering what sort of Emblem you might be if you were to appear in Elyos.
Visit: I am Divine Dragon Lumera, here to visit your world with a gift from [F]'s world.
Level: How joyous. It feels as if I have been blessed by this world.
As long as my service gives you strength, I will be there to provide.
Not all wishes can be granted.
Summon: I am Lumera, a Divine Dragon who wishes for the continent of Elyos to know peace. For you, I fight again.
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude, Summoner. Your support drives me forward.
Confession:
You always seem calm, but there must surely be moments where that is not the case. In battle perhaps?
Were you to fall, would you want to be rescued? Or would you prefer others fall with you?
Hehe. Forgive me. That was a cruel question to ask... I already know what your answer is.
I promise to support you here in your world, just as the Emblems support my child in our world...
Allow me to light your way, and have faith that we will share this connection forever.
Status: My child has a summoning power not unlike yours.
*chuckle* If you wanted to chat, all you had to do was ask.
I am certain Askr and Elyos are connected. That means my child is watching over you.
Even if I am no longer the Divine Dragon Monarch, I will always pray for the happiness of those I care about.
I wonder how the Emblems are faring... Your Heroes remind me so much of them.
This time, I wish to fight alongside my allies until the very end.
Not all wishes can come true. But if you allow your dreams to shine on, they will light the path to a brighter tomorrow.

marth7.name: Marth
marth7.title: Of Beginnings
marth7.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to Elyos. Resides in the Ring of the Hero-King. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem / Fire Emblem Engage.
marth7.emblem:
**Enhanced Engaged Special:**
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1; max cooldown count cannot be reduced below 1). If unit triggers the "unit attacks twice" effect, reduces Special damage by 8.

Castle Hall: I thought I would never be reunited with my allies from Archanea. I missed them so.
In Elyos, I joined with the Divine Dragon. As long as we are called to bring peace, that is what we will do.
I have persisted as an Emblem for many an age. I am much older than I appear...like a manakete!
As an Emblem, I am not accustomed to being corporeal. I can fight as a Hero here—and even eat!
Whenever I spy a Hero wearing a ring, I get the urge to follow them... It's only natural, I suppose.
Visit: I come bearing a greeting. Please, continue to support your friend [F].
Level: Excellent results. To bring aid to all, I must grow stronger.
I feel my power as an Emblem increasing.
Sometimes, I wish to grow stronger, but it is not to be. I won't let that stop me.
Summon: I am Emblem Marth. It was a shock to be called to this new world, but you have my faith and my support.
Learn Skill: As you wish, I shall grow stronger still. I intend to fulfill your expectations.
Confession:
You showed strong leadership today. As you could summon me despite not being a dragon, I'm unsurprised.
But, [S]...
Bear in mind that our very natures as Emblems change depending on the intentions of our partner.
Our power is meant to be used to protect those who need protecting, not to wage wars of aggression.
I think you know this well. And so I have come to trust you, and I will stay by your side till the very end.
I would like you to wear my ring one day as well. Promise me—when that day comes, you will engage with me!
Status: I hope to form an unshakable bond with you.
Oh, I see. I can be touched in this world.
The original Marth dwells in this land as a Hero? An odd circumstance.
Do I resemble the Marth you know at all? Or is he truly different?
There was once an invocation to summon me. Imagine calling out "Shine on, Emblem of Beginnings!"
If I can fight at your side once more, Alear, I hope we are never again parted.
If we had my Emblem Ring, I could grant you my power. And were you then to call out "Emblem, engage!" we would be as one.

lyon5.name: Lyon
lyon5.title: Esteemed Royals
lyon5.description: Quiet, mild-mannered prince of Grado and Princess Eirika of Renais who both share a strong connection with Prince Ephraim. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.
lyon5.duo:
Inflicts the following status on foes in cardinal directions of unit through their next actions: "after start-of-turn skills trigger, action ends immediately" (for foes who have not yet taken an action in Summoner Duels, instead of inflicting this effect, ends their action immediately).
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Lyon:** Having Eirika at my side, today of all days, makes me nervous... I need to concentrate!
**Eirika:** I'm ready, Lyon. Let's go deliver the gift of our love to everyone!
**Lyon:** Uh! O-oh... You mean these flowers?
**Eirika:** Lyon and I wanted to take this opportunity to get Ephraim a gift of some kind...
**Lyon:** Ephraim surely won't turn down a festival gift. Hopefully no one takes advantage of that fact...
Visit: They say this festival is a chance to express your true feelings... A-are all attendees...expected to participate?
Level: **Lyon:** Eirika is always surrounded by people showering her with gifts. It's like she draws them in with her light...
**Lyon:** Don't shove now! There is enough for everyone!
**Eirika:** Here is a small token of how much I care. I hope you like it.
Summon: Thank you for inviting us to the festival. Eirika and I are looking for a gift to give Ephraim.
Learn Skill: **Lyon:** This is for us? Oh, thank you, [S]!
Confession:
**Eirika:** I'm not sure about the name, but the idea of the Day of Devotion is wonderful, I think.
I wish I could share it with everyone back home—Seth and the knights, Tana, and everyone from the castle!
**Lyon:** Hm... I don't actually have anyone like that at home in Grado.
**Eirika:** But still you helped me find a gift for Ephraim, and so we got to spend time together. I'm grateful for that.
And I'm grateful that, in you, I know Ephraim and I have a true friend.
**Lyon:** Oh, uh... Yes. I, um... Actually, I am also grateful. For—er, to you! So...
I-got-you-this-I-hope-you-like-it.
...
Status: "I have doubts..." "It's all right. Be brave!"
Conversation: **Eirika:** Hm... What should I do?
**Lyon:** Is something troubling you?
**Eirika:** I'm not sure what to give Ephraim for the Day of Devotion...
**Lyon:** He would surely be happy with any gift from you...wouldn't he?
**Eirika:** That's kind of you, Lyon.
I've given him a gift every year on his birthday, and he's not shown even a hint of joy...
**Lyon:** Oh, really? Well that's rather rude of him...
**Eirika:** Nothing seems to hold his attention except battle.
I gave him a beautiful brooch, and he never wore it. I got him a book he'd find of use. He never read it.
**Lyon:** Heh... Well, that does sound like Ephraim... But I'm sure he appreciated those gifts in his own way.
**Eirika:** I suppose he has told me that he's afraid of damaging them or getting them dirty...
**Lyon:** See? He just feels awkward expressing his gratitude. It isn't that he dislikes your gifts.
**Eirika:** Is that so? You seem to understand my brother better than I do, Lyon.
**Lyon:** We've been friends a long time. I know him well. And I know that if I received a gift from you, I would...
**Eirika:** You would what?
**Lyon:** I-I just mean that I would surely be happy...with any gift from you.
**Eirika:** Well, I'm happy to hear it, because I have a Day of Devotion gift for you too!

ephraim7.name: Ephraim
ephraim7.title: Ardent Prince
ephraim7.description: Prince of Renais in search of a present for his twin sister, Eirika, who has gone off on her own to seek elsewhere. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: What would I like as a gift? ...Oh! A strong opponent I can go all out on—like Grado's General Duessel!
I didn't invent "tough love," but when Eirika heard I wanted to gift a training session, she sure acted like I did!
A festival of love celebrates that which lives within all our hearts... the source of the Sacred Stones.
I need others more than I care to admit. If I spent the time to fully express my gratitude...it'd be days!
*sigh* What should I get for Eirika? Some kind of jewelry perhaps? Do you have any suggestions?
Visit: I come bearing warm greetings from [F]!
Level: I am Ephraim, and I will emerge victorious no matter the contest, be it spearmanship or love!
Satisfied? If not, then it only means we've more training to do!
I will hit the mark...next time.
Summon: I am Ephraim of Renais. The festival of love is always around the corner. Are you prepared?
Learn Skill: Aha! Is this another Day of Devotion gift? What a blessing!
Confession:
I have yet to see Eirika... She would not be hiding, would she? Where could she be?
I know Lyon was with her, so I suspect they were planning something...
Little do they know that I know they're up to something, so I have the advantage... Look!
I found this charm in town. The vendor carves initials into them...
I got this one with all our initials— all FOUR of us—mine, Eirika's, Lyon's, and yours!
Surprised? Don't be! You are someone we think of as our close friend, [S]!
Status: I am not used to outfits that are quite so...flowing. It's making me second-guess my footwork.
Oh, thank you. These flower petals seem to cling to everything.
Choosing gifts is rather nerve-wracking. Thinking about it is enough to make me ill...
What am I looking for in a gift? Nothing in particular, I suppose.
Eirika, Lyon... I will always be grateful for you.
Tell people how you feel while you have the chance. You may regret waiting.
I did get you something. I apologize in advance if it isn't to your taste...

selena4.name: Selena
selena4.title: Admiring General
selena4.description: A magic user and one of the Imperial Three who goes by the moniker Fluorspar. Adores Emperor Vigarde, who saved her village from disaster. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: His Majesty is a paragon of royal magnanimity.
I have known hellish times, but I have survived by His Majesty's grace. I will protect his people in turn.
The prince has an aptitude for magic. I hope I, too, can be of some use.
My devotion is to Grado, and to His Majesty. There is nothing I would not do for them.
I once hid pickles in His Majesty's meal, just so he would try them... The chef was not pleased.
Visit: Here is a token from the Day of Devotion festival being held at [F]'s castle.
Level: None will walk away unscathed! All will know the power of my devotion!
I am full of my love for Grado! Tomorrow I will push even further!
A life can be saved by the simplest thing... His Majesty is worthy in that he is not above small kindnesses.
Summon: I am Selena, Fluorspar of the Imperial Three. All here shall witness my devotion to the emperor of Grado!
Learn Skill: I am grateful to know you thought of me.
Confession:
Hm... Oh, it's you!
You see this stone? This is fluorspar. The real thing. It absorbs daylight and then softly glows at night...
That's how my feelings are—never out in the open.
If I meet defeat on the battlefield, I plan to give my name, Fluorspar, back to His Majesty with this stone.
But enough of such things. For now, I will put my devotion to Grado on full display!
Status: I appreciate the invitation, but...I am not sure I have the right to enjoy a festival of this kind.
Oh, was there a flower petal stuck to my shoulder? Thank you.
My feelings toward my liege are far beyond simple gratitude.
These flowers are lovely—and completely unlike the ones where I grew up.
I am a general of the empire—and I have never once forgotten it.
If His Majesty could just be healthy...
Please accept this flower from me, if it would bring you any amount of joy.

myrrh5.name: Myrrh
myrrh5.title: Adored Dragon
myrrh5.description: A girl from the village of Caer Pelyn, where she is honored as the Great Dragon. Separated from Ephraim and friends when summoned to Askr. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Where has Brother gone? Have you seen Ephraim?
I've heard this festival is a chance to give a present to someone you care about, and it comes once a year...
Everyone is happy to be given a gift... And it makes me happy to give gifts too!
No, sorry... This stone isn't for you.
My father dedicated his life to protecting humans. I want to do whatever I can too...
Visit: I'm so excited... I'm going to the festival with [F]!
Level: I feel so warm and floaty...
I still have more to do and learn. I'll do my best.
You want more? Satisfying wants will not satisfy the soul...
Summon: I'm Myrrh. Is devotion when...when two people are always together?
Learn Skill: Thank you... I will have to think about what to get you in return.
Confession:
Spending time with humans can be nice. Being around humans means not being alone...
Before, I was always with Father in Darkling Woods, day and night.
When he died, I thought I'd be alone.
I've met some nice people, but they always leave. I don't belong in the human world...
But Ephraim told me I could stay with him. He said he wouldn't just disappear...
Would you say the same thing, [S]?
I am always glad to have new friends to care for. And that is what the Day of Devotion has meant to me.
Special: Thank you for all you do.
Status: This dress is so soft and fluttery... And there are so many ruffles!
*gasp* You mustn't touch people without their permission!
I like festivals. They are so full of life, it is difficult to feel lonely.
I thought hard about my present for Ephraim.
Flowers are so pretty... I wish they could always be in full bloom.
I want to give Father a gift too...
I'm happy you are always nearby. I just wanted to say...thank you.

vigarde2.name: Vigarde
vigarde2.title: Warmhearted Sire
vigarde2.description: Beloved emperor of Grado, once known as the Silent Emperor. He is said to have great concern for the well-being of all his people, far and wide. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Lyon grew up clever, like his mother. But his tendency to turn his mind inward surely comes from me...

I merely look after Grado, as any ruler looks after their realm. It is not mine alone. It is the people's.
I hope I am able to instill that lesson in Lyon.
A celebration of the devotion one feels for another... What a glorious display of the human spirit.
I am only able to eat food prepared by my chefs. My apologies. Please give my sweets to others here.
I once ate a rather peculiar pickled delicacy in my travels. I remember the Fluorspar had quite the reaction.
Visit: It is a joy when those in power are not mired in conflict. May your hearts and blades remain aligned.
Level: When body is satisfied and spirit fulfilled, there can be no conflict.
This is a gift bequeathed by Grado. Satisfy your hunger and ease your tensions.
I am winded... Are Duessel or Selena near? They must serve in my stead.
Summon: I am Vigarde, ruler of the Grado Empire. I have devoted myself to both Magvel and the Sacred Stones.
Learn Skill: A failing army hastens its kingdom's decline, but one cannot maintain an army for selfish purposes.
Confession:
This festival is a time for people to express their devotion to each other, yes? What a splendid event.
As emperor, I frequently witness the ugly side of quarrels born from the pursuit of material gain...
One cannot survive this position and remain naive, but that does not mean one must abandon their ideals.
If Grado's citizens trust each other and the nations of Magvel grow close, peace may endure...
I hope, for my son and all the people of Grado, that such an age one day comes to pass.
Status: I am Emperor Vigarde of Grado. I received an invitation to this festival.
Oh! Did you mistake me for someone else? Well, no matter—certainly jolted me awake!
My nation has enjoyed a long and durable friendship with Renais. I can only hope it extends well into the future.
A festival for expressing gratitude... What marvelous traditions your world has.
As I have told Lyon many a time, the emperor's foremost duty is to protect his subjects.
When I am gone, it will fall to Lyon to protect the people of Grado. I pray that you do, my son.
You seem worthy of my trust.

ivy.name: Ivy
ivy.title: Snow Queen
ivy.description: Crown princess of Elusia, Kingdom of Knowledge. Unfailingly upholds the dignity and majesty of royalty. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall:
I was given a tome by my sister Hortensia, so she could protect me in battle, even when we're apart...
But it is my wish to protect her.
The kingdom of Elusia worships the Fell Dragon. My father, the king, is a devout follower. As for me, though...
Do not worry over me. Whether or not I am troubled, I won't trouble with my confiding.

Will you accompany me to the library? It's a bit gloomy, and that is not my cup of tea...
Not to say I'm afraid, of course.
I prayed to the Divine Dragon who rules over Elyos, and...I was saved.
Visit: I am Ivy, princess of Elusia. I am here on [F]'s behalf.
Level: The Divine Dragon has blessed me, but I will not let this inflate my ego.
The minimum one should expect from Elusian royalty.
I cannot imagine the Divine Dragon's disappointment at witnessing this...
Summon:
I am Ivy, crown princess of Elusia, here to answer your call and fulfill my duty...
...Is the Divine Dragon here?
Learn Skill: Thank you for the attention. You can trust I will repay the kindness.
Confession:
I believe you are aware of this, but I have a duty to my home country—it must be rebuilt.
At first I felt that I was wasting time fighting in Askr, that I needed to return as quickly as possible.
But as I've fought by your side, I've found meaning in it I never expected.
It's strange...but in a way, you remind me of the Divine Dragon.
...I fear I've overstepped. What I mean to say is that I intend to keep fighting as your ally.
I would not say this to anyone who did not have my full trust... So do remember you have my support.
Status: Keep your hands to yourself. Where are your manners?
*startle* Ghost! Oh, it's you. You gave me a start.
Do not presume you are entitled to my friendship. Only the Divine Dragon has that right.
It was Emblem Lyn's ring that was entrusted to Elusia.
My retainers? I haven't the faintest idea. They will either find me eventually, or they won't.
The other heroes are so... So sociable. Where do they get the energy?
Must you be so...attentive? I suppose I don't mind it. So long as you don't expect me to be grateful.

hortensia.name: Hortensia
hortensia.title: Little Charmer
hortensia.description: Second princess of Elusia and Ivy's younger sister. Though selfish, she loves her family and all of those close to her. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I'm enjoying my time here, but I can't help thinking about Elusia... Father would want us to rebuild soon.
Kids in Elusia begin schooling when they come of age. I'll have you know I was an excellent student!
Your poor skin! Here, try this fruit— it's moisturizing. And get some rest! I'll wake you before our next mission.
Ugh, I'm so bored... Oh, Summoner! You're just in time to take me shopping. Come on, let's go!
Adorable, elegant, regal... The Heroes here have it all. Well, I'll just have to...have even more!
Visit: Ooo, love the castle! Your Heroes are quite stylish too. Oh, yeah, [F] says "hi!"
Level: Gotta say, I'm happy about this.
Stronger and cuter, bit by bit.
Guess I need to try harder.
Summon: It's me—the second princess of Elusia, Hortensia! Hellooo, Askr!
Learn Skill: I feel even cuter with this new power! Now, where's the best place to take it for a test run?
Confession:
Can I ask you something, Summoner? You're from a different world too, right? You ever get homesick?
I understand. You miss home, but protecting the people here is even more important to you.
I feel the same way. I miss Elusia a lot, but right now there's nowhere I'd rather be than at your side.
I think my father would understand that. Above all else...he'd want me to do what I think is right.
Ugh, how'd you get me to open up to you like this? You're good, I'll give you that...
Status: You owe me one.
How cute am I?
You know, you cut a striking silhouette. Very mysterious with the hood up!
I'm the second princess of Elusia. My wisdom and refinement are outclassed only by my cuteness.
Lots of adorable Heroes in this place. I almost feel bad about putting them to shame.
Fighting for another country before Elusia's been restored... What would Father think?
Hey, don't forget I'm here to support you. That's why you summoned me, after all!

kagetsu.name: Kagetsu
kagetsu.title: Onigiri Samurai
kagetsu.description: Ivy's retainer and an affable soldier from the royal castle of Elusia. He enjoys sparring and dining on the cuisine of Pale Sands. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: More delicious onigiri today! I did well to bring rice to Askr. But what to do once I run out...
I hail from Pale Sands, where my family is prominent. But freedom is beyond price!
You work hard but overdo things. Let me ease your burden. I will do the grunt work, dear friend!
I see that you have fought many battles. Come—let us duel! Though I fear your weapon's projectiles...
Will you go out with me? Today, let us deepen our bond! Perhaps we can take a meal outside.
Visit: I am Kagetsu, here to deliver tidings from my friend and yours, [F]!
Level: Yes! Exactly as I foresaw!
My skills have improved. You will soon see!
What?! I do not understand!
Summon: I am Kagetsu of Elusia! We shall be friends from today onward. Is Princess Ivy here?
Learn Skill: I am filled with power! I want to spar! Quickly, now!
Confession:
Listen well, Summoner! I have small talents for foresight, as my mother is a priestess.
Today, I learned we are compatible as both friends and allies in battle... thanks to visions from above.
Do not tell me... You anticipated this? Impressive.
I cannot help but smile to hear this. How delightful! Let us go out...a very special outing!
Sparring, eating Pale Sands cuisine... And whatever else you want to do, my cherished friend!
Special: Will you go out with me?
Status: Oh! Would you like to train with me? Come—show me your skill!
*startle* You came at me while my guard was down. Well struck!
It is not mere chance that you and I have met. Will you go out with me, so we can strengthen our bond?
Many people in Elusia were curious about my clothing. Would you also like to know more about it?
I long for my homeland's cuisine. Grilled fish and rice for breakfast... Askr does not do this.
I have not seen Princess Ivy. Do you suppose she has gotten lost? I fear she will be wandering alone after nightfall...
I am pleased that you are keen to spend so much time together. Our bond of friendship has grown incredibly strong!

rosado.name: Rosado
rosado.title: Adorable Artist
rosado.description: A soldier from the royal castle of Elusia and Hortensia's retainer. A talented painter and fashionista. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Looking cute as ever, Summoner! I bet all your summoned Heroes will be cute too. Like me!
I'm not officially a retainer, but Hortensia's my friend, and it's only natural for me to protect her.
I resemble my father, so it makes me happy when I get compliments. Like they're for him too.
Wherever I go in Askr, there's something worth drawing! Would you like to see a landscape I did?
I want to buy a bunch of ribbons so I can dress up the horses and wyverns. It'd be great if we all matched, huh?!
Visit: I hope you like this adorably decorated greeting card I made for you with [F]!
Level: It should make me proud to be useful in battle, shouldn't it?
Cute and strong in equal measure.
Good thing I'm already cute.
Summon: I'm Rosado, adorable royal knight of Elusia and retainer of the equally cute Hortensia! Is she already here?
Learn Skill: You're making me even cuter?! Wow, thank you!
Confession:
Hey, I'm as cute as ever, right? Maybe because I get as much food and rest as I want.
Haha... But no need to worry. I'm still training hard for battle, promise.
It won't matter how beautiful I look if it doesn't match what's on the inside. Hortensia told me that.
Which is why I keep up with my training, so I can be a refined and worthy Hero, inside and out!
I'll do my best so you remember me, even if I'm not your number one. So keep doting on me, Summoner!
Status: Wow, look at you—a great hero and a summoner! Would you mind posing for a drawing?
Oh! Was my ribbon off-kilter? Thanks so much!
Absolutely love your outfit. Do you think I could pull off that look?
Isn't my wyvern adorable? Her name is Camille. I'm so glad she's here with me!
Askr's beauty is out of this world—literally! I hope my drawings will capture that.
I wonder how Hortensia's doing without me. Cute and genuine as ever, I hope.
I'd say your finest quality is your eye for people. It makes me happy to help you out...while looking amazingly adorable!

mauvier.name: Mauvier
mauvier.title: Penitent Knight
mauvier.description: Veyle's knight and former member of the Four Hounds. He's a loyal warrior who favors the straightforward, direct approach. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: May Lady Veyle's heart be saved, even if fate is forever altered. I have no doubt there is hope for her.
The deeds of the Four Hounds can never be erased, only atoned for by my lifelong devotion to Lady Veyle.
Leave it to someone like me to ease your burdens so you may focus on more crucial tasks.
Huh? You want to play summoners? Ugh, why me... All right... I will appear in front of the great stone monument.
What will you have me do now? I cannot just rest until my next mission... I do not know how.
Visit:
I come bearing a token of friendship from [F].
I hope you will fare well together.
Level: This is a happy result. But no time to rest.
Now that I am stronger, I must accomplish even more.
I need to be more diligent.
Summon: My name is Mauvier. Is Lady Veyle here? I am her knight.
Learn Skill: Apologies for the trouble, but what should I do with this power?
Confession:
Yes, Summoner? You want to talk? It is foolish to grow too attached. Best to remain objective.
For now, we are on the same side... But if someone harmed Lady Veyle, I would cut ties with them instantly.
And that includes you. So, as I said, best to remain— What is this? A yam?
You are putting together a gathering? I suppose I can help, but do not get too excited.
I am only doing what is necessary to atone for the sins of the Four Hounds.
Status: I will strive to prove my worth to you.
Yes? What is it?
I am used to spending long hours on watch. Do not be concerned.
Rest is not relaxing to me. I prefer to remain active.
My past with the Four Hounds is tainted by unforgivable sins.
I will always be your knight, Lady Veyle. Even in this other world.
Spending your time with a sinner like me can only be to your detriment. It would be more appropriate for you to seek out a proper Hero.

malear2.name: Alear
malear2.title: Engaging Fire
malear2.description: The hero who brought peace to the world by bringing his companions and the Emblems together and fighting alongside them. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I owe my life to those closest to me. It is because of them I have been reborn, not once but twice.
The Emblems and I parted ways as the battle came to a close. But... I have a feeling I'll see them all again.
It's important to exercise and eat healthy. And don't forget to rest. My friends taught me this.
If you live true to yourself, your dreams will follow, like stars following you in the night sky.
I used to give everyone gifts on the Somniel. It'd be nice to do something similar for the Heroes! I can help!
Visit: Hello! I am Alear. With my help, I hope you may forge a bond with [F].
Level: Now, I'll be able to help more!
I want to keep getting stronger.
I accept this and will push forward.
Summon: I am Alear, from Elyos. In my world they called me the Divine Dragon. Here, I will be known as your Hero.
Learn Skill: I'm grateful for this power. I'm certain we'll make a great team.
Confession:
You're safe now. But this life should never be taken for granted, especially in war.
I'm told I was once the child of Fell Dragon Sombron and nearly all of my siblings died in battle.
It could have easily been me who died instead of them. It is my duty to carry on for them.
I will fight and fulfill my role as a Hero. Because there's nothing more I want than to help you.
No matter what befalls us, I will keep fighting. I thank you for this incredible bond of friendship.
Status: I am a good dragon. Count on me to protect you.
Hm? Is something wrong? I'm here to listen, if you're willing to confide in me.
The past may be set in stone, but the choices you make now will shape your future.
If not for my mother, the Emblems, and my friends...I wouldn't be here.
I would have preferred a mortal life, but I made this choice for the sake of my friends.
Shine on, Emblem of Beginnings! Hmm, not this time. One day, Marth.
As the Divine Dragon, I aspire to save as many people as I can. As your Hero, I hope to stay by your side.

chloe2.name: Chloé
chloe2.title: Spring Wings
chloe2.description: Pegasus knights who hail from Firene and Ylisse, celebrating the spring festival in rabbit outfits. They appear in Fire Emblem Engage / Awakening.
chloe2.harmonized:
Grants Special cooldown count-2 to unit and allies from the same titles as unit. Grants 【Resonance: Blades】and【Incited】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Incited】
If unit initiates combat, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = number of spaces from start position to end position of unit during combat (max 3; that turn only).
(Harmonized Skills can be used by tapping the Harmonized button. Harmonized Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Chloé:** Firene's famous spring-festival treat was candied flower petals. What sorts of spring foods does Askr have?
**Cordelia:** Even though we pegasus knights were strict, there was one spring we enjoyed a festival. I do miss that...
**Chloé:** Sounds like we could both use a little celebration. The festival is our oyster, Cordelia.
**Cordelia:** I do believe these clothes suit me well. Though, when compared to you, I'm not so sure...
**Chloé:** I feel like a hippity-hopping rabbit in these ears! Reminds me of the ones the Divine Dragon adopted.
Visit: **Chloé:** If ever I saw a picturesque pair for the spring festival... It'd be you and [F]!
Level: **Chloé:** We did it, Cordelia! Feel that extra spring in your step!
**Chloé:** Cordelia's and my efforts have bloomed beautifully together!
**Cordelia:** I suppose my skill won't grow abundantly just because it's spring...
Summon: I'm Chloé, royal knight of Firene, here with Ylissean pegasus knight Cordelia. This festival will be a true fairy tale!
Learn Skill: **Chloé:** Thank you for this picturesque delight! Together, we'll make this festival a fairy tale to remember.
Confession:
**Chloé:** Most people in Firene were devout followers of the Divine Dragon. What about in Ylisse, Cordelia?
**Cordelia:** Our leader, the exalt, descended from a hero who once, alongside a Divine Dragon, sealed a Fell Dragon.
**Chloé:** What a heroic tale! I'm glad we both serve a Divine Dragon. But Fell Dragons in both worlds...
**Cordelia:** Yes. And Ylisse is at war with the resurrected Fell Dragon. So this is no time for me to celebrate.
**Chloé:** Of course... But this break is only temporary. There will come a time for both of us to fight a Fell Dragon.
Perhaps it's the Divine Dragon's will that we rest before our season of war. Let's rejoice in spring, together!
**Cordelia:** You're right, Chloé. Let's create warm, vibrant memories of springtime before returning to our worlds.
Status: Hmm.
"Ready for the festival?" "First, I want a plan to make the most of it..."
Conversation: **Chloé:** What a feast for the eyes! I just love seeing everyone in their whimsical outfits.
**Cordelia:** Yes, Askr's spring festivals are dazzling. This is actually my first time dressing up for one.
**Chloé:** So this has been a long time coming! Well, the costume looks great on you, Cordelia.
**Cordelia:** Thank you. Although, you look much more at ease in yours.
I can't stop worrying about what people might think, or say... *groan*
**Chloé:** Perhaps a bite to eat would make you feel better?
**Cordelia:** What did you have in mind?
**Chloé:** Some hearty folk food—like grilled gecko or deep-fried snake!
**Cordelia:** Gecko? Snake?! The realm of the edible is larger than I realized...
**Chloé:** I'm not sure you can get them here, but maybe we'll get lucky at one of the stalls.
**Cordelia:** Yes, uh, one can only hope...
**Chloé:** What sort of foods do you like best, Cordelia?
**Cordelia:** Hm. Fruit, I suppose. I am always grateful when I find a nice, red apple in the rations.
**Chloé:** Oh, what a picturesque image! We'd better get you an apple right away. I wonder if there's a fruit stall.
**Cordelia:** Well, we are pegasus knights. I can think of one way we might get a better view of the festival grounds.
**Chloé:** *giggle* A rabbit riding atop a pegasus... Now that would make for a marvelous pairing.
**Cordelia:** I'd say we make quite the pairing ourselves. Shall we get back to enjoying the festival?

framme.name: Framme
framme.title: Spring Fangirl
framme.description: A 33rd Steward of the Dragon who hopes the Divine Dragon notices her at the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I get to decorate and hide eggs?! Hmm, what should I put on this one... "Divine One, please, look my way..."
Lythos never had a spring festival. But it looked like one when Divine Dragon Lumera's flowers bloomed.
Sunshine and flowers... It's so nice! But I keep— Ah... Ah... Achoo! It's that flying flower powder! Huh? Pollen?
A spring festival with dragons from other worlds? As steward and fan club co-president, I'll make sure it's great!
Spring is about beautiful flowers! Like that blue one, or that red one... Hmm... Just like the Divine Dragon!
Visit: Hey! I'm here to present to you a festive "How d'ya do?" from [F]!
Level: Yaaay! I did it! I'm gonna hop around like a bunny now!
Oh Divine One... Spring Framme is doing her best. Nothing less.
I got too distracted...again! Vander's gonna be so mad at me!
Summon: I'm Framme, Steward of the Divine Dragon! I'm so happy to be at this festival. The Divine Dragon is...where?
Learn Skill: Now I have the power to truuuly enjoy this festival. Full Framme incoming!
Confession:
After being around all these people, I can tell you have sooo many fans, just like the Divine Dragon!
Huh? No fans? Yeah, right! You're so modest! Trust me, I can see it in their eyes. All the Heroes love you!
And the spring festival's the perfect place to give them a treat. Come on, spring is calling!
Feast your eyes on the colorful flowers! Decorate an egg! Shake hands with all your fans!
The Heroes will be so happy. I never thought a spring festival could bring this much joy! All thanks to you!
Status: In my capacity as president of the Divine Dragon Fan Club, I commend your splendid festival!
Ahh! Am I not supposed to stand here? Sorry, must've gotten turned around...
I don't really care how cute my costume is. I want to watch the people, not show off for them!
The Divine Dragon would look dignified even with rabbit ears on!
Spring's the best time of year for fan clubs. Nice, warm weather, perfect for giving out pamphlets!
If Vander and Clanne saw how much fun I'm having, they'd really tell me off...
Come on, Summoner! Let's go enjoy the festival! Or if you're too busy, I can wait around until you're ready to go.

mirabilis3.name: Mirabilis
mirabilis3.title: Spring Daydream
mirabilis3.description: A ljósálfr from Ljósálfheimr, the realm of dreams, who brings daydreams to mortals. Looking forward to the supreme napping the spring festival allows.

Castle Hall: Ahhh... The sun smells so nice...and the flowers are lovely! I bet Peony would love this too!
*yawn* The perfect napping weather. It's as if Askr has become Ljósálfheimr.
I could be friends with the one who thought up this serene festival!
I could just sit and watch rabbits eat carrots all day long... So cute! Though they do—*yawn*—make me sleepy.
I am both a ljósálfr and a rabbit. Which is my true self? *yawn* Makes me sleepy just thinking about it.
Visit: Mmm... The spring festival is...fun... We should do this every day. ...Huh? Where's [F]?
Level: The best sleep comes after working hard, so I'll do my best a bit longer.
A fluffy bed is waiting for me, so...
Huh? This isn't a dream, is it?
Summon: *yawn* My name is Mirabilis. This weather makes me...want to... *snore*
Learn Skill: *yawn* I feel so warm! Are you sure I can take this?
Confession:
The weather is so lovely today, just perfect for a nap. Don't you think so, [S]?
The warm, gentle breeze is so cozy... *yawn* ...Like being cradled in a mother's arms...
H-huh? That's strange... Tears... Oh, I yawned so big that tears formed in my eyes without me noticing.
Now is a perfect time... The sun is still high in the sky, so let's have a nice dream together in its warmth...
Status: *mumble*
Please wake up.
*groan* I'm awake, I'm awake.
I had the cutest dream. There were these little bunnies, hopping along... *chuckle*
I love these flowers. *sniff* *sigh* They smell incredible...
The sun is so nice. It feels like the warm embrace of a caring mother.
Let's take a nice long nap. Maybe it'll be next spring by the time we wake...

sylvain3.name: Sylvain
sylvain3.title: Spring Flingster
sylvain3.description: Heir to the title of Margrave Gautier. He has rushed to the spring festival in the hopes of making new acquaintances. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses

Castle Hall: I bet these bunny ears would suit Dimitri too... I'll have to ask His Highness next time I see him.
Of course the people of Faerghus were grateful for spring. It meant a welcome respite from the bitter cold.
I've always enjoyed lively places! And all these gorgeous bunnies hopping around the spring festival... It's great!
It's silly to get in your head about yourself or your nobility during the spring festival. Let's just enjoy it, eh?
I do look good in just about anything! Though, it's not surprising. I do put a fair amount of effort into my looks.
Visit: I made certain to deliver this to you. It's a spring-festival notice from [F]!
Level: Hopping straight into such power... It must be a blessing of the bunnies!
I...don't want to embarrass myself in front of the cute bunnies.
Chase after two rabbits, and you'll catch neither... I gotta remember that.
Summon: I'm Sylvain Jose Gautier. I rushed here as soon as I heard about the festival! Where's all the cute bunnies?
Learn Skill: Got it! I won't disappoint. Watch as I liven up this spring festival.
Confession:
I do enjoy spring, which is said to be the season of new encounters.
Actually... This is the season I met the professor and all the Blue Lions!
So I know it to be true. Spring is about starting anew and having hope for the future...
And the festival is a springboard for this! And it's only just getting started!
There's got to be something new out there just waiting for me... Perhaps some cute bunnies!
Wanna search for some spring encounters with me, [S]?
Status: Yeah?
Well, that settles it. I really do look great in anything.
You're excited about the festival too, right? I didn't think you got excited about anything.
You can tell it's spring when the ladies start wearing bright colors.
*yawn* This is what I call napping weather.
So many bunnies. What is it with women and bunnies?
Somehow I can't see Prince Dimitri coming to a festival like this.
**Come on. Come on! Not even one time? Just repeat after me:** Hippity. Hop.

linhardt2.name: Linhardt
linhardt2.title: Spring Snoozer
linhardt2.description: Heir to House Hevring who has found time between his studies of Crests to participate in the spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Even Askran royalty are willing to don rabbit costumes during the festival... I appreciate how relaxed this place is.
I wouldn't be surprised to find that a napping Crest exists somewhere in another world.
I see you insist on doing patrols, even during a festival. Why don't you rest with an afternoon nap instead?
You mean you don't take naps during the spring festival? Why not? It's the perfect cozy atmosphere.
I never thought I'd enter another world dressed as a rabbit. Perhaps I'm dreaming...
Visit: Hm? Where am I? Last I remember, I lay down for a nap... Is this not [F]'s castle?
Level: I never would have believed I could become this strong. It really does feel like a dream.
Are we all wrapped up? Good. I'm going back to sleep.
I can't help but doze off when fatigue strikes. I'd imagine that to be true for any Hero...
Summon: Who are you? You interrupted my nap. I am Linhardt. I thought I was merely dreaming of a spring festival...
Learn Skill: I really would have preferred a soft pillow instead, but to respect your thoughtfulness, I will accept this gift.
Confession:
**Someone at the festival taught me this expression:** "In spring one sleeps a sleep that knows no dawn."
Supposedly it means that spring nights are so comfortable, you end up sleeping through the morning.
I will admit I tend to sleep through the morning no matter the season, but there's something about spring...
What do you suppose makes spring so exceptionally comfortable? It may be worth researching.
Actually, if this is the perfect season for sleep, shouldn't we all be sleeping instead of having a festival?
I'm only joking. It's easy to see how much fun everyone is having. Just look at their smiles.
No demands, no conflicts... If only this dreamlike moment could last forever.
Status: I'd rather be napping, but I'll go to the festival if you insist.
*start* Cut that out, would you?
Do I really have to wear this? It's a bit too...festive for my taste.
Spring has the best weather for outdoor naps. That's a fact.
Rabbits are the cuddliest animals in existence. Just being near them makes me sleepy...
*yawn*... Think I might slip away for a snooze...
If even you're having fun at the festival, then maybe it's not so bad after all.

merric3.name: Merric
merric3.title: Wind Pontifex
merric3.description: A mage who grew up with Marth, the prince of Altea. After two wars, he and Marth's sister, Elice, have learned to read each other's hearts. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Protecting Princess Elice is my wish... Just as I wish to fulfill my duty in supporting Prince Marth and Altea.
After the War of Shadows, we returned to Khadein where Master Wendell left me and Arlen in charge.
Khadein is a truly remarkable place. But I always intended to return home once I completed my magic studies.
My plan was to leave Khadein... For this I considered Arlen a more worthy successor to Master Wendell.
When the war is over and peace is secured, I wish to be by Princess Elice's side.
Visit: I am Merric, a mage from Altea. Is it true you're friends with [F]?
Level: I will expel every ounce of my power to protect those precious to me!
Caring for others is a power not unlike magic. It grants you courage, which is why I'm not afraid!
There's nothing to be ashamed of, as long as I keep progressing.
Summon: I am Merric, a mage from Altea. I offer all my strength for my homeland and those I love.
Learn Skill: It takes a healthy mind and body to use magic properly.
Confession:
My homeland, Altea, has recovered from the brink of annihilation thanks to Prince Marth and his efforts.
I have no doubt he will end the war and bring peace to the land. And I wish to aid him as best I can.
Likewise, I wish to stay by Princess Elice's side, forever, so she is never alone or without protection.
I plan to establish a new school of magic like Khadein's once the war is over and certain matters are resolved.
It'll keep me busy, and Princess Elice waiting, but it'll all be worth it to address her as my partner.
What's that? That'll make me Prince Marth's brother-in-law? That's right! I hadn't considered that.
H-how should I approach him? This could be more challenging than mastering a new magical technique!
Status: This new garb is far too impressive for me. Don't you think?
*startle* Come now. That was uncalled for.
Master Wendell's steady hand guided me, and now I am myself a master of spellcraft.
Training in Khadein was a challenge, but a fulfilling one.
The mightier I become, the more vigilant I must be. I cannot lose myself in power.
If Princess Elice could see me now...
If this power allows me to be of greater aid, I am contented.

caeda6.name: Caeda
caeda6.title: Marth's Faithful
caeda6.description: Princess of the small kingdom of Talys. She and Prince Marth, who fled from Altea to Talys, share a close and unbreakable bond. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Princess Nyna said that your feelings gain wings to reach further when you express them in words, or so I hear.
Talys, where I grew up, is only a small island kingdom, but maybe that's why people there looked after each other.
While you are pushing so hard to help out others, don't forget to take care of yourself too.
What would you like to talk about today, [S]?
Through words we can communicate heart to heart. I believe we should do so when reaching out to enemies too.
Visit: It's always a pleasure. I've come here with greetings for you from [F].
Level: Do you have someone you love? Stay close to those who are important to you, and look after them.
When I left Talys, I made the decision to remain by Marth's side, no matter what happens.
Please don't try to hold me back. I can't stay safe in the castle while everyone else is out fighting.
Summon: I have faith in the love we feel for those who are important to us. Do you trust in love?
Learn Skill: I will do my best to repay this. Thank you, [S].
Confession:
War devastates the heart, no matter how lovely the words used to speak of it. No matter how strong we are.
Those who are stronger may have a bigger heart to inflict wounds upon. To the point that it sometimes breaks.
I have witnessed such sorrow. Even Marth is just a person who has been in many battles and has many scars.
Grust, Macedon, Dolhr, Gra, Aurelis, and Archanea... Marth has fought battles throughout the continent.
Though driven from his kingdom, he is responsible for leading an army, so he has no freedom to complain.
That is why I wish to support him. To get closer to his strong heart. Even if I am asking for too much.
It's odd how freely I can speak with you. Thank you for listening. Putting my feelings into words refreshes me.
Status: As long as Marth is safe, consider me satisfied.
*gasp* Did you sneak up on me? That's rude, you know!
Some say I should be more genteel. Frankly, I disagree.
The Order of Heroes has helped me realize how much there still is to learn.
I'm not used to fighting in a cape. I should ask Marth how he does it.
Marth... Please, let me stay by your side forever...
If you ever need a shoulder to lean on, I'm here. I care about you too, you know.

yuliya.name: Yuliya
yuliya.title: Princess of Grust
yuliya.description: Surviving member of the royal family of Grust, and sister to a twin. After the War of Shadows, Wendell took her under his protection. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Am I lonely without my brother? Why, of course! Jubelo and I have always been together, even after Grust fell...
By Master Wendell's hand, Jubelo and I escaped captivity. Yet Lorenz... gave his life. What more can one do?
Others refrain from even glancing my way for fear of a rebuke. So I am quite used to being left to my own devices.
Ogma has proven his loyalty. One day, I will have an equally stalwart guard of my own.
Hold your head high, Yuliya... You are of Grustian make, a true brave heart. Now, to show it!
Visit: Pledge your integrity by lending aid to Grust, as was already pledged by [F].
Level: Oh Jubelo...where have you gone? I cannot waste my time in worry. Must I always be the strong one?
Me, frightened? Absurd! I will fight for us both. Such is my duty, as the eldest twin!
You brute! Come no closer!
Summon: I am Yuliya. I have been separated from my dear brother. Do you happen to know where Jubelo is?
Learn Skill: Well done. I see you are astute enough to recognize true strength.
Confession:
Who's there? Ah...Summoner, I see. You believe you are skilled enough to aid me, [S]?
Come, why don't you use that power of yours to summon my brother, Jubelo.
He is likely out there all alone, and a storm of tears is about to rain down. I would know...
No, no! Not me! I am the esteemed princess of Grust! As a royal, I do not allow grief to overcome me.
I know...in my heart...Jubelo is safe. In fact, he could be foolishly worrying about me at this very moment.
*sigh* Talking this out appears to have calmed my nerves.
I do appreciate the concern you have shown me today, [S].
Status: Never show weakness.
On your feet!
I am Yuliya, princess of the kingdom of Grust.
With a weak-willed brother like Jubelo, it falls to me to be the brave one.
I find Kris rather an intriguing figure... No, not in that way!
I pray Lorenz is watching over us.
If I feel so inclined, I may seek out your company again.

arlen.name: Arlen
arlen.title: Mage of Khadein
arlen.description: A mage entrusted with Khadein's future by the sage Wendell. He is envious of Merric, who inherited Excalibur. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Excalibur was rightfully mine, and yet Master Wendell gave it to that whelp Merric instead. Utter foolishness!

Until Master Wendell returns from his business with the White Sage, it is up to me to ensure Khadein's safety.
Hmph. I suppose Merric bears some responsibility as well...
You wish to socialize with me? I'll allow it. Until I unravel the mystery of your power...
Why should we assist Altea, traitors to the Archanean Empire who invade their very neighbors?
If I could use that summoning power of yours for my own purposes, none would dare stand against me.
Visit: You. Yes, you. Tell me all you know about how Heroes are summoned by our ally, [F].
Level: One such as Merric could never hope to surpass me. Any who side with him will experience my wrath!
Why? Why did he choose Merric over me? It must be because that wretch is Altean nobility...
Khadein has sworn fealty to Emperor Hardin. Do not forget that.
Summon: I am Arlen. Pontifex Wendell has entrusted me with maintaining Khadein's independence.
Learn Skill: Hmph. Perhaps compassion for others is worth more than just a passing thought...
Confession:
Merric has always been second to me. I was Master Wendell's pupil before him.
And there has never been a single moment when that oaf's magic has rivaled mine. So why...
Why did our master bequeath the tome Excalibur to him when it was rightfully mine?
You cannot imagine the agony I felt upon hearing this absurd decision.
The one who inherits Excalibur will succeed Master Wendell. Who could suit that position better than me?
And now, Merric has led Altea's forces right to Khadein's doorstep, jeopardizing our independence.
Has the fool forgotten that we allied with Archanea?
His reckless crusade must be halted before it causes further damage.
**Then, Master Wendell's eyes will be opened to the truth:** that only I am fit to take his place!
Status: I am Arlen. I study magic in Khadein.
*startle* What do you think you're doing? The nerve...
How could Master Wendell give Excalibur to Merric instead of me?
You will find that I am quite different from the simpletons around here.
Merric? Don't be foolish. How could I ever consider someone like him a friend?
I have always been alone...
So you're the summoner. Hmph. I expected you to look more impressive, somehow.

castor.name: Castor
castor.title: Loving Son
castor.description: A hunter who lived in Talys and joined the war effort so he could afford medicine for his sickly mother. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Mother, I'm so ashamed. I haven't any money to send you right now.
I owe much to Prince Marth of Altea.
Well, you see, I um... I don't have any money to live off of, so...
I should have expected no less than genuine kindness from Heroes. Think of all the medicine I can buy now.
Talys is a small island. I wasn't a very successful hunter there, so I decided to try my hand at mercenary work.
Visit: My mother is a kind person... Oh, you are also very kind, or so [F] always says!
Level: I couldn't make much money in Talys, so I came all the way out here to try my luck someplace new.
My mother's sick, and...well, that's obviously why I need money.
Please forgive me. I need to stay here and make money. It's important.
Summon: My name is Castor. I'm a hunter from Talys. I need money to buy medicine for my poor, sick mother!
Learn Skill: I can hardly believe how kind you're being to someone like me... I know! I will offer up my life for you!
Confession:
What am I going to do? Oh, whatever in the world am I going to do?
*sniffle* I hate to put my burdens on you, but my mother is sick and I need money to buy her medicine.
