I... What? You know that? I've told you about it several times already? R-really? Are you sure?
N-no... It's the truth. My mother is sick and I do need money to pay for her medicine.
I know what people say about me behind my back. They call me the conman from Talys... Cruel, isn't it?
But... No one's heard the rumors here. I'm thankful for the kindness everyone has shown me.
Oh, Princess Sharena! Um, have I told you about my mother...
Status: Oh! *chuckle*
I am Castor—from Talys. Truth is, m-my mother's sick, and I'm short on money?
*squeal* What? M-my mother? She's sick! Really sick!
My mother is ill. To afford her medicine, I would do anything.
Princess Caeda and Prince Marth are so kind! Even to somebody like me...
So many friendly faces here.
Oh... What should I do? I'm in trouble!
My life is yours!

ike7.name: Ike
ike7.title: Of Radiance
ike7.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to Elyos. Resides in the Ring of the Radiant Hero. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn / Fire Emblem Engage.
ike7.emblem:
Enhanced Engaged Special
If foe's Range = 2 and unit's or foe's Special is ready or triggered before or during this combat, reduces damage from foe's next attack by 40% (once per combat; excluding area-of-effect Specials).

Castle Hall: I thought I recognized some of the faces here as fellow Emblems, but no... They're Greil Mercenaries.
When I was in Solm, I got to join the royals on their free-spirited travels. Nothing beats music at a campfire.
Champion, Emblem, Hero... It doesn't matter what I'm called. I fight, I get stronger. That's all there is to it.
Not needing food was convenient, but you won't find me complaining about a post-training spicy meat dish.
The ring? It was big, with a silver halo surrounding a blue center stone. I think it'd suit you well.
Visit: I'm not used to traveling alone... Do you mind directing me back to [F]?
Level: I have gained much. My reward for fighting against powerful foes.
It's fine, as long as I can become an even stronger Emblem.
Let me fight more. I'll show you I can make a comeback.
Summon: I'm Emblem Ike. I was brought here to protect this world? Well then... I won't let you down.
Learn Skill: This is your way of telling me I need to get stronger, right? Well, that's what I plan to do.
Confession:
Oh, it's you. Nothing's wrong, I just— I feel...strange not being able to sync my power with others.
The desire for strength is ingrained in me, no matter my form. But as an Emblem, my instinct is to share it.
...If my ring happens to be summoned here, then engage with me. I know you'd be a fine partner, Summoner.
Until then I'll keep training, so when that day comes, I'll have even more power to share with you.
Status: Yeah...
Yeah, I glow and float around. So what?
Huh, I keep forgetting you can touch me in this world. That wasn't possible in Elyos.
I hear we Emblems can actually eat food in Askr. What kind of meat you got?
My Emblem Ring doesn't need constant polishing.
I used to be summoned by invocation. You had to say, "Fight on, Emblem of Radiance!"
I can't help but look back on my time at Solm Palace fondly. I even miss that endless desert...
I'm curious about the Ike you know in this world. Is he strong? Maybe we should spar for the right to fight at your side.

frobin7.name: Robin
frobin7.title: Vessels of Fate
frobin7.description: Robin and Chrom, meeting now out of time. Is it an illusion or a miracle created out of the bonds that will one day form? They appear in Fire Emblem Awakening.
frobin7.duo:
Grants【Rally Spectrum】and【Dual Strike】
to unit and allies within 7 rows and 7 columns centered on unit.
【Rally Spectrum】
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit during combat and if unit's attack can trigger unit's Special, grants Special cooldown count-X to unit before unit's first attack during combat (X = 1 if unit can trigger the "unit attacks twice" effect or if unit's maximum Special cooldown count is reduced (Special trigger is accelerated); otherwise, X = 2). (That turn only.)
【Dual Strike】
If unit initiates combat and is adjacent to an ally with Dual Strike (excluding unit), unit attacks twice. (That turn only. Does not stack.)
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Robin:** Hey! Don't scare me like that! Huh? N-no! Of course I'm not hiding my hand.
**Chrom:** Girls are so mysterious to me, Robin. Princess Sharena is akin to my sister Lissa, who's nothing like Emmeryn!
**Robin:** An older sister and a younger sister... I sure hope Chrom can be reunited with them soon.
**Chrom:** Times like these are for training! Hi-yah! ...Phew! There, I got some good practice in.
**Chrom:** Emmeryyyn! Lissaaa! Where are you? Hm... I should really stick with them...
Visit: **Robin:** Bonding with others is wonderful! Here, a token of friendship from [F].
Level: **Robin:** My right hand... Is this where my power comes from?
**Robin:** Even though he acts foolish at times, Chrom's not a bad person... I'm sure his sisters must worry.
**Robin:** Be careful, Chrom! Don't go looking for trouble all by yourself. And remember, look before you jump.
Summon: My name's Robin, this is Chrom. When I woke up we were together, so...yeah...
Learn Skill: **Chrom:** Thank you. Let us know if you ever need help with anything.
Confession:
**Robin:** Is that called...a Brand?
**Chrom:** Yes. I believe it's the same Brand carried by all House Ylisse's bloodline. Why?
**Robin:** I just...have something similar is all.
But mine's nothing as sacred as a Brand. It's more like an evil omen of an unlucky fate.
**Chrom:** Sounds like we're two of a kind! Maybe that's why we were together when you woke up.
**Robin:** Oh, Chrom... How I envy your outlook. Everything's so simple for you.
Status: We work well together! Incredibly so.
Conversation: **Chrom:** Hah! Yah!
**Robin:** Your swordplay is incredible, Chrom.
**Chrom:** Kind of you to say, but I beg to differ. I have a long way to go yet.
**Robin:** Well, you're a prince. You have a lot of other things to worry about.
**Chrom:** Don't I know it. Supporting my sister in her role as exalt, protecting the people of Ylisse...
My dream is to become strong enough to do all that and more.
**Robin:** I admire that. I wish I had that kind of direction in my life...
**Chrom:** There's nothing special about it. How do you like to spend your time? Let's start there.
**Robin:** Well, I love to read. Tomes, tactical texts...whatever I can get my hands on, really.
**Chrom:** Hehe. Total opposite of me. I'd rather be just about anywhere than a classroom.
**Robin:** Really? But books are so interesting! Each one is like a window into another world!
**Chrom:** If that's how you feel, maybe you should consider becoming a tactician someday.
You could use the tactical skills you learn from reading to help lead in times of conflict. Save lives.
**Robin:** What a wonderful idea. Yeah, I really like the sound of that.
**Chrom:** You'd be doing me a favor, that's for sure. With you as my tactician, I'd never have to pick up a book again!
**Robin:** Hey, weren't we supposed to be talking about my dream?
Hee hee... Anyway, thanks, Chrom. I think I know what I need to do.

mrobin8.name: Robin
mrobin8.title: Fated Vessel
mrobin8.description: A boy who knows little of his father or the nature of his birth because he left with his mother soon after being born. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Oh, I need to keep my right hand hidden. Mother said so, after all!
Mother is a kind person. She doesn't mention the past much... Only that Father was a strict man.
Ahh... A lively place I have no memories of. I could get used to this!
Mother always said we'd live out our days in peace... In a place where no one knows us.
Thanks for worrying about me, [S].
Visit: "I hope we can stay good friends." Yes, that's it. I did it! Oh wait... "From [F]."
Level: What's going on... My right hand's throbbing!
That's about all I got for now...
*sigh* There's no point in bringing me along any further.
Summon: H-hi. I'm...Robin. Who are all of you?
Learn Skill: I'm not sure why, but this feels... familiar.
Confession:
You aren't from this world either? Hmm... Just like me...
Then why are you here? Where did you come from? Did you come alone, [S]?
Oh, sorry... I didn't mean to blurt out so many questions. Truth is, I have these same questions about myself.
I thought I might have been brought here because of what's on my hand— Oh, wait. I better keep that to myself.
I feel a sort of bond with you, like I know you... If I stick around, will you promise to teach me lots?! Hehe.
Special: All I want is to help!
Status: My name is Robin. I hope we can get along.
*chuckle* You surprised me. What a prankster!
I really like reading. What about you?
There are a lot of other kids my age here! Maybe I can make some friends.
I feel like I have a lot to learn about the world. Will you teach me?
I haven't thought too much about the future... But I hope I can help people.
You know...I hope that I can be like you one day. When I'm older.

lissa4.name: Lissa
lissa4.title: Littlest Princess
lissa4.description: Second princess of the Halidom of Ylisse and little sister to Emmeryn and Chrom. She is still young, but she is nevertheless kind to her core! Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Sneak a peek at my big sis's forehead or my big bro's right shoulder, you'll spot their Brand in a jiffy!
I'm a princess of Ylisse, ya know! Now that my big sis is queen—I mean, exalt—I guess I better act the part.
EEEEK! Do you see that huge, creepy-crawly bug over there? I bet it's poisonous! Get it away, quick!
There are so many really cool adults around here! I sure hope Emmeryn and Chrom grow up to be like them!
I won't be one of those lazy nobles who can't handle buttering their own crumpets! That's never gonna be me!
Visit: Hiya! You must be a pretty good person, since you're friends with [F]!
Level: I'm gonna put everything I've got into helping Chrom protect Emmeryn! Just watch me!
Hey, tell me you saw that! You did, right? Am I awesome or what?
Whoa, watch it! You better not think I'm just some little girl you can poke fun at. It's "milady" to you, buster!
Summon: In she comes, like a shooting star... Brace for impact—KABOOOOM! Startled you, didn't I? Name's Lissa!
Learn Skill: Hey, thanks a bunch! I'm gonna make good use of this from here on out!
Confession:
Ugh! I just don't know what to think. Oh! Hey, could I maybe ask you a question, [S]?
It's totally fine to bash the bad guys around a bit with a KERSMACK here or a KAPOW there, right?
See, my big sis said something about wanting Ylisse to work toward solving its problems with words.
But, hey, it's not like we're the ones throwing the first punch! We can't let them get away with that, right?
Even I know that becoming the new exalt is gonna make Emmeryn a target for a whole lotta dangerous people...
That's why Chrom keeps working to get stronger. So he can protect her and our people. That's my plan too!
I love my big sis to pieces and wanna keep her safe, so I'm gonna help Chrom do exactly that!
Status: Hiya! My name's Lissa. You wanna have some fun?!
Hey, cut it out! *giggling*
Didja know my sister Emmeryn is actually a real queen? She's so cool!
My big brother Chrom? He's really good at whacking stuff with his sword!
Shhh! Watch me slip this slimy frog down Fredrick's shirt...
When I'm a grownup, I'll be a real proper lady, just like Emmeryn.
Hey! Let's play hide-and-seek! You be "it," OK? Close your eyes, count to ten, and NO PEEKING!

emmeryn2.name: Emmeryn
emmeryn2.title: Selfless Exalt
emmeryn2.description: Took the throne as exalt of the Halidom of Ylisse before the age of 10. She wishes for a time of peace, without violence. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I must remain a reliable elder sister, not just for Chrom's sake, but for all of Ylisse.
Ylissean royals, descendants of the Hero-King who banished the evil dragon, are beholden to bring peace.
I heard the king of Askr was a fine person. I sure would have liked to learn from him directly.
I know real life can be different from how you picture it. But we can still have ideals... We just need a leader.
Kingdoms are not for war. Should they not exist as places for people to live calm and peaceful lives?
Visit: I am Emmeryn. I study law and am here to wish you good health from [F]!
Level: War leads only to hatred... I do not want that for Ylisse. And not for my brother and sister either.
I am not like my father... I can bring peace to the world...without fighting. I will prove it!
No one wishes for bloodshed. There will come a day when everyone understands that...
Summon: I am Emmeryn, standing as the new exalt of Ylisse. Please...do be patient with me.
Learn Skill: I sense that you have a gentle heart. I wish to follow your example.
Confession:
Father taught us that, as descendants of the Hero-King, we are to rule Ylisse and other kingdoms with force.
Had Father not died so suddenly, Chrom would have followed in these footsteps and invaded our neighbors.
I would never wish for such a terrible future as that.
Perhaps now that I have succeeded to the throne we have a chance to change our fate.
I will exercise my power to rid Ylisse of brutality. I wish for no army. And no war.
True peace comes through dialogue, not force. And is it not my duty as exalt to enact this?
I know change is far from instant. But bit by bit, my wish for peace will come true.
Special: Please, let this be the end.
Status: I have to believe.
Please, let this be the end.
Chrom and Lissa are both still so young. I need to stay strong for them.
I want to create a country—no, a world, of peace.
I am not always sure of myself, but the support of people who are important to me gives me courage.
Someday all of my people will have faith in me... Someday.
I fear I am not strong enough yet, but I wish to be of service nonetheless.

frederick3.name: Frederick
frederick3.title: Youth in Service
frederick3.description: A squire of the Halidom of Ylisse and personal guard to Prince Chrom. His diligent and earnest personality earned him his honorable post. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
Lord Chrom deserves only the most well-trained, battle-tested guardian.
I hone my skills that I may fulfill that role.
Lady Emmeryn accepted the role of exalt quite young. My lord Chrom shares her noble blood.
My hobbies? I do enjoy foraging for mushrooms. When I happen upon a rare one, I nearly shake with glee!
I fear no man or beast! Well...except perhaps that mountain wolf. Those memories are best left buried...
Please, be silent... I am honing my concentration by focusing on this candle's flame until it dies out.
Visit: Hail and well met! I am Frederick, and I come bearing a gift from our ally [F].
Level: This honor is more than I deserve, but we must not celebrate until victory is fully ours!
Perfection is only attained through practice and time. I must persist in my training with diligence!
What is Lord Chrom's status? I must verify his safety with my own two eyes, and quickly!
Summon: I am Frederick. I strive to become a knight worthy of Prince Chrom.
Learn Skill: I thank you. This humble knight is moved by your generosity.
Confession:
Greetings, Summoner. How may I be of service? Oh, is there a matter you wish to discuss?
Ah, yes, the previously empty castle room. If I recall, you cheerfully agreed to my request concerning that room.
The Ylissean royal family requires suitably royal lodging, so I performed a few minor renovations.
After I deep-cleaned the carpets, I noticed that the walls looked quite barren. So I knit this banner...
It depicts Exalt Emmeryn, flanked by her honorable siblings. All three are draped in gleaming regalia.
Topped with the holy crest of House Ylisse, it evokes a sense of youthful vigor and new beginnings.
What's that? You'd...like me to move it? Perhaps a more public locale— Oh gods! I've forgotten to add a motto!
If I added cloth here... How about... "All Fidelity and Esteem unto the Illustrious Exalt and Her Kin!"
Yes, that should do. My thanks for your aid, friend! I will correct this grievous error with utmost haste!
Status: I am Frederick. Please command me as you see fit.
*exclaim* Argh, this won't do... A proper knight must never be taken by surprise!
I spend my days training to become a knight in service of Lord Chrom.
Lord Chrom and Lady Lissa are still young, so I must be their shield.
Fear not! I have cleared all dastardly debris from our planned route.
Carrying so many pebbles is proving quite the challenge... But if I simply consider this training, no burden is too great!
If I am able to further develop my skills while in your service, I will be pleased.

azura7.name: Azura
azura7.title: Song's Reflection
azura7.description: A princess of Nohr who was raised in Hoshido. Her song echoes across the battlefield, with her faith in Corrin granting her strength. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
We mustn't avert our eyes from the path we've chosen, no matter how unpleasant it may be.
We can get upset, throw a fit, cry about it... Then we must push past it.
Corrin is a Hoshidan raised in Nohr, yet I am a Nohrian raised in Hoshido... Both royals with strange fates.
There is value in not allowing oneself to be caught off guard. So my voice, as my weapon, is always at the ready.
Hmm, the way the sunshine filters through the leaves in the courtyard... It reminds me of Castle Shirasagi.
Singing at the castle's communal baths really lifts my spirits. I feel I give my best performances there.
Visit: I do hope your bond remains strong forevermore with [F].
Level: Corrin, do know that you will never be alone, so long as I draw breath.
This song I sing so boundlessly... May it span the waters of space and time and reach Corrin's ears...
So be it. I must work harder from now on.
Summon: My name is Azura, the one whose destiny is entwined with Corrin's.
Learn Skill: I am grateful for your sentiments, forever etched in my heart.
Confession:
My bond with Corrin took shape not only due to our similar upbringings... We share an idealism for the future.
Corrin taught me the world is replete with joy, but it was not until I saw it for myself that I truly appreciated it.
Compassion for others, procured from the care shown to me, is now the strength that drives me forward.
Even if the world turns against us... No matter what darkness lies before us... Our bond will never shatter.
Side by side, Corrin and I will dispel the dusk with our combined light and bring a new dawn unto the world.
Status: We go together.
Let us sing.
Corrin and I are reflections of one another, as are the paths our destinies have followed.
If you have a moment, could you direct me to a suitable place to practice my singing?
Somehow, while wearing this outfit, I feel more deeply connected to Corrin.
No matter the distance between us, Corrin, we will always be together.
You and I share a connection that I cherish as well.

hayato.name: Hayato
hayato.title: Diviner of Reppu
hayato.description: From the Wind Tribe, who live within Hoshido. Despite his age, he has a rare talent for magical techniques. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: This castle is pointlessly large and poorly lit. *whimper* I am not afraid. Ghosts do not exist... They do not...
I aided Corrin at the chief of the Wind Tribe's request, not as some excuse to get out and see the world.
Ah! Don't just come up and start talking to me! All the time I spent on this charm... I have to start over now!
Many in the Order of Heroes are still children. B-but, not me. I am far too mature an adult to play with them.
It is pointless teasing me. I cast a spell that will send anyone who tries to do so whirling away in a tornado!
Visit: Of course, I can deliver a message on my own! I'm not a child! Curse you for doubting, [F]!
Level: Did you see what I did?! Nothing is beyond me!
Heheh. No less than everyone should have expected.
Urgh! This cannot be the limit of my power!
Summon: I am Hayato, a diviner from the Wind Tribe. You clearly have Lady Luck's favor, for I have decided to aid you.
Learn Skill: Not bad. I shall accept this with appropriate gratitude.
Confession:
I had never left the Wind Tribe village until I met Corrin.
Traveling with Corrin's entourage showed me that the world is vast and filled with such a variety of things.
But the world is so much more than just Hoshido and Nohr.
Other worlds connected through Askr hold countless sights I have yet to behold, all just waiting to be seen!
I yearn to see more! I want to travel to all the lands! Don't you want to do the same? You could accompany me.
...N-not because I would be lonely out there, but I would allow you to carry my bags if you wish!
Special: Your time is at an end.
Status: I caught that look! Don't think I didn't!
Whoa! You could try acting more mature!
I'm not being conceited when I say that you would be lucky to have me on your team.
This paper contains very special charms of my own creation. They are extremely effective.
Of course I go out on my own at night. I-I have nothing to fear.
How often must I remind Fuga that I am no longer a child?
You should be grateful I am going to aid you in your endeavor.

yukimura.name: Yukimura
yukimura.title: Puppet Master
yukimura.description: Tactician in the service of Queen Mikoto of Hoshido. Uses automatons to do battle. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The replenishment of soldiers and restoration of morale are important considerations in the art of war.
My father was also a tactician, but I gained much of my knowledge about war from King Sumeragi as well.
The Order of Heroes is truly a well-organized army. I admire the skill of their tacticians.
Do you have an extra set of glasses? I'm embarrassed to admit that I tend to break mine soon after I get them.
I engage in battle using automatons. I create them as well.
Visit: My name is Yukimura. I come with a message of your enduring friendship with [F].
Level: Excellent results. It was worth the effort to develop a strategy.
All according to my calculations.
That's strange. Was there something I miscalculated in my preparations?
Summon: I am Yukimura, a humble tactician from Hoshido with much to learn. I'm pleased to make your acquaintance.
Learn Skill: This power is...fascinating. I shall utilize it in my next strategy.
Confession:
I once developed terrifying strategies utilizing traps and automatons to eradicate the enemy.
My strategies were exceptional, but King Sumeragi, ruler of Hoshido then, reprimanded me severely for them.
He said one must not kill the enemy without also considering the lives that we are chipping away at.
His words reminded me the enemy has family too. Each loss of life brings devastating sorrow with it.
It is enough to subdue one's enemies without destroying them completely. That is the true measure of victory.
I am motivated to be the kind of tactician who is able to analyze a situation and bring about true victory.
The kind of victory in which as many lives as possible are saved.
Status: I am Yukimura. I still have much to learn. That said, I am here to help in any way I can.
Oh... You should never do that. Push people, that is.
In Hoshido, I served as Queen Mikoto's tactician.
I think Corrin's return is a message from the gods.
It is said that the Yato was forged to be the key to peace in our world.
Queen Mikoto foresaw her own death.
You are the one I am to serve now, correct?

mozu.name: Mozu
mozu.title: Tragic Start
mozu.description: Joins Corrin after being saved from attacking monsters. Is good at farmwork and hunting. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Not sure if I got a knack for fightin' or what, but I don't mind hard work— my sole redeemin' trait!
The village and all its fields were ruined, and my mom died protecting me. So now's my turn to fight back.
You could grow some mighty fine crops in Askr's soil. Just need some high-quality fertilizer—dragon dung!
I never planned on getting this strong, but working the fields every day sure does make for some good trainin'.
I'm hanging some fruit to dry right now. It'll make for some nutritious and yummy snacks!
Visit: Wow... Fancy place! Here, I brought you something nice from [F].
Level: This even surprises ME! I gotta say, you won't find villagers as strong as me in just any old place.
Nice! Let's keep up this pace!
Darn it all! So close! Why aren't I gettin' stronger?
Summon: I'm Mozu, from a village in Hoshido. I can hunt, farm...and I'm sturdy as heck. I'll do my best to help!
Learn Skill: For me? Really? I'll do my best!
Confession:
The people in the Order of Heroes are so great. Just like the people in my village... But they're gone now.
War stole everything from me, including my own mom. And it left only sadness that spread like wildfire.
All I want is to end this spread, not just in Hoshido, but in Askr too. And that's what I plan to do!
I'll give the Order my all! And in doing so, I'll honor the people from my village. That's my hope, anyhow.
The Order of Heroes is my family now, and I'm not gonna lose my family again.
I don't know how helpful I can be, but I'll sure as heck give it my all!
Status: I'm Mozu! I'm here to lend a hand!
Gah! Oh, it's just you. You scared the tar outta me!
Farm work and hunting is all I've ever been good at.
Around my village, you weren't a real hunter until you'd bagged yourself a boar.
I'm not afraid! I might even save you or your friends.
I'm gonna do my best. Mother, everyone...watch over me.
It's not fancy, but I cooked up a little something. Give it a try?

candace.name: Candace
candace.title: Sly Snatcher
candace.description: A treasure hunter who travels the world. She uses her agility to get the better of her opponents and make off with what she can snatch. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I seek the most valuable riches. Only genuine, one-of-a-kind treasures are good enough for me.
You want to know who I really am? Hehe... That might be the greatest mystery of them all.
No matter how clever the trap, I know I'll be able to evade it. Behold my impressive agility!
You won't always see me. Quick as a wink! That's my motto! I pop in with a flash and go out with a bang!
Order of Heroes, huh? I hope they're heroic enough to keep pace with someone of my expertise.
Visit: I bet there's some excellent treasure here. This place is just as nice as [F] said.
Level: Leave it to me! I have an explanation for every occasion!
Surprised at how nimble I am? It takes lots of practice to get this good.
What's this? Well, this is quite the disappointing outcome for such a notorious treasure hunter.
Summon: Locater of legendary riches! Genius! Explorer! Notorious treasure hunter Candace has arrived in Askr!
Learn Skill: Finally! A treasure suitable for one of my skill!
Confession:
Worlds of possibilities... I suppose the real treasure of Askr would be the so-called "gates to other worlds."
As you can imagine, the prospect of visiting different worlds holds a lot of appeal for a treasure hunter.
Hunting for treasures beyond Nohr and Hoshido in a variety of different worlds sounds thrilling, doesn't it?
You're going to tell me Askr's peace comes first, right? My keen treasure hunter's eyes read you like a book.
Have no fear! Peace is an unrivaled treasure for many, and I won't allow anyone to take it away.
If they try, I'll snatch it back in a flash with my unrivaled agility. Nothing is impossible for a genius, after all!
Status: I'm none other than Candace, the notorious treasure hunter!
*yelp* Why, I never! You're behaving as though I've stolen something!
If there's treasure to be found, leave it to Candace.
Well, well... It looks like there are mountains of treasure in this world, ripe for the picking!
Some of these Heroes look a little green. Hope they can keep up with the likes of me.
There must be some scheme I can deploy to distract the prince and sneak into Askr Castle...
Care for a game of tag? I'll warn you, though. I'm quick as a wink.

loki3.name: Loki
loki3.title: Trickster God
loki3.description: God who plays at chaos, deriving great joy from the messy nature of mortal emotions.

Castle Hall: I don't mind my usual attire... However, I can't help but feel this suits me better.
This world... It's like a game board and you're all just pieces. Who knows who will win or lose...
The power to bring even gods to their knees... Are you aware of how extraordinary that is? Hmm?
Chaos is the sole staff that will crack a person's mask. Once it shatters and falls, their true character is exposed.
It has been some time since Thórr last saw this form. Hehe... I can imagine the surprise on her face.
Visit: Hmm... Surprised by what you see? I got the same expression from [F].
Level: My oh my... Quite unexpected. It is wonderful that I am able to grow so strong.
*yawns* Such a common future of victories is sure to bore me.
I suppose I could lift another finger for you. Next time, perhaps.
Summon: At last, we meet while I am in this form. I am Loki. I bring pleasure to humankind and lure them to chaos...
Learn Skill: Such fundamental change can evoke joy in gods and mortals alike. Don't you agree?
Confession:
Do you know what the most interesting thing in this world is, [S]?
It is an unpredictable future, one that holds hope, despair, bliss, confusion... All the emotions one can imagine.
A predictable future is boring, but the unexpected is never mundane, don't you agree?
It's all the more exciting to me when plans go awry. Hehe... A welcoming chaos.
If you know who wins and loses from the start, what is the point in playing the game, hmm?
I have high hopes for the sort of future you'll show me. One of extraordinary unpredictability.
Special: Try a little harder for me.
Status: Yes?
I can take care of you...
Come...closer...
My name is Loki, and I must enjoy myself, darling. Remember that.
Thórr is an old friend of mine. I do so love teasing her. Don't you?
Now that you've seen what I look like as a god, what do you think? Are you ready to fall in love all over again?
I don't know who will win or lose. That's what makes it all so interesting.
Even the gods must bow their heads to you. How wonderful it must be, to have the gods at your beck and call...

lumera3.name: Lumera
lumera3.title: Corrupted Dragon
lumera3.description: The former Divine Dragon Monarch revived by the Fell Dragon. Wishes only for more time with her child. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I am done waiting. This time, I will be with my child, and no one will dare to get in the way.
I was entirely alone after losing my kin. That child brought an end to my loneliness. That is all I remember.
Do you know what it is like to wait for someone? To wait forever without knowing if you will get to see them?
A thousand years of waiting to only get mere hours together... I refuse to accept that outcome.
When I sensed my child, I flew here as fast as my wings would carry me. Here, we can stay together forever.
Visit: It matters not who I am here to serve. Please, tell me if my child, my Alear, is in this place too?
Level: Mother worked so very hard for you... Here... Come see what I've done.
Do you think my child would be impressed to see this?
How frustrating... I must have power to protect my child.
Summon: I am Lumera, a dragon resurrected by the power of Lord Sombron. I am here to see my beloved child.
Learn Skill: Has something changed? It feels as if...perhaps, but I cannot quite tell.
Confession:
Alear? No, I am mistaken. You are the summoner, yes?
Does this endless fighting not seem futile? Why not avoid it and live only for the one most important to you?
There was a time when I fought too. For peace in Elyos. Hmm... When is this memory from, I wonder.
It's not important now. My child is all that matters to me. I would rather die again if I cannot be with my Alear.
If that happens, summon me again and again until we're finally together. What do you say? Pinky promise?
Special: I am the Divine Dragon Queen!
Status: Where is my child? Are you trying to keep us apart?
Don't tell me you're frightened. I have a friendly face, do I not?
I would ask you not to come between me and my family. I wish only to see my child.
Heroes, villains, war, peace... None of it matters to me. Let me leave it behind.
Obsession? I am a mother who loves her child. How is that obsession?!
I have waited a thousand years for you, Alear. Do not make me wait any longer...
Were it not for your call, summoner, I would still be all alone in that temple. I am...grateful.

veyle2.name: Veyle
veyle2.title: Fell Successor
veyle2.description: Daughter of the Fell Dragon. Full of destructive urges, she wishes to excel her siblings to be the sole successor to their father's power. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Ah... My head hurts. This worthless other me should just die. There is no purpose for that defect here.
It is just as well that my brothers and sisters are dead. They need not have ever existed. I am Father's only child.
I look into the eyes of my victims as I crush them. Their final moments of despair are my greatest masterpieces.
I have nothing—no part of me nor any possession—that is completely my own. Nothing, except this one outfit.
I will not acknowledge as my sibling a fool who would masquerade as a Divine Dragon. I will kill Alear...
Visit: I am Veyle. I will let you live for now. I must be nice to you because you are [F]'s friend.
Level: This power is great. I must test it right away to be certain it is worthy of me.
I did it, Father.
I am not supposed to be a defect...
Summon: I am Veyle, the Fell Princess and Father's only living child. Give me the Emblem Rings.
Learn Skill: It is pointless giving me offerings. I will use all the resources at my disposal for my father.
Confession:
Your power and your divine weapon intrigue me. You can summon beings from other worlds, can you not?
By using you, we could grant Father's wish without having to open a portal to other worlds ourselves.
*chuckle* I find you quite interesting. We have been together on countless battlefields. I might call you a friend.
Shall I burn down a village for you, or slaughter someone of your choosing? Neither? You are difficult to please.
If we are to be friends, I shall obey for now. When the time comes, I do hope you offer yourself to my cause.
Status: If you don't have an Emblem Ring, you're of no use to me.
Heroes, you said? And you don't need rings to summon them?
This outfit was given to me by my father. You like it? You have a good eye, if nothing else.
The Four Hounds are not here? Just as well. I can carry out my plans without them.
You'll find I'm perfectly agreeable—so long as you don't get in my way.
I am my father's true child. I am Veyle!
The other Veyle does not seem to awaken here... Did you murder her for me? How sweet!

ursula4.name: Ursula
ursula4.title: Blackened Crow
ursula4.description: Member of the Black Fang assassins. Adores the Fang's puppetmaster, Sonia. Following her death, she has been made into a morph. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Lady Sonia takes no interest in pathetic failures. So...I will continue to win. No one will get in my way.
The Black Fang belong to Lady Sonia. Yes... They will offer up their lives to fulfill her every...last...wish.
Something strange about me? Nonsense! Do your eyes take pleasure in deceiving you?
Useless people...do not deserve to live. Yes... Why don't I clean up this mess? I can just kill all of them...
Failure is unacceptable. Must...be perfect. Hehehe, yes... Lady Sonia... My only joy is in serving you.
Visit: Are you truly worthy of existence, you...sworn friend of [F]?
Level: Oh, the joy of serving a perfect being... To deny it...is foolish.
All I need to do is...dispose of the useless... Yes, that is all. Hehehe...
This... This will not measure up to Lady Sonia's expectations.
Summon: I am Ursula, the Blue Crow... I have value. I will...prove it to you.
Learn Skill: Yes... I shall please Lady Sonia even more with this power!
Confession:
Do you know the joy of being chosen, [S]?
Everyone...yearns for perfection. It is a natural desire, to be without faults... To be perfect. But it is pointless...
There is but one perfect person who already exists. Serving this person... That is the only suitable desire.
Hehehe... I dare you to understand it! There is joy to be had in servitude.
It is an honor to be chosen. It is what gives my life...value.
I...will never be a failure. I will devote my life to Lady Sonia, forever... Ahahaha!
Status: *chuckle* What do you mean, what's the matter with me? I'm the same as ever.
Bold of you, to lay a hand on me...
Only a few are chosen. The rest are simply...refuse.
Nino? Ah, yes... That insipid child.
All will be as you desire, most gracious Lady Sonia...
I will never be a failure. Never.
Prove to me that you are worthy...

nergal.name: Nergal
nergal.title: Traitor to Nabata
nergal.description: A fiend who steals human quintessence to create living constructs called morphs to do his bidding. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Ah... I sense an abundance of fine quintessence within you, a mark of human willpower.
A war in Lycia would have generated a glorious amount of quintessence in one blow. That is my desire.
Friendship is a trivial pursuit, a waste of life. Do not be such a fool as to sacrifice yourself for it.
Flesh that cannot endure the tremendous power I grant will be corrupted before tomorrow.
My beloved morphs are beauteous works of art... Necessary in the pursuit of my life's dream.
Visit: I have my eye on a fine sacrifice, one who possesses a strong spirit... Yes... [F].
Level: Be prepared. You are to be witness to a power that overwhelms all!
I shall exterminate these insolent rats.
Hm... Do not think for one second I can be impeded by such trivialities.
Summon: I am Nergal. And this is Askr, hm? Its cracks and crevices are filled with fine quintessence, just waiting for me.
Learn Skill: Hwah ha ha ha... Excellent! With this power, I shall rule over fate itself.
Confession:
Why did I yield to your summon, [S]?
I shall tell you why... I desire the quintessence from this place, a place where worlds converge.
Imagine the essence that dwells within Heroes from other worlds. It shall be mine in due time.
The Order of Heroes will make a splendid army of morphs, yes?
And you... Not to fret... Your quintessence shall be of great use. I assure you that. Hwah ha ha!
Special: Hwah ha ha ha ha ha!
Status: *chuckle*
I am Nergal. You may choose to obey me, or...
Foolish to think you could lay a hand on me. What hubris.
My beloved morphs, my beauteous works of art...
Death feeds me. Death pleases me. I am the essence I consume.
I was a fool to believe you were truly my friend, Athos...
I left something behind. Something valuable...
Your weakness runs deep. I will never comprehend one such as you.

lloyd2.name: Lloyd
lloyd2.title: Vengeful Wolf
lloyd2.description: Member of the Black Fang assassins. After the loss of his younger brother, he dies himself, only to be made into a morph by Nergal. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Who am...I? Lloyd, the White Wolf... of the Four Fangs.
Back then... Before father brought that...woman to us... The Black Fang were different.
Nino...move on. Live your life. Linus... He will...
This body... Everything feels so cold in this body.
I will use my blade only against villains... That is the pride of the Black Fang, after all... Right?
Visit: Do you know... [F]?
Level: I will eliminate those responsible for my brother's death... One by one, methodically.
I will get to each and every last one of them... Those responsible must... be brought to justice.
But Linus... I...
Summon: I am Black Fang. I am...Lloyd.
Learn Skill: I vow to slay your killers! L-Linus?
Confession:
I have no concern for who you are, [S].
This country...peace...does not interest me. Not after what was done to my brother.
There is only one thing I want— I need... My brother Linus's killers... Are they here? In this world?
I will find them. I will end them. No matter if my body or soul crumbles to nothingness. No matter what...
Status: *grunt*
I am...Fang. I kill bad people...
Who are you? What are you...to me?
The Fang's... Laws? I can't remember...
I don't understand... Who is bad and...who is not?
Linus...
Family...family... My family...
You...are not a bad person.

sharena3.name: Sharena
sharena3.title: Pillars of Peace
sharena3.description: Sharena of Askr and Veronica of Embla together at the bridal festival, dancing as one.
sharena3.duo:
Grants unit another action, and if Canto has already been triggered, re-enables Canto. (May be used only if unit has already acted and an ally within 3 spaces of unit has entered combat during the current turn.)
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Veronica:** If Bruno were to see me in this wedding dress... Would it make him happy?
**Sharena:** I want Askr and Embla to walk hand in hand into the future, like happily married couples do!
**Veronica:** Whoever marries Princess Sharena will have their hands full. Perhaps... that's just a form of marital bliss?
**Veronica:** Once the festival is over, can I bring this bouquet stand back to Embla with me?
**Sharena:** What kind of person do you think Veronica is likely to marry? It's so fun to think of all the possibilities!
Visit: **Veronica:** We look good in our bridal gowns? Oh, why thank you. We bear a gift from [F].
Level: **Sharena:** Make us happy for the rest of our lives!
**Sharena:** Princess Veronica! Let's spread joy in our wedding gowns!
**Veronica:** Princess Sharena...will you please not step on the hem of my dress?
Summon: Your Sharena is here, dressed in her bridal gown! Come on, Princess Veronica, introduce yourself... Smile!
Learn Skill: **Sharena:** I have a feeling lasting happiness may just be within our grasp!
Confession:
**Sharena:** That was hard work, right, Princess Veronica? But the festival was a huge success. Everyone looked so happy!
**Veronica:** Hmm...that's good. I am tired though. I can't wait to get out of this dress...
**Sharena:** What?! But this could be an opportunity to practice dressing for your wedding day.
**Veronica:** Oh...I don't know when that will be.
**Sharena:** How about we make a promise? Whenever we do get married, we'll attend the other's wedding!
**Veronica:** OK, Princess Sharena... I promise.
Status: Oh... Such a beautiful gown. Is it? Thank you.
Conversation: **Sharena:** Hehe... What a treat to get to dress up in these lovely gowns! Don't you think?
**Veronica:** I do not dislike mine. But as for marriage itself, I had never given it any thought.
**Sharena:** Now that you mention it... I suppose I haven't seriously considered it either.
But when I see all those happily coupled Heroes, I do think to myself, "how nice..."
Ah, I look at them and my hopes that one day, I could... Hnng... Enough of that!
**Veronica:** When you are to marry, you have to consider how the situation would impact the future king.
**Sharena:** Alfonse? Oh, I see what you mean. Royal politics and that sort of thing.
**Veronica:** I wonder what sort of person the prince is likely to marry.
**Sharena:** Well, for starters, whoever it is will have to be intelligent, supportive, kind...
Strong enough to protect him from harm, of course...
**Veronica:** Ah, Princess Sharena... You are the image of an overbearing sister-in-law.
**Sharena:** How rude!
**Veronica:** Well, I'd feel the same if Bruno were here—were he to marry someone lacking... I could not tolerate it.
**Sharena:** See? You're no different from me!
**Veronica:** Perhaps, but we should focus on finding good companions to marry. Not making and fulfilling checklists...
**Sharena:** You're right... During the festival, I'll focus on what it means to be a bride!
**Veronica:** Very well. So shall I.

lapis2.name: Lapis
lapis2.title: Mighty Bride
lapis2.description: Prince Alcryst's retainer. Afraid of getting her outfit dirty, she is behaving a little more modestly than usual. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I'm not really a bride, but...if my mom and dad saw me dressed like this, I just know they would cry.
I always wanted a sweet and simple wedding like those back home. We'd cut the potato cake together, and...
What good is this dress if I can't rip it up to make bandages for allies who get injured on the battlefield?
That grass may be an edible variety! But, heh, I suppose I should refrain from eating grass in a bridal gown.
Do you think I'll get to put on a ring from a special someone someday? If so, I'd like to make their ring myself.
Visit: I have a wedding invitation for you! Actually, looks like it's just a greeting from [F].
Level: That's right! I'll always protect my allies, no matter how I'm dressed.
I did my best! Though I seem to have gotten some dirt on my sleeves. No problem! I'll clean them up later.
I-I'll never make excuses. No claiming this outfit tripped me up or anything like that.
Summon: I'm Lapis. This outfit looks expensive, but I vow to be of use in battle while still keeping it clean!
Learn Skill: I swear I will use this power to help everyone in the army find happiness!
Confession:
Hah! Yaaah! Rrraaah! Phew... Oh, hello, Summoner. No, I'm not training right now, I'm making a ring.
I got used to fighting with an Emblem Ring on. Now I feel like I fight better with a ring on than I do without.
Dressing like this makes me wish for a wedding ring on my finger, but...this is a time of war. I should focus.
I made this one with a pretty stone I picked up. I think it would look really nice on you. Here!
Oops! Th-that was your ring finger! In that case...I vow to at least bring you lasting happiness on the battlefield!
Status: *sigh*
This dress is so fancy. The lace alone must be worth more than all my other clothes combined.
Oh no! Tell me I didn't get the dress dirty?! I'd better tend to that stain right now!
Who do I wish could see me in this dress? Well, um...that's kind of a secret.
Beautiful? You must be talking about the dress, right?
"Would you...marry me?" Did that sound OK? Wait, it is all right for me to do the asking, isn't it?
These clothes are so fine... They look like they were made for Prince Alcryst or Citrinne.
It won't interfere with combat, of course. Even if I were in the middle of an actual wedding ceremony, I could step out and defeat our enemies, then get right back to it.

nel2.name: Nel
nel2.title: Stoic Bride
nel2.description: A dragon from another world donning bridal dress and thinking of the precious one she lost long ago. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I stand here dressed this way, holding flowers from a special garden, aching for someone I can never see again...
My world was bound for destruction. Would people still have sworn vows to one another if they had known?
I hear marriage is an oath one swears to uphold until death. Does this mean no vow reaches those we have lost?
I have no interest in weddings, but I would like to see my brother host one. Hm... That would be precious.
A legend says if a bride has an old thing, a new thing, a borrowed thing, and a blue thing, they will be happy.
Visit: I did not mistake this for a wedding venue. I came to deliver a greeting from [F].
Level: I am very happy with how strong I have become.
I feel you should applaud my efforts for doing this well in these restrictive garments.
I suppose I should vow to be more successful next time.
Summon: I am Nel. Why am I in a wedding gown? It is absurd to think I would desire this after what I have survived.
Learn Skill: Did you wish for my happiness? Then I offer you my gratitude.
Confession:
Is it true you can summon even those who have fallen in their worlds? And from worlds long since extinguished?
If so, that means you might one day summon the Divine Dragon who fell in the world I come from.
Should that happen, I beg of you, allow me one meeting.
A promise was given that we would be together again, and I could finally say what I never could before.
But, no. I will not say it, after all. My heart was crushed back then. Please forget everything I just said.
I am happy enough with you and the many comrades I have here now... alive with me.
Status: Hmm...
I look forward to celebrating victory in battle with you, not my wedding day.
Stop tugging at my dress, or you will soon find yourself dealing with a dragon.
Even as a Fell Dragon I understand the happiness of being joined together with the person you love.
I would like to see the expressions on the faces of Rafal and the Four Winds if I were to really become a bride.
These windflowers... I remember them blooming in a garden I can never return to. They bring back memories of someone precious to me.
My Divine One... I truly wish you could have seen me wearing this.
Since I come here dressed in bridal attire, I suppose I have no choice. I pledge to make you happy...by slaying your enemies, that is.

embla2.name: Embla
embla2.title: Closed-Off Bride
embla2.description: God of the closed kingdom, which shares her name. She has arrived at the bridal festival adorned with a wedding dress of sorts.

Castle Hall: The mortals chose Askr over me. No one chooses me. So I ask, what is the meaning of me dressing as a bride?
I was not lonely...not even a little. I have lived a secluded life. But, despite that... Urgh...
Damn you! If Askr were to see me like this, I would be shamed for a thousand years...
This gown... Why does it fit me so perfectly? No... Elm?! What did you do?!
This is a...bridal gown? Hm-hmh... Ha-hah... Wait! Do not get the impression I am enjoying this.
Visit: I am Embla... What?! This outfit? It is a trap! The one responsible is [F].
Level: I will play along with your little dress-up game, just this once... Better make it worth my while!
You say I am pretty? Such obvious false flattery...
You deserve but the wrath of my hate... For you have brought me more shame than this gown.
Summon: I was tricked into coming to this... bridal festival. Curse you, Askr! You and that damn summoner.
Learn Skill: You believe a charity of this caliber will soften my heart? Hm-hm-hmh...
Confession:
I...remember... Long ago, some newlywed mortals came seeking my blessing... Yes, to me...
They were...so full of joy. And what did I say to them? What did I...think of them?
Mortals once loved me, you know. However, that was long ago. I have since closed that chapter...
But here...at a festival like this...I feel a strange sensation, long forgotten, seeping out of my heart.
Uuurrrgh... Curse you! For meddling with my heart! I will never forgive you for this... Never.
Status: *grunt*
Did you summon me only so that I may suffer?
*grunt* I warned you before. Do not touch me.
None would choose me. They would choose one like Askr, as the mortals did.
A partner in life... One whom I would make an undying vow to... No.
A wedding dress, is it?
If someone were to love me... Then I...
Will you stay by my side? Could you be...

alcryst2.name: Alcryst
alcryst2.title: Tender Groom
alcryst2.description: Second prince of Brodia. Feeling unworthy of such outstanding garb, he nevertheless carries himself with an appropriate air of nobility. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I feel...different now. I vow on these fine clothes to protect the people of my homeland...and everyone here.
Brodian weddings are truly inspiring. When I see my parents' portrait... I long to be that happy.
If I had to, I'd guess my brother will marry first. And it will be beautiful, apart from me bawling my eyes out.
Once again, I sit, staring at an ant trail and daydreaming of one day being worthy of someone's company.

My current bow is designed like a harp. And it's true, I do know my way around stringed instruments.
But I must not torment this place with a melody played by a worthless piece of trash like me.
Visit: I'm truly sorry you have to see me... and in this...wedding garb... I was sent by [F].
Level: I pledge my devotion to this result... Though I doubt it will accept a proposal from me...
As long as you're happy. Then...so am I.
This is how pitiful I am. And even when I dress in eye-catching clothes for a happy occasion...
Summon: Sorry. I must have squashed your anticipation of a wonderful groom. I'm Alcryst, scum of the wedding...
Learn Skill: Oh... This outfit grew even more blinding. My wish is to become invisible beneath it.
Confession:
Hello. I am sorry for afflicting your eyes with my presence. And still...in this outfit, with no plans to marry...
Hmm? Yes...I am the second prince of Brodia. One day, I shall marry... at least I hope to.
For now, all I have is the ring my father gave me when I was born. It's for whomever I choose to marry.
It even matches my eyes... Red and blue mixed together, but it's far too pretty for me.
If the day ever comes when I can give it to someone, I'll wear this outfit and hold my chin higher than I do now.
But for now, please watch over me a bit longer... I know it'll be unpleasant for you, but I'll be forever grateful.
Status: *sigh*
I-it's me, the worst of all grooms...
Ahh! I know these garments are too nice for me, but I seem to be stuck in them!
I vow to fight well, in sickness and in health...though I know I am unworthy.
The best I can do for these clothes is serve as a talking coat rack for them to hang from.
I wish I could show this to Father. I think...he would be happy for me.
These clothes would look a million times better if my brother were wearing them.
Marriage? I'm not destined for anything so grand. But, if I did meet someone...I would try to make them happy.

mcorrin7.name: Corrin
mcorrin7.title: Child of Dawn
mcorrin7.description: A Hoshidan prince raised in Nohr. Guided by destiny, he fought against Garon, the king of Nohr, alongside his companions. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: As the new king, Ryoma will reign over a wonderful era for Hoshido, I'm sure.
If your choice was between the home you were torn from or the family who raised you, which would you choose?
Hinoka and Sakura cried waterfalls at the final coronation celebration.
When I close my eyes, I can hear Azura singing... It's as if she's right beside me.
I pray that the people of Hoshido and Nohr take hold of each other's hands and walk happily together, forever.
Visit: I was told to tell you "I hope you are well!" from [F].
Level: We will live our lives to the fullest, in honor of those who lost their lives on the battlefields upon which we stood.
We all try our best each day... Yet, in an instant, all that could be ripped away by those without mercy.
If misery or happiness become so commonplace, one can no longer be distinguished from the other.
Summon:
I'm Corrin, and...you must be [S]...
That is a good name, I must say.
Learn Skill: Ah, this feels good! Perhaps we work well together.
Confession:
Sometimes I think about what a world without war would be like...
In my world, two countries were in constant dispute. If one invaded the other, peace was not an option.
If one considers the history of repeat conflict and the relationships that ensued, perhaps...war is inevitable.
Then perhaps the fierce battle in which I fought my siblings was a necessary bridge to cross as well.
But despite all of it, my mother's wish for undying peace... It still lives on in the people of Hoshido.
Ryoma once said, "It is not such an easy path to tread." But still... We can't forget our hope for that world.
So we will advance onward, for the sake of our future, with courage and hope. Right, [S]?
Special: This is the path I chose!
Status: A Legendary Hero? No, no... You must be mistaking me for one of my siblings.
I pledge to be someone who believes in people, and works for their betterment.
If you introduce me to your friends, I'll introduce you to my friends!
Why don't we spend some time getting to know each other?
Nothing could ever replace my brothers and sisters. Each and every one of them is special to me.
Both of my families mean so much to me.
We'll create a future together. With the two of us side by side, we can take the next step forward.

micaiah7.name: Micaiah
micaiah7.title: Dawning Maiden
micaiah7.description: A young woman who saves people with her empathic abilities and powers of foresight. A member of the Dawn Brigade. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: To some, I am the Silver-Haired Maiden, savior to the hopeful. I will not let them down.
One needs just enough money to live on. Any more than that, and the soul becomes impoverished.
I'm highly familiar with the back roads of Nevassa. They're perfect for staying concealed.
Hey, you look tired. I could rub your back, if you'd like. I always find that soothing.
I'm exhausted from talking to so many people. I just need some time to myself.
Visit: What a beautiful castle. It's just as [F] described.
Level: I was touched by people's kindness. Now, I'm scared to lose it. Very scared.
I'm not afraid. I am a member of the Dawn Brigade, after all!
No matter the manner of man, the goddess judges with an even hand.
Summon: My name is Micaiah. Don't be afraid.
Learn Skill: Thank you, [S].
Confession:
This brand is proof that I have both beorc and laguz blood in my veins, making me anathema to both...
There's no way to hide how very slowly I age, so I just keep moving through Daein.
I know this truth will cause trouble. Therefore, my time in the Dawn Brigade is temporary.
But I will not forsake Daein, as my power is necessary for its liberation. So I stand here, ready to fight.
This is my choice, no matter what Sothe has to say about it.
Status: Hm.
Sothe and I do match now, it's true. I might blush...
*startled* Yune? Oh... You scared me.
*sigh* The color green brings me so much comfort.
Side by side we battle, united.
For the sake of Daein's future, I'll never back out of a fight.
When did you get so tall, Sothe?
Sothe and I are glad to stand by your side.

sothe3.name: Sothe
sothe3.title: Dawning Zephyr
sothe3.description: A thief from Nevassa. Micaiah holds a special place in his heart. A member of the Dawn Brigade. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Ensuring Micaiah is safe and we are together... That's everything to me.
After the war, Crimea was stretched thin and struggled to remain stable. They couldn't worry about Daein too.
It's not smart to overexert yourself. You should rest, please...
I feel partial to the Dawn Brigade, but if it comes down to it, Micaiah's safety is what matters most to me.
You can manage most things with a sharp knife.
Visit:
Don't worry. There's someone who will vouch for me by the name of [F].
A contact of yours, right?
Level: I'm prepared to cut anyone down who stands in our way!
I don't take orders. The Dawn Brigade will protect the people of Daein. It's why it exists.
I only do as you say.
Summon: I'm Sothe, of the Dawn Brigade, here to protect Micaiah. Where is she?
Learn Skill: If this is what's meant to be...
Confession:
I'm afraid I can't hide it from you, so I might as well just tell you...
Micaiah has looked the same ever since she found me when I was little. She doesn't age normally, you see...
She's spent her whole life hiding, concealing what others see as cursed blood.
But despite their persecutions, she was resolved to end people's suffering after the war.
That's why she started the Dawn Brigade, to protect the people of Daein. And I will protect her.
Micaiah is more important to me than my comrades or anyone in Daein.
Special: I'll never let go of hope!
Status: *sigh*
A new weapon... A new me.
Hey! Keep your hands to yourself.
I am brimming with power.
To be honest, I don't care about the gods. They have nothing to do with me.
I've always chosen to fight for the smaller things in life and the people close to me.
Together, Micaiah and I will fight for our future.
Thanks to you, I'm stronger than ever. I'm truly grateful.

edward.name: Edward
edward.title: Blade of Justice
edward.description: A boy from the streets of Nevassa, the capital of Daein. A member of the Dawn Brigade. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Micaiah sure is rambunctious. What?! Oh, nothing. I'm just talking to myself.
Curse Begnion. They walk over Daein like they own it and let villains do as they please here. I can't forgive them.
Ugh! I get so nervous before a battle!
I'll go in under cover fire and cut the enemy down with my blade. That's a safe way to approach a fight, I think.
The members of the Dawn Brigade fight for the people of Daein.
Visit:
Are you [S]?!
I'm supposed to deliver best wishes from [F]!
Level: If the soldiers were gone, there would be no one to wage war. Quite the simple solution, don't you agree?
I'm going ahead to fight them off! The time is now!
Don't treat me like I'm just a kid! I'll show you I can keep going!
Summon: You can put your worries to rest. You have me. I'm Edward, a swordsman and member of the Dawn Brigade!
Learn Skill: All right, I get it. I could use some improvement. I'll accept this happily.
Confession:
Everyone has experienced terrible things because of the last war.
The occupying empire, Begnion, sent all able men to prison camps to work as forced labor in awful conditions.
Now they steal valuables and food from the women and children and leave them to suffer without.
You get it, don't you? Everything Begnion takes from us, the Dawn Brigade is fighting to take it back!
Damn it, though! We can't do it all by ourselves. Even I know that.
But with Micaiah in the Dawn Brigade I know something good will happen. I just have this feeling!
Status: I'm Edward—a proud member of the Dawn Brigade!
*startled noise* Oh, it's you. Do you sneak up on everyone like that?
I just don't get it. Daein is our country... Why do we have to live in hiding, like prisoners in our own land?
Leonardo's a good friend. Together, we can get through anything.
Micaiah can be surprisingly rough around the edges. What? *laugh* It's true!
Military life is strange. Not sure what I'll do once the war is over, though.
You're fighting for a peaceful life too, huh? I know what it's like.

leonardo.name: Leonardo
leonardo.title: Freedom's Arrow
leonardo.description: An aristocrat from the hinterlands of Daein, alone in the world as a result of war. A member of the Dawn Brigade. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I'm sure the existence of Daein's long-lost prince is the subject of speculation for many.
Daein suffers as it does because we lost the war and Crimea won. That is the sum total of the story.
I wonder if everyone from the Dawn Brigade is safe. I hope we can all be together again someday.
Work hard, but be sure to rest to the fullest. If you push yourself too hard, then our effort has been for nothing.
I'm truly grateful to live in this castle. It means I don't have to camp out every night.
Visit:
You're [S], right?
I knew right away. Micaiah's foresight is always spot on.
Level: How is it that people are born, only to die so swiftly?
Phew, I made it! I've got your back— don't be rash.
At least I'm still alive. I'll try my best to keep up.
Summon: My name is Leonardo. May I join you? I think I could support you well with my bow.
Learn Skill: Just dreaming gets you nowhere, but you mustn't lose your hope.
Confession:
Fighting for one's country... It's a noble cause, but it's also scary, isn't it?
It's so easy to go too far. To try to revive a memory at the expense of many lives...
I think it's nice to have a dream, but maybe it's better sometimes to have a more realistic goal.
Daein lost the war, and the empire's occupying forces are mighty. Nothing can be done until we recognize that.
I can't take on such a heavy battle because of petty grudges or resentment. But even so...I'll fight.
The Dawn Brigade exists so we might restore the days of Daein's people living without fear of violence.
Status: *sigh*
I'm Leonardo, a member of the Dawn Brigade. It's a pleasure to meet you.
What's this?! I think you should try to restrain yourself a little.
My utmost desire would be to live a peaceful life in Daein.
It's great to have a dream, but sometimes you have to wake up to reality.$k
Edward and I are each other's best friend. We're family.
Summoned into another world... Why did it turn out like this?
I don't know how much I can accomplish with only my bow, but I will use it to fight alongside you.

jarod.name: Jarod
jarod.title: Nevassa General
jarod.description: General of the Begnion forces sent to Nevassa. With the support of Duke Numida, he ruthlessly dominated the locals. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Silver-Haired Maiden... Priestess of Dawn... Whichever they call her now, her instincts are keen as they come.
The role of overseer is a dull existence. A little fresh game to hunt is just what I need.
Unbelievable! If it's not one thing, it's another. Why am I always stuck leading the buffoons?
Argh, dratted bird! Yes, get that mangy, flying bag of bones away from me!

If you are a soldier of the empire, you will follow your superior's orders promptly and without hesitation.
It's so simple, yet the filth fail to understand it.
Visit: What am I being used for? A mere messenger? What insolence! Damned [F]...
Level: Don't expect an easy fight. Before I die, I will see each of you dead in front of me.
I live as a proud soldier of the empire. I choose death rather than settle as a commoner to survive.
Grrr... Useless... That's as far as we go today. I advise you to withdraw, [S].
Summon: Don't mistake me for a lenient general. You will carry out my orders promptly and without hesitation. Am I clear?!
Learn Skill: Hold on—I have to tie my scarf a specific way... There. Now, what is your business with me?
Confession:
I am here, so...what is it you have to ask me at this hour? Let me guess... It's about how I treated Daein...
Do you know the horror of their past atrocities? Hm? I apologize for nothing. I regret nothing.
Daein is no victim in this. That said, they will be the end of me. There is no salvation in war, after all.
Duke Numida used the occupation army to conceal his injustices, then left us. We are living proof of his evil.
Should we have pleaded our case to the apostle? Nonsense... That, right there, would be true self-destruction.
I would rather choke on my own vomit than accompany the senate to the grave.
We are proud soldiers of the empire! Begnion's superior army will strike fear into those wretches from Daein!
Special: You've got to be kidding me!
Status: I am General Jarod of Begnion. I advise you not to forget my name.
What was that? You there! Watch where you're going, worm.
You will follow my orders promptly and without hesitation.
We live as proud soldiers of the empire!
I am sorry for nothing... I regret nothing.
It is better to face your foes and die in glory...than to live in fear of their pursuit.
Don't mistake me. Things will be done one way. My way.

gullveig3.name: Gullveig
gullveig3.title: Glittering Sunlight
gullveig3.description: Gullveig, the Golden Seer, and Seiðr, Goddess of Light, shining together with the summer sun, sparkling amongst the waves.
gullveig3.duo:
Grants unit another action. (May be used only if unit has already entered combat during the current turn.)
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Gullveig:** By myself, I would certainly hesitate. Yet, with her by my side, I might well be able to take this step forward...
**Gullveig:** I never imagined such a future where I could relax alongside the children of Midgard...
**Seiðr:** Even though she keeps silent on the topic, I can feel the peace that has taken hold of Gullveig's heart.
**Seiðr:** Take my hand and come with me. I've found a spot of shade beneath a tree where we might cool down.
**Gullveig:** I was given this outfit with the hope that I'd enjoy my time here. I wouldn't humor just anyone...
Visit: The sunlight shines on the ocean, and I have a summer message for you from [F].
Level: **Seiðr:** The summoner has given us this time to enjoy ourselves. Let us embrace it.
**Gullveig:** I will not allow anyone to interfere with our precious summer memories.
**Seiðr:** Oh my. I-I'm sorry... The sun's rays have made me dizzy...
Summon: I am Gullveig and this is Seiðr. We wish to spend the summer with you.
Learn Skill: **Seiðr:** The light dancing upon the summer ocean gives us power.
Confession:
**Seiðr:** Look, Gullveig. The ocean! It is glowing!
**Gullveig:** What a beautiful golden sea...
**Seiðr:** There is no war upon the water, and there is only laughter on the beach. This is the meaning of paradise.
Gullveig, let us combine our strength, so that we can protect these joyful days forever.
**Gullveig:** Yes. Our mutual acquaintance would want that...
Status: "Is this attire...appropriate?" "Well..."
Conversation: **Gullveig:** The heat is merciless... Let's rest in the shade a moment.
**Seiðr:** That sounds lovely. How are you enjoying your trip to the sea?
**Gullveig:** I never imagined it would be possible for me, as the Golden Seer, to spend my days like this...
Yet here I am on the beach, with the children of Midgard. Nothing short of a miracle could have allowed this.
**Seiðr:** That's the work of the summoner! Who else could manage such a feat?
**Gullveig:** Heh. I remember my time with those feelings you have now...
I was always so caught up in my destined, my revelation...
**Seiðr:** What?! You— The intent behind my revelation to the summoner was to save the world—from you! That's all.
**Gullveig:** Still lying to ourselves, are we? I was once like you, of course, so there is no sense arguing...
I wish to grow closer to the summoner. Is that so wrong?
**Seiðr:** I suppose that depends on what you mean when you say, "grow closer."
**Gullveig:** I mean...reclining in the shade together, watching the clouds, the summoner's head resting in my lap...
**Seiðr:** While that does sound nice for you...
I may lose my composure were I to come across such a sight...
**Gullveig:** Really... And if we were to walk along the beach, watching the sunset, and we held—
**Seiðr:** You may hold each other's hands!
...That is, if I may join you. The summoner does have two hands for holding, after all.

nerpuz3.name: Nerþuz
nerpuz3.title: Beach Chaperone
nerpuz3.description: Goddess from Vanaheimr, the realm of light, and god of the land. Visiting the sea only so she can enjoy the summer sun with the lovely children of Midgard.

Castle Hall: The ocean is my brother Njörðr's domain. Given how poorly we got along, I had no love for those waters.
As a goddess, I preside over the land, but perhaps there is value in time spent near the ocean now and then.
The sun's rays are strong today. You must not forget to drink plenty of water, [S].
So this is a frozen treat? The foods children of Midgard make are always so cute.
I am pretending to be like a child of Midgard in this summer garb. What do you think? Does it suit me?
Visit: You're the one then. I've heard of you. Shall I give you a hug in [F]'s stead?
Level: The adorable children of Midgard are watching. Can you really blame me for being excited?
I am not one to be bothered by a wave of this size.
Perhaps I do not get along so well with the ocean after all...
Summon: I am the goddess of the land, Nerþuz. Ah, behold how the cute children of Midgard gather by the summer ocean.
Learn Skill: I appreciate the warm summer sun as a necessary element for the growing of bountiful crops.
Confession:
It seems I've grown fond of the ocean here, [S].
Or perhaps it is spending time with children of Midgard by the ocean that I have grown so fond of.
The happiness in their smiles as they play in the waves, bathe in the sun's rays, or partake of a cool drink.
I get the utmost satisfaction and joy just from watching them. My heart is overflowing with it.
They may lack the power of a god, but that is what compels me to want to protect and support them.
Hehe. Ahh, you dear children of Midgard are truly the most precious creatures.
Status: Oh, the joys of the sea... We'll make this a lovely summer yet.
Gah! Sea spray everywhere!
With the Njörðr being the god of the sea, I usually keep my distance.
Oh! Refreshments? You are too kind.
Drifting away from the land makes me uneasy. Can you keep close?
There's an undeniable beauty to the sun setting on the sea...
That sunburn is adorable. I just want to hug you...

olivia4.name: Olivia
olivia4.title: Wavecrest Dancer
olivia4.description: A dancer from Ylisse. Enjoying the summer sun and the way her swimsuit moves as she dances. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: It's so odd to me that the sound of the waves should be so calming.
Of all the places I've traveled in my career, the summertime sea is one of the most pleasant.
They're selling shaved ice! Why don't we go over and get some together, [S]?
I feel like I'm being stared at. Is there something wrong with my swimsuit?
The warm summer sun has me flushed. It's making me dance a little better than usual as well!
Visit: Hello. Um, p-please pardon the swimsuit. I'm here with a gift from [F].
Level: My dancing will keep us all strong in the face of the summer sun.
It feels amazing to dance out here in the sea breeze.
Ahh! D-don't look at me! I'm not used to walking around in a swimsuit!
Summon: I am Olivia, a dancer. This is my first trip to the beach... Is...is it really OK for me to relax here?
Learn Skill: Thank you. I shall repay your kindness with a dance!
Confession:
Do you enjoy swimming in the ocean? I really wish I could enjoy it...
It's just that swimsuits are so utterly embarrassing that I hate being seen wearing one...
Huh? You think it's the same as my dancing clothes? That's where you're wrong.
Dancing clothes are meant for display. Swimsuits are... Well, for swimming!
I don't think I can cope with wearing this in public!
Then again, maybe this is a chance to prove I can entertain people no matter how I'm dressed...
Status: Shall we swim?
Sure is hot!
I love swimming and the sea, but...wearing a swimsuit outside the water is bit embarrassing.
Do you think this suit—No, never mind! Forget I'm even here!
Being in the presence of such breathtaking scenery inspires me to come up with new dances.
How well will I be able to dance on the sand I wonder... I suppose there is only one way to find out.
Um...would you come out and swim with me?

hrid3.name: Hríd
hrid3.title: Island Ice Prince
hrid3.description: Prince of Nifl, Kingdom of Ice, and Fjorm's older brother. Having his first taste of tropical leisure time.

Castle Hall: The heat here beside the ocean is different from what I dealt with in Múspell. I feel uplifted by it.
Nifl is a harsh land, covered in ice. I don't know that I've ever been outdoors in garb as light as this...
It makes me happy to see my sisters enjoying the ocean. It has been too long since I've seen them smile so.
The chill of the snow brings focus, but training on the beach, beneath the summer sun, is not bad.
Anna asked if I might bring ice from Nifl for cold drinks at the beach but... I think that would be challenging.
Visit: I am Hríd, prince of Nifl. I come here bearing a summer correspondence from [F].
Level: Training beneath the sun has proven beneficial. I feel stronger and better prepared than before.
I am still growing accustomed to the summer sun. I will produce better results next time.
I believe my problem was being blinded by the sunlight. I have much more yet to learn.
Summon: I am Hríd, of Nifl, and this is my first summer outing. I intend to enjoy myself as much as possible.
Learn Skill: Thank you. With this, I imagine I will be able to overcome even the sun's most powerful rays.
Confession:
I sincerely appreciate your invitation to this summer getaway, [S].
These experiences have given me new perspective on the vastness of the world.
More importantly, I have cherished the opportunity to see my sisters enjoy the ocean.
I was responsible for many of their painful experiences during the war with Múspell.
Having seen them here, I believe they have overcome that darkness and are moving forward at last.
I, Hríd, am in your debt yet again. I shall devote my life to repaying you. This, I pledge.
Status: Ah... Hot, hot!
My sisters have spoken highly of the beach, so I've been looking forward to this outing!
Hm? Oh, a cold drink. Were you trying to startle me with it?
I may not be the strongest swimmer, but how about a friendly race?
As beautiful as Nifl is, you would never be able to see such a vibrantly blue sea and sky there...
It's wonderful to see my sisters enjoying themselves so. I thank you for making it possible.
This heat certainly makes me love Nifl all the more.
I have long owed you much. And now, I owe you just a little bit more.

vaike.name: Vaike
vaike.title: Sunbaked Stunner
vaike.description: A hothead who sees Chrom as his rival, set on turning up the summer heat. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Summer's for havin' fun, and the sea's for playin'. That's instinct! The rest... Well, don't worry about it.
No matter where I am, my goal is to battle Chrom and win! That's all!
Woo! Summer's the best! What's that? I'm too loud? Heh, sorry. I get carried away with this much fun!
I sure do like this swimsuit! I can do THIS! And THIS! So much easier than wearing heavy armor.
Hey, you! Have you seen Chrom? I wanna challenge him to a swimming contest!
Visit: Yo, there! I've got some fresh seafood for ya, from your buddy [F]!
Level: Chrom! Hey, Chrom! Watch this! Even in the sea, I've got perfect form!
Not too shabby, huh? Whaddaya say? You can be my trusty sidekick!
Ahhh! My foot got stuck in the sand! Let's have a rematch!
Summon: Vaike's the name. Nice to meet you! Nothin' to fear now that I'm here. Get ready for the hottest summer ever!
Learn Skill: Nice! I feel myself warmin' up!
Confession:
Hey, [S]!
You know, I was thinkin' of takin' a dip and catchin' some fish.
Better save your appetite— Oh no... I brought a conch instead of my harpoon!
Must be 'cause I kept telling myself "don't forget your axe this time" and grabbed something similar in shape...
But I can't swing a conch underwater, so I'll be goin' into the next fishing contest empty-handed!
Don't worry, though. The Vaike can handle anything! I'll catch way bigger game than Chrom!
It's all about spirit! Just you wait and see. My catch'll be so big it'll scare you!
Status: Whoo!
The seaside in summertime is top notch! Excellent choice!
*startle* Oh, a treat? You could just hand it to me.
The Vaike can never lose to Chrom—including at swimming! Now, uh, where is he?!
Look at me. Now try to guess how many weapons I have on me. C'mon, guess!
*yelp* That crab pinched my toe! Little does he know he's messing with the Vaike...
With everyone dressed to go swimming, where, uh...where am I supposed to be looking?
Just follow my lead, and you'll be in for the best summer of your life!

celica6.name: Celica
celica6.title: Of Echoes
celica6.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to Elyos. Resides in the Ring of the Caring Princess. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia / Fire Emblem Engage.
celica6.emblem:
Enhanced Engaged Special
Boosts Special damage by unit's max Special cooldown count value × 4 (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
For each foe within 5 spaces of unit, unit can move to the nearest spaces that are within unit's range from that foe (unless space is impassable terrain).

Castle Hall: Is that...Alm? I haven't seen him for...thousands of years. Yet, I feel as if I just saw him yesterday.
