I was in the kingdom of Firene, in Elyos. It was so peaceful, with fields of beautiful flowers...
Though I was considered its guardian, I was surely the one being protected there.
I do miss the oranges that grew in my homeland and in Firene... Perhaps there are some that grow here?
Seems I can eat again in this world. Though I do like sweets, I would like to try some of Askr's rarer foods also.

When one engages with an Emblem, their hair color changes based on that Emblem.
I would very much like to see you with a peach hue in your hair from engaging with me.
Visit: Friendship is worthy of protection. Accept this gift, a token of concern, from [F].
Level: I ponder the meaning of getting stronger or obtaining power... For what is the purpose?
If this is for the sake of all, then I am happy.
If only the world were such that no one would wish for more power...
Summon: I am Emblem Celica. I desire peace, not conflict, yet I will lend you my strength to protect this land.
Learn Skill: I, too, wished for this. However, please do not abuse this power.
Confession:
I have been looking for you, [S].
I took a walk around the Order of Heroes' facilities, and I wonder, are there any flower fields here?
You see, in Elyos I was entrusted to Firene's care. Perhaps it was because I was guardian there for so long...
But being surrounded by flowers, drinking orange tea... I feel true joy. The other me here may feel similarly.
Oh! There are fields toward the castle? Then let us engage and go there together.
If we use Warp Ragnarok, it will take but a moment to get there.
Though I may be unable to transport us as far as in Elyos, we will enjoy a wonderful excursion together.
Status: Oh!
Oh? I see such nostalgia in your eyes when you look at me. Have our paths crossed before?
Hm? Oh, hello. For a moment I thought you were offering to polish my Emblem ring.
I finished offering prayers. One to Mother Mila, and many more for everyone on Elyos.
Please, reach out to me if anything troubles you. I want to be of service, with or without my Emblem ring.
May I share the invocation that previously summoned me? It was, "Care for us, Emblem of Echoes!"
I really hope that Alfred and Céline are doing all right on their own.
I am certain that each Celica here has contributed to the Emblem standing before you now.

goldmary.name: Goldmary
goldmary.title: Coy Beach Divas
goldmary.description: Goldmary and Bernadetta descend from Elusia and the Adrestian Empire to the beaches of Askr, each held in her own unique esteem. They appear in Fire Emblem Engage / Three Houses.
goldmary.harmonized:
Grants Def/Res+6,【Resonance: Shields】, 【Bonus Doubler】, and【Bulwark】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Shields】
Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."
【Bonus Doubler】
Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = current bonus on each of unit's stats for 1 turn. Calculates each stat bonus independently.
【Bulwark】
Foes with Range = 1 cannot move through spaces adjacent to unit (does not affect foes with Pass skills).
Foes with Range = 2 cannot move through spaces within 2 spaces of unit (does not affect foes with Pass skills).
(Harmonized Skills can be used by tapping the Harmonized button. This skill can only be used once per map. Harmonized Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Goldmary:** I'm sorry I'm so good at lounging by the water. I had a lot of practice at the hot springs back home.
**Bernadetta:** I want to open this big umbrella, but Goldmary has such a strong grip and won't let it go! I need some shade!
**Goldmary:** Bernadetta shows such talent with embroidery. I'm quite the seamstress myself. Just another way we're alike.
**Bernadetta:** The ocean is kind of gross. But I like some of it. A little. I wonder if I could grow a strange sea plant in my room...
**Goldmary:** I'm considering getting a tan. I'm a bit worried I might look too good. I don't want to come off as if I'm trying.
Visit: **Goldmary:** I apologize for stunning you with our beauty unannounced, but we bring a note from [F].
Level: **Goldmary:** I apologize for my appearance. I wish I could avoid being so beautiful in this heat, but such is life by the sea...
**Bernadetta:** *whine* I'd rather go somewhere in out of the sun than get stronger!
**Goldmary:** Is there sweat in your eye? You seem distracted by something other than me.
Summon: We are Goldmary and Bernadetta, the goddesses of summer! How nice for you, having us drop by like this.
Learn Skill: **Goldmary:** If you're not careful, we'll be more beautiful than ever. Don't complain when we're too perfect to behold.
Confession:
**Goldmary:** I may not look it, but in my world, I'm a student, same as you, Bernadetta.
**Bernadetta:** A student?! Wow. Now that you say it, there were some mature-looking people at the Officers Academy...
**Goldmary:** I should have graduated by now, but a war started, and...there were more important things to do than study.
**Bernadetta:** It's the same in every world, isn't it? I pray at the very least you do not have to fight your friends.
**Goldmary:** Thank you! It is so sweet and dear to see you concerned for the safety of my beauty. Let's be friends forever!
**Bernadetta:** Gahhh! You're holding me too tight! Friends should let friends go!
Special: **Duo:** I leave this to you... What?!
Status: *giggle*
"I fear my natural charisma might be drawing too much attention." "What is with her...?!"
Conversation: **Bernadetta:** Phew... The ocean... It's so big and bright... I hate it. What did I do to deserve to suffer like this?
**Goldmary:** This isn't suffering—it's a mission! Directly from your professor and my Divine Dragon.
**Bernadetta:** I can't do it! Really! I'll go back to my room then apologize for giving up! I'm sorry! I'm sorry! See?! I'm sorry!
**Goldmary:** I understand your desire to apologize... I feel the same way.
Apologies for my perfection. I am truly so ashamed at how good I am.
**Bernadetta:** Wh-what?! You don't understand at all.
**Goldmary:** I suppose you're right. It is not my charisma, but ours! Please, forgive me for misspeaking.
**Bernadetta:** Leave me out of your apologies! I don't think like that! Not one bit!
**Goldmary:** But you're so skilled! And I only fight beside those as talented as me!
**Bernadetta:** Well, you're so talented that it's making me feel dizzy...
**Goldmary:** How awful for you. Is it due to the heat, not me? Perhaps there's a cool spot around here...
**Bernadetta:** A cool spot? Now that's an idea! I bet my room is nice and cool. I'll go there!
**Goldmary:** No! Let's dive into the sea.
**Bernadetta:** Whaaaaaat?! Whyyy?!
**Goldmary:** It will cool you off and make you feel even stronger! We will emerge in watery splendor, all eyes on us!
**Bernadetta:** No! Nooo! That's way too much for a recluse like me! Please, stooop!
**Goldmary:** Sorry! Everyone's already looking! We're just too amazing, I suppose!

falear3.name: Alear
falear3.title: Seaside Dragon
falear3.description: After a thousand-year slumber, the Divine Dragon wakes to swim in the ocean for the first time in memory. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: You dropped something in the ocean and it rusted? Let me shine it for you. I have practice polishing accessories.
There's been so much fighting since I woke that this is the first chance I've had to enjoy a summer vacation.
I love the shape of these seashells. I want to take a bunch as souvenirs for everyone on the Somniel.
Imagine if somewhere a world exists where Emblems reside in inner tubes. Makes you laugh to think about it.
The summer sky is so rich with color. From cloudless, clear blue skies to crimson-dyed sunsets... I love it all.
Visit: I bring a seaside breeze and wishes for a summer full of good memories from [F].
Level: We should keep enjoying ourselves to the fullest. Summer engage!
Getting the chance to grow stronger like this will make for another great summer memory.
What do you mean I let my guard down? I must have gotten caught up in the summer vacation.
Summon: I am the Divine Dragon Alear. It looks as if we get to enjoy the summer ocean together!
Learn Skill: This makes my heart sing. What kind of summer do you suppose I'll have with power like this?
Confession:
You're always doing your best, but you shouldn't push past your limits in the heat, [S].
Take a nice nap in the shade. I'll have someone on duty wake you, and we'll alert you if a battle should break out.
I've had so much fun since I began spending summers with you. I want to give you a token of my appreciation.
It is a ring made from tropical grasses and flowers. No Emblems reside in it, but plenty of memories do.
I believe the memories we share of this summer will make us stronger, so please keep it with you.
Status: I am accustomed to swimming on the Somniel, but never in such a massive sea.
Oh! What is it? Is something on me? I was just swimming, so maybe it's seaweed!
Presenting a ring on the beach is considered a grand gesture? Sounds lovely. And...if it's an Emblem ring? Is that grand too?
I got this swimsuit from the boutique. It just came out this summer.
You must be overheating in that outfit. I should have brought you an extra swimsuit from the Somniel.
Fluffy white clouds, big blue sea, a salty breeze... I question if the me from before knew of such wonders.
I am intent on making up for the thousand summers I missed while sleeping. So please, summer, engage with me!

clanne.name: Clanne
clanne.title: Summer Fan
clanne.description: A 33rd Steward of the Dragon who wishes to burn the image of summer's Divine Dragon into his eyes. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I like swimming fine, but try drawing a board game in the sand and using the the seashells as pieces. That's fun!
The holy land of Lythos had ocean all around it, with a large bay where everyone would swim in the summer.
I revere the Divine Dragon's presence in this lovely ocean setting, even while I'm enjoying the summer.
The Divine Dragon Fan Club has to make a special-edition pamphlet for summer. Want to add a few words?
These salty pickles are even tastier in this heat. I'd like to try making some from the vegetables in Askr.
Visit: Is the Divine Dragon enjoying summer here too? Oh! I come with greetings from [F].
Level: It was worth the hard work, even if I did almost faint in the heat!
The steward's summer is only just getting started. It's going to be great!
Vander warned me against letting my guard down, even during summer vacation...
Summon: I'm Clanne, Steward of the Dragon. I'm honored to be here, but I must find the Divine Dragon some shade.
Learn Skill: It seems as if the heat is a little more bearable now. Is this supposed to make you resistant to the sunshine?
Confession:
The sun's finally setting. Sunlight may be the main attraction of summer, but I really love the scenery at dusk.
The ocean turns a deep, dark blue with the scarlet sunset spread over it. It reminds me of the Divine Dragon.
What? Do you see someone in the summer scenery too? Tropical leaves and a faint yellow flower?
Seeing it reminds you of me? Wow! No one's ever said that to me before. Heh, I think you made me blush.
I see you in the white sand and bright ocean sometimes. This is how we can remember each other every summer!
Status: Hoo!
I'm sorry…this heat's a little much for me.
Thank you for the summertime visit! You seem to be having fun, too.
You should be swimming with the Divine Dragon, not here looking after me!
It's important to stay hydrated. Bring along a bottle and you can drink whenever you want!
Say...can you summon beachwear versions of your favorite Heroes whenever you want?
Can you use seawater for pickling? Uh, the flavor might be...off, I guess.
Building a sandcastle might be a bit childish, but what if I built Lythos Castle? Or the Somniel!

petra2.name: Petra
petra2.title: Faraway Sun
petra2.description: From Brigid, in the western reaches of Fódlan, hails this princess who enjoys basking in Askr's summer sun. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Summer in Askr is giving me nostalgia for summers in my homeland. The similarities bring a calm to my heart.
Brigid is surrounded by water, so I am trained expertly at swimming. I can swim anywhere.

Are you needing a cold drink, [S]?
Come, let us drink together.
Is it feeling hot? I am used to it. This heat is much comforting for me.
I don't know if my swimsuit fits me suitably. But...it is feeling easy to move around.
Visit: I do like the summer ocean. I also heard it is liked nicely, or greatly, by [F].
Level: I show Brigid's pride at sea too.
The flame spirit's protection is strong in summer.
The sun blinds me... It is dizzying.
Summon: I am called Petra Macneary. I much enjoy swimming in the sea. Will you swim with me?
Learn Skill: This is summer growth in abundance. You are receiving my gratitude.
Confession:
I am spending my days with devotion to my studies, even at the ocean. It is important to keep growing.
But...it is making me remember my home's blue sky and surrounding seas... Distantly far from here.
But somehow I am not lonely. It is strange. Though...
I know the reason—Askr's gentle sea breeze, the sun falling under the horizon—these are familiar in Brigid.
I am feeling a connection with Askr and its ocean. So I have a desire to protect it.
I will be stronger and believe in the flame spirit's protection. Brigid's pride will show. No matter what.
Status: I feel glad swimming in the sea, so every chance I go, I go.
Brrr... What was that? An ice-tickle?
There's not much protection on this swimsuit. What if an enemy attack comes?
I am wanting to display to the professor my culture... My marked skin is representing of it.
The spirit of the sea is with two faces. One kind, one other frightening...
I am having nostalgia for Brigid's sea…
Together, we will dive under the sea and look on the sky through the seawater.

dedue2.name: Dedue
dedue2.title: Loyal Life Guard
dedue2.description: A servant to Dimitri who is loyal to all ends, including along the shores of Askr's ocean. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I am a servant to His Highness above all else. It matters not if we are at a resort—he is my foremost duty.
Duscur, where I once lived, is a cold land with short summers. The idea of swimming in the ocean is foreign.
Flowers that bloom in the summer bask in the sunlight, growing strong. One can feel a rugged vigor in them...
I am roasting oysters. Would you like one? The bounty of Askr's ocean inspires me to cook.
I look unprepared in just my swimsuit, but I will protect His Highness with my bare hands if need be.
Visit: I come bearing the ocean's bounty, a gift from [F].
Level: It does not matter where I am. I will serve His Highness as best I can.
I believe I am beginning to grasp how one should fight on the beach.
I cannot protect His Highness if I cannot tolerate a little sunlight...
Summon: I am Dedue Molinaro. I have one goal at this ocean...to protect His Highness and ensure he enjoys his stay.
Learn Skill: I suppose this means there are things I can learn from the ocean as well.
Confession:
My role is to protect His Highness with my life. This is the meaning of my existence...
One can never be certain where danger might lurk, even as we enjoy a peaceful ocean diversion.
The reaper can only harvest when your guard is down. That is why I must be ever vigilant.
I know you are being considerate when you say to enjoy myself, [S].
However, I will suffer in any way that I must if it serves His Highness... I do so eagerly. And at every opportunity.
I will defend him against any and all tribulations this ocean has to offer. I swear this upon Askr's very sun.
Status: Hmm...
Surely there's someone more suitable than me for...summertime fun.
I am not a fan of such...humor.
I will not leave His Highness undefended. Not even at a resort.
I am only an average swimmer. Duscur...has short summers.
I cannot allow myself the joy of the ocean, so I shall be satisfied watching from afar.
Is it possible the creatures of the sea might not loathe me?
I'm going to catch and cook a fish. I will offer you a taste when it is ready.

eirika8.name: Eirika
eirika8.title: Resolute Princess
eirika8.description: The princess of Renais, determined to protect her country alongside her twin brother, Ephraim. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: My brother pats me on the head... It is sweet, but I wish he paid more notice to company in such moments.
I will support my brother when he becomes king of Renais, just as we spoke of when we were children.
My brother is difficult to read. He can often seem insensitive, yet I know he considers others very deeply...
I enjoy our talks. I would like to make plans to spend time together in the near future.
Do not venture too far ahead. Stay behind me on the battlefield.
Visit: I come with greetings from [F].
Level: I am princess of Renais, and I shall fight for my land. I will not stand by and be protected.
I would prefer a world where such power is unnecessary though.
I ask your forgiveness. I fear I still have much to learn.
Summon: I am Eirika, twin sister of Ephraim, prince of Renais. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Learn Skill: If you insist. I appreciate your generosity.
Confession:
We fight repeatedly, even though we know it to be foolish. Why do you think that is, [S]?
I believe that things gained through cooperation are far greater treasures than a bounty taken by force...
Nothing is so shameful as war for the sake of satisfying greed or for the simple pleasure of the war itself.
But I will wield a sword, if necessary. I will stand brave in the face of violence, should it befall the innocent.
Like the warrior princess who fought for Caer Pelyn, I will fight with courage and pride till the end.
Status: Ephraim and I have always been together, from the moment we were born.
*surprised exclaim* Up to your old tricks again, I see. Ever the mischievous one...
When we were children, Ephraim and I were sometimes dressed in matching outfits. Such is the life of twins!
Somehow, I sense that my brother's strength is flowing through me...
Each of the battles I've fought have taught me something new about the world. I've gained much perspective.
I must grow stronger. Not only for my country, but for Ephraim and Lyon too.
I strive to be an ally you can rely upon for anything.

amelia2.name: Amelia
amelia2.title: Blossoming Talent
amelia2.description: A soldier from Silva, a Grado village. She grew strong quickly, training under General Duessel. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall:
It's taken all I have to survive. But I have grown a little more confident in my abilities.
And now... At least I am confident enough to protect those precious to me.
I'm ready to act at any moment! I've trained under General Duessel, after all. Not many match him... R-right?
Even with amazing armor and a strong body, I'm still just Amelia, a villager from Silva.

The basics... Easy to learn, tough to perfect. They are the strongest and most pure of techniques.
Did I sound like General Duessel just now?
Swords against axes, axes against spears, spears against swords... This is the law of battle. I can't forget it.
Visit: It's best to keep up good relations with [F]!
Level: I will be a magnificent general! That way I can be most helpful to everyone!
Circle right, circle left, thrust! The basics are key!
Aaargh... I got too intense and overdid it!
Summon: I'm Amelia from Silva, a village in Grado. I've just become a general! I'm...a bit nervous, but I can do this!
Learn Skill: Thank you! I will do my best!
Confession:
I never thought someone like me, just a regular girl, would fight alongside those regarded as Heroes.
But it's all thanks to General Duessel. He taught me all I know—how to wield a weapon, how to fight...
"Choose whatever weapon that feels right to you, and train until you can control it like you do your own limbs."
When General Duessel said that to me, I didn't understand it. But now... Now I get it!
Never forget the basics. Don't let my guard down. Don't hold back. Focus... In practice, just as on the battlefield!
I must protect those important to me. Protect my country. That is what I vow to do! You will see!
Status: Well... Wh-what do you think? Do I look strong, like General Duessel?
Hey! That's awful, teasing me like that.
I wouldn't be here without the support of all those around me.
I can do this. I'm no longer in training, of course.
*grunt* This armor...still so heavy, after all this time. But I am strong.
Mother... No, I won't cry. I'm not a child anymore.
I see how hard you work. I will too!

kyle.name: Kyle
kyle.title: Zealous Knight
kyle.description: A knight of Renais who serves Ephraim directly. He is eager and known for his sternness. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: My life has been given in service to Renais and Prince Ephraim since the moment I took my chivalric vows.
Forde and I have competed since we crossed blades at a tournament. His attitude aside, he is quite skilled.
To fight well, you must maintain the right level of tension. Try devoting more energy to the endeavor.
A knight of Renais should stand bold at the front lines and face the enemy. This I believe.
Swing and thrust with the sword... Thrust and swing with the spear... I must train each and every day.
Visit: I pray that there is a long-lasting and rewarding friendship between you and [F].
Level: Time to do roll call for each battalion! Check on troop morale, and confirm the safety of every encampment!
For the pride of the Knights of Renais!
My weapons and belongings are all properly maintained, and my horse is in good health. All is in order.
Summon: I am Kyle of the Knights of Renais. I humbly request that you allow me to accompany Prince Ephraim!
Learn Skill: It is an honor being trusted to hold the front lines. Leave it to me.
Confession:
When Renais's army broke before Grado's onslaught and the capital fell, Prince Ephraim remained composed.
Neither arrogant nor cavalier, he did not cling to his heroism for comfort but faced the reality before him.
Bravely he set about distracting Grado's army to allow King Fado and Princess Eirika to escape.
Everyone was so inspired by the prince's determination that not one person left their station.
We were proud to be knights sworn to Renais and stand with him for what we believed in.
Those sentiments have motivated me to this day. I feel the same will in you. I shall aid you as long as time allows.
Special: You will not get past me!
Even if it costs my life!
Status: Yes.
Kyle, of the Knights of Renais.
*startled* How shameful to be shaken by such a simple movement...
My life has been in service of Renais since the moment I took my chivalric vows.
When I was young, I hated losing to Forde.
Prince Ephraim and Princess Eirika are the heart and soul of our country.
That Forde... I see he's painting again...
It's an honor and a privilege to serve a leader such as you.

forde.name: Forde
forde.title: Unfettered Knight
forde.description: A knight of Renais in Ephraim's service, he is free-spirited and fickle, even on the battlefield. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Prince Ephraim would never drag innocent people into war, not even if he ran out of food in enemy territory.
Oh, Kyle? He's been stuck-up since his plan to take over the nursery as a baby. Still...the ladies sure liked him.
Sorry... I don't paint portraits. Not anymore.
I'm curious to see who settles for an uptight knight like Kyle. Maybe his heart has chosen who it wants...
I'm sketching this hall. See, I use charcoal to draw and shade... Really just my way of recording memories.
Visit: I'm Forde. I specialize in landscapes, still-life paintings... I keep busy with work from [F].
Level: This is a nice view. I think I'll try my hand at sketching this place.
If you ask me, all I can say is that I hope we win.
No point in panicking. It's important to remain myself, no matter what life throws my way.
Summon: I'm Forde, a knight of Renais in support of Prince Ephraim. Try not to be too uptight now, OK?
Learn Skill: Well in that case, I've got no choice but to garner some resolve, right?
Confession:
You wanna know why I don't paint portraits? I gotta say, I'm impressed you noticed. You see...
When I was a kid, I beat Kyle in a tournament for swordsman trainees. It was pretty remarkable.
But my mother was more pleased about a portrait I drew of her than my victory in the tournament.
I didn't understand at the time, but now I get why she wanted me to wield a brush over a sword.
My last portrait was of her. Maybe one day I'll want to do more, if I can put down my sword for a bit.
Yeesh! Not like me to get so introspective. Something about you... I can talk for ages. Come on, let's go.
Status: Uh-huh.
Yeah, I'm Forde. I'm working hard at not overextending myself today.
Whoa! Ah, good morning. I-i-it is still morning, isn't it?
This? Oh, i-it's a sketch. I use this piece of charcoal to draw and shade, like this.
Death will have a tough time catching anyone who rides with our prince, heh! But it's not like we've avoided trouble altogether.
Kyle was so cool when we were children. I still remember how impressed I was.
When we lost our parents... Well, I don't know where I'd be now if I hadn't had Franz's help back then.
I felt this warmth engulfing me, blowing across my face like a summer wind. It must have been your energy.

nidavellir.name: Niðavellir
nidavellir.title: Founding King
nidavellir.description: The first and founding king of Niðavellir who fought and won independence from the jötnar.

Castle Hall: We faced many hardships to gain independence. In spite of that, we'll keep fighting for freedom.
Niðavellir is a country in its infancy. There's so much more to do still.
A leader exists for the sake of all, but they can also be resented. I know full well the burden of such a position.
We're about to test a new invention. Want to be part of the experiment? Come on, it'll be surefire fun!

It must've broken when I was moving around. Huh? Oh, it's the device Sindri gave me to communicate.
I bet I get an earful when I return...
Visit: I'd like to form a friendship, similar to the bond you share with [F].
Level: Perhaps now you've seen a couple of my kingly qualities?
About what one might expect, right?
I'm a little tired...
Summon: I'm Niðavellir. Yes...my name is the same as my country's. Sorry for the confusion.
Learn Skill: You want more from me? Oh geez... You can be a little scary sometimes.
Confession:
Truth be told, I may not be the best choice for a king, but I wasn't about to be ruled by the jötnar all my life.
So we rose up and combined our strengths, including the technical skills of some of my comrades.
And that's when we found an opportunity to stand up to the jötnar. Developing new weapons was—
It was how we ensured victory, even if part of that victory was instilling fear in the jötnar and their queen.
Now I've had enough fighting. All I want is peace for Niðavellir, for long into the future.
Status: Hahaha.
I'm Niðavellir. I realize my name being the same as my country's can be confusing. Sorry about that.
Whoa! Hey, I am a king, you know. A little respect would be nice.
I want to live a free life, not a life controlled by someone else. Don't you?
Sindri is our best researcher, though a little rash at times.
I admit, our independence cost some lives... But I don't regret it for a second.
It'd be nice to have more time in this life.
You're pretty interesting. Ha! I'm even tempted to take you back to Niðavellir with me.

glen.name: Glen
glen.title: Sunstone
glen.description: One of Grado's Imperial Three generals, he rides a wyvern and goes by the title of Sunstone. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I remain ignorant of the emperor's plans. Both General Duessel and I questioned the wisdom of the war.
The emperor said the rebel army invaded Carcino and massacred all in Port Kiris. It cannot be...
The army cast Valter out for his mistreatment of civilians. What lies could he have told to be reinstated?
Neither I nor my brother, Cormag, will ever do enough in battle to repay His Majesty for appointing us knights.
I keep this dagger at my side sharp at all times, so its shine reminds me of the brilliance I felt becoming a knight.
Visit: You can tell a lot about a person just by looking them in the eyes. Your will resembles [F]'s.
Level: A wyvern's pride is steadfast. Gaining their trust rivals the challenge of a battlefield laden with enemies.
As a servant of the empire, I am duty bound to obey His Majesty's orders.
**Mark my words, Valter:** your crimes are neither forgotten nor forgiven.
Summon: I am Glen of the Grado Imperial Army. I am the Sunstone, a name given to me by the emperor.
Learn Skill: As one of Grado's Imperial Three, I will live up to my name as Sunstone, containing the brilliance of the sun.
Confession:
The one time I met the princess of Renais was when Renais and Grado were on friendly terms.
I spoke briefly with Princess Eirika, and I could sense she was a woman of kindness.
But I am told she and her brother, Prince Ephraim, are ravaging lands, and I am to capture them...
His Majesty never spoke one falsity to me, but I...I cannot believe the princess is evil.
I do not understand His Majesty... not his bringing strangers into the army, nor his invasion of Renais.
I have to find out what is truly behind his orders... I need to speak with Princess Eirika, and I'd like your aid.
Special: I am duty bound to obey.
Status: Glen, general of the Grado Imperial Army. I am the Sunstone.
You need something? What is it?
As a servant of the empire, I am duty bound to obey His Majesty's orders.
I cannot bring myself to believe Princess Eirika is evil. I cannot...
My younger brother Cormag has been known to get... a little hot-blooded.
Valter, your crimes are neither forgotten nor forgiven.
You are a kind-hearted soul. I place my trust in you.

heidrun.name: Heiðrún
heidrun.title: Healing Nectar
heidrun.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands. Her nectar is a potent medicine that can heal poison and disease.

Castle Hall: In the Healing Hands, I traveled the nine realms healing the ill. I was very busy, but I've never been happier.
There was nothing I could do for the Quieting Hands... I'm of no use when it comes to combat.
My nectar heals maladies and toxins in the body. It helps whoever drinks it grow healthy again.
Father, Eikþyrnir, Hræsvelgr, Níðhöggr, Ratatoskr... They will always be my family.
Ratatoskr is so sweet. I hope her future is a bright one—I do.
Visit: I am Heiðrún. Have some nectar. I've come all the way from [F]'s castle.
Level: I... I really can fight?
Have I been of use, at least?
I wish I were better at this...
Summon: My name is Heiðrún. Are you feeling all right? If you need refreshment, I can offer you some nectar...
Learn Skill: Thank you. Might I offer you some nectar in exchange?
Confession:
As the Healing Hands, we helped those who were suffering.
But Father brought an end to that when he forced everyone to kill...
I was helpless to stop them. I wish there were something I could have done, but...
I'm just...not strong enough.
Thank you for listening...
You are both strong and kind... I wish I could be more like you.
Status: My name is Heiðrún—once known as the nectar of the Healing Hands.
*startle* Oh, are you in need of healing?
If I could fight like my siblings... If I could share their burden...
To have the opportunity to use my gift is a blessing I welcome.
Father was once kind. But...no longer.
I hope Ratatoskr is staying safe...
Please, drink of my nectar. Allow it to do its soothing work...

eikthyrnir.name: Eikþyrnir
eikthyrnir.title: Quieting Strength
eikthyrnir.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands who firmly believes that any illness or injury can be resolved through training the body and building strength.

Castle Hall: Prince Alfonse and Princess Sharena are close, as brothers and sisters should be.
Yggdrasill is great, and we are small. We can't know every branch.
If you like, I can show you my training methods. Just ask.
My sisters, they... No. Forget it.
Ratatoskr is my precious little sister. I want my sisters to be happy. All of my sisters.
Visit: I am Eikþyrnir, and I have come to— ...Shall I repeat my name? Eikþyrnir.
Level: The body is the first weapon, yes, but it is also the final shield.
My training gets the desired results.
I could have trained even harder...
Summon: I am Eikþyrnir, of the Healing Hands. I train the body to protect from injury and disease. I can train you too.
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude. This will help focus my training.
Confession:
I learned something I did not want to know. Since then, I've wondered why I was born...
What is my purpose? The answer escapes me, even now...
But many humans share in this same confusion...
Yet they live on, pressing onward each day...
Speaking of it...lifts a weight from my shoulders. Thank you for your ear, [S]...
Status: Hm...
I am Eikþyrnir. I'm not...a talker.
Hm? Did you touch...my muscles?
The body is the first weapon. It must be honed, made sharp.
The body is the final shield. It must be tempered, made hard.
Læraðr was our leader, our father. He was...everything...
I hope my sisters are happy one day. I want that for them.
Tired? Try training. Your body can fight illness, injury—even fatigue.

nephenee3.name: Nephenee
nephenee3.title: Festival Harmony
nephenee3.description: Nephenee, a Crimean villager, and Sakura, a Hoshidan princess, overcome barriers of status and celebrate the summer festival together. They appear in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance / Fates.
nephenee3.harmonized:
Grants Atk/Spd+6,【Resonance: Blades】, and "unit can move 1 extra space (that turn only; does not stack)" to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn and neutralizes any【Penalty】on unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).
(Harmonized Skills can be used by tapping the Harmonized button. This skill can only be used once per map. Harmonized Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)

Castle Hall: **Nephenee:** You sure are nice, Princess Sakura... Even though you're royalty, ya still treat us country bumpkins real good.
**Sakura:** When the festival begins, it's as if the gates of summer open. I pray we will cherish these memories together.
**Sakura:** Uh... Nephenee... Are you enjoying the festival? It would make me so happy to know you like the yukata...
**Nephenee:** This here outfit is so elegant. You reckon I'm cut out to wear it?
**Nephenee:** We have festivals back home, but they ain't nothin' like this one. Not nearly so many people.
Visit: **Sakura:** It has been quite hot lately. Care to cool off with us at the festival at [F]'s castle?
Level: **Sakura:** Come, Nephenee, join us in the dance circle.
**Nephenee:** Am I doin' it right? I mean, does my dancing look correct?
**Nephenee:** Hm. I don't think I'm gettin' it...
Summon: I am Sakura, second princess of Hoshido. Today, at the festival... Oh, Nephenee, join me!
Learn Skill: **Sakura:** I picked up some nice things at the festival, Nephenee. Come, let's split them.
Confession:
**Sakura:** Nephenee, it appears you have grown accustomed to wearing a yukata. Tell me, do you enjoy it?
**Nephenee:** Yeah. But, I ain't—I'm not sure if it's all right for someone like me to walk 'round with a princess like you.
**Sakura:** Of course it is. Festivals are a time to have so much fun that you forget all your worries. I sure do.
So, if you will, I would love us to join together as one and enjoy all this festival has to offer us.
Status: Yeah.
I reckon that there outfit looks amazin' on ya. I-I mean, it really suits you. *giggle* You look wonderful too, Nephenee.
Conversation: **Nephenee:** *grunt*
**Sakura:** Um... Nephenee... Are you enjoying the festival?
**Nephenee:** Huh? Uh, yes, I most certainly am.
**Sakura:** Oh, thank goodness. You haven't said much so I wasn't sure if you—
**Nephenee:** Sorry, I'm not much of a talker.
**Sakura:** Oh really? I'm shy too...
**Nephenee:** Uh, it's nothing like that. Ya see... I don't talk the same way y'all do, so it's...kinda embarrassin'.
**Sakura:** Oh, no! You shouldn't feel embarrassed. I mean, surely people aren't used to your accent, but...
Well, think of it this way. These yukata we're wearing have been passed down for generations in Hoshido.
That accent of yours is quite the same. It's...a precious piece of your homeland.
**Nephenee:** Ya really see it like that?
**Sakura:** Of course! There's absolutely no reason to feel ashamed.
**Nephenee:** Aw, thanks Princess Sakura. But... ain't it a bit hard to understand me? I mean...isn't it a bit hard?
**Sakura:** Don't worry about that. I'll let you know if I have trouble understanding you.
So, we should definitely talk more!
**Nephenee:** You know, you're right. I reckon we could be good friends, Princess Sakura. Whaddaya say?
**Sakura:** Yes, of course! I'm certain we will be good friends.

mia5.name: Mia
mia5.title: Summer Slice
mia5.description: A polished sword wielder and member of the Greil Mercenaries, Mia dons a yukata at the summer festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: Wearing a yukata, you feel like a true master of the sword. Hm... Looking the part's not a bad way to start out!
In Tellius, I didn't have the luxury of enjoying a festival like this. I can't wait to eat, play, and have all the fun!
I bet my boss, Ike, would like those huge chunks of meat on a spit! If it tastes as good as it smells...
This...yukata? It's nice and cool. Perfect for these hot summer evenings!
Ooh, tiny fish... There's a contest to see who can scoop out the fish with a thin piece of paper? I'm in!
Visit: I bought this souvenir at a summer festival stall. I was told to deliver it to you by [F].
Level: Aha! Before this festival heat melts my weapon, watch how I split things in two!
Festivals like this don't come around every day, so I won't allow anyone to disrupt this fun!
Whoa! I broke my sandal!
Summon: The name's Mia! Do I look all right in this yukata? Why don't we enjoy all we can of this festival, eh?!
Learn Skill: You bought this at a stall too? I gladly accept!
Confession:
Today's festival was more fun than I expected!
There was the fish-scooping contest and all that delicious food from all sorts of shops. It was the best!
I don't usually afford myself too many distractions, seeing as my goal is to reach the pinnacle of swordsmanship.
But...it was nice to have a little diversion today, even if it means working that much harder tomorrow!
Well, I better get to it. The sword waits for no one! This festive spirit though... I might bring that with me.
Special: I can really move in this!
Status: Hehehe!
Yukata are so cute! They make me feel all warm and fuzzy inside.
Hey, watch it! Don't mess up the dress-up.
So you form a circle and dance...like this?
Wow! So many food stands! Now, what am I craving...
According to my fortune, good things are going to happen today.
Oop. I need to be more careful in clothes like these.
Heya, boss! Go to the festival with me?

lucia2.name: Lucia
lucia2.title: Loyalty Enrobed
lucia2.description: Lucia is a loyal retainer to Elincia in Crimea. Her work has brought her to the summer festival, wearing an elegant yukata. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: A festival is no excuse to let one's guard down. It is my duty to protect Princess Elincia.
Once Crimea has recovered from the war, I would like to hold a festival and celebrate our country's new day.
The shops are so colorful! I shall buy souvenirs to take home to Geoffrey and the others.
I pulled a fortune at the shop earlier. See this color? Do you suppose it is good?
Princess Elincia looked wonderful in her yukata. She managed to be both adorable and dignified.
Visit: I am Lucia of Crimea. I come bearing a summer gift from your friend and mine, [F].
Level: This time when the people come together as one...I shall protect it, no matter what.
Let us accomplish what we must without losing ourselves in the festival atmosphere.
Urk! My foot got caught as I walked in this unfamiliar garb.
Summon: I am Lucia. I hail from Crimea and have come for the occasion of this summer festival.
Learn Skill: This is for me? Thank you. It will always serve as a good memory from the festival.
Confession:
I am grateful you invited me to such a fantastic festival.
It fills my heart with joy seeing the people's smiles, their eyes so full of life.
Not to mention the various stalls...
The traditions of Hoshido and the vibrance of its people are just as Princess Elincia said.
I pray that everyone will be able to enjoy the festival together next summer, and the one that follows...
Status: Hmm...
Thank you for inviting me to the festival! We're going to have fun.
Oh, was I becoming disheveled? Thank you.
Have you seen Princess Elincia?
Wearing a uh...what did you call it? A yukata? Certainly makes you stand up nice and straight.
I'm not used to wearing something like this, so don't laugh at me if I look a little...awkward.
It is not every day I get to wear something so gorgeous... Hm? Oh, nothing. Lost in thought.
Summer nights go by so quickly... It was nice to spend this one with you.

leo5.name: Leo
leo5.title: Festival Bonds
leo5.description: The second prince of Nohr accompanies Takumi of Hoshido to the summer festival, their bond put on display. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I understand Xander took part in the Hoshido dance...but I prefer seeing the festival stalls in the evening.
We have festivals where I am from as well. I will invite Prince Takumi to one as thanks for his inviting me today.
There are ring-toss games... My gravity magic would be useful, I imagine, but perhaps a bit boorish of me?
I had my yukata on inside out. I swear, if Xander hadn't told me, I would still not have realized it even now.
There are so many food stalls. I hope there is at least one that specializes in dishes with tomatoes.
Visit: I come bearing an invitation to a summer festival from your friend, [F].
Level: Festivals are not so bad. This feels like the start of an unforgettable summer memory.
It's one's own prerogative to have too much fun at a festival, but they ought to be attentive to their surroundings.
I have begun to grow used to wearing this yukata. Next time I will be much more successful.
Summon: I am Leo, second-eldest prince of Nohr. Being invited to this festival is an honor. I shall enjoy myself.
Learn Skill: Is this a summer festival specialty? I am happy to have it.
Confession:
I didn't know you were here. I was pondering something just now.
It feels strange to enjoy a festival with the people of Hoshido, with whom we had such a fraught relationship.
Though, being summoned to Askr is, in itself, about as strange a thing as I can imagine.
At first, Prince Takumi and I knew little of each other and believed the other to be unpleasant.
However, we have developed a friendship, as you can see, through our conversations.
People from Nohr and Hoshido taking part in the same festival—so grand. Perhaps peace is possible after all.
Status: Mm-hmm.
This is my first time wearing a yukata. Am I doing it correctly?
You're getting carried away, don't you think?
Hoshido's summer festival is, as expected, quite different from Nohr's.
I saw candied tomatoes for sale at one of the food stands. Do you think they're any good?
I dislike the heat, but I don't hate summer nights.
I cannot believe I've been invited to a Hoshidan festival...
I'll invite you to a Nohrian festival sometime soon. Be sure to attend.

takumi6.name: Takumi
takumi6.title: Wishful Spark
takumi6.description: The second prince of Hoshido has formed a bond with Leo of Nohr and decided to bring him along with him to the summer festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Hoshido's summer festival has shops, candied apples, shooting galleries... It's impossible to get bored!
It's been a while since I last wore a yukata. It reminds me of going to summer festivals with my siblings.
Why not have Oboro tailor a yukata for you? Her family are all tailors, so I don't think you can go wrong.
Ryoma is giving his all while dancing, as with everything. I should learn to be more like him in that way.
It looks like Prince Leo is enjoying the festival. I am glad we invited him.
Visit: I'm Takumi, of Hoshido. There's a big summer festival going on at [F]'s castle.
Level: I will have brutes who would disrupt the festival ejected from the premises.
I won't miss. I'm quite good at festival shooting galleries.
Oh, no, I was just a little surprised by the sound of the fireworks.
Summon: I am Takumi, the second prince of Hoshido. Walk with me, and I will show you the summer festival.
Learn Skill: It seems I benefited from the festival this year.
Confession:
The festival stalls bring back memories of when Hoshido still enjoyed peace...
Though the war with Nohr is over, the battle continues in Askr, so true peace is still a distant notion.
Yet it is not a dream so long as we continue to build connections with our comrades.
Look at Prince Leo of Nohr. He is having so much fun at the festival...
Yes, this summer festival has a special power to connect people.
Special: All I need is a target.
Status: You know about yukata? Hm...
Why are you pestering me? Do you have nothing else to do?
It doesn't look like anyone here knows how to wear a yukata.
Just going around looking at the food stalls accomplishes nothing. You must also train.
Oboro picked out this yukata for me. Looks nice, doesn't it?
Everyone at the festival together is such a peaceful sight... Alas, I have other things to do.
Let's make the rounds one more time! Summer nights are short, after all.

bernadetta4.name: Bernadetta
bernadetta4.title: Sheltered Loner
bernadetta4.description: Daughter of Count Varley, Minister of Religious Affairs to the Adrestian Empire. Overly shy, she prefers to spend her time alone in her room. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I realized just a bow isn't enough to keep me away from other people in fights. So I've decided to ride a horse!
Ahh... So...relaxing. It's true, if you're going to admire a flower, the best way to do it is alone.
I-I'm okay with things as they are. No, really, I prefer it. If possible, I'd like to live life holed up in a greenhouse...
My mother works in the Imperial capital. People respect her and say she's a genius.
I-I wanted to go back to my room, but then I was told to stand here. What did I do to deserve this?!
Visit: Here's a present for you. What do you suppose is in it? It-it's from [F], not me!
Level: Hehehe. See? I can get things done when I put my mind to it!
The only "reward" I get when I push myself to leave my room is battle...
I can feel people's eyes on me... Everyone's wondering what the shut-in is doing out of her room.
Summon: I-I'm Bernadetta! Were people calling for me?! OK, well, it's scary. So could you not do that?
Learn Skill: Does this mean I have talent too?!
Confession:
You're a good person for being so considerate, [S].
But, if I... If I become friends with someone again... Father will...ohh!
When I was still a child, I became friends with a boy. He was one of the helpers around the estate.
My father found out, and the boy disappeared. There were all sorts of rumors about what happened...
Ever since then, I don't let myself get close with anyone. Commoner or nobility, I've been too terrified...
It's true that this isn't Fódlan... A-and there is logic to that, isn't there? Should I let my fear go now? Eep...
No! I can't! It's not possible! If I keep to myself, everyone's safe. This is how I live now, if I like it or not!
Status: Oh!
So, what do you think? Do I look fancy?
Hey! I'm not a child, you know!
OK, OK. I'll do my best!
Tell me, how should I train to stay alive? If it involves staying hidden, I'd be great at that!
Wouldn't it be great—a world where we can hide away forever!
I might need to prepare to prepare...
I really hate fighting! But maybe now that you're here, it'll be less... You know.

frobin8.name: Robin
frobin8.title: Exalt's Right Hand
frobin8.description: Ylisse's tactician and Chrom's other half. She dons new garb and offers her strength to the exalt and the people. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I must continue growing if I'm going to stand beside Chrom. It will take a lot of work, but I'm ready for it.
I had no past to speak of, but Chrom taught me that was OK because I have a future of infinite possibilities.
I have learned much here in Askr, but there is still more of value to be gained.
Oh, this? It's a tome that records strategies from many other worlds.
I thought a magnificent outfit might help to display the majesty of a strategist. What do you think?
Visit: I am Robin, tactician of the Halidom of Ylisse. I come bearing supplies from [F].
Level: With this power, I will build the future that Chrom envisions.
Exactly as I expected!
I shall use these results to learn more and reach my next goal.
Summon: I am Robin, tactician to Exalt Chrom. My studies here in this land are dedicated to Ylisse's future.
Learn Skill: With this, I'll be even more capable of aiding Chrom! I'm sure of it!
Confession:
Are you on patrol at this hour? Good work, [S].
I was busy reading magical tomes at the library, myself. The collection of books they possess is overwhelming!
I have gotten to know many tacticians from a number of different worlds since I was summoned to Askr.
I am internalizing all of the knowledge and wisdom I receive from them and will use it to help build the future.
Chrom fights with his sword. I rely on my knowledge. Different weapons, but the future we seek is the same.
I will continue to stand beside Chrom because I believe in the tomorrow our bond will build!
Status: Yes.
Such fine clothes. I-I couldn't... Though I suppose they're necessary if I'm to stand next to the exalt.
Huh? Am I wearing this wrong? I-I'm not accustomed to wearing anything like this...
I should not be content with my current position. I'll continue to work even harder.
Right here, right now, with everyone together—that's what's important. Not the past.
I've learned so much, fighting with the Order of Heroes. I'm forever grateful.
I feel as though I should stand a little bit taller while wearing these clothes.
For you, I'll come up with a hundred—no, two hundred plans!

alfonse5.name: Alfonse
alfonse5.title: Heir to Openness
alfonse5.description: A kind and serious prince of Askr. Wearing the same gear his father once wore, he possesses a renewed determination and sense of purpose.

Castle Hall: I will carry Askr's fight for peace, the legacy of my father and the kings of old, on into the future.
Though a great challenge lies ahead, peace will come. It is certain. I have every faith.
I still owe you much. I will one day repay you for all you've done for me, [S]. I promise.
The trust and support of the Heroes has made me into who I am now. I must not betray that trust.
Both Mother and Sharena looked happy to see me wearing this armor. It means a lot to all of us.
Visit: I am Alfonse of Askr. I've come to deliver a token of your friendship with [F].
Level: It is my duty to fulfill this role, and I will face any challenge to do so.
Am I a worthy successor to my father and his legacy?
One's truest self is revealed during moments of suffering. Father taught me that lesson.
Summon: I am Alfonse, prince of Askr. I pledge to carry on the work of the late king Gustav—and bring peace to Askr.
Learn Skill: Thank you. No words can express the depths of my gratitude to you.
Confession:
I do not wear this out of grief; I wear it as a reminder of what I stand for, of what I fight for.
My father was a strong, kind, and great hero, both to the people of Askr and to us, his family.
But I can't hope to forge Askr's future by only looking to him in the past.
I have to face the challenges before us in my own way, and do so while keeping his memory close to heart.
I will press onward, my head held high, and strive to be worthy of this honor. Watch over me, Father.
Status: Father.
These clothes are styled after my father's. Do they suit me as well as they did him?
*startle* Oh, right... This is your way of being considerate.
Each and every Hero has played their part in Askr's continued defense.
The sight of me in these clothes brought a tear to my mother's eye. It's...still difficult...
Everyone has high expectations of me... It's an honor to know that so many have such faith.
I will work every day to be a king worthy of your legacy, Father. Please, guide my hand...
Of everyone, it is you whom I owe the greatest debt of gratitude. I look forward to many more years at each other's side.

felix3.name: Felix
felix3.title: Sword Savant
felix3.description: Second son of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus's House Fraldarius. Pursuing improvement, he will cross blades with any he values as a skilled foe. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Hmph. I cannot understand wasting useful break time eating sweets.
I do not regret being born into a family of warriors. Wielding a sword is as natural as breathing to me.
Never underestimate me. I prepare myself for the worst. Your actions should show that you do the same.
I have no problem cooking, but I better not hear anyone complain about how it tastes.
I never had an interest in magic, but a swordsman who understands it has an advantage over one who does not.
Visit: I am Felix Hugo Fraldarius. Now that introductions are complete, I wish to duel your strongest warrior.
Level: I must continue to get stronger and faster. I aim for ever greater heights.
Too easy. Is there no one with more skill who can face me?
There is nothing to be learned from cutting down the defenseless.
Summon: I am Felix Hugo Fraldarius. Is it true that I can fight Heroes from other worlds here? I may enjoy this place.
Learn Skill: Hmph... I suppose a thank-you is in order.
Confession:
The more one fights in battle, the more one comes to bear a certain weight, whether one wishes to or not.
If the king falls, what becomes of the hopes and dreams of those who fall with him? Of their homes, their land?
...What? Why are you looking at me like that? Did you think me a shallow man obsessed only with combat?
I have taken time to consider the purpose of living in my way.
This comes from bearing witness to who will be king and who should be king up close...
You may follow me if you want to see where this path leads, but know I am selfish and will not wait for you.
Special: You think this is a game?
Status: What do you think you're looking at? Impudent buffoon.
What—! ...I have no intention of playing along with your ridiculous games.
How many foes have tasted my blade? Too many to count, and I assure you, there will be more to come.
My father and I may share the same blood, but that is all we have in common. I despise him.
Humans and beasts are ultimately the same. When they're cornered, they lash out however they can. They fight for their lives.
From the moment I first picked up a sword, I wanted to surpass my older brother.
Be proud of your skills. I consider you my most worthy new opponent.

panette.name: Panette
panette.title: Classy Brawler
panette.description: A warrior for Solm and retainer to Timerra. Her speech tends to be stilted, but at times it's erratic. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: As a royal knight of Solm, I have an exquisite taste for cooking. I am especially skilled at roasting chicken.
Before Princess Timerra, I was a little rough around the edges. Being her retainer changed me for the better.
You should relax! Why don't you take a look at some bottled bugs? Or... perhaps we can search for ghosts?!

You can fight too if you train. All you need is to perfect the ability to evade attacks and act fast without thinking.
Once you do that, you can develop the power to strike hard and smash your foes into the ground!
Huh? Is it time to bring the pain?! Oh... Uh...I got a little excited there. Is it time for battle?
Visit: Good day! I have greetings here from [F].
Level: Get in my way and you won't get home alive! Ahem, I mean...goodness, what pleasing results!
Bravo to me! My offensive capabilities have increased.
Ugh! That's no good.
Summon: I am Panette, a lady from the queendom of Solm. Leave the exterminating to me!
Learn Skill: I am at my peak strength. I pity any enemy who dares brawl with me now!
Confession:
Hmm... Oh, uh... I was just offering my prayers, [S]!
To tell you the truth, I am a child of the church. I left home a long time ago and have not returned since...
However, since I was a child I have imitated the techniques of prayer. Go on, you can tell me I look the part.
Sometimes I think about Elyos's blue sky, Solm's desert, and Oasis Village, where I spent time with Timerra...
I look back, and I hope she and the others are well. But of course, ending the conflict in Askr comes foremost!
My nostalgia for home and my passion for battling foes are distinctly different. Now, let's roast 'em!
Special: I'll beat ya to a pulp!
Status: As a lady, I shall exterminate thy foes with the utmost elegance!
Draw yer weapon, fiend! Oh, heh, u-uh, pardon me! Uh, please forgive my rudeness, Summoner.
Without doubt, the thing that will serve one best in combat is the ability to act fast without thinking! Perfect that, and you shall never know defeat!
Excuse me... Perchance might there be a cleric by the name of Pandreo here?
I can only presume by your bold approach that you wish to challenge me in combat.
I like my deity, of course, but I despise the church. I haven't got a single good memory from there.
If you're spooked by insects and ghosts, I'm your girl! I'll protect you anywhere creepy things might appear.

mshez3.name: Shez
mshez3.title: Dual Sword Master
mshez3.description: Mercenary that throws himself into the battles of Fódlan. Defeated countless foes and led many allies to victory. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: This place is a mystery to me. Maybe there is someone here who knows what Arval really is.
I was in the midst of a battle for Fódlan, then I just appeared here... Must've been confusing for them.
What, you're lost? I know how you feel. But I think I've just about got my bearings, so stick with me.
Ugh. I'm trying to nap until the next battle! Oh...you want to nap too? All right then, let's get some shut-eye.
Since the war began, I've had to act as leader. It's good to get back to my roots. I am only a mercenary after all.
Visit: I was told to make an appearance by [F]. So? Ready?
Level: Definitely getting stronger.
I've still got a ways to go.
I'm not stopping anytime soon.
Summon: Oh... You called for me, huh? Name's Shez. With these blades, I'll cut a path for you through the battlefield.
Learn Skill: I'll take what I can get. Maybe this new technique will be enough to win.
Confession:
Back in Fódlan, I was in countless battles. I encountered ambushes, skirmishes, rescue ops, betrayals...
I fought for a long time. And we won many of those battles.
When I came here, I got caught up in the mess of this world and started adding to my war stories with you...
I told myself it was just another job. But even after victories, I didn't celebrate. I don't know when, but...
Something changed and I started feeling proud to fight beside you.
And now, you'll be happy to know, the future of this world is just as vital to me as the future of Fódlan.
Status: Huh...
This blade comes when I call it. I can put it away whenever I like, too.
*gasp* Hey, I could have taken you for an enemy!
Er… Look, I'd love to chat, if I could think of something to say.
Finding a place to take a rest on the battlefield? That's a tough one.
When my company of mercenaries was completely wiped out... That was difficult.
This wind... A storm is comin'.
I'm told I'm pretty calm, but if something were to happen to you, I don't know what I'd do.

fjorm6.name: Fjorm
fjorm6.title: Gleaming Ice Pair
fjorm6.description: Nifl, known as the god of ice, and Princess Fjorm participate in the festival of snow and ice.
fjorm6.duo:
Applies【Divine Vein (Ice)】to unit's space and spaces within 2 spaces of unit for 2 turns (excludes spaces occupied by a foe, destructible terrain other than 【Divine Vein (Ice)】, and warp spaces in Rival Domains).
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)
【Divine Vein (Ice)】
Applies the following status on space: Foes treat space as impassable terrain while status is active, but status is destructible (with 1 HP). Allies can move into and occupy space. If any allies occupy spaces with Divine Vein (Ice) applied, attacks targeting those spaces will hit the ally over destroying the Divine Vein (Ice). (Divine Vein effects do not stack; replaces any existing Divine Vein effect; Divine Vein effects applied simultaneously cancel each other out. Does not count as defensive terrain. Does not trigger in Pawns of Loki.)

Castle Hall: **Nifl:** Leave me in solitude. Unless, of course, there is a festival of ice. That, I shall see for myself.
**Nifl:** The snowcapped mountains, icy rivers, frozen oceans... I created Nifl to be a beautiful, serene land.
**Fjorm:** The Order of Heroes is filled with people who have a deep connection to ice. I feel a kinship with them.
**Nifl:** For a wish to be granted, something must be sacrificed, the way silence is for a successful festival.
**Fjorm:** You look lovely as always, Lady Nifl. What a perfect outfit for the ice festival.
Visit: Take a look at this magnificent castle, Lady Nifl. It belongs to a friend of [F]'s.
Level: **Nifl:** Such elation for the simple reason that this is a festival is not necessary.
**Nifl:** I will say this but once—I dislike commotion.
**Fjorm:** I am so sorry, Lady Nifl! I wish I wasn't so incompetent.
Summon: I am Fjorm, and with me is Lady Nifl, who graces us with her presence at the festival of snow and ice.
Learn Skill: **Nifl:** You prepared this for the festival? Hmm... Thoughtful, for a human.
Confession:
**Fjorm:** Ah, I found you, Lady Nifl. Everyone has gathered to see the sculptures. Shall we?
**Nifl:** No, I will stay here in solitude. I am not fond of noisy gatherings.
**Fjorm:** Then I will stay with you. Is that OK?
**Nifl:** You remind me so much of her... The similarities are— Oh, forget it. You may do as you wish.
**Fjorm:** Oh, Lady Nifl! It's snowing! Is this because of your power?
**Nifl:** I think not. I believe the people of this world have wished for snow.
Perhaps, once the noise of the festival subsides, this land will be blessed with a peaceful silence...
Status: Aww!
Look at it... Everything covered in ice! It's beautiful. Hmm. A scene I am accustomed to.
Conversation: **Fjorm:** Lady Nifl, look at the plaza! There's a beautiful ice sculpture of you!
**Nifl:** How foolish. I no longer rule as a god. What favor could the sculptors have hoped to garner with this totem?
**Fjorm:** There's no grandiose reason behind it. People just create things they like.
There's a rabbit sculpture, a castle, a snowman... I think there's even one of the summoner around here.
**Nifl:** If these are simply things people like, who is it that would make a sculpture of me?
**Fjorm:** My little sister and I, of course. *giggle* It was hard work, but so much fun.
**Nifl:** Hmm...
**Fjorm:** Are you...happy with it?
**Nifl:** Of course not. The face is all wrong. Nothing about the form is accurate.
**Fjorm:** Oh, I-I thought it was pretty cute, but...
**Nifl:** However, creating a work like this takes significant effort.
If nothing else, I should reward you for your toil. Here—a flower long-lost in this age, preserved forever in ice.
**Fjorm:** Oh, how beautiful! Thank you, Lady Nifl.
We should show my sister too! Come on. She'll be so delighted.
**Nifl:** No. I prefer solitude.
You may go. I will stay here and gaze upon this crude sculpture for a while longer.
**Fjorm:** *giggle* I understand. I'll see you later then...

thea2.name: Thea
thea2.title: Wings of Winter
thea2.description: A pegasus knight of Ilia. Her new mission is to participate in the festival of snow and ice. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: My sister taught me how to ride a pegasus. She's a mother now, so I hope she's staying safe somewhere.
I am quite accustomed to the snow. Ilia, where I'm from, is a land covered in snow and ice.
There was a snow festival in your hometown as well? Interesting...
Crops don't grow under snow. My country was poor, its people hungry... Mercenary life was the best option.
My fondest memories of the snow all revolve around my sweet little sister, who enjoyed it so much as a child.
Visit: I am Thea, a mercenary from Ilia. I bring an invitation to an ice festival from [F].
Level: My oath as a knight of Ilia is my pride.
I will fulfill my contract, no matter the foes I must face.
This is silly. Could I have actually caught a cold?
Summon: I am Thea, an Ilian pegasus knight. My mission this time is... Really? To take part in a snow-and-ice festival?
Learn Skill: Thank you. I shall apply myself in a manner befitting a knight of Ilia while in your employ.
Confession:
Am I fond of snow, you ask? I like it... and I don't. My memories of it are numerous and quite varied.
Whenever I flew through a blizzard as a pegasus knight of Ilia, the snow was cold and painful.
On days when the skies were clearer, the powdery snow that danced in the air could be very beautiful.
The snow hides away the fertile land, keeping its potential bounty from us, but...
It may be the snow that strengthened us and endowed us with the fortitude we now possess.
So you see, I cannot say, after all, if I dislike it or not.
Status: Mm...
Thank you for the invitation. I'm looking forward to today.
Ah! You're getting wound up because of the festival, aren't you?
This outfit is wonderful... Do you think I'm doing it justice?
My homeland of Ilia is also a very cold and snowy place.
The chill can be unpleasant, but I really like the wintry view.
*sigh* Look at this beautiful landscape... If only I could show it to Juno and Shanna too.
I am worried you may catch a cold. Make sure you stay warm enough.

flora3.name: Flora
flora3.title: Polar-Perfect
flora3.description: A calm, composed maid from the Ice Tribe of Nohr. She supports the festival of snow and ice with poise and perfection. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The festival is fun, but I'm worried about Felicia. What if she gets too excited and blunders into trouble?
Kilma, leader of the Ice Tribe, is Felicia's and my father. One day, it'll be our responsibility to lead the tribe.
A festival of snow and ice? I am perfectly prepared to help out. Let me know if you need anything.
Would you like some frozen fruit? I chilled it myself. I promise it's both fresh and delicious.
It's not every day we get to enjoy a festival of ice, so Felicia and I ordered new outfits for it. What do you think?
Visit: I am Flora. This is an invitation to a festival of snow and ice, from your friend [F].
Level: Be like ice. Be still. Wait for the right moment to strike. That is how the Ice Tribe fights.
I request that any and all who are unnecessarily loud please vacate the premises immediately.
You have my deepest apologies for failing to meet your expectations...
Summon: I'm Flora, a maid from Nohr. A festival of snow and ice is to be held. If you need anything, please let me know.
Learn Skill: I am grateful for your thoughtfulness. I will be of use to you no matter what.
Confession:
Are you enjoying the snow-and-ice festival, [S]?
As a member of the Ice Tribe, I'm very proud to help put on an event such as this.
I was worried if Felicia and I were of any service in this world, with so many other great Heroes around...
Well, seeing everyone enjoying the festival has reduced my unease.
Both the cold of the snow and ice and the warmth of everyone's hearts have left me feeling happy.
Never fear. I shall continue to exert every effort to support everyone alongside my sister.
Status: A festival of snow and ice? How lovely!
Oh, be careful! I know I'm quite cold.
I've prepared you a meal. Please, have a seat and enjoy.
I'm from the village of the Ice Tribe, actually. I miss it dearly.
Are you feeling sleepy? Care for a pick-me-up?
What's that? You like my outfit? Oh, thank you so much!
Spending time with you makes me so happy, I worry I might accidentally conjure up a blizzard...

felicia3.name: Felicia
felicia3.title: Confidently Cold
felicia3.description: A hard-working but clumsy maid from the Ice Tribe of Nohr. She fights eagerly to make the festival of snow and ice a success. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: Wow! There are snow sculptures in every corner of the event space! I need to be careful around them...
I'm Ice Tribe, same as my sister. Our body temperatures are lower than most. Here, try it, touch my arm!
What? This is not a Faceless! This is a statue I made of my liege, Corrin. I carved it out of ice!
I made you soup to warm you up. I'll bring— AHHH! I slipped in the snow? How did that happen?!
My sister's festival outfit suited her quite well. It was just perfect for the ice festival, don't you think?
Visit: I'm Felicia! There's a snow-and-ice festival happening right now at [F]'s castle.
Level: Let's make some fun memories at the snow-and-ice festival!
You don't need to get so heated! Let's enjoy the festival.
Ahhh! I dropped my weapon and almost stabbed my foot...
Summon: I'm Felicia! I'm here to help out with the festival. Here's some warm tea... Yikes! I slipped on the ice!
Learn Skill: What?! Is this for me?! Is this my reward for all my hard work with the festival? Thank you!
Confession:
I brought you some warm tea. Don't worry, I know where everything is, and nothing can trip me...
AHHH! Snow fell from a tree branch and hit me?! Wh-why did it fall right now? At this moment?!
I spilled most of it, but here, have some tea. There's sugar as well... What? This is salt? Oh...
Shoot... I really wanted to make you a fun memory of the snow-and-ice festival, and now this...
What? Why are you laughing? This will be a fun memory? R-really? If you say so...
I guess I can think of this as a success then? Right? Haha.
Status: Leave everything to me. It's a festival of ice, after all!
Ahh! I'm kind of busy, so you mustn't pester me!
I can't stop staring at this ice! So blue, so clear. It's beautiful!
How do I look? Am I ready for the festival?
Don't worry! The plates are made of ice, so I can fix them! No matter how many I break!
It's wonderful seeing everyone enjoy the festival... *giggle*
When it's this cold out, I always recommend a warm cup of tea. Here!

nils3.name: Nils
nils3.title: Snowflake Melody
nils3.description: A boy who travels with his sister, Ninian. He shows off his talent with the flute at the festival of snow and ice. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Princess Fjorm said her country is covered in snow and ice year-round. I would like to visit there someday.
I've traveled many different countries with Ninian, but none of them had as many festivals as Askr does.
You don't dislike the cold? Fantastic! Then you should enjoy this festival, right, [S]?
Ninian and I are deeply connected to ice. The blood of ice dragons flows through our veins, after all.
Does this outfit suit me? Dressing in clothes fit for the occasion makes a festival more exciting, doesn't it?
Visit: I'm Nils, a traveling bard. Come have fun with us at the ice festival over at [F]'s castle!
Level: How long has it been since I had fun like this? If only Ninian were here to enjoy the experience with me.
Whoa. Don't get so intense. Let me play a relaxing tune for you to help you cool your head a bit.
I'm not quite my usual self... Could I have caught a cold? Do ice dragons even catch colds?
Summon: I'm Nils. Is this the event space for the snow-and-ice festival? I can add some atmosphere with my flute!
Learn Skill: You're giving this to me? Thank you! I love ice festivals even more now!
Confession:
I had a lot of fun! Were you able to enjoy the snow-and-ice festival too, [S]?
Ninian and I traveled together a long, long time, believing that one day we would find a land of peace.
We hid ourselves from view because our power draws too much attention in the world of humans...
But people in Askr don't look at us with suspicion or fear. They invited us to a festival! Can you believe that?
It may be that Askr is exactly the kind of peaceful land the two of us have been searching for.
One day, we will return to Elibe, but we will never forget Askr. I can assure you, we'll come back here again!
Status: Let's play some more.
Hahaha. Aren't you tired?
Ninian and I are ice dragons. Well, a-actually, only half.
You're cold? Ahaha. I'm completely fine!
Oh this? I'm making a sculpture of Ninian. Like it?
I had no idea everyone could come together to enjoy ice like this.
I know the perfect tune for this festival! M-mind if I play my flute?

timerra.name: Timerra
timerra.title: Desert Warrior
timerra.description: Crown princess of Solm, the Queendom of Freedom. Bubbly and outgoing, she is known for being accessible and approachable by all. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: The Order of Heroes' structure and attitude is a lot like Solm's Sentinels. I hope to learn a lot while I'm here!
I've always behaved with the dignity of a princess... I dance, camp, make new friends, and cook meat!
I've made perfectly cooked, golden-brown meat! It's all yours, since you always do your best!
My spear's a gift from my brother. I'll never lose a battle with it, and it'll be a national treasure of Solm someday!
I'm good with faces and names, so I won't forget the Heroes I met here. I won't forget you either, Summoner.
Visit: This castle is wonderful! I'm gonna sing a song about it. Oh! And here's a note from [F]!
Level: Achievements like this deserve a party. So let's make sure to get back safely.
Expect no less from the princess of Solm! Ha! Just joking. But it is cool how strong I am.
Ouch. Oh well, I guess these things happen.
Summon: I'm Timerra, crown princess of Solm. I'll sing a song to celebrate arriving in this world! Lalala! Nice to meet you!
Learn Skill: I feel great! Like I've just eaten some delicious meat! Thanks, Summoner!
Confession:
I'm cooking up some meat for you as a symbol of my gratitude and trust!
If I'm honest, I wasn't sure I trusted you at first. I worried about why you were summoning so many Heroes.
But, after spending time with you, I understand you're forging bonds so you can bring peace.
I saw the Divine Dragon do the same. I know bonds rid us of the darkness. We'll part ways eventually, but...
I'm totally devoted to helping you in... Look! The meat is done cooking! This will be a taste you'll never forget!
Status: For my seventh song, a little ditty called "Ode to the Askran Trees." ♪O Askran trees... Your bark and leaves... ♪
Ow! If you want to get my attention, you don't have to poke so hard!
This weapon was a gift from Fogado. I love it so much!
My country, the queendom of Solm, has held on to Emblem Ike's ring for generations.
Hey, can you use those summoning powers of yours to make a nice steak appear? Come on, at least try!
I like hearing how other nations do things. Who knows, maybe I'll pick up some new ideas.
**When I'm tired, there are two things that help me wake up:** yummy food, and singing as loud as I possibly can. Wanna join me?

reginn3.name: Reginn
reginn3.title: Dvergr Heir
reginn3.description: Princess and future queen of Niðavellir. She is training so that she may one day find herself worthy of the throne.

Castle Hall: I'm doing my best to make my brothers proud... I hope they watch over me.
This thing floating beside me is a drone! It sure helps me out a lot.
I've got a seiðjárn tool that's super convenient. I'd like to gift one to you if I could, [S].
We should take a walk together! Uh... Huh? You want to ride a Gullinbursti? Sure, hop on behind me!
I'd like to send my drone on an errand for me, but...I don't know if I can.
Visit:
"Sorry I couldn't make it myself," from, [F].
That's in case you're wondering why I'm here alone.
Level: Nice! I wonder if my drone had anything to do with this.
I'm doing my best!
Maybe my Gullinbursti needs a tune-up?
Summon: I'm Reginn, princess of Niðavellir. I don't have my brothers with me, but...I'll prove I'm a strong leader!
Learn Skill: This power... It's new to me. I'll use it to the best of my ability. You'll see!
Confession:
Thank you for bringing me into the Order of Heroes, [S].
When we first met, we didn't have a choice in working together to stop my brothers, but now's different...
We've chosen to be friends and I cherish everyone here.
They're all from different worlds, with different pasts. But everyone is determined to create a better future.
It's time I grow strong and learn all I can from them, so that I can protect Niðavellir.
I know my brothers will be watching over me. And I hope you'll support me, [S]!
Status: Do you think people can see that this gear makes me stronger? I sure feel stronger!
*yelp/scream* I don't usually scare easily... I'm not a child anymore.
I wish I could grow big and strong like Princess Dagr. Maybe in my dreams...
I want to be a proper queen. To do that I need to fight and get stronger!
I'm learning more about seiðjárn now! Though... most of it's like gibberish to me.
My dear brothers... I'm doing my best to make you proud. Please, watch over me.
If anyone picks on you, I'll blast them away with my Gullinbursti!

fogado.name: Fogado
fogado.title: Affable Prince
fogado.description: First prince of Solm and Timerra's little brother. He is more amiable than one expects of royalty. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: It's not as warm in Askr as it is back home. That makes tropical fruits pretty hard to come by.
Solm is a queendom, so I'll never be a ruling king. But I will always work to support my mother and sister.
You're working today? You could take a break, have fun, make some noise... But I admire your hard work!
Let's have a party! Not every day the Heroes all gather in one hall. What an opportunity to get to know everyone!
I've been gathering intel... Er, I mean going for walks and reading! I'm off to see what the other Heroes are doing.
Visit: My Sentinel duties include foreign relations. So here's greetings from your friend [F]!
Level: I've grown so strong I feel bad for my foes.
Thank you to all my enemies for helping me grow so strong!
Hahaha... Sorry. I haven't changed at all.
Summon: I'm Fogado, a Sentinel of Solm, and the first prince too... But don't worry about that part. Let's be friends!
Learn Skill: Wow! I'm so happy! I'm going to work extra hard for you!
Confession:
We've gotten pretty close fighting on the battlefield, haven't we? Let's chat for a bit, just the two of us?
Haha, you're busy and you're going to turn me down, aren't ya? No? This is a good time? Great! Love it!
You know, I've wanted some alone time with you for a while. I've been interested in you since we met.
