How do you manage to capture the hearts of all the Heroes? I think it's because you sincerely care for them.
That's why I'll do whatever you need. Knowing we can talk, just us two, is really good motivation for me!
Status: Hey.
Back in Solm, I was captain of the Sentinels! If there's trouble, I'm here to help!
Ah, you're inviting me to a party? I'll be there all the way till dawn!
Since I'm here, I want to experience all of the fun this world has to offer! Any suggestions?
Anyone ever told you you're a good listener? Well, I'd love to hear about what's going on with you!
What a lucky day, getting to talk to you! There are lots of Heroes though, so I won't hog you all to myself.
I leave the castle to travel all the time... but never quite as far as this!
If you're in trouble, I'll do anything to help! As captain of the Sentinels, it's my duty to help people who need it.

merrin.name: Merrin
merrin.title: Suave Knight
merrin.description: A knight of Solm and Princess Timerra's retainer. She is a suave woman who cherishes animals. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I met a Hero who can turn into an animal! I didn't know people who aren't dragons could do that!
In my homeland, I protected Princess Timerra as her knight. Mostly, I'd guard her camp and tend the fire.
To soothe an aching heart, eat a sweet, or pet an animal! If you like doing those things, that is.
Askr's animals are wonderful. Have you seen that owl over there? She's so fascinating!
I saw a person with rabbit ears! Was it a Hero in a costume? Or are they a rare critter from another world?!
Visit: Are there rare critters here too? Oh! I've got a greeting for you from your friend [F]!
Level: I shall remain stoic as I defeat my enemies. It's simply my style.
As long as I'm improving, that's cool enough for me.
Ugh...that wasn't very cool. I wish you hadn't seen that.
Summon: I'm Merrin, royal knight of Solm. This isn't my world, but I'll fight for it! Where is Princess Timerra?
Learn Skill: I've been granted the power to fight, so you'd better believe I'm going to give it my all!
Confession:
Look! An Askran rabbit! It's so cute! Oh! It ran off.
I'm so happy you summoned me. I've seen new rare critters, and I've met knights from other worlds.
I learned a lot about fighting in my world, but here, I've learned to polish my strategies.
Please keep on teaching me all sorts of things. I want to learn everything I can!
Now, I have an important question. The owl that's at our castle... Where does it get all those rainbow orbs?
Status: Ooh...
I am a knight who honors her princess, no matter where I go.
Oh— You closed that distance like it was nothing. Reminds me so much of the Tartu Flamingo from my homeland!
Tell me. What sorts of animals live here? I want to know everything about this place.
I hear that summoners like you are incredibly rare. So... You're like a rare critter!
My wolf partner was given to me by my princess. I bet you'd like to pet her sometime, huh?
I'm in the mood for some snacks. Something sweet, or salty? Or both!
I don't only chase after rare critters, you know. You'll see... I'm a cool cat.

pandreo.name: Pandreo
pandreo.title: Party Priest
pandreo.description: A Solm Palace priest and Prince Fogado's retainer. He's deeply religious, but loves a party. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Everyone runs when I start dancing, but it's great when I sing! Small birds and animals gather all around me!
Fogado may be my master, but we're more like friends. I'll always protect him with my life on the battlefield.
I heard you're a talented tambourine player. I'd like it if you wanted to show off your skills at my next party.
AROOO! Let's get this party started! Oh, Summoner?! Forgive me. I'm most certainly not throwing a party here.
I was offering a prayer to the Divine Dragon for peace in my motherland of Elyos, a land very far from here.
Visit: AROO! That's from me! I also bring a greeting for the summoner here from summoner [F].
Level: This power that's been granted to me... I understand its importance, Summoner.
Oh! I got stronger! I am so grateful to you, Summoner.
Oh, Summoner, please forgive this poor lost sheep.
Summon: I'm Pandreo, a cleric of Solm. Didn't I hear your voice in the church? Are you also divine—a subject of worship?
Learn Skill: What a warm, comforting power. I am grateful to you for your protection.
Confession:
Summoner, it pleases me to see you looking well today. I am honored that you allow me to fight with you.
...What? You feel distant when I call you by your title, so you want me to call you by your name instead?
Oh, I could never be so impertinent! Imagine speaking to such a great hero without using a title to show respect!
But wait! Is it more rude to deny your request? Uh... In that case, it's good to see you, [S].
You seem satisfied. Then, I suppose, once in a while, I will call you by your name. With respect and affection.
Status: Yeah!
Strength in faith!
Now this is a party!
I worship the Divine Dragon. Does any such being exist in the Order of... Huh? You have lots of them?!
I want to throw a party. Are there any churches that it'd be OK to decorate?
Oh, you're wondering what "aroo" means? Think of it as a carefree greeting.
Where is Fogado? He's always forgetting about us retainers...
You look troubled! You should get loud and forget the bad things in life! Aroo!

marni.name: Marni
marni.title: Pining for Praise
marni.description: A member of the Four Hounds. Relishes praise most of all and regards herself as superior to others. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: With so many Heroes here, how will anyone even notice me?

In the world I come from, I was one of the Four Hounds, followers in service to Fell Dragon Sombron.
When I told people that, they would tremble with fear, so, you know...
You're always running around. It's a little irritating, you know... Huh? No, I'm not offering to help you out!
I was great today! Impressive, huh? Bring on the praise! Special for today, I'll even let you rub my head.
There are parent and child Heroes here. I'm not sure I've seen a parent show their child so much love before.
Visit: I brought this from far away. Tell me I did a great job. Come on, praise me! Oh! It's from [F].
Level: I'm amazing! Now's your chance to tell me so!
This much is a given. It's got "worthy of praise" written all over it.
What? That's it? But...I can do better.
Summon: I'm Marni, one of the Four Hounds. I've come a long way, and I'm pretty exceptional. I know you see it too!
Learn Skill: This means you're looking after me, doesn't it? I love being the favorite!
Confession:
Oh, Summoner. What is it? Something about the next mission? I guess I can listen, but make it quick.
Whaaat?! You're putting me on the front lines?! But why?! Is it because I did too good a job in the last battle?
Ooh. Did you just praise me? I see. I do really like people who can see how amazing I am.
My mother abandoned me as a child. I helped her so much, but she never praised me. Not once. That's why...
I mean, it doesn't matter now. I'm over it. I'll prove that I deserve your praise. Then you can give me more.
Status: What? If you don't need anything, just go away. U-unless you've come to praise me, that is.
Just one minute! Don't think you can casually come up and poke at me, all right? Actually, wait, when did you even get behind me?
They worship you as the summoner or whatever, but basically you can only fight by summoning others, right?
The Four Hounds are Lord Sombron's favorites. We can do anything, with impunity. Feels good to be appreciated!
I bet you have a big family. What? ...You don't have anyone here? Oh, um. That's a...a little sad.
I wonder where Zephia and Griss are right now. Oh, and Mauvier too...I guess.
You're this great hero, but you don't look like much, so I'll help you out. When we win, be sure to lavish praise on me.

sigurd5.name: Sigurd
sigurd5.title: Of the Holy War
sigurd5.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to Elyos. Resides in the Ring of the Holy Knight. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War / Fire Emblem Engage.
sigurd5.origin: Genealogy of the Holy War + Engage
sigurd5.emblem:
Enhanced Engaged Special
Boosts Special damage by number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat (max 4) × 2.
Enables【Canto (X)】. If unit's Range = 1, X = 3; otherwise, X = 2.
At start of turn, grants "unit can move 1 extra space" to unit for 1 turn (does not stack; excludes cavalry with Range = 2).
【Canto (X)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move X spaces (once per turn; only highest value applied; does not stack).

Castle Hall: The faces of those beloved to me and those of my enemies fill me with nostalgia in equal measure now.
I was with Lumera in Elyos. I know all too well the great sorrow she must have felt at leaving her child behind.

I never thought I would meet my wife and child again. Now, might I have the joy of being with them?
Speaking with them, walking with them, dining with them...
It would be a waste not to enjoy the ability to dine here. I would like to try making a meal for family and friends.
What meaning has a ring? To me, Emblem Rings symbolize entrusted power and my bonds with you all.
Visit: You need not praise my efforts. This was not so far to go. I bear a message from [F].
Level: I would like my presence to be one that inspires fear in my enemies and emboldens my allies.
I take pride in this. I shall support and protect everyone with this power.
Anyone is capable of regret. I will look to the future.
Summon: I am Emblem Sigurd. My desire is for peace in all worlds. If you have need of strength, I shall lend you mine.
Learn Skill: I shall use this power to fight, so that no one has to be parted from those they love.
Confession:
The battle today was fierce. It is a relief to see that you made it through unharmed, [S].
I may have said so before, but I lost those precious to me in the world I was first born into as well as Elyos.
I never wish to feel such loss again. I wish to protect the Heroes and friends around me, and you as well.
I may not be as courageous as my other self, but...as an Emblem, this power is mine and mine alone.
I shall bring peace by fighting as only I can without losing anyone. I am glad I could share these feelings with you.
Status: Ah...
If you are riding far, I will accompany you. You might arrive sooner with me at your side.
Oh! I thought you wanted to polish the Emblem ring. It is a common practice on the Somniel.
In Elyos, I was with Lumera at Lythos Castle.
Both my original self and my Emblem self have lived through the loss of those important to us.
What was it? "Provide for us, Emblem of the Holy War..." Yes, that was the invocation to summon me.
Deirdre, Seliph... I never dreamed I would get to see you again.
It seems there are many Sigurds in the Order, some you may know well. As an Emblem, I am all of them, and none of them.

nagi2.name: Nagi
nagi2.title: Hopeful Eternity
nagi2.description: Nagi, a Divine Dragon with no memories, attends the harvest festival, where Idunn imparts wisdom she has gained by reclaiming her heart and mind. They appear in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem / The Binding Blade.
nagi2.origin: New Mystery of the Emblem + The Binding Blade
nagi2.harmonized:
For unit and allies from the same titles as unit, grants Atk/Res+6,【Resonance: Shields】, "neutralizes 'effective against dragons' bonuses," and【Warp Bubble】for 1 turn, neutralizes any【Penalty】, and restores 30 HP.
(Harmonized Skills can be used by tapping the Harmonized button. This skill can only be used once per map. Harmonized Skills cannot be used by units deployed using
Pair Up
.)
【Resonance: Shields】
Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."
【Warp Bubble】
Foes cannot warp into spaces within 4 spaces of unit. (Does not affect foes with Pass skills or warp effects from structures, like camps and fortresses in Rival Domains.)
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).

Castle Hall: **Idunn:** The lives of mortals are far too short. Yet, I believe the radiance of their sentiments lights the land for all time.
**Nagi:** Could I have...participated in a festival like this before? I cannot remember...
**Idunn:** Manaketes are connected to the land. We could not maintain our existence without its blessing.
**Idunn:** Trick or treat. I understand that these words are used to bridge the distance that separates people at this festival.
**Nagi:** Festivals are mysterious things... I feel as though something in my heart stirs when I see people so full of cheer...
Visit: I am Nagi. A mysterious fate guides me. Now I take part in this harvest festival with [F].
Level: **Idunn:** The bounty of the land flows into me. I shall use this power to protect all that is precious.
**Idunn:** Nagi, take my hand... Let us make the festival more wonderful together.
**Nagi:** It seems I have grown...weary... The excitement and cheer of the festival are...so much.
Summon: I am the Divine Dragon Idunn. Come, Nagi, let us make the most of this festival together.
Learn Skill: **Nagi:** So this is the land's bounty... Is it permissible for me to...accept this?
Confession:
**Nagi:** The harvest festival... This should be my first festival, yet...it feels familiar somehow... Why?
**Idunn:** Perhaps, in the distant past, you have enjoyed similar festivals with humans.
Offering up gratitude for the blessing of the land...
Dragons and humans depend on it. All living beings share this sentiment.
**Nagi:** Gratitude... Is that why everyone is smiling? Because they feel this way.
**Idunn:** I am sure you understand this deep inside. Even if you have no memories, your heart beats, alive and warm.
**Nagi:** This is true. If I am to offer gratitude, I must offer it first to you, Idunn... Thank you.
Status: Huh...
"We are to...surprise people? If that is the case..." "Um... You should probably refrain from transforming into a dragon here."
Conversation: **Idunn:** Hehehe... Ahahaha...
**Nagi:** Huh...
**Idunn:** Oh, excuse my laughter. The child in costume over there is rather cute.
**Nagi:** I...see...
**Idunn:** Er... Nagi, could it be that you are not enjoying the harvest festival?
**Nagi:** Enjoying... I am not sure I know what that means.
All I know is I must finish what I have left undone... There is nothing else.
**Idunn:** Is that so... You remind me of how I used to be.
**Nagi:** I am...as you were?
**Idunn:** Yes. Long ago, I, too, knew nothing of joy and laughter...
But I know those things now, thanks to Fae and the others.
Perhaps it is my turn to share what I learned with another. Nagi, I want you to know what it is like to smile.
**Nagi:** You want me to... I am not sure I can.
**Idunn:** You can. I am certain. Come with me to the courtyard.
To learn to smile, it is helpful to see many smiles yourself. This is what I discovered while observing Fae.
**Nagi:** To see...smiles...
**Idunn:** I think you will find that Askr is a good place to learn to smile. Now, let us be on our way.

nah2.name: Nah
nah2.title: Grateful One
nah2.description: Nowi's daughter. She looks young, but she's very put together, and she expresses her gratitude for the harvest at this year's festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: The harvest festival, eh? I see. Now I understand why Mother was dressed in such an unusual outfit.
The harvest festival is fascinating. There were almost no festivals left where we come from.
It's OK to play tricks on people at this festival? Well then. It's time for me to rampage.
Trick or treat. If possible, I'd rather get some sweets than play tricks. I'm tired of eating tree roots.
Why do people dress as witches at this festival? I'll ask Mother... No, I think that will be more confusing.
Visit: I am Nah. This is a witch costume! We are having a harvest festival at [F]'s castle.
Level: It is time to act like a witch. Ahem... FIERY ICY DEATH STRIKE! Good, yes?
If you're going to obstruct the festival proceedings, then you should know I will have to eat you whole.
No! I wasn't distracted by the treats!
Summon: Why would I dress up in this outfit? Sweets? What? I can get sweets? I'm listening...
Learn Skill: *munch munch* Not bad. Not bad. I'll allow you to give me more.
Confession:
We are still in the midst of a war, so I do not feel like we have time to play.
But, expressing joy for the harvest and being grateful for the land's bounty is a necessary thing, I think.
In the world I came from, the land was ruined, and there was no room in people's hearts for gratitude.
Thankfully, there's still a place for that here in Askr.
Protecting the peace so this festival can continue on forever... That seems important. Vital, even.
So I'm going to enjoy the festival too! Otherwise, Mother will eat all the treats herself.
Status: *giggle*
I'm a spooky witch! Did I scare you?
Ahh!! Aww... It's supposed to be me who scares you!
Is it true that the harvest festival is the one day when you can get all the sweets you desire?
I gave Mother some candy. Even though she's my mother.
I wouldn't ordinarily prank anyone. I'm entirely too well behaved.
My outfit is just like Mother's! Hehe...
I'm not giving you any sweets until you've done some mischief.

lethe3.name: Lethe
lethe3.title: Cat Attack
lethe3.description: A fierce warrior from Gallia, land of the laguz. She shows her thanks for nature's blessings at the harvest festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Why the costumes? Why the tricks? Why must beorc culture be so difficult to understand?
Gratitude to the land for its blessings is not only for beorc or laguz. We all live because of those blessings.
Many from Gallia prefer meat over sweets, but if this is tradition, then I suppose there's no changing it.
My sister, Lyre, is the better choice for a trickster. But you asked me, and I'll do anything to oblige.
I would imagine my prey is likely to be surprised and flee if I wear a flashy outfit like this on the hunt.
Visit: I come to deliver a gift for the harvest festival from [F]!
Level: Choose between a trick or a treat. And choose wisely! I must warn you that I do not hold back!
I am able to continue being a warrior because of the land's blessings.
I-I am not surprised! No! Warriors are not easily put on their heels!
Summon: I am Lethe of Gallia. I will participate in this harvest festival with all of my sincerity as a warrior.
Learn Skill: I must offer my thanks to the land for its blessings.
Confession:
I am growing used to this outfit just as the festival is set to end. It has been a lot of fun.
I thought the beorc were strange for dressing up in costumes and making threats for treats, but...
I've learned the true purpose of the festival is to offer up thanks to the land for its bounty.
Such bounty is precious for all who live, even those of us in Gallia who obtain our sustenance from hunting.
Our warrior life is possible only due to the land granting us its bounty. We must never forget that.
I worried I had begun to forget. But this festival reminded me. You have my gratitude for inviting me.
Status: Hmm...
Uh, aren't these clothes just a bit too festive? They're bound to draw attention...
Huh?! You spooked me! You're a bad person.
Ugh, I've had it! Why is everyone so obsessed with my ears and tail?
I bet Lyre would like these sweets. Is it OK if I take some for her?
A piece of candy this big can't be good for my teeth.
When everyone's in costume, the differences that make us laguz or beorc cease to matter.
There's so much about this festival that's lively and fun. Humph. Thank you for inviting me.

askr3.name: Askr
askr3.title: Open Harvest
askr3.description: The god of openness from which the kingdom of Askr's name originates. He enjoys the harvest festival to its fullest.

Castle Hall: The land's bounty is not a privilege bestowed by the gods. It takes effort to reap from the harvest.
I so admire the energy mortals place into appreciating all of life, which is displayed in their wonderful festivals.
I received so many sweets. I think Ash will be happy if I share some with her.
Festivals are known to bring gods and mortals together. In fact, they're a great way to meet all sorts people.
Do tell me if there's anything strange going on with this outfit. It is the first occasion I've had to dress in costume.
Visit: I was sent to tell you there's a harvest festival going on as we speak at [F]'s castle.
Level: Trick or treat? Whichever you choose, I will use all the power at my disposal to grant it to you!
Let gods and mortals alike enjoy the festival together!
Oop—I must have spooked you. It was only meant to be a trick. Controlling my power is no easy feat.
Summon: I am Askr, here to join in the festivities. No need for formalities. Let us celebrate the harvest together!
Learn Skill: May the people of Askr reap abundance forevermore.
Confession:
Greetings, [S].
I'm happy to see such a lively harvest festival this year. You see...
I've known about the festival for quite some time and always wanted to join, but it's not so easy in my position.
I am glad to be able to celebrate the joys of this year's harvest with the people of Askr.
And I pray the fruits of this harvest will nourish everyone for a long time to come.
Status: Ahh...
Thank you for inviting me to this festival. It is the first occasion I've had to dress in costume!
Oh! Uh, was that some sort of harvest etiquette just now?
Festivals are a wonderful way to take a step outside the day to day and celebrate our lives.
It is an amazing feeling, seeing everyone pleased by the harvest.
Would you mind if I brought some sweets back for Ash?
This is such fun. I should have asked Embla to join me...
I pray that the time you spend here in Askr will bear fruit for you.

yarne3.name: Yarne
yarne3.title: Trick or Taguel
yarne3.description: As last of the taguel, he fears extinction. This year, he dons a costume at the harvest festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: There are pumpkin decorations all through the castle. But...I can't eat that much...
I'll do my due diligence and express my thanks to all the food out there. Without it, we'd go extinct.
Sweet things are tasty, but be careful because too much can rot your teeth. That's a trap that leads to extinction!
Heeey! What are you doing?! My ears aren't costume pieces; they're real! Paws off!
Eek! All these people in monster costumes are bad for the heart! I wish they wouldn't dress so scary...
Visit:
Aaah! It's a ghost! Oh... It's just you, [S]?
No matter what, I cannot let my guard down at this harvest festival...
Level: Oh, land, thank you for your bounty. It's important to express my gratitude, or I might go extinct!
I'm not afraid of ghosts. I'm... just cautious!
I'll go extinct if someone plays a trick on me!
Summon: Trick or treat! If I'm the one to play a trick on someone else, then I can get by without being surprised, right?
Learn Skill: Candy, for me? This'll keep me from extinction! I'll save it for the moment right before I die of hunger.
Confession:
Eek! Someone's trying to trick me again! Oh... It's just you, [S]...
I don't like being surprised, so I thought I'd be the one doing the surprising. But it's not working...
It seems it takes talent to trick others. That's something I don't have.
Hm? It's easy to tell me not to be so down when you're not on the verge of extinction. Oh, candy? Thank you!
Too bad this festival isn't just about candy, instead of tricking people...
I'm going to be nervous the whole time until it's over. Stay with me? I'm begging you, [S]!
Status: *startles*
Harvest festival? I hope there's no rabbit on the menu!
Eek! Please don't eat me!
OK, I'll eat the whole harvest, grow extra strong, and...kiss extinction goodbye!
Do you like my costume? Ah, ah, ah! Paws off!
I'm not so sure about all these monster costumes... *shivers*
I'm going all-out! If that's OK?
Yeah those monsters are freaky, huh? All right, all right, we can walk together so you're not too scared.

marianne3.name: Marianne
marianne3.title: Cursed Blessing
marianne3.description: Adopted daughter of Margrave Edmund. She is more optimistic about herself than ever before. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I always disliked myself, but now... I feel as though I've been freed from those terrible feelings.
I'll do my best in life to use what I have learned from the kindness and warmth of others...
Supplies for the infirmary are here! I brought them over right away... Oh no! There go the bandages!
I've been nervous, but everyone is so warm... You know, it really reminds me of the monastery.
I was offering my prayers to the goddess. Would you join me?
Visit: Whew! I made it without getting lost! I'm here with a message from your friend [F].
Level: Oh, Goddess... I offer my thanks.
Will I be more useful now?
I'll follow secretly so I don't hold anyone back.
Summon: I am Marianne von Edmund. I am little more than what you see, but please allow me to aid you.
Learn Skill: Goddess, watch over me. Please give me the strength to protect everyone.
Confession:
I was praying to the goddess because I recently did something in battle that frightened people...
I was once told not to interact with others, so I did just that all my life.
I don't know that I've ever gotten over how that made me feel. I think this must be what a curse feels like.
But, I want to change. I want to be useful. I want to make it so everyone is able to smile...
So I'm praying for help to do my absolute best all the time, and to never hold anyone back.
I think I feel like I can do it because I met you... I hope we can keep having a positive impact on one another!
Status: Yes.
I feel as though my curse is finally lifting.
Sorry. Did I...do something wrong?
The beast must have roamed aimlessly, suffering the whole time for what he'd done.
Maurice's Crest is a symbol of disaster. Anyone who came near it—near me—would suffer great misfortune. At least, that's what I thought...
I'm starting to like myself.
Goddess, I thank you.
I shall do my best to not let anyone down, especially you.

dagr4.name: Dagr
dagr4.title: Sunny Bloom
dagr4.description: Princess of Jötunheimr who lost her older sister and is now the next and only heir to the throne.

Castle Hall: She's sleeping, isn't she? Veðrfölnir, you're getting a little heavy! Pshaw, ancestors... Whatcha gonna do?
I got too much going on lately. I feel like my head's gonna pop! OK if I take a little break?
I got this medicine from Niðavellir that makes you feel all sorts of energized! Want some?
Ahh... Sure is nice outside. Know any good napping spots?
It's boring having no one to fight with. It's not that I'm lonely without her, I just...
Visit: So what are we playin'? Bet you're glad it's me instead of [F], huh?
Level: I'm just gettin' started! Can you keep up?
Aha... So far, so good!
Uh... Things seem to be heatin' up around here. Time for me to get serious?
Summon: I'm Dagr, princess of Jötunheimr! And this here's Veðrfölnir. Now, where's some stuff we can break?!
Learn Skill: Sweet! I look forward to testing this out!
Confession:
Aw... You're here to check up on me, [S]?
I'm all good, full of energy as always. I'm the same ol' Dagr, after all.
Oh, you mean— Yeah... When my sis died, I wasn't myself, but...I can't focus on that now.
Besides, she'd laugh at me if she ever saw me tear up. So, you won't see me wallowing.
If ever you need somethin', leave it to me. I'll get it done lickety-split!
Status: Yeah...
So! Whaddaya think of the new and improved Dagr? Pretty great, yeah?
Wah?! Ho ho, time to retaliate! *exert*
On my shoulder is Veðrfölnir, first of our kind. She grants me her power.
There's so many different personalities in the Order of Heroes. So cool!
Being the future queen is tough for a lotta reasons, gotta say...
Nótt... I really do miss you. Just, y'know, a little!
With you, I'm invincible!

dorothea.name: Dorothea
dorothea.title: Daring Ex-Singer
dorothea.description: A student of the Black Eagles. She once drew the attention of aristocrats as a songstress. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall:
The heirs to the Alliance, Empire, and Kingdom were all enrolling at the academy.
I thought it would be a great opportunity and allow me to pursue the path Manuela chose...
Manuela is the finest songstress the opera ever had. She's my inspiration, even though she has her problems.
A plain girl can be more popular than a beauty. Some people simply want a viscount when they could have a duke.
We should have teatime so all of us in the castle can get to know one another better. What do you say?
I can cook...food. But not anything you'd call "cuisine." It's all the same once it's in your stomach anyway.
Visit: I'm curious, on a personal level: Just what sort of relationship do you have with [F]?
Level: I aim to at least learn how to defend myself. I'm seeking a balance of brawn and beauty.
Is making us experience a real battle part of the church's teachings?
Even I get it.
Summon: I'm Dorothea Arnault, a songstress with no family. I'm searching for the love of my life. I'll see you around.
Learn Skill: I appreciate your coaching.
Confession:
They have dances in Askr, yes? I'm excited to attend one. Maybe there I'll catch a lover.
I'll do anything to be happy. No, I'm serious! I'm always serious. It's how I've stayed alive this long.
That's why I need someone to love. Or, more important, to be loved by. One-sided love isn't good enough.
You, Edie, the professor... I can see you're all doing your best to uphold your ideals...
But you know, hasn't it been a while since you arrived? You must've had at least one or two crushes by now.
I won't pry. Some things should stay secret. But I'm going to spend my days looking forward to that dance.
Status: I'll look after you.
I'm right here.
If there's anything you need, I'd be delighted to help out.
Let's not waste a moment of the time we have together.
Back in the imperial capital, I was a songstress. But those days are behind me, now.
So many beautiful and important people in one place. The possibilities are staggering, aren't they?
Times are tough, but try not to pout. Think of all the people who look to you for inspiration!

ashe.name: Ashe
ashe.title: Chivalric Amends
ashe.description: A student of the Blue Lions. Though he was born a commoner, by a twist of fate Lord Lonato took him in. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: There are certain things you have to know if you want to command troops.
I'm Lonato's adopted son. He raised me as though I were his own blood. That takes a certain kindness.
My dad used to own a restaurant. I helped out a lot around the kitchen, even as a little kid.

I see Kyphon as the ideal knight. He can overcome any hardship.
His devotion and loyalty did enable his best friend, Loog, to become king, after all.
I have a lot of experience in the kitchen. I can make just about anything.
Visit: I'm Ashe Ubert! I have arrived with tokens of friendship from [F].
Level: Tacticians can grasp the battlefield in an instant and provide a clear course of action. I think they're amazing!
Mastering this can only make me stronger. And so, I will keep trying even harder!
A Crest is a gift. If I had one, I would have used it to make sure my siblings never lived in poverty.
Summon: I'm Ashe Ubert. I am studying to become a knight—a virtuous and gallant one!
Learn Skill: I'm eager to learn so much more.
Confession:
I used to be a thief who stole because I was poor and starving.
Even though I did it to feed my brother and sister, I know it was wrong.
Lonato saved me from that life... He took me in, and I got to go to school and not worry about how I would eat.
But I understand that such a blessing is rare. Most commoners experience one hardship after another.
My reason for becoming a knight isn't so that I can atone... It's so that I can save others who are struggling.
I will use my work in Askr as proof of my training. Every ounce of my being will go into my assignments here!
Status: Hi, there! I'm Ashe. Great to meet you.
Did you, ah...need something?
I'm going to be a proud knight—virtuous and gallant!
When I'm not sure what to do, I ask myself how Lonato would behave in my place.
Are there any chivalric tales in the castle library? If so, I'd love to read them.
I'm not proud of it, but I did what I had to do to feed my younger siblings when we were kids.
I'm sure there's more I could be doing for you. If there's anything you need, let me know.

caspar.name: Caspar
caspar.title: Hotheaded Inciter
caspar.description: A student of the Black Eagles. He is the second son of Count Bergliez, the Minister of Military Affairs. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: My father came by during the Battle of the Eagle and Lion. He was talking to Edelgard... I wonder what about.
At the academy, they would hold a mock battle called the Battle of the Eagle and Lion. Pretty cool, huh?
Everything tastes good on an empty stomach, but some things I'd never order on my own. Don't you agree?
I wanna blast through battle, cutting my enemies down left and right to secure victory!
Time for some more training... I gotta get better if I expect to get anywhere in this world.
Visit: Hey, are there any training partners around here? Oh! The name's Caspar. Sorry for barging in on you!
Level: It's up to me to cut a path to my own future! You'll see, Professor!
Always happy to fight!
I'm just gettin' started! Don't count me out.
Summon: The name's Caspar! I'm raring to go, just point me towards the enemy!
Learn Skill: Heheh! Let's send some enemies flying!
Confession:
My father led the Empire's army that fended off the invaders from Dagda and Brigid.
Yeah... There's no way I wanna be on his bad side.
My father may be the Minister of Military Affairs and a part of the six great noble families, but...
My brother is the heir, and with so many mouths to feed in our family, I can't count on any support.
I pretty much have to make it on my own, you know?
My aim is to one day surpass my father, Leopold von Bergliez... A tall order, but I'm up for it!
I've got no problem being on the front lines, so send me to battle! If it's you giving orders, I'll be fired up!
Status: The name's Caspar, by the way. Pleased to meet ya!
Hey now! Don't sneak up on me like that!
Sure, I'm a noble, but I'm also a second son. It's up to me to cut my own path!
Out there on the battlefield, all you can do is quit worrying and try your best!
If we're gonna uphold justice, then we gotta stop evil. Simple as that.
Edelgard's always got a whole lot to say about her grand plans for the future...
I believe in justice, and I want to help you achieve it. Just point me in the right direction!

metodey.name: Metodey
metodey.title: Shrewd Braggart
metodey.description: An arrogant, yet gifted assassin who aids the Flame Emperor. His ambition extends far beyond any morals he may possess. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall:
A secret mission from a mighty noble, huh? Just a few more moons, then all will know that I am the Empire's—
Hm-hm-hm... Forget I said anything.
What?! D-don't sneak up on people!
From covert investigations to removal of rivals, I'll take on any dirty work, as long as you make it worth my while.
Hehe... Everyone desires something. Deep down, pretentious aristocrats and Heroes are just like the rest of us.
Got an idea for a new device while I was eating. It uses a hook and string, like so... Hehe... Oh, it's for fishing.
Visit: I'm Metodey! I may not be someone you want to write home about, but I still expect a warm welcome!
Level: Don't move, any of you! If you move, your lives will be forfeit!
Winner takes it all! Ahahaha! Rob them of everything!
Cheap party tricks!
Summon: Hehehehe... At last, it is time for Metodey! You kept me waiting far too long!
Learn Skill: Let's make sure it's not some cheap imitation. Hand it over.
Confession:
Hey there! You've got skills, I'll give you that... I could use someone like you.
Can't say too much in public, but I took on a job from a notable client. Kind of a secret mission, if you will...
Payment's no concern, but without an assistant, I can't possibly present myself before those stuffy nobles.
Which brings me to you. You're not too honorable or too conspicuous. You're perfect. You should join me.
It involves secrecy, but no danger. If things go awry, only some brats will... We just have to watch our step.
We can become the emperor's aides if we don't mess this up. Can't you feel it? The goddess smiles on us!
Status: Hm-hmm...
I am Metodey. Soon, all will know that I am the Empire's— *chuckle* Forget I said anything.
Hey! Watch what you're doing. I won't hesitate to kill you!
Perhaps I will help myself to any treasure they have as a parting gift and take my leave.
Get to work, everyone!
Th-the person over there, is that...Emperor Edelgard!?
I wonder...is there no employer that can pay me more than this?
There's no time for foolish blunders when our glorious future is at stake.

hraesvelgr.name: Hræsvelgr
hraesvelgr.title: Quieting Blade
hraesvelgr.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands who, though level-headed and stern, loves her family with unwavering devotion.

Castle Hall: Few understand my blades of healing. When they slice skin and spill blood so easily, to fear them is only natural.
My healing is that of the blade. A slice can remove a disease at its root, though it is never painless.
My wings and my blades have been granted to me by my father... They serve as proof of our familial bond.
Níðhöggr and I often disagree, yet I still believe she could be great...were she able to abstain long enough.
Ratatoskr is my beloved sister. We will always be family, no matter what...
Visit: I am Hræsvelgr. I shall wield these blades, should you require healing.
Level: Yes, I am the Quieting Blade.
I shall carry out my mission, no matter my opponent.
My blades must be sharpened.
Summon: I am Hræsvelgr, the Quieting Blade. I will fulfill my mission for my family, whether it is to save a life or to end it.
Learn Skill: I hope it is clear to you. I do appreciate this. Thank you.
Confession:
Family is always there to help one another. They always treat one another with love and affection.
Familial bonds are eternal. They do not break or fall apart as with lovers and friends...
I love my family... My father, Ratatoskr... They have always been everything to me. Yet now...
I do not know my true purpose in this life. Perhaps I will one day find it, perhaps not...
Status: I am Hræsvelgr, blade of the Healing Hands...
*startle* ...How were you able to mask your approach?!
Whether saving a life or ending it, the function of a blade is the same.
A slice can remove a disease at its root—then its cut is called healing.
Níðhöggr has availed herself of her supply again, I see...
Ratatoskr, you may yet be proven right...
If you need a surgeon, I am at your service. But I cannot promise there will be no pain.

lucina8.name: Lucina
lucina8.title: Shadows of Fate
lucina8.description: Chrom from the Halidom of Ylisse and his daughter Lucina from the future join us as we honor this parent-child bond at the ninja festival. They appear in Fire Emblem Awakening.
lucina8.duo:
Grants unit another action, and if Canto has already been triggered, re-enables Canto. (May be used only if unit has already entered combat during the current turn.)
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using Pair Up.)

Castle Hall: **Lucina:** Is "Tracking Tiger Tackle" really a common saying among ninja? Finding the right time to use it seems difficult.
**Lucina:** Even if this is just for the festivities, fighting alongside Father is a valuable opportunity. I will give it my all!
**Lucina:** Father's attire truly does make him look like a real ninja. Not that I have ever seen a real one before.
**Chrom:** We should hide our true identities if we're going to be ninja. Lucina, are you going to put on that mask?
**Chrom:** Attacking from the shadows, huh? I'm more in favor of fair fights, but I guess this is also a legitimate strategy.
Visit: **Chrom:** I'm Chrom, a participant in the ninja festival. I was entrusted with this scroll by [F].
Level: **Chrom:** This is an excellent outcome. Get ready, Lucina! We're heading for the next battle!
**Lucina:** What was I supposed to say at times like this? Oh, right! Tracking Tiger Tackle! Mission accomplished!
**Lucina:** Father, I apologize. I made a fool of myself in front of you.
Summon: Tonight, we are ninja, racing through the shadows. With the strength of our family bond, we'll excel at our duties.
Learn Skill: **Chrom:** All right, Lucina! It looks as if we have reached even greater heights working together as ninja.
Confession:
**Chrom:** Lucina, those garments have come to suit you. You look every bit a worthy ninja, through and through.
**Lucina:** Thank you, Father! My time spent studying what a ninja should be like was well worth it.
Living in the shadows, always ready to put your life at risk for your lord. It's an intense way to live, isn't it?
**Chrom:** Ninja may rarely see the light of day, but their efforts have helped to build the foundations of nations.
**Lucina:** Indeed! As we aim to prevent a future full of despair, we could learn from the things they have accomplished.
**Chrom:** I agree! We'll put forth our best effort for the rest of the festival. Let's say it together! Tracking Tiger Tackle!
Status: Uh-huh.
"I won't slow you down!" "That's my line!"
Conversation: **Lucina:** Sparkling Shuriken! Flashing Falchion!
**Chrom:** You're really working hard, Lucina!
**Lucina:** Father! Of course I am! I'll be joining the festival at your side, after all.
**Chrom:** I should do my best then so I don't embarrass myself. What was that you were just shouting?
**Lucina:** I'm told they're traditional ninja sayings. Some people who have participated in the past taught me.
I'm trying to learn about the culture of this world so I don't accidentally offend anyone.
**Chrom:** I heard ninja are spies in Hoshido.
Their culture sounds similar to Chon'sin.
**Lucina:** Oh! Are there also ninja in Chon'sin?
**Chrom:** I don't know for sure. We will have to ask Say'ri the next time we see her.
**Lucina:** Yes! Do you think we could meet a true ninja? That would be so exciting!
**Chrom:** Haha! That enthusiastic curiosity must come from your mother.
**Lucina:** Really? Is that how you see her?
**Chrom:** Not necessarily, it's just... I'm not particularly that way, so I'm assuming...
**Lucina:** I'd like to hear more about Mother. What else can you tell me?
**Chrom:** Ahh, I don't... Oh, look! The festival is about to start. Let's go!
**Lucina:** What? Wait! You can't just leave me wondering!

tharja6.name: Tharja
tharja6.title: Shadow Ninja
tharja6.description: This dark mage of Plegia brings her gloom and jealousy to the ninja festival, never letting Robin too far out of her sight. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Sneaking up on someone in utter silence... That, I am quite experienced in. Hehehe... It's mere child's play...
A smile is unsuitable for ninja to wear, in the same way it is unsuitable for dark mages.
Ugh! Why must a normal girl like me do something so strange as being a ninja? Hey! What are you looking at?!
Hm, Noire can pull off the look of a ninja... We shall work together, to be most useful to the one I seek.
No substitution technique can avoid my hexes. You're welcome to try if you don't believe me...
Visit: Hm... I snuck in here more easily than I anticipated. Perhaps I need to tell [F] to stay alert.
Level: Perish in darkness! Hehehe. I will never allow you to touch the one I seek.
Ugh! Your fixed gaze is making me ill... Aren't you a little too relaxed for one on a battlefield?
If I were using hexes instead of ninja techniques, I would never have fallen so far behind.
Summon: I am Tharja, a dark mage from Plegia. This...ninja festival is quite intriguing. A perfect place to shadow someone.
Learn Skill: With this technique, I can get even closer to a certain someone without being spotted. Hehe... Hehehe...
Confession:
Hehehe. You didn't even notice me, did you, [S]?
I have learned the covert ways of the ninja at this festival. Hiding my presence, softening my steps...
It affords me much tighter proximity to my subject without being spotted.
Now, I can watch over a certain someone more closely. Hehe... Hehehe...
However, using this technique in battle is another question entirely.
It purely depends on what a particular tactician is in need of. Nothing else interests me.
Though... That tactician holds you in high regard, so perhaps I will lend you my skills if the mood suits me.
But only if it suits me...
Status: Ooh...
I've gotten quite skilled at covert operations, since I'm always following a certain someone.
*gasp* For you to get so close without my spotting you... Not bad.
I don't even have to get that close to an enemy. I prefer tormenting them with my curses from afar.
If I'm stealthy enough, I could pluck just one strand of hair, and then... *chuckle*
Noire has considerable latent potential as a mage.
Ahh Robin... Even from this secret perch above, you look magnificent.
I will curse every last one of your enemies for you. You're welcome.

celine2.name: Céline
celine2.title: Teatime Ninja
celine2.description: Princess of Firene. She respects the harmony and elegance of flower arranging and tea ceremonies, pondering them with fondness. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Moving unseen is strange. Everyone passes by, oblivious to me. Is this how it is for an Emblem in a ring?
I've never arranged flowers with these principles in mind. I'll have to learn and teach everyone in Firene.
If you need to learn something, invite your target to tea and talk it out of them. Try not to overuse this method.
I can move quickly in this garb. I can dash across the fields, climb trees... Oh! That's like how my brother trains.
A shinobi must gather medicinal plants and fruits and brew them to... Oh no. Am I just making tea?
Visit: Rest assured, I was not noticed by anyone on my way to deliver this from [F].
Level: A shinobi can control their emotions. Even when feeling great happiness, they maintain a peaceful mind.
I have accepted this sneaking power, and I will use it often.
Oh, did I draw suspicion? I have failed as a ninja, then.
Summon: I am Céline. I swear to devote all my strength to peace, with the resolve of a shinobi.
Learn Skill: I'm truly happy! It's as though my power as a shinobi has bloomed. Thank you!
Confession:
Oh, hello. How unusual to meet you here... Thank goodness. It really is you, [S].
I'm sorry I doubted you. The truth is, I've studied the ninja arts and learned shinobi are masters of disguise.
I need to be careful and confirm that everyone near me is who they seem to be.
Disguises are like any new weapon of war, so we must be cautious. Who should we be suspicious of?
How suspicious should we be?
But for now let's trust in one another and enjoy some tea together! I'll put some water to boil...
Status: Hm.
These clothes are so much less cumbersome than my usual gowns.
Watch out! I...have shuriken tucked in my hair.
I typically only drink black tea, but this outfit has me in the mood for a nice cup of green tea.
Oh! The ninja festival is so much fun! I wish it would never end.
I am fascinated by Hoshido's twin traditions of tea ceremonies and flower arranging.
I suspect Etie would be able to carry a big shuriken with ease.
I am Céline, the only daughter of the royal family of Firene. I shall work from the shadows for peace. Ahaha! Did I sound like a real ninja?

diamant2.name: Diamant
diamant2.title: Gallant Ninja
diamant2.description: The crown prince of Brodia. He works earnestly to become proficient in the art of the ninja. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Heh, you found me. Even as a ninja I cannot trick you, Summoner. Are you aware of all Heroes, as I suspect?
If my retainers were to see me now, Amber would want a matching outfit, and Jade would tell stories about it.
Adorned as a ninja, I almost feel as if I have become someone else. I will not forget my royal duties though.
I imagine my brother is more skilled at spying and lurking in the shadows. I must live up to that as well.
Ninja are good for covert operations. I prefer to face my foes head-on, but that is not my role right now.
Visit: I feel ninja here too, watching from the shadows... I only bring this letter from [F].
Level: Good. This gives me more confidence to apply myself as a ninja.
If I have improved even a little, that is something to be proud of.
Am I not skilled enough as a shinobi after all?
Summon: The smoke screen has cleared. I am Diamant. I am here to accomplish tasks as a ninja. It is a pleasure.
Learn Skill: A new ninja technique? I understand. I will show that I can use it well.
Confession:
Is that you, Summoner? I believe I am growing accustomed to this attire and to fighting in the way of the ninja.
In my homeland, I would strike down foes when I encountered them, but combat is a last resort for a ninja.
As I understand it, their role is to flee and return to their master and allies to impart the information they gather.
I may be the prince of a kingdom of warriors, but I understand...
Even if you must flee in defeat, if you are reduced to a wretch at the time, at least you survive to try again.
Flee if you find yourself in danger, Summoner. If you are captured, I will come to save you no matter the odds.
Whether you are in the heart of the enemy's formation, or in a church buried in snow...
Status: *chuckle*
Look at how freely I can move in these clothes.
Hmm... Hahaha! Looks like you spotted me.
I'm not one for stealth or surprise attacks, but if it's a show of ninja pride you want, I will put my life on the line.
These shuriken would make great souvenirs for the soldiers at Brodia Castle.
Fire technique? I can't do fire magic, but if this is a ninja skill, then I'm sure I can handle it.
Work from the shadows... That's not my way, but I suppose I could try if it's for the Divine Dragon.
I've been told that ninja all say the phrase "Sparkling Shuriken." ...They're not just trying to make me look ridiculous, are they?

noire3.name: Noire
noire3.title: Demurely Deft
noire3.description: Tharja's daughter. Her timid personality can turn on a dime when she is enraged. She joins the ninja festival with her mother and tormentor. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I don't do well in public... I mean, if all I need to do is follow people around in secret... Maybe I can...
I should be skilled at sneaking up on people. I am my mother's daughter, after all.
This outfit really stands out. I thought ninja were supposed to be stealthy...
My mother has such a good figure. No matter what she wears, everything looks good on her.
IF ANYONE CATCHES MY EYE, I'LL EXPOSE ALL OF THEIR SECRETS! Ahahahaha!
Visit: I made it... Eek! D-don't be suspicious of me... I was sent here by [F].
Level: YOU CAN NEVER ESCAPE ME!
Let me try this... Allow me to take your life! Did...that fit the mood?
Eek! I'm sorry! I am...useless...
Summon: My name is Noire. Since...this is a ninja festival, I can stay hidden, right?
Learn Skill: YOU FOOL! TO SIT ON TREASURE LIKE THIS! YOU COULD HAVE HANDED THIS OVER SOONER!
Confession:
Stay stealthy, get close... Eek! I've been spotted? Oh, it's you, [S]!
I thought I would be able to stay hidden at this ninja festival, but no one is leaving me alone...
Children are coaxing me to recite ninja sayings and begging me to perform stealth techniques... Ugh!
WHY WON'T THEY LEAVE ME ALONE! I ONLY WANT TO PASS THE TIME IN PEACE!
Oh, uh...sorry. I lost my temper again.
No ninja should act this way, right? I'm afraid I need to have my mother teach me her covert ways...
Status: Huh?
A ninja... Do I even have what it takes?
*yelp* Oh, sorry. I should really be more alert.
Stay stealthy, get close... Uh, and that's it, right? OK, here goes nothing.
I'm happy to be wearing such a cute ninja outfit.
I will devote all my efforts to being a proper ninja, so at least...I'll be out of my mother's way.
My mother? She would use a curse to fulfill the mission.
There are many reasons I need to be brave. One of them is to be more useful to you.

lilina6.name: Lilina
lilina6.title: Brilliant Flame
lilina6.description: Princess of House Ostia, a leader of the Lycian League. She fought through an ocean of chaos while being swept up in the currents of destiny. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: As the daughter of Hector, I refuse to run from battle.
It is said that although he was small of frame, the hero Roland wielded Durandal with ease, despite its size.
Princess Guinivere... She is wise and so noble. Anything I can do to aid her strength, I will.
Both Bors and Cecilia feel that we all grow as our station warrants and by meeting the challenges ahead of us.
When we finally reunited, Roy gave me this magic tome. It is...precious to me.
Visit: Please, keep watching over [F].
Level: Father... Please, watch over me.
I am the daughter of a warrior. I will not falter in battle.
I won't be able to protect everyone unless I fight. Still...have I truly readied myself for what that means?
Summon: My name is Lilina. With my magic, I hope to help as many as I can.
Learn Skill: I hope to learn more about you—not your past or the status you were born into, but about who you are now.
Confession:
In the humans' battle against dragons, powerful legendary weapons have been passed down through the ages.
Ostia's first leader, and my ancestor, Roland, inherited the mighty blade Durandal, the sword of sacred fire.
After the Scouring, Roland returned to his homeland, Ostia, and thrust his blade toward the sky in victory.
It is said that in that moment, the land that had been decimated by war was not just saved, but healed.
I believe the power of these weapons can bring about both destruction and prosperity.
With my anima magic and your guidance, I hope to aid as many people as I can. Just as Roland did.
Status: Oh!
With this new tome, I can use my skills to greater advantage in battle!
Ah! Come on now, Roy... Oh, it's you?
Should I be wearing such an impressive outfit? Yes! I will endeavor to become equally impressive.
I've been supplementing my studies by learning from the mages in the Order of Heroes.
I wonder what my father would say if he could see how my power has grown.
I won't be pushed aside by some other girl!
I promise to be by your side, now and on into the future.

zeiss.name: Zeiss
zeiss.title: Ebon Bolt
zeiss.description: A wyvern rider of Bern. The younger brother of Melady, who is ever by Princess Guinivere's side. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: So Galle was telling the truth... I am still not completely convinced, but... I do believe Melady.
I've decided to see Lady Guinivere's will through to the end, even if it means fighting against my country.
Elen hails from the same town I do, so I feel a certain responsibility to protect her.
Are you...going to eat now? Do you mind if I join you, [S]?
I am a wyvern rider of Bern. And after I aid Princess Guinivere, I will return one day with my head held high!
Visit: I come bearing supplies from [F]'s castle.
Level: Zeiss, abandon your doubts... You must be stronger and crush those who stand in your path!
With pride, for the wyvern riders of Bern!
I charged ahead using purely my momentum, without even thinking... There is still so much for me to learn.
Summon: I am Zeiss, a wyvern rider of Bern. I am on the run since being accused of treason, but...I have faith in this path.
Learn Skill: My sister has always been the one to protect me... I must get stronger so that I can protect her for once.
Confession:
Not long before I came here, I was fighting against someone I called a brother... Galle, another wyvern rider.
His skill was equal to that of the three Wyvern Generals of Bern. I looked up to him, aspired to be like him...
My sister was also quite fond of him. I... I never thought we would fight against one another...
I know... "One must carve their own path." Even though I did abandon my homeland, I have no regrets.
I will keep moving forward on this path. And one day, I wish to be as strong as Galle!
Status: Ah...
I am Zeiss, a wyvern knight of Bern.
*startle* Oh, it's you. I was worried Sin was targeting me with his bow again.
I did abandon my homeland of Bern, but...I have no regrets.
I need to ascertain for myself how Lady Guinivere's convictions can be worthy of my sister's unbridled faith.
Galle was like my true brother, someone I looked up to and aspired to become.
I will get stronger for my sister. I want to be the one to protect her for once.
I want to stay by your side and protect you until the end. Would that...be all right with you?

bors.name: Bors
bors.title: Ostia's Bastion
bors.description: A heavily armored knight dispatched to escort Lilina. On her request, he agreed to stay with Roy and loyally fight beside him. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I want my sister to think of her own happiness rather than dwelling on thoughts of conflict and war.
People grow as their station requires, but this does not change the essence of who they are.
I am not impressed by arenas. As a knight, I cannot condone making battle into entertainment for profit.
Remaining ever wary is part of a knight's duty. Do not let my vigilance concern you.
I have known Barthe since I took my knightly vows. If one of us is showing off, the other will see through it.
Visit: I was asked to deliver this with the message "Wishing you all the best" from [F].
Level: The armored knights of Ostia use their armor as a shield to protect those precious to them.
Battles should be carried out with purpose. There is no such thing as a battle for the sake of it.
How is Gwendolyn? Is she eating well? Has she been injured? Does her armor weigh heavy upon her?
Summon: I am Bors, an armored knight of Ostia. I will protect you as ordered by the lady Lilina.
Learn Skill: I am thankful for this.
Confession:
I was ordered to protect Lady Lilina, the marquess's daughter, and ensure her safe return to Ostia.
At Lilina's insistence, I accompanied Lord Roy, who stood at the head of the Lycian League's army.
Lady Lilina is akin to Lord Hector in her strength of will. They both have an innate desire to protect everyone...
Because of this, I am proud to be an armored knight of Ostia, sworn to protect my lady and her people.
I shall be a shield to deflect hardship for the sake of the world my master, she who leads Ostia, wishes to forge.
Status: Ah, haha!
I am Bors, a knight of Ostia
Oh!? That was you then? I was afraid it might be my sister stopping by.
I am a knight who has chosen to give his loyalty to Lady Lilina.
Hm... I am pleased to see how Lord Roy has grown from all his experience.
We lost our Lord Hector. The responsibility for that loss is one we must bear together.
Have you seen Gwendolyn? No, I am not trying to find her...not exactly.
I swear to stand by your side and to protect you.

elffin.name: Elffin
elffin.title: Truth Beholden
elffin.description: A supporter of the resistance fighters in the west, he lives as a mysterious bard. But his true identity is that of Prince Myrddin of Etruria. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: Oh... My eyes...
A blow to the Etrurian government is necessary in order to save those across the Western Isles.
It is best to take a breath and rest a moment before one pushes too far.

My eyesight is still hindered at times... It is an aftereffect of the poison...
Please, do not concern yourself. I need but a moment to recover.
Though he is young, Roy understands the people. With him as leader, the future is bright.
Visit: I am a traveling bard who mends the hearts of those scarred from battle. Care to listen to a soothing melody?
Level: When I awoke from the brink of death, I did not recognize the world. Perhaps it always looked this way.
Shh! We never know where the enemy spies may hide. I am a mere bard...as I have always been.
I must eliminate my father's fear of losing me. Once that is gone, I will see him again.
Summon: I am Elffin, a bard. It is an honor to make your acquaintance. May I interest you in a song?
Learn Skill: At some point this fighting will end. And when that time comes, what shall I do then?
Confession:
I once died in the most literal sense. My horse was shot, and I was thrown off and struck by a poisoned arrow.
General Douglas reported me fallen and arranged for my escape to the Western Isles. He...saved me.
I teetered between life and death with a high fever. And at some point, the poison affected my sight as well.
When I finally opened my eyes, I saw the Etrurian aristocrats' countless abuses against those in the west.
I was ashamed of myself and my country. I regarded my misfortune as punishment for my ignorance.
And so...I joined the resistance, in hopes of eradicating the infection that runs through Etruria.
My sincerest hope is to restore some semblance of justice.
Status: Hmm...
I will not give up!
They will be saved.
I...regret my ignorance... To be so blind to the offenses committed beyond my country's border...
Roy... When I first met Lord Roy, I felt as though I could entrust him with my life.
Something you deem simply coincidence may very well be destiny.
I will never give up. And with Roy, the future is bright.
Please, simply regard me as another of your retainers.

pjazi.name: Þjazi
pjazi.title: Ruthless Jötun
pjazi.description: The younger sister of the queen of ancient Jötunheimr. She is fierce and merciless, and will not acknowledge dvergr independence.

Castle Hall: Dvergr independence? Hah! I will put them in their place and take my rightful one on the throne.
Jötunheimr is a country of strong warriors with no use for weaklings.
Hm? Oh, you... You are so small I didn't notice you. Next time, chirp louder if you wish to draw attention.
Hey, you! Hold out your hand... Hah! Just as I thought. It only takes one arm to lift such a puny being.
Aha! Worthy opponents...show yourselves. Hm... Who should I crush first?!
Visit: Point me to the strongest one here so I can crush them to bits! You can thank [F].
Level: Hahahah! Did you catch sight of that?! That...is true strength!
Those who dare oppose me, I will rip to pieces, limb by limb.
I won't lose!
Summon: I am Þjazi, a proud jötun warrior. Bow before me!
Learn Skill: I see you have an eye for true strength.
Confession:
You... What are you— Refrain from prancing around my feet, unless your wish is to be crushed!
Why must I listen to an ant like you, squeaking and chirping in my ear?
Strength is the true equalizer. Should you defeat me in combat, I will accept your orders. Until then...
I refuse to partake in this contract. You have wasted what little power you have in summoning me.
I will flick these chains off with my pinkie. Then I shall brandish my blade. Say goodbye to your head!
Status: Haha!
I am Þjazi, a proud jötun warrior.
Hah! You thought you could stagger me with that subtle graze?
*spit* Impudent dvergar... Their place is to serve us and bring us something to feast on!
The queen is a coward, trembling at the sight of dvergar prancing around, playing soldier with their little toys.
For jötnar, our strength is our virtue. Ha! We have no use for weaklings.
They'll see... I will defeat Niðavellir. Then I shall take my rightful place on the throne.
You... I think I could make fine use of you as my subordinate.

ogier.name: Ogier
ogier.title: Ostia's New Blade
ogier.description: A mercenary hired by House Ostia. Even though his armor is substandard, he holds his head high in battle as a member of the heavy knights. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade.

Castle Hall: I chose a lighter style of garb to make up for my inadequacy as a heavily armored knight.
I became a mercenary to feed my family back home.
I am honored that you called on a new recruit such as myself. I will do my best!
I'm going to run some laps so I can strengthen my hips and legs!
Yah! Hiyah! These practice swings help me to reinforce my basic sword skills.
Visit: It is a pleasure to finally meet you. I have heard wonderful things about you from [F].
Level: I'm able to focus very well right now! It's important to remember how to do this.
*sigh* Growth happens one step at a time...
For my brothers. For all my family... I must not falter!
Summon: I am Ogier of the knights of Ostia. I want to be useful to you all!
Learn Skill: Are you sure I'm the right choice for this duty? I'll do my best to meet your expectations!
Confession:
My story is a boring one, you know. I was born in a typical village. We had nothing of note.
I traveled all the way to Ostia to feed my brothers and parents. I had a sister who was close to my age.
But, it's the men who do the work in our village, so... When a girl is born into a poor home...
She was left in a distant town with only a few beautiful outfits and a hope for a good future.
My brothers and I did not begrudge my parents' choice. This way, none of us would starve.
Thank you for listening to my story until the end. I must remind myself, not even a god can save everyone...
Special: I will stand on my own!
Status: Hm.
I am Ogier of the Ostian Knights.
Oh!? I apologize if I bumped into you. It was not intentional.
I would hate to lose an ally because I was not strong enough.
The act of fighting must always serve some purpose. For me, that purpose is to feed my family.
Saving everyone is impossible, even for a saint like Elimine.
I have to believe my sister is out there somewhere making a life for herself.
I will put in the effort necessary to acquire the skills I still lack.

laeradr.name: Læraðr
laeradr.title: Quieting Heart
laeradr.description: Leader of the Healing Hands of Yggdrasill. He is known to control people's hearts.

Castle Hall: To heal those who suffer throughout the nine realms... That was once the role of the Healing Hands.
The first life I took was that of a king. I transformed my power, and then delivered him to madness and death.
It is quite simple. I transform the mortal heart how I please—be it into a state of misery or peace.
My family...
I once had a family... Though perhaps that, too, is a falsehood.
Visit: You must be [S]. I will remember that.
Level: To quiet hearts... That is what I do.
Tell me, shall I be pleased or shall I be disappointed?
I apologize. I have failed to meet your expectations.
Summon: I am Læraðr, leader of the Healing Hands and of the Quieting Hands. Which me do you prefer?
Learn Skill: How shall I offer my gratitude? Would you like me to transform your heart?
Confession:
My children...have all died...
No replacements will ever satisfy the longing in my heart. I could never truly love those who are not mine.
Of course, they have loved me... That is how I made them.
It is a simple thing, to transform a heart. I could even transform my own to be filled with joy.
However, I shall remain as I am, harboring the sadness of losing my family, suffering from my mistakes.
Status: Hm.
I am Læraðr. I was once leader of the Healing Hands.
I know the techniques used to move the mortal heart—to soothe it, to crush it—all at my will.
To heal a heart is to transform it. I select the form it takes.
Whom do you think would make a truly terrifying assassin? I wonder...
At the count of three, you will be at my command. One, two...
Peace, and family... Those two things are all I've ever desired.
I see the weight that sits on your heart. I could help to lift it, you know...

nidhoggr.name: Níðhöggr
nidhoggr.title: Quieting Dose
nidhoggr.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands who prefers to remain intoxicated in order to keep her true feelings from coming to the surface.

Castle Hall: The injured wail and cry, but they get nice and quiet real quick if there's a few drops of poison involved.
Poison is different from medicine. It can paralyze a person and make their pain go away in an instant.
My power over poison is a gift from my pops. I like to think it's proof that I'm his favorite.
I'm better than Hræsvelgr, to be sure. I mean, she saved me once way back when, but these days...
Ratatoskr is easily overwhelmed and clumsy as a newborn deer. But I guess she's never boring.
Visit: *hic* I'm...Níðhöggr. I'm here to... Uh... What was it again? Oh yeah! I'm Níðhöggr.
Level: I'm the Quieting Dose. That's me.
*hic* Heh. I'm starting to feel good...
Haha! I'm dizzy...
Summon: I am the Quieting Dose, Níðhöggr. Forget about family, I just wanna relax and have a good time... *hic*
Learn Skill: Uh... For me? Wh-what the heck? Why are you being nice? You're throwing me off.
Confession:
Ah... *hic* Hey, Summoner, why don't you take a bite too?
Family? They're just people ya can't stand but can't cut out of your life 'cause you're too connected.
One time, I went to heal some people with Hræsvelgr and Ratatoskr. Wanna hear about it?
No, you don't. It was a rough time.
That's why I'm going it alone now. I'm good like this. Seriously. But...
Ah no! I'm not going there! I've had too much of this fruit, but...maybe I I need just one more.
Status: Níðhöggr! That's meee! I handle poisons for... For... Ah, I lost my train of thought there...
Care for a bite? Juuust a nibble? You might like it...
Ahh... Let me savor this bite for a moment...
Ugh. Indulge one day, regret it the next...
Hræsvelgr hates fun. Always sooo...on edge.
Ratatoskr can make her own choices, y'know?
And this can help you forget your troubles—for a while, at least...

rune.name: Rune
rune.title: Source of Wisdom
rune.description: A boy who fled from Ásgarðr, the celestial realm. Through his mysterious power he can decipher writings that depict the beginning of creation.

Castle Hall: Midgard...the world of mortals... This is a place I have only heard of in stories and legends.
The celestial realm of Ásgarðr is ruled by Alfaðör, the king of heaven.
There exist mysterious writings that tell of all creation. I wonder who wrote them...
It is said that there is one creator of all the nine worlds. For what purpose would they do this...
Ásgarðr and Vanaheimr are both realms of gods. One day, I would like to visit Vanaheimr, the realm of light.
Visit: Hello. I am Rune. I offer you greetings from [F].
Level: One day...I want to be able to fight like the gods and heroes from the stories I have heard.
Is it even possible for someone like me to fight like a hero?
I knew it... I am sorry...
Summon: I am Rune. The Celestial King is after me. That is why I fled Ásgarðr...
Learn Skill: Th-thank you! With this, do you think I can learn to fight?
Confession:
I have been weak since I was little... I never went outside much.
The only comfort I felt was from the legendary stories I read... Stories of heroic adventures.
There was one... The Twilit Runes. It told of a great battle between the gods and the heroes...
Reading it, I imagined myself as a hero in battle. I want to have an adventure like that one day...
When I am with you, I feel excited for our adventures together. Would you mind if I stay with you awhile longer?
Status: Oh...
I fled from the celestial realm of Ásgarðr... I am Rune.
*gasp* Oh, I am sorry. Did I make a mistake?
I know where I came from, but... I am no god.
Throughout the nine worlds, there are mysterious writings that tell of all creation.
I came to realize I am able to decipher some of the writing, but...only a small part.
Alfaðör is the king of heaven. He...is after me...
I am interested in learning more about you. Do you mind if I stay?

hector7.name: Hector
hector7.title: Steel Warrior
hector7.description: Brother of Marquess Ostia and rumored to be a little rough around the edges. He dashes to aid his best friend Eliwood whenever he's in danger. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Eliwood hatched a plan to search for his father, but he didn't even come to me for help. Really, Eliwood?
My brother is no fool. We all hear what he tells people, but he knows what I'm up to, make no mistake.
You know, now that I think about it...I suspect Eliwood got himself mixed up in that succession dispute in Caelin.
Ostia is crawling with spies. Our neighbors want to know just how competent Uther will turn out to be.
Oh, we have spies too. I'd say the most competent in Ostia is Leila, no contest!
Visit: Eliwood and I are thick as thieves— like you and [F]!
Level: This is a battlefield. If you don't want to die, then you'd better run.
No time to talk—I have to mop up some ne'er-do-wells.
Don't sweat the small stuff!
Summon: No need to be formal. Name's Hector, and I'll take care of what needs taking care of.
Learn Skill: Oho! High expectation, I see!
Confession:
Eliwood and I have been bound since we were kids. We even swore a warrior's oath.
We cut the palms of our hands and pressed them together, mingling our blood.
We vowed that if either of was in danger, the other would stake his life. That day, we became men. And now Eliwood's father, Lord Elbert, has gone missing. This is serious.
Problem is, I can't mobilize Ostia's army. My brother must be chafing at that too. He looks up to Elbert.
All this to say that I'm going to help on my own—unofficially speaking.
Idon't know who's responsible. Be it the Black Fang or not, I give you my word I'll crush them!
Status: Oh ho...
This outfit matches his. Do we need to dress exactly the same?
Whoa! Do you need something to keep you occupied?
Eliwood is not built as sturdy as I am. I hope he doesn't do anything reckless.
Is there no one willing to spar with me?
I will always rush to his aid, even when I am a feeble old man.
Eliwood. If you die before me, I will never forgive you!
I am close to Eliwood because we share the same worldview. My friendship with you is growing for the same reasons, Summoner.

leila3.name: Leila
leila3.title: Superb Shadow
leila3.description: A spy who serves House Ostia. She is exceptionally skilled and loyal, and has a romantic relationship with Matthew. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Valor, the Dread Isle, is off the southern coast of Lycia. I hear the Dragon's Gate is there...
I was following Lord Uther's orders to investigate Marquess Pherae's disappearance.
You should really rest. The only reason I can work nonstop is because I've trained for it.
This castle is not the most secure, but in the areas that really matter, it's managed well. Impressive.
I posed as a member of the Black Fang for the past several months.
Visit: I am Leila. Pleased to make your acquaintance. This is a gift from [F].
Level: Seems you were too late to challenge me. Get lost, won't you?
Not bad.
Just keep moving, Matthew...like you always do...
Summon: I'm Leila. My job is to gather intel, infiltrate the enemy, and sabotage them. All good uses of my skills.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I take it this is to prepare for our next job, right?
Confession:
The Black Fang were once regarded as chivalrous by the common folk.
As an organization of assassins, they targeted only nobles who preyed on the weak.
But their leader has changed since his second marriage. Now, their targets are based purely on price.
A mysterious man, Nergal, controls the Black Fang through their leader's new wife, Sonia.
My role is to determine Nergal's goals and prevent him from achieving them.
I have a bad feeling... Lord Uther does as well. We must stop the Black Fang, at any cost!
Status: So, what do you think? New weapon, new outfit...
Hey! That's it, you've done it. One day, you'll pay for this. *chuckle*
People want to know what you like. They keep asking me.
I would have served Lord Uther even at the cost of my life.
I can see Lord Hector is acting rashly, per usual...
If Matthew sees me— No, I shouldn't be daydreaming. I need to keep my head clear, my hopes low.
Go on, give me an order. Anything at all, I'll get it done. I'm more than sly words, you know.

uther.name: Uther
uther.title: Frugal Militarist
uther.description: Marquess Ostia, the head of the Lycian League. Though his body appears strong, he suffers from an incurable disease. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Hector, the headstrong fool, has not been in contact in some time. He is a nitwit, hmph... But I worry about him.
I am sorry about Lord Elbert. I was powerless to help. I did wrong by Eliwood.
Wounds may heal, but it seems one's innards are not so simple. One must pay for the recklessness of youth.
What is Nergal after? Commanding the Black Fang across all of Elibe, stirring discord in every land...
An invasion would be madness. My brother must understand that. If there is a problem, he must act alone.
Visit: There is something to learn from any castle. I must thank your friend for the introduction.
Level:
None should allow themselves excess luxury. Doing so can lead to mental and physical depravity!
The heart of Ostia lies in working hard and paying respect to valor.
I will aid you as much as I can.
Urk... *cough* *cough* Worry not. It has settled. It was nothing.
Summon: I am Uther, Marquess Ostia, leader of Lycia. I cannot shame myself before my brother or his acquaintances.
Learn Skill: Your thoughtfulness is impressive. I feel compelled to do something in return.
Confession:
If asked to choose between me and his country, my brother would not hesitate in rushing to my side.
Though he speaks in anger, we are brothers. We are our only family. I would never doubt his affection.
Yet what if the choice were between brother and friend? To choose one would mean abandoning the other.
He would come to despise himself, whatever his choice. Ostia's treasure must not bear such a burden.
I ask that you please think of our meeting as an important twist of fate, [S].
And I want you to watch over my brother...watch over Hector.
This is the first and only request I have ever and will ever make, not as Marquess Ostia, but as a brother.
Status: Hmm...
I am Uther, Marquess Ostia. You may know Hector, my fool of a brother.
Oh, it is you. Haha... I thought it was that headstrong fool...
Ah, Hector...don't trouble Lord Eliwood by being overly obstinate.
For generations, our ancestors dedicated themselves to a sort of...frugal militarism.
I still regret what happened to Lord Elbert. I was powerless to help.
Oswin, Hector... This is in your hands now.
Do your best for all of us, and I will do all I can to help you.

oswin.name: Oswin
oswin.title: Impregnable Knight
oswin.description: An armored knight of Ostia. He accompanies Hector on his journey under the strict orders of Hector's older brother Uther, marquess of Ostia. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: I am a knight in service to Castle Ostia. Until now, I have only offered my lance to Lord Uther. Yet...
Lord Uther was worried about Lord Hector traveling alone. I have been ordered to keep a close eye on him.
You must not rely so much on physical strength alone.
Lord Hector and Lord Eliwood are on the front line. If we, their retainers, do not help them, then what are we?
Lord Hector, hate me and scorn me as you will, but...please do not doubt Lord Uther's intentions.
Visit: This is a gift for you, entrusted to me by [F].
Level: We can use our thick armor to form a living shield.
I will guard him with my very life's blood.
Pitiful... Please, do forgive me.
