Summon: I am Oswin. If the goal is to defend, we knights are your best hope.
Learn Skill: I shall meet your expectations no matter what may come.
Confession:
It is my duty to protect Marquess Ostia's younger brother, Lord Hector.
However, he is not easy to protect, for he does not walk a clear path of his own volition.
By not walking the clear path, he always forges new ones. Those are the paths he is apt to choose.
By his very nature he walks an unpaved road, after which a paved one is forged behind him.
He may be beyond blunt, and it may stir conflict, but... I have to come to hope he does not lose that trait.
Status: Ahem.
I am Oswin. I've been ordered to keep a close eye on Lord Hector.
Huh?! So, even you take part in this kind of mischief.
No matter what Lord Uther says, he's just worried about Lord Hector.
Hmm... I cannot condone resorting to force so quickly...
If the goal is to defend, knights are your best hope. We can use our armor to form a living shield.
Lord Uther... I will guard Lord Hector with my very life's blood.
I wish to offer you my service. Please grant me that honor.

vaida.name: Vaida
vaida.title: Dracofang General
vaida.description: Praised as the most powerful Wyvern General of Bern. When she expressed anger toward the corrupt military, she was falsely accused of a crime and expelled from her country. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: Those little Lycian nobles... Prince Zephiel insists it was they who saved him... What's this world coming to?
I am loyal to Bern, even still. Prince Zephiel is our future, our hope. That is why I fight.
Should the one with the dignity and nobility of a true king take the throne, Bern would change. I am certain.
How many times must I say, I've no interest in befriending a knight of Pherae...
I am your ally, not your foe. It's best for you if you understand that.
Visit: I stood high even among the other Wyvern Generals. Yet here I am, a mere errand runner... Just take this.
Level: Heh! This is what I'm capable of! Keep your eyes peeled to not miss anything!
I seek bigger game... More enemies, [S]!
Hmm... I'm lagging behind.
Summon: Surely you've heard of the Wyvern Generals of Bern? I am Vaida.
Learn Skill: Send me a general now... I can take it!
Confession:
I decided to observe your leadership in action, and you've got some fancy moves. But let me explain things...
I took the Black Fang's side once to fight against the Lycian scum. Even tried to kill that brat Eliwood.
I have no desire to befriend a naive knight, too eager for his own good.
So, listen up. You better keep your eye on me. You never know if I might attack when your back is turned.
Hah... That look in your eye isn't half bad. Are you trying to see through my thick exterior?
Then I'll tell you what... I'll judge your worth too, whether you're worthy of trust or not... Do your damnedest!
Status: Hey!
I'm Vaida. I'll be traveling with you now.
What? I don't have time for games.
I owe the Lycian lords my service for what they've done for Prince Zephiel.
I am loyal to one master only—the one who sits on the throne of Bern!
Prince Zephiel is our future, our hope.
I can only do so much for those who are so far away...
Heh, I think I like you.

malear3.name: Alear
malear3.title: Gifted Dragons
malear3.description: Two Divine Dragons who adorn Askr's winter festival. And they are joined by the guardian spirit of the Somniel too. They appear in Fire Emblem Engage.
malear3.duo:
Neutralizes any【Penalty】effects on unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit, and grants the following to unit and those allies for 1 turn: "neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat" and "reduces the percentage of foe's non-Special 'reduce damage by X%' skills by 50% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials)."
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).

Castle Hall: **Alear:** Isn't Sommie a cute reindeer? Pulling a sleigh like that, the path glittering like a starry sky!

**Alear:** After my thousand-year sleep, I woke up to my mother, new friends, and a whole new life... 
So I suppose I know what it's like to wake up to find wonderful gifts!
**Alear:** Let's do our best to deliver presents to everyone's bedside! But quietly, of course. Wouldn't want to wake them!
**Alear:** I saw a beautiful ice sculpture earlier that looked like a jewel. I wonder if that's what dragonstones look like...
**Alear:** Something about the snowscape is familiar. I feel like I made a vow, a pinky promise, in a place like this.
Visit: **Alear:** Oops, you caught us! We were on our way to deliver a present to your bedside from  [F].
Level: **Alear:** The winter festival is so fun! Let's go make more memories together!
**Alear:** I'm all warmed up and ready to have fun no matter the weather!
**Alear:** Brr, it's gotten cold... How about we put on more layers and try again?
Summon: Merry engage! We are the Divine Dragon Alear, here to celebrate the winter festival.
Learn Skill: **Alear:** Thank you for the gift! I'll have to think of what to get you in return..
Confession:
**Alear:** Look at this food, Alear! Not even the Somniel's Caf� Terrace had whole roast chickens or star-shaped sweets.
**Alear:** Even the stalls themselves are a treat for the eyes. And speaking of stalls, I bought a present for you!
**Alear:** Thank you! And what a coincidence� I have something for you too. Why don't we open them together?
**Alear:** Oh, a snowflake badge! Somehow it doesn't surprise me that we got each other the same thing.
**Alear:** I'd expect nothing less from my other self. It looks great on you! Of course, I got Sommie one too. Don't tell me...
**Alear:** Yep, I also got Sommie a badge! Our little reindeer shines even brighter with two of them.
Thank you, Alear. This gift will be a wonderful reminder of all the fun we've had here.
I'll cherish these memories long after the festival is over. Even thousands of years from now!
Status: "Meeting another me is the greatest gift of the winter festival." "I feel the same!"
Conversation: **Alear:** It's been unexpectedly moving having a chance to meet myself at a winter festival here in another world.
**Alear:** I couldn't agree more! Look at how even our outfits match!
**Alear:** The stewards prepared these for me. Clanne and Framme collected a lot of clothing and accessories...
**Alear:** And then Vander expertly selected the very best of those items for you, am I right?
**Alear:** Exactly! I take it that's how it worked for you too. Your outfit looks great on you!
**Alear:** *giggle* I could say the same to you. It's almost like looking in a mirror!
**Alear:** Sommie seems delighted to see us enjoying ourselves.
**Alear:** Is this the Sommie from your world? They're a little different from my Sommie, but still very cute.
**Alear:** Um...no, this isn't my Sommie. I had assumed that this one came here with you.
**Alear:** Oh no! Does that mean this poor Sommie is lost?! Or perhaps they came here on their own?
**Alear:** Either way, we shouldn't leave them alone. Imagine how lonely they must be here, so far from the Somniel.
**Alear:** Well, it seems as though we all came from different worlds...but we could still enjoy the festival together!
**Alear:** I had the same idea! Festivals are a lot more fun when you share the experience with others.
Besides, spending time with you seems nostalgic somehow. It's like my heart feels lighter.
**Alear:** Though we are the same being, I also feel as though I regained something I left behind long ago.
Perhaps Mother or the Emblems led us here.
**Alear:** If that's so, it's one more reason we should enjoy the festival to the fullest together! Let's go, Alear! Sommie!

hortensia2.name: Hortensia
hortensia2.title: Winter's Dearest
hortensia2.description: Second princess of Elusia. She grew up in a country known for its deep snow, therefore is highly knowledgeable about winter festivals. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Before the Fell Dragon returned, Ivy, Father, and I enjoyed winter festivals together. We can never do that again.
Wintertide Village in Elusia is home to talented merchants who celebrate the winter festival there all year round.
We can decorate everywhere during this season! Trees! Rooms! We can make it all as cute as we want!
I'm deciding what to get everyone! No eavesdropping, Summoner! You don't want to spoil the surprise!
The people of Elusia always have a grand festival to help them make it through the long winter.
Visit: Happy winter festival! This is cute, isn't it? I pray that this castle makes it through the winter too.
Level: This is how the winter festival is supposed to be! Let's keep having fun!
I'm familiar with winter festivals, so this result is no surprise.
I won't lose, even in a blizzard!
Summon: I am Hortensia, princess of Elusia. Happy winter festival! Wait... You want me to fight like this?!
Learn Skill: A present for me? This makes me so happy! I'm cuter now thanks to you!
Confession:
I've always liked the winter festival. Towns and villages full of cheer, the dark nights twinkling with light...
Everyone's always in a good mood! There were so many times I wished the festival would last forever.
That wish came true thanks to you! I mean, I'm not in Elusia, and neither is Father...
But, now I know the truth. I didn't want the festival to last forever— I wanted everyone to be happy!
So I'm going to fight for that. I know this look doesn't inspire confidence, but it's cute and that's OK! Right?!
Status: Did you know, theres a village like this all year round? One long winter festival!
*laugh* Quit sneaking up on me! I'll put you on the naughty list!
*sigh* The people of Elusia look forward to the winter festival every year.
Of all my outfits, I'm proud to say this one's the cutest.
Need someone to walk you down to the festivities? Fine, fine. C'mon.
I can't believe I got a compliment from Ivy. I'm never changing clothes again!
Let me show you around the festival, OK? I know where to find all the cutest things.

fshez4.name: Shez
fshez4.title: Snowfield Envoy
fshez4.description: A mercenary who wandered Fódlan alone. Her new mission is assuming the role of winter envoy. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: The voice in my head is telling me it's not a good time to get distracted by a festival. But...I do like this job.
A winter festival, huh? Back in Fódlan I had no time to think of such things, what with the constant war and all.
I don't have time to discuss how cold it is here. There's hordes of children waiting for presents.
These dual blades were entrusted to me. They're actually pretty handy for this job.
I'll stand out like a sore thumb wearing these clothes. But...I suppose they're perfect for a winter festival.
Visit: Ah, I take it I'm at the right place? I'm here to deliver a winter-festival gift from [F].
Level: I won't let anything get in my way, not with people counting on me.
Obstruction eliminated. I'll continue my mission.
At this rate, I'll be hard-pressed to make it in time.
Summon: I'm Shez. My work as a mercenary brings me all over the place. So, now I'm to be a winter envoy? You got it.
Learn Skill: You got me a gift too? I accept.
Confession:
I'm a mercenary who'll complete any job that's asked of me. It's just who I am.
I can be known to throw myself into dangerous situations for a job, even when the outcome is dire.
Still, other times, I get paid to stand around and look tough.
But this go-around stands out as being truly meaningful, since now I'm a winter envoy.
When I deliver presents to children, they smile at me and their eyes light up like stars.
I'm not picky, but if you're offering more work like this, I'd gladly take you up on it.
Status: Hoo...
As a winter envoy, I have to be sure not to get lost.
Ah! Oh, great. Now I've got snow in all the wrong places.
No, it's not too heavy. Pile on the gifts!
Walking through the snow is good training.
The town looks so festive with the decorations... You don't get a lot of pretty on the battlefield.
*sneeze* Oh, I'm fine. Just training.
Please, have this gift. I sure hope you like it.

fomortiis2.name: Fomortiis
fomortiis2.title: Dark of Night
fomortiis2.description: The Demon King who once cast a long shadow over the continent of Magvel. His intention is to adorn Askr's festival night with terror... Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Winter festival? Why does this call to mind those cursed sacred stones? Why does it enrage me so?!
I am king over all Magvel's evil. I am that which guides the world to chaos. Descend into despair!
Why? Why do the little brats gather so close to me?! Begone! I am no winter envoy!
The smiles and laughs of humans... This joyfulness is unwelcome in my world. I shall grind them all to dust.
Why must I lend my aid to these mortals' winter festival? Lyon, you wretch...
Visit: Fools lost in festival merriment! All of you will be thrust into the depths of the darkest of nightmares!
Level: Winter-festival blessings? What idiocy. I bring naught for you but the eternal blight of darkness!
I shall grant you the greatest gift... A future decorated in death and unyielding despair!
Curses! I am being thrown off! Is this outfit to blame?!
Summon: The time has come. My resurrection is nigh! The Demon King Fomortiis shall at last... What is this? A festival?!
Learn Skill: *chuckle* With this power, I shall fill the festivities with despair!
Confession:
[S], you wretch...
Why have I been summoned to this winter festival? Humans enjoying themselves in harmony? BAH!
Simpleton. Did you believe if you dressed me up in this ridiculous outfit that I would change my ways?!
I shall submerge this festival in a sea of despair and wrap the world in the embrace of endless darkness!
You! Do not applaud me! This is no performance! I am serious! Deathly serious! Brats! Do not laugh at me!
Fine! I shall bestow upon you these toys! Get in a line! Begone from my sight once you have what is yours!
I am Demon King Fomortiis, not some common jester! I shall exact wintery vengeance upon you someday!
Status: What do you mean I am to be a winter-festival envoy? I am Fomortiis.
When you touch me next, your life will be forfeit.
Mortals are naive. They know not their place.
Flames burn brightest just before they are extinguished. This festival is no different...
You will pay for making me take part in this foolishness.
Lyon, you wretch... What are you so happy about?
Terror, despair, horror...which do you wish? It shall be yours.

eikthyrnir2.name: Eikþyrnir
eikthyrnir2.title: Blessed Strength
eikthyrnir2.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands who, as winter envoy, extends a standing invitation for all to start on a path to physical training.

Castle Hall: Reindeer are such strong creatures. With legs that effortlessly power through snow. It's inspiring.
Mending the body is one thing, but training with others does its own kind of healing.
To become strong, you must learn to steel yourself against nature's fury. I welcome the challenge of the cold.
Marching through snow greatly strengthens one's legs.
No, I'm not cold in this. It will take a lot more than snow and ice to slow me down.
Visit: My name is Eikþyrnir. We'll be training all winter over at [F]'s castle.
Level: The chill of snow. The power of ice. Train your body in the cold and watch how clear your mind becomes.
A body that has been trained well deflects such things like the winter's cold.
Is my body really...stiffening up in this cold? Pitiful. I must train harder...
Summon: I am Eikþyrnir, winter's envoy. It's truly amazing, the body you can obtain in the cold.
Learn Skill: You like my muscles? Thank you for noticing.
Confession:
Toys and clothing, books and sweets. I understand why children may want these things.
But no present compares to the gift of training. A body fortified against illness, a spirit that never breaks.
A healthy heart in a strong body. That sounds like the perfect gift to me.
Of course I won't forget about your training this winter, [S].
Take these dumbbells in hand, focus your mind, and allow your body to do the rest.
Stay consistent, and I believe you can become an even stronger hero.
Special: There is no roof too high.
Status: *sigh*
It is my duty to serve as envoy for the winter festival.
Hmm? No. I feel no cold.
The body is the final armor. It must be polished, made to shine.
What my sisters want? I do not pretend to know.
Carrying gifts to the rooftops is good training.
I have happy memories of Læraðr giving us gifts during celebrations.
Preparations were made for forging your body. Now we train together.

lyn9.name: Lyn
lyn9.title: Of Blazing
lyn9.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to Elyos. Resides in the Ring of the Lady of the Plains. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade / Fire Emblem Engage.
lyn9.emblem:
Enhanced Engaged Special
When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's max Special cooldown count value × 4 (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Unit can use the following【Style】:
————— Emblem Lyn Style —————
Unit can attack foes within 5 spaces of unit and 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit regardless of unit's range.
Unit suffers a counterattack if any of the following conditions are met: foe is armored with Range = 2, foe can counterattack regardless of unit's range, foe's Range is the same as the distance between unit and the foe.
Unit cannot move or attack structures, after-combat movement effects do not occur, unit's area-of-effect Specials cannot be triggered, and remaining movement granted from Canto is treated as 0. Skill effect's Range is treated as 2, including by skill effects determined by attack Range, like Pavise and Aegis. This Style can be used only when unit's Range = 2, cannot be used on the first turn, and once used, cannot be used for two turns.
————————————————————

【Style】
Change Style using the Style button at the bottom of the screen.
A unit's Style is only active when that unit is taking an action. When unit is equipped with a skill that has a Style, unit will not be able to use skills like Duo Skills or Harmonized Skills. Style use is disabled when unit is deployed using Pair Up or when unit is equipped with multiple skills that have a Style.

Castle Hall: It's hard to believe I will see friends who accompanied me in Elibe. They may be surprised that I'm an Emblem.
In Elyos, I was very precious to the king of Elusia. Though, he has passed...
Both Elyos and Sacae had places with wide-open, emerald plains... I can imagine a place like that here.
If I have the ability to eat in Askr, then I wonder if I can change clothes too... I suppose I should ask the other Lyns.
Engage with me and you can send an arrow a great distance, and even hit a scrap of paper dangling from a tree.
Visit: This is from [F]. I thought I'd send it with Astra Storm, but I wanted to meet you in person.
Level: It seems the wind is assisting us. Now is a good time to make a move.
The wind is in our favor. Let's keep this pace.
When the wind blows against you, it is time to push harder.
Summon: I am Lyn, the Emblem. I can feel a familiar wind here... Let us fight together.
Learn Skill: I will meet all your expectations. You will know both victory and renewal.
Confession:
I see you are looking up at the night sky with that gentle gaze, [S]...
Perhaps you are hoping to catch sight of a shooting star that allows you to summon Hero after Hero?
*chuckle* That is one reason to appreciate a starry night sky. Though, I do hope you aren't too cold...
I don't mind the cold myself. In Elyos, I was entrusted to a snowy land.
As an Emblem, I appreciate both grassy plains as well as vast expanses of snow.
I have fond memories of the cold wind that swept across such lands.
Should you grow tired of waiting for this star, I will lend my ear. Entrust me with your problems, anytime.
Status: Ah.
A familiar wind... It brings back memories of Elyos and my homeland of Sacae.
Ahhh! Don't poke around thoughtlessly. Do the blue flames interest you?
Where are Ivy and Hortensia? I should stay nearby to protect them.
Polish the ring up and make it sparkle... Oh, right, my ring isn't here!
"Sweep across, Emblem of Blazing..." Remember those words. They are the invocation to summon me.
*chuckle* It's nice that both Eliwood and Hector look well.
I am different from the Lyns who have come before me, but I am quite strong. I will show you the true power of an Emblem!

heidrun2.name: Heiðrún
heidrun2.title: Sisters of Healing
heidrun2.description: Sisters and members of the Healing Hands of Yggdrasill. They pray for the health of all at Askr's New Year celebration.
heidrun2.duo:
Grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit.
Applies【Divine Vein (Green)】on spaces within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit for 2 turns.
【Divine Vein (Green)】
Applies the following effects on space for foes: Foe cannot warp from this space or into this space (does not affect units with Pass skills or warp effects from structures like camps and fortresses in Rival Domains). Inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack (only highest value applied; does not stack). (Divine Vein effects do not stack; replaces any existing Divine Vein effect; Divine Vein effects applied simultaneously cancel each other out.
(Duo Skills can be used once per map by tapping the Duo button. Duo Skills cannot be used by units deployed using Pair Up.)

Castle Hall: **Ratatoskr:** This kimono is gorgeous! I feel like a different person while wearing it.
**Heiðrún:** The New Year brings new hope... I pray the Healing Hands can offer people hope this year too...
**Heiðrún:** Free of illness and injury... How nice. I wish for everyone in the nine realms to remain healthy the whole year.
**Ratatoskr:** Are you worried your stomach will hurt if you eat all this delicious food? Just tell me, right away. I-I'll fix it.
**Heiðrún:** It feels so nice to celebrate the New Year with Ratatoskr while wearing kimonos together... This is promising.
Visit: **Ratatoskr:** Umm, umm... I have a New Year's gift here from [F].
Level: **Ratatoskr:** Ooh! I think this year will be a good one, all right!
**Heiðrún:** It is a new year now... I hope everyone is able to spend the year in good health. That is my wish.
**Ratatoskr:** Ohhh... Something feels off! And the year just started too!
Summon: I am Heiðrún, from Yggdrasill... I offer you New Year's greetings alongside Ratatoskr.
Learn Skill: **Ratatoskr:** Is...this a New Year's gift? F-for us? Let's express our appreciation together, Heiðrún!
Confession:
**Ratatoskr:** New Year's is so fun, isn't it? Everyone is so happy and there is so much delicious food!
And there's even New Year's gifts!
**Heiðrún:** Hehehe... Yes, there is, Ratatoskr. New Year's is a time to celebrate, a time for hope.
Yet illness and injury may still creep into people's lives. As Healing Hands, we must not let our guards down.
**Ratatoskr:** Y-y-you're right! We need to stay alert!
**Heiðrún:** Let us not forget the spirit of a Healing Hand. We shall pray for the happiness of all people.
**Ratatoskr:** Yeah! That way, everyone can have a good year!
Status: Hah...
"So many holiday delicacies..." "They look delicious! I want to eat them with the whole family."
Conversation: **Ratatoskr:** Umm, umm, let's see... I've wished Father and all my siblings a happy New Year...
So, that means I have the summoner, Prince Alfonse, Princess Sharena, and, and...
**Heiðrún:** Ratatoskr, there is no need for you to worry yourself over this.
Everyone is enjoying the New Year and living life quietly right now.
**Ratatoskr:** But I want to make sure I can greet everyone before the end of the day.
The summoner taught me a proverb. "The whole year's plans should be made on New Year's Day."
So, I've got a lot of things to do today if I'm going to have a good year!
I really want to make sure I keep getting along with everyone this year too, so I...
**Heiðrún:** Oh. Well. When you say it like that, I have to admit I feel the same way...
I understand now. Let's go do our greetings together.
**Ratatoskr:** Thanks, Heiðrún, I'm glad you... O-oh no!
I can't believe it! Oh no, I'm so... I forgot to wish you a happy New Year!
**Heiðrún:** Oh! Now that you mention it, I forgot to wish you one as well.
**Ratatoskr:** I'm so sorry! I hope you have a happy New Year, Heiðrún!
I love having my sister so close by. Promise you'll stay close to me all year?
**Heiðrún:** *chuckle* I will, Ratatoskr. A happy New Year to you as well.
This year, I wish for us all to be close to our family and friends. I will be so happy if that wish comes true...

nidhoggr2.name: Níðhöggr
nidhoggr2.title: Daze of Healing
nidhoggr2.description: A member of the Healing Hands of Yggdrasill who heals others with a sweet fruit. She turns up to Askr's New Year celebration already tipsy.

Castle Hall: I'm the best-behaved of all of us. I always do what Pops asks. But damn, what'd he say? New Year's...uh...
This New Year's party is nice. Nobody bats an eye if I'm a little tipsy all day long.
Hey, c'mere. Got a present—one of my special fruits. Hey, I'm talkin' to ya, [S]!
Hræsvelgr and Heiðrún could stand to let their hair down on New Year's, at least! Couple of stiffs...
So this is called a kimono... It's pretty tight, isn't it? That isn't bad, though. Offers some support.
Visit: Feel like I was just partying over at a different castle... It was probably... [F]'s?.
Level: Told ya I was great. So no complaints if I'm a bit, y'know, wobbly!
Want a bite of my fruit? Feels real good, especially ringin' in the New Year like this.
You're too tense. It's the New Year, let bygones be bygones!
Summon: Name's Níðhöggr. *hic* Intoxicated? Me? It's New Year's! Who isn't?
Learn Skill: A great way to start the year! I'll take a big bite of fruit and kick back.
Confession:
This Askran New Year's party ain't so bad. I blend right in.
I mean, Hræsvelgr told me to shape up, but that's nothing new.
The whole thing got me thinking, though. If we don't have peace, we can't celebrate like this.
I want to kick back like this next year too. Take a bite out of life!
So I guess we're just going to have to do our best this year. Isn't that right, [S]?
Status: Happy New Year! Today we can have as much fun as we want, yeah?
Huh? A snake? Oh! Me! You mean me. *giggle*
Hræsvelgr is mad at me. New year, same old tedium...
The New Year is a special occasion, so here's some fruit for you!
These clothes are so uncomfortable, but I guess I have to wear something...
My pops got me a New Year's gift! He makes me so happy.
Let's keep having fun together this year!

hraesvelgr2.name: Hræsvelgr
hraesvelgr2.title: Wings of Healing
hraesvelgr2.description: A member of the Healings Hands of Yggdrasill. She greets the new year with well-wishes for the health of all people.

Castle Hall: I pray Níðhöggr does not welcome the New Year intoxicated on her fruit...again.
At the beginning of each year, I say the same prayer for illness to be erased from all the worlds.
Look at this joyful doll. It is a daruma, and I feel I have seen it somewhere before... Ratatoskr, perhaps?
I just healed someone choking on food. Do not gorge yourself just because it is the New Year.
I have healing items on the belt of my kimono. I like to be prepared for anything that may come to pass.
Visit: I am Hræsvelgr, blade of the Healing Hands. I have been sent to help you celebrate the New Year.
Level: I will not allow the evil of disease to approach any precious to me. I shall slice down all sources of illness.
I shall remove any nidus of disease that shows itself this year!
Did I allow this lively atmosphere to relax me? I must focus...
Summon: I am Hræsvelgr, here to celebrate the New Year with my family. I pray for all to be free of illness and injury.
Learn Skill: I understand your expectations. I shall heal as many as possible this year, as I do in every year...
Confession:
My family and the people of Askr all smile with the arrival of the New Year...
However, the evil of disease may appear whenever and wherever it chooses. Without mercy.
If a patient comes to your attention, do not hesitate to inform me.
One must be especially careful on the New Year, when people lose themselves in merriment.
My family and I wish for everyone to be safe and healthy throughout the coming year.
I shall wield these blades to remove the evil of disease this year, as I do every year.
Status: Hm.
I am Hræsvelgr. A happy New Year to you.
It is dangerous to touch me without warning.
Even in this new year, my only concern is the mission.
Níðhöggr is intoxicated already this year.
This is the first time I have worn a "kimono." Does it look strange?
People smiling. Laughing. It...reminds me of the good days.
Anything that is gnawing at you, I will sever with my blade.

tana6.name: Tana
tana6.title: Soaring New Year
tana6.description: Princess of Frelia, donning a special outfit in celebration of the new year, and joined by her brother, Innes. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: Any year that begins with donning a wonderful outfit is certain to be a good year!
I want to become a graceful and strong pegasus knight like Syrene this year. I have but to put in the effort!
This sword is connected to Nidhogg, the Serpent Bow of Frelia's Sacred Twins, passed down the generations.

I've heard of the hatsumode ritual—of the first shrine visit of the year to pay respects to a god.
I will invite Eirika and Ephraim to come along.
I'm told this kimono is an outfit for celebrating New Year's. I thought I'd wear one along with Innes!
Visit: I am Tana, princess of Frelia, and I am here to deliver you a New Year's greeting from [F]!
Level: I shall soar high in the sky this year!
This is going well! I think I might be able to grow even more this year!
Urk... I did not realize just how difficult it would be to fly while wearing a kimono...
Summon: I am Tana, princess of Frelia. Let us work together to make this new year a good one!
Learn Skill: Is this gift money what they call an otoshidama? What a nice New Year's gift! I will take care to use it well!
Confession:
Have you decided on what your goal will be this year?
I have too many, and I am having trouble deciding which one to focus on.
I wish to be able to support Innes even more than I already am...
But I also wish to be more adept so I will not lose to Ephraim or Eirika. I even want to catch up to Syrene!
I have so many goals, but I do not want to abandon my goals from last year either!
I'm going to do my best to show everyone how much I have grown by the year's end! Just watch me!
Special: May this year bring good fortune!
Status: Mm-hm
Happy New Year! I am glad I got a chance to extend my greetings to you.
*react* Your hand! It must be quite cold outside.
Kimonos are certainly cute, don't you agree? I just wish they were a bit more comfortable...
Every year, I pray I become strong like Innes.
I am considering decorating my pegasus for New Year's.
I feel as though I look more mature in this attire. What do you think?
May you be blessed with many good things this year.
Map Select: I will bring forth my greetings.

innes4.name: Innes
innes4.title: New Year's Aim
innes4.description: Prince of Frelia and Tana's brother. In an effort to continue to improve upon himself, he begins his training day one of the new year. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: I have a pile of strategic treatises I wish to read. I must see how many I can make it through this year.
Frelia's New Year rituals are solemn. Askr's, though, are lively and extend beyond the boundaries of this world.
Have you decided on a goal for the New Year? Ah... I see a strong will in your eyes. It was crude to even ask.
Ephraim would certainly be swinging a spear at first light of the year. I try not to get so carried away.
This is an outfit worn to celebrate the New Year? I imagine Tana being fond of the refined elegance of its design.
Visit: I am Innes, prince of Frelia. I bring New Year's greetings from your dear friend [F].
Level: I shall grow closer to becoming perfect royalty. On this New Year, I swear it.
It would not do for me to miss my target first thing in the year.
I see an area for improvement. I shall refine my skills and success will be mine.
Summon: I am Innes. Allow me to offer words of celebration in welcoming this new year as prince of Frelia.
Learn Skill: I will use this new power to help me take on even larger challenges.
Confession:
A Hoshido proverb is that the quality of a day is decided in the morning, and a year on its first day.
It need not be said that one's training is just as important every other day as it is on the first of the year.
The first of the year holds important meaning as the day one decides on concrete goals for the months ahead.
How one wishes to improve oneself. How one wishes to be at year's end. This proverb strikes true.
Even if the goal is small, if it only gets one through the moment at hand, reaching that goal is of significance.
Just as a great tree's roots grow deep into the earth, unwavering devotion will bring me the life I desire.
Status: Mm-hm?
As an exemplar of Frelia, I offer New Year's greetings.
Oh? Is that a customary greeting here?
This...kimono...is nice. I am quite fond of it.
I have a renewed sense of purpose this year. I will devote myself wholly to my training, that I may be a just king.
Where is Tana? I have a New Year's gift I must give her. It is called an "otoshidama."
I will not lose to Ephraim, no matter the contest. Spinning tops, flying kites...
I am happy to greet this new year with you beside me.

brigid.name: Brigid
brigid.title: Awakened Bow
brigid.description: Older twin sister of Edain, whom she was separated from when they were small. Brigid's path was harsh until she was awakened to the divine bow, the legacy of her forebears. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Edain, my twin. You did well to find me.
Is my father well? And what of my brother, Andrey? Tell me.
"I won't prey on the weak." "Pirates for the powerless!" These were my credos, and I won't forget them.
You look tired. Are you well, [S]?
Andrey will meet his end at my hands. His crimes are too grave, and so this falls to me.
Visit: I am known as Brigid. I come as an envoy from [F].
Level: A strange power flows through me. There's a warmth growing within my heart...
Being raised by the Orgahil Pirates is nothing to regret.
When the battles are all over, I may return to my home, Yngvi... I wonder what it's like.
Summon: I am Brigid. Upon my bow, Yewfelle, I will restore the pride of Yngvi.
Learn Skill: What a wonderful gift. Thank you.
Confession:
I cried alone as the Orgahil Pirates fell upon our ship... Is that why the captain raised me as his own?
From that day, I lived as a pirate. But why dwell on it? The crimes I committed cannot be erased.
But as for my brother's crimes... He killed our father and invaded Silesse. Those crimes are unforgivable.
His sins stain our family name, and it is my duty to put a stop to him and restore our pride.
Yes, I will bathe my hands in blood. But what matters is my sister, who suffered so, understands my acts.
Status: I am Brigid, descendant of the crusader Ullr and daughter of House Yngvi.
Oh! You got me!
Yewfelle has been in my family for generations. It's the bow of the gods.
I remember everything now. Edain, Father... Andrey.
I'd still be leading the Orgahil Pirates if not for Edain. She reminded me who I am.
There's a warmth growing within my heart...
This cause of yours is worth pursuing. I will lend you the power of Yewfelle.

edain.name: Edain
edain.title: Lady of Yngvi
edain.description: A lady of Yngvi and descendant of the crusader Ullr. She was captured by Verdane but escaped with Jamke's aid. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: I am thankful for your efforts, Midir, and very sorry to have worried you.
I feared what might become of me when I was abducted, but there are good people in Verdane as well.
The beasts within people seem to be awakened by war. Gods, please allow them to keep their human hearts...
The pegasus knights of Silesse are formidable foes. A hero's bow must be given to one who can use it well.
Brigid is my twin sister. Pirates stole her away when we were five. I have been searching for her since that day.
Visit: Blessings upon you, [S]. You have earned the respect of all.
Level: War inflicts great harm and hardship on many people. As a servant of the gods, I wish to help them.
If there is anything that might bring this fight to an end faster, it must be done.
Do not concern yourself with me. Please focus your thoughts on how the most lives might be spared.
Summon: I am Edain of Yngvi. I am sorry... It seems as though simply being near me may beckon danger to you.
Learn Skill: If this gift can ease the burden placed on those who must fight, I will humbly accept it.
Confession:
I became a cleric in order to find my lost sister. It is as simple as that...
I needed to see her again and give her the holy bow of the Yngvi.
Yewfelle, the bow of the gods. It is said that only one direct descendant can use a weapon of the gods.
I believed Brigid was that one within the Yngvi line. If she could wield it, I would know she was truly my sister.
She must have led a very difficult life with the Orgahil Pirates. I wish only happiness for her going forward.
However, she is likely to find herself upon the field of battle. Please watch over her, [S].
Status: Gods, bless them...
Do not be reckless.
Only one direct descendant can use a weapon of the gods. In my family, that is my sister Brigid.
I became a cleric hoping to find my lost sister.
If there is a way to bring this fighting to an end even one day sooner, it must be done.
Gods, please allow them to preserve their humanity in the face of conflict.
You are a kinder person than anyone I know. I treasure that.

midir.name: Midir
midir.title: Archer of Yngvi
midir.description: An archer knight in service of Yngvi. He was severely injured when he stood up against Munnir's assault. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Lady Edain... I will protect you, no matter the cost.
How could we let them take our Lady Edain? How do we still call ourselves her knights? Pathetic...
I have trained with a bow since I was a boy. Even on horseback, my aim rings true.
Lord Sigurd. Lady Edain is safe thanks to you. If ever you are in need of my bow, it shall be yours.
When I first met the princess's twin, I was stunned. Looking back, I may have left a poor first impression...
Visit: I have been entrusted with a package. A gift from [F].
Level: Behold the renowned strength of the knights of House Yngvi!
I will go. I have no need for rest!
If I had only been stronger, I... I will not fail Lady Edain again.
Summon: I am Midir, knight of House Yngvi. No matter how intense the battle becomes, I stand prepared.
Learn Skill: Let us move forward together!
Confession:
What beauty... I never imagined there were two in this world so radiant... Like twin stars lighting dark... Like—
Ah! Oh, it's you. It is unwise to sneak up on a knight. What did you hear, [S]?
Ahem! No, actually. Let's move on... House Yngvi was founded by the bowmaster Ullr.
It would come to pass that Duke Ling would father twin girls and a younger son, Andrey.
But the elder twin...Lady Brigid, was stolen by pirates as a child and had long been missing...
Now, Lady Brigid has grown into someone even more luminous than the rising sun...
Status: I am Midir. I serve house Yngvi.
What?! Ah, sorry... That was quite loud.
Lady Edain... To have you come to harm when I was with you...
I will never forget the debt I owe to Lord Sigurd!
I am fine to continue on. Please, command me as you see fit.
That I would meet a person more beautiful... Oh, it is nothing...
I will protect you even if it costs me my life.

dew.name: Dew
dew.title: Benevolent Thief
dew.description: Was captured for his thievery but allowed to escape with Edain at her request. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: This is bad! If I get caught one more time, Munnir will yank my tongue right out!
Well, I did promise Lady Edain, so I suppose my thieving days are truly behind me...
Hey, you work pretty hard, [S]!
Let me know if you're looking for anything specific. I have a way of getting my hands on things... Hehe...
*whistle* What a nice castle. Hehe, you all go on ahead. I'm just gonna... take a look around.
Visit: Hey, why are you looking at me like that? Oh, this? You, uh...dropped it! Now that it's back, I'll just be going.
Level: Ha! Look at me go! You did pretty good too, Summoner.
I have an idea! You clear the way while I grab their things. I promise I'll be right behind you.
Ah, I'm beat! Just a tiny rest? Please?
Summon: I'm Dew. Maybe I'll hide out in this castle for a bit. You know, to make sure everything in there is, uh...safe!
Learn Skill: I wish I had something to give you, but since changing my ways, my pockets are a bit lighter nowadays.
Confession:
Say, you know the Tower of Bragi, right? You may have seen it. The tall one on the western side of Orgahil.
Well, inside, I head this strange voice... It said something about "trespassing in a sacred place."
Anyway, I found this unusual sword. I wasn't sure what to make of it—who would just lose a sword like that?
It must have been a gift from the voice! For, you know, trying to scare me. At least I think that's what it is...
Now, I don't show off my finds to just anyone, but I may consider showing you, [S].
Status: I'm Dew, a thief. Former thief, I mean. I've washed my hands of the business! No, really!
*yelp* It wasn't me! I swear it! Oh...it's you. *sigh of relief*
Oh, if I get caught one more time, Munnir will yank my tongue right out!
This is a nice castle... I wonder what Askran treasures are hidden deep inside!
Well, well. They're using a lock like this? Too easy!
Jamke, I'm sorry we fought so much. I don't hate you, you know.
Summoner! I got you something! Er, no need to ask where it came from.

chulainn.name: Chulainn
chulainn.title: Unbeaten Warrior
chulainn.description: A gladiator who wanders the land in search of bounties. It is said he has never seen defeat. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall:
Take this sword. Even if you do not stand on the battlefield, it is best to be prepared for anything.
A sword is no burden, no matter how many you have.
This fight will be a hard one. I can feel it.
There is no use in worrying about me, just as I will waste no effort worrying about you.
Fighting not for money but for justice... That's what I seek now.
Did you need something from me?
Visit: I'm Chulainn. I've been staying at [F]'s castle.
Level: I'm the son of Sofala's lord, and I'm a man who let his heart be stolen by a beautiful girl. I am...a foolish man.
This is about what I expected.
I see...
Summon: I'm Chulainn, a simple swordsman. I have never lost in the arena... Not until now.
Learn Skill: So this is what it feels like from the other side.
Confession:
Just who are you, [S]?
I've won every battle I have entered, until now... You won so convincingly. It has opened my eyes.
Seeing your spirit and strong will to fight for what you believe in made me question my way of life.
Because of this, fighting simply for money has left me feeling empty of late.
I'd like to fight at your side, if you'll have me. I want to use my sword for something greater.
Status: I'm Chulainn, a simple swordsman.
What is it? Are you bored?
I've only ever fought for money...but it has left me feeling empty of late.
I want to use my sword for something greater.
Something tells me this fight will be a hard one.
I am a man who let his heart be stolen by a beautiful girl. A foolish man.
If you would allow it, I'd like to fight at your side.

marisa3.name: Marisa
marisa3.title: Willful Blades
marisa3.description: Marisa, of Gerik's Mercenaries, and Byleth, a former mercenary of Jeralt's band. The two meet for the first time at the Jehanna festival. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones / Three Houses.
marisa3.harmonized:
Grants "unit can move 1 extra space" to unit (that turn only; does not stack).
Grants【Resonance: Blades】and "unit cannot be slowed by terrain (does not apply to impassable terrain)" to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
Once used, Harmonized Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Harmonized Skill has already been used, unit can use Harmonized Skill again.

Castle Hall: **Marisa:** I like the feeling of the dry, sandy wind that blows in Jehanna.
**Byleth:** You also learned how to live as a mercenary from your father, Marisa? It seems we share that commonality.
**Marisa:** Did you enjoy the festival? To be honest...I don't understand much else besides fighting.
**Byleth:** This outfit suits you, Marisa. You should hold your head high and wear it with pride.
**Byleth:** I hear you are called the Crimson Flash, Marisa? I would have preferred such a moniker to Ashen Demon...
Visit: I am Marisa of Gerik's Mercenaries. We are having a Jehanna festival at [F]'s castle.
Level: **Marisa:** It's easy to fight next to you, Byleth. It's like we've been partners for a decade.
**Byleth:** You are doing well, Marisa. The energy of the festival is shining through you.
**Marisa:** Sorry. My timing... It didn't match yours, Byleth...
Summon: I am Byleth of Jeralt's Mercenaries. Is this where the Jehanna festival will be? Please, show me around, Marisa.
Learn Skill: **Marisa:** Take this, Byleth. We'll need each other to survive in this desert.
Confession:
**Byleth:** The Jehanna festival was quite fun, Marisa. Thank you for showing me around.
**Marisa:** Even though I just met you for the first time in Askr, I don't feel like you're a stranger.
**Byleth:** As I said before, it seems we both learned how to live our lives from our mercenary fathers.
**Marisa:** Yeah. You grew up following your father's path, and now you fight to surpass him... Same as me...
**Byleth:** Perhaps we both have the Jehanna festival to thank for bringing us together.
Let us continue to push each other so we may keep growing!
Status: "I hope you like Jehanna." "Yes, I do...very much."
Conversation: **Marisa:** You're a professor, right, Byleth?
**Byleth:** Yes...that is true.
**Marisa:** Wow, so you must be really knowledgeable.
**Byleth:** I suppose it depends on the field.
**Marisa:** How about mercenary commanders? Can you teach me how to get mine to like me?
**Byleth:** Oh, well, is there a reason your commander dislikes you?
If your relationship is not faring well, then perhaps—
**Marisa:** No, no. Our relationship is good. It's just not...
**Byleth:** The kind of relationship you want. Is that right?
**Marisa:** Yes! I think?
**Byleth:** Hm... I don't have much experience in getting people to like me, but...
I do feel a special affinity for my students who step up to lead their houses and encourage their peers.
**Marisa:** Lead? Encourage? I'm...not a good talker. I don't think I can do that.
**Byleth:** Actions can be more effective than words. Perhaps, if you are first to the enemy and you fight with valor...
**Marisa:** I-I can do that!
**Byleth:** That's the spirit. I will be rooting for you.
**Marisa:** Thanks, Professor. I'll try.

tethys2.name: Tethys
tethys2.title: Dancing Sands
tethys2.description: An elegant dancer of Gerik's Mercenaries. She dances to entertain the crowd at the festival of her homeland, Jehanna. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones.

Castle Hall: A Jehanna festival to celebrate my homeland?! I would like everyone in Askr to be as excited as I am!
Most of us in Gerik's Mercenaries are from in and around Jehanna. We're used to the desert heat.
In the desert, one is truly grateful for a cup filled to the brim with water. That's just the kind of place it is.
How do I look in this new outfit? It's not every day there's a festival, after all. *giggle*
Where do you suppose Ewan ran off to? I hope he's not playing pranks and using the crowd as cover...
Visit: I am Tethys, a dancer. I'm here to deliver a Jehanna-festival dance to you from [F].
Level: It's not every day you get to enjoy a festival. Go on, lay down your weapon and relax a bit.
You... *giggle* You stopped dead in your tracks! Can't tear your eyes away from my dancing, perhaps?
I was not able to move the way I normally can... Let's take a moment and then carry on.
Summon: My name is Tethys. I'm a member of Gerik's Mercenaries, born and raised in Jehanna. I'll show you around!
Learn Skill: Is this for me? How nice! I will be able to dance with even more passion!
Confession:
Hello, [S].
So, I have some good news and some better news. Which do you want to hear first?
Well, the good news is that everyone from Jehanna enjoyed the festival!
And the better news is that everyone in the Order of Heroes enjoyed it too!
I know... The sun can be harsh in the desert, the dust and sand terrible. It is no easy country to live in.
But there are so many other wonderful things about it...
The food and drinks that offer respite from the unbearable heat... The moon that floats in the dark desert sky...
If it's true that everyone enjoyed these things, then I'm so glad we had the festival!
Status: *giggle*
Keep it together now.
Almost there!
Welcome to Jehanna! *giggle*
It is no easy country to live in, that's for certain. But, it is my country.
This souvenir is for Ewan. Now— What do you think I should get Chief Gerik?
All we need to do is think positive thoughts.
You know, you're a good person. I can recognize these things. *giggle*

ike8.name: Ike
ike8.title: Desert Mercenary
ike8.description: Leader of the Greil Mercenaries. He works as security at the festival being held in the deserts of Jehanna. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: The sand is an unstable place to fight. Though, Soren would think of a way to adapt to it.
The Greil Mercenaries are not motivated by money. We just fight to help those in need.
Dried meat is great for surviving in the desert. Meat is meat, no matter what it looks like.
I never liked heavy armor. If I wear something as light as this, I can fight without it getting in the way.
Gather people together and it's bound to result in some conflict. I'm here to put that to rest.
Visit: I'm Ike of the Greil Mercenaries. I've got a Jehanna-festival souvenir for you from [F].
Level: When you're in the desert, you've got to adapt your fighting style to fit the location. Just need to figure out how.
If someone comes here to start a fight, it's my job to drive them out with force.
I won't make excuses. I just wasn't up to the task yet.
Summon: I'm Ike of the Greil Mercenaries. My mission is to guard the Jehanna festival.
Learn Skill: This is precious stuff in the desert. I'll be sure to use it well. Thank you.
Confession:
The hardship you face in the desert can be overcome by cooperating with your comrades.
Just like in battle. You can overcome more with your allies than you can alone.
The Greil Mercenaries have learned to rely on each other. We've overcome a lot of obstacles.
And it's the same way the people in the desert band together and help each other.
I learned at the festival how the people of Jehanna have survived in such a harsh land.
I plan to use what I've learned here to solidify the bonds within the Greil Mercenaries even more.
Status: I'm not one for clothes that get in the way of my movement, but if it's protocol, I'll do it.
Hm? Ah, was there sand on my outfit? I hadn't noticed...
You've got to adapt your fighting style to fit the location.
Mercenaries go where the money takes them, even to a desert.
Ah, I smell cooked meat. That's something festivals always get right.
Well...my stomach is certainly cool in this outfit.
As a mercenary you hired, I'll make sure no one lays a finger on you.

malice2.name: Malice
malice2.title: Blooming Blade
malice2.description: A mercenary who wields a sword as easily as water flows through a stream. She sets her sights on making money at the Jehanna festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: The prince of Jehanna likes gamblin', huh? Damn, if my old man got word of this, he'd challenge him to a bet.
I've been all over the place with my old man, including the desert. He lost a lot of bets there...
There's sure to be good money here where bandits gather. Should I buy somethin' for my father and Ogma?
I like this outfit. It makes time in the desert easier with garb that breathes like this.
I suppose I don't got much of a choice. I'll perform a bit at the tavern and make some money.
Visit: I'm Malice. And this here is a Jehanna-festival souvenir from [F]!
Level: I performed quite a bit at the festival. It's only right I make a profit. So... that'll be 590 gold. A fair price too!
Don't get so down on yourself just for losin' a few times. If people can't take you seriously, it's over.
Hey now! Don't go cuttin' my pay!
Summon: I'm Malice. So, this is a festival for a desert kingdom? I bet I won't get bored here. Time to make a profit!
Learn Skill: Ho! You can make a lot of money at festivals like this!
Confession:
I can't believe it's come down to this. Dancin' in taverns... And I thought I'd be a profitable mercenary.
You know, my swordsmanship came from sword dancing. It's all for show! So you can never tell where I'll strike.
I learned this technique to make some money for the road after my old man lost a few too many bets.
Turns out, it ain't too shabby in battle either.
But listen up. This festival is a special occasion. I don't usually perform in outfits like this.
Next time, I'll make money with my real swordsmanship. So let me know when you need a bodyguard!
Status: I can make a lot of money at festivals like this. I owe you one.
Hey! If you wanna start a fight with someone, you should do it to their face.
All I can see is desert. It'd be pretty hard to make ends meet here, don't you think?
It's all for show, you know? My style of swordsmanship.
The prince of Jehanna's got a thing for gambling? Ugh, just like my old man.
Hey, look at that—I made good money! But... It'll be gone in no time...just like the rest.
My performance was done for the day, but for you I'll make an exception.

saber2.name: Saber
saber2.title: Dune Walker
saber2.description: A money-hungry mercenary who will take on just about any job if he's paid enough. He makes an appearance at the festival being held in the deserts of Jehanna. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Look at that—an accessory with a desert flower on it. Guess I should pick this up for the little lass, eh?
The desert south of the Temple of Mila in Zofia was littered with thieves. That place was dangerous.
The prince of Jehanna left the castle to work as a mercenary? Heh! Now that guy's eccentric.
I guess it makes sense to dress for the desert if you're gonna be in one. When in Jehanna, am I right?
My client says "frozen wasteland," I go to a frozen wasteland. If they say "desert," guess where I go? It's simple.
Visit: I was sent to tell you the Jehanna festival's a real hit. Said so by [F].
Level: I got a little more carried away than I usually do. Is this what it means to get caught up in the festivities?
I'm taking some time to relax. Don't go stomping out my fire now.
This heat is doing me in. I'm gettin' too old for this.
Summon: I'm Saber, a wandering mercenary. It's odd to see a festival in the desert like this. Think I'll relax here a bit.
Learn Skill: Is this how you host a visitor of Jehanna? Gotta say, I don't hate it!
Confession:
I am a mercenary. As long as I'm paid, I'll do any job, go anywhere— Well...
I'd rather not go to an icy land where my fingers freeze off, or a scorching land where the sun blurs my vision.
But I do like this Jehanna festival. I can really feel the spirit of the desert people who live in such a harsh land.
All I wanted was to get a little bit of relaxation here, but...
Before I knew it, I was part of the festivities, even pumping others up too.
If ya invite me to this festival again, I might lend a hand free of charge. Heh! Never thought I'd say that.
Status: Mm, mm, mmm...
Was it really a good idea to invite me to this festival?
Oop! The festival is meant to be fun, but you're getting carried away.
I was born in the north, so I don't have much love for heat.
Never met a mercenary that looked the least bit trustworthy.
Word is the queen of Jehanna is a good woman.
Every now and then, I'll free myself from the lass's grip and take some time to relax.
I offer up this victory to you... Hahaha! Did you think I was serious?

ayra3.name: Ayra
ayra3.title: Supreme Astra
ayra3.description: Princess of Isaach, a descendant of the crusader Od, and a master of the sword. She was praised as the sword princess of the technique Astra. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.
ayra3.artist: Makimura Shunsuke (マキムラシュンスケ)

Castle Hall: The fate that befell Isaach... Thinking about it now, I suspect a plot.
Mallicur knew he would die and was resolute. He entrusted Shannan to me, and we fled.
I have no need of gifts. Seek another for your generosity.
Do you need something? If not, I will take my leave.
I will see that Shannan is raised well so that he may become an honorable king. It is my sworn duty.
Visit: I have something for you, I think— from [F].
Level: My father, my brother—all the scions of Od have been great warriors. I aspire to that same greatness.
You stand before me knowing you cannot win? To take to the field like this is regrettable.
The point of my sword is a blazing star shooting through the sky. It joins countless fates in its brilliant trail.
Summon: I am Ayra of Isaach. I vowed to my brother Mallicur that I would watch over Shannan and guide him.
Learn Skill: Thank you. I will use my skills with care and remember you as I do.
Confession:
My brother had faith that if Shannan were to live, Isaach could be reborn.
Seeing to this is my life's vow. It is my duty to watch over him and ensure he grows into a fine king.
The descendants of Od must not be purged from Isaach.
Shannan has matured and can now stand on his own two feet. And he is blessed with fine companions.
I feel my duty is done. Someday, I may even return home—though not until the fight here is over.
Just as I once supported Lord Sigurd, I would be happy to serve as the blade of this land's prince.
I would remain a stalwart ally of you on your chosen path, that we may forge a future together.
Status: Hm.
A Legendary Hero? It is too early to award me such status.
*gasp* Oh, it's you. Did someone tell you to sneak up on me?
I am happy if you regard me a warrior.
I will always be there for Shannan.
I will return to Isaach. But not until the battle is finished.
This is the only life I know.
For you, I will wield my blade.

athos.name: Athos
athos.title: Omniscient One
athos.description: One of the Eight Legends who fought in the ancient Scouring. For over one thousand years, he lived and pursued the mysteries of the world. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.

Castle Hall: An evil star...rises in Bern... But do not fear. Once again, Lycia brings hope.
It's been almost a thousand years... and the world is ever-threatened by one who craves the might of dragons.
It is the will of all the people collectively that decides the course of the world's fate.
The teachings of Elimine, created for the sake of future generations, reflect the will of the people. And yet...
Do you seek me? Well, you have found me.
Visit: You have a fine look in your eyes. You must be a boon companion to [F].
Level: As I use my power—my life force—it grows dimmer. At these times, I see the future... The children of fire...
Once it begins to turn, none can halt the wheel of fate. But as long as there is hope, people continue to try.
To fuel your quest with the stolen lives of others, this brings not wisdom but abomination.
Summon: I am Athos. Many choose simply to call me Archsage. Now, what will I learn here, I wonder?
Learn Skill: The hunger for knowledge... It knows no bounds. Solve one mystery, and along comes another.
Confession:
The weapons we once wielded contained great strength, fearsome enough to repel dragons.
Much of this power has been lost to time. That which remains is guarded by the stalwart to prevent its misuse.
All the same... No, in fact, due to this, malcontents scheme to harness the power of the dragons.
They seek the dragon's gate, which will open for none but them.
Ah, I see... This will force humans to realize that their fates are bound to those of the dragons...
They will protect them and so seek salvation that is only possible through cooperation.
I have lived very long. Very long, indeed, but I foresee that this is as far as I go.
And yet, I am glad to know one such as you in my final days...to visit a realm filled with those of strong will.
My utopia, and the ideals that shaped it... I see them in you all.
I have attained true conviction by walking this path to its conclusion. I thank you, [S].
Status: Aah...
I am Athos. Many centuries ago, I fought in the Scouring as one of the eight legends.
Hm? You are a strange one. *chuckle*
The world is full of mysteries. Solve one, and along comes another...
In my drive to find the truth, I grew detached from my fellow man.
Once it begins to turn, none can halt the wheel of fate.
Nergal... How did we both become...so distant from humanity?
As you guide me, perhaps you too were guided when you summoned me to this world.

rhea4.name: Rhea
rhea4.title: Aura of Love
rhea4.description: Archbishop who guides the Church of Seiros. She bestows love in equal measure unto all who celebrate the festival, including her mother, Sothis, who joins her. They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
rhea4.duo:
Grants the following status to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn: "neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat."
Applies【Divine Vein (Stone)】to unit's space and spaces within 2 spaces of unit for 2 turns.
Applies【Divine Vein (Stone)】
Applies the following effects on space for unit and allies: Grants Def/Res+6 during combat, reduces damage from foe's Specials by 10 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from area-of-effect Specials by 50% (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials). (Divine Vein effects do not stack; replaces any existing Divine Vein effect; Divine Vein effects applied simultaneously cancel each other out. Does not count as defensive terrain.)

Castle Hall: **Rhea:** Silken hair, so similar to my own... Looking at you, I feel feelings such that I cannot put into words.
**Rhea:** All I wanted was my mother to return. Perhaps fate led me to this land as I wished so fervently to be reunited...
**Sothis:** You appear tired. Shall I allow you to avail yourself of my kindness? Shall I offer my warm embrace?
**Sothis:** Hey, you! And you! And you! And you—you too! Do not call me "goddess"! I feel self-conscious!
**Sothis:** All is well that ends well, or so they say. This, too, is an ending.
Visit: **Rhea:** We offer the goddess thanks for her love and guidance. I ask that you stay true to [F].
Level: **Rhea:** When the goddess's love fills the hearts of the people, the land will be fertile, and conflict will be no more.
**Rhea:** As a servant of the goddess, I pray that all the devout will be granted her everlasting love.
**Sothis:** Do not yearn for me! It rankles. My love is not so cheap.
Summon: I am Rhea, of the Church of Seiros. And you are...Sothis, did you say? That is the goddess's name! Lovely.
Learn Skill: **Rhea:** Ah! This, too, may be the guidance of Sothis, the progenitor god!
Confession:
**Rhea:** Now that I think of it, Byleth did speak of visions of a girl with no inhibitions and a savage streak...
**Sothis:** A crude and selfish brat? Me? I shall choose to ignore that.
**Rhea:** Sothis... You...
**Sothis:** The excitement of the festival has influenced us all, I think. So open a window and let in a breeze!
**Rhea:** The wind feels so nice. The heavens stretch above us, and the breeze rustles the flowers and trees...
When we're here together, like this... The feeling we have spent an eternity together overwhelms me. Strange...
I feel like I am wrapped in the peace and warmth of the sun's embrace...
Did the progenitor god guide us to this moment?
**Sothis:** And how am I to know? But I do understand how you feel. To an extent.
**Rhea:** Let us pray that this warmth may illuminate the people's days, that it may lead them to a future of light...
That their time is filled to the brim with the goddess's love and blessings.
Status: *laugh*
"I cannot believe how cute you look, Mother." "Do not gawk so at me."
Conversation: **Rhea:** Mother, shall we go over there next? Seems worth having a look.
**Sothis:** I am willing to go with you. Yet, I cannot grow accustomed to your calling me "mother."
**Rhea:** *laugh* I suppose not. It feels strange for me too.
I cannot believe you are here, or that you are so adorable! All this other-worlds business is so strange.
**Sothis:** I do not disagree with you on that point, yet... The idea that I once birthed a child feels somehow unreal.
And yet you call me "mother..."
**Rhea:** It's terribly sad to know you do not recognize me...
Just know that, no matter what you look like...you are still my mother.
I spent so many years seeking you. I... I felt I would lose my mind...
**Sothis:** Now, you listen to me! This is a festival. I will not have you wear such a sad look upon your face.
Ugh, fine! On this occasion, you may call me whatever you like, whether "mother" or "mama." Hmph...
**Rhea:** Thank you so very much! Fortunately, today is the Day of Devotion, a day to express gratitude...
I would like to express my gratitude to you, Mother. I have never been able to do so. Until now.
**Sothis:** *sigh* I do not remember doing anything, but it appears pointless for me to even say as much.
**Rhea:** Before that... I am wondering if you could please entertain one request from me.
**Sothis:** Well then, do not hold back now that so much has been spoken. Tell me.
**Rhea:** I want you to call me by my name. Just like back then. Call me... "Immaculate One."

edelgard7.name: Edelgard
edelgard7.title: Adorned Eagle
edelgard7.description: Princess and heir apparent of the Adrestian Empire. She exhibits exquisite grace as she embarks on a path of domination, even at the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Yes, I am enjoying myself. Thank you for extending the invitation.

During wartime, we can create space for the people's enjoyment. It takes only the resources of a likely victor.
It may not need saying, but trapped rats cannot challenge a looming eagle.
Hold a moment. Is something stuck to my head? Ah, a messenger owl's feather. Might this be a gift?
I am grateful to all who support me. Demonstrating that gratitude in a concrete form is an idea with merit.
The local varieties are pleasant, but I prefer the Hresvelg brand. If you invite me to tea, remember that.
Visit: I was trailing a friend of yours and became lost. But that is fine. Have you seen [F]
Level: Love is sometimes unrequited. But one can forge a path to the future even so—with a clear head and heart.
The Day of Devotion demands certain responsibilities, and I will fulfill them.
My efforts were not enough.
Summon: I am Edelgard, she who will conquer all of Fódlan. I see that, for now, this festival will be my domain.
Learn Skill: You are unexpectedly attentive, aren't you?
Confession:
*sigh* Oh, me? Do not worry yourself. I am merely a little tired. Surely you could use a rest as well.
Did I meet everyone's expectations? This is an Askran festival, after all. Well, [S]?
In truth, I am not one for these sorts of festivities, but you have been a helpful guide.
Were I not in line for the throne of the Adrestian Empire, I could relax. It is a demanding role.
In fact, I haven't spent a moment on something like this in quite some time.
Stoic, aren't you? No, I do not mind that at all.
In fact, in that way, you remind me of the professor. I hope that you and I will share as pleasant a relationship.
Status: Aha.
Is putting on a festival really the best way to express appreciation?
What? Is that supposed to be a joke?
I would much rather build camaraderie at a festival than a worship service.
What kind of flowers do I like? Well, I've always been fond of carnations.
To govern properly, a monarch must respect not only their crown, but those around them.
I wonder where the professor ran off to. Of course I cannot find the one person I appreciate most...
Please, accept these carnations as a token of my gratitude. Of all the flowers in Fódlan, they were always my favorite.

dimitri7.name: Dimitri
dimitri7.title: Stargazing Lion
dimitri7.description: Crown prince of the Holy Kingdom of Faerghus. Enjoying the enthusiasm of the festival, he lets loose and throws aside his inhibitions. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: The more precious something is, the easier it is to break. Do you suppose the heart works the same way?
My home is a cold, relentless place. But Askr, with its trees and the scent of flowers... I admit I'm a bit envious.
I thought these whetstones I found might make for good gifts. What do you think, [S]?
I would normally dedicate this time to maintaining my armor. But I suppose I can make an exception for today.
I wonder if Edelgard and Claude feel clumsy at this too. No...I imagine they both do well at these kind of things.
Visit: It seems I'm not the only one giving gifts today. This one is for you. A gift from [F].
Level: This feeling is new to me, yet... It is a feeling that will never go away, even after the festival is over...
I wasn't sure you would like your gift, but I'm so grateful that you do.
I know relaxation can be good for a team, but I'm still not used to it. I suppose it's something to work on...
Summon: I, Dimitri Alexandre Blaiddyd, hereby swear to do all I can to make this festival a success!
Learn Skill: Are you enjoying yourself, [S]?
Confession:
So this is the Day of Devotion... The people of Askr have love in their hearts, at their core... How?
War rages in this world, but still, here they are, celebrating sincerity, spreading hope for the future.
Meanwhile Fódlan is scarred with conflicts. And now, my homeland despairs while here...they rejoice.
I must put an end to that darkness. I must save my people from that hollow despair. I swear I will...
I...I need to walk...clear my head when the festival concludes. Will you join me, [S]?
Status: Ah...
Don't misunderstand. It is a lovely festival, but it's also...a bit embarrassing.
Hey! *scoff* Didn't I tell you to stop that?!
I am so very grateful for both Dedue and the professor.
I thought I was done concerning myself with choosing gifts.
The costumes I must wear for these festivals are so...elaborate! It pains me.
I will admit I am not used to being...appreciated like this.
Thank you for all you've done. You have my gratitude.

claude7.name: Claude
claude7.title: Distant Deer
claude7.description: Heir to House Riegan, leader of the Leicester Alliance. At times he's like a shadow, other times as vibrant as the sun. But he remains elusive as ever at this year's festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Don't go into this without some kind of plan, got it? It's a festival. Just map it out and you'll be fine.
If you think gift-giving is a big deal here, you should see it at Garreg Mach Monastery!
I love hosting festivals and banquets. It feels so good when it all comes together and everyone is having fun.
It's much easier to trust people here than in Faerghus or the Adrestian Empire... Maybe that's unfair to say.
Is that a board-game piece? So that's where I dropped it. Thank you!
Visit: Here, this was left for you. Sorry, but festival preparations are taking up all of [F]'s time.
Level: My dream is your dream! Today, we need to make sure it blooms!
Everything is ready. I should be able to finish giving out gifts just in time for the banquet.
I thought I was ready. I was wrong.
Summon: I'm not really "delegation" material... But if you really want me to head the Day of Devotion, I'll do my best!
Learn Skill: Great thinking! I was just saying how you should never skip a chance to learn something new about yourself.
Confession:
Found you, [S]!
You promised to show me around Askr after the festival. I'm going to hold you to that, so don't forget.
This festival may not be perfect, but it's still very impressive.
You can really get a sense of Askr's culture and traditions. There's so much warmth and love here.
It's had me thinking about how to share my traditions. I think I know.
I'd like to show you my homeland. Not right at this moment, of course.
But please! Take this bouquet as a promise that someday we'll go. Here, [S].
Now we've both made promises.
Status: Heh.
I'm always humble and thankful for those around me. Really!
Whoa! Hey, can't you calm down at least for today?
Flowers are a good gift. A fleeting one, but good.
The world will fall apart if people believe they're surviving through their own strength alone.
If you want to show your gratitude, I'd love to have a party.
I'm not sure this is my style but...here I am with a bouquet of flowers.
You must already be drowning in gratitude but...here's mine too.

hubert2.name: Hubert
hubert2.title: Crimson Schemer
hubert2.description: Loyal to Edelgard and considering himself her counselor, he discerns for her the optimal path to victory, even at the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I merely prepare the scene... I provide, and my lady graciously receives.

I am well aware of how I contrast with this festival's...joyful petals dancing in the sunlight and so on.
I am merely here to serve Her Highness.
My only wish is to see Lady Edelgard fulfill her ambitions. All other matters pale in comparison.
That I am able to fulfill my duties as I am now is your doing, is it not? In that case, you have my gratitude.
"A Treatise on Love and Hate for the Hresvelgs." What a perfect inspiration for waxing poetic about love...
Visit: If this will build a friendship, then the cost is a trifle.
Level: Time well spent. Sad that it passes so quickly...
Ah! So this is why Askr insists on holding this festival.
Well... Let's not pass judgment.
Summon: So it's "the Day of Devotion," is it? It is no use questioning Her Highness's judgment... There is work to be done.
Learn Skill: A most gracious gift. It would be impolite to refuse such generosity.
Confession:
Perhaps it is strange for us to sit for tea like this. And unfortunately the coffee bean is unheard of here...
Oh! My sincerest apologies. You are my guest, and you have graciously offered your time.
I hope I do not come across as brash, but I think quite highly of you. Enough so that I have a proposition...
You have a rare focus, and you seem to understand things in a way that others do not.
You are also immensely creative— a singular talent. Which is why...
I would like to ask you to join me in assisting Lady Edelgard on her path to ascension.
This is the true reason I set up this this meeting—for us to discuss our part in Lady Edelgard's ambitions.
There is no need to answer just now. I only ask that you hear me out...
Status: Ahem-ahem.
Strange... I am not sure why you have invited me to partake in a festival such as this.
I will attend the festival, but I have no desire to engage in frivolous antics.
Appreciation? There are few I find deserving, but I suppose the professor has earned it.
My...devotion to Lady Edelgard spurs only from her capabilities as a leader. Nothing more.
Just what are you snickering at? Is there something humorous about this garb?
If anything, I appreciate fate for bringing me into Lady Edelgard's service.
Uncovering your interests was no small feat, but I believe I have found a good gift for you.

yunaka.name: Yunaka
yunaka.title: Hidden Mask
yunaka.description: A wanderer who travels Elyos. She keeps a tight lid on the details of her past. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Anna seems to like me since I said I could tell a product's authenticity. I wonder what she'll have me do.
Tales from my past? I can't say I remember any! Besides, I'm one of your Heroes now. Is...that enough?
I want to live a just and pure life. But I will eliminate—I mean, I won't forgive anyone who threatens you.
I'll never get sick of this courtyard! All these unusual things— Oh! Look at that person's gleaming sword!
The southern freecat at my feet came with me! Maybe because I was just at the farmyard in the Somniel...
Visit:
I, Yunaka, have a hiya papaya to deliver from [F].
Keep up the good relations, you two!
Level: Zappy! Look how far I've come!
A death sentence for the enemy!
We can laugh this one off, right?
Summon: It's hiya papaya to meet you! Call me Yunaka. Seeing as you've summoned me, I'll be sure to be useful.
Learn Skill: I'm ever so honored to receive this valuable gift! From now on, I'll prove even more useful!
Confession:
That was some mighty fine leadership in today's battle! Did you fight like that in the world you came from?
I bet you were always this powerful— Oh? You never set foot on a battlefield or summoned anyone?
If you obtained all this power here, then people really can change... I, too, want to be a new Yunaka in Askr!
At least...enough to atone for my past sins as an assassin...
Oh, uh... I was just talking to myself. Not to worry! I'll see you in battle! I look forward to lots of hiya papayas!
Status: Zappy!
Have you seen Emblem Micaiah around? Just curious.
Ooo, what kind of weapon is that?! The grip is so distinctive. I've never seen anything like it!
Hiya papaya! I'm here to have a good time.
Truth is, I'm just a wandering nobody. "Hero" is overselling it.
Did you know some of these Heroes are assassins?! I couldn't believe it either!
Any one of these Heroes could be a threat. I can't afford to let my guard down.
Got an impression for you. Wanna hear it? OK, here goes. *ahem* "If there's one thing I'm really good at, it's lighting up the room!"

nel.name: Nel
nel.title: Stoic Dragon
nel.description: A child of the Fell Dragon from another Elyos. She is Rafal's elder sister and very much his counterpart. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: The Fell Dragon's children are always twins. In rare cases, there are defects with two souls born into one body.
In the world I come from, Emblems dwelled in bracelets instead of rings. I had the power to put them to sleep.
You appear tired, Summoner. Might I sing you to sleep with a lullaby? I will not stay to wake you, but...
Rafal shared my life and dragonstone. No matter what anyone says, we are truly two halves of the same whole.
The meals mortals eat seem bland. I often add hot or sour spices, though I get the strangest looks for doing so.
Visit: Please, give my regards to the Divine Dragon and accept this greeting from [F].
Level: If this benefits the Order of Heroes, then I accept it.
This is a mere moment. I will not be the one who decides my worth.
Things do not always go well.
Summon: I am Nel. I cannot believe I am the one being called upon for aid. Where are the Divine Dragon and Rafal?
