Learn Skill: I promise to protect this world with the power bestowed upon me so it does not follow a path to destruction.
Confession:
You were summoning again, I see. Did you find the power you hoped for?
I performed a summoning ceremony once in my grief over the world's destruction and got but one savior.
You can summon so many Heroes. I understand this is because of how great of a threat this world faces.
If that is the case, even if the Order of Heroes' courtyard is full of Heroes, I shall do my best to become a savior.
I will not allow you to witness your world's annihilation or lose those who are precious to you, as I did.
Status: Hmm...
Divine One? Oh...no. Of course, it is only you.
I am a Fell Dragon. Does it not frighten you to get close to me?
The power to put Emblems to sleep... Having crossed to another world yet again, it has still been denied me.
I fought alongside the savior of my world to collect the seven Emblem bracelets.
I will not die again knowing there is someone who waited a thousand years for me the first time.
Wherever Rafal is now, I hope he is not lonely, being apart like this...
The Heroes here ask that you look after yourself, so that you always make it back from the battlefield. That is my wish, as well.
Map Select: Let us be on our way.

rafal.name: Rafal
rafal.title: Atoning Dragon
rafal.description: A child of the Fell Dragon from another Elyos. He is Nel's younger brother and very much her counterpart. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Tell me of the sweets of this world. But omit the mild sweets! I desire what most would say is TOO sweet.
My father cast a spell on me, and I ended up doing...unforgivable things. Those sins are all mine to bear.
I could awaken Emblems in my world. Yet in having traversed worlds twice, I seem to have lost the power.
Allow me to take on your...unsavory missions. I am expendable, unlike my sister, the Divine Dragon, and the rest.
If Divine Dragon Lumera is here, I will be curious to learn what it was like to await a loved one for a millennium...
Visit:
I come with greetings on behalf of [F].
I also come with some of my sweet treats, specially made to suit average palates.
Level: Witness my power!
The expected result. But I can do more.
No... I will not be a failure...
Summon: I am Rafal, and I bring with me the power of the Fell Dragon's lineage. Is it possible...my sister Nel is here?
Learn Skill: You choose to grant me power... Very well. I may return the favor.
Confession:
Summoner, I applaud your deft use of my power. I wish to reward you by speaking about myself and my past.
For a long time, I took the place of one named Nil, who was the true twin of Nel. I looked for Nil here, yet...
Only those who have done great deeds, whether good or evil, will be brought here as a Hero.
Nil's deeds were, sadly, insufficient. Meanwhile, my great deeds were... apocalyptic.
But evil pawns can still do good if wielded well. Thus, thanks to you, I now fight on behalf of the slain.
I believe I shall spend this evening watching the stars. Nil always did like looking at the stars...
If you have no other plans, would you join me, [S]?
Status: Your attempts at altruism remind me of the Divine Dragon...
Do not cling to me! Shall I take on my Fell Dragon form?
The power to awaken Emblems is of no use in Askr.
Only the sweetest of confections can satisfy me.
Nel... My sister is my precious counterpart. She always will be, no matter how many thousands of years pass by.
Neither the seven bracelets nor my father's power are necessary now.
Huh? You'll be taking a nap? And would like me to wake you?! Ugh! How dare you. I am not some blithering rooster!

zelestia.name: Zelestia
zelestia.title: Loving Leader
zelestia.description: Leader of the Four Winds. A scion and last survivor of the Mage Dragons, she is rich in love and affection for her companions. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I think I might be hungry. The last time I ate was... Um... Ugh! I forgot to eat again. Always so much to do!
The Four Winds lost a member. Still, no matter where we are, I believe the four of us will always be together.
It is a bit chilly here, isn't it? You can sit closer if you like. Mage Dragons have a high body temperature.
How moving to see Lumera and Alear talking as they did in my world, back when they both still lived.
My magic may be weak among Mage Dragons, but I won't complain. I will still protect everyone as best I can.
Visit: I took great care to deliver you this warm and thoughtful greeting from your friend [F]!
Level: I want to achieve strength befitting my role as leader of the Four Winds.
Even the smallest changes fill my heart with joy!
Odd. I'm still young for a Mage Dragon. I should be improving faster.
Summon: Did you summon me, Zelestia, leader of the Four Winds? Then, I am happy to make your acquaintance!
Learn Skill: Oh my, thank you. I am touched by this gesture!
Confession:
Welcome home! You must have had a difficult day full of missions, patrols, and summoning.
Oh? Was "welcome home" an unusual way to greet you?
But the Order of Heroes is home. It is a family of sorts, like the Four Winds that I have long been a part of.
We take on different roles within that family—parents, siblings, children— but you are clearly the head of it.
I'd like to be a mother figure, though it is presumptuous to claim that title, or a needy child from time to time.
I shall support you with unconditional love, so keep coming home healthy, all right, [S]?
Status: Yes?
I am Zelestia, leader of the Four Winds. I will fight for the Divine Dragon, even in this world.
Ooh! *giggle* Oh! That tickled. *giggle* Should you surprise me in that way again, I shall return the favor.
Mage Dragons have a high body temperature. Feel free to stand closer if you're cold.
Oh, I forgot to make time for a meal again. I suppose I should make up for it.
I lost someone important to me in my world... Please, do not leave me like that.
Even if we are apart, the Four Winds will always be together. Even Mauvier.
The Order of Heroes is like a family. I can see myself enduring even the most difficult of battles so I may return here.

griss.name: Griss
griss.title: Indulging Pain
griss.description: Second-in-command of the Four Hounds, he is a dangerous villain filled with madness, more fond of pain than anything else. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Ugh, "hello" is so boring! Cut me with blades, crush me with magic! Doesn't that sound like a better introduction?
I will follow you, Lord Sombron! Give me blood! Show me hell! Stab me into your enemy's heart like a dagger!
Perhaps we can strike a kind of deal. I will tear your foes from this world. In return, you'll give me sweet pain!
Hey, do I have more orders yet?! It's torture waiting around without something to bleed!
Huh? This isn't an injury. I've simply bled myself as an offering! To who? Well, you, of course, Summoner.
Visit: I've gone well out of my way to come here. So take this. A greeting from [F].
Level: They're dying too quickly! We haven't even gotten to the fun part!
Ahaha! I can still feel it! The ecstasy of gutting my foes and spilling all their pretty insides!
What? Would you like more blood?! Haha! Then please, allow me to fight more!
Summon: I'm Griss, second-in-command of the Four Hounds. Would you like to hurt me? Or would you prefer I hurt you?
Learn Skill: More death? Haha! Oh, Summoner, you do give some good orders once in a while!
Confession:
Haha! I knew I'd like you. Killing with you, I see just how gloriously cruel you are, [S]!
Oh, no need to be shy. You order us to fight and suffer pain, all while healing us right at the brink of death!
Ha! How your Heroes have managed to cling to their sanity is impressive. Or, perhaps, they've already lost it!
Good thing you have me as the voice of reason. HAHA! Say... How great would it be if this war never ended?
Let them tear at me, but never allow me to die! Do that, and you and I can kill and be killed for eternity! AHAHA!
Status: *laugh*
If you really want to get to me, try a blade. Do you lack the courage to do that?
Oh, the great summoner is here? Shall I offer up my blood?
I'm dying of boredom. Say, is there a Hero you don't like? Why don't we murder them?
You wanna die without suffering? Don't be stupid! Pain that exquisite is worth feeling.
Promise you'll keep sending me into rigorous, gruesome battles... Got it, Summoner?
What am I to do alone in this soft world without Zephia?
You get a kick out of making Heroes battle, eh? As you wish...I'll fight covered in blood and drowning in anguish.

sakura4.name: Sakura
sakura4.title: In Full Bloom
sakura4.description: Princess of Hoshido who is a gentle healer. She offers a hand to any and all in need. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: All that I am is because of my friends and my siblings. I hope to live up to their expectations, as they have mine.
We overcame our conflict with Nohr and brought peace to Hoshido. Now...w-we'll do the same for Askr.
I've been blessed with the support of many... I...have no words to express my appreciation.
D-don't you think an outfit this grand is...wasted on me? I hope I have the character to match it.
I wish to save everyone. I... I know... It's nothing more than an ideal, but... I will not give up.
Visit: I am Sakura of Hoshido. I was entrusted this token of friendship from [F].
Level: Even if the journey is difficult, p-people are capable. You must not give up...
Is-is everyone OK? Tell me if someone is hurt and I will help... N-no matter their status.
Never forget... Positive thoughts. Even if things do not go your way...
Summon: I'm Princess Sakura of Hoshido. I, uh, wish to extend my hand to ALL who are injured.
Learn Skill: Do I really deserve something so valuable? Th-thank you. I will repay you for this. I p-promise.
Confession:
Y-you're keeping an eye out at this hour? That is s-so kind of you. Thank you, [S]...
And I...was just s-studying. I want to learn as much as I can so I can heal people's injuries.
As long as there's war, people will get hurt. And I wish to be the one to heal them.
No matter their status—soldier or commoner—I want to heal all who suffer.
I don't know how long and hard of a journey that will be, but I won't give up.
I wish to get even stronger, learn even more, a-and keep pursuing my ideal world!
Status: Oh!
I'm here to help!
It'll be all right!
A L-Legendary Hero?! Me?! Oh, n-no, that can't... That is... I'm very humbled that you would...
Did you need me for something? Hehe, oh, you just want to praise me for a job well done? Well, OK. Go ahead!
The world I'm from is finally at peace... It's so wonderful.
I want to travel to as many worlds as I can, and help everyone who's been injured by war.
I, um... I... Uh... I r-really enjoy being with you! From...from the b-bottom of my heart!

plumeria4.name: Plumeria
plumeria4.title: Spring Dance
plumeria4.description: Plumeria, the dökkálfr, and Olivia, the dancer. Their dance brings color to the spring festival. They appear in Fire Emblem Heroes / Awakening.
plumeria4.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
If unit has not entered combat on the current turn, grants another action to unit, and if Canto has already been triggered, re-enables Canto.
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Olivia:** Since we're dancing in pairs for the festival, I vow to do my best so I don't hold Plumeria back!
**Plumeria:** This is merely a spring dream... I must believe that if I am to tolerate the lascivious looks humans direct at me.
**Plumeria:** Considering how self-conscious she seems, Olivia's dancing is quite bold.
**Plumeria:** Eitr came to the spring festival too. I hope she can find the warmth she seeks in this world...
**Olivia:** Plumeria, look how wonderfully that outfit suits you! Oh... You don't like when people look at you?
Visit: I am Plumeria, the dökkálfr of lewd dreams. You are in an eternal dream of spring, [S].
Level: **Olivia:** I-I'm embarrassed, but as long as Plumeria is with me, I can do this!
**Olivia:** I always try to keep the spring winds at my back when I'm dancing.
**Plumeria:** Humans...how their gazes cling to me. Their attention is so vile, I cannot focus on dancing.
Summon: Olivia, is this where the festival is to take place? Why did I agree to this... demonstrating my dance to humans?
Learn Skill: **Olivia:** Plumeria, we're in perfect sync! Oops! W-well, I thought I'd give saying it a try...
Confession:
**Plumeria:** Olivia, what is it that inspired you to invite me to the spring festival?
**Olivia:** About that... To tell you the truth, from the first time I saw you, I felt...
Well...like I could perform the kind of dance that would make everyone smile if I did it alongside you!
**Plumeria:** I have no desire to entertain those vulgar creatures, so full of lust.
However, pathetic as they are, I can pity them enough to allow them a fleeting spring dream, I suppose.
**Olivia:** Um...yes! Let's make spring memories together that no one will forget! I'm certain I can do that with your help.
Status: Uh...
"Of all the possibilities, why call me here?" "It does look...fun, though, doesn't it?"
Conversation: **Olivia:** And for the grand finale... There! All finished!
**Plumeria:** Yes... And so our spectacle has reached its point of completion. Now disperse. All of you.
**Olivia:** *giggle* The crowd certainly seemed to enjoy our performance.
**Plumeria:** That's all well and good for them... Do you really not mind?
**Olivia:** Hm? Mind what?
**Plumeria:** That they were all leering at us the entire time! It was obscene!
**Olivia:** Well... I know what it's like to get embarrassed when people stare, but...
**Plumeria:** Then you understand! They look straight through your clothes and imagine you without them!
**Olivia:** Even when I get flustered, I still want an audience when I'm performing... so I just try to set my nerves aside.
**Plumeria:** But...you're always shrieking, "Mm, don't look at me! How embarrassing!" So, which is it?
**Olivia:** It's just that...being looked at can be a little overwhelming sometimes, that's all.
**Plumeria:** So, you'd have it both ways, hm? *sigh* Typical mortal way of thinking.
**Olivia:** If you could think that way, maybe you wouldn't feel so uncomfortable around people!
**Plumeria:** Out of the question! That's just what they'd all love, I'm sure...
Not that anything I do turns them away—I call them out as the filth they are, and they clamor for more! Why?!
**Olivia:** Hmm... Who could say! *chuckle*
**Plumeria:** Indeed. As ever, mortals defy all comprehension.

eitr2.name: Eitr
eitr2.title: Spring Sunrise
eitr2.description: Unquestioning servant of the ruler of nothingness, she lacks the confidence to express her own will. Yet, at Askr's spring festival, she comes to know of a new world.

Castle Hall: Such gatherings usually frighten me, but... It's so nice and warm here. It's very calming.
I was in a world where nothingness had spread far and wide. No hope, no future, no spring sunshine... Nothing.
Spring has arrived. I hope my brother is out there somewhere...enjoying the spring wherever he is.
This season is so bright... It's hard to believe such a world exists beyond the nightmares.
I wonder... If I'm dressed as a rabbit, does that mean I can run away faster if I get scared?
Visit: Is...someone there? I was told this spring-festival invitation is for you. It's from [F].
Level: My heart... It feels so warm. I believe I may come to enjoy the spring.
I cannot just yearn... I must extend my hand and take the strength that the spring dream has for me.
I'm sorry if I ruined the festival...
Summon: I am Eitr... Is it r-really OK if I join you in the spring festival?
Learn Skill: A gift...to celebrate spring? I will take good care of it. Thank you.
Confession:
[S]...
Thank you so much for inviting me to such a wonderful festival. Truly.
In my world there were no festivals. There was only cold and dark and a vast, endless nothingness...
But even in that empty world, I had faint memories of my brother. They were my one and only hope.
The spring air reminds me of him... Kind and warm...and soothing.
I want to stay in the spring sun just a little while longer...if that is OK.
Thank you so much. I won't forget this... The first festival where I could spend time in the sun...with everyone.
Status: Uh-huh.
Why would someone want me at a spring festival?
Ah! Stop it! Please! Don't pick on me...
Bunnies are cute. And everyone likes them. I wish I...
I-if I get embarrassed, I'll just hide behind the ears.
Spring changes so much. But I'm always the same. I do like the flowers though...
Oh Freyr. I miss you so much...
I feel so hopeless... Would it be all right if held your hand?

mae2.name: Mae
mae2.title: Spring Cheer
mae2.description: A mage who is well liked for her positivity and energy. She is Celica's close friend and strives to bring Askr's spring festival to life. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: While I'm here, I might as well use magic to bring this spring festival to life instead of using it to hurt people.
Novis is so pretty in springtime! The flowers all bloom at the same time, and the ocean shines brilliantly.
Ooh, spring is so exciting! It makes me feel all...hippety-hoppy.
Even though spring comes every year, it's never the same. Each time, it feels fresh and brings a new cheer!
Such a cute outfit! I wonder what Celica and Boey would say about it.
Visit: Hello there! I have a spring delivery for you from [F].
Level: It's not every day you have a spring festival. Let's hop around and enjoy it together!
Festivals are no time for sadness. They're a time to laugh in the warm sunlight... Come on!
Oh, uh...did I get too carried away? I might hear from Celica about this...
Summon: I'm Mae! I hear you're having a spring festival. I'll do my very best to make it lively and fun. Let's hop to it, 'K?
Learn Skill: For me, really?! Oh, yay! See, good things are bound to happen in the spring!
Confession:
Ahh... This is so much fun! I hope you're enjoying the spring festival too, [S].
No more cold, wintry days. Flowers are blooming, everyone is smiling... It's the best, don't you think?
I understand now why you want to protect the people of Askr, keep them smiling all day, every day.
And that's why I'm here—to lend you my strength so everyone is free to keep enjoying festivals like this.
And we want to keep having these festivals every year, of course. So, while I'm here...
We should enjoy the festival as long as it lasts. Come on! Hippety-hop! Spring is here!
Status: Whoa!
Aw, thanks for the invite. And such a cute outfit!
Whoa! *sigh* You startled me.
Ahh, spring... I can't help but be excited about this season.
Celica told me to have fun at the festival. So *giggle* that's what I'll do.
Novis is so pretty in springtime! Amazingly so!
I wonder what Boey would say if he saw me in this outfit... *laugh* That'd be silly!
Ugh, it's so warm out! Ha... Great outdoors, here we come!

veyle3.name: Veyle
veyle3.title: Spring Tranquility
veyle3.description: A dragon with a heart as warm as springtime. Her friends picked out her outfit for the festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: How strange. I dislike bright places, but I long for spring sunlight more than the dim illumination of candles.
I've always watched from afar. I never thought I would get to enjoy a festival for myself. I'm so excited!

Did the spring warmth cause you to oversleep? Sleeping for a long time is scary, isn't it?
But don't worry, I'll stay by you, even if you sleep for one hundred years.
I'm not good at drawing or painting... Hmm. Could I just dye my egg a color I like instead of drawing on it?
If I was born a rabbit, I wouldn't have experienced so many hard things, but I also wouldn't have met all of you.
Visit:
Did the rabbit ears surprise you? We are having a spring festival where I just came from!
Here! This festive greeting is for you, from [F].
Level: Wh-what do I do? I'm so happy, my ears are bouncing.
When you're at a festival, things that normally brighten your day a bit can have an even greater impact, huh?
Sorry. I know it's a festival and all... I'll be more careful!
Summon: I'm Veyle. I'm a dragon. I hear there's going to be a spring festival. Can I be of use in some way?
Learn Skill: Thank you. The festival is going to be even more fun now!.
Confession:
Hello, [S]. Thank you for being there for me. I can't help but await your return when we're apart.
Why do you keep me with you? Oh, maybe you like bunnies? That's not it? Then, do you enjoy my company?
N-no, forget I said that! I shouldn't be so silly. It's because you have some greater strategy in mind, isn't it?
It doesn't matter. I'm just glad I got to make some memories with you this spring that I can treasure.
When the spring festival comes again, remember your friend with the long bunny ears. Let's talk more soon.
Status: I can't believe I'm really at a festival! It's like a dream... A dream with an adorable outfit!
I probably look strange, a Fell Dragon with rabbit ears... Really? You think they suit me?
I'm seeing lots of people in rabbit outfits. Do you think they'll want to be friends with me?
*yawn* With all this sunshine, I could almost use a nap. But no! I will not sleep through the festival!
Do you need help carrying anything? Your flowers or chocolate eggs, perhaps?
Papa would never, ever go to a festival like this. Well, except to burn everything down.
I hope you won't mind me asking, but... Oh, come on, Veyle! Summoner, would you like to walk around the festival together?

lonqu2.name: Lon'qu
lonqu2.title: Spring Jitters
lonqu2.description: A skilled swordsman of Regna Ferox who is oddly skittish around women. He shows some hesitancy toward Askr's spring festival. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: The spring air is so clear... I wonder if its warmth could heal the scars of my past.
I am a swordsman, yet as hard as it is to believe, even I have a part to play in this festival.
I freeze whenever a woman approaches. This is a festival, and yet... How pathetic.
I cannot rest, nor can I concern myself with spring merriment. I must always train.
What do I think of this outfit? When Basilio gave it to me, I believed he had lost his mind. That is all.
Visit:
Ah! I have a delivery for you from [F].
And please do not ask me about what I'm wearing.
Level:
Spring is here!
I...was told to say that.
I will not hold back, no matter how ridiculous I look.
Are you suggesting I got lost in the... festive atmosphere?
Summon: I am Lon'qu, swordsman of Regna Ferox. Now, explain why I've been called to this festival. Spare no detail.
Learn Skill: I'm beginning to understand why Basilio sent me to this festival...
Confession:
I am grateful you invited me to the spring festival. I have overcome my discomfort around women at last...
That is what you'd like me to say, isn't it? Well, it is not true.
Be honest—why summon me to such an absurd festival?!
I need to train, and I need to fight. I do not have time for this uniquely embarrassing nonsense.
This outfit... The ears are restrictive beyond measure, and the time it took to put it on... Wait.
Is this, too, part of my training? Did Basilio foresee all of this when he involved me?
Status: Hm.
Festive clothes for a festive occasion... But I'm not very festive.
Hm? I understand it's a festival, but don't get carried away.
It's just the season changing. Why is everybody so excited?
I dream of mastering the blade, no matter what other weapons I add to my arsenal.
Don't be careless. The warmth can...make you sleepy.
Asleep? Me? Uh... Don't be a fool.
Do not worry about me. Please enjoy yourself.

alm5.name: Alm
alm5.title: Powerful Resolve
alm5.description: A young boy from Ram Village with the Brand on his left hand. Fights with resolve, determined to keep his oath he swore to Celica as a child. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: We need to move onward if we want to bring an end to this conflict.
People driven mad by Duma's power are repeating the tragedy of the past. Celica and I will end it at the source.
Thanks for your concern, but you needn't worry about me. I have more endurance than most.
What would you think of planting a vegetable garden at the castle? I'm pretty decent at working the fields.

I have faith that there will be a long future for Valentia, even if the gods abandon it.
To ensure that future, we will stop Duma ourselves.
Visit: I am Alm. I have been fighting alongside [F].
Level: I won't falter, even if the path ahead is a hard one. I will reshape Valentia and live in a better future with Celica!
I will grow stronger! I must, for I have something I wish to protect!
I was weak. I'll do better next time.
Summon: I am Alm. I hold the sentiments of my beloved Celica, Sir Mycen, and others I care for close to heart when I fight.
Learn Skill: Thank you. This is much better.
Confession:
Forced to make a choice between the world's future and Celica's, I believe I would choose Celica's.
That is what I fight for. It may come across as selfish, but I believe personal motivations are important.
Everyone fights to change the world for themselves and the people they care about. This is true in all worlds.
The passions of individuals bring them together to influence the world. I feel that this is how it should be.
Celica and I often talked as children about how we wished people could get along. That was all we wanted.
If our world continues to exist, I hope people can choose their paths and correct their own course as needed.
I wish to build that with Celica. We will till this land after the gods depart and work for a prosperous future.
Status: This attire, so similar to Celica's... I am glad to wear it.
Yes, Celica? Oh, it's you. Apologies for my confusion.
When we were little, Celica and I were together for a time in Ram Village.
I always felt as if someone was calling out to me. I'm sure it was her.
Gray and Tobin aren't here, are they? If they saw me, I'd never hear the end of it.
You are already part of me, Celica.
Do you think our meeting was fate? *chuckle* Or perhaps that's an exaggeration.

nuibaba.name: Nuibaba
nuibaba.title: Mistress of Fear
nuibaba.description: An arcanist who serves the Duma Faithful. Trades souls in exchange for a dark spell that brings death. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: I'll not let the likes of Jedah claim a bearer of the Brand. Such a soul could grant me life eternal!
That's right. All will be mine soon enough. Eeeeee hee hee hee!
I would like for us to talk more. You aren't trying to avoid me, are you?
Jedah even offered Lord Duma his own daughters to empower himself. Yes, it's true—Marla and Hestia both.
This land is filled with vigorous and spirited people. Plenty of offerings to choose from to please Lord Duma.
Visit: I am Nuibaba. I hear you are good friends with [F].
Level: Come to me. The real feast is yet to begin...when I dine upon your souls!
Eeeeee hee hee hee! The specter of love ever draws fools such as you like butterflies to nectar.
It cannot be... I won't be...
Summon: I am Nuibaba. Jedah placed me in charge of Fear Mountain. It pleases me to have been summoned by you.
Learn Skill: Excellent. To express my gratitude, I shall bestow Lord Duma's power upon you. Come to my abode...
Confession:
Father Duma's power is vast, and not to be looked down upon. I imagine you have seen enough to know that.
And it is your wish to use this power? Duma will make that wish a reality, and I will also give you my aid.
To that end, allow me to give you this mirror filled with my sorcery.
Of course, I believe you when you say you have no need for such... tricks, [S].
But one day you may find yourself cornered and without recourse.
If that day comes, shatter the mirror. It shall answer your call. May it turn the tides in your favor... Hee hee...
Status: Yes.
I am Nuibaba. Jedah placed me in charge of Fear Mountain.
My... I would advise against that. You never know when I might lose control of my sorcery.
The specter of love seduces all to ruin... Fools, each and every one.
The power of the child of fate's soul could grant me life eternal! *laugh*
Berkut and his bungling... Ugh... A useless prince.
All will be mine soon enough...
If you would taste of Duma's power, I will conduct the ceremony myself.

jesse.name: Jesse
jesse.title: Blithe Mercenary
jesse.description: A wandering, fun-loving mercenary who refuses to turn a blind eye to any woman in need. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Grieth's payroll's a veritable who's who of Zofia's nastiest thugs.
They say Zofia's Deliverance chased off Desaix and the Rigelian army. That's actually pretty impressive.

Deen and Sonya are two of Grieth's best, but it's not loyalty that keeps 'em there.
I don't know the specifics, but it's clear they've their own ambitions.
The world's full of beauty. Only a fool doesn't enjoy it. Take women— the gods' most perfect creation.
The ladies in this army are fierce as hell AND gorgeous. I love it! All this motivation has me stir-crazy.
Visit: I'm Jesse, a wandering mercenary. Oh, and by the way, I'm currently working for [F].
Level:
Ruling the world with might and terror? Talk about your stale clichés.
What's the point in living if you're not having fun? I'm not about to find out.
So? Whaddaya think? This is what ya get from a merc who's been through his fair share of trouble.
Turns out it's a terrible idea to go off on my own tryin' to look cool...
Summon: I'm Jesse. Just another mercenary of the unwashed-rogue variety. What's your story? Care if I join you?
Learn Skill: Ah, now this is nice! Hope you think so too, [S].
Confession:
Just thought I'd say hey, see what your deal is... Say, doesn't your face get tired from scowling all the time?
I mean, it must be rough bearing the weight of another person's life... I fled from that kind of responsibility.
I took off to find a place where I can live how I want, free from Zofia and Rigel.
No nobles! No commoners! Just a place for folks like us. Don't you think that's a good idea?
Whaddaya say? Wanna join me? We'll take you in, even if you're a wandering drifter.
I mean, it'll be a land of free people, after all!
Status: Haha!
Name's Jesse, by the way. I'm just your average garden-variety merc.
Whoa, pal. What're you doin' there?
The Deliverance chased off Desaix, didn't they? *laugh* That's pretty impressive.
Gotta keep my eyes peeled. Ya never know when someone cute'll appear. Really, I'm serious as a stab wound.
It's been forever since I've seen my family. Might never see 'em again.
I took off to find my own place where I can live how I want.
You're pretty fun, ya know? I got a feeling good things'll happen if I stick with you.

nomah.name: Nomah
nomah.title: Priest of Mila
nomah.description: The high priest of the Mila Faithful, a group influential in southern Valentia. Oversees the priory on Novis Island, and raises Celica as his own. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Follow the path before you. Trust in it as I in you.
Zofia faces her darkest hour in some time. Sick and hungry come to the priory's door each day seeking aid...
I traveled to Rigel, long ago. That was when I first met Mycen. Ha! We were both so young back then...
What do you think of taking over the orphanage after me? I will welcome you anytime to Novis Island.
Now is the time to create a world of hope and possibility for the next generation. Don't you agree?
Visit: I seem to have found myself a little lost... Which way will take me to [S]'s castle?
Level: Life has taught me the limits of brute force. This was only possible because we have Mila's blessing.
I'm not so bad myself, am I? I won't lose to you little whippersnappers just yet.

Bah! Stop treating me like a frail old man with one foot in the grave!
Though I admit all this fighting DOES take a toll on my poor back.
Summon: I am Nomah. If this is a meeting of Mila's providence, then I shall follow wherever your heart leads me.
Learn Skill: Lithe as a willow branch, thanks to you. I won't forget this.
Confession:
I have no family of my own. I have dedicated my life to the teachings of Mila.
But I've had the chance to watch over Celica, Mae, Boey, and Genny... All such fine, noble-hearted youths.
They have given me so much joy. And I pray they'll each live out their lives unfettered and free... Though...
I did worry about Celica when she left the island, so I left too, for the first time in a long while, only to get lost.
Hm... And now, it is my back that is giving me trouble of late.
Bah! But don't treat me like a frail old man with one foot in the grave!
There is so much more I can do with you by my side. Yes... It is wonderful to be here, [S].
Status: Ah...
I'm Nomah, a sage from Novis. I'll be ready when you need me.
Ow! Hey! Ow! What ever happened to "respecting your elders"?
Zofia faces her darkest hour in some time. All I can do is put my faith in Celica.
I may be an old man, but I'm not done yet.
Mycen and I are old friends. And I know a few things about him he'd hate for me to tell you.
Celica, Boey, Mae, and Genny... Ah! The little ones have given me so much joy and a sense of purpose.
As long as you're fighting for a better tomorrow, I'll be at your side.

jedah.name: Jedah
jedah.title: Priest of Duma
jedah.description: The high priest of the Duma Faithful, a group influential in northern Valentia. Has received the protection of the god Duma and boasts arcane power beyond that of normal humans. Appears in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.

Castle Hall: Ah... So that is Alm?
I shall return all to the gods' control. It is the dawn of an age of fear and chaos, cradled in Duma's shadow!
Alm... Rudolf's worthless spawn... You're both disgusting heretics. How dare you wish harm on Duma!

Mila's kindness and mercy weakened the hearts and bodies of mankind, transforming them.
They became monsters bent on only satisfying their own desires. Can you claim that such a world is just?
I'm afraid what you ask is beyond my ability. Mila has sealed Falchion. We mortals have no say in the matter.
Visit: I am Jedah, servant of Lord Duma. Will you offer up your soul along with [F]?
Level: Now is the time. Offer your soul to Lord Duma as an offering for the second coming of the age of gods!
The hour is come for the world of man to return to the gods' control!

If you are displeased, I suggest you point your ire at Mila.
Lay blame upon the merciless goddess who forsook her Zofian children!
Summon: My name is Jedah. Offer your soul to the great Lord Duma. Obey him and kneel before his might!
Learn Skill: None know my true intentions. It may be that even I have lost sight of them.
Confession:
Lord Duma...is ill. Countless years of mortal idiocy have driven even the hearts of gods to madness.
We have reached a limit collecting feeble souls and shaping them into divine life.
It seems as though we need a soul that bears the fate of a Brand...
Without the gods' strength at its foundation, Valentia cannot sustain life, unlike a prosperous continent.
Do you see? I am both Lord Duma's faithful servant and he who shall be the world's savior!
Presumptuous human children let my mercy go to their heads. They throw tantrums without my approval.
You understand the proper way of things, do you not? Will you walk with me, [S]?
Status: I am Jedah, first disciple to the great and glorious Duma.
You seek audience with me of your own volition? Do you desire to sacrifice your soul to Duma?
Anthiese's soul is rare and precious—I must have it.
Rudolf and his worthless spawn are disgusting heretics. How dare they wish harm on Duma!
The Duma Faithful shall deliver Valentia from its depravity and ruin. When that day comes, I expect your thanks.
Sonya? Hm... I used to have a daughter by that name...
I will work alongside you, but only to assess whether you could be of use to Duma.

eirika9.name: Eirika
eirika9.title: Of the Sacred
eirika9.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to Elyos. Resides in the Ring of the Azure Twins. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones / Fire Emblem Engage.
eirika9.emblem:
Enhanced Engaged Special
When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's max Special cooldown count value × 4 (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If it is unit's first combat initiated by unit or first combat initiated by foe that turn, inflicts Atk-4 on unit and unit attacks twice during combat (triggers only when unit's Range = 1; does not trigger when equipped with an area-of-effect Special).

Castle Hall: To see another me dressed like that... Oh! My clothes are no different...

I was in Lythos Castle for a long time in Elyos... That is, until enemy forces took me.
I did not reunite with the Divine Dragon's army until the very end.
My father's repute as the Warrior King is a distant goal of mine, even as an Emblem...
As I can now enjoy food, I'd like to share an Elyosian meal with everyone. First, I'll need to learn how to cook it.
My brother, Ephraim, and I are one Emblem, existing only at our power's peak. I'll forward any orders for him.
Visit: Everyone here trains together too? You inspire us to improve, just as [F] does.
Level: My brother, who is by my side, asks you to count on us.
It is a kindness to slay a foe in an instant.
Of course, an Emblem does not stop in their tracks when this happens.
Summon: I am Eirika, the Emblem. I shall wield this blade with the hope that the world will be free of conflict.
Learn Skill: No matter if I am the strongest or not, if I have you with me, my heart will be filled with kindness.
Confession:
It is great to see you have returned alive again. Tell me, do you have any injuries, [S]?
Since I became an Emblem, my distaste for battle has not changed.
Perhaps my brother emerges during battle to encourage me so that my blade is not dulled by weakness.
But I am determined and prepared to fight for peaceful times.
You shall be the next to receive the power of the bonds I formed fighting alongside the Divine Dragon in Elyos.
May your heart remain ever pure like the clear blue sky... I shall take your hand and support you always.
Status: *giggle*
May peaceful times come so that no blade need be brandished.
What? Is something off about my outfit? Or is it the radiance that has piqued your curiosity?
I am grateful to have been rescued by Rosado and Goldmary during the battles in Elyos.
My twin brother Ephraim and I are one Emblem. Though I cannot see him now...
"Restore calm, Emblem of the Sacred" is the incantation used to summon me and my brother.
Tana, Seth, Lyon... There are so many familiar faces. I can't wait to visit with them all again.
Being the strongest of the Eirikas here is not my desire. With a heart full of kindness, I will carry out the duties only I can—as an Emblem.

mcorrin8.name: Corrin
mcorrin8.title: Young Kinship
mcorrin8.description: Young Heroes blessed with the power of the First Dragons. By order of the king of Nohr, they live apart from their siblings at a fortress in the north. They appear in Fire Emblem Fates.
mcorrin8.duo:
Grants the following status to unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit for 1 turn: increases Spd difference necessary for foe to make a follow-up attack by 10 during combat.
Applies【Divine Vein (Water)】to unit's space and spaces within 3 spaces of unit for 2 turns.
【Divine Vein (Water)】
Applies the following effects on space: Acts as difficult terrain for foes with Range = 2 (moving over this space costs +1 movement; does not apply to "cannot be slowed by terrain" effects; movement cost cannot exceed unit's allowed movement). Inflicts Spd-5 on foe and reduces the percentage of non-Special "reduce damage by X%" skills by 50% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials). (Divine Vein effects do not stack; replaces any existing Divine Vein effect; Divine Vein effects applied simultaneously cancel each other out. Does not count as defensive terrain.)

Castle Hall: **Corrin:** If I wasn't born in Nohr, then I was born in... I don't remember...
**Corrin:** We are from a dark castle, but we're never lonely. Our brothers and sisters come to visit us...
**Corrin:** The nights can get lonely... But that doesn't last long with all my siblings and Gunter to keep me company.
**Corrin:** Askr is a mysterious place. Meeting another me... It's like I'm a character in a storybook.
**Corrin:** Being with Xander, Camilla, Leo, and Elise is the most fun of all.
Visit: We are Corrin and Corrin, two of the same kind. We brought a delivery from [F].
Level: **Corrin:** I'm no good at fighting. But if it's to protect my siblings, then I'll do all I can!
**Corrin:** Why can't everyone just get along?
**Corrin:** It's OK. We'll do better next time.
Summon: I'm Corrin, from Nohr. And this is Corrin too. We're...the same. Strange, huh?
Learn Skill: **Corrin:** Th-this is for us? Thank you for being so nice to us.
Confession:
**Corrin:** Askr is a wonderful place, isn't it? We're even allowed to roam freely here, outside of the castle...
**Corrin:** Yes, but we'll have to return to Nohr once Askr is at peace.
**Corrin:** I know... That is a bit unfortunate, isn't it?
In Askr, we can see our siblings and all sorts of other people any time we want...
**Corrin:** If we can make Nohr like Askr, then it would be wonderful too. If we do our best, I think it's possible.
**Corrin:** You're right! If we work together with our siblings, I know we can do it... Let's do our best!
Status: Whoa...
"We're...the same? Strange." "I know, but...I'm glad we met."
Conversation: **Corrin:** OK, so, you're me and I'm...you? It's like a dream.
**Corrin:** Or like...we're looking in a mirror.
**Corrin:** This must be what it's like to have a twin.
**Corrin:** Like Flora and Felicia!
**Corrin:** There must be many of us that exist in other worlds. Some male, some female...
**Corrin:** Maybe some of us were allowed to roam freely, outside of the castle...
**Corrin:** Oh, I hope so. I mean, I am certain some were.
**Corrin:** Aw, that sounds wonderful... Tell me, were you also kept in the castle at all times?
**Corrin:** Yes... But it makes being in Askr all the more special!
**Corrin:** You're right! And the castle here is so big, and the meadow just goes on and on... *sigh* It's like a fairy tale.
**Corrin:** Yes, and the people here are all so different, with so many interesting stories to tell.
**Corrin:** There's so much I want to do. Like shop in the town, visit the Kingdom of Ice...and the Kingdom of Flame too!
**Corrin:** I'm not sure how much time we have here... I don't wish to leave Askr a-anytime soon...
**Corrin:** Same. I wish I could stay, except...
**Corrin:** *chuckle* I know... I miss home too...
**Corrin:** We should do all we can while we're here.
**Corrin:** You're right! We should fill our time with making memories we can bring to everyone back home.

camilla10.name: Camilla
camilla10.title: Young Beauty
camilla10.description: First princess of Nohr. She cares deeply for her siblings and unleashes a relentless wrath on any who threaten harm to them. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I will do anything to protect my siblings... Crush anything!
My sweet Corrin should be able to play with me, not be locked away in a castle all the time.
I've circled the places I want to take Corrin on this map of Nohr. And I'll keep circling more and more...
I'm not afraid to play in dangerous places. I mean, I do ride a wyvern.
Corrin likes resting on my lap and sleeps so peacefully after a nice hair brushing. Haha.
Visit: I'm Camilla, eldest princess of the kingdom of Nohr. It seems you're well liked by [F].
Level: My age doesn't matter one bit! I'll do anything to protect my sweet, sweet Corrin...
Haha. You lost only because you underestimated me, thinking I was only a child.
I just need more experience... Then I'll be able to get stronger.
Summon: I'm Camilla, first princess of Nohr. Where is— I want to see my Corrin's face. I must...
Learn Skill: Haha... I'll be able to protect Corrin with power like this.
Confession:
The reason I want to grow stronger is because I cannot stand to see my siblings sad.
Xander, Leo, Elise, Corrin... Their smiles are my treasures.
Our bonds are unwavering, even if we only share half of our blood...
If you turn out to be their enemy, I will not hesitate to unleash my wrath upon you, [S].
I will make an enemy of the entire world if it means protecting them.
So, I'm going to get stronger. Much, much stronger. I'll gain experience here. And I'll protect them to the end.
Status: Haha.
I'm Camilla, first princess of Nohr.
*gasp* Hey! Keep your distance! I am a princess, you know.
Though we all have different mothers, my siblings and I are so very close.
I would gladly die for my sweet, sweet Corrin... Without a doubt.
I do wonder if the girl who was taken from the castle is faring well.
I must be cruel to my enemies. That's what Father wants.
You are too kind. *giggle* May I stay here in Askr a while longer?

leo6.name: Leo
leo6.title: Dark Sprout
leo6.description: Youngest prince of Nohr. Exceptionally talented, he is capable of just about anything, particularly magic. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: There's no value in keeping around those who do bad things. Leave it to me. I will dispose of them for you.
My father used to be kind...long ago. He would rub my head, let me ride on his shoulders...
I am studying magic. I have no interest in focusing on the sword or spear. I'm not like Xander, you know.
If you turn against my siblings, I'll flatten you with a new spell I just learned.
Xander is reliable, Camilla is kind, Elise is cheerful, and... Mm-hmph! All my siblings are precious to me.
Visit: I am Leo, prince of Nohr. You have delicious tomatoes here? I heard so from [F].
Level: Too easy! Hahaha.
Thought you could win because I'm a child?! Fool!
Ugh! Everyone will be disappointed in me.
Summon: I am Leo, prince of the Kingdom of Nohr. I'll say this once—I don't trust anyone except my siblings.
Learn Skill: I'll accept this, as long as you're choosing to give it to me... Thank you.
Confession:
When I was younger, my father's mistresses were always fighting, trying to win his favor.
And I think my mother was using me to improve her status with him. I never liked her because of that...
She never once spared me a single moment's attention. And then... she died.
Because of all the fighting, I could never really have any real conversations with my siblings.
But now, those of us that remain have finally grown close... I am truly happy.
I hope we'll be able to stay close from now on, forever. It's up to me to do all I can to ensure that happens.
Status: Hmph.
I am Leo, second prince of Nohr. And I expect you to treat me as such.
Ugh! Stop being so childish.
My older siblings are so strong...
My collar is inside out? Ahem. I know that.
Think we'll have tomatoes with dinner?
Someday I'll be taken seriously. Someday...
You look kinda weak. So I'm going to be strong for you!

elise5.name: Elise
elise5.title: Sparkling Smile
elise5.description: Youngest princess of Nohr. She is a kindhearted person, always smiling, who is very considerate of her siblings. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I wanna be with my siblings all the time. Smiling, playing, laughing...
I made a friend the other day when I snuck out of the castle. I wish I could see them again...
Xander is so strong, and noble, and-and...amazing!
My big brother Leo knows everything! If you can't figure something out, ask him and he'll know!
Camilla is pretty, huh? I wanna be just like her when I grow up!
Visit: I'm Elise. I'm from Nohr. I snuck here from [F]'s castle!
Level: I'm going to do my very best. I'll be the strongest, most unstoppable princess ever!
Wanna read a book and learn with me?
I'm tired! I wanna play hide-and-seek...
Summon: I'm Elise from Nohr. Are all my siblings here too?
Learn Skill: Is this for me? Yay! This makes me so happy!
Confession:
Am I getting in everyone's way, [S]?
I'm still little, so I can't do much, but... I wanna do my best so I can be the greatest little sister ever!
I'll do anything—read tough books, train till my muscles are sore and tired...
I want everyone to think, "I'm glad Elise is my little sister!" Then I'd be happy!
So, teach me all sorts of stuff, OK? 'Cause I'm gonna grow lots and lots. You'll see!
Status: *giggle*
Let's gooo!
I'm. Playing!
My name's Elise. And I'm a princess of Nohr!
My family's really big. I got a big brother, I got a big sister, and, uh...umm...
I'm practicing with my staff. Wanna see? Taaake this!
I wanna be just like Camilla when I grow up!
Hey! Hey! You wanna play hide-and-seek?

xander6.name: Xander
xander6.title: Focused Firstborn
xander6.description: First prince of Nohr. He works diligently every day to protect his siblings. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: We may not have the same mother, but our sibling bonds are still very strong. They cannot be broken.
I am mediocre at military studies and academic pursuits in general. That is why I must work harder than most.
I was relieved Leo chose to study magic. Things might have gotten awkward had he chosen the sword.
Camilla, Leo, Elise, and Corrin... All of us should bear the responsibility for our homeland of Nohr together.
I get nervous when I stand before my father. I must work even harder so he does not lose faith in me...
Visit: I am Xander, the first prince of Nohr. Please read this handwritten letter from [F].
Level: One cannot win with talent alone. You must be willing to put in hard work to get results.
If I were to disgrace myself, as the eldest brother, I would be unable to face my siblings.
One could lose a battle they might have easily won if they are less driven than their opponent.
Summon: I am Xander, eldest prince of Nohr. I shall apply my strength to meet the expectations of my family here too.
Learn Skill: I shall use this power to overcome future conflicts.
Confession:
I was born the eldest brother in my family, but I had no single trait to help me stand out in a positive way.
As a result, I always felt pressured by the talent of my younger siblings.
I worked hard daily to be competent enough not to be an embarrassment as the eldest brother. And now...
I train to overcome countless trials and be a knight who can carry the weight of Nohr on his shoulders.
I want to be the kind of older brother my siblings can feel proud of.
I shall strive to do noteworthy work here in Askr as well so that I can live up to those expectations.
Status: Mm-hmm.
I am the crown prince of Nohr. I cannot tolerate insolence.
Huh? I thought I said insolence could not be tolerated.
I must always be an example for my siblings. I can never show cowardice.
Corrin is such a strange child—always at the center of attention.
I shall study whatever I must to grow the kingdom of Nohr.
How Father dealt with Corrin... No! I must put it out of my mind.
I've come to believe I can put my trust in you.

ytiki7.name: Tiki
ytiki7.title: Dragon's Progeny
ytiki7.description: The last child born of the Divine Dragons. Bears the fate of living for thousands of years as a manakete. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: People sometimes make scary faces at me...
Did you know about my power? They say it's so strong, it can obliterate the whole world. What's obliterate mean?
My mother said not to fight with humans. But I'd never pick a fight with anyone!
Sitting still is so boring... I want to go play outside!
This stone is pretty, isn't it? They said it's my color!
Visit:
You're...[S]!
I'm gonna remember your name! And [F]'s name too!
Level: Have I been good? Can I play outside now?
Stay back! I-I'm not allowed to fight with people!
Everyone's so scary! I want to go home...
Summon: I'm Tiki! Can I go play now? Oh... I can't?
Learn Skill: Thank you! This makes me happy!
Confession:
Hehehe... I'm so happy! So, so happy! Are you happy being here too, [S]?
This place makes me so happy! There are so many other kids my age! One, two... I can't even count them all.
Can I stay and play in the castle? I'll be extra quiet...
Ohhh... Yay! I love you! You're the best! And...thank you!
Status: Hehe...
My name is Tiki!
Heh! Hehe... You're so silly!
When I grow up, I want to be... Errr...
Shhh! I'm hiding...
This is a dragonstone. They're very important, and I shouldn't lose it!
I feel lonely when no one else is around.
Let's play some more! *giggle*
Map Select: I said I can do it!

naga3.name: Naga
naga3.title: Ruler of Dragons
naga3.description: Ruler of the Divine Dragons. She sealed the Earth Dragons, who sought to exterminate humanity, deep underground. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem and Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Exceedingly few Divine Dragons remain. Everyone... Take care of her.
The day of ruin was fast approaching. Some of us, myself included, foresaw its coming.
To lose power as a dragon is to lose one's form. The elder dragons chose the human form for the age to come.
Your name inspires faith...and the memory of a distant past. Or might it be a distant future?

The five sacred orbs of sealing placed in the shield are treasures passed down among the Divine Dragons...
I believe they will guide humanity.
Visit: You should continue on your path. It seems you share the same fate as [F].
Level: An evil heart merely denigrates one's own life. Why do so many not realize this is true?
Wisdom and courage are necessary in order to resist the darkness and follow a path toward light.
The time of dragons is coming to a close...
Summon: I am Naga, last ruler of the dragons on their path to ruin. I will continue to fulfill my responsibilities as such.
Learn Skill: I had thought I would no longer dwell upon my own future, but...
Confession:
The dragons are on a path to ruin, though some refuse to acknowledge it. The age of man is upon us.
If the world possesses a will, it has decided that their time is now and has made it our role to guide them.
The age of the dragons comes to a close... Humanity must face the coming time of flame with courage.
My fear, my regret, is not being there for my daughter. Tiki was born with terrifying power.
She possesses a hidden strength, exceptional even among her kin.
If someone learned of and used it, it would be nigh impossible to stop her. She could destroy the world.
But, if one with a just heart were to appear bearing the shield that binds the Earth Dragons, then...
That power should become a shield for her as well.
I hope humanity does not simply fear the power of the dragons but that they understand it and overcome it.
Let the light we leave empower a brave hero to establish such an age, and remain with her into her future.
Status: Hm-hm.
I am Naga. Ruler of the Divine Dragons.
Hm! These human bodies offer so many surprises...
For dragons to survive, they must abandon their draconic forms and live as humans do.
Dragons and humans must shape this world together.
There are very few of us left...
Tiki... Her power...
My wish is to protect humanity. Your presence only makes that wish grow stronger.

gotoh2.name: Gotoh
gotoh2.title: Apostle of Naga
gotoh2.description: A Divine Dragon in service of Naga's will. He commands magic beyond human comprehension. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall:
Though we dragons presided over all, we were also living organisms.
We could no longer maintain our physical forms as we were. Hence our predicament.
To avoid the extermination of humans and dragons alike, dragons could give up their power and live as humans.
Watching how humans grow beyond the limits of their own capacity is fascinating. They burn so brightly.
This world and your existence are intriguing. Fragments of potential, as the ruler of the Divine Dragons put it.

Five sacred orbs have been passed down among the Divine Dragons since ancient times.
It is said that the domains the orbs represent are stars, light, darkness, the land, and life.
Visit: I am Gotoh. I am pleased to speak of whatever you wish.
Level:
The ruler of the Divine Dragons is the leader of dragonkind, but she extends her thoughtful guidance to the world.
That is why I swore to follow her.

Individually, there is a significant gap in abilities and intellectual capacity between humans and dragons.
It shall be a challenge to determine what I can pass on to them.
Inconvenient... It may take time to get used to this body.
Summon: My name is Gotoh. I serve Naga, the ruler of the Divine Dragons. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Learn Skill: Our forms are ever transient, but I shall treasure this interaction...this heartfelt exchange.
Confession:
The end of the dragons began when new generations stopped being born.
Anger and confusion were rampant, especially among younger dragons, as the world itself appeared to reject us.
I have yet to understand the cause of our fate, but many dragons disobeyed the Divine Dragon elders and leaders.
They grew obsessed with remaining dragons, lost sight of themselves, and became beasts.
When they began attacking humans, the Divine Dragon ruler decided to seal away dragonkind.
She did not wish history to remember the last days of dragons as a tragic war between us and humanity.
She made the choice for those of us who had already become manaketes as well.
My thoughts grow clearer as I speak with you. I would welcome you again, when there is time available to us.
Status: Mm.
My name is Gotoh. I came into this world a Divine Dragon. Now, I have turned my attention to the study of magic.
How did you...? Hmph. Humans are quite surprising creatures, aren't they?
The Divine Dragons once led their kin to unparalleled prosperity. That has changed...
Naga bestows her benevolence upon all who seek it. Even mortals.
What more could I be doing for the humans of this world?
Tiki...what plans does Naga have for you...
You are worthy of shouldering this world's future, Summoner. To that end, I will be at your side.

medeus2.name: Medeus
medeus2.title: Last Earth Dragon
medeus2.description: The only Earth Dragon who decided to follow Naga and become a manakete. He guards the Dragon Altar in Dolhr. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I lament that we proud dragons would crawl across land in such form, but I must accept it as reality.
Not only Earth Dragons, but wyverns, Fire Dragons, Mage Dragons... All lost the ability to reason, turning beastly.

The Earth Dragons, second in power only to the Divine Dragons, despised the idea of becoming pitiful humans.
Most of them chose not to follow the elders' directions and, therefore, parted ways with their kin.
Though we abandoned our forms, we are dragons. We are merely borrowing the human shape.
I am the sole Earth Dragon who chose to live among the humans. And if I am ridiculed as a traitor... So be it.
Visit: Hm... I smell dragons... But of course, my kin is not here. So, I shall be on my way.
Level: Naga's will is to eliminate any and all evil, no matter if this evil exists within the heart of a dragon or a human.
It cannot be helped.
I may no longer have my form, but I will forever have my pride as a dragon.
Summon: I am Medeus, guardian of my Earth Dragon kin who sleep in the land of Dolhr. May they sleep peacefully...
Learn Skill: I acknowledge your spirit, [S].
Confession:
As annihilation drew near, the elders attempted to convince us dragons we must abandon our nature to survive.
Those who chose not to assume human form eventually lost their sanity and became beasts.
Though my kin chose to decay rather than defy their kind, I refuse to call their determination foolish.
In truth, it is impossible for humans to conquer dragons. No... Such a feat is only achievable by other dragons.
But had we chosen such a path, all of humanity would be exterminated, and the dragons would fall to ruin.
The world would turn to ash, and nothing would remain. But we did not wish for that future.
Humans must never forget their good fortune, nor the tears the dragons shed to protect their world.
Status: Oh.
I am Medeus, royalty among Earth Dragons.
Impudent... You would be wise not to toy with me.
I will not sit by while annihilation draws near, even if it means I must defy my kind.
I am merely borrowing the human form. I have no affinity for them.
The power of the dragons fades...and the humans grow ever stronger.
Divine Dragon Naga... You do so much for the humans... Why?
You have potential. For a human.

xane3.name: Xane
xane3.title: Fickle Dragon
xane3.description: A young, dubious Divine Dragon. Took part in the conflict in which Naga sealed away the Earth Dragons. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall:
The history of the dragons is just plain disappointing... In the end, they turned against each other.
Don't you think they coulda used their knowledge for somethin' better?
If I didn't abandon my true nature, I'd lose all reason and turn into a beast. So...I became a manakete instead.
Humans aren't concerned with others. They just think of themselves. I guess there were dragons like that...
I feel like I don't wanna leave you, [S].
Gotoh is sure earnest, doin' exactly what Naga said to, working for the sake of humanity.
Visit: Eh! I found you. Sorry to drop in on you like this. I'll head out soon, 'K?
Level: Gotoh doesn't want any unnecessary violence. He told us to "disperse the sparks of flame that descend on us"!
Looks like I underestimated this appearance. It happens sometimes.
Dragons who've lost their minds are beasts. Same with humans. And there's plenty of those around, huh?
Summon: Me? Um... Seeing as how I'm not a dragon anymore, you can call me Xane.
Learn Skill: Oho! What do you want this dragon to do for you? I think I know...
Confession:
So, how much do you really know about dragonkin? I mean, you know I abandoned my dragon self, right?
But, that doesn't mean I have to like humans, you know. There's no reason I should have to.
Humans are ignorant creatures who talk about us behind our backs.
I just can't believe this is the species now responsible for the age following the dragons.
Naga says we should support them, but... I'm not like Gotoh. I think I'll wait and see how it all pans out.
Status: Ahaha!
Name's Xane, and I'm a Divine Dragon. Sort of.
Wha? Hey! Be careful with that.
The world can do whatever it likes. It's not my problem.
I really oughta play with Tiki. There aren't many of us left, you know.
Naga is our ruler. For what it's worth, I don't think she'll do terribly.
*sigh* What's our purpose? It's a heavy question.
You're pretty interesting. For a human, that is.

marth8.name: Marth
marth8.title: Love and Courage
marth8.description: Marth, prince of Altea, and Caeda, princess of Talys. They developed a deep love for one another on the battlefield during both the War of Shadows and the War of Heroes. They appear in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.
marth8.duo:
Grants another action to ally with the highest HP that is within 2 spaces of unit and has already acted (excluding unit) and grants【Potent Follow】and "neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat" to that ally for 1 turn.
(If multiple allies meet the above conditions, effect will not trigger.)
【Potent Follow】
If decreasing the Spd difference necessary to make a follow-up attack by 25 would allow unit to trigger a follow-up attack (excluding guaranteed or prevented follow-ups), triggers【Potent Follow X%】during combat (if unit cannot perform follow-up and attack twice, X = 80; otherwise, X = 40).
【Potent Follow X%】
Triggers an additional follow-up attack immediately after unit's standard follow-up attack and deals damage = X% of unit's normal attack damage (if unit cannot make a follow-up attack, this effect triggers when the standard follow-up attack would occur; this effect is treated like a follow-up attack, so effects like "reduce damage by X%" still apply, but this effect is not affected by effects that prevent follow-ups or "attacks twice" effects; only highest value applied; does not stack).

Castle Hall: **Marth:** Hardin must not have known about Princess Nyna and General Camus... Or he would have refused the throne.
**Marth:** Archanea, Aurelis, Grust, Gra, Macedon, Altea, and Talys all form the seven kingdoms of Archanea.
**Caeda:** If the gods take someone, I pray they take me, not Prince Marth. His mission is too important.
**Marth:** It's finally over, Caeda. I am sorry for the hardships you had to endure.

**Marth:** Legend says in ancient times, Naga, leader of the Divine Dragons, saved humanity in the war against dragons.
Since then, that legend has become myth, and Naga's name remains that of a guardian deity.
Visit: **Caeda:** You must be the lord of this castle? I do hope you'll continue to care for Marth and [F].
Level: **Caeda:** I will follow you, Marth, no matter what happens, for I swore to always believe in you.
**Marth:** I made it this far because you are with me, Caeda.
**Marth:** We can overcome any hardship, so long as we are together...
Summon: With you by my side, Caeda, I feel a courage bubble up within me. Thank you for your unbridled faith in me.
Learn Skill: **Caeda:** Thank you. Let's do our best, Marth.
Confession:
**Caeda:** Even though Anri, ancestor of Altea's royal family, defeated Medeus with the sacred blade, he was alone...
Since he could not be with the love of his life, Artemis, he never married for the rest of his life.
It's such a sad fate, losing the one you love most... Do you think that fate is decided by the Fire Emblem?
Marth: If I had lost you in battle against Medeus, then I, too, would have lost the love of my life...
I would have lived alone, forever...
Caeda: Oh, Marth...
Marth: But we are here now, and if fate wants to take us, we will overcome it. That is what I believe.
Caeda: As do I, Marth...
Status: Oh.
"I need you." "And I you."
Conversation: **Caeda:** What are you doing, Marth?
**Marth:** Caeda... I was studying the history of Askr.
I understand the basic facts, but I would like to learn more details.
**Caeda:** Of course... Whether you are here or in Talys...
you've always had a passion for learning more about where you live.
**Marth:** That is true. Every country has a long history, so there is a lot to learn from them about how to lead one.
I can learn about how they first developed, and also how they function in the present day.
**Caeda:** That's the Marth I know, always thinking about the country and its people.
I shall study alongside you. It's the least I can do to support you.
**Marth:** Thank you, Caeda. Your support continues to encourage me, but...
**Caeda:** What is it?
**Marth:** I am not only thinking about the country and its people.
I am thinking of you, Caeda.
**Caeda:** Oh, Marth! I am always thinking of you too.
**Marth:** Thank you. It is because of you that I have made it this far.
I feel I can overcome any hardship as long as I have you with me. Let us stay together...forever.
**Caeda:** Of course, Marth. I will follow you wherever you go. Know that you have my full faith.

elm.name: Elm
elm.title: Retainer to Embla
elm.description: Retainer to Embla, god of barriers and broken bonds. Snide and shameless, he lines his words with barbs meant to wound.

Castle Hall: I was supposed to die back then... And yet, I stand here now.
Don't get the wrong idea. There is no way I would ever have lost to that dull little cow!
I once entered Askr's world. It was an open world, completely unlike the world Lady Embla and I existed in.
I thought I had seen the last of your faces... It never occurred to me that I might end up here.
There was a time when Lady Embla and Askr weren't enemies. Now, though... I don't know about now.
Visit: Why must I do this? Fine... Greetings, from [F].
Level: Stand in awe. This is what comes of Lady Embla's power.
I feel such power. It is Lady Embla's... and another's...
Bah! Of course, this is the cow's fault. What else could it be?
Summon: My name is Elm. I am a servant...an ally...of Lady Embla. Could...this be Askr's doing?
Learn Skill: Now I will be even more useful to Lady Embla.
Confession:
Back then, when I fought you and your allies, I lost that fight...
I don't begrudge you that or anything. It was my privilege to die in service to Lady Embla.
Yet now I am here. I don't know why I am, but it couldn't be Askr's or Ash's doing, could it?
Hmph... It feels as though I'm being manipulated by someone, and I don't like it, but...
If Lady Embla is in this world too, then I suppose I should be grateful to whoever is responsible.
Status: My name is Elm. I serve the great Lady Embla.
Huh? Get out of my face.
Ash? Comparing me to that cow is an insult.
Because of you lot and Lord Askr, Lady Embla has retreated and remains in solitude...
I'd sleep easier if the servants of Askr decided to stop existing already.
I will never abandon you, Lady Embla...
I'll help you, but only because I'd rather not listen to you complain.

dedue3.name: Dedue
dedue3.title: Dauntless Beast
dedue3.description: Uses a Crest Stone to transform into a Demonic Beast in battle, repaying his debt to Dimitri, who saved his life. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I would abandon everything, even my life, for His Majesty.
I only live to this day because of His Majesty... I am honored to have walked by his side.
The Crest Stone transforms me into a Demonic Beast. It is too late for me now...
Rrraaahhh... I have no...regrets! Even if this power is forbidden... As long as it is for His Majesty!
It matters not who stands in his way— I will go through them. Even if they are former peers, it does not matter!
Visit: Do you call yourself a friend or a foe of His Majesty, Dimitri? I am certain [F] will aid him.
Level: I must... Even if my body turns to dust!
People like you...can never understand the weight His Majesty has borne.
Urrrggghhh... For His Majesty, I must not fall!
Summon: Even if I lose my own humanity and become a Demonic Beast, I shall pave the path for His Majesty's future.
Learn Skill: With this, I can protect His Majesty!
Confession:
The people of Duscur never forget their grudges. And more so, they never fail to honor favors...
His Majesty risked his own life to save me when I should have died alongside so many of my people.
I'll return the favor by risking my own life for his. I would cast that life aside if it was for his benefit.
The Crest Stone... I can never go back to being human now that I have used it.
I wish for you to be an ally to His Majesty until the very end. Can you do that, [S]?
Urrr... My body...will take the form of a Demonic Beast... I must leave the rest...in your hands...
Status: My name is Dedue. Even through hell, I would follow His Majesty.
I suggest you back away from me now.
If we lose here, the Kingdom falls. It seems I have no choice. I must use the Crest Stone...
I only live because of His Majesty.
You could never understand the burden His Majesty carries on his shoulders!
You are the one true king... Dimitri.
I hope you come to accept His Majesty's ideals. I will go through anyone in his way.

falear4.name: Alear
falear4.title: Red Days Past
falear4.description: One of the Fell Dragon's countless children. At her father's command, she desires the Emblem Rings. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: It seems I left the rings I had in the world I came from. Must I gather them all over again?
Emblems with red auras only follow my commands. If they were able to speak, then...
Do you not have any orders for me? My father would always dispose of pawns he had no use for.
Have you ever encountered the Corrupted? I dislike them. They kill my siblings.
I want to live. Just to see tomorrow, and the day that follows, and...
Visit: I don't have time for foolishness— I must return to my father. Take this. It is from [F].
Level: I am stronger. With this, I may be able to survive whatever lies ahead.
I've done it, Father.
This...makes me a defect.
Summon: My name is...Alear. I was told my father called me that...just once.
Learn Skill: What do you hope to achieve by giving me power?
Confession:
Summoner, I think I understand now how many mighty individuals exist in other worlds.
Observing some among them who resemble me stirred something deep in my heart...
It makes me wish for more than is permissible—to be saved by one adorned in white, like you.
But, that is a wish that cannot be fulfilled. This is the fate of one born a Fell Dragon. Forget these words.
I am a defect. A dragon who can never become something more and will only be disposed of one day.
Status: I must collect all of the Emblem Rings.
What are you doing? You cannot kill me by poking me like that.
I shall continue to prove that I am not a defect.
I seek Emblem Marth. The one who is red, like me.
It is interesting how your expression constantly changes.
I wonder what Father thinks about the fact that I have not returned.
One of my older brothers was drowned. One older sister was burned alive. I wonder if I will have a similar fate one day.

malear4.name: Alear
malear4.title: Fell Dragon Child
malear4.description: One of the Fell Dragon Sombron's countless children. Dissociated from his emotions, he acts out his father's orders. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: The Emblems who have become Heroes all have a blue aura, don't they? They're my...enemies, then.
I must collect the Emblem Rings and defeat Lumera, the Divine Dragon Monarch. That is the role I must play.
If you tell me to fight, I will obey, for I can do nothing but be here until I am able to return to my father.
Why do you give me such attention? If I am useful as a pawn in your plans, then what more is there?
Joy, sadness, and fear are unknown to me. Only defects feel emotions.
Visit: Father did not order this, but I have no choice. I was told to bring this to you from [F].
Level: There appear to be no problems if I can accomplish this much.
I've done it, Father.
I will gain more power next time.
Summon: I am Alear. I am meant to follow the orders of my father and gather the Emblem Rings.
Learn Skill: My state has changed. What am I meant to do with this?
Confession:
Oh, it's you? Recently, when I see you, I am beset by a strange feeling.
If Father were here, I do not doubt he would tell me to kill you.
I believe he would order me to take the Heroes and use them to help fulfill his wish.
But, I do not feel compelled to do that. Prioritizing one's emotions is something that defects do, but...
No, there is no point in saying more. I will obey and fight for you while I'm here, as I have up to now. That is all.
Status: Huh...
I am not a defect.
Please refrain from touching me. I will end up killing you.
I must follow Father's will. It is what I was born for.
Divine Dragon Lumera is an enemy I must defeat.
"Shine on, Emblem of—" No, there is no purpose in reciting those words here.
Is she all right? My littlest sister, Veyle...
I had a cute little sister and brother who were torn apart by the Corrupted. I despise the Corrupted.

lena2.name: Lena
lena2.title: Bereft Angel
lena2.description: A cleric from Macedon whose mind was stolen by Gharnef to be used as a sacrifice in the resurrection of Medeus. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: Ju...li...an... Ahhh! My head... I cannot remember...
Those I save will take from others. Why... Why do I save lives then?
We offer our lives to Lord Medeus... That...is our fate.
This world is filled with humans who continue to harm one another. As such, this world should not exist.
Lord Medeus devoted all his power to Naga, who desired peace. Humans betrayed this desire.
Visit: You are to be the fuel that propels Lord Medeus to his goals, [S].
Level: If everything fades...the world will be without pain...without sadness...
I will not allow anyone to get in the way of Lord Medeus.
I am sorry I fell short of your expectations, Lord Medeus...
Summon: I am not the cleric you know as Lena. No... I am Lord Medeus's loyal servant. I will give my life for him.
Learn Skill: This must be another manifestation of Lord Medeus's will.
Confession:
I have seen with my own eyes countless lives lost to war...
Even if I healed someone...they would return to battle and take another's life. A vicious cycle...
Humanity will continue to spread this sadness across the land.
So, let us be done with it. Let us erase the rage, the hatred, the agony from this world...
Such is the reason Lord Medeus has descended upon us from the heavens. He shall end all conflict.
And you, too, are to offer your life to him...for your final salvation, [S].
Status: Y-yes?
Here.
Please. Please...
Those who resist Lord Medeus will die.
I'm scared... Oh, gods!
Am I being punished? Did I ask too much from others?
Julian, where are you? Call to me...
Please... Please don't leave me...

fafnir.name: Fáfnir
fafnir.title: King of Desolation
fafnir.description: King of Niðavellir who rose from his station as a lowly soldier. Remembers nothing of his past.

Castle Hall: Where... What am I searching for? I struggle to even know who I am...
My kingdom is Niðavellir, the realm of the dvergar. I was not born of royalty; I took the throne of my own strength.
Do you find our weapons and mounts that unusual? Well, go on then. I'll allow you to touch them.
You should be grateful that I'll allow a peasant such as you to have a match against me.
Does that person we passed back there have anything to do with my past? Something feels familiar...
Visit: Next, I'll take your castle. I already took [F]'s.
Level: Who do you think I am? This is nothing for me.
Not good enough.
This...cannot be...
Summon: I am Fáfnir, king of Niðavellir. I shall train you ignorant swine to do my bidding. Do your best to obey me.
Learn Skill: How insightful of you. Now, eyes up. You won't want to miss what lies ahead.
Confession:
Niðavellir is my country, but to call it my homeland is...just not right. I have no memories of my homeland.
And my family, well... I picked them up on a whim, nothing more... But they've proven themselves useful.
Family has nothing to do with one's homeland. Only a naive peasant could think that.
No... It does not matter where my homeland is if I hold the whole world in my hands.
Eventually, I will rule your homeland as well. For now, I'll humor you and act as your subordinate. Ahaha...
Status: I am Fáfnir, king of Niðavellir. You should kneel.
You would sully me with your touch.
Reginn and Ótr? I found them on the battlefield and brought them along. It was a whim, nothing more...
I will conquer all worlds. That is how it is and shall be.
This is the crown of Niðavellir's king. Is it not magnificent?
Not here... This isn't right! Where... What am I searching for?
I feel a strange relief that you summoned me. Strange indeed, this feeling...

julia5.name: Julia
julia5.title: Brides of Light
julia5.description: Princess of the Grannvale Empire whose veins run strong with the blood of the 12 crusaders. She participates in the festival alongside Ishtar. They appear in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.
julia5.duo:
Grants【Empathy】to unit and allies within 2 spaces for 1 turn, and grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit and those allies.
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Empathy】
Grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = number of types of【Bonus】effects, excluding stat bonuses, and【Penalty】effects, excluding stat penalties, active on player team and enemy team during combat (max 7).
【Bonus】
