All effects that last "for 1 turn" or "that turn only." Includes bonuses granted by a skill like Rally or Hone and positive status effects (extra movement or effects like Dominance).
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).

Castle Hall: **Julia:** This is a truly wonderful festival. The hearts of the people shine brightly.
**Ishtar:** Lady Julia, Lord Julius's twin sister, is precious to me as well.
**Ishtar:** Lady Julia, I offer you my support. Please, take this opportunity and enjoy yourself.

**Julia:** Holding the Book of Naga, Saint Heim offers a prayer to the heavens.
That prayer brings light... And light becomes the white dragon that shines throughout the world...
**Ishtar:** I heard the bride throws her bouquet after the ceremony, and whoever catches it will have their love fulfilled.
Visit: **Julia:** I hope a time comes when all who wish to can join with the one they love. Including Ishtar, and you...
Level: **Julia:** I hope I may find true happiness... Ahh... Was I daydreaming again?
**Julia:** Is it my bouquet you are after? Or maybe you would like Ishtar's?
**Ishtar:** Lady Julia, are you growing weary? You mustn't push yourself too hard.
Summon: How exciting! Both Ishtar and I have long awaited this day. I look forward to the ringing of the bells!
Learn Skill: **Ishtar:** Thank you for these sentiments. It is because of you that Lady Julia and I have had such a pleasant time.
Confession:
**Julia:** Um, Ishtar. Close your eyes for just a moment.
**Ishtar:** Hm? Why, Lady Julia? What has come over you?
**Julia:** On the names of the 12 crusaders... may you find everlasting happiness.
**Ishtar:** Wh-what kind of charm is that? There is no need for you to—
**Julia:** I feel now is a time when it is all right to dream of miracles, so I will go on praying for such.
**Ishtar:** Lady Julia... You are so kind, and you are right. One day, I hope to be with Lord Julius again...like it was before...
Status: *giggle*
"Umm...your dress is lovely." "Thank you. As is yours, Lady Julia."
Conversation: **Ishtar:** Hm. I think this flower looks better over here.
**Julia:** Excuse me... If you're ready, it seems to be almost time.
**Ishtar:** I apologize for keeping you waiting. I was not satisfied with how I looked.
**Julia:** That gown... You must be thinking of Lord Julius.
**Ishtar:** Yes. I would like it if he could see me as beautiful...if just for a time.
**Julia:** You are very beautiful.
Your beauty shines more brightly because you love him from the bottom of your heart.
**Ishtar:** Is there no one whom you have come to love, Lady Julia?
**Julia:** Not in that way...
But I do care deeply for Lord Seliph...my brother.
**Ishtar:** Well, Lady Julia, you also look quite beautiful. One might even say that you have a glow about you.
**Julia:** Oh, do I? That must be...because of Lord Seliph's kindness.
He supported me when I thought I had been left with nothing.
When I felt only fear, it was Lord Seliph who told me that he would protect me.
**Ishtar:** I see. I always prayed that you, as the lost sister of Lord Julius, were safe somewhere.
It brings me great happiness to be here with you now.
**Julia:** Thank you. Knowing that you also care for me...it makes me happy as well.

larcei3.name: Larcei
larcei3.title: Bride of Astra
larcei3.description: A swordswoman and descendant of the crusader Od. She strikes with all her might like lightning. What fated partner will match her fervor? Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Does something look off? I'm pretty certain I know how to dress myself. I'm not a child!
It wasn't often anyone told me I was pretty, so...when I hear those words, my heart skips a beat.
This is a good opportunity for me to learn how to fight while dressed in attire like this.
Even after I become someone's wife, I intend to keep swinging my sword. So, this is good training!
I shall win the bouquet! And one day, it will be my turn...
Visit: I'm Larcei, from Tirnanog. Here, I'll share with you some blessings from [F]'s castle!
Level: Step forward, you who tries to steal my bouquet! I'll practice my blade on you!
Prince Shannan himself taught me to fight. You want my bouquet, you'll have to pry it from my fingers!
It's all right. All I have to do is grasp love with my own strength!
Summon: I'm Larcei. I will do what I must to secure victory, at the bridal festival, the Day of Devotion... In any conflict.
Learn Skill: What's this about? I... I suppose I can consider it.
Confession:
I see Lord Seliph is playing the role of groom for this festival, is that right, [S]?
I mean, of course, he's qualified for such a role, but I wonder...
Will there be any reward for the bride who gathers the most bouquets, such as...
letting the winner choose someone they'd like summoned?
If I win, I'd choose... Well uh... You really put me on the spot here!
Anyway! Why don't we continue this conversation after I win. Just think about it, all right?
Status: Hm.
I may not be a child anymore, but this is still a big step.
*gasp* You should know better than to accost a bride. Learn some manners!
I remember when we were hiding with the liberation army in Tirnanog, Lord Seliph and I were never far apart.
I don't think Iuchar and Iucharba will ever let me out of their sight.
Someday, Mother will get to see me in a real wedding dress...
Love befell me, so I will do what must be done.
You've done so much for me. I won't leave your side.

tine2.name: Tine
tine2.title: Determined Bride
tine2.description: A mage and descendant of the crusader Thrud. Swears an oath to be strong and live for both herself and her mother, who suffered great misfortune. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Lord Seliph is exactly how I heard he would be. I wish I had met him sooner...
I heard that Ishtar will also be participating in the festival. I look forward to seeing her.
One day, I, too, will be with the one I love.
Bridal gowns are lovely, aren't they? I wonder... Would my mother be happy to see me wearing this?
Ishtar treated me as a little sister, doting over me... I remember it made me happy.
Visit: I am Tine. I fled here in an attempt to protect my bouquet!
Level: Mother, are you watching? Lifelong happiness is within my grasp!
I can't give away my bouquet to just anyone!
Tell me, what should I do, Mother?
Summon: I am Tine. So this is a festival where you become a happy bride... Mother... Are you watching me?
Learn Skill: F-for me? Thank you...
Confession:
The spirit here is fantastic. Lovers, brides, grooms... Promising lifelong love to each other beneath the sun.
Things like this are difficult where I come from, with constant war unfolding...
Mother and Lady Deirdre were both powerless against the chaos of war.
But, I don't want the same fate. I won't surrender to it. Mother... Please, watch over me.
Status: Huh...
Ah, such a beautiful dress. Just wearing it is exciting!
Ah! Oh...a-are you to be my escort? Thank you.
Lord Seliph... He is everything I heard he would be.
Ishtar and Prince Julius... They were so in love...
Mother... She always seemed so sad.
I'm actually wearing a wedding dress... *sigh* If only mother could see me.
Allow me to stand by your side, and I will be your strength.

seliph4.name: Seliph
seliph4.title: Light's Legacy
seliph4.description: Descendant of the crusader Baldr and praised as the Scion of Light. He was invited to the festival to fill the role of a groom. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Who do you suppose will stand by me when that day comes? Wearing such an outfit...it makes one wonder.
I'd want a ceremony in Tirnanog so people who supported me through difficult times could watch.
From my heart, I hope those playing the role of brides at this festival will find true happiness.
What kind of ceremony do you think my father and mother had?

Until we grew strong enough to fight, my companions and I had to hide from the empire.
I hope our efforts benefit the ones who aided us in those trying times.
Visit: Greetings. I am Seliph. When next I visit...it may be that I will come with the one I love by my side.
Level: Let us advance, holding the feelings we have for our loved ones close to our hearts!
The time for blessings is at hand!
Even if there is adversity, if I can find someone with whom I can share both suffering and joy...
Summon: I, Seliph, am here to play a groom for the festival. I humbly ask you all for your patience and understanding.
Learn Skill: I believe it is my responsibility to meet the expectations of the people. I hope I can continue to do so.
Confession:
[S], fine work today. Have you reached a good stopping point? I know I am ready for a bit of rest.
It is exhausting at times being the Seliph that people expect me to be.
How can I explain it? It's as if there is the person I am, and then there is the person I must be in public.
This festival may be Askr's, but...I will hold a true ceremony of this kind for myself one day...
To marry someone I can see myself building a future alongside in a world ravaged by the chaos of a long war.
Huh? Who would that be? Well, that is an excellent question...
Status: *hum*
I must admit I am a bit nervous dressed like this. Do I look all right?
Ah! I...wish you would stop teasing me.
Whatever else, Mother and Father lived and loved one another. And I am proof of that.
Such beautiful clothing and...so much love in the air. What a wonderful festival!
There is no doubt that Julia will be radiant in a wedding dress.
When I marry, I am sure I will have Father and Mother's blessing.
I shall never tire of seeing that smile.

lana.name: Lana
lana.title: Benevolent Bride
lana.description: A kind cleric and descendant of the crusader Ullr. As one who is loved by all, she decides her own fate. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: Though I am not much help in battle, I am happy just to be by Lord Seliph's side.
I have such fond memories of Lord Seliph and myself playing together as children. I wish to be like that again.
How do I look? If Mother were here, she would ensure everything was in its place.
You would like to know whose bride I want to be? But, I... I never really thought about it.
I have no intention of forgoing my true purpose as a cleric, even in times like these.
Visit: I pray the gods will shower words of celebration upon this land of [S]'s castle!
Level: I pray you, too, will be blessed!
Larcei and Lady Julia deserve to be truly happy. And I, too, will do my best to be happy as well!
I find myself trembling under the gaze of so many...
Summon: I hear this festival is a celebration of sharing love. I will work with Larcei and Lady Julia to ensure all enjoy it.
Learn Skill: Thank you. Let me know if anything troubles you. I will help in any way I can, [S].
Confession:
Wedding dresses are so lovely... Whoever wears such a gown is truly blessed.
I wonder if a day will come for me where I will promise to share a future with the one I love.
Though, there are many lovers who have been torn apart by countless wars.
I pray this sorrow will end, and that all people will be blessed and joined with the one they love.
And so, I will enjoy this celebration from the bottom of my heart and express my feelings to all I love...
Including the one who is most precious to me.
I would be happy if you chose to watch over me as well, [S].
Status: *sigh*
This blessing...
Wish for happiness.
I am Lana. I am honored to be a part of this festival... And in such a lovely dress.
Lord Seliph and I often played together when we were young.
After I marry, I wish to be blessed with many children... That is my hope.
My heart cannot help but quaver when I hear those words.
I worry over you, so...I will stay by your side.

blackknight3.name: Black Knight
blackknight3.title: Mortal Legend
blackknight3.description: A swordsman and general, revered as the strongest of Daein's Four Riders under Mad King Ashnard. It is said he protected the Dawn Maiden, who sought to restore Daein's former prosperity. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Darkness is my way of life. How could anyone really know me if they cannot see me?
To surpass General Gawain was my ultimate goal as a swordsman.
No thanks are needed. I do nothing more than fulfill my duty.
My armor lost its protection after my battle with him...
The light of judgment is approaching...
Visit: Use your strong will to keep on the path toward self-improvement, just as [F] has.
Level: Make your peace. This blow will be your end.
In battle, you either kill or be killed... There is nothing else.
Fate is immutable.
Summon: You are the tactician who commands Heroes from other worlds? Then I shall make my blade of use to you.
Learn Skill: My life was shrouded in darkness. There was not anyone capable of measuring its meaning...until now.
Confession:
I assume you ask to know what I am thinking out of either pity or compassion...
You want to know why a man such as me would abandon his identity to live only by the sword?
I find the world in which I live to be grotesque, filled with endless conflict between those who harbor hate.
Mortals filled with contempt that knows no bounds...
If you wish to hear more, then you should inquire of my master, [S].
As for me, I will return to the darkness beneath the moonlight.
I wish to remain a phantom in the night, one that crosses blades with him in the end.
Status: Hm...
Hahahaha... A Legendary Hero? Me? What sort of legacy could I have left?
Hm. Strike my armor all you wish. You will only hurt your hand.
I was once one of the Four Riders, serving the army of old Daein.
If you hope to protect her, become stronger. Strong enough to surpass me, and stronger still.
My maiden...I will stop at nothing to protect you.
Son of Gawain...and courageous warriors...
I will become your shield. Do not leave my side.

tharja7.name: Tharja
tharja7.title: Gloomy Mage
tharja7.description: A dark mage who spends her days researching strange charms. Her usual gloominess is contrary to her secret passion. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: My homeland still carries so much bitterness toward Ylisse. I never shared those petty feelings.
I was instructed in the dark arts from infancy. Even my umbilical cord was cut with a curse.
I need some salamander skin. I don't suppose they would have something like that in the shop?
Dark magic can be medicinal if you want it to be. Warding off a malicious influence, like a flu, would be simple.
Ah...I see why my future self didn't share this knowledge. The dark arts carry with them tremendous risks.
Visit: I need the heads of two black snakes. There were none to be found in [F]'s castle.
Level: Heheheh... My curses are unrelenting. I will curse them down to the last of their descendants!
Noire, you can rest easy knowing I will erase from existence anyone who dares to frighten you.
If it's for my daughter's future, then I care not what happens to me. I am a mother, after all...
Summon: I'm Tharja, a dark mage. I'm keeping an eye on, Noire, my daughter...my future daughter... It's complicated.
Learn Skill: After all this time, I would consider hearing what you want to say. I can make an exception for you.
Confession:
The world is full of strange things... I've come to a conclusion about one, though. Care to hear what it is?
It's about my future daughter...Noire. Her magical power is impressive, and yet, she is not a dark mage.
My daughter, not a dark mage? Is it not odd that the future me taught her nothing.
I wondered why that would be. But after seeing her, I think maybe I did not want her using dark magic.
Curses are dangerous things. Why pass down something like that?
Not an exciting revelation, was it? It was simple. A future great dark mage chose to act as a mother. Heheh...
Status: I am Tharja... Noire is my daughter from the future.
Ah! Sorry to disappoint you, but I only have eyes for someone else...
This outfit is similar to what Noire wears, though I do not carry a bow.
You say it's my fault that girl is easily frightened? What's done cannot be undone...
Hm... I wonder which outfit Robin would prefer, my usual attire or this...
Even if she never learns hexes, she still has her own path to follow.
How can I describe the feelings I have for you? They differ from those I have for my beloved and my daughter.

noire.name: Noire
noire.title: Of Two Minds
noire.description: Daughter of Tharja. Timid and pessimistic, but turns into a totally different person when enraged. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall:
Are you ever scared to use your weapon? It can be awfully loud, and loud noises are awfully frighte—
HALT! DO NOT DARE FIRE OFF THAT DIVINE WEAPON IN MY PRESENCE!

I'm scared to fight, but I can't run away. In the future I'm from, my parents faced much scarier things...
And it was all just to protect me.
I'll use this delicious fruit I found outside to make you something. I'm pretty good at making sweets.

Let's take a walk through the forest for a change of pace. If we see any bears, we can just run away.
Escaping is sort of my thing, if nothing else...
Aieee! O-oh, it's just you... I'm sorry for being such a coward. I wish I had more guts...
Visit: EEK! Are you...are you the summoner here? I've, um... Brought a greeting from [F].
Level: This new strength is... It's unnatural. A CURSE?!
Whew... This means I can keep fighting...
Aieee! I... I don't feel any different at all!
Summon: I'm Noire... Uh... Tharja's daughter... Wh-why am I here? I'll be able to go home soon... Right?
Learn Skill: Y-you gave me more power? I'll use it to...to become stronger.
Confession:
Oh, [S]!
Wh-what are you doing here? Do you need me for... Wait...
You aren't sending me into battle, are you?
Phew, you're not? Oh, I'm so glad. I'm already busy with something else at the moment.
Huh? I'm not hiding anything in my hands.
I SAID I AM HIDING NOTHING! I AM NOT CREATING A THING SUCH AS A TALISMAN!
HEAVENS FORBID I SHOULD PERFORM AN ACT OF KINDNESS FOR A MORTAL SUCH AS YOU.
Uh, I mean... Ugh, it happened again. Sorry. OK, I'll admit it. I was creating a talisman for you.
Unlike the Heroes, you won't come back to life if you fall in battle.
I don't want to lose someone so precious to me. I've been putting a lot of care into this talisman, so...
I hope you'll accept it when it's finally finished.
Status: What do you want?!
You have a weapon that can summon Heroes? That's amazing!
This place... Do you have any strange diseases here? I can't get sick...
Eek! What do you think you're doing? Surprising me like that!
I'm always making trouble for you. I'm sorry. I promise... I'll get stronger.
I've lost my parents — and I've lost my talisman. But I have to go on — I have to give it my all.
I am so scared. But I'll fight as hard as I can. I want to help.

mgrima.name: Grima
mgrima.title: Tyrant of Ruin
mgrima.description: Grima, having consumed Robin. The world, filled with death and destruction, greets its end. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Robin? Unfortunately, our hearts and minds have melded... They can never be separated...

Robin, you fool. I thought you might want to leave your comrades with a heroic, selfless image.
But you left them with the final memory that you were their undoing!
Tell me what it is you desire... With me, you can have it all...
WRETCHED CHILD OF NAGA...YOU WILL BE DESTROYED!
A future of annihilation and despair awaits humanity. And I caused it... It is quite something, don't you think?
Visit: It seems you two have souls of similar quality... That is, you and [F].
Level: WRETCHED...YOU ARE NOTHING! YOU WILL RETURN TO NOTHING!
May I request the vile vermin leave my sight?
You have all thrown your lives away, and the result is the same! It never changes, no matter the time or world.
Summon: I AM...GRIMA. I AM...DESPAIR.
Learn Skill: THE DRAGON'S MIGHT...WILL BE MADE WHOLE.
Confession:
Summoner, do you not find it odd...
That I...OBEY SO WILLINGLY?
I am here to eliminate every Fire Emblem, from the worlds in which they exist.
However, tracking them down is no simple task, so I decided to show myself here, where power gathers.
I grant you a choice...to stand at my side or be devoured by me, when this world meets its end.
Status: *grunt*
I AM...GRIMA. I AM...DESPAIR.
YOU DARE...TO TOUCH ME?
WRETCHED CHILD OF NAGA... YOU WILL BE DESTROYED.
Once our powers are joined...THE DRAGON'S MIGHT WILL BE MADE WHOLE!
You are all powerless, frail, insignificant. You are NOTHING!
The bonds between humans... So frail. Short-lived. Futile.
Now you too...are a part of me.

fgrima.name: Grima
fgrima.title: Tyrant of Despair
fgrima.description: Grima, having consumed Robin. The world, filled with death and destruction, greets its end. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Robin? Unfortunately, our hearts and minds have melded... They can never be separated...

Robin, you fool. I thought you might want to leave your comrades with a heroic, selfless image.
But you left them with the final memory that you were their undoing!
Tell me what it is you desire... With me, you can have it all...
WRETCHED CHILD OF NAGA...YOU WILL BE DESTROYED!
A future of annihilation and despair awaits humanity. And I caused it... It is quite something, don't you think?
Visit: It seems you two have souls of similar quality... That is, you and [F].
Level: WRETCHED...YOU ARE NOTHING! YOU WILL RETURN TO NOTHING!
May I request the vile vermin leave my sight?
You have all thrown your lives away, and the result is the same! It never changes, no matter the time or world.
Summon: I AM...GRIMA. I AM...DESPAIR.
Learn Skill: THE DRAGON'S MIGHT...WILL BE MADE WHOLE.
Confession:
You are wise, [S].
You are not like the fools who brandish their power without discretion...
Now, I surmise you understand why it is I...OBEY SO WILLINGLY...
I am here to eliminate every Fire Emblem, from every world in which they exist.
Since you are wise, you know it is meaningless to stop me. You know Grima's true horror...
I will grant you the freedom to choose if you wish to remain with me when this world meets its end...
Status: *sigh*
I AM...GRIMA. I AM...DESPAIR.
Hmm... What are you...
Wretched child of Naga... You will be destroyed.
Once our powers are joined the dragon's might will be made whole.
Return to me... For we are one.
The bonds between humans... So frail. Short-lived. Futile.
Now you too...are a part of me.

excellus.name: Excellus
excellus.title: Conqueror's Wile
excellus.description: A tactician who serves Walhart, the emperor of Valm. Acts superior to others and does not hesitate to make use of and discard them. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I'll end up on the winning side one way or another! Whee hee hee hee!
Everything is going exactly as I planned! To hell with him...with the both of them!
Today's "struggle"? I think you mean today's SLAUGHTER.
I'm after Yen'fay! I could care less whether the little girl lives or dies. Whee hee hee hee!
They always forget who I am! Whatever I do, this spider crawls out alive! Eee hee hee hee!
Visit: Oooh, it appears I'm just in time for the reunion! Delicious...
Level: Did you see the grief etched on their face? The mix of longing and pain in the eyes?
You have important matters to think after, and to deal with...quickly. Feel free to thank me some other time!
Whee hee hee! Disgusting!
Summon: Be confused! Be insecure! Be afraid! In the face of the brilliant tactician, Excellus! Wee hee hee hee hee!
Learn Skill: I'll fry them where they stand with my magic! We will crush them all...
Confession:
Well, well, if it isn't [S]!
I like that name. It shines like a light.
Pity about your looks. But no matter. I've always been surrounded by oafs.
Yes, I know. Looks and brains—I've got it all. I'm the god of tacticians!
And speaking as the god of tacticians, I'd say you're not half bad yourself. You could use some pointers, though.
I can tell you're salivating at the very idea of sharing in my wisdom, so... Let's do it. Starting tomorrow.
Ready for your first lesson? You may be surprised, but I do love teaching an eager student. Wee hee hee!
Status: Hm.
I am Excellus! You should feel honored to stand near me!
Oooh, so you wish to bask in my presence? My, you flatter me!
Mm, seeing the grief etched on good men's faces...the longing and pain as they meet their demise...is so thrilling!
I don't know about you, but I try to avoid committing murder...myself.
One must attain the only sparkling beauty in this world: the flower that is victory!
I only brought the rebels to that general so they might...learn from her shining example!
You summoned me here. You had better take responsibility for that!

celica7.name: Celica
celica7.title: Sunlit Priestesses
celica7.description: Celica, a priestess and follower of Mila, and Serra, a cleric and follower of Elimine, bring their protection to the beach this summer. They appear in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia / Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade.
celica7.origin: Shadows of Valentia + The Blazing Blade
celica7.harmonized:
Neutralizes any【Penalty】, restores 40 HP, and grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
Once used, Harmonic Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Harmonized Skill has already been used, unit can use Harmonized Skill again.
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Serra:** An adorable, helpless person like me is better suited to a summer beach than a rugged battlefield!
**Celica:** I am used to playing at the beach on Novis Island, where I once lived. It, too, was surrounded by the sea.
**Serra:** Saint Elimine, I pray that all will enjoy this wonderful summer, and may they fawn over me in my swimsuit.
**Celica:** Does this swimsuit look all right on me, Serra? I want to be sure before Alm sees it.
**Serra:** You don't look half bad in a swimsuit yourself, Celica! There is simply no way to conceal our nobility, is there?
Visit: **Serra:** I am Serra, a cleric in service to Saint Elimine. I, with Celica, am delivering a letter from [F].
Level: **Serra:** Hehe! We will play the leading roles this summer!
**Celica:** It seems to be working out all right. We won't be beaten by this summer heat!
**Celica:** Are you all right, Serra? You shouldn't push yourself too hard. Let's rest awhile in the shade.
Summon: I am Celica, from Zofia. Together, Serra, let us pray for everyone's lasting happiness!
Learn Skill: **Serra:** Look at this Celica! Now, no eye on the beach will be able to look away from us!
Confession:
**Celica:** Serra... You said you were born of a noble family with a long, distinguished history in Etruria, right?
**Serra:** Y-yes, that's right! Since I was born an aristocrat, no matter what I do, my body overflows with a noble light!
**Celica:** I can feel that light shining from your soul. Your cheerfulness brings a smile to everyone's faces.
No matter if you were born a noble or not, I'm sure your light would still shine on any who beheld it.
**Serra:** Y-you're right. My family's status may be an insignificant detail...
**Celica:** Haha... We may follow different gods, but I think we can do our best to bring light to the future together!
Status: *sigh*
"What do you think of my bathing suit?" "Looks good! Now we're an even match!"
Conversation: **Celica:** The sea is beautiful... Come, Serra. Let's go for a swim!
**Serra:** Ugh! How careless can you be? You've got so much beauty hiding in there somewhere, yet no sensibility.
You shouldn't just run off to the beach. You need to apply this oil to protect your skin first.
**Celica:** Thank you, Serra. You know so much about these types of things.
**Serra:** Of course I do. As the daughter of a count, I must protect my beauty at all costs so as not to shame the family.
Getting a sunburn is out of the question! But, I still want to play on the beach, of course...
And everyone might be terribly disappointed if they didn't get to see me in my swimsuit.
Saint Elimine herself has guided me on a path of servitude... It's the least I can do for them!
*sigh* OK! Come on. Hurry up, Celica! Let's go!
**Celica:** But I thought— I'm not quite ready...
**Serra:** I must show off how I look in my swimsuit to as many people as possible, as quickly as possible!
First, we'll walk to the end of this sandy beach, and then we'll swim all the way back.
**Celica:** Oh? Isn't that rather far? And are you sure about swimming all the way back? It sounds difficult...
**Serra:** And of course I need to show off how I look when I'm relaxing. So I'll carry a fancy drink in hand too.
Woo! I am so busy! I can't believe how hard I work for Elimine. So, so commendable! Ugh, I'm tearing up...
**Celica:** So... Does that mean you will make the most of your time here at the beach?
**Serra:** Yes, of course I will! Let's go, Celica! Everyone is waiting to see me.

palla5.name: Palla
palla5.title: Soaring Summer
palla5.description: A tactician who serves Walhart, the emperor of Valm. Acts superior to others and does not hesitate to make use of and discard them. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Isn't the ocean fabulous? I wonder... What would it be like to come here with someone special.
Askr's ocean is quite calm compared to the turbulent waters of the ocean between Archanea and Valentia.
You can count on me to patrol the beach. I'll get the best view of these sandy shores from the sky.
Flying above it all with a nice breeze blowing in from the ocean makes me grateful to be a pegasus knight.
I didn't expect to show up in another world wearing a swimsuit... How will I explain this to my little sisters?
Visit: I'm Palla, one of the Macedonian Whitewings, flying in a summery gift from [F].
Level: That was a wonderful experience. I will never forget the memories I made this summer.
Whew... Looks like everything worked out. Let's enjoy some cold drinks to cool ourselves down.
I know now is not the time to feel self-conscious, but...
Summon: I am Palla, of the Whitewings. Isn't Askr's ocean lovely? An ideal spot for me and my pegasus to rest our wings.
Learn Skill: Oh! What a wonderful gift! I promise I'll live up to expectations.
Confession:
Thank you for inviting me to Askr's beach, [S].
From Archanea to Valentia...my days of fighting had no end in sight. This has been a pleasant change of pace.
But, if I could have a wish right now, it would be to show this lovely place to my little sisters too.
That desire has only grown stronger during my time here.
Sharing the little things that bring us joy with each other... That is how we have lived our lives to this point.
I want the three of us to fly to this beach together someday. When that time comes, I truly hope you join us.
Status: Hmm...
I've been looking forward to today. The ocean is so beautiful in summertime...
Oh! Is that drink for me? Thank you. It's even a pretty color too.
I've never worn a swimsuit before... It makes me feel a little self-conscious.
I can tell my sisters are jealous, though Catria would never let that show.
It's really quite enjoyable just walking along the beach with you.
Watching the sunset along the ocean shore with him— Uh, no... That's foolishness.
The sun is beating down hard... We shouldn't forget to wear sunscreen.

nino6.name: Nino
nino6.title: Burst of Summer
nino6.description: A tactician who serves Walhart, the emperor of Valm. Acts superior to others and does not hesitate to make use of and discard them. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: Running from the ocean surf makes for great training! If I keep this up, I'll be as fast as Jaffar soon.
The ocean is beautiful, isn't it? I want the others to see it too.
Look! Look! That stall made a frozen treat just for me! It's covered in this sweet syrup!
The ocean is so big. There could be a continent even larger than Elibe somewhere beyond that horizon.
Uncle Merlinus got this swimsuit for me. What do you think?
Visit: I'm Nino! I was entrusted with this souvenir from the ocean for you by [F]!
Level: Even at the beach, I put up a good fight! Now I have another story to tell Jaffar.
Haha! Once we're done here, I'm going to eat a bunch of cold fruit!
Ugh... The sunlight is so intense. I feel a bit dizzy...
Summon: I'm Nino! Today's important mission is...to enjoy summer at the beach!
Learn Skill: Can I really have this?! This just became the best summer ever!
Confession:
Thanks for inviting me to the sea with you, [S]!
I had no idea beach adventures could be this much fun.
I made a new goal for myself. I want to bring the others to the beach next time so we can all have a good time!
Lloyd will be there. And Linus. And Uncle Jan... And Jaffar.
After we swim in the ocean, we'll sit on the sand eating tasty food and watching the sun set together!
For that to happen, I need to keep working hard to bring peace to Askr. Haha! I'm super motivated now!
Status: O-oh...
The pretty ocean gives me so much energy; I could run forever!
*gasp* That's so cold! Is it a frozen snack?
I'm not so confident in the water, so I'm using a floatie.
Awww, look! A cute crab!
Hmm... What souvenir do you think will make Jaffar happy?
I wish the others could see this ocean...
I'm so glad we can make wonderful summer memories together.

lapis3.name: Lapis
lapis3.title: Forager of the Sea
lapis3.description: A warrior of Brodia and retainer to Alcryst, she hunts for food on the beach and in the ocean. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I'm not just fishing. I'm also gathering colorful shells and beach grass, as one does while enjoying the summer.
I caught the unique fish you see in my creel from a pond on the Somniel. It's an island that floats in the sky.
Is the heat wearing you out? I'll go extract salt from some ocean water and make my salt candies for you.
Leave free diving, distance swimming, and water combat to me! I trained in the raging oceans of Brodia.
When I tried to make myself a classy swimsuit for playing in the ocean, my hands wove a fishing net instead.
Visit: Mind if I fish while I'm here? After I drop off this summer greeting from [F], that is.
Level: Wow! I caught quite the haul today! The ocean really is bountiful.
I want to try using this power for fishing... What?! No, I meant battle!
The ocean certainly is moody today. Should I come back another time?
Summon: Lapis, royal soldier of Brodia, here to report in! Is this where we're fishing today? I will bring in a big haul.
Learn Skill: Fantastic! This is perfect for summer! I'm not sure I deserve it, but it makes me happy.
Confession:
Here's some beach grass, tropical fruits, and freshly grilled fish! All for you, [S]!
Oh, no, you didn't look hungry. But... Well, sharing food with a friend is how I show them I care about them.
Where I'm from, it's a sign of strong friendship when you give someone the most delicious part of something.
Um... Heheh. It's just...after our ocean adventures this summer, I wanted to give you a gift to show you how I feel.
Here, this is for you... It's the head of a huge fish I just caught. That's the most delicious part!
Status: Swimsuit? Oh, no, this outfit is made for battle in the water. I designed it myself.
Hold on! Hands off the fish! I've got plans to mince them all later.
Isn't the ocean amazing? It's beautiful, vast...and full of so many edible things.
Brodia has a robust fishing industry. I'm better suited to using a harpoon than sitting around with a fishing pole.
I caught so many fish today! I got matob octopuses and mir catfish. Oh, and even big-eyed sardines.
I'll give this seashell to Prince Alcryst and this one to Citrinne... When it comes to souvenirs, you can't beat seashells given freely by the sea.
These garments aren't perfectly made, but even if they get damaged, I can reinforce them with seaweed and keep fighting.

fogado2.name: Fogado
fogado2.title: Summer of Bliss
fogado2.description: First prince of Solm. He loves the heat, the ocean, the beach, and everyone. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: Me? I'm good at all kinds of sports— you name it! Except for fishing. I can't get the hang of it. Any tips?
Ta-da! This floatie is made to look like Emblem Ike's ring. Next I need one that looks like Emblem Corrin's!
I hear Askr's summer is over before you know it. But not this time! If you miss the heat, just come and find me.
Let's head to the beach later when things quiet down. Beneath the stars, listening to the waves... So relaxing.
It's summer, so we NEED to throw a party! Let's gather some tasty food and enjoy tonight with our friends.
Visit: Oh, hi there. I'm Fogado and I'm making the most of this summer with [F]!
Level: Wahoo! This is why I love summer!
This is all thanks to you being there for me. Let's make it a summer to remember!
Maybe I was goofing off too much! Focus, Fogado!
Summon: Huh? I was having fun at the beach and now I'm...here? Ah, well. Nice to meet you! I'm Fogado!
Learn Skill: This'll be the best memory from the summer for sure. Thanks!
Confession:
Hot, isn't it? So hot that we should DEFINITELY go jump in the ocean. What do you say to a swim?
Just us, I mean. I love partying with our friends, but I wanted to have a nice, long chat with you.
We can listen to the murmuring of the tide. Picture it. You'll remember today for the rest of your life.
At least, I hope you will! I want to be someone who's special to you. A true friend. I hope you feel the same...
You do? Great! Though I guess I shouldn't be surprised. I knew I could count on you.
OK, let's head to that beach. I know the PERFECT spot. C'mon, hurry it up!
Status: Whoa!
Take a look! Fogado, captain of the Sentinels and prince of Solm, wearing a swimsuit. Haha. You're swooning again, aren't you?
Huh, this? It's a floatie! Uh, maybe it isn't a surprise since I live in the desert, but I don't have a lot of experience being in water.
Solm is a desert queendom, so I love summer! All this bright sunshine is invigorating!
The ocean sure is beautiful. Just appreciating the scenery and the crashing of the waves is nice.
There's a place called the Azure Coast where I was raised. I'd like to show it to you someday.
I bet Pandreo would love to have this seashell as a decoration, and ooh... Bunet is definitely gonna want to taste this fruit.
Summer won't last, so we can't just lie around! Come on! Let's get out in the sunshine and create some memories!

micaiah8.name: Micaiah
micaiah8.title: Of Dawn
micaiah8.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to Elyos. Resides in the Ring of the Dawn Maiden. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn / Fire Emblem Engage.
micaiah8.emblem:
Enhanced Engaged Special
When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's max Special cooldown count value × 4 (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If a Rally or movement Assist skill is used by unit, restores 20 HP to target ally and neutralizes any【Penalty】on that ally, and grants another action to unit and inflicts 【Isolation】on unit and Pair Up cohort through their next action, and also, if unit's or Pair Up Cohort's Range = 2, inflicts "restricts movement to 1 space" on unit and Pair Up cohort, respectively, through their next action ("grants another action" effect and onward is once per turn; if another effect that grants additional action to unit has been triggered at the same time, this effect is also considered to have been triggered).
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).
【Isolation】
Target cannot use or be the target of Assist skills through its next action. (Target can neither use nor be the target of skills like Dance and Sing, skills that neutralize penalties, like Restore and Harsh Command+, etc.)

Castle Hall: Whenever I see small, orange birds, I am reminded of Yune. But here, I can meet with the real Yune.

When I was in Elyos, I was entrusted to the kingdom of Firene as a ring, which was hidden in a shrine.
I only awoke when I sensed the revival of the Fell Dragon.
Even after a thousand years, Emblems do not change. I am no longer alone here, watching others come and go.

It is true that Emblems do not need food to survive. But things are different here in Askr.
I look forward to sharing a meal with the Dawn Brigade and my allies, just like old times.
My power was helpful when I used it to bear the injuries of others. But if my engage partner used it...I worried.
Visit: I feel strange and...nostalgic here, as if I know this place... I have a greeting from [F].
Level: I foresaw a favorable outcome, but it was your strength that made it happen.
Hope will never fade from any world. I will not allow that to happen.
Let us use the power I have now to turn the tides of this battle.
Summon: I am Emblem Micaiah. I sense the future shifting... Now victory lies ahead. Let us go together.
Learn Skill: This power you have granted me comforts me. I can truly feel how much you care. Thank you.
Confession:
It is rare for you to be resting in the shade of these trees... Do you need something, [S]?
Ah... Of course, I can read your fortune... You must be anxious about the battles to come.
You must not worry though... I see a bright future—a radiant future—you and your allies will grasp together.
Hehehe... I am glad to see you smile.
When I was in Elyos and Tellius, nothing warmed my spirit like seeing my allies smile.
This may be asking too much as an Emblem, but...I hope to heal spirits as well as bodies on the battlefield.
I will happily stay by your side until a time of peace when you can smile from the bottom of your heart.
Let us continue on this path together.
Status: Ugh...
You have warm hands. That warmth is a sign that you are cared for deeply.
Ah! You approached so unexpectedly. Are you hurt? Is there a fortune you wish me to read?
I am fond of this appearance. Wreathed in blue flame... It is as though I am meant to match Yune.
My ring was hidden in a shrine in Firene, but Yunaka heard my voice and brought me out of it.
"Heal us, Emblem of Dawn..." That is the invocation to summon me. It will aid you. Of that I am certain.
It pleases me to see Sothe and others who inspire so many memories... Though, I knew I would come here.
None of the Micaiahs from whom I originate could have foreseen becoming an Emblem. Like them, you also have limitless potential.

hapi2.name: Hapi
hapi2.title: Eternal Sunlit Pair
hapi2.description: Hapi calls forth monsters with her sighs and Constance seeks to rebuild House Nuvelle. Will their bond grow even stronger in a land of perpetual summer? They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.
hapi2.duo:
Grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit.
Grants "unit can move 1 extra space (that turn only; does not stack)" and 【Incited】to unit for 1 turn.
Once used, Duo Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Duo Skill has already been used, unit can use Duo Skill again.
【Incited】
If unit initiates combat, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = number of spaces from start position to end position of unit during combat (max 3; that turn only).

Castle Hall:
**Hapi:** Being here is interesting... Living underground, I never got to experience day or night.
Not to mention these waves... Each one has a different shape.
**Constance:** The sunlit beach? I have no problems with this! As long as there is shade, I shall endure with ease...probably.
**Constance:** The blue sea, the colorful flowers, the scrumptious seafood... I am sure even Hapi will find this amusing!
**Hapi:** Look at this seashell, Coco. Pretty, right? It's like a million stars were scattered across the shore.
**Hapi:** It's nice here, huh? I can even wear this swimsuit and not get any weird looks. Putting it on is a pain, though.
Visit:
I'm Hapi. I know I'm in a swimsuit, but that doesn't matter here, right?
Here, it's a gift... Summer tidings from [F]. How nice!
Level: **Constance:** Ahahaha! I shall fill the ocean with my noble air!
**Hapi:** If I get any stronger, I'll be put into action even more. And this heat is already exhausting as it is.
**Constance:** This place is unfamiliar to me. It's simply a string of bad luck!
Summon: I am Constance von Nuvelle. I have arrived to Askr's beach in all my grandeur! Come Hapi, let us enjoy!
Learn Skill: **Constance:** I will not tolerate being called Shady Lady any longer! You may refer to me as Lady of Everlasting Summer!
Confession:
**Constance:** Ahahaha! The fish here in Askr are delicacies. And I've reeled in one of great magnificence!
Roasted over an open flame, it turns into a work of art! Sprinkling on a bit of salt elevates it to the next level!
**Hapi:** Coco, we've made it all the way to Askr, so there's no need to be so careful with your money, you know?
**Constance:** This is no act to conserve finances! This is an elegant way to take in all the sights of such a noble place!
Now, bon appétit, Hapi!
**Hapi:** Yeah, yeah. OK. *munch* Mmm... This is tasty!
We should share it with Yuri-bird and B. I'm sure it'll taste even better if we eat it together. *munch*
Status: Ugh.
"Why are you taking a parasol into the sea?" "I can never be too careful in weather like this. It shall accompany me even while I swim."
Conversation: **Constance:** Uh, Hapi? Mind if we rest a moment?
**Hapi:** Oh, sure. Are you tired, Coco?
**Constance:** I would not say that. However, this parasol seems unable to fully defend me from these intense rays.
The sunlight glistening off the sea is affecting me. I am unworthy of such weather.
**Hapi:** Let's rest under those trees, then.
**Constance:** I do apologize for making you move. *sigh*
**Hapi:** I was a bit tired anyway, so the shade is actually nice.
**Constance:** Of course. I presumed you were tired, just too shy to say so. That is precisely why I proposed a rest.
**Hapi:** Um, yeah... OK... Anyway. The sea is fun, huh? I'm glad we came.
**Constance:** Likewise. Feeling the cool sea breeze, as well as the hot sand, is a truly magnificent experience.
**Hapi:** Yeah. Plus we're all together. But... It is weird, don't you think?
Being underground in the dark for so long, and then being so lucky to come to this bright, beautiful place.
**Constance:** I suppose it is strange, going from one extreme to the other.
**Hapi:** Right? I guess no one knows what's right around the corner.
**Constance:** I welcome such luck with open arms, as I doubt we will be so lucky again.
**Hapi:** Let's not think about that right now. So, are you feeling better yet?
**Constance:** Much. Now, let us welcome our good fortune and enjoy what this summer has to offer, shall we?

yuri3.name: Yuri
yuri3.title: Tropical Wolf
yuri3.description: The pillar of the Ashen Wolf house. He comes to Askr, unsure about what he sees here, as it is so different from the darkness of Abyss. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Well, isn't this ocean nice? My old gang may be gone, but I wish I could bring them here, at least once.
A pleasant breeze, with blue sky and ocean as far as the eye can see... In Abyss, I forgot such things existed.
Looks as though Constance, Hapi, and Balthus are enjoying the ocean. I've never seen them this rowdy.
I've obtained everything I desire, from money to social status. The ocean, however, appears out of my reach.
Are you that impressed by my beach attire? I'll have to charge you if you look too long... Relax. I'm just teasing.
Visit: Here. I've been entrusted with this ocean souvenir. It's from your friend [F].
Level: What is it? Are you enthralled by the sight of me in my stylish beach attire?
We can't stay at the beach forever. Let's enjoy it to the fullest while we can. Don't get overheated, though!
I can't get focused for some reason... The novelty of visiting the beach may have caused me to overdo it a little.
Summon: I'm Yuri Leclerc of the Ashen Wolf House. Askr's ocean, huh? Looks interesting. I'll stick around for a bit.
Learn Skill: My youthful beauty is refreshed. Summer may be the most indulgent of seasons, wouldn't you say?
Confession:
Hey, [S]. I've enjoyed visiting Askr's ocean. It's a nice place to be.
Great food, a nice breeze, and sounds of laughter from all around. I wonder if heaven is like this?
But...I will return home to a dark back alley. This place is too bright for the Savage Mockingbird of the slums.
As long as I remain who I am, I cannot escape the underground. That is my immutable fate.
Still, even if I get but a single moment to walk out into the sunlight, I'm glad it can be peaceful like this.
Anyway! Enough depressing talk! We should swim again. Have fun while you can, or you'll miss out on life!
Status: Eheh.
Did you summon me to bring some charm to the beach this summer? *chuckle* Let's go, then.
Huh?! Ohoho, now you've done it! You're going under too!
Ugh, I'm going to end up sunburned, aren't I? Oh, that's not good. My face is one of my most charming features.
Spending summer vacation on the beach is truly a luxury pastime.
Are you really asking if I can swim? Eh! Who do you think I am? Of course I can swim!
Surrounded by all this wonderful scenery, I'm inspired to sing a song...
Enjoying the summer like this is nice. Allow me to treat you sometime to show my...appreciation.

heidrun3.name: Heiðrún
heidrun3.title: Peaceful Horizon
heidrun3.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands who heals people with her nectar. She visits Askr's ocean in search of peace, safety, and serenity.

Castle Hall: What a beautiful ocean. It would be delightful if I could walk along this beach with my entire family.
I saw the ocean when I traveled the nine realms as a member of the Healing Hands of Yggdrasill.
My nectar cures the body of maladies and toxins. If you have a drink this summer, it will be best served cold.
I have heard that the ocean is a source of life. The crashing of the waves is soothing to me...
This is my first time wearing a swimsuit. Does it look all right?
Visit: My name is Heðrún. I have come from the oceanside to deliver healing by way of [F]'s.
Level: The vast blue sea forever heals me.
The crashing of the waves is relaxing, isn't it? I feel as though I could listen to them forever.
Pushing beyond one's limits is...dizzying.
Summon: I am Heðrún, of the Healing Hands. I look forward to learning about the comfort that lies within Askr's ocean.
Learn Skill: Thank you for this wonderful summer memory.
Confession:
I am grateful you invited me to this beach, [S].
Although I am a Healing Hand, it seems I, myself, required healing.
When I saw Askr's ocean, I felt a new vigor arise within me.
The clear sea, the blue sky, the rustling wind, the tranquil tides... These things healed me.
Once again, I can feel the wonders of nature's beauty and experience the full blessings of our surroundings.
These things have made for an unforgettable summer, a soothing remedy for my heart.
Status: Ahehe...
I am so happy you summoned me to this beach. I am excited to experience the summer festivities.
*gasp* Oh! Is that a cold drink for me?
Although I cannot fight, I can swim with everyone in the ocean.
This swimsuit is quite comfortable and nice to swim in.
I have collected beautiful seashells as presents for my sisters.
I wish I could visit the beach with my entire family. It would be delightful.
Are you tired? Here, drink some of my nectar.

eikthyrnir3.name: Eikþyrnir
eikthyrnir3.title: Fit for Waves
eikthyrnir3.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands who prevents injury and illness through physical training. He has chosen Askr's ocean as his next place to train, pushing himself even harder.

Castle Hall: This is a good ocean. My sisters would be very happy to see it, Ratatoskr in particular...
Yggdrasill is a vast world with many branches. But there is nowhere as beautiful as this beach.
Remember to hydrate so your training doesn't become a burden.
I'm not a skilled swimmer. But I do like the ocean. It is the perfect place to train.
This garb is good for training, on land or in the sea.
Visit: I am Eikþyrnir. I came to tell you your friend is training hard in the tropics. That is, [F].
Level: My body has reached peak fitness. It will not stagger, even when struck by raging waves.
The sun gives me energy, fuels my training.
Pathetic... For the slightest heat to overwhelm my body...
Summon: I am Eikþyrnir, from Yggdrasill, the World-Tree. I hope to train in the sea. I'll best any wave that comes my way.
Learn Skill: Training on this beach has borne fruit.
Confession:
I have no talent for swimming. But that's not the only way to train at the ocean.
Running on the beach strengthens the legs. Meditating as the waves hit the rocks strengthens the mind.
And the heat causes sweat to pour from the body. You see, the ocean is the perfect place to condition.
It is filled with life. It nurtures it, helps it thrive.
I, too, will take on the challenge of the ocean. I will stir up a frenzy for life, with passion as hot as the sun.
I am grateful for this new place where I can hone my muscles. Thank you, [S].
Status: Hmm?
I am here to train on the beach.
If the world is too bright, you may stand in my shadow.
You see that speck in the distance? It's a boulder. I shall run there.
I am not a talented swimmer, so I will walk across the ocean floor.
While training, remember to replenish yourself with fresh water.
I would like to show my sisters to this beach.
Let's run on the beach together. It will be good training.

balthus2.name: Balthus
balthus2.title: Summer's Big Bet
balthus2.description: A former noble who loves gambling and alcohol. He feels lucky at Askr's ocean and decides to go for the big win. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: No way the bounty hunters are going to chase me all the way out here, right? Looks I can finally relax a bit!
This sunshine is so much better than the dismal dark of the underground! Lady Luck is smiling on me!
You want to know what I'm looking for? Heh. There must be a gambling house around here, don't you think?
Hey, do you wanna race to that island? Bet you I'll get there faster.
I'm not a fan of heavy layers or restrictive clothing. Being lightly dressed like this is fine by me.
Visit:
Delivery! We're going all out this summer at [F]'s.
How about a cool drink as thanks, then you can come join us.
Level: Did you see that?! Even in the ocean, the King of Grappling is in top form!
All done! Working up a sweat under the sun isn't so bad!
Hey, what's going on?! Don't tell me the goddesses of summer have abandoned me!
Summon: I'm Balthus von Albrecht, the man of the summer! I'm ready to cut loose at the beach!
Learn Skill: That's more like it! Seems my luck has turned. Time to go make the gamble of the summer!
Confession:
It's here! There's a wave of luck just around the corner. Enough luck for me to win big!
Can you feel it? It's as if the blazing sun and crashing waves are cheering me on!
All right, this is it! I'm going for a big win, [S].
Hey, don't fret. I'm not running off to gamble irresponsibly. I have a good feeling about this one.
Expect great things! Tomorrow, I'll be treating you to more frozen treats than you could eat in a lifetime!
I depart as the King of Grappling. I'll return as the Tropical King of Askr! Just you wait!
Status: Yeah?
You got good taste, inviting me to the beach in the summer! Thanks!
*shiver* That's cold! Is that a frozen treat you've got?
There's no way a bounty hunter would be hanging around by the ocean, right?
Hey! Have you seen Constance? She isn't withering away in this heat, is she?
Ah! Isn't this the best?! The crashing waves, the white sand, the...summer outfits.
With so many people gathering here, this looks like a great place for some gambling.
Don't be a stick in the sand! C'mon! You're going swimming too!

leif4.name: Leif
leif4.title: Sworn to Country
leif4.description: Son of Quan, prince of Leonster. He musters warriors to defeat the empire alongside Finn, to whom he owes his life. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776 / Genealogy of the Holy War.
leif4.origin: Genealogy of the Holy War + Thracia 776

Castle Hall: If the people are being mistreated, I wish to aid them. We should set off as soon as preparations are complete.
Unification of the Thracian peninsula was my father's life-long dream. It is my wish to carry on his will.
If I need to become the symbol of northern Thracia's liberation, then I will do nothing less.
Finn informed me Prince Shannan is a swordsman of impeccable skill and a great man, beloved by the people.
When I was a child, Ulster and Queen Áine's love kept me alive. I will not forget the debt I owe them!
Visit: I wish to free those suffering under the empire's oppression. Now I have [F]'s aid.
Level: I shall inherit our fathers' will, unify Thracia, and bring light to the world once more!
Until we reclaim northern Thracia, with its vast blue skies and lush green lands!
I need to be stronger. I am nothing like Lord Seliph of Chalphy, or Prince Shannan of Isaach...
Summon: I am Leif, of northern Thracia's liberation army. I will fight to live up to my father, hailed a knight of Njörun.
Learn Skill: I have received aid from many. I hope to repay those debts someday.
Confession:
My parents were slain in a battle long ago, and my homeland, Leonster, was occupied by the imperial army...
My father's knight, Finn, saved me... Protected by people across the land, I waited for my homeland's liberation.
My late father wished to save the people and reclaim peace for the Thracian peninsula.
I am grateful to Finn, who protected and raised me as a child despite the empire's harsh pursuit.
Finn never let me go hungry, even if it meant he did not eat. I can scarce imagine how difficult it was.
I want to live up to all he and those in the liberation army did... To defeat the empire and restore Leonster.
A dream I share with Finn. I will learn all I can here, and I will grow... I shall make that dream a reality!
Status: Hm.
These clothes bear the weight of responsibility.
Hey! Keep that up and you'll have to answer to Finn.
Restoring Leonster is our dream. The two of us have spoken of it often.
I will not run any longer. It's my duty to protect northern Thracia.
As long as I live, I will never forget the night Leonster fell.
Since then, it seems Finn has forgotten how to cry. And how to laugh...
No matter how hard the battle, I know that I will make it with you at my side.

machyua.name: Machyua
machyua.title: Blade of Gales
machyua.description: A member of the Magi, a group who work toward freeing Munster. A native child of Munster, she has strong animosity toward the empire. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Raydrik colluded with the Grannvale Empire while he was general of Connacht... Despicable!
Loptr's army is so cruel. It only takes one person to stand against them for them to burn everyone alive.
I am confident in my strength. You don't need to worry about me.
Time to get some training runs in. Would you like to join me?
I will never forgive the Grannvale Empire for kidnapping children to offer as Loptr sacrifices.
Visit: Friendships can last forever, you know? I come to offer just that, from as far as [F]'s.
Level: We will never stop fighting! Not until Munster is at peace.
Do not worry. I am with you.
Thank you, but you don't need to worry about me. I'll be fine.
Summon: I am Machyua, a member of the Magi. I believe I can be of use to you. Let's go!
Learn Skill: Are you sure? Thank you... Really.
Confession:
I will never forgive the empire for what they've done. Countless children sent to Belhalla...
Now that Munster is influenced by the Loptr Church, you never see children there... It is horrifying...
Of course, the Magi resist them, along with other brave citizens, but the empire overwhelms us every time.
Munster— No. The children should no longer be sacrificed! I beg you, [S]... Please...
Lend us your aid. You don't have to do it right now, but the sooner the better. The Magi are waiting.
Status: *sigh*
I am Machyua, a member of the Magi.
*gasp* You got me by surprise. *sigh* I still have a lot to learn here.
Lara is quite the picklock. You can rely on her.
My dream is to see a rebuilt and peaceful Munster. And I won't stop until I achieve it.
We in the Magi share the same goal. They are my dear comrades.
Munster will prosper again...
Do not worry. I am with you.

linoan.name: Linoan
linoan.title: Lady of Tarrah
linoan.description: A noblewoman who inherits her father's last wishes and leads the free city of Tarrah. She is promised in marriage to Arion, prince of Thracia. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: I have heard that the noble family of Tarrah is related to Grannvale royalty and are descendants of Saint Heim.
My father was prepared for what came of protecting Prince Leif. He said it was for the sake of the world...
Your kindness is unparalleled. If only the world was filled with people like you...
I heard tales of a free spirit, undisturbed by trifles, a valiant knight of the skies who could not be bested...
When I see a particular someone, I remember the tales of the crusader Dáinn that were told to me as a child.
Visit: I am Linoan. I have been blessed by all [F] has done.
Level: My father was proud to accept Lord Leif into Tarrah. I shall turn his pride into courage!
We made it through, somehow... I am forever grateful to you.
I shall return to Tarrah one day... No matter what!
Summon: I am Linoan. I stand against the empire for the liberty of Tarrah.
Learn Skill: You have my thanks, from the bottom of my heart.
Confession:
Please, allow me to explain my circumstances.
When the empire invaded northern Thracia, Tarrah remained free so long as it followed the empire's orders.
But my father, he... The empire killed him for protecting Prince Leif. They took our manor, and my freedom.
At times I lost sight of my pursuit. But I cannot lose heart. Tarrah needs me! The empire shall never be forgiven.
I thought you might understand my perspective, [S].
Let us both take action so that we can leave this world with no regrets.
Status: Mm...
Gods...please...
We are grateful.
I am Linoan. I serve as mayor of Tarrah, a free city.
I am deeply saddened by my father's death... Though I am proud of what he did.
The blood of Saint Heim...flows within me?
I will return to Tarrah one day, and Leif and I will see it as it once was.
I will stay with you. And one day, we will arrive at Tarrah...together.

homer.name: Homer
homer.title: Traveling Bard
homer.description: A bard who has traveled throughout Thracia, observing an age of war and chaos. It is said that his saga is beloved by many in the generations that follow him. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: I have no intention of staying long. I'll enjoy tonight, and then... We'll see what tomorrow brings.
I may not look it to you, but I am a bard. I happen to know what Prince Shannan really looks like.
Aw, thanks for asking, but...I've got plans tonight. Sorry to disappoint.
How about we rest and forget all our worries?
All right, all right... So, you really want my help?
Visit: How about a verse? It'll cost you a night of lodging, and perhaps a drink, if you're feeling generous.
Level: I'm supposed to be on the receiving end of service... Ugh! All right, only for today!
My body isn't the strongest, so don't force me to do any hard labor.
You can't be serious...
Summon: That's right, I'm a bard. You can call me Homer. A drink and a bed, heh! That's all I really need, if you ask me.
Learn Skill: A simple "thank you" is easy to say. But as a bard, how should I express this...
Confession:
Hey! I'm trying to nap here! Go on, leave me be, [S].
What?! You're so demanding, just like Princess Nanna.
Listen up. I'm not a strong fighter, and I've got no pride for my country or anything like that.
I'm definitely not a prince on a white horse who's out to save a princess. No... I'd rather sing about it.
I don't understand fighting for justice. Sometimes it's better to flip the coin and see what's on the other side.
This world isn't just made up of valiant heroes and pretty words...
People's passion for their countries is just a dream. But like a drink, it only lasts so long. I can understand that.
If I drank from that bottle, as long as I kept my eyes open, any drop left would be pure joy.
Status: Hm...
I doubt you've met a bard quite like me. You can call me Homer.
I'm trying to nap here. Go on, make yourself scarce.
Everyone wants to save their skins. It's not like I've got a duty to share the same fate as this country.
As you can see, I'm not very strong, so don't force me to do any hard labor.
If I don't help out, Nanna will hold it against me, won't she? *sigh* A woman's grudge is a scary thing.
I'd like to show my love to everyone here, but...ah, I'm only one man.
For you, I think I can cancel my previous plans.

meliai.name: Melíai
meliai.title: Warrior Wanderer
meliai.description: A mysterious warrior who attacks Askr. Though she has lost her memories, she has the power to travel between worlds.

Castle Hall: Askr... Father... Huh? What do you think you're lookin' at?!
I have always drifted from place to place. I've lost count of how many worlds I passed through.
Ash said our role here is to devote ourselves to you and your kind. So, tell me. How should I do that?
If I've got time to stare off into space, I've got time to train. Hey, be my opponent, will ya?
It's like I can feel Askr's presence in everyone I see here.
Visit: I was told to come greet you by [F]. How'd I do?
Level: I have the power now! And no matter what, I will meet Father!
What, that? Humph. That's nothin'! I can get that much done before sunup.
Damn! I can't meet Father like this...
Summon: The name's Melíai. Oh...you mean my true name? Only my father needs to use that.
Learn Skill: Th-thank you. I'll repay you for this.
Confession:
Of all the places I've been, this Askr's pretty high up there.
You're probably wondering about the other Askrs, huh?
Most of them are peaceful, and the people are friendly. But that's why I never quite fit in.
I'm sure my father protected them with his love. And that's how they became the way they are.
Humph. When I think of it like that, I get it. Now I wish I'd paid them the respect they're due.
This Askr... It's not the same as my father's. I'd like to care for it the way my father did his.
Status: I am Melíai. I chose that name myself.
You... Try that again and I'll crush you!
You sure that's me from another world? What a dimwit.
I have no family, no friends, nothing worth remembering...
I'm sure my fighting probably looks unrefined to you. That's because I taught myself.
Askr... Father...
You're not my enemy, right? Then I think you and I are all right for now.

dagdar.name: Dagdar
dagdar.title: Reformed Bandit
dagdar.description: A former leader of bandits who hid in Mount Violdrake. He changed his ways after meeting Eyvel and began to fight against the empire. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.

Castle Hall: Against the imperial army, even Eyvel would feel threatened.
It's hard to believe the imperial army would return to such a backwater. They must have had a good reason.
No one wants to starve to death, but it happens daily in southern Thracia. Everyone is desperate to survive...
While I was off visiting Fiana, one of my men went back to being a bandit. He may be strong, but he's an idiot.
Not to worry. I'll be here to help you out from now on.
Visit: Anyone up to no good around here? If so, send a message to Dagdar at Castle [F]!
Level: Imagine, calling me a skirt-chasing, senile old man! Those are fighting words. I'll take every one of them!
I'll slow them down. You go ahead.
I guess I haven't got a choice. Worst case, I'll gather up my old comrades and stage an assault with them.
Summon: I'm Dagdar. I may not be able to take on Eyvel, but I've got no trouble keeping up with those youngsters!
Learn Skill: Got it! I'll show them!
Confession:
I may not look it, but I was once a bandit. I led a massive group that made its home in Mount Violdrake.
None stood a chance against us. But, it wasn't right. Eyvel taught me that I was fighting the wrong people.
The imperial army's attack on Fiana stopped me on my way to Mount Violdrake, but I still plan to return.
I will cultivate the arid lands and grow food for the people there. When their bellies are full, their hearts can rest.
It won't make up for my past wrongs, but I want to help the starving kids in Thracia. That is my true desire now.
Status: Huh...
I'm Dagdar. I'm no bandit... I've washed my hands of that life.
What do you think you're— Oh, uh...sorry if I scared ya.
How is Tanya? I expect she's pulling her weight around here.
Prince Leif is no coward.
Not to worry. I've got no trouble keeping up with those youngsters!
Eyvel... You're really something... Even a seasoned fighter like me is no match for you.
From now on, you can count on me!

baldr.name: Baldr
baldr.title: Celestial Sun God
baldr.description: A god of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm, with a conceited nature. Responsible for accompanying accused criminals to the place of judgment.

Castle Hall: Mortals of Midgard... Ha! Benighted beings, far beneath the gods of Ásgarðr. Father taught me this.
My father rules the celestial realm, Ásgarðr. He possesses knowledge beyond that of any god.
Our duty is to carry out heaven's judgment. And so, we must align ourselves with truth and justice.
Höðr should stand upright. Her strength and beauty rivals even my own.
It is true that Ásgarðr and Vanaheimr are both realms of gods, though... Father was hostile toward Vanaheimr.
Visit: These mortals often forget their way. I, Baldr, Celestial Sun God, shall guide them along the path of righteousness.
Level: Ohoho! I see...
I am divine justice!
I stand, unfazed...
Summon: Take notice, mortals. I am Baldr, the celestial god of the sun. I have descended from the heavens.
Learn Skill: You... You have done well. I shall offer up my praise.
Confession:
I was once defeated, disgraced in utter humiliation that I never should have allowed.
Mortals are used to these types of failures... Yet they use them to propel themselves ever onward.
This requires great strength—strength that, I dare say, rivals that of the gods.
I, too, will continue to fight. No matter how many times I lose, I possess something that does not waver.
True justice remains, secure in my heart!
Status: I am Baldr, the celestial god of the sun.
*gasp* You insolent mortal— Your actions are unforgivable.
Incline your ears, meager mortals.
You, mortals... You have acquired powers that far exceed your station.
It should not be possible to harm me... So it was once said…
Even in the face of humiliation... Still, I stand...
For one to defeat me... Just who are you?

hodr.name: Höðr
hodr.title: Dusk Shadow God
hodr.description: A god of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm, with an introverted nature. Responsible for defending accused criminals at the place of judgment.

Castle Hall: I have imagined all sorts of things about the mortals of Midgard... I wonder what they are like...
I am to defend the accused on their judgment day. But I...cannot speak well. I fear that I...failed you...
When my eyes meet another's, my heart beats so fast I cannot think... I wish I could be like my sister...
Baldr is so strong, so beautiful, so graceful. Compared to her, I am...nothing.
My younger sister, Váli, and I always talk about Baldr. There is so much to admire about her.
Visit: H-hello? I, um...came with a greeting from [F].
Level: Baldr? Are you...watching?
Did I become...more like Baldr?
I am so sorry...
Summon: Um... I am Höðr... Is that all?
Learn Skill: Th-thank you. It makes me so happy that you thought of me.
Confession:
Baldr is perfect. She has...everything. I...have nothing. She glows so bright, I can hardly look at her.
It is all my fault...that she lost her protection and now...Father's trust.
She should blame me... Hate me... But, she does not...
No matter what happens, she will always be perfect... My idol...
I wish to repay her...for everything. So I will do all I can for her. That is... how I feel...
Status: Baldr...
Me? Um... I am Höðr. Is that all?
Oh, sorry...
My sister is so strong and so beautiful. I am...nothing like her.
Mortals are not wicked. It is the truth, I know it...
When we attacked the mortal world, I... I am so sorry.
All I have ever wanted is to be useful to my sister...
I'm sorry you must waste your time talking to me...

ingrid4.name: Ingrid
ingrid4.title: Cordial Teatime
ingrid4.description: Ingrid, daughter of Count Galatea, and Nanna, princess of House Nordion, fill the roles of servers with an air of relaxation. They appear in Fire Emblem: Three Houses / Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.
ingrid4.harmonized:
Grants "unit can move 1 extra space" to unit (that turn only; does not stack).
Grants【Resonance: Blades】and【Empathy】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn.
Once used, Harmonized Skill cannot be activated again right away. At start of every third turn, if Harmonized Skill has already been used, unit can use Harmonized Skill again.
【Resonance: Blades】Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Empathy】
Grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = number of types of【Bonus】effects, excluding stat bonuses, and【Penalty】effects, excluding stat penalties, active on player team and enemy team during combat (max 7).
【Bonus】
All effects that last "for 1 turn" or "that turn only." Includes bonuses granted by a skill like Rally or Hone and positive status effects (extra movement or effects like Dominance).
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).

Castle Hall: **Ingrid:** What delicious looking tea treats! So colorful... And that sweet aroma... No! I need to wait on the customers first.
**Ingrid:** The time I spent sipping tea with the professor was precious to me. Those memories help support me now.
**Nanna:** Ingrid is so earnest about choosing sweets to pair with the tea. I would like to learn from her example.
**Ingrid:** Princess Nanna, that tea-server outfit looks adorable on you! Seeing you in it makes my heart happy.
**Nanna:** I would like to express my gratitude to those who have watched over me. Maybe I will repay them with this tea.
Visit: **Nanna:** I am Nanna of House Nordion. This invitation to tea was placed in my care by [F].
Level: **Nanna:** I will give those I love the gift of some extra special time.
**Ingrid:** I shall proceed along the path of being a bold and just server!
**Nanna:** I am sorry, it seems I got the blend of tea leaves all wrong...
Summon: Are you prepared, Princess Nanna? I am here to aid you. We shall do a grand job fulfilling the role of servers!
Learn Skill: **Ingrid:** What kind of tea party sweet is this?! Princess Nanna, um, m-may I try just one little bite? Please.
Confession:
**Ingrid:** Princess Nanna, as someone devoted to becoming a knight, I found the tale of Hoðr, the black knight, fascinating!
**Nanna:** If there is time, I have more stories of the legendary 12 crusaders to tell. Perhaps I could share them over tea?
**Ingrid:** Yes! I would be delighted to prepare the tea for that. I have learned so much about brewing and serving it.
**Nanna:** Oh? I would also like to brew tea for you sometime. I am more confident in my ability to prepare it now.
**Ingrid:** Well then, let us make some tea and take turns serving one another?
**Nanna:** Haha! That sounds like a lovely time, indeed. I look forward to tasting the tea you prepare for me, Ingrid.
Status: Hm?
"So many delicious looking sweets... No. Today, I am the server." "Um, Ingrid, are you all right?"
Conversation: **Ingrid:** This is delicious! Princess Nanna, you excel at making tea.
**Nanna:** Ah, it is nothing. I am used to serving tea to my father and Lord Leif.
**Ingrid:** Ah, that makes perfect sense. I heard that Lord Leif is a childhood friend of yours.
**Nanna:** Yes. We grew up around each other. He has always been kind.
He's also very enthusiastic about the art of combat and his studies. I have great respect for him.
**Ingrid:** Uh, he sounds wonderful, especially when compared to some of my childhood friends.
**Nanna:** Did they cause you trouble?
**Ingrid:** Not that much. There are many things I can respect them for now, but...
They could still benefit from some... self-improvement, and can be a lot to deal with at times.
**Nanna:** Oh dear. That must be difficult. At the same time, it sounds as if it could be entertaining.
**Ingrid:** Heh, I suppose it does keep things from getting boring.
**Nanna:** Will they also be attending the tea service today?
**Ingrid:** I believe they are coming. They can't pass up an opportunity to give me a hard time while I'm serving tea.
**Nanna:** I am looking forward to it. You must introduce me.
**Ingrid:** I will. Also, um... Before they arrive, would you be willing to teach me the proper way to brew tea?
I'd like to prepare the tea for my friends myself.
**Nanna:** I would be happy to show you! Let us make this a lovely little tea party.

felix4.name: Felix
felix4.title: Savant's Service
felix4.description: Heir to House Fraldarius who fearlessly devotes himself to the way of the sword. How will he master his new role as tea-party server? Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I must never allow Ingrid, the boar, or any of the others to see me wearing this... Especially not Sylvain...
If you have time for tea, go practice swordsmanship instead. That's how I live and how I plan to keep living.
I have to choose the right tea leaves for the tea... You appear to be idle. You can accompany me as I do so.
I prefer practical clothing. But, if the tea party requires this, I will merely note my objection for the record.
This tea set is of exceptional quality. Like a fine weapon, if it is handled with skill, its quality shines through.
Visit:
So you're the one who requested my exceptional tea service. This blend blew away [F].
Give it a taste.
Level: This is my signature brew. Go on, have a sip!
You'll never catch me serving tea at the wrong temperature.
What's with that dissatisfied scowl? Hold on! I'll pour you another cup!
Summon: I'm Felix, and today I'm serving as a waiter. If you want some of my tea, show me a resolve worthy of it.
Learn Skill: Hmph. I'm not sure what you hoped for, but I can thank you with this cup of hot tea.
Confession:
When talk of this server business reached me, I thought you had lost your mind.
Have you never heard the saying "find the right person for the job"?
My duty as a server began before I was convinced there was any point... but then I noticed something.
Above all, a server must focus on the needs of their customers. That's an expectation I can easily meet.
You must keep a watchful eye on all your customers and promptly assess their needs at any moment.
As in battle, you can't win by blindly swinging a sword. It's crucial to be able to read your foe's intentions.
While serving, I refined situational observation skills I can make use of as I follow the path of the sword.
Status: Mm...
