You aren't familiar with the saying, "The right person for the right job," are you? I'll do what you ask, but...
Watch it! Can't you see I'm holding a tea set?!
If you have time to drown yourself in tea... Well, whatever. I'll keep my thoughts to myself.
Slacking off? Of course not. I am waiting for the tea pot to heat up.
No matter how many tea cakes I bring, they vanish immediately. I don't understand.
I have seen many kingdoms devastated by war. But this is different... Could this be what peace looks like?
You may drink the tea I've poured. I can't guarantee you'll enjoy the taste, though.

celine3.name: Céline
celine3.title: Blissful Tea Party
celine3.description: Princess of Firene. Serves the ultimate tea that grants deep satisfaction to any who drink it. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: You don't have to use only the high-quality tea leaves. Any tea can be the best if it makes you happy.
Firene is the preeminent grower of tea. I once snuck out to a village there to see the tea fields for myself.
I love selecting flowers for the table. Like pretty peonies! Perhaps I should put out your favorite flowers today.
A legend says that tea in which lucky leaves float will cure any illness. How wonderful would it be if it were true?

I used to be quite skilled at guessing the origin of different teas when I tasted them.
I shall have to start from scratch and study up on the teas popular in Askr.
Visit: I would like to have tea with you next time, but today I bring you a greeting from [F].
Level: This makes me happy. A tea with a bright floral aroma would suit these sentiments perfectly.
I'm pleased with these results. Let us refresh with a fruity tea and continue awhile longer.
Shall I brew a calming herbal tea?
Summon: I am Céline. I feel truly blessed to be invited to a tea party in this world. If it pleases you, I will serve the tea.
Learn Skill: Thank you for treating me to this. It made for a fantastic tea party.
Confession:
Welcome, [S]. I am delighted you made it today. I will start brewing your favorite tea right away.
Mmm, this aroma. From now on, I will recall this pleasant, relaxing time we spent together when I brew this tea.
In Firene, attending tea parties was an official duty, but those were rife with tense formality and subtle politics.
Enjoying this time with Heroes from other worlds, free of that rivalry, is an exceptionally rare treat for me.
Thank you. If I ever return to days of chaos and war, these memories will strengthen my heart to keep fighting.
Status: *giggle*
I changed clothes to serve as a tea party hostess... This outfit suits me, don't you agree?
Oh! It would be awful if I spilled the tea. Please be patient and partake of some confections.
You would like another cup? These tea leaves do have the most wonderful floral aroma.
I was always the one being served in Firene, but I actually longed to try being a server myself.
This is so delicious. I have outdone myself. *giggle* I must have one more taste, just to be sure, of course.
I remember indulging in tea parties often as a child. I had tea with my mother, my older brother, and...my father...
I hope you have fun today. I plan to fill your cup to the brim with heartwarming joy.

veronica6.name: Veronica
veronica6.title: Royal Reception
veronica6.description: Imperial princess of the Emblian Empire. Hosts a tea party, acting as server, to deepen her ties with Askr, which she once was hostile toward.

Castle Hall: What a pleasant aroma. Tea calms the heart, soothes the nerves...and in time, brings tranquility.
I can't believe I'm here, drinking tea with...friends.
I am sorry I broke a cup... What? Don't be down? OK. I'll be more careful next time.
This outfit is lovely... I think I prefer it to what I usually wear.
I would like to have a tea party with my brother and sister someday. I wonder if they would enjoy my tea...
Visit:
I am Veronica, princess of Embla. This tea party invitation is from [F].
You will come, won't you?
Level: May this cup be a bridge that connects Embla and Askr.
If you would like more, just ask. I will get it for you.
I am sorry... Was it too hot?
Summon: I am Veronica, princess of Embla. I would be happy to develop Embla and Askr's bonds over some tea.
Learn Skill: I've learned how to brew a delicious cup of tea.
Confession:
I've thought of many ways the Emblian Empire and the Kingdom of Askr can deepen their bonds...
But now I know... Sitting face to face and enjoying tea together, in peace and warmth, is the simplest way.
Time spent this way builds trust, so bonds grow deeper...
I'm still not used to this, but... I wish for those who drink my tea to enjoy it. That would make me truly happy.
Status: Oh.
If you're having a tea party, I can serve...if you need help...
*gasp* *sigh* You almost made me spill the tea.
So many delicious-looking pastries...
There are so many sorts of teas... I like the ones with a pleasant aroma.
This outfit is so...cute. And fluttery too.
I wish I could have tea with Letizia and Bruno...like we used to...
Have a seat. I'll brew up one of my best teas for you.

finn2.name: Finn
finn2.title: Devoted Service
finn2.description: A devoted vassal who serves Leonster's royal family. Trading his trusty lance for a tea set, he puts his skills as server on display. Appears in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776.
finn2.artist: Makimura Shunsuke (マキムラシュンスケ)

Castle Hall: I would like to use this opportunity to gift Lord Leif a moment in which he can rest and enjoy a warm cup of tea.
I know the importance of taking time to appreciate tea. Lord Quan and Lady Ethlyn valued such moments.
If peace comes to the world, and I no longer have to fight, one thing I plan to enjoy is teatime with my daughter.
I am not used to such attire, but it would be boorish to don armor for tea. I shall endeavor to wear it well.
A cup of tea calms the nerves and gives one time to reflect. I would be pleased to aid in that pursuit.
Visit: I am Finn of Leonster. I bring with me some high-quality tea leaves sent to you by [F].
Level: How is the tea? I pray the time you spend sipping at it will be fruitful for you.
The path to proper tea cannot be traveled in a single day. I must devote myself to the practice.
Did I let my guard down?
Summon: I am Finn, a knight of Leonster. I am pleased to act as a server for all from the Order of Heroes this day.
Learn Skill: I shall strive to improve so that I never forget to consider others.
Confession:
I have spent my days fighting foes as a knight.
Now I'm learning how warmth and hospitality are essential to providing guests an enjoyable experience.
It is an attitude that shares similarities with the loyalty and service a retainer gives to their lord.
I must consider how I can make the guests smile, or what they might wish for, then make those things a reality.
It gives me an opportunity to grow as a person, not only as a knight. I am grateful to you for this experience.
Status: Aha.
I am uncertain if I am suited to be a server, but I will put forth my best effort.
Oh! Do be careful. If the tea spilled, it could burn someone.
I would like to ensure that Lord Leif is served the finest tea.
I believe my daughter would appreciate these beautiful sweets.
Taking time to enjoy tea can warm...even the depths of one's heart.
Lord Quan and Lady Ethlyn often conversed over tea...
It would please me if you tried a cup of the tea I have brewed.

sharena4.name: Sharena
sharena4.title: Hopeful Princess
sharena4.description: Princess of Askr. Dons the same garb as her mother, Henriette, and swears to bring peace back to the land.

Castle Hall: The tome of Hero introductions I've been creating has gotten pretty thick, but there's no way I'm stopping now!
I didn't get this far all on my own. I've been encouraged along the way by the voices of so many others.

The very existence of Askr has been threatened many times, but we rise up when things seem hopeless.
Our indomitable will gives us the strength to do so.
My goal was to make one thousand Heroes my friends. I did it! In fact, I made even more than that!
It's nerve-racking putting on clothes like my mother's. I will aim to be an upstanding royal worthy of this attire.
Visit: Hey, [S]! I come with a letter from [F].
Level: I shall keep growing stronger for as long as it's possible to do so. Just watch me!
Alfonse! Commander Anna! I'm really improving, aren't I?
Ahaha... It's important not to let your guard down, huh?
Summon: I am Princess Sharena of Askr. My greatest treasures are the bonds I've formed with my Hero friends.
Learn Skill: I can feel it! I've got even more rapid growth ahead of me!
Confession:
Do you think I can become the princess everyone wants me to be, [S]?
Up until now I've felt in my heart as though I have allowed myself to rely on others more than I should.
Almost as if, no matter the dilemma we faced, I knew the Heroes lending us their aid would save Askr for us.
From now on I will strive to do my part as princess of Askr and repay them for the debt we owe them.
And, with this oath in my heart, I will fight alongside Alfonse, to support our mother!
Watch me, Father. I will protect the family and country you loved!
Status: Oh.
My mother was a wonderful, noble lady. Do I remind you of her?
Aw... So much for looking composed and sophisticated.
Were a lot of people calling out to me, or was that just my imagination?
I want to become a strong and beautiful woman, capable of protecting everyone, just like my mother.
Alfonse and I are matching now! Like Mother and Father.
I do wish Father could have seen me like this...
Watch as your Sharena shines brighter than ever!

baldr2.name: Baldr
baldr2.title: Rays of Judgement
baldr2.description: A god of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm. She beams with confidence as she accompanies accused criminals to their judgment.

Castle Hall: An attempt to conquer all nine realms is an ambition neither I nor heaven will forgive!
There is not one thing the king of heaven does not know or see. Yet...
We gods of Ásgarðr are powerful and just. We are model examples for mortals to emulate.
Höðr and Váli are my beloved sisters, gods of Ásgarðr. Together, we carry out Alfaðör's will.
This attire is fitting for a god of heaven. May it bestow upon me even more strength and brilliance.
Visit: I have come as a messenger, wishing you good health and fortune, from [F]'s castle.
Level: Ohohohoho! May heaven's rays of judgment burn into your eyes!
Ha! Such a manner is befitting the Celestial Sun God.
I cannot believe I left myself vulnerable to such criminals...
Summon: I am Baldr, the Celestial Sun God. My rays of judgment shall illuminate every corner of the world!
Learn Skill: Ohoho! You have earned my praise.
Confession:
You must wonder why we gods of Ásgarðr bear such incredible power.
We are granted such power for the sake of truth and justice, to overcome deceit and immorality.
And with it, we have a duty to watch over the nine realms and guide them down a path of righteousness.
For this is the will of heaven, and we will stand against all who resist it.
We have a responsibility to uphold absolute justice.
Any who attempt to disrupt our pursuit are to be taken to the place of judgment!
I will continue fighting for that cause, no matter what!
Status: Ohohohoho...
Ohohohoho! Dazzled by my new look, are we?
Do you not fear the repercussions of your actions?
Höðr and Váli are my darling younger sisters.
I must set an example, not only for my sisters, but humanity as well.
My father, Alfaðör, the king of heaven, rules with absolute judgment. His verdict determines your fate.
We gods of Ásgarðr must value truth and justice above all else.
I will remain here until I discern your true nature.

eikthyrnir4.name: Eikþyrnir
eikthyrnir4.title: Resolved to Train
eikthyrnir4.description: A member of Yggdrasill's Healing Hands who answers the call of many, tautening his body with power.

Castle Hall: Equipment is unreliable. The body is the most trustworthy in battle.
No matter the world, I will train beside those who seek healing. That is how I can heal.
Everyone chooses their own form of training. The important thing is the desire to train.
No, not Eiþkyþir. I am Eikþyrnir.
This is the same clothing as Læraðr. I must uphold his will to value and respect life.
Visit: Training will open the future for you, as it has for [F].
Level: There are heights only achievable through harsh training.
I need not talk much. My muscles do that for me.
My heart must be forged alongside my body.
Summon: I hear voices of those who wish to train. I, Eikþyrnir, will train them until they can go no further.
Learn Skill: Training does not lie. My muscles attest to this.
Confession:
I do not forge my muscles for power. I have one wish—for peaceful days with my family. I train to protect that.
Each one of us has something precious to protect. My muscles give me the strength to do that.
Muscles fend off illness, uncertainty, even fatigue. They are the most powerful armor.
Understand? That is why I promote training above all else.
Strength is a bridge. Let us train together and cross that bridge to a bright future.
Status: The same clothing as Læraðr? An honor I am unfit for...
Hm? Are you curious about the outfit? It is Læraðr's.
Many voices called to me.
The Order of Heroes is well suited for training. Many of great strength can be found among its ranks.
Both body and mind grow stronger with training.
I only wished for peaceful days with my family, just like everyone else...
I would like to keep training beside you.

mbyleth5.name: Byleth
mbyleth5.title: Anchor of Hope
mbyleth5.description: A former mercenary, and once a teacher at the Officers Academy. Wields the blade of another world for those who seek peace. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I feel as though the time I spent at Garreg Mach taught me so much and helped me grow as a person.
I inherited a lot from my father. I will pass those rarer assets on.
I was just a mercenary, yet I became a teacher and am now being hailed as a Hero. Life is indeed strange.
I'd like to check for items people may have dropped. Will you go patrolling with me, [S]?
On me, this uniform leaves a different impression from when my students wear it, but...does it suit me?
Visit: I'm Byleth. I come bearing a personal letter for you to read from [F].
Level: Before I advance, I wish to consider why I posses the power to fight with these hands of mine.
I must continue with my studies if I am to guide my students.
I cannot stand before my students like this...
Summon: I am Byleth. Let us study and progress into the future without losing anyone.
Learn Skill: I shall study more and more and, by doing so, continue to grow stronger.
Confession:
What a strange turn of events. I had been a mere mercenary, but I came to guide my students as a teacher.
Now, as a Hero in Askr, everyone expects even more. I am tasked with bringing about peace.
I have faced many challenges, but I never overcame them on my own.
My power came from bonds shared with my allies and students, and from Sothis, supporting me from within.
This power I have nurtured...I shall continue to use it for everyone. My father and Sothis would want that.
As long as there is need, I shall go on using it to protect the hope that will carry us into the future.
Status: Huh?
This is the uniform my students wear. How does it look on me?
Huh? You know, I could end up stepping on your foot if you crowd me like this.
The other teachers looked at me strangely when I greeted them wearing this.
I could imagine my students teasing me if I came to class in this.
You may find this hard to believe, but the goddess Sothis once dwelt within me.
I thought I heard many voices calling out for me. Could that have been some form of guidance...
Let us continue fighting together...for peace in the world.

bruno.name: Bruno
bruno.title: Masked Knight
bruno.description: A masked knight whose identity and motives are a mystery.

Castle Hall: The blood of Embla's royalty was cursed to harbor murderous urges toward any associated with Askr.
Alfonse... I may look like someone you knew, but I am not that person. Time's course cannot be reversed.
Veronica also suffered Embla's curse. I hope she escapes the chains of our blood to walk a just path as princess.
The Sharena of this world learned to wield a spear from me? Hmm. I do see familiar elements in her style.
Zacharias... That name exists only in your memory of a man who is not likely to appear before you again.
Visit: My name does not matter. I shall go, now that you have what I was sent to deliver from [F].
Level: I have something I must accomplish, so I cannot falter here.
Unless you wish to close off your destiny, you would be wise not to approach me.
I was certain I had no undue pride, and yet... How feckless of me.
Summon: I am no one worthy of mention, but if an introduction is required... Bruno is what I was once called.
Learn Skill: So this is the form your trust takes? Then I must prove it is deserved.
Confession:
I have discussed the truth with you before. I am not the one you seek.
I am merely an individual who came here from another world.
Yet, you may see in me the shadow of a man who will never stand before you again.
Looking at the faces here, I can tell he was truly beloved. That he was precious to you...
Believe me when I tell you I can never replace him. I came to this world with a purpose... Something I must do.
All I can do is see this through to the end...and try not to dishonor him.
Status: Hmm...
I have no name with which to introduce myself to you. Pay me no mind.
You mustn't stand so close. We are not allies, remember.
I hail from a world entirely different from this one, in search of...something.
I am not with Embla. Nor am I with you.
The one whom you seek will never return. It is time you accept this.
I believe the me of this world is...no longer...
This is a contract, nothing more. I am at your command.

diamant3.name: Diamant
diamant3.title: Fortified King
diamant3.description: Young king of Brodia. Possesses a tenacious heart that stands against adversity without fail. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall:
I have fond memories of Roy as the Emblem entrusted to my country.
When I encounter other Roys, I feel I may unintentionally speak to them as though they were him.
In Elyos, the thirteen rings exist along with a single Emblem now. A great person who brought us all together.
I saw many a general and king perish on the battlefield in the last war. I ask that you not push beyond your limits.
I shall rule as the new king of Brodia, with my father's strength...and amiability toward Elusia he never had.
Ore and crystals mined in Brodia are exported to Elusia. Proof one can work amicably with a former enemy.
Visit:
Am I to understand you are a friend of [F]?
Do not hesitate to visit our castle and nurture a friendship that will last for a long time to come.
Level: As king of Brodia, I want to present an image that the people can be proud of.
These are satisfying results. You have my gratitude.
This does not mean our forces have been weakened. Let us fight on with the strength we have.
Summon: I am Diamant, king of Brodia. With all my might, I will help bring peace and prosperity to every land.
Learn Skill: As an inexperienced king, I am pleased to know I have your confidence.
Confession:
Ah, it's you, [S]. I was deep in thought, thinking about the kind of king I will be for Brodia.
I never believed I was as strong as my father. Now, as king, I realize he must have felt the same way I do.
Though he may have been fearful and uncertain at times, he maintained the image of a strong king for all of us.
I had opinions about his policies, but I should follow his example, and give people a sturdy shoulder to lean on.
It would be difficult to accomplish alone. I will count on you. I hope you can listen as a friend whom I trust.
Status: Ah.
Shortly after the war ended, I was crowned the king of Brodia.
*chuckle* That tickles. Laughter really does release tension.
Alcryst and my retainers have continued to support me since my ascension to the throne.
Though many oppose the idea, I would like to work toward friendly relations with Elusia during my reign.
"Rise up, Emblem of Binding..." *sigh* I realize the invocation serves no purpose for me, and yet...
Father, I will honor your last words to me, and continue to live...strong of body...strong of heart.
We continue protecting Elyos alongside the Divine Dragon. That is, the Divine Dragon Monarch. Being under different skies does not change that.

fir4.name: Fir
fir4.title: Dual Warriors
fir4.description: Fir, a girl who earnestly follows the path of the sword, with her mother, Karla, a sword master. Side by side, they battle with stunning grace at the tournament. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade / The Blazing Blade.
fir4.origin: The Binding Blade + The Blazing Blade
fir4.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit for 1 turn and grants Special cooldown count-2 to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Any effect that can be triggered only once per turn by unit's equipped Special skill can be triggered again if that effect has already been triggered (excludes boosted Special effects from engaging).
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Karla:** I consider myself a blade, not a person... I am sure there are others here with this same attitude.
**Fir:** I'll showcase the strength I got from my mother and my uncle at this tournament. No matter what!
**Karla:** I'm shocked to see that my daughter grew to be so skilled. I suppose it's in her blood.
**Fir:** This is like a dream, seeing my mother's swordsmanship up close like this. I've always looked up to her.
**Karla:** Don't rely on your shoulders, Fir. First, observe your opponent, then let your sword guide you
Visit: **Nanna:** I'm Fir and I'm here with my mother. Hm... People are strong here too, just like at [F]'s.
Level: **Karla:** Fir, don't forget how you wielded your blade just now. You struck with your entire soul.
**Karla:** I won't allow you to see through the flash of my blade so easily.
**Fir:** I'm so sorry for holding you back, Mother. It's all my fault for being so inexperienced...
Summon: I'm Fir, a traveling swordswoman. A tournament is the best training. I'll be champion with my mother beside me!
Learn Skill: **Fir:** Someday, I'll cut my own path into the future, just like Mother and Uncle!
Confession:
**Karla:** When the tournament is over, I will depart. The path of the sword has no end.
**Fir:** I-I will go with you, then! There's so much I want to learn from you!
**Karla:** With all these swordsmen from different worlds, I'm sure there's a lot you can learn here.
And even still, there should be more you can learn from your father, Bartre, too.
You should stay here and keep growing in the Order of Heroes, Fir.
And promise me, next we meet, your skill will surpass mine and my brother's.
**Fir:** I...understand, Mother. I will fulfill this promise, no matter what. And when I do, I will come see you!
Status: Haa...
"I can't believe I get to show you the results of all my training! It's like a dream!" "Just don't hurt yourself. I think you're making too big a deal out of this."
Conversation: **Fir:** Hah! Hyah!
**Karla:** Hyaaah!
**Fir:** Ah, curses, there goes my sword... Well fought. You really are strong!
This is like a dream, facing off against a young version of you, Mother.
**Karla:** Mother? Oh, yes. Well, you have the right principles. And I'm sure you'll keep growing.
**Fir:** Really? Thank you.
I'll aim for the skies and train extra hard to get even stronger! Just like you and my uncle.
**Karla:** Uncle? Oh, you mean Karel. He is a harsh man. I doubt he would teach you.
**Fir:** Huh? Actually, he's really nice. He's guided me with open arms.
**Karla:** So then...people can change.
Tell me, is everyone in your world healthy? Your father? Karel?
**Fir:** Yeah, they are.
**Karla:** I see. And you too, it seems, judging by the looks of you.
Then...there's nothing more I could wish for. This makes me truly happy.
**Karla:** Now then. Enough warming up. Let's get to the tournament.
**Fir:** Let's! And I'll be the champion, as long as I have you by my side!
Back Unit Supporting: Show me what you can do.

lucina9.name: Marth
lucina9.title: Masked Gladiator
lucina9.description: A masked swordsman, referring to themself with the same name as the legendary Hero-King of old. Splendid technique is on display here at the tournament. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I must fight in a way that doesn't bring shame to the Hero-King, since I am borrowing his name!
A tournament... This reminds me of when I crossed swords with Father after traveling through time.
Hm? Prince Marth has come to the tournament to cheer on the gladiator Ogma? That's a bit problematic...
I can't believe Father is participating in the tournament this time too! This is... Oh. Never mind.
I need to keep the mask on, even if I change my attire. I must not reveal who I really am...yet.
Visit: I am Marth. Here's an invite for you to the Regna Ferox tournament from [F].
Level: I will cut a path to the future using this skill!
I've practiced this technique in order to survive. No one will best me!
I thought I still had more growth ahead of me, but...
Summon: My name is Marth. I was hoping to join the tournament. This is not my first time competing in one.
Learn Skill: I'll grow even stronger and resist the future of despair!
Confession:
I appreciate you inviting me to the tournament, [S].
I feel as though participating in it and experiencing the fighting spirit of the gladiators has improved my skills.
I would like to reveal my true identity, only to you, since you are looking out for me. However...
What? You don't expect me to reveal it? So you understand the position I am in? You are insightful, indeed.
I promise you, I shall use any strength I gained in the tournament here for Askr's benefit.
For I believe that doing so will help us to avoid the future of despair.
Status: Mm, yes.
I am Marth. For the duration of this tournament, I will not be holding back.
*startle* To think, I would let myself be caught off guard... And this close to the tournament, too.
So I fight with a lance this time... I will make good use of any weapon I am given.
Basilio once pressed me to represent the western army of Regna Ferox.
*sneeze* Uh...er. It's nothing. Regna Ferox is just a cold place.
Father was quite the hot-blooded young man back then... U-uh, what?! I didn't say anything.
I promise I will bring you victory. Watch and see.

chrom9.name: Chrom
chrom9.title: Pivotal Blow
chrom9.description: Prince of the Halidom of Ylisse. He participates in the tournament, not as royalty, but as a lone gladiator. Appears in Fire Emblem Awakening.

Castle Hall: I'm enjoying the festival, but I'm preparing for the tournament. I don't intend to lose.
Your birthplace and upbringing don't matter in a tournament. Your skill in combat is what counts!
Regna Ferox greatly values strength. In the past, we fought in a tournament to forge an alliance with them.
I once fought with the one who goes by Marth's name. It seems the warrior is wearing the same mask.
Arena attire isn't especially refined, but it is easy move around in. It's meant to be worn by a warrior.
Visit: I'm Chrom of the Halidom of Ylisse. I am participating in a tournament at [F]'s castle.
Level: I've nurtured this power alongside my allies. The bonds I share with them strengthen my weapon.
My experience in the Shepherds has made a difference.
I clearly haven't trained enough...
Summon: I'm Chrom. I'm not acting as royalty of Ylisse right now. I am just another fighter in the arena.
Learn Skill: Good technique. I'll put it to use to change the future!
Confession:
Were you watching me while I was fighting, [S]?
In a tournament one's abilities do the talking. No one here will take it easy on me because I'm royalty.
And I have no intention of relying on that status to gain advantage. I will fight as an individual gladiator.
There are so many capable fighters outside of Ylisse. If you count other worlds, the number seems infinite.
I wish to become more capable by crossing blades with them, so I can better protect my family and friends.
Oh, I hear Basilio now. I wonder who my next opponent is! Watch me cut a path to the future by my own hands!
Status: A fighting tournament, huh... I hadn't expected to ever participate in another one.
*surprise react* Hey? Are you trying to sabotage me before the tournament?
The last time I went to Regna Ferox... Well, it was certainly chilly.
I've heard it is tradition in Regna Ferox for the ruling khan to be decided by a tournament.
Ah! The bow string snapped again. I'll fetch another.
That masked warrior... Hm. I suppose the mask is how he makes an impression.
No matter how hard the fight, I don't intend to lose. Watch me in action.

chulainn2.name: Chulainn
chulainn2.title: Leading Gladiator
chulainn2.description: A gladiator who knows nothing of defeat and who has inherited the blood of the crusader Od. He proves he is still no less capable of winning here at the tournament. Appears in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

Castle Hall: I take each battle one at a time. That devotion is what's gotten me this far.
True justice comes in the form of fighting for an ideal... For the sake of others, not for money.
A battlefield is similar to an arena, but each requires something different. One must know this in order to win.
I shall see how the techniques I have developed fare against warriors from other worlds.
I'm not used to this outfit, but I think I'll be able to make good use of my skills while wearing it.
Visit: Excuse me. I'm Chulainn. I have here for you an invitation to a tournament from [F].
Level: Skill does not decide the victor. Rather, it is the fighting spirit to not lose no matter what.
No matter the battle I face, I have no intention of losing.
I have no excuses. The result speaks for itself.
Summon: I'm Chulainn, a gladiator. A tournament of warriors, hm? I sense this will be quite the festival.
Learn Skill: I expect no less from a festival of a warrior nation. There is much to be gained here.
Confession:
I once had nowhere to go after all my victories at the arena...
But I learned of a new pathway to victory—fighting for my ideals, rather than for money.
This revealed to me the true meaning of my life, when I had nothing left.
The others who fight in this tournament are all gladiators who fight for their ideals, not for riches.
Through my battles with them, I have a renewed strength in fighting for my convictions.
I am determined to save as many lives as possible with these hands. That'll never change, even after this is over.
Status: The tournament of another world, is it? This brings back memories of my time in the arena.
Hmph. It's not wise to approach someone who has a weapon in hand.
What do I get if I win this tournament? If it's money, I no longer need it...
I am not used to this weapon, but neither am I used to losing.
Everyone has their own reason to fight. So... What's yours?
The beautiful girl who stole my heart... I hope she's watching me from somewhere...
It is interesting traveling to another world. I have a feeling I'll never get bored being with you.

ogma3.name: Ogma
ogma3.title: Former Gladiator
ogma3.description: Captain of a group of mercenaries who swore his loyalty to Princess Caeda of Talys. His capabilities are on full display here at the tournament. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: I represent Talys, and I won't betray Princess Caeda's trust in me. She's here in the crowd.
When I fought in arenas in the past, I was forced to show off my skills. But here, I'll put my pride on the line.
All of the tournament participants have exceptional fighting spirits. Each one worth a thousand men.
I hear that many in Regna Ferox have a ferocious temperament. Bord, Cord, and Barst'll fit right in.
I know what I need to do, and that is to defeat any foe that stands before me. No matter the equipment I use.
Visit: You've been invited to participate in a tournament from Regna Ferox at [F]'s castle.
Level: Thanks to you, I've fought some mighty powerful foes. As such, I've gained more power with the sword.
Princess Caeda is watching. I can't make a fool of myself.
I wasn't reckless, I was simply not up to the task.
Summon: I'm Ogma, a mercenary. Since I've been entrusted with representing Talys, I plan to achieve victory here.
Learn Skill: Another technique I can use to survive...
Confession:
Did you know I used to live as a hardened gladiator who spent day in and day out covered in blood?
The only way I could survive was to achieve victory with the sword.
But I knew there had to exist a way to compete in the pursuit of strength, rather than killing.
It would be a battle of techniques, fought with respect...
And that's what I've found here at this festival... It's not what I'm used to. It's like a dream.
You have my gratitude for providing such a proud stage we get to fight on, [S].
Status: I'm Ogma. For now, I'm an arena fighter.
Hm? You want to test who's stronger ahead of the tournament? All right then.
A tournament held in an arena sounds like a fitting event for someone like me.
The cheering here is...lively and joyful. Not what I'm used to.
I hear there are lands where the ruler is chosen by combat... It's actually quite noble.
I hope Princess Caeda enjoys this tournament as well.
You'll have my victory. Watch and see.

ash3.name: Ash
ash3.title: Borrowed Power
ash3.description: Ash, having been granted some power from Melíai, who is a version of herself from another world, and whom she fights earnestly to save.

Castle Hall: I have been bestowed a new power, and it would be my utmost pleasure to give my very best for everyone.
I am most grateful to you for providing me with such peace of mind.
Please do not hesitate to let me know if there is anything that I can assist you with.
Why, what a lovely day it is. I would very much like to spend this valuable time together with you.
Melíai and I are not similar in the slightest. Though I do believe there is something we share in common.
Visit: My sincerest apologies for disturbing you. I have come to deliver greetings from [F].
Level: If I were to say so myself, I would consider this a satisfactory result.
I do believe the most important matter is that of moderation.
I feel utterly ashamed to show my face.
Summon: I am Ash, retainer to Lord Askr. With this new strength, I wish to be of tremendous service to everyone.
Learn Skill: I am exorbitantly grateful to receive such a gift.
Confession:
Though odd as it may sound, I do feel blessed to have come across a me from another world...
We may be the same being, but I am amazed by how different we are due to our vastly different upbringings.
I was created by Lord Askr to serve all humans. I have not forgotten my duty.
While on this path, I met all these people, overcame hardships, and got to know true joy and sadness.
My heart aches with pity, considering how lonesome Melíai must have been. Which is precisely why...
I would like to offer my assistance so that she, too, may feel the joy of life and be able to share that with others.
Status: Um... I may have received more power than I am worthy of. As such, I shall endeavor to give my best for all of you.
*startle* You must understand how befuddling it is to be caught unawares like that.
While I recognize that Melíai may be me from another world, I am utterly baffled by how different we are.
I am positively bursting with joy at being able to work on behalf of everyone.
I do feel a profound pity for Melíai, having to live without knowing Lord Askr's love.
Lord Askr...Father...please watch over us.
I would be most pleased if you would allow me to stay by your side for a long time to come.

ryoma5.name: Ryoma
ryoma5.title: Warrior of Bonds
ryoma5.description: The first prince of Hoshido, who bears the responsibility of his country. He polishes his technique with his family's unity ever at the forefront of his mind. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: As the eldest son of the Hoshidan royal family, I strive to bring everyone together for solidarity.
Hinoka fights with valor now, but she was quite a crybaby when she was little. She embraces her emotions.
Takumi lacks a little self-awareness, but I believe he will become stronger given time.
Azura guards her heart. Even when we spent time together as siblings, I sensed a distance between us.
Sakura, the youngest, is kind-hearted. She is always prioritizing others. It is an admirable, yet worrisome, trait.
Visit:
It is [S], right?
I hope you will continue to be friends with [F].
Level: We siblings hold strong bonds. We are the souls of Hoshido, linked by Corrin. There is no foe we fear!
Strength isn't solely skill or power. It requires strength of heart to strike down foes without faltering.
Ahh! No, I must not hesitate if I aim to grow stronger...
Summon:
My bonds with my siblings make me stronger. No matter the foe, I will not back down!
I, Ryoma, high prince of Hoshido, will forge ahead!
Learn Skill: You have my gratitude, [S]. I hope we can form a relationship built on mutual respect.
Confession:
[S]. That inquisitive gaze... Did you wish to ask me something about this ring?
Long ago, my siblings and I had it crafted and we made a vow.
That vow was to present the ring to Corrin upon our safe reunion. It is something of a luck charm.
I believe we siblings—Hoshidan and Nohrian—can bring joy to the world if we join together around Corrin.
I am considering a similar ring for the day when I can finally welcome you to Hoshido, [S].
That is how much I value our bond. We, too, are siblings.
Status: Apparently, this outfit represents my bond with my siblings.
Hm? Use caution. You will find this armor has sharp edges.
My siblings have grown to possess such strength and kindness. I am extremely proud of them.
We are greater than Nohr in many ways. Even when it comes to familial bonds.
I must devote myself to perfecting my swordsmanship so that I can protect everyone.
Corrin...such an enigmatic child...with a fate shrouded in mystery.
Strange. I sense a bond between us that is not unlike those I have with my siblings.

hinoka6.name: Hinoka
hinoka6.title: Warrior of Gusto
hinoka6.description: A princess of Hoshido who is sincere in all she does. She trains day in and day out, standing up against any who threaten her family. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: I'd like to spend some quiet time with my pegasus, with no thoughts of battle. I should value times like these.
I was just taking a breather. I don't mind if you want to join me, [S].
They say to always conduct yourself as if on the battlefield. Call out to me if you see anything suspicious.
Rice is a great source of energy. I like to eat up before going into battle.
I aim to be as strong and capable as my siblings. They are truly splendid.
Visit: Allow me to offer you greetings from [F].
Level: You'll have to best me if you want to get past! That is, if you can!
Come at me all you want and you'll see the full might of a Hoshidan warrior.
I won't let anyone past me, no matter who comes my way.
Summon: I am Princess Hinoka of Hoshido. The pride of the Hoshidan royal family resides in my heart. I'm ready to go!
Learn Skill: What do you think? I look strong, don't I?
Confession:
Is it already time to depart for the next battle? It's not a problem for me, I just...
I feel a little light-headed from the bath I took earlier... I was just trying to cool off...
Oh? I give off a different impression in the castle than in battle? I grew up as a Hoshidan princess, you know.
I'm in the midst of learning proper word usage, and how to conduct myself appropriately. But...
It's common for me to enter battle, so I place more value in warrior aptitude than princess etiquette.
And I would feel weird being treated like a princess now... So I'd like you to deploy me to the front lines.
Don't hesitate. Got that, [S]?!
Status: A new weapon, huh? I'll do my best to live up to it.
*react* Hey, watch it! It's not nice to mess with people!
I swear I'll use this power to bring peace to Hoshido—no, to the world.
I won't neglect my training, no matter what world I'm in. And I'll have no trouble finding a sparring partner here!
Quit sayin' such sappy things! It's embarrassing.
Oh Corrin... I wish I knew what your future holds.
It brings me great joy to battle alongside you for your cause.

shura.name: Shura
shura.title: Righteous Rebel
shura.description: Survivor of the ruined nation of Kohga. Now a thief in Nohr, he dreams of rebuilding his homeland. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall:
You call us Heroes, but there are all types here. Royalty, nobles, knights, even a few outlaws, like me.
Even a few people who have lost their homelands...
I was born a ninja in Hoshido, but I lived as an outlaw in Nohr. I'm one of Kohga's surviving few.
Be careful when you go out on patrols. Your life actually has value, so don't go dying a careless death.
I like listening to people talk about their homelands. If you've got the time, tell me about yours.

You Hero types sure are a noble bunch. Risking your lives to save a kingdom that's not even your own...
Makes me regret becoming an outlaw, rather than some upstanding soldier with a righteous cause.
Visit:
Are you [S]?
I'm here to deliver a greeting from [F].
Level: One step closer to rebuilding Kohga...
I'm glad I'm getting better.
I hope your expectations of me aren't too high.
Summon: I'm Shura, from Nohr. This place has a noble air about it... I don't think an outlaw like me will fit in.
Learn Skill: I'll try to meet your expectations of me, no matter how sparse.
Confession:
You on patrol? You spend a lot of time checking up on everyone, but you should get out sometime.
I headed out just the other day. Took a look around Askr, went people watching... I saw some kids playing.
They reminded me of my homeland, Kohga... Before it was destroyed.
When you summoned me out of the blue and started calling me a Hero, I was sure you were dead wrong.
I wanted nothing more than to get back to my own world as soon as I could. But, well...
After seeing how much this world has that's worth protecting, and after you dedicated so much time to me...
I remembered what happiness feels like. Well, I at least remembered that there was a time when I was happy.
Besides, every time I become stronger, I get one step closer to rebuilding Kohga.
I guess what I'm trying to say is... Thanks. And keep up the good work.
Status: Don't waste your time talking to me. There are better people to chat with.
Me? A Hero? Don't say things like that. I'm not a good person.
If someone destroyed your homeland, wouldn't you seek revenge?
You don't have to pat me down like that. I haven't been stealing your things.
Being stuck here surrounded by all these Heroes... Someone may mistake me for an upstanding citizen.
I'm not ready to die yet...not 'till Kohga's rebuilt, anyway.
"Justice?" "Heroes?" Just words. Or so I thought until I met you.

scarlet.name: Scarlet
scarlet.title: Rebellious Streak
scarlet.description: A knight from Cheve who leads a group of resistance fighters against the army of Nohr. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: This castle is top-notch. I could stay here forever.
If we let ourselves be pinned down, we'll be treated this way forever. We must strike the throat of our enemy!
Seems like you're always on the go, [S]!
This world's accessories are looking pretty sharp! Heh. They match my style.
If I smash these rocks apart, I can get at the good stuff. The sparkling bits sure pretty up my weapon!
Visit: Hah! This castle is pretty neat. I've come with greetings for you from [F]!
Level: Bring it, world! Show me what you've got!
Obviously, I keep getting better!
Hey, this is nothing to fret over. Better luck next time!
Summon: I'm Scarlet. Cheve will not yield to Nohr—I'll make sure of it. I will achieve freedom for my people!
Learn Skill: For me? Gotta say, nice choice!
Confession:
It's almost that time again to pretty up my little friend... Now, hold still... It won't hurt... Ah!
Oh it's you, [S]!
As you can see, I'm smashing some rocks apart. You see, the sparkly bits are all mixed in with the rest.
First, I set my friend—my weapon— down. Then I slather on some of this magical liquid.
Once it's all coated, I stick on the shiny fragments. Decorating like this is probably my favorite hobby...
Hey, you should try it some time. Come on. It'll be a nice change of pace!
Special: You went and got me mad.
I'll get all Nohrian on you!
Status: I'm Scarlet, by the way. I'm a self-taught fighter, but I'm confident in my abilities.
Whoa! Heh. Not bad.
I won't let Nohr oppress my people any longer. For freedom!
When I found out Ryoma was a Hoshidan prince... Well, it was surprising, to say the least.
The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Heh, don't sweat it. I'm on your side.
It's tradition among the knights of Cheve to pin on a flower whenever one faces a monumental event.
You're pretty special, getting everyone to follow you around like this. But...you're not quite as special as Ryoma.

haitaka.name: Haitaka
haitaka.title: Persistent General
haitaka.description: A spearman from Hoshido who built an impenetrable defense while protecting Fort Dragonfall. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates.

Castle Hall: The wars in this world are waged by people not unlike those in my own, so my tactics should still be effective.
Fort Dragonfall is a natural stronghold made from the decayed remains of an ancient dark dragon.
I've examined this castle's defense system. I have several suggestions for enhancing its functionality.
In battle, balance is crucial. You will not suffer defeat if you can control the balance during confrontations.
Hoshido and Nohr—equal nations in constant conflict. That is the history of the world I know.
Visit: You should endeavor to work hard alongside [F].
Level: My strongest skills are in formulating defensive strategies. The opposite... not so much...
You must hold your ground without breaking formation. That is essential.
How...mortifying...
Summon: I am Haitaka, a Hoshidan general. Let me show you some of my Hoshidan combat techniques.
Learn Skill: I am grateful for the kindness you show outsiders.
Confession:
[S] from another world, I am thankful for this unique opportunity.
Soldiers of Hoshido polish their techniques for their lords and nation, to defend against the Nohrian army.
I never considered a way of life other than that. My world was simple.
But...I've observed the Heroes in this land and learned of their multifarious reasons for going into battle.
My spear is for Hoshido, but for now, I will contemplate the meaning of war as I use it for your sake.
Status: I am Haitaka. Care for a little lesson in Hoshidan combat?
Hey! What are you up to? Do you have a death wish?
As if I would allow our beautiful Hoshido to be overrun by Nohrian barbarians.
King Sumeragi and Queen Mikoto were both extraordinary people.
Battle is cruel. There is often a chance of being captured by the enemy.
I can hardly believe I am stuck fighting for an army from another world...
It seems we are connected by fate. I shall hasten your foes to their graves with my spear.

fcorrin9.name: Corrin
fcorrin9.title: Of Fates
fcorrin9.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to Elyos. Resides in the Ring of the Crux of Fate. Appears in Fire Emblem Fates / Fire Emblem Engage.
fcorrin9.emblem:
Enhanced Engaged Special
When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's max Special cooldown count value × 4 (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
At start of enemy phase (except for in Pawns of Loki), if there is no【Divine Vein (Icicle)】 currently applied by unit or allies, applies 【Divine Vein (Icicle)】to spaces 2 spaces away from unit for 1 turn (excluding spaces occupied by a foe, destructible terrain other than Divine Vein, or warp spaces in Rival Domains), and 【Divine Vein (Vert)】to unit's space and spaces within 3 spaces of unit for 1 turn (excluding spaces with【Divine Vein (Icicle)】applied).
【Divine Vein (Icicle)】
Applies the following status on space: Foes treat space as impassable terrain while status is active, but status is destructible (with 1 HP). When destroyed, it changes to 【Divine Vein (Vert)】. Allies can move into and occupy space. If any allies occupy spaces with Divine Vein (Icicle) applied, attacks targeting those spaces will hit the ally over destroying the Divine Vein (Icicle).
【Divine Vein (Vert)】
Applies the following effects on space for foes: Foe cannot warp from this space or into this space (does not affect units with Pass skills or warp effects from structures like camps and fortresses in Rival Domains). Inflicts 【Canto Control】on foes that trigger Canto in this space through their next action. Inflicts Atk/Spd-5 and Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack), and also, if foe's attack can trigger foe's Special, inflicts Special cooldown count+1 on foe before foe's first attack during combat (cannot exceed the foe's maximum Special cooldown).
【Canto Control】
If unit's Range = 1, unit can move 1 space when Canto triggers. If unit's Range = 2, their action ends when Canto triggers.

Castle Hall:
I am an Emblem who has reached the ends of the paths before me.
But when I'm with my siblings, it's as if I have gone back to who I was before.
In Elyos, I was entrusted to Solm. I was kept in a fortress that was not dissimilar to one in Nohr or Hoshido.

In Elyos, my power manifested in the form of fog, flames, and ice pillars with Dragon Veins.
I wonder how it would manifest if you used it.
I still do not grow hungry here, but it is a wonderful feeling being able to enjoy food. Shall I gather ingredients?
I often had my ring polished at the Somniel. It sure tickled! I wonder, are you ticklish too?
Visit: I am Emblem Corrin. I see you, too, are in the midst of your journey, just like [F].
Level: This is the result of both your and my decisions. I always had faith we would make the right ones.
As an Emblem, I wish to grant you many fruitful outcomes for your journey.
There is meaning behind every experience. I shall have faith this is true and continue my journey.
Summon: I am Corrin, an Emblem. I shall fight with all my might so the path you choose leads to hope.
Learn Skill: This is a power you chose for me? Nothing could bring me more joy.
Confession:
Askr's nights are truly beautiful. The sky full of stars rivals even the world I came from, as well as Solm.
Isn't it wonderful to think about how we are just one of many possibilities shining in the night sky?
Do you suppose there are other Emblem versions of me who exist on a different path?
I am sure there is another me protecting someone with a katana, or roaring as a dragon!
But I am here with you, no matter the path you choose to take. For I believe it will lead us to where we seek.
This must be how my siblings felt, to watch over me so diligently. Thanks to you I share their sentiments.
Status: Oh.
I can imagine the look on my siblings' faces if they saw me like this.
*gasp* Oh. *giggle* For a second, I didn't see you there.
My memories of Elyos and of the three paths are what shaped me into who I am.
The Northern Fortress of Solm is where my ring was... I also spent much time in the Northern Fortress of Nohr.
"Bare your fangs, Emblem of Fates" is the invocation to summon me. I hope you try it someday.
Seadall is a wonderful dancer. His long, flowing hair reminds me of Azura...
It is not up to Emblems to decide the world's fate. In Elyos, Alear decides, and here, it is up to you to forge a path into the future.

lyn10.name: Lyn
lyn10.title: Plains Wind
lyn10.description: Disciple of the light goddess Naga. Though she cannot remember her past, she remains firm in her convictions. Appears in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade / Shadows.

Castle Hall: The wind feels...welcoming. This is a nice place, isn't it?
Is...something wrong? The way you're staring at me... Is there something on my face?
Leave any bandits to me. I can't tolerate those who would harm people just trying to live their lives.
My hearing is top-notch, and I'm fast too. When someone calls for help, I'm usually the first to arrive.
You and I appear quite different at a glance, but...we share a desire to look out for the well-being of others.
Visit: Um... My appearance? Is something off? Well, I brought you this greeting from [F].
Level: There's a gentle wind blowing... I feel as if it's trying to guide me.
I want to save everyone. I believe that's what my power is meant for.
I'm sorry. I guess I'm not at my best right now.
Summon: I am Lyn. I'm told I am a disciple of light, guiding others toward Naga's ideals, but... Um. What is this place?
Learn Skill: Thank you. I hope you can see how grateful I am.
Confession:
I... The first thing I recall is being in a field, not knowing where I came from or who I was. I remembered nothing.
A disciple of light... That's what they called me. Meant to guide the world toward Naga's ideals or something...
Then, I felt like someone was calling me, and suddenly I was here. It's all quite...confusing.
But, wherever this is, and whoever I am...what I must do stays the same.
I will protect the oppressed. That is the cause I will champion.
Status: My name is Lyn. I remember nothing more...
*startle* Is this how you normally greet each other in this world?
You arrived from another world too? Then we have that much in common.
It's peculiar, but I get the feeling this isn't the first time we've met.
Regardless of the world we're in, the most important thing is that everyone can be happy, wouldn't you agree?
I will never forgive those who destroy the happiness of others.
My mind is at ease when I'm with you. This wind...it carries whispers of the past.

freyja3.name: Freyja
freyja3.title: Parallel Hearts
freyja3.description: Freyja, the queen of Dökkálfheimr, the realm of nightmares, and her past self, Eitr. Together, with parallel heartbeats, they join the harvest festival.
freyja3.duo:
Neutralizes two【Bonus】effects, excluding stat bonuses and inflicts【Frozen】and 【Discord】on foes within 5 rows or 5 columns centered on unit (neutralizes the first applicable 【Bonus】effects on foe's list of active effects).
【Bonus】
All effects that last "for 1 turn" or "that turn only." Includes bonuses granted by a skill like Rally or Hone and positive status effects (extra movement or effects like Dominance).
【Frozen】
Reduces inflicted unit's follow-up ability and increases foe's follow-up ability through unit's next action:
Increases Spd difference necessary for unit to make a follow-up attack by X and decreases Spd difference necessary for foe to make a follow-up attack by X during combat (if foe's Def > unit's Def, X = 10 + difference between Def stats × 2; otherwise, X = 10). (For example, if Spd difference necessary increases by 10, Spd must be ≥ 15 more than foe's Spd to make a follow-up attack; stacks with similar skills.)
【Discord】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-X on unit during combat (X = 2 + number of allies within 2 spaces of unit; max 5) through its next action.

Castle Hall: **Freyja:** Eitr is me as a child... Seeing her is like seeing my shame on full display.
**Eitr:** I come from a world of nothingness. But here... This place is so bright and full of smiles.
**Freyja:** The mortals here look truly content. I am sure my brother would be happy to see this harvest festival...
**Eitr:** I am too scared to do this alone... But if someone's with me, then maybe I can...
**Freyja:** That costume looks great on you, Eitr. Now, try to trick someone.
Visit: **Eitr:** U-um... I'm Eitr. I came to tell you about the harvest festival at [F]'s. O-OK, bye!
Level: **Eitr:** Trick or treat! *sigh* I said it!
**Freyja:** As I expected, your options are trick or treat. What will you choose?
**Freyja:** This is unlike me...
Summon: I am Freyja, ruler of Dökkálfheimr. Hold your head up, Eitr, like me. You are certainly capable of at least that.
Learn Skill: **Eitr:** Uh, are you sure? No one has ever been so nice to me... Thank you.
Confession:
**Eitr:** At first, all I noticed at the harvest festival were how many people there were... I was so scared...
But everyone was kind to me. And I was able to say "thank you" to lots of people. So, um...
**Freyja:** What is it? If you have something to say, speak up.
**Eitr:** Y-yes. I wanted to be sure to tell you something...
Thank you for staying with me. I hope that future me turns out just like you someday...
Status: Ugh.
"How can you expect to scare them when you yourself tremble in fear?" "I... I... *sob*"
Conversation: **Eitr:** *sob* I'm scared... There are so many people here...
**Freyja:** It is a festival, after all. How long do you intend on cowering?
**Eitr:** We...have to scare everyone?
It doesn't matter if I wear a costume or not, one look at me and people would be surprised...
But then they'd just make fun of me... *sob*
**Freyja:** Will you stop crying? Here.
**Eitr:** Is this...a treat for me?
**Freyja:** You cannot cry with your mouth full. Now, eat up.
**Eitr:** Oh... All right. Freyr gave me treats too when I was sad...
**Freyja:** Yes, I know. I am you. However, I know more about the world than you.
I know it is filled with more than just ill intent and prejudice. Such was the reason Freyr cared for mortals.
**Eitr:** Really? I guess...you're right. There are some mortals I have encountered who were kind.
**Freyja:** Perhaps back then, what I... No, what you lacked was courage...
The courage to believe in mortals, and even in Freyr.
It would be foolish to keep repeating the same mistake. Now, muster up your courage.
**Eitr:** Yes... I will try believing in Freyr and... in mortals too.
**Freyja:** That is the me I know. Now, shall we join the festivities?

nerpuz4.name: Nerþuz
nerpuz4.title: Divine Abundance
nerpuz4.description: A goddess of Vanaheimr, the realm of light. She celebrates the harvest alongside mortals as the goddess of the land.

Castle Hall: I feel the gratitude of all you sweet little mortals. I am certain the land will continue to grant your wishes.
The land supports many lives. Let us head toward the future together, and always remain grateful for its bounty.
Revel in the harvest-festival joy while you can, but winter will soon come... Do not neglect your preparations.
I am happy to receive treats, but it would be deliciously fun to trick some of these adorable mortals too.
Well, does this suit me? I tried to fit the mood of the festival. Mortals do make the most interesting outfits.
Visit:
I am Nerþuz, goddess of the land.
There is a festival to give thanks for the land's blessings going on at the castle of [F].
Level: The land's blessings help to build the future. I pray that this abundance can continue eternally.
The smiles of these darling mortals are quite infectious!
Neither gods nor humans can truly thrive apart from the land.
Summon: I am Nerþuz, goddess of Vanaheimr, here to offer gratitude for the harvest alongside all the precious mortals.
Learn Skill: This is to celebrate the blessings of Askr's land... I will gratefully accept the thoughtfulness of these mortals.
Confession:
I am enjoying myself at this wonderful harvest festival. Thank you for inviting me, [S].
As a goddess who presides over the land, I know how important it is to all its inhabitants.
People spread their roots into it, and live upon it, fueled by its bounty as they forge their history.
If they do not forget to show their gratitude, the land will sustain them with its gifts for all of eternity.
I also watch over them, to ensure their world continues to be filled with abundance, so...
please call me for the next harvest festival. The smiles of all the adorable mortals fill my heart to bursting!
Status: If they're offering thanks for the blessings of the land, do you suppose they'll thank me as well?
*startle* Please don't play pranks on me. Here, you can have some treats...
Mortals come up with the most adorable ideas. Imagine, dressing up in costumes for a festival...
Do you enjoy treats? Please, eat as many as you like.
When I see creatures of the land, I want to give them all the blessings there are to give.
Dressing up in costumes makes these precious mortals even more adorable. I am truly delighted.
Oh my, you have a treat stuck to your cheek... That's so cute. Hold still, I'll remove it for you.

peony4.name: Peony
peony4.title: Fruitful Dream
peony4.description: A ljósálfr from Ljósálfheimr, the realm of dreams. She dreams of blissful abundance alongside mortals at the harvest festival.

Castle Hall: Pumpkins on the left! Pumpkins on the right! Pumpkins everywhere! How fun! It's like being in a dream.
I feel like there was a time when I was always hungry... I hope everyone gets a full belly at the harvest festival.
What a wonderful festival! It would be a waste not to enjoy it to the fullest. I'm going to wake up Mirabilis!
Lady Freyja and Eitr both have such adorable outfits! I wonder if they're enjoying the harvest festival.
Isn't my festival outfit wonderful?! I'm going to play lots of tricks in it!
Visit: My name's Peony. I'm a ljósálfr from Ljósálfheimr. There's a fun festival at [F]'s castle!
Level: My dream is for fun, festive days like this one to go on and on!
Trick or treat! I'm sure this will be fun either way!
Hm... I wonder if I got a little too carried away.
Summon: I'm Peony, the Sweet Dream. This festival gives thanks for the harvest, right?! Let's make it like a fun dream!
Learn Skill: Is this a portion of the blessings of the land that you're sharing? Thank you! I'll take really good care of it!
Confession:
Trick or treat, [S]! Will you give me a treat? Or would you prefer a trick?
The harvest festival is so fun! I wish it could go on and on.
It looks like I'm not the only one who feels that way. Everyone dreams of these fun days lasting forever.
After a festival ends, they all go on living their lives, looking forward to the next one.
Dreams continue unending. Isn't that why we're here? To safeguard that bounty of happiness!
I'm going to make the most of the best festival ever, and harvest lots of lots of dreams and joy!
Status: Oooooo! *giggle*
Surprised?
Have some treats!
I adore festivals! I was so excited yesterday I couldn't even dream of falling asleep.
What do you think of this outfit? It's really cute, don't you agree?
I love how the whole town is shining like Ljósálfheimr. It's just so pretty...
Tonight's dreams will be sweet as candy for sure.
Going to a festival with you is like a really good dream. If only I didn't have to wake up...

skrimir.name: Skrimir
skrimir.title: Echoing Howl
skrimir.description: A member of a laguz tribe and viewed as the heir to Caineghis, Gallia's king. With no prior knowledge of the harvest festival, he's here alongside Ranulf. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: Trick or treat? Is that some kind of sorcery?! Show me the enemy!
Ranulf thinks I look down on the beorc too much.
When Ranulf isn't around, people turn to me with their troubles. So I decided to come with him.
You'll get soft and weak eating only treats! Eat meat, gnaw some bones, and become a warrior like me!
How are you training soldiers during the festival? I'll be training morning, afternoon, and evening, like always.
Visit: I'm Skrimir, general of Gallia. I'm in command at the harvest festival at [F]'s castle!
Level: I've been waiting for this! I won't give out treats for free. Wrestle me with all you've got!
Yah! Hah! I'm starting to enjoy this! Come at me some more!
Grr... How pathetic of me, a general of Gallia! Here, take these treats!
Summon: I'm Skrimir! It's finally time to get this festival going. I'll show everyone the strength of the beast tribe!
Learn Skill: Are you trying to get on my good side? You're a smart one!
Confession:
Hmph, such a lighthearted affair! They've combined a ritual to praise the land with lots of fun and games.
A warrior's festival has combat! Tests of strength with fist and claw! That is how a beast tribe's festival should be.
We laguz are always part of the land. All of this just to show their gratitude to it... Typical beorc insolence!
The festival food's good though! I bet that's why Ranulf was so eager to get here. He wanted to feast!
Food is the land's blessing. Digging into it with gusto shows gratitude. I'll eat and eat, then eat some more!
Don't hold back to be polite. Join me! We should enjoy the blessings of the day, [S]!
Status: They call this a harvest festival costume! It suits me!
*startle* Hm. I can't believe you caught me by surprise.
Giving thanks to the land for its bounty... Commendable.
Is it only treats? No meat? Meat! Meat! Hand over some meat!
My uncle, the king, ought to see me in this outfit.
Laguz and beorc are enjoying the festival together... Not a bad thing.
All right! Time for you to go scare everyone too. Let's move!
Map Select: Let's see what they can do.

ranulf2.name: Ranulf
ranulf2.title: Considerate Gaze
ranulf2.description: A cat warrior from Gallia, the home of the beast tribe of laguz. He is considerate of others at the harvest festival, acting as Skrimir's assistant. Appears in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn.

Castle Hall: I didn't expect Skrimir to come out at all. He has a tendency to go berserk, so I'm here to keep an eye on him.
So I hand out treats to the children? Sounds fun. I don't mind a few tricks if we're just playing around.
I find it very strange that Lethe, of all people, enjoys this festival. Is she just playing the cool cat here?
The harvest festival, eh? Lethe was fond of it, so I decided to come check it out for myself.
I'm not that good at dressing up, but participating in a country's cultural events can help build understanding.
Visit: I'm here to share portions from the harvest festival. You can give your thanks to [F].
Level: A festival to recognize the blessings of the earth. You know, this one kind of works for me.
What was it? Trick or treat, right? Well, then, let's have some fun.
I'm not sure I get how this works yet, so let me know if I make a mistake!
Summon:
I hear you took good care of Lethe. I'm Ranulf...
Actually, formal self-introductions are boring. It's a festival! Let's make this more exciting!
Learn Skill: You're sure you want me to have this? All right. Thanks.
Confession:
I'm surprised Skrimir is attending the festival. The general can be forceful and direct, like how Ike used to be.
He has the capacity to be a good heir to the king of the lions, but his views are narrow. This is good for him.
Not every beorc is an enemy. We're not all that different, especially in the unbiased hearts of our children
I have felt the warm spirit of order here.
I hope the division between laguz and beorc in my world gets resolved, but... Well, that will take a long time.
Anyway, I learned a lot here. Thank you for this, [S].
Status: Ahoy!
Look at this! I'm a pirate captain now! Well? What do you think?
Huh? W-w-wait, was that supposed to scare me? You've got a lot to learn.
Even if I dress up as something else, I'm not hiding my tail. You know that, right?
Me? A pirate? I typically prefer to keep my feet on the land.
Maybe Kyza and Lyre won't bicker if I have enough treats.
I get to eat delicious food and make a ruckus with my comrades? I think I like festivals.
I get the feeling the festival will be twice as fun with you.

sharena5.name: Sharena
sharena5.title: Borrowed Divinity
sharena5.description: Sharena, having been granted power through the weapon of another world's Askr. Whether here or there, her love of Askr is ever strong.

Castle Hall: All cleaned up! Oh, this? It is Lord Askr's weapon, bestowed upon me by Lady Embla. I have to keep it clean.
I've been going on walks lately during my patrols, and I've discovered all sorts of new things!
With this new power... Your Sharena can help with anything!
Would you like to go for a walk together? It'll be so much fun!
I tried to ask Melíai about Sharena and Alfonse from her world, but she kept evading me.
Visit: Oh good, it's you! You've caused quite a stir over your well-being at [F]'s castle.
Level: I did it! Your Sharena is here to help!
Being greedy is never a good quality.
Huh? That wasn't a challenge, was it?
Summon: I'm Sharena and I bear the will of another world's Lord Askr. No matter what, I'll protect the Kingdom of Askr!
Learn Skill: For me?! Yay! I'll get even more fired up!
Confession:
Aren't you curious about the other versions of me and Alfonse from Melíai's world?
It sounds like she met even more Askran royals. But when I asked her about it, she avoided me. Though...
She did say, "You're a woman, huh?" Wait! Does that mean the me in her world is a... And Alfonse is...
Oh! It's just amazing thinking about all the other worlds out there! Now I'm even more excited to visit them!
Status: *giggle*
Ta-da! Your Sharena is here and all powered up!
Oh! Ah, you got me...
OK, enough flattering me. So...what is it?
Borrowing Lord Askr's power is liking having the strength of one hundred warriors!
What do you think the other versions of me are like? Maybe there's even one nothing like me in another world...
I hope I can help Alfonse even more now...
Your Sharena will put her life on the line to keep protecting you.

soren6.name: Soren
soren6.title: Isolated Strategist
soren6.description: Young tactician of the Greil Mercenaries. He has a tendency to disrupt the harmony of others by not mincing words. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: I doubt you have any business with me. If you have time to bother others, consider reflecting on yourself.
The name Four Riders is given to the persons of highest ability among the king's advisors.
If it's Ike you're after, check the food stalls before doing anything else. I'd start with those that serve meat.
If you have something for Ike, I can hold on to it for you.
There is no doubt the enigmatic general known as the Black Knight is the one who killed Commander Greil.
Visit: I have something for you. It's from [F]. Here.
Level: A feint is meaningless if it is overdone... We must be thorough when we take them by storm.
This is not surprising. There were no flaws in my strategy.
I must stay with Ike for the entirety of his journey.
Summon: I am Soren of the Greil Mercenaries. I hope to expand my knowledge and experience in battle to support Ike.
Learn Skill: If you're all right with me here, then know I will meet your expectations.
Confession:
"Lehran's Medallion still exists. While it does, we cannot allow a war that could stand to engulf all our nations."
Deghinsea, the Black Dragon King of Goldoa, said something of the sort. I wondered at the meaning behind it.
I thought a galdr was key to releasing the dark god, but what if Daein's king is trying another way...
An objective of sowing disorder with warfare. That might explain the mad invasions into Crimea and Gallia.
On the surface, he appeared to want to expand Daein's power.
Strife and discord spreading across the land would eventually reach the lost medallion.
If that's his intention, Daein's king is extremely dangerous. I must regroup with Ike and the others immediately.
Status: A new weapon? I'll make good use of it, for Ike.
Hmm... Could you do something more meaningful with your time? Preferably without involving me.
Even the most powerful weapons lose purpose if they're not wielded well. I will devote myself to my training.
Why do you stare? I am not here for your entertainment.
I suppose I must acknowledge that being here is not exactly unpleasant.
I wonder if Ike will be happy I've acquired this new power.
I'll use this power for your sake as well, because I must.

elincia6.name: Elincia
elincia6.title: Hearts of Purity
elincia6.description: Princess of Crimea, born and raised hidden from most of the world. Her bond with Lucia is like that of a sister. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.
elincia6.duo:
Grants【Bulwark】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Applies【Divine Vein (Stone)】to unit's space and spaces within 2 spaces of unit for 2 turns.
【Bulwark】
Foes with Range = 1 cannot move through spaces adjacent to unit (does not affect foes with Pass skills).
Foes with Range = 2 cannot move through spaces within 2 spaces of unit (does not affect foes with Pass skills).
【Divine Vein (Stone)】
Applies the following effects on space for unit and allies: Grants Def/Res+6 during combat, reduces damage from foe's Specials by 10 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from area-of-effect Specials by 50% (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials). (Divine Vein effects do not stack; replaces any existing Divine Vein effect; Divine Vein effects applied simultaneously cancel each other out. Does not count as defensive terrain.)

Castle Hall: **Elincia:** I am the last hope of those who wish for Crimea's restoration. I want to fully embrace the importance of that.
**Lucia:** General Ike taught me a lesson at Delbray Castle. Now, I strive to put Princess Elincia's feelings first.
**Elincia:** I am relieved that Lucia, Geoffrey, and Bastian survived... Please, do not throw your life away, Lucia.
**Lucia:** Even at an ally's encampment, we must not trust strangers. They may appear nice, but villains often do.
**Elincia:** Thanks to the instruction of Tanith of Begnion, I am prepared for true battle. I am grateful to Marcia too.
Visit: I am in the correct place, am I not? Lucia and I come bearing greetings for you from [F].
Level: **Elincia:** Father, Mother, Uncle... I shall not cease in my efforts to reclaim our homeland of Crimea!
**Elincia:** I don't want... I don't want anyone else to be sacrificed.
**Lucia:** Princess Elincia, take care. A snake could be lurking in the grass.
Summon: How do you fare? You have my most sincere gratitude for inviting me and my retainer, Lucia.
Learn Skill: **Lucia:** I am grateful for the offer. Princess Elincia will be very pleased.
Confession:
**Elincia:** Lucia, thank you for everything. You spend your days always on high alert to compensate for my lack of caution.
**Lucia:** That's because I am your primary bodyguard, Princess Elincia. It's only appropriate that I remain vigilant.
**Elincia:** But...I am a daughter kept hidden from the public, and not recognized as the official princess of Crimea...
**Lucia:** "The secret princess of Crimea is fighting to save us all." Such talk of your battles alongside General Ike...
It spreads even to Crimea. Retainers and the people alike all eagerly await the return of the princess of Crimea.
**Elincia:** It does my heart good to hear that. I may cause you more worries, but I am prepared to do whatever I can!
Status: *chuckle*
"Having you with me is reassuring, Lucia." "Leave it to me, Princess Elincia. I will not fail to claim victory for you."
Conversation: **Elincia:** Hya! Waa! Hyuah!
**Lucia:** All right! That is enough training for today. You mustn't overdo it.
**Elincia:** Whew... I found it difficult to score against you. How disappointing...
**Lucia:** Don't be discouraged. The progress you've made is something to behold, Princess Elincia.
**Elincia:** But I need to become substantially stronger. For Crimea's sake...
**Lucia:** You are putting in plenty of effort. But, if you feel it's not adequate...
I think that your greatest asset is your agility, Princess Elincia.
I shall devise some training methods through which we can help you make better use of that.
**Elincia:** Thank you, Lucia. I am always relying upon you, aren't I?
**Lucia:** You may rely upon me as much as you wish.
**Elincia:** I had hoped you would say that. In that case, might I rely upon you for one more thing?
**Lucia:** Certainly. What is it?
**Elincia:** In truth...all this training has given me quite an appetite.
**Lucia:** Oh! Of course. I can take care of that right away.
I had a feeling you would ask, so I baked a cake ahead of time.
**Elincia:** Lucia, you have made me so happy! Thank you.
**Lucia:** Oh, a hug... That takes me back to when we were children. Heh...

boyd.name: Boyd
boyd.title: Intrepid Warrior
boyd.description: Warrior of the Greil Mercenaries. Second of three brothers, he has a boisterous personality. What you see is what you get with him. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: My axe is great against lances but not against swords. Wait! That means I'm weaker facing Ike. That can't be!
When Titania told us Ike would be the new commander, Gatrie and Shinon left. They only wanted to follow Greil.
Listen up. Don't act on impulse the way Ike does, or you're sure to have a painful outcome.
If you need any help, just let me know. But don't you ever try to hold me at arm's length. Got it?
Hyaaa! Gyaaa! Hrrraaaa! Phew... That's enough practicing for today. I just don't feel into it.
Visit: Hey! I brought you this gift from [F]!
Level: Yeah! We won because we're better than them!
Now, come at me however you want! I'll take you on!
Oh, Titania! I didn't see you there. I was training so hard that... She's not even there, is she?
Summon: I'm Boyd, one of the original Greil Mercenaries. Just sit back and watch how a professional handles things!
Learn Skill: Thanks for this. Now, leave it to me!
Confession:
Mercenaries risk our lives facing foes. I look rough, don't I? It's that kind of job. There is no other job for me.
Oh, don't get the wrong idea, though. I do this job because I like it. I want to repay Commander Greil.
Rolf's mother left him and our father passed away. After Oscar's return, life was still difficult and discouraging.
Commander Greil saved me and my brothers by providing a "job" that got us a place to sleep and food to eat.
The commander was Ike and Mist's father, but he also called us family. And Titania is unexpectedly caring.
So, I'm a mercenary and a warrior protecting his family. Just watch! I'll grow even stronger!
Special: I'll take whatever you can dish out!
Status: I'm Boyd, of the Greil Mercenaries. It's good to meet you.
Whoa! Come on! What's that all about?
I have an older brother and a younger one. There's Oscar, and then there's Rolf.
The commander gave us jobs, a place to sleep, food on our plates... He gave us our lives back.
I can give a rookie like you a few tips. Like, don't let yourself get worked up and jump out in front of everyone.
I'll do anything to protect my family... That's why Ike can always count on me.
If you need any help, just let me know.

stefan.name: Stefan
stefan.title: No-Man's-Blade
stefan.description: A Branded swordsman who has the blood of both beorc and laguz. He is a direct descendant of Soan, one of the legendary three heroes. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: I am curious about Gallia's beast tribes. I'd like to ask you about them sometime.
Hmm... It seems I made an error.
The people here are all so different. I will make a note of this for now.
Find me when you come to the dunes. We can sit and talk, with no fighting.
Do you not intend to go fishing? There's no greenery in the desert, so it feels nice to cast a line into a river.
Visit: It seems I was wrong. I have no use for this place. And so, with your leave...
Level: Once this battle is finished, you'll have time to converse, yes? Off we go then!
Sheathe your blade. If that's all the skill you possess, you're not ready to challenge me.
Oh no! This is nothing to worry about.
Summon: I am Stefan! I come from a desolate wasteland where I play at being a hermit. Now, what about you?
Learn Skill: This, too, is honorable. For now, I will devote myself to this path.
Confession:
