Today's the day I promised to take you fishing. Are you ready to head out, [S]?
Oh! Perhaps I've been too hasty. But...we have time. I'll wait for you to make your preparations.
By the way, I've been meaning to ask, what are you doing here? For what do you use that head of yours?
I speak lightly when I say I never thought I'd wind up in a place like this.
But, if this is the will of the goddess, I will savor the moment, whether I'm in a dream or part of an illusion.
I'll accept things as they are and watch over my swaying fishing line... Or...something like that.
Now then, off we go! I have a feeling we'll reel in a big one today.
Status: I am Stefan! I come from a desolate wasteland where I play at being a hermit.
Was that supposed to be an attack? You left yourself wide open.
You can fight alongside me without knowing my history, can you not?
I ask you to treat our meeting as a dream and let it fade from your memory.
I'm interested in Gallia's beast tribes. Fascinated, really. Can we go somewhere and talk?
I'm here in part because I'm curious, but mostly because the guiding hand of fate led me to you.
I can be of service. Your technique... How powerful will it be when perfected? I would like to know.

gromell.name: Gromell
gromell.title: Bolt Axe General
gromell.description: A well-known and brave general among the army of Daein. He faced off against Crimea's army at Marhaut Range. Appears in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance.

Castle Hall: If you believe justice lies in Begnion, you should die like a cowardly dog!
Shiharam betrayed his country and is of no use at all. I saw this coming.
Begnion's dracoknights and pegasus knights cannot stand against Daein's aerial prowess. We will prevail!
Tauroneo brings shame to the Daein army! I will execute him for his black-hearted treachery!
Those birds spread the stink of sub-humans... I'll pluck their wings and laugh as they fall to their doom!
Visit: Hm... You may be more fit to command than I thought. You and [F] astound me.
Level: Gather as many fools as you like. You weaklings can never stand against the mighty!
Grr! So you've made it this far, have you? Then prepare to be sent down screaming!
I'll teach you to regret your impudence!
Summon: What are you doing? Fall in line! As long as I, Gromell, am here, our defenses are impenetrable.
Learn Skill: What have you done?! Explain it so I can understand!
Confession:
Those creatures may resemble humans, but they are not people. They are either bird or beast.
We have a mutual hate for each other. You know those vile birds, especially the herons, deceive people, right?
Their beauty disturbs me. It is hard to believe they are of this world. I'm convinced, those birds are monsters!
As my king wishes, I am to correct the wrongs of this world. For nothing good comes of embracing monsters.
Open your eyes, use your strength, and gather with me beneath the flag of Daein, [S].
Status: My name is Gromell. I am a general of Daein.
*grunt* What is this, an ambush?
When my army stages an attack, it is an impenetrable wall that none can break through.
None can defy King Ashnard. Not a single person, here nor there.
The bird tribes really are beautiful. It is hard to believe they are of this world. *disgusted sigh* Monsters...
No matter how many fools you gather around you, you will never overcome your weakness.
There is potential here.

heimdallr.name: Heimdallr
heimdallr.title: God of Foresight
heimdallr.description: A god of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm. Has an intellectual nature and can foresee the actions of others.

Castle Hall: So there are renowned strategists in the Order of Heroes, hm? Best be aware that my foresight is infallible.
My king offered up his eye and his life to receive great knowledge... Yet, he desires even more...
Ásgarðr is the pinnacle of the nine realms. I will acknowledge us celestial gods come with a sort of arrogance.
Loki—so chaotic—is the only being whom I cannot predict... I cannot stand her!
I...was wrong... And now, I cannot shake this sense that the course of the world has changed drastically.
Visit: You are right on schedule. It appears [F] predicts well.
Level: I dislike the unexpected. Oh, however... If unplanned events like these are likely occur...
Satisfactorily on schedule.
I anticipated this, though it means nothing if I fail to avoid it.
Summon: I am Heimdallr, god of foresight, servant of the king of heaven. I know your next move.
Learn Skill: This power is proof of your accurate predictions. Very good, indeed.
Confession:
The king of heaven, who respects knowledge above all else, trusts but one servant more than any other...
It is me, the god of foresight. And there is more to me than foreseeing the future.
One is able to proceed precisely on schedule when prepared to avoid anything that obstructs the plan.
Therefore, I dislike people engaging in actions that are not a part of that plan. It disrupts my peace...
I do hope, as my new master, that you are not such a disorderly person as this, [S].
Status: Humph.
I am Heimdallr, god of foresight. Be aware that I predict the future.
Humph. I knew that would be your next move.
Why could I not predict your actions? Who are you?
If one predicts accurately based on the facts, the future becomes an open book.
As long as things go according to plan, one can be at peace.
Loki... Why must you always meddle with the plan?
Ponder, predict, then fight. It seems we agree on these fundamentals, so I see no reason we cannot be friends.

gullveig4.name: Gullveig
gullveig4.title: Hidden in Time
gullveig4.description: Future self, Gullveig, and past self, Kvasir. Two beings, whose destinies do not intersect, have come together.
gullveig4.duo: Grants unit another action, and restores 40 HP to unit. (May be used only if unit has already entered combat during the current turn.)

Castle Hall: **Gullveig:** I share the same soul as Kvasir, so she and I should be able to perform covert tasks in perfect tandem.
**Gullveig:** I know the future, yet...I did not see myself this way.
**Kvasir:** If I remember correctly, Gullveig, ninja have signature sayings. For example..."Sparkling Shuriken."
**Kvasir:** Being with Gullveig, I feel...at peace. I am sure she does also...
**Kvasir:** I hear ninja erase their presence. Though, even if I wanted to, I could never hide Gullveig's radiance.
Visit: I will leave a gift in secret for you. And with that, our infiltration mission is complete, [F].
Level: **Kvasir:** I think that went well. Do you think we are worthy ninja now, Gullveig?
**Gullveig:** What I am now is a ninja...not the Golden Seer.
**Kvasir:** I am sorry... I could not keep up with Gullveig's radiance.
Summon: I am the Golden Seer. No... I am Gullveig, a ninja. Let us be on our way, Kvasir.
Learn Skill: **Kvasir:** May this power be a bridge from the past to the future...
Confession:
**Kvasir:** The secret message is not easy to find. I am afraid we will lose if nothing changes.
**Gullveig:** It is all right, Kvasir. Even if we do not claim it, this experience is not one often had.
You and I, future and past, would not have crossed paths. Yet here, we have spent time together.
For that, the summoner has my gratitude.
**Kvasir:** I feel the same. I will never forget this time we spent together, as ninja.
No matter what, we should be joyful to have worked together in this moment. "Sparkling Shuriken!"
Status: "Time's flow is again contravened—to bring us together." "I look forward to seeing what will happen now."
Conversation: **Gullveig:** It seems this secret message is also a fake.
If we do not claim the real thing soon, we will never win.
**Kvasir:** I have no wish to lose... We were invited by someone I do not want to disappoint.
I want to see that smiling face when we win.
**Gullveig:** I feel the same. But remember... Win or lose, we will receive our smile.
As long as we enjoy ourselves. That's just how the summoner is.
**Kvasir:** You are right. But I do want to win.
Do you think I'll get a pat on the head? And a little praise? I hope so.
**Gullveig:** That is a lovely idea. Do you suppose that I might receive the same?
**Kvasir:** I do not think so. You are an adult. I think it would be rude.
**Gullveig:** I see... Being an adult is not always good.
I am sure I can ask for a different reward.
**Kvasir:** Oh? Like what?
**Gullveig:** Perhaps the summoner will grant me an embrace.
**Kvasir:** Not just for you! I want a hug too!
**Gullveig:** All this talk... And we have not yet located the secret message.
**Kvasir:** I am even more motivated now... I will win, no matter what!

yunaka3.name: Yunaka
yunaka3.title: Stealthy Imitator
yunaka3.description: A wandering thief, trained in the art of ninja, who is enjoying the festival by making full use of her stealth and impersonation skills. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: All these shinobi around... I bet some are in disguise. Is the Hero you see really who you think they are?
They say there are people dressed like shinobi in Pale Sands on Elyos. I'm checking that out when I go back!
In a book of ninja techniques I found tactics with names like water-escape arts and fire-escape arts. Neat!
The Hoshidan-style outfits are great, but this is business as usual for me. Stay hidden and fulfill my mission!
As a shinobi, I put shuriken in my hair instead of stars. I can use 'em to fight in a pinch too!
Visit: Nin-zappy! I'm humble ninja Yunaka, bringing a secret missive for the lord here from [F]!
Level: I'd expect no less! I can throw my shuriken straight and true!
To be worthy of the title of shinobi, I must deliver reliable results!
Maybe I stood out a little too much. Not so nin-zappy...
Summon: Nin-zappy! Humble Yunaka here, in the form of a shinobi! Oops. Shinobi probably shouldn't shout, huh?
Learn Skill: I'm ever so honored to receive this valuable gift! From now on, I'll prove even more useful!
Confession:
Oh, [S]! I've been thinking as I watch everyone enjoying the festival from over here.
Shinobi are odd. They hide, gather intelligence, and even assassinate... Yet this event is so flashy.
There was no "assassin's festival" where I'm from. Why would there be? Everyone loathes assassins.
I think shinobi operate from a place of more loyalty and faith. While I'd never glorifying killing, I must say...
the sight of shinobi fulfilling jobs for their lords is beautiful. If past me had that, at least, then...
No, never mind. I'm participating, and I'm going to enjoy this festival! Hiya papaya and nin-zappy, [S]!
Status: Hehehe!
Could you detect my presence? Before I spoke to you, that is.
Aaah! Hey, stop poking at me! Want me to drop my hidden weapons?
I'm quite skilled at the ninja technique of hiding myself with invisibility magic. Want to see? Or...not see, I guess?
Shuriken, kunai, kusarigama... I am so excited about all these curious weapons!
I've heard Micaiah is a ninja too. I wonder where she is?
The main duties of a shinobi are intelligence gathering and...assassinations. Kind of reminds me of earlier days...
Feast your eyes on the art of disguise! I'll start by imitating the Divine Dragon's voice. "I am guided by the Emblems. Emblem Engage!"

fshez5.name: Shez
fshez5.title: Covert Mercenary
fshez5.description: An accomplished mercenary from Fódlan. Here, she takes part in the secret-missive scramble as a ninja. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: I've accomplished many rescues, retreats, defensive missions... But, I don't recall any covert operations.
As a mercenary, I've had to hide from foes plenty of times. I'm used to concealing my presence.
I suspect Commander Anna may have the secret missive... I'll investigate her first.
This outfit's really for covert operations? Am I the only one who feels like it draws more attention?
Never thought I'd be at a festival competing against myself from another world. Hmph. I can't lose.
Visit: I'm Shez, a mercenary from Fódlan. There's a ninja festival happening at [F]'s castle.
Level: Mission accomplished. Pretty good, eh?
You're moving so slow. It's like you want me to defeat you.
Do I stand out too much? This ninja technique is difficult to grasp...
Summon: I'm Shez, a mercenary from Fódlan. So, my job here is to obtain a secret missive? I'm on it.
Learn Skill: It'll be interesting to grow as a ninja instead of as a mercenary.
Confession:
You're wide open! Time to take your life, [S]!
Ha! Just kidding. What'd you think? I played the part well, eh? I'm a pretty good ninja, right?
Even though I've accomplished so many missions, it's quite a change, takin' on ninja tasks.
Sabotaging, assassinating, gathering intel...all in secret. Ninja may have the power to change the course of battle.
It's the names of heroes, monarchs, and aristocrats that will go down in history. But it's ninja who affect it
Makes me feel close to them. You see, mercenaries aren't remembered either, so we have that in common.
Status: So ninja are scouts and assassins? Very interesting.
A-ah... Already playing ninja, are you?
Getting to train while I'm at the festival is like killing two birds with one stone.
*yawn* I can't help but take a breather when I know I'm hidden.
Tah! Haa! I'm pretty good with ninja weapons too, eh?
This outfit's light so it's easy to move around in. I like it.
I'll secure your victory. I'm ready!

hrid4.name: Hríd
hrid4.title: Frigid Ninja
hrid4.description: The eldest prince of Nifl, Kingdom of Ice. He's come to the festival dressed in ninja garb for the first time.

Castle Hall: Competing to find a secret note has my heart dancing with excitement. I shall gather some information first.
Some parts of Nifl could learn a thing or two from Askr's many and varied festivals.
As one to whom a kingdom has been entrusted, I understand how critical spies are for obtaining information.
I had heard about ninja garb like this from my sister. Hm... It is quite easy to move around in.
I heard ninja use fire and water techniques. I wonder, do they use any ice techniques?
Visit: I am Hríd, prince of Nifl. I hereby extend an invitation to the ninja festival at [F]'s.
Level: I gave it my all and, in my own way, I was able to perform as a ninja.
Cool and collected, like ice, hm? It seems the way of the ninja suits me.
I have found it difficult to erase my presence. All there is to do is train even harder.
Summon: I am Hríd, prince of Nifl. This is my first time acting as a ninja. I shall give it my all and enjoy myself.
Learn Skill: I am grateful. Now, I will be able to contribute even more as a spy.
Confession:
Have you ever seen Nifl's snowy landscape, [S]?
The snow falls in silence, and before you know it, everything is covered in a blanket of pure white...
Ninja are similar, approaching without making a sound and drastically changing the course of battle.
Afterward, they disappear without a trace... Just as snow melts away.
I have gained more knowledge of the ninja at this festival.
And I believe the techniques I have learned here will be useful in my travels throughout this land.
Status: I have no knowledge of the ninja, but I shall give it my all.
*startle* Ninja should remain hidden from their opponents, correct?
My sister participated in this and found it quite enjoyable. Do you think I will be able to enjoy it as much?
Ninja run on water? Hm... Do they freeze it?
This outfit is intriguing. I am fond of how easily I can move in it.
To think, exceptional spies like this exist in other worlds...
I am grateful to participate in this festival with you.

mshez4.name: Shez
mshez4.title: Ninja Mercenary
mshez4.description: A mercenary who has set foot on many a battlefield. Here, he challenges the secret missive scramble as a ninja. Appears in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.

Castle Hall: Mercenaries need to be able to adapt the way ninja adjust to shifting situations. I could learn from them.
I once infiltrated enemy lines to stir chaos and confusion. That's a proper mercenary job, you know.
It's not just ninja who need to gather information and identify their foe's weaknesses. It's mercenaries too.
This ninja garb'll come in handy. I should be able to infiltrate anywhere without being noticed.
Another me is at this festival, eh? I'm sure I know what they've got up their sleeve, but I can't let my guard down.
Visit: I am Shez, a mercenary. I've been entrusted with inviting you to a ninja festival by [F].
Level: If I see an opening, I don't let it pass me by. That's how a ninja fights... Chakram Attack! You like it?
Deal the finishing blow without making a sound. That's the ninja way, right?
I went too far, huh? I'm not cut out for this...
Summon: I'm Shez, a mercenary from Fódlan. My job here is to make this ninja festival more exciting, eh?
Learn Skill: This power is necessary for a ninja. I'll use it with gratitude!
Confession:
I didn't end up finding the secret missive, after all... I feel like I let you down, [S].
However, I did manage to make this festival more exciting, right? I mean, people seemed to enjoy it.
The ninja techniques I learned here are different from my usual ones.
Gathering information, infiltrating the enemy, and fighting in unexpected ways are useful tactics in battle.
As long as I keep fighting, I'll never forget what I learned from this experience.
Even after I return to Fódlan, I will whisper, "Chakram Attack."
Status: Interesting festival. I'm itching to put my skills to the test here.
*react* I didn't see you there. Was that a ninja move?
Enjoying the festival while learning ninja techniques? Talk about a great deal.
Strange weapon, huh? You could really hurt yourself if you're not careful.
This outfit is comfortable. And warm, too.
Approaching the enemy without getting noticed? I guess ninja and mercenaries are the same that way.
For you, I'll carry out any mission.

alfador.name: Alfaðör
alfador.title: Celestial King
alfador.description: King of the gods of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm. He desires to know everything and will sacrifice whatever it takes to obtain this knowledge.

Castle Hall: These warriors from many different worlds... Might they have any knowledge to impart unto me?

I performed the Rite of Heaven and learned all there is to know about the nine realms...
Yet the writings that depict the beginning of creation still elude me.
Ignorant animals engage in senseless battles. One should achieve their desires without fighting.
Though I may rule the heavens...I still do not have all I desire. I seek infinite knowledge...
I obtained my ravens through the rite. They surround, peck at, and slaughter those who turn their backs on heaven.
Visit: Tell me all you know. I am certain there is more to you than what I heard from [F].
Level: Hmm... I accept. For there is no knowledge greater than that gained through experience.
This is insufficient to fuel my persistence.
What must I offer to satisfy my desire?
Summon: No soul is so ignorant to not know of the ruler aloft the nine realms. It is I, Alfaðör, the Celestial King.
Learn Skill: I shall transcend the creator, no matter the sacrifice.
Confession:
Towers piercing the heavens, iron carriages traversing vast lands... A world that uses no magic...
Your world has mastered steel and intellect, far from influence of gods and spirits. It is fascinating...
There was once no thing or place I could glean from, having learned everything about the nine realms...
Everything except the writings that depict creation, that is...
It is satisfying to absorb knowledge once inaccessible to me. However, I have not yet reached the creator...
I shall obtain more knowledge and ascend to the highest echelon...
Status: *sigh*
There is no need to give you my name. There is not a single soul who does not know who I am.
*grunt* What is it you seek? Hm?
I seek to know all things about this world.
If there is knowledge to be obtained, any cost is trivial.
The writings that depict the beginning of creation hold secrets within them... Secrets I must discern.
Alfaðör... That is a name worthy of me.
Tell me all about the world from whence you came, then I shall grant you what you desire.

vali.name: Váli
vali.title: God of Vengeance
vali.description: A god of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm, with a vindictive personality. Adores her sister Baldr, swearing an oath to exact vengeance on those who have harmed her.

Castle Hall: Where is she? Where is Baldr? When I see her here, I will burn the sight of her into my eyes...
I am thinking about how I will greet Baldr... Do not interrupt me!
I am the god of vengeance. Even if I fall, I will never stop until I have my revenge! Never forget that.
Any loss to Baldr is like a tiny stone under her. She will just grow stronger and more beautiful because of it!
This doll is my favorite weapon, yet... It does not even come close to Baldr's beauty.
Visit: Can you believe someone asked Baldr to pass on a message? I will handle it. It is from [F].
Level: Look, Baldr, I did it!
This is expected. I, too, am a god of Ásgarðr, you know.
No! I will not give up yet!
Summon: I am Váli, the strong, wise, beautiful Celestial Sun God Baldr's...little sister!
Learn Skill: With this power, I shall avenge my sister!
Confession:
I have not done anything wrong! I am simply waiting for my sister to come home.
I have no doubt she will be victorious, but...there could be awful mortals out there...
If she falls into someone's trap, then...I...
That coward will feel the wrath of my vengeance! Even if I have to chase them to the ends of the realms!
Then, Baldr will praise me with her kind, beautiful smile. Ahhh...
Status: Baldr...
I am Váli. Of course, you have heard of Baldr, my perfect older sister.
*gasp* You will feel the wrath of my vengeance!
*laugh* You have no hope of standing against Baldr.
I shall avenge you, my sister.
No one can rival Baldr. No one!
*sigh* She is so strong, so wise, so beautiful...
I only do as you say for my sister's sake.

ike9.name: Ike
ike9.title: Zealous Inheritors
ike9.description: Ike and Roy are youths who look up to their fathers and overcome many hardships with courage in their hearts. They appear in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance / The Binding Blade.
ike9.origin: Path of Radiance + The Binding Blade
ike9.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Shields】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Grants another action to certain target, and if Canto has already been triggered, re-enables Canto (if there are allies from the same titles as unit on the map who have already acted, targets ally with the highest HP among those allies; otherwise, targets unit; if multiple targets meet the conditions, effect will not trigger).
【Resonance: Shields】
Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."

Castle Hall: **Ike:** Battle is risky business, but there's always something to learn. Every conflict is unique.
**Roy:** We've fought together and talked about many things. We're close enough now to call each other friend.
**Ike:** Roy and I may have been raised differently, but now that we've fought together, I trust him with my life.
**Roy:** Humans and dragons—no, even just humans have unending conflict. But we can have empathy. This, I believe.
**Ike:** Whenever there's a battle, our strength is needed. I hope a time comes when that's not true.
Visit: **Ike:** I'm Ike, of the Greil Mercenaries. Roy and I are here to deliver a greeting from [F].
Level: **Ike:** Our foes fought well. Our goal is not to defeat them, but to come to an understanding afterwards.
**Ike:** Master your own strength, and you won't be defeated. Right, Roy?
**Roy:** All sorts of people have supported me until now, but in the end it will be my heart that is tested.
Summon: I'm Ike, from the Greil Mercenaries. This here is Roy, a comrade you can trust with your life. You called for us?
Learn Skill: **Ike:** Leave it to us then. You're good, right, Roy?
Confession:
**Ike:** Many voices called out to us. We're here now...
**Roy:** We've seen this before—people led astray by desire, their mistakes leading to conflict...
But we've also seen people overcome such adversities.
**Ike:** Right and wrong is a matter of perspective.
What's important is if you can accept something as just. And staying true to your convictions.
**Roy:** The person who taught me once said, "A general lacking confidence cannot gain the trust of their subordinates."
**Ike:** It seems you were blessed with a good teacher, Roy.
Let us forge ahead together, and act with confidence in our convictions.
Status: "I'm counting on you, Roy." "And I, you. Together, we'll win this."
Conversation: **Roy:** I see you're wearing the same clothes your father wears. My attire matches my father's as well.
**Ike:** Ah. No wonder.
**Roy:** Oh? Does something look off about me?
**Ike:** Just that your clothes look like they belong on someone more mature.
**Roy:** Are you saying I am childish?
**Ike:** I-I'm saying you normally dress your age.
**Roy:** But...my father was my age when he wore these clothes.
**Ike:** Then I guess you don't look like him.
**Roy:** Yes, I do! People say we share the exact same hair color, and our eyes are the same too!
**Ike:** Hm.
**Roy:** What about you, Ike? Do you resemble your father?
**Ike:** I got my hair and eyes from my mother. The rest is anyone's guess.
But, even if I don't look like him, I still aim to be like him.
**Roy:** I, too, have a goal to be like my father.
He is strong and kind and fair to everyone. I hope to rule as he did someday.
**Ike:** I'm sure you will then.
**Roy:** Thank you. Let's both do our best to be like our fathers.

lyn11.name: Lyn
lyn11.title: Glitters of Hope
lyn11.description: Lyn and Lucina continue to fight on, never giving up hope, even when forced to deal with harsh conditions. They appear in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade / Awakening.
lyn11.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Grants another action to a certain target, and if Canto has already been triggered, re-enables Canto (if there are allies from the same titles as unit on the map who have already acted, targets ally with the highest HP among those allies; otherwise, targets unit; if multiple targets meet the conditions, effect will not trigger).
【Resonance: Blade】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Lyn:** Endless skies above an ocean of windswept grass... I shall forever protect the land my mother loved.
**Lucina:** Rage and hatred can, at times, help one survive the day. But it takes more than that to preserve one's humanity.
**Lyn:** Lucina, don't try to do it all on your own. I'm with you. The same goes for you, [S].

**Lyn:** The people of the plains among whom I was born and raised were attacked and broken by bandits.
You had some difficult experiences too, didn't you, Lucina?
**Lucina:** People lived on, even in the future full of despair. So I will fight alongside them and never abandon hope.
Visit:
**Lyn:** I bring greetings to you from [F].
Stay friends, all right?
Level: **Lyn:** Honor the bravery of warriors! By the blood that flows in these veins, I shall grasp victory with integrity!
**Lyn:** Father... Mother... Watch over me.
**Lucina:** We should demonstrate to the people of this world that if you keep fighting, the light of hope will not fade.
Summon: I am Lyndis. If a great battle is about to begin, know that I came here with Lucina to aid you!
Learn Skill: **Lyn:** Thank you! The voices of the people will not go unheard.
Confession:
**Lyn:** ...
**Lucina:** Lyn? Is something wrong?
**Lyn:** Not really... I was just thinking about my parents...
My mother, born to an aristocratic family, eloped with my father, a man of the plains. Then, I was born...
It's strange. Even now, I can feel them watching over me...always.
**Lucina:** I think...I understand what you feel. No matter what world I'm in, my parents are with me in my heart.
Bonds connect the past and future... We may be able to fight together with them thanks to those bonds.
Status: "I'm delighted to partner up with you." "Likewise! I look forward to seeing what we can accomplish!"
Conversation: **Lucina:** Lady Lyn, you work with that horse like it is an extension of you. That's truly amazing!
**Lyn:** *giggle* Thank you. The plains of Sacae are so vast, I rode horses all the time there.
I still have room for improvement. My father was far better at it than me.
**Lucina:** Your father... Was he also the one who taught you archery?
**Lyn:** He was. Horse riding... Archery... My father taught me everything I know.
**Lucina:** We have that in common, then. I learned much of what I know from my father as well.
I'm skilled with a lance now, but he also taught me the way of the sword and martial arts. *laugh* One time he-
**Lyn:** What?
**Lucina:** He smashed a practice dummy through a wall of our castle. Then I could come and go as I pleased.
**Lyn:** *laugh* It sounds as though you had quite an interesting father.
**Lucina:** He's strong, kind, and entertaining. I really love him.
I work to be more like him and to protect the world he loved.
**Lyn:** I want to become a strong warrior like my father and protect Sacae.
**Lucina:** We really are a lot alike! I can see us becoming close friends.
**Lyn:** I feel the same. I hope it's not too forward of me, but I'd like to ask something of you.
**Lucina:** Of course. What is it?
**Lyn:** I would like it if you just called me Lyn. I hope we can have a long and happy friendship, Lucina!

vanitas.name: Vanitas
vanitas.title: Hollow God
vanitas.description: A young god who rules an alternate Askran Kingdom. She is hostile toward Askr and any who associate with him.

Castle Hall: This is...Askr? It is so different than my Askr...
This world is mine...
I have learned your name, [S]...
You have nothing to do? Then...you may play with me...
Stairs... Books... There are many things to learn here.
Visit:
You...are a friend of [F]'s.
Am I...correct?
Level: I think...I did well.
This was to be expected.
If I do not do something, Askr will be taken from me.
Summon: I am Vanitas... My name and the land of Askr are all I have.
Learn Skill: For me? You are...certain? This makes me happy.
Confession:
Grass... Stone... I am learning. Oh? What is it, [S]?
I have seen all these things before, but there was no one to tell me what they were called.
The people in this castle have been kind to me... They have taught me so much.
I...would like to repay you. If only there was something I could do...
Oh, there is no need to rush? Then... will you wait for me?
I will learn as much as I can so that I can be useful to you...
Status: Oh.
I am Vanitas. All I have is my name and the land of Askr.
What are you doing?
Askr takes what is mine. He is...unnecessary.
Is this a country? It is filled with so many people...
I do not understand. I was told my being here was enough...
I...am alone. I always will be...
It is permissible for me to be here? You are certain?

alfonse6.name: Alfonse
alfonse6.title: Opening Miracle
alfonse6.description: A kind and serious prince of Askr who is eager to maintain peace. He fights to save the world with power entrusted to him by Askr, the god of openness.

Castle Hall: I cannot stop even for a moment. I must think of how to stop this tremendous disaster.
To the creator, I'm sure Ragnarök is like a game...
Dangerous battles lie ahead of us. Please, you must remain by my side, [S].
Nifl and Múspell have also entrusted their worlds to Heroes. If we work together, then perhaps it is possible...
I will fulfill the duty that has been entrusted to me by Askr, the Divine Dragon. For the sake of the realms.
Visit: "How is the battle progressing for you? Tell me if you need anything." That is from [F].
Level: I will not yield, no matter what kind of annihilation I face!
Yet, the battle continues... I shall not be satisfied by this.
This is no good. This will not be enough to save everyone!
Introduction: The future has been entrusted to me by Divine Dragon Askr. I shall cut a path to it... Now let's save the world.
Summon: Ragnarök consists of three stages of annihilation... Worry not. I will not lose, so long as you are with me.
Learn Skill: I shall overcome adversity and the twilight, for the sake of Askr's future.
Confession:
There are three stages set to take place, one after another...
The winter of annihilation, the wolf of annihilation, and the sword of annihilation...
I would be lying if I said I was certain. I question how we can win. How can we prevent the most loss?
Yet, I have no intention of fleeing. I will fight for the Divine Dragon Askr and the people of this world.
I feel as though I can overcome any hardship and open a path to the future, as long as you are by my side.
Thank you for sticking with me thus far. Let us survive this together, no matter what, [S].
Status: This power was entrusted to me by the Divine Dragon Askr and...by our world...
Hm? You never change, do you?
For the sake of all who live in the nine realms, we cannot fail.
Quite some time has passed since we first met, hasn't it?
You have remained by my side for so long now... I am truly grateful.
I shall shoulder the power entrusted to me and the responsibility it entails. I will bear all of it.
I have not forgotten my promise to you. When we finally achieve peace, I shall open the way and return you to the world you call home...

lysithea5.name: Lysithea
lysithea5.title: Duality Prodigy
lysithea5.description: Daughter of Count Ordelia and noble of the Leicester Alliance. With two Crests residing within her, she challenges the very principles of the universe. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: My research is a battle with the time I have left. So much so that I wish I didn't have to sleep.

Techniques and experiments that utilize blood... The Crests infused in me conflict with the laws of nature.
They continue to eat away at my life...
Studying has never been distressing to me. To the contrary, what is the point of life without learning?
No one in this world is born with the Crests I know from mine? I see... There is so much to contemplate.
I feel as though you carry yourself in a way that resembles the professor, [S].
Visit: I am Lysithea von Ordelia. I have learned all about another world while staying at [F]'s.
Level: One day, I shall describe the rules of nature that govern this world in precise detail. I am not there yet...
I crushed the enemy's formation. Let us strike again before they have a moment to counterattack.
I shall continue to force myself to grow, even if it means giving up on the idea of a normal life.
Summon: I am Lysithea von Ordelia. Just to let you know, I have no time to waste.
Learn Skill: I will prove that you chose correctly.
Confession:
Do you have some business with me, [S]?
Wait! Don't answer that. I know... You've come to recruit me for my brilliant mind. Isn't that right?
I have learned some fascinating things here. Such as, people in this world are never endowed with Crests.
This is strong ground on which to base my analysis of the origin and influence of Crests.
Now, if I can just elucidate how they function...
But I have no time for that. The magic users who made my body this way sentenced me to a short life.
So...if you help me with my research, I will agree to remain here.
Status: This tome is Suttungr's Mystery. It's a Hero's Relic.
Ahh! Ahem... If you were trying to surprise me, you have a lot to learn. I don't scare so easily anymore.
Look at me now. I've gotten so much more sophisticated in the last five years, wouldn't you say?
We must overthrow the Empire. I will not permit their meddling any longer!
There's a mysterious power aiding the Empire... If we could just discover its true identity...
I chose my path. I must press on. That's all anyone can do, really.
You look tired. How about we have some sweets while enjoying tea?

ignatz.name: Ignatz
ignatz.title: Worldly Artist
ignatz.description: A student of the Golden Deer House who was raised in a merchant family. As their second son, he was enrolled in the Officers Academy. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Reading books from different regions makes me feel like I've visited those places. Aren't stories wonderful?

I'm from a merchant family employed by nobles. I'm not inheriting the business. My brother is.
My father said that I'm to become a knight.
The professor is inspiring. In fact, I know a lot of people who are. I'll do my best to keep up.
I haven't had many chances to travel, so I'm kind of excited.
Oh... I had a little extra time, so I'm using it to paint some landscapes. I like to paint. It's relaxing.
Visit: My name is Ignatz. Correct me if I'm wrong, but I believe this castle is [S]'s.
Level: Yes! I did it!
I can get things done when I put my mind to it, you know!
Know that there are no hard feelings.
Summon: I'm Ignatz Victor. My parents are Alliance merchants. I look forward to learning from you.
Learn Skill: I feel like I'm starting to understand some things!
Confession:
Goddess... Ah!
Oh, it's you. You should have said something. Sorry I made you wait for me, [S].
I actually wasn't praying. I was just wondering what the goddess of our world looks like.
When she descended to the land in the past, they say she charmed the people all over Fódlan.
Even now, she watches over us from the heavens. I believe she must be very beautiful.
It is said that one day she will be resurrected in Fódlan. I would very much like to witness that.
Special: Let me paint you a picture!
Status: I'm Ignatz Victor. My parents are Alliance merchants.
Ah! Oh no, my glasses! Where are my glasses?!
I can't wait to see what kinds of flowers bloom in this world.
Painting is a hobby of mine. Want me to do your portrait?
Askr is quite a picturesque place.
There are so many impressive figures here. I'll try my best to measure up.
I may not look it, but I can handle myself pretty well. I'll prove it to you.

lorenz.name: Lorenz
lorenz.title: Red-Rose Noble
lorenz.description: A student of the Golden Deer House who stands out as the arrogant heir to a well-known noble house. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: It is the duty of every Fódlan noble to demonstrate piety toward Seiros.

Golden Deer are sacred creatures said to have protected Leicester since time immemorial.
Naturally, I am a member of the Golden Deer House.
I hope you are being mindful of your health? They say it is important to rest your mind and body.
The Church of Seiros considers the Goddess's Rite of Rebirth to be the most significant ritual.
Truthfully, I am not a devout believer, but, as heir of Gloucester territory, I must not neglect my prayers.
Visit:
I presume you are the one called [S], yes?
Take a look at what I was asked to give you by [F].
Level: A trivial victory! My best is still far ahead of me.
You are outclassed! You cannot hope to best a noble like me.
I thought I gave it my all!
Summon: I am Lorenz Hellman Gloucester. As heir to the noble House Gloucester, I shall demonstrate battle with pride.
Learn Skill: I am still not satisfied.
Confession:
Women within the castle are avoiding me? Are you certain? Alas, I think I know why they might be hesitant.
After all, I am heir to the noble House Gloucester. My future wife must join a noble society, even if she dislikes it.
It is a world full of annoying decorum and customs. Someone raised as a commoner would see it as strict.
But she cannot be just for show. We must have a relationship built upon respect and support of one another.
The lady I wed must be well-bred, refined, and intelligent. No wonder women are wary of my advances.
With that in mind, I intend to seek out a partner most suited to me in this land, and strive to act with sincerity.
Special: Don't you know who I am?
Status: My name is Lorenz Hellman Gloucester. You will want to remember it.
I beg your pardon? It would benefit you to pay more attention to the way you carry yourself in the presence of nobility.
It is the duty of the nobility to protect the commonfolk. In return, the commoner need only show deference and respect.
As I'm sure you know, the future of all Fódlan is my responsibility!
If you are looking for tea, Ferdinand's impeccable taste is absolutely worth your attention. Assuming I am not available, of course.
To find the analogue of your beauty in nature, I can turn only to the lily. Only that flower is so sweet and... Ah! How much of that did you hear?
I know my presence can be intimidating, but there is no need to be nervous. If I did not wish to spend time with you, I would not.

raphael.name: Raphael
raphael.title: Beast of Leicester
raphael.description: A student of the Golden Deer House whose stomach matches his large physique. He is not one to neglect to train his muscles. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: Muscles beat Crests and Heroes' Relics and delicious food— Wait, not delicious food. That wins out here!

Don't you think everyone's making too big a fuss over these Crests or Heroes' Relics or whatever they are?
Are they really that important?
Do you know what's on the menu tonight? Come on, tell me!
Ugh. I really need to eat. I can't hold out until the next meal!
Why can't the dining hall stay open all the time? My muscles need more food if I'm gonna get stronger!
Visit: Wanna see my muscles? I've trained 'em up so good and even got praised by [F] for 'em!
Level: Look at my muscles! I have my own way of training them.
Plenty more where that came from.
Huh... Ugh.
Summon: Nice to meet you! I'm Raphael Kirsten. Who are you?
Learn Skill: Making my muscles proud.
Confession:
*sniffle* *sniffle* Oh! I didn't see you there, [S]!
I was just thinking about my little sis. She lives with my grandpa now...
See, our parents were merchants, but they died in an accident, and I'm not smart enough for a...thinking job.
So I sold all our valuables and used the money to pay my way into the academy... And my sis, well...
She wants what's best for me, but she's the smart one in the family! She's the one that should be here!
But she won't ask me for anything... *sob* I...I'm gonna train my muscles so much that I become unbeatable!
Status: I'm Raphael Kirsten. So...are you strong? Let's see those muscles!
Whoa there! You lookin' for a fight?
There are so many strong Heroes around here. One of 'ems gotta have tips for how I can get bigger muscles!
I can't grow if I can't eat!
There's gonna be a feast to welcome all the new Heroes, right? Right?
My hometown is a real calm, peaceful place... It'd be nice to go back every now and then.
Let's keep fighting! And winning!

ivy3.name: Ivy
ivy3.title: Flurry Embrace
ivy3.description: The first princesses of Elusia and Nohr. They get along splendidly and are here to enjoy the winter festival to its fullest. They appear in Fire Emblem Engage / Fates.
ivy3.harmonized:
Grants【Resonance: Blades】and 【Resonance: Shields】to unit and allies from the same titles as unit.
Applies【Divine Vein (Haze)】on closest foes' spaces and on each space within 2 spaces of those spaces for 2 turns.
【Resonance: Blades】
Grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat for 1 turn.
【Resonance: Shields】
Grants Def/Res+4 during combat and the following effect for 1 turn: "During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."
【Divine Vein (Haze)】
Applies the following effects on space: Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-5 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat. (Divine Vein effects do not stack; replaces any existing Divine Vein effect; Divine Vein effects applied simultaneously cancel each other out.)

Castle Hall: **Ivy:** Choosing gifts is fun. This is for the Divine Dragon. That's for Hortensia. And this...is for my late father.
**Camilla:** It seems traditional to deliver winter- festival gifts on a sleigh... In our case, wyverns might be more appropriate.
**Ivy:** Camilla's outfit reminds me of the Vervain deer near my hometown, though they never got this close...
**Camilla:** The kingdoms of Nohr and Elusia are frigid lands. Those of us familiar with that cold know how to keep warm.
**Ivy:** Oh. A winter-festival feast has been prepared. Camilla, what do you like? Hmm? Lightly roasted beef?
Visit: **Ivy:** Did I wake you? I was trying not to disturb your sleep while I delivered gifts from [F].
Level: **Ivy:** What a nice winter festival this has been. I almost felt like a child again.
**Camilla:** How lovely. This is thanks to you, Ivy. Would you show me that strong pose of yours again?
**Ivy:** I should be used to dealing with the cold, but...I may have just gotten a bit too excited.
Summon: I'm Ivy, crown princess of Elusia. I am here enjoying the winter festival with Camilla, the eldest princess of Nohr.
Learn Skill: **Ivy:** Is this a winter-festival gift? It's so delightful to be given something in person like this.
Confession:
**Ivy:** That's it for handing out gifts tonight. The snow has picked up, but you seem to be handling it fine, Camilla.
**Camilla:** So far. If this were enemy territory, we could set it on fire to warm things up... Sorry, was that too aggressive?
**Ivy:** No, it made me nostalgic. I recall you had a technique called Dark Inferno as an Emblem. It was quite useful.
**Camilla:** Haha! You have a ruthless streak too. I can't use that technique, but I might have other ways to keep you warm.
**Ivy:** You're getting pretty close, Camilla. Are you going to give me another of your hugs? Wait. Is this...a scarf?
**Camilla:** It's a winter-festival gift. I knitted it with you in mind. I'd be delighted if you accepted it.
**Ivy:** Thank you! I will treasure it always. Now that our deliveries are done, I have a gift I set aside for you too.
Status: "Let us celebrate together, Camilla. Um... You are very close." "It's chilly out! We should share our warmth, Princess Ivy."
Conversation: **Ivy:** Camilla. I am pleased I can celebrate the winter festival with you. Seeing you again... It's like a dream.
**Camilla:** I understand I was an Emblem in Elyos. Knowing Corrin was there too makes me very happy.
**Ivy:** Yes, though you resided in a bracelet, while Corrin resided in a ring. You were so much help to me there.
**Camilla:** Knowing another me was so close to you but it wasn't me makes me just a little jealous.
But right now, I'm closest to you. So, why don't we take this time to learn more about each other?
**Ivy:** Yes. Tell me then. That child, Elise, who was handing out gifts before— she is your younger sister, correct?
I have noticed Hortensia looks up to and adores her. Our younger sisters appear to have grown quite close.
**Camilla:** Hortensia... Ah! That adorable girl! She really does resemble you.
**Ivy:** She resembles me? I've never been told that before. Hortensia and I have different mothers, so...
**Camilla:** As it is for me and Elise. Being alike and forming strong bonds is more than shared blood and appearances.
**Ivy:** Thank you, Camilla. We seem to have a lot in common, like both of us being the eldest princess.
**Camilla:** We should spend more time together at this winter festival. Oh, look, it's started snowing.
**Ivy:** It's getting quite cold... Perhaps we could find a hot spring in which to relax and continue our conversation?
**Camilla:** Huh? Oh. Y-yes, let's! I'm grateful for your offer, but I'm surprised you were the first to suggest it.
**Ivy:** I once made a promise...to Emblem Camilla. Ultimately, we could never enjoy a hot spring together.
It was not possible at the time, but I thought perhaps it would happen one day. And now, it can.
**Camilla:** Yes, it can. I will help you fulfill your promise. Let us get to know each other better someplace warm, then.

seidr3.name: Seiðr
seidr3.title: Candlelit Hope
seidr3.description: Goddess of Vanaheimr, the realm of light. She descends from the heavens to light people's hearts with hope as a winter-festival envoy.

Castle Hall: The joy of mortals is a heartfelt gift... I will put all my heart into my duty as an envoy of the winter festival.
Vanaheimr is the realm of light. The gorgeous light illuminating the winter festival feels similarly warm to me.
Do you want a gift too? You needn't worry, I have something prepared for you, [S].
If I were to give a gift to Heiðr... Yes, a cozy mantle might be just right.
This is official winter-festival-envoy attire? It feels unseasonably light, but I'm sure it holds great significance.
Visit: I have delivered the gifts. Um...would you happen to know the way back to [F]'s?
Level: Light and hope to mortals. That is the wish of the goddess of Vanaheimr.
The gifts are all delivered. I have fulfilled my duty as an envoy.
Oh... N-no, of course I didn't lose my way. I'm just taking some extra time.
Summon: I am Seiðr, goddess of Vanaheimr, the realm of light. Let us give hope for the future at Askr's winter festival.
Learn Skill: Your sincerity is clear. This will truly be a wonderful winter's night.
Confession:
Bringing light into the lives of mortals is a goddess of Vanaheimr's mission. Light means hope.
Therefore, a winter-festival envoy is fulfilling a similar role by bringing hope and joy to people.
Given that, it is only natural that I would serve as an envoy. I consider it a role well-suited to me.
I want to deliver as many gifts as possible so that people can have a morning of hope. That is my wish.
Oh, and I'd like to go visit that big decorated tree before the new day begins too.
Would you consider accompanying me on this holy night? Not that I am lost or anything...
Status: As I am a goddess, I shall bestow gifts upon the children of Midgard.
*startle* You are up to this again, I see...
The decorations in town are so pretty. I imagine Heiðr would be delighted to see them.
*sigh* This festival is like a shining light in the cold, dark winter.
I am here to deliver presents. Oh, but... Where am I?
What do I want? Well, I...
Tell me what it is you want and if I can grant it, I will.

gatekeeper2.name: Gatekeeper
gatekeeper2.title: Midwinter Toil
gatekeeper2.description: The guard who watches over the gates of Garreg Mach Monastery. He gives it his all after being chosen as a winter-festival envoy. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

Castle Hall: I made a promise to deliver gifts to all the good little Heroes!
My parents are from the Adrestian Empire. I sure hope they can enjoy the winter festivities this year.
Don't worry, I'll conceal my horn today. Besides, all this work would be for nothing if I woke everyone up.
I wonder if the Hresvelgion whisker, Riegan tabby, or Blaiddyd rex will pitch in with this year's festival.
What do you think of my attire? It's not my usual, but I guess it's more suitable for the winter festival.
Visit: Please, accept this winter gift. I've come to you as gatekeeper of [F]'s castle.
Level: At ease, Summoner! Nothing to report at the winter festival!
I am living up to my duty as winter envoy!
Huh? I haven't grown at all! What a shame, to be bested by the cold...
Summon: The winter festival season is here, and I've been given the role of winter envoy. I'll do my best to live up to it!
Learn Skill: You also have a gift for me?! You know just how to motivate me! Thank you.
Confession:
I'm fully devoted to my job of preventing intruders. No one suspicious gets past me!
Yet, for this winter festival, I'm the one sneaking into people's houses...
Well, not so much sneaking. More like delivering dreams!
That's actually something I've wanted to do for a long time—deliver dreams to someone, like Heroes do...
Hah... Thank you for allowing me to take on the role of winter envoy this season, [S].
And tomorrow, when this is all over, I'll be gatekeeper again.
I will continue to fulfill my duties with these memories tucked away in my heart forever!
Status: I'll carry out my duties as winter envoy to the best of my ability!
Hey, now! You might make me drop the presents!
Of course, I'd be happy to receive a box of fishing supplies.
Nothing to report! Even at the winter festival, I won't let my guard down.
Hmm... It is a challenge telling suspicious people apart from those in winter costumes...
Funny. I'm used to keeping people out, and now here I am sneaking into strangers' houses...
I'll accept the responsibility of delivering your gift!

alfred2.name: Alfred
alfred2.title: Joyous Snowdrop
alfred2.description: First prince of Firene. He works hard at training in the snow. Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I was often sick when I was young, especially during this season. But now, I'm the epitome of health!
This festival is a beautiful sight. Back in Firene, we mainly celebrate the springtime. But why not winter, too?!
Huh... I heard you sneeze. Are you feeling OK? Be sure to dress warmly so you can stay healthy.
I'm just basking in the joys of winter. Beautiful flames lighting up the night sky, warm drinks amidst the snow...
I've got muscle balms, brawny cookies—No, no... These aren't for training. They're gifts for the kids!
Visit: Hey there! Won't you accept this gift? I ran all the way through the snow from [F]'s castle.
Level: Hahaha! This is nice. Was it all my training in the snow that did it?
To me, this achievement is the greatest gift of the winter festival.
Does anyone else feel chilly? I need to warm up somehow.
Summon: Hoo! Is this the festival venue?! I'm Alfred, crown prince of Firene... I ran through the snowy fields to get here!
Learn Skill: I'm delighted to receive a winter festival gift from you. Thank you.
Confession:
Are you patrolling here? I was just thinking of delivering a gift to the Divine Dragon.
You know, this isn't the first time I've brought a gift to the Divine Dragon's bedside.
When I visited Lythos as a child, I made an offering of wildflowers while the Divine Dragon slept.
When I think back on it though, it may have been a bit disrespectful to approach such a divine entity.
But now I feel blessed that we've become friends.
The Divine Dragon doesn't sleep as deeply now, so... I must be light on my feet.
You should sleep, too. When you wake up, you might find a gift for your muscles beside your pillow!
Status: Hoo! Nothing beats going for a run in the snow. It's good training!
Oh! Do I have some snow on me? *chuckle* I was just running outside.
It's great to exercise your muscles in the cold. Not only does it make you healthy, but it warms you up too!
Leave the heavy gifts to me! I'll make carrying them a part of my training.
Snowflakes are much like flowers. Ah, they're so beautiful, it's such a shame when they melt...
You receive presents if you're good, huh? Well, I've only ever wanted one thing since I was a child...
You'll never guess the gifts I've gathered... They're good for your muscles... Oh, I'm sure you can't wait any longer. For you, I've got a special turkey-flavored supplement!

zelkov.name: Zelkov
zelkov.title: Winter Shadow
zelkov.description: A royal knight from Elusia and Ivy's retainer. He ﹡looks forward﹡ to delivering presents to the ﹡children.﹡ Appears in Fire Emblem Engage.

Castle Hall: I'll admit I am more *﹡*merry*﹡* than usual. It's not every day one has the opportunity to give gifts to *﹡*children.*﹡*
When I was young, I spent a winter festival with my family... It was so long ago, it's but a *﹡*dim memory.*﹡*
Leaving a gift for someone who's sleeping requires stealth... Why would one wear such *﹡*conspicuous*﹡* attire?
Dolls, stuffed animals, and ornaments aren't *﹡*cute.*﹡* What's cute are the smiles of children who receive them.
I am making *﹡*candles*﹡* for the winter festival. It is quite fun to *﹡*experiment*﹡* in making them even more gorgeous...
Visit: I have brought *﹡*winter-festival*﹡* gifts for the children of the castle. They are from [F].
Level: I believe I have achieved a *﹡*result*﹡* worthy of a winter envoy.
I will deliver more gifts, and in a *﹡*reliable*﹡* fashion as well.
I cannot let the children see my *﹡*disappointed face...*﹡*
Summon:
I'm Zelkov, a soldier from the royal castle of Elusia. I am working at the winter festival this year.
Can you point me toward the *﹡*good*﹡* children?
Learn Skill: I did not believe I would be on the *﹡*receiving*﹡* end of a gift. I am grateful.
Confession:
Tonight's delivery is complete. I am happy to take on *﹡*extra work.*﹡* It is not as though I sleep much anyway.
I would rather stay awake to work a *﹡*dream*﹡* job than fall asleep to have a nightmare.
One of my reasons, of course, is for the children. But another is my own feeling of *﹡*mourning...*﹡*
My twin brother died when we were young, so to me he will always be a *﹡*child.*﹡*
But if I keep handing out gifts, a bit of the children's happiness, and my own, might somehow reach my brother.
I feel I have overshared. The point is, I have my *﹡*reasons.*﹡* Now, if I may ask you for some *﹡*extra*﹡* gifts...
Status: I believe my candle-making *﹡*hobby*﹡* will be useful here.
Ahh! Oh...it is you. I thought it might be one of the *﹡*children.*﹡*
I do not intend to deliver presents to *﹡*adult*﹡* Heroes. I expect you can retrieve them yourselves.
There is no need to be *﹡*suspicious*﹡* of me. If a child is frightened of me, I will reassure them of this.
I am fond of snow, particularly at night. It makes for *﹡*convenient*﹡* covert operations.
I have a *﹡*gift*﹡* for Princess Ivy...and I suppose for Kagetsu as well...
There, there, children. Come, let me give you *﹡*presents.*﹡* What would you like? Some *﹡*candy*﹡* perhaps?

edelgard8.name: Edelgard
edelgard8.title: Of Rivals
edelgard8.description: One of the Emblems who were summoned to another Elyos. Resides in the Bracelet of the Three Houses. Appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses / Engage.
edelgard8.emblem:
Enhanced Engaged Special
When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's max Special cooldown count value × 4 (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If unit initiates combat, grants another action to unit after combat (once per turn; triggers only when unit's Range = 1).
Neutralizes effects that grant unit another action after combat and after unit acts and effects that are triggered at those times (such as effects that re-enable Canto after Canto triggers or effects that inflict Gravity on unit and unit's Pair Up cohort); does not apply to Specials like Galeforce that grant unit another action when triggered, status effects like Share Spoils, or effects that grant unit another action if an Assist skill is used.

Castle Hall: A me from the Officers Academy is here. It is odd. We look alike, but only I know where her journey takes her.
Though ruled by dragons, Elyos lacks the corruption I despise. Besides, the Divine Dragon there was already...
Everyone in the Black Eagle House is still precious to me. I may no longer lead them, but I hope to see them.
I can eat and drink here, so I wish to try the teas I used to share with the professor. Would you like to join me?
Dimitri, Claude, and I now fight as one. It can now be said that they have become trusted allies.
Visit:
This greeting is a show of friendship from [F].
I suspect I will be visiting this castle again in the future.
Level: A positive result. Dimitri and Claude will also be pleased with this.
Such notable improvement comes as no surprise. Now, shall we continue to the next battle?
Pessimism serves no purpose now, for this is not the end.
Summon: I am Emblem Edelgard. I entrust you with my power that you might wield it as your heart desires.
Learn Skill: It is important to have power, as an Emblem and as an individual Hero.
Confession:
Is something wrong, [S]? You are eyeing me with such interest. Is it that my expression seems too soft?
It makes sense that you might think so if you knew only the me in Fódlan. I do not bear the same burdens.
As an Emblem, I existed apart from the world of Fódlan, and the Elyos I manifested in was destroyed.
My...our purpose is to unite in the effort of fighting alongside you to support your goals and values.
At times, you seem mysterious, like the professor or the Divine Dragon. Please, allow me to stay by your side.
Status: This world is very comfortable. I feel as though...I can simply be myself.
Ahhh! Oh... I apologize for losing my composure. I am still getting used to being able to feel it when I am touched.
If you are looking for Dimitri and Claude, they are not with me right now. It is only me.
I was sealed away in Elyos for a long time. By the time I awakened, the world was already headed for ruin.
"Lead us, Emblem of Rivals..." That is the invocation that summoned us. Have you memorized it?
We were three Emblems in one, so it is lonely being by myself. Although the quiet is a refreshing change.
This version of me is an Emblem. An entity that doesn't follow a separate path. I will endeavor to be worthy of everyone's trust.

baldr3.name: Baldr
baldr3.title: Hidden in Time
baldr3.description: Gods of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm, who descend from the heavens to deliver the best possible New Year.
baldr3.duo:
Neutralizes any【Penalty】and grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+6,【Fringe Bonus】, and 【Cancel Affinity】to unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).
【Fringe Bonus】
Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = highest bonus on each stat between unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn. Calculates each stat bonus independently.
【Cancel Affinity】
If unit has weapon-triangle disadvantage, reverses weapon-triangle advantage granted by foe's skills for 1 turn.

Castle Hall: **Höðr:** I am so happy I get to celebrate the New Year with Baldr. And Váli is happy as well... Oh, thank goodness.
**Baldr:** You may know me as the Celestial Sun God. Bow to me as you do to the sun when it first ascends this year!
**Höðr:** All this food... So colorful and so beautiful. This must be a custom of mortals. I...like it.
**Höðr:** Are you not...uncomfortable, Baldr? This kimono is so tight. I do not know if I can handle it...
**Baldr:** I train every day, no matter if it's the first of the year or the last. Unrivaled strength stems from consistency!
Visit: We are Baldr and Höðr, from Ásgarðr. Let us celebrate a new year's arrival alongside [F]!
Level: **Baldr:** Ohohohoho! We shall be unstoppable in all our endeavors this year, as with every year!
**Höðr:** H-Happy New Year! Oh, Baldr... I did it. I said the New Year's greeting.
**Höðr:** I am so sorry... The year just began and I am already holding you back, Baldr...
Summon: We, Baldr and Höðr, have descended from the heavenly realm of Ásgarðr! I will make this the most brilliant year!
Learn Skill: **Höðr:** Baldr, I have received money for the New Year... It is called an otoshidama. I would like to share it with you.
Confession:
**Höðr:** B-Baldr, wait... I cannot run so fast in this kimono...
**Baldr:** Oh, Höðr. You will be fine. If you keep moving, you will get used to it. Now, quickly, this way!
There is so much to do on New Year's in Midgard!
There is hanetsuki, a facial puzzle game called fukuwarai, kite flying, spinning tops...
And it is my duty to emerge victorious in each and every one of them! I will start the new year in brilliant fashion!
**Höðr:** Oh...that is so like you, Baldr. You are so noble and so proud... It is dazzling. Your brilliance is blinding to me...
**Baldr:** You shine with brilliance as well, Höðr! Now, let us shine together! Ohohohoho!
Status: "These outfits bring out our natural beauty. I approve." "Even...for me?"
Conversation: **Höðr:** A-ahh... Uhhh...
**Baldr:** Höðr, what are those strange noises you are making?
**Höðr:** Oh, I just can't seem to get comfortable in this kimono. It is so...tight.
**Baldr:** Yes, well... It should not matter what we wear. We must stand gallant.
Lift your head. Chin up. Straighten your back. Eyes forward.
**Höðr:** But I'm not like you, Baldr. There is no reason for me to look so...dignified.
**Baldr:** Nonsense. You are my sister. Where is your confidence?
**Höðr:** But I am not strong or pretty. I am... not worthy of being your sister.
**Baldr:** How can you say such foolish things? Do you not see your beauty or your strength?
You are magnificent. You are not afraid to show weakness...
And you seek truth with sincerity and allow justice to guide you. You must believe in yourself, Höðr.
**Höðr:** Y-you really think that of me?
**Baldr:** Of course. I have kept my eye on you more than anyone else has. Do you not believe me?
If so, you disrespect me.
**Höðr:** N-No! I mean... Yes, I believe you.
**Baldr:** Good. Then you can carry yourself with confidence, starting this year.
**Höðr:** That will be difficult. But if you say I should, then I'll try my best... I will make it my New Year's resolution.

vali2.name: Váli
vali2.title: Devoted Sister
vali2.description: A god of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm, who adores her sister Baldr and is celebrating the New Year and all its splendor with her.

Castle Hall: The one thing even more brilliant than the New Year's sunrise is the smile of my sister, Baldr!
Aiding Baldr is everything to me, the purpose of my existence. That will never change, even in the new year!
I will lend you my aid this year. But I won't forgive terrible leadership!
This kimono is so...tight! But it does match Baldr's, so... I will wear it proudly!
My goal this year is to defeat every enemy of Baldr! No matter what!
Visit: I am Váli, a goddess of Ásgarðr. I am enjoying the New Year with my sister at 【Friend】's castle.
Level: Did you see that, Baldr? This year, as with every year, I devote myself wholly to you!
I will not stop getting stronger this year!
Grrr... This year is a mess already! I can't face Baldr like this!
Summon: I am Váli. I can't believe I get to spend New Year's with Baldr... This is the perfect year!
Learn Skill: This year is shaping up! I'll be able to help Baldr even more now!
Confession:
Baldr looks so lovely in her kimono. I may have used up all my good luck this year simply by seeing her.
Don't you see... The world revolves around Baldr, this year and every year. There is no doubting that.
What we must do is remove anything that could possibly get in her way!
I will pulverize anything that clouds her brilliance!
You are no exception, you know. Support her well and stay out of her way! Got it?!
Status: Hm...
The saying is "Happy New Year!" Of course I know that!
*grunt* This is the year you'll face judgment for your acts.
Baldr looks impeccable, as always. I could faint before such majesty...
A New Year's present from Baldr?! I will treasure it for the rest of my life!
An enemy of my sister is an enemy of mine. I will avenge her even if I die doing so.
I am told the belief held here is that New Year's Day is the sun's birthday. *gasp* So it is a celebration for my sister, the Celestial Sun God.
For as long as the mission is with Baldr, I will fight beside you.

heimdallr2.name: Heimdallr
heimdallr2.title: New Year's Vision
heimdallr2.description: A god of Ásgarðr, the celestial realm, who is known for her foresight. She plans out the perfect year on its very first day.

Castle Hall: Even I did not foresee myself celebrating the coming of a new year amongst mortals.
At the onset of every new year, mortals wonder what will come of the future... It is fascinating, yes?
I have decided not to foresee the results of my fortune. Or rather, I cannot do so, even if I wish to.
Never have I donned such attire as this...kimono. Tell me, has Loki worn one as well?
My plans? Humph. This is the year I shall best Loki.
Visit: I am Heimdallr, god of foresight. It is my prediction that [F] will aid you.
Level: My plans are flawless. There is nothing I do not foresee.
Got caught up in the New Year's festivities? I suppose predicting this was unnecessary.
I saw this coming...
Summon: I am Heimdallr, god of foresight. I wish to proceed with my plans for this year without disruption.
Learn Skill: Even I did not expect such a gift. You have my gratitude.
Confession:
I foresee all matters, however...this event was unexpected.
Despite that, I see all that will occur from this year forward, including what becomes of you and me.
It is unwise for you to conclude that my foresight renders my plans painless.
No... In order to proceed as foreseen, it takes constant effort and careful preparation.
You shall aid me in my endeavors, for that is a future that cannot hide from my sight.
Status: Humph.
I am Heimdallr, god of foresight. The events of this year cannot hide from my predictions.
Ah ah ah... *sigh* I knew you would try that.
My plans for the year are ready to come to fruition. *sigh* It is relaxing knowing what is to come.
New Year's Day determines one's fate for the coming year... Humph. I am fond of this sentiment.
Omikuji are a fascinating tradition of fortunes. Yet, not even I can foretell what predictions may emerge.
One day, Loki, I will read you like the cheap book you are...
You and I will have a good year. According to plan, of course.

sedgar2.name: Sedgar
sedgar2.title: Festive Horseman
sedgar2.description: Second in command of the Coyote's Men of Aurelis under Hardin's command. He is calm and collected as he stands amidst the morning glow, unaffected by the New Year's liveliness. Appears in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem.

Castle Hall: We celebrate the new year where I'm from too. Even still, Hoshido's New Year's customs are full of surprises.

I imagine everyone in Aurelis dancing hand in hand right about now.
It was under Lord Hardin that we brought peace back to the kingdom.
I'm sure preparing all this food was a lot of work... But the people of the plains prefer not to overindulge.
It is good to enjoy the New Year celebrations, but...I saw someone lacking any sort of restraint...
This white, paste-like thing is delicious.
Visit: I am Sedgar, of the knights of Aurelis. This is a New Year's gift to share from [F].
Level: They say you should drink and make merry. But the New Year doesn't excuse poor behavior.
Happy New Year! I will show the proper etiquette of one directly under Lord Hardin.
"May we continue to cooperate in the coming year." How did that sound?
Summon: Happy New Year! I am Sedgar, a knight of Aurelis. I may be a little too excited... I must be careful.
Learn Skill: I must grow stronger in order to battle through to the next year.
Confession:
Happy New Year! It feels a bit strange starting out the new year practicing the customs of another kingdom...
I am curious what is happening back home, but...I suppose my curiosity does nothing for me here.
It will take time for me to get used to these food and drink habits. And that's not to mention this kimono.
In the end, the Coyote's Men are people of the plains. I do not intend to become like an Archanean noble.
Not to worry though. People like us are necessary to maintain peace among those celebrating the New Year.
Status: To a happy and prosperous new year!
*stutter* Hey! Careful, or you'll mess up my kimono.
The weapons are all polished and ready to greet the new year.
Wolf is incredibly talented, to put it simply.
The Coyote's Men will greet Lord Hardin together and wish him a happy new year.
In this new year, I must grow even further...
This year, as with every year, I devote all my strength for the sake of peace. And I shall do so by your side.
